column10: I had given up pasta because my body doesn't like simple carbohydrates (sets up unpleasant cravings). This whole-wheat product works for me, though, and I appreciate the organic sourcing. Pasta makes easy meals, and I'm thrilled to have it back.

Besides the fact that it's good for you nutritionally, I like the fact that it tastes almost like 'white' pasta in texture. I never boil for as long as directed, they seem to be quite fragile.Smaller in size than I expected, but just right for in soups or chili!

Vegan. Organic. Kosher. Whole wheat. Great nutty flavor. Excellent for organic pasta salads. Spirals are a nice occasional "fun" change from penne.  Recyclable cardboard box. Also do really like Hodgson Mill Organic Whole Wheat Penne with Milled Flaxseed, 12-Ounce Units (Pack of 8). This review is out there for those for whom this makes a difference. See all of my reviews for more great choices. Check out "Vegan Grocery Favorites" and "Vegan Grocery Top Ten" in Listmania. Your "helpful" votes count and will be greatly appreciated to benefit the search of others. Thank you.

I'm a person who really never gives 5 stars... I guess I can't really say that now though!! These are truly amazing! I love this pasta. The taste, texture, ingredients -- everything about it is good! I would, and do suggest this pasta to anyone. It's the best.

column9: Great Value and Good For You Too!
column10: We loved the shape of these and love the extra fiber with the flaxseed in it! Great price too! Thanks, Amazon!

I have this on my "subscribe and save" list because it is, hands-down, my favorite pasta ever!  I try to eat healthy but it just doesn't work unless it tastes good.  and this stuff tastes fabulous.  I'm old enough to remember trying the "new" whole wheat pasta and lordy, was it bad!  All brands have certainly gotten better at it, but this is tasty, healthy, even has flax seed in it!  The spirals hold up well to boiling and holds a sauce well.  I'd give it 17 stars if they were available.

I've been buying Hogdson Mills products for many years, and I have yet to be disappointed.  The quality is excellent, as is the flavor.  If you're on a vegan diet, you should be eating whole grains, and of course organic helps.  This product combines both for a reasonable price.  There are less expensive whole-wheat organic products, but all that I've tried sacrifice quality.  I recommend Hodgson Mills products to those looking for whole-grain and/or organic products.
Just what I was looking for. Pasta that is good and good for you. The kids love it too.

This pasta is truly one of the best organic whole wheat pastas out there. It does not taste as heavy or fibery as the other brands... it comes as close to "white" pasta as you can get. I second the other reviewer who warns not to overcook it, as it easily falls apart.
My family really enjoyed The Gourmet Burgers. Try the onion poppyseed buns, and the smoky mustard with the burgers. Great Flavor!
I have ordered from Omaha Steaks for years and their products are always delicious! Find out for yourself!

Oh pasta, how I love thee in all your wonderful forms! But the toothy wonderful texture of bucatini and perciatelli is the most sublime of them all! This pasta is the opposite of Angel Hair pasta - it's a chewier, thicker version of Spaghetti and is wonderful with all kinds of strong sauces. We love Perciatelli with a garlic, chili, olive oil sauce with spicy Italian sausage or even sauteed boconcini. De Cecco brand pasta is wonderful quality too and very reasonably priced.

Delicious!  I can't say enough good things about this pasta.  I just love the texture.  It brings out a whole other side to sauces.  Great quality and taste.  I've made it a few times and every time it comes out perfectly al dente.  It's small tubes, so that gives it a great chewy mouth feel.  I can't find this at my grocery store here, so I'm grateful Amazon stocks it.

column9: Perciatelli Must Be Italian for Happiness
column10: I love Bucatini / Perciatelli Amatriciana and this pasta is the perfect ingredient. Cooks perfectly al dente and has a wonerful taste, five stars.

This pasta makes the most amazing dish. Since I was a little girl my mother made a dish every Christmas to go with the ham. Cooked Perciatelli mixed with tomato sauce, shredded cheddar chesse placed in a casserole dish, topped with buttered bread crumbs and baked until the chesse bubbles.....amazing!

It can be hard to find Perciatelli or Bucatini in any brand, let alone a good brand like DeCecco.  This DeCecco far exceeds most of what you will find on the shelf at the supermarket and is even better than many more expensive brands.  A must for an Amatriciana sauce.  The box says to cook it 12 minutes, but if you like it al dente, and especially if you are going to finish it in a pan with the sauce, start checking it at about 9 minutes to make sure you don't overcook it.
Came quickly. Was plentiful and delicious and cheaper than in the store. You will enjoy it if you like thick pasta.

If you know what bucatini is, then this is good bucatini pasta.If you are unfamiliar with bucatini, this is FAT spaghetti with a really thin needle sized hole through the strand of "spaghetti".  This isn't a good replacement for folks who just want to chow down on spaghetti. It can't be twirled with a fork.  It must be cut first -- you need some manners -- before it gets on the fork.  The pasta is just too sturdy and thick to "swirl".However, your diners will like this BETTER than spaghetti if they have the patience to cut the past before putting it on the fork.  It holds sauce well, feels substantial, and is just plain more interesting than spaghetti.I recommend for a change of pace from regular ol' spaghetti, but know your diners -- they might be confused that it can't be twirled(!

We cannot buy perciatelli where I live in Maryland, and this is my son's favorite type of pasta. It is delicious cooked al dente, the way our family likes it. When I ordered this item, the seller shipped it within a day and a half.  This is the fastest delivery I have ever seen.  What great customer service! Thank You!

I just want to know - How do they make these cute little tubes?  This will be an essential pasta for my pantry now.  First dish out of the box, I made Rachel Ray's Big Fat Spicy Sate Noodles over which I served Orange Scallion Sesame chicken. I was so pleased with the result. Her recipe called for this particular Italian perciatelli pasta which seemed strange since I was making an Asian spiced dish. But whatever. It was absolutely delicious. The bite of the noodle was chubby and somewhat chewy, not like al dente. but just perfectly chewy and dense. I highly recommend this product. I imagine this pasta noodle will be a good canvas for chunky Italian tomato sauces also.

This item is hard for me to find locally.  If I happen to come across it, it's very expensive.  Now I subscribe & save so there is always a fresh supply in my pantry. This is a "toothy" pasta which is the ultimate comfort food!  Kids love it too!  Thanks, Amazon.  I am one happy pasta lover!
Can't get this in any store in our town.This is the coolest pasta around.Love it,and as long as you have it?I'll keep buying it.

Used to buy this product in local store in Arizona, now in very rural area and greatly missed this pasta. Fantastic, holds together well, great with shrimp,olive oil, pepper flakes,fresh tomatoes and cheeses. Also hold thicker pasta sauces well and absorbes  into tiny tubes. Will definantely order again.
I used this pasta with a pesto sauce & it was excellent!  Tried it again with a beet and feta pasta - it held up beautifully.  Great product!

This is a brand and type of pasta that is very hard to find in the south. Was delighted to find it on Amazon. Used a pound of it last night and throughly enjoyed. Even shared 5 boxes with my son and his family. Will eventually buy it again.
My whole family loves this pasta that is hollow and slightly bigger around than regular spaghetti noodles. I cannot find it anywhere locally, so will continue getting it from Amazon.
Paradise it the perfect word for THIS coffee! Absolutely delicious coffee with a exquisite chocolate flavor. I will be purchasing this again, and often!
Love kona coffee. This product is great for pods, though somewhat watery, but still very good. Will probably buy more for my de longhi espresso machine!
Great flavor, a little high priced. I received this product on time and packaged to protect the contents. Great flavor for that relaxing moment.
These work well with the Senseo coffee maker.  It is a bit lacking in chocolate flavor but very smooth and hardy
I did not get the product I ordered.  Seems I can't return it!!! I guess someome I know will get a gift they might not need.

Now that this SNOWBIRD is back north I couldn't find it in any store here.  It is quick and easy to make in the microwave and I usually make enough to have some in the frig for a quick warm up.
finished the whole package fast once we got it from mail! glad it's already available at one store near here :)

One by one, every grocery store and big-box retailer in our metro area has stopped carrying liquiud sweeteners.  All they sell is powders.  I have no idea why they have made the decision to force us to use powders.  They are NOT the same, and we prefer the liquid.  So I was thrilled to find the liquid products for sale on Amazon.  Of course, 12 bottles may last awhile, but it won't spoil.  Free shipping was a real bonus.

I only use this stuff once a day (coffee), and I probably would fail a taste test vs. other brands.  This brand does the trick, and I prefer the liquid version vs. the silly packets, which are messy and seem wasteful on the face of it.  The liquid version has become quite difficult to find in stores in our area.

My family uses the Sweet N' Low Liquid.  We like it very much, not only because we are cutting out sugar, but also the convenience ofturning up a bottle for a few drops of sweetener instead of havingto open a package and wonder how much to put in our coffee!For convenience of ordering click on Amazon.com and go to Grocery.Gloria Wells
I have to be careful of what sweetener is used in products. I like to make my own iced tea and Sweet n Low is still the best for mixing!  It also does not start a migraine.

The title says it all.  This is a great way to sweeten your iced tea.  It's much more efficient than tearing open little pink packages.  You have to experiment to get the right amount though - enough to get just a hint of sweetness because too much gives it a bitter taste.  Sweetened this way the tea is pleasant but not cloying,  and I can put away over a gallon of it a day.

IT IS THE ONLY SWEETENER WE USE IN OUR COFFEE AND WE CAN'T GET IT HERE IN THE STORES. ANY STORE, SO I ORDER IT ON LINE FOR THE SAME PRICE. GETS HERE ON TIME AND READY TO BUY ANOTHER BOX. THANKS FOR THE FAST SERVICE. SWEET N LOW 8-OUNCE BOTTLE (PACK OF 12) BUD IN ALASKA

This is a great product that's not available in my local stores anymore. I much prefer it to the packets of Sweet N Low. It's much more precise on measurements. It came in the mail quickly and packaged well. I am very pleased!

Have used for years and like.  A few years ago local stores discontinued.  I found on Amazon.com at a reasonable price (around $25, I believe).  About 2 months ago, I decided to reorder.  At the time, you were out.  When you notified me it was available again, I was shocked that the price had more than doubled to $65, so I ordered a similar product for UNDER $20.  What's going on?Charles RopkePetaluma, CA

Hard to find in stores but a good price value sharing case purchase with family.

column9: Delighted to find this stuff on Amazon
column10: You can't get this stuff in stores anymore so I tried all the alternative sweeteners in my coffee.  I wasn't satisfied with any of them.  The little envelopes have too much sweetener so I throw half of it away and the individual packaging makes it more expensive needlessly.If this is the taste you are used to and find others distort the flavor of your beverage as I did, you'll be as delighted to find this product as I was.  Recent research says this artificial sweetener is not as unhealthy as others.  I was glad to learn that previous bad press has been proven incorrect.I would have been happy with a couple of bottles, but I'm definitely set for life now with 12!
My puppies look very healthy. I have had then on the Royal Canin Babydog since they were weaned and they love it.
I love this stuff, too bad they don't make it anymore. The have a "new" babydog formula but it's just not the same in my opinion. I bought up every last bag I could find of this stuff.

Until about a year ago my favorite whole-bean espresso was Green Mountain Organic.  They stopped selling that as beans so I searched for a replacement.  I wanted something low in caffeine and not expensive.  Eventually I learned that Lavazza is the best bargain around and found their Top Class blend to be a very good replacement.  Here are my impressions of some of the Lavazza whole-bean espressos:Pienaroma - high acid, low aroma, fruity, medium roast, mild, low caffeine.Super Crema - high acid, medium roast, mild, low caffeine.Grand Espresso - low acid, high aroma, medium roast, spicy finish, high caffeine.Top Class - moderate acid, aroma, and caffeine; medium/dark roast, spicy finish.
This one has lots of black pest. Too many live black pest, so things was irritating. Rice grain was good though if they can remove the black pest.

The Brewer's Yeast is for my cats. Every day I sprinkle a little onto their food. They like the taste of the yeast and regard it as a special treat. The yeast provides them with extra B vitamins.One of the vitamins in the yeast is vitamin B1, thiamine. Many people believe that thiamine repels fleas. This has not been proved. However, since the cats like the yeast, they get in on their food. One 18 ounce bottle seems to last forever. Also, they do not have fleas.

column9: Superior to other screen doors in quality, ease of installation, & price.
column10: Length:: 2:37 MinsBegins with a look of my door, with the screen installed.  Can barely see it, huh?  :)I share the width of my sliding glass door, how it's installed, how it's shipped, and a handful of hints + suggestions.  ...a few things I wished someone had (visually) shared prior to me purchasing it (just to clear up a few doubts I had).  In summary, I dig the product and would recommend it to my friends and family, especially after installing AND returning a screen door I purchased at my local hardware store (that actually cost MORE than the Bug Off screen door!).Hope you find my feedback helpful!- Chevassus Studios

We used our bug off, 60 x 80, all last spring and summer and intend to begin using it again this year.  It fits our double doors very well both side to side and height.  It is easy to go in and out and the snap closure works instantly.  Our dogs easily learned to go in and out so, if you need to keep a dog inside this wouldn't work for you (unless your dog is very well trained and can learn that he is not allowed to go through the screen).  The screen opens up our outdoors to us with plenty of filtered light and breeze.  would recommend it to anyone.

column9: OK, but does not close automatically. Needs to manually close.
column10: The screen set up is pretty easy. The sides of the screen need to use velcro stickers to adhere to the side frames. The top is secured by a hanging rod. Weight is sewn to the bottom to ensure it does not lift. The automatic "magnetic" door does not close automatically. The two screens overlap by a few inches. They depends on the magnetic pads to shut it closed. But the magnetic pads do not align easily and need to manually align them to get a proper seal. It is essentially a screen curtain.
Not necessarily heavy duty but seems like a good product.  Happy with it as it serves purpose of being able to leave the door open for a few minutes and keeping the bugs, etc out...

column9: Good, but not hands free in/out
column10: I have 60" french doors. Easy to install. No tools required. I did it alone. Keeps the mosquitoes and flies out like it is supposed to, and lets fresh air in. Negatives: You can't just walk though it. You will need to use your hands to open and close it. Also, my cats are dumb and it took them a while to figure it out (maybe that's a positive since it keeps them out side). Bottom line, I would recommend this, but you should know about the opening and closing issue.

column9: As advertised- fits and works great, super easy!
column10: I ordered this screen so I can keep my French doors open in the spring and fall without having tons of bugs get in the house.  It truly does install in minutes- just slide the screen onto the tension rod, open your doors and place the rod at the appropriate height for your doors.  The added velcro helps keep the sides in place.  I think that overall the magnets do a great job of keeping the opening closed, but it is a good idea to just make sure it closed properly after you go through the doorway.  No, it doesn't automatically close perfectly without help every single time, but come on people- it is a screen with magnets for less than a hundred bucks- you have to give it credit for doing the intended job so well even if it isn't perfect!For me, the length and width was perfect. I feel like the screen material looks nice and is of good quality, and the opening functions well enough for the purpose.  I think I paid a fair price for a good product that I am getting lots of use out of.  I would purchase this product again, or in different sizes for my other doors.

column4: Ben G. Martin "Just and average consumer"
column10: We needed a screen so desperately for our french doors because of the insane fly problem at the beach in the summer. We got a quote for $800 for a professional screen which was unheard of, so I decided to do some research and found this screen. Reluctant at first because it was priced so low I wasn't sure the quality would work for us. BUT! I was wrong! I LOVE this screen! It is of great quality and is very easy for my dog and 2 year old to get in and out. Most importantly my house is bug free. I would recommend this screen to anyone! Easy to install and to take up and down if needed! I am so happy with it!

I have three dogs and french doors that I love.  My dogs enjoy open access to their backyard thanks to these screens.  They have lasted a whole season with a family of four people and three dogs running in and out.  I was a little worried because my dogs scratch at the door when they want in and I was sure that they would destroy it before the end of the summer but the screens held up perfectly and will be up the minute we have our first 50 degree day.

I bought this screen to allow my cat to go in and out without letting all the bugs in. It does the job, though not perfectly. Without adding additional velcro, it does not fit tightly against the door edges so some bugs still get in - though many fewer than before. Also, my cat can pull it down as it is held in place at the top with a rod. The screen fits with most of my needs and I feel that it was a good purchase.

Pros1. Has weights to keep screen from blowing in or up.Cons1. Not impressed with its sturdiness.2. Puddles on floor as it is too long - looks unattractive3. Made in Mexico.4. Dark screen is easily seen though at night5. Held up by a puny tension rod my dog knocks down.6. Overpriced for what you getIn retrospect, I wish I had purchased Aluminet Reflective Shade (and folded/sewn top over a STURDY tension rod). It reflects heat and keeps out bugs.  Or paid more and used those screens that mount on side of door.  This Bug Off screen is not worth the cost.

The photo is highly misleading as it suggests that the screen opens down the middle. However, what I received has the opening off to one side (1/3 of the width of the screen).This does NOT work for my french doors....a middle opening would have been perfect. Because I don't live in the US and had the package shipped to the hotel where I was staying just for a few days, it's not feasible for me to return the item. I hate advertising tricks!!

This piri piri is the real deal.  No extraneous flavors and just the right thickness.I wouldn't call it very hot, but I certainly wouldn't want to chug a shot glass full and maybe that's just me.  Adds a nice bit of pure red pepper zip to everything from barbequed ribs to fried eggs.Joe

column9: How Could Healthy Taste So Good
column10: Organic and low sodium plus lots of flavor.  Put a few Fritos in a bowl, cover with chili, sprinkle on some chopped onions and a little cheddar cheese.  Fabulous!  Thank you Amazon for carrying this product as I can't find it in any of our supermarkets.

Good healthy chili, low salt (nice for older folks like me) but beans have a slight sour taste. Will buy this now and then, and you can add your own meat for a full meal. Not bad for canned Chilli, maybe I'm just too used to homemade.

Oh my, this is the best chili, for me, at least. A little heat from the chipotle, but not overpowering. The flavors the mingle are superb. Packs a fiber wallop, too. Try it...you won't be disappointed unless you really like it hot.

My wife and I enjoy some jelly occasionally but never eat a whole jar before it spoils. This individually packed jelly looked like a great solution but when it arrived the use-by date was just a little over a month away. There is no way we'll eat that much jelly in a month. The jelly tastes good enough but the short shelf life made it a bad purchase for us. Most of it will end up being thrown away just like the jars we used to buy. Who knew jelly only lasted a month?
I love this wine.  It is fruity without being too sweet and is low in tannins.  You can also get it at national spagetti chains. Enjoy!

column10: I love this size. My only regret is that there is no plastic lid to keep it fresh.

Whether your just looking to spice up your sex life, or you just have the munchie's, this stuff is great. I use it on everything from mashed potatoes, to chicken salad, to lasagna, to women. Some people say your supposed to drink it with milk but I drink it straight like a real man. Highly recommended.

column10: Just placed my second order. Love this. I have tried others and some are very good as well, but I just like this one better. I am a huge fan of almond butter, my doctor recommended it to me as a good source of protein. I eat it almost every day.

This is one of the very best Kansas City style BBQ sauces I have ever tasted. Being thick, it sits on the meat rather than sinking in and does well for stuff that you want to have sauce on top of (some like their ribs that way, I like hotlinks that way). The flavor is really well mixed and rounded smokiness and lightly sweet with a touch of spice; well balanced sauce that goes with anything smoked or 'cue'd.

column9: Simply the best bottled BBQ sauce on the planet
column10: My uncle introduced this brand to my mom at a BBQ  he had last summer and explained this is what he uses on ribs, and chicken to get it so good. Yes he was right my mom passed down the info to me I been trying it with my crockpot bbqs, george foreman, showtime rotisserie, flavorwave bbqs etc and yes the outdoor bbqs let's not forget those. This is a extremely good sauce that's all I am going to say as to not give away to many spoilers but this sauce is the "sauce" so to speak. and great price for it to. I use it frequently and buy it exclusivity now.

Got my adult daughter some nice jewelry for her last birthday. She remarked that she would have been happy with some tea. Soooo had Amazon gift wrap (excellent) these and sent to her. They were well recieved.
If you like dark warm tea this is it.  Definitely good for the cold days.  Easy to use, pretty cheap for a good earthy, robust tea.

I was expecting and hoping that this Bigelow tea would be very flavorful as tea bags I use unfortunatley I am left disappointed.I will go back to steeping in a cup of hot water and no longer try this in a Keurig.I would recommend people try Stash's version of Earl Grey.
I ordered this for my wife, she likes it very much and need to order to regularly. It's time to order it again.

I used to only make coffee with k-cups in my Keurig. I would make tea, but just used the hot water and my own tea bags...figured that it wasn't worth the extra cost. Boy was I wrong! I was at a hotel and they had keurig machines and had a few K-cups of tea there...I took them home to maybe try...and was very pleasantly surprised when I did! Why was I fussing with bags and steeping times, when I can have a perfect cup with the touch of a button? I mean, I bought the machine for the convenience, why wasn't I doing that with tea?I liked the Celestial Seasonings Earl Grey the best from those samples, but took a chance on the Bigelow here because it was cheaper, and found I liked it more. It has a nice sweetish, flavor...and Earl Grey IS supposed to have that nice citrus flavor from the infusion of orange...this does. I found the other brand to almost be slightly spicy which I DO like (especially in Constant Comment which I am STILL waiting for in K-cups), but it didn't seem "clean" like the Earl Grey I know. I even use the large size button and the tea is still good...though obviously not as strong as the small. I like mine with sugar only...but this flavor lends itself well to honey, lemon...or even (yes!) maple sugar (or even syrup!)Just a straightforward, easy-to-like cup of tea.Edit: You may want to keep an eye on the price of this (and most k-cups) here because the prices and sellers seem to change.
Great that I can get the Bigelow Earl Grey Tea in the K-Cups.  I received them in good time and all is well.

My daughter is a teacher.  They have a Keurig machine at school.  She loved it so much I bought her one for Christmas.  Earl Grey is her favorite tea and she says, "Bigelow is the best".  I order this tea for her and some other flavors too.  It is cheaper than buying it in the store.
I ordered 5-cup sample packs (from Keurig.com) of every Earl Grey they offer, and in my opinion, this one is the best.  So now I buy it from Amazon.com because it's cheaper!  :-)
This was not only really, really expensive for a very, very small jar of salt, but it stinks.  It has an aftertase and a weak lemon flavor.  SAVE YOUR MONEY!
Fusion Lemon Sea Salt arrived at my door on time. The only problem was that I live in Las Vegas, NV where in the summer,temps. reach well over 100F. When I opened the product it was a solid not salt.

I'm surprised how much it tastes like coffee. To be completely accurate, it tastes like a watered down coffee (like the kind you get at hotels) with hazelnut flavor -- and a *very slight* earthy undertone. If someone gave me a sip and didn't tell me what it was, I'd think it were coffee, let's put it that way.There's not all that much root per teabag though, and since I like strong coffee I only use 6 oz of water per bag and steep it covered for 15 mins. Then with some cream and sugar it's quite good.As for the liver tonic claim, well dandelion stimulates bile flow and supposedly helps clear out some stuff gunking up the liver. I don't know about that yet, but so far I haven't noticed any ill effects from drinking this. I feel fine, if not outright good after drinking a cup, but that's as far as I can confirm the effects.And with even decaf coffee containing 5-15 mg caffeine per serving, this stuff being completely caffeine free is a blessing for those of us who go bananas and light public property on fire when we get the slightest bit of caffeine. Anyone who needs a coffee substitute, do give this a try.

I've read lots of other reviews deeming this tea as "coffee tasting" or with "roasted flavors," but to be very truthful, it tastes just the way I could imagine second hand smoke would. It's very very strong, requires 15 minutes to steep, and is not for the faint hearted. I've heard wonderful reviews related to weight loss regarding this product, but I was not able to tolerate the taste long enough to actually see any weight loss benefits. Good luck to those who care to brave this "roasted" flavor.
I have been taking this tea twice per day and I am enjoying the way I feel

column9: Part of Dr. Oz's Tea Diet
column10: This is part of Dr. Oz's Tea Diet. Works like a charm. I have lost inches already and I have been on it for 4 days.

This was the worst tasting tea, actually the worst tasting anything, that I have ever consumed. I took one sip and could not bring myself to finish the cup. It tasted like dirt, which makes sense since it is a root. The rest of the tea bags are going in the trash.

The benefits are supposed to be amazing so I'll keep it around to water down and sugar up but wow it's bad. So strong too, tastes like dirt (*that's been pissed on in the woods).

Dandelion root is reported to aid in reducing high blood pressure, which is why I drink it.  I've pretty much given up coffee drinking and this is a tasty substitute, though one must acquire a taste for it.  At home I use bulk roasted root but these tea bags are fantastic during travel.
I really like this tea, I started drinking it at the suggestion of a friend.It helps to sooth an upset stomache. I will be buying it again in the future.

column9: Cup of dandelion tea a day, keeps the doctor away!
column10: I love this brand of Dandelion Root tea.  The tea is so good for your health and keeps you regular.  Transaction went smooth like always.  So glad to hear Amazon may soon have home delivery of groceries to my door.  I have some disabilities that require someone to shop for me but I do a lot of it on Amazon.com

I love this tea. And it makes you feel very healthy, which is so needed during the Christmas and New Year season.. I haven't used it in one week, and I can soooo feel my body needing a good detox.  I recommend for anyone who has stomach issues, over indulges, and wants to feel generally better.
Reveived my item fast! It was exactly what I ordered in excellent shape with safe shipping - i will came back and shop here again.  Thanks

I drink this tea every day (I'm 7 months pregnant), and have done so since I found out I was pregnant.  I love that it's organic and contains all the herbs that support a healthy pregnancy.  I don't notice anything dramatic when I drink it or don't drink it, but I will say I feel nourished when I drink it, and have had NO PREGNANCY COMPLICATIONS WHATSOEVER.  I'm 36, this is my first pregnancy, and I have been exceptionally healthy throughout.  I highly recommend this for any pregnant woman--at least a cup a day!

column9: GOOD FOR YOU, BUT WORST TASTING TEA EEEVVVEEERRR
column10: As an avid tea drinker of all corners of the earth, I have had hundreds of teas, and everything from this company as well. I read about this tea as a very powerful health herb but all the reviews said it tastes bad. What do I care? I'd rather be healthy. I never take sugar in my tea either. If you've read this far you are waiting for me to say how bad it was. You can't imagine how bad it is. Without exaggeration I would describe the flavor as a very bitter tasting dirt. Yes, as a 32 year old with children I know what dirt tastes like and this tastes like dirt but with a super bitter taste that makes it hard to drink. My recommendation is to let it steep for a shorter amount of time as to not make a rich bold tea. As you know, the longer it steeps the bolder the tea becomes. Yea, don't do that with this. Four stars because it is apparently very good for you and I thank the company for bringing it to us regardless of the taste of death when other tea companies are using Artificial ingredients to make their teas taste better.

I used these treats to crate train our Maltese puppy.  Four years later he still gets a treat before going into crate.  This is the cheapest place to buy, and one of the only places I've been able to even find the product now. Perfect for small dogs.

My dogs love these! I have small dogs so it can be hard to find small treats that don't add a lot of calories to their diet. I like the fact that they have quality ingredients, & are baked. A lot better than table scraps for they're all natural. They come in a variety of flavors too which allows you to let them have a new flavor when you want to. I'm happy, if they're happy, & they are.

I love that this product is available in 6 packs, so you can have a fairly large supply at your house. They are very small and the perfect size to give your dog when you want to give him a treat but not spoil his appetite for a meal. My dog seems to love them, I leave a small handful for my dog when I leave for the day, and they aren't there when I get home. I like Cloud Star products because they seem to use quality ingredients. The description says it's perfect for small dogs, but my dog is 50 pounds and seems to enjoy them just fine!

column9: Perfect for dogs who are motivated by treats!
column10: One of my dogs has allergies to several foods, which makes finding a healthy, all natural, and affordable treat a challenge. These are wonderful for her. They're small enough that I can give her one or half of one easily each time she returns with the ball when we play fetch, but they're not so small that she can't catch it or bite my fingers off trying to eat it from my hand. Other treats I've tried have been too big, have had some ingredient she can't handle, or have had a bunch of ingredients that aren't natural which I don't want to give her a lot of. These work out great.

column9: My dogs do not want to try
column10: After reading the good reviews, I bought it. However, My babies (one poodle and one samoyed) they even don't want to try. So totally waste the money. When you buy any treat, you should buy one small package to see whether or not your dogs will like. This is my suggestion.
My Yorkie takes them from my hand, but then he just drops them.  It's like he thinks it's a piece of cardboard meant to be shredded and then spit out.I am disappointed.

I first bought these biscuits in a specialty store in another town.  My dog loves them!  I could not find them where I live.  I found them here and get them on line now for a better price.  I highly recommend them.  My dog cannot have any sweet because of her tendency toward diabetic like symptoms.  These are healthy and tasty and have NO molasses in them.  Every biscuit now a days has molasses.  WHY?  These biscuits make us BOTH happy!
I was looking for something to put Blessed oil in to pass out this worked perfectly. I purchased some and got some for my mother. God Bless You.

The 2 dram vials are just as described. I expected the glass to be a bit thin because of the price and the small size of the containers. I am using the vials for insect/aquatic specimens. They do not leak, but like anything that is glass, you need to be careful about how you handle them.

These are a nice quality container.  They aren't a heavy duty glass so I'm careful not to screw the plastic cap on too tight.  I use them for storing my small pills or pills that I split up.  Note:  The plastic seal inside the cap points inward so the container holds a very slightly smaller volume.

column9: Happy, qaulity at a good price
column10: Nice quality, lids fit well and I saves a fair amount vs. local purchase.  Will order more in the next few months.

I Wanted to add spices to my mess kit so I got these. They work great. Perfect size and tight seal. I filled 5 of them up and tried to fit them in an altoids tin but they were a little to big so i placed them in an old sewing kit and they fit perfect.  Holds more and cheaper than the alternative. A must have for any outdoors man.

column10: Just do not understand how you can package fragile cheap glass like this. I cant believe I didnt slice my finger up. just ridiculous. Very cheap product
Received this in a nicely bubble wrapped package. It came to seattle area Super fast!! Vials are good quality and have the very nice plastic seal inserts in the caps.
These little vials have worked perfectly for storing the meds I purchased! They seal well and I have seen no leakage from cap!

I use these to mix and hold essential oils and carrier oils I am mixing for massage or diffusing or a mix I like to have on hand.  They don't leak, they close easily, and while I'm sure they are quite breakable, the one I dropped didn't break.  P.S. 2 dram= 1/4 oz. or just under 7 mL from what I've been told.
The product came on time and has been very useful. I found the vials here for a more affordable price here.

I collect insects and various other specimens. I had these on my wish list for Christmas, so received them as a gift. After transferring some of my specimens to these containers I was closely examining one of them when the container spontaneously exploded in my hand, spilling alcohol and my carefully collected and preserved specimen all over the table and myself.I guess I should have trusted my gut feeling when I first opened the package. They seemed pretty thin walled. I will continue to use them, but for temporary storage of specimens rather than permanent display.

column9: Eggs are Eggs - A very reasonable product for those with reasonable expectations.
column10: Many people in this review section seem to be slamming these eggs and I can't figure out why.  I bought them on a whim and have been very satisfied with the purchase.  They are great for cooking, and just fine for my Sunday breakfast as well.  Just remember you are buying "powdered" eggs.  You won't have the exact same texture or the precise taste of fresh eggs, but then, what would you expect? They're powdered. When you eat them, your mouth and taste buds still say "yup, that's egg allright." A very reasonable product for those with reasonable expectations.

I bought these for a camping trip.  Mixed exactly as described.  Taste great.  Once cooked could not tell the difference in them and whole eggs.  Taste and texture exactly the same.  Them seem to thin when you first mix them but once cooked they are great.

I develop sugarfree recipes and find these eggs invaluable when adding extra liquids to an existing recipe. To date I have not been disappointed in any of the baking results yet. I would and will purchase these again.

These eggs are perfect for baking, but NOT for eating by themselves.  Use them for baking only and you'll love it.  I live in rural alaska where eggs are not easy to come by.  We keep a can in the fridge and it lasts us a year or two of baking.  We still use real eggs for omelets or fried egg sandwiches.  Also if you don't open the can until you need it they will keep forever, something like 7 years.  You can also buy these from honeyville grain's website.  They have flat $4.99 shipping anywhere in the lower 48 no matter how many items you buy.

column9: If you add a LITTLE liquid,you are golden!
column10: I see alot of people slamming this product for using other than baking needs,and I guess I can understand if you are cutting this powder with 2-1 water and trying to scramble!However,if you try using milk(I actually use powdered milk as well,but thats your call),and just add a tiny little bit of liquid at a time until you get to the consistency you need,and make sure to butter the pan(use a little oil as well to keep butter from burning),you will find this item is NOT as bad as all that scrammbled,it is however,hard as heck to try amd make an omlet out of this stuff,but add a few other items,green peppers,onions,selentro,spices,etc,and you will find they arent all that bad,they definately are NOT farm fresh eggs,but no-one ever cliamed they were,just cut WAY back on the liquid to powder ratio,and cook it SLOWLY using a buttered luke warm pan,bring it up to medium to medium low temp stirring constantly until done,you will find yourself liking this stuff,just my opinion,but give it one more shot using milk or powdered milk,and only tiny bits at a time,and you may be surprised!
I love these eggs.  But amazon is ripping you off.  You can go to honeyville web site and buy same eggs for 16.99 and shipping is 4.49 for your entire purchase.

column9: They are powdered and they are eggs
column10: You probably don't want to fix them for your guests but they are an excellent way to keep eggs on hand for baking or as part of your emergency food supply.
Tried these and liked them. Tried OvaEasy when these were out of stock for so long and liked the OvaEasy much better. Tasted more like fresh eggs. Just my 2 cents.

column9: Great for a large group to feed.
column10: As someone who has taken up backpacking this summer, I have dived head-first into recipies beyond that of trail mixes.  Alot has been written about the taste of powdered eggs vs. that of regular eggs, all I can say is that there is a definite difference-but just remember-when you're in the middle of nowhere-this product will take care of your craving for eggs.  The product comes in a coffee-can sized tin that probabily take an individual like myself about a whole season of weekly camping to go through.  This product would be great for those trips with a group of people to cook for.  I've also tried the product in baked recipies with a fair amount of success

Not quite as tasty as liquid egg whites, and some care needed to dissolve the powder in water or milk, but they cook up great and you can control the thickness and richness by the powder to water/milk ratio.  Never needs refrigeration, easily stored, great for camping or backpacking or when you run out of refrigerated liquid egg whites, as it is an extra hassle to drive to the store in the traffic, rain, or snow.

Well i read all the reviews VERY carefully before i bought theese things....i was a bit scared at first naturally eating a egg from powder but i kept thinking about the buffet eggs...we all know thir not real eggs yet theres something magical about them! lol i figured i could make my own shoneys buffet at home...(kinda lol) but anyhoo i made some right when they got here as i was anxious to try em....lemme say when i tried them i wasnt very hungry at all so im sure that had something to do with it...but in all honesty their not bad all.... they aint like the buffet eggs...granted ove only made about 3 eggs..(3 tsb) one thing i did learn is DO NOT COOK THIS EGG ON A HOT SURFACE! cook it slow...this aint no real egg....it gets all dry and, well, nasty to be honest. but if you asking yourself of you should buy theese eggs, and you have the spare cash and if you dont feel like running to get a dozen eggs every few days then yeah id deffinetly do it...they taste pretty good actually, but one thing i noticed was the "yoke factor" if i had it to do ovre again i would have gotten the egg whites....as im using these just for breakfast eggs.theese are really yolky...i always eat the yoks too...but theese seem like powderd yolks to be honest...lol so if you doing some baking and need yokes get theese! but if your like me and want scrambled eggs...get the whites they may be more but theyre probbly worht it.but if your a super yolk fan get theese...anyhoo thats about it..they are decent eggs, and i would probably get them again (whites next time)anyhoo...thanks!

column9: Great addition to an Emergency Pantry.
column10: For those of you out there that are stocking up on emergency supplies, this is a really good purchase. I had purchased these eggs in a smaller bag in the past at my local camping store and when I saw them here I decided to get some for my emergency supply. They taste like what you would expect of powdered eggs but for some reason people want the 100% exact taste of freshly cracked eggs, which would make about as much sense as expecting powdered milk to taste 100% exactly like fresh dairy milk. Go figure!  I have used these eggs in the past to make brownies, microwave brownies at that, and they came out OK. I personally love to make Tomato, Pepper and Onion Omelets with these eggs but to each their own I would say. Are these eggs tolerable enough to eat? Well, considering that one morning I made a Cheese and Tomato Omelet for my wife using these same eggs and she barely noticed the difference until I told her afterwards, I would say these eggs work out well in a pinch. And in an emergency situation these eggs will taste like gourmet food to those who are starving, so this product gets an A+ in my book.
The can did not have an expiration date listed on it. The powder was dark in color and tasted terrible. A complete waste of money!
I am suprisingly delighted with the quality of this product.It was everything it was advertised to be.The ease of use and good taste was a great extra!
This product works great when a recipe calls for eggs.  I haven't tried it for use as scrambled eggs alone, but have been happy with its use for cooking and baking.  Very handy to have on hand.

column9: If there were no Chickens Left
column10: I guess I got the title wrong. If there were no food left is what it should really say. I broke down and opened up this can to try it out and kind of wished I had waited till there was no more food left on this whole planet. When that day comes, these powdered eggs would taste pretty good. But knowing there is a grocery store a few miles from here and knowing that I could pack something much more tasty if I were to go backpacking, I would have to opt out on packing these powdered eggs. They are edible, but they are by no means a viable replacement unless you used bacon grease to cook them in or you had some ketchup to put on them. Something to add some taste to them as they are bland with a tint/hint of egg flavor. Some people were looking for what ratio of egg powder to water they should use. Well, it does not really matter so long as you actually dissolve the powder since the cooking process evaporates the water. However, I do believe that you might want to use more than an even 1:1 ratio. I think a 1:1.25 ratio would be better. Make them a little more runny so that they spread out over the pan you are cooking them in. As for the rest of my can of eggs, I suppose I am going to have to vacuum seal them and hope they last till the end of food as we know it.

I have never eaten dried eggs, so I can't comment on the taste or quality for human diets.  I bought this product to add to my dog's food because I have a couple of picky eaters, especially one older girl who doesn't have much of an appetite sometimes.  I feed only top quality, high protein, all natural dog food, but even so, I sprinkle a tablespoon of the powdered egg on top of each dog's meal and add a little water.  My dogs love it.  In addition to adding taste, it's low in calories and a great coat supplement as well.  I would highly recommend this product for this type purpose.

Their is NO flavor, whatsoever!!!2. Sticks "hard" to oiled stainless frying pan (fried like a pancake. pre-heated to med/low)- Worked better when I mixed in 1tsp of Canola oil, per egg... (like waffles...).For 1 egg sandwich- I mix 1/4 cup water, to 1/4 cup mix (they say 2-1), which was a runny mess (maybe for baking?).Limited shelf life...- I store unused mix in the freezer!

The product is what it advertise to be. If you expect it to taste as fresh eggs you will be disappointed. Nevertheless, you can make great omelettes and scramble eggs concoctions. Easy to mix and cook. After mixing with water it looks thinner than regular eggs, but it cooks well. If you are not sure, order powdered eggs in a smaller package and try it first. Will definitely buy again once it runs out.
So far so good.. have used for baking and scrambled eggs for breakfast. Recommend mixing them a little dryer than recommended for scrambling.

I bought 5 lbs of this instead of my usual order from Sweet Maria's.  I had some of each on hand to compare, and right away I saw that the Coffee Bean Direct beans were full of misshapen beans and even a few stones.  When it came to roasting, it was much more difficult to get an even roast in my iRoast2.  When I drank the first few cups, the difference was even more striking.  I will be pawning this off on my relatives who don't know better, and ordering a replacement from Sweet Marias.As bad as this review is, there is nothing horrible about the beans, but with an equally priced and far supperior competitor out there, there is no reason to buy this one.

column9: Very nice taste, easy to roast and well packaged
column10: I just started home roasting and this was my first purchase of green coffee.  I am a coffee enthusiast, and living in a small town, home roasting is the only way to get fresh roasted coffee as the stores just don't sell inventory fast enough.My first batch of this coffee was great tasting with nice body and earthy flavor I would expect from Sumatran. It was packaged well and I received it in 3 business days.From past experience with store bought Sumatran, I like a city plus or maybe full city roast rather than the very dark vienna or french roast the stores seem to like. Roasted to city plus or full city, this product produces a flavor that is full and earthy, but not over the top like a dark roasted Sumatran can be. Lighter than city plus will taste grassy like most coffee. Just my preference and your experience will tell you what works for you.I read some home roasting how-to articles on the web and tried to roast using an air popper to a city plus or full city, ending up with nice medium colored and evenly roasted batch. The aroma when newly roasted is kind of "raw", but after an hour or two it is fantastic.  It wasn't very tricky to roast and I've been able to repeat the results as often as I need fresh beans, usually 6 to 8 oz. of beans each weekend.After letting the roast "breathe" for a day, it made great espresso in a 15-bar pump espresso machine with fair crema, and in a 3-cup Italian moka pot. With a coarser grind it was terrific in a French press as well. I haven't tried it in a drip machine. The results have been consistent from batch to batch and I would buy it again.

This was my first purchase from this vendor. The quality of the product is great, the price is awesome and the packaging protected the shipment from any damage. I also bought another variety in the same 5-lb bag size. I've already roasted about a pound of each and am very happy with the results. I am very partial to the Sumatra. Getting a nice dark roast without burning is always a challenge but it seemed easier with these beans. When the oils were released from the beans the aroma was excellent. Will be buying more from this vendor.

I'm fairly new to home roasting, and was very excited to find unroasted beans on Amazon. I usually procure my beans through Sweet Maria's, but I like the speed and convenience of the Amazon purchasing process. I ordered a 5lb bag of unroasted Sumatra Mandheling beans and they arrived the following day.It was late in the evening before I got around to opening the bag. As soon as I cut the top off of the vacuum sealed bag, I noticed that the beans didn't look quite right. They looked sort of "mealy", as though something had been eating them, and they smelled off. As my eyes focused a bit better, I quickly saw the cause of the problem. Bugs. Little reddish-brown beetle-like bugs, crawling all over the beans. UGH! I took a few pictures to document the problem, closed the bag, wrapped it in a couple plastic grocery bags, and stuck it in the freezer.The following morning I called Coffee Bean Direct to report the insect infestation. Though the person I spoke to was professional and polite, she was completely disinterested in assisting me. She kept repeating, "You bought the beans from Amazon, you'll have to deal with them to get a replacement or refund." I told her that I wasn't worried about replacement/refund...Amazon is fantastic when it comes to making things right. I just wanted the company who actually imported & packed the product to be aware that they had a serious insect problem. Again she was completely disinterested. Afterward I did call Amazon, and they sent out a replacement immediately. The replacement bag didn't contain any live bugs, but the beans were again so bug-eaten that they are totally unfit for human consumption. Again, Amazon made things right and issued a full refund, then pulled the product from the site so that no one else has to get a bag full of bugs.I have contacted the USDA, the FDA, and the local health department for Stockton, NJ, where Coffee Bean Direct is located. The gentleman at the health department was a bit thrown off by the name of the business, as his department has neither issued a certificate for, nor inspected, a business by that name. Similarly, the FDA stated that they would be seizing imports for this company at it's point of import. They are very concerned that this company's products may be introducing non-native species of insects into the country.CBD is a company to be avoided at all cost. The beans they offer for sale are inferior quality beans, and not subject to even a minimum of quality control. And they do not stand behind their product. Who could blame them, really?

I roasted a cup of these for a medium and then dark roast to test the quality. Both were horrible. These beans may have been "green", i.e., not roasted, but they are not fresh. The whole point of purchasing green and roasting your own is to achieve real freshness in coffee. I will never purchase coffee again on Amazon. When I attempted to return (which was most of the product minus 2 cups) I was told that was not possible.

I ordered this coffee along with a number of others.The lower price was appealing.Live and learn.The quality of the beans was not good. I found a number of small stones in the mix. It was hard to get an even roast and the brew it produced was not very good.If your going to roast your own coffe spend a couple of extra dollars and get something good.You're worth it.

column9: Pretty good beans for the price
column10: This is a good bean for a commercial bean, I will always try to buy from this vendor for my personal stock.  Coffee Diret's beans are always fairly well cleaned and sorted, not a lot of trash and the bag always weighs a couple ounces over.  It roasts up very well, I go a little into second crack and it doesn't get that burnt flavor.  Do let them cure a day after roasting or you'll get that peculiar grassy kind of aftertaste.  If you order the sampler from them and the cups are broken (mine were), just call Coffee Direct and they'll send you more.  They are very friendly and responsive to the customer's needs.Check Sweet Maria's out of Oakland, CA for some other Sumatra varieties, a little more pricey but still well within reason considering the higher quaility. I buy their beans to change things up a bit, keeping the Mendheling as my primary stock.Oh yeah, coffee comes from third world nations so you're gonna find a bug or a rock every great once in a while.  Just kill the bug, pluck out the rock or whatever needs to be done and try not to have a meltdown over it.  You can bet the big companies that sell ground coffee don't bother with picking the bug out, I'm sure that bug gets roasted and ground up becoming part of the end product.  Things are better now than they used to be, I haven't found any nasties in my beans in about ten years, used to be every other bag!  By roasting your own coffee you're taking control of what's actually in the coffee and making it just the way you want it, good for you!  I hope this was helpful!

These by far are my favorite bean from coffee bean direct.  I had ordered them a couple years ago from CBD direct but this time I ordered through Amazon because it had the best price and shipping.  I like the fact I can roast/sauté my green beans in the pan until they are dark to my liking and fresh...

I've been roasting this bean as my usual for about 4 years. I first tested out a number of different breeds of bean at different roasts and I found that this one was my favorite for lattes. The flavor is subtle and complex with potent notes of chocolate. But if sourness (acid) bothers you, I would make a different choice.Broken beans, yes. Stones, no.

I bought this product because I knew I liked sumatran coffee . Im new to roasting coffee but I roasted these beans many different degrees and cant get much flavor out of them. I sorry I bought 5# and will probably throw 4# away.

My family used to be in the candy business when I was a kid growing up, and my dad's favorite was always chic-o-sticks.  The preference definitely wore off on me.  These are great - the bin is a good size and will last a while.  I docked it a star only because there is a slight difference between the "original" version and this version in that the coconut and peanut butter is inside the orange shell instead of the toasted coconut flakes being on the outside.  In the end it tastes the same, so I'm satisfied!

I just had a birthday party with a 1960s theme, and a friend bought a box filled with candy from the era. One of the candies in the box was a Chick-O-Stick and I had forgotten how incredibly delicious this candy is. I'm hoping that my co-workers love this candy as much as I do! Also, if you head to the manufacturer's website you might see a different price on their online store..

This product is a good/standard Jamon with the great flavor I enjoyed in Spain.  What great memories right in my kitchen!!  Would by this again in a heartbeat.  Excellent idea if you entertain during the holliday season. Brings the flavor of Spain to your kitchen.

O.k. I was a little nervous ordering the half slab here on Amazon for a few reasons: Not Prime, not direct from Amazon, shipping.  Have to say that my purchase was super smooth and that the bacon is (was) excellent!!!  I posted some pictures so check them out if you want the nutrition information from the label or a look at the package.I ordered on a Tuesday and the bacon arrived Thursday afternoon.  Was sent a tracking number right away, and it shipped UPS 2 Day which was included in the price.  As I live in California it was tax free also.  The package was left on my door step in the sun when I arrived home in the afternoon.  It was very warm to the touch and I was worried and dreading what would be inside.  However, when the box was opened the bacon was cold to the touch - though  not frozen.  Just like you would get it from the store.  The outside of the box was wrapped in a heavy shrink wrap, the box was a thick cardboard and sealed with tape well, and inside the box was an inner styrofoam cooler, with a strofoam lid, that fit the dimension of the box perfectly.  Inside the styrofoam cooler were two ice packs and the bacon.  The bacon is shrink wrapped also.  It arrived in perfect condition.  My half slab weighed in at 5.12 lbs.So I have never "cut" my own bacon from a slab before.  I used a shaprp Henckel butcher knife and cut slices about 1/4" thick.  The slicing is a bit of a chore and a bit of a mess as compared to the pre-sliced.  Still the bacon cut easy with the sharp knife and I just used my shrink wrapper to re-package the bacon into 3 smaller packages to put into the freezer.It cooked delicious!  Crisp and slightly crunchy and moist and a bit meaty inside.  Even before cooking the aroma was delicious.  A slight smokey aroma.  Upon cooking over a low heat the smell just ROCKED!!!  Again flavor was great too.  Better then store bought bacon?  Yes!  Worth 4x the cost?  Well that's up to you.  I think so.  Mail order bacon can only be described as a luxury item anyway.I will order from Burgers' Smokehouse again.  Next purchase will be a ham.  Or more bacon.

GREAT STUFF~! DELICIOUS! I can't say enough about it. I refuse to eat thin sliced bacon any more. Give me chunks or give me death! If I eat too much of any bacon though, I'm sure the clogged arteries will hasten my death.Very good quality bacon. Packed and shipped well. I do recommend it!
the best bacon by far!!! slice it thick cook it slow! you may never go back!

The product arrived in a timely manner, thanks for that. Otherwise, I am quite disappointed. It sure looks nice on the product description page, but don't be fooled. column9: The best bacon I've ever eaten!
column10: I just ordered my second full slab, and can't wait until it gets here. It freezes up very well, and the last portions are just as good as the first. I cut it into almost 1/2 inch thick slices, and it's like eating a delicious ham steak. Wonderful taste! I just can't eat regular bacon anymore. Thanks to Amazon Prime, I may never have to!If I could give it 6 stars, I would!

It arrived cold and fresh in Ca. It was derinded so it was easiy to cut. It cooked well and smelled wonderful. But, It was 20% too salty for my taste. The bacon was edible and was a good component for dishes,but so salty I couldn't eat more than 1 piece at a sitting. I will not order this brand again.

column9: My cats love it and there is almost no by-products
column10: I thought that all the Market Select cat foods were devoid of the heinous by-products but I did see tuna by-products listed for one of the flavors.  Still that's way better than the other store brands that have every conceivable by-product as the first or second ingredient on the list.  I feed my cats Pet Promise dry food but they don't like the Pet Promise canned food.  It seems like all the higher quality canned foods are the same dense sticky consistency that my herd just will not eat.  They love the gravy-laden types so I'm happy to find this one, Market Select, the cosistency the cats love, and almost no by-products.  I also really like the peel off lid and sturdy plastic cups.  It's so easy to open as compared to cans or the pouches which to me are awkward and messy.  I wash stuff like cat food containers so they don't stink up the place waiting for trash day and washing the peel off lids and the plastic cups is a breeze.  No cuts from metal lids.  I have to buy this cat food by the case from Amazon because my local store does not carry it.  But I don't mind since it's efficient and affordable to buy in bulk.  I just hope Amazon does not drop it from it's offerings like they have done with so many other food items.
He just adored this. Chicken is his fave. He liked this way better than fancy feast. My boy is a meow mix cat.
I noticed no difference in the amount of hulls...very large pieces of hull and very small pieces of popcorn. Tastes very good but not hulless....won't buy again

I must admit I'm in love with these delish strawberry granola bars. They are perfectly chewy andtaste like strawberry cake. I can promise you that if you try one you will want two! These mightnot be the best bars to order if you are on a diet although they are healthier than most candybars. The secret to these bars is "strawberry powder." I just tried this product for lunch, not expecting much, but I actually found it to be quite delicious. The sauce actually tastes like something you could get in a restaurant and the potatoes and chickpeas are not overly mushy. The portion size and preparation is perfect for a quick lunch and the fact that it doesn't have to be refridgerated is a plus. I will definitely be buying more of these meals for work.

Vegan. All natural. Kosher. Chickpeas and potatoes in savory brown gravy. Reminds me of puri aloo (without the bread) from railway platforms or from street vendors across India, but higher quality and very hygienic. Convenient foil package. Heat & serve. Great with tortillas, pitas, puris, on toast, or over rice. Actually made in Maharastra, so its really the real thing. column9: Very tasty, a bit too hot for me
column10: This was very good, full of flavor, but a bit too hot for my tastes. I guess I didn't expect the amount of heat that it has. But the chunks of potatoes are big, the chick peas aren't mushy, very good.

I bought this recently from Wild Oats Markets in Tulsa. They were selling it at $3.99. It tasted OK,  but I don't know if everyone would love the strong coriander/cilantro powder flavor.  I love the taste of Cilantro leaves but I didn't like the flavor of its seeds (in powdered form) when that seemed to be the dominant flavor.
It looks very good.  Potatoes and some beans.  Delicious sauce.  I put over a chicken cutlet for dinner last night.  It was great.

column9: Flavorful, hearty and great for Weight Watchers!
column10: One packet (one whole box) of Bombay Potatoes is 4 points on Weight Watchers.  Often, for dinner I will supplement with fresh spinach, extra chick peas, or chicken sausage - this all makes for an extremely tasty, low point dinner or lunch that doesn't taste like diet food!Tasty Bites contain only ingredients that are instantly recognizable- "whole" foods.  The potatoes in Bombay Potatoes have a great, soft yet firm texture, and the sauce is incredibly flavorful.  I highly recommend.

I've been buying Bombay Potatoes for years and enjoy the consistent quality.  However, I will not be buying from Amazon any longer.  I last purchased these on Amazon in November and paid $31.38 for 12 boxes INCLUDING shipping.  Now the price is $53.32 with shippping???????????????  Amazon must be joking.  You can buy them direct from Tasty Bite for much less than that.  In fact, you can buy them from your local supermarket for less than you can from both of them.

These were spicy, as in hot. Also had good curry flavor. I loved them served over/with a meat analog such as vegetable steaks, tender bits, etc. A nice cucumber and onion in yogurt salad goes well with them.

column9: Great Meatless Meal With Basmanti Rice!
column10: The Bombay Potatoes are a great way to reduce my intake of meat; especially while dieting.  If you crave a spicy, delicious and different flavor - these are for you!  Love them!

This is another of those fast and easy meals that is so great.This I do like better than the Bengal Lentils,both are wonderful!A little more spicy than the lentils,but not as aromatic.More sauce makes this one easier to mix with other grains or what have you,without loosing it's flavor in the mix.Now all they have to do is package with recycled material and it would almost be perfect!!
I love many of the Tasty Bite products. This one is delicious, low fat, vegan and healthy.

column9: Good.......but better to add your own ideas
column10: I initially hesitated to buy any ready-to-eat product fearing that they might taste bad or how they could be preserved without preservatives.  But when shopping last week, I found it in the Indian cuisine aisle and decided to give it a try.  I just heated it and found it to be better tasting.  But you add lemon juice (enough to give it the sour tangy taste) and chopped cilantro.  I also added quarter teaspoon of chilli powder, rasam powder and salt accordingly to give it a fresh taste.  Try the above directions for a real good taste.
Not bad. Very flavorful, good nutrition, low cal, and vegan.  I'd probably puchase it again.

Very Yummy Potatoes (and chick peas)...very tasty and not too spicy hot.  I recommend it highly as a side dish or over a dead animal or rice.So easy to make---boil water, warm in packet under water for about 5 minutes, carefully lift out of water, grip, rip, pour.

Could use more flavor, but otherwise an acceptable piece of instant food. Just cook some rice and pour this on top of the hot rice and your all set. Its got all your protein and carb needs for a meal.

This is a really great Dish, the spices are perfect and it's the best packaged Indian I have had.  But, I found you can get it for much less direct from Tastybite than the price here for the same 12-pak.

column9: More like a side dish, Add cheese and it makes a great dip
column10: I'm someone who needs some substance to her food to consider it an entree. To me this was more like a side dish. The flavor was okay, then again I'm just not a fan of most store-bought microwavable Indian dishes. I added 3 slices of Kraft American cheese and turned this into a dip for some Tostitos Scoops. Not bad.

Unlike other entrees, the potatoes hold their shape and consistency well. I found that the entrees with vegetables tend to come out as an unappetizing mush, but this one so far has looked like something that I would cook.Plus, it tastes pretty good; it's not bland at all, or too spicy like other entrees.

Tasty Bite has become my least favorite brand of shelf-stable retort-packaged Indian meals. The Bombay Potatoes are a pleasant surprise after some of the other meals such as the syrupy Thai entrees.  (The Tasty Bite Entree, Punjab Eggplant, 10-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 12) is another one I like.)The potatoes and chickpeas have retained a sufficient amount of texture.  The sauce is thin but has a pleasant spiciness and there is plenty of it, which I don't mind because it is pretty good, especially compared to some of the other ones I have tried.  You can add leftover potato, chickpeas, or even green beans to this meal and I like to serve it with brown rice and garnish with diced chili peppers.The entire package is supposed to be two servings but is realistically one. The total contents have 820mg of sodium, 6g of dietary fiber, 8g of fat, and 1g of saturated fat. The meal is vegan and is certified kosher.

This is my favorite of all the Tasty Bite Entrees. It's fast (I only have 30 minutes for lunch), the flavor is great and it's vegetarian. However, this stuff is spicy hot, which I love, but anyone who doesn't do well with spicy food might not like it.
after reading reviews ordered this at a great price - delicious, gluten free. low fat indian meal .. quick and easy to prepare, you cant go wrong with tasty bite!!

This by far is the best product made by Tasty Bites!  The flavor has a kick to it but won't leave you running for water ... but it will leave you salivating for more, more, more!  And now that I have more than put Amazon through the tests of different purchases I know the only place I will be getting these Bombay Potatoes!!  We'll see how long this case of 12 lasts because the danger is I know I can eat as much as I want and know where to go for more!  As far as I am concerned Tasty Bite's Bombay Potatoes and Amazon are the two best things since they invented sliced bread!!

I really enjoy the taste of the Bombay Potatoes.  They're also kosher, gluten-free, and dairy-free which fits my dietary lifestyle.  Best of all, when I don't feel like cooking (which I have to do a lot for my diet) these come in handy for a quick fix.

The Bombay potatoes are my favorite Tasty Bite entrée. The flavor is wonderful and the first time I had I had it I was very pleasantly surprised at how delicious it was. I would highly recommend this product to all. It's a quick, tasty alternative to a home cooked Indian meal.
This item is so easy to make. Just pop it in the micowave for 90 seconds, and you have yourself a delicious, healthy meal. I love it!

In my experiences with Indian cuisine from patronizing local restaurants owned and operated by native Indian folks, this is quite comparable and the flavors are very similar.  It's nice to be able to open a package of Indian food to eat with some Basmati rice quickly. Recommended.Some of the flavors are spicy.
Definitely a quick and easy entree. Authentic (according to my experience) Indian cuisine. But too spicey hot for my taste.

I ordered a few boxes of this and I couldn't stomach this.  The spices were very off in this type of dish, to the point where it made it couldn't stand the taste of it.  It had way too much cinnamon.  I ended up throwning my other boxes out.  I would recommend Kohinoor brand over this any day.

Hi folks. This will be my very first review for a Amazon product, so please bear with me....Tasty Bites is by far my favorite choice of pre-packed Indian treats. I've tried the 3-4 other major Indian food manufacturers products and Tasty Bites is consistently better, which is also borne out by other customer reviews. So, I was very happy to see that Amazon carries my 3 favorites, the product offered, Bombay Potatoes, and also their Kashmiri Spinach and the eggplant dish, who's name escapes me for now. Having already purchased some other Tasty Bites products that I have never tried before through Amazon, I was very happy with the low cost per package, which comes out to approximately $2.61 per package, since I am an Amazon Prime member, that is the total cost delivered to my door, a tremendous price, considering the least costly alternative from my local market is $3.95 per package. So I was really jazzed when I thought I could get all my faves for the same great price, but sadly, this was not to be........Amazon does not stock my 3 faves, some other company does, and not only is the per packet cost higher than Amazon's, since it is not covered by Amazon Prime, there is also the $16 plus shipping charge on top of that, bringing the per package price to $4.40 something, nearly $2 more per package than the Amazon choices. I can go to my local market and get my faves for half a buck less, but if Amazon started offering them, I would be in pre-packed Indian food heaven. How does one go about petitioning Amazon to start carrying products? I know some people will purchase these 3 great products at the higher cost and added postage, but wouldn't it be great if Amazon delivered the orders through their excellent Amazon Prime?

I liked that I could squeeze it straight onto a spoon (good for traveling), and that it's organic. Over all, great product and would definitely recommend it to other parents, especially those who need it for a trip.

My son loves all of the plum organic baby foods.  He is 8 months old never turns away from their flavors.

column9: Toddler loves these but keep the lid away!

Our kiddo loves this food. Very convienient snack for trips and home, and we feel really good about the ingredients. Good price point too.

column9: Getting our 20 month old to eat fruits and veggies
column10: Our 20 month old loves these pouches.  He will eat fruits and vegetables on his own, but we use this as a snack on the go, or for when he's grumpy and needs a healty treat.  We tell him its "juice" and he loves it.  Perfect size and amount.  Highly recommended.

They are easy to carry and easy to give him.I bought them to give them to my baby when we are not home. But he loves them so much that I usually give him one on the days we stay hom.

column9: Pleasant taste, pleasant texture, a tidy organic meal on-the-go!
column10: My 10-month-old loves this stuff. It's organic fruit & veggie baby food in a pouch. Like a smoothie!We've taken them with us to restaurants, on car trips, up to dinner at the grandparents' house; it keeps the mess contained pretty well, and because it's made of good stuff my kid should be eating, I don't feel too guilty that it's also really convenient.

My daughter (10 mos) loves this, and does a pretty good job of feeding this to herself with minimal mess.  We give this to our 2.5 year old son as well when we eat out and don't have a good option of fruits/veggies.  And actually, my husband thinks it's pretty good too :)  Awesome that the only ingredients are carrots and apples.  Awesome.

column9: Best Choice -- Not Super Sweet like the other Flavors Are
column10: Ella's has a similar flavor.  These are the best.  Most of the other flavors (especially Ella's brand) are sickeningly sweet.  And the peas in the pear one are totally overbearing so my twins wouldn't eat them.  Recommend this one for moms who want to watch the sugar intake, even if it is fruit sugar.
Product came quickly and my daughter loves it. It's an easy way to get her to eat vegetables.

This is not a typical flavor boldo - it almost has a hint of peppermint--possibly they were growing something in the soil before the boldo- or the climate is slightly different than the typical flavor- its great though and it does taste like Boldo- its definitely Boldo- just with a slightly different twist-I recommend this to anyone who does not like Boldo usually and needs it for their stomach pains.

column9: WHO DOESN'T LIKE THESE MASHED SPUDS!
column10: Great price on a great product. We saved 75 cents per box over grocery store price. Mashed potatoes with brown gravy or country gravy are great side dishes or just for a snack.
As far as I can tell this is the same item as you buy in the store.  All 4 items in pack were good (not damaged) and fresh.  Not overpriced.  I would buy this item again.
I love the simplicity of these potatoes. They are so easy to make and they are really good. We have been enjoying mashed pototoes that we would not normally have because they are so quick and easy.

Love this tea. Great mild flavor with no weird additions and no bitter aftertaste. Perfect for breakfast. Wish I didn't like it so much, honestly, because it's not cheap. Lovely presentation with the silky sachets and cute tin; would make a nice gift.

I love Harney & Sons packaging and this tin is no exception.  It's really lovely and fun, and the tea is also pretty good!  I usually use one sachet in a tea pot so it goes further than a single cup, and it seems to brew nicely.
If you like black tea, this is excellent.  I bought it because I tried it at Bigby coffee and loved it.  It is worth the price.
I found Harney & Sons tea about 3 years ago.  I love this tea!  I've tried a lot of other brands and have not found one that comes close to the flavor of H & S.
Everything GREAT.  Delivery, packaging, flavor, and texture all combine to make me extremely satisfied.

This is a favorite of my husband to have with his morning coffee. The price is great!! 1/3 of what a package cost at your local supercenter. Buying by the case means less trips to the store which is most pleasing to me! Product arrives fresh and these cookies are the best for being "soft and chewy".

These cookies have next to NO peanutbutter taste. They're currently collecting dust in my pantry because of their metallic taste and unpleasant texture. Peanut Butter cookies are by far my favorite cookie, but THIS is an ATROCITY.
THE PEANUT BUTTER COOKIE IS EXCELENT IN TASTE JUST ABOUT THE RIGHT AMOUNT OF THINGS ADDED TO GIVE IT THE PROPER TASTE -- NOT TOO STRONG BUT JUST RIGHT.

column9: Received one day before expiration date--and still all good!
column10: My husband likes these for a quick breakfast at work.  I ordered this huge shipment thinking that there would be plenty of time before expiration--they were dated for the day after delivery.
