Purchased under a promotional price.  This made them very affordable for resale in a fun raising capacity.

column4: James C. Ward "horror and sci-fi fan.."
column10: the cookie is called "Grandma's", and that is appropriate, because when I ate the cookie, it reminded me of my own grandmother's cookies that she made fresh out of the oven during my childhood.this cookie is about as close to Grandma's home style that you'll find.  Very moist, tasty.  I plan to buy the other varieties of this brand (choclate chip, etc.) because of this positive experience.* highly recommended *

column9: Yummy, but a little high in fat.
column10: Yes, these are very good, but they tend to be a little high in calories and fat.  I try to eat just half a cookie at a time.  Usually once a day.

column9: Just as good as Nabob, my other favorite
column10: I like this coffee as well.  I keep it and Nabob on hand.  Read my review for Nabob and get more details.  Kenco has the international smoothness that I can only get with Nabob and Kenco.  The Kenco cup is a small cupper, though.  It's not a full cup like Nabob.  It is lighter than Nabob and makes a creamier coffee than Nabob.  I like them both.  I now reach for Kenco more than Nabob, because I am a small cup drinker and the flavor is great for those days when you want less caffeine in the morning and more taste.  Nabob and Kenco (and Gevalia Hazelnut for a strong falvored coffee that guests will enjoy).

The Kenco discs are good. The coffee is fine but the reason I gave it three stars is because I think these fall in the range of your good medium roast coffee but you may pay a little for the name. It brews a euro cup (smaller than a traditional American blend) that's solid, good flavor, and has a nice bite to it. But these aren't much different from the Maxwell House "House Blend" discs that brew more coffee for a less cost. It's nothing against Kenco. If you want these, buy them..it's good coffee. But for the cost/product ratio, I'd say you would be just as happy with Maxwell House.

The Kenco discs have a smooth taste.  I would consider it to be on the mild side.  If you like breakfast blends, you would most likely like this coffee.  If you like a bold or earthy taste, pick one of the Starbucks bold blends or the Maxwell House French Roast discs.

This is one of my favorite blends for the Tassimo.  In the morning I usually go with a stronger cup like Henry's Best, but as a daily cup I find this to be very satisfying.  I would equate it to the Dunkin Donuts of the Tassimo.

I really love this coffee, and my co-workers do too. All of them were so impressed at how smooth, non-acidic, yet full-bodied this is.  I've tried pretty much all the different T discs, and this is still my favorite. Try it, I'm sure you'll be pleased!
We really miss the Starbucks breakfast blend discs. I have tried most Tassimo products and none compare.Oh woe. Any word of new coffee blends coming?

Kenco coffee is good not great.I have just recently bought a tassimo machine and have been trying out different coffee's and tea's.This may be a hair above the maxwell house or about the same.So far my advice to you is to wait till the starbucks goes on sale (and it does quite often here on amazon and walmart) because thier house blend,breakfast blend and columbian are all really good.It seriously tastes like you went to a Starbucks and bought the coffee but at 1/3 the price!!!

Creamy, roasty goodness. Smoother than Nabob and more flavorful than Starbucks Houseblend.Compared to most other  t-discs, this is also a great value at less than 50 cents a cup. Yes, it is a smaller cup but it makes up for its size with quality.

I am a big fan of this product, its very good coffee.this is what I drink at work - its a smaller serving that standard American, but bigger than a Euro-shot. For me that is the perfect size, as its not so big that its get cold by the time I drink half of it.Its a very smooth, medium balanced coffee. Not too strong and not weak either. Perfect!Tassimo is the best coffee machine I have ever had, it is truly worth the purchase.

column9: Flavorful Mild Blend - Happily It's Nothing Like Starbucks
column10: If you like a really flavorful medium roast at a great price, this just might be the brew for you.Starbucks it ain't.If you're hooked on a huge cup of strong dark-roasted beans from the popular chain, you are very likely to dislike this subtle roast. Sorry!Portion SizeTassimo portion sizes run all the way from an ounce of potent Carte Noir Expresso to sixteen ounces of flavorful, but whimpy Nabob. This package makes a six ounce cup of coffee, which is my morning favorite - I can down it before heading off to work.PriceYou can currently buy this same blend in a three pack (that's three boxes of 16 disks for a total of 48 cups) Kenco Classic Blend from Amazon, in their Subscribe and Save program for less than you'd pay for this two pack. It's a no brainer to me.Get a Latte for LessI happen to like frothy, milky coffee confections some of the time, and can make something quick and easy for well under a buck. You can, too. Buy yourself the amazing and economical IKEA Milk Frother, add some skim milk to your freshly brewed espresso, heat it for about thirty seconds (experiment) in the microwave, and froth it up to your taste. Authentic? Heck no! Tasty, fun, and economical? You bet your beans.

The great selection of Starbucks coffees is one of the prime reasons I purchased a Tassimo machine. Kenco is alright if you like a mild brew but it lack the depth of flavor and robustness of a Starbucks blend. I miss my Starbucks!

column9: A great cup of regular coffee

I am going to make sure I stock up on these as they last a while and make a big cup. They are a great normal coffee (other than an espresso latte or machiatto)

column10: I purchased this for a snack for my toddler. I was shocked to discover the fruit is from China. Do your research, don't buy this!

The taste of this product is ok but not good.It is dehydrated so the texture is... well a dehydrated texture. The fruit taste mildly like the fruit they are suppose to be.If real fruit flavor is what you seek & fresh fruit is not an option, buy DRIED fruit instead of dehydrated.My concerns: I am reluctant to buy or eat any food product made in China. In 2008 all baby formula made in China was recalled due to dangerous contamination with poison chemicals, this was just a few years after a similar formula recall when it was discovered that Chinese made formula had substitued a chemical for the protein in formula & 10s of thousands or more babies were found to be sick or died from malnutrition.In 2007 all or nearly all Chinese manufactured Pet Food was recalled for the same reasons.Therefore I don't trust any food product made in China. If you like this product then eat it as junk food. In my opinion, no one should assume it is a healthy snack or a better choice than a candy bar or cookie.

column9: Yum!  My kids & I love these!
column10: After reading that dried apples, when eaten daily, can help lower cholesterol levels, I've been on the lookout for good dried apples.  I've tried different brands, and when we bought a variety pack of Brothers dried fruit crisps at a local store, we found our winner.  I just got on Amazon to see if I could find a better price here.My two year old and four year old have been devouring the pear and peach crisps.  I've been eating the apple ones...and my 9 month old baby has even been enjoying the broken bits of the apple ones.  These are an excellent, healthy snack.  They have the "crunch" you'd expect from a potato chip, so they have that snack-y appeal. Knowing they're all fruit, I love feeding them to my kids...and I love eating these, too!

I bought these because my son likes the freeze dried fruit that's available at grocery stores and wanted a little more variety and a better price.  These are very tasty.  My only complaint is that there are fewer strawberry/banana packets than the others, and of course they are my son's favorite.

column10: If your child is picky take note:  the apple and pear look the same but the strawberry & banana are in tiny pieces and are red colored. column9: YUM!!  Great for kids with sensory issues...but they are from China
column10: I have a 2-year-old daughter with some sensory issues which have greatly affected her eating.  She will not eat anything that doesn't feel or look right to her.  The only fruits she will eat is a whole apple (with half of the skin peeled off so that she can hold it from the side with the peel on, and eat from the peeled side!), and these freeze dried strawberries.  One package is just the right size...there is enough for her in the bag, but not so much that there are leftovers which get soggy.  I am so glad to have found another fruit for her to eat!  She will not touch real strawberries.My 4-year-old can't stay away from these strawberries and loves all of the other flavors we've tried, too.  She will down 3-4 bags a day if I let her.  And my husband, who is thrilled when he actually gets in one serving of fruit per day, will eat a bag if I put it in front of him or it ends up in his lunchbag.I love that I don't have to worry about strawberries getting moldy the day after I buy them, so I can stock up!EDIT:  Just found out these are from China.  Wouldn't buy them again...

column9: Tastes Great but concerned about manufacturing processes
column10: To be completely and 100% fair, I have tried this product before and enjoyed it. On their website they say they "source fresh fruit" and that " We are not concerned about issues surrounding where our product is produced because we take great care to ensure the quality and food safety of our products." With the history China has had with kid's toys/formula/etc in the past, let's just say we don't feed these products to our child. To be specific, these are sulfite-free, not to mention: gluten-free, vegan, nut/tree-nut safe, dairy free, Non GMO, and even Kosher.This particular variety contains three of my faves, so instead of ending up with 72 bags to get the entire assortment - I ordered the variety and got 24, a much more manageable number!Here's the rundown on what's in the packageStrawberry/Banana - contains 1 banana and about 4 strawberries. They are perfect for carrying in the car, sitting at a desk, hiking, backpacking, wherever you want an easy-to-grab healthy fruit snack.

column9: Tasty, no vitamins, made in China, deceptive packaging
column10: While these are tasty snacks, there is virtually no nutritional value in them.  A quick check of the label shows insignificant amounts of and vitamins, even vitamin C, in any of the varieties.  By insignificant, I mean less than 10% RDA.  That is far below what one might find in the claimed 1-1/2 apples or pears per package.  I will add that under ingredients, the only thing listed is the freeze-dried fruit on the label; there appear to be no additives, not even sugar, of any kind.  While they are not strictly bad for you, this snack certainly qualifies as empty calories.  Frankly you get more vitamins from a bag of potato chips.In addition, these are made in China, this is stated on each envelope.  Draw your own conclusions.Finally, the package counts are deceptive.  The subtexts often says "24 count".  Then in Amazon inset says "2 pack".  This leads a reasonable person to believe they are getting 2 24 packs for a total of 48 individual snack envelopes.  In fact these are sold in packs of 12 (TWELVE) and you get two of them for a total of 24.  I find this deceptive, or at best, confusing.[Update, May 2012:  It appears that the description of the item has been changed to avoid the confusion as to how many you are actually getting.]To conclude, these are tasty, the texture is good, there seems to be no odd ingredients, refined sugar or artificial stuff and the serving size is reasonable.  However, the utter absence of any nutritional value tells me that the process used to "freeze-dry" these seems different from other freeze-dry methods in that it is particularly destructive to nutrients.  I find the fact that they are made in China troubling.  Finally, the deceptive package counts found here in the product descriptions lead me not to purchase this again.  [Note my previous acknowledgement of the improved product count description.]

Ultra light weight and real live fruit, a great combination. The fruit is freeze dried, for those of you that remember space ice cream, it is the same idea. The fruit is sliced and placed in a machine that freezes the fruit and then a vacuum pulls off the water. The process retains a lot of the original flavor and preserves the fruit for almost eternity (well about two years expiration date on the pouches) without using any chemicals.The taste is really nice. These are all crisp fruit pieces, not the gummy fruit leather food. Banana / Strawberry is probably the tastiest and most fragile. The strawberry flavor is strong and the bananas are subtle without picking up the strawberry flavor. Apples come in a nice second. The pieces are thick and about two inches in diameter. The pears are good, maybe a touch tart and have the same texture as the apples.The fruit is completely dry and absorbs water in your mouth very quickly. If you eat it too fast, the strawberries coat your teeth a little bit. The others are very clean to eat.I like these packages in my carryon bag for plane trips. They make a great emergency snack, take up little space, and weigh nothing. Number two son packs these in his lunch almost every day now. He likes the strawberry banana the best. I really like all three flavors.The pouches list that they are a product of China. I list that as information so you can be aware of where this fruit comes from, and make no value judgment for you. The manufacturing process has been around for a very long time. It is a very safe process, and as long as the fruit going in is good, the food should be good. So far every pouch has been consistently good.I like these a lot. They make a great snack.

Not that crisp and more like styrofoamy.Strawberry and banana: Banana crisps are great, sweet and crunchy and the strawberry is just tangy.The problem I had was not so much with the taste but the meager portion sizes in each bag. I'd say each contained literally only a handful of dried fruit and considering the packaging and cost, its not very environmentally or economically (for us anyways) friendly. I guess, for kids this would be a perfect but I need something with a little more substance.

I can't say enough good things about this product.  We originally found individual bags of fruit crisps at our local supermarket, and were paying almost $2 a bag because my almost-two-year-old son loved them so much.  What a find on Amazon, a pack of 24 for so cheap!  We subscibed and saved.Less mess and more portablt than fresh fruit, better than a "fruit snack" or salty snack, and easy for little ones to chew.  Not enough strawberry and banana in the variety pack, we run out of them first, but my son loves all the flavors!!
The apple flavour is the best out this whole pack. The banana feels sort of bizarre. And the pear has no flavour what so ever.
i bought asian pear, peaches and fuji apple and was very disappointed.they had no flavor, just like eating cardboard. i have tried others and find kirkland from costco to be very good.
The dried fruit are very tasty. The individual pkgs are handy and convenient. Great for people on the go. I recommend this product.

I got these snacks when I was searching for the Veggie Straws.  They LOOKED tasty.  However, I didn't care for the consistency.  Since they are called "crisps" I assumed they would be crunchy...like chips.  But instead they dissolve in your mouth...kind of like party mints.  I cancelled my subscription and gave the packages that I had to someone else to try.  Lesson learned.

I was not sure what the product would taste like, since it had to be ordered, and I was looking for natural fruit that I could enjoy and would be like a "melt in your mouth" type of dried fruit. This product was EXCELLENT in what I was wanting and the taste was just as awsome, I would let anyone know that if they are looking for a dried fruit with all the natural taste of fruit, this is it. I have never had a problem with any orders from Amazon
This is a great tasting healthy product, I would recommend to anyone looking for a all natural healthy snack. Would defenetly buy again.

Based on the recommendation of my sister-in-law I ordered a couple of boxes of the Brothers-all-natural fruit crisps.  I also ordered the Kirkland brand as well.  I would have to say that I prefer the cheaper Kirkland brand over the more expensive Brothers brand.  I am not sure if the Brothers brand is supposed to taste stale or not but at least two of the packages that I have tried have tasted stale and not crisp as advertised.  The expiration date on the individual packages is 01-06-14 which leads me to believe that this brand either taste this way or I just got a bad batch.  Nonetheless, I will stick with the Kirkland brand and just chalk this one up as a loss.
These snacks are delicious and good for you. Easy to grab a bag quickly and go. The flavors are great and low calorie.
not at all whay I expected- was worse than foam when you put it in your mouth- will not buy again

Just ordered these in hopes to add to my healthy snack alternatives and they are better than imagined! Great taste and texture and guilt-free. Even my husband was surprised how tasty these crisps are. Low in sugar and great ingredient list (truly just the fruit!) Great job!

column9: Apple chips are good, strawberry/banana not so much
column10: These apple chips taste good and are good for you.  My 19 month old loves them.  She won't eat regular apples, but will eat these.  The strawberry ones are very tart.  I didn't like them.  The banana chips are kind of hard.  The pear chips were also good, just like the apples.

I really enjoy the Fuji apple and Asian Pear and each pouch is the equivalent of 1.5 pieces of fruit. Some pieces do get crushed, but the majority are good size pieces.Personally, I do not like the strawberry/banana. The pieces are too small and there is an odd taste to them (The item lost its star for the strawberry/banana).You do pay a premium, as compared to most fresh fruit, but you don't have to worry about the fruit going bad.I recommend this pack to pick your favorite fruit and then order that one individually.
my 3.5 yo toddler is a very picky eater. However, he loves the Apple and Pear dry fruits! He can eat 3 bags as snack.

These fruit snacks are an excellent way to get fruit into your diet.  I'm a diabetic and a one bag serving is about 8-10 grams of carbs and that is it.  Because the carb count is so low, I do not need insulin and the effect on my blood sugar is negligable.  I know a low of people are upset that these are made in China, but for my purposes, they could be made in Saskatchewan for all I care.  I need the health benefit that the fruit provdies without all the carbs and if this works, I'll take it.  I buy these from Costco for a slightly cheaper price than Amazon offers them for (but not much).

These snacks are individually wrapped and easy to put in lunches.  My kids love them.  The price is great too compared to other brands we have used in the past.  A good "fruit" to have around and you don't have to worry about it spoiling.
My daughter really enjoys these healthy little snacks. They also do not make a mess, which is great for me.

I ordered these freeze-dried snacks after I found a similar product in the grocery store and loved them. Unfortunately, at nearly $2 a bag at the store, it quickly became a luxury expense. I decided to try these from Amazon because they were considerably less expensive than the in-store brand, and had great ratings. I was not disappointed! These are fantastic little snacks that are neat, convenient and healthy. So easy to throw into my lunch bag or stash in my car on long trips. I love the strawberry-banana and the apple flavors. You can really see and taste the quality of the fruits they use. These little 40-calorie bags will absolutely be replacing my afternoon potato chip habit, at a FRACTION of the calories.  If you're hesitant about trying these -- don't be! These are a new staple in my household.

column9: Love the product - Amazon is too expensive
column10: Awesome ChipsWish Amazon weren't this expensive. You can get the Variety 24 back for about $13 from Costco.

When heat and humidity wreak havoc on fresh fruit and you must spend a day outdoors, these snacks really fit the bill!  My children love to take them to summer camp (and pack them for school lunches!); when they eat together, they share pieces of the different fruits to experience a crispy "fruit salad"
These are great snacks for the everyone. They taste great! they are great to have in your purse and kids love them.

They are a healthy convenient snack. Very easy to keep in purse, car, desk drawer and they have a nice texture and crisp to them. For such few calories it is a nice snack, the apples and pears are really good. It is really difficult to find 100% natural dried fruit like this brand as most have added sugars or HFCS which seems crazy because these are plenty sweet on their own!
All 3 flavor packs are very tasty and low calories.  They travel well & are not crumbly like some of their competitors.  I would buy this again.

column9: Great snack when fresh fruit isn't an option
column10: I can't stand the thought of feeding my daughter processed, sugary snacks that lack nutrients. I give her fresh fruit and vegetables as often as possible. These are perfect for stocking the diaper bag so she can have an impromptu snack. I try everything I give her because if I won't eat it, I won't make her eat it. I love these! The apple is probably my favorite. The banana does leave a strange after taste but that's to be expected.I saw a review that said they only received a 12 pack but I didn't have that problem. Theyre packaged in a 12 pack but I was sent 2 of them. I received these very quickly too.Overall, a great product.

column9: Great taste,even little ones like it
column10: I bought these on a Friday sale and thought that maybe my daughter would enjoy a bag as a snack. I received the correct pack size as stated. Upon arrival I gave my daughter a bag and she loved them. She has liked all of the various flavors. i tried them myself and they have a really good flavor for dried fruits. I will be buying more once she has eaten these...recommended.
These are a great and easy way for getting all your fruit servings. Also great for dieters on the go. They are much better than more traditional dried fruits.

I just received these today.  I immediately opened one of the packages to give it a try.  I am impressed with just how flavorful these freeze-dried fruits are.  They have a satisfying crunch, like a chip, but so much better for you than potato chips.  I had ordered these to send in soldier care packages, which I still intend to do, but I'm ordering several more boxes for personal use.  These will be great to add to my work lunch everyday, instead of those single-serving size potato chips.  You get 2 boxes of 12 packages with this product.

These were so delicious! I really like the strawberry banana the best but the pear and apple are so good too. These are great healthy and just the treat I was looking for on the go. I am definitely reordering.

I usually don't care for freeze dried fruit, but these are in a class by themselves.  They are cored and PEALED, and melt in your mouth delicious.  The same company makes the same product in separately decorated bags.  Mickey Mouse Clubhouse for Kids and Crisps for adults.  They are the exact same product, so if one is unavailable, you can purchase the other.  My favorite is Apple.  If you do purchase these, buy them through Amazon, as they sell them cheaper than the grocery store. These are really yummy and good for you too.  I am a grandmother, and this wonderful treat was introduced to me by my grand daughter.

A tasty & healthy desk snack, will tame a sweet tooth.My box at home is kept where my 2 year old granddaughter can get at it and she seems to find it yummy as well.I have tried the pear and apple which I love and my little one loves the peach as well
My whole family loves these freeze dried packs -- they are convenient for travel, and taste great.
My 20 month old son can't get enough of these. We keep a box in the car for emergencies.

column9: very yummy my kids loved these
column10: These were wonderful! Everyone in my house loved them.  They were great for a snack at home or on the go.

We got these [...] for $7 a box which was a great price!  My daughter is 1.5 yrs old and she LOVES them.  When we ask her what she wants for a snack she says "Ap-ple"  It is great, she gets a full serving of fruit and there is nothing in them that is bad for her. I think that the prices here seem high, however when you take into account that each bag has one whole apple, you would pay that amount for fresh produce and end up throwing out some of it anyways.  My daughter easily finishes an entire bag and what she doesn't we can save for the next day.  WE LOVE these apples!
These are the perfect little crunchy snack to pick you up just a bit.  My son loves them and I think they are a great  lo-cal snack.

i bought it for my son. He absolutely loves the stawberry flavor. since we could only get this flavor in combination with other flavors in stores, I started searching the internet and found it at Amazon.

Just got these and they are delicious! Crunchy through and through, which is hard to find with "dehydrated" fruits. Sweet, and tart, and crunchy, and oh so good. Also love that they come in individual packs--perfect for kids' lunches & car trips. At just over 80 cents a pack, it's a pretty good value for an all-natural yummy snack!
My sister and I both really like these and we have purchased several cases so far.  The individual packs make it easy to take them along for lunch or put them in a purse for a snack on the road.
They are very light and not super filling, a great between meals snack or with lunch.
I alternate between bobs red mill light spelt and this one for making sourdough bread. I'm happy with the results of both.
This is a very good product for baked goods - have used for coffee cakes, pancakes and muffins. I just wish the package explained what is "lite" about it.

In my area, Goo Goo Clusters are no longer sold so I can't describe how happy I was to find this product on Amazon. They were kept nice and cold with an ice pack within the box, and are, of course, absolutely delicious. Love 'em!

GooGoo Clusters have been made in Nashville,TN since their origin. I live in Cookeville,TN about 80 miles east.  Although we are a university city, we do not have a local outlet for the candy. Delighted to be able to have it available from Amazon!
Orbit gum has a true flavor, not artificial tasting, and retains the flavor longer.

Yes, ALL Wrigley's Gums, even the ones with SUGAR, now contain at least ONE, (and many contain two or all of them) ASPARTAME, ACESULFAME-K, SUCRALOSE!WHY a gum with Sugar needs these dangerous chemical sweeteners is a mystery to me, but since they changed the logo of the packages on their gum, you can no longer buy any Wrigley's (or most other brands too) gum without one or more of these nasty chemical additives.Also note that Sucralose (AKA brand name Splenda) is NOT the same thing as Sucrose! (Sugar)  The slight spelling difference is to decieve those that read ingredient labels to think they are reading Sucrose and not notice it is Sucralose.Sucralose causes severe abdominal pain, so if you have had that after chewing gum, now you know why.Aspartame has dozens of books and thousands of websites explaining what is wrong with that, as well as the other one.Very sad that I never again will get to enjoy my childhood favorites of Wrigley's Spearmint, Juicy Fruit or Big Red ever again.

I brought these at Sam's Club at the holidays - 2009.  I have never seen them again and check every store I go too.  Where are they now???  They were just like you make at home but better - not so many crumbs and each piece was perfectly covered.

I found a bag of these at our lake cabin over the 4th of July and oh my goodness! They are out of this world. Best things I've tasted in a quite a while and now, for the life of me, I can't find them!!!!!If you come across them - buy them! you might think that you don't like the peanut butter/chocolate combo (I don't) but this is such a subtle masterpiece sprinkled with a delicate powdered sugar coating.....hmmmmm

One of the greatest snacks I've ever had in my entire life. Before, I usually only ate the occasional bag of Hot Cheetos® and thought it couldn't get any better than that, but I was dreadfully wrong. Ever since my first Mud Buddy(tm), I've gotten out of my deep depression, gotten a girlfriend, and learned the old and complex art of pancake crafting. Did any other snacks do that for me? No, just Mud Buddies(tm). Thank you Chex®, for making this once seemingly worthless life have a new breath again!

Love Muddy Buddys, just need to know where I can buy them besides Sam's Club, of which I'm not a member.  Been to 3 different grocery stores, a Walgreens and CVS, no one knows what I'm asking for.  Just love those little things, but can't find them! help!

column9: SUPER HEALTHY DOG FOOD AT GREAT PRICE!
column10: My toy poodles are older now and some are losing teeth so I have to go to canned dog food to supplement their Bil-Jac. They really loved the Happy Hips and Canidae Dog Food and they are great but  I was looking for something as good for them but also a little more cost effective since I have so many poodles...11 of them!  Good thing they are well mannered and trained! A case of 24 cans of "CS For The DLS"  is the price of most cases of 12 cans with other brands. The ingredients are top notch with this one too. [...]One of my tinniest ones, Baby Doll,  gets so excited  and lets out one big yelp whenever we pop open the top tab then she does this little dance around on her back two feet.  It is so cute! I also like that these cans have the pop top lid so I do not have to use the can opener.  I know, the epitome of laziness!  It is a nice feature though.The 4-5 lb. dogs get mostly all can dog food now as their teeth are sooo little.  This canned dog food is specially formulated for seniors but I would guess from reading the ingredients, it could be for all ages. does not have lots of watery juice to take up space but more of a soft/solid form. My larger dogs, up to 12 lbs get mostly the  Bil-Jac mixed with canned.  I mix about half a can with a little water to their Bil-Jac dry food and they graze and eat it up as they feel like it.  This keeps them in shape. They tend not to over eat when they know food is always available. I have always fed my dogs this way and it has always worked. I am going to add glucosamine to it for their hips as a few have problems with hips at their old age.  It is easy to do, just google correct dosage for them then crumble pills and add. Since I have so many dogs, I mix (hide) all meds in a teaspoon with the canned dog food and give it to them individually.I would also like to say that if you have small dogs and /or dogs with problem with their teeth, it is difficult for them to chew the harder kibble. If this happens they will just quit eating except when absolutely necessary and do harm to their health due to tooth pain. Bil-Jac is the only food I have found in dry form with the tiny kibbles which are easily crumbled. There are also dog aspirin formulas you can add, sneak in, to canned food for pain. Don't use unbuffered aspirin for dogs as it is hard on their stomachs. I also add Dr. Katz's water additive to prevent and help tooth and gum problems.My dogs are on an antibiotic regimen ounce a month, first 10 days of month, to help prevent infection from gum disease.  They also have allergies. I was using Benedryl ( at Vet's recommendation) but after researching Zyrtec (generic form), for dogs, I am using that and it works wonders for their allergies. All of the a things I give my dogs are  available on Amazon for a fraction of the price at the drug store. Please, if you are going to use Benedryl , Zyrtec or any other medication on your dog and cannot afford to go to to the vet, research it completely before doing so and make sure you have the dosage down carefully so you do not harm, or even kill, your pet. It is a very serious undertaking to medicate your dog on your own but can be of tremendous benefit to your pet if you know what you are doing, so research, research, research before doing it!You may ask why I don't take my dogs to the vet for tooth cleaning.  Well, their  are several reasons; one the cost, of course, but the most important is that I do not want my little ones subjected to anesthesia once a year as it is dangerous, hard on their hearts and can cause other problems and even death.  I just make sure they are as pain free and as comfortable as possible in their later years, now.Sorry, I got a little side-tracked!Anyway, I highly recommend this dog food.  I am grateful the price is so reasonable so I can afford to feed my dogs this good food.Blessings!

My 13+ dog has lost her taste for most foods, and lost an alarming amount of weight.  I went through brand after brand of highly rated, expensive foods and each time, my dog took a sniff and walked away.I had my doubts about this dog food, but I bought a can of the adult formula at my local store, and my dog ate the whole thing.  So I ordered a case of the senior formula, and she has been enjoying it ever since!What a relief, thank goodness that I discovered this food!

My dogs love this food, and it's a very healthy food that fits a senior dog's needs.  I have dogs with sensitive stomachs, and this food has been perfect for them.  They are not having any digestive issues at all, and I know they are getting the best food for their age.

All of my dogs seem to thrive on this food. I have 3 Miniature Pinschers and a Doxi-Chi mix. Someone recently told me they don't know what I do for my dogs as they sure live a long life! My oldest MinPin is over 15 yrs. now and he gets around good despite poor sight and hearing. I have fed them Chicken Soup for years and I HIGHLY RECOMMEND it.  It is a reasonable cost for food that contains quality ingredients with no grains or other fillers.

column9: Chicken Soup for the Dog Lovers Soul
column10: WOW---wait till you open the first can. This dog food smells so good and my dogs love it.I have two Pekingese, one very senior, blinde and I think he can barely smell and a Pug with three legs and my other Peke. They get so excited when they smell the Chicken Soup coming.My very senior dog can tell when it is being served by the other two dogs clicking around on my wooden floors. He hears them and goes for his dish. A great Doggie success at my house.

column9: Won't use any other dog food anymore
column10: We have a 90 pound dog that is 11 years old. We thought that it was just age causing him to cough and spit-up a lot. He also did not go to the bathroom regularly and often was "in a hurry" to get out. Since we started feeding him this dog food, along with Beneful dry food (mixed), both problems have gone away. He really likes the food and seems to feel better.  We give him the Adult formula. We tried the Senior formula, which is almost the same as Adult, but we found that he was happier with the Adult formula.
This food gets pretty good reviews as a medium priced, good quality food. Our dogs seem to love it and it's helped the one with chronic allergy problems.

column9: Great Quality Pet Food, Dogs Love it!
column10: The ingredient list for this product is superb.  The first five ingredients list:  "Chicken, turkey, chicken broth, duck, salmon, chicken liver, ..."  I love that it has so much meat and not wheat.  Pick up a competitors can & read those first five ingredients!  The price is also incredibly lower than other gourmet or premium dog foods as well.  I would have preferred to not order the cans for Senior Dogs, but that is what Amazon had and that's what I ordered.  The dogs gobble it up and they have not had any gastric issues with this food.  I believe in holistic food for humans & pets, and this product belongs on that list.

I tried this food for my 11 year old beagles.  They loved it.  The ingredients are great.  I switched back from Natural Balance.  The dogs prefer the "Chicken Soup" food to the Natural Balance.  Even though this food costs less, it looks better, smells better, has quality ingredients and my dogs prefer it.  When I switched back they dove into their food with gusto I had not seen in a while.  Great product.  I highly recommend it.

I ordered this dog food for one of my Jack Russell's who was having issues with his dry dog food since the dog food company reformulated the brand that I normally use.  This food has basic, wholesome ingredients and my dog gets excited when he sees the can and he gobbles it up.  The price is also reasonable, considering that Amazon is shipping this for free.  I will definitely order this again.

column9: My dog was not crazy about it....although great value for dogs who like it
column10: My 10 year old husky doesn't go crazy when he smells it like he did with the Blue Buffalo food...The only reason I tried to switch him to do is because its a really great value, you basically get double the amount of cans for the same price, but I think I'll be going back to Blue Buffalo or maybe Wellness and just stick with them.On another note, I found the food filled with maggots one day, I havent had that issue with any other food, but I'm guessing it was just because it was a hot day and the food was left out.Also, i got the dry food with it, and I noticed when the food gets wet a bit from water or if the food gets a bit old, it has a really strong and bad odor...again I never noticed that with the other brands...

Just started my older dog on this and she LOVES this food.  And I must say, it LOOKS and SMELLS good to me (not stinky like some dog food). I LOVE the healthy ingredient list.  Just wish the cans were a bit bigger (they are only 13 oz).  But I will definately be ordering more!

column9: taste okay but the price..? lol
column10: Really dumb to show a photo of the package saying 2 for a dollar and then the title says 2 for 2 dollars is the original price..?  Then call it a manager's special when it's obviously marked up?  Good grief people.  They sell these at my gas station.  Cheap and dryer/harder than normal gummy worms and not many in the package.  This package looks generous compared to what I'm used to.  They are literally 2 for a dollar regular price so don't pay this silly, pretend "discounted manager's special" price.

I bought this because I wanted to give my kids the experience of blowing a SUPER bubble. I grew up in Southern CA and I remember buying this gum for 3 cents a piece. The good thing is you can chew this for about an hour until it gets gross. Plenty of time to make multiple bubbles. The sad thing is this package was hard as a rock ,not bad after you chew it down for 15 min. But would of liked it to be a bit fresher!
The bag said it had assorted flavors, but there was only about 10 of the apple flavor, which is kid of dissapionting

I didn't like this Chai very much.  Perhaps it is because it is green tea instead of black in the mix.  I drink organic gunpowder green tea almost every day, but green tea in Chair just doesn't suit my taste.

I bought this for my sister as a gift for her Keurig.  She and her husband fell in love with it. When I tried it, it had the same effect on me. Its the perfect level of bold and rich. Unfortunately, its hard to find a large box of it at the grocery store, if you can find it at all. So glad I found it on Amazon!

I bought these for my college class that was reading 'Rocket Boys' because Moon Pies are mentioned.  I thought the students would get a better idea of that time period.  The pies bordered on stale and the students did not like the banana flavor.  I would order again hoping that they would be fresher.

Growing up in the south, Moon Pies were such a part of our childhood tradtions.  Now my children love to share in the tradition and absolutely loved it when I purchased this variety pack with all the different flavors!  Great Value and so happy to know I can look to Amazon to find my favortie brands.
THE SMELL WAS BETTER THAN THE TASTE. THE TASTE WAS GOOD BUT IF IT WOULD HAVE TASTED THE WAY IT SMELLED THAT WOULD HAVE BEEN GREAT.

The best taste and I don't have to feel guilty.  Only 35 calories and fat free!!  I can't live without my fat free cappuccino.  It tastes just like the other version only without the guilt!!!  I love it!

The way this item was displayed in Amazon made it look like I was getting a 3-pack of the cappuccino for $25.00.  Instead, I was charged $25.00 each for a total of $75.00!  This is way too much for the product and I am highly disappointed that Amazon allowed this kind of misleading information.

column9: Saves a lot of calories and money
column10: This might not be as great as the coffee down at your local cafe or Starbuck's but it is the next best thing, low in calories and fat. With all the calories you save, you can dress it up with your own cocoa powder on top and still be ahead of the game. Buying in bulk means saving even more money. Just keep in mind that the pack will be half milk discs and half coffee discs so it will be more expensive than buying just straight coffee. You might want to use only half the milk disc by brewing two cups and then splitting it.  Some people find Gevalia bitter, but it is certainly better than Maxwell House. I love the House Blend Starbuck's discs myself, with one of these creamers. Still a fraction of what you have to pay in a shop. Enjoy!

Even though the picture shows "Gevalia" brand coffee discs, and even though that's what the product is called, it's actually Maxwell House Brand. The seller at least emailed me to let me know that (after of course the product was already on its way).The product itself isn't that great. The milk discs don't always work correctly and it doesn't taste nearly as good as most of the other Tassimo drinks.

column9: Not very friendly in my machine
column10: I've tried numerous creamers in my Tassimo and thought why not save a few calories.  Well I won't try it again.  Every time I used it there was at least 1/3 of it left in the disc, it didn't 'foam' and created a mess when you remove it.  I don't know why because all the other creamers I've tried worked fine.  I won't be buying this again.

I ordered the skim version of this product thinking it would cost me less Weight Watchers points. Well, it certainly accomplished that goal but the product is almost undrinkable. Thin and watery to an extreme. I find it hard to believe that they can't come up with a skim product comparable to the excellent skim cappuccino's available at Starbucks and Caribou. I would return this product if it wasn't such a bother. I can't believe this product made it through product development. Do yourself a favor and don't repeat my mistake in ordering this product.
I was so excited when I saw the "skinny" version of these.  Now I am waiting for them to make skinny lattes!

column9: Best chips around for protein and iron
column10: 31 chips in a serving and I have to count them out or I'll eat the entire bag and have all 4 servings at once!  This is an outstanding product that only suffers from having more sodium than I usually consume.  Regardless, the light, crisp, dippable, scoopable, stuffable snacks are now the favorites of my family and friends.  When I find a product that I like, I tend to give it as gifts so that others can enjoy my discoveries.  Simply 7 Lentil Chips, Sea Salt, 4-Ounce (Pack of12) is my personal favorite variety, seconded by the Simply 7 Lentil Chips, Creamy Dill, 4-Ounce (Pack of12).  I'm not sold yet on the Simply 7 Lentil Chips, Bruschetta, 4-Ounce (Pack of12) variety, but many of my friends prefer the Italian seasonings.  The chips remind me of mini pappadams.  These are so simple to slip into the mouth and kids adore them, too.  If you're looking for a new healthier savory snack, I don't think you can go wrong with these.  It's amazing just how tasty lentils can be!

I wanted to let everyone know that these lentil chips with a touch of sea salt are wonderful.  I was a tad skeptical at first but once I tried them I was hooked.  It is truly a yummy snack that any health nut would love.

I love chips, so when I was looking for a healthier option - I found these. They are yummy! And are a lot less calories and fat than regular chips. I would recommend them to anyone liking to snack but wants to eat a little healthier.
I love these chips.  It's great to have some choice and variety in snack foods. I do think this flavoring is too salty, though.  I want to try all the flavors soon!
I did a first time order in may. They came in a good time frame. They taste great and the texure is wonderful.
These chips are delicious. The bag feels very light but they are quite dense when you bite into them. Perfectly salty, great flavor, perhaps a little greasy but only after eating way too many.
These are crispy, tasty and very much lighter than potato or corn chips.  I have ordered both sea salt and creamy dill - hard to say which is the favorite, they're both so good.

Tried these the first time a few months ago, and I was hooked! I have purchased two cases within the last 2 months, and shared them with my family. The last case I just bought is gone, and I am ready to buy another case.  Only problem is, the price for the sea salt (my favorite) increased within the last week, which is disappointing.  I am wondering why the other flavors are the exact price that I paid for but the sea salt is higher???  I am hoping this will change so I can buy them soon.

After purchasing different brands of pills and treats containing glucosamine and chondroitin sulfate, I stumbled upon this brand. Initialy, I purchased their "chews". A short time later they discontinued the chews so I began purchasing the biscuits instead. ****Tazo's Wild Sweet Orange Herbal Infusion is a nice orange herbal tea. It contains lemongrass, blackberry leaves, citric acid, rose hips, spearmint leaves, natural flavors, orange peel, safflowers, hibiscus flowers, rose petals, natural orange essence, ginger root and licorice root. It is not sweet, very fruity, and not subtle at all, a wonderful tea if you enjoy orange-y teas.Tazo is an interesting company that makes only super premium teas. They are socially responsible, based in Portland, and have the motto, "The Reincarnation of Tea". Tazo is owned by Starbucks. Their web site is fun and quirky, with a Zen-type focus, definitely worth checking out. It is unclear, though, from their web site, how many of their ingredients are organic or kosher, and they do use some "natural flavors" in their teas--this wording seems a little vague for a super premium tea.On the paper tea packet, Tazo writes, "a lively blend of sweet citrus herbs and orange essences. Sweet, yet tart, this is a cup of liquid sunshine, radiating multi-layered orange flavors with exotic hints of spice and a distinctive floral finish. Wild, indeed." On their web site, Tazo describes the flavor profile of Wild Sweet Orange as "tart, sweet, smooth, licorice". Tazo describes the aroma as "oranges, roses, lime". This is pretty accurate, although the words give hope that the taste of the tea never quite approaches.I would rate this tea, and Tazo in general, as good---better than premium teas like Stash or Celestial Seasonings---but not as good as Numi. I'm spoiled by Numi teas, which is why Tazo Wild Sweet Orange gets only four stars.****

This is the story of two Tazo teas. I found that they almost need one another to produce a tea of exceptional quality.I tried each tea separately and finally blended them together. Tazo Lotus and Tazo Wild Sweet Orange make a wonderful lemony hot tea in the winter or enjoy being tossed about with ice cubes in the summer.The way I make this tea is by steeping two Lotus and two Wild Sweet Orange filterbags with 16 ounces of water. I make this in my coffee maker so there is plenty of time for the flavors to seep out into the steaming water. Then, you can add 2 tablespoons of orange blossom honey for hot tea and a bit more for ice tea.Drinking this blend is an aromatic experience. Lotus Decaffeinated Green tea is a blend of naturally decaffeinated green tea, natural lotus flower flavor and other natural flavors. Wild Sweet Orange is a blend of lemongrass, blackberry leaves, citric acid, rose hips, spearmint leaves, natural flavors, orange peel, safflowers, hibiscus flowers, rose petals, natural orange essence, ginger root and licorice root.I love the crinkly sound of the paper bags protecting the precious contents. The boxes are also quite intriguing and the stories on the tea packets are always mysterious and playful.A romantic tea with a golden-orange color. I can never decide if I like this best hot or cold, so I end up drinking it hot and cold. Half on ice and half in a mug. When this tea is hot, it is much more romantic and aromatic. When chilled it takes on a more bitter component.For something even more exotic, try the Tazo Green Ginger tea. That was the first Tazo tea I tasted and so far I can't think of a Tazo tea I don't love.~The Rebecca Review

column9: How to Keep Brown Sugar Soft

This is one of the gluten free flours I have a hard time finding locally. For the price, you can't beat just buying it on Amazon!  It is fresh and consistent, as all Bob's Red Mill products are.  Sweet White Rice flour is NOT the same as White Rice flour, and you can mess up a recipe by not using the right one.  Sweet White Rice flour is from short grain rice, which is much more "glutinous" (sticky), so it will definitely respond differently in a recipe than White Rice flour, which is from less sticky long grain rice.

I know I can get Asian sweet rice flour somewhat cheaper, and I've tried it.  It comes in boxes that don't reseal or in flimsy plastic bags that I find somewhat difficult to handle.  I find the Bob's Red Mill sweet rice worth the small difference in price.  I trust their products, and the bags are the same as those for their other GF flours - a nice size, and a shape that isn't difficult to handle - I can stand one up on the counter while measuring from it, and don't spill flour all over the place.

So yes.  You could get cheaper flour from your neighborhood China town.  The cost is the only reason why its 4 and not 5 stars.  But Bob's glutinous rice flour is a typical Bob product:  high quality.  You will not be disappointed with this flour.

You can't buy Sweet Rice Flour this affordably in stores, and for the smooth texture it brings to gluten-free baking, it's worth investigating.  Blended with other supportive flours, sweet rice flour is likely the one gluten-free flour with a texture as smooth as traditional wheat-based baking.  It has a mild, sweet flavor, and Bob's Red Mill products are consistent and dependable.  Will buy again!

It's there but it doesn't affect our enjoyment of the beverage at all.I'm so impressed with both the machine and the chai latte that I bought another one for the office. I figure after about two months of use, the machine will have paid for itself in savings from the chai lattes I buy everyday at the office.One piece of advice, give the beverage a quick stir before you drink it. It really helps to even out the flavours.Highly recommended.****EDIT****One thing I forgot to add, I'm feeling a bit guilty about the environment. The T Discs come into a foil bag, the discs themselves are good solid chunks of non-recyclable plastic and the left-over contents in the disc are not easily removed for say composting. Tassimo, if you are listening, encourage your beverage providers to go green.

This chai smells delicious which makes how it tastes all the more dissappointing.  It is way too sweet and it tastes faintly metallic.  Hard to explain.  I wish they'd update the formula because I love chai latte.

I have tried many Chai teas and this is among the best.  Since I have a Tassimo machine it just makes sense to buy this.  It comes with the cream and I put FL honey in it.  Oh................so good.  I had strep throat this week and this was all that would go down my throat.  Now, even though I'm better, I have a cup every night.  Excellent!

Twinings Chai Tea is Mediocre compared to your local cafe, book store or StarBucks, or in Asia. Just about all of the FORMER StarBucks Coffee's,and Cappuccino's were near perfect from the Tassimo Bosch machine. StarBucks is no longer available, so I'm currently trying a Keurig.At least I can still use the Milk Creamer.* The Tassimo Creamer is real Milk that has been 'ultra-pasteurized' which gives it a longer shelf life ... this is what the rest of the World offers, just wished that we could get these products in the US, instead of Powdered Milk!* My Rating is like 2.5 to 3.0.* For Chai, I'd rather drive downtown.

column9: Smells good but the taste sucks
column10: I bought this product as a replacement for Starbucks chai. But it is awful and taste horrible. Not that the Starbucks chai is any better. Waste of money if you know the real taste of chai. It is nowhere close to the taste of chai for real chai lover.

column9: Twinings Chai Tea Latte from Amazon
column10: I absolutely love my T-disc Twinings Chai Tea Latte. I have a cup just about every day, whenever I am relaxing while reading a book on my Ipad. It's not cheap, but it sure is better than paying $4.23 at Starbucks.
This has become my favorite, I love it. I didn't know it had sucralose in it until i read the reviews but that doesn't ruin it for me like with the other reviewers. I think it taste great.
Tassimo increased the price for this pack of 2 Twinnings Chai form $19.98 to $34.98. I will go to BBB and return my Tassimo brewer. Tassimo, I hope you go bankrupt.

I dont know what some of the other reviewers are talking about but this is SO good!  Unless you hate splenda I would imagine you would love this as much as me.  There is a hint of sweetness to it, such a small hint I added my own packet of splenda as well.  This is one of my favorite drinks.  It's creamy and has the perfect blend of spices, I am IN LOVE with this one!!!  The perfect blend of everything, pure bliss in a cup.
Thank you for being so prompt in sending this item to me.  It came very quickly and was in excellent shape.

I love this chai tea and can't get enough , it is strong as it should be , maybe a little bit to sweet but this is the way it should be sweet and spicy .. I love it with the latte milk and also without , If I do without I run the Tassimo chai disc 2 -3 times and is still fine ..but chai like espresso need to be strong for the original taste ...  one of the best product for me they made

column9: So good it should be illegal!
column10: Wow this stuff is crazy good, well worth the price!  I am torn between this and the Jacobs latte.  Love it!

This is one of the best Chai Tea lattes I've had. One word of caution, though: DO NOT add any water to the mix. Normally, with the Tassimo system, you can add water at the end of a brewing cycle if you don't want it as strong, want more, etc. DON'T do it with this. The traditional mix with chai tea is a 1:1 ratio with tea:milk. If you add water, it really tastes watery. If you just leave it, and let it do it's thing: brilliant.My husband hates coffee(I know, and I married him anyway), but has really started to like these. I ordered a small pack just to try them, and will be ordering them in a much larger case from now on.

I have gotten hooked on the Twinings Chai Tea Latte.  Just the right blend of spices.  I like it much better than Starbucks or Panera Chai Tea Latte  It is not always easy to find in stores so I was happy to find it on Amazon
I really enjoyed this chai latte.  Great taste, and love the creamer that runs thru the machine as well after the tea has brewed.  It comes out just like getting a latte from a barista.

I bought this chai tea when I got my tassimo machine and loved it. I then thought I could buy it online for a little cheaper. It's close to what I can get it for and Bed Bath & Beyond but I saved on tax and now gas to get there. Its just easier for me with such a busy schedule to get it shipped to the house. The stuff is AWESOME. I have some at night when I am winding down and absolutely love it.

If you are looking for the spiciness of Chai Tea Lattes comparable to those at Starbucks or Coffee Bean, you're not going to get it with these t-discs. It smells wonderful, but tastes very mild in terms of chai spice. Also as some of the other reviewers mentioned, there is a distinct aftertaste from the Splenda/sucarlose that is included in this drink. I don't like artificial sweeteners so this product was not a good fit for me. However, my husband likes the taste of the chai tea latte, probably because he's used to the taste of artificial sweeteners. Bottom line: if you can stand the taste of splenda/sucralose, give it a try; if not, skip this one.

some claimed it was bad b/c of the sucralose taste.  I am not a fan of splenda so I almost didn't try.  Saw it at the store and customized it by hitting the manual button b/f the milk was done and it tasted much better!!  I figured out it wasn't the splenda so much as it was watered down.  Try it!
I love the chai tea latte for Tassimo.  I save money and calories compared with Starbucks.  I think the taste is great!
This is now my favorite morning drink. The latte t-disks don't come with soy. So they aren't nearly sweet enough for me. But the Chai Tea Latte definitely is, and it's very tasty!

I generally dislike coffee, but we have a Tassimo in our home for guests to use. My wife also enjoys using it to make an occasional cup of coffee without having to make a pot. I've tried the hot chocolate T-Discs but found them to be somewhat wanting in terms of lacking a rich dark chocolate taste. So this time I thought I'd try the Chai Latte as I have enjoyed Chai in the past. While I generally don't add milk or cream to Chai, I went ahead and mixed this as instructed, using the tea disc first followed by the creamer disc.The overall taste is quite nice, with sufficient hues of the various spices and a richness of overall flavor without being too diluted from the creamer. It's easy, of course, to make the Chai stronger by simply clicking the appropriate button on the Tassimo just as you would with coffee, or by ignoring the creamer disc and adding your own fresh milk or cream in the quantity desired. The aftertaste of tea is just right - not so strong as to be overwhelming. There's some aftertaste from the sweetener, so I'm forced to agree with others here that Twinings should leave the sweetener out entirely and let us add our choice of sweetener if desired. I found that I could get around the overall taste of Splenda by adding about 1/8th teaspoon of sugar, but the product doesn't really demand extra sweetening. It is neither bitter nor overly sweet if left alone.I tried the Chai directly without the creamer and found it bitter; it is clear that the Chai mixture is really designed to be mixed with the sweetened creamer provided. Your thoughts may vary on this count. Realize that though you get 8 servings, you can get more if you like. The Chai disc, if utilized again promptly, will generate a second cup very much like the first. You'll need to add your own milk and sweetener as the milk disc works only once. Finally, the overall quantity of Chai generated with one combination of Chai/creamer is sufficient to fill a large mug. Although the Tassimo often makes cups of coffee that seem rather small, particularly if you like yours strong, the automatic settings for the Chai provide a good quantity of drink. So don't put a small mug on the stand and toddle off while your latte is being constructed.Overall, four stars - one deduction for the Splenda aftertaste.
I was surprise that it had a lot of flavor, and very similar to the one's sold in coffee shops. Great Value

We are hooked on this Tassimo t-disc Chai Latte.  With the Tassimo, you can make it as strong as you like.  Then, you can make one for your friend at the strength they like.  Gotta love the ease and great taste of Tassimo products.

Honestly, I don't understand the few murmurs here about this product being too sweet.  In fact, I think it is the perfect blend of the savory and sweet delicacies of a Chai Tea.  I have always been a fan of Chai Tea, but I must admit this may be my favorite I've tasted.  The reason being is that, on occasion, you'll order a Chai Tea and the spices used to give it that signature flavor are so overpowering it can take away from the joy of `drinking' something refreshing.  These spices are prevalent yet mild enough to allow the refreshing aspect of the tea to take center stage.  It has everything you'd want in product like this.  I was pleasantly surprised.  If I were to complain at all it would be that the serving size isn't big enough!  The creamer certainly gives this a latte feel, so keep that in mind.  I initially purchased this product expecting more of a tea product, but I immediately engulfed the idea of a latte beverage, so it didn't bother me at all; but if you are looking for strictly TEA then you may want to skip the creamer, or manually set your level of how much creamer you want in your tea.  Still, this product is FAR FROM overly sweet.  It is the right amount of sweet; the perfect winter drink!

I bought the machine to make coffee lattes. I love chai from the coffee shop but have not found much in the instant mixes I care for (only the one from Tastefully Simple) or the tea bags. This just blew me away. I am a diabetic so I need to keep the sugars low but don't care for a strong taste. This fit the bill perfectly. I think it is just as good as the cofffee shops and lower in sugar. What a win win. The chai alone makes the machine completely worth it. I am not complaining on the coffees but the chai is awesome. Not to mention it makes my kitchen smell really good for a bit. Can't do that from the coffee shop.

I love the Twinings Chai Tea Latte for my Tassimo machine.  It is sweet but not too sweet.  I think the taste is great and the smell is wonderful.  As for the cost...well it's not the cheapest thing to drink but it's definitely worth the cost. :)

No, these aren't quite as strong as Starbuck's version, but they are delicious nonetheless and close enough.  I've tried every option I could fine for making chai latte at home and this is, by far, the best.  Doesn't need any sweetener and great any time of day.  Only wish that there was a fat-free creamer option, but tassimo has a long way to go in terms of expanding variety.  Oh...and why hasn't amazon added t-discs to subscribe and save?  I would be ordering these monthly.

column9: A great chai right at home
column10: I have been drinking chai for over ten years and love this stuff. It's not as spicy as it could be, but it is a lovely drink to make at home for little money. Nice and creamy and the right amount of foam.

column9: Great Taste with fewer calories than the coffee shop
column10: Admittedly, this does not have that ultra rich milk flavor as Chai Latte from the barista, but it also has a fraction of the calories (I think 80) and the flavor and aroma are sweet and full of Chai spice.  Highly recommended.

This is the worst Tassimo product I have tried.  It is sickeningly sweet and bitter at the same time.  For Chai, use Tazo bags and add your own milk.  For Tassimo, any Starbuck's at all is delicious, especially the Lattes and Cappuccinos.

This company is out of their mind with the amount of money they are charging for this! Just a few months ago you could buy this for about $20 for a 2 pack. All the other coffee lattes being sold are about $20 for a 2 pack. They want you to pay $42 for a 2 pack. That means you're paying $2.63 per coffee! I recommend going to another site to purchase this. Other sites are selling it for $20 for a 2 pack. I love Amazon but they are letting people get ripped off on this particular item.

column9: So awful - the artificial sweetener is over-powering - I can't even drink it
column10: I was so disappointed in these - they taste nothing like a chai tea latte one would get at a coffee shop or a mix from the grocery store.  It has a bitter chemical taste from the sucralose and is incredibly sweet besides.  I actually could not drink it. My husband and I love the Starbuck's latte primo though!

I have a friend from up north. I live in S.C. He loves tasty kakes, so when I saw they had a sugar free version. I wanted to try it. Shipment came quickly.While the product did have a real chocolate flavor, the cakes were very dry. There was a sticker over expiratin date. I won't buy anymore tastykakes from this seller.
The taste was a little dry. It would have been nice if it had some sort of Sugar Free Icing on top. The filling was good. I don't think I would order it again.

In very small quantities this tea made me feel really hungry, and if I drank more I started feeling really nauseated having other uncomfortable gastrointestinal symptoms.  I finally did some research and found out that some people are sensitive to sceletium tortuosum, and I guess I'm one of them.  I tried it a few times to see if I would desensitize, but it didn't appear to be happening.  I understand some people have benefits from this plant, but would recommend trying a sample first, with caution.

Expected a deeper, smokier tone to this paprika than I got.  Deserves praise for not being bitter (burnt) in processing, which some pimenton exhibit.  Taste is delightful, but if you specifically want rich smoky nose to your paprika, try another.

This is great stuff. Since buying it two years ago it has become a necessary ingredient in so many dishes. Chiquilin brand has a refined flavor, smoky with no hint of being burnt. I noticed a bit of a burnt flavor in some other brands. It does not add heat like some pepper however. I use it in such things as sauteed vegies which I want to add a grilled flavor to, humus where it add a nice smokiness, and pan-frying tofu (I'm vegetarian). It can even add a grilled/outdoor flavor to your salads when used in a vinaigrette dressing.
This stuff is great. I put it everything but dessert. It really kicked up a mushroom and onion gravy we put on cube steaks. Plus, don't forget what it does for paella, the reason I bought it.

This is a good-quality smoked paprika and will work well in just about any dish you need it for.  BUT, the container is quite small and contains only 2.6 oz.  For less than a dollar more ($.64, to be exact), you can get McCormick's version, which tastes virtually the same, and you get 8.5 oz. - which is three times as much. In addition, like the Chiquilin, the McCormick paprika is made from Spanish red peppers that are smoked over wood planks.  Finally, it is available with Prime shipping, just as the Chiquilin is.
Use it in casseroles, stews, soups and rubs for your meat.  Use it everywhere except your coffee.  So glad I bought it.  It's fantastic.

This wonderful pimentón comes from La Vera region of Spain where five varieties of peppers are grown. Two of the varieties are sweet, the other three have a more piquant quality.The peppers are dehydrated and smoked using traditional techniques, a process that imparts the final product a unique flavor.If the tin doesn't say "dulce" (sweet) the paprika will have a stronger and spicier taste, perfect for dishes such as chili.The paprika "dulce" adds a delightful flavor to tomato sauces, stews, rice pilafs, and any dish containing peppers or eggplants.Only buy smoked paprika in tins with a denomination of origin (D.O.) from "La Vera" or "Murcia."Tip: All Spanish smoked paprikas have a much more pronounced flavor. If you've never used them before, start with about half as much as what your recipe calls for.Be careful not to burn this paprika because it will turn bitter very quickly and ruin your dish. To avoid that, always make sure that there's enough fat/oil in the pan when sauteing.

I'm so glad I found out about "smoked" paprika.  It really enhances so many dishes -- and I hadn't even heard of it until a couple of months ago (thanks Food Network!)  The quality is excellent and I will be ordering this again!

I expected to get a smokey taste in foods when using the product. I did not expect to get such a rich, flavorful and full bodied taste and aroma from using so little of this in my cooking. Smoked paprika and the unsmoked variety are red-haired siblings raised in different cultures. The similarities are only visual. The performance of this brand of smoked paprika is amazing. No need to use another brand. I couldn't take the disappointment. Plus, you won't use regular paprika again.
The chiquilin pimenton ahumado is one of the best condiments for all my dishes.The taste of so delicated and aromatic that make me feel like in spain myself.Oleeeeeee.

I bought this for a recipe. It lent a smoky, tasty, indefinable essence. So much so I sneak it into every savory dish. It never fails to elicit comments like, "This is delicious! What did you put in this?" But I'm not telling. My secret go-to ingridient for savory dishes, rubs, and gravies. No wonder why Ilan from Top Chef put paprika into everything. Although the reviewer who suggested desserts had me thinking, "Hmmm?" I'm hooked.

Ordered this item would have given it 5 stars but there was a bunch of clumps in it dumped it out into a shaker.  But flavor wise its the best,it adds just the right amount of smokeiness with out being over powering.
Smoked paprika is one of my favorite spices. I use it when I make Cordoban gazpacho. It's rich smokiness adds an unexpected flavor to anything you cook from scrambled eggs to chicken dishes.

column9: ORDERED SMOKED PAPRIKA BUT GOT "MILD PAPRIKA"
column10: POOR CUSTOMER SERVICE, NO RESPONSE WHEN I REPORTED WRONG PAPRIKA SENT. I DON'T RECOMMEND IT SINCE YOU WON'T GET WHAT YOU ORDERED...
This is a great product. I really like this paprika. This was also recommended by Dr. Oz. This has a little more kick then regular paprika.

column9: Great flavor - but would like to have a sprinkler top

I like to sprinkle this on steamed veggies.I has to dump the paprika from another bottle to make room for this stuff.
