Unfortunately, I had a reaction to the bread and could not eat it. So the second package will go unopened. I am not sure what I reacted to because the Enjoy Life sorghum cookies have been great for me. It was relatively easy to prepare but again just did not work for me. The flavor was great when it was hot but after the fresh bread phase wore off it was not as savory.

I use Monin Organic Syrups and their regular syrups daily. These are wonderful in tea and coffee enhancing their flavors. It is nice to have an option to by an organic product for my coffee and tea. My family enjoys this and other monin products.

Mmm..  This type of noodle and flavor reminds me of the Picante flavored Nong Shim instant noodle bowls.  The noodles are clear, and I presume it's not deep fried.  You can see the nutritional information by clicking "Nutrition Facts" near the top.  I want to say that most of the fat actually comes from the sesame paste..  I call that the "oil packet."  You don't have to put that in if you want to lessen the amount of fat you're eating.  It's about medium spicy, and really good.  It comes with two pieces of dehydrated bok choy, which adds some fiber to the meal/snack.  It's not for people who are afraid of sodium or MSG though...  It's got plenty of sodium (1,610mg aka 67% DV).  If you eat it, try to not drink all of the broth, it'll help.  This bowl is more meant for someone with hot water on hand (you could always microwave some water in a bowl and pour it in).  It says it's not microwaveable, presumably because the plastic labeling around the bowl stays on.  I have a hot water dispenser, so this isn't a problem.  I just open the flavor packet, put it over the noodles, add hot water, wait a few minutes, and stir.  Then it's ready to eat and real yummy!

I ordered this on a whim when it was on sale just to try, i was very plaesed with the quality of soup.only drawback is the very high sodium 1640mg!but did not have a overly salty taste.i will buy again

This is perhaps the most sophistocated prepared food product I've seen to date.  The complex flavor reminds me of a "Pan Roast", the signature item at an expensive Los Vegas restaurant.  I suggest that you let the noodles steep even longer thatn the packaging suggests.

column4: A Research It Maven "Just the facts please"
column9: When you're dieting real hard, this will strengthen you!
column10: I've got a real savvy trainer and he recommended that I try this soup when I feel like I just CANNOT stick with the program (because I am feeling weak and listless.) IT WORKS! Try this soup when you hit a plateau or have a serious craving, too, it really turns your attitude around! Trainer says often when we are on a hard program (controlled diet & workouts) the body just needs a dose of sodium to come back. The spices really help, too! I like to eat this soup "American style" (with a spoon) or just drink it if I'm in a hurry, so I crush the noodles before I brew the soup. Just put em in a bag and get a hammer. (No way can you cut up these noodles!) Try it next time you are under the weather or just need a pick me up! Per container: 280 calories, 8 gr fat, 45 carbs, 6 gr protein, 1610 mg sodium, just 26% of calories from fat. Crystal Noodle Spicy Sesame Paste, 2.47 Ounce Cardboard Cup (Pack of 6).

I tend to love spicy noodles of all kinds.  I go more for the stove top, than hot water in a vat variety.  The first time I tried it, I thought it was okay and I really wanted to love these noodles because it's lower in calories than my go to Shin Ramyun, but I just couldn't love it.  I dreaded eating the noodles again because I felt as though it tasted like plastic.  I am definitely not ordering this again.  I still have a number left from the pack that I bought.  I would recommend trying one before buying a whole box.

column9: Good tasting but way too high in sodium
column10: I really like these crystal noodle soups and have placed about 5 orders so far of various flavors.  My problem is with the extremely high sodium.  It's unhealthy and makes me eat these sparingly when I have them.  Great taste, very filling, just not any health benefits.

The spice is just rightWith healthy bean noodleBetter than ramen.Once you've tried this, you will wonder how you've been living with the 10 packs of ramen. This is by far the best instant soup I've ever had.

This is the best kind of instant noodles that I have ever tasted. The only problem I found were the little pieces of dehydrated little balls of something, tofu maybe? I can't quite fathom. They taste fine, this is just a preference issue. The vegetables tasted almost fresh and it IS spicy. And I eat Sriracha like ketchup. A definite must-have in your cupboard.
these are really good noodles, nice flavor, zesty, easy to prepare. I am going to buy more!

I got hooked on the spicy sesame Crystal Noodle soups when my grocery used to carry them, but now the soup can't be found anywhere in town so I have to order online.  And boy, is it worth it.  This soup is made up of thin, almost clear crystal noodles that comes with a block of dehydrated bok choy and paste, plus a little envelope of sesame paste. You put the block of bok choy and paste on top of the noodles, pour boiling water until it reaches the fill line, then put the lid on and let it sit just a couple of minutes.  Then you add the sesame paste, which tastes a little like peanut butter and pairs with the spiciness of the broth wonderfully.  The paste is a little difficult to get out sometimes, requiring some finesse with a butter knife, but it's worth it.The noodles are filling and taste better than the kind you get in the usual ramen soups.  The broth is a medium spice that builds, and the bok choy rehydrates well with good flavor.  The calories are quite good, only 280, but the sodium is high as you would expect.  I pair a bowl of this with an egg roll or two and am full for hours.

column9: Very good instant Tofu Miso Soup...
column10: Very good, I just tried it tonight...you have to mix it well...but it is very good, it tastes like the miso soup that I had in a Sushi Restaurant a few days ago... Though the tofu pieces are small, the rich taste makes up for it...and if you want more tofu...I suggest buying firm tofu separately, then adding it when you make the soup...that's what I'm going to do... I hope this helped you... :)

column9: Once acquired...This (satisfying!) miso soup might be your new addiction.
column10: I first picked this off the shelf at a military commissary in Kansas one summer... and I never stopped. The first time you try this stuff, it's like wine or avocados; it's a taste that is certainly acquired, and like nothing else. I have fed it to a friend and to my significant other; few like it the first time, but you find yourself strangely coming back for more until it's a staple in your house, like it is in mine. Kind of reminds me of sushi; first time I tried it, I was like, "this is odd, why do people eat this?", then, I found myself craving it a week later. Haha. Now I love sushi and miso! (By the way, it comes in an envelope with 3 individual packets). Mix it in hot water, to taste. You might like it with more or less water, depending on how salty you like your food. -Experiment with it to your satisfaction, and I guarantee, there is much of that to be had.I usually add all 3 little individual packets (it's low-fat) to a decent-sized cup of hot water, add my favorite vinegar, and let it sit and "cure" for a minute or so, since the little green sea-vegetable flakes (and green onions + tofu squares) need time to rehydrate and turn a little chewy and palatable. I then sip it and fish the sea vegetables out to my heart's content.(I also hear that miso can be generally healthy for you!)If you let it sit, the miso will start to separate from the rest of the soup and you have delightful little clouds of miso particles floating in your bowl, which is sort of entertaining and visually delightful, too. I think of it as cheap, delicious entertainment. But then again, I am easily amused. ;)

My love affair with miso, the flavorful paste made from fermented soybeans, started when I lived in Tokyo several years ago.  So, since then, being the miso snob that I am, it has been unimaginable to me to try any instant variety.  But I have to say that when I finally did break down and try Kikkoman Instant Tofu Miso Soup, I was amazed to find that it was practically indistinguishable in flavor and consistency from miso soup made from the actual paste.  While I would still choose the actual product whenever time permits, I would now not hesitate to substitute this great product when I am on the run.

column9: A good soup with a unique taste
column10: Personally, I'd love a bowl of miso soup any day. I first tried it in a very nice sushi restaurant, and then again in a less-fancy one. A few months later, I discovered that Price Chopper sells these exact packets (they're a bit more expensive there than here on Amazon).Miso soup is hard to describe. I think of it as having a taste that you kind of have to acquire...It took me a few bowls to really get used to it. But once you do, it's great! I suggest this for anyone who's interested in Japanese culture and food.

column9: Holds its own against any restaurant miso soup
column10: This is the best miso soup to be found anywhere; it is fabulous and the flavor is just amazing considering it's an instant soup. You can add a variety of vegetables, chicken pieces, pork, beef or shrimp if you like, and chopped spinach and if you love tofu you can add either the firm or soft variety, I prefer the soft.The soup is comprised of fermented soy beans and comes in red (sweeter) or white (saltier) miso paste and fish stock made from bonito flakes and contains kelp as well. I am going to a local Asian market where I live and make my own miso from scratch but bought more of this as backup just in case mine doesn't turn out. It is a very delicate soup and cannot ever be boiled once the bonito is added as it would collapse and the flaovr would be ruined, so I watched videos on how to prepare it.Many years ago when I was in college in downtown Los Angeles, we would go to little Tokyo for lunch and indulge in the then relatively unknown treat, sushi and have the miso and a wonderful salad of finely chopped cabbage and rice vinegar to start.Now I can buy (and do) sushi freshly prepared at my local supermarket and have instant miso whenever I want and that is my idea of Heaven. Miso has the most delicate flavor imaginable, it is absolutely unique, nothing else tastes remotely like it and it is very healthy for you as well.When I went to a fat farm the main reason we all lost so much weight was because the diet plan at this particular place included having a large cup of hot broth before every meal thus cutting the appetite down considerably. I could really put it away before, just huge gluttonous portions, but after finishing the cup of broth, I could eat what they gave us but no more than that.So whether you want in instant soup like no other or want to incorporate this soup into your diet plan, either way you'll be very happy and remember to experiment by adding whatever you like and making it more of a meal.To paraphrase a quote from Benjamin Franklin (re beer) miso is proof God loves us and wants us to be happy. Enjoy!

I've purchased several different types of packaged miso soups and this is by far the best one I've tried.  It cooks easily and quickly.  I like to pack several packets for vacations, business trips or camping trips because the soup is so easy to prepare with just a little bit of hot water.  And if you forget a spoon, it's okay - just drink it like broth.Making miso soup "from scratch" is one of the things I've failed miserably at every time I've tried, but with these packets I can save myself time, heartache and money.  It even tastes better than some of the miso soups I've had in restaurants.
LOVE THE PRODUCT BUT IT IS SO OVERPRICED LIKE EVERYTHING AWESOME FROM JAPAN!5* flavor. but only 1* for price and value.

column9: Tasty but the serving is small
column10: Serving size is a bit small. Fits in a 6 ounce tea cup.It is really good though. Tastes like regular miso except much less spicy.

I am currently have limited access to healthy foods and this soup is amazing, all you need is a hot water kettle and a cup.  I use this along with the Amazing Grass Green Superfood and several other 'health' products to keep a decent meal plan going. They are a little salty for me, I'm not a fan of salt at all though, but beggers can't be choosers here!  Even if you are busy in your everyday life these are a great pick-me-up!

i have tried a great variety of instant miso soups, this is definitely  one of my favorites. i just wish it came with a little more tofu. but other than that its a good cup of soup. i will definitely be buying this again
This is so easy to make and great to eat.  I started eating miso on a regular basis because it helps give a full-feeling to help loose weight!  Arrived fast too.
I love Miso soup and wondered if this instant version would be any good.  Althoughit cannot compete with the restaurant soups for an instant soup it is very good andeasy and fast to prepare.

I found this soup to be tasty, but on the salty side so I added more water to taste.  Tofu in product not impressive, but the spinach is amazing the way it hydrates into spoon size pieces.  The biggest downside is the cost.  Almost $1.45 a cup is spendy for instant soup....Cup a Soup brand (at Amazon) is about $0.30.  And bouillon is about 0.05.  If you are looking for something hot then there are other choices.  Was an interesting experience though.  Seller was great and product received quickly.

I love this stuff-I think it tastes great! And I even grew up in Japan in a Japanese household with a Japanese mother who makes much better miso soup but since my mom doesn't live nearby, this is the perfect substitute for me. Don't tell my mom-she'd be horrified! I gave it 4 stars because I wish there was more tofu in it. Also I only use about 1/3 to 1/2 cup boiling water instead of 2/3 cup.

The miso is delicious; Its an easy way to have a quick breakfast. I have an egg with the soup, and eat something else at lunch time. The miso in the morning is very light, and not heavy on the stomach.

column9: easy to make, a bit salty
column10: This is good for a powdered product. I prefer the separate soybean paste with a packet of dried seaweed & tofu, but this has a good flavor. A bit salty for my taste.
This was quite tasty, but the saltiness was overwhelming. If you have to limit your salt intake, steer clear of this item.

column9: Both My Husband and Me Like This
column10: It is so easy and nothing to add except water.I like it with more water than my husband.Yum!Great for late late night too...you know, instead of eggs!

I love this soup it is the best tasting instant miso, except it has MSG added that is the only bad thing about it. If Kikkoman would take that ingredient out it would be almost perfect for instant miso.

I am a HUGE fan of miso soup.  I've tried many of the instant miso soups thanks to my asian market.  Kikkoman's Instant Miso is by far the best soup out there.  It's the closest you can get to the "real" thing without actually making the soup yourself.However, this company is selling it at a ridiculous price!  I've purchase the EXACT same thing at Walmart for $1.99/package (which comes out to $0.67 per packet).  This company is trying to sell them for over $3 per package (or over a $1 per packet!) - not even including shipping.  I'd do my homework and buy elsewhere because this company seems to specialize in rip-offs.
I trusted the other good reviews, but this tastes awful and has a bad aftertaste.  Yuk.

I researched some of the ingredients on this item and i found that powdered bonito is a fish derivative however the ingedients listed on the page here only says powdered bonito but on the actual package it says powdered bonito(fish).I think the people who sell this item should modify the ingredient listing on this page.

To mark the 70th anniversary of our favorite family movie, the PEZ candy folks have created a really keen collectible: a pack of eight OZ-related Pez dispensers, including all the '39 film's major characters, plus Toto, Glinda and the giant green head of "the great and powerful Wizard of Oz!"I saw this curio yesterday afternoon in my local WINN DIXIE grocery store, was intrigued by the fine reproductions and ALMOST bought it, but sadly it took years for me to beat that Pez addiction and the --last-- thing I need right now is cravings for brick-shaped, artificially flavored and colored pieces of sugar. Plus, how would it look for this old woman to reach shakily into her handbag and indiscreetly administer a sucrose fix from the mouth of the Wicked Witch of the West?All joking aside, this well-made, attractive collectible is an item that's sure to increase in value, is one that Classic Movie fans should own, and for all OZ devotees, why it's, shall we say... indispensible?  (wink)

AFter 30+ years of collecting Wizard of Oz stuff, I am very selective these days about what new to add.  That is one reason the Oz Pez set is so great.  It is unique.It is very well made and presented.  I recomind it to all Pez and Oz collectors!
pez despensers are great, but the box was damaged. I wouldn't recommend ordering through the mail if you are a collector.

column9: A Must for the Pez / Wizard of Oz Collector
column10: This is a very nice collectible.  The craftsmanship is of the highest quality.  The figures are beautiful reproductions of the actors who portrayed the roles in the movie.  The box highlights the PEZ dispensers and enhances the display of the item.  This is an extradinary collectible for the PEZ and/or Wizard of Oz collectors.  The price is attractive enough that it also can be given as a gift to children, in love with the movie, to use and play with.

I bought this gift for my 3 year old nephew who absolutely loves the wizard of oz.. this was the first present he opened and didnt open anything else! he played with this for over an hour filling all the characters! Awesome gift!

I switched to Purina One about a month ago. I used to feed my cats Meow Mix. My one cat was losing her hair and I attributed it to stress (we recently adopted two dogs into our family). On a whim I picked up some purina one to see if my kitties would eat it. They are very fussy! To my surprise they love it. Even more importantly is that my kitties hair has all grown back. I am amazed at how soft, shiny and silky the kitties coats have become since I started feeding them purina one. I highly recomend it. My jasmine even seems happier and more friendly. Probably because her skin is no longer bothering her.

My 11-year old Himalayan cat, Simon, has never eaten anything nor liked anything other than Purina one Salmon & Tuna flavor.  Now all of a sudden "Smart Blend' has taken its place on the shelf....why?  He doesn't like it.....will you continue to make the original blend that he eats???  The little paper inside the bag even states that cats may not like the new blend at first but to mix it with the old blend until they are used to it.....again, why???  Please continue to make the original formula.

I ordered what the picture showed....... but received the "Smart Blend" type.The reason I ordered the type I saw in the picture was because our cats had a bad reaction to the Smart Blend type.  I don't know why. but they were throwing up and had very loose bowels.  We still had some of the other Tuna and Salmon dry food and found no more problems. I could not find the old type in the stores and that is why I ordered from this picture. I wasted $15.00.

It's very difficult to find healthy prepared foods that are low in salt.  Dr. Joel Fuhrman's line of canned food is a wonderful find for me.  I wish it was organic, so I lop off a star for that, but I haven't been able to find anything else like this out there, organic or not.  Most "low salt" foods are really still pretty high in salt, but Vitabeanavegamin is an exception, with only 110mg of salt in the entire can (4% of USRDA).  It takes a little while to get used to low salt foods, because we're all so used to having salt in everything (especially soup!), but it's true that if you give your taste buds a few days to adjust, you'll start to find "normally" salted foods way too salty, and the flavor of the truly low salt foods just pops right out.Nutritionally, this soup is great.  To be honest, I don't eat it as a soup but rather as it comes out of the can, which is very dense (even denser than a stew).  The whole can is 280 calories, with a total of 110mg of salt, 1g of fat, 980% of daily requirements for vitamin A, 70% of vitamin C, and 20% each of calcium and iron.  Even better, there's 14g of fiber (58% USRDA) and 14g of protein.  After I eat a can, I actually feel "energized".Also very good are Dr. Fuhrman's Supreme Greens and Dr. Fuhrman's Moroccan Chick Peas.

column9: Great for cats who like catnip!
column10: Hard to find in stores, I tracked down these treats here on Amazon after our local supermarkets seemed to have trouble keeping them in stock.  Between my two cats, only one of them consistently enjoys them, and she is the one who has a much stronger reaction to catnip.  My other cat sometimes reacts to catnip, and sometimes enjoys the treats.  However, they both like them enough that I have them on subscription!  Over the years I've had many cats who enjoyed Pounce products and I find this to be a good addition to their line of quality cat treats.The 5 pack is a good value for a hard to find product!  If your furry friend has the "catnip gene" then I highly recommend giving these a shot!

My cats are picky about treats. They seem to prefer only catnip flavored treats and Pounce Crunchy is their favorite of those. Unfortunately, I have not been able to find it in the store (grocery, Petco or Walmart)lately. We were running low and no one wants to be around kitties when they are out of treats! Thankfully, Amazon came to the rescue at a great price. We are now set with snacks for a while and I know where to turn next time!

column9: Finicky kitty loves Pounce catnip flavor
column10: I have a Maine Coon who is extremely picky, but she loves Pounce Catnip Flavor.  All we have to do is shake the bag and she comes running.

My cats really enjoy these treats.  It helps control the tarter and plaque on their teeth.  The treats are just the right size for the cats to chew.  My cats won't eat any other treats but Pounce Crunchy w/ Tarter and Plaque Control Catnip Flavor Treats.

column9: I guess it depends on the cat (s)
column10: My mother bought these locally and I could not locate them. At the time, she was caring for my feral cat colony and they LOVE these! They could eat a whole bag that is how much they like them! I am a caregiver to 12 feral cats and every single one thinks these things are the best treats! The feral cats are in a transition mode right now. I had to relocate them to my new home up north. They are in an outdoor enclosed area until they know their surroundings. One part of the transition is giving them wet food and treats so they adjust better. When they hear this bag, they cannot get enough of them! I saw they were back in stock tonight so ordered more for the fur babies. Sadly, my spoiled indoor special needs cat does not like these at all. He walks away from them. But 12 feral cats are spoiled by these and think they are the best! That is a fairly large number and a lot of happy bellies.

I always go for catnip flavor.  We can't get it in the stores near us anymore, so we buy them when we can from Amazon!  Our kitties go nuts for them, and when tempting some of our friends' kitties, they also pick catnip pounce over other brands/flavors! <3

column9: Best cat treat by a whisker
column10: This is the ONLY brand our cats will eat. Unfortunately they are getting hard to find locally. I've had cats for 40 years, and since the first time I bought the little paper can of Pounce in the grocery store decades ago, I have never met a feline who didn't LOVE them.

In my area, Pounce Crunchy treats are not easily found--especially in larger quantities. I find that giving each of my cats 10-15 of these small treats daily, reduces plaque build up. One of my cats only likes the Catnip flavor, while the other prefers the fish flavors. I would recommend this product over any soft-chewy treat on the market.

column9: Cat loves these treats, but watch the ingredients
column10: These treats are a favorite of my cat.  I try my best to give him high quality products with no corn or byproducts, but he just loves these treats so much.  They obviously have a delightful flavor because my cat will go to great lengths to get these treats.  tThey are larger than other treats so he can see them better and we can have a more active playtime.We play the following games with these treats:1. Sliding the treats across the floor, trying to get them past the cat2. Lobbing the treat into the air and cat will catch them mid-air with his paws3. Throwing them into the other room and watching him chase them and slide across the hard wood floor.He loves these treats so much, but I feel conflicted letting him have them so often.  I think of these treats as my cat's McDonalds.  The top ingredients are Corn Flour, Chicken By-Product Meal, Corn Gluten Meal, Animal Digest and Ground Wheat.  Not good.  However, as I pick up the package to read these ingredients, I immediately get a cat running towards me, eyes dilated, lip licking and meowing- hoping for me to toss a treat into the air.  How can I turn that face down?

I have to admit that my cat is a spoiled one - yet, she likes variety in her diet. This is the reason why I ordered these treats, in the first place. However, I was not able to "convince" her to eat it. With plenty of left, I handed the left-over to all my friends who have a cat. None of the cats offered this treat took it. Something is simply wrong here; my cat gets crazy over catnip and she accepts teeth brushing to get another catnip flavored treat (as she gets this one as reward, only)The GoodLife Recipe Catnip Delights - 3 oz. So, Pounce should come up with a new recipe. If your cat never successfully tried these before, stay away

column9: One of the best tasteing fruit drink on the market
column10: I like fruit drinks, the best I've tried is Capri Sun Fruit Dive. It is hard to find in my area, I have to order on line, but it is worth it.

Usually, you can only get the Cinnamon granola bars in the Variety Pack.  I was so happy to see they come in a whole box that I signed up for the subscription purchase so I can receive them on a regular basis.  A good snack that's good for you too!  And at an unbeatable price!

As standard granola bars go, this is my current favorite. As I usually eat them as a late morning snack the cinnamon flavor is a big plus. Not too sweet or chewy, these bars can also last awhile in your briefcase.
Love these bars.  Can't buy just the cinnamon flavor in stores.  Happy to be able to find them on-line.

Since my favorite Nature Valley Flavor is Cinnamon, I was always disappointed that the stores didn't carry 6-packs in that flavor.  I was pleasantly surprised to find that Amazon did.  In addition, I recently discovered that crumbled up in a bowl with milk, these bars make a tasty cereal.

Of all the various Nature Valley Granola bars, Cinnamon is in our opinion the best by far! My wife swears by the cinnamon and we buy several at a time from Amazon to keep on hand! Wish there were stores in the Dallas Metroplex that stocked the cinnamon but only able to find at Amazon!Thanks Amazon for handling!

column9: Loree's Love of Nature Valley Cinnamon Granola Bars
column10: I really like the Nature Valley Cinnamon Granola Bars and have for some time.  However, I can no longer find them in the grocery stores in my locale.  The boxes of Cinnamon bars stopped being available some years ago, and recently they were no longer available in the variety pack either.  It was a pleasure being able to purchase them again.

When those late night cravings hit, Nature Valley Crunchy Cinnamon Granola Bars are a healthy and low calorie way to satisfy that sweet tooth. At only 90 calories each these bars have just the right amount of cinnamon richness and crunch so much so that it almost feels sinful. The bars come conveniently packaged in 6 boxes of 12 each. For an exceptionally decadent treat, try crumbling the bars over a scoop of coffee ice cream. Since the bars are individually wrapped, they're also an excellent on-the-go snack. I throw them in lunches or in my backpack when I'm in a hurry.

column9: Finally!! A way to get this great  Nature Valley flavor
column10: I don't know about you, but when the family has a FAVORITE FLAVOR, you really are on the "bad" list if you vary from that request. The Nature Valley granola bars are one of our staples for snacks. With a piece of fruit it will fil in the hunger pangs on the way back from a game. It is also a favorite with coffee, allowing you to pass up calorie dense junk foods available everywhere. The cinnamon flavor is hard to find, so I was thrilled to find it availble by the case on Amazon. It arrived within a week of my order and it worked out to cost about.50 less per box than if purchased at the local supermarket, the only one that has this flavor. This method of stocking up is convenient and cost effective.

column9: The best one, therefore not sold in stores
column10: For a long time I didn't think an all-cinnamon flavor box was even available and thought how great it would be if it was, then I found this! Stores will never carry this product however because......(long pause)......(tumbleweed blows by)........(pigs start flying)."Tonight on unsolved mysteries....."
Our local stores stopped carrying this flavor. I have to buy them online now and this took extra time, while I also ordered direct from Meijer, to receive them within 7 work days
I love that products from Amazon come so quickly!! It's a great alternative to shopping at the store when I can get a product so quickly.  Awesome service!

I love Nature Valley CINNAMON Granola Bars. I was so relieved to find them on Amazon as they are no longer available in any VA stores and I have searched high and low. I have a monthly subscription now that ensures I don't run out.
I've eaten Nature Valley cinnamon bars for many years but now you can't buy them in Austin.  I'm so glad Amazon had these available!!

My husband goes on several business trips, and a few backpacking trips, each year. He loves the Cinnamon granola bars for a fast, easy, breakfast. Light enough to carry in his backpack and filling along with his morning coffee.I could not find the packages of only the cinnamon flavor, in the stores, for a very long time. I was pleased, as was he, to find them on Amazon.com. I bought a whole case. The price, including the shipping charge for the case, was actually a couple of dollars less than buying the same amount at a store.Thank You,

column9: yummy and delicious -- my fave of all the NV Crunchy bars
column10: this is my fave of all the NV crunchy bars -- and the only way you can get it at the grocery store is to buy it in a variety pack with 2 other kinds.  Bummer...but thankfully, i found these here -- Amazon, you rock!

column9: The Best Granola bars most people have never eaten
column10: I am a big fan of cinnamon, and these are great. I eat them every day for breakfast along with an apple.The cinnamon is a stimulant, and helps to get me going. They flavor the apple, making it taste better. Finally, they contrast wonderfully with my cup of tea, making my day jump into gear.

These are the best granola bars, along with the brown sugar cinnamon.  I have not eaten dessert for several years and these are a great substitute, like a cookie.  These two flavors are hard to find in the stores, and when they are there, the price is ridiculously high.  The Amazon delivery service and price can't be beat.
Can't find them in a store and we love these. Have been eating them for years!
I don't know why these aren't sold in stores (at least around my area), they are the best flavor of Nature Valley Granola Bars.

From the time Nature Valley released the Cinnamon bar years ago, I've felt it was the best I'd ever eaten.  I'm sorry it is no longer available in any local stores but am soooooo glad Amazon carries them. Until this purchase, I had never bought food online but I simply couldn't resist once I found them on Amazon.  The bars arrived in perfect condition, unbroken and ready to eat!!

I eat Nature Valley granola bars all the time. I think I'm addicted to them. So it is nice to have different varieties. The cinnamon ones are not too cinnamony -- they're just right. They arrived fresh and ready to eat . . . which I do . . . frequently.
These are great snacks that will help curb your appetite until you can get to lunch. I couldn't pass up the savings from Amazon/Nature Valley.

column9: High value for the crunchy bars
column10: The product is good for people who like to eat granola bars of cinnamon, as it is very delicious and suitable for kis for breakfast.
I was very happy to receive this package. The Cinnamon Granola Bars are difficult to get in my area. The price was excellent at 17 cents per bar, how can you go wrong.

Tried these on the basis of other reviewers and am glad I did. Great flavor(assuming you like cinnamon)and texture.These are great to keep in my desk at work for a healthy alternative to most other afternoon snacks. I also keep some in my purse and car for unexpected commuting delays. I have tried several varieties of Nature Valley and these are one of the best.

These granola bars are amazing. I always have one in my bag. They're great with yogurt or crushed onto boring cerial or oatmeal for extra flavor. I've crushed them on top of home made muffins for extra crunch. They're good warm with peanut butter. Love these bars!

column9: Expiration date close, product really dry
column10: June 28, 2011. The Expiration date. Ordered Jan 17, delivered Jan 21st. The product is really dry. Drier than usual. I mean yes these bars are really crunchy, but the Oats and Honey that came in the Variety Pack I also bought wasn't as dry as these. Part of me wonders if these have been on the shelf for too long and Amazon decided to put them on a subscribe and save sale to rotate the stock.I bought these or emergency supplies in case of a natural disaster or something but now I see I'll have to eat them all in 5 months. But I do want to question how old these are as some products I see expiring two years (about) in the future. So just buyer beware in the case that you are the sole consumer and aren't part of a larger group who might eat these.
These are awesome, and well packaged, shipped promptly, at a fair price. Couldn't be happier.

column9: Love Nature Valley Cinnamon Granola Bars
column10: I've had to order Nature Valley Cinnamon Granola Bars online because they are no longer carried at the stores in my area.  They have been my favorite granola bars for many years.  For a while I could get them in the variety pack but the problem was I ended up with tons of the peanut butter bars which I hate.

I have looked everywhere for the cinnamon granola bars for the last few years and I have now found them on line.  This is great.  No stores carry them and it is a joy to finally be able to enjoy the cinnamon granola bars again.

I have 2 labs and one is extremely allergic; these dog cookies are rated well with the Whole Dog Journal The Whole Dog Journal's Guide to Optimum Dog Care: Good Eats - they have a monthly newsletter as well - the ingredients are whole and healthy and there is no chicken, which is really hard to find - my dog is allergic to chicken, eggs, beef, peanuts ... and he's on a grain-free diet - these cookies have oatmeal which is fine for him - so it's very hard to find a healthy dog cookie that works with his allergies and both dogs love them.

My dogs love these. I love the 50-ounce boxes. This is a great product, free from bad preservatives, by-products and animal digest. Wellness is a wonderful brand that is tasty yet very healthy for dogs. These treats are a great bang for your buck in comparison to other dog treats. The price here online is the same as the price at the pet store, but I love the fact that I don't have to spend my gas money going to get it!

My puppy received these biscuits as a Christmas present from his Mom.  I don't normally purchase my dog food or treats online, but I will buy these again.  Both my puppy and mature dog, LOVE these biscuits, and I am confident that they are made of the finest ingredients.  I had some in my pocket while I was in the barn, and my horse started nuzzling my pocket, so I gave him one, and he loved them too!  All natural ingredients make this an appealing treat for horses and dogs alike.  Thanks, puppy-mama, for turning us on to Wellness Wellbars!

column9: Good Ingredients & The Dogs Love Them
column10: I have respect for the Wellness brand and have previously bought my dogs other Wellness treats.  These WellBars are marketed as "bite size."  My corgis love them!  And, they can certainly eat them in one bite.  But, for a medium dog, I consider these larger than bite size.  Luckily, the bars are easily broken in two to provide a smaller snack.  (Weight maintenance is a high priority with my chow hounds.)Each bar has 24 calories.  The first few ingredients are:  ground barley, cane molasses, ground brown rice, whitefish, and sweet potatoes.  There's no wheat, corn, soy, artificial preservatives/color/flavor.This is a big box of treats.  I do wish that the bag was resealable, but that's a quibble.
My 12-year-old Husky goes crazy for these - they are healthy, delicious (apparently), and a great training tool.  They are a little pricey, but worth it for the joy in my dog's face.

column9: My dogs tell me these treats are YUMMY
column10: My two Corgis were thoroughly spoiled by my late husband (I spent a year and a half dieting them down a combined total of 25 pounds!)They are accustomed to the finest of fare, and they absolutely love the Wellness brand of treats.

Our dog likes these treats. We keep them in our laundry room and everytime we go to do laundry she buries her head in the box until we give her a treat.  They are hard treats and kind of big so they probably wouldn't be good for tiny dogs. Our miniature schnauzer is about 18 pounds and they are just the right size for her.
My dogs love these treats!  These treats smell so good that I'm tempted to try them.  The box arrived promptly and was well packed.  Thank You!

column9: All My Dogs Have Loved These
column10: I've had three dogs who all love Well Bars. They break easily and can be used as a training treat.

column9: Good Ingredients & the Dogs Really Like Them
column10: Both of my dogs love these bars.  They smell good too - like apples.  Wellness has a reputation for using quality ingredients, and the ingredient list for these bars is no exception.Eating these bars made one of my dogs itch, though.  He does have some food allergies (corn & wheat), so I didn't detract from the treats' rating.  My best guess is that he reacted to the cane molasses because he's never eaten it before.
Our Golden Doodle loves these treats. Great size for a great price. The large size here on Amazon is the same price as the small size at a local store.

I had to try these treats and are rather impressed with them. I have larger dogs (bullmastiff etc) but they work well for him too. They are square, solid and obviously pretty tasty as all three of my dogs love them. There is a lot in the box and I think for the price, well worth it, being made with good stuff. I recommend to anyone who is the "treat" man or lady.
My dogs love these treats and the price at Amazon was a great value.  There were twice as many as the normal size I buy at less than double the price at my local pet store.
The service was great.  The product is my dogs favorite and it's healthy too.

Both my boxer's favorite treat.  It's healthy, they love it, and it smells good enough for me to try!  (I haven't..yet, for the record).  Wellness continues to impress me with their wholesome products.

Wellness is the brand I go to for dry and wet food for my dog, so I thought I'd try the chicken and cheddar bars.  The second ingredient is cane molasses... I honestly don't know why this is, and it seems odd.  As soon as you open the bag inside the box, you get a whiff of an overwhelming sweetness.  After my dog has one, he's constantly trying to get the caked treat off of his back molars.  It sticks on pretty hard.  I have to help or I have to brush his teeth to get rid of it.  This can't be good for his teeth, and I don't know if he needs the extra sweetness in his diet.  I would recommend Old Mother Hubbard wheat-free treats, such as chicken and apples, before this.  They're also made by Wellness.  Old Mother Hubbard Classic Oven Baked Chick' N' Apples Dog Biscuits Or, Get Naked dog biscuits, which are also very good.  Get Naked Super Antioxidant Biscuits for Dogs, 12-Ounce

I give them several throughout the day, so them being small (for a 60 pound dog) is great. I have been using these for years, but just recently started purchasing them online. I haven't really noticed any problems.

Our dog loves these--all the wellness well bars, not just this flavor.  They do seem to be a little hard, great for cleaning teeth but maybe not if your dog has teeth problems.  Nice healthful treats.

My dogs love this flavor and I'm happy they are a healthy treat without all the wheat, etc. thanks for providing this much less expensive buying opportunity or I could probably not afford for my dogs.
These biscuits are real favorites of my small CKC and my GSD. usually they don't like me to change their treats but these were lpve at first sniff and the vendors were quick and very courteous.
My Pit bull puppy would give up her doggy sole for these treats.  I use them all the time.  Highly recommended.
Much bigger box and bang for the buck.  I will purchase again. This is a great treat that the pups enjoy.

column9: Dogs are in love with these treats......!!!!!
column10: As with all of the Wellness products I have ordered so far....these came on the date promised and arrived safely.Both of my dogs were at my feet begging before I had the packaging open...They love them..........K
I hope this product is as healthy for the dog as it seems to be enjoyable.  My 4 year old dachshund loves these!
We have ordered these before and will continue to do so because Bailey loves them and they are good for her.

My dog, of course, adores these - anything with cheese is his favorite.  However, they gave him considerable amounts of gas.  We will, however, try other Wellness treats to see if they work better.
I have been giving these treats to my Weimaraner and Lab for years, and they simply love them! They are extremely healthy, vegetarian treats and they smell good enough to eat!

column9: SMELLS GOOD even I want to eat it
column10: This smells so good . Doesnt' smell like cardboard boxes. Comes in thick plastic bag to prevent puncture and letting the freshness go out.  There's no sealable zipper or anything so I have to use a clothing pin.My dog eats it when she wants to.  I leave it next to her bed she won't touch it sometimes. But sometimes she does eat it up.  She should eat it up fast or else it will become stale.Smells fruity and a hint of gingersnap cookies.  I gave it to another dog and he ate it like there was no tomorrow.  I gave my dog a wellness lamb jerky .. she ate it like crazy. I gave the other dog lamb jerky... he ate it like crazy.My conclusion is that not all dogs like fruity gingersnap cookies. Still have 60% left.Wellness brand is very good but I should stick to a guarantee treat....the lamb or any line meat jerky offered by Wellness.Not sure if I can eat it . lol
My dog loves these crunchy treats and I feel good about giving her them because of the wholesome ingredients. I'm about to order my second box.

I have been giving Wellness treats to my dogs for awhile.  They really like them and I think Wellness puts out a good product.  When I get the box out at night, they run to their crates and wait for their late night snack. No command necessary!

column9: Best of the Wellness Bars, too bad only comes in 20 oz box!
column10: These are the best ones of the Wellness bars because they're completely grain free. My dogs love these. They also contain no artificial preservatives. Highly recommended. However, I wish these came in a 50 oz box like the other flavors. The 20 oz box at 8.99 is the same cost at the pet store (and it is 45 cents per ounce) versus a 50 oz box which is just 30 cents an ounce. The product is fantastic, though. A++++
My dogs love these. They are not grain free, but they have no wheat, corn or soy and no artificial preservatives. Highly recommended. This is a great value at just under thirty cents per ounce. A++++

First Impression: Well the kind folks over at Wellness Pet Food heard about my website and sent me some treats to try! They ended up sending me a big box of their WellBars that have Yogurt, Apples, and Bananas in them. Totally vegetarian, oven baked with lots of vitamins! I'm sure you have read one of my other reviews about Old Mother Hubbard, they make outstanding healthy treats. Turns out that WellNess is owned by Old Mother Hubbard. Who knew? As usual Dad ran me though a barrage of tests to see how much I really wanted the treat. Let's just say I had to work very hard. Those silly "sit ups" that little dogs do, roll over, sit, stay, down, etc, just to have him put the treats in my Everlasting Treat Ball! I made short work of it and devoured my new delicious and healthy treats. The only thing I'm a little disappointed about is I found out that they have WellBites that are soft treats. They even have one that's Lamb and Salmon flavored... Those are two of my favorite things in the world. Now I have to talk Dad into buying them for me...Conclusion: Outstanding healthy dog treats! A must buy for a healthy pup.

We can't change our dog's diet much.  Unfortunately he is highly food motivated and loves to visit our local hardware for treats.  In fact, he keeps a supply at the hardware.  He had never been diagnosed with any food allergies but after buying a large box of commercial treats to keep at the hardware, we started to notice some problems.A local pet store recommended another flavor of these treats.  He liked them but we didn't notice an improvement in his symptoms so I tried these.  After all, apples and yogurt are some of my boy's favorite things!He loves these treats.  Although his symptoms have not cleared up entirely, they did improve.  His friend at the hardware likes to feed him a lot of treats at once so we consider them well tested at this point and we just ordered our third box.  Dogs like 'em and mom approves!

Our dog will not eat the Wellness Wellbar Yogurt, Apples and Bananas Dog Treats; however, we crush two of these up for each daily feeding and mix them with his regular dog food.  For this reason I would not buy these crunchy treats again, although I must say they smell good!We feel the reason for his not eating the crunchy treats is that he is accustomed to the soft Wellness wellbites that we have been giving him for over a year.  He loves these.  Wellness WellBar Yogurt, Apples and Bananas Dog Treats, 50-Ounce Pouch

I ordered this product thinking it would have been soft treats I could use for training and disappointed that they were biscuits. However they seem to be very healthy treats compared to some and the dogs really like them.

tried wellness webb bars, whitefish and sweetpotatoes and with crunchy peanuts and honey.  have three dogs two just push them away, the third who will eat dirt inhaled them.  Rate this products as a 0.

column9: Organic, Low Sugar & No Artificial Sugar - Finally!
column10: We eat healthy. That means my kids drink very little juice and zero soda. By very little I mean I never buy it, they might have some at a friend's house or a party or something. Generally they drink only milk or water. But that means they feel left out when the other kids have sugar-filled juice boxes or caprisuns. Enter Honest Kids! Yes, they have sugar in them, that's what I like. Go look at a box of 'Roaring waters' - that has artificial sweeteners (and sugar too, something I never could quite figure out). I would rather my children had a small amount of real sugar than artificial sweeteners. Since they are used to drinking only water otherwise, they like these, they don't complain they taste watered down. In fact if you compare these to a typical CapriSun, its kind of like the difference between a Vitamin Water and Gatorade. When you are used to Vitamin water, (original) Gatorade is going to taste sickly sweet, if you are used to Gatorade, Vitamin water is going to taste like water with slight flavor. Ask yourself which you want your children to be used to?I've seen other reviewers complain that they are hard to open or messy - my 6 and 8 year olds have no problems with them.  They put the straw in themselves and don't have a problem spilling them.Now they don't feel left out when everyone else has a juice box, and I feel good about the amount of sugar they are taking in. At only 40 calories and no artificial sweeteners, this is exactly what I've been looking for!

column9: Dishonest juice for your honest kid
column10: This tastes terrible. The bland, watered-down taste appeals to neither kids nor adults. I found on the packaging that this is only 10% juice -- so 90% of what you are buying is water, hence the low calorie content.As a test, I poured this out into a glass and compared it to a glass of water. I expected to see a very clear liquid, but what I found was a bit more strange -- the actual color of the "Super Fruit Punch" flavor isn't pink or red as imagined on the package, but some sort of turbid yellow. You can guess what that looks like. See the picture I posted for a comparison on the product image page.I recommend looking elsewhere for better quality and value. Don't let the "100% Organic" marketing fool you -- these are no good.A much better solution: purchase a favorite drink and dilute it 50:50 with water for young children. Better yet, teach them juice is a special treat and water is for regular drinking.

This is a great product and my kids love it but... Make sure you contact sellers before you buy it. I purchased under the assumption that I was getting 8 boxes of juice. I only received one box for $14.25 and sellers fees to return are outrageous not even worth returning! I can get these for $3.99 at my local grocery store which is why I jumped at the chance to pay less than $2/box. But it ended up being $2/pouch. I hope they specify better in the future but I doubt it they probably hope more people are dumb like me to make a huge profit. Please contact seller first and dont make same mistake I did.

column9: Hard to find and Hard in the package
column10: I finally found this product for a baseball party and was to put them on the tables as gifts to grab but they arrived so hard and flattened, I was kind of embarased to give them away!
If you like the flavor of the bubblegum you had as a kid, this comes as close as you are going to get!  The flavor lasts a long time and the gum is wonderfully soft.

I read a lot of negative reviews on this gum, but I think it's great.  The flavor is excellent and it last a long time, longer than most gums.  I am a huge fan of the Trident Splash gum, but the only flavor sold in stores in my area is the Strawberry with Lime, so it's nice to have a different flavor.  Yes, the price is high for gum, but I was willing to pay a higher price to get something I desired and it was worth the cost.

I chew sugarless gum all day long to help keep my mouth moist, because using supplemental oxygen makes my mouth very dry. Some of the medications that I take also cause a side effect of dry mouth. I have found all of the Trident Splash gums to be full of long lasting flavor, unlike regular Trident or Trident Layers. Trident Splash Pucker Me Berry has not been sold in any retail stores near me, so I decided to try ordering a wide variety of flavors of Trident Splash that I found on Amazon.com. I find the Berry Splash to be more refreshing & less sweet than the Strawberry Lime Splash. The other review of this product indicated that the flavor did not last. Trident Splash is made so that you experience an intense flavor burst when you open the liquid center; following that initial burst, there is a long lasting mild flavor. I hope you give it a try & enjoy!

This gum's flavor lasted a total of about 1 minute. seriously. The flavor is sweet and a little tangy. It tastes good for the seconds that it lasts, but honestly?? for 1 minute?? what a piece of garbage. will NOT be repurchasing.

column9: Best customer service ever and the quality is great!
column10: Originally, I ordered the Italian Wedding Cookies from Amazon and received a case that was not up to my standards. I don't know if UPS had left them in the hot truck too long or what (maybe I'm just too picky), but they were not exactly as expected. I called the company and within two days had a brand new case (with a nice bonus) on the doorstep in perfect condition. The representatives for this company are beyond all doubt, extraordinary. Usually, Amazon is the first place I look for products that I cannot find locally or cheaply enough, but in this case, I would suggest ordering directly from Geraldines.

It makes a decent wine, this is made to drink when the wine is young, while the wine is just OK at a young stage, it says aging will cause it to lose the fruity taste but since it makes about 30 bottles I think there will be quite a few that will be left to age. I have made wine before and it has turned out well and tasted good after aging. This kit has the ingredients necessary to make the wine but you do need to have your own fermenting container, carboy, the air locks, bottles and things like that. It is easy to do and the price is reasonable. The quality of the wine isn't great but it is acceptable.

This wine turned out so GREAT that my wife and friends had me order another 1 as soon as they tasted it. The bouquet was so fragrant and nice not to mention the taste which was fabulous. Will do another in the spring. Cornucopia kits include everything you need to make a great wine beverage, except the equipment. Try it, your sure to like it. The Farmwiner...

This product is great to use as a Sangria in the summer.  It is easy to make and comes with everything needed to make the wine.  Throw some fruit and rum in a punch bowl with it and you have an excellent summer patio drink.  Or just pour it over ice and it is a great patio drink as well.  Enjoy.

My Wife and I have been making wine from kits for about seven years now. This was our first Cornucopia Fruit Wine Kit. I think that my wife won't let me go back to our other brands now. The flavor of this wine is so incredibly Raspberry flavor, it's as if you are really biting into sweet juicy RED RASPBERRIES and the juice is running down your fingers and chin and the aftertaste you are left with is so pleasant on your tongue, you feel like you spent the day picking Raspberries and eating them as well. This kit was very easy to make. The only thing I did a little differently as far as bumping up the alcohol is I added about 2.5 lbs of corn sweetner (clear Karo) at the beginning of the fermenting. Just add it before the yeast. We have the Pear kit Fermenting now. And we just ordered a second kit of this Red Raspberry. We give a lot to friends and family and neighbors and they all want more more MORE!!!! lol. Well, we are looking forward to trying other flavors. My wife says to try the Red Currant for the holidays. And Green Apple at least. From all the reviews I read, it looks like there really isn't any flavor that is bad. So if your looking for an intense fruit flavor try this Red Raspberry Pinot Nero. You certainly will not be disappointed. Bet you can't drink just one glass!
Fantastic taste, No artificial ingredients and No High Fructose Corn Syrup, Gluten Free, 100% of your daily Vitamin C...what more could you want?
We have tried other flavors of the cookies with fair texture and good flavor, but these taste like chocolate chalk.

I thought I wouldn't like these cookies. I really dislike Oreo's, and I thought these would be similar. Fortunately, they taste nothing like Oreo's. They are actually very soft instead of crunchy. They also taste just like fudge. We go through packages of these way too quickly! So nice to have a gluten free dairy free cookie that is so satisfying.
I already had one of the chocolate factorys. I use it a lot for making differant treats for when we have our Sunday School Class meetings.
Kids love it and it is fun to see them have a blast during get together.

A big thumb's up! I use this every year for making some chocolate dipped cookies for the holidays. The tools included make the process so easy for producing what many people think are store bought cookies. For the price you can't beat this!The only reason I didn't give this 5 stars is that the inside of the bottom pan lost some of the coating and there is a touch of rust. This particular green flavor of monster nitrous is so good tasting that I find myself drinking it for the taste.  I have never previously done that with an energy drink.  Whenever I need to start my day before sunrise, this is my energy drink of choice.

These snacks are very addicting. I brought a bag with me to the ER and openned it up to share with my family members. They all commented it was good. Never got the bag back.  Plus the price is way cheaper than the grocery store even when they're on sale!

column9: Its The Best Quality So Far

This is w/o a doubt, the best instant coffee I've ever had. Subscribe & Save makes a big difference in price when you drink a lot of coffee like we do, so that's a great option.

This is absolutely one of the best seasonings for chicken cooked on a rotisserie. I bought this once at Costco, and haven't been able to find it there, or anywhere, since. Maple is marvelous - you'll find so many uses for this - you can even share it with friends - they'll love you for it!

I tried this on chicken in Sam's Club and bought one large bottle. When I went back it wasn't there anymore and no other store carried this flavor. But Amazon came through as usual. I shared the bottles with friends and coworkers who are inexperienced cooks. This makes a perfect flavor everytime.
This fixes your salt and sweet cravings at the same time.  Preventing my back and forth eating salty then sweet snacks.
for the most part, this trail mix was pretty good. as a college student, this was a great snack during my study sessions and in between classes.

This mix is good, but is a little sweet for my taste. I wish the peanuts were salty, at least, to balance out the other ingredients.  Overall an okay mix, but definitely on the sweet side.

column9: Excellent Taste with large whole strawberries

I love Emerald's Trail Mix Berry Blend but I can never find it in my local stores.  Very pleased with this purchase.

This one my favorite item the reason as follows, so great I eat 1/1/4 for BKF,SNACK and over salad. I shared this item with family, friends, Church Members and everyone just can't get enough. Hello, just don't take my word, try this item and all the other EMERALD BRANDS and you will like the prices too.

This is another excellent, quality mix by Emerald.  The blend is terrific and leaves nothing to be desired.  A great snack on the go, at work, on the slopes, out on the golf course... you name it!  I also highly recommend the Emerald "Breakfast Blend" mix.

column9: Emerald Berry Blend Premium Trail Mix
column10: So glad to find my favorite trail mix at Amazon since I cannot find it locally.

I spent $33 dollars on 2, 5oz hot sauces. That is all that i received. Just 2....... 5oz bottles of hot sauce! No 'out house' to be seen, even shook the small, small box. I don't think i have lost my mind so i can't believe this really happened. Ohhh what am i to do with the bottles now?

Excellent blend for early morning risers. Makes reading the newspapers more enjoyable. I was looking for a good packaged variety of coffees for my new brewer.  This is the one I chose.

I must have a dozen or so of these little skulls floating around my house now.  Both my wife and I have them on our key chains.  And a few are hanging as trophies in our kitchen.Because we love "Blair's Jalapeno Death Sauce with Tequila."  It's really yummy, and has tons of flavor. I ordered this for a family member who loves hot sauces, mustard, and other spices.  He loved the flavor and boldness of this sauce.
This popcorn is only 1 Weight Watcher point per bag.  It tastes great and very filling.
Excellent product.Fits in so well with my diet. The size assists with portion control.Will definitely purchase again.
JUST RIGHT SIZE FOR A NICE SNACK WITH LOW CALORIES. TASTES GOOD AND POPS UP PERFECTLY ON MICROWAVE OVEN. WELL PRICED ALSO!
This is a perfect sized bag, tasty and satisfying, and none of that nasty artificial butter flavor!

I love this product, it pops perfect every time. It is the perfect snack, low fat and very high fiber. Only 1 point per bag on W/W. My whole family likes the taste and it's a great value in this package.

column9: A great bargain for the waist line!

It is a portioned bag of 100 calories, so you can eat the entire thing and not worry about over indulging. I recently lost a lot of weight - and this was my snack of choice. Oddly enough,the kids were happy to see this thrown in their bag of goodies.I always preferred reeses but,what can I say... kids today.

column9: 60 bags of tasty popcorn for $23.82 hand delivered to your front door!
column10: I love this popcorn! Not just because it is 100 calories, it just really good microwave popcorn. It doesn't have too much of that fake butter flavor or anything. column9: Pretty good and not horribly salty
column10: I got this because the generic popcorn I was buying was so salty it was disgusting and I wanted to try something name brand that might not be so bad. column9: Jolly Time 100 Calorie Mini Bags Healthy Pop Butter
column10: This popcorn is wonderful. I love the mini bags, they are perfect for one person.  They give you just enough to satisfy any cravings you might be having. The expiration date was one year out , so plenty of time to eat these before they expire.

First off... there are a lot of popcorn. For those of you watching your weight this is the way to go. This and diet soda can keep you for one of your meals. Definitely a must.

I have tried various "lite" popcorns.  This Jolly Time 100 calorie is the best one.  Great flavor, and the convenient small pack, helps me monitor my calories.  The vendor was terrific.  I received my order promptly !
This is the best pop corn that I have ever bought. The 100 calorie and low salt was what I was looking for. The flavor is great.. I will for sure be ordering this product again...

I purchased this from Amazon because it is my favorite popcorn and I cannot find large boxes of it where I am currently staying.  This snack keeps me from eating heavy calorie snacks which would hinder my effort to lose weight.
I must have this in the house at all times!!!  I love that I know it is only 1 weight watcher point.  It is just the right serving size and tastes fantastic!  Get it!
Not the tastiest popcorn. Not very salty and not buttery at all. But it does pop up nicely and you get a lot of popcorn for 100 calories.

Great product! The popcorn is low in calories (100) and a delicious snack. The aroma alone is worth the price.I pop a bag every morning and take it to work for a snack at mid-day. lv this product since it WW approved it is a great filling food.  I like the fact I can order this directly from Amazon.  This is the only way I purchase some of my items.  I like the fact I can get it in bulk
This popcorn tastes good and is the ideal size for a snack.  It is good for children too.

column9: My Favorite for Low Fat and Great Taste
column10: I love popcorn with a buttery flavor, but I don't like the unhealthy levels of fat in the best tasting microwave popcorn. So, I tried low fat popcorn from Jolly Time, Orville Redenbacher, Act II, Smart Balance and a store brand. Jolly Time Healthy Pop Butter is my favorite. This is a great snack, love the built in portion control. Be careful when cooking though, it's easy to burn!

this is an ideal snack. high in fiber, low in calories, and fat.  Excellent snack to have anytime or especially at night as my night meal is the smallest.

column9: Great product, but it is 3 WW PointsPlus points per bag (not 1)
column10: Amazon needs to upload a new picture of the box.  What you'll get is a box showing clearly that this is THREE WW PointsPlus points (not ONE).  It is likely that the 1 point references the earlier WW point tracking system.  3 points is not outrageous for a decent popcorn like this, but if you were hoping for a 1-point wonder snack, this isn't it.  It actually tastes pretty good, but I wouldn't go so far as to call it "butter flavor" as it could stand to use a bit more flavor, especially considering it is 3 points, not 1.  But I have to say it is better than a lot of the lower calorie micro-popcorn out there, it satisfies the "popcorn" / "crunchy" itch just fine.  And, you don't get in trouble like you do with the full bags... so just be clear on what you're getting here.  I would order it again, I just won't be eating them as often as I originally expected given the higher points values.

column9: This is an exceptional bouillon maker that is healthy for you to use!
column10: We use this bouillon to add to our meals for multiple reasons.  Whether it is chicken of beef flavored it adds flavor to your meal without adding fat and provides an ideal bouillon to use to make gravy with or to use as a basting sauce to roast or broil your meat in.  You are buying all the flavor and you add your own water to make it as concentrated as you would like.  You can dissolve the bouillon powder in hot water and pour it into your food to cook it or simply stir it in without any water at all. You can even add it to vegetables to get a beef or chicken flavor added to them.This is great tasting, fast to make, and it is made by Hormel.  It contains only 2 carbs, 1 sugar and 1 protein per serving.  But here is the best part, it is:* Gluten free* Sodium Free* MSG FreeIf you are on a low salt and low fat diet then this is the ideal product for you. We use it all the time and it tastes good and we like the benefits that it brings to our meals as far as added flavor without some of the negative factors that you can get with other brands.  It lets you use less oil and butter while cooking and still make a tasty meal.  We like this product and we believe you will to.

I came online to order more and am leaving this review...

column9: best orange tea around by far!!

Obviously this company is off-loading its dented cans via internet shoppers.  Out of twelve cans I received, only one was in pristine condition. I will avoid this company in the future because of this lack of disclosure.

I will not use them again.  100 percent guarantee, good luck!  I honestly did not contact them after the goods were finally here. Nothing happend before my inquiries...don't expect further help.

The other reviews are right!  Do not buy this product unless you are okay with using dented cans, which have been proven to grow harmful bacteria!

column9: Numi Morning Rise Breakfast Blend Tea
column10: This is an absolutely lovely tea blend. I drink it with milk and a little splenda, and the taste holds up beautifully. It has quickly become my weekend and special occasion tea, because it costs more than plain old Lipton. I'm thrilled to find it here on Amazon.

*****Numi Tea's Morning Rise Breakfast Blend Black Tea is a premium Numi tea, both certified organic and kosher. The ingredients are fair trade certified organic Keemun black tea, fair trade certified organic Darjeeling black tea, fair trade certified organic Ceylon black tea, anfair trade certified organic Assam black tea. A powerful black tea blend indeed! There is nothing artificial in this or in any Numi tea.On the box, the manufacturer writes: "Numi perfects the classic breakfast tea with this organic black tea blend, Morning Rise. Four of the most extraordinary black teas compose this hearty, complex, and exciting morning cup. Ceylon, gardened in the small and exotic country of Sri Lanka, bestows its strong yet smooth profile, while Indian grown Assam imparts a malty and robust depth. Keemun, from China, offers deep burgundy notes that complement the natural floral finish and fruity Muscatel of Darjeeling, cultivated on the mountain peaks of India. This rich, bold black tea blend has an unrivaled smoothness and a magnificent aroma resembling dawn's early warmth. Let the morning greet you through the radiant daybreak of Numi's superior Breakfast Blend."It tastes strong and and is perfect for people who want a black tea that is not flowery or herbal-y but tasty, complex, and superb high-quality in the morning.The price is perfect, a big savings over single boxes. If you like Numi teas, get it---you won't be sorry. If you are new to Numi but love black tea, this will probably be the best you've ever had.*****

column9: Lovely way to start the day
column10: I look forward every morning to my first cup of this lovely Numi tea. This delightful blend of all my favorite black teas holds up well to my embelishment of a little stevia. It's the perfect ritual to start my day.  It's a bit spendy but cheaper here at Amazon than at my local health food store and worth every penny.  Numi represents a truly excellent organic product.
I adore Numi teas! They are usually organic and well priced at Amazon. Much better than a lot of the teas sold here.

Numi has created a breakfast blend with four of the most popular black teas--Keemun, Assam, Ceylon and Darjeeling. The aroma is a fine grassy floral tea blend. The leading flavor is Keemun, a malty, slightly smoky flavor. This is a smooth subtle cup of tea, without some of the more characteristic robustness of most Breakfast blends.  However, it is still a very stimulating blend--fairly high in caffeine I would guess from its effect!  Unfortunately, Numi does not list caffeine count on the box.Numi gets points for their manufacturing process and packaging. The boxes containing their tea is made from 100% recycled paperboard from 100% post-consumer waste--they assert that by using such packaging materials they save 2,040 trees, reduce landfill by 131,200, and prevent 184,000 greenhouse emissions. Numi uses only 100% natural ingredients without added oils or "natural flavorings".

column4: Nathan Holt "Slice Em and Dice Em"
column10: Just love this tea.  I had it for the first time at a restaurant and quickly found it in a grocery store.  It is the perfect taste to me, and no matter now long it seeps (if I forget to take the bag out) it doesn't develop that bitter taste. It IS more expensive, but I find that it is very much worth it.  Perfect anytime, but a cup of Numi is really my favorite treat in the winter or after a cold rain.
I love this tea.  Marvelous complex flavor.  I never get tired of it.

Let me say I love Sparkling Ice flavored water. I am enjoying trying all the flavors, and they are all a refreshing and tasty way to drink your water. The pomegranate is not as flavorful as some of the others, its a little weak tasting to my family and I. Its not bad, but if you closed your eyes, you'd never guess what this flavor was. My daughter said it tastes "pink" and that about describes it. I recommend the orange mango, the blackberry, for a little more flavor.

column9: My grown kids and grand kids love it
column10: My grown kids always dieting love the flavors and that it is carbonated, especially the Pomegranate Berry, my grandkids, whose parents are always watching what they are drinking, love them just as much.  I had one accident with the grandkids who had carried it into my bedroom and spilled on my carpet, I didnt think I was going to be able to get out the pink stain and was very surprised when a rag w/a little cold water got it right out.  My frig is usually the first place the whole family looks to see what flavors I have on hand. I think Sparling Ice Mountain Spring Water is far better that most on the market.

my daughter and i were looking for something refreshing to drink that wasn't plain water or something filled with chemicals.  we are very pleased with the taste of this beverage and have purchased other flavors as well.

column9: The best flavor of all the Sparkling ICE flavors
column10: The Sparkling ICE brand is one of my favorite drink brands ever. I always thought I was craving sugar when I would reach for a soda instead of water (which wasn't often but often enough to make me hate myself for craving something so inherently unhealthy) but after realizing that it was the carbonation I was after, I quickly changed to these calorie free (and carb free, gluten free, and caffeine free) drinks instead. They are seriously so GOOD.And this pomegranate flavor is by far my favorite. Many of the others are so strongly flavored (the pineapple one in particular) that you can't drink it with every type of meal (ie seafood, pasta, etc) which was annoying. This one though, I found I could. I didn't expect to like it as much as I did seeing as how I'm not a huge fan of pomegranate but if I had to chose one drink that I had to drink for the rest of my life without ever having anything else, this would be a very close second behind water. It's THAT good.The only thing I would note is that it is sweetened with Splenda. Splenda doesn't bother me at all but my husband can instantly tell the difference and ends up with a stomach ache any time he consumes it so unfortunately these can't help me to get him off his soda kick. So if you are also sensitive to Splenda, this isn't the product for you.

We discovered this ICE water while on vacation.  All the locals were buying this, so we tried it.  Wow!  It was refreshing, 0 calories, tasty and very flavorful.  Easily replaces soda.  Not available here in MD, so we order assorted flavors from Amazon.  We are believers.

I found this at the local supermarket at 10 dollars for 10 bottles so I bought a few in various flavors. I don't usually like the taste of diet drinks but this stuff tastes totally different to me. The price at the market went up 30% recently so I switched to Amazon and with Prime its a really good deal. I like the pomegranate best.

Although labeled as 'naturally flavored sparkling mountain spring water', this product lists no fewer than 17 other ingredients beside water. Some of those ingredients seem decidedly suspect, and, at the very least, totally unnecessary: food dyes Red #40 and Blue #1.  Various groups and agencies here and abroad have expressed concern about risky side effects from using these dyes in food.  In any event, nothing good can come from them. The list of ingredients also includes two different gums, sucralose, and potassium benzoate, also questioned by consumer groups. I fail to understand why a product being touted as a healthy drink can contain so many weird ingredients.  I hope the company behind "Ice" will respond with an explanation here.  In any event, I won't be ordering "Ice" again unless it is entirely reformulated to remove the useless items.

I've been eating this wild rice for years. I order it directly from the native American community that hand harvests and dries the wild rice. Now it's much more convenient to order from Amazon. I first bought the rice because my grandmother could no longer send me the two or three pounds of native wild rice she gave me each year for holiday meals...so I ordered a pound of Bineshii wild rice.What a surprise! This natural grown wild rice is far superior to the varieties grown on gigantic agribusiness farms in California. It is one of the very best Native American harvested products I've ever tasted. It cooks much more quickly and reliably than agribusiness wild rice, and the taste and texture is very nutty and so delicious. Bineshii wild rice does cost more than mass produced rice, but this is the real thing, and the real thing tastes so much better. My family is spoiled now, they notice if the wild rice isn't Bineshii, and complain if I put anything else on the table! Try a pound, you won't be disappointed.

This was shipped to me very fast.  The wild rice is very good quality , far superior to any cultivated wild rice normally found in markets.  Cooks very fast . Instructions said 17-22 minutes , I liked it cooked for 10 minutes at the most.  Slight smokey flavor , nice firm texture  .
Received the rice in a timely fashion.  I am well pleased with the quality of this product, and I will order again.

column9: Another nice smoked salt from Artisan Salt Co.
column10: This is another nice selection from the Artisan Salt Co., of which I've grown to trust a great deal, as the quality of their products is quite good. column9: Cats LOVE this Dry Food.  Best Commercial Product List I've Found that in Reasonably Priced Commercial Pet Food. RECOMMENDED.
column10: I have 4 cats ranging in age from 2-10 years old.  We previously fed them Iams Multi-Cat dry food which we purchased in 20lb bags at our local warehouse store.
