Every time I unwrap a bar and take that first bite, my thought is, "These are GOOD FOR ME???".I recommend trying these if you are diabetic, borderline diabetic, or just want something healthy and tasty to snack on.

I hadn't used a balsamic glaze before, so I wasn't sure if I'd like it or not. I tried this on some pork chops and it was very nice. I think the key is to not put too much on, or it could overwhelm the meat. WHen I get daring, I'm going to try some on some vanilla ice cream - I'm told it tastes good. I need to find some other types of meat to try it on - maybe chicken.10/8/2012 update - I have since used the glaze on chicken, and it was very good. My wife wasn't as much of a fan as I was, but she did say it was OK. Balsamic vinegar has a very strong taste, so even with a glaze, I think the key is that less is better. It is easy to overwhelm the item you are putting the glaze on.

column9: delicious fresh exotic flavor, unique and versatile
column10: Bergamot is reminiscent of orange or lemon extract, but with it's own particular personality.  It is a delicious substitute for lemon flavoring in teas and cookies. It makes a nice cologne, too.
These are the best chocolate covered coffee beans that I have ever had.  They are very fresh and very tasty.  I ordered a pound for my mother in law.

I love these cinnamon candies.  They are not the same as the cinnamon disks or imperials.  Much better!  I am having trouble finding them.  Was able to get the 2# bag at Wal-Mart but the last two times I have been there, they have not had any.
Seems Brach's is doing away with this mint which is a shame.  By far the best Cinnamon mint on the market.

I love the Brach's Star Brites Cinnamon Mints.  However, I always bought them at WalMart for approximately $2.99 per bag.  I can't buy them again at the price I paid.  Why were they at least $15.00 more per bag.  I find that unconsionable.  You asked me for my opiniion now I would like your answer to my opinion.  Thank you.
Have always kept these available at work, a lot of disappointed people there now. The very best cinnamon candy on the market, well it use to be. Hope Brach's will bring them back!

I quit smoking 6 1/2 years ago and these Brach's cinnamon disks have been a staple in my house. I, too, was buying the 2# bags at Walmart, who has stopped carrying them at all.  One local grocery store has the smaller bags, one.  And if they sell out, I am left scrounging for knockoffs which are nothing like the Brach's brand.Please, Brach's, do not discontinue.

column9: Can't keep the bowl full in my office!
column10: These are wonderful "desk" candies...everyone who stops by takes at least one. Spicy but not too hot. The problem is finding them. As another reviewer stated, I used to find them at Wal Mart but haven't in a while. I just WILL NOT pay $16.50 plus shipping for 2# of candy as listed by one seller here on Amazon. Yes, they are good, but whoa...I MIGHT pay $8/pound for some good fudge or really fine chocolates, but not for a plain hard candy like this.

We had been looking for a long time for a decent decaf black tea to have in the afternoon and evenings. Tried this Typhoo on a whim. After a long search of tasting no flavour decafs, we were elated to find this robust and lovely. We are very pleased that the search is over!

This is so flavorful and decaf! This is the best decaf on the market. I would usually use 2 decaf bags just to have color in my tea.  Typhoo just one round bag does the trick.  You will not be disappointed.

column9: Best decaf hot tea I have tasted!
column10: I buy this in the UK but it is wonderful to know I can get it here if supplies run low between trips! I recommend steeping the bag for several minutes, then adding milk and sugar to taste. It has been a lifesaver during cold and flu season. I prefer it to PG Tips, which I find to be quite bitter. Typhoo has a much smoother taste.

I love this tea...in fact it is the only hot drink I drink and I have ordered it several times but I won't again!Several of the bags are torn...when you open the silver foil pack...always very careful when I do...you can see small tears in many of the bags and of course the tea is leaking out.I have never had this happen before...and I always buy this brand.  So either this was a bad "batch" or the quality control is slipping.Buyer beware!!!!!!!!!!!

column9: I've tried them all, this is the best
column10: I gave up caffeine ten years ago. I spent months and months trying to find a decaf black tea that actually had flavor or didn't taste like seaweed. (Seriously. Lipton decaf tastes fishy.) I finally found a few brands that were fantastic. Decaf PG Tips is solid. But decaf Typhoo is, by far, the best decaf tea I'ver ever tasted. In fact, it's the only decaf brand I will purchase.If you've been disappointed with decaf teas, give Typhoo a try. You'll be shocked at its strong, full-bodied flavor.Having said that, these days, to save cash, I usually make my own decaf tea. Turns out something like 90% of the caffeine in a regular tea bag is released in the first 30 seconds of brewing time. So, if I want a cup of tea late at night I heat enough water for two cups, brew the bag for 30 seconds in the first cup then toss that stuff and drop the now-decaffeinated bag in the fresh hot water.But I always keep some decaf Typhoo on hand when I don't have the patience to make my own decaf tea.
This tea is difficult to find and is fantastic.  Highly recommend it.  Good service from the vendor.

column9: I Grew Up On This Tea!
column10: In England babies have this mixed with their milk formula and then in the younger years its customary to drink cups of this nectar. YAHOO TYPHOO!
I live in Japan and it is little difficult for me to getdecaffeinated tea bag here.I sent it to my brother's address.It is really helpful to find this kind of stuff on the amazon.com!

I have to drink decaf tea in the evenings and before I found this Typhoo I always had to trade off decent tasting tea for being able to sleep at night. But Typhoo decaf makes a very robust and flavorful pot of tea. On more than one occasion, somebody in the family has grabbed this decaf by mistake and nobody even realized it was decaf until we noticed the distinctive round bag in the bottom of the pot. This tea is best brewed by the pot using fully boiling water. If you try to make it by the individual cup using 190 degree water or water heated in a microwave, you'll probably be disappointed. Besides compromising the flavor, brewing by the cup would be wasteful since a single bag makes a good three cups of tea. The only compromise needed when brewing this decaf over regular black tea is the decaf needs to steep a bit longer (I'd say ten minutes) for maximum flavor. Alternatively, you can limit the water to two cups and then it's ready in about six minutes. Typhoo also makes regular caffeinated black tea which I consider to be just average.
Hard to find a decaf tea with such great flavor and strength.Typhoo is terrific.I've tried a number of different decaf teas and this is undoubtedly one of the best.
I really liked this tea an have no complaint about it... like the extra leaf taste in it kinda makes it a little stronger tasting tea an not water tating

In my hunt for good strong decaf, I've tried many. This is the best, alongside Tetley. I actually drink a 14 ounce cup in the morning using one bag of Tetley decaf and one bag of Ty-phoo. One would be hard pressed to guess it was full decaf. I'm throwing out my PG Tips. After forty-or-so cups, I've given it a good trial, but it's just too "green" for me. Sticking with this one...just placed another order. Ty-phoo is strong, with no weird designer tea flavors added, and no off-tastes. As close to the caffeinated tea you really want to drink as you will get.

This is a great tea on the strong side which is just the way I like it.  I will drink this cold or hot and love the tase.  I sometimes combine it with green tea to get the benefits of the black and green teas together!  A true English tasting tea.  If you enjoy strong, full-bodied, teas you will love Ty-phoo!  The decaf does not take away from the flavor.  You will not be disappointed!  One bag will brew 2 cups of tea easily!
Very nice company to work with.  My first shipment was damaged and they immediately overnighted me a new order.PG Tips 80 Tea Bags

(I'm in Arkansas, not Argentina)Typhoo tea is a traditionally British blend and the Decaf version won't dissapoint you. Assam tea is a large part of the blend which adds the "maltiness" and mouth feel that drinkers of Irish and Scottish Breakfast teas enjoy. I never drink this type of tea without milk and it was blended to be enjoyed that way. These are larger teabags than you'll find with Twinings or Bigalow brands of "breakfast" tea. I've been a tea lover for 35 years and spent many years in the UK drinking all kinds of teas, my daily black tea is Typhoo Decaf because :- a water based meathod decaffeinates the tea, no chemicals are ever used- Typhoo has a full flavor of malty Assam lightened with Ceylon (compared to PG Tips which is lighter on Assam, less malty)- the round teabags are designed to filter the maximume flavor from the tea- 1 teabag makes a heafty 12oz mug or slightly lighter 14oz pot of tea- it's a great cuppa any time of day because there's minimal caffeine (average caffeine in Decaf teas is barely 5mg)- if I over-steep this tea it doesn't get bitterCheck prices around the web and you'll find that Amazon offers the best deal, especially when there's Free Shipping !Typhoo Decaf gets you through the day and makes a relaxing cup before bed. It's the kind of tea you'd be served with rich biscuits and teacakes throughout the UK. if you like a heafty cup of tea with milk this Decaf will take care of you.NOTE : I always check the expiration dates on the boxes when they arrive to be sure a seller hasn't sold me outdated tea. This has only happened once and the seller is no longer on Amazon.
As a Soldier we work crazy hours, this product keeps you hydrated and energized ready to accomplish any mission.  Thank you MIO!

So, basically my morning routine is, wake up, go to work, buy an orange flavor Rockstar, and work; 5 times per week.I spend exactly 2.50 per can of Rockstar. The caffeine i get from it is mentally required for me, i can't function as well without having one.I saw these bottles at Ralphs for about $3.something. I bought this black cherry flavor, which packs 60mg of caffeine per 1/2 tbsp. Yikes! :)So, my routine now is, wake up, go to work, add some flavor to my water, and get to work.Assuming i drink 5 Rockstar's per week: $12.50The MIO black cherry container says it makes 18 8fl oz mixes but it depends on how many squirts you put. The regular water bottles are 16.9 fl oz. I think i can get at least 10 water bottles out of each little MIO.So, (10 approx. bottles * $0.25 approx cost of bottled water) + ($4 MIO) / (5 work days) =  around $6 dollars.If i want to save money, and reduce my overall costs of $13+ per week for energy drinks, I have to count on something with the same amount of kick (caffeine).This stuff has to work for me, and it has, so i recommend it.At least now i will be drinking water + enhancer.
I have a soda machine that is great!  These little bottles hold a lot of flavor that work great with the soda machine and they take up very little room.  Love the Cherry and Orange/Tangerine!

column9: best wine for pairing with sushi
column10: My husband and I recently had sushi at a fantastic restaurant in Annapolis, MD. called Joss. The server suggested that I try this wine with my sushi, so I did. It was so perfect. The wine is light and has a bright clean flavor, kind of cleans your pallette as you eat. I'm no expert, but was really pleasantly surprised. Try it with your sushi, you won't be disappointed.

We usually have to travel to China Town to buy this product and was so happy to have found it on Amazon. It was sent to us quickly and we love this tea which is very good for us. We would order from this company again. Thanks

column9: Still a good health choice, but blech!
column10: I had been purchasing loose leaves from another company, but one day when they weren't available, I ordered these bags.  Blech!!  The loose leaves from Immortalitea were such a pleasant tasting product.  These bags are so pungently horrible tasting that one shudders when sipping it.  I can't get past the taste.

If you like bitter, putrid tastes, this may be the tea for you.  The tea tastes so terrible I am sure it will be thrown out.  Gynostemma is supposed to taste good. Something is very wrong with this product.  I drink a lot of herbal teas, so I can usually tolerate new flavor.

column9: I bought this brand at a local store (not Amazon) and it tastes horrible
column10: I bought jiaogulan from multiple places and this brand doesn't taste right. It tastes bitter with no sweet aftertaste. I would not buy Sheng Tangshen Brand jiaogulan/gynostemma pentaphyllum.
I was not quite sure about the results.  I took only morning and evening.  Result was excellent.  I felt my stomach is smooth.
this tea is for medical use to lower blood pressure. it seems to have diuretic effect

What fun to find candy I loved as a child! Even more wonderful to find these old candies for my kids to enjoy in any season! To be in individual packs to eat in smaller quantities at a time is perfect!
I could not find Nestle Crunch Crisp bars in any store in US.  I was quite happy to find them on Amazon.  The product is superb, delivery was fast and packing perfect.  Thank you!!!

I have been a fan of these since i first saw them - can't have the old time fatty wafer and these are tasty and crisp. I don't mind buying them this way but wish the local store would have continued to order them.
It's hard to find the 20 pack boxes locally.This is convenient and cheaper than thesmall packs. When I can find the big boxes,the price is about the same.
Great product, great taste, but also a great ripoff at $15 when it's available at a local grocery for approx. $3.80 !
This product is great for a quick cup of coffee. If you use a mug I suggest that you use 2 "sticks". It ain't perked but it's close.
I love the flavor. It's my favorite with grape coming in a close second. It's wonderful on a hot day.

Not mutch to say, but my wife and I are both on a diet and we are trying to drink only water.  Water gets very boring after a short time and I love this fruit punch stuff.  We keep a gallon made at all times and its pretty much all we drink.  We get it off amazon for almost half what you pay at giant eagle.  Then we sav any extra 15% for auto reorder.  Can't say enough...

column9: Sugar Free Fruit Punch for Grown Ups!
column10: With the summer heat, a cool drink it what hits the spot.  You could drink something like Snapple, but at such a lower cost and just as good (if not better) are these Crystal Light Drink Mixes.  The Fruit Punch is a winner!
Delivery was very fast but the jelly beans were loose in a box and were stale.  I will never buy from this seller again.

One star for never replying to my email in which I included a photograph of a foreign object I found in the first package (looked like a dark brown chunk of foam, along with a hair). I was very much concerned when reading the labels' country of origin that among three, included China (Somehow I doubt that Canada beat out China for pricing = most likely China). Although I'll never know for sure since they never responded to any of my questions/concerns. I wouldn't recommend this product if your concerned about food quality.

column9: Black Tea with a great Apricot taste
column10: If you like me wear and drink black, then this tea is for you. I for the most part keep cautions of fruity teas, I like my tea solid and strong. However this tea had this boldness with a twist of Apricot, which I enjoyed. It is great to break-up a routine of always just black and have some additional flavor to it, and this tea is the one.
This oil is wonderful!  Use it to add kick to pasta or pizza.  Use regular olive oil, fresh garlic, and capers with a four or five drops of this per dish for a wonderful Italian pasta sauce.

If you have yet to try the Zevia line of natural sodas, you're in for a real treat!  Finally, a sugar-free soda that tastes GREAT and isn't loaded with artificial chemicals and flavorings!These drinks are winners for me because they're sweetened with all-natural Stevia, which has zero glycemic affect but all the great taste of sugar... and the flavorings are natural!!  I can drink it all day without going into sugar overload!Thus far I have tried the cola, root beer, orange and the latest, Dr. Zevia... THE BEST!!  Root beer comes in a close second!!  For some reason, I like them better over crushed ice rather than straight out of the can... Seems that these sodas taste even better if they can breathe a bit (or maybe I'm just crazy!).  Either way, TRY ZEVIA, then come back and tell me how right I am!!  LOL!!
I'm so glad to have another caffeinated choice of Zevia than just the cola. This one is obviously modeled after Dr. Pepper... I'd compare it's flavor more to Cherry Dr. Pepper. It's very yummy!

column9: Not a substitute but still Good
column10: This is not a bad flavor, but it's not a good substitute for Dr Pepper like Veggie burgers are a not a good substitute for Hamburgers.This soda has more of a cherry overtone, but very little bite and is much sweeter than diet Dr Pepper. However, by itself as a new flavor, it's really good and I still would recommend it to others.

column9: This flavor was not for me...
column10: Sprout's was having a sale on Zevia 6 packs (I got them for $4.50 a six pack, but they were usually $5.59), so i bought cola, rootbeer, orange, twist, Dr. Zevia, and black cherry flavors. I did not buy the ginger ale as i was never really a fan of any ginger ale.As far as Dr. zevia goes, I is by far the most intense flavor, in my opinion. Too strong for me. Very very cherry...it almost tasted like cough syrup without the consistency. I ignored someone's warnings on this flavor, and now i regret wasting 5 bucks on the six pack. Im a really big diet dr. pepper fan, and Dr. zevia just didnt cut it for me. :/As far as the other flavors go:The orange one seemed a little too light in flavor. (I rate it 4/5)Black cherry was perfect for me! (5/5) Nice flavor and carbonation.Cola (5/5) and rootbeer (5/5)were good too. Cola almost tasted like Diet Rite with slightly less carbonation. Rootbeer is hard to compare to anything.The lemon lime twist one was interesting. As a sierra mist gal, i had high hopes. Unfortunately, i would give it a 3/5. It just had a funny taste to it. Hard to compare it to anything really.This is just my two cents on the flavors.I refridgerated them, so i drank them ice cold. I can't comment on the flavors when they are luke-warm.

This soda is fantastic, I was dreaming of the day it would be made. Seriously its great. My kids love it and the best part is that it is all natural! no cancer causing benzoate- I do not feel guilty drinking this soda every now and then!

A long time ago I tried Zevia's Orange soda and was really disappointed.  Eventually I tried the lemon/lime flavor, which I found similarly underwhelming, but the Cola flavor was actually not bad, although not great.  I do actually quite like their Root Beer flavor though, and have been buying it for awhile now.  So just recently I finally decided to give Dr Zevia a try, after seeing it on the shelves and not expecting it to be that good (I think maybe because I associated the red packaging with the color of Jones Soda's diet cherry flavor, which I tried once and did not like at all, and which usually sits nearby at the store).  So anyway, WOW.  Root Beer is now my second favorite Zevia flavor.  When I indulge in regular sugar-sweetened soft drinks, I prefer Root Beer over Dr. Pepper.  But I now feel that Dr. Zevia is their best offering, and tastes more like the real thing and less like a "diet drink" than any of their other sodas.  I've been getting two six packs of their Root Beer at a time, but from now on I think I'll be buying at least one of Dr. Zevia instead.  I'm very impressed with this drink!

column9: the new lord of diet soda
column10: Zevia is eventually going to destroy other diet sodas once they are officially labeled as dangerous. Until then, it is a great secret. Dr. Zevia is the crown jewel. It tastes almost sugary with a complex cherry-like flavor. Get some.

After reading all the warnings about artificial sweeteners, I found these sodas from Zevia. Nothing artificial, just with natural sweetness and no calories. We probably would have had the sweetener Stevia years ago if our domestic producers of artificial sweeteners hadn't interfered. It has been used in Japan for over thirty years.

This is a nice, dark tea with a really rich vanilla flavor. It smells amazing. I've had other vanilla teas that smell sort of artificial, like a vanilla scented candle, and don't have a great taste, but this one smells like real vanilla and is delicious. Perfect for tea-time with cookies.

As someone who does not drink caffeine, I am always challenged to find a great hot beverage. I picked up some of this tea on a whim because Amazon was having a special on it.  I love it.The tea is wonderfully spiced with a great aroma that makes you feel warm and cozy on a cold winter's night.  And, since it's decaf, I don't have to work about it keeping me awake.

I love this tea.  It gives me three cups from one bag and it does not give me a horrible caffeine high!  The taste is the best Chai that I have found out of a bag, even better than the caffeinated version.  Try it.
My wife loves this tea and drinks it in the morning as a pick me up and in the evening to help relax after a hard day's work.  Buying in quantity from Amazon helped make the price very attractive.

This is my FAVORITE tea, and the decaf version is difficult to find in stores.  Was thrilled to find it on Amazon and at a price similar to what I paid in stores previously.  The tea is lightly spicy and a bit sweet (no added sweetener needed, like other teas I also enjoy).  I also like that I can get about a cup & a half of tea out of one tea-bag (re-filling my cup after drinking the first half cup).  Tea bags are individually bagged so they are easy to take-along, too.
This tea is great!  I have been drinking it for at least a year now and never tire of it and nothing else seems to compare.  It is great with honey and a splash of milk.

Tazo's Chai is my favorite, and decaf does not disappoint. It makes its best mug around 8 oz, though I still roll with a 12 oz. mug on occasion and though slightly weaker, is still delish - particularly if I go latte with it. Decaf Chai is my version of sleepytime tea :)
This is the most delicious chai tea I've found that can be purchased in a bag. Try it with milk and sugar, it's fantastic.
i loved this tea especially in winter realy its warming the whole body in cold weather

Very good!  I like that it doesn't have any dairy, egg, peanuts, no allergens to speak of which is important to me.  The taste and texture complement any pizza pie, just as it should.  Sometimes pizza sauces containing cheese overtakes the whole pizza.  I was able to buy just 2 cans of this elsewhere to sample it.  Wish I could buy it by the case here.

My husband and I were at Whole Foods and found this sauce and thought we should try it.  When I went to check out, it was not in the system and they just gave it to us.  It was so good, when my husband deployed, he asked me to send him some.  I went back to Whole Foods and could not find it.  I explained to them that it was not even in the system when I got it the first time and they said that it meant that they must have received it by accident then and that it is not a normal product for them to receive.  I started the hunt all over the city of Colorado Springs and it can not be found anywhere.  I was so happy to find it online and stocked up.  I received it in a timely manner and bubble wrapped individually so I was able to move it from one box to another.

We tried this marinade on a whim. We ended up ordering a case - it's that good! We marinated boneless, skinless chicken breasts overnight and pork tenderloin - both were amazing! We gave a bottle as a gift and the people loved it as well. We will be buying more.
This stuff is excellent on pork steaks.  My husband and I (even my kids) love this stuff.  It's got a bit of a zing, but not too much.  Just great flavor.

column9: The dogs love it; my only complaint is the price doubling.
column10: I tried this and the chicken flavor for the dogs. Both flavors came in nice large sizes (22 oz instead of dinky 10-12 ounces) and the dogs love the taste/smell of it. If they like it, I'm happy too. My only complaint is that the price has roughly doubled from the time of my first order. Other items fluctuate somewhat, but an almost 100% increase makes this stuff no deal anymore. If you can find it elsewhere, or if the price goes back down, jump on it. Your dogs will, too.

Gosh, such a big can of key ingredients that should be healthy for your beloved animal:meat by-products, soy flour, salt, added color, artificial roasted chicken flavor, sodium nitrite and then also the better stuff which you can read for yourself.It's your beloved pet and your money. I'd save both and shop for a better brand without scary ingredients.

column9: Really Good, Much Better Than Expected
column10: If you are expecting the old Fiber One cereal then you are going to be in for a surprise. This cereal tastes like regular honey cluster cereals and not like Fiber One twigs. It is really good. And it will really make you regular with its amount of fiber. Even my kids enjoyed the taste.Highly recommend, try it, you'll like it.

In my first order, instead of sending Fiber One Honey Clusters, I got six boxes of "Basic Four" cereal. When I complained Amazon sent another shipment, but again, it was all Basic Four. I have given up on Amazon getting this order right and have asked for a refund.

I think this is the best tasting cereal in the Fiber One brand. I have been eating this for breakfast for more than 3 years now. My 2-year old niece snacks on it!At 51% of daily fiber, I found this a great way to get fiber in the morning, and it helps me be regular.I does not pack a lot of calories per serving also- I think 160-170 calories per cup. I tried other fiber-rich organic/health store cereals but either they are too sugary, or taste like cardboard.

The best cereal in the market for its fiber content, and it tastes good. I have been using this product for a few years and it has resolved many digestion digestion issues I had. Why take fiber supplement when one can eat fiber in food?

I've eaten regular Fiber One, but this is SO much more versatile!  Not only is it good with milk, but it's great dry as a midnight snack.  I often pour some in a bowl and eat it like chips while watching TV.My 3 year old son even likes this, which is a a HUGE plus!  He eats it with milk for breakfast, and even likes sharing a bowl with me while we watch TV after dinner.My wife is convinced she hates "fiber cereal", she changed her mind after I got her to try this without telling her what it is.  NOW, this is her choice for a quick breakfast.Now that I know the family likes this, I won't hesitate buying it by the case from Amazon rather than paying the higher prices for an individual box at the grocery store.

Love this product, it tastes great and each serving has 51% of your daily needed fiber. I'd rather have a bowl of this in the morning than to use a fiber supplement. My 3 year old loves it also. Tastes great and is not full of sugar ,like many of the kiddie cereals,so I happily let him have this for breakfast. It's also cheaper on Amazon than in the store.

I am very pleased with the order. The only thing I would change is the amount of time your customers can order your products. This product is 3 months or 6 months before ordering again. I think we should be able to order when we need the item. Three months is too soon and six months is way too much time in between. Other than that the flavor and cost is great. Thank you.

column9: One of the better high fiber cereals
column10: I generally like cereal with a little less sugar.  I can add my own sweetener if I want it.  Otherwise, it is a good flake type cereal with a good quantity of fiber.  It is a little low on protein compared to some cereal, but people generally add some protein by using milk.  You can add your choice of fruit (I usually like a combination of sliced banana and strawberries, and sometimes add blueberries).
Yummy and high fiber cereal, we like to eat it out of the box for a snack as well as with milk.

column9: Great cereal!  More fiber, without the disappointment.
column10: This cereal is absolutely fantastic...best fiber cereal yet that I've found.  It tastes more like I'm eating something just tasty instead of great for me.  Does wonders for the digestive health too.

Fiber One Honey Clusters accomplishes something most other fiber-laden foods don't: It has flavour!I was originally turned on to this cereal by a nutritional website's ranking of top cereals.  Compared to other "ultra-healthy" cereals like the original Fiber One it may not be the healthiest but it's a nice compromise to get a little sweetness out of your "grown-up" food while still providing some very worthwhile health & nutritional benefits.I don't know that any kids are going to be begging their parents for this because it obviously doesn't have all the sweetness of super-sugary cereals, but it also doesn't taste like cardboard and for those of us grown-ups who still have a bit of a sweet tooth, it fills the bill.  (If you want to add a bit of extra flavour, try it with Vanilla Silk soy milk.)Also, if you're the type of person for whom a single bowl of cereal doesn't cut it hunger-wise, this may have you singing a different tune in your morning shower.  Foods high in fiber give you a greater sense of being full so naturally this cereal should be able to keep you satisfied until your next meal.One word of caution though: For those of you who have not consumed high-fiber foods or taken Metamucil as a supplement before, start small and work your way up.  It's not uncommon to experience some uncomfortable digestive consequences if you try to take in too much fiber all at once without giving your body time to adjust.  In the long-term, though, fiber is obvisouly a fantastic way to keep your digestion in tip-top shape.Since Amazon only sells cereal in bulk, I always recommend taste-testing a single box at your local grocery.  But once you know you like it, the Subscribe & Save program may just save you money AND deliver your groceries to your door!
This is the first fiber cereal that actually tastes great. Finally an easy way to get your daily fiber. I would recommend this highly for anyone who is having trouble getting thier daily fiber.

I have been using this for about 8mos and love it. I do have a hard time finding this so I just get it on line and have it shipped. saves me gas and time and it is less then at a store when I do find it.

Can it be?  A cerial that has "fiber" in it's name that I don't have to mix with another cerial just to choke down?  Yes!!  This is it!  Get your fiber in a way that is actually pleasant.  I love the 21st century!

column9: Too much sugar, not enough fiber
column10: To be fair to those who must have pre-packaged sweetness in their breakfast cereal I've given this three stars. For readers like myself I'd give only one star. Reviewing this cereal on its own merits, it's OK: it tastes good and contains moderate amounts of fiber and sugar.The problem that I have with this particular Fiber One product (and to an even greater degree with the caramel and raisin-cluster versions) is that it scarcely resembles in any way its namesake, original Fiber One. When my local grocery ran out of the original Fiber One, I picked up this Honey Clusters version, thinking that with 51% of one's daily fiber requirement, it would be a decent substitute for the original, which provides 57% of the daily requirement. I should have read the label more closely: the serving size on which the 51% is based is twice that for the 57% provided by the original Fiber One; in other words, one has to consume more than twice as much in volume to get the same amount of fiber. In so doing, one will also consume almost three times as many calories due to the fact that sugar is present in several forms, including honey and high-fructose corn syrup. Original Fiber One uses aspartame rather than sugar. I really don't think that General Mills should squander the good name of Fiber One on this product.It is also most disingenuous to plaster "low fat" across the front of the package. Of course it is low-fat! Why would a product consisting of mostly grain and sugar contain much fat (other than a small amount for leavening and to help it hold together)?!! What General Mills is trying to imply is that this cereal is not fattening, hardly the case since it contains so many calories. The calories come mostly from sugar, and it could have been worse, though; some of the sweetness is from sucralose, which, contrary to the assertion of one reviewer, has not been proved to be "poison" by any reputable scientific study.Amazon considers all Fiber One cereals to be part of a "product set" and does not allow separate reviews; this is particularly unfortunate in that almost the only thing this product has in common with original Fiber One is the name and its ownership by General Mills. So I will elaborate a little on the original product, which is what any health-conscious person should buy instead. The original Fiber One is tasty, low-calorie, and the most pleasant way I know of to get more than half one's daily requirement of fiber. Some people won't like the form and texture of original Fiber One, however; if General Mills made a Fiber One in flake format that had the same taste and nutritional value of original Fiber One, they would have a virtually perfect product.

column9: At first I was'nt sure what to expect...

column9: Acai Gold: Increased energy, decreased weight
column10: Aug 2012 - I used Dynamic Health's Acai Gold as a last resort, because nothing else seemed to touch the extra weight I'd been carrying for years. Lo and behold! column9: Won the approval of my very finicky cats!

column9: My cats love this easily digestable, good-for-them Friskies
column10: I have five cats: two inside kitties and three feral cats (yes, they are spayed/neutered)that live in dogloos in my garden. All five love Friskies Senior Diet Lamb and Rice, and I know it's good for them. Amazon is competitvely priced even when compared to sales with coupons.

My four cats really, really like Friskies Cat Food Meaty Bits Senior Diet with Lamb & Rice in Gravy.  I add a little warm water which makes even more gravy and then mix in a small amount of dry food.  My cats are very impatient that I'm not faster at feeding them.  It doesn't matter to them that there is a pop tab on the can so I open it quickly.  In their opinion, I simply don't put the plates down fast enough.  I think they were watching episodes of Star Trek: The Next Generation where Data gives a command to the unit in his quarters and a mere second or two later, a bowl of food appears for his cat Spot.  I appreciate that Friskies Lamb & Rice comes in a senior formula as three of my cats are seniors and this formula is easy for them to digest.

Although this isn't his absolute favorite, I always have a few cans on hand to toss into the mix whenever my male gets tired of his regular routine. If you've EVER had a Persian (and PLEASE, feel sorry for me because I have TWO), you KNOW they're the most finicky of all cats.  But, every male I've ever had has gone crazy over this lamb variety.  It's just something very different, something they just don't make in every brand, so it's quite nice to have the change.  It has bits of rice in it which, although my guy thinks it's VERY unmanly, he does eat it clean.  I do recommend this variety, even though it's diet, he's had it since he was a year old.  Great stuff, highly recommend!

I bought this cat food because of the wonderful low price and I enjoy the adorable cat on the commercials. My cats did eat this food, in fact they really enjoyed it. However, after reading the ingredients and doing some research, I completely regret purchasing it and feel just awful for feeding it to my cats. The first few ingredients are (which indicates the most prevalent ingredients) are water sufficient for processing, meat by-products, chicken, turkey, and wheat gluten. At least there is chicken and turkey in it, which is the only reason it got more than 1 star from me. But other than that its all nasty stuff. Wheat Gluten is just gross and by-products aren't even a real meat! By-products are the stuff leftover once all the actual meat is harvested. We're talking beaks, chicken feet, eyeballs, even chicken poop! I would not recommend this product. It is just not a good quality cat food. I think the only reason why it was cat-approved may be because it contains artificial flavors that taste good to cats and because I usually feed them dry food for dental reasons and wet food puts off much more of a scent for them to enjoy. I recommend to stay far away from Friskies, as it is simply a very low quality filler food. Other Friskies flavors are even worse than this one. Even though the price is quite inexpensive, your cat will actually eat more than if you paid for a better quality food, because they will never feel full. Cats need to eat real, identifiable, pure meat, and there just isn't enough real meat in this food. When purchasing a cat (or dog) food, the most important thing to consider is the first 3 ingredients; just make sure those first three are decent ingredients that you can identify and would eat yourself. Now that I know what to look for, I usually buy my pets all natural foods such as Natural Balance, Blue Buffalo, Halo, or Wellness. All of those brands contain real, whole meats that I myself would eat, with no added fillers or low quality foods.

Contrary to what the picture on the labels implies, there aren't any meowing, cuddly kitten inside these cans! There's only mediocre fois gras in them. Two stars because my husband loves this fois gras on toast corners.

If I had a spa/salon/wellness center I would serve this tea!Even if the idea of Cucumber White tea puts you off, try it. I think you'll be as surprised as I was.

I bought these vanilla beans in 2007 and five years later they still made a delicious vanilla syrup. I've used them in other recipes although I found them difficult to open since they seem to dry out a bit. When I make vanilla syrup all I do is cut the beans into half inch pieces. To make a syrup bring two cups water and two cups granulated sugar to a boil. Add in eight cut up vanilla beans. When boiling lower heat so that the syrup is still rolling but more like a simmer. Simmer for 15 minutes. You want a bit of the water to evaporate. Then turn off the heat and cover the syrup. Leave it overnight so more vanilla is infused into the syrup. Then strain it through cheesecloth and pour it into a prepared bottle. I use an old vanilla syrup bottle. When you make your own syrup you don't have to worry about preservatives and it tastes way better. You can then drizzle your homemade syrup over fresh fruit or put it in your coffee. Don't expect the syrup to be clear however. The vanilla beans do color the syrup a bit.~The Rebecca Review

column9: A SWEET TOOTH CANNOT BE IGNORED
column10: To our taste these chocolates are on a par with far more expensive ones in glittery gift boxes.  We often take them as hostess gifts (hoping, of course, that said hostess will immediately open them and pass them around.)  See's Candies hasn't disappointed us yet.
Chocolates are great. Shipping costs are high. They took close to a week to actually ship the chocolates.

See's Candies is a well-known San Francisco chocolate company, now with stores throughout the United States.  In California, the lines to buy chocolate can snake out the door.  I've had See's Candies many times, most recently this assortment, and while See's makes an excellent product, the chocolate coating could be richer in flavor.  Still, these confections are above average; they easily outclass ordinary brands such as Russell Stover and Whitman's with fresher and more flavorful fillings.Anyone receiving a box of See's Candies for a gift knows that an extra effort has been made.  Although they aren't the best I've had, they certainly rank up there with the finest chocolate assortments available in a box.
The problem is not with the candy. Amazon pictures a christmas box but instead you get the regular white box.

$13.95 in shipping (5-7 days) for a $26.00 order!?!?!?  Do the math, that's OVER 50% extra on shipping alone.  Are you crazy?  We're not talking about Scharffen Berger chocolates here and they only charge $9 for 3 to 5 days (for a $30 order).  I don't care what chocolate you buy, but don't get taken on the shipping for a cheap product!!!
I really enjoy sending things online. This purchase was a gift so I really think that there should have been available a gift card to send with it. I had to mail a card separate from this purchase.

Although I have never ordered the candies from a website, I have heard from other reviews that the shipping is outrageous. I find that very disapointing since the chocolates themselves are so outstanding. However, these are available at other locations like airports around the country. That is, now a days you need to actually be flying in order to enter the shopping area, but that are often there if you do!
Nothing particulary outstanding about this chocolate, it's good but the extremely high shipping/handling costs not worth it.

they were really great and they came in excellent condition and i was a little worried with the heat that we have been having back here but it was in a cool chest and the candy did not melt and they had all the great taste of the candies that you get in the store. and the shipping was great too.

I've tried the rest, but this is the BEST!I've been eating See's candies since I was just a kid!  Easter was one of my favorite holidays, because my mom would order See's large easter eggs, we would get to pick our favorite filling, Chocolate or Chocolate Walnut, then we'd get a medium chocolate egg, I would always choose the Bordeaux (by far the best flavored candy See's sells), you could get the divinity if you liked that.  The buttercream is always a huge favorite at our house.  You have your choice of Dark or Milk chocolate. Choose your own liking!  I prefer Milk chocolate.  Another of my favorites is California Brittle.  Also, the Vanilla Nut Carmel (no chocolate on this one), but very tasty!Just remember the Assorted premade box doesn't always have the best picks in it.  If you like nuts and chews, that's one of the better choices.  I prefer to go down to See's and select my own mix!  Pecan turtles--just melt in your mouth.  Try the truffles if you like!Never did like Godiva or Fanny Farmer, once in awhile I could take a piece of Helen Grace or Lindt, but they never live up to my standards.See's is the perfect candy and it makes the perfect gift for family, friends, co-workers, neighbors, service company's and the postal person.  Don't cross anyone off your list until you surprise them with a gift of See's candy for the Holidays.
I always send See's as a gift to relatives!  They are worth the extra shipping cost and have always arrived in perfect condition.
The quality, presentation and taste of See's is top notch. We highly recommend the two pound box as a gift. The assortment is a nice mix and there's something for everyone's taste.

We ordered the box of candy for an anniversary gift along with a separate order of flowers.  The flowers arrived in a timely fashion but the candy arrived 6 days later.  When they arrived they were completely melted and had reformed in the box.  The recipient called to say what had happened.  A replacement box was sent a week later.  We don't know who to blame for the delay in shipping or for the manner in which it was shipped.  If you would like to discuss this matter further, please call me at 888.671.6402.Sincerely,Janet Mack Zaloga
The only all natural dog food my dog will eat.  I mix a little of their canned dog food in it and he chows it down and he's a very picky Havanese.

column9: PERFECT!!!! (and yes, I HAVE tried it)
column10: Let ME preface MY review by saying that I actually HAVE tried it and it is well worth the price! The grind is perfect for my Solofill and tastes better than any K-cup I've ever used. But here's something I do not get at all! Did that reviewer really just say "It's a lot cheaper to continue using my Solofill cup to scoop some coffee out of the can"?  I don't get it... the logic I mean. I buy a 2 liter bottle of soda when there's a birthday party or office party, picnic, etc. I KNOW that the bottle will be gone and it's cheaper by the ounce. But that doesn't keep me from buying a 12 oz. can of the same brand of soda!!! Ounce for ounce a can of soda costs FIVE times as much as a 2 liter bottle.  But it doesn't take a coffee snob to figure out after a few days that the ground coffee in that can is losing its flavor the same way a bottle of coke loses its fizz after a few days. If you don't want to spend money on Ekojava coffee packets, then at least buy whole bean coffee and grind it as you use it.But then I suppose someone would say "Why not just buy K-cups then?". Good question - easy answer (in my world anyway).These little sticks of coffee that are ground nicely, weighed out perfectly (instead of the freaking mess you make scooping coffee out of a can or bag), and FRESH! So far, sounds like a K-cup. BUT... I use other things to brew coffee other than a Keurig. The packets work in the Melitta I have in my office. I gave a handful of sticks to my neighbor who tried it in his drip coffeemaker. After trying it a few times, he found that one packet in a drip coffeemaker using a paper filter makes 5 cups of awesome drip coffee! Try that with a K-cup! AND JUST out of curiosity, I stopped by a very cool coffee shop in Boise, Idaho (Salt Tears... VERY cool place!) They have a pour over bar and use the Coava Kone filters instead of paper. I asked him if I could use my coffee packet instead of there DOMA coffee (one of a few roasters in Idaho I would recommend). The water was at 206 degrees and he expertly poured about a third of the water in. The coffee began to de-gas (yeah... ain't gonna happen with ground coffee from a can) and then finished off the pour and we waited. We were both pretty blown away. It was awesome.Bottom line? Not sure I'd recommend this to people who are happy with coffee from a can. And I am NOT knocking those who do. My father scooped Folgers from a can when I was a kid and for years I thought that was the epitome of great coffee (but then, I also used to think hamburger was the highest quality beef). But I confess... that sounds a bit condescending and I realize that many people truly enjoy simple store brand ground coffee in their Keurig. My point it, just because you own a Keurig and a Solofill, doesn't qualify you to write a review for something you've never even tried. Dude... At least try something before you review it. C'mon... really? Okay, I sound like a snob. But I guess that's my point. If you are happy with ground coffee from a can, this probably doesn't make sense. If you are more discriminating than that, and you need something to take with you that is a high quality, one cup solution, is fresh, and you want to use it anywhere in almost anything, then heck yeah... this is a great buy!!!

column9: Decent cup of single serve coffee
column10: These individual pre-measured coffee packs work great in the Solofill and ekobrew.The Grind seems perfect and brewed a decent cup of coffee in my Keurig B70 on the 8oz cup size.Getting coffee with the perfect grind to work in the solofill & ekobrew is a challenge unless you have a good burr grinder so this is a really convenient alternative.I'm more of a dark roast extra bold Kcup drinker and this is a much lighter roast than I prefer.The Flavor I would rate as average but nothing special.reminded my of the average ground coffee you find on grocery store shelfs.Amazon had it priced really low so I gave it a try and it serves its purpoes well at that price point.

column9: Looking for Bold FLAVOR?  Look Elsewhere.
column10: This review is on the coffee itself, not the packaging or the EkoBrew concept itself.  If this were for the packaging and concept, it would be 5 stars.  These little suckers are convenient and work fabulously with the EkoBrew cup gizmo.  Even though I don't care for this blend of coffee, I'm glad I purchased it to get a manufacturer-provided example of the type of grind and proper amount of coffee to use in the EkoBrew cup.)This Honduras House Blend coffee is a medium-light roast coffee at best.  Weaker than anything you'd get at a restaurant or coffee shop, that's for sure.  It's not acidy or bitter at all, just not full-bodied or bold flavored.  I tend to use a heavy hand with my cream, and for this coffee only needed about half as much.  As a reference, I drink Newman's Own K-cups on a daily basis and find them to be a near-perfect cup of coffee.  I do prefer darker roasts like Green Mountain's Sumatra Reserve or Dark Magic.This isn't a *bad* roast, just a weak one.  I'm sure there are some people who would like this (maybe occasional coffee drinkers?) but no one in my house enjoyed it.

I ordered 3 different blends to try this coffee out. So far I've just tried the Honduras House Blend, and am very pleased. I've been rather partial to Green Mountain K-cups, but this EkoJava blend has even my favorite GM blend beat in the flavor department, in my opinion. It is not as convenient as K-cups in that, regardless of the "no mess" claim, it will always be easier to throw out a K-cup than to clean a filter. But it certainly isn't difficult, and for the superior flavor and the reduced waste, it's certainly worth it. I highly recommend it!

column9: 7 Cents a cup!!!  WONDERFUL drip coffee!
column10: My husband and I don't have a Keurig but since we like going on 3 day trips a lot, we like the sticks. My husband drinks more than I do so I make a full 12 cup pot using just 2 sticks. It was PERFECT!!! Not weak but not too strong. So, I can get 150 cups out of a canister. I see they are now $10. Even better! Got my calculator out and... That comes out to LESS than 7 cents a cup! I'm sold!!! We got it for taking trips but it's good enough and inexpensive enough, we are buying this for home now. No grinding, stays fresh and tastes great. I have no idea how someone could give this just one start! He  (or she?) didn't even try it!

column9: A good alternative to high priced K cups -
column10: My wife likes the French Roast, Honduran House Blend, West Coast Roast, Breakfast Blend, Sumatran, and then Donut Cafe in that order.  I prefer the Donut Cafe, Sumatran, French Roast, Breakfast Blend, West Coast, then Honduran.  They each have subtle differences and are a good alternative to more expensive Green Mountain (K-cups) varieties.  These tend to work better with the My K Cup (reusable filter) than Folgers or other regular coffees due to the finer grind and package size.  I paid $3.82 per 25 count container on my last order before the price went back up to $11.99 and would pay that again.  I don't think I would pay regular price however.
I have been using this coffee in the keurig at work because the price of K cups has skyrocketed. I like the price and the convenience but wish the coffee tasted a bit better

Ever since the cost of k-cups sky-rocketed, I've been searching for a cheaper alternative to brewing a cup of good joe.  I'm very happy to have found EkoJava.  The coffee is a tad weaker than the k-cups I purchase (French Roast), but for $0.20/cup it is well worth the switch.  I am also pleased to have found a way to use my Keurig that does not produce as much waste as k-cups.Overall, I'm happy with this coffee, the ease of using it, and (most importantly) the price!
The packaging is convenient but the coffee itself is nothing special.  I probably will not buy again unless it is just dirt cheap.

I have tried 3 different blends of this coffee and think they are great. I use the solofill, but am thinking of buying ekobrew cup. Even with the solofill or ekobrew cup this is a good buy and your not putting all those kcups in the landfill.
In addition to liking the whole EkoJava concept, they also have good, fresh coffee well-sealed in the single serving packets.

I bought one canister of each blend of EkoJava, as I love fresh ground coffee. Each one I tried was disgustingly stale, like ground coffee that had been sitting in an unsealed container for months at a time. Good concept, but a BIG disappointment!

column9: Thought it would be bold; instead it's blah!
column10: I am glad I only paid about $4 for this coffee...the taste is just blah! Being Central-American coffee, I was expecting something similar to Costa Rican taste. I struggled to taste that crisp coffee flavor; alas it is just bland.

I purchased this item as a companion gift to a new coffee maker.  When I received the shipment, this container of coffee had been previously opened.  The item does not qualify for return, so I am stuck with a previously opened food item that I cannot return.  Buyer Beware.
It was not apparent to me that these were not K-cups. I have now bought a reusable K-cup and can use these coffees in that device.

I will preface this by saying that I have not tried this coffee.  But the reason I decided not to order is that at 10 grams of coffee per pack and 25 packs per container, it's really expensive.  250 grams =.55 lbs of coffee, which works out to almost $20 per pound. It's a lot cheaper to continue using my Solofill cup to scoop some coffee out of the can.  Just as easy, too!  Solofill cups are great, by the way:-)
A local Italian restaurant on Cape Cod serves this EVOO for dipping. So good! Finally had to ask what brand is it? It's Unio Siurana. Now we can enjoy it at home as well.

Ab-so-lute-ly-luv-these!!!Ok you got:- Ole Naples chocolate - goes without saying - mmm mmm.  Creamy and hits that chocolate spot.- Caramel like the old fashioned caramel toffees that are so hard to get these days - Creamy buttery flavour, smooth texture with no congealed/powdery bits that ruin a good caramel.Put them together and you have a chocolate delight that you wont want to share with anyone!  :-)Will be ordering again!
LOVE the product! This is my 4th time ordering. Always on time and the Chocolate Caramels are to die for!!
These are some of the best chocolate covered caramels I've ever had.  There's no comparison between these and those available at the average grocer.  Well worth the price!

column9: When only the very best will do...
column10: Couldn't be better!  I order these milk and dark chocolate covered soft caramels over and over again from Olde Naples Chocolates.  Soooooo good!!!  And beautifully boxed for gift-giving---if you can dare to give them away...
This stuff is great!  Believe it or not, it is wonderful spread on crusty bread with a thin slice of blue cheese on top.  Worth the price.

First let me say this is a wonderful hot sauce.  Spicy, flavorful, a wonderful addition to soups, pizza, etc.  Nice smoky flavor you hope for in a chipotle sauce.  Bargain priced.The bottle design for this thick of a sauce, on the other hand, is an abomination, a work of the devil.  The sauce is typically as thick as ketchup and will only with extreme coaxing exit the long narrow neck of the bottle.  It does not matter how you shake it or where you tap it or how loudly you heap curses upon it.  Your neighbors will wonder what is going on.  The opening is narrow enough that a knife is of little help, which leaves a chopstick as an poor alternative.  And additional perversity is that the sauce will *leak* when I pack it in camping gear!  Perhaps you think I have gotten a lone bad bottle - nooooo, repeated testing and consumption has found the same problem in at least 8 bottles!  I must stop typing now to go reassure my coworkers in neighboring cubicles that I was just putting hot sauce on my pizza and not having a knock down drag out fight steel drum band.sauce = winpackaging = fail

Chipotle makes everything taste better.  I first encountered this sauce at a small restaurant in New Mexico and it instantly made everything spicy and smoky.  We made sure to buy a few bottles in a Mexican grocery store, and I've used this on burgers, chicken, etc.  It's awesome.  And it's less than $2.  You can't beat that.

This Chipotle sauce is really good! I'm not a big fan of hot sauce, but I like this stuff. My spouse loves it and I just had to reorder some more. Good in all kinds of food. Has a nice smoky flavor. Excellent addition to homemade chili (I always add some while cooking it). Order multiple bottles to save on shipping.
This is my favorite out of the chipotle sauces I've tried. It has a delicious taste that resembles barbecue sauce. It goes very well with pizza and mexican food.

I live in New York where you'd think Mexican hot sauces wouldn't be readily available.  And while it's true that Tabasco Chipotle Hot Sauce is easier to find than this brand, like the original Tabasco sauce, the Tabasco chipotle has too much vinegar and not enough smoky pepper flavor for my taste buds.  That's why I always have a bottle of Cholula (or Tapa Tio), which are red Mexican hot sauces, and a bottle of Bufalo Chipotle in my fridge.  Bufalo's smoky flavor is the best.

column9: One of the best Chipotle sauces I have tasted
column10: I saw this at my local grocer one day and bought it on a whim.  I did not hold out high hopes but this stuff gave me a very pleasant surprise!The smoky flavor of chipotles is the main star in this sauce of course, and has a lovely tangy/sweet balance.  This sauce is very versatile I have found, being good right out of the bottle with cheeze and crackers, or as a condiment with cooked meats.  The heat is rather mild, allowing you to get as much of the great flavor of this sauce onto your dishes as you wish.I highly recommend this sauce.
Try it, you'll like it. Insanely great chicken wings.....rich, smokey, chili.....quick chipolte mayo! I'd go on but I've made myself hungry. Just get some.

I really love this sauce on chicken and rice, eggs, pizza, quesadillas, grilled cheese sandwiches, Steak, Fajitas.I ordered 15 bottles last time to save on shipping, Im down to 5 bottles now and going to order soon, can't believe the price dropped more. $.63 + shipping each. WOW

I'm a hot sauce fan, and this is the absolute best chipotle sauce I  have tried.  It is an item I will go out of my way to get.  Very thick sauce, with a smoky chipotle taste.  It is great on nacho's or taco's.  Really a flavor boost.
My absolute favorite chipotle hot sauce. Way better than the tabasco chipotle (though the regular Tabasco is of course a classic).Great stuff and a bargain at $1.95 a bottle.

column9: Lot's of fake stuff in here
column10: While this sauce is acceptably good, (it's neither amazing nor spicy), it lacks any sort of natural ingredients, having a tiny percentage of actual pepper extract. Lot's of other artificial flavors and colors in the mix. Sure, it's cheap, but you get what you pay for. Try the Yucateco version instead, at least it's more natural, and better taste, too.
These were very attractive in person.  I was disappointed because 3 were broken through. Overall they were a good product for thr price.
These lollipops were so cute and colorful you will love these. there were 4 different colors too, used for a crafting project not for eating.

Love this tea, and it smells divine!  It definitely put me in the Christmas spirit.  I drink it plain, but I can imagine it could be doctored to resemble Starbuck's Chai Tea with a some sweetener and cream.

I ordered this chai so I would have something tasty to drink in the evenings during the cold winter months. If you've ever had a rooibos tea you know they are lighter than black teas. But they are still tasty and with Numi's delicious chai spices, this is a wonderful decaf tea to add to your collection. Not to mention it's organic and fair trade. Great tea from a great company!

I sent several boxes out for Christmas presents and it's one of the only years I ever gotten feedback about my gifts. Everyone I sent it to loved it and reminisced about candy they used to buy when they were a kid. My aunt even said she took a picture of she and her friend wearing the wax lips.  We're talking about two people in their sixties! So it was definitely a big hit.
I was expecting to have lots of candy like the picture did...Wow..not even close.  Small pieces and not all the candy that was listed was in the box.  Very disappointed.

I enjoyed the Nostalgic Candy assortment greatly, and the product was well packaged without missing or broken candy, and the product arrived in a timely fashion, so I was very pleased with the purchase.
I was expecting a bunch more candy.  The ad photo is very deceiving!  I wanted something with older candy in it, not the stuff I can buy today. I would not recommend this item to anyone.

There were a few pieces of candy that were considered "nostalgic" but not many that I couldn't get at any store. Also the "nostalgic" candy was old and hard. Not like it should be. The price was decent and the delivery of the items was good. Just not impressed with the item.
The majority of this candy was penny type candy.  Very disappointed in the value...although the candy was good Most of the candy can be purchased locally.

What they fail to mention to everyone is the fact that the candy is all for the decade it was created in. My first piece of candy was an orange tootsie roll. When I bit down I almost broke my teeth it was so rock hard. The product may have been better if it wasn't so old. I also discovered that the small box that I thought was stuffed to the top with candy has paper filler in the bottom. Most of this "hard to find" candy can be found at Walmart and various other places for much cheaper prices.

The box was a bit smaller than I thought it would be.I gave it as a hostess gift and She loved it When we opened it we saw that there were a few paper strings for filler but not much it seems it was just used as decoration(thus the smaller box it was filled with candy not a bunch of paper on the bottom)She immediatley had a piece of candy and it was fresh(I saw some reviews that candy was stale) It was a great different hostess gift and i would purchase it again
Great for holiday gift giving when you do not live near the people you're sending to. :-D

column9: Bought it as gift, seems like a good thing for any candy lover
column10: The package comes already pre-wrapped to a certain degree. The variety of candy is superb. A+

I was very disappointed in this candy.  As mentioned in many of the previous reviews, it was cheap penny candy, much of which can be bought at any store today.  I kind of expected that... I mean, they aren't going to produce old candy just for these packages, so they have to still be making them somewhere.What I was really disappointed in was the amount.  The total worth of the candy in the box was maybe $5.  The box was cute, but very tiny.  You would be better to do a little research and put together your own box, with 3-4 times the amount for the same money.
I simply enjoyed reliving the days again when I was a young girl with this nostalgic candy package. It was simply everything I expected and more! I would recommend it to others and order it again!

I bought this one since there was a great discount on Amazon. But after ate them, we love it so much. It is the best roast peanuts on the market I have ever try. Believe me, you will love it at the first time.

Do not buy this product. The ingredients are different from those listed on the website.Only purchase if you like MSG, corn syrup and natural flavor!This is a list of the actual ingredients:PeanutsSea SaltSugarCornstarchMonosodium glutamate (MSG)GelatinTorula yeastCorn syrup solidsPaprikaOnion and garlic powdersSpicesNatural flavor

column9: Love these, but that's just me.
column10: I always enjoyed these, and will buy more, but they do come in a jar, as it says, which is glass, not plastic.  Just so you know.

column9: Wish I'd known more about the ingredients
column10: These Planters peanuts are quite good, but I ordered them without knowing that they contained more than just plain, dry roasted peanuts.  Although theere is no noticeable taste, these peanuts contain sugar, cornstarch, msg, paprika, garlic and onion powder, and other spices.  I have four jars of them and to be honest, I am enjoying eating them, but I would not order them again.  I do a lot of Asian cooking in which peanuts are used quite frequently and I thought I'd save time by not having to open the shells of peanuts bought in a bag, so I took a shortcut in ordering these and it was a mistake.
I absolutely LOVE mango Juice my package arrived pretty quick and tasted delicious. It was sweet and tasted as if I squeezed the mango myself.

Every now and then I like to give my son a treat of a "boxed juice" and this is the only thing I will give him. It is organic, fairly priced, and nutritious. I will keep purchasing this item again and again!

After trying, and hating, so many organic juices, this one is a clear winner for my 9 year old. It tastes as great as the juices we were previously buying but with the added piece of mind of being organic.

column9: Great on the go for kids and adults...
column10: My kids love it, even the older ones, and I like the fact that it's organic.  We've purchased it several times.  The fruit punch is good as well!
I think Amazon.com has a very good selection of organic foods and drinks and i would highly recommend it. Its better for our children.

it's nice to know that the juice is organic and not from conventionally grown apples(which has pesticides, junky fertilizers etc.). you really can't tell the difference from this and the regular apple juice, which may be a good thing for my kids. all in all i'm pleased with the purchase.
My Maltese and Cavalier King Charles love these treats!  I feel good about feeding them a healthier treat.Not made in China!

column9: A healthy treat that my puppy LOVES
column10: My puppy just loves these treats.  Unfortunately, they are getting hard to find locally and I'm hoping that Amazon will keep selling them.  From the labeling, it would appear that they are healthy which is also getting to be rare since many other dog treats are coming from China with tainted ingredients.  We owners who care about our pets need to be extremely vigilant and only buy safe, healthy products.  Thank you, Amazon for providing them.
My family loves this.  I use it  cooking, we sprinkle it on just about everything that we eat.  One of the best Cajun seasonings that I have used.

This tea is absolutely delicious!  I stumbled upon it a few years ago and it is my favorite!  It also was the only tea that I drank while I was pregnant because it settled my nausea and is organic and is caffeine-free!!  The flavor is so light and delicious!  Just a dab of sugar (or not) is all it needs!  Very fragrant tea!  Thank you Davidson's!

column9: one pound is not very much
column10: was surprised to see how many cordials you get for one pound.  - not very many!  taste is wonderful with liquid sweetness in every bite.  yum!  shipped fast
THESE ARE THE BEST OUR FAMILY HAS EVER HAD.  WE ALWAYS GET A COUPLE OF POUNDS FOR THE CHRISTMAS HOLIDAYS.  WE'LL BE GETTING MORE SOON.  DELICIOUS!!

Although this item was being sent to the southwest, there was no effort to ensure it would arrive safely.  They did not include any cold pack, and it took a week to get here, so you can imagine the mushy ball of chocolate goo that arrived.  I love these rum balls, but it is difficult to enjoy them when they are in either a state of globy mess, or one solid piece.

column9: Milder than most of the bold flavors with a slight  zing of lime citrus flavor!
column10: These almonds are very good with a slight zing of citrus lime in the favor.  I was surprised that the chili flavor to me was not as bold as I expected. Some of the Blue Diamond bold flavors like the Wasabi and Soy flavors are just, WOW, bold and overpowering.  This flavor while it was good it is milder and I didn't get a hint of a lot of chili until a minute or so after eating a few.  Even then it seems mild when compared to some of the other bold flavors.One serving of these nuts is 170 Calories and it contains 6 grams of protein, 5 grams of carbohydrates, 3 grams of fiber and only 1 gram of sugar and 1 gram of saturated fat. You also get calcium, vitamin E and magnesium from the almonds which are good for your body, heart and bones. I would rather eat 28 of these almonds for 170 calories than 11 potato chips for the same calories and none of the dietary benefits.This flavor has only 5% of your daily intake of sodium. The only problem with these almonds is that they taste so good you have to be able to close the can and walk away. If you don't like the super bold and spicy flavors then this flavor is ideal for you.I like all of the Blue Diamond Almond products as I feel that they are healthier for you as long as you don't overdo it in eating them.  This is still a great flavor and I like them!

column9: Can I offer you ladies a cool beverage or a tasty snack?
column10: These almonds are very tasty and popular at my workplace. If you've had wasabi peas, you'll probably like these too. "BOLD" is a bit of an overstatement, as these almonds are not as intense as the peas with the nasal burn, but still do have a bit of kick. I wouldn't say the soy sauce flavor is that apparent, though, but I'm not counting that against the product.Most wasabi-flavored snacks really contain horseradish because it is a cheaper substitute. Wasabi is notoriously difficult to cultivate and the chemicals that give it its characteristic pungency are volatile.I like these a whole lot and routinely buy several cans of them from my drugstore whenever they are on sale. My mom's factory wo-workers like these too. However, I took this to a baseball game and it was almost universally hated. Go figure!

column9: Bold BBQ taste that is not too spicy!
column10: I love these Blue Diamond Almond snacks and I particularly like the bold flavors.  This flavor is very good and the smoky BBQ taste just sets off the flavor of the crunchy almond that it coats.  I like an evening snack while I read a book and these for me are just so much better than chips and other snack foods.  It gives you a chance to snack but still eat healthy.One serving of these nuts is 170 Calories and it contains 6 grams of protein, 3 grams of fiber and only 1 gram of sugar and 1 gram of saturated fat.  You also get calcium, vitamin E and magnesium from the almonds which are good for your body, heart and bones.  I would rather eat 28 of these almonds for 170 calories than 11 potato chips for the same calories and none of the dietary benefits.This flavor does have 7% of your daily intake of sodium and if you are on a salt restricted diet then make sure to watch your salt intake.  The only problem with these almonds is that they taste so good you have to be able to close the can and walk away.This is a very good product and I recommend it to you!

column9: Crunchy almond treat with a sassy Jalapeno kick!
column10: Rather than just eat chips for a snack I love the Blue Diamond Almond snacks.  This is one of my favorite flavors and the only problem is that they are hard to stop eating.  They have a nice rich smoky flavor and the jalapeno is just enough of a spicy kick to make these almonds taste better.The nice thing about this treat is that they have only 1 gram of sugar while giving you 6 grams of protein and 3 grams of fiber.  They are a healthy snack and you get Vitamin E, magnesium and calcium in every serving.  This particular flavor does have 180 mg of Sodium (7% of a daily 2000 calories diet) per serving but they really taste good!  Just make sure that you only count our 28 almonds and eat one portion for 170 calories.  It is really hard to do and they taste so darn good!

column9: A hot, bold and tasty snack!
column10: I love Blue Diamond Almonds and this bold flavor gives you a spicy hot choice for a snack.  They are rich in vitamin E, magnesium and calcium while only being 170 calories for one serving.  They also add 3 grams of dietary fiber to your diet and 6 grams of protein while only adding 2 grams of sugar.They do contain 15 grams of fat but only 1 gram of saturated fat and 0 grams of trans fat. (Mostly they are the good stuff)  If you want a quick snack that is high in protein and low in sugar and sodium these are pretty good and spicy.While there are other flavors that I like more this one is still very good.  Just remember, they are addictive so you only get one serving!
I love these.  I bring them to work for a between meal snack.  They are bold and really take the edge off my hunger.

I'm a big fan of Blue Diamond brand Almonds. I really like the bold flavors, Habanero BBQ and Lime & Chili. I've never seen the Jalapeno Smokehouse flavor at the local grocery store so when I saw them on Amazon I decided to buy them.I'm pleased to say that I wasn't disappointed. This is right up there with my favorite flavors. It has just enough heat and jalapeno flavor with just a little bit of smoke. To me, these have almost as much heat as the Habanero flavor. Which isn't a bad thing. I like spicy.I would defiantly recommend these if you like the Bold line of Blue Diamond Almonds.

column9: Not habanero-y at all, but still insanely addicting
column10: The heat here is very very mild. I've had habanero sauces and chips that were so hot they made me cry for help. These are not like that. Only occasionally will you get a little kick. It's actually mostly tangy and tomato-y. The dusting of flavoring on the outside of the nuts will coat your fingers in an orange film.Satisfyingly crunchy and tangy, it's really hard to stop eating these. Even though the habanero kick isn't there as promised on the label, it's still really tasty. I highly recommend these. Sodium content is very low at 4% per serving. High in Vitamin E (35%) and magnesium (20%). This 1 pound bag (x3 bags) is a great deal compared to buying the 6 oz tins at the store, however, when my local Walgreens has buy 1 get 1, the price drops to about $0.35/oz.Blue Diamond makes about 8 other flavors that I know of. My favorites are the Soy Wasabi, Honey Roasted, Smokehouse, Dijon Mustard.

I'm a big fan of the Blue Diamond brand almonds and I especially like the "bold" flavors.The Lime n Chili flavor is my favorite with the Habanero BBQ being a close second.I agree with another reviewer that says the tartness of the lime flavor is just enough to bring out the chili flavor. Its a nice balance.I would say my only complaint is towards the end of the bag the flavor can get a little overwhelming because of all the extra spices that accumulate towards the bottom.
these taste amazing. might make the poops burn a little :o but they taste amazing. the salt and vinegar ones are the best and very addicting.

When I first tried these tasty almonds, I was amazed at the great marriage of flavor. Has the kick of wasabi, and the sweet taste of roasted almonds. The first one is an eye opener each time even after you have had them many times. Bold and fun! If you like sushi, and you enjoy the taste of wasabi, these are for you.

Diamond AlmondsAlmonds are a good source of magnesium. One ounce contain approximately 20% of the RDA for an adult recommended dietary allowance (RDA)Recommended Dietary Allowance (RDA) the amounts of selected nutrients considered adequate to meet the known nutrient needs of healthy people. The RDA is based on scientific knowledge and has been presented by a committee of the Food and Nutrition Board (FNB) of the National Academy of Sciences (NAS). The Canadian equivalent is the Recommended Nutrient Intakes. RDA is generally accepted throughout the world as a valid source of information. At least 40 different nations have as well as organizations have published standards similar to the RDA.Magnesium is the fourth most abundant mineral in the body and is essential to good health. Approximately 50% of total body magnesium is found in bone. The other half is found predominantly inside cells of body tissues and organs. Only 1% of magnesium is found in blood, but the body works very hard to keep blood levels of magnesium constant.Magnesium is needed for more than 300 biochemical reactions in the body. It helps maintain normal muscle and nerve function, keeps heart rhythm steady, supports a healthy immune system, and keeps bones strong. Magnesium also helps regulate blood sugar levels, promotes normal blood pressure, and is known to be involved in energy metabolism and protein synthesis. There is an increased interest in the role of magnesium in preventing and managing disorders such as hypertension, cardiovascular disease, and diabetes. Dietary magnesium is absorbed in the small intestines. Are you taking enough magnesium in the diet? The recommended daily allowance is 300mgs/day for men, 350mgs for women. Magnesium is extremely safe by mouth - too much simply causes diarrhea. Try increasing the amount of magnesium you take by mouth until it causes diarrhea, then reduce the dose slightly so it does not. This is called taking magnesium to bowel tolerance (just like using vitamin C to bowel tolerance.Almonds are a good source of Fiber.One ounce contains approximately 12% of the RDA for an adult.So, in summary, Almonds are a very healthy snack, so what's left to say?Two things:1st be cautious about "bowel tolerance" or "happy bowels" if you prefer.2nd Taste.  I realize that taste is a personal thing.  That's why they make chocolate, strawberry, and vanilla.Here's my current favorites" 1st Blue Diamond Dark mint dark chocolate (reminds me of the chocolate mint Girl Scout Cookies with less sugar).2nd Blue diamond Dark Chocolate Oven Roasted3rd  Blue diamond Blue Butter Toffee4thd Blue Diamond Almonds Bold Habanero BBQ (reminds me of  BBQ potato chips again with less sugar).5th Bold Blazin Buffalo Wing6th Blue Diamond Almonds Cinnamon Brown Sugar7th  Blue Diamond Almonds Lime `n Chili8th  Blue Diamond Almonds Smokehouse9th  Bold Wasabi & Soy SauceBut that's just me: you might have a completely different take on these flavors. 4th  and 5th are very close.GunnerMay, 2012

Not a big fan of chili actually... so these almonds are perfect!  ok sounds weird right!!??  What i am saying is that i LOVE LIME, and these almonds are mostly lime with a very subtle hint of chili n spice as an after thought... PERFECTION!

These are great almonds, especially in these 1.5 oz packages.I introduced these to my boss and he loves them too.Great portion control packs.
