Ramune has to be one of the coolest and most unique soft drinks that I have ever seen. My kids had been dying to try this stuff ever since they had come across it on J-Box, the popular Japanese import webshop. Ramune is incredibly popular in it's native Japan, and now it looks like the fun is beginning to spread here in the States.To open a bottle of Ramune, you have to remove the top, pop out this little plastic plunger from it's casing, and then use the plunger to pop out a marble that seals the neck of the bottle. The neck of the bottle has two indentions that will hold the marble when you tip the bottle back to drink from it, keeping the neck of the bottle clear. Hold the bottle the wrong way, and the marble will clog things up. You can avoid carbonated overflow when opening by pressing gently on the plunger until it depresses the marble; knock it down with force and you're sure to get a fountain of spray.The melon flavor reviewed here has a very unique taste. Think honeydew more than watermelon, sweet and light with that distinctive Ramune lemon-lime backbone flavor holding everything together. Truly a treat.This is a way fun product that kids (and most adults) will have a blast with. It's a smaller portion (8 ounces) than what we're used to here in the US, but that actually works out for us as we're trying to limit the amount of soda that our kids consume. Ramune works great as an occasional soda treat and the fun factor alone keeps us coming back for more. Ramune is easy to find at just about any Asian market, but for those who don't have easy access to one, ordering here on Amazon would be recommended.Also, for the safety conscious, I can attest that these drinks are very safe. We've never had a problem with the marble, and I can't find any reports on the internet that would indicate any safety concerns with this drink. It's not a choking hazard, in other words. Ramune means 'carbonated' in Japanese, and I can highly recommend this wonderful and very different drink.

It's definitely an item for tourists. If you don't know how to open one, don't throw away the cap and look up some how-tos from youtube.The flavor is hard to describe. It's VERY sweet. If you've smelled melon-scented lotions or perfumes, this would be its flavor. Whenever I see someone selling this, melon (and strawberry) is usually one of the first to sell out, so grab one if you see one. If you're unsure if you'll like it, try the original flavor (sweet like a bubble gum flavor) first.

This stuff is GREAT! A little hard to open at first (dont throw away the top!) but is very tasty and very refreshing. If you want to try something new, go for this. I love this stuff, the taste is quite different, its like a sweeter lemon-lime soda with more emphasis on the lime but is truly amazing. If you dont want to try melon, try the classic or strawberry.
This is by far the best pancake batter ever especially when using real buttermilk to mix it.  I also add a tiny bit of bran or wheat flakes just to make it healthier!

I love Farmer Brothers Buttermilk Pancake mix. I used it all the time when the kids were little. I used to get it form a lady that sold food form different company's out of her house. I thought they didn't make it anymore. was looking for some seasoning and ran across farmer Brothers. It is really easy to use. I would buy if your looking for something quick and easy.

White Coffee Company took over the First Colony coffee line almost a year ago and I've been waiting for them to offer the coffee through Amazon and it finally happened, much to my delight.  I'd been drinking First Colony French Roast for almost 50 years and was having a hard time finding coffee which measured up to what I felt was a perfect cup of coffee.  Now, I don't have to look any further.  The French Roast is dark, full bodied, has a nice aroma, and is not as expensive as some of the other gourmet coffees available on Amazon.  I'll be buying more.

column9: Good product, not so good service
column10: I am a huge fan of these Greek cookies, but if my next order is wrong again, will have to find a different source. The order was for a variety of flavors, including LEMON. Instead of lemon, I got BANANA, which I detest! I have reordered lemon, we shall see...BUT, the cookies are awesome (except for BANANA!!!)

this stuff smells and taste great seems to have a little stronger smell then the kind I buy in the store.the only problem is pouring it from the bottle it tends to spill. so what I do is refill a empty store bought bottle of Extract other then that this is good stuff I will be buying again shipped and rec on time.WARNING keep it away from open flames this stuff contains 90% ALCOHOL

Nielsen-Massey organic extracts including orange, vanilla, almond, coffee... These of amazingly good quality. They are extremely concentrated and utterly delicious. I like to use them to flavour coffee.The almond extract is  a product to restore your faith in people.  It  is intoxicatingly delicious. It does not smell in the least artificial. It has a complex odour. It is a bit like Christmas past in a bottle. Nielsen-Massey set out to make the best extract on earth taking no shortcuts. It is potent. In fact, it is so strong, it is hard not to over do it. I found just moistening a finger and rubbing around the lip of cup of coffee is often too much. It should come with some sort of eye dropper for measuring out tiny amounts. I added it to the endorsements on my own personal web page I was so impressed. The orange extract is similarly magnificent and potent.

I make a lot of rice pudding and use almond extract for flavoring. I add it the very last thing, right when it is finished cooking, and taken off the heat. This extract is wonderful and gives a really nice touch to the pudding.

I used this extract for my cookies and it really gave them a great almond flavor without overpowering them.  When I opened the bottle, I could smell the pure almond scent without the alcohol scent I get from some other extracts.  Great quality product!
I bought Nielsen Massey Vanilla and loved it so I tried the Pure Almond Extract.This is a terrific product... I love the flavor!  Will definitely orderagain when this is empty!

Homemade cranberry sauce with this almond extract is delish!Cook cranberries in water and sugar over medium heat til berries begin to burst.  Remove from heat and add this lovely almond extract.  Stir, add turkey, stuffings, mashed potatoes and squash.  Yummy.

I love the oil. It was great; however, the product name says it's a pack of four and I only received one 1-ounce bottle.I spent $20 on 1 ounce of flavoring!I will not be buying anything from this seller again - I promise you that.When I called to complain nothing was done to resolve the issue - not even a refund!

I LOVE this stuff, I use it in a lot of different recipes,  it adds a fullness and richness to the food. I can't buy vanilla butternut flavoring where I live in California so I buy this product and it's great. I've used other flavors from this company and have never been disappointed.

Everyone needs this in their pantry! There are some older recipes around that call for this hard-to-find flavoring, so be sure to have some on hand. I will be ordering again! I tried this in a chocolate cake in place of the vanilla, what a nice flavor!  You can use this in many recipes.

column9: If you like Butter Beer from Universal Studios get this!
column10: I bought this product because I went to Universal Studios Orlando and tried Butter Beer which is sold in the Harry Potter section.  I didn't like the frozen Butter Beer that much but I loved the regular one.  I hunted online and found a recipe for it which included Vanilla Butternut(never heard of this before)and butterscotch flavoring, and cream soda. This recipe was on the mark and you don't need to use much of the flavorings.

I was looking for a butter pecan natural flavoring, but couldn't find it.  I think King Arthur sells this brand (LorAnn Artificial Flavoring), so I thought it would be ok.  And it is Ok, but I still don't like artificial flavorings.  It smells that way to me.  It reminds me of the smell of those old fashioned maple nut candies.  It was a little expensive too.  I can't say that this brand is better than the one (vanilla-butter-nut) in the grocery store.  This stuff is quite concentrated and these four packs will probably last the average cook about 5 years.

column9: A Delicious Choice for Raisin Lovers Everywhere
column10: I am looking at a box of these raisins as I write this review; this product is a staple food in our house. I am a dedicated fan of raisins and enjoy snacking on them and adding them to a variety of other dishes.One of my favorite evening meals is a bowl of Grape Nuts with a liberal supply of raisins mixed in; this is a nourishing combination that is very satisfying to me and has actually been a player in my weight loss program. One of its advantages is it keeps hunger under control longer and I'm less tempted to snack in the evenings. I don't know about you, but I need all the help I can get in that department.One of the things I do to help control dryness is to wrap the opened raisin box in one of the plastic bags one gets in the vegetable department of most grocery stores. I've found that the raisins have a slight tendency to dry out a bit even at the rate in which I eat them and the extra bagging helps keep the raisins moist all the way through the box.I almost forgot to mention another one of my favorite health snacks involving raisins; I love to mix them with whole raw almonds and really enjoy that combination as a snack between meals.If you enjoy raisins, this is a perfect choice!

Vegan. Organic. Kosher. Lush, luxe dark chocolate. Very smooth. Dark chocolate flavor notes are very long and enjoyable. Not excessively bitter at all, but the taste of chocolate is not masked or overwhelmed with the added raw cane sweetness and is without other added oils or flavorings. Thick, long-lasting consistency. Well balanced and a good choice for chocolate purists. Great value for a high quality organic chocolate. Made with 72% organic cocoa and organic raw cane sugar only. 570 calories per 3.5oz/100g bar. One half (or less) of a whole bar is a nice serving. The remaining portion can be saved in an airtight container or ziplock bag for another day. Best stored at room [~70F/21C] temperature. Kosher "D" from processing on shared equipment. Product of Germany. [The ingredients list includes "cocoa liquor" and "cocoa butter" separately which are both derived from processing of raw cocoa beans. Both are just technical terms for cocoa components and are 100% plant-based from the cocoa bean only and contain no dairy or alcohol or fermentation.] This review is out there for those for whom this makes a difference. See all of my reviews and the vegancompassion Profile for more great choices. Check out "Vegan Grocery Favorites" and "Vegan Grocery Top Ten" & all the other helpful "Vegan Grocery" Listmania. Your input counts and will be greatly appreciated to benefit the search of others. Thank you.

column9: Good, but beware of the mismatch between title and  product info
column10: As of the date of this review, the product title indicates "dark chocolate with orange flavor," but the picture and description are for their regular 72% dark chocolate bars.Vivani is perhaps my favorite chocolate, so I took a chance on this ambigious product hoping to get the 72% cocoa version.Bzzzzt.  They sent me the orange flavored stuff.  But I called and asked Amazon to try again.  Bingo!  Got the good stuff.  But both versions had the same ASIN numbers on the boxes....Anyway, IMHO Vivani makes some of the best tasting off-the-shelf dark chocolate you can buy.  I like their 85% cocoa even better, but Amazon doesn't stock it, and the 72% is very good (and less expensive than my local store).Compared to the other dark chocolate Amazon offers (Cote D'or), the Vivani is much smoother, tastier, less flat, and better texture.

Absolutely wonderful, melt in your mouth, not too sweet, dark chocolate.  Well worth the money.  The Germans take their organic food seriously which I appreciate. There is no lecithin in these bars which is good news for people who can't have any soy products.

Most dark chocolate bars tend to be too sweet for my taste. This bar is less sweet than most, but is not bitter. So if you like a strong chocolate flavor without all the sweetness, then this bar is for you. Good price for organic chocolate.

With all the publicity regarding health benefits of dark chocolate, Vivani is one of the best I've tried. It has a creamy, full-bodied taste that is definitly chocolate. The ingredients are organic and each bar has 72% cacao. For someone who enjoys dark chocolate, Vivani tastes too good to believe that it provides health benefits.
The Vivani organic dark chocolate is outstanding.  Not only does it taste good, my blood pressure took a significant drop when I started eating no more than 4 small squares of a bar per day.

Very very excellent chocolate. But wow the price is skyrocketing!Ever since the American version of Lindt was ruined by added lecithin (blech!) I've been searching for a good chocolate without lecithin - all but non-existent in the USA!I've found 2 brands without lecithin, Repunzel, and Vivani. Vivani is far superior, having an excellent chocolate aroma, and wonderful rich flavor without being overly sweet. And it has that incredible SNAP! that indicates a perfectly tempered chocolate. This is a superior product for its price range, even with the price of chocolate going through the roof. I stock up on this whenever I can afford it!
I have soy allergies, and was in search of a new chocolate bar. This one is is! It is soy-free, delicious, and relatively inexpensive!!  Hooray!-kimber

I've reduced the amount of sugar that I'm consuming, so the 1st thing that attracted me to this chocolate was the # of carbs/(12g) fiber(5g) per 10 squares. I'm extremely satisfied with the taste, crunch, and the melt in my mouth (feel.) AND The fact that I can eat 1/2 serving 5 "squares" without feeling unsatisfied or over indulgent makes it practically perfect, for me.

Without the emulsifiers, this tastes less creamy and breaks crisper when bitten.  I like the flavor. However here is the missing allergen information:on the wrapper it says:Made in a facility that processes milk, nuts, soybeans or wheat.

This was our first Vivani Organic Dark Chocolate Bars and it was delicious! It has a deep chocolate taste without the deep bitterness so often found in dark chocolate. The flavor is just a rich chocolate that melts easily in your mouth.  Great for eating chocolate or used for a GF lava cake.My only negative is that the chocolate bars were melted somewhat so the aluminum wrap is partially buried under some of the chocolate bar.  I had several different chocolate bars in the same shipement that were not melted so I don't know what happened to these bars.  However, the melting problem is a transportation problem and does not deter my review for this wonderful chocolate. If you like the smoothness of German chocolates, this is a must try bar.
Vivani is smooth tasting which distinguishes it from many other high quality chocolates. I didn't like the orange flavored Vivani as much as this one.

In recent years I have evolved into a chocolate snob.  As a nutritionist, I am also health conscious and anxious to avoid unnecessary additives when possible.  A deep, smooth quality chocolate, this bar was everything I wanted. For one, it did not contain soy lecithin, one of the few chocolate bars that does not.  Its rich dark color and mild bitterness are consistent with a bar high in polyphenols. However, if you are used to milk chocolate you may want to start off with a bar that is 60% and work your way up to 70-85%.  The darker chocolates generally contain less sugar than your average milk chocolate bar. Finally, the price was good and even better than what I might pay in the store for a lower quality chocolate.

column9: A tad bitter with a smooth mouth feel
column10: This is my first experience with Vivani chocolate.  It is a bit more bitter (or maybe just less sweet?) than I am used to with 72% dark chocolate (in comparison to Endangered Species 72% for example). But does have a smooth melt and mouth feel.One major plus about this chocolate is that it is gfcf, nut-free, and soy free!The ingredients are: cocoa liquor, raw cane sugar, cocoa butter. 72% minimum cocoa solids. 12g carbs, 5g fiber, 11g sugar & 3g protein for each half a bar "serving" size.

We now use the flea pills for our dogs and they need to take the pills with moist dog food for proper digestion. column9: great for a sickly dog and cheaper than petsmart
column10: i have two dogs with sensitive stomachs, and this is a great product for them.interesting this packaging is less expensive than the on sell price at petsmart and other pet supply stores

First off, do yourself a favor and buy the most lean bacon you can find. Not because it's healthier, because it taste better, there's more substance, etc. . .Okay about the genie. It simply wont catch all the grease that comes off of the bacon. Some with burst from it and you will end up having to clean your microwave. It's not a bad as just microwaving it on a plate, but still.Every time I have used it, the bacon sticks to itself where the 2 ends touch. Not a real issue but you have to let it cool down before you can tear them apart and pull the bacon off.This is a real lazy way of cooking bacon though. I bought it for my mom because she just doesn't cook. I still prefer a cast iron pan for cooking bacon but on those days where you just can't stand over a stove, this works fine.

So, here are my thoughts... I LOVE bacon, obsessed some may say! I would bathe in the grease were it socially acceptable. Unfortunatly, it is not and I would probably end up with a lot of insect bites, although it might land me a man! You never know!Pros of the genie: cooks fast, has drip tray to catch all that delicious grease I might some day bathe in, easy to clean.Cons: Still gets effin grease all over the inside of the microwave and does not work well for thick cut bacon.If you do get this, be sure to line the bottom of your micro with paper towels and clean it with some lysol wipes or something similar right after use!ENJOY!

The bacon Genie is a good tool in making bacon, i use to hate to make bacon in the pan, because of all the grease, but with the Bacon Genie it all so fast and the grease goes in the bowl it's fantastic for doing bacon.

I've been a microwave oven user since 1986, and I've tried all sorts of tricks for cooking meat in them.  For the most part, I have it all down pat - but cooking bacon without mess or fuss or stuck-to-the-paper-towel bacon has eluded me.  Not any more!I got a Bacon Genie about a month ago and since then I've found that I can cook both regular and turkey bacon to exactly the desired doneness and crispyness I want.  For my health I tend more towards turkey bacon than regular bacon and I've found that the Bacon Genie makes it easy to cook eight slices in just four-and-a-half (chewy) to five (crispy) minutes - just right for two people for breakfast.  (I place three strips on each outer side and two on the middle bar.)And cleanup?  Not a problem.  The bacon's fat drips straight down to the collector in the bottom with no splatter.  Once I'm done, I pour the drippings straight into my grease jar (What?  You don't have a grease jar?  For shame!  You can always re-use for other cooking or throw the full jar away, saving you sink from grease clogs.) for disposal.Also, the Bacon Genie comes with a nice pair of tongs for removing the bacon without getting your fingers burned or greasy.Yes.  I cannot recommend the Bacon Genie strongly enough!

Please dont buy this product , the bacon was always burnt and gross when i used this product no matter the setting, I going to buy one of those microwavable trays ive seen at walmart because i know those things actually work. This thing was also very hard to clean....just a bad product.
First, you get one package, not 6 as advertised.  Second, this is red tea, not green.  Completely false listing.  DO NOT BUY!!!
You all remember in the 80s the Lipton ice tea? Well this is like that but healthier..No sugar and it taste great..I highly recommend it.
I received them in the mail and they were all broken....very upset with how they packaged there item :-( Had to throw them away the minute I opened the plastic wrapping...

These were very nice and colorful, however, they did not package them well enough and several were broken when I received them. It ended up arriving today but still do know now why it said Philadelphia and not my city I needed it to be shipped to clear on the other side of PA. Not sure about buying from here again.

I was concerned I wouldnt get my order in time for my Granddaughters birthday as I ordered at the last minute.  I was assured by an employee that they packed the order themselves and would arrive in plenty of time..It did!!! These peace signs made for great cake decorations and the kids loved it!  (so did the adults).  Prompt service and reasonable prices..Cant ask for more!
I was nervous bout ordering these since others said they was broken. I didnt order mine from amazon i went to sweet wise and they came all in one piece and are very cute

I ordered this product for the second time because I was pleased with it and my dog loves these.  This time though when I received the package, it only had 1 bone in it instead of the box of 50.  Amazon was very quick to refund the original $69.95 and correct the issue, telling me that I would need to reorder them once my refund came through. To save significantly I buy all my flour in bulk and keep it frozen.  The 2 pound bags of Spicy World Semolina are conveniently sized.  I use the flour for pasta, but also for half of my pizza dough mix (with finer ground standard high gluten flour).  And of course the hot pizza stone gets a sprinkling of the Semolina just before the pizza goes into the oven. I live rurally and can only get Semolina in 1 pound boxes locally (and at 3-4 times the price of this great Amazon deal).

I am reluctant to say anything about this product because I don't want to share it with anyone.I found a recipe for pizza crust that required semolina flour. Having never used semolina before, I searched amazon and found 12 pounds for $18. While at first it seemed like way too much flour, the 2-pound bags are easy to store in the pantry, fridge or freezer until you need them.My pizza crust is now much improved, and I've made dinner rolls with semolina, too. Friends rave about my pizza, and the rolls were a big hit. "How'd you get them so yellow and creamy?" they ask. I smile and say it's an Olde family recipe! (I've never met any of the Olde family, but I will praise them here, in print, just in case any of them are reading this!)In the end, its flour, and it behaves as you would expect. It imparts a delicate aroma to your baked goods along with a yellow tint. It is not as finely-ground as all-purpose flour, nor is it as couarse as cornmeal - it's texture is somewhere in between. And unlike cornmeal, it doesn't burn when used on a hot baking stone. Sprinkling semolina on your peel and proofing your loaves makes it easy to transfer them onto the stone.I have not used any other semolina flour, and I am unlikely to do so after discovering Spicy World.Finally, I challenge you to find semolina for less than $1.50 a pound!

Okay so I have not delved into pasta maKing but this semolina makes an awesome basbusa, which is a middle eastern sweet made very simply with eggs, sugar, oil, yogurt or kushta cream,baking powder, shredded coconut, and of course semolina. Using this brand I always get compliments, my kids love it, and it's perfect every single time. I added some ginger and lemon extract to change things up a bit and used Meyers lemons to make the very simple syrup that is  poured atop.Conveniently sized and packaged and the price is terrific. SIMPLY DELICIOUS-THANKS SO MUCH!!

The flour was delivered in one large plastic bag and was six 2 pound bags of flour.  I put four bags in the freezer, one in the fridge, and opened one to make pasta.  This flour was the best price I could find anywhere - it worked out to $1.50 per pound with free shipping (bundled it with another item).I had my own recipe for making pasta that I picked up from the interweb somewhere.  I only used one cup of the flour (with one cup of All-purpose flour) and the total recipe made one pound of pasta (yes, I weighed it).Anyway, the flour itself was sifted with the AP flour to make the pasta.  After the eggs, salt and oil, it was kneaded for 10 minutes.  Then the flour was passed through a pasta machine to flatten it and then it was made into linguini.  The pasta itself came out fine.Since this was my first foray into homemade pasta, I think it was a success.  The product was as expected.  If I had something to compare it to, I might have had a different opinion.  But I don't, so I don't.I would buy it again and recommend it to others.

I decided to use semolina flour for my homemade pasta but was frustrated by the high cost in our local stores.  Found this product, ordered it, and it's working great!  I froze a bunch of the packages and have been slowly making my way through them.  Fast shipping and well packed.  When I make my way through the last four pounds, I'll be ordering more from Spicy World!  BTW, semolina holds its shape much better than all purpose flour (put fresh pasta made with all purpose flour in the fridge overnight and it's a messy glump; dry semolina well and then store it in the fridge and it keeps a decent shape).

column9: Decent price for a quality product.
column10: I make pasta with this and the taste and texture are great. I like how it is packed in 2 lb bags so you don't have to worry about it going bad very quickly just pop the unopened unused bags in the freezer until you need one.

It's difficult finding Semolina flour in a grocery store. We use it for pizza dough, pasta flour and bread. The flour is packaged in smaller amounts. For longl term storage we use our vacuum sealer to store it. This flour is great when only Semolina flour will do in the recipe. Great buy.

After you try this, regular flour just won't cut it. If you want authentic tasting pasta this is it. This was the best price I could find for a reasonable amount. It works so well and the directions on the bag are perfect- better than my pasta machine's. It was a lot more than I could use before it would go bad though, so I just threw the other bags into the freezer.

This is good flour at a reasonable price.  I got it mainly for making semolina bread, a favorite of mine.  It's a little finer grind than an imported variety that I got here which makes it ideal for bread.  I've also use this for pasta, but added to a blend of whole wheat flours, so it does get masked a little.I'll get it again when I need to re-stock.

The MTR line of soups in shelf-stable retort pouches is generally of good quality.  This Simply Tomato soup is mildly spicy with Indian flavors and is not at all bland but for more of a bite, try the MTR Spicy Tomato Soup.It's very easy to make-- just boil 500ml (0.5 liter or about 2 cups) of water in a pot, add the paste, and stir a little with a wooden spoon.  I make it as directed but substitute ½ cup of milk for some of the water.Ingredients:  tomato, milk, sugar, edible starch, salt, refined sunflower oil, onion, ginger, jeera (black cumin seed), garlic, and black pepper.This soup is vegetarian but not vegan as it contains milk.  Note that the label indicates five servings per packet but two or three is much more realistic as it makes less than three cups of soup so each serving would be a little over half a cup which is not realistic.Calories 70Calories from fat 20Total fat 2.5gSaturated fat 1gTrans fat 0gCholesterol 10mgSodium 950mgTotal carbohydrate 10gDietary Fiber 0gSugars 7gProtein less than 1gVitamin A 2%Vitamin C 6%Calcium 0%Iron 0%The primary nutritional criticism is the high sodium content--each package contains about 4.8g of sodium.

column9: As tasty and decadent as a chocolate cake
column10: I love these carrot cakes. I order them here as well as straight from their website. It has this awesome glaze that reminds me of chocolate. It is fresh. Feel free to warm it in the oven.The only reason I rated it 4 stars instead of the 5 is the texture...it is very crumbly. It is a hit or miss for me to cut a slice without it falling apart. Now, this could be me not using the right utensils.Other than that: Taste, Freshness, Customer Service, Product Delivery - all 5 stars!

column9: Very good bread, tastes like homemade
column10: I've always liked quick breads, my mother does little baking these days so I thought I would try these out,,,,,,did the carrot, banana, and zuchini-all were very good, delivery was fast,,,,,,,unfortuately I have an egg allergy so I could only try a slice or two but my family is enjoying them.

WOW this sauce is so good.. we wanted to try a new BBQ sauce and decided on the Blue Ribbon Sauce and we used the 2 bottles we purchased in one weekend... can't wait for our next bottles to get here... and its for a good cause... can't wait to make more Blue Ribbon Ribs!!!!!
The best BBQ sauce I have ever had. Great for any outdoor BBQ or just plain dip anything in it!!!
This BBQ sauce has the best flavor!!  I love it!  Tastes outstanding on chicken, can't wait to try on other meats!!!  Plus it is for an outstanding cause!!!
This seasoning is amazing - I wasn't a fan of roast until I used this seasoning. Very prompt shipping by seller.

I purchased this as a last minute Christmas gift for my wife. It arrived as promised and was everything I hoped for. My wife loves smoked flavor uses it on everything. She couldn't be happier. You can smell the smoke as soon as she opens the container. My next problem is to find a covered shaker that will trap the smokeand keep the salt fresh.

If you like smoked sea salts this is a very good product.  The smoke flavor is mild and the taste is great.  I put this salt in a grinder and find that the crystals are a bit small so it comes out fast.  I may switch to a small jar and salt spoon or a large holed shaker.  The 12.4 oz jar is enough to go a long way as seasoning salt.

I would have given this a 5 but wanted to leave some room.This is one of a number of orzo offerings from Prepared Pantry.The quality and variety of their orzo will have you never buying plain again.Another nice feature is that the orzo is a bit larger than your normal grocery brands.Taste is excusite and unique - i am ordering a whole second batch of all their versions of this staple.In terms of recipies an example is their Mediterranean - cook it up and cool - put in really fine dice of shallot,oil cure olive, celery and carrot - mix in some feta and a dash of balsamic vinagrette.

column9: Package NOT Marked "Tellicherry"; NO SKU or ASIN #
column10: Received zip-lock bag of black peppercorns.  Label from MoreThanAlive.com merely lists "Black Peppercorns".No way of telling whether these are Tellicherry, or just their bulk black peppercorns.MorethanAlive's website makes NO mention of Tellicherry.  Just Black Peppercorns, in bulk, for $4.80.I ran out of pepper and don't care for a three week wait for a refund.  But I will never order from this company again.BUYERS BEWARE !

I buy all my herbs and spices from Frontier, knowing they're the best and that they're coming from an environmentally conscious co-op run company.  However, the last time I ordered these from Amazon, I was shipped a competitor's product instead, and sent it back at Amazon's expense.  So make sure you get what you're buying and they don't ship you an inferior substitute product.

Best value I've found after years of searching. This pepper is stronger and more flavorful than anything you'll ever find in the supermarket, and is reasonably priced. You can use a little less than normal if you like, since the pepper flavor is so much more pronounced than you're probably used to. But I like to use my normal amount  and thoroughly enjoy the great pepper flavor. As long as you have a good pepper mill and grind it fresh, this is really the best I've found.

After buying a pepper mill I did some online sleuthing to find out that this peppercorn was highly & positively reviewed. I am no at all a foody but bought this as a gift for my wife (who is an amateur gourmand). She raves about this pepper. It is a large bag that at our rate of consumption will probably last at least five years.

I got these after tiring of spending $8 for about a half ounce of whole peppercorns at the market -- these seem as good, and there is enough to last at least a year. Good taste! Seller experience was just fine, no complaints.
Has a nice sharp pepper flavor that really shows in recipes versus the grocery store stuff.  Excellent price.

column9: Not Frontier brand, but good pepper.
column10: I would beef about this product being advertised as "Frontier" brand but arriving as another brand, but until someone weird enough to do a blind taste test of, um...pepper... can show me there's a difference worth griping about, this bag o' corns will do me fine - for a good long while.

It is said that the Tellicherry is "the largest of the peppercorns".  The product that I received must be from a miniature variant.  Measuring in at a scant 2.5mm, my grinder turns these little corns into dust, even at the coarsest setting.  The taste however, is excellent.  I will utilize these in recipes calling for "hand-cracked" peppercorns, and will use a light hand when I do.

This is a wonderful pepper corn. Fresh ground it has a great aroma and an even better taste. Squeeze a lemon on a chicken breast and grind these pepper corns on it and saute in your pan till done. This is a truly good spice. Supermarket brands dream to be this good.

I've always bought the cheap pepper corns in the store, and never knew there was better pepper out there.  I recently bought a bag of this Tellicherry, and it is awesome.  It is much more flavorful than anything I've had before.  I know I won't be going back to that cheap store bought pepper!

It's difficult to explain the difference that fresh ground Pepper makes in savory dishes.  And quality pepper very much more so, and this is a very high quality pepper.  I bought it at the same time I purchased a new pepper mill.  Poured in the pepper and made eggs, once over easy with lots of pepper;  fresh, fragrant, inviting.  What a refreshing difference it made in both the aroma and taste of the eggs.  Now I use it when ever I create savory dishes.  It adds richness to stews and life to meat dishes.  My chili recipe how has a spark that was missing before.  An excellent product that I enjoy so much that I gave part of the package to my son, a self taught chef.
IMO tellicherry peppercorns are the most flavorful. These came fresh and they really don't get any better. I like the large 1# container because I use a lot in making broth and grinding on food.
I love this pepper.  The taste is great and you do not have to use as much as regular pepper.  People who use ground pepper do not know what they are missing.  This is my second order.

After searching the supermarkets and specialty stores, I found this bag of Tellicherry peppercorns to be the best value.  I also feel that the freshness of the product was excellent.  The bag weighs one pound, and this size was not found in any store.  Usually whole peppercorns come in much smaller containers, for a much higher price per ounce.  I would recommmend this product highly.

This is a very nice pepper. Fresh ground it has a slight fruity smell and flavor along with the peppery bite.  I split the bag with my brother. My wife doesn't handle spicy food very well and the full bag would have gotten quite old before i would use it all.  Next time i'll look for a smaller bag of peppercorns.  Having fun and loving it. Do yourself a favor and try this one.
I was so excited to get this product.  I think it is absolutely the best peppercorns that are around.  I love them and will never go back to regular Black Pepper again.

Not all pepper is created equally.  This I learned a long time ago and I have been really enjoying this  pepper.  It is truly robust and has a much stronger flavor then regular store pepper.  I was shipped very quickly so was happy with the service. So make sure you get what you're buying and  don't buy an inferior substitute product. I buy several herbs and spices from Frontier, knowing they're the best with some but not all of their spices are good, and that they're coming from an environmentally conscious company.

The peppercorns arrived on time and were sealed, air tight, in a thick plastic bag.  I cook on a regular basis at home.  I think tellicherry peppercorns are the best black pepper taste.  I got some variety peppercorns years ago for my grinder, and I forgot what I was missing.  Now I've got a huge supply of awesome peppercorns for stews and my grinder.  This product is probably more the size that a restaurant would buy but it smells and tastes amazing, I'll share some with my neighbors.
This is the best pepper you can buy. Buying it by the pound saves you at least 60%... of course you'll use more because it price per oz. is so low.

column9: Great Price and Came as Describred
column10: You can't beat this price. This amount should last me a good couple of years and I like peppercorn. Product came just like the picture. I'd recommend this to everyone.
Fresh and very tasteful.  Full bodied and robust flavor.  More than enough to last for awhile.  Packaging of the product was just right.

Item was shipped the day after I ordered it, and it was delivered the morning after it shipped! I thought it would taste different than pepper I normally buy, but it is a little spicier than I'm used to - not complaining though! Awesome product.

column4: Nick Vasey - author of 'Roppongi' the Novel
column10: Not a lot more to say here folks! Great pepper - good price. Enjoyed it very much. Unlikely to disappoint!

I bought this and a couple pepper grinders a good while back.  This pepper is great.  It tastes better than store bought ground pepper.  It only takes about a 3rd as much for me.  It has a nice and spicy taste.  It has a little heat but in a good way.  I plan to buy some more soon and this will be what I get.  I try to keep some stocked up.  Most food has to have pepper and this makes everything better.I took mine out of the bag and put it in a mason jar.  I figure it will keep its flavors better in there.
Absolutely outstanding pepper, the flavor stands up in all dishes. The pungent pepper smell when I opened the packaging was awesome.

I have been looking for these peppercorns and I have a question after reading the discription and shipping information...it says a pound of pepper but the shipping weight is 15.2 oz. Am I missing something here? A pound is still 16 ounces isn't it?
Bought this for my pepper grinder I got myself to Christmas. Love the taste of fresh ground pepper.
I like pepper, I don't like spending a lot of money.  This is better then McCormick in price per pound and at least the same quality.

I was dreading ordering pepper online because I had no idea how long it would have been in the warehouse and how stale it would taste. I was pleasantly surprised because this still has a peppery kick and does not have the cardboard-like taste that stale pepper has. It's also a great price compared to the ripoff that is whole pepper at the supermarkets.

We go through a lot of pepper in our house so I was looking for a good pepper that didn't kill the budget and this one does it. They came fresh in an air tight bag, perfect for pepper mills. I don't know that I can comment on the flavor of them except that they taste like pepper! They are an all-around good choice for my family.
If you have a peppermill, this is a very good source of peppercorns.  Don't waste your money on grocery store pepper.  This is the way to go.

Great peppercorn, absolutely love it. We were having problems finding a big bag of it to use to fill our pepper grinder when it gets low, and we're really happy we found this! Will purchase more in the future.

column9: I dont know if I would call this spicy
column10: It does have a good black pepper flavor but I don't think I would call it very spicy. I use a lot of this stuff in my cooking and for finishing and it works well. Most other peppercorns when I grind them usually makes me sneeze like mad, but I have not had any problems with this one bothering me. Grinds very well!
I needed to fill a giant pepper mill. I didn't know if this package would be enough. I had leftovers.

Never thought I'd be reviewing peppercorn! Ever! Heck, I never thought I'd be reading reviews of peppercorn before I buy it but I must say, not only is this peppercorn EXTREMELY FRESH, it has actually shown me what peppercorn should taste like. Until now, I might as well have not bothered. It was disgusting dust I was crushing all over my food, apparently because the Spicy World Peppercorn iS DELICIOUS - the reviews are not kidding. You get a heart-felt 5 star from me, baby! Packaging was awesome and it arrived on time too! Thank you :)!

Absolute best pepper I've ever tasted. I've paired it up with the Ozeri Graviti Pro Electric Pepper Mill and Grinder, which I also got on Amazon. I've always loved pepper, but this combo has taken my ethusiasm to a whole new level. Plus, pepper has the health benefits of anti-oxidants and Vitamin C. I will never be without this fantastic peppercorn. When they say it's Gourmet it's definitely the truth!
Fresh crisp spice that is now available to your food and kitchen.  Gives one a sense of uniqueness in every dish served.  I am happy to have it in my kitchen.

column4: Jon Atwood "Computer Geek and loving owner of...
column10: These peppercorn are great.  We keep some in a grinder on the dining room table and then we run about 1/2 the bag through our Vitamix (Vitamix 5200c - 7 YR WARRANTY Variable Speed Countertop Blender with 2+ HP Motor and 48-Ounce Jar) to have pre-ground pepper for cooking with.This is our 2nd purchase in the past year.  MUCH better than buying ground pepper at the grocery store.

column9: You haven't had pepper until you've had Tellicherry pepper

Hey, its peppercorns, so I don't know what to say, but they are fine and peppery and I have no issues with them.

column9: Well, I doubt that it's Tellicherry
column10: It's OK pepper - I don't think it's Tellicherry (and looking at the price I hadn't expected it would be) - it is flavorful and zesty enough, though. And inexpensive - I am a student and price is very important to me. I would buy it again. But if you expect a superior quality product, you will be disappointed!
used this pepper 30yrs ago when I was in india and I loved it because it grinds very nicely and it is delicious.

column10: Product seems ok but, is shipped in a flimsy cellophane bag that cannot be reclosed.  (Note that the photograph of the product appears to show the rim of a jar, but the ad intentionally avoids a description of the packaging.)  A cheap jar with a screw on lid would not have added much to the price.
I had the product in a matter of days... too bad it had to ship seperate from the grinder I ordered at the same time.

I have been feeding abandoned cats..and vagabond racoons...but the more expensive brands.  they were standoffish at first but after a day or so began eating this as if it was the "good" stuff and that helps my budget alot.

column9: Whiskas Meaty selections dry cat food
column10: my cats absolutely love Whiskas Meaty selections dry cat food.  they never waste a piece of it so i'll be ordering this often

I expected the Blood Orange infused oil to be a bright red. It was not, so I wonderd if it would have much flavor. What a surprise when I tasted it. The flavor of orange was really intense. It is perfect in honey orange salad dressing or just drizzled on fish or chicken for amazing flavor. I will buy this product again.

I have used the Blood Orange, Meyer Lemon, Roasted Garlic & Red Chili oils for a few years now. I use all four, however at my Cafe I use the Blood Orange by far the most, as it is a fabulous flavor for baking as well as cooking. We make Blood Orange Chocolate Chip Cookies, Brownies, Scones, etc.The combo of grapeseed oil & olive oils makes for a higher flash point when cooking, so they are great saute oils.  Fun to mix flavors as well. One of my favorites is Red Chili & Blood Orange with Asian Spices on Salmon.Just waiting for them to come out with the product in gallon sizes for us commercial users!

I was lucky enough to grab this on Woot.com along with 3 other flavored oils (4 bottles for $44) and they are fantastic.  The garlic infusion is fragrant, leaving a delicate garlic flavor to meats and vegetables.  I have used it to marinate chicken, filet and salmon with equally good results.  Also, cooking a batch of fresh summer veggies in a little of this oil infuses a wonderful flavor into them.The lemon infused oil is wonderful for fish or chicken.  It has a robust flavor and a little goes a long way.Definitely a re-order for me!! :)

I have tried and loved all of the Exravagonzo infused olive oils, but my favorite is the Red Chili oil.  I have used it in everything from salmon to citrus salad to chocolate chip cookies.  My chocolate chip cookies have always been popular, but the addition of the Red Chili oil has taken it up a couple more notches.  Wow!

column9: Best Infused Olive Oil I have tasted!!!
column10: I have been purchasing Extravaganzo Olive Oils for 3 years!  They are the best!  I love the lemon infused on salads.  Much healthier than ranch dressing.  I have used the orange infused to make chocolate chip cookies!  OMG - devine!!  I have also been taking a bottle as a gift to various parties - in lieu of a bottle of wine. Makes for a creative twist!But don't take my word for it - taste it yourself!Lisa

This is advertised as an Extra Virgin Olive Oil Super Premium. Not so. Upon receipt the label says olive oil and grapeseed oil. Cloying and dominate grapeseel oil flavor. Neither the Red Chli, the Meyer Lemon, nor the Blood Orange Infused rises to the flavor profile expectation. Plus that grapeseed oil dominance is nastique. I ended up throwing all three bottles in the trash. I would never buy any of this product line ever again. Very disappointed.After many years of purchasing from Amazon, this is my first disappointment.
Makes delightful fresh blueberry muffins and a very tasty citrus vinegarette! Also bought blood orange olive oil...great but the lemon has more uses.

column9: Delicious -- great when preparing ground beef, pork chops!
column10: Thought I'd use this in preparation for a stuffed pork chops dish and it turned out fabulous.Being that the flavor is infused you get that "pure orange smell" and it is heavenly indeed.
I use the Garlic and Chili oils regularly. The quality of the olive oil itself if excellent, and the flavors added are neither too bold or too subtle. Just right for my taste.

I've tried all four of these wonderful oils. I tend to love the Roasted Garlic the best. It's so versatile you can put it on anything and olive oil is so good for you, too!The citrus and chili are also really tasty..I like to blend them for an Asian Spice. I truly would recommend these.

I am totally addicted to these oils. My very, very favorite is the Lemon.  I use it on all sorts of stuff...from salad to popcorn.  No other lemon infused oil is even Close!  Same for all four flavors.  I regularly send four box sets as gifts.  Extravgonzo around the world!

I am a lemon freak and I am hooked on the lemon infused oil!! No more trying to mix the right amt of lemon juice with olive oil for salads...this is the perfect blend!! And the Roasted Garlic oil is perfect! I use it in all my recipes that call for garlic. It enhances the entree without overpowering it. Total thumbs up! And it's healthy!!!

I have  used garlic infused oils for years and have not  tasted any better than this one. Unlike many others, it has no sharp biting aftertaste. It  has a high "smoke" temp and I  use it in dishes  where  heat/temperature is  significant.  I have tried the other  flavored  oils and like the lemon  and garlic the best. My hope is that they will come out  with a sesame or ginger flavored oil..that would be  great !

...and Crazy Mary really must be crazy, or RoJo - not Amazon - is selling old stock with misleading copy ...these blended oils are refreshing, flavorful, and very tasty enhancers in the right dish ...the blends are clearly disclosed on the front label [in the picture] and the back label shows that grapeseed is only 20% ...which is a good thing ... enjoy!

column9: Pricey, But Saves on Vet Bills
column10: Just as we are what we eat,so are our cats. Having lost a cat to the poisoned pet food last year and spending big bucks saving several others, I wanted quality. PetGuard is the brand my finicky cats eat with relish.It is worth the price.

I have used this formerly terrifc product for over 10 years. It was the only canned turkey sold in North America that contained no food additives. It was just turkey, water, and sea salt.As of this month( March 2011) new labelling and contents have appeared. The label now proclaims "Better Flavor".The product now contains 50% more sodium - at a time when many manufacturers are either cutting back on salt content or introducing "reduced sodium" vesions of their tradtional products.Worse yet, the "Better Flavor" is achieved by adding "rice starch", "vegetable starch" ( a call to the company revealed that this is potato starch) and "broth" - which contains, among other listed ingredients, "natural flavor" (derived from corn - an increasingly common food allergen ).This product is now useless to me as I am highly sensitive to corn products. While the label still claims the product is gluten free, which was pretty much guaranteed before, since it had only turkey, water and sea salt in it, this claim is now somewhat suspect in as much as with the introduction of each new additive, there is the possiblitly of cross contamination in the prodution of the various grain based starches and "flavors"The company needs to re-think this change. What made them unique and a mainstay for people on specialized diets, was their plain and simple good food. Now they are little different from every other canned meat that is adulterated with unecessary and unwanted food additives.They can kiss goodbye all their former customers who are allergic to or sensitive to corn, processed starches, who are on the Atkins or no grain diets, who have arthritis which is exacerbated by potatoes, and who avoid processed food additives in general.The company also needs to be more up front in their new labelling and say "potato starch" rather than "vegetable starch" AND in bold print say "Contains Corn" to warn customers who are allergic to corn products that they probably should now avoid the product.Hopefully this "Better Flavor" change will be about as successful as New Coke" and we will see Valley Fresh "Classic" Turkey in a year so.

First I wish to say I have no problem with the quality of this product.  It is a good, fairly low sodium turkey.My problem is in the serving size information.  The can says serving size is two ounces DRAINED and there are "about four" servings a can.  To me this means between 3.5 and 4.4 servings a can - or 7.0-8.8 ounces of turkey per can.I have weighed the last three cans and the drained weights are 5.7 ounces, 6.0 ounces and 5.9 ounces.  This is about 15% less than the stated minimum on the label. At this average you are paying $8.75 per pound of meat.Quality product but you are NOT getting the quantity advertised.

The Valley Fresh 100% Natural White Turkey in Water as shown here, and as I've been ordering for quite some time, is excellent. It contains only turkey, water and salt. I order it because my daughter and I have a large number of food sensitivities, which makes finding whole foods without added ingredients difficult.For those of you who use this product because you need to know EXACTLY what's in it, the company has changed the product, and it is no longer what you see here. It has rice starch, "vegetable" starch...who knows what that means...and turkey broth, which could mean anything, including onion, garlic and yeast...all of which will set my daughter and I back. By that, I mean it will take months to recover from the damage it's likely to do.Please take a look at the ingredient list on the Valley Fresh site for their exact listing. A great disappointment! And now I have a ton of product that only my husband can use.
Received product in a timely fashion. The only place to find turkey in the can is on-line. This price was reasonable.

column9: Valley Fresh White Turkey in Water
column10: This is a great product!  Rather than the highly processed turkey slices generally encountered in "convenience" foods, this gives you genuine chunks of cooked turkey breast with natural flavor.  I prefer it for sandwiches, and would not be afraid to substitute it for home-cooked turkey in any recipe.  (I suspect that turkey has lower fat content than chicken--if so, this product might be substituted advantageously for chicken in many uses).
Turkey can sometimes be dry but this is actually very good.  Tender, juicy, and convenient for those on a diet but without a lot of time.

I couldn't believe how little was in each can. It looks the same as the amount in a can of tuna which is two servings. There is about 15% less than the stated minimum on the label. At this average you are paying $8.75 per pound of meat. Weight it yourself and you'll see that this manufacturer is not being honest with the amount of turkey stated to be in each can. I will never purchase from them again.
Great product! They are really cute and were perfect for my one year-old's puppy-themed party birthday cake.
Brachs makes the best mints and Amazon had the best online deal for buying them.  None of the online candy stores even came close to the deal I got at Amazon with free shipping on a $25 order.

column9: Beats any other brand of mint hard candy
column10: I've tried lots of brands of mints but have found no substitute for the refreshing, non-sugary flavor of Brach's Star Brites. I love to toss one in my cup of hot coffee, tea or cocoa. (Yum!) I sometimes place one in my coffee pot when starting up my drip coffeemaker: it dissolves completely by the time the coffee is ready and adds the tiniest hint of minty aftertaste to every sip. With only 20 calories, 5 carbs and 0 fat per mint, I don't mind using them freely.

I've become addicted to Starbrite Mints by Brach's so when I was unable to find them at my local stores,I was pretty upset. Checked out internet candy suppliers but shipping charges were high. Amazon's price was terrific & they arrived before I finished my stash.

I used to really like these... until I got this order and saw printed on the bag "MADE IN MEXICO"! Is anything still made in the United States of America? Are they subject to inspection now? Are they safe? I won't be buying anything else made by Brach's.
I love this gum. It's delicious and really helps me to overcome cravings.Amazon Prime is timely and professional, as always.

column9: Good, but not as good as the original citrus flavor formula
column10: The first time I had Citrusmint I liked it a lot and for a long time it was my favorite gum flavor.  For some reason they decided to change the "recipe" (I noticed the flavor was off and then saw 'new improved flavor' or some such notice on the package).  SangriaFresca became my new favorite flavor and remained so until Wrigley stopped making it a few months ago.  Anyway, this is a gum that keeps its flavor a long time, but it's a bit strong (hint of orange peel maybe?).  I still like it better than most fruit flavor gums.
The Citrus Mint is hard to find in stores but was able to buy via Amazon. Arrived sealed and fresh. Will purchase again. Now if only they would bring back that lemon lime flavor *sigh*.
This gum is great. It contains some xylitol, which is good for your teeth. It's accurately described.

So far ive tried the breakfest blend, columbian, sumatra, verona, winter blend, house blend and a special christmas blend they had one year which was diffrent and had a spicyness to it and im looking forward to trying all the blends eventually but out of all of them ive tried so far the French roast has to be my favorite- probably between the french and winter blend. The french roast has an excellent taste and is deep dark beans and a smooth smoky taste. Absolutely delicious and smells great to. I would recomend this if you love dark coffee with alot of taste. Excellent and highly Recomended. A+

This is a good value for a two pack of a full pound of French Roast. It's my favorite Starbucks coffee by a long shot--good black, good made up as latte, versatile.If you buy your coffee in grocery stores, it's not a full pound, but can cost almost as much. So this is a decent deal.The coffee should be oily, dark and smelly snappy and fresh. If yours is not (mine was fine) then send it back. Life is too short to drink lousy coffee. I grind mine in my Magic Bullet.

column9: Starbuck Coffee Not sold as advertised
column10: I have purchased this coffee from Starbucks store and it was great, however what I received from this purchase was not even in the same bag as shown and the coffee not nearly as fresh.When I opened the new bag from Starbuck it was rich & oily and smelled very good, however the bag I purchased here the beans were very dry and the smell barely smelled like coffee. column9: better after open a few days

Both my girls, ages 3 and 9 love these fruit and veg sauces. And they go in my car, bag, wherever we go.  Such a great idea.

column9: Great way to get in veggies
column10: These are our go to snacks!  My daughter loves them and I feel great about giving them to her.  Its easy and she is getting more fruits and veggies that makes every mom smile.
