I have also bought Peter Rabbit Organics Sweet Potato/Corn/Apple and Carrot/Squash/Apple blend. He eats them all with no problem. I'm so glad to be able to get him to eat a vegetable when I can't get him to eat it off his plate.

selected this product as a way to get my ever-more-picky toddler to eat some veggies. she loves the packages, and i love how easy it is for her to self-feed with them. i wish that spinach and peas were the first ingredient (instead of apples), but otherwise, thumbs up.

My daughter loves this stuff, and I've got to say they taste pretty great.  The packaging is genius as well.  You can't beat it for on the go convenience and as long as your child doesn't get too crazy with the container, it's fairly mess free as well.  Love them!!

I have kids who need extra iron and who need to have liquids thickened to drink them- this snack fits the bill as something we can take-along when we are out. In addition to being a great package, the taste is great and gets the extra vegetables into my kids when they are on the go. SO awesome to find a healthy take-along for my kids!

I really like being able to purchase these organic products for my child. He loves them and it's a great way to get him to eat some veggies during the day. Super saver is awesome because it ends up costing a lot less then buying them at the store.

column9: Single Father needs all the help he can get...
column10: I am loving being a father... and despite my best culinary attempts, pasta with olive oil or mac'n'cheese; how do I get her to eat the veggies? I bought this as a snack, but after last nights overly cooked veggies, found that they can be good side dishes as well.My little one likes the the green A LOT vs the yellow, just bought the brown; we will let you know.  So far, HUGE success.  Great for lunch on the go or to make up for a single man's cooking.  Either way a must have in winning the war that is meal time with a toddler.

I am loving this line of Peter Rabbit Organics! I just tried this one, and was again blown away. I think blending these ingredients together was a great idea. Otherwise how do you get your little one to actually eat spinach or peas without spitting it all back up?! I can't say it too much, but I love the pouch! When its fun to eat the kids will try anything! Great product

column9: Love, love, love the fruit and veggie pouches!
column10: These are a dream! Fruit and veggies for my little one in a fun and easy to use pouch - yes please! My daughter cannot get enough of these tasty Peter Rabbit Organics pouches. Plus it makes me feel great knowing that I am giving her snacks that are good for her. Great work guys!

Peter Rabbit Organics has successfully created a product that has your baby in mind. I have 3 kids: 8, 7, 8 months. They will all eat all the flavors happily. If you had time to make your own baby food, wouldn't you make it pure? Would you have a huge problem putting a apple in it to mask some of the less flavorful veggies like spinach? I have bought plenty of baby food over the years and with so many options I have decided to actually look at the labels these days- Peter Rabbit Organics is the best on the market. Its a family centered company that is totally focused on your baby!

column9: Utz Cheese Balls Barrels - 2 / 35 oz. is misleading
column10: I just want to warn the buyers that the title "Utz Cheese Balls Barrels - 2 / 35 oz." does not mean that you will get 2 packs.  It's only one pack and -2 is misleading.  I would recommend seller to change the title of this product as "Utz Cheese Balls Barrels - 35 oz.".  You can get the single container for $11 as well.  I really thought I was getting 2 containers.Though we love cheeseballs.

I used to eat these things all the time in college... man those were the days.  Anyway, I was thoroughly pleased with my shipment of cheese balls, even though I ended up eating way too many of them since I have no willpower.  If you love cheese balls these Utz barrels are for you!

These are as good as Planter's Cheese Balls which were discontinued a few years back. My husband was recently looking for the original in the store and purchased a store brand of cheese balls which were extremely salty. The container keeps them nice and crisp even in the humidity of the Pacific NW.

I bought it because I like to save the containers to store dog treats in. The cheese balls are good & the barrels are gigantic. I didn't realize how big 35 oz. would be. But it was a good price at the time. I think the price increased since then but will more than likely decrease again. I froze one of the tubs because we'll take awhile to finish the first one.

column9: On the verge of being good, but something's missing
column10: I ordered this for my birthday. I got birthday money from family, and I ordered a couple of goodies, perfume, and this cocoa.  I love hot chocolate, and I'm always looking for new ones to try.  Based on the first review I decided to go ahead and order.  I will probably not reorder.  Mixed by itself into hot water it seems to lack thickness.  It also has too much of an artificial raspberry taste.  I like Hershey's Bliss Raspberry Chocolate much better.  I've been adding one spoonful of the Cobblestone Kitchen to my regular cocoa to give it a raspberry boost.  But, by itself, it does not stand up to the test. I plan on finishing the three remaining cans over time by using it as a stir in additive to other cocoa.

column9: There is good and then there is wonderful
column10: Cobblestone Kitchen's Irish Creme Hot Cocoa mix has got to be the most luxurious tasting cocoa on the market.  We originally bought this cocoa to use as a base for Frappuccinnos but quickly decided it was way to good to waste in a mix.  The flavor is rich and smooth.  We have made it a part of our winding down for bed time procedure - a couple of cups together and just relax.Cobblestone Kitchen refers to the cocoas as "Delicious and Decadent"  and they are being extremely modest.

Many moons ago I was a nanny for a Korean family in the midwest (I am not Korean).  The kids were a delight and so was the freshly prepared, culturally authentic food.  These chili flakes are a tasty addition to the Korean dishes prepared in my home.  Enjoy!

column9: Holly's Oatmeal, my go to breakfast
column10: Since I have discovered Holly's oatmeal, I eat it almost every morning.  I have lost 30 pounds on Weight Watchers and this has been a great help.  It is delicious and FILLING, which keeps me full until lunch and so it keeps me on track to maintaining my weight.  An added bonus is that it is so tasty.  I am trying to lower my cholesteral, so it helps me there too.  My favorite is the Cranberry Almond flavor but I love the Goji Berry too.  I would hightly recommend this product.
THIS IS JUST THE BEST OATMEAL EVER.IT IS ALL NATURAL,PLUS I LIKE THE GOJI BERRIES,BECAUSE THEY ARE GOOD FOR YOU,AND TASTE GOOD TOO.

I love oatmeal, but I've struggled to find a kind that was easy to fix and not too sugary, but not your basic boring oats either.  For a while I used Quaker instant Low Sugar packets, but they just add artificial sweetener to it, which makes it still waaaay too sweet for my taste.  That's why I LOVE Holly's oatmeal... it has just a hint of sweetness, and you can always add more (a little syrup or brown sugar) if you need it.  Just add milk and it cooks up on the stove in less than 10 minutes.  The website has instructions for the microwave, though I haven't tried it yet.  The goji berries are an interesting addition, though they are extremely mild in flavor.  I catch a hint of green tea taste when I bite into them.  Really, all the flavors are great.  This is my go-to snack!

column9: Better than oatmeal in so many ways
column10: Worth every penny. This is MORE than regular oatmeal. It's heartier and has more to offer, and it is DELICIOUS. I make my oatmeal with water, and don't need to add any sweetener. Sometimes, I add more dried fruit (like cranberries), but it's fine on its own as well. I'm also on WW, have lost 25 lbs, and love Holly's as part of a filling breakfast or snack. Here's from Holly's website about the nutrition:"Holly's has more protein (9 grams) and soluble fiber (4 grams) than any other oatmeal.  There's no salt, no saturated fat, no trans fat and no cholesterol.  Holly's is a hearty and unique blend of seven whole grains cooked in soy milk. Think of the creaminess of instant hot cereal with the chewiness of long cooked grains - that's the texture of Holly's."I couldn't have said it better myself and can't wait to run out so I can try the other flavors!
This "enhanced" oatmeal is fantastic!  It's slightly sweet enough so that I don't even have to add any sweetener, which is great.  And it cooks much faster than regular non-instant oatmeal.

Holly's Oatmeal is the best I have ever tasted. Only the best ingredients are used and the quality shines through. Try it and you too will be a believer. It has become my regular breakfast anytime of the year!
This oatmeal is great. It is very healthy and low in points (3 points) for my Weight Watchers diet.

I eat only oats every morning. I try different brands and did not find this to be much different from Quaker or other organic oats (except for the goji berries that don't really have a strong taste). Not worth the high price for me. Note: I make my oats with water, not milk.
Great for sending to soldiers over seas in Iraq it was hard to find someone who would ship very satisfied

I have been using Earth Balance Crunchy Peanut Butter for almost a year. I really like it because it is sweetened with agave and that helps  to keep from having spikes in my sugar levels, plus it is yummy. I love it.

column9: Hooked on Annie's, will never return to Kraft!
column10: We stopped buying the Kraft mac n' cheese once we got started on Annie's products. The cheese sauce tastes more like real cheese than the sweet, overprocessed Kraft sauce. Once you acquire a taste for Annie's, there's no going back! On the other hand, the kids' friends who come over for lunch often turn up their noses at our Annie's mac and cheese, because they are so accustomed to Kraft or the like. I like that Annie's are all-natural, too, but it's mainly the taste that keeps me coming back for more. A note about the shell kind: you get more for your money than the bunny or Arthur shapes. The kids love the cute shapes, so we buy both, but the shells are a better deal.

This is without a doubt one of the best "mac and cheese" products around.  And it is good for you too!  I noticed some negative reviews about the cheese sauce being too thin.  YOU NEED TO DRAIN THE SHELLS REALLY WELL and this will remedy that.  They are like tiny water buckets, so I stirred and shook the water out of them while they were in my collander and it did the trick.  ENJOY!

column9: This is how I perfect it
column10: 1) I use a 1/2 cup of Dannon NonFat Plain Yoghurt (per the instructions) and find that even without butter or milk, the sauce is creamy, tangy, perfect.2) Tabasco for a kick3) Parsley (dried will do) because it is awesome.4) Cracked red and black pepper because that's how I roll.5) Tuna if you like tuna.Result = wholesome joy.
When you mix the cheese sauce with milk, the mixture becomes too thin. So I mix a small amount of cheese into the shells along with the other sauce, and this makes it more thick.
Good for you and the kids beg for more?  That's because of the great taste.  This mac & cheese is a keeper- the shells make them even more appealing to the little ones!

column9: Not near as good as Annie's creamy delux mac & cheese
column10: This the only product of Annie's that I am disappointed in.  The cheese powder is not nearly as flavorful as Annie's creamy delux mac and cheese with the foil packet of cheese sauce (which my family and I all love and will be the only kind I buy from now on).

column9: Tastes Like the No-Name Store Brand
column10: It tastes absolutely the same as any other store mac-and-cheese.  The "totally natural" cheese is a fine-as-talcum-powder substance in a foil packet.  Save some money and buy the store brand for 69 cents on sale at Ralph's Market.

I am very careful when it comes to organic and natural food and this is one of the main reasons to choose Annie's brand and in particular their mac & cheese over other options on the market. I am very, very satisfied with the quality and taste, and I eagerly recommend them.

This mac n' cheese is pretty tasty, but honestly I think the cheap boxes of Kraft are more delicious and they don't cost as much. The shells are smaller than I'd like and the cheese doesn't really blend that well, so I always get tiny chunks of cheese powder in my meals. Nobody wants that.

column9: Try it with yogurt for more flavor
column10: I suggest trying it with yogurt, and skipping the milk and butter all together if you prefer a stronger flavor. I like strong cheeses and sharp cheddar, I also appreciate a thick and creamy Mac & Cheese. 1/4 a cup of plain yogurt (or to taste!) is worth a try.

column9: Not as good as it used to be...
column10: My children and I have eaten Annie's macaroni & cheese for over ten years and loved it. So it was to my dismay when I began to notice in the last year that the flavor was obviously reformulated to be much weaker. The directions were also reconfigured. It used to be 2 tablespoons of butter and 2 tablespoons of milk; now it calls for 1/4 cup of milk, which is why the outcome is so runny and yucky. My children have never eaten Kraft mac & cheese, so we were comparing the difference in taste with the original Annies. I honestly expect that my family will wean themselves of Annies mac & cheese because the flavor is that disappointing and bland.

This is my kids' favorite mac and cheese. They like this one better than Kraft! :)I have tried all of the other "healthier" or "organic" Mac and Cheeses--Trader Joe's, Whole Foods, the various Annie'e etc. This one is the best and the "cheesiest".It is so nice to order it from Amazon--great price and I can order a case and it shows up at my house two days later with free shipping. Great!

This is good stuff made with real ingredients.  I really hate reading the ingredient list of Kraft Mac & Cheese.  Annie's makes quality products that taste great.  Once I starting eating Annie's Mac & Cheese I stopped eating Kraft's.  This is great comfort good.
Another brand of mac and cheese with powdered cheese is not one of my favorites, but Annie's shells with real aged cheddar is good. The kids liked it too.
Was very disappointed, there was no real cheese flavor. Had to add our own extra sharp cheddar to give it pop. Also, cheese sauce didn't cover the noodles well.

I bought some because I love mac and cheese, and lived off the kraft ones in college. However, I became concerned about the laundry list of chemicals kraft uses,including Yellow # 5. This box uses annatto and beta carotene for coloring.Its difficult to put in words what this taste like. On one hand its utterly bland and flavorless, yet it also leaves a weird sharp chemical like aftertaste in your mouth. I've tried the white cheddar one as well and it had a similar taste. I'm giving it 2 stars instead of one because I like the fact that it does not use yellow #5 for coloring, but I don't think I'll be giving Annie's pasta another chance.

column9: By far the best ____ & Cheese product around!!!!
column10: Picked up this product at Target when I saw it on sale for a buck a box awhile back, and have NOT gone back to Kraft since! They taste so much richer than the "original" that even my processed husband doesn't flinch, he devours the entire pot! Thanks, Annies!

Annie's is simply the best.  I don't know what some of these other reviewers are talking about.  It does take a while to get kids used to the taste of real food versus whatever is in Kraft.  But - it's simply a great product.  I cook it two boxes at a time so we'll have leftovers.  I recommend being sure to add butter.  And plain yogurt is a great substitute for the milk (as someone else suggested)  I'll never go back to Kraft!

I had seen Annie`s advertised along side of kraft for years but never  took the leap until recently and now I wish I hadnt.  First off the overall portion size is small and they use a very small pasta shell (it has to be seen to be believed). You get more pasta not to mention much bigger pasta shells in the Kraft mac and cheese version and personally I think they taste better despite not being organic.  Perhaps if youre just buying this for children this might suffice but if youre looking to eat this as a meal or even as a side and there`s more than one person and/or you have even an average appetite I`d look elsewhere or just plan on cooking two boxes.  As far as flavor is concerned and the final product... I followed the directions and mixed the recommended amount of milk with the powder cheese mix and it came out more like soup than anything even closely resembling mac and cheese.  Not sure what they were going for here but I definitely dont get what all these 5-star reviews are about.  I even tried adding a few slices of kraft cheddar and it still was soupy.  Then I substituted margarin for milk as some other reviewers had suggested and although it was more palatable (only reason I didnt give it one star) I was still very disappointed.  There was hardly enough cheese for half the shells muchless the entire box.  Maybe if they used larger shells and gave you a lot more of the powder cheese Id consider reviewing it again but given the portion police state we live in I doubt either will happen.  In conclusion, if you like eating mac and cheese like u do your cereal in the morning then this version of annie`s is for u, if not, try Kraft (not the powdered version) and youll be much happier for having done so.

My local grocer always sells out of this stuff so it's hit or miss to find it when I shop, but thanks to Amazon it can be purchased in bulk (and cheaper than my local grocer).You simply can't beat Annie's Organic Mac & Cheese.  It has the best flavor hands-down.

column9: Simply the best mac n cheese!
column10: Maybe this is TMI, but after trying Annie's mac n cheese, I've noticed I no longer have to "run" to the restroom after having consumed it like the Kraft brand has always done to me.  Makes me wonder what I was consuming??  My kids have had nothing but Annie's and can't get enough...It truly does taste great!  I also agree with the previous post in that you'll get more in the box of shells versus the Arthurs or other shapes...

When it c omes to eating box food, this is the way to go.  I love this stuff.  Organic, and very good.  You can make it with milk, or yogart, and it is always easy and fast.  I only wish you could order a box with a variety of types, and not all the same flavor.

I'm not an expert on macaroni cheese from a box. I love the real thing, but it is time consuming. I've tried Kraft Macaroni Cheese, but I wasn't impressed. I read the good reviews for this Annie's product. I wanted to get the subscription to save money, but 12 packets was too many to buy, when I didn't even know if I would like it.I went to Walmarts and was lucky to get a packet, they didn't have many. I just compared the prices, in Walmart it costs $1.62 a box. On Amazon with the subscription, a box costs $1.23, that's a big saving.I made it yesterday, and mixed in a little grated mature cheddar, after it was cooked, then put it under the grill to melt the cheese. I was going to eat half and heat the rest up today, it was quite a lot for one person. It tasted so good, I ended eating all of it! If you like mature cheddar you'll probably like this. It is great with ketchup on or slices of tomatoes added with the cheddar before grilling it. It tastes almost as good as the reat thing.I ordered it on subscription yesterday, I can't wait to try it again.

I'm not sure about other people's negative experiences with these boxed pasta but I find it to be quite delicious and very quick to make. There is an aftertaste but most foods have one I find.. However in my case it is not a very strong one.

Soo I've been stalking this product on Amazon but I'd seen mixed reviews. So, I wanted to see if I could find a box in a local store to try it out before buying a 12 pack.  I tried it today, and WOW! I love it! I think this will help my fiance jump on the organic foods bandwagon with me ;) Also it's great for those days I get home from work at midnight and want some comfort food!

Don't be swayed by what some reviewers are saying about Annie's Natural Shells and Aged Cheddar Mac and Cheese. I almost didn't purchase this product because of some of the reviews I read on here, but I'm glad I did. It's not only healthy and fast, but actually pretty tasty too. If you're expecting something all natural that tastes like Kraft, you're going to be disappointed. Kraft's sauce is thicker and sweeter, but Annie's sauce tastes less processed and has a better all-around flavor. I prefer the Aged Cheddar Mac and Cheese to the White Cheddar one (which was very bland). Try adding a little extra butter to enhance the flavor of the sauce.

column9: Annie's Mac & Aged Cheddar Cheese Shells
column10: Growing up I thought I hated Mac&Cheese.  I was the weirdest kid on the planet.  But as I grew up, and experienced other Mac&Cheeses I came to the realization that it wasn't that I hated it; it was that all I had ever experienced was that gross neon orange stuff in the blue box.  Since then, I've moved on to liking more than the homemade stuff, but it still has to be a pretty good product if I'm going to eat it out of the box.  And this Annie's Mac&Cheese qualifies for that.I like Annie's because the brand represents natural and organic and everything that makes you feel good about the world and yourself.  They use quality, real ingredients, and the taste is usually good.  They also make an effort to be Green in their business practices, which is always a pleasant attribute for a company.  And even if their food is still technically junk food; at least its a healthier junk food that you can feel ok sneaking into your diet once in awhile.The ingredients are really what make this product a good one.  Organic pasta, real cheese, and annatto for the coloring, and a few other ingredients; the ingredient list is small and for a boxed product that's rare to find.  Even better is the fact that for mac and cheese, this product doesn't have a lot of fat or calories in comparison to other cheesy meals.  There's no artificial flavorings or colorings, and they even throw in some calcium so you can pretend you're getting your vitamins.  Not a super food, but one that's good enough to cheat with.The taste wasn't as good as a homemade mac and cheese, but for a boxed food it was pretty good.  Preparing it the way the directions state made it a little watery, but every once in awhile you'd break into a clump of seasoning that hadn't dissolved and get a rush of cheddar.  Which might sound disgusting, but I actually enjoyed it.  The noodles themselves didn't have an abundance of flavor, but the cheese sauce covered that aspect and it was a respectable enough cheesy taste for a boxed mac and cheese.The noodles cooked up to a little past al dente and were firm to the teeth.  Not too mushy but not undercooked either by the suggested stove top method of cooking.  And it really did only take about 10 minutes.  Cooking it is a simple enough process that is quick enough for someone needing a small meal or a side dish to go with the rest of dinner.I would definitely buy this product again.  Maybe try it as a meal with some chicken or other type of dish.  I like that I could have a quick mac and cheese that wasn't disgusting and was even a bit healthy too.Review by M. Reynard 2012

I've bought this a long time and there's one thing you have to do. Don't add all that milk. I only use about a teaspoonful (if that much) so the sauce isn't all drippy. I've read the complaints about the nasty watery sauce and this takes care of it for me. I've eaten the usual boxed  mac & cheese and even found rat hairs in one several times. (I won't tell you the brand but it was a major one). So, I won't eat anything but Annie's. It's costs more but it's worth it. I wouldn't eat anything else.
This pasta is delicious and makes me feel I am making a healthy choice with this brand.

I just came back to order more.  My son (7 year old) loves this!  He likes his mac and cheese to be orange.  This is the only natural version I have found with orange cheese.I do make it with butter which the directions say is optional, but I think its better with a creamier sauce.  Its also really good with a bit of cream cheese melted in if I am low on butter.

column9: Wonderful for Lacto-Ovo vegetarians like me!
column10: This tastes better than the Kraft stuff I used to eat, and really any other brand of Mac & Cheese I can recall using. It's only competition is homemade macaroni and cheese, just follow the directions, and you'll enjoy a wonderful, cheesy meal in almost no time.

I wanted this to be even moderately tasty so that my 3-yr-old would eat it. He's picky, and Kraft Mac and Cheese is something I can always get him to eat - but hate that it's so highly processed and non-organic. Quite frankly, Amy's just doesn't taste very good. It's bitter, the cheese is thin (and I got rid of the water in the shells).I still give it three stars because of Amy's business practices which I love - but won't buy again.
My kids love this and I can feel good serving it to them.  Say goodbye to preservatives and ingredients I can not pronounce.
best mac and cheese ever!  seriously delicious.  perfect in every way, and good for you!!!

I bought a box of this at the local grocery store to try before we buy a case.  The taste was great, we just switched over to organic foods and I am gone 3 days a week for work.  The 2 "boys" (my s.o. and 16 year son), fend for themeselves for food while I am gone.  They used to eat all those processed boxed premade dinners, so it has been hard as neither wants to spend lots of time cooking.  This and the other boxed meals are great alternatives to all the processed boxed food.  Annies brand has so far been consistently good and I would recommend to anyone.

column9: Better Than Watery Old Commerical Kraft...
column10: The trick to Annie's is to use only butter and no milk (or just a splash).  Using all of the milk that the directions call for will give you cheese of a watery consistency.  This is also a really good deal on this stuff, considering that it is about $2 per box in the grocery store.

I normally love everything made by Annie's and often buy the bunny grahams and fruit snacks for my grandson. However, I was stunned by how much I hated this mac and cheese mix!! It's absolutely awful --the cheese sauce tastes artificial and leaves a weird aftertaste. Sorry Annie, but won't purchase this again. I will give it one star for being organic.
I found this product to be tasteless. Even a dollar store product has more flavor than this does. Iwould never buy this brand again and would not recomend it to anyone.

I bought these after reading all the great reviews and I would not advise you to do the same -- not to the tune of 12 boxes anyway.  I've foisted as much off on friends as I can and I still have one box left.It's funny that everyone raves about it being free of chemicals, etc. because to me the taste makes me think of exactly that.  It's just truly awful -- does not resemble a cheese taste in the slightest.  Just a weird sharp and very unpleasant taste.  The sauce is thin.  They are even worse is you try to reheat.  Obviously, this is just my opinion, but I warn you not to buy 12 boxes if you're a first-timer!
I love this product. Great taste and I like being able pronounce (and know)all of the ingredients.

column9: Good Alternative-Don't Care for the Organic Mumbo Jumbo
column10: Annie's Natural Shells are a good alternative to the pasty white flour Kraft Mac & Cheese. Flavor is good for boxed Mac & Cheese when you just want something quick and easy.What I really don't care for is all of their organic and the "I'm saving the Earth so I'm a better person for buying this product" mumbo jumbo. There are those of us that just want healthy alternatives without all of the being green political correctness.The fact is that the dairy products that Annie's uses come from cows that eventually end up in a saluter house. "How nice is that Mr. Rabbit?"

column4: Jan Kellis "Author of Bookworms Anonymous & T...
column10: Finally, I found a product that satisfies my daughter's mac and cheese craving and also meets my nutrition requirements. We've tested this on several young teens and they all found it delicious; what more could you ask from an instant pasta dish?

I compare this to Kraft or other conventional mac 'n cheese products and give it a 5. You cannot compare it to homemade, however. I actually haven't touched any mac n cheese other than natural ones in decades...yuk. But this is a product I like to have on hand for nights I don't want to cook. Quick, easy--almost like not cooking. Tasty.

My husband and I bought an "Annies" mac and cheese one night at our local store.  It was amazing, and we were so excited that we decided to buy a large lot online.  I couldn't find the exact style we bought, but the lable on this box was almost identical to the other Annies.  I was WRONG, this was awful - the cheese was a powder instead of the pre-mixed packet that came in our original box.  It was watery and smelled like vomit.  It left a bad after-taste.  I do not recommend this particular type of Annies.
I honestly would rather gnaw on the box this macaroni came in than to ever eat a bite of the actual product again.  I am all for organic foods but this is just plain disgusting.

I buy quality, more natural mac & cheese quite regularly and was a long time customer of Annie's products. Unfortunately I often found that glue and other contaminants (which spark when heated) made it into the finished products Annie's sells. I contacted the company about this and was ignored twice before receiving very brief a reply that there was no danger to the consumer. Call me skeptical but eating glue (it's probably from the sealant used on the box tops) caked to the pasta does not seem to me like a good idea, and I wasn't exactly thrilled with Annie's customer service, which was mostly dismissive (ignored my first two missives to them). There are plenty of great products and companies out there. I buy Back To Nature mac & cheese now, and actually prefer their spirals and elbows to Annie's shells as these also cook much faster than shells.  Furthermore, Back To Nature mac & cheese has the added benefit of employing vegetarian friendly enzymes in their cheese culture, as opposed to Annie's which does not uses animal enzymes. All in all there's no sense taking a chance on eating toxic substances when looking for a healthier alternative to the chemically heavy products from Kraft and the like.

I was excited to try organic mac & cheese but this stuff has got to go.  It honestly tastes like vomit.  The first 2 bites I put in my mouth were good but thats where it ended.  It takes really bad on either side of my tongue.. just like vomit.  I cannot stomach this stuff & will never try it again. Ew.

Tastes like sick chemicals. I cannot imagine any child eating this and liking it, same goes with all of Annie's mac and cheese products. Sauce is thin, noodles are too small, and it tastes like vomit or stomach acid (I'm serious). Kraft now makes Organic mac and cheese and it's DELICIOUS, I'm eating some right now.

column9: Disapointing after all these great reviews!
column10: I really wanted to like these, but unfortunately, can't stand the taste of the cheese sauce.  (I don't care for Kraft either).The ingredients are better in Annies Homegrown Mac & Cheese, so if I could stand the taste, I'd eat it without question.  But the taste is, is my opinion, acidic and just bad.  Almost like another reviewer said : vomit-like.Now what will I do with the case that is left?

column9: Really Great Snack...Not sure what others are talking about???
column10: My review is for the Triple Berry Crunch granola in the 12 oz bag.  I had not tried this particular flavor before but had tried the Fruit and Nut variety in a free sample.  I was looking online to purchase the Fruit and Nut and found the Triple Berry which had less fat and calories and so I bought that instead.  At Amazon's subscribe savings plus the current discount, the cost is less than $3 a bag which is great!  This product tastes great, has a great texture, and is great to take along in little zip loc bags for a snack.  My children ask for it and eat it by the handfull.  I've since gone back and ordered more of the other flavors of this granola.  The company has a website with all their nutrition information listed so you can check all that out and compare flavors in detail before you decide.  My only somewhat negative comment about this product is that I wish it had a few more berries in it (what couldn't use more berries??) and that it came in more of a cluster form so my toddlers could eat it a little easier.  We've not experienced any of the tasteless choke and gagging that others have mentioned, nor did I find the product to be overly priced as someone else had said.  In fact, we've found quite the opposite and will be stocking this product and other flavors of it on a regular basis.

column9: Excellent quality, flavor, and eat-ability...and Amazon's price can't be beat!
column10: I first purchased Bear Naked Low-Sugar granola from a brick/mortar grocery store...for $4.59 for the 12-ounce bag.  I loved it, and keep it in my office at work to incorporate into any flavor of yogurt or to satisfy those late afternoon munchies.  It's nutritious, delicious, and wholesome.  The Amazon price is an absolute steal for this product -- over $1 less per bag than you might pay at a store down the street!Having tried Bear Naked's other products, I can also assure you that you are not sacrificing flavor or texture by choosing the low-sugar option.

I purchased one 12 oz bag for $5.99, bag after reading the reviews here on line to ensure that I would like it before I purchased a case.  I've tasted the Bear Naked oatmeal and I enjoy it.  But I was not sure about this product so I decided to try just one...And I love it, I add skim milk and fresh fruit and have a great breakfast daily that not only taste good but also it's good for me too.

I'm on a low sugar diet and this was great to put on my yogurt in the morning.  Yogurt gets so boring day after day, it's so nice to have a low-GI option.  I'll agree it doesn't taste as good as the sugar kind, but for what it is, it is very good.
I really love this granola. The dried berries are plentiful and sweet and reconstitute very well in milk. The best way to eat it is mixed in Chobani yogurt, which makes a fabulous breakfast. Yum!

I've tried many a granola but this one has them all beat- it's chewy without scouring your inner mouth, is has just the right amount of sweetness and taste- wonderful on greek yogurt. I love the subscribe and save plan, living in a one big chain store town,the variety is lacking and I have control over delivery. Thanks Amazon!

most delicious granola I have found and it stays crisp.  I love to add it to vanilla yogurt with or without a few extra berries.  sometimes it's hard to find in stores so I've started ordering from Amazon.

column9: Granola I will absolutely purchase again!
column10: I have been reading some of the other reviews and I'm not sure we're even eating the same product. I cannot attest to what their older version of this granola was like as I started eating it in fall of 2010.I had been searching, and nearly gave up, trying to find a granola that was not ridiculously high in sugar. I was pregnant at the time and was taking serious consideration as to what was going into my body. ((Brewer Pregnancy Diet)) I found these at the local grocery store and decided they were worth a try. I picked up the Triple Berry Crunch as well as the Bear Naked Peak Flax Oat's and Honey. They're GREAT! (Tony the Tiger voice)I purchase plain yogurt now and add this granola to it. Much better nutrition than 98% of the other granolas on the shelf in the health/natural food section.Low in fat and 4g of sugar in the Triple Berry Crunch and TASTY!! When not in my yogurt, I keep a mixed back of this, with the Oat's and Honey flax to snack on at work. Good stuff!

This stuff is amazing in yogurt.  One 1/4 cup serving of this in your yogurt makes you feel as though you've had an actual meal.I originally bought it because It had much fewer calories than alot of the other granola options at the local grocery store.  I was surprised by how sweet the flavor was.  It tastes great.

The cereal has only 4g of sugar and has a great chewy crunch. Plus there are lots of raspberries, blueberries and strawberries, and ground flax seed. All of that is so good for you.  There are very few granola cereals which have sugar grams this low.  I have it almost every morning with extra blueberries.

column9: Excellent addition to baked goods and other foods
column10: Bear Naked Triple Berry Crunch Fit, is an excellent addition to baked goods, cereals and anything else you would like to make into a healthier food.  It can make healthy foods healthier and unhealthy foods a little better for your body to endure.Don

Pretty good cereal -- if doctored up: I add yogurt, blueberries, strawberries or raspberries, and let it soak for at least five minutes... Not nearly as tasty as conventional granola (which has larger amounts of oil and sugar), but it's healthful and a nice way to start the day.

column9: My favorite of all the Bear Naked flavors ...
column10: I've tried a few of the Bear Naked granola flavors, and this one is my favorite by far. It has the right amount of crunch and sweetness, is lower in fat and sugar, and has a good amount of fruit chunks.  I mix about 1/3 cup of this granola with 8 oz. of strawberry or raspberry fat free yogurt for a yummy filling quick breakfast.Amazon's price is excellent, especially if you opt for Subscribe and Save. Good product at a good price; what more could you want?
I use this all the time with my yogurts...it's healthy, delicious, and makes a yogurt an even more filling snack!

The original product, which I bought a few years back, were very tasty and full of flavor.  Now the product is lacking in flavor and lacking in some ingredients, but still nice aromatic bouquet.  It's NOT the same excitement my taste buds got  orginally from  the product.  I DON'T think it's a fluk and every bag is the same.  I've tried at least two bags of the new shipment already and every bit taste the same.  Portions "appear" to be slightly down too. I still have (4) bags from the (6) bag order.  This shipment, I bought both Very Berry and Vanilla Almond Crunch (12 bags total). What a disappointment ! !  Too bad, I won't buy this product again.

This looked like a great low-sugar cereal and had all of the elements I like in a cereal - berries, flax, no weird ingredients...so I gave it a try.  I poured myself a bowl of cereal the day I got it in the mail and couldn't finish the bowl.  It's like eating raw oats - which is not a pleasant experience, and it has a weird artificial aftertaste - even though it doesn't have artificial ingredients in it.  I couldn't figure out why it tasted so strange.  Sorry guys, but I may have to feed the remaining 5 and 4/5 bags of cereal to the local horses.  I couldn't even choke it down.

column9: Granola I Would NOT Buy Again
column10: Since this was the only Bear Naked Granola on the store shelf that did NOT contain Canola Oil, which I'm very allergic to, it was the only one I could use my coupon on.  Maybe the other Bear Naked varieties: Bear Naked All Natural Granola, Fruit and Nut,  12-Ounce Pouches (Pack of 6), Bear Naked All Natural Granola, Peak Protein, 12-Ounce Pouches (Pack of 6), Bear Naked Fit Vanilla Almond Crunch Granola, 12-Ounce Pouches (Pack of 6), Bear Naked All Natural Granola, Banana Nut, 12-Ounce Pouches (Pack of 6), Bear Naked 100% Pure & Natural Granola, Maple Pecan, 12-Ounce Pouches (Pack of 6), Bear Naked 100% Pure & Natural Granola, Peak Flax, Oats & Honey with Blueberries, 12-Ounce Pouches (Pack of 6), and Bear Naked Granola Heavenly Chocolate, 12-Ounce Pouches (Pack of 6), taste better, but I found this product unpleasant, with a foul aftertaste coming from the freeze dried berries.I recommend the Back To Nature Oat Vanilla Almond Agave Granola, 12-Ounce (Pack of 3) instead.

None of the BEAR NAKED GRANOLA products are organic nor do they contain any organic ingredients.  Further they DO contain genetically modified ingredients (GMOS).  These very misleading statements/descriptions by Amazon.com need to be removed immediately.  For those of us for whom eating organic food is very important because we do not want GMOs in our food, this is deceiving and potentially dangerous.  Please update the necessary listings at once and remove the erroneous information.  Thank you.

This product is drastically overpriced and since it contains "Natural Flavors" (cerainly imported from China and probably MSG!) is NOT fit for human consumption. Since it's impossible to rate at zero, I've been forced to give it one star.

The above reviewer was disappointed because it's marketed with a runner on the front like it's a workout product. This is a mistake.  I find this stuff to be an absolutely AMAZING product to study, read or write with. Mental concentration goes WAY up. No more eyes bouncing off the page from fatigue. I have a slight attention deficit at times, and this stuff CURES it. I LOVE that. It only helps physical performance as much as your concentration is wandering. They should market it to students, but I suppose that would limit the amount of people who try it. I would think this is great for late night driving. No caffeine jitters, either.

This is a great product when it's time for midterms and finals. I use this energy drink to stay awake and concentrated while studying for an exam. It gives you the energy you need to stay awake all night and beyond. I am not sure that I would take it as a workout drink because the energy it gives you is more mental than physical. You don't feel a crash after either like I often do with Red Bull. Also, I researched the ingredients and found out that non of them go over the maximum daily intake recommended, so this drink shouldn't be of any health risk for normal, healthy people. Again this is for sure something I will continue to use and would recommend to anyone that needs a little bust while studying.

I've tried Red Bull, Monster, etc. but found this product suits me much better.  I'm a working mother of two, in my late 30's and the best description I have for 5-hour is that it makes me feel 10 years younger.  I don't feel like superwoman. I'm not hyped up. I just find that my concentration level and energy level stay at a consistently productive level so that I can continue getting things done all day. I like to drink 1/2 a bottle around 10 a.m.  No after-lunch drowsiness.  No crashing as soon as my children have gone to bed in the evening.  I just feel like I did in my 20's - like I have enough energy to do the things I need to and have a little fun too. I eat well, I exercise, I get enough sleep - but I can feel a difference in my body from 10 years ago.  I'm not over-the-hill, but I can feel myself slowing as I approach the peak.  I've done some minor research and talked to my spouse who is a nurse to find out what kind of health risks there may be in taking this regularly.  So far, none.  Everything in moderation, right?

column9: not what it says it is
column10: I purchased this thinking I was getting a good deal...description says 1-12 pack of regular, and 1-12 pack of extra strength, got the package today and there were only 12 bottles total, so only 6 of each kind...making the price I paid more than what I could have picked up them individually at a convenience store...Guess I'll go back and order the 12-packs separately...

I tried this for the first time today and thought it was great. I hit the gym early and then had a million errands to run and on top of that had to coach soccer practice tonight. Normally I'm drained after my workout session. So, I drank a 5 hour energy and was able to get through my day with no tiredness. I got everything done with spunk and energy and never felt gittery. It was just enough energy to get you through a hectic day and no crash!

As the reviewer above stated this is not for two 12 packs.  Rather this is for one 12 pack with 6 of each variety.  What a rip off.  Amazon, this is a major deal breaker.  If I could find a 1800 number I would have called and went beserker, but there is not one.This would have been a -1 if possible.

column9: Pretty good, Not a fan of Red Bull so this is a pleasant surprise in comparison
column10: I've used this product for the past 4 months, and am pretty pleased with it. This product is suppose to have Vitamin B's, caffeine, etc (noticed they have some enzymes as well...) which, although not wholly perfect in energizing you to the extreme you are probably looking for, does seem to be helping me a little with concentration, mood, and keeping me awake for studying, without the jittery nervousness and fatigue that comes with excessive coffee drinking. I can't speak for its usefulness in exercise, but everyone's body works differently to some degree, so if you don't know if it works for you (exercise or study-wise), it's probably best to try one or two out before buying a box of 12.

Terrible product. does not work. Myself and a few friends of mine have all reported falling asleep within half an hour of drinking these. We take the drink in one shot as to maximize effect. I myself have had these on 2 separate occasions and have had the same experience. Also, I work at walgreens, where we sell these, and after 1 year of carrying the product I have not met a single person who has bought these more than once. I have heard that if you mix the shot with mountain dew or pepsi, it can help... but then again its probably just the mountain dew.

5 Hour Energy, Liquid Energy Berry, 2-Ounce (12 Pack)I found myself getting really drowsy in the afternoons when I would like to relax and read.  Too many times, I fell asleep after getting through only a page or two.  This product originally came as a free test in the mail.  I tried it, and was amazed at how quickly I felt energetic and awake.  It contains about as much caffeine as a premium cup of coffee, plus a mix of b-vitamins.  Coffee's been getting good health reports recently, and the b-vitamins are essential, so there's no need to feel guilty about drinking these little bottles.  Also, they're sugar free and have only 4 calories.  How nice to come across a product so helpful but not harmful!
The taste isn't great but this stuff really works and doesn't fill you up or make you feel bloated.
Excellent product delivered in a very timely manner.  Am very pleased with this transaction.
I ordered this product hoping it would give good results.  The first 3 times I used this product I did feel energized without jitters. After that, it was like my body got use to it. I felt nothing.

Before buying this product, I read some of the other reviews and felt pretty assured that this product would give me the energy boost that I wanted. I bought the 12 pack to have a decent amount to try.I am a relatively well built six foot 215 lb guy and decided to drink one bottle before working out. I felt absolutely none of the energizing effects promised by the manufacturer. I tried this a couple of times, and each time I expreienced the same result. I then decided to drink 2 bottles to see whether the dosage might be to blame. After drinking two bottles I noticed that my heart beat increased and that I had difficulty in trying to catch my breath, but again none of the energy benefits promised.I still have a few more bottles which I will probably finish, but I do not think the results will be any better. I guess you need to try it for yourself in order to see whether this formula complements your bodies chemistry. It certainly didn't complement mine.
I did not receive product as of 11/02/07.  I have asked my credit card company to not pay.

I was looking around Amazon and I noticed that you can get these as 2 oz. single bottles for 2.50 a piece here at Amazon. At this price, it works out to 2.90 a piece.  A word to the wise, shop around before paying higher prices and do your math! I rated 3 stars as I haven't tried the product yet.

Tastes like what you want and shipped in glass. Most other black molasses is sold in plastic today, which we wanted to avoid entirely. Simply enough, this is a fine blackstrap, so give it a try. I think we found that this was a little more natural than some of the other brands we looked into, but don't recall now. Just a note that one of our bottles smashed while shipping and made a huge mess with glass and molasses all through the package at the time of delivery. The seller made it right immediately, so I recommend the product and the vendor (Baker's Box).

column9: If you like molasses, this is it.
column10: This is pretty good molasses, and for blackstrap molasses lovers, I'd say it must be about perfect.  I take two tablespoons a day for the iron and calcium because the label says that a single tablespoon contains 20% of our daily requirement of each.  It's my understanding that Plantation blackstrap molasses is prepared in iron kettles, thus providing the high level of iron -- which not every brand will have.

A good breakfast bread which isn't too sweet.  I sometimes have problems with the bread rising well because of the humid climate where I reside, but this made a good size loaf.  It had lots of almonds with the mix which was very good.
This is really easy to fix and is DELICIOUS! I highly recommend this to all who have Bread machines.It was a hit with all the family.

This made the most wonderful bread in my machine!! YUM! Company offers unique bread mixes. Great service - received quickly and in excellent condition. Will buy from again. In fact, just placed another order!

I served this bread and my guests raved about it.  The crust is nice and crunchy, and it is soft and moist on the inside.  Very nice taste and consistancy for a bread machine type of bread.  Good with meal or as toast, with butter or jam.  Highly recommended.

The Swedish Vanilla Almond Bread Machine Mix is the most wonderful tasting bread.  The almond is a crunch that goes with the vanilla flavorings.  I always take it out 5-6 min early.  Then it is so soft and delicious.

I like this soup.  One of the problems with low fat or healthy is it frequently means an inferior or different taste to the regular, not so healthy stuff.  This soup doesn't suffer that particular problem.  If you like classic to eat, this is a nice substitute.

I am a huge fan of the betty crocker fudge brownies which always turn out incredible, but these were a disaster.  I cooked them in an 8x8 glass pan just like it said, and they were still completely uncooked in the middle after 50 minutes.  I continued to cook them another 20+ with no luck.  I was able to salvage the ones around the outside but the middle brownie portion was completely raw to the point where when I stirred it up with fork, it became the normal liquid consistency of uncooked brownies, even though the cookie part seemed baked.  I ended up throwing the entire middle away.  What a waste.  Stick to normal brownies, these are a joke.

My mother's friend used to make cookie bars and give it to us as a small friendly gesture when I was little so when I was at the grocery store I splurged on some chubs food during finals week and me and my roommate shared it while studying for finals. Delicious and lasts for about five days while still keeping its flavor and not getting too 'gummy.' After a few days the chocolate does start to taste a bit cheap, and you become aware that its just some cheap brownie mix, but for most people (families?) it shouldn't even last that long! Try Zingerman's if you like gourmet!

column9: Quick & Easy Chocolate Chip Cookie Brownie Bars
column10: What do you get when you combine chocolate chip cookies with brownies?  Chocolate Chip Cookie Brownie Bars - the best of both worlds!  I love to bake from scratch but also appreciate the convenience of packaged mixes, especially for busy home bakers, and am having fun experimenting with them.I tried this quick and easy mix from Betty Crocker for the first time yesterday and will definitely be making it again.  These cookie brownie bars have the look of fancy from scratch cookie bars and good flavor and texture.  Easy to mix up, they were done to perfection in the stated time specified on the box.  They were a big hit when I served them for dessert with vanilla ice cream last night.

column9: On a quest for the perfect light-roast
column10: I am currently going through the selection of light-roast coffee beans Amazon has to offer on a quest for the perfect light-roast coffee.  I drink a cup of coffee every morning.  In general, my bags of coffee beans last quite a while so like some tea connoisseurs, I don't mind spending a little more on the good stuff.This coffee is great.  When you see the beans in the bag, it's obvious this is a light roast unlike others that claim to be.It's a very good blend of beans that won't leave that bitter left-over taste on the sides of your tongue like darker roasts or many that claim to be light roast coffees that really aren't.  Even if you make it strong, the color is very reddish.  Extremely smooth taste.Recently, I served this at a family party and even with the pies and cakes for desert, people were asking about the coffee and talking about how good it was.Obviously, this is one of the better light roasts out there.--- Edit Jul 12, 2012 ---This is the best light roast out there.  After trying many different brands, I've found most companies do not know how to do a light roast.  Starbuck's Blonde is laughable and equivalent to most French roasts.  Other light roasts from other lesser-known and better-known brands I've tried so far all introduce strange unsavory flavors/bitterness or have no right to call their coffee 'light roast' because the beans are just plain barbecued.At this point, since I prefer light roasts, Jeremiah's Pick Coffee Kona Blend is the best coffee I've ever had.  I might still try others, but I'll keep coming back to this as a point of comparison.
One of the best from Jeremiah's Pick. Surprising depth of flavor for a light roasted coffee. Their customer service is top notch, too.

I've been eating this brand of granola since it first appeared at my Whole Foods. I particulary love the Vanilla Almond Crunch "Cereal" which I use like granola over my fruit and yogurt. I love that it is sweetened naturally and is low in fat. If you want a traditional granola, I also really like the Peak Protein. It is great for snacking right out of the bag and since I don't eat meat, the extra protein is needed. It kind of tastes a little like an oatmeal cookie to me. I've tried all their flavors and these are the only two I like, although I will say my husband is partial to the fruit and nut. There is a flavor for everyone!

I never dreamed I would purchase cereal on line! However I had been purchasing this brand at a local market until it became so expensive the store dropped the line. Since I had been eating it mixed with yogurt almost daily for the past 6 months, I wanted to find a new source to continue purchasing it. I was thrilled to find it on Amazon. We were also VERY pleased that the cereal from this supplier seems to be fresher than the store where I use to purchase it. The shipping time was excellent and cost reasonable. The cereal is flavorful, low calorie for my diet, and full of nutrition.  I also enjoy it as a healthy snack. I have tried most of the other flavors in this line and find this one to be the best.

column9: Delicious and good for you too!
column10: This Granola tastes delicious & has less then 3 grams of fat and sugar per 1/4 cup serving.  The ingrediants are healthy too (no bad oils, preservatives, trans fat or corn syrup)!  This is one of the best snacks I've found. Bear Naked Fit Granola found a way to make a  healthy good-for-you food without sacrificing taste!

column9: Delicious granola, low in calories and sugar!
column10: Another Bear Naked granola deserving of 5 stars. The granola is fairly low in calories, low in sugar and yet very flavorful. Will keep buying this!

column9: The Best-Amazon's subscription makes it cheaper!
column10: I wondered about 6 bags of this FANTASTIC granola at once, but the packages are small (12 ounces) and I figure I use one per month so went the 6 month subscription route which means Amazon will ship it to me once every 6 months. This dropped price per package to $2.97 from $3.50 (I usually pay $3.99 at Kroger).Great cereal, nutritious and a yogurt must!

Compared to the other low fat / low calorie granola I have been eating this stuff is great!  I was shocked at how tasty it was and it was more than $10 cheaper on Amazon than at my local grocery store.  However, when considering the fat and calorie information, note that the serving size is 1/4 cup and many other granola packages are based on 1/2 cup servings.
I could not find this at any stores, so I tried Amazon. I receive it every six months. It is kinda of on the expensive side, but its good.

There are so many products have too much sugar (for me), but this is close to perfect on sugar level.  Also, I like the crunchiness of oats and almonds that gives you feel of "eating".  I usually mix it in yogurt which makes good breakfast for me.

column9: Good product; recent problems with packaging
column10: I have been ordering this as a "subscribe and save" for months now, and have been happy with the product and the quality that I receive.  However, the last order I received--which arrived in a sealed box--contained two punctured bags in the box. Though I imagine they are probably fine, they could have been tampered with or they could have been infested with bugs. Unfortunately, I'm not sure what can be done about the problem, so I'm writing this review.  It may make me reluctant to continue placing orders through Amazon.
This is my favorite healthy granola. Great flavor and low fat.  It is nice to get six bags at once at a lower price per bag than at the grocery store.
This granola is great: I have it every day with yogurt and fruit and it keeps be going for hours.

My husband and I have been eating this almost every day for the past year or so.  Found it at our local grocery store first, and now it's great to be able to order it on Amazon.  We mix it with plain yogurt, and maybe some honey for a tasty breakfast.  Some of the other flavors are good also, but the Vanilla is by far the tastiest.
I mix this stuff in my oatmeal.  Tastes great.  Amazon does a good job delivering and it is a good deal compared to buying it in the local grocery store.
This product is awesome - great by itself, sprinkled on cereal or yogurt.  It has been a terrific way to watch my calories and still feel full and satisfied.
My favorite is the Vanilla Almond Crunch.  Delicious and healthy.  Add plain yogurt and berries on top for a nice snack or dessert.

This is great stuff. Chunky and crunchy. I mix it in on my yogurt with bananas and apples. I also enjoy it on my milk and drink it on the go. Some people tell me that is gross. I don't know why. I just chug it and don't use a spoon. On the go, hello!

This is great mixed with plain yogurt, Fat-Free ricotta (use Calabro brand only, the rest are terrible!), or just plain out of the bag for a snack.  Bear Naked really delivers on taste and quality.  Plenty of almonds inside too, a wonderful product!

None of the BEAR NAKED GRANOLA products are organic nor do they contain any organic ingredients.  Further they DO contain genetically modified ingredients (GMOS).  These very misleading statements/descriptions by Amazon.com need to be removed immediately.  For those of us for whom eating organic food is very important because we do not want GMOs in our food, this is deceiving and potentially dangerous.  Please update the necessary listings at once and remove the erroneous information.  Thank you.

Seriously - what is so special about this granola?  I purchased it in the grocery store for $5, which is WAY too expensive for this tiny little package of NON-organic, bland granola.  I suppose if you subscribed and saved (and bought in bulk) if might be worth it - if you even liked the taste and texture.  Nature's Path organic granolas win the prize for best granolas in my book.  This one is bland and unexciting...

column9: Bear Naked Vanilla Almond Crunch Fit
column10: This product adds a nice crunch to my frozen yogurt that I eat and it tastes very good.  The only downside to me is that there are not many almonds in it for the price.  I was getting it on subscribe and save because I loved it so much, but it seems as if the company started to add less almonds so I no longer get it.

Barley malt?  These guys are friends from grade school when they were spitballing each other, not reading ingredients lists, of gluten-free products because they've added barley malt...the reason you can't buy off the shelf of a regular grocery store...just about every cereal it seems has barley malt.I don't get it...can we google on this and see if it's gluten-free? I did and the answer was NO!pick the spitballs outten your ears and try again fellers...

The crunchy product has a subtle vanilla flavor.  The oats are rather bland and pasty.  Almonds are sparse.  Low in sugar and salt, but fairly high in calories.  Good snack for someone looking to limit sugar and salt.

If there's a Whole Foods store near your home or work, they sell this product for 30-50 cents less, per package and you won't have to wait for delivery.  And, if you are sugar-sensitive, don't buy this flavor...it's a little too sweet.
This tastes like someone left the cereal box open...for tooo long.  It's on the stale side, though it smells great.Too bad I purchased 6 bags.  I DO enjoy the Banana Granola though, its excellent.

column9: Horrible - wouldn't feed it to a horse
column10: This cereal is hard, tasteless, and very difficult to chew.  Has a strange off-smell to it too.  I would not recommend this to anyone.  In fact I am going to write the company a letter since I am angry that I now have five and a half bags of crappy "cereal" lying around.
perfect and lucious added to chicken makes it taste like pheasant, easily.  would buy again any time.  very affordable came in easy to open container

column9: Great taste but watch the sodium
column10: As others have said, Flavacol is the missing ingredient that makes your popcorn taste like it does in the theater. I don't even use butter anymore. I make about three 8oz servings of popcorn for our outdoor movie night and I use only 3 teaspoons of the stuff. I'm not sure I'll make it through the box in a year.Be aware, that the 1 teaspoon serving size carries over 1100mg of sodium. You probably aren't going to eat the whole 8oz yourself, but it was a bit of an eye-opener when I found out.Make sure you add this to the oil in the pot or popcorn kettle you are cooking the popcorn in. This is not to be sprinkled over the top of your air-popped popcorn. I would recommend cooking in coconut oil for the best flavor.
Like many people, I love movie theater popcorn. I recently discovered Flavacol Popcorn Salt -- use sparingly, but enjoy the taste!!

This is a product I won't hesitate to endorse. It has everything I am looking for in a low glycemic index energy bar. It's packed with vitamins and nutrients, is low in calories and tastes great. I give them to my son who has special needs and they help to keep his appetite in check. He loves the peanut butter and chocolate bars. I tend to have dips in my blood sugar between meals and these bars are great as a "hold over" snack until I can eat a meal. The only problem I have is I wish they were sold in more stores.Lois Scian, RN, MA, CHES

These bars have a low GI index of under 30 so they are great for diabetics. I cannot believe it but I can get them cheaper on Amazon than at the store. (Cheaper and no shipping charge!) The longer I use them the better they taste. Maybe its because I've forgotten what real candy bars taste like, but I really enjoy these bars.
Wonderful item.  Great taste, not dull or dry like other bars.  Highly recommended.
This is a great way to curb your hunger during the day when all you're surrounded by is vending machines and fast food.  Tastes great too!

As a newly diagnosed diabetic I have become more concious of what energy bars I eat - these are by far the best I have found!  Hubby loves them too - flavors and textures are great and the balance of protien fat and carbs makes for good energy without a glucose spike.

I like the berry and lemon flavors of these better, the PB was soooo very sweet that I could only eat half with a cup of coffee.  This flavor is like a treat, not a meal replacement.  The Lemon Lift is best

Solo Energy Bar helped control blood sugars throughout the morning when used as a breakfast meal.Have tried both the chocolate and peanut butter. Will try both again. I like the convenience when on the go.

column9: Filler food is empty, leaves your cat always needing more
column10: This review will make me sound really stupid, but whatever. I don't really care as long as people find out what's real and can avoid my mistakes.I got my wonderful little sweet Bella Bean when she was a few days shy of three years old. She had been bounced around from house to house and eating whatever was cheap. I have had cats around me my entire life, for about twenty-five years now. My mother always just fed them whatever, the kinds of food you buy in the supermarket - Friskies, Nine Lives, Kit & Kaboodle, stuff like that. And our cats were always fine, at least in terms of their eating habits. They would eat in the morning, stop when they were done, come back, and eat some more when they got hungry.My housemate at the time was working for Hill's and assured me that this was the best food ever made, so great, so on and so forth. I now know that she is an utter buffoon, but I initially trusted her judgment, which is so unfortunate because she doesn't think. She also had plenty of coupons for free or deeply discounted bags, which made it a much more attractive choice.I first tried feeding the little Bean an unmeasured amount of Science Diet in a bowl, but that didn't work, as she would devour it in one sitting. So then I took to measuring it, and she did the same thing. Then I started parsing it out to twice a day. That didn't work either, because she would start going crazy in the middle of the day, running around, intentionally destroying things, deliberately spilling her water, crying, etc., until she got more food. So then I split it into three servings. Same thing. Then it got to be four servings. That was a little better, but it was too much maintenance and unrealistic to be around every day to feed her four times. So then it went back to three. All the while, I was trying to reduce the amount of food I was feeding her to less than 3/4 of a cup because she was a little chubby. Reducing was hell. She became even more hungry, but I figured she would get used to it. Not really.For over a year, she would wake me up every morning looking for food in a serious way, knocking things off my desk, ripping up any paper she could find, scratching at the door and committing general acts of mischief. As soon as she got food, she was back to her sweet self, but only for three or four hours.We thought she was bored, we thought she was a little nutty, and maybe even had a kitty eating disorder. She always wanted food. It was kind of funny but in the end it was just sad.A few weeks back, we took her to a new (good, non-money factory) vet for her second checkup since I've had her. I talked with him about her being always hungry. He asked what she ate, and I told him the adult indoor Science Diet. Without saying as much, he basically told me that this food is garbage and I should look for something else. He said cat food should have a protein followed by a carbohydrate as the first two ingredients. Science Diet does, in a very loose, by-product kind of way - ground up slaughterhouse leftovers and corn dust. Then they put a bunch of vitamins in it to make it "healthy," instead of just using good ingredients from the beginning. Not that I care about spending money on the Bean, but this food is way too expensive for what it is.So we began transitioning her onto Wellness indoor formula about two weeks ago. She is still eating 50 percent Science Diet with 50 percent Wellness (you really shouldn't just give a cat different food one day out of the blue) but SHE NEVER FREAKS OUT ANYMORE. It's amazing. And it's 100 percent because she is eating real food now, along with that sawdust and chicken hearts I still regrettable have to feed her. We have her down to eating twice a day, only 1/3 cup in TOTAL. She was eating three times a day, 5/8 of a cup in total. Now she eats some in the morning, walks away, eats some more a few hours later, and then looks for dinner about twelve hours after her initial feeding. No more knocking things over, no more trashing Dad's papers on the desk, no more howling, no more deliberately spilled water on the floor. It's incredible.I feel so bad that I was doing this to her for so long. We really thought she was just being dramatic or whatever. But no, she was genuinely hungry because she wasn't eating any real food.Do your cat a favor - buy her or him so food made with real ingredients, things you would eat - Wellness, Halo, Innova, Evo, whatever. Figure it out for yourself, but please don't feed your cat this. It's garbage.

Can someone please reassure me this stuff is safe to drink?I know it is not approved for use in cat food so what something that is used in industrial antifreeze safe for humans?  PROPYLENE GLYCOLPropylene Glycol, AlcoholA colourless, volatile, flammable liquid produced by fermentation of yeast and carbohydrates. Alcohol is frequently used as a solvent. As an ingredient in ingestible products, alcohol may cause body tissues to be more vulnerable to carcinogens.Mouthwashes with an alcohol content over 25% have been implicated in mouth, tongue and throat cancers. Note, the forms of alcohol used in cosmetics are not necessarily those used in alcoholic drinks, and may be much more dangerous.Some examplesEthylene glycol, is commonly used in acrylic paints, brake fluid, antifreeze, tile grout, primer, sealant paste, floor polish, tyre sealant and shoe polish. Oh yes.......and it's also used in some "smoothing lotions" and "firming moisturizer"!Known health effects: throat irritation, headache, backache, kidney problems, oedema (swelling), necrosis (cell death). If swallowed, can cause drowsiness, and slurred speech, possibly stupor, vomiting, respiratory failure, coma, convulsions, and deathPropylene GlycolA cosmetic form of mineral oil found in automatic brake and hydraulic fluid and industrial antifreeze. In the skin and hair, propylene glycol works as a humescent, which causes retention of moisture content of skin or cosmetic products by preventing the escape of moisture or water. The Material Safety Data Sheet warns users to avoid skin contact with propylene glycol as this strong skin irritant can cause liver abnormalities and kidney damage.

column9: Try it cold for a very different, refreshing summer dish
column10: Pop a can overnight in the fridge. The next day open and pour into a bowl. The gelatin hardens it to the consistency of a very soft Jello. BTW, eating it involves a certain amount of slurping, since it slides around on the spoon.

I would of gave a 5 if the quantities were even.16- 2.1oz Frosted Flakes10-2.8oz Raisin Bran Crunch10- 1.5oz Apple Jacks10-1.5oz Corn Pops8-2.3oz Cocoa Krispies and6-1.5 oz Froot Loops

In fact the one with the highest calorie count (280) is the Rasin Bran, and that's something that would actually be considered "healthy". All the rest fall into the 160-220 range.

EDIT: I edited my original review today because the contents in the assortment have changed. I just got a new box and inside there were:13 - Frosted Flakes10 - Apple Jacks9 - Cocoa Krispies8 - Froot Loops8 - Raisin Bran Crunch6 - Corn Pops6 - Frosted Mini WheatsI don't know why they don't make the distribution of each type more equal (8 or 9), but they don't. I imagine some must be cheaper to make or something. Still, at least the ones with the most (Frosted Flakes and Apple Jacks) aren't my family's least liked ones and it is a little more evenly distributed than it used to be. We used to always have leftover Raisin Bran Crunch and with each new shipment, the backlog of those got bigger and bigger. At least the upped the Cocoa Krispies allotment!Warning: boring review follows! ha ha: I was interested in buying these individual servings of cereal for my family and wondered if the cups, bowls or little boxes were cheapest per ounce.  The cups hold more than the bowls and boxes(usually about twice as much based on cereal type). I mean we would have eaten 2 bowls if it was really cheaper that way.I went to the kelloggs site to compare how much cereal was in the cups versus how much in the individual bowls or the little boxes.  The bowls, cups and boxes all seem to end up costing fractions of pennies of one another ounce per ounce.  I didn't add up all the kinds per variey pack and see which grand total costed pennies more or less based on ounce (I am not THAT frugal), but picked corn pops and frosted flakes to compare.  The prices for all the kinds are very comparable, so if your wondering which type to buy, it doesn't really add up to much difference. I do check these things because sometimes the big "value" sizes are actually more expensive per ounce/gram than the little sizes. I ordered a case of these during the winter when my whole family was stranded inside by bad weather and the flu and again in the summer for a family vacation.  Great value.  Not ultimate nutrition, but kids love it.

Easy, convenient and tasty snack or breakfast.  Particularly good for college students.

These were wonderrful! I have to get up real early and when I get my breakfast all I have to do is grab one pour the milk in and eat. No mesy bowls to worry about. At 5 AM in the morning that is great!

As long as Kellogg's uses GMOs this product is just too dangerous to consume. The corn used has been proven to disrupt major organs of the body. Other studies show a corrolation with impotency and decreased sex drive. No study has determined long term health hazards.

I just got my box today, no problems.  Every cup was fine, not one crushed or busted open.My box assortment came as follows, as well as printed on the carton they were all in:16 Frosted Flakes6 Fruit Loops10 Raisin Bran10 Apple Jacks10 Corn Pops8 Cocoa Rice KrispiesThese cups are just enough cereal for a quick snack, or fast breakfast.  You pour the milk right into them.  Great for taking to the office, as long as you have a spoon to eat them with and some milk.  Very convenient.  I switch up the different cereals daily, and not have to worry about them going stale since each one is sealed individually.  Get this if you want the convenience of taking cereal on the go as well as a snack anytime of the day.  Fresh cup everyday!
Out of 60 cups of cereal in one box with no insulation( there was no popcorn or plastic air bags) one cup exploding was not that bad of a deal especially for the price - great delivery time!

lets see here;Frosted Flakes: Frosted flakes are great, that frosting on the flakes never really leaves when you add milk, but i don't find myself getting them that often, but when I see them in the drawer, I'm happy.Corn pops: Corn pops are not the type of cereal you'd buy. If there was nothing else to eat at your home, and then you saw some pops on the shelves, you'd be happy, but they have a weird taste....and come in a different bag compared to the others, so they're never on my shelves.Froot loops: froot loops are good, but after one bowl of 'em, you'd wish you had eaten some other cereal. Unless its that time when they have marshmallows in them, they're nothing special, just colorful.Raisin Bran: Why are these in the pack? I'm reviewing kids' cereals in detail! you think I've ever eaten raisin bran? whatever, they are just corn flakes with raisins.Cocoa krispies: Very good. In the beginning all those moist chocolate bits are good, but after you eat 30% of the bowl, the pieces become soggy and you don't get a satisfying crunch or taste, even if you are lucky enough to get a spoonful.Apple Jacks: These are pretty good, they smell good, and some of them are green! although i must say, the new advertising campaign is lame. The old "they don't taste like apples" commercials were great because it made you wonder why they were called apple jacks, and made you buy 'em. the new "cinnamon is the winna, mon" campaign is lame, why are you all of a sudden advertising its cinnamon taste, these aren't cinnamon toast crunches, they're apple jacks! ever since the new commercials, I've gotten this cereal less.So, 3 winners, 1 ok one, 1 not-so-good one, and one black sheep that I can't comment on, enjoy and don't forget the milk!

Kellogg's cereals contain genetically modified organisms, those are crops that have their DNA spliced with toxins or bacteria. Kellogg's has paid over 600,000 dollars to fight against our right to know that there are GMO's in our food! I would not buy their cereal.

I bought this cereal assortment instead of the "Wellness Assortment" to try something different. The "Wellness Assortment" is alot better, however totally different cereals.There are very few "Fruit Loops" but plenty of "Frosted Flakes" in this assortment. None of the cereals have any protein or fiber, ok maybe 1 gram. I was hungry an hour later after eating this stuff. Although, Pops, Fruit Loops, and Apple Jacks taste awesome. They're a great replacement to greasy potato chips or fatty ice cream.The "Wellness Assortment" has alot more protein and fiber, and also tastes great. On the other hand it has a lot of Special K cereal, some have "red berries" (stawberries) though.Leave this sugar cereal to the kids (or keep as a snack) and get the "Wellness Assortment" for yourself.
