I love cornbread and of all the mixes and recipes I have tried, Buckeye Cornbread is by far the lightest and best tasting cornbread I have had!

We also discovered this product at Williams Sonoma.  Hard to find but worth the effort.  We have tried Marie Calendar's, Flako and a variety of others and the Buckeye is in my opinion the very best.  Moist, nice rise to the bread, nice grind on the corn meal make for excellent tasting corn bread.

I found this product originally at Williams Sonoma and realized my quest for the perfect cornbread was finally over.  I'm a baker and have never found a recipe or a mix that makes the truly delicious cornbread I dreamed of.  Not dry and nominally tasty like Jiffy.  Not overly sweet and fake corn tasting like Marie Callendars. Clean,clear corn taste, perfect crunch on the edge and so flavorful!  And dead easy to make. The directions are clear and simple.  Like any quick bread or pancake, don't overmix.  A few small lumps are fine.  I bake it in an 8" cast iron fry pan.  No problem in buying the case, friends and family are always begging to take a box home.

column9: Light, slightly sweet with a nice exterior crunch!
column10: Originally found this product at Williams-Sonoma Outlet on our way to Vegas.  My husband fell in love with it. Needed to locate the product closer to home and was thrilled to find it available on Amazon. Try it, you'll love it!
This is the best cornbread I have ever had - Fabulous and moist.Highly recommend this!!

The cornbread was easy to make and so easy to eat. The texture was moist but not crumbly and the taste was incredible.  Reheating, in a toaster oven a day or two after baking, did not change its original yummy taste.
Does make average cake mix. Just top with ice cream. Mixing instructions are exact and simple except forget the veggie oil. Grease the pan lightly (I used coconut oil).

Close to home made pudding you will ever get.  Pies or pudding your guests will love this dessert.  When the pudding is cool just foldin lite cool whip add to a pie shell or individual dishes, you can also add more cool whip on top to make more special for guests.Rsfrigerate until ready to serve.
This was a Christmas present to myself.  I love Rose's Lime marmelade.  It is absolutely the best lime marmelade you can buy.

column9: Wonderful flavor treat, glad to find it available here.
column10: My sister is a Canadian, where it seems there is an English population who crave their lime marmelade. I have had her bring this to me on her too-infrequent visits to Michigan from Ontario, but she pays about the same price per jar, and the seller included free shipping. It was packed with sturdy shrink-wrap in its original 6-pack case, bubble wrapped to make breakage impossible, then put into a sturdy second box. The quality and flavor of Rose's preserves is unrivaled, and with a bit of rationing and self-control, this 6-pack should last me many months. I don't understand why a product this wonderful is so hard to find at typical retail outlets, including imported gourmet shops, or why an American supplier does not offer a similar product. Key Lime originate in the Florida Keys, though they can be grown in any suitable climate zone. If you like plain ol' Orange Marmelade, you really need to experience this treat!

This is the best hot sauce I've ever tasted...unless you count the other flavors/varieties available from Boulder Hot Sauce. There is a habanero version that is amazing. Hot but flavorful and you can eat it without dying! This price is little higher than I've paid for it off the shelf BUT it isn't available everywhere. So if you can get it sent to your home, I say go for it!
Pomigranite bars taste great but i orderedA case but did not realize that meant 6 bars?  Paid way to much

with all the variety of fruit bars out there, it's hard to know which ones to buy.  i have to say, of all the fruit bars i've gotten, archer farms brand seems to be the best.  i really enjoy the taste and flavor of the bar, as it actually tastes like it suppose to.  there is a freshness to the taste that is quite excellent.  ingredients look good: apples, fruit juice, oat fiber, and red cabbage for color.  no red dye #40!  110 calories and 27g of carbs.  i highly recommend this fruit bar for your next snack.

These are fantastic.  we are still able to purchase these locally, but I will continue to buy them from here if that changes.  My son has been eating these since he turned 2.  It's a great way to get one of the "superfoods" into his diet w/o worrying about him eating seeds or pulp.  He loves them and will often ask for these over candy, so I love them too.

My Target does not carry these any more.  They are the only reason I ever set foot in that store.  There is nothing like them. Tart but not too tart, great chewy texture and good for you.  The bars with added fiber that seem to have replaced these are gritty and the fruit strips are for kids. At least they are available here, but who knows for how long.

I love the healthful ingredients, the quality and the fun of enjoying these awesome little lollipops.  I think that you get 10 for the one low price! I'm all out now, but I'm going to order a bunch after writing this review.  Much appreciated!

This product by Archer Farms is the best drink mix ever. Just mix a flavored packet with your 16 oz. water bottle. Contains the all natural sweetner Stevia, real fruit flavoring and no food coloring. Just colored with fruit or vegetable colors. Pure and natural and tastes great. There are eight packets in a box and only contains 10 calories per packet. Thank you Archer Farms!

I love Country Time Pink Lemonade, but I do not love a Seller that never follows through on the order.  This item was totally missing from my order.  It was listed as shipped and it was not in the box, with no word from this seller.  Very disappointing.

Use this when serving up our garden greens. Complimented with Bragg Vinegar. We don't use it for general cooking due to the flavor gets cooked off. We use lesser grades of olive oil for that purpose. You can count on Bragg Products. Might seem expensive, but the quality matches the price. Recommend it Highly.

column9: Not what it says it is!
column10: I purchased this based on the name, Bragg.  I have always trusted this company and what they stood for.  However lately I have put my store bought olive oil to the refrigerator test and it failed to solidify.  So I bought the Bragg brand and much to my dismay it does not pass the test!  It does not harden or thicken at all in the refrigerator!  I contacted the company via e-mail on their web-site and conveyed my concerns but they did not respond at all.  I am sorely disappointed and will not buy again.

We love this oil. It has a really good taste and we use it more than any of the other oil that we have. The bottle is a bit large, so we pour some out of this bottle into a smaller glass bottle. We have already purchsed more as we used up our first gallon.
I found a recipe that called for two kinds of coconut, so bought this hard-to-find kind from Bob's Red Mill.  It worked perfectly.  It arrived quickly and was nice and fresh.  Love it.

column9: Makes the best macaroons we have ever eaten!
column10: I am not a fan of coconut macaroons but I make them for my family. I purchased this to make cookies for my DH and DD and they raved about them so I tried one, they were "heavenly". We ate a double batch in one day. I used 1/2 cup Bob's red Mill almond meal and the gel vanilla I purchased here too. I used turbinado sugar for sweetener, and cut down on the sweetener called for, even though the coconut is unsweetened, they tasted so creamy and flavorful, my family never knew the difference. The recipe doubled, used I package of the coconut, which was worth it to have the yummy cookies.

column9: Chipped my tooth of fun dip
column10: I love fun dip, it was one of my favorite candies as a kid. But this time, I chipped my tooth while eating one of the dip sticks. Just be sure you have licked it alot before you bite down on it. I still love fun dip, but my teeth arent what they used to be as a kid. Just be careful!

What can I say? It's roast beef hash. I've loved hash (corned & roast beef) since I was a kid. Comes 6 in a pack. I'm down to 1 can. Always filling, great with a scrambled egg mixed in while frying. 1 can was dented, but no biggie. Cause I'm still alive to write this review.  Long live Mary Kitchen Roast Beef Hash!

it doesn't have sodium nitrate as the corned beef hash same brand does.  I like the flavor better.  I have been waiting for this to come in subscription!!  I love the flavor especially with eggs scrambled into it.
FOR A CANNED PRODUCT I FIND THIS TO BE SATISFACTORY.  A NICE QUICK MEAT & POTATO DISH FOR MY ELDERLY MOM.  EASY TO INCLUDE YOUR OWN ACCENTS TOO...ONIONS, GREEN PEPPER, CORN.
I've been buying this in the grocery stores from time to time, and it is very good, it's milder and a lot less fat than corned beef.Now I can order it from Amazon and it will be delivered to my door.

Hormel is the most widely sold brand on the market and rightly so. I like the corned beef hash better but that's just my personal preference and if you like the roast beef version it's as good as you're gonna get.

column9: Not like Mom used to make, but OK occasionally
column10: I understand what reviewer Natasha was saying; this isn't a prime quality roast beef hash, but it is the most available hash on the market, delivers a large amount of protein, calories (not a great diet food), and is a classic stick-to-your-ribs canned food.For the above reasons, it is a good idea to stock some this at home. It is, as she mentioned, more greasy, salty than you might like, but it microwaves well (use a splatter cover). Or fry it in a covered pan to serve with eggs, soups, veggies etc.I think this does what it should do: it suggests what real homemade roast beef hash should taste like. But it isn't the same. If you want that, you'll have to roast some beef, grind it up, add some boiled potatoes chopped fine along with some onion chopped and a little gravy. There you have the real thing. Look up the recipe in old cookbooks. Consider this useful canned food to be a substitute. If there is a better one on the market, I'd like to know.
My mother stuffed peppers with this!!!I have not had it in years!!  I liked it a lot.  Was shipped,etc. in excellent time and condition.I love AMAZON!!!!

column9: Tastes like cheap meat and salt
column10: I guess I am in the minority, but this hash product tastes like cheap fatty meat and stale potatoes.  It splutters out so much grease while browning that you need to be prepared for a very stinky house and a stove that needs A LOT of 409 to get clean.  Maybe this is a nostalgia food I missed the boat on; I bought a can to try to see if our family wanted to stock some in our emergency food box since I have never had canned hash before.  This roast beef flavor has less salt than all others which is why I bought it, I cannot imagine how salty those must taste. If you like canned hash, listen to the 5 star reviews; if you never had it before, buy one can at the store to try before investing money and pantry space -- I am so glad I did!

Although I was looking for fat free gravy, I did wonder how it would taste without any fat. That's not your usual gravy by any stretch of the imagination -- gravy generally has a lot of fat whether it's chicken, beef or turkey. But my family is calorie-conscious and I decided to give Campbell's Chicken Fat Free Gravy a try. When it arrived from Amazon and I gave it a taste test, I was delightfully surprised at its very good flavor. I served it without announcing that it's fat free until I noticed that the family had enjoyed it and I even received compliments.Well, 24 cans are not staying around as long as I expected they might, so I'm ready to order another case. Opening a can with the pop-top lid, heating and putting it on the table has become a last minute thing. Buying by the case from Amazon is a terrific deal. Campbell's fat free isn't available in my area and there's only a generic available at one local supermarket costing $2.89 for a 12 oz. can. Don't think I'll bother taste testing that one.The calorie count is 15 per serving size (1/4 cup). That's even considered a "free food" on the ADA and Weight Watcher's exchange lists. The sodium count is a bit high at 13%, but I find that to be true in any prepared foods. I must admit it doesn't have that golden color you get from chicken gravy that contains fat, but I've solved that by occasionally adding a couple of drops of Kitchen Bouquet when it's meant to be ladled over potatoes, rice, etc. I don't bother when using it in recipes. All in all, the flavor is good but it doesn't overwhelm the taste of the food it's going on or into.

I have finally found someone who delivers Peppermint Crisp! My husband is from South Africa and he grew up having these as a treat. I've tried to find them everywhere. Should've known I'd find them through Amazon. If you've ever had a peppermint crisp, you'd understand why I've tried to find someone to ship them to me. It's unlike any chocolate mint candy you've ever had. I'm always leery of buying foodstuffs via the web, but these came in good condition and weren't "old". Would order again.
Disappointing- the chocolate had that old look to it, (white sheen) even though it had not expired and it didn't taste bad either.

I feed my dogs a raw homemade diet. But there are times when I am in a hurry or my husband has to feed the dogs so to have another food source on hand is helpful. Because this food is grain free and of top quality ingredients I don't hesitate to serve it to my two dogs. My young dog has liver problems so a top quality grain free food is very important. Plus, they love it.

I have a black lab who is an extremely picky eater.  Even though I had tried many excellent quality dog foods, mealtime was frustrating as he would refuse to eat and I would end up throwing the food away and trying again next mealtime.  My local pet store recommended this for finicky eaters.  They were right, he loves it.  You measure out the dry food into a bowl and add water to reconstitute.  My lab's nose immediately went up sniffing when the water was added.  It has a nice aroma, it doesn't smell like traditional dog food.  Now when the bowl is placed down, he's right there eating and he even comes back to the dish once or twice to make sure there isn't any left.  I finally found something he likes and mealtime is peaceful again.
Got a box of these at the store tonight. Was pleasantly surprised by them. They're good. The wasabi is a good addition to the rice crisps. I'd recommend these.

This is a great product.  Too bad that Amazon discontinued selling it.  My kids really like this item but after I received my last shipment from Amazon, they told me that they were no longer selling this item.  It seems every time that my family likes something they have to stop selling it.

I don't really know what it is about David's that sets them apart from other brands, but they are unquestionably the best sunflower seeds that money can buy. I work out doors and I eat sunflower seeds every day. There have been times when I have been forced to purchase other brands of seeds, and over the years I have tried them all. It is amazing how much better David's seeds are than every other brand. Their seeds are not toothpick thin like some other brands, they have the best flavor, they are not too salty, and they don't fill the bag with empty shells. Now that I have found these seeds for sale from Amazon, I shall never be forced to buy those horrid, bitter, burnt, stale seeds from other brands ever again.  Thanks, Amazon.
I ate a lot of Fisher brand many years ago and they could get pretty buggy sometimes if you know what I mean.  David brand is pretty good.

column9: Great Quality, Good Stop Smoking/Diet Aid, Price Fluctuation a Problem
column10: I've tried many other brands and only DAVID brand sunflower seeds is consistently good. Yes, all items that are minimally processed from plants can change slightly in flavor from bag to bag (as each plant is an original factory of it's own) but DAVID seeds have consistently good flavor (fresh, not rancid or chemical tasting). I trust DAVID products, always have.Eating sunflower seeds is good for many reasons. Cuts down on smoking, over eating, and is good nutrition. The salt is not too salty, just enough. If you read the nutrient label you'll see one serving is only 6% of sodium for one day, not high at all.UPDATE: My earlier recommendation of this item was partly due to the quality and partly due to the low Amazon.com Subscribe & Save price, which was $7.34 when I subscribed and first wrote this review. But as of 7-5-11 the Subscribe & Save price has gone up to $11.03. Most likely will not be ordering any more or might have to cancel our future orders if this price hike remains. Sellers need to understand that quality AND price matter. And if they are going to hike up the price just because a reviewer says it's a good item at a low price, they will loose customers and sales!! It looses one star and I can no longer recommend this item until or unless it comes back down below $7.50.

I love these soft salty seeds, they're the only ones I can munch on all day and never get tired of them. I must have gone through a hundred bags in the last year.But though every store carries them, I still have trouble finding what I'm looking for. That's because many bags (maybe 50%) are duds, filled with these little pebble shaped seeds, hard and awful-tasting. This is especially bad when Sunflower isn't in season, and of course at its very worst in early Summer when it's been almost a year since the last planting. That's when David really scrapes the bottom of the barrel and gives you 100% dud bags. Late summer is the harvest, and then the blood pressure induced heart attack stats spike. :)You can tell just looking through the window on the packaging whether you should buy the bag or pass. Nice long seeds are great, round pebbles are foul. I'm skeptical that the savings of ordering online outweigh the ability to inspect the goods before payment.

Sunflower seeds are my drug. Some people crave cigarettes or alcohol, I crave sunflower seeds and Coke.What mystifies even me is why I love seeds so much. At one point I thought it was because of the seeds themselves, but now I find I enjoy sucking all the salt off more than I do eating the seeds. Heck, if I find a shell that has that salty flavor INSIDE the shell too? Oh man, I'm like a ray of sunshine.That's why I love David brand sunflower seeds more than any others. The chances of finding that delicious dose of outside AND inside saltiness is far greater than others. I used to like Fisher's better but I had a run of bad luck with those in which I kept getting bad, rotten seeds. In David's, if I find two per bag I'm usually surprised. Add in the fact that Fisher has so much 'dust' at the bottom of the bag (I call it dust because I don't really know what it is...excess salt maybe?), I'll go for David everytime.If you're a sunflower seed lover, if you have a bad enough craving brands don't matter. But time and again I've found myself craving not just seeds, but David seeds in particular. Each brand has their own thing to offer, but these are all around my personal favorites.

I prefer the Reduced Sodium, but Amazon doesn't sell them. It's only my health. They arrived on time. The quality was as expected. They just weren't the Reduced Sodium. I can't believe they don't carry them.
I would have to return them because of the salt as well as taste. They do not seem to be fresh and only once in a while I can get one seed that tastes really good.
I love these bigger seeds!They are so hard to find in the stores its so great that Amazon has them. And for a great price.

More than likely, you have experienced David Sunflower Seeds before. If you have not, give them a try, they are probably the best you will find.What really makes this particular product great is the price. If you eat sunflower seeds on a regular basis, have a family or friends who like seeds, or have a baseball/softball team, this is for you.If you buy this and subscribe, you get the case of 12 packs for $10.66 with free shipping. That comes out to about $0.88 per bag of seeds. Most stores charge $1.59 or more for a bag of seeds, plus tax!When I ordered my seeds, the expiration date was almost a full year in the future (plenty of time to tear through 12 bags of seeds).This is the deal to have. Eat. Spit. Be Happy!

column9: There is David and Sons, then you roll the dice
column10: I don't know if there are different grades of sunflower seeds, but no other brand comes close to the consistent quality of David and Sons. I have been eating an average of a bag of seeds a day since I was 10 (30 years)..  I will drive to multiple stores to find David and Sons. They are extremely addictive. I like the original best but they have done a great job with all the flavored seeds, especially the ranch.

I love these as a snack food. A bag lasts me a few days and I just tape it closed between nibbling.Yes, they are salty, but not as salty as lot of the other brands. The flavor is classic and they are always consistently roasted.A nice consistent product, if you haven't had them in years, they still taste the same. My son prefers the flavored varieties, but these are my favorite.

column9: Not good like they used to be...
column10: I don't know what's up with the David company but they sure don't make sunflower seeds the way they used to.  They used to be thick and tasty.  Now they're thin and you're lucky if you can find a seed at all.  And they don't taste very fresh.  I just cracked open two that had no seeds.  These sunflower seeds are very skinny, like there's nothing in them.  It's just not as fun as it used to be.Maybe they just need some good old-fashioned competition....I'll go look for some.
Nothing compares to David Seeds. I have tried almost every kind of seed, and they are perfect.Crisp outer shell that holds its taste, soft inner seed packed full of flavor. Perfect for spitting.

This purchase was definitely worth while. I love these sunflower seeds and plan on making more purchases in the future. Now I never have to go to the local store and pray that they are in stock. Glad that I found them on Amazon! Now what else can I find? Hey, don't second guess this purchase they are great and arrive much faster than you expect them to. Go for it!

I like sunflower seeds. These are good, not overly salty, and I don't get a ton of broken shells in the package. Every so often I get a burnt or nasty one, but the vast majority of the seeds are good. If you like roasted and salted sunflower seeds in the shell you can't really go wrong with these. I ordered 12 packages of them and I know it's going to take me a long time to go through them all. Yum.
If you like sunflower seeds - these are THE BEST!  Liked them as a kid, love them as an adult!  Thankfully I get to snack on them all week long at work :)

column9: messy and salty shells, but there is a solution
column10: I am disappointed to see that the sunflower seeds have very messy shells. They literally stain your fingers with some kind of dusts.Also they are covered with salts so your tongue will feel the salt each time you crack shells with your teeth.The seeds are also small compared to seeds I usually buy from Asian stores.But I later found a solution: rinsing the seeds before eating them!Rinsing will wash away the salts and dusts on the shells and make shells softer, easier to crack. I can even crack the shells with my fingers now.Now I can enjoy sunflower seeds.
David's are the best tasting sunflower seeds in the world.  The combination of the roasted taste and just the right amount of salt makes David's the best, hands down.
David's sunflower seeds are the best for on the go people.  Great taste and a convient size.David Sunflower Seed, Original Flavor, 5.25-Ounce Bags (Pack of 12)

column9: Product is fine but Amazon screwed the shipping up.
column10: I received exactly what I ordered but I got it 3 days after it was supposed to arrive. It shipped from just outside LA to the Phoenix area, which is a two day shipment anyway, and it was shipped on my Prime account. It took 6 days to get here. This is the first time Amazon has screwed something up like this for me but it is still unexplainable.

I believe I did order the wrong item, however:  the case has not been opened and i was hoping to exchange it.  I have been notified there not eligible for return, probably because its a food item.  However, as stated it hasn't been opened, and the individual bags inside would be safe of tampering.

I bought the David Sunflower seed. I thought I was getting already shelled seed, butthey are in the shell. They are so small that when shelled there is very little meat.I would never buy them again. I guess I will need to chew the shell and all. This isthe only product I have bought from Amazon that has not been satisfactory. The peanutsI ordered are great.

column9: On a scale of 1 to 10 for hotness....
column10: I'd give it a 6.It sounds low (especially since I rated it a 4 out of 5) but most "Extra Hot" horseradishes or mustards are a 3. Regular Horseradish is like -4.This stuff has a decent kick, but is by no means really really hot.So far, it's the hottest horseradish I've found in retail channels, but not the hottest I've had.Would I buy it again? Yes. Until I can find something hotter that's fulfilled/shipped by Amazon.

column9: DEPENDS UPON YOUR TASTE, BUT IN GENERAL THIS IS OKAY STUFF...
column10: I suppose that horseradish is like everything else, it is all in they eye of the beholder; although in this case we are talking taste buds and sense of smell which really work hand in hand and rely upon each other.  Anyway, we each have different taste expectations when we buy a product billed as "Extra Hot."  This is particularly true when it comes to horseradish.  I suppose this all boils down to what you have experienced in the past; both good and bad.  All of our tastes differ so much that it would be quite impossible to create a product like this that would make everyone happy I should think.I like horseradish and will not eat a roast beef sandwich without it.  Both my wife and I use it in making certain sauces and dressings.  I cannot remember a time when we did not have this stuff in our fridge.Anyway, I most certainly have mixed feeling about this particular product.  It is most certainly NOT the hottest of the hot horseradish I have had in my life.  Now this is not as important to me as it is to my wife.  She likes things extremely hot, whereas I am a bit of a wimp at times.  This stuff is just about right for my taste...although even I could use a degree or two of extra heat here, but it is not to her satisfaction.My primary problem; if problem you want to call it, is that I feel that this stuff is ground too fine.  I like a bit of texture to my horseradish and this stuff is almost creamlike.  I personally would like to find a bit less vinegar taste involved...hey, it I want vinegar I will put it on myself.  This causes a problem with some of the dressings we make.Now don't take me wrong.  I am not really complaining all that much as I do like this product; its just that I feel it could be better with a bit of tweaking here and there.  We will continue to use it. I do like this stuff on my roast beef sandwiches and have even been known to add it to my Italian sub sandwiches I purchase at the local deli.This is a good product but keep in mind that ever one has a bit different taste.  I think if my wife reviewed this product she would give it a much lower rating than I have.Don BlankenshipThe Ozarks
While fairly hot, I have tasted better-- the vinegar flavor is too strong. This horseradish is watery (possibly due to high vinegar content) and finely cut, so there is almost no texture.
This stuff will clear your sinuses. Mixed with yellow mustard and you have a killer pretzel dip. Great on beef or pork. Love this stuff on sausages with cheese.
Exactly as advertised, and the service was great.  I`m not exactly a horse-radish gormet, but I can`t imagine how it could have been any better.  Best I`ve ever bought.

This is a pretty decent horseradish for using straight on your meat or what have you. Not too hot. Horseradish fans will find it a little bland. Mix it with a little mayo (about 2 parts horseradish-1 part mayo) for the more squeamish eaters.

I recently purchased this at the grocery store hoping it would live up to its claim of "Extra Hot".  Sadly, it doesn't come close. I put it on my sandwich today that includes 2 slices of country white bread, 3 slices of roast beef, and 1 slice of swiss cheese.  I liberally applied the horseradish, as I really like the taste of it, and sadly I can't even taste the horseradish.  I would at least expect to be able to taste it, given there's really nothing else on my sandwich, let alone have a slight singe in my nose, but no, I get nothing.  I might as well have put bland cardboard paste on my sandwich.. in fact when I get home I'm going to double check the bottle to make sure that it's really not cardboard paste cleverly disguised as horseradish, and then return it to the store.Advice: avoid.

It is not often that I write a review for something that already has a following, but this time I felt really compelled.  If you are looking for a vegan, organic, and tasty superfood addition to your protein shakes or smoothies, look no further.  I mix it with ground flax seed, vanilla whey protein and Loclo for my morning shake and ever since I started adding it I have felt a surge in energy and physical/mental focus ( i an avid Kettle-bell enthusiast and cross fitter as well as an active duty US Marine ).  This energy stays with me throughout the day.  The taste is a bit overwhelming  by itself, but when mixed with a vanilla protein powder creates this spicy kind of veggie flavor that paris well with the vanilla flavor in the way.  I consider my self a convert to this awesome powder and will probably set up a subscription.

I love Amazing Grass Raw Reserve! Don't expect it to taste good-because it doesn't-but it sure makes you feel good on the inside. I usually mix about two ounces of water with some lemon juice and a package of this stuff. I still plug my nose as a gulp away--but I'm hooked on how it makes me feel for the rest of my day. I'd highly recommend this above many other superfood supplements. All quality, organic ingredients--can't ask for much more than that!

This was a good transaction but while Amazing Grass has amazing ingredients I didn't see the flax seed in the ingredient listing online. For reasons I do not understand flax in products like this just upsets my system (perhaps it goes rancid when ground or made in to oil). I prefer to just add spirulina powder or E3Live to my smoothies.

I have tried 3 different types of Dehydrated dog food - each have been good, but dogs lost interest after a week.  So far Grandma Lucy's products have held their interest.  They smell better prepared then most of my dinners and my finky eater actually comes back to the kitchen to ask for more

After reading about this spice in a book about healing spices I really felt the need to try it. Needless to say I have found this to be one of my favorites in an Indian drink for cooling down. Very good quality, and flavorful too. Thank you.

column9: improved Halo canned cat food formula
column10: My cats liked Spots Stew but when I found out the high carb values, I stopped feeding it to them. It had too many vegetables which cats don't need.I called Halo and found out that this chicken Pate is much lower carb and slightly higher protein. The best news of all is that my kitties love it!Another good thing is that Halo has never had a recall.

I've been using Halo for quite a few years for my 2 adult cats.  I've now switched over to the grain-free Halo products.  The paté is very nice and can thwart any cat when it decides it wants to pick out the vegetables and eat around them. ;-}This product works great for kittens too.  I rescued some feral kittens lately and fed the paté to them, small amounts at a time.  I just mash it up and they love it.All in all, great products from Halo.  I have no intention of ever switching to another brand.

What a great food!  My cats, both shelter rescues, are SO VERY picky that you would think they had been raised by Royalty. I have tried MANY foods (which they like one day, but reject them the next), then I tried Halo Pate'.  WE'VE GOT A WINNER!The ingredients are top notch and I am so pleased there has never been a recall.  My cats adore the Pate'!  They like to 'lick' their food, rather than biting it, so I open the can, mix it with a little bit of warm water and they lick away!  If I wasn't a vegetarian, I would probably even taste this food, because it really smells great.  Thanks so much for making such a great healthy food, Halo!

I feed my cat Stashu the dry grain free Halo food too!  The combination of the Halo Wet & Dry Grain Free food is wonderful!!!  Stashu used to "Toot" all the time, so much so it made you think he was stinky!!  Our dog eats Halo dry food too, so I put Stashu on Halo brand and he no longer "Toots" like crazy !  Big improvement and he absolutely loves it!  I feed him the wet Halo food to help keep his "Urinary Tract" healthy and he likes dry food so I give him a little of the Halo Grain Free dry food every day too.  He had no adverse reaction to switching brands at all  (he was a stray cat I took in - I am so lucky!)  I'm so happy I found a Natural, Healthy GRAIN FREE cat food for him.  Cats do not eat grains, they are carnivores and require high protein diets.  I highly recommend this product for all feline lovers.  I feel good feeding this to Stashu and he is mroe than happpy and healthy eating it!

column9: This is the only cat food my cat with CRF will eat
column10: As soon as I kept noticing my 16-year old cat by the water bowl, I knew.  Kidney failure.  (Chronic Renal Failure)The vet said we caught it early but my cat's appetite started to change and lessen.  I feed all my cats and dogs the organic and free-range foods and preferably "human'grade."For my cats, they all liked Fromm's brand in cans (Fromm Four-star Duck & Chicken Pate) which cost more than $2 a can.  When my cat stopped eating it, I panicked and ran to the vet to get the horrible prescription canned cat food for CRF cats.  They were not cheap and my cat wanted nothing to do with it.  Ditto for all the other premium brands such as Wellness, Wellness core, By Nature Organics, Newman's own organic.When I finally turned to the Halo brand, I was desperate.  My cat did not like Spot's stew but I could tell she liked some of it. So when I noticed Spot's Pate grain-free ground chicken, I bought two cans for her.  I was shocked to see her actually eating it and not just "tasting" it.  I ran to the store and cleaned out their stock of this flavor.Now I no longer have to remember to go to the store, or waste the gas & time.  It's cheaper here at Amazon and it gets delivered to my door for free.  I save even more now that I'm on the subscribe & save plan.
I bought both the ground chicken and whitefish pate for my sister's cat.  He loves it and better yet, it's good for him.  According to my sister, he asks for it by name!  :)
Canned cat food is much healthier than dry. Grain free cat food is much healthier than one with grains. My cat hates food with "chunks" so this nice smooth pate suits her fine. Great food!

We use Amazing Grass ORAC Green SuperFood and I purchased these to take on vacation.  This is my favorite flavor/texture + health benefits of all the Amazing Grass drink mixes and the packaging made it very convenient to take on the plane without being questioned about the strange powdery stuff in baggies stuffed in my luggage. :)Price could be better, but you pay for convenience.

I found these crackers at Whole Foods and just love them.  They're light and crispy and so so addictive.  It's hard not to have just a few.  Very good with cheeses and salami.  Luckily, Whole Foods is far away enough to only make a weekly trip there (I like to have them as my special treat).  I can't find La Panzanella crackers anywhere else.  These are my favorite!!

Once tried - now a permanent staple in our home.  They are crisp and very tasty.  Have tried other ones and they do not come up to the taste of LaPanzanella.  They do break into smaller pieces but big enough to spread brie or other spreads on.  Love them!

I discovered the full size flatbread rosemary La Panzanella croccantini this past spring at a winery in California.  Loved them, and ordered them from Amazon when we got home.  Then I discovered the mini size and tried them - the size is great!  Have already ordered more!
These crackers are wonderful!  They taste great and are a very convenient size for snacking.  I hope Amazon continues to offer them as they are very addictive!

The large box these Rosemary Mini Croccatini were shipped in was much to large for this shipment!The many pieces of bubble wrap didn't protect the 6 packs because the space within the box was huge, and the flat breads had too much space to move around in.

As a person who is sensitive to gluten, I must use alternative flours when cooking or baking.  This flour mix is created from a formula in Bette Hagman's "Gluten Free Gourmet Bakes Bread."  It is an excellent mix and can be used as is, (exchange rate: 1 for 1), for any recipe which already calls for rice flour.  In her book, Bette mentions that this flour does not have the protein levels found in wheat flour and that it is advisable to add protein (usually in the form of egg whites).I have converted many wheat flour recipes (for yeast breads, quick breads and cookies) to use this mix just by adding 1 - 2 egg whites and a couple teaspoons xanthan gum (to replace the gluten in wheat flour).  It should be noted that adding egg whites adds moisture to the recipe, so you'll need to eyeball whether or not you need to add less of another liquid or more of a dry ingredient.  Many times, I find that nothing else needs to be adjusted.Because I bake and cook a lot, I now mix my own Featherlight flour.One last thing, there is another mix made from bean flour which Bette claims exchanges 1:1 for wheat flour and can be substituted immediately into wheat recipes without the need for more protein (you'll still need the xanthan gum to replace the gluten when baking).  It should be noted that some people are "sensitive" to the taste of bean flour to the point of ruining the enjoyment of the baked goods.  In any case, it is called Bette's Four Bean Flour BlendAuthentic Foods' & Bette's Gourmet Four Flour Blend
Don't need to say much. Have made my own flour blends and have purchased almost every brand. This is Hands down, the best!

"Bette's Featherlight Rice Flour" put out by Authentic Foods is a great product, I love it! My baked goods turn out as though I used regular flour! The packaging is better than other brands that offer gluten free grains/flour - I use it as someone that is gluten intolerant but... I live in the rural country and there are no vendors that sell this particular product in my area so I have to buy it off-line... The only kicker about buying it off line is that the shipping cost is almost as much as the product itself so you end up paying double! It would be nice if Amazon could offer "free shipping" but...

column9: Enjoy all your family recipies with this gluten free flour.
column10: When I was diaganosed with Celiac, I was thrilled to find Bette's Featherlight Rice Flour Blend. It can be used for any recipie with the addition of 1 teaspoon of powdered egg substitute and one teaspoon of xantham gum per cup of flour. Nut roll, snickerdoodles, oatmeal cookies, pinapple upsidedown cake, and all my old favorites turn out just as if they had been made with wheat flour. If your oatmeal cookie batter seems too thin, just add a little more flour.

This an absolute for those with wheat allergies or need to eat gluten free. I blend it 50/50 with Bette's Gourmet Four Flour blend. I then can use this cup for cup as a substitute for wheat flour in recipes. Just add xanthum gum and you can use all of your old recipes again!!!!Can you say fabulous!
The product is good. And its made in USA - Lessens the chance of harm to our 4-legged family members.

I found out after this was received that the product is not made in America, so I returned it.  Value Pet Supplies customer service is EXCELLENT! They were pleasant and went out of their way to be helpful. I would not hesitate to order from them again, but I wish I had been able to determine before ordering where the product was made.

This Vendor JustCaviar, has gone above and beyond any expectation of fullfilling my order.  I placed this same order with another vendor and after a couple of days was told, they could not find the product.  JustCaviar was given my order and they too could not fill it.  I was sending a birthday present to a family member that I had never met, so this was important to me.  JustCaviar called me at home, to say they WILL find my product and it WILL be sent to the recipient, and not to worry.  Sure enough...JustCaviar is true to their word, and my package is on it's way to the recipient.  In this day and age, to find such EXCELLENT service is unusual!  JustCaviar has made a friend for life.  All of my gourmet needs will be ordered from JustCaviar.EXCELLENT...5 STARS.  Thank you.

column9: For those who prefer light roasts
column10: I have a Keurig in the office for guests (and I drink a cup occasionally, but usually my caffeine consumption is happening in the car on the way to work.) Now, I like dark roasts, and the famous "burnt flavor" of a lot of Starbucks blends is not to everyone's tastes. Some people like a light, aromatic, slightly acidic blend and Veranda is just that.There is a faint "woody" taste that I can detect but it doesn't detract from the light flavor. Milk or cream make this even milder and if that's how you like your brew, you may well like this very much. I keep some on hand and when we ask guests "do you prefer a light or a dark roast coffee?" it's surprising how many people don't like the ink-black French Roast that I typically drink (or the even darker Italian Roast.)It's all in what you like. So if you make coffee for guests, a few of these may be a welcome cup for the light roast folks.

column9: Best flavored seeds, yet you can't find them in any stores
column10: Who the hell wants to buy pickle or nacho cheese flavored seeds? Yet, for some reason, they are sitting next to every cash register in America. Meanwhile, this is the greatest flavor to ever exist, and you have to scour the internet to find them.  The taste of these things is simply irresistible. There are no other seeds or flavors I have tried that will ever compare. And for those who say that Reds or other brands are better tasting, they must have some seriously screwy taste buds, because I have tried them all, and these blow them out of the water. Can't wait to get my 12 pack in the mail.

The flavor on these are not hot, they are tapping on the slightly spicy side, however, they have very good flavor to them. I received my 12 pack less than a week ago and already down to 6, of course I started sharing and now down to 4 packs. Everyone I share them with are now also hooked. Originally tried them over a year ago but don't see them in stores often, so when I did at a local store, I bought them until they ran out of stock, now ordering through Amazon! I really have to say Amazon's shipping is super fast on this order and others, even the estimated shipping arrival date is dead on, so far not a single problem. I love the change of using air cushions rather than Styrofoam.

I'm not one to resort to hyperbole but as sunflower seed enthusiast, these seeds are great. To be fair, not every bag is the same. Some seeds are lower quality than others but it does balance out if you have around 1 bag per week. Some people claim the flavor can be too much, which I understand, but for me it's perfect. While the BBQ flavored ones are sort of sweet, these are packed with jalapeno and salsa flavor.I used to go out of my way to find these Jalapeño flavored seeds around DC but only two 7-11 stores had them. It was awful. Then came along Amazon. Packaging 12 packs in one box is genius. Now I'm stocked for a good 2 months and pay a great bulk price (since I end up buying the same amount over the same time period). It's just great.
I've been eating sunflower since a little kid.I enjoy Davids alot and they come in so many great flavors.I highly recommend if your into sunflower seeds.

I ordered the seeds for my son.  He had left an open bag in the garage for months.  I threw it away and he was very upset with me.  I surprised him with the order.  He really likes the jalepeno seeds.

These are easily the best tasting seeds that David produces.  It's also worth noting that because the flavor comes from the spices and not salt, the sodium content of the Jalapeno Hot Salsa is actually lower than the reduced sodium seeds that they sell.

These are great and very addictive. I get them at the gas station every once in a while, but they're getting more and more expensive so I think I'll start ordering from here.They aren't too spicy and these are easy to crack and are satisfying. The only problem I have is the saltiness of every David Sunflower Seeds product, they tear my mouth up pretty bad so I cannot eat them all the time.Makes a great seed once a week or so, I give it 4 out of 5 stars.
Great roasted seeds with probably the best tasting kernels in the business ( bigs being other ). Jalapeno flavor def recommended if ur looking for that spicy tangy option.  Try a bag !

I ordered these because I was never able to find the flavor in any local store.  The flavor is great, and isn't overwhelmingly spicy to the point where your mouth is burning.  Just a nice solid kick of spice and then it's time for another!  Couldn't be more satisfied.

I am not the typical sunflower seed eater but recently a friend of mine re-introduced me to them. I love everything hot and spicy but these are impossible to find in the stores so I ordered from Amazon. OMG....these are great!! I also like the Ranch but they are a bit saltier than these so I have to eat them in moderation. These are the perfect little "snack" for when you are sitting in front of the tv and don't want the carbs and calories from eating popcorn with butter. With a case of 12, I will be stocked up for a while!!

column9: Tasty flavored salty snack that's not to hot
column10: I love sunflower seeds and this is a great flavored version that has plenty of taste but is not to hot to handle.  In my opinion David's does the best job in sunflower seeds that have the most taste.

These are the BEST sunflower seeds ever. They will light your mouth on fire at first but after that they will be fine. My entire team loves them and they taste best when you mix them in with the originals in your back pocket.

I have a hard time finding these in the store so I typically have to buy them from amazon when they're in stock.  These are the only flavored seeds I like, all the others are disgusting to me.  If I can't find these, which seems to be more and more common, I unhappily buy unflavored.
Seeds are of good quality with no wormy or rotten ones in the bag.  The bag seemed to have a lot of powder of questionable source in the bottom.

I eat sunflower seeds all the time and I have since I was a little kid.  I have tried all the flavors (ranch, lime, etc.) but I am just in love with jalepeno hot salsa. It's not HOT but it has a great flavor. I paid approximately $25 for 24 bags which wasn't a bad buy when you consider that they cost $1.39 at the grocery store and $1.59 at the gas station.  I bought them online because they stopped ofering this flavor in the stores.  The seeds arrived in a timely fashion and so far have all been very fresh.  All in all I found it was a good buy for a great product

Have been ordering Dave seeds by the case for a couple of years. Always fresh and great tasting. But this past case that I received does not live up to the high quality of the past. Every bag so far ( I'm on the 6th of 12 ) has been poor in quality. The seeds are smaller, a lot of broken shell with no seeds, and a lot of "bad" seeds (kind of rancid tasting). It's as if they bagged up the floor sweepings.
Jalapeno Hot Salsa is David's best flavor of sunflower seed.  I have no idea why they are so hard to find at gas stations and what not, but I am sure glad I found them on here!
BEST FLAVOR PERIOD NO COMPARISONS. Very good deal only flavor i even touch just bought 24. My only complaint is that they dont sell the seasoning strait
i like the taste however they give me sores on my tongue. other flavors dont do this. i think its the spicy ingredients. i wont buy these again, ill probably go with ranch or something.
The 'David' sunflower seeds are delicious and addictive! they are fresh, crunchy, tasty and come in bags which are just the right size for a family to share.

column9: Excellent Blend of Flavor for Sunflower Seeds
column10: I had only had regular and BBQ flavored David Sunflower Seeds, until I saw the Jalepeno Hot Salsa flavored sunflower seeds on Amazon.Com. Since I'm hooked on chewing seeds during baseball games and football games, I decided I would try some. Wow, what a pleasant surprise. I am now a confirmed Jalepeno Hot Salsa Flavor David Sunflower seed lover. These are the best I have ever tried. As a matter of fact, I won't watch a game without a pack of these wonderful seeds beside my recliner. I also love the fact that Amazon sells them in boxes containing 12 5.25 oz bags. Based on the local retail stores here, I save almost $1,00 per package too! If you like sunflower seeds and have not tried these, try them and be ready for a sunflower party inside your mouth. They are hard to put down,, once you get started, so you've been warned. Don't wait, Baseball playoffs will be here soon, the final 12 have been chosen for the NASCAR chase for the championship, and the NFL and NCAA are just beginning, plus I can't mow my lawn without a jaw full of the spicy seeds. Take it from me, you can't go wrong with this one.
If you want true flavor and big seeds, go get some Big's sunflower seeds.  Once you try Big's, you're not comm'n back to Davids.

column9: Our Cat Goes CRAZZZY With This!
column10: We've tried a lot of different catnips over the years... but Kong Catnip Spray is the best - by far!  We can take any toy, even one our cat no longer has (or even never had) an interest in ... and give it ONE spray of Kong Catnip and WHAAMM!!  Suddenly, he's playing with it like it's the best toy in the world!!  Tried it on a his scratching post... and for the next 20 minutes plus, he's rolling, flipping, scratching, jumping off it... pretty funny to watch!  Just a spray or two is all it takes... and it lasts for a while too!  I always felt a little frustrated when I'd go a buy a toy only to have my cat take little to no interest in it.  That's all changed thanks to Kongs spray on catnip.  Really glad we found this!!
This product is a great product.  My cats love it and I appreciate it's size, easy to carry around and store.  Lots of power and excitement packed into such a small bottle. Recommend it to anyone.

column9: Very Potent! Our cats love anything sprayed with this catnip oil!!
column10: I actually bought this after reading an article about catnip oil keeping mites and other buggies away from chickens (we have chickens). However, upon receiving it I sprayed a couple of kitty toys that our cats ignore and view with disdain. Immediately they came running (they smelled it from the another room) and now the previously ignored and rejected toys are the favorites in the house! Seriously!! They were rolling, licking, playing with these toys for quite some time (45 min?) and even now when they walk past they can't help but go over and give the toys a bit of play.Very potent - highly recommend for cats!

Thanks Kong!  Now my cat is a nip addict!  Normally, my fat, lazy, orange tabby wants three things out of life:  something to eat, a warm place to sleep, and someone to rub his sweet face and fat belly.  I can't believe how he goes NUTS for this stuff!  I've never seen him so playful!  This must be some seriously psychedelic stuff from a feline perspective.
Just by smelling this you can tell that it is a very concentrated cat nip. Our cats enjoy is much more that dried cat nip or even fresh cat nip. Its great!

Our cat has been having some behavioral issues. He's been spraying and basically walking around the house meowing very loudly and basically "screaming" at everyone. He's always been very vocal. I'll spray this product on his coat or on my finger and he instantly clams down. Great product!

Was an instant hit when I tried it on our three cats' toys. Now, I spray it on their tower & toys in the mornings when I leave for work so they burn off some energy while I'm away. Another great Kong product!
my cats love this stuff.they know what the bottle looks like now.and the second that they see it the first thing that they do is jump on their cat house and wait for the fun to start

For whatever reason my cat didn't go for this catnip spray.I suspect that this spray works better for cats that are desperate for catnip - mine usually only gets moderately excited about catnip.  If your cat doesn't go that crazy about catnip to begin with (it's genetic), then I would skip this product.
Worked great the first time I used it.After once though its like my 2 cats are immune to it.I would not recommend this product to others.

The cats go nuts over regular catnip but they also eat it so I decided to give this a try. I shook it as directed before using it and it had no effect on them whatsoever. Maybe it's just the cats, but I won't be buying this again.

Marco runs in the opposite direction as if he's scared since I sprayed a teaser with this stuff. Would like to return it but not worth paying for the shipping :((( I couldn't find the Kookamunga one when I ordered this instead, but now I see the former is $14 a bottle, so I guess it's back to the messy stuff!

I am owned by 5 cats and I foster another 17 cats for my local humane society, so I can give the reaction of 22 individual cats to this Kong Catnip Spray product. Most of these cats respond very positively to anything catnip - those who don't respond positively just don't respond to catnip much at all. I sprayed some of the Kong stuff on a couple of their favorite toys. I did notice a peculiar very unpleasant odor, but held the two toys out for the cats to sniff - they all took one sniff and bolted. This happened with all 22 of the cats, even those who don't normally have a reaction to catnip. I waited a couple of days just in case the scent was too strong, but got the same reaction. Really wish it did work as well as the reviews I read on the website......

column9: The fun of catnip without the mess!
column10: I spray it on my cat's scratching post to keep him interested (as opposed to being interested in door jambs, furniture, etc).  I've used the  dried catnip before, but it ends up everywhere. I love how you put this exactly where you want it and it never makes a mess!

I bought some toys I thought my kitten would play with which didn't have catnip in them. Others I bought did. I just got the kitten who was six months old. I had some small toys I thought if I'd spray this catnip on it, "Piper" would love them. He hated it, and the toys he had tried to play with, he didn't want to have anything to do with. I wouldn't waste my money on this product.

Received the package fast and in great condition. The product itself however is sitting in front of me on a desk as a nice reminder of the $10+ I blew on a spray my cat dislikes so much that he no longer plays with the catnip filled banana toy he enjoyed just 30 minutes before I put this on it.I really wanted this to work I had planned on spraying it on my sons pants as he walked around the house cuz frankly it would have been hilarious, but ohwell. :(

column9: Catnip spray entices my kitties and doesn't make a mess
column10: In December 2011, I purchased an Omega Paw Ripple Board Scratch'n Massage Bed for my cats. It comes pretreated with catnip oil, and I thought it would be nice to have some extra on hand to refresh the box every now and then.I found KONG Naturals Catnip Spray for Cats at Amazon and ordered it. Although the bottle isn't very big, it seems a little goes a long way. My four cats love the way it smells! Not only do I use it to refresh the Omega bed, but I have started using it on other things, like their cat tree and other things I want them to scratch and lay on. Just a squirt every now and then keeps the kitties interested and I think they've started to recognize the sound of that little bottle.What I really like about the spray is it isn't messy like spreading the dried catnip is. I still use the dried catnip inside some toys, but now I use the spray to attract the cats to whatever I want them to pay attention to.I will definitely be restocking this catnip spray when my current bottle starts to dwindle.

column9: Works Great---As a minty air freshener
column10: I love the Kong brand, but this dissapointed me. My two kittens love catnip--but apparently only if it is the real stuff. They don't even notice the spray, and humans can't stop noticing it. The spray is way too potent and makes the lower half of my home reek of it for almost a day. I'll stick with the legitimate loose catnip from now on.
This is amazing!! its very potent and i just need to spray a tiny bit. My cats go nuts over it. They love their scratching post.

This spray is awesome. My cat goes crazy over it. I would say it works just as well if not better than dried catnip. The best part is that there's no mess! All you have to do is spray it on the toys or scratching posts that you want your cat to use. I will definitely be buying more of this when I run out!
We've got three DSH cats (two boys and one girl, all fixed) and they could care less about this spray. They love regular catnip leaves though. *shrug* Your mileage may vary.

I bought this because we adopted a cat from a shelter and he would not use a scratching post.He loves the smell and just rolls around on the floor and runs around the house but is still not using the scratching post.It was worth a try. The cat is happy, I am not but then again, I don't know how to train a cat to use a scratching post and only got the catnip on the advice of my vet.I won't be buying it again but not because of anything specific.

column9: Great replacement for my other brown rice!
column10: I make a lot of curry, and had an issue with the typical brown rice flavour totally dominating a dish. For awhile I was forced to use white rice, but I know its not good to consume. I have always been meaning to try Lotus Foods rice, and took the dive and bought (2) 11 lb bags of this Mekong Flower Rice when I saw it go on sale. Boy, I tell you what, the fragrance when those grains cook is very pleasant! The rice is organic, whole grain, and although having a unique and 'lighter' taste, it was well received by my partner and I and we will stick to buying high quality Lotus Foods rices! Truly a treat and Amazon offers some of the best prices I have seen! Not to mention this company is awesome for protecting heirloom varieties of rice, using SRI sytems for rice growing, and giving work to farmers all over with fair pay for their labor.

column9: Mekong Flower Rice - Cambodian brown rice - The best!
column10: I have always loved the brown jasmine rices of Thailand and other specialty rices of the Far East.  The Mekong Flower rice has become my very favorite and my husband now raves about it as much as I do.  He was not too excited that I had bought 11 pounds and was disappointed that he wasn't getting the brown jasmine last night.  When the Mekong Flower rice started cooking (in a small clay pot on top of stove) and that wonderful aroma began to fill the kitchen, he decided this new rice might be a winner.  It was perfect. The flavor was delicate, the grains cooked perfectly and there was not even a grain leftover.For an unforgettable and really flavorful dinner, try it with any of the Rancho Gordo heirloom beans (cooked in a clay bean pot) and laddle the beans over the rice.  I'm on the list to be advised when this rice is back in stock.  It's just that good!!!  Both grains and beans just taste better and earthier in a good clay pot on top of the stove.

Mekong Flower Rice has become my favorite brown rice:  it's organic; it's whole grain; it cooks up fluffy and tender unlike other brown rice varieties I've tried over the years; and it's farmed using a System of Rice Intensification (which results in higher crop yields with less water, less seed, less land, and NO chemicals).  And it's now available at an even lower price through Amazon's Subscribe and Save program.  What's not to love?By the way, I use one cup of rice to one and three-quarters cups water and soak for 12-24 hours before cooking.  The rice cooks up in approximately 20 minutes when pre-soaked.  I started pre-soaking my rice several years ago when I realized that if soaking increases the digestability of beans, why wouldn't it do the same for grains?  Pre-soaking makes for plumper more tender rice.  Give it a try!

Previously when I had ordered this rice it came in a fully sealed plastic bag. I loved the rice and that is why I ordered more.....but...Without any change to the advertised description, the rice came in a paper bag.  The paper bag was not made water/air proof in any way, even for shipping.  Obviously this does not seem sanitary at all and I will not be eating it. I have received a refund. Amazon has not acknowledged that the photo for this product does not represent the actual product being sent, nor the potential health risk.I will still buy from Lotus Foods, but will be more careful to buy in smaller quantities less likely to be switched to inappropriate packaging.  I will not mark down this organic item from 5 star, but others whom are concerned about the potential for contamination from packaging not airtight should be cautious.

CELIACS, BEWARE!!  I believe this rice is gluten-contaminated.  I've tried it twice in the past year, and each time suffered a serious reaction (I have a very high level of sensitivity to gluten).  The first time, in 2011, I wasn't sure if it was the rice or perhaps something else.  So in 2012 I tried it once more, this time being very careful that there were no other foods that could influence the outcome.  The reaction the second time was even worse.I don't have any problems with Lundberg Bros. rice products or Tinkyada or Jovial brands of rice pasta.

When I first opened the box that the 11-lb sack came in, it produced an aroma I couldn't place my finger on.  I set it to cook in the rice cooker, and the distinct smell of mold pervaded my home.  Amazon was kind enough to send me another bag to try out, however, it too carried the same strong scent.  Mold can be toxic, causing anything from allergies to diarrhea to more serious illnesses, especially if you have an injured immune system.  I eat rice everyday, and I've never had this experience before (usually, it will be a rancid oil smell, if any).  I do not recommend this eating this rice if you sense it is at all "off"-smelling.  Trust your nose.

column9: Good rice from a Great company
column10: This long-grain brown rice smells more like green tea to me than floral.  It arrived to me quickly and in fresh condition from Amazon.Organic Mekong Flower Rice(tm) - Cambodia's Floral Brown Rice, Imported from CambodiaMekong Flower is called 'Phka Malis' in Khmer, which means beautiful garland of flowers, because of its delicate floral aroma. Leaving the germ and bran layer intact intensifies its fragrance and nutty flavor while retaining the highest nutritional value. This nourishing whole grain rice has a lovely supple texture - unlike the chewy and bland taste of some brown rice.Perfect in dishes that will showcase its delicate fragrance, Mekong Flower is nutritious and flavorful.Perfect for all cuisines, it can be used steamed plain, in a pilaf, stir-fry, salad or pudding.Mekong Flower is chiefly grown on small family plots by households belonging to the Damrei Romeal Organic Rice Cooperatives in Takeo, a province dominated by rice fields and sugar palm trees. Cooperative members are using a set of growing methods, called the System of Rice Intensification (SRI), which enable smallholder farmers to harvest more rice from their traditional varieties using less water, seed, land and no chemicals. Researchers have found that the major aromatic compound in rice is increased in response to water stress. With SRI, farmers drain their paddies periodically, which may explain why Cambodian consumers are saying that SRI-grown 'Phka Malis' is more aromatic and better tasting. Visit our SRI section to learn more about this amazing system that is transforming the rice-growing world.# Cooks in 30 minutes# Whole grain and heart healthy# High in fiber, trace minerals and vitamins# High in phytonutrients and antioxidants# 3rd year transition, organic certification# Fair trade# Gluten and wheat free

column9: Jasmine scented heirloom organic brown rice!  Love it!
column10: Gives off the loveliest jasmine scent while cooking ( no worries, it's not "perfumed"--see the product description on Lotus Foods' site for full details).The texture is just right, not mushy or "fiber-y".  And the flavor is distinctly different, kind of nutty.  Not a bland starchy flavor.  And the hull isn't so tough you feel like you're chewing cud...With some brown rice varieties, sauces aren't absorbed well...not with the Mekong Flower rice. I'm rating this a very neutral three stars - because it's just a warning that Amazon has these reviews scrambled. This item is supposed to be the Omaha Steaks 1lb Snow Crab Cocktail Claws. Before you rate the reviewers down for posting to the wrong product (i.e. crab cakes, shrimp cakes, or seafood-stuffed mushrooms), try to post a reply to one of the reviews, then look at the picture of the product reviewed. You'll see that the reviewers actually reviewed the correct products - but Amazon scrambled the reviews for three different products here.

These stuffed mushrooms arrived with no cooking directions attached.  (I purchase frozen food online from another retailer---everything comes with cooking directions, times, etc...I am used to superior products.)  I perused the original site online for the proper cooking directions, then followed them to the letter.  First, I tasted one mushroom right from the oven, then I waited until they cooled before the next attempt.  Then, I waited one hour and tasted the product again.  There was absolutely no taste.  I couldn't discern a crab taste or aroma; nor could I sense the taste of mushrooms.  I  felt like I had a mouthful of tasteless bread crumbs.  I'm not willing to ingest a boatload of calories while experiencing no taste, so I threw the entire tray of 9 mushrooms into the garbage.

We received these Omaha Steaks brand Coconut shrimp as a gift. I like coconut is some preparations (pina coladas, certain cookies), but I don't eat it as a snack. I enjoy the scent of natural coconut.Though these shrimp are edible, the coconut aroma and subsequent taste overpower anything else. Even from the oven, the only thing that I can smell is coconut. When eaten, they leave a strong aftertaste that for a while makes one wonder if by mistake you consumed a coconut-scented wax candle by mistake. This holds true even when drenched with cocktail sauce to try to drown out the coconut.I cannot imagine that the overpowering odor is natural coconut, which I find to be pleasant. One of the listed ingredients is "Artificial Flavor," which likely means that Omaha Steaks attempted to "enhance" the flavor in some way. Unfortunately, I can't tolerate the resulting smell, which is an integral part of the perceived flavor when eaten.In short, if you're a huge coconut fan, or if your sense of smell is inoperative, then these might be for you. If you are an occasional consumer of coconut, then proceed with great caution.

column9: Mmm... One of my all-time favorite chocolate bars! :-P~

I was introduced to the Pingvin Salt Pastiller about 5 years ago in Miami when I met some Swedish tourists who had purchased them at the Duty Free shop on their way out of the country. I was in love. This is the greatest liquorice on the planet. I don't know why I even qualified that. It's the greatest candy on the planet. According to my Swedish friends, Swedish Duty Free shops were the ONLY place to buy this treasure. Thus, as an American I've been mostly deprived of it over the past five years. I've scoured the internet over and over again, hoping someone would start carrying it, but each time I found the same thing . . . fellow non-Swedes in the same position as me--unable to get a hold of the greatest candy on earth.Until now. I saw this product for sale here. It's not in the traditional Pingvin Salt Pastiller packaging (the pill container--I added a photo), but it looked like it might be the same stuff. Well, I took a chance on it--ordered 3 bags to minimize the sting of shipping--and ladies and gentlemen, we have a winner. This is the real deal. The packaging is different, but the content is the same.Now that I'm sure, my next order will be for more like 10 or 20 bags. Get it while it's available. Who knows when this seller will close up shop?Note: If you've never had salt liquorice before, be warned that it is a VERY strong liquorice and it's very salty. Many non-Scandinavians are repulsed by it. I initially thought it was pretty revolting. But my repulsion very quickly became an addiction. It's an acquired taste, but one that I acquired surprisingly quickly. And now nothing else comes close.

column9: best of the Wabash I tried
column10: Went to the store in downtown Lake Placid. Bought a large bag of the extra-large caramel style, the red, and the purple. My wife and I agree the purple is the best. It is more dense and not chewy at all. It has a richer flavor. The red was second place, great but just not quite as good with poor popping. The extra-large was third. You could see that it would be great for caramel popcorn, but not for simple butter and sea-salt popcorn like we prefer. Still, they were all good.The correct way to pop: High heat on canola oil in a pot. Add 3 kernels. When they pop, add rest. Cover with spatter shield, this will keep the kernels in but let the steam out.Enjoy!
Love this popcorn. It is the only one we eat at this house! And I guess amazon is the only place I will order it from now on. It would really be great if it were organic.

This pop corn was very good and every kernel popped and had a very good taste , I would like to see a 6 pound bag

This is very high qulity pop corn, I recomend it.  Almost all kernels pop and they are a crisp white when they pop.  Very healthy and yummy, I have tried almost all of them.
