We heard about this coffee before leaving for Jamaica so we pick up some and have fell in love with it.  The best we have had yet smooth without that bitter after taste so many other coffee have.

column9: Excellent coffee, not all that exotic, though...
column10: I love my coffee, and because of that, I have tried lots and lots of varieties although I began as a simple Folgers fantatic.  Jamaican Mountain Blue Coffee has been touted to be the best of the best world coffees out there by such highly esteemed sources as the Food Network and the kitchens of the White House.I found the low acidity of the coffee very refreshing, but the darkness of this roast has not allowed a lot of subtleness of the flavor to come out.  To me, this tastes like Folgers at its best, but nothing more than that.  Great for everyday drinking, because it is smooth and rich and leaves little acid "bite."  But still, after having tried Kona coffee with its myriad of subtle flavors, I found Blue Mountain kinda boring.I guess I disagree with experts, but hey, my coffee is important and taste is everything!  If you like exotic flavors, this isn't it.  But it you would like to have consistently smooth, rich, honest coffee, this is the one.

I am a coffee lover of many years and as such am always interested in finding good coffees.  This was my first time to try blue mountain, and purchasing it with a gift certificate allowed me to be a bit more extravagant than I otherwise would have been.While the coffee is good, I don't find it to be superior to other coffees I have ordered which are considerably less expensive.

These are some of my favorite beans. I've purchased this brand a number of times in various roasts, and I've never been disappointed. Whether you use them in your French press, your espresso maker or your conventional coffee pot, some of the best tasting coffee you can imaging comes out of this bag.Definitely recommended.

column9: Love Blue Mountain Coffee, Hate JABLUM
column10: While in Jamaica, my wife and I drank Blue Mountain Coffer every day and loved it.  We even went on a bike tour of the Blue Mountains, and purchased some coffee.  It came in a plain clear plastic bag, and we could see the darkness of the roast.  We enjoyed that coffee.In Ocho Rios, we bought some bags of JABLUM.  You can't see the darkness of the roast, and all you can smell is the burlap bag.  When we opened it up, it was a very light roast, not much fragrance, and once brewed, the coffee tasted a lot like dirt.  We were very disappointed.

I bought this coffee in Jamaica ($15 for 1 lb bag).  While I liked and enjoyed it, I prefer several coffees from my local shops at about the same price.  I think that it may have been worth the $15/lb, but no more.  Certainly not at these prices.

column9: Only 2 of 3 16 oz. received in shipment
column10: I recently ordered the 16 oz., 3 Pack.  When my FedEx order arrived on December 26, 2008 there were only two 16 oz. bags contained in my order.  I would like my missing 16 oz. bag to be sent to me or at least be refunded 1/3 of my $105 charged price.

Went to Jamaica last May and brought about 6 pounds of this and the Waldenford's Blue Mtn back with me. About half what you are paying here, but still not worth the money. It is good coffee. No question. But don't believe all the hype. I am a casual coffee drinker and someone that takes coffee more seriously might get more benefit from this coffee. To me, not the case. I order my Peet's Arabian Mocha Java online for about $14/lb and it is still my favorite coffee.
I don't get all the hype over this coffee. Not much of a head on it. Doesn't taste that great. What's the big whoop?

I ordered this for my husband for Valentine's Day.  The picture and description on Amazon's website made it appear to be a large, loaded gift basket.  This is so not the case!  One basket was used just to make it appear larger, there wasn't anything in it!  The other items were stacked around the edge of it and on the smaller basket on top.  The roses are small and cheap looking.  The candy, what there is of it, is not all that great and brands that I have never heard of!  The coffee packet made terrible coffee that I dumped out.  I would not recommend this gift basket and will never order from them again.  The basket was probably worth about  $19.95 at most.  Definitely a rip off!!

My favorite for twenty-three years. Nothing compares...the tangiest, the saltiest, the most rustic, bar none. My Northern-situated family members bring me bags of these pretzels to keep me tame. Nuff said.
This is one of my favorite coffees of any brand. I love strong coffee, and this is bold and very flavorful.
I love coffee and this one tastes very good. The price is lower than in the store. I will be back and buy more after finish this one.

I bought this at a gourmet store while traveling and once I started to use it I was hooked!  I've added it to sandwiches, vegetables and different cassaroles--wish they sold it in quart size.  I've carmelized onions and it takes forever!  I love the addition of the fennel-gives a spark to the sweet onions! And the raisins add another sweet note--more chutney like.  I really like this product!

I first puchased a box of this tea at Epcot in Disneyworld on a whim...and I'm so glad I did! Ever since that first box, I've been hooked on this tea (and subsequently got my father hooked on drinking it around the holidays). It's delicious, with just the right amount of spice. Perfect for any tea drinker.
The only thing wrong with this item is that you can only get it at Christmas! All twinings tea are good but this is THE BEST! if you like Chai tea you'll like this tea!

I love this tea and have had a hard time finding it in local stores.  I was thrilled to be able to get it on Amazon.  It's a spicy black tea that is perfect year round even though it's called Christmas Tea.

I've previously had the Twinings loose leaf Christmas Tea, and got this hoping for the same taste in a more convenient package. Unfortunately, these bags have a different formulation, and omit the actual orange peel, cloves, and cinnamon bark of the loose tea. As a consequence, the flavor and smell are much weaker.

I ordered this to give as gifts to friends.  I read such great reviews, and was very happy when I got a reminder that it was again in stock.  I have not tried it personally, but it smells really nice.  It arrived quickly, and was packaged well.  Thanks!

Twinnings is the only blackcurrant tea I have tried that has a true tea flavor merely enhanced by the blackcurrant flavor.  Other brands are more like hot varieties of a child's fruit mixture. If it's blackcurrant TEA you want, this is the brand.

This is an excellent full bodied tea. I tried another major tea brand's black current tea, but it was more of an "herbal" tea. It tasted like more like hot Hawaiian punch than tea. When you drink the Twining's, you know your drinking a lovely black tea.
Great tea the flavor is wonderful hot or as iced tea any time of day.  I will continue to order this flavor.

Twinings Blackcurrant Tea is a wonderful product....full-flavored and quite delicious.  Not always easy to find in supermarkets but well worth the search when found.  We go through it very fast around here.

Twinings Blackcurrant Black Tea is one of the very few flavored teas that I like. Too many of these teas have a strong, artificial taste that spoils them for me. According to the label, the ingredients are "black tea, natural & artificial flavour, and blackcurrent pieces." To my senses, the aroma and taste are just fine, with little or no hint of any artificial ingredients.I've been drinking about two cups a day for about a year, and I still love the great aroma and slightly sweet taste of this tea. If you like flavored teas, this one is definitely worth trying.
I really like this sauce.  I use it on almost everything.  Fresh Market used to carry this in their store in Charlotte, NC but not longer does.  I was so happy to find it on line.  Great product!!!!
I gave these out to the folks at work for Halloween.  They were an unexpected hit!  Everyone was making comments about not having Pixy Stix since the were a kid.

column9: Quite possibly the best candy you will ever taste!
column10: Enstrem's Toffee is absolutely the best candy I have ever eaten.  When I was a kid living in Grand Junction, Colorado (the home also of Enstrem's) my parents used to get a box of this every year at Christmas.  Needless to say the box would not last very long.  This is thick, rich, and buttery toffee at its finest.  Whole almonds inside this delicious toffee make for the excellent crunch and the crushed almonds and milk chocolate on the top is beyond yummy!  After you eat this awesomeness, there is the crushed almonds, bits of the toffee and chocolate, at the bottom of the box.  You literally have to shake the box of these delicious crumbs in your mouth!  Enstrems has become world famous not only for their toffee but for their chocolate, hard candy, and so much other delicious candy.  They have shops in Colorado from Grand Junciton to Colorado Springs.  It is now easy to order Enstrem's off the internet and their website is outstanding!  I order at least a pound of this delicious toffee every Christmas and have to be careful not to order it every month of the year!  But, I just torture myself and wait to Christmas to order this.  I can't recommend this delicious candy enough!  5 stars and more!!  HIGHLY RECOMMENDED DELICIOUSNESS!

column9: You will eat the whole box.
column10: I love this toffee and buy it for friends during the holidays. It is the best toffee, buttery, crunchy sweet goodness. ok, I'm about to order some more. Their peppermint bark is delicious too.

column9: Eat this and you will find God
column10: I remember about 30+ years ago my brother in law (then my sister's boyfriend) came home from a trip with his folks. He brought over a 3 lb box of this funny looking, broken up bits of chocolate-covered something, dusted in powdered sugar and crushed almonds. I grabbed a small piece and popped it in my mouth. At that point and time I heard the sound of singing angels, cherubs buzzed around my head and I was transported to a large golden gate that opened before me. Behind it was a beautiful old man with a long white beard who stood there with his arms folded and a smirk on his face."Well," he said, "whudja think?""Decadent," I said.He laughed, "yeah, I know."
About half this box of toffee had such a burnt flavor it had to be thrown out.  Very disappointing.  I cannot recommend this product.
Great Cookies, I really like that they are not only great tasting but chewy and not the usual dry stuff that passes for sugar free with many other brands.

column9: best olive oil produced in the US
column10: Bariani is rated the best olive oil produced in the US.  I have been ordering for about 8 years.  The truffle oil is even better than the regular oil.  I just had some on a piece of costco whole grain bread.  It is really like a dessert.  If you order direct from bariani it is only $15.  I just got 2 bottles of their green olive oil and the truffle yesterday.  It makes all other olive oils taste mediocre.  At least that is my opinion.  Or, you can order some olive oil from some winery in CA and pay $50-200 if that makes you think you are getting better oil.[...]  I give it as gifts.  And, I  detest people selling olive oil for $100 for a small bottle when you can buy the best for 1/4 that.

I had been looking everywhere for Chew Lotta Bones and finally ordered them through Amazon.  My Standard Poodle, Mocha Java, is a "power chewer" and these last her about an hour. Does she ever love them!!!  They are a bit pricey ($3 each) so next time I hope I can order the medium sized ones.
This is my Dogs' FAV!  I can get them to mind and do anything I have taught them which they prefer not to do.  It keeps them quite for hours.

My dogs go nuts when they see the package..  They absolutely love these bones.  Both my dogs are large and the small/medium size is the perfect size for them.  The large size was too big.  One dog, an older dog, couldn't bite into it- it was just too large.  A good price and prompt delivery

Chew-Lotta Edible Dog Snack, Small (5 Ounce) Bone, 2-Count Small/Medium Bones (Pack of 5) this is one of my boston`s favorite treats and are usually hard to find locally,however they are far less expensive and available at amazon.

My dog has a hx. of pancreatitis.  She cannot eat anything with a high fat content (i.e. pig ears).  Her stomach is also very senistive and a lot of other bones and dog chews give her terrible diarrhea.  The Chew-Lotta bones have been a God send for us.  She loves to chew and she gets one Chew-Lotta every week.  She tolerates them well and they usually last for 2-3 days.  This is the best dog treat I've found.

This was larger than I realized (my fault). I wish it was about half the size. This is more like a meal than a treat, at least for a mid to large sized dog. My lab went through hers within minutes, so it's not a long chew, just a very large treat. She loved it, but I won't buy it again only because I think it was just too much treat for her size (she's 80 lbs).
We have a black lab that gets a Chew-Lotta bone once a week. She enjoys it and it satisfies her need to gnaw and chew - at least for awhile!

We have a chew fan, but so many are unsafe.  Used to buy Booda Velvets, until they "reformulated" them.  Used to take 3-4 DAYS for my pup to chew up one of them, now it's about 20 minutes, so haven't bought them since.  Tried Chew Lotta and she doesn't finish it at one sitting, which I really like, these are a LOT less pricey than the Booda ones.  My only gripe is I wish they had a "petite" size for small dogs, it'd be perfect for my small dog.  But try these, they last a long time and they are SAFE!!!
My bigger dog can get through one of these pretty quick, but it does last a lot longer - just like the package says.  I have to say this is both of my dogs all time favorite treat!
My dog loves the Chew-Lotta, a lotta. She chooses them over Denta-Stix and Greenies, but doesn't like them as much as Chew-Eez dog treats.

column9: Mellow Coffee with a New York Attitude
column10: I received a sampler of Brooklyn Brewery's K-cup coffee and probably tried half of them within two days. I love the names of their flavors and I had no problem with any of the K-cups as some stated below. I found the flavors of the coffees to be light and mellow. I found it to be a good choice for a later morning and afternoon cup of joe. For my morning cup I am sticking with Revv.
Absolutely loved the coffee.  The maple was my favorite of the flavors!  Most of the flavors were very smooth--just what I look for in my coffee.
I got a variety pack and so far every one I've tried has been great! I would definitely buy this again!
This is amazing coffee, you won't be disappointed! Try the variety pack - it comes with some really nice flavors options!

column9: Tasty coffee-- great price from Amazon.
column10: This coffee selection is very rich and tasty.  The French Roast is more full-bodied but not at all bitter and too strong.  Very tasty.  I have been ordering my K-Cups from Amazon for awhile because they are about the cheapest anywhere and I don't have to pay for shipping and I safe so much money.  Plus I have more flavor choices.
Excellent..nice and robust. It was also a great value. Do they make a decaf?  I hope you will continue carrying it.
I AM A DARK ROAST KIND OF COFFEE DRINKER AND NOT A FAN OF FLAVORED COFFEES. I AM REALLY ENJOYING THE DIFFERENT BLENDS OF COFFEE IN THE VARIETY BOX. I AM VERY SATISFIED WITH WHAT I PURCHASED.
Received my free K cups as a sample promotion and LOVE them. I have at least one a day at work!!!!

I really like this coffee myself. I didn't get any issues with the actual cups and the flavor of the Maple Syrup one is awesome it actually really tastes like maple syrup. These are not overpriced either which is nice. I just sent a text to my mom recomending them as we are both coffee junkies. I also when reading through these reviews saw their responses to bad reviews and think it is great they are trying to address the issues they initially had with each of the customers who had an issue. Overall a good product for a very reasonable price.

We loved this variety pack. My husband likes flavored coffee and I love strong coffee. (I know, it's strange) generally, we have a hard time ordering coffee to keep everyone happy. This really did the trick. We will be subscribing to this monthly.

I was very excited to try these K Cups with the great names and designs for the K cups because I have been to brooklyn many times. The coffee was so weak, I tried every flavor in the variety pack, they all taste very weak and similar. I tried them with milk as well as black and same result. The quality of the K cups is terrible, they have destroyed my B70 brewer one of the K cups lid came off and coffee is all over inside my brewer, I cannot clean it. So now everytime I brew coffee or tea, coffee grinds end up in my cup.So now I have to replace my brewer, all because the cute designs sucked me in to thinking this was going to be good coffee. Beware folks, the coffee is weak and the K cups are not like the regular K cups you can buy anywhere. They are not engineered the same, you will see when you brew your first cup. Hopefully you do not have the problems that I had and end up having to replace your Keurig brewer.

column9: Got the variety pack - even the DECAF is great!
column10: Thought I'd try the "Brooklyn Beans Variety Pack K-Cups, 40-Count", and I'm really glad I did.  All of the blends/varieties included in this pack that I've tried so far have been really good - even the decaf (which in my experience tends to be both weak and bitter - but THIS version of decaf is actually really, really good!).Some of the blends ARE stronger than others, and it's kind of obvious which ones would be.  But overall, I haven't noticed any bitterness or burnt aftertaste (like you'd find from a certain major coffeehouse chain), and I haven't had ANY problems with the K-cups during brewing or whatever.I would not, however, suggest the "Maple" flavor (it seemed more a combo of hazelnut and caramel than maple), but then, I don't particularly like flavored coffees anyway.The rest of the non-flavored varieties are really good, not bitter, not burnt, don't taste like they've been swept up off the grinding room floor, don't smell like they've been left exposed to open air for a month, and have a great "mouth feel" (if you're a snob and try to care about such things).Did I mention that the decaf is actually good?  Yeah - it really is.
Great tasting coffee. As to mishaps with K-Cups NONE they are performing as they should.This coffee is the closest to perked coffee I have tried so far
I was disappointed with these K-cups; they were nowhere as good at most of them I have ordered from Amazon.  I would not order again.

With the price of k-cups going the way of gasoline, I thought I would give this deal a try. Who would of thought you could get a great cup of coffee with the name Fuggedaboudit. If you want a full flavored cup of great coffee than this is the one. This is a very aromatic, smooth, strong cup of java without a bitter taste. I would put this right up against the best. Thank you!

column9: Of the Brooklyn's this was strongest
column10: Tried Brooklyn Bridge, Fuggetaboutit and cyclone.  Cyclone was the only one strong enough for me--but still short of Dark Magic (green mountain).
I LOVE THIS COFFEE. I am not a huge coffee drinker but I really love these flavors. Highly recommend it.

column9: Yummy!!! One of the best cups I have had
column10: One of the best cups I have had. The variety was great. Better than Starbucks and the other brands of k-cups.
THIS COFFEE IS AS GOOD, IF NOT BETTER THAN THE EXPENSIVE STUFF! FORGET THOSE, GET THIS PRODUCT!! GOOD VARIETY TOO!

column9: Not a coffee drinker, but even I like these
column10: I am normally the last person in the world to willingly drink a cup of coffee, but I was at a friend's house and they made a cup of Vanilla Skyline and it smelled so good I shocked myself by asking for a cup.  Not only that, I drank it straight up!  No milk, no sugar, just the coffee as it came out of the machine!I am now pestering my husband to get one of the machines, but in the meantime I find myself carpooling with her and spending more time at her place than ever before.  I hope she will not be lonely once I finally get my husband to cave and get me a machine of my own.

Their Colombian is by far the BEST Colombian I have ever had, very complex in taste with sweet and nutty undertones.French Roast is usually not high on my list, but Brooklyn's is astounding! It doesn't display the bitterness that I usually find with other French Roasts, and makes an excellent dark roast after dinner coffee.In short, we're so fond of Brooklyn Bean coffees, all of them so far, that it really is a tough choice to shop for a single box of any one blend. This is why you should really try the variety packs! Keep up the great work, Brooklyn, I predict that this will soon be the #1 K-cup coffee on the planet!

Hi,I have only tried two flavors, so I can not speak about all their products, but this coffee is great. I have had my Keurig for over 2 years now and I have been using Brooklyn Bean Roastery Coffee, as well as the brands, with no problem. I am so glad someone has finally upped the cup amount to 40 per package, I would like even a little more. I like it even better that I can order it via Prime. Now I get more great coffee and Free Shipping. What could be better. The two flavors I like are darker roasts, so some may not like this type, but for those who love really dark roasted coffee, this is the way to go.Cyclone is a a very heavy roast, which is great for the monrning for me. I use it as a quick pick me up. I have never had any issue and they taste great. I got French Roast one time because the Cyclone was sold out. It was slightly less dark, but still dark enough for my tastes. I think I will get one order of the Variety Packs, when they are not sold out, next time. This way I can try them all and figure out if any of the others can match my current experiences.
amazing coffee, with good variety, minimal repeats, good company, good price, i'm gonna order more today!! even the lavored ones are good and i generally do not like or buy flavored coffess

I've been reading all the reviews on Brooklyn Bean Roastery Coffee for weeks now. I've read the horror stories about exploding K Cups and fouled Keurig Coffee Makers.  But I also read the quick responses from the Manufacturer and the mostly positive comments about the taste of the coffee. It looks like the problem with the K-cups has been corrected (though there may be a few older K-Cups still floating around). So, I finally decided to "pull the trigger" and try the Brooklyn Bean Roastery Coffee "Corner Donut Shop" K-Cups. I am happy to report my family and I love it.  Following the advice of a reviewer, we make sure we firmly close the lid on the Keurig machine to make certain the cup is punctured.  So far, no problems with the K-cups. As far as our family taste goes, this is good coffee.  It tastes different from the other coffee shop brands, but is an excellent, medium blend. The taste and the price make Brooklyn Bean Roastery Coffee a winner, in my opinion (and that of my wife and 2 sons).  I look forward to trying some of the other BBR blends and commend the company on its responsiveness to consumer concerns. Give it a try. Hopefully, you will like it as much as we do.10/7/12 Have used most of a box of 40 K-cups, zero product failures!

column9: Brooklyn Bean Roastery Breakfast Blend K-Cups
column10: Brooklyn Bean Roastery Blend K-Cups are great tasting coffee. I like the Breakfast blend flavor the best, it is light tasting and it surprised me how fast it wakes you up. The dark roasts Fudgeddaboutit and Cyclone have a stronger rich flavor. I think the donut shop and maple flavor is sweet flavored and light which is good in coffee. The Brooklyn Bridge is a good well balanced coffee. I think the Breakfast Blend flavor is the best flavor and it wakes you up quickly.

column9: Small K-Cups that pack some serious flavor
column10: I really enjoy a good cup of coffee and with Brooklyn Beans French Roast K-cups,I get more than just a good cup of coffee,I get a great tasting,full flavor cup of the best coffee,period.I have tried many others,but they just don't compare to Brooklyn Bean French Roast coffee.I totally recommend this brand and flavor to all of the coffee lovers out there.

Been looking for a vanilla k-cup coffee for awhile now.  Have tried many of the French Vanilla k-cups out there but really enjoy a plain vanilla coffee.  The box arrived yesterday(8/25/2012) and so far I have not been able to stop drinking them.  The vanilla k-cups is a perfect blend of vanilla and a strong coffee.  I drink my coffee black and do not add any artificial flavorings to it.  I will be ordering another box or two as this box won't last.  Finally, a vanilla coffee that is strong as has a true vanilla taste.

Brooklyn Bean Roastery provides great quality k cups to coffee lovers! Boardwalk blend and Cyclone are great for dark bold blend lovers like myself! Take a chance on this new company, you won't be disappointed!

I was extremely impressed with the smooth, robust flavor of the coffees manufactured by Brooklyn Beans. No bitterness, just smooth, strong, flavorful coffees. No matter if I used a large cup setting or small, the coffees were amazing!
This is a nice bold flavorful coffee. I like mine over ice, which tends to water down the flavor of most coffees but not this one!

I happened upon this brand of K-cups on another website that offers weekly specials in different categories.  Wanting to get out of my usual 2 flavors of K-cups that I always drink, I thought I'd give this company a go.  So, I tried their Corner Donut Shop and Vanilla Skyline varieties.  The Corner Donut Shop coffee blew me away!  I love another brand's donut shop k-cups, but this one just has a better flavor.  My sister raves about the Vanilla Skyline.  Not being much of a flavored coffee person, I wasn't as crazy about it.  But, rest assured, my sister loves flavored coffees, and she went wild over it.  This time, I'm getting more of the Corner Donut Shop stuff, and I'm trying the Brooklyn Bridge type too.  I look forward to getting it!

I was a bit skeptical at getting another brand than Green Mountain brands, since Grove Square and San Fran Bay were really bad. Besides the original problem they had with the production on their first boxes, Brooklyn Beans have been a great new find for us. I could go through each blend, but they are all similar to other GMCR brands. The k cups seem a little lighter in weight and the lighter roasts  did seem watery for the travel cup size, but that is about the norm with all k cups. The best thing I really like is the company actually responds and fixes any problems. So, stop complaining about the shipping when you are leaving feedback on the product! (I always get my shipments at least 2 days ahead of scheduled date.) So, don't be afraid to try these and save money. Subscribe and save another 5%.

column9: The best part of waking up is Brooklyn Beans in my cup
column10: I love the Vanilla Skyline brewed over ice cubes for breakfast drink. The rich and mellow taste is a delight and gets me ready for what ever challenges the day may offer.

I am the happy recipient of a NICE sized sampler box of the Vanilla Skyline coffee, which is absolutely delicious. The aroma that fills my kitchen while I am brewing it pales in comparison to the delicious flavor of taking that first sip. I am thoroughly enjoying this coffee and look forward to trying the other flavors available. Thank you so much for being so generous with your samples, and letting me be lucky enough to win one!
Love this coffee . No problems brewing .Cannot beat the price realy good coffee and afordable.customer service was top notch .We raise our coffee cup to you
I really liked the fughettaboutit and the donut shop blend. Good cup of coffee and a better value than Green Mountain or Starbucks.

Brooklyn Bean's hazelnut has a strong aroma, but it's a little weak on our Keurig's high setting.  I'd rate it slightly above Gloria Jean's, but it's not, alas, as strong as the Green Mountain or Timothy's hazelnuts I've had, and is nowhere close to Van Houtte, who I think makes the best hazelnut k-cup.  On the other hand, the BB's are (currently) cheaper than the afore-mentioned.  On the other foot, though, k-cups costing more than $.050/ea just aren't worth it IMHO unless you only drink a single cup a day or never leave the house - it's Wawa city around here and their hazelnut is VERY good, and cheaper per quart.It's too bad, 'cause I like the Brooklyn Bean coffees we've had - Colombian, Donut Shop, and Boardwalk Blend - decent medium blends.  I've never had the exploding pod problem some people speak of.  I'd like to support the company, but economic pressures are pushing the Keurig off our kitchen counter generally!
I'm not saying I'm the greatest judge ever, but I sort of am. This is good stuff. Enough said, buy it.

column9: One of the best coffees I have ever drunk!!!
column10: When I was first introduced to the this coffee, I was sceptical, wondering will this live up to my expectations?  But after a few cups of Brooklyn Beans Roastery, I was hooked and now I cannot function without my cup of BBR!

Working long hours is made much more enjoyable with this tasty coffee from BK. I am a big fan of the Brooklyn Bridge Blend. It's a great medium roast. Not too strong like some of the dark roasts people like but still has a nice full body. If you're tired of so-so coffee from your Keurig, look no further. Get the real stuff from these guys.
Tried Brooklyn Bean coffees for the first time this week and love, love, love all the flavors.  Especially Vanilla Skyline and Fuhgeddaboudit! Will definitely order again!

This coffee is great. I enjoy having this coffee early in the morning.The coffee aroma and flavor are incredible and gets me going in the morning. I would recommend Brooklyn Beans Brooklyn Bridge Blend for people who like a full bodied medium roast to start their day!
I drink about 40 ounces of coffee a day. Switching to brooklyn is the best move I've made. No more messing with my grinder and it's delicious to boot!
I'm a die hard Starbucks fan and these tasted even better! the price is great too! i recommend to anyone who loves great coffee.
I really enjoyed this coffee. It is not too strong, not too weak, but just right.  It is not always easy to find good coffee. The price is good too. I strongly recommend this product.

Being a real coffee lover I bought Brooklyn Beans just to give it a shot, Wow! was I blown away it beats any other Keurig coffee I have tasted including Green Mountain Starbucks and Dunkin Donuts. I would recommend it to anyone interested in a real good coffe. I had noproblem using my Keurig machines. Great job Brooklyn! Keep it up!

Great flavor. The variety pack comes with various flavors and each one is better then the next. Great coffee company! Go Brooklyn K Kups (and that is a big complement coming from a Seattle girl who grew up drinking from the best coffee houses around).

I was lucky enough to win this coffee. It is so smooth and delicious. I recommend it to anyone who doesn't like bitter coffee. I look forward to trying all the flavors when the variety pack is back in stock.

column9: you will not forget this coffee
column10: Wow Love this coffee.  Bought it for the memories and the cute names.  Will buy it again for the great taste.  Medium to bold roasts that make an enjoyable cup of coffee
Tasty coffee. All selections are solid. I especially liked the Brooklyn Bridge Blend and the Cyclone blend.Good value for the money.
The Brooklyn Beans Variety Pack K-cups is delicious and tasty! We really enjoyed the different varieties and the different flavors!!

column9: Best coffee in a very long time!
column10: I have been sick of the flavors out on the market for Keurig machines. Brooklyn Bean coffee flavors are so much more bold and flavorful. In addition, they actually have enough caffeine to wake me up! Other Keurig flavored brands are too "light". Highly recommended.

column9: Finding Your Roast is the Ticket to Bliss
column10: When I first bought my Keurig, it came with a box of assorted K-cups from some more established coffee companies, and I worked my way through the donut blends, the dark, light, and medium roasts, and the decafs.  It came to the point where I was looking forward to finishing off the box because I hadn't found any K-cups that I loved.I bought Brooklyn Beans on the recommendation of a friend, and I felt that I had hit coffee Nirvana.  I first bought a full box of the Cyclone dark roast, which was the perfect dark roast for me--dark, but not over-roasted, and very rich.  I bought the variety pack so I could try all the varieties.  I'm still working my way through each type of coffee included in the variety pack, and I have a strong preference for a darker roast, but every cup has been smooth and flavorful.  The light roasts are not overly acidic or tannic.  In addition to the Cyclone, I will definitely be a repeat customer for the Fuhgeddaboutit dark roast, and the Maple Sleigh is my pick for best flavored coffee.There have been absolutely no problems with brewing this coffee.  I have gone through a whole 40-count box of Cyclone without any issues with grounds in the cup or problems with the way the cup works in the Keurig.  I've found the taste to be consistent, cup after cup.As an enthusiastic (and picky!) coffee drinker, I say Brooklyn Beans Roastery earns its five stars.
I was very pleased with the selection in this variety pack.  Both the flavors and selection of brews was excellent.
This variety pack coffee from Brooklyn Beans is very good coffee. I enjoyed all flavors.  The price is good,taste is good.  Will be ordering more in the future.
Good taste with a medium flavor......not too strong, just right. Great coffee to wake up to every morning. Great buy!

column9: A great way to sample new K-cups - "Brooklyn Beans"
column10: This is the first time I've tried Brooklyn Beans and so far the selection has been great.  It's also cheaper than most other K-cups.  "Cyclone" is an excellent dark roast and i found it to be more full-bodied than "Fuhgeddaboutit".  I'm not a big fan of flavored K-cups, but "maple sleigh" wasn't bad.  "Breakfast Blend" is a good light roast.  However, I personally dont get "Breakfast Decaf" - if it's my first cup of the morning, I want it to wake me up!  Overall, it offered great variety and allowed me to sample most, if not all, of the Brooklyn Beans K-cups.  I would recommend this.
Great flavor at a reasonable price.  Many varieties to pick from and all have a very good aroma and flavor.  I will purchase more.
as opposed to other Kcups I have bought from Amazon the Brooklyn Beans Colombian was and tastless.I do not recomend it

column9: Coffee is good, some of the Kcups leak
column10: This coffee has great flavor. I do have one issue with the actual Brooklyn Bridge Kcups. Several of the lids come unsealed during brewing. This results in coffee and coffee grinds spewing out the side of the coffee maker.

column9: Good taste, but found grounds in my coffee
column10: Coffee tastes good, but grounds in the coffee, not so good.  Never experienced with other K-Cup products.  Will try a few more before cancelling my Subscribe and Save Subscription.  Too bad - great price!

column9: The BEST coffee you'll ever brew in your K-Cup brewer, hands down!
column10: I was pleased to win a sampler box of Brooklyn Bean Roastery's eight most popular varieties (2 of each) in a contest promotion, and I can't say enough wonderful things about this ambitious new company's offerings.  The quality of the coffee is top notch, and the blend variety is mesmerizing.  It's SO good, in fact, that it's really hard to pick favorites, which is why I think that the most brilliant thing Brooklyn Bean did, is offer a VARIETY PACK!  After all, not every one wants the same exact coffee, cup after cup.  Variety is what makes life interesting, does it not?Brooklyn Bridge Blend was the first one I tried, and my personal favorite.  It's a delightful medium roast that delights any time of day or evening, with just the right balance of body and flavor.  If I had to choose one coffee to drink for the rest of my life, THIS would be the one.Breakfast Blend paled in comparison, being a light roasted coffee, but was not a standout for me.  My wife thought it was stellar, and she usually prefers dark, strong roasts.Their Colombian is by far the BEST Colombian I have ever had, very complex in taste with sweet and nutty undertones.  Start your day with this, and you'll have a happy day.French Roast is usually not high on my list, but Brooklyn's is astounding!  It doesn't display the bitterness that I usually find with other French Roasts, and makes an excellent dark roast after dinner coffee.Boardwalk Blend is a medium roast, extra bold, that is best made in a larger size cup, 10 or 12 oz, and is also excellent over ice!  It won't knock you out, because it's not overwhelming in any one character, but it's a pleasant, drinkable blend.Corner Donut Shop is unique, in that it's not like any other company's "donut shop" blends for the Keurig type machines.  The flavor is a bit more subtle, and compliments pastries, pies, donuts (of course) any time of day.  This is a relaxing coffee, not one to shake you up, which is a good thing sometimes.  Think of it as the "comfort food" of coffees.  Medium roast, extra bold, make this in a larger size cup, also.Cyclone, named for the iconic Coney Island rollercoaster, is a kick in the pants coffee.  Strong, bold, daring and a thrill-ride of complex, intense flavors, circling your palette, with each sip being a new thrill ride.  Yes, you'll want to ride again!  My wife has called this the "Guinness of coffees", with chocolaty undertones and full-bodied texture.  Definitely make this in a larger cup, being both a dark roast and an extra bold cup.A Brooklyn uniqueness, Fuhgeddaboudit, is another dark roast extra bold blend that leaves no doubt in your mind that you're drinking a cup of COFFEE!  This will wake you up out of a coma, folks!  Only in New York could they possibly come up with something this brash, cosmopolitan and interesting.In short, we're so fond of Brooklyn Bean coffees, all of them so far, that it really is a tough choice to shop for a single box of any one blend.  This is why you should really try the variety packs!  Keep up the great work, Brooklyn, I predict that this will soon be the #1 K-cup coffee on the planet!

I received my order of 40 of the Brooklyn Beans Brooklyn Bridge K-cups yesterday, and we first tried them this morning. I don't care for the flavor, and I'm not sure what to compare it to except it has a bit of a "cardboard" taste, I think. It certainly does not care to Green Mountain's Nantucket, in my estimation. In addition, two of the 4 k-cups we used today did not give a steady stream of coffee, but squirted out in an erratic manner. I am disappointed.

If you want coffee grounds floating in every cup of coffee, and K-cups that explode open in your Keurig, then this product is for you. I have used about a dozen of these K-cups so far, and about half have come open inside my Keurig, with the top foil seal coming off and the water and grounds going everywhere. The other half stayed sealed, but I still get a lot of coffee grounds floating in my coffee.The inner constuction and filter must be defective as well. The manufacture of these K-cups is somehow inferior to Green Mountain and others. The taste of the coffee is irrelevant when the K-cups don't work. I have used many other different K-cups, Tully's, Donut Shop, Emeril's, Starbucks, Green Mountain,Timothy's, Caribou, etc. and never had any problems. I should have heeded the other reviews that stated the same problems, and not believed the company's claim that these problems were resolved. I now have a partial box of unusable K-cups.

First off - disappointed with the false "Prime Shipping". I ordered this on 8/9 thinking I would get it before my vacation on 8/12. It came on 8/13 after I was already gone - if that was the case I would have ordered it when I returned.So I tried this product, despite the reviews and it exploded for me also. I used Cyclone first - it started coming out fine then began to squirt all over. When the K-Cup exploded, the foil opened on the side of the cup. What I noticed when I opened the box was that the foil that seals the K-Cups were not properly attached to them. They did not go all the way to the ends of the cups (like all the other brands I compared them too). Also, they were not sealed tight with the bubble on the top (like the other brands I have) which tells me they are not sealed properly.I am disappointed. The taste is OK (that's the 2 stars) but the poor design is frustrating and messy. POOR DESIGN!I will not order these again. I am not even sure I will use what I have or if I will attempt to return them.

I purchased the Boardwalk Blend because it was described as being a flavor match with Newman's Own (which I like very much). It wasn't a match. It didn't have much taste and had no aroma at all. Its taste most resembled the flat-tasting stuff that came out of my pot-and-filter coffee maker, and that's what I was trying to get away from with the K-cup machine.Immediately after I tasted this coffee, I made a cup of Newman's Own to be sure I wasn't being too critical. I was not. It's definitely not a flavor match.I am all for as much competition in the K-cup market as possible (so their prices might finally come down). But Brooklyn Beans is going to have to try harder if it wants to stay in that competition.

Over the last year we've tried to up our "coffee cred" at work. I purchased an Aeropress here on Amazon and we've been making amazing coffee ever since. The problem is it takes a little bit of time and some mornings you are running late for meetings and need something fast. We've started experimenting with Kcups for those quite pick-me-ups. I've tried almost every brand and flavor so far and Brooklyn is by far one of the worst! Terrible quality and taste. Flat and bland coffee. Don't waste your time.
Stale Coffee. Foil lid does not stay intact and gets grounds all over...apparently they did not have this issue fixed like they stated.
Ok, but tastes like maxwell house.  Does not have the rich flavor I expect from a bold.  Lacks complexity and depth that I would expect from a specialty coffee.

column9: If you like strong and flavorfull coffee, don't buy Brooklyn Beans
column10: Don't believe the hype about this coffee being strong and flavorfull. I was looking for new options besides Jetfuel, Emeril's Big and Bold, and Donut House, and thought BB would be the one, based on the reviews. I'm not sure what coffee they got, but the Fuggedaboutit and Cyclone are both really weak and without much flavor. I even tried the smallest size setting, thinking it might make the coffee more concentrated, but it was still weak and dissapointing. I can't speak for the other coffee, but Fuggedaboudit and Cyclone were a waste of my money. I have a machine at home and at work, so I will just take them to work as an option for people who like weaker coffees.
THIS COFFEE IS STRONG BUT NO FLAVOR, NO TASTE, NO AROMA. POOR CHOICE DO NOT TRY.  I WOULD NOT RECOMMEND TO PURCHASE.

First of all, the shipping of this item was VERY SLOW!  I had to purchase additional k-cups from the grocery store because this item had not arrived.  It was a day later than what the estimated arrival showed.  Usually everything I order from Amazon is earlier than expected.Secondly, this coffee did not have a good taste.  It was very weak; as if it had been watered down.  This was the Brooklyn Bridge flavor and after reading some good reviews about it, I was very disappointed.  My husband also commented that he could not drink this.Needless to say, I have cancelled my automatic subscription.  I guess it is true; you get what you pay for.
The coffee itself is alright, but every cup I've brewed (about 10 so far) have had grounds in it. I wouldn't buy this again.

column9: Not a robust cup of coffee
column10: As someone who likes a strong cup of coffee, the Brooklyn brand just doesn't do it for me.  The flavor is great, but it ends up being more like tea than coffee.

I had high hopes for this coffee after reading some of the reviews; although some of the reviews were not so favorable either. I should have taken those into account before ordering this coffee. This coffee was awful. I tried it a few times on different water settings on my Keurig thinking that maybe a lower setting would help. Maybe a little, but certainly not much. It was bland and had hardly any flavor. I won't be ordering this coffee again.

If you like weak or watered down coffee, then this is the product for you.One of the flavors I tried was not too bad but the second one of the same flavor was completely different.  There seems to be no uniform, some being very weak and others week.  The coffee is just bland.  Nothing you can do with it.Just don't waste your money on this product.  The cheapest regular low price coffee would be better than this.

Nothing special here, barely any taste at all.  I recieved a few of these in a K Cup sampler.  Definitely on the bottom of my list so far (and I'm from New York!).  Caribou Mahoganey or Barista Prima Italian Roast are on top of my reorder list, smooth bold taste, very flavorable.  The Brooklyn Beans samples (Breakfast and Bridge samples) are weak, no difference between the two.
Not only did the K-cup explode, after i strained the coffee, when i tasted it, it tasted like the water in my universities salinated pool.

Don't know if it's deliberate, or just a bad batch, but the diameter of these cups is a different size from  all the other brands we use. The grounds consistently got into the cup ruining the coffee, and causing a mess in the machine to clean up. We threw away the last 10 or 12 pods.

Purchased two 40 count boxes, gave them both away, not sure the people even consumed it.  Product says bold but on the half cup it was the color of the weakest tea so you can imagine what it looked like on a full cup.  I am so sorry I purchased this brand and now I am out of the money for it.  It was even hard for me to give it away.  I drink 3 to 4 cups a day and this was the worst I have ever purchased from Amazon.  If you like bold flavor, stay away from this brand.  Coffee grounds also surfaced in the cup, I don't what happened to these two boxes, but I recommend that people who like coffee as much as I do, STAY AWAY.  Ann Glasscock
This coffee is not near as robust as I would like.  I have had coffee at donut shops, and this wasn't it.
My husband and I both disliked the flavor of this coffee--what flavor there was.  It was weak and tasteless.  We threw the rest of the box away.

Brooklyn Beans Breakfast Blend Decaf K-cups: tasty coffee. However, k-cups were not full enough, making brewed coffee TOO WEAK. I had to use 2 k-cups per large size coffee cup. After all, it is breakfast!!
Its hard to find a k.cup is not acidic like most green mountain products . This coffee is flavorful and mild. Goes well with breakfast.

I purchased the hazelnut pods and the coffee tastes great, however, some pods open up while brewing allowing grinds to get in your coffee as well as all over your coffee maker. I had to run water through the coffeemaker 2 or 3 times to clean it out. As much as I like the coffee, I won't purchase again as I've never had this issue before with other coffee brands.

I purchased the variety pack excited to try all of the great sounding flavors, and now that I've tried them all, I'm appalled that Amazon even allows this garbage to be sold.  This is, by far, the worst coffee I've ever tried.  They all taste exactly the same.  Like dirty water with a hint of mocha.  I don't know if these are instant coffee rather than real beans like some others have tried to sell here, but this stuff is just awful.Do yourself a favor, don't ever try this stuff.  Regardless of how cheap they make it or how appealingly their friends review it, don't waste one penny on this stuff.To qualify my opinion, I've tried just about every k-cup out there - thousands and thousands of k-cups have gone through my machines in my office and at home.  I can tell you which brands are stronger in general and which are weak.  I can produce a review for just about every k-cup flavor immediately, including the teas, hot chocolates, iced coffees, etc.  Really, I've tried it all.  I've even tried (and been much more satisfied with) k-cups that were expired for over two years.And this coffee is several notches below the worst I've ever tried.  Every flavor.  Just unbelievably bad.Avoid it.
Althought this a nice tasting coffee, like a strong roast, it DOES NOT taste at all like Maple.  Too bad, now I have 40 more regular k cups!!!Brooklyn Beans Maple K-Cups, 40-Count

column9: Rarely give negative reviews...but if I could return this nasty stuff I would!
column10: I love a good cup of coffee....such as REVV, Jet Fuel,Tigers Eye or any of the Caribou flavors here on Amazon.....I got an Email with this coffee featured and thought...what the heck? Lets try it....what a waste of money. wish I could send it back...gave the remainder to a co-worker who even said...'can I toss it?'  Don't get me wrong...I did try each and every flavor....there was one that was ok...but most of them burst open in my keurig before the coffee even was finished.  Plus a few of them shot coffee grounds right into the coffee cup as it was being made.  I like my coffee bold but not bitter...so I tend to be picky, however, I will drink other strengths as well...no matter which one I tried, it was bland...boring....and I lost $24  on this terrible stuff.  Wish we could get our money back...but I won't be purchasing this brand ever again.  Hey, at least I gave it a try!

I received the pods and after several days am very disappointed. Several of the pods I've used are defective.......they do not brew the appropriate size coffee (pressing the largest cup size I get less than a quarter cup), it comes out in single drips from the very start of the brewing process and many, many grinds in my cup. Now,I don't want to us the remaining pods (I never know which will brew as described) for fear of breaking my Keurig brewer.Having grown up in Brooklyn I was very anxious to try these Keurig pods. I loved the packaging design and the fact that it was  avariety pack. That's where it ends.

I LOVE the taste of this coffee...bought the Cyclone.  I have made either 4 or 5 and 2 have exploded and made a mess in my Keurig and all over my counter.  I now see that that was a problem in the past, which I hadn't noticed--however the company says it is fixed.  I am definitely having some issues, which is too bad because I really like the coffee.  Would have given it 5 stars if I didn't have to clean up such a mess.  Now I have a bunch of cups that I don't know if I should make or not?

I'm not a Coffee or Wine Snob, but I do live in Starbucksville, Washington State, so I enjoy a nice cup of Coffee, and this particular roast is nice.No problems with the top coming off as others have commented on.  I did notice that with most other K-cups the lid is Convex, this one is Concaved, but is attached well, and does not leak.Pretty Good - Medium Roast Coffee !

I have tried all of the Brooklyn Bean coffee except the flavored ones and they are all good. I usually go for light or medium roasted because the dark roasts always taste "burnt" to me. The Cyclone is a dark roast, however it is so smooth and very flavorful without any bitter taste...It's really my favorite unflavored coffee!!

I was skeptical about ordering what with the trouble of the cups exploding, but I didn't have any of that trouble. I did find, however, that it just wasn't full-bodied enough for me.  It left me wanting.  I can usually brew an 8 oz cup from my K-cups but truthfully even brewing at 6 oz I still didn't get the rich flavor I craved. So I've been finishing up the box by brewing it at 2 or 4 oz and adding a different K-cup brand to the mug.  I'd stir clear of this one.

column9: Good coffee makes for a great morning.
column10: I was very happy to find this deal.  Good price and excellent coffee. Gets my morning off to a good start.

column9: No coffe ground in my cup
column10: I have read the reviews and noticed some complaints of coffee ground residual left after brewing. I have tried ALL of the blends and I have not had a single problem.My kuerig is over a year old and I can honestly say this coffee is very good and a reasonable price!I was so thrilled when the new hazelnut flavor came out and it is very flavor filled and  no unpleasant aftertaste. I give it a solid 4 as the only way it would get a 5 is if I brewed a whole pot and I can't with my k-cupsBUY !! you will not be sorry
We enjoyed the Brooklyn K Cups very much. The price was right and it was very convenient to receive by mail. We would definitely consider ordering again.

I won a pack of the Hazelnut K-cups from Brooklyn Bean Roasters. I was so excited to try it! I was very happy with it! The taste is very good, not too strong, but enough to taste wonderful. I would highly recommend the Hazelnut to any coffee lover. Brooklyn Bean Roasters is an amazing company as well and is really focused on their customers!
I received my k-cups Hazelnut flavored coffee and I found the taste fantastic and still love your other flavors too
This is exactly the taste i needed. Friendly people helping me decide from the vast amount of choices.Wake up in Brooklyn with a taste of Brooklyn!
Fast delivery and good value.  However, did not fulfull the taste and strength.  Most French Roast blends have a distinctive flavor and are very bold tasting, this one did not.

I loved this coffee! I liked the taste a lot. It was not too strong and not too light. Their flavors were great. I don't usually like flavored coffee but they pulled it off well. Especially the maple flavored!

column9: I wish this could be a better review
column10: I purchased this variety pack hoping to discover some new K cups.  But this variety pack was a big let down..  The only one I enjoyed, was the Maple Flavored one.  The other coffee flavors tasted very weak to me.  Also, I always had coffee grinds in the bottom of my cup when brewing.  I won't be buying these again..

This coffee bears NO resemblance to Jet Fuel (as they advertise). The first indicator was the weight of each pod - they are noticeably lighter weight and sure enough the coffee is very watery tasting.I can understand why you can't return food items, but now I'm stuck with 80 of these weaklings!If bold coffee is what you're after you should definitely "fuggedaboud" this one.
These were very reasonably priced compared to other k-cups which is why I tried them. Not as strong in flavor but still very good. Will buy them again.

column9: Most excellent selection of Brooklyn coffees
column10: Love all the real coffees especially CycloneLike my coffee to taste like coffee no extra flavorings necessary20 words not necessary -this coffee is excellentTry it

column9: Coffee or a taste of heaven?
column10: This coffee is absolutely fantastic. The varieties are superb and the aroma is intoxicating. The price can't be beat for such high quality roasts as these. Who made this stuff? Ohhh, Brooklyn Bean Roastery, yeah, love this stuff, Fuggedaboudit.

column9: its ok...not as bold as hoped for
column10: The coffee advertisement seemed to indicate that this would be a bold tasting coffee. Methought it was ok but kind of wimpy tasting

I was disappointed with the flavors and wouldn't purchase from this vendor again.I found the bold coffee selections bland and boring.If you are a fan of more mainstream milder coffee flavors this might be for you.

The coffee did not taste like it was fresh.  The coffee tasted as if it was brewed from stale coffee beans.  I was very disappointed because I expected a good cup of coffee coming from Brooklyn which is where I am from.  I regularly drink Starbucks coffee and have been pleased with all of their varieties I have tried ranging from Verona to the blonde Veranda. These brands taste like fresh brew which is what I look for in a cup of coffee. I will not order from this company again.

I bought my first box of Fuggedaboudit about two months back.  I was only able to have three or four cups out of 12 K-cups of coffee.  The seals would pop off causing the grounds to go everywhere.  This was a huge issue as coffee grounds are one of the most difficult things to get completely cleaned up.I wrote an email to the manufacture about this issue.  They responded promptly and even admitted the issue.  These days it is uncommon for a company to accept responsibility.  This was a step in the right direction.  After apologizing, they told me they were going to send me some coffee out of the new batch.  I expected a couple of cups, instead I received almost a whole months' worth.  They definitely gave me a reason to give them a second try.The new K-Cups work flawlessly.  Every cup is good and the flavor is consistent.  So far I have tried the Fuggedaboudit, Cyclone, and the French Roast.  These are all darker blends which can have a tendency to be bitter, but not these.  They are all very smooth and flavorful.Don't let the bad reviews about the cups scare you away.  The manufacturer has stepped up and fixed the problem.  I will be buying coffee from Brooklyn Bean Roastery again.

column9: Fresh taste, great variety, nice price
column10: The grounds are fresh and you get a nice crisp flavor.  The variety is nice and the price speaks for itself.  I'm becoming a K-cup believer.

column9: Excellent way to start my morning
column10: I ordered these because I was tired of spending all that money on the kuerig cups so I figured I would try something new.  It proved to be an excellent decision.  This coffee tasted delicious, it is a nice medium roast with a really good flavor.  I have at least one cup of it in the morning and one in the afternoon so after only a week am about halfway done with this box and have already ordered another few boxes of it.  And I think I will be adventurous and try out some of the other flavors, cyclone sounds very promising.
I was suprised with the taste of the Brooklyn Beans coffee. The price makes it an excellent value. Ordered shipped and received on time.

I confess I purchased this variety box mostly because of the price.  Seemed like a pretty good deal plus a good way to try out a new brand.I think we've tried mostly every variety by now.  I did farm out the Vanilla and Maple to friends who are much more into flavored coffee so I cant speak to those.  Most of these are of a more mild to medium roast.  They are all pretty tasty.  I haven't had one that I wouldn't try again.  If the price is right, give 'em a try.

I recently received the Boston Beans 40 cup variety pack and tried each one.  The coffee seems weak, although flavor is ok.  Maybe the type of filter in the cup is hindering the full flavor and strength from coming through.  I normally don't like the french roast and dark roast coffees because they're too strong & bitter, but preferred them in this brand because they were strong enough. I was planning on having a regular delivery of the pack, but have cancelled that.  I like having a variety of coffee flavors available for times when people drop over for coffee.I sometimes wash out the k-cups and reuse them, as they contain a filter.  I noticed these have a different type of filter than other k-cups, which could be inhibiting the flavor.  I did refill a couple of these k-cups with a favorite coffee, and the flavor was not as good as in other brand k-cups when refilled.

I tried the Brooklyn Beans Colombian K-cups and found the taste to be pretty smooth.  Once in a while I find a little sediment on the bottom of my cup, but other than that, I'd say they were pretty good for the price.

I read some reviews before buying this product and found some people have had issues with grinds in their coffee. Bklyn Beans stated that they addressed the issue.I received my order last week and I am having problems with the grinds too.Nothing more annoying than having grinds in my coffee.The taste is good but the grinds are not.

This isn't really a review but more of a frustration.  My husband and I are avid coffee drinkers.  We have had our Keurig for about a year now and really like it.  The problem is we often have a hard time finding a coffee we both really like so for us sampler packs work well for us.  We are always looking for new k-cups and were excited at the chance to try these.  The only problem, they wouldn't ship to us.  My husband is serving in the Armed Forces overseas.  We have the standard overseas P.O. Box and normally don't have a problem ordering anything.  I am disappointed we missed out on a chance to try a new coffee company.  Especially since the reviews about this product are so good and the price very reasonable.  I guess I would say to Brooklyn Beans could you work to fix the problem of not shipping to APO/FPO boxes?

I got the sampler pack, and was, in general, very happy with the coffees. I generally prefer my coffee on the intense side (no, not burnt, but with a lot of flavor), so I found the Corner Donut Shop to be too mild for my taste, but Cyclone was much more in line with my preferences.The coffee was all really fresh for a K-Cup. I found the ones marked Extra Bold to have the right amount of taste, while the regulars were passable.Now that I've sampled the variety, I'm ready to move on to the specific blends that match my palate.
This is by far one of their better flavored of coffee from Brooklyn Beans. I would definitely recommend this one.

I just received my 40 k-cup sampler and this coffee is AWESOME!!! Great value and price! I absolutely love love love the Fuhgeddaboutit!!!! Dark, extra bold and chocolate fudge flavor = BLISS!  I usually find that flavored coffees are too light tasting for me but this one does not disappoint! The other varieties are great as well! Keep on Brewing Brooklyn Beans!
Very middle of the road. I might try another Roast of their's. This was for my mother and she likes Colombian coffee and to her this was just OK.

Tried the coffee and liked the aroma and flavor, but the manufacturing of the K cup needs improvement. Nothing is worse than cleaning up the brewer after the seal on the K cup fails and the grounds leak everywhere including the table. This happen on several brews to the point that I was prepared to send the unused product back for a refund.
This is not terrible coffee, but it is on the weak side. I like a mild, smooth cup of coffee, and this isn't it. the Brooklyn beans donut house, which I also tried, was far more flavorful.

So far I have tried The extra bolds - Cylcone, French Roast and Fugghedaboutit.  I have also tired the Donut Shop blend and Maple Sleigh.  Brooklyn Beans does a decent job with middle of the road coffee.  There are no truly bold flavors or accents and this is a very simple coffee.  I prefer the intricacies of Coffee People coffee, the intensity of Starbucks and Barista blend.  There are no nuances to this coffee - all very straight up.  If cheap is what you are looking for this beats Folgers. I think it a step up from Folgers, on par with some of Green Mountain ( I am not a fan) and not even close to Coffee People, Starbucks or Barista Blend.  The flavored coffee (I have only tried Maple Sleigh but flavored coffee is flavored coffee in my opinion) was very good.  I am not a fan of flavored coffee, but this was very good. I originally ordered the Columbian blend, and admittedly I thought they were ok, I also thought they were a little weak for a Medium/Bold roast.  I reflected that in my original review of that one flavor.  The company immediately offered email assistance, to help me choose another flavor that would better meet my taste preferences.  I never did respond back to that request as I was not really looking for any assistance.  It was merely my first impression and observation.  I got through those cups and decided to give the Brooklyn Bridge roast a try.  I liked these much better.  Then it happened...  I had a couple of those cups more or less pop their tops in my coffee brewer.  It was a mess and a pain in the caboose to clean up.  I had known of other customers complain of the same issues, but again I reluctantly gave these a try hoping that would not happen to me.  Well, it did.  I then signaled the company with a review, reflecting what had happened, and the company immediately sprung to action again, wanting to resolve the issue I had, and desired to make me whole.  I never once thought that I would really get the attention that I got from the company, nor did I solicit any new product directly from the company.  It's like going to a grocery store, and buying any one of a myriad of items.  I believe that it is something you take an inherent risk, if you've never bought that item before.  If you don't like it, lesson learned.  You just probably don't buy it again.  You don't run back to the store, demanding a refund, or contact the manufacturer and expect anything.Well, Brooklyn Bean emailed me, and basically summoned me to give them a detailed explanation of what happened, what cups I was using, the expiration date, which translates to the manufacture date, etc.  After giving them that requested info (I even sent them a photo of the messy exploded cup) they emailed me back and unexpectedly offered to send out new product.  I thought, Wow!  This company must be serious about making it in the business.  They are trying to make right, what had gone wrong, and at no expense to me, they sent out new product, and then some.  They sent out replacement cups, and also a 16 cup sampler pack.  We tried all of them and my wife fell in love with the Vanilla Skyline.  We have since ordered more product, including the Vanilla, and each cup has performed flawlessly!!!  I emailed the company and thanked them, and added that it surprised me that they would go to that effort for me, just one lousy customer in UTAH, and their response back was, how could a company NOT stand behind their product, and make it right, if they want to make it a successful company.  That is music to my ears!  I told them, that not every start up company would do that.So, I highly recommend this product.  Find the flavor you like and run with it!!!

This is less of a review of the actual cookies; though I rated them 5 stars.  The real merit of this "review" is to provide  information that may help others avoid the confusion that I experienced when I received my order.I stumbled upon the product page on Amazon for "Double Stuf Oreo Chocolate Cream."  The Amazon product image clearly said "Double Stuf Oreo Chocolate Cream" and I had never seen that product description or package previously.  I had seen regular Chocolate Cream Oreos before and even original Double Stuf Oreos (with the white filling) in local grocery stores but never the Double Stuf Oreo Chocolate Cream.  I put my concern about the potential need to buy new pants aside and I ordered a case of 12 boxes, which is the minimum order.I received the case promptly from Amazon.  When I opened it, I found 12 boxes that simply said, "Chocolate Cream Oreo".  I uploaded a picture of what I received.  I called Amazon and told some nice representative in India that I received the familiar regular stuf Chocolate Cream Oreos that I have seen in stores and not the Double Stuf Chocolate Cream I had been expecting.  He apologized and shipped another case.I received another case today and it was the exact same product that I received a few days previously: "Chocolate Cream Oreo".  Instead of calling Amazon, I decided to call Nabisco (Kraft Foods, Inc.) for clarification.  The number is listed on the package 1800-622-4726.The following is probably the real virtue of this review.  I was told that the package now for the Double Stuf Oreo Chocolate Cream does not say "Double Stuf" anywhere.  As I mentioned, I uploaded an image of the Double Stuf product package that I received.  According to Kraft, the only way to tell is the UPC and package weight.  The package weight for Double Stuf Oreos is 1 pound 1 ounce.  The package weight for regular or normal stuf Oreos is apparently 15.6 oz.  The UPC for Double Stuf Oreos is 04472700.  The UPC for (regular stuf) Chocolate Cream Oreos is 044000025298.  Since the package does not say Double Stuf anymore, I am not even sure what my local grocery carries.  I need to check the package weight and UPC at the grocery store.Therefore before you jump, head-long, into buying 12 boxes of this magical Double Stuf Chocolate Cream, you may want to check what your local grocery store carries.  I really do not see the logic in having 2 different products with the same package, but there you go:  that is apparently the case with Double Stuf Chocolate Cream and regular stuf Chocolate Cream Oreos.  I will also mention that it would be interesting to see a side-by-side comparison of Double Stuf and regular Oreo cookies.  My guess is that the difference is not as significant as you might expect since I initially thought my cookies were regular stuf.

Everyone loves Oreos. They're even better dipped in chocolate. I made a plate of them for my son's Cub Scout cookie auction and a plate of my cookies sold for $20. So yummy.RECIPE2 cups semi-sweet chocolate chips2 tablespoons shortening1 package Oreos*optional: 1 cup white chocolate chips and 1 tablespoon shortening**Before you begin, make sure everything is absolutely dry. Even a drop of water will ruin your creation.**Melt the chocolate chips with the shortening in the microwave for 1 minute. Stir until melted. If needed, heat another 10 seconds at a time until melted. Be careful not to burn the chocolate.Place one cookie in the chocolate and coat. Use a fork to scoop it out, tapping against the bowl and scraping the bottom of the fork on the bowl to remove excess chocolate. Place on wax paper and let it set. Store refrigerated.Optional: To make it pretty, melt a cup of white chocolate with a tablespoon of shortening at 70% in the microwave for 1 minute. Dip a fork in the white chocolate and let it drizzle from the fork onto the semi-sweet chocolate covered cookies. If done neatly, your cookies will look beautiful.Hint: I do one batch in semi-sweet chocolate and one batch in white chocolate. Then, I drizzle the cookies with the alternate chocolate. Plate them together for an eye catching presentation.
