column9: Fantastic quality - doesn't crumble easily into food.
column10: These cinnamon sticks stay whole and aren't brittle - they work great in crock-pot oatmeal.  I hate the cheap versions that crumble into your food so you get little bark bits in your teeth.  These do not do that - highly recommend!

I really do like my Senseo coffee maker.  I, like others who have reviewed the Kona Pods here, was always searching for a better tasting coffee pod to use in the machine. I was excited to see that Kona now made pods and was also happy to see that they had a pod that was a '2 cup style'.  I have not found it to be a huge deal to use 2 smaller '1 cup' size pods, but it sounded nice to be able to just put one large pod in the machine instead of 2 smaller one.After reading some of the reviews here, I could not figure out what some of the reviewers meant by the Kona pods making different amount of coffee per cup each time or how the coffee could be strange and undrinkable.  It just didn't make sense.  Well, it still doesn't make sense, but it certainly happened with the coffee I made using the Kona pods also.My results were overall poor and it was very disappointing as the Kona pods cost a lot more than Folgers or other pod brands that I can buy locally. The first thing I noticed was that the coffee in the 2 cup sized Kona pods is packed in much more tightly than in any other pod I have ever used in my Senseo.  The instructions for the Kona pods say to wiggle the pods to break up the coffee before inserting into the machine.  The Kona pods feel very hard when taken out of their package.  I always  wiggled and jiggled the pods for about 10 seconds before putting them in the Senseo. After my problems with the Kona pods, my husband decided that I was not 'wiggling' them enough.  He promptly wiggled one to the point that it broke open.  So, there is just so much that can be done to the pod before putting it in the machine.The first thing that I noticed was that the amount of coffee brewed when using the Kona pod was quite a bit less than when using 2 smaller pods.  That did not make much sense, but after several cups of Kona, it was obvious that there was never the amount of coffee coming out as before when using 2 small one cup pods.  The best I can figure out is that the Kona pods themselves seem to 'hold' a lot more water.  There is more water that remains in the pod itself after the brewing is done.  The pod itself is heavier when I take it out to throw it away.  So, I believe the reason that there is less actual coffee using Kona pods is that the pods themselves retain a lot more water and it cannot pass through into the coffee cup.Then, as others have mentioned, there is the problem that happens to me about 1/2 the time when using the Kona pods.  The problem is that for whatever reason, the water does not actually go through and penetrate the Kona pods during the brewing cycle. The 'coffee' that is supposed to be coming out of the spout is just water!  This problem is one that I still cannot really figure out.  The Kona pods are a little smaller in diameter than all the other pods I have tried.  So, I guess that somehow the water has enough room to 'go around' the actual pod and come out of the spout without 'going through' the pod to brew coffee.  I also wonder if the paper filter of the Kona pods is different than other pods and for some reason the Kona paper is more difficult for water to penetrate.  I have tried wetting the Kona pod paper filter right before starting to brew the coffee thinking that perhaps it would help the water to penetrate the paper and pod.  But, that has not worked for me.So, it is back to regular more reasonably priced coffee pods for me.  I have wasted too many expensive Kona pods trying to get a proper cup of coffee from them. Even when the Kona pods brew a cup of coffee, it is not as large of an amount of coffee as I get using other brands.  So, adding the cost of the Kona pods to the fact that it brews a smaller amount of coffee equals a product that is way too expensive when it does actually work.I have been reading of a product called an EcoPod.  It is a refillable pod for these type of coffeemakers.  It might be the next thing I try.

This coffee is great!  The Senseo machine can be difficult to use as far as getting pods into it correctly.  I am not sure what has happened to the people reporting "steam locks" but I have had issues when:  - the pod is not inserted properly  - the pod holder is not seated correctly within the machine  - the pod is not prepared for insertion properlyMy issues were varied, but basically consisted of hot water  coming out of the sides of the coffee maker and no coffee would be brewed, and the pod would have to be discarded.  This happened to me with Senseo pods, and probably would have happened with the Aloha Island pods except that I learned how to deal with the machine.Also in some of these cases the lid to the coffee maker would be stuck, (possibly the dreaded "steam lock"), but I was always able to open the machine after a minute or so of wiggling the lock/release handle on the machine, which I would think most people would do automatically when the machine doesn't open.By properly preparing the pod for insertion I am able to use single pods for the Melitta One in my Senseo as well as the Aloha Island pods and of course the Senseo pods.  If you don't put it in just right, you will have problems.  The key is to spread the coffee equally around within the Pod before inserting it into the machine.  Do this by wiggling the pod around a bit (take about 5 seconds).  The helpful instructions with the Aloha Island pods say to "break up the coffee" within the pod before using, which has the same effect.  It took me five months to figure this out while using the Senseo pods, especially when brewing two cups.  I wish Senseo would have included a little note like Aloha Island did.During shipping the coffee can settle or collect within the pod, either on a side(s) or even in the middle.  This changes the thickness of the pod, ever so slightly, and the machines tolerance for different thickness pods appears to be extremely low!So smooth out your pods and enjoy, I think that any problems you have with pods are really problems with the design of the machine, not the pods themselves.

Echoing other reviews, performance is not consistant.  One time we did get excellent coffee, this morning it jammed the Senseo machine with a steam lock and there is not telling when we will be able to re-open it.  Considering the price of these pods, even only one bad pod makes it impossible to recommend the product.

column9: Ah!  Senseo pods that rock!  Mahalo!
column10: As a bachelor who frequently must grab a cup of joe at home and run, i was reluctant to waste coffee in my Braun drip machine, and disinclined to clean up after the French Press method.  A New York Times article convinced me that a Pod system would be the way to go, and i found the Philips Senseo machine to be the best at the consumer level.  Alas, the Douwe Egberts pods that come with are, um, IMHO, not good.A brief web search led me to Aloha Island's Senseo-style pods, and i ordered a box of their single serving espresso pods.  The package arrived swiftly, and the box of pods was swaddled in styro-peanuts:  nice touch!  i immediately placed a pair in the Senseo unit and let it do its thing.  Wow!  The quality of the coffee is, to date, unparalled.  Rich, smooth, and frothy, almost like a latte before the milk is added.  And i was surprised that the yield was about one ounce greater than with the DE pods.I'm a believer, an advocate, and a confirmed drinker and fan.  Thanks and Mahalo!

I was thrilled to find Kona coffee in pods for my Senseo machine.  However, these pods do not really fit right.  Consequently, sometimes you get a full cup that is mostly water -- then you might get half a cup.  There is NO consistency in how much coffee will actually come out -- or how strong/weak the coffee will be.  I can't tell if it's manufacturing irregularities or whether the pods are just poorly designed.  In any event, only about one in five pods actually produces a drinkable full cup of coffee.  I emailed Aloha Island Coffee Company with my concerns and asking for advice, but have not yet received an answer after two weeks.I'm going back the the Douwe Egberts pods -- at least they are consistent and A LOT less expensive.
Fabulous marriage of convenience and quality. Rich, full flavor from the touch of a button! A dream come true.

I bought a Senseo machine for the convenience of making one cup at a time but was underwhelmed by the coffee choices available.That is until I found the Kona coffee pods from Aloha Island.These are all I use now. They cost a little more but worth every penny if you want a very smooth, rich cup of pure Kona coffee these are the ones to buy.

I have to agree with the guy who complained about consistency.  I have wasted two very expensive pods so far.  The first time I used a Kona pod the machine jammed and I could not open it for 24 hours,(caused a steam lock), about 5 tablespoons of undrinkable crap came out of my senseo.  The next time I tried a Kona pod I got a quarter amount of what should have been a two cup try. I am not very impressed so far.  I am now afraid to try again.

column9: Top Quality Coffee, but Pod technology leaves something to be desired
column10: Yes the coffee is the best quality, pesticide free.  There are technical issues with the pods. 1 pod was broken when I opened up the pouch it was stored in.  For any pods to arrive broken when they are so expensive is just not acceptable.  Also, many times the pod is not working, but turning it around and pressing down on it with a fork or a spoon makes it work (I have Black & Decker Home Cafe Machine).  Great coffee, but I felt that I had to really work for it.  I also feel that to charage $15 to ship a box of coffee pods is a bit excessive, considering that they are being shiped from LA not HI.

column9: Great pods from Hawaii, and nice people too
column10: If you are looking for pods for your espresso machine, give these a try.  I have a Francis X1 and have tried them all.  These are the best.  Also, the people in customer service are super nice - guess it is not a surprise they live in Hawaii.

WOW!! was my reaction when I tried these for the first time..If you're looking for a premium coffee pod to use in your Senseo coffee machine this is the one to get. These pods work perfectly in the Senseo and they produce a very rich & smooth cup of Kona coffee with almost no acidity...If you want the best this is it!!

These kona pods are the highest quality pods that I have found yet. I love kona coffee so I was extremely pleased to find these pods. They certainly cost a little more than other cheap pods but it's worth it especially when you consider what you pay for a cup of coffee at retail. Now I have the best coffee in the world at home for less...

column9: Great pods, if you have a real coffee maker...

Read the reviews, pry open the wallets and get a maker that is worthy of such great pods! Otherwise, go ahead a stay with Folgers pods. A real coffee maker will make you a coffee snob too!

column9: Best cup of coffee I have ever had...
column10: After reading many of the reviews I think I have figured out the problem.  You guys have the wrong POD brewer. I have a BUNN and tried various different pods with it.  The Aloha Island pods are the best of the lot. I have been in search of a good cup of coffee for years.  The answer is a BUNN and the Aloha dark roast Pods.  I bought two el-cheapo pod brewers including black and decker and senseo.  I couldn't get a good cup of coffee even with the Aloha pods.  Once I ditched the cheap pod brewer and spent the $200.00 on the BUNN, all my troubles were over.  You guys will never be happy until you get a good pod brewer.

After reading the reviews, I was hesitant.  However, I've gotten a perfect cup every time so far with my Senseo.The coffee is very good, but it has fallen a little short of my expectations. I've previously brought Kona back from my Hawaiian vacations and ground it myself.  The pod coffee is not quite as good as fresh ground.UPDATE:  for my next shipment, this two-cup style was backordered.  Aloha Island Coffee Co. sent me the equivalent amount of coffee in single-cup style pods instead.  I've found these pods to work better, fit the Senseo machine better, and this coffee now does tasted just as good (or better) than fresh ground whole bean Kona!I think the single-pod style is quite a bit more expensive than two-cup style, but the difference is definitely noticeable!
Excellent taste, good price, and fast shipping. Raw almond butter is much tastier and better for you than roasted. Only problem is that it is not organic. But taste is superb.

I struggled with rating this bar a 3 or a 4.  Taste is only about a 3, but quality of ingredients in providing a healthy and edible alternative to a candy bar rates it a solid 4. Below is the gist a a review I wrote for Larabar Fruit & Nut Food Bar, Cherry Pie comparing it with the PURE Wild Blueberry Bar.When I was searching for a healthier between meal afternoon snack I read a lot of reviews for a lot of products.  I wanted something with few ingredients, not "fortified" and with some nuts in it.  I settled on the Larabar Fruit & Nut Cherry Pie bars and the PURE Bar Organic Wild Blueberry Living Food Bar.  I love cherries and I love blueberries so they seemed like good choices.The stats of the bars are very similar, weight (both 1.7oz, not 1.8), calories, fat, sugars, etc.  The PURE has more protein at 6g vs 4g.  The Larabar has no sodium while the PURE has just a bit at 5mg.  The Larabar is thicker, the PURE bar is wider.  Visually the Larabar appears to have more nuts in it, which doesn't seem to jive with the protein stats.  The PURE bar has a grittier texture while chewing so maybe more of the nuts are finely ground.1st ingredient is dates for both followed by almonds and then cherries for the Larabar and followed by blueberries and various nuts, organic agave nectar, rice protein and lemon juice for the PURE bar.  One would think with the extra ingredients in the PURE bar they were added to tweak the flavor or give it a fresher taste, but the flavor of the Larabar is better than the PURE by a pretty good margin.  It has a much fresher and lively taste.  I have to say the PURE bar is a bit cardboardy tasting to me and has a drier mouth feel.  It is not bad, in fact my 2 youngest kids eat them readily, just not nearly as good as the Larabar.  I think the tartness of the cherries in the Larabar kick up the flavor vs the milder blueberry flavor of the PURE (maybe the lemon juice add as an attempt to kick up the PURE bar flavor and tartness?).  In fairness I should probably review the PURE Cherry Cashew bar but I much prefer almonds over cashews so don't plan on ordering any from Amazon.  If I stumble on the PURE cherry in a regular store I will give one a try though.  I still get both auto shipped from Amazon for variety sake, but am looking for a better tasting blueberry bar w/ basic ingredients including nuts.For grins here is a comparison of the Larabar, PURE, Snickers, Hershey's and Maruchan Chicken Ramen noodles in a few categories.  Stats are listed in the order I listed them in the previous sentence.Calories:  190, 190, 280, 210, 380Total Fat:  8g, 9, 14, 13, 14  Saturated Fat:  0.5g, 1, 5, 8, 7Sugars:  21g, 20, 30, 24, 0Protein:  4g, 6, 4, 3, 10Sodium:  0mg, 5, 140, 35, 1540 !!!UPDATE Nov 11, 2009  PURE has changed this bar.I got my regular shipment and noticed the bars came in a newly shaped box and new packaging.  Total fat went from 9g to 8g and they eliminated all sodium.  Total carbs edged up to 26g from 25g.  Protein remains 6g and calories at 190.The BIG CHANGE is that "Organic Wild Blueberries" drops from the 2nd item listed on the ingredients list to the 5th!  Blueberries are now after not only dates but walnuts, cashews and rice proein concentrate.  Bumping up the nut content would not be a bad thing, but since the total fat actually decreased and carbs increased, I think the nut quantity actually decreased along with the blueberries, but the date quantity increased.  This seems to basically be a date bar w/ nuts now and some minor blueberry content.  I'd love to see the actually quantity of blueberries in this bar.  Ironically, I can actually see blueberries scattered in the new bar, whereas the old bar was more of a dense blended mush.  The bar is noticeably lighter in color now (and density)...more tan than blue.  The new packaging implies a longer slimmer bar shape, but oddly the actual bar is shorter, wider and a tad thicker...package marketing?  The total weight is unchanged at 1.7oz.  I'm still looking for an alternative blueberry bar...I imagine cost is a big factor in blueberry content.  My 2 kids will still eat these but they noticed the change right away and are not impressed.

This bar is the closest thing I've ever experienced to eating a brownie fresh from the oven in a packaged food.  I have no idea how the folks at Pure Bar managed to make a chocolate bar that tastes so much like baked goods, using only raw and living ingredients, but it's wonderful that they have, and I mean to buy several more cases.  Any of the store bought brownies you've had won't satisfy you like this will - Entemanns and Hostess are not nearly as delicious and warm-tasting, and the health food and energy bars I've had that are chocolate flavored always end up tasting like wheat germ or oats.  It's easy to carry, one bar fills me up, and as a chocolate fan, I am happy to see that Pure Bar uses raw cacao powder - the real deal, and not carob chocolate substitutes.  You can definitely taste the difference.  This particular Pure Bar product makes for the best tasting snackfood or dessert I've ever eaten out of a wrapper, and unless you're on a completely raw vegan diet, it's going to be better for you than whatever meal you ate just beforehand!  If you like chocolate like I do, you're going to love this.  It's a soft, gooey brownie, pure and simple, walnuts and all.

column9: Regular Guy says:  "Ingredients are PURE, and the PITS"
column10: Allow me to give you some frame of reference on me:  I'm not a vegan or even vegetarian, or sufferer of Celiac Disease.  If I fell into either one of those camps, I would instantly raise the rating at least a star.  But since I'm not adverse to occasionally ingesting an artificial ingredient or two, I'll give you the straight dope on this very healthy snack bar.The ingredient list is quite impressive, if only for the fact that someone who doesn't have a chemistry degree can understand it.  That in itself is refreshing.  They've even got a YES/NO breakdown printed next to the ingredients that goes something like this:YES!:  Certified Organic, Gluten-Free, Full Serving [of] Fruit, Organic Protein, Rich in Omega-3s, Good Source of Fiber, Raw, VeganNO!:  Refined Sugars, Gluten Dairy or Soy, Cholesterol, Trans Fats, Preservatives, GMOs, Artificial Nothin'WOW!  5-STARS SO FAR!  Let's tear this thing open!At first glance, it looks just like holiday fruitcake that's been mashed with a rolling pin.  Mmmmm...  Maybe that's why it doesn't need preservatives and the expiration date is almost a full year in the future.  Smells a lot like fruitcake, too.  I lost my first test subject (my wife) on looks and smell alone.  (Minus 1 star for lack of family appeal -- I don't count the kids' outright rejection.)The first bite redeemed the bar.  It's tastier than I'd anticipated, full flavored and sweet without being powdery or sugary.  I think I might like this.The second bite lost the other star instantly.  I felt like I almost broke a tooth on a rather large fruit pit.  Guess I should have paid closer attention to the disclaimer on the wrapper that states, "May contain pieces of nuts, shells, stems, or pits."  I found a stem in the other half of the bar.As good as this fruit bar may be for me, I don't think I should have to strain it prior to eating it.  I have enjoyed similarly nutritious bars in the past and not one thought of seeking a dentist.Though the PURE BAR is EVERYTHING they promise (pits and all), I'll probably do some more "research" (read: taste tests) on other healthy snack bars before buying a case.  I will, however, recommend this bar to a family member who needs a Gluten-free diet, because it tastes significantly better than most Gluten-free snacks I've sampled.Just be careful and take small bites.

The best part about this bar is that (unlike most others) I cannot taste the dates.  They're a little sweet, but not too much so; the tartness of the cherries helps balance things out.  I take these with me for breakfast or a snack to classes, and it helps fight off any hunger while I get some protein.  I've also found that it is more filling if I drink it with something (juice or a bottle of water) and can make a quick meal.  I'm new this whole raw food thing, so these have been life-savers for when I'm tired of eating whole foods and salads.

I tried Pure Bars after seeing them reviewed on a health website. The site waxed poetic about the flavor, as well as the extremely high quality ingredients, but I figured "right -- these bars all end up tasting like dates no matter what flavor they are". Well, I stand corrected, the flavor on these bars is excellent and is by far the best I've tasted (and I've tasted quite a few). That's a real bonus, considering the fact that the ingredients are completely raw and organic and the whole bar is relatively low on the glycemic index. To those unfamiliar with raw food bars, take note: if you're expecting any of them to taste like "granola" bars or candy bars, you'll be disappointed. Think fruit sweet instead and your expectations will be met. I can also vouch for the fact that my 2.5 year old daughter loves them. On to the chocolate next...

column9: BEWARE OF BUGS FROM THIS SELLER
column10: I love these bars.  I basically live off of them.  HOWEVER, this is now the second time that I have ordered them from Amazon where the internal boxes of bars have had bugs in them.  They looked somewhat like ants, but I wasn't sure what they were.  Just gross little crawly things creeping around inside and outside of the box.  I say beware because the bugs are tiny and you might think that they're not there when you open the package.  My advice would be to let the internal box of bars sit outside your cupboard on a counter for a day and see if you notice any bugs before you co-mingle the box with your household food. Gross, gross, gross.  So unhappy because other than that, these bars are great.  But I will never order them online from Amazon again.  Thank g-d Trader Joes and Ralphs are starting to carry this brand.

column9: small bar for a high price with an untrue claim and hidden fructose
column10: As a person who is more involved with health and nutrition than the average person that has also purchased raw food bars before, I was happy that this was offered though the Amazon Vine program and I glady ordered the sample.  It tastes good and it claims to contain "nothing cooked, nothing processed," but that is not the simple truth.  The bar contains "agave nectar" which does not occur naturally.  It is not unprocessed and it is in fact, a highly cooked and processed sweetener.  It is derived from processing and cooking the core of the blue agave plant for many hours in order to break down its starches into sugars.  Agave nectar was originally touted as a "healthy alternative" to table sugar, but it is potentially much worse than table sugar on your body.  It is essentially a super high fructose syrup, just like high fructose corn syrup, but with a much higher fructose content.  Typical high fructose corn syrup used in soft drinks is about 55% fructose while agave nectar contains a whopping 85-90% fructose.  First of all, I don't understand why they thought they needed to sweeten this "raw" bar, and second, they used "agave nectar" which sounds good to the uninformed, but it is not a raw ingredient and it has a very high fructose content.  I think they used "agave nectar" to hide the additional fructose (or sugar) on the label.  There is controversy, but fructose and particularly agave nectar may be bad for you.You can research for yourself, google "agave nectar bad"and look for entries from "foodrenegade," "nourishedkitchen" and "living-foods"You can also google "fructose bad"check out the hits from "about" and "the american journal of clinical nutrition"Fructose and in particular, High Fructose Corn Syrup are the subjects of much controversy today.  There are studies that conclude that there is no appreciable difference between sucrose and fructose to our bodies (and of course, fructose is a component of sucrose).  There are also studies that indicate fructose may be problematic.  Regardless of which camp you're in, "agave nectar" is a hidden source of fructose in this bar and it is not raw.  The fact that the manufacturer of this bar claims "nothing cooked and nothing processed" is nothing short of fraud.

column9: Not terrible but I won't purchase again
column10: Usually, I go to Whole Foods and try to buy a single bar of a brand or flavor I haven't tried before purchasing an entire box... & I should have followed that rule before making this purchase.Ordinarily, I love the tart twang of cranberry and orange together - but the additional ingredients in this bar made it overly sweet for my taste.  I also found the texture to be quite gritty and overly moist.I gave the product 3 stars for the quality of the ingredients and because it would likely appeal to those who enjoy REALLY sweet fruit treats.I think in the future I will go back to Lara Bars.

I don't know how these would taste if one is used to eating junk foods and cooked foods, but I have been eating only raw foods for two months and these bars are really a special treat.  The chocolate in them is as pleasing to me as any chocolate cake, brownie, or candy bar ever was when I used to eat junk foods - even more so because I know that they are healthy and I am truly satisfied once I am finished with the bar!

This bar is like having a piece of apple pie without the guilt!!! I would highly recommend this bar!  I have tried so many "health bars" and when I opened them up they all tasted dry and like cardboard....YUK!  Not this one!

Weighing in at about 6 gr/CHO this make a bread option for those who use insulin. Not 16 or 36.  Use it for Pizza, use it for sandwich, don't use it for birthday cakes and the like.  I've been using this for years and can attest that it is a winner. I am told that if you spray it with cold pressed olive oil, and cook (fry?) you can eat it with middle eastern spices.  However, be aware that even if you have a place which stocks this it's not always easy to find around the dates of some middle eastern religious festivals when everyone buy every loaf in site.Stock up, and remember that with proper care this stores very well.

These pitas (and their lavish also) are delicious, low calorie, low carb and so versatile!  What more can you ask for from a pita?  I am borderline diabetic, so must watch carb consumption. Joseph's Oat bran and whole wheat pitas have become a staple for me.  I've stuffed 'em with veggies, used them for fajitas, used them as a pizza crust, cut them up and baked them as chips (both savory and sweet) and so much more.  Now that I've moved from New England where they were readily available, I find I must order them online.  It is no imposition when they are so well loved by me!!  I strongly recommend them!

I love, love, love this pita bread.  Its soft, not too dense, and is low carb to boot.  An entire pita is only 60 calories. SIXTY calories. It doesn't get much better.  My one complaint is that it is really hard to find in brick-and-mortar stores.  Some Walmart's used to carry it, but I haven't been able to find it for months.  The last time I was visiting family in LA, I found it and bought 7 packs of it so I could take it back home with me!  It holds up well in the freezer.  If I continue to be unable to find it in a store, I'll be forced to buy it online and pay shipping charges.

I have been buying this bread for a few years when I can find it, so far I've been getting it at the local Walmart up until lately they've stocked it. I checked here and it's out of stock here too. I will find it somewhere as it in good to have on hand to use for bread. It holds up better than any other low carb breads in the freezer so I generally have a few packs in the freezer. Love it for low carbing. It is soft and you can make pita chips for dipping with a brushing of olive oil, some salt and baking. It is one of my favorite staples. Disregard the idiot who posted in the wrong place for another item.
I keep finding disgusting dead bugs inside these seeds. I usually love sunflower seeds, but these bugs are making me sick

I buy these because I travel a lot and need some snacks in the car, airport, or plane.  Buying a box really saves on the per pack cost.  I find these packages to be a good size and besides I have always liked sunflower seeds.
This packages are big. Order and deliver on time like always . No problem at all. The packages array bigger than I thought . But they deliver the purpose .

I'd never heard of a Snacktivity before, but now that I have, WOW! Hard to believe David has that market cornered so well. The only other snacktivity I can think of is Oreo's... but you can't really twist those things on the run without them crumbling in your hands so.... Anyway, David seeds are way better then others, perfect salt to seed ratio. These conveniently sized packs stay at my desk and give me the chance to take them wherever I please. It's like all the fun of packing chewing tobacco without the cancer, black spit, and lack of protein. Pretty sure they fall into the Paleo diet also.. bonus.
Individual packages split open along seam when trying to open. Seeds were somewhat stale. In the future I'll purchase this item locally at a CostCo or Sam's Club. Their price is compatible.

As a kid my mother would punish me with peanut butter and jelly sandwiches (I would rather go hungry).  So needless to say, I am not a huge jam fan.  Maybe that's because I grew up on store brands or Knott's grape jelly.  Anyways, I relieved a 4 pack of Maury Island Jams as a Christmas gift and all I can say is I don't know what a Marion berry is but i love it out of this jam jar!!!  The raspberry is also the best I have ever tasted so far (not that I have tasted a lot though).  I am sure the other two flavors are great but I need to calm down on my consumption before I gain 10 lbs.  Crackers + low-fat whipped cream cheese + teaspoon of Marion berry jam by Maury Island Farm = Deliciousness. :)

I bought five different jams for my husband for 2010 Christmas.  He opened the marionberry first.  He didn't say much, just nodded and munched away, which means he really likes it.  I took a small spoonful and loved the strong berry flavor.  I'm not a fan of sugary jams so I was elated w/the intense marionberry taste.  It does have small seeds similar to a strawberry, so it's not intrusive in your mouth - you won't be picking at your teeth.I was looking for a high end gourmet jam and am very pleased that I bought this.  It's exactly what I was looking for.

column9: I really enjoy this pad Thai
column10: the sauce is what makes this pad Thai different. The sauce has a body to it.  Not just to clear broth with nothing in it. It allows me to appreciate the rich flavors of Thai food. I feel like I am eating real food when I have it for lunch.

column9: I enjoyed this so much I fixed it two nights in a row!
column10: I really enjoy the complex flavors in the sauce. I personally recommend adding a spoonful peanut butter but I enjoy the sauce either way.

I prepared this kit with just the basics...I didn't add any shrimp or anything...just some red pepper flakes.  It provided me with two very tasty light meals.  I definitely would buy this product again.  Next time I'll add some shrimp, limes, chopped peanuts, etc.

When we first tried this version it was not too hot at all and we loved the flavor of the sauce. We always added shrimp and boneless chicken thighs. I've recently bought what I guess is a new recipe and had to throw it out. Way too hot! We're so disappointed. Wish I knew for sure how this one is.
Ok, but certainly need to add some fresh items to make this good. Try with chicken OR shrimp, egg, peanuts, and fresh cilantro.
This noodle dish is a bit spicy and the noodles never seem to cook evenly, but the flavor is decent and its a really easy dish to make and is great if you add some chicken to it.
This was foul, although oddly it had a bland, if unpleasant, flavor while also an extremely strong and unpleasant odor. We threw it in the garbage.

When I ordered this product, it came in the HOT version. Although the photo of the product did not indicate HOT. Hot Thai food is very hot. I like hot peppers, this is was way over the top.  Only used about 1/4 of the sauce, and supplemented with other seasonings.

column9: This is the gold standard of honey
column10: Let me tell you, if you are the kind of person who knows the difference between clover and buckwheat honey, or raw honey and generic store bought, once you try this honey nothing else will ever compare. The flavor is so incredibly delicious and ever so faintly butterscotch, I can tell you that any recipe you use this in will turn out supreme. I make my own granola and use honey & agave nectar for sweetening. When I use this brand, it makes a world of a difference. I'm dying to try it with a baklava recipe.

column9: Tawari Honey, good but nothing special
column10: This honey is tasty, just as most honeys are, but it tastes about the same as most of the honeys I can find locally, so I don't plan to buy again. I was expecting a special butterscotch flavor, as promised in the ad, which it does not have. I was also expecting a full pint volume in glass. I was disappointed to see that it is substantially less than a pint and packaged in plastic. The local honeys I can get can do everything this honey can and at less cost.

column9: Good taste but crooked cans when received
column10: I have received the mail as I was looking forward to taste those yummy crab soup. I find that two cans out of three cans are already bend and crooked...doesn't look good. The taste of soup are pretty good but not the best. One of the soup has some shells that you can taste a little. Not a bad soup but I like other kind of crab soup than this. They need to watch the cans that it won't bend or crooked.

I have been called many, many things in my life (As a matter of fact I have a list somewhere here in my home office I have been keeping for years).  Some of the things are nice; many are not so nice and some, it you can believe it, are downright nasty.  One thing though that I have not been called is a "food snob."  Hey, I like good food but as to food in general, I turn my nose up at almost nothing.I love these Chef Boyardee Beef Ravioli things.  Well, maybe "love" is a bit strong, but I most certainly have eaten my share of these in my life and quite likely will continue to do so.  The flavor is mild - I grant you that, but if you put some grated cheese on them and add a couple of shots of hot sauce, they are actually pretty good.I keep a constant supply of these in the pantry.  I am a night owl and at two or three in the morning while reading I at times get hungry.  Open a can of these and pop them in the microwave and zip - I have myself a tasty snack!These are also great grandson fodder.  Kids, or most of them that I know, love these things.Now almost nothing that comes out of a can should ever be referred to as "health food."  These are no exception.  On the other hand, relatively speaking, you could do a lot worse I suppose.  To be frank though, I am not too hung up on the "health food" thing and focus more on moderation than I do on content.Note:  There is a down side to this product.  If you drip the sauce of your shirt, it is difficult to remove.On the up-side, I always use paper plates when I eat this stuff and my dogs love to lick up the leftover sauce.Anyway, for me this is good stuff.  I like it.Don BlankenshipThe Ozarks

Convenient and tasty. Pop it in a bowl covered with plastic wrap, and microwave for 1 minute and 30 seconds. I tear up a mozzarella cheese stick and sprinkle it over the top before nuking. My boyfriend prefers his with a dash of Tabasco. I get a bit nostalgic eating these, since I used to frequently have them as an after-school snack when I was a child. Om nom nom, tasty!Tip: Use a napkin bib if you don't want a stained shirt. The sauce is a runnier than typical tomato sauce, and somehow, I always manage to get it on my clothes.

This flour blend is outstanding.  I use it for sourdough, and the resulting flavor, crust, and crumb is wonderful.  I blend it 60/40 with the Great River bread flour, and use a no-knead method and bake in a cast iron dutch oven.

When I got this flour I promptly made a loaf of bread, using the recipe on the bag, in a very old Sanyo one pound bread maker that I was given with no instructions.  The loaf came out three inches high...hhmmmm.....I did some digging around and came across an old book Smart Bread Machine Recipes by Sandra Woodruff. 1994She only uses whole grain flours.  What I was lacking was Vital Gluten as many of the flours in this mix are very low in natural gluten.Now I have wonderful bread that rises properly and it is soooo good. Just the right amount of texture and nutty taste. So looking forward to experimenting as I love Russian Black Bread.As for having to add the gluten, my thought is that older bread machines must have either a shorter rise time or lower temps or both, because I do not see gluten as an ingredient on newer bread machine recipes that use whole wheat and other whole grain flours -- I find on the web. And I read reviews that stated that they used the recipe on the bag and had no problems with rising.  So that is my the theory.... it's my very old machine.And what does a single person do with 20 pounds of flour ... I vacuum sealed three bags and put them in the freezer.And thanks to the reviewer that stated they used it for cookies... heck never thought of that... but now I will.....oh and baked donuts made with honey....

column9: For Those Who Make Multigrain Dough but Don't Like a Heavy Grain Taste
column10: I have switched from 100% white flour to a mix of white and multigrain flour for healthier breads. At first I was not happy with the limited brands I found in local stores. The taste was too heavy. I then ran across Great River on Amazon and read the reviews. Based on the reviews, I believed I had found a brand that wouldn't overwhelm the end-product with the flavor of the grains. After baking the first bread and pizza, I knew had found the brand that really works. Even my wife, who didn't want me to change my pizza dough recipe because it's the best, found my 'new' dough also produced great results. Depending on what I'm baking, I'll use Great River for 1/3 to 1/2 of the recipe with the rest using King Arthur un-bleached, un-bromated bread flour.

I baked a bread with various seeds in addition to the flour  and it came out soooo tasty! I will buy again! Generally, this kind of flour does not rise like the white (with gluten) one does, but what matters is the taste and the quality. I am also using spelt flour, and it does not rise much either. Some people don't like it, but I think it's a minor detail.

I use this flour in both my bread machine and also hand bread making.  The loaves are dense and heavenly, the way bread should be.  I am so happy to have ordered this and will continue to order this fantastic product.  The price is great too!

This is my second bread mix from great river. It has a nice nutty taste to it. It is softer than the oatmeal bread mix, and I think more people would prefer the flavorfulness of this over the oatmeal blend. I like both, this one is lighter and nuttier, other is heartier and more heavy.

I got this flour to replace the whole wheat flour I've been using for English muffins. At the same time, following some reviewers suggestions, I also got  gluten flour to help rising. I don't have a bread machine; I follow a general English muffin yeast-based recipe and hand knead the dough for about 11 minutes. I added 1 tbspn of gluten flour per cup of bread flour. I think this made a huge difference, as I've been having problems getting whole wheat muffins to rise properly. I also made some aluminum foil muffin rings to help the muffins keep their shape while they rose. The end result was a 1.5" high muffin, nicely dense, with a moist center and great texture that toasted perfectly. The flour is a keeper (especially with 20 pounds of it)

I bought this product here on Amazon.  It is wonderful!  Yes, it taste different than white bread and has a different texture.  That is why I bought it!  I am looking to increase my families consumption of healthy, whole grains.  I don't want all the preservatives in the store bought bread and find alot of the frozen healthier breads to be dry and not that tasty.  The breads and baked goods I have made with this flour have all been delicious!I have made my way through 2 of the bags so far.I have made the bread using the recipe on the package and my electric bread machine.  I have made the 1 pound loaf and the 1.5 pound loaf, both with great success each time. I made them using my quick, 58 minute cycle.  I make homemade butter to serve with it...delicious!!!  If there is any left the next day, we toast it and eat with more butter and homemade jam.  My husband and kids love this as a snack as well.I have also used it to make zucchini bread, along with some sprouted grain whole wheat flour.  I ran out of the sprouted grain bread and so had to use half of the bread flour to complete the recipe.  It was even better than when I used only the sprouted grain wheat.  So this weekend, I want to try my zucchini bread recipe with just this bread flour to see how it turns out.  I bake this in the oven...and it just turns out great.I also made some cinnamon rolls.  They turned out more like bisuits, because of the texture...but my family loved them!  I also made a challah bread with it...and again, it had a different texture, but was delicious!I want to try some of cookie and pie crust recipes with this next.  And will order some of the other flours from this company as well.
I am loving this bread flour! I made my first loaf of bread today with it and it was GREAT! I love that it has nice texture and isn't all ground up!

I haven't used this for bread yet. Too busy right now, but my husband made oatmeal, chocolate chip cookies with Craisens and almonds. They were amazing. The flour gave them a nutty, bite. The cookies were gone in a flash.I finally used this for bread. OUTSTANDING. I am writing a bread baking book and am including a whole grain loaf. I used this flour plus a 1/4 cup of gluten flour for a 2.5 pound loaf. It rose up high and light. The texture is soft and stretchy with crunchies to boot. I was skeptical about using a whole grain flour nearly exclusively for bread but this is amazing!

I absolutely love this bread flour, i have tried a lot of different ones and this is my favorite ! Great texture and you taste the freshness when the bread is done. It is similar to German breads. Once you try this, you'll fall in love !

I saw reviews saying this may be old flour because some people had problems with their bread rising.  I had no such problem.  It rose just fine.  I actually called the company and asked them how to read the expiration date on their package since it wasn't obvious, and it was fresh.  They are also very helpful with tips if you need them.  There are lots of reasons bread does not rise including old yeast, humidity, etc.  I was wary but glad I took the chance and bought the flour.
Makes an Excellent Tasty  Loaf of Bread. I tried the receipe on the bag it was very good and I tried my own receipes came out great.
Great flour, I just received a bread maker as a gift and wanted something besides white bread flour, this is it!  Well worth the money and still cheaper than buying processed bread!

I was a little anxious about ordering bread flour through amazon, but I live in an area where good flour is not readily available.  This product makes wonderful loaves that are light, but has that hearty chewey texture I was going for.  I add chopped sunflower seeds in for some additional protien and crunch.  I intend to get into the subscription plan.
My family loves the flour!The flour is in high quality and the small grains inside make nutty taste.If you are looking for healthy food you should definitely try this.

I received this very fast and immediately tried a loaf of bread in the machine.  I made just the dough and except for a couple of mistakes on my part it was a wonderful bread.  I will buy this flour again and again.  Looks like the Ezekiel bread is staying in the store.  Next time I may substitute some light spelt in the mix.  I would recommend this flour to anyone who wants to eat healthy and have a good tasting bread. And if you buy the 20 lb. combo the shipping is free.

When we bought our Panasonic Bread maker we also ordered 20 pounds of this flour. Wow, it makes good bread. And, I modify the recipe found on the label by grinding sunflower, flax, pumpkin and other seeds to put into the mix. Add eggs and sometimes some spices too. The flour acts as a good base and we always seem to get good bread no matter what else I add (within reason!!). So, will keep using this flour as it has proven to make good bread.

I usually use another 9 grain mix with no problem whatsoever. Maybe I have a bad batch and fortunately I know a builder short of corner stones!! For the first time in 5 years of bread machine baking I am producing loaves that do not rise and come our rock hard, heavy and with a dry flour taste.Reading the other reviews I am inclined to think that I have been unlucky, however considering the cost and shipping I will not be trying again with this brand
sorry but i'm not used to this food. i don't like the taste and i can't make the bread that i want.i feel that i wasted my $37.00 already.

I usually get the Fruit2O, Raspberry, Strawberry, Lemonade, Grape, 20-Ounce Bottles (Pack of 24), since my daughter and I like these and each have our favorites. My daughter's favorite is grape. I like the fact that it is not to sweet and has zero calories. It is really nice to drink.

column9: Durants BBQ Sauce...A Must Have In Your Kitchen!
column10: Durant's BBQ Sauce sits in a category of its own! It's truly the best tasting sauce I've ever had. It's great on chicken, pork, beef, and even wild game.It's definitely a must have item in your kitchen! I am extremely satisfied with this product and I strongly recommend it!

This spicy hot yellow chili paste has a unique flavor you can't find with other peppers.  it's great in peruvian dishes, but also good in sauces, in scrabbled eggs, and on meats.  i did have to wait a bit for the product to arrive, but since it's coming from so far away that is to be expected.
My dog lives with lots of cats, so she prefers fishy flavors- This food is expensive, but I have never seen her so happy at dinner-time. Seems to be 100% health oriented ingredients.

You open up some dog food cans and the contents are an unidentifiable mush.  This can has chunks of fish in a brothy gravy.  My dogs keep going back over to their dishes to lick the remnants out.  Must be delicious!
Smells very nice, like pretty flowers and fresh berries. Light and not overwhelming flavor. Just finished my first cup. :)Tea Time!
Just had one cup, very tasty I must say.  It is delightful in many ways, it reminds me of a brand from my past - ATCA... Anyways, this is a great product at a great price - i recommend.. 388

column9: I like the taste and the fragrance
column10: I've been searching for a white tea that tastes good. The idea of white tea with fruit interested me, specially when they call it "organic Very Berry White Tea With Fruit." I drink tea for several reasons. Tea is usually healthier than coffee, and I drink less coffee if I drink more tea. I'm also looking at ingredients with the teas I try. The box says, "Premium organic white tea is naturally blended with organic blueberry, blackberry and natural raspberry to create a refreshing and healthy cup of tea." On the bottom of the box the list of ingredients is given, and is a little different: "Organic ingredients: white tea, blackberry, blueberry, licorice and natural raspberry. Organic products certified by Ecocert-SA F-32600" This tea is supposed to be rich in antioxidants and "sunshine for the senses", so I'm glad to say that I enjoyed the taste. I think it will taste good both as hot tea and iced tea for the Summer.

Describing flavors is always difficult, so forgive me if I don't do it justice. It tastes of fresh berries and mild white tea, with a hint of citrus. It's refreshing but there is a certain warmth to it. I can't taste the licorice at all, which is great because though I like its properties (helps digestion), I hate its taste. This is the most balanced and delicious berry flavored tea I have ever had. The fact that it is organic makes it even better. Strongly recommend it.My local supermarket stopped carrying if for some reason and I was heartbroken. Looked everywhere for it, until it finally occurred to me that I could probably find it where I find everything else - Amazon. : ) Great price, too!
This tea is tasty and I like that it is organic. You save by buying it in bulk here on Amazon.

I thought I'd have trouble going through a case of wild rice so I split it with a friend of mine.  I have a couple of recipes that use it and I was having trouble finding wild rice in my local grocery store.  This stuff is great.  I've got on the internet looking for new wild rice recipes for an excuse to use it some more.  The package size is nice so you don't have to open a big honking bag and hope it doesn't spill all over.  I won't have any problems using up a case when this one is gone.
This is some of the best tasting wild rice I have ever had.  The fact that the individual packages are small was also convenient.

We love wild rice and order 5 lbs. or more every year.  We received our order and cooked some--I have just ordered some more because it was the best quality I have found in several years.  It has great flavor and aroma.
I love wild rice and it adds crunch to low-carb soups and stews. At the grocery store it can be hard to find and expensive, but this is a great supply at a reasonable price.

I absolutely love these Crabbers.  I found them in a Walmart store in Pennsylvania.  When I got back to NY, I found that they weren't available in this area.  Luckily I was able to find them through Amazon and I purchased 12 boxes.  I have shared a couple of boxes with friends and family, and they all love them too!  Down to 4 boxes... may have to order another case or two!

column9: I was hesitant to buy this because of the bad review,
column10: but we really liked it. While there are safe "canned" frostings available, this was a nice small portion and much better tasting.
Not too bad in taste but haven't found the right cake to put it on.  It's really hard to find GF products that are easy and taste good.

Yum! This is good stuff. I like ajvar in general. It's a great spread or dip for bread and also goes very nicely as a sort of "side salad" with meat and potatoes or rice.What to compare it to? I would compare it to salsa in a way, but it's also a bit chutney-ish. It's not vinegary tasting, nor is it horribly spicy. I dont think it's spicy at all, even the hot stuff. It's bright reddish-orange and can stain easily too, so be careful!

I received a jar of this from my croatian sister in law. Tastes intensely of roasted red bell peppers, absolutely delicious! a little spicy (it is seasoned with hot peppers) but not too much. I just eat it pure, a few spoonfuls at a time, I guess normally it is eaten in small amounts as a side with grilled meat.

Finally a flavored sugar!  Splenda is awesome (does not create sugar imbalance in your body, which is the #1 weight gainer)!  The mocha is absolutely the best of the three offered, and I am a French Vanilla fan, usually.  The French Vanilla is a close second and the Hazelnut is a distant third.  One packet of flavored and one plain packet is perfect for one travel sz. mug (14oz).  No need to use two flavored packets as one packs a pretty good punch, which is good since they are a little pricey.  The only "con" is that they are difficult to open since there is no small start-tear on the top.  You have to open it with your teeth and they are the tall plastic packets Vs. regular sugar size paper ones.  A stupid "con", I know, but nothing can be perfect, can it?!

Flavored coffee creamers have been a guilty pleasure of mine for a long time now, but even if you buy the sugar-free kind, you're ingesting a whopping 1 gram of fat per tablespoon of creamer. As if that weren't bad enough, it's partially HYDROGENATED!Splenda Flavor Blends is a wonderful alternative if you're like me and just can't face black coffee. Please note that this is not a creamer. It sweetens/flavors coffee. If you find you just have to have creamer to "tame" down your coffee you can add a Splenda Flavor blend and a splash of skim milk or if you like things more creamy, buy some powdered non-fat milk and add that along with the Splenda Flavor blends.Lots of times, I find products with Splenda already in them to be too sweet but I didn't think that was the case with this. All three of the available flavors (hazelnut, mocha, vanilla) taste great without being overpowering.Finally, now I can kick that fatty creamer bad habit!
My spouse and I are both using this product and enjoy the slight taste of chocolate it gives the morning coffee.
Not as sweet as I expected, but still has a good flavour, Will only dissolve well if your beverage is VERY hot!! Maybe buy again.
Tastes great - Less Calories. Amazon's pricing is cheaper than my local grocery store so I stocked up!
These were bought through Amazon.com and I use them to sweeten plain homemade or store bought yogurt. Yummy, especially when you add fresh strawberries.
I just love this product.  The taste is true Mocha and it leaves no aftertaste.  It is great in coffee but the surprise was adding it to plain yogurt and WHAT A BLAST OF FLAVOR.PERFECT!!!

column9: Plenty sweet, no calories and no aftertaste
column10: For me, the Splenda products are great.  I get a sweet taste with no aftertaste.  (I don't mean no aftertaste like so many diet sodas have claimed for decades, I mean NO aftertaste at all!)  I like the Mocha a lot.  My only complaint with it is that 2 packets make my coffee too sweet but 1 packet doesn't quite bring enough of the mocha taste.  After some experimenting with adding cocoa powder, I've decided to settle for the 2 packets.  Great product.  I've also enjoyed some of the other flavors - Hazelnut and French Vanilla.  And for me, with those two, only one packet is needed.
The Mocha sweetener makes my day just a bit sweeter.  I like it in the morning and I love it in the evening.  Very delicious!

I really love this product!  So much so that when the grocery stores were not carrying this item anymore, I made it a conscious effort on my part to find it on line and buy a good supply of it.  When the boxes arrived ,I even gave my friend, who really loves the taste as well, 2 boxes for her to enjoy.When I could not find this product in the grocery stores I frequent, I tried all sorts of flavorings and nothing came close to being the same as the MOCHA flavor in the splenda packets.Now that I have found this item on line, I am truly a happy person when I have my coffee every morning.Splenda No Calorie Sweetener, Flavor for Coffee, Mocha, 30-Count Boxes (Pack of 6)

Splenda Mocha adds flavor to the skim milk drinks that provide protein to those of us watching our weight.  Splenda made several flavors, including Hazelnut and French Vanilla that all helped make smoothies and "lite" drinks more palatable.  In fact, they make the taste terrific.  However, they have been disappearing from supermarket shelves in the past year so now the only way I can find the Mocha flavor is online.  Thank you for offering it thru Amazon!
I'm never disappointed with this product.  Just enough mocha flavor to not make me feel as if I'm drinking hot chocolate.

Got these because I love the Splenda products. These have a very odd taste, all chemically. It has a small "hint" of chocolate (mocha) but it is obvious that it is chemically produced cause it is just nasty! I don't see how anybody can 5 star this since it really tastes bad. Nice concept and all but, WOW!!!!, what horrible execution.Won't be buying this again........
great product, tastes great, love being able to buy in bulk at a good price, rivals generic prices. well worth it!

column9: Love the product - but be aware it's just a flavor and sweetener.  Not a creamer based product.
column10: I really like it - but it's not what I thought it would be.  I didn't read the product description well enough, but it's still black coffee you're drinking if you use this product. Just keep that in mind.  Makes a GREAT iced coffee - take cold coffee, ice cubes, one or two packets, and some skim milk.  Mix in the blender.  Outstanding - and virtually calorie free.

I add this to my chocolate protein shake every morning.  It gives it a mocha coffee flavor and is yummy!  A good way to start my morning!  I also add it to my coffee after lunch.  Mmmmmmm.  I highly recommend Splend flavors for Coffee!!  I used to buy this at my local grocery store, but they stopped carrying it.  So yay that Amazon sells it! I buy the Pack of 6 30-Count boxes so I never run out!

This product i first found in a grocery store.. I love it sooooo much, I decided to see if Amazon sells it.... Well, they did and I have been buying it ever since.. Love the way it tastes in  my coffee and by the way, my favorite is the Mocha... dont care for the other flavors....Great buy on Amazon

I love these Splenda flavors for coffee.........I especially like the mocha and use it regularly in my coffee.  It's not always easy to find in my small town, and so easy to order online for home delivery.
I love this flavor! Makes my coffee taste so much better!!Such an extra treat in the morning! Look forward to it every day! I could not find it in the stores any longer and thank God Amazon sells it!
It is so surprising that people who made Splenda Hazelnut Flavor did this one too. It has a bitter taste (in the bad sense) and a weird smell. Neither taste nor smell has any resemblance to mocha.
The Mocha flavored Splenda is GREAT in coffee! It gives the coffee a very mild chocolate flavor and you don't need another sweetener.  LOVE this product and shipping was FAST.
Thanks Amazon for carrying this product seeing they took it out of our grocery stores in my town!  Your a life saver!
I am a repeat-buyer of this sweetener. It tastes so good, and how great to not be adding extra calories to your coffee!
I look for this all over walmart use to carry and now dont so I found it on amazon.com thank you its the only thing I like in my coffee

I fell in love with Splenda's mocha flavor when it first came into stores.  For the past year I haven't been able to find it and I am so excited that I can get it from you.  Thanks for carrying my favorite coffee flavoring.
I've tasted Splenda Mocha, French Vanilla, and Hazelnut. I've shared it with my co-workers and all agree that the Mocha has a nice aroma and tastes great.
My grocery store stopped carrying the mocha flavor I love.  I was so glad to be able to order it in bulk from Amazon.
Love our flavored coffee.  Easy to throw some in pocket book for travel.  Company enjoys trying it too.
This is a terrific product especially for flavoring strong coffees and espresso. Not always easy to find in stores unfortunately.
I was very pleased with the delivery and product. I can not buy this in a store near me. This is the only place I can get it. My dad uses 1 to 3 per day. THanks for carring this product!

I looked at every type of grocery store in the surrounding 25 miles and could not find the Mocha flavored Splenda packets.  I finally thought to check Amazon. There they were and they are here now. Everyday is just a little bit sweeter with a mocha twist.
I like this product and it is slightly more expensive then buying it at Wal Mart but I refuse to buy at wal mart........Wish there was a 6 pack of mixed flavors tho

I have never been able to find the Mocha flavor in any local market so I thought I'd give this a try.  I absolutely love this flavor!  It makes my morning start off with a smile.  I am so glad I bought the 6 box pack, it should last me at least 6 months.  I only use one packet per my morning coffee and some creamer and it tastes like what you might buy at Starbucks. I've tried the Vanilla and Hazelnut, but the Mocha is by far my favorite flavor.  Thank you Amazon for selling Splenda flavors for coffee.

These packets are very good with coffee.  While trying to make "skinnier" iced coffee I tried the Caramel and the French Vanilla, and those flavors with a bit of fat free milk made excellent "skinny" iced coffee.  Mocha is up next! I haven't been through all the flavors yet to find one that I think is best, but it's well worth a try for hot and iced coffee.

column9: Really Good Flavored Sweetener - Highly Recommended!
column10: I already use Splenda as a sweetener, so was happy when my wife brought home these Splenda Mocha Flavor for Coffee. The Mocha is my favorite, followed by Splenda No Calorie Sweetener, Flavors for Coffee, Hazelnut, 30-Count Boxes (Pack of 6) and Splenda No Calorie Sweetener, Flavor Blends for Coffee, French Vanilla, 30-Count Boxes (Pack of 6). This is only a sweetener so I still use a splash of "Half and Half" along with two of these in my morning cup. These have no calories and less than 1 Net Carb each, so it isn't bad for me to have more than one cup in the morning.Highly recommended!

I use Splenda Mocha on lots of different things:  To brighten up the taste of plain Cheerios (or other unflavored cereals), to put in plain oatmeal and even to add some variety to yogurt, and of course, in a cup of coffee! Mocha is definitely my favorite.  I also like French Vanilla and Hazelnut.  Caramel is okay too.I just wish that it dissolved better in a cup of coffee.  Most of the time, the majority of it is floating on top of the cup of coffee.Overall, I highly recommend this product.  The price on Amazon is great!
I use the Splenda Mocha flavor in my coffee everyday.  I do use a Nespresso coffee machine which makes strong coffee.I love this product, and I recommend it strongly.
This flavor works great in coffee the mocha flavor blends nicely with all coffee flavors.

At first I just put one of these into my large cup of coffee, and the flavor was just not noteworthy.  Then I put in two of them, and really liked the chocolate kick.  I do recommend these for a touch of variety in your coffee.  Good with creamer, too.

If you are looking for a way to cut back on fat and sugar, these SPLENDA flavor sticks are just what you are looking for!They give you the sweetness and mocha taste without the calories and fat you would get in a non-dairy creamer.I find them handy too, and keep a few in my purse for use at restaurants or coffee from drive-thrus.
the splenda i bought is splenda. it is what it says it is going to be.

My mother, who loves her coffee sweet as candy, fell in love with this product.  It is nice and chocolatey.  I can't even remember how we came to get a packet of it to try, but none of my local grocery stores or discount stores carried this flavor.  I was thrilled to be able to order some for her Christmas stocking this year.

In my area, only the French Vanilla and Hazelnut flavors are available in stores, and I do use the FV flavor, but visiting my sister in Manassas I tried her Mocha flavor and really liked it. I was totally unable to find it in my area, so I was pleased to find a seller on Amazon after being unsuccessful on eBay. The seller shipped it quickly and at a good price. It tastes great in coffee (I don't know about tea...) and really does have a nice chocolate flavor.
I found this a great product taste wise and can be used a multiple of ways to perk up whipped cream, yogurt, angelfood cake, etc.
I did receive the Splenda flavor packs and enjoy them alot.

I use this mocha flavored splenda in my iced coffee daily! I use 2 packs to 4 tsp reg splenda in a 32oz cup filled with ice, pour (fresh ground coffee beans) hot coffee over ice, stir, add splash of half & half, stir. Slurp & then you go AHHHH.....Best price for this here on Amazon, buy on subscription.Enjoy,Teresa

I was very disappointed in the taste of this item.  Not at all what I expected from Splenda.  It is much too overpowering, strong and when added to your beverage, that is all you can taste.  For instance, if added to coffee, you will not detect ANY coffee flavor, only the Splenda flavor.  Much too strong.  I prefer the subtle taste of the other coffee additives over this Splenda product - without question!!

I was looking for a less expensive nori source and this is the spot! Shipping was prompt and all of the nori has been top quality thus far! I would definitely order more again, but I ordered ten bags so I'm not sure how soon that will be!

column9: The product is good--the price is ridiculous
column10: I feel kind of foolish that I've been buying this Nori from Amazon for a while now.  To be fair, the Edozen Nori brand does taste great and is easy to work with when making sushi rolls.  However, I thought $4.99 wasn't bad for a pack of 10 . . . until I discovered this exact same brand, same package for sale at my local Kroger grocery store for $1.99.  Yep, I've been paying 2 1/2 times too much for something that was readily available at a grocery store chain.  I would check out your local grocery store before buying this product from Amazon and you may get a much better deal.
The item was so easy to use, I only with there were more of them.

I make sushi often and these are the worst Nori I have ever purchased.  They were extremely thin, very crumbly and fell apart at the most gentle touch.  After trying to use 2, I threw the remainder in the trash.

I got the sushi sheet for a healthy additive to my eating habits. i just cut off a square or two and place it on or with my food. i can add it to sandwiches or even make impromptu sushi. Example, I had some lasagna leftover so I made Lasagna Sushi Rolls !!! It was great !!!I've even experimented with making sushi chips. Basically baking slices of the sushi sheets in "chip" sizes. They are great with guacamole.However, make sure you use two sheets thickness on your "slices" and dip them in olive oil and cover with milled flax seed (as a batter) THEN place in over(preheated 325) and bake until you feel they are crispy enough for ya.
Still sitting in my fridge after a year, Used about one sheet. Just go to your local market or store - don't be lazy like me! not fresh or very tasty at all either...
You can get a better value if you shop at a local store. You only get ten very fishy tasting sheets, but I was able to get 60 sheets at a better price, and better quality out in town.

These packets of 10 sheets sell for $1.99 to $2.99 in local grocery stores.  When I first ordered this item is stated that there was more than 1 pack of 10 sheets; what I received was one (1) packet of 10 sheets.

This is very good roasted seaweed.  Excellent, in fact.  Most companies just dry their seaweed but let me tell you, they are lazy and really don't know seaweed.  See, that's the problem with most of the world today, laziness!  I can remember a time when companies and people cared about going the extra mile, when quality still mattered.  It's a shame.  Everyone is all about speed and convenience, speed and convenience.  It's like we're all on treadmills or really fast escalators or something quick and automated like that.  I just don't know what is wrong with everyone.  Sometimes I just have to sit down and shake my head.Roasting makes the seaweed almost taste like chicken and when you use it in your favourite recipes, you will think you've died and gone to heaven.  Yamamotoyama is the best!

I never received this. I waited almost a month and sent an e-mail. I was told to wait a little longer, after I did I sent another e-mail and was given a refund. Horrible communication, should have been told that it was going to be delayed instead of having to send e-mails a month after the fact. Terribly disappointing.

I do not know how the product itself is because I gave it to my sister for Christmas. However, the company said it would be delivered on or by Dec 24 if I ordered on Dec 17 (which I did). It did not come until Dec 26. So, on Christmas day I had to tell my sister what her Christmas present was but that I did not have it yet. This was part of a Sushi making kit that I was putting together for her and some of the other items in it were from this company too.
This is the only electrolyte tablet I could find that has caffeine and no aspartame or acesulfame potassium.  The taste is mild and not overpowering.  Highly recommend!

column9: If you've ever experienced severe dehydration
column10: If you have ever experienced sever dehydration you know how important a way to rehydrate rapidly can be. I've been there, and suffered heat exhaustion. Nowadays I hyperhydrate before doing any prolonged outdoor activity, but I also use the ZYM tablets as a way to rapidly rehydrate and repalace lost electrolytes during and after such activities. They are convenient to use and work rapidly. The berry flavor is my favority.
I use this drink mix on all of my workouts. Not too sweet and goes down easily with no GI upsets
I love these things! They really seems to help with my energy levels when I run. I only wish they were cheaper...
I was looking for alternatives to the Camelbak elixir because I got tired of always having orange if I wanted the caffeine.Berry taste was ok and they seemed to work as you'd expect.
I received the ZYM Berry sports tablets in a timely manner and started using them right away. The tablets are more convienent than powder mixes. The ZYM Berry is berry-licious!

I ride Dualsport, so we go on pretty long rides, (100 mile+). I used to cramp up around 3 or 4 o'clock, but with this product, I tend to stay hydrated a lot better. Camelbak elixer is also good, as is any electrolyte mix. I highly recommend it!

I am not an athlete but I have read several reviews which investigates the role of electrolytes in increasing the body's energy level.Electrolytes serve as the motor oil of the body. It keeps your cells on the go and a sudden decrease in its amount will result to fatigue and exhaustion. Most athletes experience these situations after long hours of training so many of them rely on different types of energy drinks, energy bar and power shakes which promises immediate energy booster. However only ZYM Catapult Energy Drink offers immediate absorption of electrolytes which results to instant improvement of your stamina and energy leve. YOu simply mix it with your water and you experience how it will give you additional jolts of energy to endure further trainings and work-outs. Unfortunately, the energy boosting effects of ZYM will not last  for so longGiven the chance to purchase Gene Eden Vir 101, it is still by far the best and perfect energy booster I will recommend for athletes and non-athletes who wish to gain longer lasting energy boosters. It suppresses the production of chronic viruses in the body so the much needed energy of the cells is efficiently utilized. It costs a little higher than ZYM Catapult Energy drink but if you are in search of long lasting energy boosters and increased level of immune system then it is the perfect choice not only for you but your family as well.

I ordered these not knowing exactly what they were: there's no picture or description at Amazon, and google wasn't helping. But at the price I thought I'd take a chance :DThese are 12 individually wrapped plastic containers. Each has a chain attached (so can be used as a key chain), and a round lid with a "doodle" on it. All 12 in our assortment were different, but all of them were cute. A couple had monsters that would appeal to boys (and since we got them for Halloween giveaways, they tie in nicely!).Inside each container there's about 20 pieces of gum, different colors (white, yellow, red, green, orange and blue) and different flavors. The pieces are smaller, so you'd probably want to have 2 at a time. The flavors are ok, but don't last super long.My kids (10 and 6) were very excited to try this product and said that it's "the coolest gum ever", and it would be an awesome addition to a goodie bag.The gum I received (10/1/2011) appeared very fresh, but did not have an expiration date stamped on the containers. It is NOT sugar free. It's made in Canada, and the containers have something stamped in Hebrew, so the containers might be made in Israel. (It's a rare thing nowadays to find something this inexpensive NOT made in China).Overall, we are happy with the product and delivery (only took one day to get here!)
I mix this half and half with Crystal Light Iced Tea with Lemon, and it turns out just right for my Arnold Palmer.

I bought two boxes of this, I love spinach noodles, and this is a great price, its hard to find this in the grocery stores I shop at, I use this in salads and is delicious tossed with olive oil, garlic, and a little wine, its great for many recipes, the spinach flavor is more subtle than some brands Iv tried, I like that because it doesnt taste too spinachy, I will buy this again for sure.

I loved the idea of receiving Biscotti by mail at it is sort of a main stay for me.  I have it for my breakfast and at 4pm each evening, I may have another piece with my tea. I was so disappointed when it came as many of the biscotti were nothing more then crumbs. Whoops back to Cost Co.  Thanks.  BB

I've been using K-cups for around three years and this flavor of coffee is my absolute favorite. It has a hint of cinnamon without overpowering the coffee flavor. I'm a black coffee drinker so I get the full impact of a wonderful, lightly flavored coffee.Since I live in a small beach town, it's wonderful to have Amazon to go to for coffee delivery. The company is very dependable.

Received a flat of this product on a subscription. I was hoping to save money by buying in bulk and was looking forward to the  convenience of having the product shipped on a scheduled basis.The very first carton I opened contained a thick and lumpy fluid. It did not smell bad or have a distinct taste - it just was not what I expected to come out of a carton that should have contained soy milk. Yes I did shake the carton well before opening it.The second carton was fine.The bottom line is that the loss of one carton from the flat eliminates the whole value proposition of buying in bulk and on-line. I would avoid this brand.Update: Score so far for the pack of 12: 3 bad 8 good. One more to go!

I cannot tolerate milk so this soymilk is ideal for me. It's fine for coffee and in anything that will overpower it. By itself it's not that great. Ii makes awesome protein shakes: 3 cups of soymilk, 2 scoops of soy protein powder and 3 to 4 tbsp of agave gives you 20gr of protein per cup. I have no sugar spikes with this drink and my stomach is happy with it.

column9: tasty soy milk, love that it's unsweetened
column10: I really like unsweetened soy milk and I was thrilled when I saw this product on Amazon. Not only is it unsweetened, it's also organic, and you can get it for cheaper through the subscription service. It's super convenient to just get a box of 12 cartons or so every month instead of having to lug them home from the grocery store.I did recently discontinue this subscription for two reasons. First, I saw that the regular store-brand unsweetened organic soy milk is cheaper per carton than this one (even if I factor in the subscription discount). Second, and more important, I wanted to switch to a soy milk that is fortified with certain vitamins (i.e. B12, since I don't eat animal products).That being said, I really liked the taste of that one and the convenience of the subscription service.
Pleasant taste, smooth texture, although unsweetened, has a sweeter taste than some soy milks.  Great in coffee!

I have to second what Croy said, I use this with All the Whey chocolate flavored whey protein and an electric mixer every weekday morning for breakfast. 3 cups & 2 scoops is just about right, adjust to thickness preference. I prefer it to be very thick, I find it tastes better and has more protein that way. On its own this soy milk is OK.

After ordering the first time this great, sit on the shelf unsweetened, organic soy milk I became a frequent flyer subscriber.  Once one was puntured in transport, said nothing.  Like magic, from then on double wrapped, plenty of room, fits on the shelf in its own carton.  I could not find seller feedback for this item, so i will put in this review...today i got almond by mistake.  organic, unsweetened...maybe this is a promo !!  i will review soon and though, i need my soy.  Thank you Amazon and Pacific Natural Foods for helping us be organic.

I'm allergic to so many food additives, mostly vitamins and preservatives, so was happy to find a purely natural soy.  I was buying another organic soy, then they started adding vitamin supplements and I started to break out.  Unfortunately my coffee shop has switched to their blenders version, which has additives, so not more soy chai on the run.  This is a good product and I'm not all itchy.

Love that this product has only 2 ingredients: filtered water and whole organic soybeans. This is exactly what we wanted; no extra vitamins, no sweeteners, no carageenan. The only problem is that 2 out of the 12 containers were spoiled. I have attached a photo above. Other than that issue we love it and are working through a second case. If we have the same issue with these I will contact customer service.
The soy milk is great.The price is comparable to the grocery store, but getting a dozen boxes at a time means we don't have to go to the store every other day.
Thank you Pacific for providing this option to have a simple pure product. I use it daily on my oatmeal or sometimes a small glassful to quench my thirst.

My husband is dairy sensitive and uses soy milk on his cereal and in other circumstances because he can't use dairy forms of milk.  He had a hard time switching to soy milk because of the taste, but after awhile he has come to like it.  He doesn't like the taste of soy milk at room temperature, but has found that refrigerated soy milk tastes pretty good.  I have bought different brands in stores over the years and he doesn't really have a preference as to which tastes best.
