It's pretty much a commodity for him.So, when I saw this brand on Amazon and I could sign up with the Subscribe and Save program, I was thrilled.  It meant not need to lug those big containers home from the grocery store. However, it didn't turn out so well.  My husband said that the refrigerated form of this soy milk tastes pretty much like other brands do when unrefrigerated.  It just doesn't taste very good to him.So, I have cancelled my subscription for this product.  What a disappointment.

Once the bag is opened that's the end of it. They have the kind of flavor that won't let go until the bag is empty. Fortunately the bags are only 7 oz. Still a fair amount but better that a quart of your favorite ice cream. Just too good!

These are terrible -- not even edible.  They were soggy with a bad aftertaste.  I give up on trying to find a different good tasting butter toffee peanut on-line.  I tried these because of the other good reviews, honestly I don't know how anyone could rate these anything other than disgusting.
These are very tasty and addicting.  Not the very best Butter Toffee peanuts I have ever tasted, but I do like them a lot and I have reordered them a couple of times.

I tried this based upon a recommendation from a local trainer. I purchased online to avoid the hassle of going to numerous stores to find it in my area. Shipping was free, that helped. I am pretty picky overall, do not like most of the aftertastes of protein drinks. I actually thought these were quite good and will be adding them to my daily regimen. I do not use as a before workout/post workout drink, but rather as a quick snack midmorning to hold me over. I have not tried the Chai but the Cappucino, Chocolate, and French Vanilla were good. I did refrigerate before drinking.

column9: The chocolate tastes like mocha, not pure chocolate
column10: I'm a huge fan of chocolate and cocoa.  This doesn't taste like pure chocolate or cocoa.  Instead, it has a coffee taste, and I'd bet that one of the "natural flavors" listed is coffee.  My stomach agreed and gave me reflux (which is common for coffee).  The erythritol and stevia took a little getting used to.  Other than that, it had a smooth texture and a nice amount of protein.  I wish they didn't hide the true ingredients with the "natural flavors" listing -- a lot of stuff is natural and still not what I want in a protein drink.
Delicious, especially the chocolate. The vanilla is not bad either.  Haven't tried the chai.  This drink not only tastes good but also makes me FEEL GOOD!

column9: Filling but doesn't taste very good
column10: I picked up a four pack of these at a local grocery store.  I did not care for the taste at all.  If you like soy, great, but I really don't like it and soy is definitely the predominant flavor.  The aftertaste is also really lingering.  I know some say that's the stevia, but I don't mind the stevia aftertaste in non-soy products, I think the combination of the two is what makes it so unpleasant for me.  I still wanted chocolate after having this, perhaps because it doesn't taste like chocolate, it tastes like soy with some cocoa.  It is filling, and I was able to use it successfully as a meal replacement (unlike your typical meal replacement drinks, which are a joke).  I also tended to get a headache and minor stomach ache while drinking it and had to practically force myself to finish each bottle.  Other drinks out there taste a LOT better, but nothing has worked as well for an easy meal that I can grab and go.  I think I will keep looking until I find the perfect protein drink for me.  I just don't think this is it.  I give it three stars because the ingredients are better than average and it does fill me up well.  It does what it should, just not in an appealing way.

I don't eat meat, so am always looking for a tasty source of protein. I also have a hectic job, and don't always have time to sit for a meal. This drink is great!! Very good by itself, or in fruit smoothies!

column9: Great - Awesome - Amazing from every ASPECT!!!!!!
column10: Finally something that is good for you AND tastes like you are cheating....... JUST LOVE IT!!!!!... please do not let the ball drop and tell me there is something "bad" in it that we aren't supposed to have .... I can only speak about the chocolate flavor.... i actually look forward to it every morning!

For starters - I do not like most forms of energy and protein drinks.  I find the tastes are too sugary or the aftertaste is bitter or it just doesn't do what it's supposed to.  Anything that states it can be a meal replacement should not make me feel starved or deprived 1 hour later - as is the case normally.The Svelte Chocolate is good.  Yes some aftertaste exists, but to me it taste like the same aftertaste as anything made from soy.  I've only had the chocolate because my local store carries chocolate and cappuccino and I don't like coffee related flavors.This drink will leave you feeling full and sated for several hours.  I had one for breakfast one time and was perfectly fine all morning.  I didn't sit at my desk craving food.  It also works really well for afternoons if there is a long time between lunch and dinner.The flavor is also rich.  It's not super sugar sweet but more of a rich sweet, which satisfies any cravings for sugar or chocolate.One of my favorite things is the size - 1 bottle is an entire serving!  It's not one of those, "Here's a single-serving size container that has 4 servings in it" products.  Which probably helps with the satisfaction afterwords because you can have more than 4 oz.If chocolate isn't your style - try one of the other 3 flavors.  I hope to try the french vanilla and chai soon.

Svelte sustained energy protein drink is the best tasting nutritional supplement that I've ever had. Both the Chocolate and French Vanilla varieties are rich, satisfying and so tasty, you'd swear they had to be bad for you.

Really like these protein shakes, and had discovered them in a high-end grocery. When I looked, Amazon carried them! So I now subscribe and have them shipped every month. On my third or fourth month and not tired of chocolate yet (tired of chocolate=oxymoron?)
I have tried many protein drinks - prepared and powdered.  This is one of the best tasting chocolate ones around;  it tastes great cold.  It also is organic, which I like!

Enjoy this product  m-f  for breakfast... it keeps me  satisified,  and it is delicious ... great taste..a tiny bit price but well worth it...Great for Chocolate lovers like me who are trying to lose weight... delightful..

I have finally found it, a yummy chocolate liquid "food" that actually helps several health problems.  It beats all the diabetic drinks, both on the label and by evidence of my own little experiment.  I drink it every morning in my coffee - a half/half recipe that starts my day out just right.  Rich, creamy, filling....

column9: Best protein drink on the market!!
column10: Calnaturale has figured out a way to make a protein drink without that chalky aftertaste.  It tastes like a delicious milk shake yet it's quite healthy with a minimal amount of sugar.  For me, it has become the go to drink after a vigorous workout.

The chocolate Svelte flavor is good until two seconds after you drink it. The Stevia flavor is an unpleasant surprise that lingers. I needed the protein from the drink and was filled up by it. However, I felt like I was forcing down every swallow and dreaded the aftertaste. Cute designs but I guess I'll have to try some other flavors and see if it can mask the Stevia.

I had high hopes for this product - lots of protein, not too much sugar, convenient packaging, and comes in several great-sounding flavors. Unfortunately, I failed to notice that it's also a veritable cocktail of nasty zero calorie sweeteners. I don't know whether it's the erythritol, the stevia, or both, but something in this product gives it a horrible, too-sweet, chemical aftertaste that I find truly undrinkable. I had to throw the whole thing away after the first sip. Consider yourself warned!
There was a coupon for this so I purchased it instead of Orgain. It's not bad but I prefer the taste of Orgain. This has a slightly weird after taste and it's a little bit bitter.

Strangest thing how something that is supposed to be good for you has all kinds of vegetable gums listed on the label. I guess people who drink this stuff are candidates for enemas, which is one of those growth industries in California. Do you want an enema? Oh right, there is inulin and other not-quite-fiber added to help out with the drain clog process. Do you think their added "fiber" makes a difference? I don't.And, when did the FDA allow food processors to use the highhanded and totally consumer-enemy term "Natural Flavors". I guess that is more informative than, say, "Unnatural Flavors", or even "Abnormal Flavors". Hmm, I think I'll go with "Abnormal Flavors", because that is what it tastes like.If you like the taste, you'll like the taste. Some products tell you that a man will turn into a woman from ingesting soy protein. This product eliminates all that and cuts to the chase by putting "Hello, beautiful" on the front. Well, fact is, I am a good-looking man, and I don't care what nonsense they put on these packages.It's the stevia ingredient that leaves that bitter aftertaste, as the other customer pointed out, but it tastes like sucralose. Tell you what, live a little. Put some sugar in to taste. Much, much better that way.

I was so excited for this to arrive because I LOVE Orgain drinks and this has two benefits over Orgain.  The first benefit is the drink is larger in size (15.9 oz versus 11 oz) and it has a twist off cap that you can put back on (which Orgain does not).  This unfortunately is where the benefits end for this product.  Orgain tastes SO much better and also has more vitamins in it.  I don't know if it is the soy milk or what, but the taste of this is absolutely horrible!  It is like a bad medicine after taste.  I purchased this because of all of the positive reviews on amazon and because of the packaging versus Orgain.  I was REALLY hoping this would be great, but I now have eleven containers of this stuff that I will never drink.  I cannot stress how bad this was to me, but maybe you will like it since so many others do.  I wish that I would have purchased an individual bottle before buying a whole case, but that was my own fault for not doing so.  Don't make the same mistake I did!

This stuff only got 1 star because there is no option for ZERO stars. Bottom line, it's nasty--terrible aftertaste. We got it free as a trial through AmazonFresh, but we'd never waste money on buying it.

I will buy this variety pack again and again. I get bored with the same coffee every day and this decaf sampler gives you a chance to change it up every day. There's also a nice variety from milder breakfast blends to extra bold decaf for later in the day. Thank you for offering a sampler box. It will be my new standard order from now on!!

I bought this try to figure out which decaf brand of coffee I would like to stock up on for my Keurig.  All of the flavors in this pack tasted great and so I was unable to narrow it down to a single flavor.  Instead, I will be re-ordering this pack.

This coffee might be decaf, but it gives a big punch of taste. love that I have the choice of four great coffees to choose from and that each one is excellent. Great value, too, for those of us that drink a lot of coffee.
I would buy this variety box again. Good value and good mix. Green mountain is my favorite brand of K-cups.

column4: terzap "aka I Love my Quaker Parrot"
column10: My sister liked these a lot more than I did--she likes a far milder coffee than I do.  I had to use two of them per cup on a smaller water setting (as I do even with many caffeinated varieties) to get the flavor I like.  So three stars from me and four from my sister.  A nice, smooth tasting selection of decaf if you like mild coffee.
I enjoyed this variety box very much, except that the dark magic extra bold was too strong for me.  I loved every other flavor and then I knew what to buy in the future.

I really liked this sampler. There were several different types of decaf coffee in it, including two I really like, the Vermont blend and Breakfast blends.  I like getting the sampler so I can find which kind I like the best, and then can order more of that.My only complaint about it is the price, which is why it's only 4 stars instead of 5. Overall it's been great.
I have tried most of the offerings in this sampler, and they are well worth the 50 cents or so they usually cost.  Here they are offered at over a dollar each - a true rip off.

column9: This price is for only one small pack.
column10: The $11.33 price is for only one pack of these.  I'm used to paying much less in the store, about $3 a pack.  These are my favorite sushi wrappers though.  I have to drive out of my way to get them, so I thought buying them through Amazon was a good idea.  I should have read the description more carefully.  Another Amazon seller has these in a 4 pack for about the same price but not with free shipping.  I saw this one and decided to purchase it because of the free shipping.  It wasn't until it arrived that I saw it wasn't for a 4 pack.  I'm returning it.  It's a great relief that Amazon is good about returns.

column9: Small amount for the money but delicious candy
column10: I received this item. A tiny bag arrived with only 4 pieces of candy in it. I complained to the seller and they remedied the situation. Very nice seller. Good candy; but still a very small quantity for the price you pay.

I love good Pecorino, but finding it where I live can be challenging! And when I do find it, it's usually extremely expensive. This is excellent cheese, and a great value. The p0ackaging ket it in great condition - with a cold pack and cooler! I will definitely buy this again.

As a long term vegan I use this product for salads and sauces not as a source of B12 (nutritional yeast doesn't contain B12 unless it's fortified with it).I love the quality and consistency (I've been a long term buyer). I would highly recommend you check out Barry Farm for gourmet and hard to get foods (no, I don't work for them or have any investment in the company).I live in a area where it is impossible to get wasabi, nori or other specialty Asian products, so I'm forced to purchase online. I'm glad that there is a Barry Farms in cyber space.

I've been eating nutritional yeast or brewer's yeast on my popcorn for years and this brand has the perfect flavor and texture. It gives it that perfect, rich, almost cheesy flavor that I'm looking for.

I wanted to try a recipe which called for Nutritional Yeast - something I had never heard of before.  I did a little research to find out more about nutritional yeast and I was intrigued. It is very tasty.  I sprinkle it on my fruit breakfast every morning. I have used it in soups, sprinkled on vegetables, on pasta. It adds a unique flavor, which I like very much.  I have to trick my boyfriend into eating well and this is a great way to add Vitamin B12 to any dish.
I can get this product in bulk from Wegman's for just a dollar more per lbs, but since this vendor has less expensive bulk Gluten and other vegan type products, it worth buying from here.

I've purchased several items from Barry Farm, and I have been impressed with the quality of their product, and the way they package it.  I would highly recommend the products from this company.  The only downside is they don't offer 'prime' shipping.

I love nutritional yeast!  Full of protein and fiber, but ver low in calories.  My favorite way to eat them is on popcorn, but I also put them in soups and salads.  Or I just eat them by the spoonfull!  My 5 year old daughter loves them too and calls them, "yummy flakes."
This is a good product. I've used it in several different recipes to increase the flavor and nutritional value. I couldn't find this where I live so glad to be able to order it.

I ordered Nutritional yeast from Berry Farms.  Order was supposed to be shipped within 24 hours, however, it took 4 days for them to even start to ship it...This is unacceptable in my opinion especially since this was an in stock item.  As I am still waiting for product to arrive though its been 12 days I can not tell you how good the product is.  Will not order from this company again no matter how good the product is..

This nutritional yeast was alright. It was my first time ever trying a dish using nutritional yeast. I used it to make cheesy sauce and it was okay. It had a weird look to it and I wonder if it's suppose to look like that?
I love how it's long lasting. I don't buy any other gum. Buying large pack size works great for me. It arrived fast.

does this gum make it almost impossible to drink water within 30 minutes of chewing?  The menthol is so incredibly strong that it burns afterward.  The gum does have VERY fresh mint taste, but it can be a bit overbearing...
admittedly.....if you do not mix it...it is awful....but mix in the same amount of pineapple juice as rum punch and you have ONE GREAT TROPICAL DRINK....THAT'S ALL THERE IS TO IT!

We love Malibu Rum but they sure missed the mark with their Rum Punch. I even tried to mix it with some juice and fruit but the cough syrup flavor was still present. Don't waste your money. Too bad there's not a no star option, one star is still too high.

Really. Is this robitussin? Pretty sure it is. Barf. The only thing that made it not directly taste like cough syrups was the sun tan lotion lingering after taste. I wouldn't waste my time with this...it would be embarrassing  to serve.

I don't know if I might have got a bad bag, but the stuff I got was terrible. It tasted like unsweetened grapefruit and other weird things. I went back and read the ingredient list and no grapefruit. I can't figure out what makes it so bitter. The ads say its a sweet drink.... Don't waste your money.
It's very effective. I don't use it for losing weight, but I drink it when I need to regulate my bowel movmnt. :)
This tea helps for constipation, I have nerve damage and I rather take a naturalproduct over precription drugs! I had a hard time getting this at first. I take two cups of water to one tea bag a day.

This is a very good product if you must have a bowel movement at least once a day and that doesn't happen.  With Uncle Lee's green tea I have no problem with that issue.  I take pain medicine and this helps me stay regular.
I love this tea. I have about 2-3 cups a night and it has been helping me lose weight. Add some honey to it and you're all good to go!
This tea really helps with bloating and digestive issues. I definitely recommend drinking this at night.  This works EXACTLY the same as ballerina tea.
china dieter tea has been a great product i would but again. it works andalso great for detoxing
My items were shipped fast, I used the onions this week, I let them soak for a bit then added them to my Meal while cooking, they did good! I will be ordering more products from this Farm. Thanks

column9: Thery don't have what they list on Amazon
column10: I would like to say I find this to be a good product.  But this company canceled this part of my multi-item order.  I went on Amazon the same day of cancellation and they still listed it for sale, apparently in-stock.  So I found the same thing at Sam's Club for cheaper once you factor in the astronomically high shipping charge.
I love all the products that Barry Farms sell.  They are excellent in every way!
The label indicates this is a "medium roast" coffee however, it looks, smells and tastes like a burnt espresso. Very unpleasant!

column9: Not a bad taste but nothing special
column10: This coffee is not bad but there are better and cheaper options out there. For me personally, this is not a smart buy.

My Chihuahua is a very particular dog when it comes to her food. I brought her home for the first time when she was six weeks old, and as soon as she was old enough to eat treats, I bought her a box of dog biscuits. She wouldn't touch them. No matter what brand of biscuit my dog was offered, if it was shaped like a little bone and was crunchy she wouldn't touch it. I even purchased some special home made biscuits from a dog specialty bakery that were coated in dog safe icing. She licked the icing off and left the biscuit. She won't even eat milkbones.So imagine my surprise when she received one of these treats from my Uncle before I could warn him that she doesn't eat dog biscuits. My dog wolfed it down so fast I almost missed her eating it! I don't know what she loves about these things so much more than other biscuits, but she loves them! I'm glad I've finally found a dog treat that she'll eat that isn't bad for her.
GREAT STUFF! FEELS VERY WHOLESOME TO BOTH ME AND MY DOGS..LIKE I SAID THEY JUST LOVE THIS STUFF AND II JUST LOVE THEM. SO, THAT'S WHAT THEY GET-WHAT THEY LOVE.

column4: R. Mastromauro "Loving life as a Mom"
column10: A co-worker recently bought this in to work from an island vacation.  It was so good, it was gone within seconds of opening it!  I searched for it and was lucky to find it on Amazon and pretty decent prices!  Once I received it, my husband and I dug into this and it was extremely good!It is the perfect cake!  moist through out, sweet with a slight pungent sweet rum aroma and flavor.  Yum Yum!My new favorite type of cake!  It is pretty lethal, and pretty saturated with sugar, so be careful!

I have the recipe for this cake in the original, not a copy cat, but the actual real recipe. I only know this cake from making it and if this is half as good as that, I'd say grab it. It puts most rum cakes to shame save a rum baba which is yeast risen and I prefer this to a baba.My guy adores this cake (he had it there once while on a cruise) and I will make it for our holiday season this year as a surprise. This rum cake is famous and renowned in the world of rum cake lovers.Anybody calling this junk, obviously is not coherent IF one is a true rum cake lover. I'd HIGHLY recommend trying this before investing your time in making one. I have successfully made this with a good quality gold rum and with a spiced rum.
I love this rum cake.  I've only had the original flavor but it always amazes me how moist it is.  I recommend storing it in the fridge after opening but a must try for anyone who likes rum.

I usually make homemade rum cakes for Christmas gifts.  This Christmas (2011) my schedule was hectic, so I decided to purchase the Tortuga Caribbean Gold Bar Rum Cake instead of baking.  I bought several as gifts, but I also bought one for myself to try out (taste test).  This rum cake is moist, light, and there is rum generously soaking the bottom of the cake.  DELICIOUS.  I was tempted to not give out the gifts and eat all the cakes, but relented and decided I could order more for my own pleasure.  I highly recommend this as a gift - or be selfish and enjoy the cake all to yourself.

column9: Very Good, reminds me of Cayman
column10: The Tortuga Caribbean Gold Bar Rum Cake is very good.  For some reason, it tastes better than the same version in the round cake form.  I have no clue why, but the rum taste is a little stronger and the cake is rather buttery.  It actually reminds me of the Blackbeard Rum Cake in Cayman which isn't available online anywhere outside of Cayman.  The Blackbeard cake is better, but this Gold Bar Rum cake is very close and is flavored better than the round cake version made by Tortuga.

Just the smell of this stuff is an experience. You know this really has rum when you open it. The flavor dissipates quickly so eat everything in one sitting! If you must save some, keep a little rum on hand to sprinkle on a slice five minutes before eating. You'll be glad you did.
This was the best tasting rum cake I have eaten in a very long time. It was moist and delicious by itself or with coffee or tea. It just needed to be larger;to soon and it was gone.

We went our honeymoon 17 years ago in the Cayman Islands where we first tasted/became addicted to this moist buttery yummy rum cake. They even sell mini cakes in corner stores like a twinkie :)  I actually ordered this cake from Cayman 17 years ago before it was availabe through Amazon.
Tortuga Rum Cakes are always a good choice.  If you haven't tried them before, you need to.  Never a bad experience with them, always fresh and tasty.
just a mass of "cake-like" over soaked in poor quality rum,with a small amount(10 or so) of mini "choolate chips"..pass this up
I purchased the almonds for a bridal shower and they were perfect and delicious. They were the perfect addition to the shower.

As a kid, I always wanted the ability to buy Lucky Charms without the cereal. Jet-Puffed Mallow Bits are just that. They're perfect for my hot chocolate and taste exactly like the marshmallows in your favorite cereal. They are much much cheaper at Target than this listing though.
The stated shipping weight says eight pounds so I thought this was a bulk order. With shipping, I paid more than ten times what I would have paid in a store.

I have a popular single cup coffee brewer and liked the hot chocolate but they always lacked the mini marshmallows.  This helps make that cup PERFECT!!!  I also add these to Rice Krispies for my daughter's morning cereal and they make great toppings for cake pops too!  Oh, and don't forget to add these little bits to your homemade Rice Krispes treats.  I have to buy 3 or 4 when I go to the store and find these. (Because not all stores stock them and my daughter likes to eat them up before I can use them sometimes.)
my absolute favorite! i love putting these in my cereal, with dried fruit, and adding extra to my hot coco!!

My kids were so excited to get this in the mail.  We make hot chocolate now with our keurig and they were missing the marshmallows these work great.  But i got the bottle on Oct 22, 2012 my husband checked the run out date and it was Oct 23, 2012.  Wish they would pay closer attention to this when shipping products my husband is a very close watcher of these run out dates.

In the past I had purchased a bag of another co's Birthday Cake coffee and it was beyond delicious, especially when mixed with other flavored coffees.  I got this in hopes...  but it doesn't taste like anything except plain old coffee.  I was expecting too much I'm sure but it could have had a little taste to it - the description sounded tasty - but the product?  Not so much :(

column9: Disappointing...sorry I didn't read previous review:(
column10: I too had a different company's Birthday Cake coffee and loved it. I was so happy to find this product, thinking it would be similar to the one I had a few months ago. This coffee has absolutely no "vanilla & creamy butter flavor" as stated on the package, it just tasted like plain coffee. I'm so sorry that I didn't read the previous review entitled "huge letdown" because this coffee certainly was a disappointment.
This coffee is delicious, just as described by the manufacturer, and the packaging looks great too. The taste is warm, light, and sweet, without being overwhelmingly flavored or tasting "burnt".

I love this product, and can't find it anywhere locally. It is delicious, and the taste far outshines that of grocery store brand microwave popcorn. The kernals are small and pure white when popped, and for you folks who love the semi-pops - there's plenty to enjoy. A great American product. Thanks for listing it. I only regret that the box will soon be empty...

These are really delicious.  Unfortunately I have stopped ordering them because I was eating the entire 2 oz package at one sitting, which was too many calories for a snack!  I wish they came in smaller packages!

column9: Good Food but Cans --> All Deeply Dented
column10: Since I purchased a case of this, it arrived to me shrink wrapped.  I put the entire case on the shelf.  When I opned it weeks later, I learned that each and every can was dented, some severely.  When I tried to return this to Amazon, they declined saying that too much time had passed to return it (about a month).Unfortunately this has turned me off of Lick Your Chops brand.  They were clearly dented before they were shipped, not by Amazon.  Is their quality control that bad?Lesson learned:  when purchasing a case, open it immedately; perhaps I could have returned it then.I regret not being able to give the product more stars as the food inside has been historically good.  But I won't feed anybody food from cans with gashes in them.

column9: Kind of natural, at least my dog doesen't throw it up
column10: My dog pukes on just about every canned dog food.  I can feed her a little of this on some dry food and she almost always keeps it down.  As far as being natural, it looks just about ( and smells) like all the other dog foods.  But you do see an occasional piece of rice or vegetable in there, if those are expensive parts of this dog food, I guess it is better than whatever the other dog foods put in that make Brandy throw up
The product arrived very promptly and in excellent condition.  I liked the packing material because it was recycled gift wrap!
Delicious, reasonably priced, a nice zing, and all proceeds go to a great cause.  RIP Paul Newman!!

column9: Best Mints Ever... Altoids? Nah... Newman's!
column10: Ok, I was a confirmed Altoid freak, but hated the price, and they were just a very little bit too strong for me... But these! Wow! I love letting them melt in my mouth, I could go thru 2 rolls a day if I didn't stop myself :) TIP: right now they are on sale at Ocean State Job Lot for $1.50 for a 4pak of rolls...(Jan 2009)

column9: The Best Mint Ever.  Very Refreshing
column10: 24 rolls of the most refreshing mints ever. These mints are the best and quite a value.  You will really enjoy these mints. They won't last long because they are so good.  The best mint ever.
Delicious and oddly addictive. I literally can't put the bad down once I open it! A little spicy, but I happen to like spice!

column9: Wasabi is a flavor, not a color.
column10: I love wasabi and I was thrilled to find such an unusual product as wasabi flavored jelly beans. I couldn't wait for their arrival. They came quick enough and I rushed home to open the package and dive into one of my favorite flavors. I popped a few in my mouth and waited for the classic burn (remember to breathe in through your nose and out through your mouth) - here it goes....nothing. I popped a few more in my mouth. Nothing again. No wasabi flavor whatsoever!!! They might as well have been labeled honeydew mellon. To say the least I was disappointed. Then I thought maybe I misunderstood and the wasabi was a color and not a flavor - maybe so. Nonetheless, if you're looking for a new way to experience the wonderful kick of wasabi, look elsewhere. These jelly beans are only sweet with no other distinguishable flavor. Nice idea, poorly executed.

David's Signature Beyond Gourmet "Wasabi" jelly beans will remind you of that wasabi paste or sauce that you find in sushi bars and is essential to Japanese cuisine.  These jelly beans won't clear your sinuses like the actual wasabi, but it will definitely remind you of wasabi.  I like different flavors like this because they're unusual and will get the attention of your guests if you put them out at a party.If you enjoy unusual flavors this flavor also comes in a mix called David's Signature Beyond Gourmet Jelly Beans Man Mix that has other unusual flavors such as Chipotle, Thai Chili, Habenero and others.  These beans will wake up your taste buds!

column9: Spicy enough to keep your attention
column10: When I first received a small sample of these to try, I didn't remember what Wasabi was. With my first bite though, I was transported back to the Japanese restaurant where we sat around the grill while the chef prepared our meals. It is funny how taste can trigger such a vivid memory.These have enough spice to make them interesting, and enough flavor to make you enjoy them. If you are a fan of Wasabi, you really do need to try these out.

column9: Great Choice For A Jelly Bean Flavor - Highly Recommended
column10: These David's Signature Beyond Gourmet "Wasabi" jelly beans really do taste like a slightly sweet and more than slightly spicy bite of fresh wasabi paste. I love the taste of wasabi and enjoy snacking on wasabi flavored treats like wasabi coated peas, so I was thrilled to find these in a sample pack provide to me by manufacture.As noted above, these not only taste like real wasabi, they also provide authentic wasabi heat. I very much enjoyed it but most of my family found it too spicy for their tastes.Highly Recommended!CFH

David's wasabi jelly bean is a surprise. Wasabi flavored green beans are usually spicy hot crispy salty soy beans. What a strange surprise to pop one of these in my mouth and get sweet followed by a light wasabi flavor and no sinus cleaning. My brain is totally confused, in a good way.David's jelly beans are tender, with a thin outer coating. They avoid high fructose corn syrup and use natural flavors.As an unusual jelly bean, these are a fun surprise.The manufacturer provided me with a sample for review.

These sugar cookie ornaments are no longer available in my state (Florida), after being used for decades, somebody decided that the silver on the "Silver Dragees" was not a substance that should be consumed.  I have been making Christmas cookies for 40 years using them to decorate sugar cookies and Spritz wreath shaped butter cookies, and searched everywhere for them.  I was very happy to find them here at Amazon.  My traditional Christmas cookies will once again, look like they always did, and my family members are all still alive and well, after consuming them for decades.  Happy Holidays..........
These were very dull in color and many of the beads were very misshaped. I was not happy with this product.
Just what I was looking for.  They are not sold in stores, that I  can find, anymore.  Necessary to decorate sugar cookies for Christmas.They arrived quickly, with good packaging.
This is a very large package of silver dragees - they were exactly the size I was looking for...and I have several left over from the project I did.  Highly recommended.

I received these quickly and packaged well. There were the correct amount and the quality is definitely there. They were comparable to the ones you may buy in a grocery store but cost a bit less and you get a bit more.
If you eat Kosher or Halal this is a bad buy! I think the ingredients should be put in the description!

The description for this item is not accurate. I bought the freeze deied raspberries and stawberries from this same company and they are great. However, these are dehydrated which means 2 important things:- Texture: these are very hard and do not soften if left in milk or water. Don't think about adding these to cereal, only for trail mix or eating out of hand.- Saturated fat: the second ingredient is coconut oil! One 2oz. serving has 190 calories, 19 grams of fat and 16 grams of saturated fat. You're better off eating Cheetos.These are extremely unhealthy and don't even taste that great. There is (unsurprisingly) and oily aftertaste. Buyer beware. Stick to purely freeze dried fruits - nothing is added and they are healthy.

i felt the need to defend these banana chips, which i don't feel deserve a one star rating.  i got them in a #10can -case pack (6 different items) of various dehydrated fruits from honeyville farms, and i think they taste just like banana chips you buy at the supermarket in small packs, or mixed with trail mix.  they are not the freeze-dried kind, mind you, which honeyville also sells, but the dehydrated, slightly oily variety that are a bit crunchy.  i find i eat these by the cupful sometimes, and must remember to drink something!  they are very sweet and satisfying.  my kids really like them too.a yr. later-- i wanted to add that I continue to get these delish banana chips.  i also would like to explain that i don't eat many sweets (I think craisins are a bit too sweet to eat alone), so the "very sweet" comment for me is just kinda sweet for many people. I also use coconut oil extensively at home for the taste and health properties (along with olive oil and butter), so the coconut oil in these chips was just an added bonus.I highly recommend these chips.  Honeyville makes freeze dried banana chips as well, if you like that texture better. i just like these, because they remain crispy and tasty (vs. getting mushy faster with freeze-dried products you don't re-vacuum seal)

I never got around to trying to bake with these because I just used them as a snack rather than regular chips or sweets.  I think these would be great in trail mix or just plain as I've been eating them.  I don't eat massive quantities of them, so I'm not concerned about the coconut oil or the small amount of sugar added.  I just eat them to take the edge off hunger sometimes between meals.  Honeyville does sell freeze-dried bananas though if you're concerned about additives.

I bought these for snacking and to use in cooking.  I thought they would last for a while.  Then my kids and grandkids came for a visit.  Now they are gone.  They must be really good; I didin't even get a chance to try them.  At least they are a healthy snack.

This 6-Pack sampler lets you savor 6 different tastes of the Caribbean Rum Cakes! Truthfully, I like every single flavor. I was thinking that the Key Lime would be absolutely sickening but it turned out to be my favorite one. These cakes will appear small to you but I reccomend buying this instead of one 33oz cakes incase you may not like that flavor. With this sampler you get to try each one and decide which is your favorite, which then you can go ahead and purchase the 33oz of whatever flavor is your liking.Overall - EXCELLENT (If you like Rum)

When I went to Barbados and discovered these rum cakes I never thought I'd eat them again unless I went back to Barbados.These are the best rum cakes I have ever had (and I am Caribbean.)They taste great and are a wonderful gift at Christmas for co-workers, people who drop by, and neighbors. I even gave one to the maintenance person who came to fix my oven the day before Christmas.Do yourself a favor, order a lot and keep them around. I will warn you now...it is hard not to eat them yourself.

These cakes are so good and moist. I suggest having a glass of milk with them or you might have a hard time talking. The rum is strong but it is nice and smooth. The cake is sweet and creamy. I have only tried the 'Golden Original' so far, the other 5 flavors sound really good, and I can't wait to open them up.These are packaged beautifully, and would make great gifts as well. The cakes are roughly the size of a really fat donut. They are perfect to split with someone else. I wouldn't suggest eating the entire sampler box of 6, you might get more than a buzz from these. So you probably shouldn't bring these to work, or you might get in trouble.I will definitely order these again, or probably a larger cake next time.

It's hard to tell from the picture, but all six cakes come in lovely (individual) hexagonal boxes.  I split up the set into six small gifts.  Each cake is very small (serves 2 and no more) but very fresh and wonderful.

For anyone whose been to Grand Cayman and wanted to bring rum cakes back for friends and family, this is a less expensive way to do it.  Save the hassle of carrying on the plane.  Price is right.  Same stuff.

My husband was given a piece of this wonderful cake in his office and came home raving about it. He asked me to find it on the web and to order it. I found it on Amazon.Com and hoped it was the same one. Received it and found it to be so moist and tasty. We had ordered the smaller 6 pack mix,to try the different kinds so that in the future, wecan order our favorite one in a larger box.Thank you Amazon.Com for making it easier for us........Linda DiazNJ

After visiting the Cayman Islands on a cruise and coming back with just one pack of Tortuga chocolate cake, I decided to get this 6 pack to give friends and also try the key lime and original golden cakes.  Key lime was definitely much better than I expected.Note that the individual cake packets are not suited for more than 2 people.Price for this 6 pack on the cruise ship was $25+, about one $ less than what Amazon carries this for.
Great product for the price, better price than other sites, fast delivery, and exactly what I expected.

I first purchased these when we were in Jamaica a few years ago.  A friend brought one back from Jamacica a couple of months ago and reminded me of how good they are.  I ordered the six pack to give some as gifts, but ate the key lime and pineapple.  They were both delicious, very moist.

column9: We love the Tortuga Rum Cakes!!!
column10: We love the Cayman Islands and this rum cake brings back great memories!  They are the exact ones we get while on vacation and they are so delicious!  Each cake is enough for two people and they are extremely moist and flavorful!  Anyone is sure to enjoy these cakes.

Hi- I was very pleased with my purchase of this rum cake package. All the flavors were good, but I was very pleasantly surprised by the Keylime flavor. It was a big hit at the dinner table with my family members. The other flavors were also excellent. The product arrived quickly and was very fresh tasting. Great Job and highly recommended. JT
I gave these cakes as a gift and they were a big hit.  The couple I gave them to said they loved that they are individually wrapped so they could bring one on a hike.

column9: not as good as whole cake
column10: I purchased this after buying the 33oz original. Sadly it didn't live up to the large one. The rum flavor was weak, the cakes were not as moist & the flavors it came in were okay but not great.

column9: Good but not as fresh as getting right there on Barbados
column10: Nice present to give and the the flavors are unique.  We were hooked on these cakes when we last visited Barbados.
very good fresh and worth buying when you forgot to bring someone something from the Islands!Tortuga Original Caribbean Rum Cake, 16-Ounce Cake

This is a great way to try the different flavors and enjoy really nice cake.  Some flavors were better than others (surprisingly, I found the regular flavor to be the best) but all the cakes were moist and delicious.  The taste of rum is prominent, but not overwhelming.  I would recommend this to any one and suggest that they would make wonderful and unique hostess gifts.
Very tasty but I first tried Bacardi's rum cakes and they are just a touch better.Still a delicious option!

Put this item on your list of "never-fail gifts for a person I must remember who is a bit difficult to buy for and, oh no, it is only a few days before the birthday/occasion!"I am one of those persons who, sadly, finds myself in the above situation more frequently than not. Most recently, I needed something for my Dad, who lives 1000 miles away. This is the same brand he had purchased while on a cruise, so I knew it would be welcome -- tasty and a source of nice memories too! And what could be better than six different flavors, each in a size quite suitable for a single person. The package arrived in 2 days, nice and fresh and yummy thanks to my Amazon Prime delivery.

This is sooooo good! I shared a bit of the coconut one the other day and now, I have to hide it when I bring it into the office 'cause I will get trampled.  I have loved Tortuga rum cakes for a long time and now that you can buy them on Amazon at an AMAZING price it saves me the trip down to the Caribbean to pick them up :) Highly recommended! Only rum cake I like.

Bought this as a gift for my aunt -  cheaper here on amazon than on the company website, and I got the free shipping. She loved it,and I loved how it had all the different flavors. Great gift for anyone who is a rum, cake, or tropical island fan =)

column9: Cheaper than cruise ships or the island stores
column10: I recently purchased this same 6-pack while on my cruise to George Town, Cayman Islands.  This price is cheaper than what I paid in the Tortuga shop on the island.  All of the flavors are very good.  I suggest to get the sampler to preview all of the flavors before spending $30 plus for the larger cakes in case you don't like the flavor.  The Original and Banana are my favorite.  Great gift idea for any occasion.

I like bright vibrant colors and flavorsThese cakes were not that, so to me they were just alrightI found the original and chocolate mild and subtle (people who water their coffee down would like them...I like concentrate from the can)The coconut was nice, and I may buy that one againBasically, this is a 6 pack.  buy it, share it, try it, hog it, flaunt it, enjoy it, etc etcIf you go out to dinner and try dessert, think of it this way - its dessert at the houseThe shrink wrap on the cakes are very thick and will keep it plenty fresh for a long time (though the fresher the better, don't want 6+ month old cake)

This is the best rum cake!  I got some in Grand Cayman when I went on a cruise several years ago.  My favorite is the original flavor, but the variety pack is awesome for trying a little of every flavor.  Highly recommended!

I bought the Tortuga Rum Cake six-packs when I vacationed in the Bahamas and gave them as gifts to friends and family. I also kept a six-pack for myself. The different flavors, ie. chocolate, coconut, banana, key lime, and pineapple are just delicious!

This product was fantastic. It was exactly the same as when I purchased them on cruise to bermuda. The rum cakes arrived perfect, fresh and delicious. Would definitely order them again. The chocolate and banana are family favorites.

First when it arrived everyone on the house were like...  hey why did you ordered this cake form internet.. asking if i was crazy or something..  but after i openen one of the cakes put it in a plate and shared it with the family.. everyone was amazed, they thought it was delicious, it really melts on your mouth. Then everyone was writting down the name of the cake..  they asked me where did i got it from so they could purchase it too.

column9: A great way to taste all the flavors.
column10: The cakes were super! When I opened one of the bags, all I could smell is strong rum, and I was a bit taken back, but the taste is phenomenal. I highly recommend these, especially warmed with vanilla ice cream. I'm thinking about buying larger ones for family gatherings and parties.
These are the best rum cakes.  All the flavors taste great.  You cannot go wrong with Tortuga rum cakes.
These cakes were really good and small enough that you got a taste and did not have to eat a large cake.
These are excellent products.  I use them often for gifts.  Everyone who has gotten them has given rave reviews.

I and my Husband go to Jamaica every 7-9 months so we love to pick up special things like this or Blue Mountain coffee each and every time. We recently ran out of all of our frozen goodies so we got these. We are normally creatures of habit but figured this would be a good way to try other flavors. Some of them (that I wasn't used to) seem extra rum infused than other and the "flavor" of each one wasn't as strong as I would have liked but they are still yummy. If you LOVE rum though; you will LOVE these.

I am a bit disappointed in this product. I have tried it before when I was on my cruise. The cake was super moist and it taste delicious. That is what prompted me to order this cake online. When I finally sampled the cake it was very dry. It wasn't moist nor could you taste the rum. I believed the cake was old. It was not fresh at all. I guess I will have to go to the Caymen Islands to get the full experience.

I order at least six to eight of these each year as Christmas gifts and people look forward to receiving them. Its hard to keep one for myself. Last year I wasn't able to buy enough through Amazon due to a shortage.

I buy this every year for my dad's birthday.  Thankfully I found it here on Amazon this year.  My previous suppliers stopped carrying this product.  These cakes are so delicious and my father really looks forward to receiving them every year.  This last time I called to see if he got the cakes and the card I mailed out.  He said I got the cakes and that's all that mattered.  lol!
Each flavor is just as good as the other. Would give 5 stars if not for the price.

Unfortunately, i never received my tortuga rum cakes.  UPS left this with someone in the building and I never ever received it I went to the person's apt. after tracking the order and to pickup the cakes and they said UPS gave them a computer which they had ordered instead.  No cakes.  So I can't tell you if the cakes were good or bad.Please do not let UPS leave anything with anyone unless you're home to sign for it.  This happened this Christmas 2008, I was heartbroken because I had paid for this already including shipping and handling.  It added to an unhappy part of my Christmas.Thanks.

I always worry when folks not from the southwest start cooking with jalapenos.  As a rule, they call mildly spicy foods by adjectives like BOLD.Don't get me wrong -- these are really good almonds. And they're soooo fresh they practically explode when you bite into them.  I intend to buy more.  But they've got just the smallest, itty-bittiest bit of jalapeno flavor to them.  And after the first two or three -- you can't even taste it at all, so basically it is a handful of smoked almonds.So far, all these "bold" varieties I've tried have been good.  But as far as I can tell, "bold" is just show-business for "our newest flavors."

I order this item consistently for my office. Everyone here seems to enjoy the flavor of this coffee. Its bold, and strong, and comes out great from the K-Cup. As with all K-cup products, its not a premium/gourmet coffee from a top roaster and brewer, but it really makes us happy here at work when a K-cup is all that we can produce.
I like a strong coffee, particularly when using the Keurig coffee machine.  This coffee really wakes you up in the a.m.

Got a Keurig for Christmas, and have spent the past two months trying to find great coffee that is also affordable.  Over a dollar each for the ones that I was getting at the grocery store was just not cutting it for me.  I purchased a reusable K-cup.  Couldn't stomach the weak coffee it made, and that was with superfine ground coffee.  Not to mention that it often only brewed half a cup.  So, after trying many different types, I decided I liked the taste of the Starbucks Sumatra the best, but it was way too expensive.  Come to find out, Green Mountain makes the Starbucks K-cups.  So I decided to try Green Mountain, as it is MUCH more affordable.It's GREAT!  Nice, strong, flavorful cup of coffee!  FINALLY!
This is some of the real stuff... rich full flavor, not bitter just full body, dark and rich.In the same park as French Roast

column9: Just about my favorite K-Cup coffee so far
column10: Got a Keurig for Christmas, so I've been having fun trying the wide variety of available K-Cup products.  So far, this is my favorite of all the coffees, and one of the few I'd stack up against a good cup of freshly ground and brewed regular coffee. Usually I like K-Cups because they're convenient.  I like these because they're truly excellent coffee and taste wonderful.  These and Coffee People's extra bold varieties are good enough to pass for the real thing - no one would ever suspect they were K-Cups if you didn't tell them.

Green Mountain Double Black Coffee "cups" are still the greatest cup of coffee.  Discovered it when I  purchased it from Amazon after purchasing a one cup keurig pot. Can't be beat if you want to start each day with a "hop, skip and a jump!"Try it - you'll like it....and that's a guarantee!

Finally a good strong cup of coffee.  After drinking weak, flavorless K-cups I found this one.  It has a very strong, smooth, almost floral taste with no weird afertaste like some bold coffee.  I highly recomend this coffee especially if you are a true coffee junkie.  Trust me you will love it!

This is a knockout bold coffee. It is great cup at the 12oz setting with tons of flavor. Haven't tried it yet at the 16oz setting but assume it will still pack a flavor punch. Great deal in the 50 pack.

I like this brand. I didn't realize I was ordering extra bold. To me these T cups are bitter. Since I can't control the strength, I make a small cup and toss. Then I make a large cup to drink. It is still strong which I like, but still has a bit of bitter aftertaste. I still like this brand.

This was an awesome deal ! I love a strong cup of coffee and this is the best I have had in the k-cup varieties. It's bold and smooth. Quick delivery, very happy with my purchase and I will purchase this item again.

Love the strong taste it has. I will reach for this every time when I have it.Great morning coffee to get the day started.Only buy it when on sale. Too expensive at full retail price.Try it if you like strong dark coffee.
I LOVE this coffee.  It's strong and bold without a bitter aftertaste.  I have just placed an order for another one.
The Green Mountain Coffee extra bold is our absolute favorite. It seems to arrive fresh and it seems to stay fresh. We had a real problem with Emeril's k-cups being stale, and not tasting right.

I put cream and sugar in my coffee, but I like one with bold flavor that shines through. I have tried other extra bold k-cups and come back to this one. Great taste, bold but not bitter. I only wish that the green mountain coffee would be offered as a subscribe and save item. Now that they are selling k-cups at Costco, I am tempted regularly to move to the lines they carry. It would be nice not to worry about running out, and to be rewarded a bit for my loyalty!

column9: Green Mountain Double Black Diamond Kcups
column10: If you like a strong bold coffee that's not bitter, then this is the coffee for you.  It has a great flavor and I really enjoy it.  Would recommend.

I enjoy the other strong ("extra bold") K-Cup varieties such as Jet Fuel and Black Tiger, but the Double Black Diamond is just too bitter. I add one packet of sugar or Xagave to this coffee and the sweetness barely comes through. My co-workers don't like Jet Fuel so I will stick to Black Tiger and try the new Starbucks K-Cups.
This is much stronger than the Carabou or the original Lake and Lodge coffee. Not for the faint of heart. But it is tasty, without bitterness.

My wife and I love strong coffee, this and the jet fuel are our favorite! If you like strong coffee, give it a try....Update to show how much we like it, I just placed our 3rd order in as many months.
I absolutely love this blend of coffee!  I was extremely happy to find it in the k-cups and it tastes just as great!
Green Mountain Double Black Diamond K-Cup is one of the best coffees I've tasted.  It's a very strong coffee.  If you enjoy bold coffee that stands on it's own this is the one.
This is a good strong coffee.  Both my wife and I like a coffee with good flavor and it must be strong.  This is one of the best.

column9: Better than a coffee house brew
column10: This coffee is better than any "coffee house" coffee. Freshly brewed each time, with a strong, smooth flavor! Excellent! Delivery is fast! Never worry about remembering to pick up k-cups at the market again. Amazon service rocks!

Let me start by saying I like French roast, pressed coffee. I was purchasing 1 lb. S***bucks French roast and having it ground for the press weekly. This coffee, GM Double Black Diamond (k-cup) and Gevalia Dark Italian Roast (Tassimo)come so close I do not purchase the ground coffee any longer. Very strong, full bodied coffee without being bitter or having an aftertaste. If you like strong, fresh coffee this is it.
I received what I ordered faster than expected, item was in great condition...I love the strong taste of this coffee. I will definitely buy this item again.
Best K cup I have found hands down.  Rich, bold, deep flavor; almost as much so as drip or press brewed.  After 50 cups I had no issues with grounds in the cup at all. Definitely recommend
its so delicious smooth n robust a great cup of coffee u wont regreat it if u luv a real cup of strong coffee
Very good coffee.  You definitely have to like strong coffee to like this product -- it's a "waker-upper".  Definitely would order this product again.

A nice strong brew. I am new to Keurig and have lived on French press for years. This coffee is strong enough to compete.  It is a little on the bitter side like some of Starbucks coffees but I consider that a plus. I would rate it 5 stars but it's not French press
Good flavor and plenty robust. One of the better coffees available in K-cups.  I would give it a five if it was a touch smoother on the finish.  Will certainly buy again.
Unlike other K-Cups I was pleasantly surprised by the strong and good taste of this K-Cup. Definitely recommended for those looking for a stronger brew.

I make my coffee like an ersatz latte and need a very robust coffee to pull that off---this fits the bill.  This is my method:  using a large mug, I first pour in about 1/4 c. of milk and nuke that for 60 seconds.  I then use either the small or medium (depends on my mood) Keurig setting and brew the coffee with the scalded milk, then top with a dollop of Bailey's coffee creamer.  Delicious!  I like a strong coffee but not a bitter one and Double Black Diamond works beautifully.
So many K-Cups just do not deliver true bold flavors, these Green Mountain Double Black Diamond cups are an exception.  No issues with grounds, delivery, or anything.  Will be ordering more.
Good coffee for a keurig pod,a little on the thin side for my taste, bust still a decent cup of joe.

column9: They are the same thing as you buy in the store only in bulk.
column10: Same coffee only you get them cheap because there in bulk.You dont get those little boxs that come in a 10 qty box but who cares.
this coffee is intense and very yummy!  it has a strong espresso flavor.  i would definitely recommend it and buy it myself again!

I've tried various dark roasts with K-cups and could not find something that was dark and rich enough.  Tired the Caribou, Jet Fuel, French Roast....nothing.  My apartment smells great and this is a smooth, rich cup of coffee.  I highly recommend it to dark roast lovers.

column4: terzap "aka I Love my Quaker Parrot"
column9: If you like a dark and toasty big mug with just one K-cup, this will do it.
column10: I have real issues trying to find a K-cup that will give me a robust-tasting enough mug of joe. For a while, I'd found near-perfection in the Coffee People extra bold mix... especially the Wake-Up Call (which got horribly expensive all of a sudden), but even those I only made on the middle setting of our brewer, and never the largest.  The Double Black Diamond still satisfied me on the largest setting, and has an intense, smoky dark edge that reminds me of the coffee that first converted me to the Pacific Northwest style of espresso---one I had a a tiny, roadside espresso stand out in the middle of nowhere between Tumalo and Sisters, in Oregon.  (It's probably not there any more--this was back in the 90s. LOL)  Anyway, it's definitely robust, and as I use milk/creamer, I don't find it bitter at all, but rich and worthy of savoring.  It will stand up nicely to a shot of your favorite flavor, and even shines through getting mixed with cocoa and vanilla for a toasty mocha.I just wish the coffees I'm finding out that I really, really like weren't shooting up into the "Can't Afford" ranges. But for those who love bold, smoky dark roast---this one is a real winner! I will keep it on hand for the times when I sit down with breakfast or with my Kindle to savor a cup of coffee rather than drink it in haste on the way out the door. But, if I find this coffee "loose" I'm getting it for my Eko-Brew reuseable K cups for sure.

column9: Among the best K-Cups I've tried
column10: Very dark, near-espresso, but complex.  Some of the best K-Cups I've tried, although I'd need to do a blind test between these & Dark Magic.
love it!  I like strong coffee.  This is it!  I got a great price too!  I am going to order this one again!

This coffee is so strong, I found it bitter.  I even tried diluting it by brewing larger sizes, but I still found it bitter. If you are tempted to try it, I would advise purchasing a sample pack first.
Excellent FULL body, not bitter.  Green mountain makes coffee taste as good as it smells.  I think my search for the perfect cup of coffee is almost over.

If you like a strong cup of coffee...... this one's for you! Excelent taste, aroma, without the bitterness of most strong coffees......I've tried most all Bold coffee available.... this one is my favorite......
I was so pleased with my coffee shipment. Nothing was damaged and my coffee was good & fresh. This is some of the best coffee I've tasted. Smooth, strong and flavoable just the way I like it.

Green Mountain Coffee Double Black Diamond, 24-Count K-Cups for Keurig Brewers (Pack of 2)I love a bold, dark cup of coffee. I've been buying the Gloria Jean's Black Gold for many years until just recently as it was discontinued. I searched for something that I thought would be comparable. I found this one and ordered with low expectations that it would match up, but I was pleasantly surprised. It's dark and strong and not bitter at all. If you like a bold coffee like me, definitely give this one a try.
Of all the varieties we have tried, this was one of our favorites.  The Amazon price was the best I've found.  The taste combined with the price is why I rate it so high.
This coffee is not for light coffee drinker! This coffee is EXTREMELY bold, strong and smooth. I love this coffee. I highly recommend.

This coffee was just too strong for my family.  No matter how much milk or cream was put in, it did not alter the strength of this beverage. If you like a strong cup of coffee, this is the one for you.

I think I have tried all the extra bold K cups out there and have setteled on Double Black Diamond. It has a good strong coffee flavor, an 8oz brew has just a little bite at the end but smooths out if you need it to by brewing it at 10 oz.  Dark Majic extra bold is a milder version but still very good.Joe
Order arrived quickly, earlier than stated -  coffee is great and makes a great iced coffee... I will order these again.

column9: Awesome if you love strong coffee
column10: I have tried many different k-cups in my search for the strongest but non-bitter one.  This is it.  It brews dark and strong but there is no bitter aftertaste.
We love ordering from companies that use one large box to hold all the k-cups as opposed to multiple little boxes.  This coffee is strong, just the was we like it.

I love the Keurig coffeemakers because I prefer mild or flavored coffees, while other family members love the dark roasts--and this one certainly fits the bill! The "Double Black Diamond" moniker is appropriate, for it has a bold, dark flavor and aroma that was a hit with those in my family who like strong coffee. This size box (50) makes the cost-per-cup a good deal. Highly recommended.

I love this coffee. If you like Emerils' bold or Jet fuel you'll love this one. It's the closest I've found to bold coffeehouse blend and even though the prices on K-cups continue to increase these are still a bargain when you compare the cost to Starbucks or your local cafe.

column9: Some of the BEST coffee with a KICK!
column10: Green Mountain puts out some really good coffees, and the K-cup is no exception.  Double Black Diamond is very strong and rich in flavor.  Highly recommended.
This is Top of the line in my book. Absolutly the best bold taste ever!!! I've tried the majority of the bold k-cup coffees and this in my opinion is the Best!!!
really a bold and stong taste, we like a bold coffee and its hard to find for the k cups, this one is our favorite ,

I have been searching for a nice strong coffee for my Keurig that doesn't leave a bitter or flat aftertaste.  This a very nice bold flavored coffee that seems to fit the bill.  I am a bit spoiled after tasting Barista Prima's Italian roast as it has such a nice rich full-bodied flavor.  It is a bit pricier so the Double Black Diamond is a nice close second at a more affordable price.  I like my coffee black or with a little milk and this does not leave you wondering where the coffee went!

I have tried all the K cup coffee out there I think.  I had setteled on Dark Majic untill I tried Double Black Diamond.  This is for people that love the tase of coffee. It is strong but smooth. I have the Cuisinart and set it for 8 oz of water.  Great cup of coffee.

column9: Looking for a replacement for Starbucks and Tassimo? This is it.
column10: I have been drinking Starbucks brand coffee with my Tassimo brand machines for years.  It was the perfect combination for me.  Now that they have stopped making Starbucks inserts I was forced to look for an alternative.  I bought a K-cup machine because it appears to be the dominant brand on the market.  This coffee is actually better than the original Starbucks!  I will not go back to the Starbucks brand even if they start making it for the K-cup machines.

WOW again!  This coffee is quite strong.  My husband and I drink our coffee black, and I usually drink 2-3 cups per day.  But this coffee is almost like drinking expresso. If you are looking for a dark, rich, very strong coffee, this one's for you.  Those who add sweetener and cream might also enjoy this wake up coffee.  Double Black.... perfect name.  However, I can only drink one cup a day of this brand.

Tried a lot of different k-cups in search for a bold, expresso type of coffee. This one fits the bill all right. Strong but not bitter. Am able to make a large and medium cup out of one k-cup. Truly worth a few cents more per cup. Would absolutely recommend this to anyone who wants a "real"" cup of coffee.
Double Black Diamond has a very full bodied flavor, yet it's not too bitter. K-cups are a convenient way to get your morning cup of coffee without having to stop at the local Starbucks.

column9: Tastes like a real cup of coffee
column10: Double Black Diamond Kcups are the nearest I have found to the Starbucks Tassimos Pods that are no longer available (maybe even a little stronger). If you like strong coffee that tastes like you spent $3, get these bad boys! If you like watered down, mild coffee I would stay away.

The Green Mountain Double Black Diamond Coffee is smooth even though quite strong. I run one cup  through my Keureg Brewer twice, first 10 oz then 6 oz. The coffee is strong enough to do this and it fills my largest mug and the coffee is then "just right" for me.
This coffee was a real treat.  Nice a bold yet not bitter.  Just the kind of coffee to get me going in the morning.  And, a good deal, too!

column9: a strong, bold cup of coffee
column10: I like a strong, bold, dark roast coffee and Double Black Diamond is my current favorite.  If you like a medium roast coffee this isn't for you, but if you like 'Black Tiger Amazon' or 'Jet Fuel', you should try Double Black Diamond.  It will also stand up to a larger cup size for those of you that can brew them.  I usually brew it on my Keurig's 9.25 oz. size and it still makes a satisfying cup.

column9: If You Like Bold Coffee, This Is It!
column10: My only hesitation in purchasing a K-Cup Brewer was whether the coffee would be bold enough for me. Since purchasing my brewer, I've tried many varieties and Double Black Diamond is my favorite. I drink my coffee black so I don't like weak coffee - I want it to be bold and smooth, not bitter. Black Diamond will not disappoint if you like good coffee. My other favorites are Green Mountain Expresso Blend and Coffee People Jet Fuel. I love my Cuisinart K-Cup Brewer - easy to use and no clean-up. I can make just one cup of fresh coffee whenever I want and don't end up throwing away unused or old coffee. And happily, I've found Double Black Diamond to start my mornings!
Good value and good coffee if you like the extra bold, like my husband does. His favorite is the Dark Magic and this replaces it at a fraction of the cost.
This coffee is strong and flavorful and is in no way bitter. All in all one of my all time top three and I recommend it highly.

column9: Green Mountain Double Black Diamond Coffee
column10: I like coffee....no, i like BLACK STRONG COFFEE. I was hesatant on getting this but thought what the heck. I was tired of picking up a limited supply of k-cups from the Discount Department Stores and having them taste a little weak. From the beginning, when your cup starts to brew, you can tell "this is going to be a GOOD cup of coffee". I wasn't disappointed. Great stuff. My wife drinks it more than I do but get it....you wont be let down at all, especially if you like just coffee....in your coffee.

In all the time I've had my Keurig I've been searching for the right flavor in a Extra Bold K-Cup. This one has been on of the best flavors to date. Not too dark to be bitter and not too light to taste watered down.

I like a strong cup of coffee.  This Double Black Diamond delivers.Unlike some reviewers I did not find it bitterDelivery was faster than promised.  The cups come in one big box,and one was damaged. Other than that I have no complaints.
Tried so many that called themselves "bold". But finally found one! We make it with a generous amount of water, and use half n half, and it is still very flavorful. And not bitter.

We love bold coffees and this is the second box of Double Black Diamond we have ordered.  It's smooth, strong and full bodied.  The aroma alone draws you in.  It's a great cup of coffee to wake up with.
Just how I like it! I can make a large cup of this on my Keurig (the one with three cup sizes) without losing any flavor. No nasty aftertastes and not bitter. Will order more.

Perfect flavor on the medium size setting.  I used to have to do two of the Kenya AA extra bolds on the small setting to even get close to the flavor of this cup.  So, this actually saves me money too...very nice:)

column9: Once you go "Double Black" you'll never go back!
column10: Not for the amateur coffee drinker! If your current coffee just isn't doing the job, step up to the Double Black Diamond. We like dark, bold coffees and this one is our number one fave. :)

I love my coffee strong and black, but I don't like the harsh and sometimes burned flavors that many extra-bold K-cups have.  Double Black Diamond is the perfect blend for me; I actually hoard my supply in my house.  The flavor is more intense than many others while still maintaining balance.  Not for the faint-of-heart, this blend approached but stops short of espresso strength.-- Debbie Lee Wesselmann

I have had this problem with Green Mountain coffee where about 1 out of every 3 cups brewed has a large amount of coffee grounds in the cup when brewed. Other brands do not seem to have this problem but Greem Mountain seems to have this issue.
While Peet's Coffee is the greatest, this is not far behind.  Easy to make, no mess, what more could you want?

Jolt-wise, this is a nice, gentle introduction to Extra Bold. (Darker roast, therefore less caffeine than most XB's.) The taste is charcoal, with charcoal notes and a charcoal finish.  I have a sweet tooth and tend to prefer the sweeter, smoother coffees.  However, I occasionally have a Double Black Diamond because it wakes me up without making me jittery.
This is a great blend when you need that extra kick to get you going! Excellent flavor with a Bold blend, "a manly mans blend"!
This coffee is the worst I've ever tasted!  I like strong, but this was very bitter!  Stick with the kona blend and Nantucket blend, or even breakfast blend.
Now that's Bold!!!If you need that morning shot in the arm look no further. I was using Bustelo in the reusable k-cup, this is better. I will not turn back.

I typically use my Keurig as a hot water dispenser, running it without kcups because they generally are too weak, even on the small cup setting.So, I'm very much in the market for stronger k cups.I can make medium size cups with this pod, but it's still a bit weak, and still bitter.  Makes a very strong small cup.  Perfect would be 2 pods, one cup, one brewed on short and the other on medium.As for the flavor of the beans, they produce a full bodied, bold and bitter cup.  Not necessarily a bad bitter, as it is pure arabica, however, I personally wouldn't recommend having more than one cup of these a day.  That bold flavor loses it's luster cup after cup, so it's not really a good all-around coffee.It's a good first or second cup of the morning coffee.  It's kind of like a cup of "good new york city coffee" back before the coffee renaissance of the past decade.Buying this in the extra large amount may not be suitable from an individuals' point of view because it's not something you'll want to drink 2+ times a day.

column9: I like it for my little wife
column10: I love K-Cups coffee.  They are easy and one always has a FRESH cup of coffee in less than a minute.  However, coffee this way can be quite expensive.  I myself use those refillable cups that one can find on amazon.  I have a half dozen of them.  I fill them with grocery store cheap brand and set my Keurig for the 6oz expresso cup.  It makes great strong coffee.  My wife on the other hand is lazy and doesn't want to mess with the two seconds it takes to fill the refillable little baskets.  She loves the Green Mountain Extra bold and as I buy it for her she doesn't care how much it costs.  It's good coffee and keeps my wife of forty years off my back.  I'd pay twice as much for that feature alone.

Impressed,as always,with Amazon's expedient delivery. I perused customer reviews before ordering and felt comfortable with my choice (I was going to get the Emeril Bourbon Street blend , which I love) as reviewers gave this a great rating. I find it strong but bitter as opposed to strong and rich. Would not recommend this blend to anyone. No negatives to Amazon but wonder who could find this a pleasurable coffee.
I placed an order for this on 4/18/2011, and it was $28.59. Today, 5/3/2011 the price is $40.50. Are you serious?! I guess I'll be shopping elsewhere!

I have tried lots of the bold coffees from different makers and this is my favorite.  It is really dark and smooth.  I love french press coffee but hate the mess.  This is the first K cup that has been the equivalent of that and I love it.  I highly recommend it!

There's a Keurig machine at my new job, and they have a couple varieties of K cups that I haven't seen in local stores or wholesale clubs. My favorite, easily, of these is "Double Black Diamond", the darkest, boldest coffee offered by Green Mountain. So I checked for prices on-line. I was psyched to find this box of 50 for a reasonable 57 cents each or so delivered to my doorstep. I ordered on Wednesday, and the coffee showed up Saturday morning in time for brunch. Hooray to Green Mountain and Amazon. We'll be ordering more soon.

Ive tried many KCups. I bought a Green Mountain Bold Variety pack and it had a few of these gems in it. This is some good, strong coffee. Might be overpowering for some people.I recommend this to anyone who has been searching for a kcup that taste like REAL coffee. some of these kcups are so weak. i say giver it a shot or at least try the bold variety pack. their espresso blend s also very strong and Kenya-AA (all part of variety pack) but i liked this one over all.

My biggest gripe with the Keurig pods is that the coffee is too weak so I always try the bold varieties.  I think I met my match with this one though. Its almost too strong for me.  I take my coffee black and this one has just a hint of bitterness. I have to use the tallest coffee cup setting when I use this pod.  Dont get me wrong...its a good cup of joe but for my taste I think I like the Emerill bold pods a tad better.On the plus side you can often reuse this pod for a second cup as its strong enough to still make a good cup second time around.

column9: Did you feel that coffee lover?  That was the freaking Quickening!
column10: We're comfortable being honest are we not?  Cool, so I have a coffee problem, I'm OK admitting that to you.  And with that affliction comes the experience of having consumed a crap-load of coffee from all over, K-cups and otherwise.  In the end, Highlander-esque, there can be only one, and the Double Black Diamond is that coffee.  This is the untouchable, best Keurig coffee that I have ever encountered and I am relatively sure that once or twice while drinking it I experienced the mythical Quickening.Buy it, don't buy it, I don't care, just get out of my way so I can keep drinking it.  I just want to die with the taste of it on my lips.

My wife and I have been a little frustrated with our Kuerig coffee maker because we want a big mug of bold taste and several coffees just come out weak!  Not this Double Black Diamond from Green Mountain! If you like bold flavor, you'll love this brew!

This coffee is excellent if you like strong coffee.  I have tried Black Tiger, Jet Fuel, Wake Up Call, and most of the other XB coffees, but this is the first one that is strong enough for me in an 8 Oz cup.  For reference to Tassimo owners, this is very similar in strenght to the Starbucks Caffè Verona t-discs.I would NOT purchase from this any of the sellers selling it for twice as much as the other sellers though.  DO note that this product package cost you about $1/cup as you only get 1 box (of 24 cups) vs 2 boxes.  Otherwise, enjoy!

column9: If you like french roast, you'll like this
column10: I'm not a big fan of the french roast flavor, but I do like a bold coffee. I was hoping this would be just a great bold flavor, but it tastes pretty much like a french roast. I'm not too happy, but it's not a bad coffee.

In my humble opinion as a life long coffee addict, this is the best K-Cup flavor available.When drinking a cup of this you will be treated to a strong full coffee taste, without any bitterness.I have tried many of the k-cup flavors and although there are other good ones, this one beats them all, hands down.

Of all the K-Cups we have tried, and that's a bunch, this one is the hands down favorite for flavor and boldness.  This is the one the spoon stands up in, the jolt that brings you to life no matter what.  This is always our go to for strength and good flavor.This is certainly our favorite from Green Mountain!

I've had my Kuerig for about 6 months now.  The hardest thing to do is find good, bold, strong coffee that can be used to make a 10oz mug of coffee.  Too many (most) K-Cups produce a watery-horrible 10oz mug but this cup stands up.  A mug of this coffee is still rich and bold.  I still lhave a hard time with how much K-Cups cost but when on sale this is a worthwhile coffee.

Coffee is my favorite drug and the first 2 cups in the morning better wake me up. This is one of my favorites to enjoy first thing every day.  It's strong, smooth, and doesn't upset my stomach because it's not bitter. I usually get bored with the same coffee after a while, but this one never lets me down.  Enjoy.
