column9: He loves it, and so do we!
column10: This dry kibble was the third try in our quest to find a balanced kibble for our Bernese Moutnain Dog. There is plenty of technical information about what to feed your dog and, nearly overwhelmed, we entered the pet food market with an idea of feeding a quality kibble, but chose to avoid high-end designer food, high protein (>26%), bi-products, wheat, soy, and corn. We decided that whole grains, fruits, and vegitables would be an acceptable source of carbohydrates but wanted the ratio to be 40% or less (hard to do when you avoid high protien foods). We also believe chicken is the easiest protein source for our dog to digest. Lastly, we wanted to be near 24% Protien and 14% Fat. Keep in mind that our review below is based on our pet, and every pet will react to food differently.We fed Precise, which was only a great puppy food. We fed Canadae, which resulted in loose stool, gas and a pretty lethargic pet. We did some more research and decided to try Nature's Variety, the result was shocking! Our BMD had ZERO gastric upset during transition and became energetic again. Nature's Variety has produced nearly half the stools, which are small compact and virtually odorless. He has NO gas and his coat is shiny and feels conditioned. People are noticing the change and we couldnt be happier. Add this to the fact that Amazon will ship it to my door with free super saver shipping! Oh, one last thing: The 15lb bags have a decent zipper to lock out air.Thank you for this quality food at a reasonable price.

column9: AMAZING Dog Food at a reasonable price.
column10: We have a mixed breed dog; likely a Walker Coonhound/Great Dane mix. He's a 85-90lb lanky, goofy, lovable example of a canine, but he has a digestive system that is more temperamental than my own weak stomach. As a pup, we had continued him on the original shelter's choice of food for the sake of consistency: Purina Pro Plan, but that food is a misleading, expensive upgrade to a standard grocery store food, which I wanted to get him off of as quickly as possible. From research, and experience, I've found that you either pay for your dog's health through your dog food bill, or through the vet bills that you'll inevitably get from feeding them junk food. We chose the former. We had tried other high quality foods like Wolf King, Solid Gold, and some samples of Wellness.Nature's Variety Prairie, although not their highest level kibble (Instinct), is an affordable and healthy alternative to the low grade grocery store brands. I was unbelievably happy to find this on Amazon now, after feeding this to our dog, Toby, for the past 6 months - and at anywhere from $10 to $5 cheaper than the few pet supply stores near us that sell this brand.I'm not quite as scientific about our choice of food for him as some other reviewers/owners out there, but I did want to keep his diet free of low quality grains/wheat, and disgusting, bottom-of-the-barrel, meat and protein sources. With this food, I know the meat and protein is a primary ingredient (as it should be) and is complimented with healthy fruits, vegetables, minerals, and oils that would theoretically be found in the wild. I would love to begin rotating the food at some point soon to explore his interest in the other meats, specifically lamb.To be blunt for a moment, his stool is now dense, dark, and smaller in quantity than it was with the low grade food he was started on, since the majority of the food is healthy and absorbed through digestion. When he goes, it's not the gamble that it once was when his stomach was being bothered by the junk food full of fillers and unnatural ingredients. His coat is shiny, his energy level is high (maybe too high, haha), and he continues to be the happy, healthy dog that he should be. I owe a lot of this to Nature's Variety, and I'll continue to purchase their food (now through Amazon Prime with two day shipping) as well as their treats, which I bought for the first time yesterday.This food is worth every penny, and it's still cheaper than many of the other high quality holistic foods out there.

My Golden Retriever has had hotspots all his life. They are definitely food related and once I find a food that works for him, we stick with it. He originally was eating Dr. Andrew Weil's food, Promise, and was very healthy and happy. Well, the company folded and I had to scramble to find dry dog food that was comparable to what he was eating. Prairie matched almost perfectly! He has never had a hotspot while eating Prairie. He loves the food. It even smells good to me and the cat. The cat will eat out of the food bin if I leave it open. She is also a Prairie for Cats fan but that is another review. Now, a word of caution about mixing flavors...mixing flavors is OK if your dog is young and active but be very careful about reading the labels and noting the amount of calories that vary from flavor to flavor. You WILL need to adjust the amount of food!!! I switched to the beef variety and didn't check the calories and was shocked to see how much weight my elderly Golden gained in just one bag of food. Overall, I am very happy with this food and highly recommend it!

Let me start by saying...I am a huge supporter of the Nature's Variety brand.  My cat, Flea, is on instinct and my dog, Mystie, is on prairie dry.  I've tried nearly every variety of both product lines and I love how they have been so great for my fur-kids.  However, when I began to feed the Chicken Prairie to Mystie, she would throw up the food every morning after eating. She hasn't had a history of sensitivity to food and it's a real shame because she LOVES this flavor the most.  It just keeps making her sick.  We have given her the Lamb and Beef versions of this that we have on hand to test and see - but it seems to be only the Chicken that causes an issue.  She does not get sick on any of the other flavors we try.  Let me say again, I love this brand!  However, I felt I should share my experience should there be any other consumers who may be having the same problem with this flavor of Prairie.

column9: Reasonably Priced, Cruelty Free, High Protein and High Quality Dog Food
column10: Nature's Variety is on a very short list of dog food given my requirements: Cruelty Free company, Quality Ingredients, High Protein, and Reasonably Priced. At $45 for a 30 pound bag, it fits the bill. Good luck finding any dog food in this price range that meets these requirements. There are certainly other dog foods with higher protein content, but not at this price. I did have an issue with one of my dogs having excessive gas, but I cured this by slightly adjusting (decreasing) the amount I was feeding him on a daily basis.The ingredients list includes "Montmorillonite" Clay which is naturally occurring and has numerous minerals (it is approved for use by the USDA in organic certified products). Reported benefits include the binding of certain mold-based toxins and even controlling diarrhea. The ingredients also includes probiotics and chelated minerals for improved digestion and immune system function.

column9: Top quality dog food, excellent price
column10: I have been feeding my dogs Nutro for years.  Many times we tried to switch to a different, "better," dog food, but my dog's coat would not look so shiny and they would become ill.  One of my dogs has a very sensitive stomach and she tends to throw up several times a day. It's so common, I've trained her to go outside to puke.  Switching her food seems to make this worse.However, I realize that I have been paying $45 for a 30 lbs bag at the pet store for mediocre at best dog food, so I've been on the hunt for a better, and preferably cheaper, alternative.  I've literally spent days online researching all the different dog foods.  There are many good ones out there, but most of them cost $2 and up a lb.  My food doesn't cost $2 a lb!  This is the only top quality dog food I've found that I can afford.  I'm absolutely certain it is the best value as it is currently $1.27/lb. with subscribe and save.  I also love that I don't have to haul 30 lbs. bags from the store anymore!My dogs love the food.  It does not exacerbate my Sheltie's stomach issue and we save money: almost $10 every month.  Who says you can't have your cake and eat it too!April 15, 2011 update:  My dogs have been on this food for a couple of months now.  My Sheltie's stomach is upset much less often and my short haired dachshund is very noticeably more shiny.  I can't wait until my Sheltie sheds her coat so I can see the new one. One surprising thing is that my dogs eat considerably less of this brand of dog food.  I'm estimating that it's at least 30% less food (and less poop too).  I'm still on the first bag with two small dogs and I used to purchase one (30 lbs) bag of dog food a month before.  I couldn't be more pleased.

column9: Great quality food from a trusted company
column10: This food is not grain free, but the company does commit to making sure the ingredients are mostly meat.  They do not use any grain fragments, which are cheap fillers in many foods.  It has a moderate amount of protein, but I also supplements my dog's diet with some raw meat on a nearly daily basis. My dogs love the flavor of this food and seem to enjoy it a lot. I rotate this with other flavors and the Nature's Variety Grain Free Instinct line as well. I guy this on Amazon.com because the price is really good, especially because I have it set to deliver every two months with Subscribe and Save. This is an all life stages food. Simply feed more to puppies about 4 times a day or once or twice a day to adult dogs. It's healthy food, but your dog can still get fat on it, so don't overfeed.

column9: Didn't help hot spots but better overall quality
column10: One of my dogs has skin allergies and I wasn't sure if it was from Gluten or filler found in other commercial grade dog food.  Someone on here mentioned a dog food analysis Website that rates all dog food ... thank you for that!  I went on there and found that the food they had been eating for the past 3 years was 1-star!  So searched around a little and found that this Prairie food was 5-star (out of 6-star total).  Based on that and the subscribe and save price on amazon and being a prime member it was a done deal for me.I switched their food cold turkey as both my dogs are very large breeds and have no stomach issues.  They took to it right away with no issues.After 1 month of use my dog still had his hot spots and the only thing that seems to work for him is the fish oil pills.  The food didn't do anything in that area.  They both have great coats so I didn't really see a difference.  I just feel better knowing that it has more protein and not so much filler and comes from good ingredients.  Plus it gets shipped right to my door so no complaints here at all.Was going to rate it 4-star due to no immediate noticeable difference but will rate 5-star since the dog food analysis site also gave it 5 -stars for quality ingredients.

This is a great product.  Keeps my dog's skin allergies under control.  I used this for a year until the price went wayyyyy up.  It has no corn, wheat, or junk, so the increase in the cost of the ingredients cannot be because of the corn shortage.  It went up from $37 to 46.  crazy for 30 pounds of dog food.  southern states coop makes an identical one which is 40 pounds for $30 and they often have coupons for their store.  I switched.  no brainer.

column9: Love the dog food but price has increased too much over the past 12 months
column10: Over the past 3+ years I have fed my dogs 3 different dog foods.  I previously fed my dogs Blue Buffalo lamb but after 7 or 8 months I was not happy with the results and the dogs did not seem to like it very much.I then switched to Natural Balance Dry Dog Food, Grain Free Limited Ingredient, wanting to see if feeding them a grain free product would help with their shedding. After about a year I again was not satisfied with the results (large and soft stool and no help with the shedding).My next dog food was Nature's Variety Prairie.  They like the smaller dry kibble and I liked the technical information about what to feed them, looking for a certain range of protein and fat by using an independent dog food advisor site. Also, through my research I noted that Nature's Variety was noted to add probiotics to enhance a dog's digestive functions and also include certain minerals that make them easier to absorb.Enough technical though.  My dogs really like Nature's Variety Prairie and their stool has improved.  Shedding is still an issue and both my vet and groomer say some dogs just shed regardless of what you feed them.  My dogs have been eating Nature's Variety Prairie for the past year.I have 2 very large mixed breed rescue dogs so we do go through a lot of food each month.  I love getting it from Amazon on subscribe and save mainly because the price was right for a very good quality food and it arrives at my door with free shipping and without me having to think about it at all.  My dogs eat slightly more than 30 pounds each month so every 3 months I need to order an extra bag so I never run out.Yesterday I went online at Amazon to place my extra order I was surprised to see how the price has increased over the last few months, going from $37.90 in May to $43.17 in August to its current $49.38 in September.  This price has now increased to more than I can buy it locally and I no longer have the tax free in California.Unfortunately, I will either change again or just buy the food locally since I do like Nature's Variety.  I am considering one of Merrick's dry foods as I like the fat-to-protein ratio of about 50% but I hate the gradual process of switching dog food.

column9: Great dog food on paper but dog will NOT EAT!
column10: I researched many brands, and read reviews and was happy with this choice, as it sounded great/healthy/quality food for my rescued dog.  We switched off of the Science Diet, to this... slowly.  My dog ate every morsel it could find of the Science Diet leaving all of this behind.  So when we went fully over to this dog food, she went on a hunger strike!  She wouldn't eat it at all, so we added some meat juice and then she'd eat.  She is NOT a picky dog at all.  So now we've switched her to California Naturals Herring and Sweet Potato, and she devours her food.  In the switch over part, I actually witnessed her grab some of this kibble and then spit it back out to go for the California Natural.My other complaint is the kibble size is TINY.  These are NOT chunks that dogs can bite into and chew.  This is almost as small as cat food.  So if you had a dog that ate fast, this would just be inhaled.Good intentions and sounded great on paper, but taste was a resounding NO from our adopted pooch.

When I adopted my dog, she was 9 months old, and on Diamond Naturals Lamb & Rice puppy and her foster mom recommended she stay on it.  I bought one large bag of it which lasted about a month, or maybe even 6 weeks.  The dog was doing okay on it but she didn't seem terribly interested in the food.  Many meals sat untouched and although she would eat when she really got hungry, she is an incredibly active dog and I was concerned she wasn't getting enough to eat.  So when that bag was gone, I reverted to a cheaper food that we had fed our previous dog.  She liked this better but it didn't take long to notice how much she pooped on it.  I'm talking EVERY time she went outside she both peed and pooped and that seemed excessive.  Also, we had to start watching her closely or she would turn around and eat what she had just discarded.  Ewww.  I know some dogs do this but....then she'd come in and lick me and I was totally grossed out.  The breath smelled pretty awful too.So - back to the drawing board.  For the first time I actually did some research into dog nutrition and ingredients and spent literally hours analyzing lots of different foods.  In these tough economic times, I simply can't afford to pay $5/pound for dog food, when I'm scrimping and saving to feed my family on the cheap.  I do care about my dog though and wanted to feed her the best food I could afford to feed.When I found this, it seemed to meet the criteria - a higher quality food that has meat as the first ingredient (instead of corn or soy or wheat), but didn't require that I take out a loan to buy it.  I've had it a week or so but wanted to finish up the bag of feed we're on first so it doesn't go to waste.  Yesterday, as I watched her poop for the 6th time in almost as many hours, it occurred to me that I could go ahead and switch her right away since our other dog doesn't have the pooping issue, so can finish up the cheap stuff.  Last night I opened the Prairie and immediately had my dog's attention.  She lay down and polished off the entire bowl without once leaving to see if the other dog had something better, as she typically does.  When she finished the kibble, she licked the bowl clean.  I let them both outside and as soon as she came back in, she ran over to the bowl to lick it again and check that there wasn't a crumb she had missed the first time around.  Honestly, I've never seen her this enthusiastic about a food before.So I think I've found a winner: I'm pleased with the ingredient list and the cost, and my dog loves the taste.  It is too early to tell if it solves the pooping issue but I will update with that in a week or so.  For now, I'm super pleased.

I buy this product monthly it is much better than your 9.99 dog food at walmart such a purina or pedigree. It is not a pricey as some brands like Blue which I highly recommend as well it is still affordable and GREAT for your dog. My dog eats this with no hesitation, switched to this from blue. She loves them both but this is a little more affordable for now.

Changed to this food recently, then had to change again due to vet's recommendation to go to a non meat, non poultry protein source. Can only comment that this food received a very good rating on Dog Food Advisor, a great site that impartially and scientifically reviews dog food quality. Also can say Amazon's price, especially by subscription, is by far the best I could find.

I am buying the second bag of the Prairie food for my 18 months old German Shepherd Dog. I started him out on a different brand of dog food, as an 8 week old puppy. He grew very fast eating that one and then the vet switched him to adult dog food at the age of 6 months to slow down his growing (to avoid joint problems). He didn't like that one very much, so I tried a different one which he wasn't too fond of either. After reading all the favorite reviews for this dog food, I bought it for my GSD this past spring. I like the fact that it is made of natural ingredients and most of all I like the chicken and rice ingredients in it. My dog has a sensitive stomach (like most of the GSDs do) and, whenever he has to take medicine, he ends up having a bad case of diarrhea. When that happens, I feed him steamed chicken with white rice to stop the diarrhea (vet's advice). My dog has been  enjoying his first bag of Prairie food and I am buying him the second one before he runs out of it. Purebred dogs need an excellent nutrition in order to strive and stay healthy, and I think I found the right food for mine.My dog is now 2 years old and he loves his Prairie with chicken meal and brown rice. I once tried to switch him to a different dog food and, as my vet put it "he went on a hunger strike." He refused to eat that other dog food. I had to order the Prairie dog food with next day delivery because my dog didn't eat for several days. I gave him milk bones treats just so that he had something in his stomach. So Prairie has been his food for most of his life since it is the one and only one he wants.

My Doberman has been on this food since puppyhood. He loves it! People ask me if he is a show dog and stop me on the street to say how beautiful he is. He has had absolutely no health issues. Shiny coat, no infections.  A good food like this is a little pricey but well worth it.  In the past, I've fed dogs cheaper foods but they would end up with ear infections, hot spots and dry coats.I use Amazon's automatic delivery feature and this big, heavy bag is delivered right to my door on a schedule that works for me!

Our seven year old lab has been eating this dog food for about five years now and never seems to tire of it.  He is always anxious for his meals.  He had ligament surgery last Feb. and needed to lost 10 lbs.  I cut him back to 2/3 of a cup morning and night and after about two months he had gotten down to 70 pounds.  He is maintaining his weight and looks and feel good.  Nature's Variety Prairie Dry Dog Food, Chicken Meal & Brown Rice Medley, 30-Pound Bag

First, go to this website: [...]Look for the rating section, and find the food that you are feeding your dog or cat right now, (they have a cat food link). Look for the ratings, and see what your food is rated. Then go up to the next rating, and see if you can find a better quality brand, for about the same price (this is exactly how I found a better rated brand). Do the research, and see what you can do to, get your pet the best possible rating, that you can AFFORD. Keep in mind too, that with less fillers, your dog will get more use out of the food, and it actually goes further than the cheap foods. The doggie waste is also much less in the yard. AND,,,lets just say that he has a much smaller problem with room clearing gas problems, when eating a premium food.This brand is one of the few that gets a five star rating on [...] - this website has proved to be indispensable for help in picking out a decent food for our dogs, but nothing is fool proof, when it comes to how that food is produced, and that is the fault of the government not having enough oversight over what can be put into the food. It is sad, because our pets deserve better. After using a "premium brand" food brand Iams, for year, I was very sad to learn how terrible the food actually was/is for the high price. Again,,,you don't have to purchase THIS brand, but get the best food for the money that you can afford for them. Having a website like Amazon, is actually the most helpful because just about EVERY brand mentioned on the dog food site, can be purchased and delivered to your door - something for me that is well worth, not having to lug around that huge bag.Yes it  [this brand], is expensive. However, in light of all of the Salmonella outbreaks happening to even the BEST of dog food companies, (like Buffalo), I chose this company, because they have not had a recall on their products, that I could track down. I was using Premium Plus (another expensive brand,,but they have had a few recalls, for unclean factories and fungal tainted batches). If you are like us, your pets are no less important to you, than your children. Truthfully, unless we hand cook everything for our dogs, we have no control over the way the food is made, or what goes into it. Sadly, there is also no oversight, as to what they are allowed to put into that food. This often includes any and all scraps and pieces of whatever "animal product", that will be the base protein, being used for that type of food, (any of these scraps qualifies for "meat").Because of the recalls on so many brands, I still keep a watchful eye on the company, and hope that they keep up their standards for a clean facility, on a regular basis, to try and keep up with the quality and safety of his food, to the best of my ability. Better to be safe than sorry with a sick pup. Or worse yet losing him to a food born illness caused by tainted food.Be warned though, if you have a very large breed dog, the kibble size on this brand, is EXTREMELY small! We have since put his food into a "Kong Feeder" that he has to roll around, to get the food out, which forces him to, take his time in eating it. If we didn't do this, he would totally gulp down an entire bowl, within minutes, often getting sick, because it was not chewed up at all.

I like everything about this food. The company seems to be pretty outstanding. The ingredients are great. The price WAS just right. The dogs like it. There are just two problems, the price literally jumped like $10 a bag and our dogs aren't digesting this well.We recently moved to a much smaller house with a less secure yard, and as a result the dogs are spending a lot more time with us indoors and we have to walk them everyday twice. I noticed that they were constantly farting and their stool was loose. Honestly, I'm a little disappointed. It took a lot of time and research to find a all around good dog food, but I can't argue with their stomachs.

column9: Best Dog Food on the Market.. Period
column10: I have had several dogs over the years and now am fortunate to have a Rottweiler and a Pomeranian.  I say both of the breeds only for the purpose of showing the ability for this food to span not only drastically in breeds but size as well.With that said, this is the only dog food that my dogs literally love to eat that is HEALTHY.  And that is a huge point especially considering that both of my dogs health are a primary concern considering the nature of what they do for a living e.g. Service DogsA great additional to being just dog food, it doubles as a healthy treat.  I generally use frozen billjack dog food for a treat, but that is not always the best to use in the heat or really in any situation that is not for immediate consumption.  With that said, this dog food is tasty enough for my dogs that they go nuts for it while performing training.  It is likely a combination of gratification for pleasing me and taste for them.  Either way I jokingly refer to it as "puppy crack" for my dogs mainly because they literally can't get enough.That brings to the cons- It is important to watch a dogs weight and maintain a healthy lifestyle with your dog.  It is easy to just fill up a bowl and leave it and let your dogs eat.  And if done with this food, your dogs will eat the heck out of it which is a con in if consumption is more than what is recommended by a veterinarian.And don't let the price scare you away.  If you wouldn't feed your kids fastfood everyday then don't skimp for your dogs!***ALSO GET TO SAVE 15% IF YOU SUBSCRIBE AND SAVE!!!Seriously a sweet deal!!!

First of all, before reviewing this product I have some important news- today my family is finally able to bring home the basset hound puppy at the dog place up in Harrisburg!  They couldn't bring it home sooner because the puppy was just too young and I guess at that point they want to make sure all the shots and paperwork are in order.  This is going to be a fantastic day!  Anyway this Nature's Variety Prairie Dry Dog Food is going to be the main dish I serve to our puppy, but perhaps he's too young to eat it just yet.  I'm not sure.  I'll have to check out the size of the chunks.  I want to make sure the puppy can digest the food properly, haha.  One thing's for sure- when you raise your dog on the dried food, they won't be mooching for table scraps!

column9: My German Shephard Lab mix loves this!
column10: This is some great stuff, and the price is right! My medium/large size dog loves it, even though the bits are small compared to most food for "large" dogs.It ships in a large box which can be a little bit of a hassle, but so worth it considering I only have to drag the 30 lb. bag from my front door to the pantry instead of all the way home from the grocery store!

column9: good value for fantastic quality dog food
column10: Our dog is a very fussy eater and a lot of food we tried he would turn his nose at or throw it up.  This food is great.  No tummy problems at all.  Will buy again.  I bought this food after readying other reviews saying that their dog had no tummy problems.  Highly recommend it.

We have a 8 year old yellow lab. She has been eating this food fora  few years now. She eats the Chicken Meal & Brown rice variety.  The food is a good quality. We often have people comment that she is much younger than her actual age. She is trim (about 65 lbs) and is able to maintain a healthy weight.  We love having this food delivered from Amazon. It is much easier then lugging it home from the store. Even with pet store 'discount' member cards, the food is a better value at Amazon.

We researched dog food for a couple of weeks before deciding this would be our best bet.  I feel there has been a lot more attention given to the ingredients over the last couple of years, or maybe I just never paid as much attention before.  We have been using this food for our two dachshunds for almost a year now & they seem to really like it.  I prefer the chicken version mainly for their weight control.  I love that we are able to set it up on the subscribe & save to save a little extra money plus it gets delivered straight to our door without any shipping costs.Bottom line - I feel good about serving this to our dogs & really appreciate the ease of purchase.

There are already enough stellar reviews for this food, but I want to just briefly add to the pile.Our golden retriever was on Puppy Chow -> Dog Chow for all of her 5 years. I know, I know... Dog Chow is not the Rolls Royce of dog foods, but we got a good deal on it and she did fine with it for years. But we noticed in the last few months she was getting lazy and sluggish, and listening poorly. But the worst part was the stomach issues. Throwing up inside after eating, 2-3 times a week? Not cool - especially when it happens while visiting your mother-in-law who just her her carpet replaced. Whoops.After researching on our own, we decided to invest in our dog: she adds so much to our family, so it's only right for us to help her out. We switched to Nature's Variety after comparing the reviews to other foods in this price range. We had it narrowed to NV and Buffalo Blue, and just pulled the trigger on NV here on Amazon. (By the way, while it's ridiculous to see your UPS guy haul dog food to your doorstep - Amazon's price is unbeatable when you subscribe.)We're halfway into the second bag, and our dog just keeps on getting more vibrant, entertaining, playful (but not crazy), and attentive. This is the best thing we've ever done for our dog. I don't know if other foods in this "class" would have had the same effect, but you won't see us switching anytime soon.
My dogs are healthy & strong on this food. Love the ingredient list! Highly recommended by a local holistic pet store.

We are weaning our younger golden off of prescription food and it is going well.  Our older dog (also a golden retriever) also loves it (we are converting her as we want to feed one food). I would recommend this food.

So the crazy clay stuff listed on the bag really is a difference that makes a difference. And it's not a miniscule amount for show, it's high up on the list (anything listed after the fat source in a bag of dry food is not a significant food source, though nutrients still of course need only be present in tiny amounts). Prairie is a really good all rounder food. I like the variety, the balance of the protein and fat for the average companion dog,  and the simple list of ingredients. I'd only love to see a probiotic source. They used to include inulin, curious why they dropped it. This was my base diet for my sedentary, retired dogs, for a few years. Great to see this on Amazon!

My shiba enjoys eating this and her coat has become very soft and healthy!  Definitely recommend this for the quality and value.  And also for the convenience of not having to haul dog food from the store to my house.

We bought this for our lab/ golden retriever mix and introduced the food to her by mixing it with her other food.  She had no trouble with loose stools or rejection of the food.  Once she was on Prairie for a full month without it being mixed with her old food, she suddenly stopped eating. We were growing very concerned about her because I could tell she was hungry and lacking energy. Our veterinarian suggested we try mixing some wet food with it to entice her.  We did, her appetite returned immediately, and she immediately returned to her old happy self. It's important to note that if any of the food is not covered in the gravy/ ground meat mixture from the canned food she refuses to eat those bits.  The dog just hates this food, and this is a dog who will eat ANYTHING. Back to Blue Buffalo. Too bad, because I really liked the subscribe and save feature for this kind of food.
I am very happy with this product.  We have been using it for years and the added convience of having it deliverd each month makes it worry free.  I recommend this product.

.dogs were on blue buffalo they loved it but i thought i would try prairre chicken, because of the rating it got on dog food analysis,plus it was cheaper on amazon. with the automatic ship and free delivery it was a better buy. the dogs love this one also. will stay on it as long as it stays economical

We were having issues with our 13 year old collie and new puppy wanting to eat the other's food...trying to separate them caused other issues so we looked into finding dog food that would work for both and the Nature's Variety Brand came up several times from our vet, groomer, etc...There was no adjustment period and both did very well with the switch. It is wonderful now to see them side by side eating...The best part is that you can order online and have it delivered right to your door step.

column9: Better price on Amazon than I can get locally!
column10: This dog food is one of the better ones available, but it can be pretty pricey, WHEN I can find it!  Our dog has been raised on Nature's Variety but when I was out of work, I was looking for cheaper alternatives since it's so expensive.  I really hated to do this, since it's so healthy for him and he isn't very receptive to change. I was relieved to find it on Amazon and love the idea of the subscription...especially with the discount!  Thanks to the subscription pricing I was able to swing it. Love having it delivered, don't have to haul it to and from the car and it arrives safely at my door, boxed to prevent damage to the bag.

We have been trying one brand of dry food after another to no avail.  The switching process, although not difficult, is still a pain.  One of our two dogs had boughts of diarrhea about every 3 - 5 days and since having made the switch to Nature's Variety Praire Chicken Meal & Brown Rice, I have not had to medicate him as he hasn't had any diarrhea in at least two weeks.  The last food he was on was a popular warehouse brand.  This is allergy season and the scratching and licking were bothering both dogs (and us!) but while one is still at it (I think he's just so used to doing it) the other one has stopped.  I tried this food because at the time all the ratings were five stars.  It is a five star food and I would highly recommend giving it a try.  I did subscribe to a monthly delivery and although the box didn't survive so well, the product was intact in its secure bag.

One of my dogs has a megaesophagus which creates a lot of bloating and unstable bowel movement. This food is the best that I've tried so far (and I've tried most of the most expensive brands).  The price with the recurring shipping is very reasonable, both dogs seem to love it, and they BM is now very stable.

I started my Lab on this after realizing that the food he was eating was mostly corn and "by-product."  He loves it.  He weighs about 115 lbs., but should weigh around 100, so he gets 1/2 cup of food morning and night with a cup of frozen green beans.  The food is more dense, so when paired with the green beans, it definitely keeps him fuller- longer.

column9: Wonderful food for our two Berners
column10: Love this food.  My two Berners are healthy and happy when they eat this food.  My local feed store had the 30 pound bag priced at $54.  With the subscribe and save with Amazon, we are saving approx $15 per bag and best of all, its shipped to my door for free.  Love this food and am so glad Amazon now carries it for such a great price.

I will only buy this branf form now on.  The price is comparable to store brand, but the product is much better.  My dog loves the food.  We went straight from pedigree to Nature's Variety with no problems.  She actually eats less and poops less.  Her attitude has changed too, shes a six year old puppy now.  I am going to subscribe to several different flavors alternating monthes.  Shes 100 ponds and a 30 pound bag will last around a month.

column9: Even the picky eaters love this one!
column10: On the recommendation of a breeder friend, we decided to try out a new kibble for our small pack of assorted fur babes. My mother has two Pomeranians (one of which is *extremely* picky, even with fresh "people" food), I have one Pom, one Peke mix and a German Shepherd mix. Since we were all together over the holidays we decided to give this food a try to see how they all liked it. I was impressed with the nutritional content, but that doesn't always translate to taste or appealing to our dogs. From the very first bowl, they were all interested - even my mother's super picky eater. I highly recommend this food, especially for picky eaters. We haven't been using it long enough to determine it's long term effects on the health of our dogs, but have noticed smaller stools, less gas/tummy upset and happier, more playful pooches!

My dogs (Australian Cattle Dog mixes) love this stuff, in stark contrast to other dry food.  They had no GI problems when I switched from Science Diet, and they both continue to have high energy levels.  (This isn't a very scientific experiment on the merits of a new kibble, I realize.)

My husband and I were looking for a better quality dog food.  Mainly because our dogs REALLY stank after coming in from outside and randomly smelled like corn/fritoes.  I researched it a little and found it might have to do with the dog food we were feeding them.  We gave this to them (we have a hound shephard mix and pug) and the bigger one loved it!  She was hoarding the food and trying to make sure the other one didn't get any-she is a pretty picky dog.  The pug liked it too, but he will eat anything.  I feel as if the smell has gotten a lot better-not 100%, but they are dogs and dogs will smell.  I am rating this 5 stars because my dogs love it so much, it is a pretty good deal (we were feeding them Beneful from Costco which was bout 14 dollars cheaper), good size morsels, and I like the ingredients.

We have a 9 month old Australian shepherd rescue who's been eating this food since we adopted her at age 3 months. I chose it randomly from the local pet store because the packaging claims it can be used in rotation with other dog foods.  Since I had also heard that Aussies have sensitive digestive systems I thought it would be good for us since we didn't know what she ate prior and I anticipated possibly having to sample a few different types of food. She loves it.  She eats it so fast I've considered trying a strategy to slow down her eating (such as one of the toys that the dog food comes out of more slowly).  Her digestion patterns seem pretty good on this food so I have no complaints.  Pricing is comparable here to the local premium pet supply store.

The Nature's Variety Dry Dog food has a great kibble size and comes in a very durable bag for storage, but the product list on Amazon's website neglected to list the entire contents of ingredients contained in the dog food. My dog has several food allergies,soy and certain grains, peas, and EGGS. The ingredient list appeared to cover what I was looking for, or the lack thereof, and so I ordered a bag. I was extremely surprised when I started seeing a rash on my dog, and began searching for the cause. Since he was eating the Nature's Variety, the only new item in his diet, I got the bag and read the list of ingredients, and was shocked to see several kinds of eggs listed! Eggs were NOT listed in the ingredients nor in the item description. So, needless to say, I will not be buying anymore Nature's Variety for my dog.

The price seems quite steep to me, but I haven't found this size bag in the stores.  Not sure if I'll be ordering from them again, but the delivery was fast.  Box was a little beat up, but it is a 30 lb bag of dog food after all...

My dogs have enjoyed it for many years. I'm a senor and my problem was getting help when I got home to get the 50# bags up the stairs, NOW I order them and they are del. to my front door on my porch...no more stairs.

Bought a bag of Nature's Variety Prairie Chicken & Brown Rice for my 10yo Doberman and her dry coat has cleared up in less than a week. Gonna rotate the different flavors of this brand from now on. Hopefully she feels good and healthy too. $45 well spent.
I have been very happy with the Prairie Chicken Meal and Brown Rice Medley Dry dog food by Nature's Variety. My dog Missy is is allergic to corn, wheat and soy. She is fine now.

column9: GREAT Food. Best food ive ever fed my dogs
column10: I switched to this food 3-4 years ago and am NOT looking back. Both of our dogs have switched to this. Its the closest thing to grain-free you can get to... we cant feed grain-free to our dalmatian because of the purine content. They eat this quickly and we've never had a problem. We havent switched the flavor yet, apparently you can do that without the dogs having digestive problems.
it is a great dog food, you can't find anything on the market that is better than natures variety dog food and ordering it through amazon is the way to go
This sure beat going to an overpriced dog boutique and hauling a 30 pound bag to my car and then to the house.  Cheaper and it was waiting on my doorstep.  Delivery was quick too.  Loved it.

You really do get what you pay for most of the time when it comes to pet foods.  There are foods out there that are better than this one, but this one is a good value when you look at the lbs and the ingredient list.  High quality ingredients in small kibbles mean that I can feed less food and that it turn means less waste!  My dogs have been on this food for 6 years and I've never once felt like they need to be on something different.  We rotate flavors (lamb, chicken, beef, etc) if the store is out of stock or Amazon's price isn't suiting me.  I've never had a hard time getting them to eat it and they look absolutely amazing.  Very pleased with this company and with this food!  Only thing is that I wish they would bring back the zippered 30 lb bags, I had to buy a rolling bin and I still don't feel like this food is very fresh.

I wanted to switch our 9-year old Dalmatian's food because what he'd been eating had fallen off the "good" lists.  This sounded like a good alternative, but at a 1 to 3 or even 1 to 4 dilution with the old food to start, it induced very loose stools.  Disappointing.

We have a 5 month old pit bull mix and she had very loose stool every time we tried to feed her this stuff.  I offered the food to other people who have dogs and no one wanted it.  I threw it away.  What a waste.

column9: Food is great, packaging not so much.
column10: I just opened the box and realized the bag was open. This happened once before and Amazon replaced the product. Has anyone else had this problem? My german short hair pointer loves this food, but I will not feed him something that came open.
Product was rec'd damaged, the box was crushed & the bag inside was open so quite a bit of the food came out in the box. I didn't return it because I needed the food

Both of our dogs are adopted dogs.  One was at a shelter being fed raw meat when we got her and the other was in a foster home being fed Nutro.  We wanted a food that would be easy to transition to for both of them.  After a ton of debate, we landed on Prairie because it's supposed to be better for the dog.I justify the healthy food for dog thing by asking myself if I would eat McDonalds or Burger King every day and I personally would not, so why would I make my dogs eat the cheaper dog food that filled with all kinds of stuff that's not actually food?Both dogs transitioned to Prairie extremely well.  But after a few months, one of them started developing horrible gas (*farting*).  So we immediately thought it was the food.  We decided to switch their food and give them Rachael Ray's dog food.  The transition to that went fairly smooth as well.  However, after a few months of that we couldn't find it anywhere (not sure if they stopped making it).  So we switched again, this time to Nutro.  Not only did Nutro give them horrible gas, but their coats were less soft and they seemed to have almost no energy.  After trying a few other brands over the years, we ended up back at Prairie and are sticking with it (at least for now).  The dogs just seem to have more energy and better fur (even if they do still have gas). So I'd recommend trying it.We found it to be about $20 cheaper on amazon for a 30lb bag than at the local pet store.

column9: Dog refused to eat, and got sick once
column10: I am writing this after my dog refused to eat this food after a couple of weeks. She threw up once yesterday. So I guess I will be donating this food to the shelter, and getting a different brand. I tried finding a supposedly healthier brand, but I think I will stick with Science Diet Mobility.

This is a very mild and tasty cheese. It is quite mild, very soft and a bit crumbly, with a slight hint of salt. It is a good eating cheese and would mix well with various types of salads. I ordered 2 rolls of this cheese which considerably reduced the cost/pound of the cheese as the combined shipping was lower.The packaging was well done and the cheese arrived cool and in good condition. Of course, I live in New England and it is not very ht here. I would be a bit more concerned if I lived in a warmer climate. I am not certain that the packaging would provide adequate cooling for a warmer location.

column9: Is what it is.. I've moved on to things with more dramatic effects
column10: The great news is I haven't gotten sick!Unfortunately after a couple months of drinking this product daily I've not felt a huge change either... I've moved on to trying Amazing Grass which has been supplementing my daily vegi intake that I wasn't getting and has had more dramatic effects on my health.  I've switched from this product to taking two tablets of Lifesheild mushroom blend at night.  Overall I've seemed to have missed my yearly 3 day (or so) crippling sicknessGood will hunting,Tom

It has taken me a while to review this item, but better late than never.  My wife enjoys making soup and mentioned how expensive really good French green lentils are.  Decided to take a look and take a chance on this item.  Not only was it a very good price but the lentils were really top quality. They store well, and when we are finished with these my wife (who is very particular on the quality of ingredients she uses) has said she would order these again.

I purchased these at a local health food store, however, these are cheaper through Amazon.  They are wonderful dried fruit, in all the different varieties.  I am especially fond of the pomegranate.  Just enough dried out, just a bit chewy some of the time.

column9: My cats swear by this food!
column10: I was shocked and saddened to see the two negative reviews posted below for Natural Value here on Amazon - but then I actually read the "reviews".To "Mamakitty" - most ALL meat/seafood used in pet food comes from Asia; and seafood products in particular typically come from Thailand. Even certain other high-end pet foods source their seafood from Thailand. Most of the seafood (fish/squid in particular) YOU buy for your own consumption at the grocery store is usually from Thailand!! Your concerns stem from product coming from China (which is not "Asia" or "Thailand" FYI). Natural Value has high standards of processing/manufacturing as listed on their website and they stand behind it. I trust them 100%.To "happyhalloween" - well yes, it is unfortunate to pay that much for shipping - but what exactly does the shipping cost from Amazon have to do with the product itself?? Nothing. Perhaps next time you would be better suited to actually base your rating on the quality of the food instead of leaving a one-star review that has nothing to do with the product in question.Now - onto my review - I have been buying Natural Value tuna n' toppings for my cats for about five years now. This is a very healthy and affordable cat food! Even after all this time - my cats still gulp it down no questions asked - they actually prefer this over anything. I have bought just about every type of  high-end cat food out there. My cats love this food above all of them.The ingredients are self-explanatory - it's free of rice, grains, "meals", and all those other fillers put in just about every other big name cat food.When you open the can - it looks just like what it is supposed to be - tuna meat with an additional "topping". The can is filled to the brim with chunks of red meat tuna with no watery liquids (the jelly used to hold the meat together is very effective). It's solid meat, solid food and its definitely affordable for all consumers.You know you are buying the right food for your cats when you are the only one you know who doesn't have a "fat" cat. All of my felines have maintained a healthy weight and a soft, shiny coat while eating this food. I also never find myself complaining about finicky eaters when I have a supply of Natural Value in my kitchen.Do yourself and your cat a favor and try this food instead of the grocery store junk. Natural Value has a great balance of nutritional additives and a good supply of taurine (a very important part of a cats diet). I cannot recommend this food enough! I am very thankful I discovered it in my local corner store (of all places) way back when.Also - the price here on Amazon is fantastic - I just picked up two cases with free shipping (50 cans) for under $30.00!

Cat loves the food. You feel good about paying less and getting a product with real meat listed as the first ingredients.  Also the can is really easy to clean out because it doesn't have sticky fillers like Science Diet does.  The only thing is Cat seems to be hungry all the time, meowing for food often.  I'm not sure if it's because it is less filling than other foods or if he's just obsessed with it.

Feeding 2 cats twice a day is made so simple with this bigger can.  I just give each half!  I give them Tiki Cat, which they adore, but I wanted to try this one because of the good deal.  I was hesitant because of the menedione sodium bisulfate listed in the product description, which isn't in any of the pate forms of this brand.  I took a risk and am glad I did...there is no MSB in the case I got and I have to say, it looks just like Tiki!  Only difference is, it cost me 27 cents a serving versus 83 cents.  I ordered more!
Unlike the tuna with shrimp flavor which my cats wouldnt touch, they seem to enjoy this flavor quite a bit. I would recommend it. BPA free is a + too.

column9: great, but my cats do not like it at all
column10: just because my two cats do not like this does not mean it is not a great product. they are known to love something (weruva paw lickin chicken) and totally dismiss it in a year or less. therefore, i cannot rate this any less than five star because i like the brand and will try another flavor.

My cat loves this food.  She will run to dinner time and eat it all up by the time I get it into her bowl.  The only reason I didn't give it five stars is because of the shipping.  They used to have this on "Prime" shipping but now that they don't, I cannot get it.

column9: Cats LOVE but tuna is wild caught from Thailand
column10: Amazon was out of the chicken variety that our cats love. I decided to order the Tuna blend even though I don't like to feed my cats too much fish. They love this and will gobble it up like its their last meal, and it doesn't have a strong fish odor which is surprising for a food made from tuna... but on the box it is marked 'Wild Caught! Product of Thailand'. I'm wary of any foods from Asia (and most non-USA foods for that matter) except Japan, where the manufacturing standards are even higher than the US, after the horror of the Chinese pet food ingredients that killed all of those cats and dogs. Still, the food seems good quality, Natural Value is a respectable company committed to organic and healthy products, and when Amazon has it in stock, the price with free shipping is a bargain.

My cat loves this stuff, and would order a case but paying over $18 for shipping is ridiculous. Their total price makes this stuff almost twice the 89 cents that this is available for at the corner store. Keep shopping.

If you are buying these as a chocolate flavored treats with a fringe benefit of  contributing to oral health, look elsewhere! If you are primarily interested in using xylitol sweetened candy as a preventative measure to use against cavities and gum disease, you might find these barely satisfactory. The bottom line is that these, allegedly, chocolate flavored lollipops have hardly a hint of flavor AT ALL and if it weren't for the dark brown color that primes the mind to expect a chocolate flavor, I doubt whether one could even discern that that they are supposed to BE chocolate. I ordered from Dr. John's website directly and I have decided to keep them in spite of my negative opinion because of the benefits of xylitol and I will just eat these everyday as if i were taking medication. I may order again but it certainly won't be the chocolate.

column9: Best brown organic brown rice I have had!
column10: I just picked this up at my local grocery store because it was the only organic brown rice they had and I was pleasantly surprised! It cooks really well, not sticky at all (I use a bit of coconut oil and cook it in organic vegetable broth.) Tastes great! I am not typically a brown rice lover but this kind was really good. My kids and husband ate it and asked for seconds as well. Was delighted to see it on Amazon and for such a great price with subscribe and save so I just stocked up!
This has the long thin grain and light texture of real Basmati rice unlike others I tried before that claim to be Basmati. It also has a rich, nutty flavor. And it's organic!
Love this rice and will order again. Cooks up nicely in microwave. I recommend this product  to anyone that likes brown rice.

column9: For those of you who have been searching for Clearly Canadian and those who haven't
column10: Years ago Clearly Canadian offered flavored, carbonated water in glass bottles. As the years went by it was harder and harder to find as grocers and gas stations stopped carrying it. Clear American has harnessed the flavor that CC contained but bottled it in a standard plastic bottle. The flavors are rich and pure, without that heavy syrupy taste.Nutritional Facts(1/30/2012)Calories  0Total Fat 0Sodium  0Sugars  0Protein  0Check out these other flavors as well.Clear Choice Sparkling Water 12 Pack - Black Cherry, 1 quartClear Choice Key Lime Sparkling Water - 12 PackClear Choice Kiwi Strawberry Sparkling Water 4 ct - 6 PackClear Choice White Grape Sparkling Water 4 ct - 6 PackClear Choice Tropical Fruit Sparkling Water 4 ct - 6 PackClear Choice Golden Peach Sparkling Water - 12 PackHighly recommended.

The first time I had this tea was during cream tea at the Brown Palace Hotel in Denver.  Completely addicted from that day, I have a hard time finding this Twinings tea!  (Sometime carried by import stores, but not always.)  TRY IT!  With milk and a lump of sugar it's wonderful.  Always a pick me up on a dreary day.

i love this tea!  i wouldn't normally think that i'd like a "flavored" tea, but the black currant undertones mix so well with the addition of milk n' honey - that it's really my all-time favorite black tea...i like chai too, but the spice-blends can be so tempermental that i'd rather just stick with something that i know is a sure thing!  once you try it, you'll be hooked - the only problem, is that it is VERY HARD to find...so glad, that amazon has sense enough to carry it

I originally ordered these for my sister in law, but we found they would be perfect for my mother in law who lives alone, and honey crystalizes so fast when you don't use it enough, but the flavor is really good, I tried some in my tea first day and I Loved it and plan on ordering some more :)This seems to be the only safe one (some of the foreign honey granules have a cancer warning - this one does not) thats why we picked this brand.
this is a quick, easy way to add light sweetness to tea or baked goods.  We even sprinkled it on our ham before baking--just sprinkle on after basting with the pan juices for a light ham glaze.

Was having a small group and needed some honey for tea.  Opted for this.  Not sure how sensitive my palate is, but didnt get a real strong smell and taste of honey.  But is definitely sweet. Very pricey.Still looking for a neat and easy way to offer honey.  Thought this was going to be the solution, but not exactly.  I guess for these price I wanted more than just sweet. I wanted the honey bee experience.
I ask the Manufacturer - this item has 8.5% Honey. Doesn't seem nearly enough to call the product Honey Granules.

On a whim I purchased this item in an effort to eliminate the sticky mess that dripping honey made on my bedside table.  The granulated honey works beautifully.  There is absolutely no mess and the granules have a taste remarkably close to real honey.  I still prefer the real thing but this keeps everything neat and not sticky!  This will also be a good addition to my tea parties with friends.

I took this stuff on a two week camping trip and had no problems with mess or attracting ants!  Tastes great. Note that this does not seem to reconstitute into a thick viscus honey-like substance. My results were much more watery  Use in place of sugar.
Until I find out what the foreign object was in this that made me sick, I would hold off on using this product. More information to come.......

column9: Great spice to use for tagine cooking!
column10: I've used Shawarma for Meat to cook osso buco (cross cut veal shank) and lambs on my tagine.  It comes out great every time!  Along with this spice, I found it necessary to add sea salt and ground pepper to the meat before cooking it on low heat for 1.5 hrs.  The meat comes out fork-tender.  Great on white or brown rice.  The beauty of tagine cooking is that you can bring the dish from stovetop to the dinner table.  Very simple...and delicious.The same can be said of Shawarma for Chicken.  I normally don't like to buy too many spices.  Shawarma for Chichen and Shawarma for Meat both have very diffrent taste.  I end up using these spices quite often on my tagine.  Dump all the meat, shallots, onions, olives and lemon juice into the tagine and wait for 1-1.5 hrs (scraping the bottom of the dish every now and then so it doesn't burn.)  Combined with veggie (sautee or steamed) and rice and you got one hearty meal.  My family was quite impressed!

Zamouri Spices prepares their deliciously unique spices with great care. They are absolutely delicious. A big plus are their online recipes! I have made the Moroccan Barbequed Chicken on many occasions as it is produces one of the most delicious meals I have ever eaten -- and I do not like chicken!I suggest you peruse their online recipes to determine which spices to purchase. And buy more than you expect to use, because you will find yourself cooking more and more with their declicious recipes.

I've never actually had Shawarma that someone else has made, but I've been on a mid-east kick for several years now. I wanted to try this instead of using my own, just to compare. I'm very pleased with this blend and the family loves it too. It doesn't have much salt if any, so I do add that to the cooked meat. I've used it on chicken mostly but it will work on other stuff too.
Good taste, very high in fiber (great for diabetics).  Cooks fast. Great in a Mack n' Cheese or a chicken / tuna salad.  2 oz. dry = about 1 cup cooked.

column9: GREAT PASTA, HIGH FIBER, VERY TASTEY
column10: THIS PASTA TASTE SO GOOD, IT HAS HELP WITH MY 35# WEIGHT LOSS.I NEVER COULD OF STAYED ON IT, IF IT WAS NOT FOR FIBER GOURMET PASTA.I HAVE ORDERED MANY TIMES.Fiber Gourmet Light Penne, 8-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 12)

This is simply one of the best low calories food out there. Great taste, low calories, low sugar, high fiber.If you want to eat pasta and don't want to rack up the calories, one answer: FiberGourmet!!!!!

I picked up a box of this at Whole Foods ($5) to try.  It was simply amazing!! Tastes exactly like regular pasta. Even my picky husband said it has the same consistency and texture as regular pasta.  I was expecting that cardboard box taste like most low calorie anything has and this stuff was nothing like that at all.  I made a type of hamburger helper with it,  and purcahsed a case of 12.  Simply amazing, you won't regret this purchase especially if you are watching calories.

These rotini are by far my favorite Fiber Gourmet product AND my favorite boxed pasta.  Not to mention you can eat almost double the amount for the same calories as other pasta products, even whole wheat.  The taste is wonderful and they cook very quick!  An absolute staple in my household.

column9: This shape really makes for great veggie n pasta and homemade Mac N Cheese
column10: I had tried the FiberGourmet pasta a couple years ago and thought it was okay, but they only had the fettuccine back then. I just tried these this week and I really like this shape. This pasta holds up well, firmly, even if you cook it past the recommended time (I find that unlike regular pasta, which to get al dente the way I like, I need to cook LESS than package instructuions, this pasta needs more time or tastes undercooked). I made a really good low-fat, high-fiber mac n cheese with this  using light cheddar, low fat american cheese, skim milk, and Smart Balance and a teensy bit of onion powder. Mmm.I like the packaging now, too, and the newer pasta shapes are much more convenient and useful for me than the old fettuccine nests I originally tried.Recommended if you need to up your fiber, cut your carbs but keep eating pasta, or just wanna cut calories.
Don't know why it's so hard buy decent crystallized ginger here in the USA but this is the real deal and passed muster by my sister-in-law who is quite discerning.

I've been having terrible cravings for Ginger and you wouldn't believe how difficult it is to find decent 'Crystalized Ginger' 'round these parts.  The candied ginger I've found at the local grocery store could have been plain ol' sugar cubes for all it's worth.  You couldn't taste the ginger and the texture... just horrible.  This ginger however is AMAZING!  Great sweetness with a good balance of 'spiciness' thrown in.  You can definately taste the ginger in these sugared goodies!That said, I've recently ordered a bunch of Ginger products from a company called 'The Ginger People' (I've tried their 'Ginger Chews' which are available locally and they are very tasty).  I'm hoping that their ginger products have even more of a kick because it's the sweet 'spiciness' that I truly crave.  But for the time being, it is safe to say that this is the BEST Crystallized Ginger I have had to date.
Excellent product.  Tender, not stringy at all.  Perfect for eating just as is.Great, true ginger flavor.  Will purchase again.

I purchased this ginger as well as ginger tea from another merchant because it's supposed to help with muscle aches and pains.  I've never really tasted ginger in this form before so my rating really isn't good for much especially since I don't like it.  Although my taste may improve regarding this product.  My only negative thought for those allergic or watching there weight is the fact that there is no nutritional information on the packaging.  I did ask the supplier and they quickly supplied me with the information.  Serving size is 7pcs with the calories being 120 per serving.  This product is processed in a facility that handles nuts, wheat, milk, and soy products.  Zero fat, zero Cholest. 25mg sodium, 29 carbs, 1 fiber, 28 sugar per serving.

column4: Tina Something ""We know why you troll""
column9: Some of the best I've had
column10: I've had some good crystalized ginger and some bad. This might be the best ever!Uniform size pieces, no stringy un-chewable pieces thrown in to ad weight. I stored them in an airtight container and they never seemed to dry out, though they didn't really have to long to wait till they were eaten. I"m making my second purchase now and plan to make another when I run out again.
Very good product for the ginger lover.Not too sweet. Not too hot. Consistentpiece size.I've come back for more.

This brand is very soft and almost melts in your mouth. Not quite as hot as the Ginger People brand, but more tender and not stringy at all. Sugar is loosely coated and some of it can be rubbed off if it's too much.
This Australian ginger is the best.  The ginger is smooth, and the crystalized sugar is a crunchy contrast. It's impossible to resist.

column9: Did I get a bad batch?
column10: I adore ginger in every form.  Buoyed by the glowing reviews, I ordered three pounds.  Unfortunately, it was not at all as described.  The first bite was bland and too sugary; the after-taste almost medicinal.  I couldn't detect any spicy ginger flavor.  I tried a couple more pieces and found them thoroughly unpleasant.  The store owner was great, however.  I returned the two unopened bags and he/she issued a full refund.  I threw the third bag away.

column9: Not bad at all, pretty tasty in fact
column10: This ginger candy does not have as much of a "bite" as some brands of (more expensive) ginger candy I have previously enjoyed and is a bit sweeter than I would prefer. That being said, it is a nice bag of ginger, lots of flavor, tastes very fresh. I am pleased with the price, shipping, amount and flavor so this is a keeper. I will order from this place again and get another bag of this crystallized ginger yummy-ness.

Thai Crystalized Ginger is supposed to be the best in the world, so I am told by a food technologist.  Australian is supposed to be the second best.  I am not so sure that Thai Ginger would be the best after the recent tidal wave, if there is much difference at all.  Those are the two premier crystalized gingers of the worldRegardless, this is about all you could ask for in great ginger.  This ginger is moist and tender, unlike some dry and stringy ginger that you get elsewhere.  It does indeed seem to come from tender, baby ginger shoots. My wife and I just love ginger.  We love crystalized ginger as a snack, or mixed in other foods, such as cookies, cranberry sauce, salad dressings, dipping sauces, truffles, all manner of ways.  It is a secret ingredient.  If you have never had good crystalized ginger, you have missed a real treat.I have only had one other crystalized ginger that I can say is better, which says a lot.  This is about as good as it gets.I have purchased other gourmet items from J&M Mushrooms in the past.  This ginger has always been fresh tasting, as have all of their other specialty items.  They seem to prefer to have a moree limited gourmet line, that they concentrate on and have great quality at very good prices.  Suits me.  If you are placing an order, you might check their other items as they are one of the few distributors of Spinosi Italian Egg Noodles (great product), and they have a great price on Madagascar Vanilla Beans.

I have been buying Australian Crystalized Ginger from Sweet Energy company for a long time.  Very tasty product but ridiculously expensive.  I therefore decided to give the current item a try.  It is a haphazard mix of good and bad pieces.  But what is very curious is the texture and substance of each piece.  If I could take a wild guess I would say that these pieces seem to be mashed ginger blended with sugar then compacted and molded into solid feeling coins.  On the outside too there is entirely too much sugar.All in all this product is not up to par.
This product seemed to lose some of its flavor after awhile.  I used it infrequently in baking.  It didn't have as much zing that I initially expected.

This stuff tastes good, but it is a very mild ginger flavor compared to other brands.  If you find other crystallized gingers to be too strong for you, try this.  It has a lot of sugar on it too.  I'm giving it 4 stars because I prefer spicier ginger.  Pieces are perfectly regularly cut and even quality.
I have never tasted ginger taste this good.  Everyone remarked about it and wanted to know where I purchased it.  On a whim, we coated it with excellent chocolate. Beyond ecstasy.

column9: Crystalized Ginger is better than candy!
column10: The crystalized ginger was wonderful! Ginger helps with digestion and this product is perfect.  Fast shipping and no problems.  Would by from again.  Thanks so much
This ginger was quite easy to cut up for The Christmas cookies, we WILL buy again next year! The flavor was also quite good.

This is very good ginger.  Soft and flavorable.  I only have tasted one product that was better, but am unable to get it!!  I would highly recommend this.  I sent some of it to a good friend who loves ginger.

My husband got these because he read that it would help his back pain.  I tried one and if that's all I had to eat on a desert, then I guess I'd starve.  I did not like the taste and I do like many different things, but this is icky!  :)
This hot sauce has so much pepper flavor!  It's just the right amount of heat, not too hot, but definitely not mild.  It's my favorite hot sauce, and I've tried dozens.

column9: NO Carb just as it claims but...
column10: No carb Apricot fruit spread, should have warned me. All fruit has carbs, I was looking for a good flavor sugar free jam. This just doesn't have enough actual Apricot flavor for me and you certainly can't see any fruit due to the texture. It's like a cross between an apple butter and a jelly. I did find a sugar free fruit jam with lots of flavor but this wasn't it. It's nice enough, but the Kraft sugar free jams are better/cheaper and they didn't meet the fruit flavor test I am searching for. Sweet isn't good enough. I haven't tried any of their other products, maybe it's just the apricot that is like this.

I've been on a moderate protein/low carb/low fat program for months, and have a salad with my portion of meat and 2 cups of stir-fried vegees every night.  This spread is great for a sweet/sour dressing, like what you get with egg rolls.  Microwave a tablespoon or so to soften, add a dash of soy sauce and a dash of apple cider vinegar to brighten the flavor.  I top it with fresh cilantro.  Some of the Walden Farms items are awful, but this one is really good.

The first time they sent to me it came broken...but as soon as the company found out what had happened they emailed me and sent me a new one. It came two days later and it was all in one piece and was awesome...tastes so good. Excellent company and great product. Would definitely order again!!

I ordered these for my sons birthday, they came really quickly and packaged well, they are very cute and perfect for a child's birthday! I had purchased airplane lollipops from another seller and was really disappointed with them but these ones looked just like the photo

I had to cut back on my green tea habit (apparently there is such a thing as too much), so I gave this a try.  It has an unusual smell, but the taste is somewhere between a full-bodied mate and a woody coffee/almond flavor.  I've developed a passion for this tea as the taste definitely grows on you.  I do use a slightly larger serving for 2 strainings (the 2nd cup is a little weaker but still good, saves money!).

I wanted something different besides green tea and chamomile and the rest of the usuals i have every day.  I searched for a while at my health food store for the right tea, and i found this one.  I've never heard of Rooibos before, but i liked the idea of almond and vanilla.I opened it in the car and sniffed it all the way home.  I could have steeped my tea a little bit longer, but the flavor was still great.  it was naturally sweet and didn't require any sugar or honey.  I paired it with vanilla soy milk.  I can't wait to introduce people to this tea.  I plan on trying other flavors by the same brand.

column9: Great rich taste and good for you - WOW!
column10: I was forced by my Doctor to cut out caffeinated coffees and teas. That led me on a long search for something to replace the rich flavor of coffee and black teas. Flavor rich this organic herbal blend of Rooibos, vanilla and almonds is a great substitute for English breakfast. Add a little milk and honey and even the kids love it. I use a coffee press and make a cup every morning but with a more hot water the same herbs are good for a second cup. Rooibos is naturally decaffeinated and the added bonus is that it contains additional heath benefits such as antioxidants and minerals such as, magnesium, zinc and other things my doctor is happy about.

I absolutely LOVE, LOVE, LOVE(!!!) this tea blend! I've been a fan of rooibos (red or green), but I've never tasted something as delicious as this. It's funny to see that I'm not the only one who thought this smells and tastes like cherry! Everyone I asked to smell it said I was crazy. I suppose it depends on your sense of smell. If you love rooibos, black cherries, almonds, and vanilla, you'll love this tea too. If you've never had rooibos, good luck with getting any idea of what it tastes like before you actually taste it. It's pretty hard to describe, but it's very pleasant. Once again, this is one amazing tea!

column9: I'm starting to like this tea more after shortening the brewing time.
column10: Upon opening the canister and taking a whiff, my first thought was, "OMG, they sent a canister of my grandfather's pipe tobacco!"  My grandfather died more than 40 years ago and I still recall the smell of his tobacco.  A pleasant smell for tobacco, but not for tea!Getting past the aroma, I brewed a cup per the instructions and ... didn't like it  ... at all.A few days later, I thought I'd try again.  Brewed it again, using solidly boiling water and let it steep 6 minutes again, as recommended.  Again, failure in the taste bud and aroma department.Finally, I got up the courage to try it one more time this week.  I again used rapidly boiling water but only steeped if for 3 minutes... and  I like it!! A shorter steeping time cuts the overwhelming vanilla flavor (and aroma) but keeps the pleasant rooibos flavor and color and allows a hint of almond to hover in the background.I don't think this will ever be a "favorite" tea of mine but I'm finding it drinkable now.  I'd actually rate it a 3.5 stars if that were an option.It comes with two tins of tea and I'm going to pawn the 2nd tin of it off on my sister ...  :-)

This is my favorite tea of all time.  My son gave me the first tin of it to try... at the time you could not order online anywhere... I had to drive from Woodbridge, VA to Leesburg VA to get the next tin.  Then finally they had it on their website for sale... boy was I excited.  Now it is available through Amazon with free shipping... It does not get any better than that.

column9: Rod Rocks makes the perfect toddy.
column10: Wonderful, deep, nutty flavor. Aroma reminiscent of pipe tobacco (in a good way.)Especially nice with some honey and brandy. Rod Rocks Toddy!

I love Rooibos tea! It is naturally caffeine free but there is something in it that just perks me up in the morning.  Red Rocks is a great mix of Red Tea with a hint of vanilla and almond.  I do not need to add anything to my morning cup and can enjoy the strong yet mild flavor.  I have my pack of two for several months now, last quite awhile!

I became interested in rooibos tea after reading Alexander McCall Smith's No. 1 Ladies' Detective Agency series. As she ponders the vagaries of human nature and thinks about her most recent case, Mma Ramotswe, Smith's crack private investigator, always sips a soothing cup of redbush tea.I later learned that redbush, or rooibos, tea has tremendous health benefits. According to some experts, it rivals green tea in the number of polyphenols it contains. Some describe it as anti-aging and anti-carcinogenic as well.On its own, rooibos tea can be a little harsh. It has sort of a dusty, metallic taste that isn't particularly pleasant.Red Rocks tea, however, has none of that rusty taste. As other reviewers have said, the vanilla and almond give it a gentle nutty sweetness. There is no bitter aftertaste, and the tea needs no additional sweetening or flavoring of any kind. A five-minute steep makes for the perfect cup.

If you like the S. African Rooibos tea you gotta try this blend. The vanilla is tasty and the almond bits add just a touch of flavor. Just steep to taste. It's a great tea, and easy to blend with soy. Mmmm.

This tea sounded great. I love the flavors of almond and vanilla so I was really looking forward to it. It ended up tasting more watery than anything else. I had to add some vanilla extract and honey for it to have enough flavor to drink. I would definitely not purchase it again.

column9: Soothing tobacco tea with almonds to munch!
column10: This is one of those tobacco teas that some people dislike, unlike them, I tremendously enjoy the aroma of fine African rooibos red tea with slight vanilla hint, and 1 or 2 hiding pieces of almonds at the bottom of the cup when I am done.  It's good to drink at anytime of the day, but I prefer it after 5 PM or later as it has no caffeine, the rest of teas I drink contain some traces of caffeine (green, white) which I leave for the second part of the day.  Rooibos tea is a fantastic tea containing full arsenal of antioxidants, protects the liver, fights viruses and has many other medicinal properties.  I am finishing my jars of loose green tea and won't come back to it because of caffeine (even small traces of caffeine is really a light carcinogen, I bet you didn't know! :) ).  In reality, herbal teas like rooibos, chamomile, st. john's wort, hibiscus, Melissa (lemon balm) etc, beat green and white teas, and are some of the finest teas that fight viruses, bacteria, HIV, hepatitis, herpes infections (HSV 1 and 2), protect the liver, normalize several blood values decrease lipoperoxidation, increase antioxidant defenses, etc. (hibiscus for example decreases oxalic acid (stone) formation in kidneys). So herbal teas are your friends, treat them with boiling water and they will take care of you with time.  Another great idea, if you are adventurous, is to mix several herbal teas together to have a synergistic effect.
