column9: Try One Carton First - Taste "Okay" But Too Mushy For Me
column10: This review refers to Country Choice Multi Grain Hot Cereal -For the last few of years I have been hooked on the Irish style Steel Cut Oats. At first I was buying the McCann's, and then I stumbled onto the Country Choice(also Irish style steel cut), which I found just as tasty and satisfying a meal but at a much better deal here. The Steel Cut Oats have a very different texture from regular oatmeal -  creamy but a little chewier feel which I really liked and also it was a meal that kept me going until lunch time without feeling hungry. The steel cut usually takes about 25-30 minutes  to prepare and I found they are well worth the wait.So seeing these and the reviews saying how good they were, I thought I'd add a little variety to my mornings, and reap the benefits of some other type of whole grains. The first thing I found was that these only take 5 minutes max to cook, and I had to make several attempts(even following the directions) to get it to where it wasn't either still sitting in half the water or had absorbed it all before it was actually finished cooking. So getting the ratio of cereal/water part down, I still felt these grains too mushy for me - if I used less water, they would cook too fast. They tasted okay - just okay - I thought the cereal a little on the bland side and have to add honey or something extra.With the oats I could just add some blueberries or raisins or sometimes a tiny bit of a butter substitue just to have a little variety each morning, but the truth is they (the oats) are good enough to eat without anything added at all.Also, I did not feel as satisfied with one serving of the multi-grains as I did with the oats, getting hungry a couple of hours later. So I was a little disappointed with these. I will still use these multi-grain on ocassion(they are not bad, just not as good as I thought they would be)and there is even a recipe for Applesauce Multigrain Muffins which I might try out, or use in some other baking in place of flour.The nutritional facts are pretty close per serving; Multi grains have 1 gr fat,Oats have 3(1 of polyunsaturted, 1 of Monosaturated); Multi- 130 calories a serving, Oats - 150; Neither have any cholesterol or sodium; oats have 1 gr of sugar,multi 0; both have 5 g's of protein; fiber - 5 Multi, 4 Oats; and of course everything comes from the oats/grains themselves, nothing is added to either. Both are orgainc.Both are very healthy foods.So I would suggest to try one carton from your grocery store first, before investing in a multi-package deal - which by the way is a really good deal for both compared to my local markets.Remember to breathe, Eat Healthy...and Enjoy.....Laurie

column9: Best hot cereal I have tasted
column10: I wanted a break from oatmeal every morning although I do love the taste and texture of real, old-fashioned oatmeal.I decided to try this and I was pretty surprised at how good it is and much I loved the texture. I do not see how youcould improve the product, as it it spot on perfect. I gave it 5 stars.
This has been my breakfast for many years. A great daily nutritious source. Sometimes I mix it with the Old Fashion Oats. My local Trader Joe's carries it for $2.29, a better deal.

Have been eating this cereal for almost 10 years.  Have to order it online. Moved from Calif to FL -- couldn't find it locally.  Besides being healthy w/lots of fiber, I only add water (not milk) after cooking and save extra calories.  Has a good, nutty taste.

column9: I love the taste plus it's good for you!
column10: I moved to a town where I could not get this stuff in the stores. When I saw I could get this by the case at a good price I got it. It tastes so much better than plain oatmeal and is easy to cook. I just add a little water and microwave for 3 minutes and yummy! Get this with the subscription for free shipping and a better price...

I recommend this to any one who is eating standard oatmeal everyday.  The texture and flavor of this rolled multi-grain "oatmeal" is so much nicer.  After a while, regular oatmeal seems to have the flavor and texture of wallpaper paste.  This stuff has a deep rich flavor, and a pleasing texture that tastes and feels like real food.  Works in oatmeal cookie recipe's too!!!I like mine with walnuts, raisins, cinnamon, sugar, flax seeds, and a pinch of salt.Another variation I made recently had chopped hazelnuts, flax seeds, sugar, and 3TBSP of non-roasted sesame seeds.  Mmmm...  Hazelnuts and sesame seeds go together very well.

Of the dozens of hot cereals I've tried, this is one of the best tasting and textured, and it has one more gram (6) of fiber than anything else like it. Kudos to Amazon for having it as a substantially lower price (with free shipping) than at the stores.

I've been eating this hot cereal for breakfast regularly. I find it to be substantial and filling. Adding fruit, nuts or maple syrup and popping it into the microwave makes a quick 2 minute breakfast.

column9: Trader Joe's have them for 2.29 each
column10: I LOOOOOOVE this oatmeal, has less calories per half cup because has less fat than the old fashioned oatmeal, since traders has it for 2.29, i buy 2 or 3 at a time, since i live in an apartment and have roommates my pantry space is small for 6.

Although I first purchased this cereal to use as a hot cereal, I do not care for the mushy texture of the cereal.  The taste, however, is TERRIFIC.  The cannister included a recipe for muffins made with the mix.  I tried them and they were TERRRIFIC.  I then went on to make a batch of oatmeal raisin cookies using the multigrain cereal instead of oats. They were TERRIFIC.  Moving right along through my recipe box I added some of the multigrain cereal to a pumpkin bread recipe.  Can you guess?  It was TERRIFIC.  Lasly, I may not enjoy eating this cereal solo, but I find using half steel cut oats and half multigrain cereal makes a TERRIFIC porridge.In looking at others reviews I see that most people love this as a cereal.  Texture is a personal preference and I think people who enjoy creamier cereals will enjoy this as well.
I have this every morning for breakfast. Love the flavor.  Very filling and keeps me full for most of the morning.  Amazon makes it convenient to order this online.

column9: Organic - good deal for money & heart/health
column10: Good deal for money & brains/health.Cheaper than in-store, Organic, packaging.I am a repeat buyer, though price's been rising as food in general in recent years.

column4: T. Bowles "vegan child of the King"
column10: very nutritional oatmeal, loved putting it with raisins, almonds, goji berries, cherries, etc love the mix of grains and so affordable
Found this oatmeal many years ago at Trader Joe's in So. Cal., but moved recently and am no longer near a T.J.  I like it because of it's coarse texture and it's not processed much.

column9: Love substituting MultiGrain for Oatmeal in Granola & Bread
column10: A great flavor substitute for oatmeal when making your own Granola or bread. I haven't used it for hot cereal yet.

This is the first time we have tried this product - I'm a big fan of their steel cut oatmeal.  Both my wife and I really like the taste and texture of this multi grain cereal, plus it is quick to prepare.  We do not hesitate to recommend this product.

column9: Great for adding variety to breakfast and 100% Whole grain
column10: I was on vacation in another state and spotted this on the shelf while shopping for some healthy snacks for a road trip. I only eat whole grains now so decided to give it a try. Well, it is an awesome alternative to even Old Fashioned oatmeal, which I love too. The texture is awesome, way chunkier than any type of oatmeal I've cooked and if it's cooked in the microwave according to directions, you don't have to stir it which preserves the chunkiness. The flavor is excellent and I love that it adds the variety of other grains to my diet.I like to add frozen blueberries or mixed berries right after the microwave dings. This thaws the berries and also helps to cool down the cereal so I can eat it burn free.Thank you Amazon, for carrying this product and offering it at such a reasonable price.

I searched high and low for a good multigrain cereal and found it in Country Choice. We love the texture and how it's not gloppy like oatmeal. It turns out exactly like the picture on the label. Even my 6 year old loves it!
I am a lover of multigrain cereals... I used this for making breads, pancakes and hot cereal.I first grind it and then use it in my recipes****

This cereal is great as-is, but to make a really delightful breakfast add some sliced apple, chopped walnuts, and some cinnamon. It only takes a couple of minutes to cook after it reaches a slow boil; we then let it sit another couple of minutes before adding milk and chowing down.  The Country Choice oatmeal is also good, but we like the Multigrain even better.

column9: A delicious alternative to regular oatmeal.
column10: I absolutely love this stuff! I usually have it with dried cranberries and apricots added to it! Yum! It's low in calories and has a delicious nutty flavor from the whole grains. It is also far less gloopy than regular oatmeal! In Southeren California, the only place I know that carries this is Trader Joes. If anyone knows of where else I can get it at, please do let me know!

This is the best multigrain cereal I have found. I make the following granola with it: for each cannister, 1/2 c. maple syrup, 1/2 canola oil, 1 t. vanilla, 1/4 t. salt, 1 c. slivered almonds. Dissolve salt and vanilla in oil and maple syrup, and rub mixture into cereal and nuts. Roast in 375 oven stirring every 10 minutes, until dark golden brown nut NOT burned. I usually makes 2-3 containers up at a time because my family eats it up so fast.

As the title says, it is a good change from oatmeal and has a very good flavor.  The wife is going to try making cookies with this instead of Oatmeal...should be good.  Try it, you will probably like it.
Long Run's 2898 is DELICIOUS!!! It's a super awesome high quality pu-erh that is very sweet and almost chocolate like in texture and taste. It's AMAZING. <3

I have to admit the desire to try Q-Soda was started while traveling outside of the country where club soda often is just water with carbonation which was either to flat or void of any taste.  Q-Soda is just a very clean product and lots of carbonation that delivers a refreshing taste to a normal water break during the day.  The hint of salt is not too great just enough to add some taste and it has zero calories which is also a plus.Also, I have enjoyed the soda and scotch mix, the extra carbonation gives the scotch a better aroma.Cheers

I first had Q Club Soda several months ago when I found it at my local "gourmet" grocery store.  It had been a while since I had had any club soda, probably years.  I had been thirsty all day, and I thought this would quench my thirst.  Well that it certainly did - and more; I just cannot believe how good this club soda is each time I take a drink.  I am not sure exactly what it is that makes it so good.  Maybe it is that pinch of Himalayan salt they put in each bottle, or maybe they fill each bottle with as much carbonation as it can theoretically hold.  Whatever the reason, this beverage is good - I mean really good.  It has become my beverage of choice all day long (except in the morning when I revert to coffee).  This is one smooth club soda.  It is so refreshing.So I got to thinking - other than the pinch of Himalayan salt, I really did not know the first thing about club soda.  Therefore, I did a little research.  Here is what I found out: Club soda goes by many names.  But mainly, it is merely carbonated water, also referred to as sparkling water or seltzer water.  However, believe me when I state that Q Club Soda is not just "merely" carbonated water.  I have been drinking a lot of club soda over the years, just by different names.  All this carbonated water is simply a concoction of carbon dioxide and water.  How simple is that.  This Q Club Soda is unique because of its maximum carbonation and that wonderful pinch of salt.  I am assuming that this Q Club Soda is so good because of the extra fizz and the salt from the region from whence the Yangtze flows.  Either way, I certainly would not want my Q Club Soda to be used for stain remover when spills occur on clothes.  That would be a waste.  I would use my Q Club Soda to relieve an upset stomach, with a touch of bitters.Therefore, if you try Q Club Soda, I hope you like it.

Do a taste test. Wet your finger and dip it in some standard table salt. Then repeat with the Himalayan Sea Salt. Notice the difference? We sure did. The Himalayan Sea Salt is not as harsh or bitting, and has a sweeter (yes sweeter) aftertaste. A little less than two years ago I started trying different artesian salts. So far, the Himalayan Salt has been my favorite. It has a mellower flavor, though it is still just as salty. There are also the studies that show it is better for you than your over processed and recently made table salt. I am not sure about that, but I know I like it. If it has trace minerals and no pollutants, so much the better.It costs a little more, but I think it is worth it. At least try it and see for yourself.

All kidding aside this is a wonderful salt with not quite as sharp or metallic aftertaste as most. It still contains the natural minerals and other than packaging has not gone through the usual bleaching, breakdowns, and processing most others do. I really can taste the essence and all the properties when I use it on less complex culinary preparations as in a poached egg, plain baked Idaho potato, rice, buckwheat, or roasted fowl. You get the idea. If you look carefully you will actually see tiny colored trace elements of rock or mineral. One of my favorite finishing table salts. Save the processed iodized salt with the sharp sometimes bitter aftertaste for your ice ridden sidewalks during winter or lay it down around your vegetable garden to get rid of those pesky snails! A little to pricey for brining or cooking with a lot of other components, herbs, spices, etc, etc, so I use my kosher Morton's for that and use this only for finishing flavor enhancements. Love the Amazon Prime as well as you know how expensive some of these sellers shipping and handling can get.

I have been very curious and interested in this type of salt. The price was great compared to buying it for around $12 in the store. Very happy with my purchase as I've been giving it away as a nice little gift to friends and family! Highly recommend it.

column9: tried the rest, now try the best
column10: I went to wholefoods and saw they had a salt section with something like 20 salts or more and 20 pepper varieties. I bought about 7 of each. They don't carry either of my (now) two favorite salts. I tried all of those as well as some other brands like celtic (which tends to clump).NO COMPARISON.Himala is the creme de la creme.FULL DISCLOSURE: I sell some items on amazon and one of the items I sell is Himalyan salt but NOT this brand.  The brand I sell is WBM.  BUT, as other reviewers have mentioned, while the "Himala" brand is a little more expensive, it is the best tasting and worth the price.  I use it on all finished foods.  I have containers that I keep in every car. Our family goes through this product faster than almost any other food product.  The WBM brand is better (and more cost effective) to use IN cooking...breads, recipes, etc.  This Himala is definitely worth your consideration.  Others have mentioned the health benefits and I'm completely sold on Himalayan salt for that purpose, but mainly, my review is to point out that this stuff is WAAAAAY tasty!
Not only does this make everything taste better, it's good for you (unlike the killer salt from the grocery store) and one shaker lasts forever.  It's a staple item at my house!

column9: The only salt we use in our family plus health benefits
column10: We've been using this salt in our home for about 3 months now. Let me just say I won't use any other salt ever again! I've never liked the taste of salt or used it much in cooking. This salt is completely different. The flavor is so much better and doesn't have a bite to it, it's mild. It really enhances flavors of the food you put it in. I compare the taste of table salt as black pepper and Himala Salt as white pepper when people ask about taste. It took my husband awhile to get used to the salt as far as how much to put in his food.  At first he said it took more to get his food "salted" but now since this is all we use it doesn't take as much to "salt" his food. The health benefits of this salt are: regulating the water content throughout your body, promote a healthy pH balance in your body, help with sinus health, regulation of your blood pressure(of course to much of any salt is bad for blood pressure), and helps your body detox. Himala Salt is pure, unprocessed salt with all the minerals left in. The salt can get expensive if you use lots of it. In my opnion though I can't put a price on something that is good for my health in moderation. If you want to try some before you get a 6 pack most health food stores carry Himala Salt.
I've been intrigued by artisan salts.  This is my absolute favorite and I would choose this before any other salt.
Love this product!  I have been purchasing from the Jet line for several years now.  The mixes are so easy to use and prepare.  The taste is GREAT!

column9: Fantastic chocolate taste, filling protein bar!
column10: Let me start by saying that I have a monstrous sweet tooth. I'm pretty sure I've tried every protein bar out there, and this is the best one I've had by far. This bar is filling, but most protein bars are filling. What Think Thin Chocolate Fudge accomplishes is truly remarkable. The chocolate actually tastes like chocolate and not some contrived chocolate-imposter. The texture is chewy and smooth at the same time. When I eat these, I don't just feel like I'm "making do", when really, I'd rather have a cookie.

"thinkThin Chocolate Fudge, 2.1-Ounce Bar (Pack of 10)" taste excellent so long as they are always kept at a temperature above 40 degrees Fahrenheit and below 80 degrees Fahrenheit. I live in the desert southwest, so when I first ordered these from Amazon last summer, and it was well over 110 degrees Fahrenheit, what I received was a mess, so I put them in the Fridge. Went from too hot to too cold, the taste was gritty and messy as the chocolate enrobing shattered and fell off, still better than 110 degree puddles I was first presented.  Now that it's winter, and the weather is between 40 and 70 degrees Fahrenheit, every bar I have received from Amazon has been perfect. I store the bars at room temperature. The bars are smooth, moist and chewy, perfect in all the ways I expected.  I will need to order a 6 month supply before May if I want to enjoy these bars during the very hot summer months. So, for everyone who is having taste troubles with these particular bars, try to schedule a shipment when your local weather will be  above 40 degrees Fahrenheit and below 80 degrees Fahrenheit.

This is by far my favorite thinkThin flavor. I'm a recently diagnosed diabetic and have been looking for a protein bar that has no sugar - these are such a life saver when I need something in between meals. The order arrived quickly with no hassle or fuss so I could continue with my new diet.

If you're looking for a great Atkins bar or just a good protein bar in general, you can't go wrong with these. I've been buying them for years at Trader Joe's and am so happy to see them here at Amazon - and even cheaper! I also recommend the Brownie Crunch flavor.

column9: Pretty good for a protein bar
column10: For the haters...seriously?  Protein bars never taste like real brownies or candy bars, so I feel like the complainers are newbies to the protein-scene.  If you find a decent one like this, with this much protein, you go with it.I eat one of these every night I work (night-shift cardiac nurse).  Makes me feel full without making me tired from excess carbs. Zero sugar in these; good job.Incidentally, I have had several types of the Think Thin bars, and I think this one tastes the best.  Not bad for a protein bar, and even better with a big cup of coffee.  Wish the chocolate flavor was a little stronger, but not a deal breaker.  I just bought another box.

column9: Best Think Thin Flavor, Hands Down!
column10: I have tried the following flavors of think thin-Creamy Peanut ButterCrunchy Peanut ButterBrownie CrunchLemon CreamAnd, last but definitely NOT least- Chocolate fudge!  This one is the best by FAR out of all of them.  The others have gritty textures (Lemon Cream has that nasty dish soap taste) and not so good aftertastes (Creamy PB is 2nd best. The others suck!) The fudge flavor also has a fudgy texture! Totally does not taste like something meant to be a supplement/healthy! Strongly recommend!

These bars got me to become more healthy. Realizing all the nasty junk I eat daily, these helped me get more protien and fiber in my diet. These are like fudgey yummy chocolate bars that taste anything but healthy. I love the white chocolate ones as well.

These were my first attempt at a high-protein, vitamin-fortified, low-sugar bar, and I was pleasantly surprised.  Chewy fudge, mild chocolate flavor, no aftertaste.  I'll try other bars also, of course, but from what I've been told by friends, it probably doesn't get much better than these.

column9: Delsious protein!  These bars are the tastiest on the market and have a high protien content.
column10: I love this product! Unfortunately they are hard to find in stores, so I was thrilled to find them on line and to get free shipping! They are higher in protien than most bars and are very tasty!

column9: Excellent ! Great tasting and tons of protein...
column10: These bars taste wonderful and have 20 grams of protein! The texture is soft and chewy, very fudge like. Excellent flavor and taste. My teenage boys have already eaten half the box and I have to order more....

column9: BEST Gluten Free & Just Protein Chocolate Bar Out There
column10: I have recently started following a gluten-free diet for medical reasons, so this bar is amazing because it is gluten free and delicious. However, I tried almost every protein bar on the market before going gluten-free and this chocolate fudge flavor is the best. Why?Reason #1) Most protein bars have, well, for lack of better words, a "protein" taste and the chocolate flavor rarely resembles chocolate. However, the chocolate fudge actually tastes like chocolate. It is delicious. It is amazing. It is chewy. It is full of chocolately goodness. It is a snack I look forward to eating, not just forcing myself to eat for the protein.Reason #2) It has 0 grams of sugar - it is sweetened with malitol instead - a natural sweetener. This makes it healthy, diabetic friendly, as well as delicious.Reason #3) It has 20 grams of protein. I really dont know if I need to further elaborate here. Thats alot of protein for a small delicious bar. Its perfect for a quick snack or pre-workout boost.I can't say enough wonderful things about this bar.
Best Protein Bars I have found. Ordered them once and trying to do so again and I can't. Not sure what is going on.

The Chocolate Fudge Think Thin bar is my.favorite flavor. It tastes as smooth and good as a chocolate candy bar, yet there is no sugar, glutun, and lots of protein. It is filling, and I am able to use it as a meal replacement when I am on the run, and have no time to eat. It is small and compact, and I find the proce.is.good on Amazon compared to other places.

I have not tried a lot of these types of bars to compare, but I did not like this one. It is very chewy and it might be filling too if you can finish it before you get tired of chewing it. I tried to eat these on several occasions and I noticed they also seem to give me a headache and just a general bad feeling.

i can't slam this product because the ones i recieved from amazon are very stale(although date says good through may of 2011)i think from poor storage in warehouse,so with that grain of salt, i found them to have a chemical taste. but i'm sure if they were fresh it would have been better.and if i were on a gluten free diet it would be great

column9: Not bad tasting when it came to health bars
column10: I ordered the chocolate fudge, crunchy peanut butter, creamy peanut butter, and white chocolate. The chocolate fudge is by far my favorite, it had the consistency of a fudge brownie soft and moist with all the chocolate flavor. The peanut butter flavors were the worst as neither had any peanut taste. The crunchy peanut butter had no crunch, I looked at the bar and it had what appeared to be peanuts but evidently they were not really nuts I couldn't discern any difference in terms of initial taste between the 2 peanut butter, but the crunch did leave an after taste while the creamy did not. I just cant get over how good the texture is definite rebuy of the chocolate flavor.

Think Thin bars are a great product. Low in carbs & sugar and high in protien. Chocolate Fudge is our family's favorite. We no longer can buy this flavor at Trader Joe's, but it's super easy to order online from the company. They come fast and are very fresh.We highly recommend this prouduct!
These bars taste pretty good relative to other nutrition bars. They are filling, and have a lot of protein. However, they also are high in carbs.
I have tried many different flavors but these are by far my favorite!  My kids love them too and the protein keeps you satisfied for longer!

column9: Might be healthy, but won't be buying again. . . .
column10: I've tried a number of protein bars or low carb type, and would have to say that these were the least enjoyed.  In fact, the taste did so little for me (not to mention aftertaste), that I pitched the last four.  I hate wasting food, or anything for that matter, but the alternative was to let them go stale in the pantry.  The texture was decent, but taste -- ugh -- waste of calories.

I love protein bars...love that this one doesn't have sugar in it, either! They're delicious!  A little pricey, yes, but the Subscribe & Save can help with that...especially if you love your protein bars and know that they're a great meal or treat. They don't have hydrogenated oils or sucralose...nothing ICKY.  ;-)

I've ordered this product a couple of time. Both orders were past their sell dates...FOUR MONTHS OLD. Bought in November product had a July date. Food was discolored. For a dollar more a box you can purchase at TRADER JOE's.

These were terrible.  The "chocolate" had turned white like it was old or waxy.  The bar was gritty and had a terrible chemical aftertaste.  With so many glowing reviews, i was VERY disappointed in this product.

column9: Chocolate Fudge lot that expires July 7, 2011 is bad - powder all over the outside of chocolate
column10: I love these chocolate fudge bars. Unfortunately, all six boxes, from two different deliveries, had to be thrown away.  There was powder all over the outside of the bars.  The box was not wrapped in any covering, taped close.  So, even though the expiration date is July 7, 2011, they all had gone bad (rancid).I have informed Amazon about this situation and hope that they will be able to correct it.  They were very good in refunding my money, but that doesn't help when I need the product.I suggest that nobody buy these chocolate fudge bars.  I don't know if there is a problem with any of the other flavors.I have requested that Amazon let me know when a new shipment arrives, but I don't know if that will actually happen.thinkThin Chocolate Fudge, 2.1-Ounce Bar (Pack of 10)
This is my favorite flavor of the Think Thin bars that I have tried so far.

column9: "Think Thin" to get yourself through eating one
column10: It may have great protein and be sugar free, but there are better tasting bars out there (I like Pure Protein's chocolate-chocolate chip). The moment I took my first bite I thought, "Wow, Think Thin must be the mantra you have to repeat to yourself to get you through one of these things. It was so depressing to eat. I'll stick to my Pure bars that also have 20g of protein, better flavor, and 40 fewer calories.

I have been eating "breakfast bars" for at least 10 years.  I've enjoyed various protein bars, Zone bars, Balance Bars, Triple Threat Power Bars, etc etc.  I just ate my first "ThinkThin" chocolate fudge bar, and it is BY FAR the worst-tasting bar I have ever eaten.  What little bit of taste it offers is AWFUL.  I hate to spend perfectly good money on something that makes me want to throw it away.  Don't buy them.  ICKY TASTE!

Not so much. There is a definate deficiency between the real calorie loaded bar and one of these. The Chocolate is much better than the peanut butter one, but it still takes some getting use to. I found the Fudge ones doable after eating a few.

column9: Looks like Chocalte tastes like paper
column10: I bought one of these today from my local grocery story. The taste on these is not bad, its just non-existent. I don't know how others can post that it tastes just like real chocolate...I suspect they might be paid review writers. I've tried other protein bars that taste sweet and more like real chocolate for example "Oh Yeah" bars (but those have more sugar).If you value a good tasting protein bar stay away from this one. I do like the fact that it has 0 sugar, perhaps this is why it tastes like nothing. I will give it three stars just because it has no sugar and these bars do not taste bad (taste like nothing).
Very dry and chalky, and watch out for the sugar alcohols.  You may need gasix after eating one of these bars.

I bought these because they were on sale so I thought I would try them - bad idea. They are not good at all, kind of taste like chocolate rubber. They all ended up in the trash. Not worth it at half the price, much less at the expensive rate they usually charge.
Had high hopes, I'm on a low carb, high protein diet , But these are like eating cardboard, and gave me severe acid reflux, Wouldn't suggest them to anyone.  My Dog doesn't even like them!!!!

column9: Warning for the weak of stomach
column10: I am not a regular reviewer, but this product was so awful that I would be remiss if I didn't warn others.  The taste is what I suspect compressed sawdust would taste like if it has a sticky chocolate coating. Even my dog - who will usually eat anything won't touch these.  If you don't trust me and want to try them anyway, I suggest you order one box only. I ordered four. Guess where they are going?

This product can't possibly be for human consumption. The horribly chemical "chocolate fudge" taste exploded in my mouth after the first chew (and chew vigorously and extensively you must to break it down enough to swallow). It left a metallic tingle and itch on my tounge. I felt nauseated. I needed to brush my teeth immediately to get the taste out of my mouth enough to cease the increasing urge to vomit. I was exciting about ordering this product when I saw it on Amazon's "Today's Deals" and read the description. It sounded perfect for my needs. Now I'm stuck with nine bars whose only use I can see fit is as a form of severe punishment for delinquent children.

This product was REALLY BAD.When it arrived, after opening one of the energy bars, it looked like it had melted and also had some white fuzzy stuff all over it.YUCK!Because this was so bad, I hesitate to buy more food products from Amazon grocery. I've asked Amazon to resolve this.
These tasted absolutely terrible to me.  I can't understand why any one would like these.  I didn't expect it to taste like a real brownie or candy, but it should at least be edible.

column9: DO NOT BUY! TASTE LIKE CR@P
column10: This is the worst tasting chocolate bar ever. I think if actual poo has a taste this would be it. Nasty!!

column9: Good product; not the color you see, though
column10: We bought this for the cake for our daughter's Tiffany blue themed wedding. However, the product is actually very, very green and can't be used. Since there are no returns/exchanges I'd advise ordering very small quantities to verify color prior to a purchase. Lovely shimmery sheen to these, though!
The lid came completely off while I was shaking salt onto some food, and half the bottle poured out into my pot. Unfortunate! Be careful with this one.
I recently tried this sauce and loved it. It is one of the best jarred sauces I have had. It was delicious on pasta, but we also loved it used as a pizza sauce.
I loved this product the taste was fresh not what you would expect from a jar!  Perfect for dinners!  I used it with Ravioli and beef.  I am also hoping to use it on a pizza.

The Red Pepper Gourmet Topping is a bright and flavorful sauce, with great versatility. I've used it one pasta, in homemade stromboli and in dips and it provides robust flavor and freshness. My family loves this product.

I was hesitant about buying a pack of six bags since this was my first time trying these mints, but wow - I will not go back to the chemically sweetened mints after tasting these!  They are refreshing, cool mints with just a hint of sweetness.  They are not bitter at all - they taste great and natural.  Love them!  :)

They're organic, so that's a plus from the start.  The drops have a sense of strong, minty flavor which is awesome if you want your breath to smell good.  These drops are not bitter at all.  I highly recommend buying these for your children or patients.

They're organic, they've got some awesome minty power in your mouth, and they're pretty cheap.  These mints remind me of Altoids, 'curiously strong' seems an apt description.  They're not the type of candy you shovel into your mouth a handful at a time, one will last a while and probably going to be painful to eat several at once.  Helps me resist the urge to munch mindlessly while working at the computer. Because they're extra minty strong, I find them pretty satiating one at a time, consequently a bag lasts a [little] while.  By way of example, the half-life of a bag of gummy bears at work is about 10 minutes, YummyEarth Organic mints is closer to a few days but, I get a lot more enjoyment out of the mints. Seems to be pretty good for a cough too, at least that's the excuse my co-workers have been using lately to grab a few.In short, I like them a lot, my friends love'em, my son (12yo) asks for them, and you probably shouldn't leave them out in the open unless you're really the sharing type (of course you are!) since they will disappear.  If you find yourself buying mints at convenience store check out lines, want something to 'freshen your mouth' after that morning Starbucks, or your kids get an occasional sweet tooth going on, you should definitely give them a try.  They come in packs of 6, so throw one in the kitchen, another in your desk, one for the co-workers, the glove compartment...and spread a few more around for good measure.

column9: Excellent taste and a bargain compared to buying locally
column10: We absolutely love these mints. After having read what most brand-name gums contain, we started looking for healthier alternatives. This is a wonderful find. Not overly sweet, just a clean, fresh flavor that is so very much better than artificial mint flavors! Each is individually and well wrapped, making it easy to carry a 2-3 in a suit pocket for the day.

column9: Looking for a strong mint? Look no further!
column10: I am a big fan of Yummy Earth products. I love that they are committed to using the best natural ingredients in their candy. I bought the mints for myself, but have ended up sharing them because they are wonderful. They have a wonderfully strong peppermint taste, which freshens your breath (so you need not worry about having bad breath). I am very happy with these mints and will continue to recommend an purchase Yummy Earth products in the future!

WOW I can really tell the difference between these and every other kind of mint. Clean-tasting means these don't coat my teeth with ick like some other candies do and the mint flavor is very crisp. Never going back to ick-mints after these. Glad I bought them.I've read the other reviews that compare them to Altoids ... I'm not going that far. These have a milder bite, that I actually prefer. I think Altoids go too far. I don't get that feeling in the back of my throat/sinuses that starts to make my eyes water.Size-wise these have a diameter between the size of a dime and a nickel. So, they could be a bit bigger. They look hand-made because each one is slightly unique ... nothing like those candies that are all exactly the same.The individual wrapping is very good so they're very easy to take-along.
I ordered these because peppermint is soothing for your stomach and they're organic. They taste great and knowing their organic is a bonus.
I am a massage therapist and always want great breath.  These are strong and yummy and dont have anything bad in them.
Great peppermint taste.  They are stronger than the everyday peppermint candies available at most stores, made with corn syrup.  I liked the strength, hope you do too.
These mints are awesome and made without artificial ingredients. 6pack is very convenient so I'll never run out!

I bought these to crush up and add to homemade peppermint bark. They were not great for this use because they were extremely minty and not very sweet at all. They were also too hard to crush easily. I did use them sparingly for the peppermint bark, and the flavor was okay. But, these are less like a candy and more like a breath mint. Still, the ingredients are great and natural, so they are probably one of the best breath mints out there.

This is by far not worth the money I paid for it. I ordered it as a suprise for my daughter's classroom. It is a plaster like cast with very little detail.  It came late (ordered 10/18, recieved 11/5).  It is damaged (chipped in one corner), dirty (covered with plaster-like dust), and will break the first time it is dropped or bumped.  I probably could've used clay and some plaster to make a cast of simliar quality myself. Don't waste your money!
This tea is perfect, absolutely delicious! It smells amazing too.The price is amazing for this quality of product. I will buy again and again.

column9: The secret to classic Thai taste
column10: Golden Mountain Sauce is the secret ingredient that makes Thai dishes come alive. You may be able to find it in Asian food stores by the Thai fish sauce.  You can also order it from one of the Asian gourmet or grocery vendors at Amazon.com.  Look for "naturally fermented" on the label; otherwise you may be buying hydrolyzed soy protein (used in fake soy sauces) which is unhealthy and potentially toxic in high levels.  Check with the vendor PRIOR to purchasing to ensure you are getting the "naturally fermented" product.

column9: Very good sauce but  <$2 at local Asian stores
column10: I almost always love Amazon's price but almost thirteen bucks a bottle....that's outrageous! I paid less than two bucks at local Asian stores in DC metro area. I use this sauce in stir fried vegetables with or without meat, fried rice or noodles and very good all in one sauce. I like Golden Mountain more than Meggie brand in both price and taste.

column9: I call it my secret soy sauce...Thai Golden Mountain is just better!
column10: Similar to soy sauce but different...exciting. Great on Asian dishes but excellent all by itself on some hot rice. I can't eat normal soy sauce that way and really enjoy it like I do with Golden Mountain. Also very good as a marinade I use for my Thai chicken wings on the grill.

Our local Asian foods market used to carry this, but no longer keeps it. This sauce adds excellent flavor to our Thai cooking, and is a good substitute for Fish sauce. We also use it instead of soy sauce in cooking. Great product.
Not sure why people are even purchasing this at $15.  Absolutely absurd.  Costs a couple bucks at any Asian market.

column9: You've got to be kidding me.
column10: This is a passable substitute for fish sauce, I'm told. I've used it from time to time. But 15 dollars and 91 cents for a bottle that normally costs under two dollars is asinine. The stuff is salty. Very salty. Headache-inducingly salty.
This tea is beautiful to watch and wonderful to drink.  I found myself drinking cup after cup with one bloom.  I have since ordered more.

I have very much enjoyed the blooming teas recently.  In addition to tasting good, they are a good way to stop and watch the flowers, as it were.  Taking a few minutes to slow down, watch the tea bloom, enjoy the magic of the moment, is good for the soul.

The package looked good, but the content was not so good. It's basically the repackage tea from the chinese supermarket. I was expecting with this price, I'll get the premium quality tea, but instead just the repackage tea that I can buy cheaply from the chinese supermarket. The tea was very dry and not taste good. I'm very disappointed.

I really like regular Triscuits but (to me) they taste too salty.  The Hint of Salt Triscuits have enough salt to taste great.  The other nice thing is that there are only 3 ingredients (whole wheat, oil, and salt).Just so you know where I'm coming from: I'm not concerned with sodium intake, just the taste (and that it doesn't have 100 ingredients).

I love that Nabisco came out with these.  I love regular Triscuits, but they taste really salty to me.  I even snack on dry Shredded Wheat b/c I like the taste, but want a tiny bit of saltiness.  (Sounds weird, but I'm a Dietitian and it's a healthy snack!)  I was so happy when I tried these Hint of Salt Triscuits.  I was unhappy when my local Kroger stopped selling them!  I can only find them in one small grocery store and they're usually sold out!  Enter Amazon.  Like the reviewer before me I am thrilled with the natural list of ingredients.  I tried another brand that made a triscuit-like cracker and there were at least 20 ingredients and they tasted so weird/fake.  Next I'd like them to make the Reduced Fat Triscuits with a Hint of Salt.  Please Nabisco?
The 9.5 oz is the smaller box.  I did not read ad (my mistake) correctly, and could have purchased these for $2.50 per box at Walmart.

I keep trying the "natural" brands of Triscuit-like crackers and neither my seven-year-old nor I like the taste -- I even did a blind taste test with my daughter and Triscuits were definitely the winner!  In addition, Tricuit's ingredient list is short and sweet and if I'm going to buy processed food, I love it when it only has three ingredients.

column9: Very yummy!  Just the right amount of salt and crunch.
column10: Sometimes you want a cracker by itself, or sometimes with cheese.  This has the taste of a regular triscuit, but without so much salt.  You can actually taste the cracker and cheese without having salt overload on your tongue.  Don't get me wrong, they still have enough salt to satisfy your craving, but they have just the right amount.  This one is on auto-order!

My daughter brought me some from the Pacific Northwest when she was here for a visit.  I cannot find them in local markets, and was delighted when I saw them available on Amazon!  All the sweet crunchy taste of regular Wheat Thins, but lower in salt, and to my palate, more tasty.

THESE DELICIOUS SNACKS ARE SO ADDICTING! THEY HAVE TOTALLY REPLACE MY "NEED" FOR POTATO CHIPS OR ANY OTHER SALTED SNACKS! PLUS - THE ADDITIONAL BENEFIT OF HELPING ME TO STAY REGULAR - YOU JUST CAN'T GO WRONG! THANK YOU NABISCO! THANK YOU AMAZON!

Triscuits are great, and these are not only tasty, but fairly healthy.  The only ingredients are wheat, a little oil and a little salt!  Excellent.  And buying them on amazon is so much cheaper than at the store!!  :-)

AWESOME QUALITY! I was afraid they'd be on the crunchy side, but they weren't. I eat low/no sodium foods, and Triscuit's sodium level is perfect, please don't change a thing. Tastes great too! Thank you Nabisco for this piece of gold in a world of food companies selling hypertension.update 1/30/2012 These use to be $14.63 free super saver shipping when i purchased them 9 months ago. Inflation or robbery?

I am addicted to Triscuits. I like both, regular and hint of salt, but I prefer these ones with less salt. They are so tasty that I cannot stop having them. Most importantly, they are healthy. Amazon sends me these automatically every  month, and very often I have to come on Amazon to change the shipping date so I can get them sooner. I just wish Amazon would sell them in packs of 12. These six last me a little over a week, if that much! How many types of crackers can one find that are BOTH delicious AND healthy? Love them.

I am an avid tea drinker and came across this tea with wonderful reviews on how it helps clear up your skin. I have perfectly clear skin on most of my face except on my chin area. For some reason I break out horribly around that area and despite my efforts and products galore, I still have a hard time keeping that spot clear. I would say after a week of drinking the tea, my skin started to change dramatically. My chin area started to clear up and I noticed no new pimples coming in. I get the cyst like pimples in that area which feel like they last forever and can be very painful. Even the rest of my skin which was always clear had almost like a glow to it. I will continue to drink this tea as directed. I always drink my teas on their own without any sugar or cream and the taste has a nice flowery hint to it and doesn't taste bad at all.

Oddly this tea breaks me out at first, not really sure if it was the tea or my new work at the bakery..But surely this tea helps me lose weight. When I got a job I stopped working out and I stopped losing weight. I started drinking this tea and I started to lose weight again every week. And I think it helps with my skin too..it's so hard to tell because at the bakery I always leave greasy lol. But the break outs stopped long ago when I started taking a shower after work. So i guess it was my job after all.

Love love Loved this tea! Definitely a little different on the taste, but it wasn't anything I couldn't get use to. Saw that my face was clearing up and showing more of a glow. Even though I'm on accutane now, I would still continue to purchase this tea! Definitely felt like it was a good cleanse overall :)

Not sure if my skin is improving, but I am loving this tea!  I am drinking it every morning.  Smells wonderful and tastes great!  No need to add any sugar, I drink as-is because it is flavorful enough!  Plus I love the little sayings on each tag, good way to start the day. :-)
Absolutely love this tea! It has a great taste and it does wonders for my skin. I Highly recommend it to anyone.

column9: Tastes great, but is caffeinated and doesn't really help my acne
column10: I didn't have high expectations going in with this tea -- yes, I've been accustomed to fabulous tasting teas from Yogi, but I had no illusions that simply drinking this tea would help my acne. Just as a tea though, it's great! Be aware, though, is that it's caffeinated. The amount is much less (18 mg) than that in coffee (90 mg for 8 oz), but as someone who's quite sensitive to caffeine, I really can't drink more than one cup per day, and only in the mornings. Still, it tastes wonderful!
Not as sweet or fresh as they could be, but a nice product and I like the cans.  Would I buy them again?  Not until after trying some others.

I thought this peanut brittle was really good tasting.  I actually like it a little better than other premium peanut brittle brands such as See's.  I would say it is on par with my grandmas homemade peanut brittle.  It has a lot of nuts in it and is not too sweet.  I also really like that it comes in a resealable container.
Product as described, shipped quickly, well packaged, and tasted outstanding.  Not too thick, and just great.  I'll be back for more!
Normal old cane sugar. Nothing special here but nothing to shy away from either. Would recommend it to anyone for cooking or other purposes.

I've had two shipments of this product so far. The first time two of the five bags were ripped, so there was sugar all over the place in the plastic wrapping. The second time three of the five bags were ripped so badly that there was sugar falling out on the floor before I even finished opening the Amazon box.
I haven't tried this sugar yet, as I put it in airtight storage for now, but I'm sure it will be quite fine.

These are the best tasting and crunchiest pistachios I have ever eaten. Without added salt you can really taste the sweetness of the nut, I love them... On a freshness scale from 1 to 10 with 10 being the highest I would give them a 20. I'll be back for these again and again.

Pistachios are a Favorite in our house. Kennan Farms delivers a Great product. Pistachios from Keenan Farms are Fresh, Tasty,and a healthy choice. We choose to buy unsalted,and are very pleased with how easy it is to order and receive them in a short amount of time. Anyone who loves pistachios should try these. I think you'll be glad you did. Enjoy.
I am very satisfied with this purchase.These pistachios are fresh, crunchy and good tasting.They are the best that I have had in a long time.Highly recommend to others.

column9: Excellent choice for the sodium restricted
column10: These in the shell, sodium free nuts are very good.  I like them far better than the shelled variety that are not as sweet and fresh tasting.

Amazing price for great quality pistachios. Someone said something about them being tiny but that is not the case at all. They are normal size I would say. You can definitely tell that they are not salted but it's not a bad thing. I taste more of the pistachios and don't miss the salt at all. Will probably buy again when I run out.

Now I know where all the small nuts go. Taste and freshness is ok on these nuts but you will work your fingers to the bone trying to get enough to satisfy your appetite. Bought unsalted by mistake but they taste good non-the-less. If you like to work for your snack, these are the nuts for you.

These nuts are so fresh and absolutely delicious!!! Once I start eating them I find I can not stop.The pistachios in the shell are the way to go, because having to shell them yourself does slow youdown from eating as many. The unsalted pistachio is much more tasty and healthier, especially forthose people that must watch their salt intake.
Keenan's pistachios are great. I love having the no-salt option. The nuts are fresh with a very good flavor. Finding a clunker (inedible nut) in the bag is very rare.

I was worried that they would taste bland because they are unsalted. I've had unsalted sunflower seeds that were soft and not that great. These were fantastic. Excellent flavor, a healthy snack and very addictive.

It is much better to have them unsalted than regular pistachios you buy from grocery stores that come with so much salt! I just can't believe how people don't understand the side effects of salt. I really don't see much difference. Also, unlike other pistachios I bought before, even after opening the bag for some time, they are still crunchy and taste good. My recommendation to the company is consider using ziplock bag. This way they will stay even fresher. Great product!
The quality of the pistachios were mostly good, but some were bad.  The price was relatively good and we received them in a timely manner.  This is the best pistachio value we have found.

We've ordered these before; repeat order.  As part of a healthy diet, we watch sodium intake, so get unsalted nuts.  While we're not gourmets, these are perfectly fine for our tastes.  Items from Amazon come quickly after ordering.  No complaints.

column9: US GROWN, CRUNCHY & FRESH, NO SALT ADDED...CAN'T STOP EATING THEM!
column10: I bought them twice already. They are so delicious! I need to hide them because if my husband finds them the 6 bags are gone in no time:)! Those pistachios are part of our daily meals and part of some of my recipes. Cheaper than in our local stores.

Not much to say. There are some pistachios that haven't been opened up properly, but most of them are just fine. Sometimes you can taste the sweetness (I had no idea they could be sweet). I ran through them pretty quickly- an open bag just vanishes like that. I'll probably buy some more from this seller.
Fresh and flavorful.  The unsalted ones are harder to find, I really like them and find it easier to eat an appropriate portion with these than the salted ones.  Shipping is fast, which I appreciate.
It's not easy to find top grade unsalted pistachios.  As I am writting this review, I am enjoying them. Good price, great nuts.

Great product/Good source of potassium. I don't know if it's just my area, but unsalted pistachios seem to be hard to locate. A perfect product(Unsalted Pistachios), and best price I've been able to track down. Yeah.... they're good, too.
Was pleasantly surprised.  They are very good and I don't miss the salt at all. Would always have to rinse off the salt but no longer.
These pistachios are naturally opened on the tree, and have a fabulous taste, and no added salt, for a heart healthy snack.

column9: I am a regular customer now
column10: I discovered immediately after moving to the south that most groceries don't carry unsalted nuts. What a disappointment!Since Pistachio is claimed to be the nut with lowest calories and shelling them burns some calories too, it quickly becomes our nuts of choice. What's not to love about Keenan Farms pistachio?
Great Product for those of us who love Pistachios but don't need the extra salt. The price was right too.

Nice Job!  Day five after I made the order, these items still haven't shipped.  This is really pretty poor IMO.I like the product and occasionally purchase it in my local store.  It's a good product.I 'm rating the shipping experience.

column9: francesco rinaldi tradional meat pasta sauce jars 45 oz
column10: i'm glad I found this brand to use. great price offered thus far. rich red color  thick sauce with good flavor. this is a good every day sauce for an every day budget.
this pasta sauce is okay. it is very fresh and it tastes really good. i usually add other things to my pasta sauce like a can of mushrooms and chopped onions. i am happy with this purchase.

I'll start this review by saying I never usually just dump a pasta sauce on top of noodles and eat it as is.  I usually add mushrooms, tomatoes, garlic, onions, etc. depending on what I'm serving it with.  That being said, I'm reviewing this sauce based on it's original taste and ability to be combined with other ingredients.  This is a pasta sauce and it tastes like pasta sauce.  Although ground beef is the second ingredient listed, I didn't find it to be an obvious flavor.  I like the quantity that comes in each jar, since I usually cook large batches to freeze the left overs.  I think this is a good starting point to add more ingredients to, the flavor tastes just like any other pasta sauce until you kick it up a notch with whatever ingredients you prefer.

column9: It is OK, but not the best of this line of Pasta Sauce's
column10: I have tried 3 varieties of F. Rinaldi's Pasta Sauce.  This one is ok, but I doubt if I will purchase again."Meat", may be an over exaggeration.  Has slight taste of meat, but if no one told you, you would not know what the "tiny bits" were, that was in the sauce.Try the other varieties, first.

Cheerwine is a regional soda from North Carolina, that has expanded into 12 other southeast states in the last 8 years. Started in 1917, Cheerwine was first formulated in the basement of L. D. Peeler's wholesale grocery store. Created during prohibition when it was common to name sodas after liquors. The owner added a new cherry flavor syrup to his previous soda and cheerwine was born. Believe it or his great grandsons still run the company.The bergundy red soft drink has a nice mellow cherry flavor, and the color is really a pretty burgundy color, almost like wine. It is more subtle and seems less sweet on the palate than the grocery store house brands of cherry soda. No aftertaste or bite. It is easy to see why the locals in North Carolina rave about this and the other drink from this company, "Cool Moon".  Also made in diet soda.
Great soda!!! I would order more, but the S/H cost (Tacoma, WA) the same as the soda. If I have the opportunity again, I'll order more. Great soda for a hot day.

column9: TIC Tac Spearmints - good as ever!
column10: Still a great product, even though its manufacturer has -- very sadly -- discontinued making it.Great seller, arrived fast, no problems. Thanks so much!

I originally received Bedtime tea as a gift and enjoyed it so much that I ordered it when I couldn't find it locally.  I believe it works primarily because it contains valerian which is also available in capsule form.  Valerian generally doesn't smell very good in a capsule but in this tea with Passion Flower Extract and other organic herbs it tastes great.  Some people report vivid dreams with valerian but that's not necessarily bad.  I don't have any morning grogginess and valerian is not associated with bizarre behaviors while asleep (eating, driving, etc) as some prescription sleep aids do.  As a rotating shift worker I have to be alert for either a day or night shift.  This helps me sleep when I need to and awake well rested.  I will definately order it again.

This is the polar opposite of Sleepytime tea. I had one cup last night, and I laid in bed and didn't fall asleep till well after midnight, and then kept waking up every few minutes after that. Worst sleep I have gotten in my entire life! I'm going back to Sleepytime tea. At least that stuff works.

This used to be sold in America but Nestle stopped selling it several years ago. This product was sold in boxes like any other cereal with the same ammount (14oz) but priced $3.00. Now we depend  of 3rd party sellers like amazon to buy it at a high cost because Nestle only produce it in Europe (Spain to be more specific). I contacted Nestle to let them know that they are losing money on this, but they responded it was a business strategy, unfortunately for us...I am buying it because it is my preferred cereal since I was a kid.

I was advised by my pediatrician to start feeding my baby cereal to get him accustomed to the taste and texture of food.  Hubby and I excitedly went out and got for him "G___" rice cereal.  My poor baby was making faces while eating his rice cereal but was a pretty good sport and still swallowed.  I was fed Cerelac as a baby and I decided that my baby should try some too.  He was smiling and laughing while I was feeding him Cerelac.  He obviously enjoyed his dinner. :-)  My only concern is that the 4 pack cans expire on 10/12 and I don't know if my baby will be able to eat everything by then, since he's also taking breast milk.  I wish the cans will have a later expiration date.  Next time, I will just stick to the single cans.  Although pricier, I will be sure there won't be any waste.

I have a distinct memory of eating Cerelac when I was growing up in Europe.  Even up until I was 6 or 7 years old I would ask my mom to purchase it.  Cerelac tastes like butter cookie biscuits dipped in milk.  It is delicious.  So when my daughter turned 10 months old and I was looking for cereals, I found Cerelac on Amazon. I love Cerelac. This price is too much though. They sell these at Korean stores for $4,99 - $5.99. Go to HMart Grand mart
Did not like this cereal has different taste than cerelac leche con trigo. Even though this product seems the same as the spanish one the flavor is not as good.Do not recommend
My 1 year old loves Cerelac.It's delicious and filling. Though, not all flavors are liked by my son, the wheat and milk one is by far the best.I highly recommend it.

We are so glad we found this online for a our baby.. and being a prime member we received this in 2 days... Thanks Amazon... oh an the best part it says Halal on the packaging which makes it even better for us.

column9: Healthy for Babies and Tasty too
column10: Better Tasting and Baby loves it! Seems to be safe too as it is produced in Europe (Spain) . Unfortunately its expensive as Nestle doesn't manufacture this locally here in .

Choice #1 for indian kids:My 8 months baby always wants only cerelac, now that we have moved to US, she doesnt like oatmeal/rice Cereals since they dont have that extra "SWEET" content.Always the best food for kids who started with cerelac, very hard to change to others.

This is the cereal I grew up with. For me, it is the best cereal in the market! I hope Amazon can include this the Subscribe and Save items because I order every month and a half for my twins who love Cerelac so much!

It is amazing. I grew up on this product and everybody loves it at home even adults. Now I'm using it for my baby and she loves it too. Has multiple stages, so don't worry about allergies. Start with stage I and advance it every month.

I totally trust Cerelac for my baby, that was my first solid food and I still love it until now lol, now my baby is eating it. very delicious and very nutritional, it's been around for years and years so it's very safe and proven good and nutritional, my baby lovess it and this pack of four is the best way to buy it and the most economic. totaly recommend it
My baby loves Cerelac.  He can be picky at times but when i serve him cerelac, he always eats it. Even my husband likes it...lol

column9: Great product!  Thank you Amazon for carrying it!
column10: I was so glad to find this on Amazon!  I know they carry it in Europe and the Middle East, but I haven't been able to find it in grocery stores in the US.  My baby loves it, and it's so easy to prepare - just add hot water.It's great for him too.  And of course, it's a Nestle product, so you know you can trust it.
I mix Cerelac with whole milk and give it to my toddler in a bottle every morning. He loves it! Plus, it is a great breakfast. I highly recommend this product.

my son loves this cereal it is so healthy and nutritious and it tastes so wonderful. what i like most about this product is that it already has the milk in it so all you have to add is warm water. and it is made oout of wheat so you know you are giving the best for your child.

Well,This is the stuff I ate from the time I was 6 months old, and I'm sort of surprised that this has not been reviewed yet. It tastes great and my little  8 months old is starting to love it.My only concern is that I'm not sure that the FDA tests this product, since it is imported. Bottom line is if is good enought for me, it probably is for my daughter.

column9: Was a Little Worried, but it's Great!
column10: I was a little worried when I unpacked this coffee and noticed the "Extra Bold" on the box.  However, this coffee is very smooth, with no bitter taste to it...and it is also not weak like some breakfast blend coffees can be.  This coffee is for my wife, who doesn't like some of the bolder coffee's I drink. (Timothy's Parisian Nights, Coffee People Black Tiger, Emeril's Big Easy Bold, Starbucks Cafe Verona and Sumatra)  This is more like Caribou Blend or some of the lighter "Donut House" coffees.  I tried a cup and I know it'll be right up her alley.

I like a light strength of coffee and this one said it was light. However, it is more of a medium and stronger than I like.  So, I was a little disappointed since the purchase included 2 boxes. I'll use it because it's a little pricey, but I won't order this brand again.
Finally found the perfect coffee...not too strong and great flavor!!! This will definitely be an item that I order on a regular basis.

I prefer bold richly flavored coffee in the morning time.  The breakfast blend is THE best kcup on the market, and I have tried a ton of them.  Its bold, but not overpowering, with a great aftertaste.

We have tried many different coffees since geting a Keurig brewer and Tully's breakfest blend suits our taste completely. Not everyone has the same taste requirements but my wife and I both really like Tully's.

I like my coffee in the mild range - and this fits the bill.  I had been drinking nothing but Green Mountain Breakfast Blend, and while I would say I prefer that variety a little better in terms of taste, these Tully's are very similar.  And given the ridiculous price of most K-cups - Green Mountain included - I will stick with the Tully's for now. My adult daughter ( who has long been out on her own, raising her own family) recently stayed with me for a week. Several times, she asked what made my food taste so good and because of "Mom pride" I attributed it to her just eating Mom's cooking again. But then I remembered that I never was a very good cook and my kids all turned out to be far better cooks than I. After much discussion about "taste" we narrowed it down to the Himalayan salt that I use. We went immediately to the computer and I ordered a box of the Himalayan salt to be sent to her house.  Now, she's back at her home and she told me how much better her food tastes since she's been using the salt.I've been using the salt for quite a few years and I've never noticed a salty after taste in my mouth, especially in the morning. But when ever I have to eat in a restaurant (or someone else's cooking) I do notice a salty taste in my mouth in the morning. I'm not saying this salt changes my life drastically but it does add enhancement to the taste of food.

It is very unfortunate that something finally IS amazingly helpful to human beings and people would try to squash its spread by creating false claims about it. The science on Himalayan salt is actually very clear...the mineral content of the Himalayan salt is extremely well balanced and there is absolutely no way that someone using Himalayan salt therapy would end up with an elevated level of fluoride. For those spreading these rumors, how about you also present some scientific research? Extensive studies on the benefits of salt therapy have been conducted in Poland and China, and the bulk of this research (mostly unknown in the US) supports the use of Himalayan salt. As for the location of where the salt comes from, the salt does come from Pakistan--but "Pakistan" is just a human-created boundary. This salt was created as the original primal sea began to evaporate--the salt crystals were formed simultaneously as the plate activity created the mountain ranges in that area. The salt crystals that resulted were therefore tucked up inside the mountains. So it's all in how humans choose to define their borders today whether it is from Pakistan or some other country...who cares where it actually comes from if it is safe and helpful? And that's really the bottom line for me...as someone using Himalayan salt for several years now, I have personally seen a huge benefit.The one way to make sure you are truly getting Himalayan salt, though, is to look for the light pink variety--because this light pink color comes from only one mine in the world! Hopefully the unscrupulous business people will not try to color rock salt, too!

I rated this 4 stars, but if you can't have whey, it is definitely a 5-star product.I'm allergic to both whey and soy, which has made finding a good protein supplement quite a pain! I have tried pretty much everything on the market, including a variety of wheat, buckwheat, and brown rice proteins.  If you are looking for the highest quality protein available, you are unfortunately limited to egg, soy, whey, or casein (based upon PDCAAS, the FDA and FAO/WHO's method of determining protein quality), so egg is really preferable to the alternatives.  Fortunately, this is, in terms of consistency, digestibility, and nutritive content (0 fat 0 carbs), and overall flavor, the best of the various proteins I tried.  In case you are wondering, there is no cholesterol in this protein, either.  Texture and overall 'drinkability' are great... I drink it mixed with water with no issues.  Flavor is decent: obviously, none of us are drinking protein powder expecting a gourmet flavor extravaganza.  This protein is decently tasty if you like chocolate (not as good as most whey/casein proteins, but better than almost all non-whey proteins... I tried quite a few of those as well before discovering that I could not tolerate dairy proteins).  Be warned: the vanilla version of this product tastes terrible.  In my opinion, it is barely drinkable.Four stars overall.  If I had no food sensitivities, I might still use this in conjunction with whey protein, but would probably not use it exclusively.Five stars if you can't have whey protein!I hope that this review is helpful!

I found this to be a good alternative to whey based protein powder. I have only used this product for 30 days and am reordering. Before I get into my review, I might mention that I never thought of myself as whey or lactose intolerant, but after 3 months of taking quality whey protein I knew that what I was experiencing was not typical. (I'm talking about bathroom habits including frequency and consistency). I asked a few older guys in the gym what there experience was with whey, most if not all where fine with it and experienced no problems or side effects. One natural BB that is about my age late 30's suggested this egg based protein product and noted that one of his training customers found it to be an acceptable alternative to the milk based protein products.I did some research and to be honest the manufactures web site for beHealthyNFit is totally useless and outdated with little or no useful information. Their poor web site almost made me not buy this product. It sure didn't invoke any consumer confidence and in my opinion is totally unacceptable.How does it taste? I bought the chocolate (I'm not a chocolate lover but I think chocolate flavoring is the best option for protein powders) The flavor is chocolate but its defiantly not a rich milk chocolate and it wouldn't fall in the same category as a dessert. More of a taste that you can get used to.  I have also seen this flavor described as chocolate with a hint metallic. I'd agree with that. It has an after taste that some may find metallic.How does it mix? I mix this with water directly in a 16oz. ready to drink water bottle. I drink 1 or 2 ounces, usually down to the top of the label. Then I place a funnel in the top and dump in one scoop. Usually I will need to shake or tap the funnel to get the powder to pass through. Then I screw the top on and shake well. I have found that if the water is very cold the powder will clump more often and mix poorly. Room temperature water or water that is cool but not ice-cold works best. I use a wine fridge to keep the water at 50.( I don't like clumps) Note: The consistency is exactly like water, if your expecting this to be a thick or heavy drink then will be disappointed.I found that if you live in a humid state like Florida you will need to make sure that you screw the lid to the protein power on tight. If you expose this power to high humidity you will have a terrible time with it clumping and mixing properly.General tips for drinking protein drinks. I have found that eating a granola bar while drinking a protein drink helps. First biting the granola bar then taking a drink. I found this to work for me and it makes the occasional protein clump less noticeable.Is there room for improvement? Yes, loads of room for improvement. Is there anything better? I haven't found it yet but I am still looking. I will give this high marks until I find something better. Please leave a comment if you find a better non whey protein product.

America has an infatuation with dairy and sweets.  If you look at any tables that show protein absorbtion effeciency in our bodies you will see this fact.  Eggs and Fish are rated at the top for best absorbtion and usage in the human body.  Eggs are around 88% effeciency, while fish is around 70% and chicken around 60%.  Whey and dairy are below all of these, this is precisely why whey is so cheap, and that is why it is so popular. column9: Careful - This food made 2 dogs very sick!!
column10: My mom recommended Weruva dog food to me for my dog, because she gives it to her new puppy and the puppy loves it (my mom buys the food from a store). It's expensive food so instead of buying it in an all natural dog food store, I bought it online instead.My dog has eaten a lot of different brands - PurinaOne, Beneful, ScienceDiet, and Ceasar (which he eats regularly) - and none of them have given him stomach issues.As soon as I started giving him this food (adding it slowly to his diet), he began to lose his appetite and have mild diaherra. I continued him on the food for 2-3 weeks, thinking that his body just had to adjust to the new food, but when his symptoms didn't improve, I stopped feeding it to him. The day after I stopped giving him the food, he was fine! Back to his normal digestion.I was convinced it was just my dog having a wierd reaction, so I gave the cans of food to my mom to give to her dog (no need to waste expensive dog food!). As soon as my mom gave the food to her puppy, the puppy got very very sick - bad diahhera and vomiting! We have tried several different types of Keurig cups in search of the right Hazelnut coffee. This is the best we've found!  Overall, I like the taste and aroma. The only possible opportunity is that it could be a bit stronger...but I think this is more a case of personal preference (I like my coffee strong!) The hazelnut flavor is well balanced---strong without overpowering, not overly sweet like some other hazelnut coffee flavors.

The K-cups are very convenient to use on work days, but I wish the flavor was stronger.  I use to brew at the large mug setting, but found the flavor watery.  Brewing at the middle cup setting results in more flavor.
Gloria Jeans seems to make the best tasting hazelnut. I tried all the rest and for some reason this one tastes the most natural to me.
Gloria Jean's Hazelnut coffee is delish.  I enjoy one to two cups per day!  The flavor is just right and not too sweet or overbearing.
The product arrived on time and the price was right.  There is really not much more to say than that.

When I first got my Keurig brewing machine, I was a little skeptical about the quality of coffee any K-Cup could provide. After making a cup of Gloria Jean's Hazelnut coffee using a K-Cup from a sample pack, I now stand corrected! Gloria Jean's makes great coffee to begin with and their Hazelnut coffee in K-Cup form is fantastic.The coffee gives off a wonderful Hazelnut aroma while it's brewing and it tastes great! It's the kind of aroma and taste you'd expect after grinding the beans yourself, but the K-Cup saves you the hassle. In the time that I've owned a Keurig brewer, this is hands-down one of the best coffees I've tried, and I'll definitely be ordering it again.My only complaint is in the packaging, but since it doesn't have anything to do with the quality of the coffee, I can't rate it less than five stars. Just wish this 50-pack came in a differently-sized/designed box so it would store more easily in a kitchen cabinet.

I absolutely love this k cup coffee,i've tried quite a few k cup flavors and always return to Gloria Jeans Hazelnut. You can't purchase it for less anywhere, that's a plus. Guests who prefer regular coffee not flavored comment that it's very enjoyable, not overpowering. Thanks for making these k cups available.
Taste is very weak and didn't improve with coffee creamer. Sorry but this box is a dud. Wish I could return.
Rec'd my coffee quickly, well packed and as described. Good value! I will definitely return when I need another Hazelnut fix.

This coffee is amazing, it is absolutely delicious!! And it was a very good price, some K-cups can run a bit pricey but this was a good deal especially since it had 18, most boxes for this price are only about 15 cups.
Gloria Jeans has a great product of Hazelnut flavored coffee.  The product is liked by all my colleagues.  The transaction via Amazon was prompt and efficient.  Will buy again from Amazon.
Best hazelnut flavored coffee I have found.  The K-cups came in one box.  The K-cups are so easy to use.  Delivered fast as well.

column9: Didn't Care For This K-Cup At All!!!
column10: I received one of these in a sampler package I had ordered of different flavored coffees from the Official Keurig.com website. I just didn't like the taste of it. I would not order this K-Cup again.
This is the first set of K-cups I've bought, and it was because they came highly recommended and I love Hazelnut coffee.  These won't disappoint.
This is my wife's favorite coffee.Gloria Jean's Coffees,Butter Toffee K-Cup Portion Pack for Keurig K-Cup Brewers (Pack of 50)
