This olive oil is by far the best I've ever tasted.  It's a bit cstly like most really good olive oils are but this is so worth the money!  You will not be disappointed.  The flavor is amazing, I do not use it to cook with, it's too good for the, it's great on bread or in salad.  I promise if you like olive oil you will LOVE this one.
I first tasted on a restaurant in Sorrento . " Il Bucco" one of the finest in that town. The taste is amazing well worth the price. Do not use it for cooking , it is too fine.
Best tasting olive oil I have had.  It gets a little peppery at the back of your throat!  It is exceptionally delicious when making garlic & oil pasta.

column9: Great product - ignore the ignorant poor reviews
column10: My 5 month old son loves this brand and flavor. I don't have to worry about whether the lid will reclose because my son can't get enough of this and wants more even after he finishes the jar; however, I haven't had any problems with the lid when I tried to close it. Earth's best makes great, natural products. Don't give a product a bad review because you can't figure out to rescrew a jar lid! The other reviewer complaining about the thickness/puree blend saying that EB is too watery doesn't know what he/she is talking about. Any pediatrician will explain and so does the EB website that "first" blends are very fine and highly strained so that your baby can get used to eating solids--that's also why you're supposed to mix a lot of breastmilk or formula with rice cereal when you first introduce it! When your baby is 6 months or older, you can move him onto the "2nd" foods which are thicker and have more varieties/combos. Hope this helps other parents!

I have started my baby on baby food and so far this is the only one she loves. She gobbles it up and pulls my hand towards her mouth when she sees it coming. She would eat the entire jar in one sitting if I would let her. She just loves it.

Wanted my daughter to keep organic as much and long as possible so we tried this brand first & this veggie when she started solids.  It smelled good and from the first spoonfull (it's not so runny it won't stay on a spatula style spoon) she loved it!  This is her fave veggie so far.She'll eat a jar of this even after a full bottle if I let her!  No side effects noticed and I even tasted it & found it barely sweet and wholesome.This is a great deal and cheaper than in store; arrives bubblewrapped to death and no weird or broken jars so far.

column9: nice price delivered right to the door
column10: My baby liked the sweet potato flavor, so we decided to stock up from Amazon rather than keep buying a few at a time from the local store. Price was good and nice part is that it gets delivered right to your door.This is a good  baby food brand in general.
This is the best tasting sweet potato baby food.  Far superior than other brands I've tried.  And it's organic!  Can't beat the price on Amazon.  Highly recommend.

To my Grandson's tummy !  He's developed definite thoughts on what he does not like, but this is really Yummy !  (it would be great if you offered single jar purchases, however---in whatever amount one might need)

My daughter loves it and I have used it for so many other things.  I mix it with oatmeal in the morning.  Mix it with shredded chicken for dinner.  Spread it on a little piece of toast for her.  I trust this brand and I feel their products are wholesome.

Sweet potato was the favorite of our now 10-month old twins. And it is absolutely loaded with vitamin A.I've asked many parents of babies around the same age as ours which foods their babies like. Each time they've said their babies like sweet potatoes, so I think this is a very good flavor choice.I've ordered and received many 12-jar packages of various varieties of Earth Best baby food. I stopped all my Earth Best subscriptions though. That's because I had three deliveries with broken jars within a short time. Amazon responded well. I wrote Earth's Best but they never responded.
If you are used to making homemade sweet potato puree, this is not a substitute.  Homemade sweet potato puree is thick and fluffy, this is thin and watery.

Only reason I'm giving this 3 stars vs. 4 is because of the lid - it doesn't close tightly! No matter how you slowly, carefully, methodically (and all while praying) loosen then tighten back the cap of the jar, it closes lopsided, potentially exposing the food to the air and, consequently, spoiling easily. And forget it if you're getting these for travel - you'll end up throwing away a half-eaten jar because you can't close the lid! Infuriating - yes, infuriating, not just maddening or disappointing, but infuriating! - and not at all Earth-friendly; why not sell these in recyclable containers with lids that twist off and on (or zip?) more easily than the glass and very flimsy tops that are now doubling as mini-frisbees for my baby?
I buy Dingo treats for several reasons. One, dogs love them, two they don't leave stains and three the price is reasonable. Our Siberian Husky carries her's all over the house.

Good quality product, our two small pooches loved the peanut butter!  They're the perfect treat, not too messy and keep the dogs busy for a good amount of time (their ears pearch up when they hear "Who wants a DINGO??").

Our 3 dogs love Dingo bones.  But these peanut butter flavor bones are an obsession of our smallest rat terrier.  He's only 5 pounds, so bones tend to last several sittings for him.  Give him one of these and he's occupied for as long as it takes to finish.  He'll still play with other bones, but he loses his mind when he sees me go for this bag.  I just wish they were priced as well as the other Dingo products and less difficult to find.

column9: Dog loved it but left a mess
column10: My doberman went nuts over this bone.  He tried to devour it rather quickly.  My only complaint about this bone is that it left a mess on the floor; the red color of the bone rubs onto the floor.  It did wipe up fairly easily.  Just make sure when you give the bone to your dog he's not eating it on a carpeted floor.

I was on a business trip with my husband and we took our poodles along.  I needed treats for the poodles and saw these - figured I had nothing to lose.  WOW, my dogs loved them!  Usually they will hide their treat and try to steal the treat for the other dog, but with these they never left their own.  Amazing - I must buy more!

I have two 70 lb. dogs. One chews on anything but the other chews on almost nothing. Both will immediately attack this bone and have a ball chewing on it. The one dog usually ignores regular rawhide but I didn't have to wait and see with this, he took to it right away. The price fluctuates wildly with these kinds of bones, so watch for a sale. I paid about 3 bucks.

column9: WARNING: Open package received with signs of used product
column10: Just wanted to warn any potential buyers that I received an open package buying from Amazon LLC.  I think that's pretty disgusting since this is a product that's intended for consumption by your pet.  Also, there were portions of the red "meat" that looked like it had been chewed on and the white bone portion was stained red all over.  Basically it looked as if a dog had chewed on it for a little and then repackaged up and sold on Amazon.  Buyer beware.
Out of all of the different bones and treats we've given our dog, these are one of his all time favorites!

I have a labrador retriever. He weighs 82 lbs. He loved the bone, but I made the mistake and allowed him to eat the bone in one sitting. It was too much of a shock to his digestive system.  The next morning he developed diarrhea. I' m not sure if the bone is the reason the diarrhea lasted so long, but to be causious I will not buy the bones again.  To be fare about the product, I bought three of the bones and the last one was the one associated with my dog's problem, but of course that last bone is the only one he eat in one sitting.  I believe the product would be best for larger dog's than mine, or for smaller dog if the owner regulator the amount of the bone that is eaten at each sitting .
The Dingo mini peanut butter bones are a favorite for our 11-year old Yorkie. Be forewarned - she won't eat any other bones any more!

My dog absolutely loves these and he is such a picky eater. I probably tried almost 6 different dog treats but I had to give them away to friends because he wouldn't touch them. These however he will chew up until they're gone. He also likes to hide them and save them for later. He doesn't however like the peanut butter ones.
Our Golden Retriever really loves these. Don't give them to him often and use them for a special treat.
My cairn terrier Daisy loves these basted bones. Having troublefinding them in retail. I hope its not a sign that the productis discontinued. She also likes the peanut butter basted flavor.
Ok, It lasted about 1hr. My dog ate it in 1hr so i would say he enjoyed it. I never tasted it myself but i guess it was good.

I highly recommend Good Earth Sweet And Spicy Herbal Tea! This tea contains a successful blend of natural herbs that work together (think Chemistry and catalytic reaction!) to create a taste, flavor that seems 'Sweet'! This brewed tea is great hot and cold - we've made Sun Tea then refrigerated to enjoy the herbal delight over ice. When we've given this tea to others, they commented "Wow! What's in this tea?!" I bet this brewed tea would be a good ingredient in recipes (deserts or as a marinade) and as a compliment to any party/social beverage event (wedding punch, tea parties, holiday Wassail). The aroma that this tea produces fills the room with mental images of 'home' and Norman Rockwell paintings. I've tried other 'sweet and spicy' herbal teas but they lack the potency his particular brand has (you can get 2 or 3 cups of hot tea from just one teabag- getting your money's worth and then some). An added plus is this tea is caffeine-free so you can have a delicious cup of this spicy tea while you're snuggled up with a good book right before bedtime.

column9: Great if you have B-6 Toxicity
column10: When I found out I was suffering from vitamin B-6 toxicity, this was the only cereal brand I could find that was not fortified with the B vitamins. Now I only wish I could find a multi-vitamin that didn't have vitamin B-6. Dropped one star because of the price, but still less expensive than buying at Whole Foods or Safeway.
I like these but not as much as I like masoor lentils. It takes a good bit if spices to mask the flavor.

I order this item consistently for my office. Everyone here seems to enjoy the flavor of this coffee. Its bold, and strong, and comes out great from the K-Cup. As with all K-cup products, its not a premium/gourmet coffee from a top roaster and brewer, but it really makes us happy here at work when a K-cup is all that we can produce.
I like a strong coffee, particularly when using the Keurig coffee machine.  This coffee really wakes you up in the a.m.

Got a Keurig for Christmas, and have spent the past two months trying to find great coffee that is also affordable.  Over a dollar each for the ones that I was getting at the grocery store was just not cutting it for me.  I purchased a reusable K-cup.  Couldn't stomach the weak coffee it made, and that was with superfine ground coffee.  Not to mention that it often only brewed half a cup.  So, after trying many different types, I decided I liked the taste of the Starbucks Sumatra the best, but it was way too expensive.  Come to find out, Green Mountain makes the Starbucks K-cups.  So I decided to try Green Mountain, as it is MUCH more affordable.It's GREAT!  Nice, strong, flavorful cup of coffee!  FINALLY!
This is some of the real stuff... rich full flavor, not bitter just full body, dark and rich.In the same park as French Roast

column9: Just about my favorite K-Cup coffee so far
column10: Got a Keurig for Christmas, so I've been having fun trying the wide variety of available K-Cup products.  So far, this is my favorite of all the coffees, and one of the few I'd stack up against a good cup of freshly ground and brewed regular coffee. Usually I like K-Cups because they're convenient.  I like these because they're truly excellent coffee and taste wonderful.  These and Coffee People's extra bold varieties are good enough to pass for the real thing - no one would ever suspect they were K-Cups if you didn't tell them.

Green Mountain Double Black Coffee "cups" are still the greatest cup of coffee.  Discovered it when I  purchased it from Amazon after purchasing a one cup keurig pot. Can't be beat if you want to start each day with a "hop, skip and a jump!"Try it - you'll like it....and that's a guarantee!

Finally a good strong cup of coffee.  After drinking weak, flavorless K-cups I found this one.  It has a very strong, smooth, almost floral taste with no weird afertaste like some bold coffee.  I highly recomend this coffee especially if you are a true coffee junkie.  Trust me you will love it!

This is a knockout bold coffee. It is great cup at the 12oz setting with tons of flavor. Haven't tried it yet at the 16oz setting but assume it will still pack a flavor punch. Great deal in the 50 pack.

I like this brand. I didn't realize I was ordering extra bold. To me these T cups are bitter. Since I can't control the strength, I make a small cup and toss. Then I make a large cup to drink. It is still strong which I like, but still has a bit of bitter aftertaste. I still like this brand.

This was an awesome deal ! I love a strong cup of coffee and this is the best I have had in the k-cup varieties. It's bold and smooth. Quick delivery, very happy with my purchase and I will purchase this item again.

Love the strong taste it has. I will reach for this every time when I have it.Great morning coffee to get the day started.Only buy it when on sale. Too expensive at full retail price.Try it if you like strong dark coffee.
I LOVE this coffee.  It's strong and bold without a bitter aftertaste.  I have just placed an order for another one.
The Green Mountain Coffee extra bold is our absolute favorite. It seems to arrive fresh and it seems to stay fresh. We had a real problem with Emeril's k-cups being stale, and not tasting right.

I put cream and sugar in my coffee, but I like one with bold flavor that shines through. I have tried other extra bold k-cups and come back to this one. Great taste, bold but not bitter. I only wish that the green mountain coffee would be offered as a subscribe and save item. Now that they are selling k-cups at Costco, I am tempted regularly to move to the lines they carry. It would be nice not to worry about running out, and to be rewarded a bit for my loyalty!

column9: Green Mountain Double Black Diamond Kcups
column10: If you like a strong bold coffee that's not bitter, then this is the coffee for you.  It has a great flavor and I really enjoy it.  Would recommend.

I enjoy the other strong ("extra bold") K-Cup varieties such as Jet Fuel and Black Tiger, but the Double Black Diamond is just too bitter. I add one packet of sugar or Xagave to this coffee and the sweetness barely comes through. My co-workers don't like Jet Fuel so I will stick to Black Tiger and try the new Starbucks K-Cups.
This is much stronger than the Carabou or the original Lake and Lodge coffee. Not for the faint of heart. But it is tasty, without bitterness.

My wife and I love strong coffee, this and the jet fuel are our favorite! If you like strong coffee, give it a try....Update to show how much we like it, I just placed our 3rd order in as many months.
I absolutely love this blend of coffee!  I was extremely happy to find it in the k-cups and it tastes just as great!
Green Mountain Double Black Diamond K-Cup is one of the best coffees I've tasted.  It's a very strong coffee.  If you enjoy bold coffee that stands on it's own this is the one.
This is a good strong coffee.  Both my wife and I like a coffee with good flavor and it must be strong.  This is one of the best.

column9: Better than a coffee house brew
column10: This coffee is better than any "coffee house" coffee. Freshly brewed each time, with a strong, smooth flavor! Excellent! Delivery is fast! Never worry about remembering to pick up k-cups at the market again. Amazon service rocks!

Let me start by saying I like French roast, pressed coffee. I was purchasing 1 lb. S***bucks French roast and having it ground for the press weekly. This coffee, GM Double Black Diamond (k-cup) and Gevalia Dark Italian Roast (Tassimo)come so close I do not purchase the ground coffee any longer. Very strong, full bodied coffee without being bitter or having an aftertaste. If you like strong, fresh coffee this is it.
I received what I ordered faster than expected, item was in great condition...I love the strong taste of this coffee. I will definitely buy this item again.
Best K cup I have found hands down.  Rich, bold, deep flavor; almost as much so as drip or press brewed.  After 50 cups I had no issues with grounds in the cup at all. Definitely recommend
its so delicious smooth n robust a great cup of coffee u wont regreat it if u luv a real cup of strong coffee
Very good coffee.  You definitely have to like strong coffee to like this product -- it's a "waker-upper".  Definitely would order this product again.

A nice strong brew. I am new to Keurig and have lived on French press for years. This coffee is strong enough to compete.  It is a little on the bitter side like some of Starbucks coffees but I consider that a plus. I would rate it 5 stars but it's not French press
Good flavor and plenty robust. One of the better coffees available in K-cups.  I would give it a five if it was a touch smoother on the finish.  Will certainly buy again.
Unlike other K-Cups I was pleasantly surprised by the strong and good taste of this K-Cup. Definitely recommended for those looking for a stronger brew.

I make my coffee like an ersatz latte and need a very robust coffee to pull that off---this fits the bill.  This is my method:  using a large mug, I first pour in about 1/4 c. of milk and nuke that for 60 seconds.  I then use either the small or medium (depends on my mood) Keurig setting and brew the coffee with the scalded milk, then top with a dollop of Bailey's coffee creamer.  Delicious!  I like a strong coffee but not a bitter one and Double Black Diamond works beautifully.
So many K-Cups just do not deliver true bold flavors, these Green Mountain Double Black Diamond cups are an exception.  No issues with grounds, delivery, or anything.  Will be ordering more.
Good coffee for a keurig pod,a little on the thin side for my taste, bust still a decent cup of joe.

column9: They are the same thing as you buy in the store only in bulk.
column10: Same coffee only you get them cheap because there in bulk.You dont get those little boxs that come in a 10 qty box but who cares.
this coffee is intense and very yummy!  it has a strong espresso flavor.  i would definitely recommend it and buy it myself again!

I've tried various dark roasts with K-cups and could not find something that was dark and rich enough.  Tired the Caribou, Jet Fuel, French Roast....nothing.  My apartment smells great and this is a smooth, rich cup of coffee.  I highly recommend it to dark roast lovers.

column4: terzap "aka I Love my Quaker Parrot"
column9: If you like a dark and toasty big mug with just one K-cup, this will do it.
column10: I have real issues trying to find a K-cup that will give me a robust-tasting enough mug of joe. For a while, I'd found near-perfection in the Coffee People extra bold mix... especially the Wake-Up Call (which got horribly expensive all of a sudden), but even those I only made on the middle setting of our brewer, and never the largest.  The Double Black Diamond still satisfied me on the largest setting, and has an intense, smoky dark edge that reminds me of the coffee that first converted me to the Pacific Northwest style of espresso---one I had a a tiny, roadside espresso stand out in the middle of nowhere between Tumalo and Sisters, in Oregon.  (It's probably not there any more--this was back in the 90s. LOL)  Anyway, it's definitely robust, and as I use milk/creamer, I don't find it bitter at all, but rich and worthy of savoring.  It will stand up nicely to a shot of your favorite flavor, and even shines through getting mixed with cocoa and vanilla for a toasty mocha.I just wish the coffees I'm finding out that I really, really like weren't shooting up into the "Can't Afford" ranges. But for those who love bold, smoky dark roast---this one is a real winner! I will keep it on hand for the times when I sit down with breakfast or with my Kindle to savor a cup of coffee rather than drink it in haste on the way out the door. But, if I find this coffee "loose" I'm getting it for my Eko-Brew reuseable K cups for sure.

column9: Among the best K-Cups I've tried
column10: Very dark, near-espresso, but complex.  Some of the best K-Cups I've tried, although I'd need to do a blind test between these & Dark Magic.
love it!  I like strong coffee.  This is it!  I got a great price too!  I am going to order this one again!

This coffee is so strong, I found it bitter.  I even tried diluting it by brewing larger sizes, but I still found it bitter. If you are tempted to try it, I would advise purchasing a sample pack first.
Excellent FULL body, not bitter.  Green mountain makes coffee taste as good as it smells.  I think my search for the perfect cup of coffee is almost over.

If you like a strong cup of coffee...... this one's for you! Excelent taste, aroma, without the bitterness of most strong coffees......I've tried most all Bold coffee available.... this one is my favorite......
I was so pleased with my coffee shipment. Nothing was damaged and my coffee was good & fresh. This is some of the best coffee I've tasted. Smooth, strong and flavoable just the way I like it.

Green Mountain Coffee Double Black Diamond, 24-Count K-Cups for Keurig Brewers (Pack of 2)I love a bold, dark cup of coffee. I've been buying the Gloria Jean's Black Gold for many years until just recently as it was discontinued. I searched for something that I thought would be comparable. I found this one and ordered with low expectations that it would match up, but I was pleasantly surprised. It's dark and strong and not bitter at all. If you like a bold coffee like me, definitely give this one a try.
Of all the varieties we have tried, this was one of our favorites.  The Amazon price was the best I've found.  The taste combined with the price is why I rate it so high.
This coffee is not for light coffee drinker! This coffee is EXTREMELY bold, strong and smooth. I love this coffee. I highly recommend.

This coffee was just too strong for my family.  No matter how much milk or cream was put in, it did not alter the strength of this beverage. If you like a strong cup of coffee, this is the one for you.

I think I have tried all the extra bold K cups out there and have setteled on Double Black Diamond. It has a good strong coffee flavor, an 8oz brew has just a little bite at the end but smooths out if you need it to by brewing it at 10 oz.  Dark Majic extra bold is a milder version but still very good.Joe
Order arrived quickly, earlier than stated -  coffee is great and makes a great iced coffee... I will order these again.

column9: Awesome if you love strong coffee
column10: I have tried many different k-cups in my search for the strongest but non-bitter one.  This is it.  It brews dark and strong but there is no bitter aftertaste.
We love ordering from companies that use one large box to hold all the k-cups as opposed to multiple little boxes.  This coffee is strong, just the was we like it.

I love the Keurig coffeemakers because I prefer mild or flavored coffees, while other family members love the dark roasts--and this one certainly fits the bill! The "Double Black Diamond" moniker is appropriate, for it has a bold, dark flavor and aroma that was a hit with those in my family who like strong coffee. This size box (50) makes the cost-per-cup a good deal. Highly recommended.

I love this coffee. If you like Emerils' bold or Jet fuel you'll love this one. It's the closest I've found to bold coffeehouse blend and even though the prices on K-cups continue to increase these are still a bargain when you compare the cost to Starbucks or your local cafe.

column9: Some of the BEST coffee with a KICK!
column10: Green Mountain puts out some really good coffees, and the K-cup is no exception.  Double Black Diamond is very strong and rich in flavor.  Highly recommended.
This is Top of the line in my book. Absolutly the best bold taste ever!!! I've tried the majority of the bold k-cup coffees and this in my opinion is the Best!!!
really a bold and stong taste, we like a bold coffee and its hard to find for the k cups, this one is our favorite ,

I have been searching for a nice strong coffee for my Keurig that doesn't leave a bitter or flat aftertaste.  This a very nice bold flavored coffee that seems to fit the bill.  I am a bit spoiled after tasting Barista Prima's Italian roast as it has such a nice rich full-bodied flavor.  It is a bit pricier so the Double Black Diamond is a nice close second at a more affordable price.  I like my coffee black or with a little milk and this does not leave you wondering where the coffee went!

I have tried all the K cup coffee out there I think.  I had setteled on Dark Majic untill I tried Double Black Diamond.  This is for people that love the tase of coffee. It is strong but smooth. I have the Cuisinart and set it for 8 oz of water.  Great cup of coffee.

column9: Looking for a replacement for Starbucks and Tassimo? This is it.
column10: I have been drinking Starbucks brand coffee with my Tassimo brand machines for years.  It was the perfect combination for me.  Now that they have stopped making Starbucks inserts I was forced to look for an alternative.  I bought a K-cup machine because it appears to be the dominant brand on the market.  This coffee is actually better than the original Starbucks!  I will not go back to the Starbucks brand even if they start making it for the K-cup machines.

WOW again!  This coffee is quite strong.  My husband and I drink our coffee black, and I usually drink 2-3 cups per day.  But this coffee is almost like drinking expresso. If you are looking for a dark, rich, very strong coffee, this one's for you.  Those who add sweetener and cream might also enjoy this wake up coffee.  Double Black.... perfect name.  However, I can only drink one cup a day of this brand.

Tried a lot of different k-cups in search for a bold, expresso type of coffee. This one fits the bill all right. Strong but not bitter. Am able to make a large and medium cup out of one k-cup. Truly worth a few cents more per cup. Would absolutely recommend this to anyone who wants a "real"" cup of coffee.
Double Black Diamond has a very full bodied flavor, yet it's not too bitter. K-cups are a convenient way to get your morning cup of coffee without having to stop at the local Starbucks.

column9: Tastes like a real cup of coffee
column10: Double Black Diamond Kcups are the nearest I have found to the Starbucks Tassimos Pods that are no longer available (maybe even a little stronger). If you like strong coffee that tastes like you spent $3, get these bad boys! If you like watered down, mild coffee I would stay away.

The Green Mountain Double Black Diamond Coffee is smooth even though quite strong. I run one cup  through my Keureg Brewer twice, first 10 oz then 6 oz. The coffee is strong enough to do this and it fills my largest mug and the coffee is then "just right" for me.
This coffee was a real treat.  Nice a bold yet not bitter.  Just the kind of coffee to get me going in the morning.  And, a good deal, too!

column9: a strong, bold cup of coffee
column10: I like a strong, bold, dark roast coffee and Double Black Diamond is my current favorite.  If you like a medium roast coffee this isn't for you, but if you like 'Black Tiger Amazon' or 'Jet Fuel', you should try Double Black Diamond.  It will also stand up to a larger cup size for those of you that can brew them.  I usually brew it on my Keurig's 9.25 oz. size and it still makes a satisfying cup.

column9: If You Like Bold Coffee, This Is It!
column10: My only hesitation in purchasing a K-Cup Brewer was whether the coffee would be bold enough for me. Since purchasing my brewer, I've tried many varieties and Double Black Diamond is my favorite. I drink my coffee black so I don't like weak coffee - I want it to be bold and smooth, not bitter. Black Diamond will not disappoint if you like good coffee. My other favorites are Green Mountain Expresso Blend and Coffee People Jet Fuel. I love my Cuisinart K-Cup Brewer - easy to use and no clean-up. I can make just one cup of fresh coffee whenever I want and don't end up throwing away unused or old coffee. And happily, I've found Double Black Diamond to start my mornings!
Good value and good coffee if you like the extra bold, like my husband does. His favorite is the Dark Magic and this replaces it at a fraction of the cost.
This coffee is strong and flavorful and is in no way bitter. All in all one of my all time top three and I recommend it highly.

column9: Green Mountain Double Black Diamond Coffee
column10: I like coffee....no, i like BLACK STRONG COFFEE. I was hesatant on getting this but thought what the heck. I was tired of picking up a limited supply of k-cups from the Discount Department Stores and having them taste a little weak. From the beginning, when your cup starts to brew, you can tell "this is going to be a GOOD cup of coffee". I wasn't disappointed. Great stuff. My wife drinks it more than I do but get it....you wont be let down at all, especially if you like just coffee....in your coffee.

In all the time I've had my Keurig I've been searching for the right flavor in a Extra Bold K-Cup. This one has been on of the best flavors to date. Not too dark to be bitter and not too light to taste watered down.

I like a strong cup of coffee.  This Double Black Diamond delivers.Unlike some reviewers I did not find it bitterDelivery was faster than promised.  The cups come in one big box,and one was damaged. Other than that I have no complaints.
Tried so many that called themselves "bold". But finally found one! We make it with a generous amount of water, and use half n half, and it is still very flavorful. And not bitter.

We love bold coffees and this is the second box of Double Black Diamond we have ordered.  It's smooth, strong and full bodied.  The aroma alone draws you in.  It's a great cup of coffee to wake up with.
Just how I like it! I can make a large cup of this on my Keurig (the one with three cup sizes) without losing any flavor. No nasty aftertastes and not bitter. Will order more.

Perfect flavor on the medium size setting.  I used to have to do two of the Kenya AA extra bolds on the small setting to even get close to the flavor of this cup.  So, this actually saves me money too...very nice:)

column9: Once you go "Double Black" you'll never go back!
column10: Not for the amateur coffee drinker! If your current coffee just isn't doing the job, step up to the Double Black Diamond. We like dark, bold coffees and this one is our number one fave. :)

I love my coffee strong and black, but I don't like the harsh and sometimes burned flavors that many extra-bold K-cups have.  Double Black Diamond is the perfect blend for me; I actually hoard my supply in my house.  The flavor is more intense than many others while still maintaining balance.  Not for the faint-of-heart, this blend approached but stops short of espresso strength.-- Debbie Lee Wesselmann

I have had this problem with Green Mountain coffee where about 1 out of every 3 cups brewed has a large amount of coffee grounds in the cup when brewed. Other brands do not seem to have this problem but Greem Mountain seems to have this issue.
While Peet's Coffee is the greatest, this is not far behind.  Easy to make, no mess, what more could you want?

Jolt-wise, this is a nice, gentle introduction to Extra Bold. (Darker roast, therefore less caffeine than most XB's.) The taste is charcoal, with charcoal notes and a charcoal finish.  I have a sweet tooth and tend to prefer the sweeter, smoother coffees.  However, I occasionally have a Double Black Diamond because it wakes me up without making me jittery.
This is a great blend when you need that extra kick to get you going! Excellent flavor with a Bold blend, "a manly mans blend"!
This coffee is the worst I've ever tasted!  I like strong, but this was very bitter!  Stick with the kona blend and Nantucket blend, or even breakfast blend.
Now that's Bold!!!If you need that morning shot in the arm look no further. I was using Bustelo in the reusable k-cup, this is better. I will not turn back.

I typically use my Keurig as a hot water dispenser, running it without kcups because they generally are too weak, even on the small cup setting.So, I'm very much in the market for stronger k cups.I can make medium size cups with this pod, but it's still a bit weak, and still bitter.  Makes a very strong small cup.  Perfect would be 2 pods, one cup, one brewed on short and the other on medium.As for the flavor of the beans, they produce a full bodied, bold and bitter cup.  Not necessarily a bad bitter, as it is pure arabica, however, I personally wouldn't recommend having more than one cup of these a day.  That bold flavor loses it's luster cup after cup, so it's not really a good all-around coffee.It's a good first or second cup of the morning coffee.  It's kind of like a cup of "good new york city coffee" back before the coffee renaissance of the past decade.Buying this in the extra large amount may not be suitable from an individuals' point of view because it's not something you'll want to drink 2+ times a day.

column9: I like it for my little wife
column10: I love K-Cups coffee.  They are easy and one always has a FRESH cup of coffee in less than a minute.  However, coffee this way can be quite expensive.  I myself use those refillable cups that one can find on amazon.  I have a half dozen of them.  I fill them with grocery store cheap brand and set my Keurig for the 6oz expresso cup.  It makes great strong coffee.  My wife on the other hand is lazy and doesn't want to mess with the two seconds it takes to fill the refillable little baskets.  She loves the Green Mountain Extra bold and as I buy it for her she doesn't care how much it costs.  It's good coffee and keeps my wife of forty years off my back.  I'd pay twice as much for that feature alone.

Impressed,as always,with Amazon's expedient delivery. I perused customer reviews before ordering and felt comfortable with my choice (I was going to get the Emeril Bourbon Street blend , which I love) as reviewers gave this a great rating. I find it strong but bitter as opposed to strong and rich. Would not recommend this blend to anyone. No negatives to Amazon but wonder who could find this a pleasurable coffee.
I placed an order for this on 4/18/2011, and it was $28.59. Today, 5/3/2011 the price is $40.50. Are you serious?! I guess I'll be shopping elsewhere!

I have tried lots of the bold coffees from different makers and this is my favorite.  It is really dark and smooth.  I love french press coffee but hate the mess.  This is the first K cup that has been the equivalent of that and I love it.  I highly recommend it!

There's a Keurig machine at my new job, and they have a couple varieties of K cups that I haven't seen in local stores or wholesale clubs. My favorite, easily, of these is "Double Black Diamond", the darkest, boldest coffee offered by Green Mountain. So I checked for prices on-line. I was psyched to find this box of 50 for a reasonable 57 cents each or so delivered to my doorstep. I ordered on Wednesday, and the coffee showed up Saturday morning in time for brunch. Hooray to Green Mountain and Amazon. We'll be ordering more soon.

Ive tried many KCups. I bought a Green Mountain Bold Variety pack and it had a few of these gems in it. This is some good, strong coffee. Might be overpowering for some people.I recommend this to anyone who has been searching for a kcup that taste like REAL coffee. some of these kcups are so weak. i say giver it a shot or at least try the bold variety pack. their espresso blend s also very strong and Kenya-AA (all part of variety pack) but i liked this one over all.

My biggest gripe with the Keurig pods is that the coffee is too weak so I always try the bold varieties.  I think I met my match with this one though. Its almost too strong for me.  I take my coffee black and this one has just a hint of bitterness. I have to use the tallest coffee cup setting when I use this pod.  Dont get me wrong...its a good cup of joe but for my taste I think I like the Emerill bold pods a tad better.On the plus side you can often reuse this pod for a second cup as its strong enough to still make a good cup second time around.

column9: Did you feel that coffee lover?  That was the freaking Quickening!
column10: We're comfortable being honest are we not?  Cool, so I have a coffee problem, I'm OK admitting that to you.  And with that affliction comes the experience of having consumed a crap-load of coffee from all over, K-cups and otherwise.  In the end, Highlander-esque, there can be only one, and the Double Black Diamond is that coffee.  This is the untouchable, best Keurig coffee that I have ever encountered and I am relatively sure that once or twice while drinking it I experienced the mythical Quickening.Buy it, don't buy it, I don't care, just get out of my way so I can keep drinking it.  I just want to die with the taste of it on my lips.

My wife and I have been a little frustrated with our Kuerig coffee maker because we want a big mug of bold taste and several coffees just come out weak!  Not this Double Black Diamond from Green Mountain! If you like bold flavor, you'll love this brew!

This coffee is excellent if you like strong coffee.  I have tried Black Tiger, Jet Fuel, Wake Up Call, and most of the other XB coffees, but this is the first one that is strong enough for me in an 8 Oz cup.  For reference to Tassimo owners, this is very similar in strenght to the Starbucks Caffè Verona t-discs.I would NOT purchase from this any of the sellers selling it for twice as much as the other sellers though.  DO note that this product package cost you about $1/cup as you only get 1 box (of 24 cups) vs 2 boxes.  Otherwise, enjoy!

column9: If you like french roast, you'll like this
column10: I'm not a big fan of the french roast flavor, but I do like a bold coffee. I was hoping this would be just a great bold flavor, but it tastes pretty much like a french roast. I'm not too happy, but it's not a bad coffee.

In my humble opinion as a life long coffee addict, this is the best K-Cup flavor available.When drinking a cup of this you will be treated to a strong full coffee taste, without any bitterness.I have tried many of the k-cup flavors and although there are other good ones, this one beats them all, hands down.

Of all the K-Cups we have tried, and that's a bunch, this one is the hands down favorite for flavor and boldness.  This is the one the spoon stands up in, the jolt that brings you to life no matter what.  This is always our go to for strength and good flavor.This is certainly our favorite from Green Mountain!

I've had my Kuerig for about 6 months now.  The hardest thing to do is find good, bold, strong coffee that can be used to make a 10oz mug of coffee.  Too many (most) K-Cups produce a watery-horrible 10oz mug but this cup stands up.  A mug of this coffee is still rich and bold.  I still lhave a hard time with how much K-Cups cost but when on sale this is a worthwhile coffee.

Coffee is my favorite drug and the first 2 cups in the morning better wake me up. This is one of my favorites to enjoy first thing every day.  It's strong, smooth, and doesn't upset my stomach because it's not bitter. I usually get bored with the same coffee after a while, but this one never lets me down.  Enjoy.

If you want a dark roast that nearly rivals espresso, here's your choice.Don't get me wrong, it's not espresso, but it is a dark, rich, balanced, flavorful roast that I look forward to when I need a pick-me-up some mornings. If you like dark roasts, this is VERY VERY GOOD!

I found this blend to be among the strongest and best K-cups I have ever tried. It is strong enough for me to brew a regular cup and then use the same Kcup again at the small cup setting to fill up my travel cup.  Never bitter, but very dark, rich and satisfying. I like to mix this with other k-cups such as Jet fuel, Italian roast, etc. If you like strong, non-bitter, dark rich coffee - try this.

I found this coffee bold and flavorful.For reference purposes my in store drink is a Starbucks Americano.My favorite k-cups are:Starbucks French RoastStarbucks Caffe VeronaStarbucks Pike Place RoastGreen Mountain Xtra Bold Sumatran ReserveGreen Mountain Double Black DiamondGreen Mountain RevvGreen Mountain Dark MagicOther k-cups I've tried:  Coffee People Jet Fuel ,Green Mountain Dark Magic Decaf, Emeril Jazzed up Decaf, Starbucks Caffe Verona, Coffee People Black Tiger,  Starbucks House Blend, Starbucks Breakfast Blend, Starbucks Sumatra, Wolfgang Puck French Roast, Green Mountain Lake and Lodge, Green Mountain French Roast, Caribou Mahogony, Wolfgang Puck Sumatra Kopi Raya, Emeril Big Easy Bold

Every time I get a new Keurig k-cup to try, it just gets better and better most of the time.  This one is no exception.  Green Mountain Double Black Diamond is AWESOMELY bold, and makes a great 6oz. cup. (And it is strong, so you may like an 8oz. brew on this one!) You can tell by shaking the k-cups that these bolder flavors are ground more finely, almost like an espresso.  This really is the best k-cup coffee I've tried so far, just edging out "Dark Magic" because of it's arabica origin.

The coffee is good and strong.  The large package cut the cost down to 60 cents a cup.  I like this bold flavor the most of the various blends offered.  If you like a good, strong cup of coffee in the morning, this it.
Definitely oriented towards the starbux crowd.  Comprared to their Dark Magic flavor, this is a bit bolder and a little more bitter, but not objectionably so.  Grown-up coffee.
Green Mountain Double Black Diamond K-Cups make a perfect cup of coffee for me.  Nice and strong, with that little "bite" that I enjoy in my coffee.

This coffee was great and is true to its extra bold status. In comparison to the "Black Magic" this one has an extra kick. My only complaint is that the cups are shipped in the box, without packaging and some of them were bent.

This is one of the best coffees I have brewed in Keurig.  I tried to order it on my Subscribe and Save account and it is impossible.  I called and was on the phone for quite a while with the rep, and she told me to input some numbers but there was nowhere on the website to do so.

I like my coffee bold and strong. I've tried some other bold K-cups but they don't come close to this blend. Double diamond is so rich, dark and bold.I used to love starbucks breakfast blend before they changed to what they currently have.This taste similar in my opinion.
I have been trying several Bold coffees to get to one that I really love. I think I found it with the Green Mountain Double Black Diamond. It is the perfect strong cup of coffee to get my day going.

Nice strong coffee - smooth but does have a bit of acidic taste at the end. My favorite is Coffee People's Donut Shop, and the Double Black Diamond is a bit stronger with a kick at the end. I've tried three cups so far. Of course it's all preference, but I think this is great. I would buy again. Strong but not too strong. Of course I do drink it slowly...this is not one to gulp down! Don't let the reviews scare you - if you're looking for a new bold coffee try the Green Mountain bold sampler pack - good choices in there, including this one!

This is definitely one of my favorites it has a fresh and great coffee taste, it's delicious. This will definitely be a must buy for those that like strong (almost espresso) coffee. If you need some energy and a nice strong kick in the morning this is definitely the coffee for you. I know I do, I live in NYC and have an awful commute in the morning. So, I need lots of caffeine to get through my commute and the rest of the day. I wasn't really getting that from some of my other coffee choices of the k-cups. I just got my machine and I am experimenting with all the extra and extra-extra bold coffees and so far between this one and the Timothy's Parisian Nights. So, so good I love them!! This is very addicting, strong coffee!!! ;o)

This coffee from Green Mountain has the aroma and taste that I love.  It is bold, dark and rich.  Not for the faint of heart.  I recommended this to a friend who replied "with Double Black Diamond who needs Geritol".  Will purchase again when needed.

column9: THE BEST! DARK ! BOLD ! THIS WILL WAKE YOU UP AND WANTING MORE!
column10: I've tried so many.... This is my very favorite. Wonderful taste without being bitter... High End !
I'm on a quest for the boldest k-cup coffee...I thought, based on reviews that this was it, but sadly it was not.  Its a great coffee blend but not quite bold-enough for me - the quest continues!

column9: Best tasting bold from Green Mountain
column10: I enjoy a very dark bold coffee. Of all of the k-kups I have tried, this one pleases me most. I like a touch of cream and this one handles it better than any other. It has a big bold taste but without the bitterness I find in other types. The Dark Magic is also good, but not quite as satisfying as this one.If you like a bold cup of coffee, you need to try this one! It is excellent.

column9: The BEST COFFEE nice and bold
column10: This is the BEST COFFEE EVER "DOUBLE BLACK DIAMOND" by" GREEN MOUNTAIN" and Kerig ROCKS!! I order this on Amazon every other month and get it usually within 4 to 5 days... I have other family members ordering this coffee now...I suggest his coffee to anyone who likes strong coffee!
I have really started enjoying stronger coffee and this is about as strong as it gets in the K-Cup variety.  In fact, I'm enjoying a cup right now!
I have a Keurig that brews 11oz of coffee.  If your really like coffee, and are brewing the larger amounts, this will still give you a good, 'kick butt" cup!

I like strong coffee and this fits the bill. My favorite is Barista's Italian Roast with Starbucks Verona close behind. Green Mountain Double Black Diamond is almost as good as those 2 but less expensive. I will buy this again.To save money, we have been making our own Kcups by reusing the brand cups -- after use, peel the foil top off, try to get all off the edge (but not necessary). Rinse out the used coffee. There is a filter built into the cups. We bought some Kcup lids on Amazon - 100 for about $15. Fill the rinsed out cup with your own favorite coffee, snap on the replacement lid and you are good to go. When placing in cup holder, make sure the little hole on the bottom from first use puncture is at the top and fits back onto the bottom pin - that way you do not get 2 holes in bottom of Kcup. You can resuse the Kcup many times befor it wears out.In the morning I will start off with GM Double Black and then for 2nd or 3rd cup use one we filled. Someday's I splurge and start with Barista Italian Roast.If you like strong, bold coffee, try the Black Magic. It is smooth without much of a bitter after taste. Although, I kind of like that after taste. It is too bold for my wife, so I tell her to reuse the Kcup I just used and make an 8oz cup... makes a good cup of coffee, just not quite as strong... and we get 2 cups out of the one Kcup.

column9: Nice replacement for Green Mountain Coffee's Espresso Blend
column10: Upon trying to replenish my supply of Green Mountain Coffee's Espresso Blend, I found they had discontinued it.  I hesitated to buy Timothy's Espresso Blend (now the only espresso k-cup on the market) due to the reviews but have since tried GMC's Dark Magic and now GMC's Double Black Diamond.  Double Black Diamond doesn't have the flavors the Espresso Blend has but it has a very good flavor on its own.  It has no bitter aftertaste as you would expect with such a strong, extra bold coffee.  Where the Dark Magic was too weak for my daily latte, the Double Black Diamond makes for a very fine latte.  This is my pick as a substitute for GMC's Espresso Blend.Update: I've been drinking this coffee for a few weeks now and have to say, it is great.  It is my new favorite!  Also, bought a couple of Extra Bold Roast k-cup coffee sample packs via Keurig and haven't found any better than GMC Double Black Diamond.

column9: Closet thing to French coffee with chicory
column10: I grew up drinking coffee in New Orleans.  I have been soooo disappointed with all of the K-cup coffees because they are so mild. After reading reviews, I decided to try all the ones that were said to be good, strong coffees.  First I tried Jet Fuel.  It is strong, but no taste.  Then I tried Paul Newmans dark roast.  It was so so, but nothing special.I saw the Big Easy k-cup and thought, this must be it.  It is good. Don't get me wrong.  It is my second choice.  But the winner is  Green Mountain Double Black Diamond! It is really, really good.  If you like your coffee strong and bold with great flavor, this is the one.  I don't care what it costs.  It is worth it.

GREEN MOUNTAIN DOUBLE BLACK DIAMOND IS BY FAR MY FAVORITE  "GET GOING IN THE MORNING" DELICIOUS STRONG BREW. THE COFFEE IS STRONG BUT NOT BITTER IN ANY WAY. TRULY A FAVORITE AMONG THOSE IN MY OFFICE WHO ENJOY A GOOD STRONG CUP OF COFFEE IN THE MORNING. I HOPE IT WILL BE AROUND A LONG TIME AS I WILL BE A LOYAL PURCHASER. TOO BAD IT'S NOT OFFERED IN THE SUBSCRIBE AND SAVE PROGRAM. TRY IT...YOU'LL LOVE IT!
Good flavor but stronger than I expected on the first gulp. Much better than Newman's Own. Also good as a warm up with Kahlua on a clod night.

In my search for the boldest, richest, darkest blend for Keurig, Double Black Diamond wins hands down. When compared to traditional coffees, it is comparable to Cafe Du Monde. I am actually quite surprised it doesn't have chicory in it. It is bold and rich without being at all bitter. Prior to this coffee, I thought Starbuck's Italian roast was the boldest commercial blend. But, Double Black Diamond makes it look weak in comparison. It brews to an almost jet-black and is very dark and earthy without a hint of bitterness or sweetness. It is very much like an espresso and I suspect it may contain as much caffeine. I am very surprised to find a Keurig blend that is comparable to the best French Market coffees and Italian espressos.
There are few Keurig coffees out there that are strong enough for me. This one clearly is with wonderful taste and smell. Amongst my favorites if you like black coffee.
As expected, this is a good strong cup of coffee. Although the flavors are subtlety different, I also enjoy the French roasts from Tulleys and Starbucks.  The best value is usually Green Mountain.

LOVE this coffee, I was looking for a strong bold coffee and was blown away with this one.  I had tried "Jet Fuel", Emeril's Bold", "Black Tiger" and "Newman's Extra Bold",  This Double Black Diamond is absolutely the best of the bunch.  Highly recommend this to anyone who likes their coffee strong.

column9: double black diamond makes for happy staff
column10: The Double Black Diamond Extra Bold makes for happy staff.  Rich flavor and aroma.  A little floral, but good flavor at first sip, sitting in your mouth and at the finish.  Happy staff makes for happy workplace!  Thanks Green Mountain Coffee!
I like STRONG coffee.  This is as close as I have found yet to the bold factor I love!

I found that this coffee was much more BOLDER than the JET FUEL that I had before. If I would have known it was that much stronger I would not have bought it. It is good, I just make the smaller cup and blend it with another flavor ,such as cinnamon. Other than that I like it. I will not buy it again though, it is to bold for my taste buds.

Ok here is the short version, I love a strong cup of coffee but I dont like french roast. So this coffee is strong and has almost no bitter after tase but it does have a french roast taste to it, so if that is what you like try this. Personally I am sticking to Gloria Jean's Coffees, Black Gold Extra Bold, 24-Count K-Cups for Keurig Brewers (Pack of 2).

I personally do not like this coffee.  However my husband loves it because it is very strong.  I like a nice medium cup, so this is not for me.  I tried it once and just could not drink it.  My husband says its a real full bodied coffee.
This was one of the best extra-bold coffees that I have EVER had!  If you like Sumatran Reserve and Dark Magic, you'll like this coffee even more.  I will definately buy more of this!!

If you like a strong cup of coffee, this is it. Some K-cups are kinda weak,( I like mine on the strong side). I don't like french roast or some other types of extra bold if they are gonna have that burnt taste. But this does not. It's just a strong type of coffee. If your like me, you will like it.

column9: GM Double Black Diamond - Pretty good.
column10: One of my concerns with the K-cup brewers is that I wouldn't be able to get a good, strong cup of coffe, which I love.  It has taken a few orders of different varieties to find a strong one that has the right blend of bold, flavor and bitterness.  Green Mountain's Double Black Diamond meets most of that criteria pretty well.  It is a little more on the bitter side than I normally prefer, which I why I only gave 4 stars, but overall a great bold cup of coffee.  I would order this variety again.
I love the bold taste of this coffee. No aftertaste or bitterness. I love the frustration free packaging. And at $0.60 per cup it's a great value for a k-cup!

I like bold k-cups. I don't stick to one type, because I always re-order on Amazon and pricing is always changing on Amazon. I basically just hunt down the best deal on a decent box of bold k-cups each time I re-order. These are good, try them!
I Love All BOLD strong coffees.  I thought I'd try this one.  It had a slight Bitter taste to me. Not my favorite. Wish the variety Bold pack wasn't so much $$$!!  I Love that one!

column9: Green Mountain kcup Black Magic, Black Diamond Extra Bold, Nantucket Blend
column10: I have tried many of the available coffee's available but, I enjoy a robust coffee in the morning and both Black Magic and Black Diamond Extra Bold meet and exceed what I was expecting.  The Nantucket Blend is a great coffee for anytime of day or night.  I usually wait until Amazon has a sale on these to make my purchase...Make sure when you buy k cups that the Amazon Prime logo appears...Without the Amazon Prime Logo, I have found what I received in the past did not reflect what I had ordered.. Substitution get made without your knowledge and sometimes count is short, etc...

If you are a coffee purist, you must give this Double Black Diamond a try.  I like straight up, unadulterated black coffee in the morning - as another reviewer put it - a real "kick in the (@$!"  Well this coffee delivers. The aroma is enticing and from the first sip you will probably be hooked.  Give 'er a try if you're a bold coffee kind of person. I don't think you'll be disappointed.
Excellent and no bitter! I tried 5 different and finally found the best! Other coffees taste like water and you cannot taste the coffee but this one is not strong just perfect to enjoy!

My husband has done nothing but complain since I purchased our Kurig,he did not like any of the coffee until I purchased the Green Mountain Double Black Diamond. He really likes it as it has bold flavor and no watery taste. As for myself, I prefer milder coffee, I can even reuse the Double Black Diamond for myself. But my real favorite is the Lake and Lodge.

I drink all kinds of different kcups during the weekday including the ones I create myself. But on the weekends I have the ultimate treat for myself with the double black diamond. It is my favorite of all the kcups!!!!!  I love the value of the 96 count box. It fits my budget very well.

So I got this for my new CoffeeMaker Keurig but this coffee, especially by Green Mountain, REALLY let me down.This doesnt taste like coffee. It's a very peculiar taste and I cannot put my finger on it...but I bought 24 k-cups and I just threw them out. The taste wasn't worth keeping around.

column9: Husband loves wife not so much
column10: My husband loves this coffee, he likes stronger coffee than I do. He says that it is very good and it must be so because he keeps on ordering it. I don't like it as much but only because I prefer a tad bit lighter brew. Amazon has the best price so far.
very happy with product. It was shipped right away. When it arrived it was in great shape. Nice and fresh tasting . I appreciated the fact I could get this in 96 kcup size.

Bought a Keurig for times when a single cup of coffee is all that is needed.  What I had not anticipated was that my husband was underwhelmed with the assortment of coffees that came with the brewer... until I found the Double Black Diamond Extra Bold. Now my Keurig is being used for afternoon coffee breaks and I don't feel like my "investment" is headed to a yard sale/thrift shop anytime soon.  If you are a lover of stronger, premium coffee, this may be exactly what you are looking for when a pot of coffee is simply too much for one.

I've tried several varities of Green Mountain K-cups of coffee.  Without a doubt this is the best.  Over the years I had coffee many places in the world but the Double Black Diamond is amoung the best.  I highly recommend if you like a strong cup of coffee without being bitter.

I ordered this K-Cup coffee on the favorable reviews of others.  But  - taste is subjective and this particular flavor of coffee has not made any impression on me.  It's not horrible - it's simply average and it hasn't captured my attention.  Because of that --- when I finish the last pod --- I will not re-order it.
Great taste, great value, like how the containers fit in cabinets and has easy access, the flavor is what will continue to keep me coming back
rich strong bold tasting coffee in the morning is what you like than this one is for you. if not than don't buy it.
We like as bold a coffee we can get without it being bitter. This is the one! It is bolder than Dark magic, the one we were drinking.

This is one of my favorite K-Cups, and over the last several months I've sampled pretty much all the "extra bold" ones I can find. This one is very dark and strong without being too bitter (although I don't mind a little bit of bitterness in mine). They are similar to the Green Mountain "Dark Magic" variety, but I find that they are stronger, and perhaps a little more bitter. For reference, my favorite K-Cup is the Starbucks French Roast variety, but I also really like this kind, Green Mountain Dark Magic, and Emeril's Big Easy Bold.

My husband hasn't been able to find a K-cup bold enough for his taste.  I bought the Double Black Diamond after comparing reviews for the various brands and blends.  We have not been disappointed.This has a french roast taste, which is a favorite of his but not usually a favorite of mine. The coffee is not bitter nor does the coffee taste burnt.  Pretty decent on days where I want something with more of a punch.I am glad this is the brand/blend that I chose.  I probably won't be experimenting with the K-cup bold blends. This one works for us.
This coffee is very good. Has a nice rich flavor! Doesn't have a watered down taste at all. The keurig coffee by green mountain is a good true cup of coffee.
Double Black Diamond is a strong cop of joe. I'm not a morning person, but this DBD coffee gets me going at 5:30 AM. The delivery was on-time. What's not to like?

I like coffee strong.  I want full flavor and I will live with a hint of bitterness to up the coffee strength.  Double Black Diamond is getting there, but it's still a touch weaker than I prefer.  Green Mountain's Dark Magic, or Sumatra Reserve, go a little darker and deeper and are, in my estimation, the five-star K-cups.  This one's close, but still not on the target.

I've tried lots of different coffees in my Kuerig brewer located in my office.  I like strong coffee, but it also has to be smooth.  Some of the stronger coffees tend to be bitter, but at least for me the double black diamond is smooth and tasteful.  While I drink some other flavors just for variety, this is by far my favorite for that first cup in the morning.

Love the full-bodied flavor of this coffee!  I figure if you can see through your coffee at all, it's not strong enough, but then I am prone to that in most things. This coffee is smooth, rich, and ready to rock, which suits me fine first thing in the morning (lark, not owl).

Until I tried Double Black Mountain, Starbuck's Sumatra was my favorite coffee--no more.  This is a wonderfully bold coffee without bitterness. It makes a great mocha.  I look forward to my daily 'fix."

I was looking for a really bold coffee to compete with the typical Starbucks brands and this is it!  I love this coffee and think it tastes great!  If you love coffee as much as I do and enjoy a very bold flavor then this is the cup for you!  I have already ordered a box for a neighbor that loved it as well and placed an order for a 2nd box for myself!
I really like the double black diamond, nice strong cup of coffee. I have purchased this coffee 3 other times from Amazon they continue to have the best price per cup.

My original review was 1 star because I believe that I got a bad batch. I kept trying it and finally it started tasting good. It is the strongest K Kup on the market. With every other bold-strong coffee that I used to buy, I needed to use the 4oz setting on my Keurig or else it would be too weak. With this brand I can use the middle setting  (8oz) and it is still strong enough for me. Actually this saves money. Be warned, if you do not like strong coffee you will need to use the highest level on your Keurig or you will think it is too strong. If you want the strongest, this is the one you need to get.

This is how I love coffee, full of rich flavor! I drink one of these in the morning and I'm good. If you are not into strong coffee, you may not like, but for those of us who really like that intense coffee flavor, this is the one! It is also very smooth, I normally use cream and sugar but with this one, sometimes I do without, its that good.

we have tried many kcups and most are not as good as traditionally brewed coffee. This coffee is rich and has good body; it's not a watered down thin cup of coffee. I like a bold cup of coffee and this one fits my requirement. My favorite Caribou Mahogany Blend and Jet Fuel is a little less bold but still good.

I love my Keurig coffee maker.  I like the different coffee flavors and the easy way of just making one cup at a time.  sometimes you have friends over and everyone likes something different.  With the Keurig, they make whatever type coffee they want.  Amazon delivered my k-cups fast and easy.  I was able to pay with Pay Pal and I feel assured my transaction will take place safely.

This is probably the best K-Cup coffee I've had thus far, and I've tried about a dozen flavors. The Double Black Diamond has a wonderful aroma, and it tastes like French Roast on steroids. If you like a really full-bodied coffee, the Double Black Diamond is for you, but beware, it could grow hair on a cue ball.

If you have one of the carnival or theatre kettle style popcorn poppers you are gonna love it. You will swear you eating your favorite "movie theatre" popcorn.If you are like me and you've always loved popcorn, but never really had a easy way to cook it and have it taste like real movie theatre popcorn, then this is for you. As a kid we had all different type of poppers; an old aluminum pot that sat on a electric burner, one of Mom's older pots with a non-stick surface, the plastic cone looking things to use with a microwave.... still none of them gave us the taste and smell of movie theatre popcorn.I finally broke down and bought a kettle style popper. Most importantly I found the "Mega-Pop" popcorn packages. Each package container just the right amount of corn, cooking oil and popcorn salt to make the best tasting popcorn you've ever eaten !Now you say, "I can't afford a kettle style popper",  no problem. If it is just me here, I snip the top of each container and pour about half of each item into a pot with a non-stick surface, cover the pop and shake the pot 'til it is done popping. Put the corn in a bowl, bag or basket and sprinkle with popcorn salt.... goes great watching a movie, college football game - whatever.
If you are looking for the same popcorn they sell at the movie theaters this is the one. I use this one with my Gold Medal popcorn maker. Big hit with friends and family.
The popcorn is taste great. The package has has everything to make the popcorn. Thats why I'm buying it again. Im a very happy customer.

I have a few UK friends who mentioned having a Twirl and suggested I try one. I am so glad I did! I cannot say what makes this chocolate better than the chocolate bars available in my part of the world but I really wish I could get these regularly.

Twirl chocolate candy bar tastes and feels pretty much like Nestle Aero Milk Chocolate Bar, 1.6-Ounces (Pack of 12) and Cadbury Flake Chocolate Bars, 6-Count.  `They're all made of cheap mainstream chocolate but they're designed to be thin and flaky or have airbubbles such that you're not eating a thick dense boulder of chunky chocolate that's hard to bite into and instead eating something that melts in your mouth.  I would rather buy these types of chocolates than the US mainstream cheap chocolates just because of how they're designed.  However, they're not as good as the premium chocolates that use more expensive chocolate ingredients.

column9: OPPS!!  Not the same as the True Lemon in envelopes
column10: This True Lemon is not the same as the True Lemon that is sold in the single serving envelope.  It does not have the fresh Lemon flavor that the envelopes have.  The envelopes are labeled for use in water, teas & recipes.  The large jar is labeled for cooking, baking, & seasoning.  I called the manufacturer and they said the true lemon is different in the jar because it is designed to survive the heat of cooking and baking.  If you want the taste of fresh Lemon for beverages, you have to use the True Lemon in envelopes.

True Lemon almost makes the lemon obsolete.  The taste is exactly right, every time- from lemonade to fish to green beans.  The only thing missing is the pulp. The product comes in a little sugar-like bag for individual servings, but the shaker is the way to go when you are standing in front of the stove.  This is crystal stuff doesn't spoil or "go bad" like liquid lemon substitutes. The package says Cold Pressed and Crystallized Lemon.  Ingredients: Citric acid, evaporated cane juice (a bulking agent), lemon juice, lemon oil and ascorbic acid (vitamin C).  It is the real thing, always at hand. Great stuff, wonderful stuff. Life just got a little better.

Sorry Sicilia. I loved and bought your lemon product for years but happened to try True Lemon and it is superior. I drink lots of brewed ice tea and this product taste just like real fresh lemon and is easy to use.

We chanced upon True Lemon somewhere a LONG time ago and once it was all gone we were so disappointed when we couldn't find it anywhere.  I was so excited when I found it at Amazon.com.  I ordered a BIG bottle that day and we have been SO happy to have it in the house again.  We use it on SO many things!

This product is simple - if you like True Lemon, you will like this shaker. For those of you who do not know what True Lemon is picture this: if you always order a lemon with your water at the restaurant, you will probably love this too. True Lemon is crystallized lemon so it has a sugar type consistency. Just a few shakes into your water, stir, and it tastes just like you squeezed a fresh lemon in your water. I used to get the individual packets for water bottles, but they are not ideal for just a glass of water. My friend had the shaker at her house and I loved it, so I decided to look into it. Couldn't find it in stores so to Amazon I went. It says its for cooking but no worries, works for water just fine. The size of the bottle was bigger than I expected as well. If you got the individual packets and found that they got clumpy after some time, don't be weary because so far this product has not done that.Overall - great product. No complaints what-so-ever :)
no calories tastes like the real thing, works great with stevia, a a a a a a a a a a a a a

good stuff.. Use on salads. sprinkle on cut portion of an avacado to keep the green color & enhance iced tea.

column10: The tiny rose buds do not smell like roses and the tea does not have the rose taste. I bought 3 different rose teas, and the other two smell and taste like rose, but this one doesn't. I used it by itself, in combination with other herbs, but it does not make a difference. I'm not sure why these tiny roses don't have the flavor. I do not recommend it for tea.
The price was great for the product I recieved. The package was attractive and the buds smelled great. We feed rose buds to our pet chinchilla and she approves of this brand!

This was a great deal- it is difficult to find this particular choice in most of our grocery stores and in the few that offer it.....each box is priced at nearly $4.00. This was a good deal overall- shipment was quick and packaged nicely. We are really satisfied and the dinner is great. We cooked it with ground turkey and added peas.....easy and the kids are happy too!

column9: If not for Annie, I'd starve!
column10: I love many of Annie's products, but of all the skillet dinners, this one is my favorite. :) This particular dinner is made even better by the substitution of one can of low sodium V8 for part of the water that is called for in the directions. It gives this skillet more of a "tomatoey", pasta sauce flavor, and adds a little extra zip. It also seems that a full pound of ground beef is a bit much, so I only use half a pound. One word of warning though, this particular flavor is downright inedible when prepared with ground turkey. All in all, a tasty, quick dinner that even the domestically challenged such as myself can pull off!

We love the national brand but don't like the MSG in it.  So, we were very excited to try this.  It is okay and we were happy to find it.  It takes a couple of minutes longer to thicken than the national brand.  We aren't happy enough with it to buy it again.

Being a fan of Annie's products, I bought the 6 pack never having tried this product and, actually, never having tried a "skillet meal" at all.  It's easy to prepare and fine for a quick weeknight dinner for two, but it tastes nothing like lasagna.  It's more of a cheesey, ground beef noodle casserole.

column9: Great product .... try adding these ingredients
column10: We love this product and eat it almost every week, but I've amended the recipe on the box to make it better.I start by sauteing a chopped onion in some olive oil. Then, I add a package of veggie crumbles until it is cooked. I substitute tomato juice for the water and cook according to directions. If you are using canned juice and it seems too thick, you can water it down (maybe one cup juice and one cup water). Sometimes I will mix-in some shredded cheese once it is done. I think that the tomato juice really helps this meal along and gives it a great flavor. I've also used canned petite diced tomatoes instead of the juice with good results as well.

I was excited to try this from Annie's. I love some of the other items they have and was expecting that quality. My experience was only so-so. This kit is called Cheesy Lasagna and the picture on the box certainly seemed to fit the bill. What I got was something brown and not really cheesy. It tasted okay but I agree with another reviewer and would consider this more of a hamburger dish. I'll continue to try some of the other Annie's products but I will not purchase this one again.

column9: my 1 year old eats 2 servings every time!

This product was hard to find at my local grocery store.  I love using it to stir fry vegetables and meat. It is wonderful!

Yeah i have to agree i don't know where these one stars are coming from.  All i have to say about Blue Sky is best Soda EVA....I mean u get the nice cola flavor but it takes better natural, its really good.  I now hate coke.
