(if you go to penn state sisu at west has it)  Its delicious.
It is Captain & Coke season, and this cola is the BEST.  It is a real treat.  Now I only have to feel guilty about the alcohol, rather than the alcohol plus the High Fructose Corn Syrup!

Don't know what the other reviewers are drinking but this soda is great. Love the Cola and Dr. Becker's (like Dr. Pepper, a little different and without the cloying sweetness). It doesn't have the fizz of say Pepsi, but neither does Coke. And I love a good fizzy soda, and this has enough fizz for me and great taste. It's hard to find where I live, and the only store selling it just closed, so I'm moving to buying it on-line, that's how much I like it.

column9: Yum!!! Real Sugar and you can tell it!
column10: Blue Sky Cola has a great refreshing taste with real sugar.  No after taste left in your mouth.  It doesn't taste like Pepsi Throw back where you get a heavy flat taste. The taste is crisp and the product sparkles in the glass.  If you are a rum drinker that likes to use a COLA mixer every now and then, this is the one!

column9: After a lifetime of Cola drinking a winner to the war of Cola!!!
column10: Grew up drinking Coke and the occasional Pepsi. Cola was always my favorite drink and I stopped drinking it due to the caffeine, until I found Blue Sky. This stuff is perfect. It has everything Coke or Pepsi had going for them without the bitter hit of Coke and the sickly thin sweetness of Pepsi. I empty my local stores stock every time they stock it.Incidentally I also love Blue Sky Root Beer and Cherry Vanilla Creme. But their New Century Cola is a little too heavy with the molasses (they must use a darker sugar for it) for my taste.

I quit caffeine in 1999.  I went organic/ natural at about the same time.  I went for years without a soda.  There was no soda made that did not have offending ingredients.  As soon as I saw these on the shelf of my local Fred Meyer I got them.  Wonderful taste.  Tastes just like my memory of a cola, but with no caffeine or HFCS, preservatives or artificial flavors or colors.  All natural, made from sugar and cola nut, with no GMO ingredients.  I have tried a few flavors and my favorites are the cola (haven't tried the new century organic one yet) and the vanilla cherry creme.
I enjoy  Hanens soda but Blue Sky is not for me. I tried 2 varieties, so I suspect it is just the brand. No fault with the ingredients but why bother with soda if  it tastes flat?

Nowhere in the description does it even imply that this is caffeine free. This is clearly deceptive. The thought didn't even cross my mind that this could be possible -- without it being explicitly stated somewhere. I don't have anything directly against caffeine free cola-like beverages, but I strongly feel like they should be clearly labeled -- as one would expect alcohol free beer or meat-free lunch meat to be.

This is the perfect snack food to keep in your purse, office and car.  It's really low cal and high protein, so you don't have to feel guilty.I would give it 5 stars but it is a bit dry and chewy, that aspect could be improved upon.  Still, I just ordered a bunch more and it's my favourite snack.

column9: Pretty good, but a little too dry.
column10: This stuff is pretty good, but kind of dry, giving a leathery texture---thus 4 stars instead of 5.  A little bit of moisture would have gone a long way, and I'm experimenting with rehydrating them by putting a piece of lettuce in the bag overnight (in the fridge).  The results have been inconclusive as to whether this helps, with two of us having a split decision.  The teriyaki flavor is perfect...not too salty as I expected, and the taste, if rated separately gets 5 stars.

I ordered an 8 pack of this jerkey to try and stay range grown and healthy in my eating, but when I got it, it was a disaster!First, I only got one of the 8 packs I was paying for.  I can't fault this  jerky, but Amazon's shipping folk for that.  However, the bag had jerky in it that had a strange gray fungus growing on it!I was told this was good jerkey, but I guess I'll never know now.  I may have gotten a very rare moldy pack, but I'll shy away from this stuff.

Snackmasters manufactures great turkey jerky. From what I've read this company was the original creator of the turkey jerky, so I decided to try and I have not been disappointed.  The turkey jerky is full of flavor and also very healthy!
I just finished an 8 pack I ordered and just wanted to say this is the best jerky on the market. It has great flavor and it's very healthy. I definitely recommend!!

I love SnackMasters' turkey jerky, so I naturally decided to try natural turkey jerky.  This turkey jerky is the same (or better) quality as the regular variety, but too dry.  I would recomend SnackMasters Turkey Jerky, Teriyaki, instead
This is the best jerky I've ever eaten and makes a great snack for travel.

This jerky is fantastic.  I'm somewhat of a jerky fanatic, and I've tried many kinds of jerky.  This one is awesome and you wouldn't know it was Turkey if you ate it and no one told you.  Highly recommended...

My fiancee and I have been missing this product since they discontinued it at Trader Joe's.  I could not be happier to find it here.  It is the best-tasting, best texture beef jerky on the market.  And it doesn't have any ingredients you can't pronounce.  The best.
Best beef jerky on the market. I've been buying  snackmasters  brand since it was being sold at Costco  and I've never been disappointed. Always fresh and healthy snack.

column9: If you love cajun foods, this is for you!
column10: I use all of the New Orleans Gourmet products, especially the beans--love the seasonings--being a lazy senior citizen, after washing the beans I simply spray the crockpot with Pam, add the water, the beans (don't even soak them), the seasonings and turn the crockpot on high for four hours and then reduce the heat to low and cook until desired tenderness. If you are adding chicken or sausage, don't add it until the end of the cooking period.  Then just make some Southern Style Cornbread and enjoy.

I purchased a case of this in February for my husband. He has been eating oatmeal every  morning for the past 5 years, and declared this to be the best he's ever tried. Taste and texture are much better than anything we've had before. Great Product.

I am not finding Libby's veggies as good as I remembered them.  I am probably spoiled by the Organic and natural and more expensive brands I have been using because they are healthier.  These came in dented cans.  They are small, overcooked and soft but work ok when added to previously cooked soup or stew and just heated.
i own a croc pot and use it often. a variety of vegetables like this are combined to produce a good meal. i pour a few cans together, turn the heat on and am ready to eat.
Order arrived much sooner than expected. Cans along the outside edge were pretty banged up but still usable. Overall a good product.
8 out of 12 cans damaged. Try smaller packaging, please!  Hope these cans open at the bottom. I had just received green peas the previous day and they were packaged better and no cans were dented.
When you are hungry for some small green Lima beans, these will satisfy your hunger.  We like them a lot. will  keep ordering.

column4: C. Lane "Be the change you want to see in the...
column10: I love lima beans but these are a little off for some reason. Maybe because I'm used to frozen and its the taste of the can? I will go back to the frozen or dried. At least these are not lined with the BPH plastic that leaches into your food!

Libby on the label means good food on my table. Great price really good service what more could you say. No dents in can fast and free shipping. Really good lima beans, These are hard to find in stores.
Items received were not Necco Conversation Sweethearts but were Necco Sweethearts.  Vendor yells at me that these are the same, they are not.  Bad flavor, bad after taste

This coffee would be great, but they added unneccessary chemical flavors and chemical sweeteners. Hazlenuts are great on their own! People should be able to enjoy the flavor and add their own sweeteners as they like. I can't drink it for this reason. I can't imagine what Nestle was thinking.
too bad they dont deliver to hawaii where the honey is from.  i had to order this then mail it to my famly in hawaii.  i live in bay area!
This pasta had somewhat of a gritty like taste/texture once it was cooked. I know its healthier for me but not sure if I will buy it again
sold at Java City outlets in Sacramento, CA blended with ice, this juice makes a wonderful smoothie.  If you like the acai berry flavor, you will love this juice blend!

Yes it's sticky. It's natural tree sap with natural flavoring. It's gum the way it was a century ago. They look and feel like the old Chicklets gum---not in sticks but in sugar encased tabs or whatever you would call them. Now that Wrigley's gum has gone all artificial, this is the only game in town.

column4: Erin Nypaver ""Why is the rum gone?""
column10: This is the best aspartame-free gum on the market!!! It was so hard finding a gum that didn't contain dangerous chemicals and artificial ingredients. This is it! The only downside is that people with fillings in their teeth may have trouble enjoying the gum due to the sticky texture.

column9: Yes - very sticky on dental work.
column10: Like at least one of the other reviewers, I also had severe problems with the gum sticking to my dental work. I found this gum to be impossible to chew because I have ONE crown on a molar.  The entire piece of gum stayed solidly stuck to the crown the whole time I was trying to chew it, forming a gum-coating on that one tooth.  I am sure that I can find someone to take this pack off my hands, but unfortunately, this one piece has been enough for me.  Other than that one issue, the gum seemed good and I think it would have been ok if I didnt have a crown.  :(

I was so excited when I found this gum today at a store, I had read about it and generally avoid gum because of all the crap in it.  At first I was pretty impressed with the gum, I actually understood the ingredients and it tasted pretty fresh.  Soon I noticed I couldn't move it around in my mouth because it kept getting stuck on my molars.  Within about 5 minutes, with two pieces, the flavor was gone and my jaw was hurting from fighting to get it off of my teeth.  Still, I would chew it when I am desperate for gum because the flavor is good at first and at least it isn't full of crap!

I've found chewing three pieces at once, and consciously keeping the chicle in a manageable wad in my mouth, will help avoid sticking to areas of dental interest.I highly prefer chewing natural chicle to Frankengums. We'd all be better off if people chewed Glee, a great sustainable product that does not leave black circles all over the sidewalk.

column9: No Soy!  (except in the peppermint gum)
column10: Our main reason for experimenting with Glee Gum is that it seems to be the only gum on the market that is soy-free.  With soy allergies at an all-time high, and a major allergen in our own family, this gum is a welcome discovery.  The flavor does drop off faster than the artificial gums, but I haven't had any issues with it sticking to my teeth or dental work.  I have crowns and fillings, and I have no complaints at all.

column9: A Decent Attempt to Bring Back Classic Gum
column10: For most of my life I loved chewing gum until the all the major companies started using artificial and unhealthy ingredients like artificial high-intensity sweeteners and sugar alcohols.  I was always on the hunt for a company that used natural flavorings and sweeteners.  When I recently found Glee Gum, the joy of chewing gum returned.  It's not perfect, but it's the best alternative on the market for people concerned about what they put in their bodies.  It's a good start, but hopefully the company will focus on producing a product whose flavor lasts longer and which stays soft longer.  As pointed out by another reviewer, if you're having problems with the gum sticking to teeth, try chewing 2 or 3 pieces at a time.  Half my mouth are caps, crowns, and bridges and I don't have a problem chewing this gum.

column4: Peace Love & Happiness "In a world of deceit,...
column9: ALL NATURAL gum that lasts and lasts!!! and even tastes good!
column10: Unlike the other reviewer, I don't have problems with the gum sticking to my teeth.  Maybe their mouth was abnormally dry?  It has just the right amount of softness and I just love the taste and how long it lasts. The taste is not overbearing like many of the chemically laden gums.  I was trying to find a gum without all the fake sugars like all the rest have, that tasted good as well.  This is by far the best I have found. I have bought several cases of this stuff. Buy it and you will see.  Great taste without all the chemicals of other gums!!

column9: Glee will leave you in a sticky situation.
column10: I initially purchased this because I wanted to try a gum that did not contain Phenylalanine.  The packaging of Glee Gum sorta reminds me of a box of chicle tab gum.  The price and flavor of the gum is pretty good, however I had a few issues:1. This gum WILL stick to your teeth!  It has stuck to my teeth each time I've chewed it. My friends have tried this gum and have complained about it sticking to their teeth, too.  It was difficult to remove from my back molars.  I eventually had to brush my teeth to remove all traces of gum from my mouth.2. The flavor doesn't last as long as I hoped, so I wound up going through the entire package rather quickly.

I read all the reviews about it sticking to dental work, but that hasn't been a problem for me. And I have a crown over a molar and several fillings. Maybe it depends on the type of filling/materials used? The flavor doesn't last very long, that's a bit disappointing, but I like the texture of the chew. It works for me!
I was lucky not to actually buy this gum - but I was given a pack about an hour ago - tried the gum and have to say it sticks to my teeth!!  Just thought I'd share with anyone interested in buying...

column9: Depends on why you chew gum
column10: I guess it depends on why you chew gum as to whether you will like Glee gum or not.  I bought my first pack today because I had read an article about it recently.  The texture is good and I don't have an issue with it sticking to any dental work but the flavor [tangerine] was gone in 5 minutes.  I chew gum to freshen my breath and give me a low cal sweet treat.  Glee gum just doesn't meet my needs.  If they could make the flavor last longer, it would be great.  Until then, this is probably the one and only box of Glee gum that I will buy.

Check the ingredients. It's basically non-dairy creamer. Vanilla is the third to last ingredient, sugar and partially hydrogenated soybean oil comprise the bulk of the product.You would think a product advertised as "Madagascar Vanilla Bean Powder" would be...well, vanilla bean powder. Not the case, unfortunately.

column9: MOCAFE Madagascar Vanilla Bean powder for smoothies & lattes
column10: I ordered this product to add to my coffee and lattes to add some sweetness and real vanilla flavor and am very happy with this product. I also added to a berry smoothie and it was delicious! It was a bit expensive but I'm assuming the 3lb bag will last me quite awhile. I will definitely order it again!

column9: This is good for smoothies and coffee drinks
column10: This powder boosts the creamy factor and vanilla flavor in blended drinks of all kinds; milkshakes, smoothies, coffee drinks -- I have even used it in pina coladas and WOW it is good.  It may have some ingredients that are probably not that great for you, but I do not drink it everyday and consider it a treat.  I have a vitamix and usually blend just fruits and veg together every morning by themselves, but treats in moderation are fine in my book.This powder has also saved my bacon a few times when we were out of milk for the coffee and didn't want to leave the house un-caffeinated. It is very versatile and the 3 pound bag lasts a long time, perfect to store in an airtight jar in the pantry for when you need it.I bought this at a restaurant supply store, not on amazon, and paid full price compared to what it is listed for on here.  I will subscribe to this on amazon when we use up our current supply and save almost 10 bucks a bag!PS:Its title does not say "pure vanilla powder," it says it is for smoothies, so why are people mad they got smoothie mix/enhancer? Also, pure vanilla powder is about $1.35 an ounce on a good day, and this smoothie powder is 41 cents an ounce, so if this were actually a 3 pound bag of pure vanilla powder it should cost around $60 on sale.  Moral of the story: Just read the product description & ingredients list before ordering.

Ingredients list is full of garbage. Shouldn't even have an ingredients list. Should be JUST vanilla bean powder, but instead there's a significant portion of the label just listing all the non-food junk inside.

This stuff in not NON DAIRY as it says in the description.  I bought this to replace the one I was using for my CBTL milk frother. It is disgusting.  I wouldn't even want it with a smoothie.  It tastes like powder coffee mate and the sad thing is I think the coffee mate brand tastes better!

Although this is prominently named Madagascar Vanilla Bean Powder, there is hardly any vanilla bean in it! Lots of sugar, sweeteners, non-dairy creamer and artificial ingredients, though. I wish I hadn't ordered it, and haven't opened it. I'd return it if it were eligible for returns. Anyone want mine?

When I placed my order,this product was listed as Vanilla Bean Powder.  I was dissapointed when I received Vanilla Bean Powder Smoothie Mix. I sent an online request for my Vanilla Bean Powder & I received a second shipment for Vanilla Bean Powder Smoothie Mix.  I am still waiting for a reply on where to send the two shipments back & get a refund on my credit card for this mix up.

column9: You should always know what you are ordering!
column10: This Vanilla Bean Powder is absolutely wonderful.  The only problem I have with it is the price.  Apparently others who have reviewed this item didn't know what they were getting.  It is designed to enhance the flavor of fruit smoothies.  And it does to great of a job at it (I use to much, it is so good).  When you add a few tablespoons to a blender of fruit and ice it transforms the ingredients into something wonderful.  Many independent coffee shops use this to make their smoothies.  This product was not originally even available to the general public for purchase.  It was sold in bulk to coffee shops.  I worked for a Mocafe distributer in Denver for several years and got hooked.  I will repeat:  This item is designed to be a flavor enhancer not a stand alone item in a drink.Granted, if you don't want sugar, you need to look elsewhere.  This stuff is loaded with it.

The title says it's Vanilla Bean Powder, but it is not. As mentioned in previous 1-star reviews, it is basically dairy creamer with vanilla flavoring (the most faint tasting vanilla I've tasted in a long time!). The package in the picture is not the same package you recieve. The package received has a different label, one that more adequitely and accurately depicts the product's TRUE main ingreedients.For what I needed it for (soy vanilla bean frap), it was okay, just not what I was expecting as a customer. I was looking for ACTUAL powdered vanilla beans, and the way it was worded (AND the vanilla bean pictured on the bag online) in this ad makes it sound like that's what is being sold. I would've given it a 1-star had I not been able to use the product in another fashion, but I was.1 star for the misleading wording, and 1 star for the happenstance of being able to use it in another fashion = 2 stars.

I've run across some old recipes that call for powdered vanilla.  I Googled powdered vanilla and came here 'cause this was the first entry.  Because people have been honest about the fact that this product is NOT powdered vanilla but some cheap-but-costly fake stuff, I'm not only NOT going to buy this, I'm NOT going to buy food items from Amazon.com.  Moving on in my search.  THANK YOU for taking the time to write and saving me from the same disappointment you must have felt.

Do NOT order this stuff.  I have ordered the VANILLA BEAN POWDER twice now and gotta VANILLA SMOOTHIE MIX both times!  The 2nd order was supposed to be the replacement for the incorrect 1st shipment.  NOPE, they sent the same stupid incorrect item.  Definitely getting a refund.  I didn't want Smoothie Mix, I wanted Vanilla Bean Powder!

I won't bore you with my (literally) award-winning chili recipe, but McCormick's Mexican Style Chili Powder is the most important part. There is NO substitute.  I have never had or made better chili, and - no kidding - I have won chili cook-offs.  If you think you might like it, try it.

I have used the product previously. I ordered this spice from Amazon. It is excellent for stews and chili.  The flavor is outstanding.  It is easily incorporated into the dish, enhancing the flavor.  It gives chili a spicy flavor without being a firey-hot sensation to the palate. It is especially an excellent season for meatless dishes, giving the dish a special flavor that enables those who usually eat meat to enjoy the dish without it.  I would highly recommend the product.

I will start by saying I can't drink anything else made by Crystal Light since artificial sweeteners disagree with me. So I was hesitant to try this, but with the disclaimers I decided to go for it.I must say that this is a very satisfying drink and solved my quest to get away from the more expensive drinks and sodas. Crystal light sure has scored a hit with a new, tasty drink with this one.My picky kids like it also, and that says a lot.

I bought this because I don't like artificial sweeteners-I get migraines with them.  I think this stuff is exceptionally sweet-I've only tried the grape.  My 5 year old son loves it and will now ask for "grape water" and not so much chocolate milk.
Tart? Yes, I guess it is tart--like a lemonade might be. But, my entire family LOVES it! It is very refreshing and I love that it has NO artificial sweeteners.

I'm trying to cut out soda and aspartame and so tried this as a substitute. Yesterday was my first day. I had 16 oz in the morning, and plain water for lunch. In the afternoon I made another 16oz bottle.By 2pm I was starting to get a headache. This was probably from caffeine withdrawal. I made another 16oz around 2:30 and could only drink half of it. I started to grow incredibly nauseous and had the flavor in my mouth like I get when I have too much diet soda. The headache intensified as well.I'm having the headache today as well so I blame the headache on the caffeine withdrawal, but the nausea and the overdosed soda flavor I blame on the Crystal Light Pure. I'm not feeling nauseous today and I've had no Crystal Light Pure.Drink this in moderation. Don't be like me and drink it all day. The flavor was excellent, if it weren't for the nausea I'd rate it 5 stars. But the awful feeling I got killed it.UPDATE 6/28/2012I decided to give it another shot with the Lemonade flavor, unrelated to any caffeine ceasing. I added the packet to a 24oz bottle of water and I drank probably 6oz and started to feel nauseous. A quick google search reveals that vomiting, nausea, and diarrhea are common side effects of truvia/stevia based sweeteners. It's likely an allergy, where it will be fine for some people, but troublesome for others. WiseGeek has a particularly helpful article detailing the side effects. Give this guy a shot, but monitor your symptoms. I really wish Crystal Light would just product a low sugar version - I don't need it to be so sweet, just a touch of sweetener to add interest.

column9: Thoroughly enjoyable fitness drink at a reasonable price!
column10: I don't usually like to spend money on fitness drinks, but I've really enjoyed Crystal Light Pure Fitness.  The grape flavor is refreshing, and the mix of electrolytes really do help you bounce back and rehydrate after a workout.  It's also a good subsitute for soda if you're trying to wean your family off sugary drinks!  Plus, the individual packaging is really sturdy, so you can toss a packet in your purse, briefcase, or bookbag, and not worry about spilling powder all over your belongings.  I would definitely recommend Crystal Light Pure Fitness to others -- my family's hooked!

I received a free sample in with an order I'd placed on line, and thought "why not try it?"  Only 15 calories and NO artificial sweeteners, flavors or preservatives. OH MY. I'm hooked.  The grape flavor isn't weak like Kool-aid; it's just right. Not too tart, not too sweet.  This product also has electrolytes in it, so it will help keep my hydrated when I work out.

column9: Love this!  More natural than most!
column10: Great grape candy taste without artifical flavors, sweeteners and colors.  THANK YOU CRYSTAL LIGHT!  Create more flavors like this!

I've tried to drink my 8 glasses of water for years without success, but not so now that I have this super yummy drink.I'm not a health food fanatic but I do try to avoid artificial colors and sweeteners (especially colors)Yes, it tastes like grape gum...yes, it has a LITTLE sugar in it so the Stevia isn't too bitter and astringent, so diabetics beware, but the calories are so low they don't affect my daily goals for weight loss.I feel good giving it to my 5 year old.I've tried all three flavors and I like the grape the best.  The Kiwi was to tart and the Lemon I just didn't care for.

I'm already Crystal Light fan, but, I received a sample of the grape Pure Fitness. It is yummy! I don't mind consuming artificial sweeteners, but I don't want my 2 year old daughter to have them. So, this is a great alternative to plain water. She loves it too! We live in Arizona and the added electrolytes is definitely a plus. There's only 3 grams of sugar per serving, which is much lower than the other fitness drinks out there.

column9: FINALLY!! A sports drink without corn syrup or artificial sweeteners!
column10: Positives:* Doesn't use artificial sweeteners or corn syrup* Affordable - this costs so much less than buying Gatorade or Powerade!* Better for you! Lower in calories than the more popular sports drinks.* Tastes good as far as I'm concerned. I like it better than the other sports drinks I've tried. Tastes like regular Crystal Light from what I remember.* Doesn't require you to purchase plastic bottle after plastic bottle of product, thus reducing your carbon footprint! BONUS!* Not much packaging and it's really convenient to carry in your purse if you're a female.Cons:* Yes it does use sugar which kind of sucks, but I find that it does cut the Stevia which can have a bitter taste sometimes. And the amount of sugar used really isn't that high.Tips:* Make sure to read the instructions as I didn't and put the entire packet in a 16.9oz bottle my 1st time. It's very strong when you do this. The packet's intended for 2 servings.* I've gotten used to drinking nothing but water over the years so you could play with this a bit and use more water than they recommend. I use a 33.8oz bottle per packet typically but intend on buying some BPA-free reusable bottles and just keeping them premade in the fridge for a moments notice.

My husband works for Kraft Foods and got a few samples of this and I love it. The grape isn't overwhelmingly sweet (like Sugar Free Koolaid). I also tried the lemon-lime. To me, it is pretty tart but still good.

Didn't taste like grape to me, it tasted more like purple lemonade.  It has a very very faint artificial  'grape' taste, but seriously, if the drink didn't have a slightly purple tint to it and it wasn't labelled as such, you'd probably never suspect it was grape at all.  Now in all fairness, the flavor's not especially bad, but if it's lemonade you're after, why not just buy the Lemon Lime flavored 'Pure Fitness' powder - it's really quite good and as others have also mentioned, it doesn't cause the headaches that aspartame does.

Of all the Crystal Light that I have tried this one is my personal favorite. It is healthy and low in calories. It's not like those zero calorie drink mixes that have an overwhelming taste of fake sweetners. I love this.

I like to work out and loose weight the easiest on a higher protein diet.  i have wasted hundreds of dollars on protein powders until now (i just couldn't stomach them).  i can put a half of a packet in pure protein's grape and it taste great. almost like the grape koolaid i had as a kid.  love this flavor.

column9: Crystal Light On The Go Pure Fitness Grape, 7-Count Boxes (Pack of 6)
column10: My son LOVE grape favor very much, instead of drinking sodas he prefer Crystal Light.  I am hoping that we still can subscribes this products from Amazon.

As a former avid soda drinker, I love this stuff.  I really just can't stand plain water.  I'm off soda, and onto low sugar 30 calories per little pack.  I also won't do artificial sweetners, so all but the crytal light "PURE" products are out.  Stevia is an all natural sweetner.Better yet, rather than mix this with 16 oz as suggested, I mix one packet in a whopping 40oz klean kanteen, and I would say it tastes like a light kool aid.  It's enough to keep me hydrated all day, it's cheaper than soda, its better for me than soda. 10 lbs down with this being pretty much the only change to my daily routine- who can complain about that?
This is a wonderful flavor and very refreshing to drink...but I think that it is too sweet if I use a whole packet, so I divide it between two waters and it is perfect.

column9: Happy with Crystal Light Fitness Grape
column10: Product arrived promptly and as stated in Amazon advertising.  Much less expensive than supermarkets and I like that it has natural ingredients.  Will watch for more like it!

column9: If you're diabetic or on a low-sugar diet (like South Beach), don't buy this!!
column10: For whatever reason, the sugar in this product isn't mentioned in the advertising.  If you check the ingredients, the 1st one listed is evaporated cane juice, which is sugar, although a natural form of it, and sugar (the regular kind) is also listed a few ingredients later.  I was excited about buying this product because I believed it was a Truvia-only sweetened product (which i prefer to artificial sweeteners).However, I definitely won't be purchasing it because it contains sugar and Truvia.  A 70 gram container (a whole box) contains 210 calories - all from sugar.  To some people this may not seem like much, but to others who consume lots of drinks sweetened with Truvia or artificial sweeteners, it can be a problem not knowing about it.If you're diabetic or on a low-glycemic diet, you'd be better off buying unsweetened Kool-aid and adding Truvia to it.  Why the company decided to do this is beyond me - Truvia tastes fine on it's own.Here is the nutrition information for this product from their website:crystal light - fitness drink mix - grape pure fitness on the go 0.31 ozIngredients: EVAPORATED CANE JUICE, CITRIC ACID, MALIC ACID, MALTODEXTRIN, CALCIUM LACTATE, SUGAR, CONTAINS LESS THAN 2% OF NATURAL FLAVOR, REBIANA (TRUVIA BRAND SWEETENER), POTASSIUM CITRATE, MAGNESIUM OXIDE, SODIUM CITRATE, SALT, DRIED PURPLE CARROT EXTRACT AND DRIED HIBISCUS FLOWER EXTRACT (FOR COLOR).[...]
I like the fact that there is no articial sweetners in this, but unless you like something that is really tart, skip this one and get the lemon lime.
This drink mix is a catastrophe. It's horribly bitter even when put in with extra water. Doens't taste anything like grape. This is supposed to be a lightly flavored drink. It's not. Yuck!!!

I tried this because there are no artificial sweeteners, I used to drink a lot of Crystal Light, and I was getting tired of plain water!  The Grape tasted okay, and I tried the Kiwi-Strawberry, which I wasn't crazy about.  I decided to mix them together in a pitcher, 2 grape + 1 kiwi, I love it! Tastes like a not too sweet fruit punch. Try it!

This Grape has a tart flavor on purpose, and at first I thought this had too much tart flavor for my liking; however, after drinking it for awhile, I became to really think this is a refreshing drink.  I like this "Pure Fitness" new line of drinks from Crystal Light; it is a welcome product line that has no artificial sweeteners.  Instead it has a little sugar and natural Stevia plant sweetener (this is better than regular soda for Diabetics, but there is still a little sugar).  I like the Strawberry Kiwi and Lemon-Lime flavors as well.  Since these debuted, this is the only Crystal Light I have been purchasing from now on.
If you like fake grape flavor, you'll love this.  Otherwise, spend your money elsewhere.

My two cats seem to really enjoy this particular kind of treats; both get excited when they see me opening the bag and they also insist upon helping me put the treats on the floor for the enjoyment.  It's at the point where all I need to do is shake the bag throughout the house and they come running.

I feel sure this will not be published, but, pershaps I can vent some of my frustration. I purchased the Goodlife Recipe Cat Treat Formula supplied by Amazon, but sold by Retail Lighting Solutions, Inc. The cost for this one 3 oz. bag of treats was $8.34. Now, I must have had a temporary loss of my mind to pay that for a bag of cat treats. I looked up the company mentioned in this review, all I could see was lights. I really hate being ripped off and that's exactly what I was.I like Amazon and whenever I need something, this is the first place I check out, then Ebay.I will be very aware and sure of what I'm paying in the future. I could go to Walmart and pay $1.50 for just about anything in the cat treat department.NOT A HAPPY CAMPER !!

column9: Pricey, but I love these crackers
column10: I purchased at Sam's for much cheaper & noticed that even the crunchmaster.com site had better pricing.  Have not tried the others yet but the Multi-Grain has a great flavor similar to corn nuts but not as heavy, I could honestly eat a whole bag in one sitting! Great that they are baked and not fried and a perfect snack for Vegans too.

This is a real review from a real person. I was not compensated in any way for making this review, though I wouldn't mind receiving a few boxes of these crackers from TH Foods because I'm always running low!I bought these CrunchMaster crackers randomly one day when they were on sale, and I must say WOW, they are extremely tasty!I've gone back and purchased another box already as I am snacking on them all the time. Just the right balance of saltiness, very crunchy of course, and just overall good taste. Fantastic with medium to strong cheeses. I love how this good taste is found in something that is whole grain and baked.The only downsides I can find is that they are so easy to snack on, I keep having to go back and purchase more. They are becoming a permanent fixture on my grocery list.Highly recommended.

column9: The best crackers I have EVER eaten
column10: These crackers are AMAZING.  I tried them as a free sample, topped with a small piece of brie cheese, at a Sam's Club store.  I expected them to taste like any other multigrain cracker, but was blown away by how good the sample was.  I immediately bought a box, and literally crave and look forward to eating them, which is not something I thought I would ever say about a cracker.Saying that they taste like corn nuts, as the previous reviewer did, might turn some people off.  They're not really like corn nuts, but they have a pleasant savory non-wheat grain/seed flavor, as do corn nuts.  The base is brown rice meal, which is mixed with a variety of seeds (sesame, quinoa, amaranth, flax) and tamari soy sauce powder.  The soy sauce is almost imperceptible and complements the other flavors well - it gives the cracker just a slight savory flavor, not a noticeable "soy sauce" flavor.  Other multigrain crackers, even high quality crackers, lose their flavor as they are chewed, and end up tasting bland or even doughy.  These keep their flavor - a deep grainy, savory flavor.  I am pretty sure they would appeal to both cracker lovers and those who like to snack on chips.These crackers are excellent topped with brie cheese, dipped in salsa, or eaten plain.  The brown rice meal base means that the crackers are crunchy and hold up to liquids better than wheat crackers do.  They're low sodium, gluten-free, and low calorie - you can eat 15 for 140 calories, and 15 of these makes a satisfying snack.  What's not to love?  I do not make a point to eat gluten-free items, but these are absolutely delicious for anyone.Just a snack idea - for 240 calories, you can eat 1 ounce of brie, and 15 crackers.  Believe it or not, 1 ounce of brie can be divided among 15 crackers and each bite is satisfying.By the way, I only paid $7 or $8 for this size box at Sam's Club.  I love these crackers so much and find them to be so unusual in flavor that I plan to buy boxes for several family members.  They make a wonderful "go to" healthy snack for anyone who is trying to lose weight, gluten-free diet or not.Note - these are FULFILLED by Amazon, NOT SOLD by Amazon.  The beef about the price should be taken up with the actual seller.

column9: The best gluten-free crackers I've found!
column10: I've tried all kinds of gluten-free crackers and these are by far the best!  I have found no other rice crackers that even come close to this taste.  Even my friends who don't care about the gluten-free feature love them.  They're great with salsa, hummus, cheese or just plain.  Even my cat eats them.

I thoroughly enjoyed this cracker.  I  served it to my friends who do not have a gluten sensitivity and they enjoyed it too.  Has a little rice cracker taste to it.  Compared to others that I have tried these are really nice and tasty.

As a picky Celiac also avoiding oats, my nutritionist recommended these crackers. I bought them hoping they would be more chip-like, to eat with salsa or bruschetta, but they are truly crackers. They're best with cheese or hummus. Crunchmasters' certainly has the crunch factor down, a feature impressing even non-Celiacs! One box contains two bags of crackers, enough to last you awhile. These are definitely a great option for Celiacs looking for a different, satisfying cracker that has some nutritional value (quinoa and sesame contribute some fiber and protein!).
These are fabulous!  living gluten free for 1 1/2 yrs and tried soooo many crackers.  These are the BEST!

column9: Real food flavor with a big crunch...
column10: Crackers have been one of the more disappointing gluten free foods for me BUT these are the exception to my experience...they are fabulous. The flavor is rich and satisfying with a crunch to match. I also love the amount of salt on these little gems so they are a good alternative to boring chips for me. Good with cheese, etc., these are yummy enough to eat straight from the bag...even my non restricted husband likes these crackers.
These are way cheaper at Costco. These are so delicious and taste like crackers unlike the majority of G crackers out there. My whole household eats them with kids ranging from 7-16.

column9: Fabulous crackers but what's up with the price, Amazon?
column10: This are fabulous tasting crackers. I eat them all the time. But I would NOT pay $14 for them. What's up with Amazon? Sam's Club charges about $7.50 for the same product. I'm shocked by this outrageous price when Amazon prides itself on offering good value. Buy these crackers...just don't buy them from Amazon until they adjust the price by about half.

As other reviewers have noted they are less than half the price at either costco or sam's club. They are so tasty that I eat them when I have an urge for a crunchy salty snack like potato chips or pop-corn or really for no reason. For me they easily take the place of any wheat based cracker that I would use in soups or for tuna salad or cheese. The real hard part is not finishing off almost one of the bags once opened. You consume 2G of dietary fiber and 3G of protein per 15 crackers which is a serving size for 140 calories. Noteworthy they are made in the USA. I'll count the next time I snack, but in all honesty I think I eat about 30 as one snack usually w/ some form of Cabot's cheese. I enjoy trying different types of food items, but if you are a staunch saltine or Ritz cracker fan, these may not be for you. They are very thin, crunchy, have a salty nutty like flavor and I can faintly taste the soy sauce. Since there is no expiration date on the box (odd I know) I will stock up while I can get them locally at such a low price. The only packaging part I don't like is the 2 cellophane bags are not resealable. The cardboard box is very sturdy and does not crush easily so they are well protected if you are considering ordering online.

These crackers are really great, the best I've tasted. I have been buying them at Sam's Club in Athens GA and my aunt buys them at Sam's in Greensboro, NC, so I assume they are in all the stores. I highly recommend them.

A lot of gluten free crackers can be kind of soft, like Club or Townhouse crackers. I really wanted some CRUNCH, so I figured what better to try than a brand called "Crunchmaster." Glad I did - they're super crunchy and salty and don't fall apart if you spread them with cheese or peanut butter. They're a little nutty and seedy, but I really enjoyed the flavor. Comes with two individually wrapped bags
I love these little crackers and they are cheaper than trying to purchase them in a grocery store and especially from a health food store.
This is the best GF cracker I have found.  Even our non GF friends love it.  Is has a very nice, "normal" taste.

My husband and I loved these crackers. They had a nice crunchy texture, a delicious nutty flavor from the sesame seeds and not too salty. Originally we purchased them because we like to try new crackers, but they quickly became our favorite. I enjoyed them with hummus also. We don't have a problem with gluten, we just liked the cracker. I would definitely recommend them to people.
As crackers go these are delish! Not just good for gluten free...actually, good. Crisp. Flavorful. Thin. Full of flavor. Everyone in the family eats them; not just those who are Celiac. Yea!

I found these crackers while traveling this summer, and Loved them so much, that I searched for them on your website. They don't even taste gluten free. They are my new favorite cracker !! Love to eat them with goat cheese or peanut butter. YUM.

These crackers are very tasty!  Lots of rich, nutty flavor, and they are "sturdy" meaning they stand up to salsa, cream cheese, etc.  I dip them in everything!  They ARE less expensive at Sams Club and Costco, but for people who don't live close to one of those stores, I'd highly suggest buying them on Amazon.  I've been Gluten-Free since 2007 and these crackers are in my top 5.  Glutino tastes bland and dry to me, and while we have a local GF bakery that makes DIVINE crackers, Crunchmaster is always a staple in our household.

which can be a bad thing!  :-)  this review is for anyone who has tried San-J sesame brown rice crackers but not these and you're wondering if you'll like them.  i tried to do a taste test but when i ate the crunchmaster i liked it best then when i ate the san-j i liked it best.  :-)the san-j has a somewhat more intense flavor (tastes like more soy sauce or stronger soy sauce to me) and definitely has a denser texturecrunchmasters are light, airy, and crispier...also very satisfying (and also yummy)i like the purity of san-j ingredients better (only sesame, brown rice, rice flour, san-j tamari soy sauce, sweet potato starch) but crunchmaster has some good seeds/grains and the latter has more fiber.  (wish it didn't have safflower oil and maltodextrin, tho.)i have only found san-j in the 3.7 oz size for about $4 so they are much more expensive.and yes you really can get crunchmaster for half the amazon price at costco but if, like me, you live in the middle of the city with no car, amazon is the place!  buy 2 boxes and free shipping so that beats driving and spending money on gas anyway!

We had these for the first time at a friends house and thought they tasted great, we didnt know that they were gluten free nor was that a concern for either of us, but it is an added plus since we can serve them to any guests who need to be on a gluten free diet. They go great with all types of cheese and my husband eats them straight out of the bag as a healthy alternative to chips. My only complaint is that they are a bit pricey when you factor in the shipping cost.

I can't imagine any crackers tasting any better than these...they are the BEST! Don't waste your money on Amazon.com though, they less than 1/2 this price at Sam's Club. Smoothe, crisp, not too salty or sweet, have an awesome sesame flavor and are totally addicting ;D I had no idea I would fall totally in love with these when I first purchased them but now my whole family requests them whenever I make a visit to Sam's Club...if Amazon.com would lower the price to about $7.00/box (or less would be better) I would purchase from them but, until then, I will buy at Sam's.

column9: Amazon folks need to check on this
column10: These multigrain crackers are absolutely wonderful. I gave only one star, because of your (Amazons) price....it is twice more expensive than at Sam's Club ($7). So why are we going to buy these from this source. Amazon, I am a huge fan, and regular shopper, but this really disappoints me. I will be checking your prices more closely.

They look pretty but neither I nor my husband could eat more than half a cracker. Terrible GF after-taste. I put them out for the squirrels and they wouldn't touch them either!(it's January in Mich.) Over the holidays I found Glutino crackers and also tossed out the Blue Diamond in the cupboard (the squirrels DID at least eat those). My favorite for spread and cheeses is the Glutino Cheese which has just hint of cheese flavor.

I enjoy GF products, make many from Bob's Red Mill and am used to the taste. I read the reviews, many of which were very positive, and decided to try these crackers despite the high price.The taste, texture and smell of the crackers is very unappealing and the price is absurd.I do not recommend these crackers.
This big box of crackers doesn't last very long in  my house and it's me and my husband. Great in place of chips, great with cheese and dip.

After going "gluten free" I was so happy to find these crackers.  Not only are they the best I've ever had (gluten-free or not), my husband even prefers them over regular crackers.  My favorite combo is to have them with cream cheese and pepper jelly, but they are great right out of the bag!

column9: Taste better than most gluten-free BUT grossly over-priced
column10: Like many people who are gluten-intolerant, I have many other food sensitivities that are not related directly to gluten.  These crackers have dehydrated tamari sauce in them. The tamari is what gives the crackers a great taste; I suspect this is what some reviewers decide is 'burnt grain'. However in my case tamari is a trigger for interstitial cystitis pain.  I would normally deduct only two stars for this, since my food sensitivities are not the fault of this maker; HOWEVER, the price is absolutely absurd.  I have no clue why anyone would pay this much for a $6-$7 box of crackers.  Check your local health food store.  Such stores are notorious for price-gouging, but even so they will be radically cheaper than here.
This is an excellent product.  It is Gluten Free.  It is crunchy, does not fall apart and has a wonderful flavor.  Purchased through Amazon.com

column9: Wow!  A gluten free cracker that tastes pretty good!
column10: This is probably the best GF cracker I have tasted in my 8 years of being GF. And it does not go stale after the bag has been opened, at least not so far (about a week).

These are the VERY BEST CRACKERS YOU WILL EVER TASTE!  PLUS THEY ARE GLUTTEN FREE!I SERVED THEM AT AT PARTY, AND NORMALLY PEOPLE DO NOT COMMENT ON THE CRACKERS, BUT SEVERAL PEOPLE ASKED ME WHAT KIND THEY WERE.THE BEST EVER!
I love these wonderful crunchy crackers.  They have been a big hit in my house and they are gluten free.  Everyone enjoys them.

column9: Better price elsewhere, but great crackers...
column10: My family loves these crackers!!  I have to say though, you can get the same box at Costco (and possibly Sam's Club), for around $8.00.  I just bought some there yesterday.  Great crackers!!!

We buy these regularly at Costco and they had a coupon last month so we stocked up.  Amazon price is higher, but I have a 7 week olf and a 3 year old, so it will be handy to have these delivered to my door rather than drive an hour each way to Costco.  They are wheat free and dairy free.  They are very crunchy but are not too hard (my 3 year old can bite and chew easily).  They go great with all manner of toppings.  I use them for breakfast with Earths Balance and some marmalade.  I love them with olive tapendade.  But honestly, I often find myself standing at the kitchen counter just eating them right out of the bag.  They even kill my popcorn cravings.  Great product...in fact, I think I will go get some right now....

This is my all-time favorite cracker.  I always have these on hand.  Save yourself some money and buy the same size box at Sam's Club for $7.98 though!

These are the best multigrain crackers I have ever had, bought them at Sams Club and I loved them. column9: Excellent, but way overpriced - try Sam's Club

For those of us who don't or can't eat gluten, these are the best crackers we have tried.  If you can eat gluten - they are still great!  Great flavor and crunch!  Provide the "missing" great taste and crunch not available in so many gluten free products.

These crackers taste great & do not give me the "carb kickback" that most other gluten free crackers do. The price is in line compared to other gluten free crackers, as the bag size is large & there are 2 bags in the box. Would recommend for anyone.

column9: Gluten free doesn't have to mean taste-free!
column10: I received these crackers as part of GoPicnic package of foods and the first bite made me fall in love with them. It's only been a few months since my Celiac's diagnosis and I'm still trying out gluten-free foods, many of which (unfortunately) leave a lot to be desired in the taste and/or texture department....not these crackers! I love them so much that I really could eat multiple servings in one sitting (I'll try not to!). Go great with hummus but also fabulous without any "toppings"!
This are a very crunchy satisfying cracker and were amazed to find out they were gluten free! They have a nutty taste that is wonderful

These crackers are a god-send. Being gluten-free often means being taste/texture/flavor-free and disappointing. These crackers are an exception. I tried them at Sam's and bought a box on the spot. I will continue to buy these crackers because the taste is amazing, they have great crunch, they go great with meat, cheese, guacamole and hummus, and best of all they don't upset my stomach! They are much cheaper at Sam's, FYI. If you're missing little snack items like crackers since going gluten-free, give these a try. So happy!!

In the low sodium world it is hard to find products that you did not personally prepare that you can have and that taste good too.  I was happy to find these crackers and also happy to note they were gluten free because I have a family member who needs gluten free products.  It's nice to have more options.  It is everything I was looking for in a snack cracker.

We tried these crackers for something different and loved them.  They taste great on a lot of different kinds of toppings.  They are pretty pricey on Amazon at around $18, but we will pay it if we can't find it cheaper somewhere else.

I absolutely LOVE these crackers !  I dont care much about the gluten free thing, I just know what I like and these ROCK !  Very nutty tasting and goes great with any dip you dunk em into !  Forget the rest, these are the best !

column9: best gluten-free crackers on the market
column10: Yes! Yes! Yes! to the product.No! No! No! to the price here. The club price is less than half of this. Obviously this company is buying them and then reselling. Just a few boxes pays for your yearly membership.There are two varieties, regular and five seed, which we like better. So good.

This is not the best gluten-free cracker, its the best cracker period.  I'm not even sure what gluten is, and its absence is not why I'm recommending these things.  Why are they good?  First, they are very crunchy, almost like a tortilla chip.  Second, the flavor is unique- its a great cornut/toasted sesame seed flavor that is appealing even without a dip, and perfectly straddles being bland and being over-powering.  Its also has just a slightly salty taste that becomes addictive.  Third, regardless of if you are needing a gluten-free product, this is a healthy snack.  No sugar, low sodium, no trans-fats.  It does have 5g of fat, but thats better than most stuff you will find.I was at Sams and they were providing samples of these crackers, and a line 5 deep had formed they were so popular.  And yes, they are much cheaper at Sams.  Wherever you order them, buy multiple bags, because you will go through them fast.
These are tasty, substantial, and appropriately priced for snack food. I would buy them exclusively because of their low fat content and high nutritional value.

Don't let the little whiff of Tamari soy sauce put you off when you first open the package. These crackers are good, crunchy and when you miss things because of the gluten you don't have to miss crunchy crackers anymore - these are wheat and gluten free! I often use them with mustard and Swiss cheese for little cracker snacks. They have become a staple in my kitchen that I use frequently.
This is a whole lot cheaper than buying the crackers in little bags for $3.79 each at Fresh Market!  Thanks,  Judi Kregg

These are the best GF crackers I've ever tasted.  A friend gave me a bag to try and I finally found them at a local box store.  Would love to order these from Amazon online but never at this price.  What a rip!

Given that these are gluten free, they are pretty good. However, I think that they have a "burnt" taste to them. I don't care for them, but they are not disgusting. I will continue my search for great gluten free crackers.
These crackers are delicious!  You don't feel deprived of wheat when you're eating these.  However, you can get a 20 oz box at Sam's Club for just a little over $7.

These are my favorite crackers.  They have a nutty flavor and are very healthy and taste wonderful with absolutely anything spread on them.  My friends and family and I are addicted and will continue to order more and more.

These are Awesome for the Gluten free diet.  Tastes like real food.  They are great to eat as a snack alone, with cheese or vegies or peanut butter!  It is nice to have a cracker to eat with soups and salads that has some real substance and tastes just like real food.  Would like to be able to purchase them at Dillons.

column9: Taste AMAZING!!! BEST gluten-free crackers I've found!
column10: I am so excited to find a gluten free item that tastes completely 'normal.' No sacrifice of texture, taste or quality here! These crackers should receive an award.After trying Mary's Gone Crackers several times, which are tasty, I literally chipped a tooth on one of the grains (I think it was the quinoa) that are spread throughout those crackers and have the consistency of dried up rice (hard as tiny evil rocks).Anyway, I knew there had to be something better out there, than trying to munch petrified grain.I dabbled with the Sesmark brand of gluten free crackers (also tasty) and these were satisfying, and NOT painful to eat (thank goodness). And you can get those even at Target, which makes them a convenient choice in a pinch. But they still lacked a little something, and were a little too salty.But ... I have found my favorite cracker! Crunchmaster Multigrains are the winner! Holy smoke not only are they delicious, not only do they taste like totally normal completely delicious crackers, they also appear to possibly even be good for you (I am wary to label anything not homemade these days 'nutritious').I can't wait to feed these to my family, because only Crunchmaster and I will know they're gluten free. Don't hesitate to buy if you're longing for some gluten-free cracker goodness!They remind me somewhat of the crackers Sociables, which are super tasty but not gluten free. They don't look anything like Sociables, but they have a loosely similar flavor.Even if you're not restricted to eat only gluten free, I still highly recommend these crackers. They are sooo good, and say they're low in sodium and have omega fatty acids.Amazon's price IS literally twice as high as you can find them in a warehouse store (Sams, Costco etc) but I would imagine it's from the shipping cost, since most who order these probably take advantage of the free super saver shipping by combining them with other items from Amazon, and it probably would cost about 5 to 7 bucks to ship these anywhere. The crackers themselves come in a big sturdy box. Still, even at $14, it's not an absolutely horrible price ... you do get a lot of crackers. If the price were to be reduced to $11, I think that would be a good deal on here. But, just my 2 cents.If they lower the price by a buck or two, I may still order them from Amazon in the future, for the times I can't bear to drag myself to Costco. Nothing better than food I didn't have to actually "shop" for.

These crackers are crisp, flavorful and are great alone or with other foods. They have their own distinct flavor so they don't go with everything that might sit on a cracker.  I like them but would like to find a more plain gluten-free cracker as well.  These cost more than if bought at Sam's Club, but if you, like I, don't live near a Sam's Club the price difference is less than gas for a trip. G. Collins
I love these crackers!  They are unique and very flavorful.  I would recommend them to anyone.

These Crunchmaster Multi-Grain Crackers are so delicious that my family prefers them "naked," with no toppings whatsoever.  The taste is toasty and nutty and delicious.  I gave a box to a friend who is gluten intolerant, and he fell in love with them so much that he asks me to pick up two boxes for him every time I make a run to Sam's Club.  These crunchy crackers are extraordinary.  I just wish they were more readily available in grocery stores.
These crackers are delicious! They are good with hummus, cheese and soup. I love them!!

These are the BEST for satisfying salty/crunchy cravings. Excellent flavor and texture. We use them for all family events now that involve cheese, fruit and cracker appetizer foods and have forgone wheat crackers altogether. They really are a celiac's dream.

I purchased a box that was not a double pack at a different store entirely and the crackers taste like they're made of burnt toast scrapings.Ever had toast and had it charred in places? Ever not scraped the burnt bits off?These crackers taste like that.Not even Nutella made them edible and I threw away the entire box because I just cannot figure out a way to make these even the slightest bit palatable. Too bad too, I wanted to like these and have a great gluten-free crunchy cracker!

I have only found a few gluten free crackers I like, this IS NOT one of them. I purchased these at Sam's Club, much cheaper. These crackers were hard, not crunchy, almost seemed stale. The first bite didn't taste too bad but they left an awful, odd after-taste, similar to burned grain. The texture wasn't too bad, not the usual prepackaged gluten-free grainy texture. My husband went Gluten-Free when I had to, he almost almost anything and he doesn't like them either. We tried them plain, with cream cheese, with cream cheese/olives, in salad, with cheddar cheese, nacho cheese but nothing would conceal the after-taste, in my opinion they were Horrible! I would say it is just my taste buds but...I not 1 of my 5 kids, 4 of which will eat pretty much anything, liked these. We offered them to friends, family, and neighbors but after trying them no one would take them. It could be possible that we purchased a bad batch, there were 2 packages in the box, but I don't think we want to chance buying and wasting another box. After reading some of the other reviews it appears many people love them, I guess you never know unless you try them. We hated to toss them in the trash so we occasionally used them as dog treats, the dogs did like them.

Ok, so these stink.  In fact I bring them to work for snacks and have had people ask what the smell was.  But they have kind of a cornchip taste to them, they are very crisp, and I for one enjoy them alot.  It is a good think they are somewhat healthy becuase I just keep nibbling them...then I go back to my desk and everyone thinks I have been gnawing on a gym sock.  Oh well, they can suffer for my satisfaction.

The best part is they last for a long time. This will keep him occupied for hours. He'll finish other chews in a matter of minutes.  Highly Recommended

Yes, it is still a pound of bully sticks, but I believe Cadet should be a little choosier about what they are throwing off to a customer. Ever asked yourself where all these bull penises are coming from and how they are obtained?It is pretty crazy to kill animals artificially to feed their penises to other animals--guess that is the human species for you.

Pros: My dogs love them. They last a long time. They don't really stink after the first 30 seconds.Cons: They're a little pricey.  And I don't like to think about what they're made out of.  They lose the star on price, though.  Pound for pound, they cost more than dry-aged USDA Prime Rib.  I don't buy USDA Dry-Aged Prime Rib for myself, so I'm not sure how I got talked into paying that kind of money for a dog treat.  I blame my wife.  She says I'm stingy with the dogs.  I say I'm pragmatic and our dogs would be happy eating out of the litterbox if we would let them.My dogs will recite Shakespearean sonnets for these treats.  One of them has learned how to mow the lawn for me, and the other has started grading my students' homework in exchange for a half-length of one of these apparently delectable sections of dried out taurine...parts.  (Seriously, don't look up what they're made out of if you're squeamish.)These things are expensive compared to regular rawhide, but they do provide a longer chewtime-per-inch for my mutts and, so I've been told by professionals, don't have the same potential to cause gastrointestinal damage.  Furthermore, I cannot emphasize enough how much my dogs prefer these things to regular rawhide chews.  They just have to see me move my hand toward the bag and all of a sudden my two Tasmanian devils are stone-still statues of obedience eagerly awaiting, nay, eagerly DESIRING any word of command I might give.  Therefore, despite the price, I don't feel I've gotten the shaft on this deal.  At least not metaphorically.  Euphemistically, though, I suppose I got a whole bag of them.Oops, sorry.  Now you know what they're made out of.When you first open the bag, they'll smell bad.  After 30 seconds, there is no scent whatsoever unless you wave one of them right under your nose.  If you're the kind of person who regularly waves dried out steer phallus under your nose and you need them to be totally odor-free, get a different product.You'll need some heavy-duty garden shears or a really sharp cleaver if you're going to cut the foot-longs down to smaller sizes.  This process makes me wince in some sort of primal, Y-chromosome encoded empathic reaction, even though I realize the animal from which the product was taken no longer has need of it.  My wife says I'm a wuss.  I say I'm compassionate.If you have neither a prohibitively strong gender-based moral qualm regarding the raw materials used to make a bully stick nor a hyper-developed sense of smell, and you can afford to pay Dry-aged USDA Prime Rib prices to throw pieces of dessicated steer pizzle to an animal that will wolf down filet mignon with the same delight it takes in bolting cat poop when you're not watching, then go ahead and buy these.  At least your dogs will give you their undivided attention for the 15 seconds between your opening the bag and distributing the treat.

This product is excellent for a dog chew stick and my dogs absolutely love them.  It will not swell in their throats like rawhide can sometimes do.  The price on amazon is much better than at dog shows, pet shops or discount catalogues ( but still a little more expensive than Costco).  It came within a few days of ordering.

Our dog LOVES to chew, and these sticks are the best! Each stick is strong, yet softens up as it is chewed. Each stick lasts long enough to satisfy his "chewing fit." For quality, value, and safety, we haven't found anything to compare with the bully sticks. column9: Finally found some reasonably priced bullies!

Excellent product, especially great for dogs that NEED-to-CHEW (like mine). column9: too stinky to have in the house
column10: My family insisted I throw these away, because they smelled so bad from such a distance.  I (somewhat reluctantly) did, and now we use another type that advertises itself as "odor free" and does seem to genuinely have a lot less smell than these.  These were a lot cheaper, and I hoped that they'd work for us, but they didn't.  The dog doesn't care which type I buy - it's just the people who are fussy.

These bull sticks carry the same name brand as the Costco standard, Cadet Bully Stick, but are not as uniform in shape or nearly as large.  Instead of smelling like dead animal, these bull sticks smell like dirty underwear.  The smell didn't bother my dog... at least at first.  My dog threw up each time after chewing/consuming the bull sticks.  Her dumb owner (me) wasn't sure what was making her sick at first, so we had three opportunities through the week to chew and clean up.  The rest of the bag went to the dumpster.If your dog has a sensitive stomach or anyone in the family has a sensitive nose, avoid these rawhide chews.

Best of all, they are low odor.  I've purchased bully sticks for my dog before and they reeked!  For some reason these bully sticks do not.
Good price on these! My only complaint is that the sizes are inconsistent. Some of my bullies were as thin as straws- not great for my  Mastiff. I still like the value and would order these again.
