column10: I tend to like cereals that have a lot of crunch and that are lightly sweetened.  Many do well on the crunch part, but are too sweet.  Some go too far on the "sticks & twigs" type crunch without taste.  This one gets it right in my book.  I'll be buying more.

The product came very quickly, and it was in fact 15oz sized boxes (I was worried since the stores seemed to carry 14.1oz boxes and I couldnt imagine there actually being two different sizes for such little difference, and ofcourse I was looking for a better deal than store prices).The cereal itself is great, except I find it a touch too sweet compared to other Kashi brands, so I actually like to mix this cereal with the High Protein and High Fiber cereal half and half. But ofcourse everyone's going to have different preferences when it comes to taste, so I'm still giving 5 stars for the service and the quality of the cereal. Natural ingredients that taste good and are actually quite healthy.If you're looking to beat store prices, you'll end up saving a couple bucks, but you'll save more if you purchase with the automatic renewal enabled, which can always be disabled anytime after or set to 6 months renewal. Not sure how fast one can really eat 6 boxes of cereal. It's taken me 3 or 4 months now I guess.

This  cereal is great to snack on while watching TV or a DVD.  My children even love it.  It is sweet enough that they eat it dry right out of the box.  Yet it is crunchy enough to keep things interesting.  Believe it or not they prefer this to a bowl of greasy popcorn.  Actually, I do too.  :)

column9: Cheaper at your local grocery store
column10: Great product, but you can get it for $2.50-$3.00 per box at your local grocery store on sale!

Most cereal either tastes good or is bad for you.  GoLean Crunch has the best of both worlds - it tastes as great as most full-calorie granola cereals but it has lots of Fiber and Protein, which most people just don't get enough of in their diets.  I even keep a box of this stuff at work for snacking!

column9: And I don't even like cereal
column10: I never have liked cereal-probably because I hate milk, but I wanted to eat healthier and kept seeing the ad for Kashi so I bought it. This is the very best snacky-breakfasty-anytime food I have ever had. I love the flavor, and because I do not drink milk, I eat mine in a bowl with a 1/4-1/2 cup of raisins-mmmmmmm...I swear its so good that you'll want to feel guilty for eating it!! Its is crunchy, but that's a good thing. Instead of reaching for the chips when I want to crunch, I reach for the Kashi. Love Love Love it!!!! I suggest you buy 2 boxes at first if you are married. My husband practically ate an entire box with in 2 days : )

This cereal is a staple in our household. We've consistently used it for breakfast over the past 4 years. It has the perfect blend of sweetness, crunchiness, fiber and protein. And the cereal keeps for a long time without going stale. Very filling and a great way to start the day.

This cereal is delicious.  I eat it dry as a snack.  It is great at work or at home.  I get the satisfaction of the crunchiness as well as the pleasure of the flavor.  The high fiber content and other healthy ingredients make this a wonderful snack any way you look at it.I like to measure the cereal out into portions so I don't over do.  It also allows me to seperate the larger cereal chunks for more convenience at work.
Whole grain, low sugar (well some of their other offerings have less sugar), and it's great with SILK (soy milk).

column9: Bad For Your Health and Bad for Your Teeth
column10: With a whopping 18 grams of sugar, this cereal ought to be banned for anyone with high blood sugar, hyperglycemia or diabetes.  Nobody concerned with being healthy ought to consume more than 4 grams of sugar in a meal.These sugary nuggets are so hard, if you have veneers or crowns, new or old, there is a good chance of them cracking and breaking off.  I've been to the dentist twice -- in order to get repairs done due to consuming this -- let's call it what it is -- breakfast CANDY!  My dentist entirely arned me off of consuming this garbage."Oh, but it's so good for you!  Those whole grains!"  Hogwash.  It's got more sugar than protein.  There are much better foods for the (non-hypocritical) health-conscious person.
Excellent healthy treat. I have lost over 30 pounds and owe my success in part to kashi cereal. I eat cereal most nights - loaded on fibre so I don't go hungry yet lose weight

column9: Yum and yum and apparently good for you
column10: It's a rare day when something is good for you and tastes good.  Every day I have Lean crunch is that day.

column9: Incredible cereal at an incredible price
column10: I've always been a fan of Kashi GoLean Crunch. I find that it's the perfect balance of taste and health. The best part is that my kids actually love this as well. This is significantly healthier than many of the sugar cereals that are marketed to kids. Even my 1 yo enjoys eating this dry. Between this and Honey Nut Cheerios, I don't have to feel guilty about giving my kids "bad" cereal.From a price perspective, you can't beat Amazon's Subscribe & Save. My family of six will work through these four boxes pretty quick. Thanks Amazon!
This cereal is very tasty, has great crunch, great fiber, great protein and little sweet.  KASHI made a delicious and nutritious breakfast treat all in one.  It is a great value, 6 pack.  We love it!
I love this Kashi GOLEAN Crunch! I would say this is the best trade-off between taste and amount of protein for a cereal. It's yummy, crunchy and healthy.
Without a doubt, the best healthy cereal I've ever had. Lots of protein, lots of fiber, and it tastes like old school Sugar Smacks :)

In an attempt to start eating healthier, I switched my morning cereal to Kashi GOLEAN.  This cereal is a treat to eat, even when switching from sugary cereals.  I definitely recommend it as one of Kashi's better cereals.

I ordered my favorite Kashi cereal to eat with yogurt on Sept. 1st and got it the next day on Sept. 2nd with free shipping from Amazon Prime!  I was pleasantly surprised at just how quickly it came.  It's the same standard size box I buy at the grocery store and for slightly less the cost.  I had a cup the day it came and it was in its usual extra crunchy delicious form.
This a very good Cereal At a very good price I am glad I found it at Amazom Becuse this is my favorite Cereal

Crunchy indeed! Careful when chewing,there may be the occasional hard chunk. The taste is sweet with a little taste of cinnamon. High in protein and fiber. I think kids would even like Kashi! I get 6 boxes every 6 months. The boxes were a little damaged but contents were fine.
I was pleased to receive such a great deal on Kashi Go Lean Crunch.  The product arrived quickly and w/ free shipping, prevented me from having to make a trip to Costco for it.
We all like it, kids a bit less than adults.  Fact that it's healthy does not appeal to them as much. I get it as a subscription item.  Otherwise it's cheaper elsewhere.
My wife loves this cereal.  When I saw this for sale on Amazon for the great price it was listed at, we jumped on it - and likely will again too.  Much more expensive to buy in grocery stores!
This cereal is awesome. It stays crunchy in the milk. Well worth the money - both the protein and fiber that are are provided by one serving of this cereal along with great taste.

column9: My Favortie Cereal...Next to Cinnamon Toast Crunch
column10: I've been eating Kashi GoLean for about two years now and I can't live without it. It's just sweet enough to satisfy the kid in me and it's healthy enough to make me feel good about eating it. Though I do tend to eat really-sugary cereals like Cinnamon Toast Crunch, Kashi GoLean is a great substitute. Come to think of it, I haven't eaten Cinnamon Toast Crunch in a while, probably because I've been eating GoLean just about everyday. The only downside is that the fiber can make you go the bathroom quite often. But if you balance your intake of cereal just right, you should be fine. In addition, the cereal tastes really good with Vanilla soy milk. I eat my GoLean with Silk Very Vanilla.
Delicious taste, but it's way too crunchy. It hurts my teeth and gums. I have to let this sit in milk for a while before I can eat it. I really wish this wasn't so crunchy.

Fibre...checkProtein...checkVitamins...checkWhat? You want your cereal to taste great as well? Well here's your answer.Pros:+ Healthy (still has sugars though)+ Delicious+ Crunchy, doesn't get soggy even after prolonged submersionCons:- The size of the granola clusters isn't all uniform. The clumps at the top of the box are quite large, and towards the end you're left with powdery stuff. Not a big minus, but I like my granola to be uniformish.
We love golean crunch: healthy (relatively), crunchy, delicious.  And I love getting it with the subscription plan:  I get 6 boxes at a time, never have to run around looking to find it on sale.
Kashi Go Lean Crunch is the best cold cereal I've even eaten.  Besides, it's actually good for you.

I have always liked the taste of GoLean cereal and now it's even better with the crunchy nuggets.  Kashi is a good source of high fiber and this makes it easy to add to my regular diet.  I also enjoy mixing GoLean Crunch with other Kashi cereals.

column9: Perfect cereal: Tastes good, interesting, high fiber, not too sweet
column10: I'm generally not a big cereal eater. I eat this cereal dry as a snack, which has been great for my waistline. Instead of eating junk, I can eat something healthy, high in fiber, and filling. I don't get hungry for hours. Sometimes there are big clusters and other times a lot of crumbs, depending on settling, but it always tastes good. A slight cinnamon flavor with a satisfying crunch. It's hard to watch TV while eating due to all of the crunching. :-) It's definitely worth a try (I have never commented on a food before, so you know this has got to be good...)

Of all Kashi's products, this is our favorite.  We mix it with plain yogurt and a little fruit-only jelly for a healthy dessert.My only advice is to keep in an air-tight container because it does tend to clump together and get hard if left in the original package too long.
Healthy alternative, high in protein, especially tasty when eaten with soy milk and blueberries! Mix some into your yogurt........goooood.
Kashi GOLEAN Crunch! Cereal, 15-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 6)Great cereal!!!!  My favorite!!!! Healthy and good for you!

column9: Good for your health but hard to chew and digest....
column10: Excellent ingredients and great flavor but difficult to digest and chew. It could be just me... worth to try!!!

column9: Love the flavor and the crunch
column10: This cereal is like rice puff clusters.  Sweet, crunchy and filling.  Love it!

I purchased GOLEAN Crunch with Turtle Rolls and Power Bars using a 20% off coupon on total purchase of $50 or more.  It was a great deal.  The cereal is delicious and was delivered in excellent shape.  No problems with the product being old or having a short expiration date.
Crunchy, just the right amount of sweetness, and doesn't get soggy in milk. Plus it is healthy. The kids prefer this over that nasty sugar coated cardboard. Give this a try!

I found a good deal on this cereal today & thought I'd give it a try, as Kashi seems to be a  high quality, healthy brand.I'm pleasantly surprised by this crunchy, filling cereal. This will be great for breakfast as I have a large gap between breakfast & lunch, and also perfect as a late night snack when I'd normally be tempted by ice cream.The dense, filling nature of this cereal will also make it easier to stick to serving size guidelines. I poured a 'normal' sized bowl and it was way too much, so it looks like I'll be more satisfied with less cereal. This may be my new favorite product here!

I love this product. It is healthy, high in fiber, and tastes delicious! I highly recommend it, especially from Amazon because if you buy $49 worth (at times), you get $25 back. :) So you get a really good deal. This cereal is god for breakfast, lunch, dinner or a snack.
I really like this cereal.  It is great that it stays crunchy and has a nice sweet flavor to it.  It does give you some energy and what can I say the fiber does its job.

I tried a Kashi cereal several years ago and hated it.  But after recently trying one of their frozen dinners and loving it, I thought I'd give the cereal another try.  I was pleasantly surprised.  This one actually reminds me of the taste of Honey Smacks - just not quite as sugary and crunchier.  This cereal still contains some sugar, but at least it's in the form of a natural product instead of corn syrup.

I take a little cup to work with me with Kashi GOLEAN Crunch, walnuts, raisins, bran flakes, etc. I make it a little different every time.When everyone around me is eating cookies or doughnuts, I take out my "survival kit," pour a cup of coffee and my diet is saved for yet another day.

...And that's a good thing, in my book. It has to be said that for cereals with this much nutritional content, it is an uncharacteristically sweet blend. But GoLean Crunch doesn't share the artificial, high-fructose corn-syrup taste of your favorite childhood cereal. The honey and cinnamon deliver a restrained but vibrant flavor that satisfies the sweet tooth and saves you the toothache. In time, you'll wonder why your body kept craving the kid's stuff at all.Kashi cereals are generally very satisfying--after downing a bowl, you feel a rush of energy and a lightness that many competing high-fiber cereals can't deliver. Along with a hot cup of coffee, fresh fruit and maybe some yogurt, this is a highly recommended breakfast item for anyone looking for sustained energy throughout the early hours of the day (and who isn't?).

column9: Finally, good granola with no guilt!
column10: This cereal is great! High fiber, no saturated fat or trans fat, modest sugar, and it tastes really, really good! Plus they admit that the serving size is a full cup of cereal. I highly recommend it.

I love this cereal. It is so healthy and so delicious. The packaging has a picture of blueberries on the cereal, so I thought it came with the blueberries. I was disappointed to find out that I had to buy my own blueberries to go with the cereal. After trying it, I was completely amazed by the taste. Usually something that is so good for you does not taste so good. Well, in this case I don't mind eating the healthy cereal or buying my own blueberries to go with the cereal! It's that good. Very crunchy and just enough sugar to satisfy your taste. It really is the best cereal I've tried in a long while.

To me this is the best cereal ever for breakfast or snacking.  It's delicious-stays crunchy(disagree totally with the person that said it got soggy-try it with just a little bit of almond milk-MMMMM).Since finding this, I'm just not happy with any other cereal, even take it with me when I travel.  And I always buy mine in bulk, so this is great, especially for folks who have a hard time finding it.  I'm lucky,as I can get it for less locally.Even the other Kashis pale by comparison, and it's the most healthy cereal i've found.mld

When I'm dieting I crave crunch food. Kashi GOLEAN is the lowest carb cereal I could find and a portion size larger than 1/4 cup. It's very crunch and stays crunchy even in milk (not forever but longer than most cereal). The flavor is pleasant and it needs NO sugar or sugar substitutes. Very good.

This stuff is great as a snack.  As a breakfast cereal?  Not so much.  For some reason, the taste totally disappears once they come in contact with skim milk and they get soggy (and extremely chewy - like chewing coconut) in less than 3 seconds.  So it's like chewing on wet cardboard with a hint of cinnamon or something.  Maybe it's just me.  Oh well, go figure.  I do love them as a great finger food.  So I recommend these as a light, healthy snack right out of the box, but if you're looking to buy this as a breakfast cereal, I recommend looking elsewhere.
This cereal not only tastes good and is good for you.  It will clean you out pretty good as well!  Tons of fiber and beleive it or not, this cereal has like 9 grams of protien per serving!!!

Billed as good tasting cereal that is also nutritious, the Kashi Golean Crunch  definately delivers the crunch.  Comparing the side nutrition info panel with other cereals shows low fat, low sugar, good fiber and a fair ammount of vitamins.  As with any granola based cereal, adding rasins, bananas, berries, etc. helped vary the taste immensely.  Even so, after 6 boxes I was ready for an extended break.  I expect I will enjoy it again later.  Enjoy!

This is an awesome cereal.  It makes a really good snack too.  That's what I mostly eat it for.  I personally think it has a natural brown sugar taste.  If you are looking for a healthy snack or a healthy cerealm this should be among your top choices.

Bionaturae Organic Tomatoes are excellent. The problem was not with the tomatoes however, but the shipping.  The cans arrived dented, some badly, and that is not acceptable. It would seem reasonable to expect that Amazon would ship these cans in a way that would preserve their integrity.I love these tomatoes, however if the shipping of said product remains the same as it is now, the damage sustained is not worth the risk involved.  Badly dented cans are not for me!I have ordered canned foods directly from Eden Organic Foods and they arrived in pristine condition.  Perhaps Amazon could contact Eden for proper procedures on shipping on canned products.Let's hope Amazon is paying attention to complaints posted by those of us who have ordered and received damaged cans.

column9: the next best thing to fresh tomatoes
column10: the ingredients are simple and pure and one of the few brands that does not add unnecessary additives. Generally I like to make my own sauce from scratch, but this is my second choice if I am short on time. Its taste good and not artificially sweet. I love the bionaturae products including the tomato paste.
These are my favorite canned tomatoes. Sweet and tangy, with a great, fresh taste. Highly recommended.

Pros-Great Taste-Always Fresh-Fair Price compared to storesCons-Cans were dentedLike another review said, the cans seemed dented from shipping.  It wasn't anything major like being busted open or can't use a can opener on them.  Most just had a dent on the side from being pressed up against the other cans.  I still gave it five stars because I don't think it is that important for the cans to look perfect, just so long as they work.

These tomatoes are wonderful for making pasta sauce. They're never bitter or acidic. I try to only use organic products and these are the best organic can tomatoes I've ever used. You can't beat the price either. Much cheaper than buying in the store.
THESE ARE THE MOST FANTASTIC AMAZING TASTING TOMATOES ON EARTH. NO EXAGGERATION.  LIFE WITHOUT THEM WOULD NOT BE WORTH LIVING.

I love this stuff. I like anything peach -- ice cream, yogurt, pie -- and this has a really nice peach flavor. It's hard to find this variety in my local stores, and when I can find it, it's nearly as expensive as it is here at Amazon ($4.59 per box locally vs $4.62 from the least expensive seller here, including shipping), so I don't feel too guilty ordering here.  I mix up a quart at a time, and usually go through two of those per day. Very yummy!

I have been looking for years for a flavoring for water and have found. I love this stuff and at only 5 calories I get the hydration I need with a great taste.  Only problem is that I am having trouble finding this flavor in Florida. So when I travel to NJ I load up a carry on from the local A&P and bring it back to Florida. If you need to drink a lot of water try this product.
I'm hooked.  This stuff is delicious by itself, or mixed with additional water or tea.  Better than Arnold Palmer.  Check out the other flavors too.
This soap lathers great, doesn't have a strong smell, is large size and lasts a long time. It also doesn't leave slimy residue in the soap dish. A+
soap that does not turn all mushy. It is excellent for the skin and all natural. A really smart bargain.
The product I reveived is just grease, and doesn't resemble the product pictured in the least. Very dissapointed with it.

I have been drinking this tea for a long time now.  I used to have to purchase it at a doctor's office because it wasn't available elsewhere.  I'm so glad that I can buy it now from Amazon.com.  I drink this tea throughout the day like other folks drink coffee.  Wonderful taste.

I have been drinking Royal King 100% Natural Organic Green Tea (100 tea bags x 2g each) as my every day tea for several years now.  I buy 12 boxes at a time to save on shipping.  For many years I used to drink coffee from morning till night.  But finally I realized that drinking so much coffee was not healthy for me.  I finally resolved to improve my health and stopped drinking coffee all together.  I tried many alternative drinks to replace my coffee habit.  I found that green tea was not only good tasting it also has health benefits.  Green tea is one of the few drinks that actually makes you healthier (coffe and other drinks do not) - the only healthier drink is quality cold water.  In my opinion, for the price, Royal King 100% Natural Organic Green Tea is one of the best tasting teas.  This green tea has a beautiful golden color, the taste is bright and fresh.  I recommend adding a tiny amount of Y.S. Organic Bee Farms RAW HONEY to the tea to add sweetness and health benefits too.  I also give myself a treat once in a while by having a much more expense tea (Tribute Xi Hu Long Jing) but this fantastic tea is not practical for me to drink as my every day tea (although I would if I could afford it).Cons:  On my latest shipment the package shown on the Amazon page is different than the one shipped.  The one shipped displays "NATURALLY HIGH IN POLYPHENOL CATECHINS" (a key contributive element to the possible health effects of tea), whereas the Amazon package displays "CAFFENE FREE".  So I am not sure if this green tea is Caffene free or not.  The other con is that sometimes the tea bag rips open when I unwrap the string from around the tea bag. So if the string seems stuck to the tea bag I put the bag in the hot water to unstick it.

column9: the best tea ever... freah bright clean
column10: this has to be one of the best teas I have ever tasted... it's clean, bright, fresh...great delivery...again quality... just try it...

I love, love this green tea.  It is very hard to find in our area and some places on the internet charge a big price and I usually don't get as many boxes as I did with this merchant.  I will definitely order from this seller again!! Thanks!!  I depend on my green tea fix everyday!
I love this tea. It helps curb my eating during the day. My Mom and I have given it all friends to try.
These are becoming harder and harder to find in the stores.Glad there is a place where they can still be purchased.Arrived on time and unbroken :-)

column9: Perfect for the big appetites here.
column10: I can eat 2 of these as compared to 4-5 of the regular ones. Others also eat fewer of these  as well. They stay nice & crunchy because they don't last very long on anyones plate. I recommend these if you have big appetites in your home.

These were packaged very well with minimal shell breakage! Maybe 1 or two were broken, but that's just par for the course with taco shells. Taste was really good & I love having the shells on hand. I definitely will be buying these again.

column9: All I Could Want in A Taco Shell...
column10: We eat tacos at least once a week.  I have ordered many different taco shells online.  Most have at least one or two broken shells in every box.  HOWEVER, Old El Paso Taco Shells always come perfect.  I have yet to have any broken shells when I order these shells.  Also, I think they taste better than most corn taco shells.  Also, they are a nice size taco shells.  Most other taco shells come unusually small.  I highly recommend these taco shells to anyone who enjoys their Tex Mex.  If you like this you might also like: Taco Bell Taco Seasoning, 1.25-Ounce Pouches (Pack of 24)

column9: Great size for a taco shell
column10: I'm not commenting on the shipping because you're probably wondering how these taste as opposed to thinking of eating the shipping box.In brief, for pre-made taco shells, they're great. They taste just like all the other pre-made shells (crispy, and best warmed in the microwave before use) so if you like corn tortillas and don't want the mess of cooking them yourself theses should work well for you.The best part is that they're also large enough to hold the meat and toppings without having to fight the shell as you spoon in tiny little amounts of lettuce, tomato, cheese, onion, salsa, etc. I find the regular sized ones a little small and it's a struggle sometimes to build a great taco.Tip - if you use a ready made seasoning mix, you might try the Rick Bayless mixes if you can find them. I tried it and found it surprisingly good; far better than most of the dry seasoning pouches. Unfortunately, Amazon doesn't carry them right now.
I purchased these taco shells for a large party.  Over half of the shells were damaged in shipping and brooken in half along their spine.  I kept the undamaged shells and they tasted fine.
We received the Gerber veggies quickly, on time, and in great condition! And my son LOVES this stuff - the consistency is perfect, it is nutritious, and it tastes great!
There are very few baby food vegetables that my son eats, but this is one of them! The price and convenience of buying them through Amazon can't be beat.

column9: Not your typical food, Baby loves it
column10: I was hesitant to start mixing flavors so soon, but ran out of regular food while on family vacation recently. My husband grabbed this for our baby (7 months old) and I thought, oh great - this is going to suck. Well, it didn't - the baby gobbled this up the first time and every time we feed him this flavor. Even though I try to do all organic, this is one I happily make an exception for because he loves it so much. I appreciate that Gerber really is making the effort to provide healthy, good quality, affordable options for baby's developing palates.

This baby food is delicious! My son (8 months) LOVES this and will eat almost the entire container. It's hard to find in the store in stage 2 they seem to only carry the 3rd stage jars of this in store.My only wish was that it didnt expire so quickly from when I received them *5 months*

column9: it is a great tasting cereal
column10: I have been buying them for years at Ralph's for $4.49 a box. I would expect a lower price online buying a box of 7!

column9: Revised Formulation Has Same 13 Oz but 25% Less Cereal
column10: This cereal really tastes great!  Why the one star review?  Seems that along with a new look to their box art (white box now), Post has decided to advertise that it has given its customers bigger berries.  That's great you say.  But when you pour out the contents into a separate container you'll be shocked to learn that you have approximately 25% less cereal by volume.  Guess those bigger berries were needed to bring the weight back up to the same heft as last year's product.  Good thing they didn't raise the price, huh?  Guess I'll be looking for another product.  Too bad Post.  You really didn't think we'd notice?

column9: Best cereal on the face of the Earth!
column10: I LOVE this Cranberry Almond Crunch cereal - the taste is superb! It is by far the best. Everyone that comes to my home and taste it, love it.

column9: Hands down the best honey ever.
column10: I heard of this honey from a friend who swore by it, so I decided to try a jar.  When my family got home I tried a taste test with Honey Republic and the other two brands I had at home.  I didnt tell them which one was which (they each were in a small dish) but hands down there was a 100% "THIS IS THE BEST" from everyone.  I am going to try the other flavors, as I love cooking with Honey instead of sugar.  This will be our family brand.  THANK YOU HONEY REPUBLIC-

column9: The tastiest roast duck seasoning I've found
column10: I have used this seasoning packet on duck, pork, but mainly for roast chicken, for years. I rub the dry mix all over a whole fryer chicken, stick it in the fridge overnight, and roast the next day in the oven or outside on the grill. Letting it "marinate" overnight gets the flavors all through the meat. Tasty and juicy, the way Chinese Roast chicken is supposed to be. The directions state to mix the seasoning with water, but I've found using it as a dry rub works best for me if I'm roasting. Definitely mix with water if putting it in the crock-pot. Delicate, slightly sweet Chinese five spice flavor. Would I recommend? Absolutely!

column9: Easy to digest, nice neutral flavor
column10: It is possible that most people are looking for mung beans to sprout but we cook ours. They were first recommended to me by two very helpful clerks in an Indian grocery store in Knoxville TN as being very easy to digest so I bought a package to try.  Indeed they are.  They also taste pretty good!Mung beans need very little soaking and cook much faster than most dried beans so they are handy to have on hand. There are a lot of recipes on line for these beans. Some call for the hulled yellow split ones, but I always use these whole green beans.  Our personal favorite recipe is from a small Indian cookbook I have. It calls for topping the cooked and gently flavored beans with "crisp fried onions" which are simply very thinly sliced onions fried in hot oil until they are brown but not burned (a bit tricky to do).  The fried onions provide a good unhealthy (but very tasty) balance to the incredibly healthy beans........Sorry.......I had to say that.Seriously:  We have found all of the Bob's Red Mill products we've used to be very good quality.  These Bob's Red Mill beans are more expensive than those from the Indian grocery store but I don't have to drive 70 miles to get them either! Once you have tried a single package of a specialty item and like it, it is great to be able to stay home, use no gasoline, and get a case lot order from Amazon!

When I worked as a barista, this was what we used, and it's excellent! You have to know how to mix it, which may've been the issue with the other reviewer. There's not much coffee in the mix, so it's easy to make it as strong as you want.Hot: Mix with hot (hotter the better) milk or coffee. You can mix in blender or, if you have a pro-type steamer, you can use that (but make sure to mix powder with the liquid a bit first).Cold: In your glass, fill with ice cubes. Add any liquid to the glass until it's about 3/4 full (you can add cold milk, cold coffee, extra flavours, or a mix). Add the powder to the blender -- about 1 scoop for a smaller sized drink, two for a large. Add your liquid & ice mix from your cup. Blend on low speed for about 20 seconds, then high until you get the consistency you want.

I was disappointed by the texture of this product. It is very thick and has more of a milkshake taste than an iced coffee. I actually found I like it better just stirring a little less of the mix in with a cup of hot coffee.

MOCAFE Frappe Tahitian Vanilla Latte, Ice Blended Coffee, 3-Pound Tin  This product will permit you to make delicious frozen drinks.  I use about 75% of one scoop of MOCAFE powder, a 12-16 oz cup of ice cubes, 6 - 8 oz. of iced coffee  and place the mix in a blender at lower speed for about 20 seconds and about 30 seconds at high speed.  If all the ice is not crushed, I stir the blender contents and then blend for another 20 to 30 seconds.  This produces a delicious drink every time.  For an even richer and smoother drink, add a scoop of vanilla ice ream in addition to the ice and blend.
it is not worth the money for tiny quantity, besides you can make your own with soy flour or carbquick mix or carbaloze flour, recipes on line.
Way  too expensive for a small package. Shipping weight claims eight pounds you receive a 6oz package.I feel ripped off.
Works really good, but remember to not use too much. Otherwise you'll end up with a gooey mess.
this stuff does what it is suppose to do but not much in the bag for the price.  i think i will start making my own
I read the other reviews but tried it anyway. It worked great for my alfredo low carb pasta. you have to let it cool for at least 5 minutes before it thickens up though.

I haven't had the chance to cook with this item yet, but already it seems like too much to be spending on a 6 oz. bag... No where on this product page does it mention how much of the product you get when purchasing.
It does what it is supposed to, but I was expecting to get a lot more than we did.  I think I will try and make my own in the future.

Excellent product!  It does exactly what it claims to do. My only concern is that you can't continue to stir and cook once it begins to thicken or it will begin to thin out again.  It can be a little tricky to know exactly when to remove it from heat. Otherwise, just call me, The Happy Camper!

As a kid, I grew up eating unfrosted brown sugar cinnamon Pop Tarts and I still love them to this day.  They are almost impossible to find on store shelves because it seems people only want the overly sweet frosted varieties.  I snatch these up whenever I can find them.

Believe it or not, I bought a case of unfrosted brown sugar cinnamon pop tarts as a Christmas gift! I couldn't find these in ANY grocery store in my area, so I was thrilled to see I could order these from Amazon grocery. There was a glitch with my order; instead of getting a whole case I only received one box. In a panic, I emailed customer service, and within a few days I had the other 11 boxes. The recipient of this gift was so happy! (she's not in to the frosted pop tarts). Thanks Amazon!

I love, love, love unfrosted brown sugar cinnamon pop tarts.  It has to the be unfrosted.  I can't stand thathard, crusty frosting on all their other flavors.  It's the only flavor I will buy, and I could eat it everyday.Unfortunately, finding a store who still carries it is becoming more and more like searching for the Holy Grail.The last Wal-Mart in my city just stopped carrying them, and I almost cried.  Scotts and Kroger discontinued themlong ago.What's up with you people?  Bring it back!  I would drive 20 miles out of my way to find it.  Now it looks likeI'll be ordering it strictly online from now on.  Very bad marketing, Kellogs!

I love unfrosted poptarts.  Since I purchased the case I do not have a fear of running out and not being able to find more.  I love them so much as well as Amazon.com.  It is true, Amazon is the place to go when looking for hard to find items.

column9: Please bring back in smaller order size
column10: Like most other posters, I loved these pop tarts as a kid and I would love to have them again.  I don't like the frosted so I haven't bought in a very long time.  I just wish you could order a smaller amount (maybe pack of 6) instead of instead of 12.  Those would last me forever and would end up being wasted.  I do enjoy them but can't see buying a case of them.

You know how sometimes you remember something from your childhood and when you try it again as an adult it just doesn't quite live up to your memory?  Well...these DO! These were my all time favorite pop-tarts as a kid and I think the only flavor I ate.  When they started frosting them I stopped eating them because I just hate the frosting.  I don't think I've had one in 20 to 30 years.  Anyway, they taste EXACTLY the way I remember them.  I can't believe I had to buy a case to get them, but I'm sending some to my siblings and actually have some friends who are buying a few off of me.  Mine arrived well packaged and undamaged and the expiration date is about 9 months away.  If you loved these as a kid...go for it!

Like the other posters, I grew up eating the non-frosted cinnamon pop-tarts, and my 16 year old daughter loves them as well. Like the others I have been finding it harder and harder to find them at my grocery store. I was so happy when I found out Amazon sold them. To the poster who complained that they are not frosted, I guess you did not read the box, the frosted ones say frosted right on it.

column9: Sooo happy to have found them!!
column10: It is almost impossible to find UNfrosted Poptarts in my area.  These are the brown sugar & cinnamon ones I've loved for so many years.  Perfect without that hard frosting.  Arrived promptly, perfectly packaged.  "Use by" date is almost a year from now...so plenty of time to each 12 boxes :)
I don't know why you can't find these much any more. When I do I stock up. I hate the sweet candy coated PopTarts as you find mostly today. Both the product and the service from Amazon were great.
Pop tarts are great, like the non frosted option and kids still love them.  Also,really like the option to have the the items sent in 6 mos intervals, would recommend.
Grew up with them as a kid in California. Then disappeared for years. Found them while in the midwest for business and then on amazon. I'm very happy to have a breakfast favorite back!

Unfrosted means good for grown-ups' breakfast. Ordered mid August, got a few days later, expires next May. A few have been fragile and slightly battered from shipping, but not really a problem, just be careful with these little beauties. Good deal.

column9: Hard to find unfrosted pop tarts
column10: Around where I live, you cannot find unfrosted Pop Tart anything.  This was a great deal and they of course are delicious!  I definitely recommend getting them this way in bulk.  It saves money and you always have them on hand.
These are the Best-est PopTarts Ever!!Been eating them for 40+ years.I hope they never ever go away.

i love the unfrosted pop tarts. these are my favorite of all the varieties of pop tarts that they make. i love the pastry... number one... and the filling is perfect to me. the filling has a mild taste. it is not overpowering or too strong like some of the others. also... it is not overly sweet. it is just right for me. i put them in the toaster for a couple minutes to heat them up and to crisp them up just a little bit. delicious.........................yum and the prescribe price is great! they arrived with very little damage by the shipper.

column9: Just like when I was a kid
column10: Deee-licious.  Hard to find the unfrosted Pop-Tarts in stores these days, so this is a nice treat.  And they stay fresh, too.
A great breakfast on the run. Cinnamon is good for you and these without the frosting aren't too sweet. They were an old favorite when I was younger. Glad to have been able to find them.thanks

There is joy in my heart to have discovered that Amazon stocks UNFROSTED Brown Sugar Cinnamon Pop Tarts.  To my dismay, the grocery stores in my area no longer carry them.  There's nothing more delightful than to experience the warm, fresh-from-the-toaster goodness of an UNFROSTED Brown Sugar Cinnamon Pop Tart with butter slathered on it. I love to make slits in the pastry so that the butter can ooze into the sweet filling. Oh the thought of it!  Thanks Amazon.

column9: Good pop tarts, like the frosted ones better
column10: Nice, quick and easy breakfast.  Should of got the frosted ones though. Not sure why I signed up for S&S on these since that's a lot of pop tarts.

Unfrosted Pop-Tarts are perfection - put them in the toaster, add a little butter . . . divine. My grocery store stopped carrying these in favor of increasingly disgusting candified versions (Chocolate chip cookie dough and banana splits?), which are too sweet for me. It's been years since the disappearance of classic apple and I dread the day these disappear too!

Unfroasted Brown-sugar Cinamon Pop-Tarts was a childhood favorite of mine.  When Kellog's decided to put frosting on everything, They lost me!!!  Thanks to Amazon.com I now have a way to stock up on one of my most favorite flavor without the NASTY frosting. I shall be a fan for a long,long time! The only topping unfrosted brown-sugar cinamon ever needed, in my opinion, was melted butter.

Yeah. There's the Cookie Monster, and then there's the Pop Tart Monster.  But, only when it comes to the unfrosted Brown Sugar Cinnamon.I see a lot of folks have mentioned they're hard to find. Only place I've been able to find them is at the Walmart here in our area (Cedar Park, TX). H.E.B., Randall's, Super S, a lot of other grocery stores don't carry them for some reason - they carry everything else, but not these. (?)Oddly enough, whenever I get the chance to get by the Walmart, they're overstocked with all the other flavors and these are nearly all bought up. Yumm...time to go get some.

column9: MY FAVORITE POP TARTS IN THE WORLD
column10: BROWN SUGAR CINNAMON POP TARTSWhy, oh, why is it so hard to find this flavor of pop tart?  And why do stores only stock the frosted brown sugar cinnamon pop tarts?I have been a fan of this flavor pop tarts since they were first invented which was a looong time ago.  Nothing beats sticking these into the toaster, just getting them a little bit warm, and then spreading a very thin portion of butter on them.  Serve with ice cold milk -- skim, of course -- and you are in for a taste treat!  Your taste buds will thank you.I only wish more grocery stores would stock the au natural brown sugar flavor.  Frosting isn't everything!Thank you!Pam

I didn't even know they made unfrosted brown sugar cinnamon poptarts until about a year ago. I loved that they weren't as sweet as the frosted ones. I always liked tasting the dough of the poptarts better than the frosting. Then about six months ago my supermarket stopped carrying them!I've been so pleased with Amazon for offering this product and with free shipping! They're even cheaper than I used to get them for and they taste fresher! I've ordered this bulk box twice now and both times have been very pleased.

I thought my favorite Poptarts were discontinued and gone forever until I recently saw them in a grocery store in town.  Apparently it was a one time deal because after that they were gone again.  I was surfing the net and googled it and up it popped.  Ordered a case to be delivered every 6 months which is perfect because I am the only one who eats them and the expiration date on the box indicates they will be good even after the next shipment is due.  The case came shipped in another box with protective packaging to limit any cracking of the tarts.  I am thrilled to have this slice of my childhood again.

Our family loves these pop tarts and we were glad to find them as the grocery stores will no longer carry them.  That said, at least three of the pop tart boxes were crushed upon delivery.  Makes them hard to toast and eat.  I am not sure who I can tell to make sure they are handled better next time.

I really love my unfrosted Cinnamon PopTarts.  It seems that I can only find Frosted Cinnamon in the store.  Having them delivered to my door is always a plus too.  Saves time and gas money!  They arrived factory fresh, in sealed retail packaging.
My son loves his pop-tarts, and now didn't have to run around looking for them, just click the mouse!

we got this coloring for food and play dough making, it is a great set to start and nice colors as well. it arrived on time and were happy that it was as described by seller. will sure get another one soon.

Very nice colors! I see 6 colors, not 4. Because you can make orange and purple. You could actually also make brown and black. Unfortunately, purple was not a successful mix. Unless it take a rocket scientist to pull it off, and that I am not, I couldn't get a vibrant purple color. It was more of a mute lilac. The orange mix looked great.
I ordered edible ink and they sent regular ink like I wasn't going to notice.  Thanks for damn near poisoning my customers!

I ordered this set based on the information that it would fit my Epson NX115 printer and the cartridges are too big. When I called KopyKake, I was told that I was sent the wrong thing. These are used for a printer that is discontinued. Be careful when buying this product
i was a little bit uneasy at ordering a plant online. but bonsaiboy sent this beautiful cherry tree promptly and it arrived in beautiful condition. i will definitely recommend him again.

column9: It didnot look anythining like the picture they put up !
column10: Expecting the Bonsai to be looking exactly like in the picture with flowers, But it came packaged well but kind of dried and no flowers. Sent it for a gift and felt very bad for sending in such a gift.
Too sweet, weak cinnamon tase, and no heat at all, but my dog likes them. These are nothing like what we had as kids.

I just love cinnamon candies. I found these somewhere some time ago, but could not find them, again. I like they are individually wrapped, so don't stick together. I was happy to find them on Amazon.com. Great product.

It is hard to find these in bulk for a good price. So I saw these and thought I would try it out. It was a waste of money for me. I love cinnamon discs, but these don't live up to their name. If you are looking for a strong cinnamon punch, these aren't for you. Cinnamon discs I like have about the same punch as a stick of Big Red and these don't do it.

I had read that Monin grenadine contained "No artificial coloring or preservatives" as stated in the product description and other websites had stated the same thing. Not true at all. I just received my bottle in the mail and read the ingredients on the side, there is nothing natural about this except the sugar. Loaded with red 40 dye and artificial flavoring. If you are looking for a grenadine that won't dye your insides red I suggest making it from scratch.

column4: Hajnal's Secret Admirer in the Regenstein
column10: Just so you know, unlike most Monin syrups the grenadine syrup isn't made with "natural ingredients"--that is, it contains no pomegranate. Monin makes pomegranate syrup if you want something approaching true grenadine.This is still a very tasty syrup, however.
This makes the best pomegranate martinis - just add a shot of the syrup, a shot of orange juice and a shot of vodka, shake over ice and serve.  Delicious!

column9: A bit too sweet for my taste.
column10: Monin Pomegranate Syrup is an excellent product. However, it is a bit too sweet for my taste. Others may disagree.Also, Amazon almost always has a product that I am looking for.

I was really impressed by this item.  It was delicious and very satisfactory to taste.  I added it to a lemon lime soda and had an instant Shirley Temple drink.  I would have waited a long time for a drink like this to be fixed  for me.  Now I can have one any time I like.I am very pleased with the value of this purchase also.I would buy it again on Amazon.
All the Monin syrups are great, but the pomegranate flavor is THE BEST! If you like your drinks on the tarter side, try Pomegranate. You'll love it!

I am always looking for decent products without high fructose corn syrup, or even corn syrup at all, and grenadine syrup without it is VERY hard to find.  This Monin syrup fills the bill and tastes great too. Natural Tequila Sunrises, here we come.

I've been drinking Yellow Label Tea since the 80's. This is an excellent and versitile tea, makes for a good hot tea and also a refreshing iced tea. A bit stronger than regular "brisk lipton" tea typically found in the U.S. I used to have to wait until I traveled to the British Virgin Islands or the Bahamas to find this tea, but now it's on Amazon (darn, my excuses to travel are dwindling!). This is an Orange Pekoe tea in 200g bags. You can find different varieties of tea marked with the "Lipton Yellow Label" brand, usually loose leaf teas. For instance I have a Sri Lanka-packed metal tin of "Pure Ceylon," a box of "Coarse Black Tea" packed in Mumbai, and another "new bright & rich" Mumbai variety which is a blend of "Assam teas." These other varieties can be found in middle eastern, Indian, and Asian markets here in the US. All good teas, but this Orange Pekoe in the bags is the most convenient and has the smoothest flavour.

column9: Why this isn't a common US tea is beyond me.
column10: Traveling world wide, I've come to much prefer good tea to bad coffee, and good teas are so much more common.Yellow Label is one of the most popular teas in the world because it has a rich, clean flavor without bitterness.  Its clear distinctive red color makes it also one of the prettiest.  The only supermarket teas I've found in the US that taste similar are the "English Breakfast" labels.  If you like these, or like strong black tea flavor without the bitterness or muddiness of overbrewing the usual black teas, you should try Yellow Label.

I first enjoyed Yellow Label in the Caribbean 20 yrs ago and have since in travels worldwide been looked at oddly at groceries as I purchased 20 boxes to take home. There it was only tea, in the US it wasn't available...or oddly in London which appears on the label.  A letter to Lipton 6 years ago gave no explanation for not marketing in the US, just "coupons to try our other brands".  Finally, Amazon has it and even better a market in Chinatown here in NYC.What makes it great?  It's the only black tea that is full flavored but not bitter.  It's so smooth that you literally can make a pot of it, leave the bags in, reheat it the next day and still have no bitterness.  This is a tea lover's tea that I have turned numerous travel companions onto for life and something I would be lost without.

I was first given a box of this Yellow Label from a co-worker who had traveled to China.  I instantly fell in love with the smooth flavor.  I found it in a Food Max in Stockton, Ca but then the store closed down.  I have been on a search for the last two months because my loose leaf is almost gone also.  I was brewing the tea for the staff in my office and they all love it, so when I ran out of tea bags they all wanted to know where I got the tea from.  The flavor is so smooth that you almost do not need any type of sweetner at all.  This should be made available in the states in at least one major grocery store.  I am buying enough to share with my friends.....

column9: Even if you don't like tea . . .
column10: . . . you'll love this one. I fell in love with this black tea blend when I lived in Europe, and was disappointed when I returned to America that I couldn't buy it here. One taste of this smooth tea and you might change from coffee. It's the best cup of tea you'll ever drink.
It has a distinct taste that differs from the regular Lipton. I wish it were more readily available in the stores in US.

I drink lots of hot tea. Don't confuse this with the Lipton Tea you find at the grocery. There is no comparison. This is the good stuff. I bought this at a local farmers market(Atlanta) and since they closed, no one else carries it, so I ordered it from Amazon. Specify "Yellow Label Tea".

column9: Does not taste like Lipton Yellow Label tea sold in Italy, possibly stale, no expiration date on pkg.
column10: This is a repeat of the same review I left for another Amazon listing for the same tea (but at a significantly different price).  Despite the price difference, both listings appear to be for the same item and are sold by the same Indian Grocery.  From reading the other reviews, it is clear that at least one other customer had the same bad experience as I did.I was initially excited to find Lipton Yellow Label Tea on Amazon, as I just got back from Italy and fell in love with it there.  The Lipton Yellow Label Tea in Italy doesn't taste anything like the weak, poor-quality Lipton we get in the U.S., but the tea I ordered on Amazon (sold by Simply Beautiful) is actually manufactured for India and tastes bitter and/or stale.  You can't see from the photo, but the writing on the packages I received is not in English and says it was manufactured in Canada for India.  It is hard to tell whether the variety sold in India just tastes different than the kind in Italy, or if the tea was in fact stale, because there is NO sell-by or expiration date on the package (very disturbing), and the bags are NOT "foil-wrapped for freshness" as described on Amazon.  I was extremely disappointed in the taste of this tea from India, having looked forward to the lovely, full-bodied Lipton Yellow Label tea bags that I brought home from Italy.  Not to mention the fact that I would never want to buy imported groceries that don't have an expiration date, so there is no way to know how long they've been sitting in the warehouse, if they are stale, or when they will go stale after opening (especially since they are not individually wrapped).  I returned both boxes of tea and hope to get an Amazon refund soon.  I am very bummed.

The Lipton Yellow Label tea is a step above the "regular" Lipton sold here in the States. This is your basic, everyday black tea but it is much more flavorful and bolder than the Lipton variety sold in supermarkets here. It brews a good, bracing cup of tea. I recommend it over the supermarket variety any day. I have used this to make iced tea as well and while it's good over ice, it is best served hot.

I recv'd this tea in great condition. The packing and timeliness were great. I love this tea. It takes me back to when I had our son in an Italian hospital near Pisa, Italy. They brought me Lipton Yellow Label Tea. That was many years ago and I never forgot how good it tasted or stopped looking to buy more once we left Europe. Hubby and I were talking about it and I thought of Amazon! It was right here. I'm enjoying it in the afternoon for a pick me up! Good stuff!

I must echo the praise of Lipton Yellow Label tea.I don't know how this label may differ across countries, but recently I spent several month-long trips to Pakistan, where Lipton Yellow Label is pretty much all the black tea they serve, and tea is served all the time.  After getting around the initial shock of their custom of putting up to four teabags into 16 ounces of water there, I came to like the Yellow Label tea.  Then when switching a few times to Twinings tea at the hotel business center, I realized that Yellow Label is much better than all the tea I'd been drinking heretofore.  Comparing Yellow Label to other Litpons, other tea available in America, and even Twinings, which I considered the top of the heap, Yellow Label was clearly better.  A Pakistani friend who travels to the U.S. says that American tea is "insipid" and refuses to drink it.  I now agree, and think that Lipton Yellow Tea is the best tea I have ever had.  Now I've got to figure out where to buy it.  As far as I'm concerned, Yellow Label is the tea most worth drinking, which no doubt accounts for its popularity in Pakistan.
I discovered yellow tea while on vacation in Thialand. I drink it daily now instead of coffee.  In the summer, it makes a great sun tea.

This is a brand of orange pekoe black tea that is drunk all over the world. Lipton sells it in many countries, and while the product might have the same smooth, almost inoffensive base note, to me the UK version tastes very different than the Indian version, which is perceptable stronger and has a more "citrusy" note. While it doesn't hold up to some premium orange pekoe teas, it is distinctly better than the Lipton tea available in US supermarkets.

column9: A great tea by Lipton. Just as in France.
column10: My wife loves this tea, so I was pleased to be able to order it for her so easily in North America. It arrived promptly, and in good condition.
The company did do a refund for the tea. It looks the same as the box that comes from London. However, it is produced in India and has a very strong, almost bitter taste.
I first had this tea in Egypt.  It is so superior to the Lipton sold in the states that I was grateful to find a source online.

column9: Better than US marketed Lipton Brisk tea
column10: Discovered Yellow Label while on a trip to Japan.  I had arrived in Nagoya for a meeting, and had time to  wonder around a market...really just rubber-necking.I bought the familiar Lipton label as well as several other teas.  Yellow Label has a little more pronounced flavor than the US marketed Brisk Lipton tea.  If you are a tea drinker, you will probably enjoy the flavor. The worst part of brewing and drinking Yellow Label...trying to get rid of the box of US standard Lipton Brisk tea I already have sitting in the pantry.

I've been buying primarily whole leaf, oolong, pu'er, jasmine teas from a wholesale tea market in Beijing (Malian St). Though the price is far cheaper than the Ten  Fu (Ten Ren) teas and other retailers, the discernment in quality seemed questionable. I am a simpleton concerning tea. So rather than purchase $90/kg for the base Assam tea, I went to Carre4 and bought an under $5/box of Lipton Yellow label Black tea 100 bags for the consistant quality.

After running out of my usual every-day tea, Trader Joe's brand of "Irish Breakfast Tea," I found this Yellow Label first at my local Chinese supermarket in the tea aisle. I had only had the "brisk" version before and wasn't such a Lipton fan, but I needed tea and bought it.Contrary to the rather dusty, mild (watery??) taste of the "brisk" American version, Yellow Label has a good flavor and no bitterness, even when brewing for 6 min (I brew a small pot with three bags in the morning). Not quite as rich as Assam tea when mixed with milk and sugar, but a good substitute. And you can't beat the price. A very nice, full every-day tea.

column9: Pricing is out of line - 2X the price of buying them from Nespresso.
column10: You can order the same products online from Nespresso for approx $25 AND you can specify exactly what you want to buy rather than taking a mixture of items, some of which you may not like.Nespresso makes GREAT coffee and GREAT machines. The Nespresso capsule offers posted on Amazon however are all by third parties who prey on people who don't know better.

Nespresso capsules are fantastic.  But DO SOME HOMEWORK!!!!! Nespresso offers the same introductory pack when you buy a machine for 60 cents a capsule!  Why would you pay over a dollar a capsule for the same thing?  Amazon, why are you allowing this type of price gouging?  It reflects badly on your site.  Some oversight is needed here.

First time buying the nespresso capsules on amazon and amazed how FAST they shipped and how easy the transaction was. The variety pack was a good way to try multiple coffee roasts if you are new to Nespresso.  Will definitely order more!

I was born and raised in New Orleans. I have been a coffee lover as soon as I could drink from a cup! My great-grandmother would give it to me with lots of milk in it. Anyway, I have been through all of them all...back and forth... Community, CDM, Luzianne, French Market (red label), Union, PJ's...I even tried different types of pure coffee and adding my own chicory. I prefer the French Market Restaurant Blend. This one was introduced to me at a seafood restaurant called Coffee's Boiling Pot in Madisonville, LA. I love it. For me, it has the right blend of coffee and chicory (not hickory as some reviewer complained!) Of course,I wish the whole beans were available so that I could grind it myself.Anyway,it's a personal preference. Try it. If you don't like it, send it to me. I'll gladly drink it!

Tired of the same old Colombian every morning?  This makes a great change of pace.  The slight bitterness of the chickory may surprise you if you've never had it before; but you get over that quickly and find yourself enjoying a deliciously rich cup of New Orleans.  Of course, if you've visited New Orleans, you know what I mean.  I use this for about every third pot,just for that wake up.  Yet, it could be daily,it's that good. The other major brand?  Well, I doubt that you'd find much difference.  If you try both at once, let us know.Now, if only Amazon could ship fresh beignets.  Well, I see they do have mixes; so if you're ambitious, go at it.

I was introduced to medium roast 'C&C' (Coffee and Chicory) whenwe went to breakfast at Stanley's in the French Quarter and I washooked.  (Most days I am choking down the last of my Maxwell Houseso it doesn't go to waste but I'm counting the days til it's all gone.)The medium roast C&C is much smoother than regular coffee and Idon't taste any bitterness at all.French Market's medium roast Restaurant Blend (white can) is awesome.It says on the plastic lid to use 1/3 to 1/2 as much as regular coffee(so a 1-pound can is the equivalent of a 2-pound can of coffee).  Basedon my experience, using only 1/3 wouldn't be enough - a 1/2 is better.One bit of advice I can give to those who add milk or cream to theircoffee - don't try adding milk or cream until the color matches whatyou had with coffee or it'll be weakened too much.  The C&C will bedarker with the 'right' amount of milk or cream.As I write this Amazon's page says it's not available but I found it'savailable directly from French Market [...]for $7 a 1-pound can ($1 less if you order 12 cans or more).  I planon handing out cans as Christmas gifts.
I have been using this product for years and this is the best price by far that I have found. The convenience of the recurring order is a no brainer.
I love this coffee! I love strong coffee so this is great! My parents are from Louisiana so I am familiar with this coffee.

column9: a favorite for years at a better price
column10: I have been buying French Market for over 25 years.  I usually get the "Red" one but also like this one.  It goes further and is cheaper than the standard coffee brands on the market... because you need to use less when measuring.  The flavor with chicory is rich and strong.  As I said, after so many years,  I must really like it.

I received my order on time as promised.  I usually order the French Market in the red can, but there were not enough of these to complete my order, so I ordered the Restaurant Blend.  I mixed it with the regular French Market coffee, and cannot tell the difference.  Amazon delivers quality and quickly as promised.  Will definitely order again.

I've been drinking coffee with chicory for decades - the chicory makes a smooth, rich, dark coffee and you use less of it too. (Save money, get a little less caffeine.)  I've bought and enjoyed different brands over the years: Luzianne, both regular and premium; Cafe du Monde; and French Market. But this French Market Restaurant Blend is absolutely the best! And with automatic shipment it is unsurpassed.Note for those who haven't tried coffee with chicory: I've read "professional" reviews where the reviewer claims the chicory makes the coffee more bitter. I find the opposite to be true. I think these reviewers just keep repeating the same info without really testing the coffees. Besides, anyone who can drink "Charbucks" cannot complain about bitterness in any other blend. :-)

column9: Brings New Orleans to me every morning
column10: Restaurant Blend is rich without being bitter. If you love New Orleans blend coffees, this blend is perfect to drink black or create a delicious cafe au lait.

column9: Great coffee, great price, great service!
column10: My title says it all.  The coffee is our favorite and this is the best price available, plus it automatically ships.  Can't beat this!
This is restaurant quality coffee. It has the great New Orleans flavor. Great coffee at a great price and came quickly.

Okay - I was expecting that French Market flavor I'm used to in the Red Can and its the white can...  Don't get me wrong its good coffee - just not the chicory blend I'm used to - more of a dark coffee flavor.  I called and got a refund on it. I'm waiting for the Red Can to be available...  Thanks.

If you like New Orleans chicory coffee you will like this.  My wife and I enjoyed it quite a bit.  The only thing that keeps me from giving it 4 stars is that you have to buy too many cans, it is not an every day coffee.

column9: Don't buy, useless with no taste or flavor
column10: This chicory/coffee is ver, very bland, with no flavor of either coffee or hickory.  I am very sorry that I bought it - in large quantity to save on shipping and I'm regretting it.  I wish I can return it, but, I don't want any one else with taste to suffer either.  I don't know what to do!Bottom line, we Americans don't know what true coffee/chicory is!

Believe it or not, I've never tried British steamed pudding until now. I ordered Aunty's Chocolate and Spotted Dick puddings on Amazon after the recent Royal Wedding of William and Kate. I noticed on Amazon that a lot of people were buying things such as scone mixes, lemon curd, clotted cream, British tea, etc. I also noticed that some people bought steamed pudding as well. I've  always wanted to try British steamed pudding after I read Charles Dickens' "A Christmas Carol" as a child, and saw "A Christmas Carol", the 1999 movie with Patrick Stewart and Richard E. Grant. I've seen many movie versions of Charles Dickens' "A Christmas Carol", and I honestly think that the Patrick Stewart version is the best one. The mother of an ex-boyfriend of mine told me that she saw Patrick Stewart doing the one-man Broadway show of "A Christmas Carol" when he came to St. Louis, and she told me that Patrick Stewart was excellent. Anyways, the 1999 "A Christmas Carol" movie captured the Cratchit family Christmas dinner so well. And the scene where Mrs. Cratchit brings in the Christmas pudding/plum pudding was a nice scene, and made me want to try Christmas pudding. Even though this is not titled Christmas pudding/plum pudding, it's close enough. I popped these puddings in the microwave and served them to my mother as part of her Mother's Day gift, and my whole family liked both Aunty's steamed puddings. I prefer the chocolate pudding over the spotted dick pudding. I bought some extra chocolate steamed puddings for some of my co-workers to try. I've also decided to order Walkers Shortbread Rich Fruit Pudding on Amazon to get the actual Christmas pudding experience. David Perdue has an excellent Charles Dickens website - type "charlesdickenspage.com" as part of the URL. Click on "Dickens and Christmas", scroll down and to the left there is an actual plum pudding recipe for people who desire to take the time to cook the pudding a la Cratchit family. Anyways, these Aunty's steamed puddings are easy to cook - pop them in the microwave for 30 to 40 seconds.  And they're less than 5% fat, and are suitable for vegetarians as well. If you want to try something different, then try Aunty's steamed puddings!

The blackberry vanilla tea has a nice aroma and a great taste.  I can taste the berry and a hint of the berry.  Also, makes a great iced tea.  Caffeine- free means I can enjoy in the evenings.  Also not that the ingredients include rosehips, hibiscus flowers, blackberry leaves, dried blackberry and raspberry pieces.  It comes in a triangle-shape mesh bag, so you can see the ingredients.  Very enjoyable.

column9: Quite tart, little vanilla flavor, but drinkable...
column10: If they call it blackberry/vanilla, I really expect more vanilla aroma and flavor than this tea has. The blackberry and currant tend to predominate the taste, making the tea tart rather than sweet. Another reviewer called it "astringent," and I tend to agree with that. Lipton suggests a 4-6 minute steep, but I far preferred the lesser time -- even 3 minutes is enough. A six-minute brew was really too tart. The color is beautiful, and the tea has a good aroma in spite of the small amount of vanilla. I probably wouldn't buy it again, but naturally it's a question of taste. For me, it's good but not great.

column9: Pleasant berry taste with just a trace of vanilla
column10: Lipton's Blackberry Vanilla herbal tea comes in a cute little bag shaped like a pyramid.  The flavors of blackberry and raspberry are a pleasant change from the norm, with the smallest trace of vanilla.I will use this product again.  It's a very nice way to fill my teacup.

I'm a big tea drinker and am always looking for different flavors and varieties to try. Blackberry Vanilla is an aromatic combination; this tea is that and a flavorful drink, too. I steeped one tea pyramid in a cup of hot water for eight minutes (the box recommends six) and was surprised by the beautiful color and nice flavor: not too overwhelming taste of blackberries with vanilla sailing in after the first sip. This also makes a great iced tea.The biggest concern I had was when I read the ingredients on the side of the box. Like a previous reviewer said, the first ingredient is hibiscus--for a blackberry vanilla tea. How strange.Good for any occasion.

First off, I love the pyramid versus the regular tea bag.  I don't know why it works better, but it does.  The leaves stay put so there's nothing floating around in the tea and the flavor is fantastic.  Now as for this particular flavor, Blackberry Vanilla, it's amazing.  I can taste the blackberry and hibiscus flowers far more than the vanilla, but since I love blackberries and the other flavorings (blueberries and raspberries among others), it's perfect for me.  I didn't even have to add any sort of sweetener.  An added bonus:  the smell is heavenly.

column9: the tetrahedral pastic bags are fun
column10: With a couple of teaspoons of sugar this tea is a real treat.I've tried mixing it with black tea and green tea with successas well. The Blackberry is good for antioxidants and vanillasmooths the taste out.

Lipton's Blackberry-Vanilla is a great decaf tea packing major hibiscus/raspberry/rosehip flavor. The aroma is fantastic with just a hint of vanilla, and the tea is fairly tart - a bit surprisingly tart at first sip. The blackberry and vanilla come through in the flavor - but the rosehip/hibiscus/raspberry is definitely the primary taste. I've tried this tea both hot and iced, and enjoyed both. Bonus points for being decaffeinated!

column4: Glenda Boozer "Live, live, live! Life is a ba...
column10: Lipton Herbal Pyramid Tea Bags, Blackberry Vanilla, has bits of blackberry, but also other berry flavors and black currant. To me, the black currant fragrance almost dominates, but if you like a fruity tea, this is a good one. The rich dark-fruit accents and the blackberries catch your attention before you even open the box. The color of the tea is an appealing dark red-violet, and it is good hot or iced. I would sweeten it a bit and consider a splash of lemon.

During the cooler months, I love to drink a good cup of tea. But there's nothing worse than getting everything ready to find that your tea bag broke and your have leaves floating in your tea. So now with the Lipton Pyramid, you won't have that problem anymore. The pyramid itself is made of a mesh material that's very strong so it won't have a problem with breaking. And the tea itself is delicious. The flavor of it was very delicate and relaxing. Overall it's a much better way to brew tea.

column9: Amazing color. Flavor... not so much
column10: Please see "tea.jpg" photo on this page. The color once steeped is tremendous, a really great ruby-red that looks like it's out of a 1940s Technicolor movie. The aroma is very pleasant, sweet and floral. The taste, however, leaves a bit to be desired. The aroma is promising you the moon and your brain is going "Yes, yes, yes!" and then the taste doesn't have the goods, you know? Kind of thin-tasting. I've had a locally-produced hibiscus tea which has a more assertive flavor (if not the incredible color). I'm going to let this cool down and make some iced tea later and see if that doesn't help this tea out a bit. Another sip. The aroma is heavenly. But the taste is absent.This comes not in a teabag, but a clever little synthetic-material pyramid for some reason. Very novel. Novelty is valuable. Really just the fact that this stuff is so different and comes in a little pyramid tea infuser would make it a nice stocking-stuffer type gift for the tea lover(s) in your life. Or "teabags" as a British ex-roommate once described dedicated tea drinkers. Another sip. Still kind of weak-tasting, but I wonder if you couldn't put this stuff in a room humidifier... (don't try this, it's just a thought because this tea smells so great)...The flavor is growing on me, but it's still thin-tasting compared to the incredible aroma...---Unfortunately, this tea wasn't very good as iced tea. Kind of tasted like watered-down fruit punch.

This is a great tasting tea with great flavor. If you are not a vanilla fan stay away. Nothing is overpowering about it however it is distinct in its flavor. I am not a fan of the pyramid bags they get stuck around a spoon easier when stirring and such.

This was my first experience with a "pyramid" tea bag, and I quite liked it. I'm not sure what it is made of; but allows you to see quite well what your tea looks like and allows for water to flow through without soaking much up.Opening the overwrap of the box there wasn't a lot of aroma & I was a bit worried. However, I have had teas that smelled great in the box and fell flat in the cup. As soon as the water (cold) hit the bag, it started coloring. That was a little worrying too...I've had herbal teas that were a lot of dye and no taste.Once this came out of the microwave, it smelled great. I have to say i didn't get a lot of vanilla, but there was a tartness that was quite pleasant. We had blackberries often this summer & while I am sure there were blackberries in the mix, I didn't get a lot of blackberry flavor either...but the "other natural flavors" (hibiscus etc) were enjoyable. And at 2.70 a box...I think this well worth the price.We are looking forward to trying a few other flavors.

I am not one that drinks basic tea. That said the Lipton Blackberry Vanilla is delicious. Very sweet does not need sugar added. I also love the little triangular tea bags that brew up a rich flavor. Delightful and I will buy more of these.

I brewed it up as hot and sipped some, it was tasty, then I let it cool and poured it over ice with some sweet n low...OH MY...iced this tea goes from yummy to SUPER DUPER yummy!! To me texting my son and telling him it was as the title says "insanely delicious" ...it's my new favorite. There's a pitcher in the fridge right now. I only wish I'd gotten a six pack for review! Now I have to order more! Happy tea drinking me!!

I honestly expected to not like Lipton's Blackberry Vanilla herbal tea. Mostly because I don't really like herbal tea. I like English Breakfast and green tea. Everything else has been "Oh that's nice. You can have the rest. Really, you can take it. I won't mind."But this was really good. All the ladies at lunch agreed as well.It has a nice color. Purple for the blackberries. The vanilla isn't strong but it is a natural sweetener so I didn't have to put sugar in it. The berry taste is primary but not like a juice. It was just delicious and light and went great with the wafer cookies that we had as an after-lunch dessert.Very pleased and will definitely add to my limited list of teas to drink.

I like it, I really, really do - and the little pyramid-shaped tea-bag seems to really let the various flavors come through, clean and clear. There is no vaugely papery after-taste. It is good and flavorful enough to even drink straight, hot or cold  although I pefer hot, with a dash of honey. Lipton might not be my choice for breakfast teas - since I really prefer Wagh Bakri Tea (Special International Blend) - 1lb for my breakfast cuppa, but as herb teas go, this is one of the best.

column9: Strong Blackberry Flavor, More Subtle Vanilla
column10: Upon first sip, the blackberry flavor is predominant. The vanilla notes are more subtle, and occur to me after I've tasted the strong blackberry. I don't mind the two-stage flavor effect, but if I could change anything about this tea, I'd want the vanilla flavor to be a little stronger.

column9: Good flavor, if potentially on the strong side
column10: I admit to being a bit of a tea snob, but I'm willing to try new ones.  This was a new one on me.  I like Lipton's vanilla caramel tea, so I thought I might not mind this one.  I was right.  The vanilla flavor manages to come through even with the berry flavors being so present.  I would not call this refreshing but rather bold.  I tried it about an hour before bed and it did not keep me up at all, so it is caffeine free as advertised.  I also like the pyramid bag as I feel it brews a lot faster.  I admit to liking my tea strong, but I still had to pull this one out pretty quick because the flavors are so big.At any rate, it's pretty good if you like berry flavors with your herbal tea.  The vanilla flavor balances the drink a bit but I find I have to be in the mood to drink this.  I wouldn't say it is great as I'm still partial to other flavors and brands, but I was not disappointed by Lipton's Blackberry Vanilla tea.

I have been a longtime Celestial Seasonings drinker for years, but they do not have a blackberry flavor among their "Zingers".  That is why I decided to try this Blackberry Vanilla Herbal Tea from Lipton.  I use a large cup; therefore, I used two tea bags like I do for all of my other hot teas.  After brewing my first cup, I was very pleased with the flavor.  It started out with a strong blackberry flavor, but the hint of vanilla gives it a very mellow finish.  The "Zinger" teas by comparison can have a somewhat harsh finish.  If it were only about first impressions of taste, this would be a hands down five star product.  However, I have a couple of complaints about the packaging.  The tea bags are loose in the box with no container.  Once you open the shrink wrap, the flavor will decay fairly quickly as the box does not close tightly.  In addition, the is a small piece of tape or adhesive strip on the string attaching it to the tea bag and taking up the excess string.  I understand that this is to keep the loose bags from becoming a tangled mess.  However, wrapping each tea bag individually would solve all of the problems noted.  If Lipton would do this, they would have a true five star product.  Until then, they lose two stars.  I would only recommend this if you intend to use the entire box quickly.  Otherwise the flavor from your first cup will only be a faint memory on the last cup from the box.

I am a big tea drinker.  I drink caffeinated tea during the day, but switch to white or green tea in the evening.  I usually drink loose leaf tea, but I thought I'd give this a try.  You definitely get the berry flavor and color from this tea.  I was surprised that it didn't contain artificial colors after brewing my first cup.  It is a little on the tart side as the box says.  If you don't like that, you can add a bit of sugar or honey.  I like it with just a touch of sugar.  The little pyramid bags are very cute and the tea is spread out better than in a folded bag, and the lightweight material seems like it allow better circulation.I have started drinking this in the evening when I sit down to read.  It has a very soothing quality to the aroma and flavor.

column9: Rich, Tart and Balanced Herbal Tea +++
