Love this stuff!Potato Chips:Ingredients:* 2 baking potatoes thinly sliced on a mandolin* Garlic powder* Salt* Pepper* Olive oil (75% of the mixture)* Truffle oil (25% of the mixture)Directions:1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees F2. Pour enough olive oil and truffle oil in baking pan/sheet to thinly cover entire surface area.3. Move pan around to coat evenly.4. Put pan in oven for 2-3 minutes to heat oil.  Remove pan from oven.5. Sprinkle desired seasonings in the oil.6. Place sliced potatoes in oil (will fit about 1 large potato per baking sheet).  Do not overlap!7. Bake for 8 minutes, flip potato slices over.8. Bake until done 5-8 min (continue to check as the outside ones will crisp sooner)9. For round 2: Reapply some oil and seasonings.  Repeat process
what an incredible addition to my already delicious mushroom risotto! I cannot wait to use it more. Absolutely delicious!!

Have been looking for truffle oil for some time and after reading the reviews here, I decided to give this brand a try.  It is excellent, a little goes a long way and it's a great addition to soups and pizza. Expensive, but worth it.  I will order the larger bottle the next time.
Bought this a couple of weeks ago. Tastes great. I add it to pasta dishes with cheese. No complaints at all
I've bought 1 ounce bottle and I didn't like the taste at all. It doesn't have that truffle aroma and flavor. It tasted like olive oil.

Pros:Pungent and unmistakable aroma and smellTastes divine with truffle saltCheap for good truffle oilGreat pouring spout and designAbsolutely addictiveCons:Absolutely addictiveCan become a costly habitIn a side by side test, this oil is, imo, far better than roland's.  It's garlicy, pungent, delciious and when mixed with some truffle salt (I use fungus amongus) it tastes divine.  Also it doesn't dribble annoyingly like the Roland's does and has a dedicated spout (I bought the larger so cannot say much about the smaller).  That alone makes it better, though don't get me wrong Roland makes really good oils as well.On the note of size, if you like truffle oil this is habit forming and you better get the larger bottle.  Then again, because it is addictive you may want to watch your caloric intake and choose the smaller bottle.  Though if you like truffles half as much as I do you will wish you bought the larger bottle.  I am eating this with plain oatmeal to taste the difference between roland's and frankly I can't wait to try this on eggs or on mushrooms.

column9: Drinking truffle oil for the first time was slightly anti-climactic experience.
column10: After reading and hearing so much about truffle oil, I have build up large expectations in my mind. As one of the few remaining, who never had truffle oil before, I did lot of asking around and checking to help me pick correct brand.This one came out as one of the best and I just chose it arbitrarily.I have had it on several pasta and vegetable dishes and it was interesting. Even though both taste and aroma are very intriguing, I have to admit I was expecting more.  Not sure what exactly, just that it does not seem as wildly fantastic as many people are describing.I am sure if I was not hyped up prior to tasting it, my experience of it would have been different, more open minded and less critical.I will be happy to finish the bottle, just that I have to use really only a little bit at a time, as it did have strange metallic taste when I took a sip of it.Obviously I am no truffle expert, this is just my personal opinion.  Once I've had other oils to compare, I will come back and write more about the comparison.

I was skeptical for the price and not having previous name recognition of this company but come to find out the truffle oil is very strongly and nicely perfumed. It is well worth the value, quality, and convenience over purchasing in a "gourmet market" paying 3x as much for an inferior product. This has already paid for itself and I'm only 1/10th through the bottle. Potatoes, pasta, polenta, and mushroom confit so far can't wait to drizzle this on some cauliflower soup or a simple white bean stew
Unable to make mushroom festival in kennett square this year.... so we decided to order online ... very pleased with taste!!!

Great oil. However, you'll never get the cap back on the bottle. Once you open it, the cap won't go back on. I placed the cap on top of the bottle to cover it, so next time I went to pick up the bottle, I ended up dropping it, wasting the oil.

This oil though not from actual truffles has a fantastic aroma it is strong so only a few drops are needed to give a delicious finishing taste to sauces pizza and or whatever you want to put it on. I got the smaller bottle and I am kicking myself for not shelling out a few more bucks. Whoever is claiming that its not good or only three stars is a moron who doesn;t know anything, Once again it is not from real truffles but does taste a hell of a lot like them. Black has a pungent aroma, and the white is more sophisticated and cleaner taste.

smells  bad  taste worst ..  i opened it up and it was the worst smell i've ever smelled.....the only thing i could imagine what the smell compares to it would be the smell of a rank hooker ..  it smelled so bad that my dog ran from the bottle....and the taste was horrific....i used it at dinner and i can still taste it and dinner was about 5 hours ago....disgusting.it was  bad  i will never try it again  ..
This looks/smells/tastes like it could be the stuffing or filling for something else. To make this a complete meal, add some refried beans, salsa, and roll up in a tortilla for a very tasty burrito.
This product makes a good tasting meal when ya dont have much time on your hands to eat.  And the left overs are just as good as when it was freshly made.
My family loves Weber Grill BBQ Rub Classic. We can't find it in stores.We use this rub for everything we grill. It taste great.
This is especially good on pork. I dry rub on roasts and ribs!Great flavor and not too much heat.

This candy was extremely heat damaged.  It shipped in September to the midwest.  The only way to eat the candy, was to cook it in the microwave and melt it from the package and than wait until it cooled.  This was purchased thur Amazon, but was shipped from one one their affiliates.

Jolly Rancher Stix Cherry Flavor - 36 count. Amazon.com had the best price for these candies & with a reasonable shipping fee, especially since it was a small order.  Received much earlier than estimated, arriving  in only 3 days. The stix were in good condition,  none were broken.
dog only ate 3 bones so far shes tiny but she loves them i think the bones will last her forever you definatly save money plus super shipping

column9: Farewell Old Friend - Exciting UPDATES below original post
column10: ORIGINAL POST (September 26, 2010):I used to buy several bags of Chocolate Twizzlers at a time, because otherwise I wouldn't be able to eat any as they were gobbled up quickly by my family. The new version is gummy and nasty tasting and no one in my family will eat them. In fact, I had to throw out two one pound bags.UPDATE (December 22, 2011):Today I received a reply to a letter that I had written to The Hershey Company a while ago about the changes in the taste and consistency of Chocolate Twizzlers. The letter dated December 14, 2011 held exciting news, "Based on consumer comments like yours, we decided to change the product back to the classic twist".  The letter also stated that the bags to look for will have a message stating, "Now in the Classic Twist".Hurrah, Huzzah, Yippee, Yahoo!!!  Thanks ever so much to the wonderful people at Hershey's for bringing back the Chocolate Twizzlers I love and adore : )UPDATE (August 15, 2012)Just purchased 2 bags of Classic Twist Chocolate Twizzlers at Weis Market - they taste just like original chocolate Twizzlers, so I can add them back on the weekly goodie list : )

Leave it to the Italians to think of a way to make something so delicious from mullet eggs.  I first had this in Italy with polenta, and then I saw Mario Battali on the Chew making a dish with it.  A very good basic ingredient, delicious in a salty way, good for base of salad dressing, on pasta...Quick service from your bottarga supplier and a hand written note.
My favorite coffee is Peet's.And Columbian is my first choice.The only thing I don't like about it is not many cities have their coffeehouses.

Peet's Colombia Ground Coffee is earthy, well-balanced and has that fresh aroma which characterizes the very best Colombian coffee.  This coffee while not overpowering is robust and rounded.  You can taste the quality and it keeps you coming back for more.
This coffee tastes similar to Folgers. It doesn't even come close to Starbucks'.  I'm stuck with 2 lbs of this average tasting coffee. Would not order this again.

column9: Not something you'd eat for every meal, but not bad tasting.
column10: I am one who loves very strong flavors and a lot of spice in my food.  With that in mind, This sauce was incredibly rich tasting. Very creamy, with a distinctive taste of coconut.  It's not the same as taking a mouthfull of fresh coconut or drinking coconut milk, but you can discern the sweet coconut flavor.  I made Chicken and shrimp Korma last night, using extremely thin sliced chicken breast (the kind of cut most oriental places put in their moo goo pai pan and other chicken dishes)  The shrimp was 31-40 count.  I added some fresh steamed veggies to the mix as well, and put it on a bed of Basmati rice.  I heated the sauce, dumped it over top, and served it family style.I thought the combination of the sauce with chicken, shrimp, AND veggies all worked, so its a versatile sauce.  I think it might go well with just about any meat or veggie option.  It did wear on my towards the end of the dish, however, due to the richness.  I would have prefered a bit stronger garam masala flavor, so I compensated and added a little into the sauce.  I won't be making this all the time, but every once and a while its a refreshing taste in indian cooking.  I still think I'll stick to Patak's vindaloo paste.  That's become a staple in my house when I'm not in the mood to make curry pastes from scratch.

This is an okay curry sauce, very basic indeed.  I did not taste anything outstanding, and little coconut flavor.  I much prefer the Shere Khan  korma, it has a bolder flavor.  But if your seeking a tame flovor this would a good choice too.

This tea is amazing. It tastes so good I switched from coffee to Teavana's tea. I feel lost with out a cup in the morning and a couple more throughout the day. The teavana travel mug is worth the $$$ invest and you will have delicious warm tea with you all day.

I am brand new into brewing loose leaf tea and this was the first cup I tried.  Delicious!!  I will never be going back to tea bags again.  I brewed it in a french press actually because I got this in the mail before my Adagio Ingenuitea arrived, and both my girlfriend and I instantly had to have a 2nd cup.  Great tea!

This tea is very good.  I'm a religious green tea drinker, so I decided to branch out and try this fruity variety.  I'll have to admit that it doesn't have quite enough of the green tea taste that I was hoping for and I don't taste any Jasmine, BUT it is still delicious and I would recommend it to anyone who likes fruity teas.

This peanut butter has a great balance of peanuts and coconut.  Tastes delicious; not as rich as I would have expected (which is good); and appears to be nutritious.  Bought it locally for $5.79 a jar.

column9: So good you forget your own name!!!
column10: This is by far the best tasting peanut butter I have ever tried.  It's so creamy and doesn't separate in the jar.  The coconut gives it just the right flavor and makes a great companion to the peanuts.  I love it so much that I bought a whole case of it from my local Whole Food Coop.  I get it for $4.09 a jar with my investor discount.  This is soooooooooo good that you'll want to eat it straight from the jar!

column9: ANY ONE PAYING THIS PRICE IS NUTS
column10: This is the best nut spread I have ever tasted! All it took was one sample and I was hooked I purchase it from Whole Foods (so sorry Amazon) I have never had to write a bad review about anything from you & never thought I would ever have to but, please find another place to do business when it comes to his product. wherever you are getting it now is simpley crazy I pay less for two jars, in fact I could get it for another 10% less if purchased by the case, right now I am paying $4.99 per jar. Huge difference right?
BEST PEANUT BUTTER EVER. I'm addicted to peanut butter, regardless. But this is super creamy... and just great. It doesn't taste like coconut, if you're worried about that. It's amazing.

column9: Good bowls, but could be heavier if intended for use by big dogs
column10: These bowls are sturdy plastic and fit great in our dishwasher.  I thought they would be a heavier resin, but they may be a more hollow plastic.  So far, they've worked fine with our labradors, so they should be able to withstand use by most dogs.
This is a great bowl for my pets water!It isn't heavy. It holds a lot of water. When placed outside neither the bowl or the water get hot- which is what I didn't like about the metal bowls.

I was quite pleased with the performance of this repellent. I am a fan of Jungle repellent but I have found this to work quite well. What I also like is that there is not too much greasiness and there is very little smell. With some other high DEET preparations an application can leave my children coughing and sputtering, not so with this product.

We bought this for a trip to the BVI - which has tons of mosquitoes, day and night.  It worked pretty well.  We still got a few bites, but not nearly as many as the night we went out without it.There is another review saying this is not DEET.  That is 100% incorrect.  This is 23% DEET, which is a high as you will find in most normal bug sprays.  It is good idea to wash it off after you come back inside or some people might have a reaction to the high DEET content.  Not for little kids.The spray bottle works very well.

column9: Says Unscented, but still smells. Works great though.
column10: This works great. The only downside is that, while it says it's unscented, it still has a strong chemical smell. Not as bad as some other similar products, but definitely still noticable.

I bought this for a hiking trip in New England's mountains.  I neglected to take into account all of the black flies.  I was quite protected from the large mosquitoes I saw on parts of the hike, but was constantly swarmed by black flies.  I wish I would have found another product, as this did not work in the backwoods of New England.  However, it would work well in areas without those pesky flies.

A friend brought it for me to Haiti and it works great! Before I had to put repellent like every 4 hours, but with this one I spray some in the morning and then at night and I only need a little bit.  I highly recommend it.

I live in the tropics of Houston, TX where the mosquitos can be known to rival the size of small gerbils. This Cutter product goes on without much scent and keeps the insects from feasting on my legs and exposed skin. Probably good for a few hours before needing to re-apply, but no complaints.
This product did NOTHING to repel insects when my boyfriend and I went on a 10 mile deep woods hike. We were very disappointed with this product
Not waterproof and very strong! We use it for walks in the woods.  Has high concentrate of deet, and thats a little concerning.

One-star review is not a reflection of product but of shipping.  It is a pump spray which came without the pictured cap, so DEET was all over the 14"x12" envelope in which it was shipped.  acehardwareoutlet is negligent with a toxic chemical, please stop ordering with them.
The is a wonderful product that is more safe for all who use it.  Not DEET.  Thank goodness!!  Pleasant scent, easy to use but not easily found locally.

These cookies are healthier than their American counterparts, that's for sure. They're delicious and I suppose you can say that they're "healthy". It arrived without any breakage but it did not arrive very quickly (I have prime and it arrived in more than a week).
Not too sweet, very European cookie. Good price. No complaint at all. If you enjoy cookies that are not too sweet, crispy and light, this is your cookie. Arrived in great condition, no breakage.

I did a fair amount of research before purchasing the Holy Jolokia sauce.  I selected this because it was pure Bhut Jolokia, not cut with Habaneros or other.  Given that the bhut jolokia is rated at 1,000,000 SHU, I was expecting some FIRE.  Tabasco sauce is up to 5,000 SHU.  Tabasco Habanero sauce is 7,000+.  This should be BLAZING.  Instead it is somewhere between original tabasco and tabasco habanero sauce.  Maybe 6,000 SHU.It has a mildly sweet flavor and a hint of orange and the heat hits differently, more on the tip of the tongue and the back of the throat.  The burn dissipates quickly and there's no real "morning after" problems.To be rather honest, I was expecting more.
I agree that it is not particularly hot, but man is it good.  I'm not sure I've ever encountered a had a better ballance of flavor to burn.

Got this in the mail had to try it out first thing.  On the heat scale for me 1 being cold and 10 being HOT!!!  I give this a 7.  First time to try it lit me up, but after a while I got used to it and then it was spicy enough for my foods.  A little dab of it goes a long way so you don't have to cover your food with it to make it hot.

i was eacited to buy this hot sauce because of the high rating from an Americas Test Kitchen tast test & comparison. i was surprised to find it, although very tasty, it was very mild. i like very hot hot sauces so be careful. it appears that the Americas test kitchen tasters, though i value their opinions very much, are kind of wimps for hot sauce.

I probably have a half-dozen varieties of jolokia sauce in the house right now (plus quite a few other hot sauces from different peppers). Holy Jolokia, a CaJohns product, is probably my favorite of the lot.A portion of the proceeds from its sale go to benefit the Chili Pepper Institute at New Mexico State University, so that's a plus.The sauce is a pure jolokia, with no other peppers, but a hint of lemon extract. It's a little thicker than CaJohns' Naga Soreass, and similar in consistency to Frank's Red Hot. The heat is pleasantly strong but nowhere near as fiery as other jolokia sauces. The flavor hits the perfect notes of smokiness for a jolokia sauce, and the ingredients list is the shortest of any of the sauces I own--usually a very good sign.Most of these sauces come in 5 oz bottles and will last me a year--I expect this bottle to be gone inside two months.
This is one of the best hot sauces on the planet , great flavor and just the right amount of heat perfect ballance I go threw a bottle about every 6 weeks I put it on everything, great sauce!!

column9: If you are looking for a heat fix, this is not it
column10: I am a bit of a hot food aficionado.  I long moved off regular Tabasco and now need the habanero Tabasco to get a decent burn.  So after reading about the jolokia pepper I eagerly ordered this sauce, paying through the nose given the extra shipping cost. However I was very disappointed. I find the habanero Tabasco to be hotter than this stuff.  I'm looking for something to knock my socks off, the kind of heat level that you sort of regret having put in your mouth after doing so. This is not it.  Even ten drops of the stuff in a sauce on my own plate doesn't do much for me.  So I wont be ordering this again.(UPDATE - getting near the end of the bottle now, and I have to say taste-wise, I'm starting to quite like it.  However, I don't like it enough to pay the Amazon shipping fees, and it's not sold in any supermarkets near me, so I doubt I will be ordering this again.  Suggestion to the makers, if they ever read these comments: dispense with the labelling which makes it seem like a rival to the "Dave's" line of hot sauces when it blatantly isn't, and just market it on the basis of the taste.)
I agree with David R., this stuff is whimpy compared to my habanero sauces. Good flavor but not high on the heat...

As somone who loves hot foods, I was looking forward to my first taste of jolokia hot sauce.  Imagine my suprise, when I doused a tortilla chip with some Holy Jolokia.  I thought somone had slipped some dull Tabasco or other innocuous sauce in place of the real thing.  It had some flavor but no more heat than the plethora of other middle heat sauces that claim to be "hot".The flavor was more like habanero....only much tamer.  And to think this was developed be the Univ. of Arizona's hot pepper research lab.  Very disappointing.

My two dogs LOVE these!  I cut each strip into bite-sized six pieces.  I like the fact that they are quite a healthy treat and low fat.Healthy Partner Pet Snacks All Natural Beef Strips, 6-Ounce Bags (Pack of 4)
My Pooshon Coco loves these doggie treats and won't eat in the morning without having one in her dish!!!  The treats are all natural and made in the USA.

Bought these to replace the "fake-on" bacon strips my dog loves with something that was actually natural meat and not some extruded bacon-ish goo.Both the beef and turkey flavors are a big hit with my big boy and they are made in the USA. Even better....
I hope they always make this product, cause my dogs LOVES them!! I go through a bag a week so I make sure to always keep plenty on hand.

This treats are awesome!!!!!! These are the only treats my two jack russells will eat and needless to say they love it!!!!!! I told my Mother about them and now she buys them for her dog and her dog loves them so much she is on a auto delivery plan. The price is fanatastic I pay 22.00 for 4 6 oz bags and I use to pay 9.95 a bag same size and everything you have my dos undying love forever!!!!!!!

I got these in the mail yesterday.  I have two golden retrievers, one a year old and one 13 years old.  The 13 year old is very fussy about treats and food.  I opened one of these bags of Turkey Chips and had both sitting waiting.  I gave one to the old dog and he ate it instantly, I gave one to the young one and he dropped it by mistake and the old one moved quicker than I have seen him move in months to grab that one on the floor before my young one could pick it up.  Obviously, they are a hit with both dogs and I can see the four bags I bought won't last long and I'll be re ordering.

column9: Dogs will be begging for more!
column10: I've bought various brands of turkey strips before, however this is the first time my dogs sat still waiting for another piece!  The strips are just the right size for treating your dog (whether the dog is big or small).  The nutritional value of the strips indicates that I can treat my dog to more than just one strip a day (unlike other brands on the market).... this makes both me and my dogs very happy!

If you look at these like candy, which is what they are with their sugar frosted yumminess, then these are a more healthful alternative to more fakey chemical treats offered out there.  The bag is plenty big enough to share with others and on amazon they are priced better than retail.  Treat as a treat and not a daily snack.

These sports gummies taste as good--and I think better--than the bulk fruit slices or individual packages of Chuckles gum drops that you can buy in the candy aisle of your grocery store.  Add in the fact that they are organic and you can't lose.  Perfect for lunch boxes or to replace the afternoon trip to the vending machine for sugary treats.

column9: These are not supposed to be hard
column10: These came today and my mouth just started to water.  These are in the top three favorite candies of all time for me.  I thought they would come in a 1 lb. package they were just tossed in the box and shipped, to me that is not sanitary, they did not even try to put them in a plastic bag, and they were not the full lb. I  paid for.  That is why they should  be shipped in the original one pound bag.Bull's eyes are an acquired taste, they are not really a caramel candy they are a sort of caramel candy. but they are supposed to be soft, you are not supposed to break your jaw trying to take a bite. I buy these because they are supposed to be soft and I can only chew on soft candies, I had trouble with my jaw slipping when I tried to chew these, I can't finish them.,  what a waste.In their own words:August Goetze purchased the Baltimore Chewing Gum Company five generations ago in 1895. Goetze's passion ultimately led him to focus on perfecting a single candy. With soft, chewy caramel wrapped around a sweet fondant center, Caramel Creams® were born. Their unique taste has been delighting candy fans ever since - and setting the standard for consistent quality in the American candy business.It is very hard to find these little gems where I live, but when I do I always find them soft and very satisfying. I guess my getting them hard is not the usual if you see the reviews soft the other buyers.  Unfortunately I did get a bad batch and I will not be buying them here again.

This is by far, hands down, my favorite candy of all time.  I've been eating them for over 40 years and never grow tired of them.  They're a little hard to find here in Ohio, land of forgotten opportunity in general, so whenever I can find a website or feel like traveling 60 miles, I get them.  The centers are smooth and creamy, and the caramel exteriors are just awesome.  You have to be careful regarding the freshness, however, because this is definitely one candy that HAS to be fresh.  You'll wind up needed jaw surgery if they're stale!  LOVE these guys, highly, highly recommend!

Just as I remember 'em: hard and chalky on the outside, sweet and melt-in-your-mouth inside!  As has been noted elsewhere, these candies must be fresh to enjoy.  The product I received was very fresh.  Yum!I just went to order more and it appears they are not available directly from Amazon anymore.  This is very unfortunate since with shipping this vendor's product is significantly more expensive.  Bummer!

when i was a young boy ,my dad owned the corner candy store in Boston Ma.i used to hang around so my Dad put me in charge of the penny candycounter,my favorite choice was the 'BULLSEYES' now referred ascaramel creams,they are still my favorite.

I've loved these candies since I was a child.  The creme center is just the right flavor and texture to complement the caramel.  The caramels are nice and soft, and they are tasty without being too sweet.  Highly recommended!
Absolutely the best candy out there! Fresh! Brought back my childhood and made me eat too much! The cream filling was soft and wonderful, and the caramel was some of the best I've ever eaten.

yuck, yuck, and yuck.  I ate about three of them and tossed the rest.  Don't even want to subject my tricker treaters to this GRAINY caramel!  They are just weak and sugary....no sense of caramel at all!

column9: Good, but very spicy. Prep issues
column10: I've tried at least six other varieties in the Maruchan Yakisoba product line. Maruchan Yakisoba Beef Taco flavor is far and away the spiciest of the ones I've tried. It's also the only one that consistently boils over when prepared according to the package instructions. There must be something in the dry ingredients packet that causes water to boil more quickly (the instructions -- a cup of water, dry ingredients pack, and four minutes, are basically the same on all varieties). Cutting the time down to three minutes and thirty seconds seems to eliminate the problem in my Panasonic microwave, but you'll just have to experiment to find what time works best in your own oven.I like these, but I definitely need to be in a mood for a spicy meal to enjoy them. I usually have frozen chopped onions and bell peppers in my freezer; sometimes I'll add about a quarter cup of them to the yakisoba pan before cooking, making for an even spicier dish.

column9: I have to give these a five
column10: I've had a few other instant fried noodles meals here and there but these, unlike others, really taste like real fried noodles!  Very stout flavor, perfectly done noodles, perfect spicing, and a really good lunch!  Add a diced hamburger patty and a dash or two of pepper sauce and serve it on warm tortilla chips and it's a real meal!  This one is GOOD!  Thank you Maruchan and thank you Amazon!

I echo what other people have said both about the heat of this product and the prep issues.  It will consistently boil over if you follow the package directions, whereas other flavors in this line do not.  I have tried teriyaki beef, chicken, roast chicken, and spicy chicken, as well as this flavor.  I have an 1150 watt microwave and I have success by peeling the lid about 75% off, then  running it for about 5 minutes at 60 or 70% power.  For my microwave, that means that it'll run for a while, then just spin without the microwaves, then turn it back on.  It doesn't constantly run at a lower power.  The water will boil up the side but the microwave usually phases it off before it boils over, then it restarts when it's settled, and the longer cooking time compensates for the lower %.  It doesn't work every time but it's better than the alternative-watching it constantly.  On to the heat- it's surprisingly hot, and I like spicy stuff.  It will definitely turn some people off.  I find if I add some additional vegetables it cuts the heat a bit.  My favorite is quartered steamed brussels sprouts.

These are great if you like a little spice to your noodles.  The product overall is not quite enough for a lunch, it would be nice if there were a little more to the meal.  The issue I have is in preparation.  I have made many of these, and almost every time I am sure to prepare it exactly as instructed and each time the water ends up boiling over the side, making a mess of the seasoning all along the edge of the bowl and leaving the liquid in the bottom of the microwave for cleanup.  They are good enough that I don't mind the cleanup, but, you would think they would package it a little differently so there wouldn't be issues.  I have tried a little less water, which usually helps, but it leaves the noodles a little dry.  Regardless, I would recommend these, just put a few paper towels under the package when microwaving.

I have been eating this brand of instant Yakisoba for awhile now, but had never heard of the Beef Taco flavor.  Based on the unbeatable price (subscribed at under $6 per 8 pack), I was intrigued, but also afraid it may have been priced so low because it was unpopular.  I gave it a shot and I had to write a review on it.  While not my favorite Yakisoba flavor (spicy chicken), it's a real nice flavor. It is possibly a tad salty, even by ramen/instant noodle standards, but the difference between this and your usual 'fake umami' flavor that most of these go for is enjoyable for a change.

I'm usually okay about salt content, since I grew up eating instant noodles (and continued throughout college), but this Beef Taco flavor tasted way too salty. There is definitely a hint of "beef taco" flavor, but I couldn't tell from all the salt.In addition, be careful about reading package labels, since there are TWO servings per box, which accounts for 76% of your daily sodium intake. Yikes.
I'm a grad student and this has good taste, very cheap, saves a ton of time. I eat this with some other meat. I put half the flavor package, because the full pack is too spicy.

column9: Holy Crap - The most spicey thing I ever ate.
column10: The noodles in these things are good but MAN this was the most spicy thing I ever ate.  If you like enormously spicey stuff and need your nasal passages cleaned then get this for sure.The package does say spicy, but I didn't know what spicey was until I ate this :).  Kind of messy in the microwave prep too.

column9: Meh, not really spicy...just noodles with taco meat flavoring
column10: I didn't actually find these too spicy at all...probably not spicy enough.  The problem was they taste like pretty decent ramen noodles...with a packet of taco meat flavoring mixed in.  I guess my expectations would be too high to expect something "complex"...but something more than meat flavoring would be nice.Next time, I'll try a half packet (and a few shots of hot sauce)...and save the other half for taco meat.  Adding some meat and vegetables to the dish would definitely round out the "meal".

column9: Like a little noodle with your SPICE?
column10: When they say spicy, man are they not joking. I actually like spicy food, however my problem with these noodles is that they have a one tone spice that overpowers the flavor. You can't really taste anything, only thing memorable is the burning of my lips and tongue lol! This was my first time trying these noodles and after my first bowl I'm sticking them in the back of the pantry to eat when I've run out of everything else. I mean they're edible if you just want something microwavable, fast and decently priced, but if you're someone with a sensitive palate or stomach(or actually want to taste your food) go for a different flavor.

I usually love this brand but the tapioca flour has an off taste. My son says it's a "gluten free bread" taste. It may not bother everyone,my husband doesn't notice it. However,if it bothers YOU,then you'll know what I'm talking about,this flour has that funny taste.
Good product specially from Bob Red Mill where i know it is milled in a dedicated Gluten-free facility. wonderful, and Bravo !!Love it !Michele

column9: Gluten free baking supplies from Amazon
column10: Our order was received in great condition and on time.  This is a great way to order baking supplies in bulk.
I received this product in a timely way, and in good shape.  I have used this product in the past, and it is good.

Harney & Sons Fine Teas Jasmine Fragrant Green Tea - 50 TeabagsThe tea is delightful.  The fragrance is intoxicating as well as the flavor of the tea.  It does not get bitter towards the end of your cup of tea.  The flavor remains consistently yummy until the end.

Brought this to work and after giving everyone a bag to try, I had them clamoring for more!!  It's so flavorful and has just the right amount of caffeine kick to tide me over after the lunch stupor.  I'll definitely order again though I'll be a bit stingier with sharing the next time around :-)
It is very strong and pure! you just need a little bit to get a great flavor. Helps with digestion but the smell is strong!!
This stuff makes a great tasting chocolate milk.  I'll gladly buy it again in the future when the current stock runs out.

Just got these yesterday/I"ve been  looking for Linzers online,since nowhere in Az has anything close to a NY/NJ bakery bought Linzer tart! These looked close but as I tasted yesterday the cookie part wasnt buttery and flaky like I longed for and the jelly was almost like a fruit roll up in between the cookie layer. Now I'm stuck with 11 more!!!!! I'd give these a 5 out of 10/Look elsewehere

My kitten, Poppy, liked to steal the lamb based kibble that my dogs ate.  I've always fed the animals the highest quality foods and I went on a search to find a lamb based cat food for him.Acana fits the bill.  The aroma of the kibbles is a bit strong, but he LOVES it.  He changed over from his other kibble (Evo) just fine, litter box odor is absent, which is wonderful with an indoor cat.His coat is super shiny.  His white fur is very white, his black fur is super shiny.  His teeth, ears, everything is in great shape.  Love this food and will keep it in his rotation.
This is a great grain free cat food. I like to vary my Bengal cats diet but it can be hard to find quality grain free cat foods. Can't beat this one.

During my last trip to our local grocery store, I picked up a Maruchan Yakisoba Noodle Bowl (sweet and sour chicken flavor) just out of curiosity, and I had it for a light lunch today. It was quite good and took only four minutes to prepare. The sweet and sour taste was very good. It was too high in sodium, of course, which is typical of these prepared bowls. Probably half the packet of flavoring is salt. So, I watch my salt intake for the rest of the day when I have one of these. On the other hand, it had 6 grams of protein, which was high for a dish like this. All in all, it made a good, but not a great, lunch.Gary Peterson
Goya Malta has always been a great product. I always enjoyedthe product. It has an addictive flavor and is a excellent thirst quencher.

I, myself am not from latin america so I didn't grow up on this or anything. To be honest, it tastes like sugary vegetable soup with tonic water. kinda of tastes like caramel as well. If you never tried this I suggest not trying it. I had this drink 10 minutes ago and my stomach hurts and every burp makes me feel nauseas. I feel that tomorrow, my stomach will not agree with me. If you ever feel the need to puke I suggest drinking this. I apologize if I am offending anyone but it seriously doesn't taste good.

I became a big fan of "jamaica" juice after being introduced to it in Mexico a few years back, so I had to jump on this when I saw it. It tastes very similar to real hibiscus juice, and is not too sweet like a lot of hibiscus concentrates are. It's slightly tart, but not as much as cranberry juice is (it's not bitter either).I use this in Italian sodas, and couldn't be happier with it.

Cherry-Lime Rickey is probably my favorite soda flavor. I used to love the Hickory Farms brand, and Pop Shoppe made a nice one too. With those long gone (at least in my market) I've long been in search of a replacement. The Torani Cherry-Lime version is good, but it's not great. Somehow it misses that crisp flavor that I associate with Cherry-Lime. That said, I do enjoy this flavor. It gets a 75% in our house - one person thinks it has an aftertaste.
This purchase was my first Internet purchase and first Amazon purchase.  Definitely would buy this again through Amazon.  So easy and arrived here almost before I finished typing in the order.
I have predominately used the raw pressed garlic juice and it it really good stuff.  You have to try making garlic bread with this stuff.  It is fantastic.

Move over Nutella...this is my new favorite guilty pleasure!  It doesn't have a strong almond flavor, nor does it have a strong caramel flavor. The perfect balance of the two make the most sensation thing I've tasted in a long time.  It sort of reminds me of a smooth butterscotch flavor. To.Die.For!

Amazing...I am not usually an almond person unless they are smoked an toasted. Well that has all changed now that I have tasted this almond spread.the creamy rich taste of almonds along with the caramel flavor of the spread makes it so hard to not just sit down with a spoon and have at it.i now have to find places that sell it at a reasonable price on line. I live just far enough away from stores to make this a cost effective method of buying this spread.i hope this isn't another product that I really like and then they quit making it. my recomendation is to get it now and try it..it is amazing, who knew that something so good for you could taste this good as well.
This stuff is incredibly delicious. It's a great snack to eat plain with a spoon. You'l find yourself craving it!

column9: I admit...I am a MaraNatha Caramel Almond butter addict!
column10: This stuff is SO GOOD! My kids hide the jars from me..I will literally eat an entire jar in a day..so tasty and just the right amount of sweetness to protein for a quick tablespoon as I run out the door!Only problem is I can't find it at many places!!  LOVE this stuff!!!

I got this at my local grocery last week and have already finished the entire jar. I ate it on fruit, bread, cookies, waffles, heated it up in the microwave and poured it on ice cream. A spoonful by itself it a great way to satisfy a sweet craving between meals without filling up on junk. I already bought more and will be shipping a few jars to my sisters and their kids to enjoy. Love the nutty sweet flavor and texture.

I don't know what's in here besides caramel and ground up almonds but it is DELISH! A bit lighter in taste than peanut butter, the caramel gives this nut spread a bit more depth in addition to the expected sweetness. This morning I used it on some waffles and found it to be a good substitute for peanut butter (which I also use from time to time). I would not recommend using with jelly or jam - perhaps a fruit butter that is not too sweet. Tomorrow I'll try it with some apple or blueberry butter we have, but today it was so delicious I couldn't ruin my first experience with fruit! Try it!

I'm so disappointed in this almond spread. I thought when I bought it, it would be caramel flavored almond butter, but it's really not. It's mostly sugar and it tastes so fake and gross. It tastes like preservatives. It's cheap "natural caramel flavor" spread. It leaves a terrible aftertaste in your mouth. I took one serving and threw the entire jar away... there's no way I'm going to even finish it. Gross.
They were fresh when they arrived. I purchased this 6-pack for $7.27 which is a good deal, and haven't seen them this low since. They were yummy, and now they are gone.
These were NOT stale. They were as fresh as any I have purchased in my local store. Good quality ... and chocolate ... milky ways are the best!

column4: Jacki Gunter "good movie or book lover"
column10: Milky Way's are always good whatever form they come in.  This isa good way to keep some in the house at all times.J. Gunter
Arrived Promptly.  Tastes good.  Helps me include more tofu in diet.  Leftovers stores well.  I prefer the medium hot and hot.  The mild is a little bland, but good.

It is delicious. Mild means not spicy at all. Goes well with ground pork, chicken, or beef. Optionally you may choose to not add any meat for a tasty vegetarian dish. Use fresh, medium tofu. Not too silky or it falls apart. Not too old or coarse or it will crumble and also ruin the dish.

column9: Really good bouillon. Yeast free too!
column10: Really delicious vegetarian bouillon, low sodium and yeast free!  This is the only yeast free bouillon I have been able to find.  I add this to many different dishes and it adds wonderful savory flavor.  Marigold also makes a regular sodium variety too which Amazon also sells.

My quest for a good vegetarian bouillon has ended! The bouillon smells great and I love that it is in powder form! It does give a nice taste to my soups and I will (finally!) no longer make vegetable stock from scratch. As an FYI, this is the brand of bouillon that several Bristish cookbooks refer to, like The Rose Bakery Cookbook or Ottolenghi.

This is my favorite bouillon, and I am surprised at its strength!I was having troubles digesting Rapunzel bouillon cubes, which used to be my favorite... better than bouillon was great, but didn't have the rounded flavor....This Marigold stuff is definitely the best, and has a very nice background of herbs and spices that makes it truly delicious.  I found reference to it in the Plenty cookbook.  Reading the label, I am surprised that they include nutmeg and lovage.. it really is a nice blend for all my vegan soups, even my Thai basil coconut soup.The only think you should know if you are worried about salt is that it has 459 mg per serving (4.5g), and it does pack a punch.  Flavor-wise, you really get a nice kick with this stuff, so you don't need to much, but it is savory and salty, so just be aware.
I bought this on the recommendation of Ruth Watson  the Hotel Inspector  and I use it in everything  frozen vegetables  soup  meats etc.

I was a bit concerned when I first opened one of these - the powder really doesn't smell very good. Once it's dissolved in water, however, it smells great and has a really nice, savory flavor. There's a hint of mint to it that I don't particularly care for (I believe it's the lovage). I add quite a bit of really good Italian herb mix to it then put it back in the can to bring to work. It makes a nice afternoon snack. The lid seals well and it stays fresh for a long time.

Unfortunately, for me, Marigold bouillon powders aren't 'clean'.  Hydrolised Vegetable Protein is seen by the body, at least mine, the same as MSG.  If you google this phrase, maybe spelling hydrolised as "Hydrolyzed" you'll find the many ways that msg makes it way into the American diet.[...][...]I really wanted to be able to depend upon this product, the people associated with are very nice!

It is one of those elusive finds: A decent commercial vegetable broth.  Most tend to be bland, sweet, or taste metallic.  Plus most are very high sodium.  Marigold Swiss Vegetable Bouillon power is a stand-out exception.This is good enough to make a cup to sip on.  It is flavorful without being too strong.  It does not have any medicinal flavor, and is not sweet.  It just tastes like a good vegetable broth. It is a light color.  Of course it is not clear, coming from a powder, so don't expect that.The sodium level is roughly 500 mg per 'serving'.  I would still love to find a bouillon that is actually 'low sodium' and not merely 'reduced sodium'.  But overall, this is a keeper.

I like this, especially because of the reduced salt content. We eat a lot of vegetarian food and also have many vegetarian and vegan friends so this product is ideal as a flavor boost without having to rely excessively on salt.

I purchased 6 pack martini mix as well as the raspberry martini mix. As noted on the bottle I made these as wine-tinis. I liked them all but the lemon drop was my favorite. I only wish Amoretti had the matching cocktail sugars to rim the glasses. These drink mixes will be the star of my party. I liked them because they were not especially sweet.....I prefer tart. Buy them....you won't regret it!

They arrived quickly and well packaged, no problems.  The sugar had settled to the bottom on most of the mixers but with a few shakes it was re-mixed. I tried the pomegranate mix for vodka martini's and it was delicious, I had lots of folks asking for the recipe. I used cranberry vodka. I'd like to get the packets of rim flavoring that go with these flavors without having to buy 6 tins of each.  I wish they would come with a little packet attached to the bottle so you could at least try the rim flavoring without having to invest in 6 tins at $7 each! Overall this product is well worth it, affordable and good tasting.  I have no complaints.

These are definitely better than other mixers available from other competitors. (Rose's, etc)My friends came over and we tried all 6. I kept it simple and made various flavored 'tinis using the 2:1 ratio suggested on the label recipe. The Blueberry and Passion Fruit were a little sweet for 'my' taste, but I added a bit of lime to balance the flavor.Amoretti were so helpful when I spoke to them about my thoughts regarding the flavors. As a smaller family owned company, I could tell that they really cared and wanted to make sure their customers are taken care of. I will *definitely* be recommending their products to my friends and will be trying out the many other flavors they have available.Give these a try.

I ordered this on line because the local store quit carrying it, this product has the same name and packaging as what I was buying locally but the flavor isn't even close, the color is much darker also.  So now I have a six pack of sauce I don't like.  It must be packaged in more than one location, I really enjoy the local version but can't handle this version.
The order I recieved was quick and I have always have been a fan of pumpkin spice flavored coffee. This brand was delicious and worth the price.
Great product, fast delivery. Looked around for a while try to find invert sugar, and didn't want to buy a big bucket. This is just want I need. Thanks!
Great transaction. Thank you so much. I used the product to make chocolate covered cognac cherries, an annual tradition at my house.
Bought this product for baking.  Seems to work very well with the recipe.  Not sure if it is supposed to be entirely clear (which it is not).

I couldn't really tell what this would be like based on the description ... I was hoping for a product like trimolene. But it is much more runny than that. I'm not sure what exactly one would use it for- I didn't know what to do with it, and sent it back.
This is my second order with this vendor and this time the chocolate were perfect and so delicious, we devoured them quickly.  You won't be disappointed in this chocolate!  Recommend.

column9: Hawaiian Host The Original chocolate Covered MACADAMIA NUTS
column10: We love 'em so much we ordered more. Yum Yum! I also sent them out to my family for Christmas and they reported back that they loved them too.
They make nice gifts.  The dogs truly love them.  I will definitely will purchase them again.

one of the best pho soup bases I have found . each jar has 2 spice mix in their own bag plus a dry base of ingredients that make- up thepho soup base.  For me I use a half of the pho soup base jar at a time which is about 4 quarts give or take how much water you add. I refrigerator what I don't use for later.I do freeze/or refrigerate the remainder of the jar dried soup base after it is open this help it not dry out as fast.I also put a baggie around the jar to help. Works good for me.Each time has been great. Good on my stomach, too.If you think the 4 jars (pack)is to much you can mix them up. If you like pho soup you will use this up fast and I think you will enjoy itI do.
The box arrived intact and quickly. Crunchy Tasty and just what I needed for my low carb diet. I will be ordering more and would highly recommend this product.

This order was the first order I had placed with Amazon.  I was pleased with the time it took the order to arrive, and with the quality of the food.  The only thing that I was disappointed with was that the advertisement promised free S&H for orders over a set price.  However, after I placed my order I was notified that my order did not qualify for the free S&H offer, even though it exceeded the price minimum, because (I believe) it was a food product.I hope that by the time I want more of this item, that I can find it in a local supermarket again, as the total order was a little pricey!!

column9: Garlic gets even better than better
column10: I ran into this at my local Whole Foods for $6.99(MSRP regular price) and thought I love garlic I'll give this a try.  Fermenting cabbage turns a lack luster vegetable into a nutritious powerhouse superfood of Sauerkraut so starting out with a superfood such as garlic has got to end up with a super superfood!  right!  I made some homemade onion soup and threw a couple of black garlic in there and let me tell you is tastes super delicious!  I may have found it for the nutrition but I am going to buy again and again for the delicious flavor!  Look at all the great recipes on their website too!Black Garlic KaleBlack Garlic T-Bone Steak"- Mini Superior Farms Lamb T-Bone with sugared mint sea salt, gold dusted micro greens, and Black Garlic fondu.Black Garlic, Crunchy Vegetable and Sesame Noodle Salad -This salad makes a good light lunch for two people.Mushroom and Black Garlic Risotto -add extra flavor to your RisottoCreamy Cheese and Black Garlic Dip - Black Garlic flavored cream cheese?Scallops with Black Garlic and Chorizo - This is an ideal starter for two or a pre-dinner nibble. It is also excellent as a lunch, served with a lemon vinaigrette rocket salad.Lamb and Black Garlic Fajitas - These make an excellent lunchtime treat. Great for children! You can substitute the lamb for chicken or for a vegetarian version add different vegetables such as mange tout and baby corn.Fillet of beef with a Black Garlic Mushroom Duxelle served with a Black Garlic Port Wine sauceBlack Garlic Stuffed Mushrooms - Exotic mixture of taste between black garlic and mushroomsBlack Garlic Linguine - You have had a busy day; don't feel like cooking. Think Black Garlic! This dish is quick, easy and very tasty!I may have one of these for dinner tonight!  YUMMY!  I am a huge garlic fan and have even been teased "oh so you are having a little linquine with your garlic?" because I used a whole head of garlic.  However, I am not a fan of roasted garlic really or elephant garlic either.  My new favorite garlic is now Black Garlic!UPDATE 4/11  These have become one of my favorite foods.  They are sweet and taste incredible chopped up on top of margarita pizza!

column9: gourmet garlic even if you thought you hated garlic
column10: Review Update: 5/2/2012: Culinary Elite brand black garlic on Amazon is a better value than this one is now. You get 2.2 oz for $6.75 on Amazon and their shipping is cheaper and it comes peeled so you are not paying for the majority of the weight in stuff you throw out like the core and peels. You wind up getting twice as much black garlic for half the price by ordering Culinary Elite. This one is good too but it is unpeeled and comes in a bag rather than a  tub and the weight you pay for includes the cores and the peels and the stems in this brand.  I liked it, but Culinary Elite is a better value.Black garlic is super soft so it's very difficult to peel if you buy it unpeeled. No matter what brand you get, I suggest buying peeled only. It's a mess to peel and gets all under your nails if it's really fresh black garlic.Original review:---------------------Black garlic may sound odd but one bite and you'll be an addict.You may have seen it on cooking shows by elite chefs; it's not easy to find unless you are in a very nice restaurant...or my kitchen. Because I'm a huge fan. And now, apparently, on Amazon too.Used in China for quite some time, it is used originally as a homeopathic cancer fighter due to it's richness in antioxidants and fighter of free radicals.But one taste and you'll be in heaven.It takes over a month to make one clove. Why? It is heated the ENTIRE time in a high humidity low temperature oven.  This acts like a balsamic vinegar reduction where you start with something a bit bitter and end up with something rich and sweet...in fact, it tastes much like a balsamic vinegar reduction/garlic fusion.Unlike regular garlic that exudes from your pores and is bitter, this is smooth and doesn't hang around long or emit a pore smell either! You can date and eat it! Woo Hoo! But it's so tender and sweet you can literally pop a clove in your mouth and chew and not grimace.  It's slightly jelly like and can be easily mixed in ANYTHING to make it better. I love it on pizza, in pasta, in green beans, mashed potatoes...my dad puts it on all steaks now.You can literally put a lot in anything and it wakes up the flavor beautifully and wonderfully...It is not mixed with anything...just pure garlic, cooked slowly for an exceptionally long time to make it rich, smooth, and molasses-like sweet.
Cooking enthusiast has it for 12.95 and you get 5 bulbs. I haven't tried it yet, but I will give it a try, but not order it from amazon. You can probably find them cheaper elsewhere also.

Black garlic is very good.  It is wonderful to just eat out right out of the skin.  Did not find that it added much taste when mixed in with other foods. Very expensvie but if I ordered it again I would buy it already out of the skins.

Love this stuff. Exotic and New, got a recipe to make a stuffing with it. Stuffed a steak first then a chicken breast. Then tried stuffing a chicken breast and covering top of entire breast almost like breading the top.Wow, Black Garlic stuffed and breaded chicken breast was off the hook,drooling now just thinking about it.I highly recommend this product while a little pricey, you get what you pay for . Nice treat for Garlic fans like myself.

I COOK GARLIC IN EVERYTHING, WHEN I PURCHASED THE BLACK GARLIC, I WASNT SURE, BUT WHEN I PUT IT IN MY EVERY DAY RECIPES, IT IS GREAT! A LITTLE DIFFERENT FROM YOUR ORDINARY GARLIC, BUT HAS A GREAT TASTE IF YOU ARE A GARLIC FAN! A BIT DIFF IN COLOR AND A BIG DIFF IN TEXTURE, BUT IT AS A GOOD ADDICTIVE TO WHAT EVER YOU ADD GARLIC TO
These are delectable, but was hoping to find a better pricebut a 10 pk of these little bags goes for 8.99 at Costco. Don't spend 29.99!
Most recipes I've been using lately request half a cup, a quarter cup, etc of chili powder! So my little store-bought bottles are pretty much useless. Go for the big bottle, and cook away!

column9: Pleasant All Round Flavor - Good Value
column10: I love chili dishes of all kinds.  This chili powder has a nice rounded flavor. It tastes quite mild to me.  It makes a great base for a milder chili dish. But if a person wants more heat, that can be achieved with additional chipotles, cumin, cayenne or a variety of fresh peppers for additional heat and character.  It's all up to the cook how the dish ends up.Whether you prefer mild chili dishes (or like me) plenty of heat, this is a great spice base and the large jar is an excellent value. If you like heat, keep cans of chipotle peppers or chiplotle powder for 'customizing".I will definitely purchase again.
I first tasted this tea at PF Changs. I loved it so much, I made the waiter go and find out what brand and type it was, so I could buy my own. This is the best!
A great way to decorate baby shower cake without all the xtra work, they are great looking and I wanted edible decorations for the cake.Arrived in excellent condition.

I needed something very fast for a baby shower and this came in right on time. I had to pay for expedited shipping of course.The product itself was OK. Kids liked it more as the designs were different. The designs didn't look as professional as the ones shown in the pictures but as I mentioned it worked for me as it was so last minute.Thanks

I ordered these to go on top of cupcakes for a baby shower. When they arrived, several were broken, and the colors were much more neon than I expected.I used them on the cupcakes anyways and they turned out OK, but I am not sure I would have ordered them had I known the colors were so different from the pictures.

column9: Baby Deluxe Assortment(32804) Edible Hard Sugar Decorations, 24 pcs
column10: They are great looking and good decoration for baby shower.  But unfortunately after I received the package, I found some are broken.

I ordered this for my God Daughter's baby shower. The quality is good and they are really cute, but I received 5 pieces broken. I would suggest ordering 2 (48 pcs)just in case. Delivery was quick though!

These were wonderful, and beautifully done. The quality was great and it was shipped so that they would not break. I thought they were a little pricey, but after receiving them I think it was worth it.I highly recommend these for baby shower cupcakes.

I actually ordered these for my sister's baby shower and we live all the way in St. Vincent which is an island in the Caribbean and I was not only impressed with how fast we got them but they were intact. Will definitely order from this company again.

I use these packs for lunches along with celery or crackers.  A great snack during the day!  They are convenient to throw in the lunch bag and store well (no refrigeration needed for unopened containers).  Perfect!
I just wanted to say how much I love the JIF to go cups.  They are the perfect portion size for someone like me who is addicted to peanut butter.
Jif peanut butter is just the best. it is so creamy and tastes so close to eating peanuts. KUDOS to Jif.

Have been a vegan for a while and tried some other vegan brands and didn't like them. These are awesome! Taste just like regular marshmallows, have a great texture, they melt perfectly, you can cook with them, and all without the nasty gelatin! I can't wait for amazon to get them in. Wish I could order them today!  :) Definitely try these!!!! You won't be sorry :)

Title says it all.I'm a vegetarian and have been missing marshmallows, and not just for cocoa.  I used to make a fantastic fudge but with no marshmallows, well, no fudge.  I picked up a bag of these at my local natural food store.  I've been looking at them suspiciously for a couple of months now and finally caved last week.These are the best ever!  I've been eating them like candy.  Oh, wait!  They are candy.  I'm picking up some graham crackers and will be fixing some s'mores real soon.I hope that Amazon gets some soon.November 2011 Update:I am tempted to take away a star for changes that I've experience with the Dandies marshmallows in the past few months.  They've become smaller in size.  Not having any of the older ones handy (not surprising), my guess is that they are 1/3 to 1/2 the size of the earlier Dandies.  They also appear to be using less of whatever they were using to coat the marshmallows.  For the past few months, the Dandies have been stuck together.  Now that is not a problem if cooking with them is the plan; however if the plan is for s'mores, cocoa topping, or even just munching, it is a problem.

So I'm not a vegan, just vegetarian, but I've been missing marshmallows for a while. Why we feel the need to stick ground up animal bones (gelatin) into food is ridiculous and unnecessary, but that's another debate.Anyway, I saw these in the store tonight and hesitantly purchased it, honestly thinking they would suck. Oh how I was wrong. These are delicious. They're fluffy, creamy and taste great. The only thing that could make these better would be if they were organic.They were pricey (at least locally, at the moment Amazon is out of stock so I don't know their pricing) but I would definitely buy these again.

column9: First time I've had marshmallows in years and I loved them
column10: As a lacto-ovo vegetarian who tries to avoid gelatin, I haven't had any marshmallows in years since they usually have fish gelatin in the kosher ones and other gelatin in mainstream ones. I picked up a bag of these marshmallows at a natural food store when we were traveling and they were the BEST. I've been looking locally since then and haven't been able to find them so I hope Amazon gets them back in stock soon.

I had them in hot chocolate and they were tasty. I must admit that I don't really remember what marshmallows taste like since it's been years since I've had them, so I can't vouch for their authenticity, but I enjoyed them that's for sure. I can't wait to try them for smores.

They are a little smaller and slightly less fluffy than traditional marshmallows but sooooo good!I actually like them better than regular ones.  They're a little bit sweeter with a slight vanilla flavor.  Yummy!

column9: Incredible tasting marshmallows!  Vegan or not!
column10: I am absolutely floored by the taste and texture of these beyond awesome marshmallows! They are easily the best i've EVER had, even putting non-vegan marshmallows in the equation. Although not a vegan, I try to shop at health food stores as much as my wallet allows, and I came across these when my 6 year old pulled them off the shelf, begging for them. Needless to say, when I tried one, I became addicted, and in 2 days, the bag is now empty. I tried these on my favorite pumpkin pie, chocolate bar, and sweet potato thus far, and they truly enhance the flavor of a lot of food. You've got to try these!

These taste and work just like marshmellows without the gelatin. They are awesome and I love them. I haven't been able to make my sweet potato casserole or hot chocolate in YEARS and now I can enjoy them again. Thanks Dandies!

I was extremely happy to chance upon these in a health food store shortly before I was going camping. Like many of the other reviewers before me, I haven't had marshmallows in a long time because of my commitment to vegetarianism. These marshmallows can toast in the fire just like gelatin marshmallows do! Personally, I think they taste better because I always found gelatin marshmallows a little chalky. These seem less prone to becoming stale--I stored mine for a month after opening them, and they always tasted fine. You do pay more for these marshmallows, but the $11.99 I see on Amazon right now is even steeper than the price I paid. They were $4 or $5 at the health food store.

These are vegan marshmallows, but contain soy.  Given soy is a common allergen, I recommend the description be rewritten to include this info.  Disappointed in discovering they had soy, the small size of the marshmallow, and the expensive price.  Still looking for a vegan, non-soy, campfire marshmallow....

column9: Love this product in place of using sugar
column10: I noticed one reviewer mentioned that the individual packaging was wasteful...but I also noticed that moisture builds up easily in the jar once opened. Date sugar is pure fruit so caking will take place if not used up in a timely fashion.  Had this been one huge jar, it might have turned into one huge lump of hardened date sugar before I used it all up, so I understand the need for individual packaging and smaller containers.I try to stay off refined sugar and date sugar has enabled me to bake cookies, muffins, cakes and use far less refined sugar by subbing half with date sugar..  It works very well and blends into recipes with ease.Just what I was looking for...and the taste is wonderful!

The sugar tastes as you would want it to -- not overwhelming, but clearly like a date would.  And it can be used almost anywhere you could use sugar or honey (if either one would not be what you want, then this probably would not be a good choice either).

It wasn't until I bought a bag of these when I finally learned what good potato chips taste like. It's sort of like the epiphany you have when you think American cheese is the best cheese you've ever had until you actually try smoked gouda. I know that sounds like an overstatement, but that's how good Herr's Heinz-flavored ketchup chips are. Once you try these, all of your previous favorites will start to pale in comparison."What's so darned great about them?" you are probably wondering. What's gotten everyone in such a tizzy? Why the rave reviews and the almost cult-like devotion to these chips? It's not just because they taste good. It's because Herr's is one of the few snack makers that bucks that shady practice so many of them engage in now, especially Pringles. You know what I mean-- that cute, little trick of advertising their chips as literally bursting with flavor, when in reality the chips are so lightly dusted that there's barely any flavor to them. Herr's philosophy in terms of chip-to-flavor ratio couldn't be more different. Open any one of their snacks-- especially this one-- and the chips are so covered in powder that it's impossible to not have it cake up on your finger tips without constantly cleaning them. These Heinz ketchup flavored chips are so heavily dusted, in fact, that you'll wind up with red-stained fingers for a few hours after gorging on them. It makes for a messy experience but in the end, getting a moutful of flavor with each bite makes the hassle of cleaning up all worthwhile!Sure, this excessive powder doesn't exactly make Herr's the healthiest of snack choices, but what snack is? It's all gonna kill us, anyway, so really-- all this really comes down to is choosing our poison. My poison happens to be these chips, and will most likely be yours once you taste them and subsequently become hopelessly addicted like me.

column4: Bartok Kinski "A casual stroll through the lu...
column10: Brown rice (or "hulled rice") is unmilled or partly milled rice, a kind of whole, natural grain. It has a mild nutty flavor, is chewier and more nutritious than white rice, and becomes rancid much more quickly. Any rice, including long-grain, short-grain, or sticky rice, may be eaten as brown rice.In much of Asia, brown rice (Chinese, Korean, Japanese, Thai, Vietnamese) is associated with poverty and wartime shortages, and in the past was rarely eaten except by the sick, the elderly and as a cure for constipation. This traditionally denigrated kind of rice is now more expensive than common white rice, partly due to its relatively low supply and difficulty of storage and transport.Brown rice and white rice have similar amounts of calories, carbohydrates, and protein. The main differences between the two forms of rice lie in processing and nutritional content.When only the outermost layer of a grain of rice (the husk) is removed, brown rice is produced. To produce white rice, the next layers underneath the husk (the bran layer and the germ) are removed, leaving mostly the starchy endosperm.Several vitamins and dietary minerals are lost in this removal and the subsequent polishing process. A part of these missing nutrients, such as Vitamin B1, Vitamin B3, and iron are sometimes added back into the white rice making it "enriched", as food suppliers in the US are required to do by the Food and Drug Administration (FDA).One mineral not added back into white rice is magnesium; one cup (195 grams) of cooked long grain brown rice contains 84 mg of magnesium while one cup of white rice contains 19 mg.When the bran layer is removed to make white rice, the oil in the bran is also removed. Rice bran oil may help lower LDL cholesterol.Among other key sources of nutrition lost are small amounts of fatty acids and fiber.In addition to having greater nutritional value, brown rice is also said to be less constipating than white rice.Brown rice can remain in storage for months under normal conditions, but hermetic storage and freezing can significantly extend its lifetime. Freezing, even periodically, can also help control infestations of Indian meal moths.

To me this rice is so different than my regular rice (long grain brown) that I think of it as a different grain. Yes, the aroma is interesting; I'd say it takes a bit of getting used to. I really enjoy the size and texture of the cooked grains. After trying the Wehani by itself, I began cooking 1/3 Wehani, 1/3 Lundberg Brown Basmati and 1/3 either brown rice store brand or Wang sweet brown rice that I get at an Asian supermarket. I always saute the rice in a bit of vegetable oil 'til it is browned, before adding the liquid. This combo and browning seems to develop the nutty flavor that I favor. [However, I've found that when browning the rice, not to overdo it because if the rice gets too roasted it will no longer cook normally - apparently it loses its ability to absorb water. Then you get the crunchies.]I do find that Wehani takes considerably longer to fully absorb the water. I use the regular 2:1 ratio, water to rice (plus salt). It is my practice to bring it to a rolling boil, then reduce the heat to a simmer for 2 hours. It just means planning ahead a bit further.Often I cook meat at the same time in the same pot, starting both together so the rice will gain the flavoring of the meat juices. When I do that, I adjust the other liquid downward. The one alert I'd post is that the strong coloring of the rice stains the meat, especially when using the Wehani alone. Doesn't bother me, but you might want to know this will happen.Chilled cooked Wehani rice makes a fine salad with the addition of minced garlic, fresh ginger root pared then diced, finely sliced scallions, chopped fresh parsley and Chinese five-spice. Add other garden veggies that you have on hand, extra virgin olive oil if you wish and consider the taste treat of balsamic vinegar. Yum!

column9: Have a seat... because your mind is about to be BLOWN.
column10: I believe it was the esteemed Neil Patrick Harris who, eons ago, said "Suit up. It's going to be legendary!" Mr. Harris would never admit it because he never was one for product endorsements, but I'mma blow the lid off this mystery: He was talking about Coffee-mate's Pumpkin Spice Creamer.Upon hearing that this product existed, I promptly began to hyperventilate and had to be awakened by smelling salts. To say that I love anything pumpkin-flavored would be the biggest understatement since... well... I'm looking for historical precedents here, but I'm really not well-versed in the history of understatements. Anyway, I digress; after being awakened, I promptly drove 107 mph the entire way to the store, causing 7 minor traffic accidents, a stampede of antelope, and at least one unplanned pregnancy. I then sprinted to the Dairy section, mind racked with anticipation and apprehension; would they truly have the Holy Grail of coffee creamers, or would I be left utterly disappointed, like that time when I was seven and my parents ate my entire birthday cake right in front of me, laughing the whole time?And then, I saw it: A fully-stocked shelf of Coffee-mate Pumpkin Spice Creamer. I gasped in delight as I grabbed the nearest bottle off of the shelf, passionately ripped off the lid, clawed desperately at that Godforsaken plastic freshness seal, and chugged the entire bottle on the spot. For what seemed like hours, I collapsed on the floor of the supermarket, chest heaving in pure ecstasy as a subtle afterglow began to emanate from every pore of my skin.Long story short, I'm serving a lengthy prison sentence now for not only my incredibly lewd public display (I don't even REMEMBER taking my pants off), but also my inadvertent destruction of the entire Dairy section. And you know something? I'd do it ALL again. And I will, as soon as I'm out. Be prepared.Also, it's now January, so if you want in on this, RUN to your nearest grocery store and get some, or else you will live in regret until October when it comes out again. Cheers!

I get coffee-mate creamer all the time, but I don't actually love it, it's just all I've ever used since becoming an adult. Usually I find the taste a little sweet but kind of bland with a poor after-taste...I usually use Hazelnut, but I've tried many flavors and it's all about the same effect for me. I don't mind too much, but I'm not in love with it. I tried this seasonal flavor last December and it was a higher caliber. Very tasty, rich-but not too rich, and certainly gave a warm holiday feeling. Was more like a coffee shop experience. I want that all the time so I have to order it here.

I'm a huge fan of the pumpkin spice coffee that's being sold at starbucks.  It gets expensive, my bestfriend told me that coffee mate was selling this so I gave it a try.  I'm very impressed by the quality and taste, the only down side is 5 grams of sugar for 1 tablespoon.  I recommend to any one reading this to buy it but go easy on the teaspoons.

I love homemade chai tea mix with the Pumpkin Spice, I have substituted with the Gingerbread but it is not as good.  Unfortunately, last Fall I couldn't find the Pumpkin Spice in the grocery store. I am hoping this season it will be available!!
i just love all the different coffee creamers that this company makes. And i loved the company who shipped this one to me. this actually was the one that got to me the fastest.

It was delicious if you don't mind putting fake stuff in your coffee.  I am generally not a fan of the powdered creamers but I don't make coffee at home frequently enough to always have real cream on hand.  This stuff keeps in the cabinet.I liked that it was lightly sweetened, so I didn't have to add anything else to my coffee.  Don't expect it to be like a good coffee house flavor, but it's good enough for what it is.
Great product when it's not during the holidays and you want it everyday =). It keeps it's freshness and it's pumpkin taste!

column9: Made a great snack even more tempting!
column10: I've been eating Loucks Sesame Snaps for as long as I can remember. I grew up in Canada, and they are sold at almost every grocery store up there. Love these snaps.  Great treat-if you are interested in getting these DO IT. Besides...sesame seeds are good for you! I will absolutely be a repeat buyer.
I first tried this when I purchased a single packet at a local store. It is very sweet and the chocolate is a nice touch. I am buying them by the case now.

I know all cats are different and well known for their finicky attitudes about eating. OF all the various foods I serve my guys, Chicken seems to be their favorite. (I am guessing that those types who do advertizing and sales are ever so aware that we want out cats to eat like we do.)But, in the end that is not the issue. Do the cats like it and eat it? Thank you. My kittys take their bow, and would gladly shake your hand on this recommendation!!!!!!!!!!!Trinigy, Gabriella, Wisdom, Mercy, and Yellow Kitty.

column9: Dark and Rich, but Drink a Small Cup
column10: There's a little place on Magazine Street in New Orleans that serves real Italian hot chocolate -- yum! it's thick, dark and just sweet enough to satisfy and replicate the European hot chocolate experience. Happily, California company "In Tempe Ran Tia" makes this treat readily available.  Creating a reasonable facsimile with a medium price point, this mix boasts of intense dark chocolate flavor that is easy to prepare and even easier to drink.'Caveat:  The only problem I had was I drank way too much -- a large 'Venti' sized cup that did not work well with my system the next day.  "In Tempe Ran Tia"  recommends a small 4 ounce cup which is about the size of a service in Europe.  So do comply with their recommended dosage.I had a bit of trouble finding the instructions for this mix - its hidden--printed in the box lid.  Follow carefully -- the mix contains arrowroot which allows the mixture to thicken after it has been properly blended.  For those who do not like sugar, this mix is sugar free--so sweetness can be adjusted to taste.The packaging is attractive --lovely violet ribbon and silk miniature sunflower adorns an orange/yellow reptile print box.  Nice!Bottom line?  Recommended for those who love dark hot chocolate, European style.Diana Faillace Von Behren"reneofc"
