I hope this doesn't get him fired, but he did accept a freshly brewed, delicious cup of Keurig coffee (I had one, too) made with the Parisian Extra-Bold Dark Magic K-cup.)** Just kidding.  I've purchased some expensive items but no car.  Yet.  But I'm not kidding about Amazon service:  Five Stars.
My dog's butt has more flavor.  I was hoping for hot chocolate and its just watered down coffee.  Still have other flavors to try though.

I was wary purchasing the variety pack after reading/seeing the pictures associated with the product. However, I just received mine and I was very happy to see that each variety pack I ordered was in its own separate box and the variety provided was exactly as pictured. I would urge anyone considering buying the variety packs from crazy cups to do so! I am very happy with it and I can't wait to try the flavors with my new keurig!

column9: Mostly Hot Chocolate/only 6 flavors instead of 8
column10: I purchased this item and it only came with 6 different flavors instead of the 8 advertised. It is also 80% hot chocolates so if you are wanting to try the chocolate or mocha coffees pick another item instead of this one.

My order included:- 7 Mocha Nut Fudge (Green Mountain Coffee)- 6 Mudslide (Gloria Jean's)- 6 Chocolate Glazed Donut (Donut House)- 4 Dark Chocolate Hot Chocolate (Cafe Escapes)- 6 Milk Chocolate Hot Chocolate (Grove Square)- 6 Dark Chocolate Hot Chocolate (Grove Square)I have not tasted the flavors inside yet...but the first impression of this order wasn't that great.Why I gave 3 stars:- 1 of the Milk Chocolate Hot Chocolate cups were open and spilled throughout the box.- The box wasn't organized very nicely which could have caused the above issue (I posted a picture to show how the box looked right when I opened it).

column9: Crazy Cups Chocolate (Coffee & Cocoa) Lovers Sampler
column10: Crazy Cups Chocolate (Coffee & Cocoa) Lovers Sampler...is a great deal. I received a Keurig coffee maker on Mother's Day and it is my favorite appliance. The sampler pack gave me an opportunity to test many flavors and decide what I really liked and would re-order.

I purchased this under the guise that the assortment would be similar to the most helpful review listed (25% cocoa / 75% coffee).  Instead, here are the small handful of flavors received:6 Grove Square Dark Chocolate Hot Cocoa6 Grove Square Milk Chocolate Hot Cocoa3 Swiss Miss Hot Cocoa6 Cafe Escapes Dark Choclate Hot Cocoa7 Green Mountain Mocha Nut Fudget Coffee7 Gloria Jean's Mudslide CoffeeHence, 60% cocoas and only 40% coffee (albeit only 2 flavors of coffee).  We also did NOT receive the 8 varieties that are listed as a product feature.Yes, the sampler is Chocolate -- which is what we ordered.  It also arrived timely and in a standard cardboard box (no print art included as former reviewer mentioned).Bottom line for me is that this sampler consisted of too much cocoa and not enough coffee variety.
I was somewhat disappointed with the selection in this sampler.  There were too many duplicates of hot cocoa and not enough coffee varieties.
This is a good thing to get if youve just bought a kuerig. Some coffees dont taste like what you think they would,and they may taste even better.

With as many different varieties of flavored k-cups out there I couldnt believe Ive tried all but one of the coffee's and one of the hot cocoa's. I also got 15 hot cocoa's which seems like a lot to me. Glad I didnt pay todays price. Disappointed :(

I've enjoyed most of the Crazy Cups variety boxes but not this one.  Mostly grove square and cafe escapes powdered cocoa, which isnt that good for your brewer as the powder can gum up the nozzles.  Not to mention its pretty easy to put an envelope of cocoa for 20c into a cup, add water and warm it up in the microwave for a minute.  The coffees weren't that exciting either, mostly green mountain.  Needs more variety and less instant cups.

I've been wanting to try some of the K-cup cocoas and more of the flavored coffees and this was a great selection to help with that!In my pack I had 17 cocoas and the rest coffees.  Of the cocoas I had at least two of each kind, some I got 4-5 of, both Milk Chocolates and Darks.  Of the coffees, for the more popular brands, such as the Chocolate Glazed Donut and the Mocha Nut Fudge I had 3-5, with a pair of some other types and a few singletons of some of the more specialty flavors (One was Raspberry Chocolate Truffle).  So as for it being a sampler... it most certainly is that.I have the B-60 model Keurig with 3 cup sizes (~5, 7 and 9 oz) and it seems that for most of the flavor samples I have tried the 5 or 7 oz is ideal, with the 9oz seeming a bit more diluted in flavor.  The cocoas come out well mixed no matter the sizes.
Its a great variety  my i buy it for work some people dont like coffe so the can have hot chocolate. i actualy baught 2 of them down to half a box in one month.
Ordered this for my parents at christmas time and they had me order it for them again they enjoyed it so much. Every flavor and brand has a lot to offer.

My sample package came in a small cardboard box, which was opened and then resealed. I had the proper amount of k-cups and nothing was damaged.My package included:7 Mocha Nut Fudge (Green Mountain Coffee)6 Chocolate Glazed Donut (Donut House)6 Mudslide (Gloria Jean's)1 White Chocolate Mint (Van Houtte)5 Cafe Mocha (Cafe Express)5 Milk Chocolate Hot Cocoa (Cafe Express)5 Dark Chocolate Hot Cocoa (Grove Square)After reading other reviews, it seems every sample package is different. I haven't read about anyone else only getting one k-cup of one flavor, but I'm not complaining.
Wonderful Coffee, Tastes the best such a great machine the Keurig is. No having bitter, burnt and stale coffee, each K-cup is as good as the last.
A fabulous coffee flavor to wake you up! Chocolate lovers, this is tasty coffee to start your day. Give it a try, it's delicious!
This is a good choice. It let me try all the different coffees and decide which one I liked enough to purchase.
This pack has a nice variety of flavors and most all were to my liking. Good way to test them out.

I was excited to try a variety of chocolate flavored coffees and cocoas when I purchased this item. Unfortunately, the cocoas have proved underwhelming at best. Weak, tasteless, and undrinkable are a few of the adjectives that best apply. On the other end of the spectrum, the coffees are great! I think Green Mountain and other brewers need to figure out a way to make rich, creamy, and most of all, CHOCOLATELY hot cocoa.

column9: For flavored coffee lovers, not hot chocolate lovers
column10: I purchased this thinking that all the flavors would be some version of hot chocolate; what I ended up with was two types of actual sweet chocolate: one hot chocolate, one white chocolate.  All the rest are flavored coffee blends.  I'm sure that folks who like chocolate-flavored coffee will enjoy this (friends at work who've tried some of the flavors like them), but I'm a dark-roast, no flavors, sugar or milk coffee lover, so this just wasn't for me.  It wasn't bad, just not what I was looking for.  The "limited edition print" wasn't exactly the draw, either, but I appreciate the interest in putting in someone's art.

Product (35 k-cups) and limited print thrown together in a plain cardboard box. Ordering page shows an attractive product box with a multicolored package top entitled, "Chocolate Lovers Sampler Gift Pack".  No mention of a plain cardboard box. Would need to contact the provider before ordering anything else from this company.

It's hard for me to describe the taste of plantain chips. They don't taste like bananas, and as tempted as I am to say so, they don't taste like chicken. It's a subdued, mild taste that's pleasant but doesn't explode in one's mouth with any intensity. I bought these on a whim to try since I'd never had a bag of plantain chips before.The crispy crunchness reminds me of potato chips without the oiliness or similar taste. While munching on a handful of plantain chips, I wondered how they compared to potato chips so I hopped on the Google train and did a little exploring.Per one ounce serving the Chifles plantain chips have 170 calories, 8 grams of total fat, and 30mg of sodium.On the Calorie King web site I learned that on average potato chips per ounce have 155 calories, 10.6 grams of fat, and 149 mg of sodium. According to several sites potato chips actually contain more potassium than plantain chips do. A serving of plantain chips holds 206mg of potassium.We just happen to have a bag of Utz Baked Ripple Chips in the house for more comparison. These chips per one ounce serving have 110 calories, 1.5g of fat, and 130mg of sodium. There's no mention on the bag about potassium content.I'd certainly recommend trying plantain chips for a change of pace. On my bag of Chifles plantain chips is a statement that these are certified WBEN. (womens business enterprise)

For anyone who is curious about plantains, it is a tropical product.  It is in the family of bananas, however, unlike eating a ripened banana, plantains must be cooked, whether in the green or yellow skin.  Plantains are used in many delicious dishes, however, as a snack, fried plantains are an absolute delight!  The taste is unlike that of potato chips, so if you are thinking it will be along the same taste, it is a big no.  Try them with an open mind, and hopefully you will come to enjoy this delicious treat as much as I do.Chifles are very delicious on its own or paired with your favorite salsa or guacamole or whatever dip is your choice.  Personally, I eat them as is; on the go.  I am so addicted to these chips I usually buy them in bulk whenever I find them in the stores.Amazon, congratulations on your customer service award!!  Your customer service team training modules should be used as a model for all other businesses.  You are truly outstanding in this area, and for your amazon customers, we appreciate this so very much.  I have NEVER been disappointed with you yet.... :-) ( don't think I will either..)
Purchased for my New Year's Party to serve in cocktails..... everyone loved it!  A fun way to "spruce" up a holiday festivity!
I di much research and settled on the Nescafe Dolce Gusto coffee maker. It has been everything that was promised and more. Excellent speed, taste and variety.

This is a superb product!!  Healthy, unlike white sugar.A fine powdered white sugar can be made from Turbinado simply by 'whizzing' in a food processor or blender.A truly unique syrup may be made by combining 1 Cup Turbinado and one cup water, bring to a boil for one minute, add 1 tsp of Arrowroot powder with a whisp, boil gently for 2-3 minutes, add 1 tsp each of Pure Vanilla and Maple flavoring, remove from heat and refrigerate when cooled.

column4: Desert Gypsy "A Brooklyn Girl Out West"
column10: This is my favorite sugar to bake with. I give a little sprinkle of this to the tops of my cookies and they come out with the perfect amount of sweetness and crunch. This sugar takes the heat well and does not melt, giving a little sparkle to the cookie tops too. I also like this sugar served just on the side of pancakes. I eat them just like a little kid, tearing off bits and dipping in the sugar which gives such a nice crunch. Demerara sugar is also great for hot beverages like tea.I love that it comes in this fine container which not only looks great on the shelf but seals very tightly to keep out any humidity or critters.Pleased with this product and highly recommended.

This sugar has a light brown color and delicious aroma. However, the granules are very large, so it is not a good candidate for creaming sugar and butter together. But if you plan to use it in a recipe where the sugar will be melted first, then it's a great product. The large granules are perfect for sprinkling on top of finished baked goods as a decoration. The plastic container it comes in is very handy. This is a wonderful product and would be perfect if only the granules were not so large.

column9: good, but not what i ordered...
column10: i have no complaints about the demerara sugar, except that i thought i'd ordered vanilla sugar (which got great reviews).  however, amazon refunded me the bill and i can't complain about the service.  and the sugar itself is nice.  very much like "sugar in the raw", except now i have 6lbs of it.
Family loved all three soups. They were so easy to make my 11 year old made the Tortilla Soup. All were quick, simple, and delicious! A definite family favorite now!

These are the best soups I have ever tried.  I went to the Homemade Gourmet website and found lots of great ways to make them other than the recipes on the box.  The sausage enchilada dip was out of this world.
Does anyone sell lightly sweetened cranberries.  I've tried 3 different brands now.  All were too sweet and 2 of them, this one included, were too oily.

We love this mix by Shan.  It isn't difficult to make, but it does take about 2 hours from start to finish.  It's very hot and spicy, but for Rogan Josh other than made completely from scratch, this is our favorite.  Just have plenty of yogurt on hand.  We recently tried another Rogan Josh sauce in a jar, and it didn't compare.  We use a lot of Shan spice mixes as Indian spices themselves are hard to come by in our area, and we've never been disappointed.
I'm still on the hunt for the perfect Rogan Josh. This isn't it, but it's still quite good. And HOT. It takes a lot of heat for me to mention it, though I'm no Aaron Sanchez.

These are great for any cake, cupcake or cookie.  They come with PLENTY so it can go a long way.  If you don't mind keeping them for a second year, then buy because you'll have plenty left over.  Or maybe you're making A LOT of food to decorate?  Cute, colorful, and fun.

column9: Great Variety and Easy Solution to Decorating Halloween Treats
column10: I used these to decorate for a large Halloween party for about 100 people.  I used the entire can for the party and made about 3 boxes of Rice Krispie treats, 3 trays of brownies, and about 4 dozen cookies.  I'll be needing to order more for next year but they really provided me with a nice variety so I can use different sprinkles with each type of treat - and that variety all came in one container! I still think the price was a little high for the amount you receive which is why I only have it 4 stars.

We received this as a Christmas gift and we enjoyed this chocolate immensely.  We then decided to search for it and found Amazon sold it.  We found this chocolate to be very smooth and rich.  We are also fans of Vosge and Ritter Sport chocolate so if you also like those two brands you'll most likely find the Brix chocolate to your liking.  It really does come in a brick and we use a rubber mallet and screw driver to break into it.  I realize there are many ways to do this but we find this way works well for us.

column9: Seems healthy, and dogs love it
column10: I have a very picky Siberian Husky, who often leaves food in the bowl if she doesn't care for the taste or is bored by it. So far she's attacked the firstmate pacific fish kibble at each meal, and finished all of it. Our second dog, a border collie, also seems to prefer it to his regular kibble, which is castor & pollux organix.I bought this at a local Seattle pet store called Mud Bay. I trust them to do well by their customers (all their suggestions have worked well for me), and they tend to keep better brands. They highly recommended it, and the dogs seem to agree.

Great product from Canada.  Wanted to know ingredients and pricing.  No grains.  Herring fish meal for main protein and potatoes for main carb.  Happen to find the 14.5 lb bags on sale twice.  Was much less than getting the 28 lb bag or 5 lb bags at the time.

column9: My dog seems to love it!
column10: My dog seems to love this product and laps it up quite nicely.  I recommend it highly!

Exactly what does this product do? How does it help your body?Along with the aloe vera this product has helped my wife and i tremendously.My joints, cancer fighting agent, a great antioxidant. Helped me to get back up and running again. Thanks for a great product!  Indian Summer Tart Cherry Juice - 46 oz. 8 pk.
If you're looking for a tasty cherry juice, this is it.  It is a tart juice but tastes great.

column9: You can buy it cheaper if you look local
column10: I just bought the Juice at Jewel foods in Chicago for @2.99 each (8 for $23.96) or Albertsons ! Great stuff i mix it with Apple Juice and Green Tea Ice cubes for Smoothies !

This juice is exquisite. It's like drinking cherry pie filling but not sickeningly sweet like that. XD It just has that tasty baked cherry flavor. It's tart, but not face crinklingly tart. I feel like I'm being rewarded with something luxurious when I drink it and I don't know why. But it's nice!!
This is a great juice, no sugar added, helps with gout and joints.  A glass a day is the answer! Pure Tart Cherry Juice, Love it!

Indian Summer Tart Cherry Juice is delicious.  The eight plastic bottles that each contain 46 oz. makes an extremely heavy box.  When I picked my order up from the mail stop that receives my packages, I was warned NOT to get this product again, because it was heavy for him to deal with.  I had to open the box and take two bottles to my car in four trips, and then I had to dispose of the shipping box as well.  It was problematic for me to find a proper storage place for the eight bottles, but it was a welcome taste treat.  I noticed that the plastic used in the bottles is not recyclable, which is a concern to me.  Although I found the juice to be delicious, I am going to try the concentrate method next, simply because of the weighty product.  I have three ruptured discs in the lumbar curve, and carrying any amount of a heavy product is not recommended at any time.  I, personally, do not find any redeeming quality for joints, but I did notice an immediate increase in the quality of sleep.  I have no trouble falling asleep, but it seemed as if I hardly dreamed for a long time, which would indicate rem sleep. When I began taking the tart cherry juice, I would dream every night, regardless of the time available for sleeping.  I also woke up with my body more refreshed.  The dreaming quality was most noticeable with Trader Joe's Tart Cherry Juice sold in glass bottles.  I did not notice the same quality of dreams using the Indian Summer product.
This is my favorite DRY soda. The cucumber soda is excellent. I also like the Vanilla Beam Lavender and Juniper, but this one is excellent! No more beers, just give me ones of these any day.

This soda tastes like the subtle essence of cucumbers. It doesn't overpower, nor is it sweet. It is the perfect balance of flavor. We can buy this at our local grocery store but it sells out so fast that I buy several four packs whenever it's in stock. Thank you Amazon for giving me another source.
I really enjoy the DRY Soda beverages.  My favorites are the low acidity options.  Cucumber is my favorite.  Very refreshing, and a great alternative to soda.
It tastes like a soy candle.  It tastes like rest stop hand soap.  I don't know what makes the "natural flavoring" (is it really cucumbers?) but it's intriguing enough to keep sipping.

You've heard about how those crazy kids in Japan love cucumber-flavored things. They've got cucumber pepsi, kit-kats, and candy. The idea of a fresh cool cucumber drink interests you, so you decide to try it. You wrench open the bottle with your sensitive hands and take a sip. Suddenly you are alone on a cloudy, grey day, on a construction site for a new hospital. The hospital is nearing its completion but is obviously unfinished; blue tarps hang in place of drywall in some areas and fiberglass powder is scattered all over the bare concrete floor. The wind gently blows and the tarps sway, sweeping a cloud of insulation-dust and dirt into your face. It's musty and dry and it makes your mouth feel dirty.That is what drinking dry cucumber soda is like.

column9: The BEST Martini olives on the planet
column10: When I make a Tanqueray (gin) martini at home, it always tastes best with Santa Barbara Olive Co's MARTINI OLIVES.  They're perfectly firm, taste great and as fresh as I can imagine they taste on the day they're bottled, and the brine is perfect when I feel like making my martini dirty.  The best tasting jarred olives I've ever eaten!

column9: even the stray cat outside wasn't interested!
column10: Since my cats have always loved Cosmic Catnip, I figured they might also enjoy the treats.  What a disappointment!  Neither cat even nibbled, and when I left some outside for the neighborhood stray, he even passed!  Save your money and just buy grocery store treats.

column9: "Is this supposed to be a treat?" (What my kitties would ask if they could talk)
column10: I've been purchasing Cosmic catnip and scratching pads for as long as I've been a cat owner, and I've never been disappointed.  When I saw the cute, colorful packaging and the variety of flavors available for these treats, I couldn't resist.Sadly, my cats won't even acknowledge these as food.  They won't even smell them, let alone taste them.  Maybe I just got a bad batch, but my cats will usually eat anything that is offered to them at least once.  Even one of my dogs, who does anything to sneak a bite of the kitty food, wasn't too eager to eat one of these Philly Cheesesteak treats.The treats arrived somewhat hard, but it is obvious that they are the type that should be soft.  I don't know if this was Amazon's error for selling a stale product, or if the cold weather had something to do with it (it's getting down to the 20's at night where I live).For nearly the same price as these treats, buy your kitties a tub of Cosmic catnip...I am almost certain they will LOVE you for it!

These are our puggle's favorite treat!  We discovered the cheese snacks at a small boutique pet store and the dog fell in love with them -- he loves anything made of cheese.  I was thrilled to find them at Amazon in the two pack at a savings!  The treats themselves are small -- about the size of a nickel -- so they are better for smaller dogs.  They even smell good!  Only drawback is that there seems to be a lot of broken pieces and cheese "dust" at the bottom of the bag.
My dog has a wheat allergy and these are the best treats I have found! He loves them! He is an 80lb boxer and boxes still seem to last a long time!

Worked better than the stuff a vet gave us for a problem that the dog chewed his skin off. This created a large bloody wound. The stuff we got from the vet required re-application daily but did not work all that well. This stuff was applied a couple of times at first and now once a week or 2 and all is well.

Perfect for fall and winter salads and to dress brussels sprouts! Intensify the apple flavor by combining it with reduced apple cider. I love to make a salad of bitter greens, honey crisp apples, toasted hazelnut, and comte, topped with an apple cider vinegar and hazelnut oil dressing. Yum!

I love coffee - good coffee - so am hesitant to even review an instant coffee.  However, there are times when I'm not up for brewing (especially not decaf) and this brand of instant works well.  If you don't think of it as coffee, and consider it more like another kind of hot drink, then it's not bad.It's worth the cost, especially if you subscribe and get the 15% discount.

column9: TASTES LIKE REAL COFFEE!!! It's a miracle!
column10: OMG This is so delicious! I'm fine with spending money at Starbucks for some overpriced coffee from time to time, and even buying fancy beans at Whole Foods or something... but when it came to decaf, I just never found it to be worth my while to get beans, or grounds, or buy a cup at a cafe. (Why spend money on something that has no return value????)Anyway, I figured I could buy some instant decaf coffee for those nights when I just want a taste of coffee, but without the consequences of staying up tossing and turning in bed all jittery and craycray.Nescafe Clasico Decaf is DELICIOUS. It has a very smooth, almost honey-like taste, not at all bitter/acidic/sour like almost all instant coffee usually is, but also not hecka expensive like Starbucks VIA coffee is.I took off one star because there really isn't clear instructions as to how much grounds you should put for how much hot water, so the first few tries I was basically experimenting blindly, which was a bit annoying.

After having diffuculty finding this locally tried a couple other brands of chipolte.  I wasted my money.  The amazon price for 3 is what I would have paid for 2 at the specialty shop that doesn't even carry this anymore.  Great smoky flavor and of course that bite.  I use it not only in mexican food but in Itaian meals with great success.  Actually I use it on anything that I need a little smoke and a little burn!
The product is fresh and I haven't been able to beat this price anywhere. It is crushed so if you are looking for grounded pepper you have to do it yourself. I will purchase again.

So glad I read various reviews of other products sold here at Amazon before choosing the Spice Hunter brand.  I wanted a chipotle chile that did not contain a mixture of other spices and salt, and that is what this product offers.  Perfect smokey heat!  And yes, use your spice or coffee grinder if you want a more powdery substance as opposed to the crushed seeds that this contains.  The aroma, the flavor, the heat - Oh, my! This stuff is great!

column9: Best option for hard to find Chipotle Powder
column10: I looked everywhere for powdered Chipotle Chile Powder but couldn't find it, even in the specialty food stores in this area. I purchased this product knowing it wasn't a powder, in hopes that I could run it through my spice grinder and get the powder I need for my recipes.  It grinds beautifull, and just takes a few seconds. The quality of this product is excellent - just be sure you have a way to grind it for recipes.  Great value too since you get 3 jars.
This chipotle pepper is wonderfully fresh and intense.  It gives a great smoky heat to whatever you put it in.  It is not ground into a powder but is made of individual pepper seeds.
I am cutting sodium and crushed peppers have replaced hot sauce for me.  Excellent replacement for my old stand by Buffalo Chipotle sauce.
My husband & I really enjoy this spice.  It adds a nice spicy / smokey flavor to sandwiches, salads, etc..

column9: tastes great but there is added sugar
column10: This product does taste great, but there is added sugar.  It is not just water with a splash of juice for taste.  Sugar is listed right after water.

This is the best alternative to juice for my kids...they love it, it's mostly water for staying hydrated and they love being able to have a "juice box" like everyone else at school without all the sugar of juice. Also, it's made of organic ingredients and mostly water (did I mention that?!) and the price is a fraction on Amazon.com of what it is in the stores (if you can find these anymore since they are hard to find). I highly recommend these!

We LOVE these little juice boxes because they contain very little sugar and are compact in size - making them not only easier for little ones to consume, but also easier for mommy to schlep to the park! Our friends are appreciative of them when they come over for play dates. We serve them at our kids birthday parties and provide them at school for snack time. The kids call them "Clifford Juice."Amazon's price is about 30% less than what we have found at the local (major) grocery store chain. This one has become a 'subscribe and save' staple in our household.

column9: Great Tasting Healthy Product for Kids!
column10: This is such a great product!!!  The flavored water gets kids to drink water by adding frutiy flavors to it to give it some taste.  It keeps kids hydrated without adding sugar and calories.  I love the carton packaging!  It is so environmentally friendly bring made from a renewable resource.....trees.  Though it doesn't have a recycling symbol on it, it is recyclable in many areas.  A great product and fun package and design!

I am a major "Chili head", these nutz are amazing. If you are into a burning tongue and runny nose these are for you. If you are only mildly into hot stuff.....Stay away. I burned a couple of folk with these, me personally I eat them by the fistful. The only other nutz close to this is Hottest F@#$IN nuts.

These nuts are "Da Bomb". Not only are these awesomely flavorful and hot for us "hot heads" but they're also a fun prank for the people who are not. You know the ones I'm talking about. The ones who are too scared to even try a medium heat sauce.Aside from the heat, and yes they are quite hot, they also taste real good. It's not so hot that you can't enjoy the peanuts. Anyway, I'm glad I have 6 cans! I'll be ordering again!
All I can say is HOT! I love these peanuts, very addicitive if you like extremely hot food! AWESOME!!!!!!

These are not very hot.They are about as hot as cayenne flavored peanuts.No ghost chile heat level.The Hottest Fn Nuts are much hotter and better flavored.These are mild enough for children, and would make a good gift for someone new to hot snacks, but it is not likely to please chileheads.
We like spicy foods but these were way too spicy for us.  We ended up giving them all away to friends that like spicier food than us.

I first purchased these nuts on a trip to Lake Tahoe from a small specialty shop at an inversely proportional large price. The nuts are tasty and have enough heat to get your attention but not enough to scare you away. My son says they are addictive. However, at specialty shop prices this is an addiction that would soon land you in the poor house. The six pack sale I purchased at Amazon was spot on for value. Unfortunately it is not the regular purchase price. I look forward to seeing this item on sale in the future and will surely purchase again.
Every nut burns. I love em. I finish a can every two days. I think I need help. A definite for all the heat seekers out there
These nuts are very spicy and taste great.  I wanted something a bit spicier than other hot nuts I have purchased.  A handful of these satisfies.  Will buy again

My oldest daughter lives in Kansas City. Since I'm a huge salsa fan, she takes me to Original Juan's factory outlet store every time I visit to stock up on some of my favorite salsas.The last time I was there, I picked up an 8 oz. can of Da'Bomb Ghost Pepper Nuts. (Original Juan manufactures and distributes this product.) They had an in-store sampling, and they were amazing.  Spicy?  Yes, but not so hot that you can't enjoy them. (I had earlier bought a bottle of their Da'Bomb salsa, and it was way too hot for my taste.) These peanuts are, however, hot but not overpoweringly so. Ingredients include ghost chili peppers and habanero peppers. And while they are also salty (180 mg per 1 oz. serving), they are no more salty than most other salted nuts.And what I really like about them is that my wife thinks they are TOO hot, so I don't have to share. HIGHLY RECOMMENDED

As another reviewer noted, these are very spicy but that's about it. There is no other real flavor there. Don't get me wrong, I bought these for heat and that is certainly delivered!So what I did, is I also ordered some other spicy peanuts here that are big on flavor but not really that spicy for someone that looks for ghost pepper style and I will blend the two together. Whoa ... nice flavor and heat!
An awsome buy for the price. Product was delivered on time, and packaged well.. Will definitly buy again..Iv'e bought the same item in stores for ALOT more money...
These hot peanuts are quite hot, but that's all they are.  There's not enough salt and not enough other flavor to make them really enjoyable.

These are great.  I would recommend these to anyone looking for something with some heat to them.  If you do not like hot stuff, you will not like these.  Most of my friends would try one peanut and their face would turn red, and get a funny look on there face.

For MMORPG junkies, I heard the heat index for these best described as "A DOT that stacks."For the rest of you, that basically means that a few of these wonderful li'l things don't seem so bad. "Heck" you'll say to yourself in false confidence "these things aren't even hot!." To which the natural response is to shovel a handful into your mouth. That, my fellow heat-seekers, is where the fun begins! These things get hotter as you eat more of them and they are loaded with flavor. Do yourself a service and buy some for yourself, then give a handful to some unsuspecting victim and tell him they're "mild at best."

There's no reason to explain hot foods, either you love them or you don't.I've had Dave's Burning Nuts (most well known for Dave's Insanity Sauce) prior but they stopped selling them at the local grocery store. I imagine I may have been the only buyer but much like Da' Bomb Ghost Pepper Nuts, they're a simple mix of peanuts and spices. The big seller here is the inclusion of Bhut Jolokia (Also known as Naga Jolokia and Ghost Chilis), an impossibly hot super pepper, with a scoville rating of roughly 1,000,000. Its clear that the Da' Bomb dilutes it heavily, for the sake of eatiblity.  They're hotter than Dave's Burning Nuts, but certainly shy of the hot sauces like Dave's Insanity or even temporary insanity. They could pack a little more punch but they're the right amount to be eatable (at least to me, everyone's tolerance is different and my definition of hot certainly a few standard deviations outside of the norm).They have a nice smokey taste, and little less salty than Dave's, closer to a BBQ taste than Dave's Burning Nuts. The heat takes awhile, to kick in, mostly after you've had a few handfuls and it lingers pleasantly, but never painful.I will say however, perhaps someone unknown ingredient causes some reaction, where they don't exactly digest pleasantly. Usually hot foods don't bother my stomach but these are a bit different. I really like them, but its hard to justify eating them.  Too bad, they're worth buying, or at least checking or gifting to someone other soul who loves hot food.

I just had my first bite of these, OMG, I love the heat they bring and I do love Hot stuff! The hotter the better. Not only hot, but the flavor itself if great! Some products are just hot, these are HOT and Tasty....Will definatly order these again

These peanuts are good if you like really really salty stuff. Too much salt in these nuts..It taste like pure salt. Wayyyy tooo salty...Other than this, these peanuts are very good. I need to drink tons of water when eating this. (not because it's spicy, but it's too salty)

column9: The BEST granola on the market
column10: I buy this at Costco all the time and am teetering on addicted, LOL!  It's VERY flavorful, perfect consistancy and is great with yogurt or milk of just by the handful!  I HIGHLY recommend it!
I tried this cereal for the first time about a week ago.  It is wonderfully crunchy and a great snack.
My husband cannot get enough of this cereal.  It is very chunky and hearty and nutty good.  It keeps you full for a long time.

column9: The flax has gone rancid in the last 4 boxes I have purchased
column10: I have not purchased this from Amazon, but at my local grocer and at Costco.  Each time, the flax has gone bad.  I had to google it to learn that the smell of paint thinner emitting from the bag, was indeed rancid flax.  My boxes still have several months to go before their expiration date.  I will not be purchasing their cereals with flax in them again.
Great cereal/granola! I have no problem eating this at anytime of the day, Morning, Noon, or Night!You can get the 33.5oz box for a little over $7 at Costco.
too much dust... it was ok but i was hoping for a more chunky granola, It would be great to mix in yoghurt

I love, love, LOVE this granola! I have some on Greek yogurt, pack some away in my purse as a snack, or eat it as a breakfast cereal with milk. Right now I am 6 months into my third pregnancy and have relied on this to be a healthy snack that keepsmy seemingly ever present hunger at bay (which I think has helped me - I've only gained 5 pounds!). I have a sweet tooth and find the pumpkin flax granola to offer just enough sweetness to satisfy without feeling guilty about calories and sugar. It's packed with fiber and omega 3's, is very low sodium and tastes fantastic. Go ahead and give it a try! I think I am going to try using it as a stuffing for baked apples next!
This is the best cereal!  My only complaint is the cost and the small amount that comes in each box.  It is hands down the best "healthy" cereal I have ever eaten.
So Yummy!  This cereal has great texture, low sugar and good on fiber.  It is defiantly my favorite right now. It's about 1/2 the price at Costco.

The pumpkin flax seed cereal is soooooooooo good! It was a new item at our local costco, and I'm so glad I tried it!! My husband is not a cereal eater at all, and he LOVED it! This is one item I hope costco continues to sell. If not, I'm glad it's  on here! I highly recommend this cereal!:)

This wonderful organic granola has become my favorite granola. It is just perfectly crunchy and goes well with milk or can be sprinkled on top of yogurt. I like the crunchiness of the pumpkin seeds and they mix well with the oats and flax seeds. This is sweetened with evaporated cane juice instead of regular sugar or corn syrup. It is also high in fiber, low in sodium and has six grams of protein per serving. Give it a try I think you'll love it.~The Rebecca Review
This is my go to breakfast! I slice up a ripe banana on top with milk and viola, deliciousness thats good for you! Love it!
I Love this cereal!  It is great in that the crunch stays and doesn't get too mushy in the milk.  It also has very full flavor and is very filling.

I got these on a lark, while hunting for the Oetker vanilla essence, and I'm truly glad I got them. We ran out of maple syrup (the organic Canadian variety, no offense to anyone; that's what we like)  one pancake-Sunday, and in desperation I made a syrup of water, honey, sugar and some of this bitter-almond essence. WOW. I have not been allowed to buy maple syrup ever since.
This water tastes great! Very refreshing and addictive. This is my go to refreshment.  If you like peppermint you'll love this!  They have other flavors too.  Give it a try!
I like turmeric, and this has a slightly different and stronger flavor than what I usually buy.  I don't need to use as much.

If you've never tried Kona coffee, Aloha Island is definitely the one to start with.  Kona coffee is grown in the Kona district of the Big Island and regarded by some to be the best coffee in the world.  I'm not a coffee aficionado by any means, but you can taste the difference with Kona coffee - it's full and rich and almost mocha-ish.  I always reserve Kona for lazy weekend brunches or to serve with dessert after a lovely dinner.  Aloha Island operates the only quality management program in Kona, so their coffees are certified as 100% Kona.  Which just means that you're guaranteed to get quality Kona coffee if you order from them. Keep in mind that Aloha Island has three grades of Kona coffee that they sell - gold, platinum, and diamond (which is supposed to be their private reserve).  Obviously, it gets more expensive as you go up the ladder.  The gold is very good and a great place to start sampling their fare.
Hands down this is absolutely the best kona coffee I have ever had in my life..This is the smoothest and richest coffee you will ever have...Go ahead and spoil yourself, you'll be glad you did!!

column9: Smooth and Sublime--This is Kona for the Hawaiian Demigods
column10: The aroma from a pot of this coffee is earthy and heavenly at the same time. Everything about this product--packaging, texture, and taste--tells you that it was lovlngly produced under rigid standards. Moreover,if you've tried a lot of "kona" coffees like I have, you know how widely the taste and quality can vary. This is the coffee you serve to the treasured few in your life who really appreciate the finest.

I can see why plenty of people will think this is the best coffee ever. It's some of the smoothest, least bitter coffee I've ever tasted. The aroma is also delicious. Opening the bag and taking a whiff right away is a must if you want to try this.But I'm the type of coffee drinker who loves it black, so I need a coffee with a rich flavour on its own. I don't wanter bitterness, but I love coffee with kick to it.I'd call it too mild but that's kind of oversimplifying it. It's worth a try to make up your own mind though.

Aloha Island Coffee Company Bonzai Pipeline Dark Roast is a very mediocre, insipid coffee, rather acidic for a dark roast. The beans are of unknown origin, but if there are any Kona beans in this anonymous mix, they must be the ones other roasters threw out as it doesn't even vaguely taste like Kona. Actually, Aloha Island Coffee Co. isn't even in Hawaii, it's located in Santa Ana, CA, an area not exactly known for great coffee. The coffee is extremely overpriced for the poor quality you get, which is why I gave it one star, and you would be better off buying some of the better brands commonly sold in supermarkets at about one-third the price. I ordered the 2-8 oz bags, but I couldn't even make it through the first one and have thrown the second in the garbage. I would never buy anything from Aloha Island Coffee company again.

I'm more of a tea drinker but occasionally want something different and I like this to keep me up or wake me up too. So, keep in mind I haven't tasted lots of coffees. I find most coffees bitter and gross, like starbucks or whatever my mom buys. With some splenda I actually enjoy this, so even if you don't like coffee give this a try. It's definitely one of the better one.

This coffee is the absolute best.  I found it by accident a couple of months ago and now I can not have any other kind of coffee.  It may be more expensive than some, but well worth it.  Plus, you aren't going to want to go out to Starbucks anymore!  Manufacturer ships quickly too!

column9: these pods fit the senseo holder and it's great Coffee!!!
column10: I'm not a fan of Senseo brand coffee pods so I've been using espresso pods from Green Mountain (not great but way better then senseo) for some reason they quit making them so I was searching for pods that fit the Senseo after reading the review I took a shot in the dark and ordered a box of them from Amazon and fell in Love I use them with the espresso pod holder I got from amazon (not the single pod holder that comes stock)and have been enjoying the best espresso I've had in years.  I liked them so well I just ordered 2 more boxes

You wake up early on a sunday morning and you turn on your other side because you want to sleep a little more. But then you smell something like scrambled eggs, fried oignon rings and above all the strong scent of espresso...This is strong coffee like the Italian espresso. Take care you don't boil the water, otherwise it will loses its flavor. The water should be between warm and hot. I use it black with a small lump of brown sugar. A real amateur will tell you that the use of any sugar is sacrilege. But what can I do? The flesh is weak.

column4: I'm A Retired Biker now "Da-retired Biker"
column10: Pretty good coffee I really liked itIt is a bit on the strong side or it may be the way I brewed it but it is a good tasting coffee in my opinion.

Product looked and smelled great - however, it was not clear from the description that this product is for non-ESE pod machines. I like the idea of organic and US source, this just didn't work for me.
Coffee from Hawaii is the best in the world, specificly the Kona side of the island and this is no exception.
This was purchased for my daughter and her husband.  I was very pleased with the selection of items in the basket.

One of our regular Tofu recipes calls for cooking the Tofu in very hot oil. One characteristic of this product comes from the language on the bottle: "This light, delicate oil seals in the flavors of meat & poultry at high temperatures. . ." I have gone through almost one complete bottle (only 8.45 ounces per bottle), and am very satisfied. Despite using it for higher temperature cooking, it doesn't smoke and it sustains sauteeing quite well.I have only been using this for a couple months, but it has become a component in my kitchen that I want to retain over time. So, as this bottle is emptying, it's time for me to purchase another and keep this an active part of my cooking regime.

My husband wanted to make a peppercorn sauce to go with our steaks.  We used a recipe from a 5 star restaurant in New York.  When we found this recipe, the chef talked about how he used the product Demi Glacé Gold instead of making his own demi glacé.  When I looked up how to make my own demi glacé, I realized I would never take the time to do this.  We ordered the Demi Glacé Gold and followed the peppercorn recipe.  It was so easy and the best peppercorn sauce I've ever had.  I've also added this product to a beef stroganoff that we love.  I would like to purchase this product in a larger container but haven't found out how long it lasts once opened or if you can freeze it.

These are not Atlantic mackerel (scomber scombrus), but rather chub mackerel (scomber colias.) Atlantic mackerel is a higher quality fish that is also less likely to contain heavy metals, PCBs, etc. than chub mackerel. Vital Choice only recently corrected their website and apparently neglected to update Amazon.
This is a great deal... A tiny bottle of this at our local store is almost $4 !!!! Now we can "afford" to stir fry alot more.
Our local supermarkets charge app. $4.00 for a 7 oz. jar of Hoisin sauce.  Not only was this Hoisin much, much cheaper, I thought the sauce had a better flavor.

Can't say enough how much my family LOVES this soup and of course it's not available at our local grocery stores (even though Amy's others flavors are available)  Simple, delicious, few ingredients but the recipe rocks!  We love it sprinkled with grated parmesan cheese accompanied by a tuna melt sandwich - especially on cold rainy days - always warms us up!

WHEN TRADER JOE NO LONGER CARRIED THEIR FABULOUS TOMATO BISQUE SOUP, WE TRIED EVERY BRAND THAT WAS AVAILABLE AND THEN TURNED TO A TRUSTED NAME AND WE WERE NOT DISAPPOINTED. AMY'S SURPASSES THAT WHICH WE MISSED. IT IS AS PURE AS MAKING IT YOURSELF FROM SCRATCH. DELICIOSO!!!
With a cheese sandwich (organic of course)you have a great mealmakes you feel like a kid again !
This soup is not only great tasting, it is healthy!  I have to watch my salt intake and was happy to find not only an organic soup, but a low-sodium soup that is delicious!

This is undoubtedly the very best tomato soup you will ever taste. There is no equal to this product. It is amazing that I am the first to write a review of this product. I captures all of the finest elements of tomato soup with just the right combination of spices and texture. Wow! Buy this and you will not be disappointed. I could eat this every day.

My wife found this soup about a year ago and can't seem to get enough of it. She had been buying this in our local stores, but at least half of the time they simply did not have any in stock. We've now ordered through Amazon about 3 different times. Each time they arrive in excellent condition (unlike a previous reviewer's comments), and now she never runs out. The price is also better than our local store's price. Thanks amazon!

So surprised after trying this bisque that customers did not clear off the grocery store shelf.  My son told me about it and with him being a chef bought several cans for myself.  Will definitely try more of Amy's organic soups as this one was quite filling and tasty.
Daughter loves this soup but it is so expensive at the health foods store so when I saw it on Amazon where I can have savings of over one dollar a can I jumped on this deal.
This soup has a really good taste.  It's Gluten free, and I am gluten intolerant, so it's something nice that I can eat.

Amy's Chunky Tomato BisqueThe name alone, makes this special!  Amy's products have always been a favorite of mine.  This is a healthy, comfort soup, to me.  Sipping, slowly, from a spoon, and savoring every flavor is a healthy satisfying pleasure!

This is a delightful Chunky Tomato Bisque Soup.  It may be organic and light on Sodium, which makes it very healthful, but doesn't give up a thing in the taste department.  I have been buying it by the case for a couple years, and finding it on Amazon makes it that much easier to get. And while you are at it, you should try Amy's Lentil soup, and or any of their other Organic soups.

Word to the wise: Amy's makes the soups that Trader Joe's carries, so save yourself $6 by buying 12 cans at your local Trader Joe's, if you have one. This soup might have relatively high sugar content, but damn is it good. Perhaps the best canned soup I've ever had.

by far the best tomato soup I've ever eaten.  Go ahead, try some restaurant tomato bisque soup, and then try Amy's.  You'll find out for yourself that you can't find a tastier soup and it's Organic!!!

column9: Super yummy, and you don't notice the lower salt at all
column10: I can't eat full on tomato soups that often, as I flush and get itchy, but sometimes, it's worth the suffering for a nice bowl of tomato bisque--one of my all time fave soups, particularly if made fresh.I really like Amy's lower sodium version. It has bits of tomato, not tasteless like some lower salt soups can be, very tomatoey, and with some whole grain pasta tossed in for "bite" and a sprinkle of parmesan, it's a complete lunch. Add a salad or side of veggies and it's supper.If you like  a creamier bisque, it's real easy to mix in one or two tablespoons of half-n-half and stir (not while bubbling, though). Granted, that makes it a less healthful option, but sometimes, I have a craving for a really creamy bisque. That does it for me.I may only be able to have tomato bisque a couple times a year due to my sensitivity, but this one satisfies.

column9: Severely bent cans. Amazon needs to adopt a policy of full disclosure.
column10: The cans I received were severely bent. This did not happen in shipping. The box was in good condition and packaged well. Amazon needs to indicate the condition of the canned good they are selling (or at least mention the possibility of the cans being bent, because it is starting to appear from the number I have received that they are selling damaged canned goods). I had to throw one of the cans away since the product in it smelled off.

column9: HIGH IN SUGAR- DO NOT FEED TO KIDS!!
column10: I was happy to see that Amy's soups have reduced the sodium, BUT this stuff has as much sugar as a cup of chocolate milk, or even more... it's like eating tomato jam!! awful stuff.. Like most Amy's soups recipes, it has added sugar cane juice. Others have corn syrup... when my mom made soup, she never added sweetners to her soup.. Amy's soups is no different than the large brands.. high in sodium ( except for a few new recipes w/low sodium), and high in sugar...NO wonder our kids have diabetes, are overweight, and have high blood pressure. DO NOT BUY ANY OF THESE SOUPS TO FEED TO KIDS. You are better off making your own soups and freezing them in containers.. tons of recipes online.
This was for my daughter in law school.  She says the soup is terrific.
Worst soup ever!!!! It has so much of sugar, remembering it makes me go sick in the tummy. I guess I will stick to buying what I generally buy at Safeway. This soup was awfully sweet and unpalatable.
This is the soft and chewy type of jerky that is hard to find. I like it for back packing it come in a 6 pack and is just right for packing. Great value.

It tastes just like I think it did in grade school.  Delicious.  Back when jerky was formed from who knows what into a process stick looking think.  By today's standards it has been relegated to looking like snacks but its still a delicious flash from my past.

When I was a kid I used to get a brand of beef jerky that doesn't exist anymore and I absolutely loved it to death (well, not really to death, but...).  I have tried so many different brands of jerky and have not really found a good substitute to that old brand until a month or so ago I found THIS brand in a small grocery store in the middle of nowhere U.S.A. and bought it on a whim.  I couldn't contain myself because I had FINALLY found a substitute to that old brand, and I just had to get more of it and fast.  So I came online to find it and Amazon.com had it so I ordered a WHOLE case.  It got here in great time and was packaged very well.  I now have a standing order to receive this product every so often and am loving snack time again.This is not the kind of Jerky that makes you feel like you just ripped a hunk of meat off a dead cow, it's been ground up and processed and then made into strips, but that's the kind I LOVE.  Thank you Amazon, and thank you Lowery's!Signed by a VERY satisfied customer.
RECEIVED THIS ITEM ON TIME AND IN EXCELLANT CONDITION.THIS IS THE ONLY JERKY THAT I LIKE BECAUSE OF THE TASTE.
It's not top of the line beef jerky but a good bang for the buck.  I recommend it when you're on a budget.

We are big jerky fans in this house and I have probably tried all brands at one time or another..This jerky is by far the WORSE!!! You will swear you are eating a Dog Treat and check the package a couple times to make sure they are for human consumption! Well my dogs are eating them as treats now
Easy way to have a snack on hand that adds protein and curbs those sugar lows.

We used to buy the canisters of these until they disappeared from retail stores.  They were addicting but later became hit-and-miss.  Some was tender and fresh, while some was too stale or smoky-tasting and would get left unfinished.  The expiration dates were at least 6 months ahead, so that wasn't the problem.Anyway, we recently ordered the bags and were pleasantly surprised.  They're not quite as tender and tasty as the first canisters we opened years ago, but they're worth the price.  The only problem we've had is that out of 6 shipments and 72 bags, 4 bags contained mold -- from 3 different shipments.  Three bags had just a couple spots of mold but were a little stale and tasted funny.  The fourth bag had about half the surface area of the jerky covered in white mold, and the smell was pretty bad.  We're still eating more but checking for mold first -- not something we should have to do.As someone else mentioned, the Amazon's product photo and nutrition information are old.  The bag now advertises 16 grams of protein, not 21.  Fat content is increased from 10 g to 14.

This stuff takes me back to the old smoke stack in a can jerky. If you are a beef jerky snob you probably won't like it but for me it is great. Tender, lots of flavor and under $2 a bag you can't beat it.

This jerky is not what it used to be.  It's no wonder I can't find it in local stores.  It has a horrible chemical taste.  Unfortunately, the case I bought is now in the garbage.  Don't waste your money - this stuff is inedible!
Received a canister with mold covered Jerky, contacted Lowrey's customer service twice by email no response .Poor  way to service a good  customer.

column9: Just like it was in my lunch box!
column10: In these tough economic times, we long for a bygone era when things were easy.  Receiving this instantly transported me to my grade-school cafeteria.  I had no bills to bay.  I had no worries and I had Lowerys Beef Jerky.  I was 5 again for just a moment.  The recipe is the same.  The only thing that has changed is the packaging.  I remember each stick having it's own plastic packaging and there being an indian on the front of the tube that held all of the packages.

This product was okay; in other words, it was edible. It was very reasonably priced. However, it was very greasy. I don't care for greasy foods. This is the first time I have ever purchased greasy jerky. I think my grandchildren liked it better than I did. They ate it up. However, I won't be purchasing it for personal consumption in the future.

This jerky is pretty gross.  It tastes more sausage-y like a slim-jim.  Both the picture and the nutrition facts on the web site say it has 21 grams of protein.  The package I got looks the same except that it's actually 16g of protein and 14g of fat!  This shouldn't be called jerky.
Worst "beef jerky" I have ever bought. Amazon wont let you return groceries either. Too bad. Now im stuck with 15 packages of awful jerky. It is only good for dog treats.

I got a bag of jerky at the drug store a few weeks ago because it was on sale and I wanted a low-fat, low-carb, high-protein snack.  It was pretty good but a bit expensive so I decided to get some at amazon.com with a subscribe and save deal.Sad to say, I shopped based on price because I thought jerky was jerky.  That was a mistake.This Lawry's jerky is tender and easy to chew but the fat content is almost as high as the protein content.  This is low-budget, low-quality jerky.  My kids like it but I would prefer to pay a little extra and get them healthier stuff.I canceled the subscribe and save.  I will look for something different.
This is good basic beef jerky not too salty not to dry not to leathery.

My only complaint is the taste. And it's a big one. Tastes like cardboard with a heavy dose of artificial smoke flavoring and a tiny bit of sugar.I bought this knowing that it was chopped and formed "jerky", so I have no complaints about the texture or that it isn't "real" jerky.(For comparison, Slim Jim used to market a chopped and formed "jerky" style snack stick some years back and that wasn't too bad).

I guess I was expecting a more authentic beef jerky but the texture and flavor of this is terrible. It reminds me of the "parts is parts" commercial that used to run on TV about all the bad pieces being pressed together to make a totally unpalatable piece of food. I was very disappointed in this and will never purchase it again.

column9: A little more than a snack
column10: My Amazon shipment of Lowrey's beef jerky came lightning fast. Anyway, what I like about Lowrey's is that it is tasty and satisfying without having to give my jawbone a workout.

After my local Wal-Mart stopped carrying this jerky, I was disappointed. However, Amazon saved the say by offering it for less than Wal-Mart! This jerky is always fresh and has the best flavor!Thanks Amazon!

OMG, these Lowrey's Jerky Treats are sooooo YUMMY! I've been addicted to these since my high school days in the mid 80's when they used to make them so dry that they about broke your jawbone. So much better these days with the same taste but not so dried out like dog treats. But, they seem to be really hard to find until I found them months ago at our local grocery store but others must have liked them as much as we do that they instantly sold out. They restocked them and days later they were gone once again. Argh! So I went onto their website where they directed me to Amazon where I ended up buying 2 sets (16) canisters so we'll have some for months to come. I just hope Amazon continues to carry these since we can't find these anywhere anymore. Thank Heaven for Amazon! : )
This "jerky" is pretty awful. The chopped/formed sticks are almost crispy, they're so dry. The primary flavor is like soy sauce. No discernable beef taste in my opinion.
I like to have some jerky for a midmorning bite while at work.  Good deal and good tasting.

I can only call this stuff "jerky-esque," because it is really not like any "real" jerky that I've ever had before. Easy to bite through and chew, but extremely processed and pressed into form. As alluded to in another review, the look and texture of the these is very reminiscent of jerky-treats that are made for dogs. Overall, I'd give the texture 2.5-3 stars....different...a bit odd...ok, but not really "meaty."Taste, I'd give 2 stars. They rate as edible, but certainly not good. Eating a full serving at one time tends to feel like a chore, so that should tell you right there that these things aren't too great. Not horrible, but not something I'd prefer to eat...Value. Decent, but in a subjective sense. You get a lot of product for the price....which is great if you happen to like them....but nothing to crow about if you don't....

column9: Yuck.  Wish I would have spent a little more $$ for another brand.
column10: This was actually a little nasty.  I love beef jerky.  When I purchased this I thought: I like cheap jerky from Walmart, so how bad could it be?  It actually pretty bad.  It may be cheap, but still not worth it.  Put a few dollars with it and buy a different brand that tastes a little better.(This stuff is also full of MSG and gave me a headache after an ounce of it.  Other jerky might have MSG too, but this brand's amount was more noticeable to me.)

I can't get enough of this product...guess I'm strange considering the other reviews :P On the other hand I'm not a fan of the Hickory version.Update: I don't know what the deal is, but the jerky I received from amazon is nowhere near the flavor from the store. It's the correct brand and flavor, but the can I got is disgusting.

I wish I had taken the time to check review of this product; I would have saved myself some money  It is AWFUL!  It has a nasty burned taste and the texture is so fake...well, we just couldn't eat it.  I don't know why Amazon is selling such an inferior product; the price should have tipped me off.  At least I didn't pay shipping; that would have added insult to injury!
I think these are excellent and a great source of protien for a perfect on the go snack! The mini bags inside hold six pieces, so its easyy to grab one and go!

This is by far the worst beef jerky I've ever tasted. Those of you who remember the good, chewy taste of Lowrey's jerky -- well, THIS AIN'T IT! I bought a case of this stuff -- based on the Lowrey's name -- and most of it is going to the dogs.
These jerky snacks come in single serve pieces and has a lot of protein and beefy taste.
my dog loved them. I can not stand the, this is not jerky at all.
This "beef jerky" does not taste like beef jerky at all. It has little flavor, and the flavor it does have tastes like chemicals. Avoid! I would not eat this if it were for free.

I've had Kashi cereals in the past and this was certainly the crunchiest of them all. Kashi managed to perfectly sweeten this cereal just the way I like and I found this cereal to be extremely filling. When I eat other brands as a meal I normally feel like I need to eat two bowls, but with Kashi GOLEAN Crunch! I was very satisfied with less than a bowlful. I find this cereal is best when I let it sit in the bowl of milk for about 5 minutes before eating it to soften the crunchiness a bit. The grains were full size and easily identifiable in each cluster. Since the nutrition info is not posted as of today, I will go ahead and post it here for those who are interested:Serving size: 1 cup, servings per box 8Calories: 200Total fat: 4.5g (2 g polyunsaturated, 2 g monounsaturated)Cholesterol: 0Total Carbohydrate: 36g-Dietary fiber 8g (soluble fiber 4 g, insoluble fiber 4 g)-Sugars 12 gProtein 9gOmega-3: 500mgIron: 8%

column9: This cereal is a life saver!
column10: I had to start eating more healthy and after years of eating poorly, it's just not easy to change. I had to learn to add more protein and fiber into my diet but watch the calories and fat. So bacon and sausage for protein at breakfast was totally off the table. Finding a GOOD tasting cereal that gave a significant amount of protein wasn't easy. Then add to that one with good fiber content too! And lets not forget the most important fact....I had to like it! Eating healthy is NOT easy! You need to do your research! I finally found Kashi Go Lean, Honey Almond after 6 months. At the store near me, they don't keep it in the cereal section so I just happened to see it off in the corner one day and gave it a look. I thought I was going to HATE it so it sat in the cabinet for a couple of weeks.....but was I surprised when I finally had some! It has the right amount of sweet and a one cup portion is so filling! I'm fulfilling my protein and fiber requirements and it doesn't even have to hurt! It also makes an awesome snack too....and its good for me!I'm currently trying to get my grandchildren to eat more healthy too before its too late. (2 yr old and 4 yr old boys) This cereal is awesome mixed with some oatmeal and they love it. They also love snacking on it. I also see a big difference after taking them off those sugar charged breakfast cereals they used to eat.Honestly, Kashi Go Lean saved my life. With it's help I've lost 80 pounds and am near my goal weight. It helps my sweet tooth and the fiber helps in ways we all know! Thank you Kashi!

For those with food allergies, here is a list of ingredients:Whole hard red winter wheat, long grain brown rice, barley, triticale, oats, rye, buckwheat, sesame seeds, evaporated cane juice crystals, soy protein concentrate, brown rice syrup, chicory root fiber, almonds, whole oats, whole flaxseed, expeller pressed canola oil, honey, salt, natural flavor, mixed tocopherols (natural vitamin E) for freshness.Contains wheat, soy, and almond ingredients.I also find this cereal to be absolutely delicious!

I have mostly been a granola breakfast person, but the calories on granola more than I want every morning, but this cereal has fewer calories, a lot more fiber, and in addition it has a large dose of Omega-3 as a bonus (Omega-3 is one of the suplements I always take because of the long list of benefits.In addition it tastes great!  When I was a kid I used to like Kelloggs Sugar Smacks, which I'm sure would taste sickeningly sweet to me nowadays, but the Kashi Honey Almond tastes just like I remember the Sugar Smacks tasting from way back when, but a scant cup of the Kashi is very filling as opposed to the couple of bowls of sugar smacks I remember eating as a kid :-).

column9: Keeps the Hunger away for up to 6 hours!
column10: I've been hooked on this cereal ever since my girlfriend, now wife, introduced me to it. We now eat it every morning (a little less than a cup) with a quarter apple and half an organic banana each, mixed with Vanilla Soymilk and topped with just a table spoon of a chocolate-flake cereal and it keeps us full from 6:30 AM to about Noon with no urge to snack (if we keep ourselves hydrated). With two people we go through a box every four to five days, about 9-10 servings. We even eat it on weekends, too, and I'm happy with the price and the convenience of subscribe & save. One less thing to worry about and our grocery store sells it for the equivalent of seventy cents more per four-pack so I'm happy with the price too. Occasionally my wife has complained about it being too crunchy and too hard on the roof of her mouth, but that only seems to have been a problem occasionally. The other nice thing about this cereal is that it takes quite a while (hours) to get mushy in case you forgot about it after already mixing it with milk. Great value, great taste, great nutrition, and it keeps me away from mid-morning snacks. Great value for the money!
the nuts tasted so old and odd, I had to pick them all out. Do not like it. would not buy any more.

column9: Need fiber? Try this tasty, crunchy cereal.
column10: Kashi makes some great whole-grain cereals (U is the best!!) and the GOLEAN Crunch Honey Almond Flax is one of the better varieties. Very, very crunchy with and excellent blend of nutty goodness and sweet honey. It's great with Silk Light vanilla soy milk.

Kashi brand products are awesome (except their cereal bars). The almond flax is one of the cereals I eat most often. My husband thinks it's too crunchy but I like it. I have to have something that doesn't get soggy easily.
previously about $12 for 15 x 4now is $16+ for 14 x 4with higher price and smaller package,that's about 45% price hike within a few months - incredible.
Ew! I love Kashi but this stuff tastes like it went bad 6 months ago. It's super hard and the chunks can be HUGE like the size of your fist. I'll be sticking to my blueberry cunch

column9: Product can cause serious dental problems
column10: I like Kashi products overalls and loved this cereal at first. However, the consistensy is too hard. It caused, not one, but TWO major dental problems for me (a young woman in her thirties). One morning, I broke a filling eating my morning breakfast. Dismissing the problem, I then later broke a cap snacking on the cereal. Overall, my dental bill amounted to almost $2,000.My advice is that if you have any dental work at all, like most of us in the world, avoid this particular Kashi product unless you want a very large dental bill.

I had a very favorite granola style cereal which I can no longer purchase locally since a mega-chain bought out their only competition in my town and the chain store so far refuses to put my favorite on their shelf.  I've searched ever since for a replacement and this GOLEAN Crunch comes close.  The bag had lots of clusters of cereal in the top third of the bag, but as you got down further the pieces became smaller and smaller.  I would imagine this is simply a result of the trauma these cereal boxes go through in the shipping process.The cereal itself didn't actually have any taste for me at all.  I suppose if I were forced to ascribe a word to it I would use "nutty".  The almond slices are certainly full sized for the most part and I think that in combination with some of the grains is what gives me that nutty taste.  The cereal does not have any sweet taste at all, but you also realize there is no need to add any sugar.  I always add fresh fruit of some kind and yogurt with just a splash of milk for the consistency I prefer.  Eating a bowl of this combination is guaranteed to keep me from even thinking about wanting anything else for a good four hours, even longer if I'm really busy.If there is a drawback to the cereal it is in the fact that one (or more) of the grains has hulls and those stick to my teeth like glue.  Like one of those annoying popcorn husks you just can't quite reach without the dental floss.  I have to make sure I brush my teeth after eating this cereal or I will find a "treasure" later which will drive me crazy until I can floss.Because my mega-chain grocery now has no competition I had to pay one penny less than five dollars for this box of cereal last week.  If I want to drive miles and miles I can get to a big box store which may or may not have this cereal on it's shelf that day.  I would much rather order the four boxes from Amazon at a really good price and save myself all that trouble.

column9: Love the taste, but some bits are too big and hard
column10: It's good and crunchy which is a good thing about a cereal.But some bits are big which are hard to chew and it annoys me.
You can buy a 3-pack for $9 at BJ's Warehouse.  both our local grocers retail it for $2.99/$3.29.  An Amazon wants $17 for a 4-pack?!?!  Yikes. It is almost double the price!!

column9: DO NOT buy this from AMAZON!
column10: Good cereal - my favorite in fact, however the packages I got from Amazon are not crunchy and stale.  I cannot even return or exchange any of them either.  I am very VERY unhappy about ordering this item from Amazon.

column4: D'ARCY "Child of innocence, messenger of joy"
column10: When I used to see the TV ad for Kashi Golean cereal,I thought the name was strange & that I would never eat it 'cause maybe it would be filled with twigs & other birdseed-like ingredients. Boy,was I ever wrong. I love it! It's crunchy & flavorful, but not too sweet. I also like the little almond slivers included. The taste & texture of this cereal reminds me a little of grapenuts. I eat it as a snack mostly without milk. I've even got my Mom turned on to it as she likes crunchy stuff too. I think what I will do next is soak it in a little soymilk just to soften it some & then top plain vanilla ice cream with it (without the soymilk). That's one way I use grapenuts too. Anyway, try Kashi GOLEAN Crunch! Cereal,Honey Almond Flax, you will enjoy it!

This cereal is just amazing.  It tastes really good, and is great for you.  I go through a box about every 4 days, and I tell everyone I know about it.  I would even eat it more if possible.  It's a great and filling breakfast.Buy it, you WON'T be disappointed.  It is as addictive as crack, although I have never tried crack.
i had hoped this would be an alternative snacking cereal. eww. its a lot like carmel coated popcorn kernels , with gravel
I got very old product i mean about to expiry. I can smell the cereal inside is stinky. I wouldn't buy this item from amazon. i know this cereal is very good where i got from my local grocery store

Warning: this isn't your average hippy-dippy crunchy cereal. It's got CRUNCH that reminds me more of granola that's been in the back of the pantry a few months too long. It's really tasty, however! I suggest letting 1 cup of cereal soak for five minutes in whole milk to improve the texture, adding freeze-dried banana slices or blueberries for extra tasty nutrition (and besides, that makes the milk tastes good at the end, too).  I usually start prepping a bowl when I turn on my coffeemaker in the morning, it does take some time, but it is a very flavorful cereal and I am not famished at the end of the day, even when I don't find time to eat lunch. However the price at my local chain grocery store is about 2/3 that of Amazon, so if you can get it locally, it might be cheaper, thrifty folks!

column9: May Develop Rancid Flavor Due To Polyunsaturated Linolenic Acid?
column10: If I store a box of this cereal for too long, I can detect a very slight rancid flavor in it.  I am extremely sensitive to this; my friends and family can't tell and think I'm crazy.  As long as you eat the cereal within two weeks or so of opening the box, this shouldn't be a problem!The rancidity may be due to the flaxseed which contains polyunsaturated linolenic oils; while they are healthy, they are also highly prone to oxidation.  While it is probably not a huge issue, research has suggested that oxidized oils may pose a cardiovascular health risk!http://dx.doi.org/10.1111%2Fj.1745-4506.2001.tb00028.xThis may be a consideration for you if you are similarly sensitive and take a while to finish the six boxes in this multipack.I share an apartment with two other college-aged guys.  Kashi is really expensive in the grocery stores nearby, so we get monthly subscribe-and-save deliveries of the following:Kashi GOLEAN Cereal, 14.1-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 6)Kashi GOLEAN Crunch! Cereal, 15-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 6)Kashi GOLEAN Crunch! Cereal, Honey Almond Flax, 15-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 4)Kashi GOLEAN Crisp! Toasted Berry Crumble, 15-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 4)Kashi Heart To Heart Honey Toasted Oat Cereal, 12.4-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 6)We save quite a bit of money this way, and we always have a stock available.  I eat it for breakfast every morning and often for a snack as well - it really is tasty and filling, has lots of healthy protein and fiber, and doesn't leave you feeling sugar-shocked like kid's cereals overloaded with high fructose corn syrup and cane sugar.  I rotate between the five cereals listed above to keep things interesting.I first encountered this stuff while on internship in the Bay Area.  At that point I didn't have much time or inclination to cook, so I came to rely on it for quite a bit of my total caloric intake, eating it with soymilk for as many as two meals a day.  To keep things interesting, I augmented it with more almonds, walnuts, pecans, fresh pomegranate, strawberries, or peaches, frozen blueberries, cocoa powder... pretty much anything I could think of!  I had a lengthy bicycle commute to work and I began exploring strength training and martial arts three or four days a week at the company gym, and this stuff kept me going.It's been four years now, but this is still my favorite cereal in the Kashi family.  Highly recommended!

To me, the taste is similar to Sugar Smacks or Sugar Crisp, though not so overwhelmingly sweet and a LOT more crunchy. This is not a cereal to just pour and eat. I usually let it set a bit to soften in milk or soy milk. It helps the flavor a little, too. I like this one slightly more than the regular crunch. I am a fan of most of the Kashi products I have tried.

GoLean Crunch appeals to both my tastebuds and to my diet.  I did, however, find the Honey Almond Flax variety a bit too sweet for my taste.  This version was also not as crunchy as the original GoLean Crunch and I do like that crunch.I can see this as an excellent substitute for parents who want their children to eat a healthier  cereal but are having trouble weaning them from the wide range of sugared cereals.
Tastes great and a good start to your morning with all the protein.  The cereal texture is a little hard, but was fine after soaking in milk for a couple minutes.
My husband and I are addicted to this stuff! It is very tasty and very, very nutritious. We eat this almost every morning and look forward to it!
If you like crunchy cereal you will love this.  It is an upscale version of rice puffs.  Sweet enough that you will not need sugar.  Very filling and satisfying.

I was hesitant to try Kashi GOLEAN Crunch! Cereal, Honey Almond Flax, as the original Kashi GOLEAN Crunch wasn't that great. Luckily, I took a chance and discovered that this is a great cereal! As with all of the Kashi cereals, you are sure to have a high level of nutrition. This cereal is great as a snack and for breakfast.

If you're tired of the sugary cereals leaving you feeling empty an hour after eating, try this!  Especially if you like crunchy, nutty, and all around goodness!  At first, I looked at this cereal and thought the price to size ratio was totally out of whack.  But, one day, my brother and I gave them a try and we found that we don't have to eat such a huge proportion of cereal anymore!  We are no longer hungry an hour after we eat!  This cereal is all about fiber and will keep you feeling fuller longer than the sugary cereals out on the market.  Amazon's subscription just makes it so much easier and affordable.  Give it a try...go to the grocery store, pay the silly price and try this cereal!  It IS worth it!  Then, come back and subscribe to it.  I did!

column9: Incredible cereal at an incredible price
column10: I've always been a fan of Kashi GoLean Crunch. I find that it's the perfect balance of taste and health. The best part is that my kids actually love this as well. This is significantly healthier than many of the sugar cereals that are marketed to kids. Even my 1 yo enjoys eating this dry. Between this and Honey Nut Cheerios, I don't have to feel guilty about giving my kids "bad" cereal.From a price perspective, you can't beat Amazon's Subscribe & Save. My family of six will work through these four boxes pretty quick. Thanks Amazon!

column9: Add to Yogurt for Protein Rich Breakfast
column10: I'm trying to increase the amount of protein I take in early in the day. If I don't, I end up hungry an hour or two after eating.Kashi Go Lean Crunch Almond Flax is a perfect granola substitute to add to yogurt.
