column9: Awesome product and Seller. Good price super fast shipping.
column10: Thank you for your excellent product. I hope to buy more in the near future. This product is very good for my mind and body. Thank you again.
This toffee is in my top 5 candies.  It is chocolaty, buttery, creamy, nuttylicious.  I would recommend this to anyone with a serious or not so serious sweet tooth.
The 2 lbs of candy is delicious; the toffee is not bitter, as some others I tried. And it comes in a nice resealable jar.  I'll be back for more.

I ordered this for Christmas and the price was right for 2 pounds of toffee. The only complaint is the taste is a little mild for me. Some of the niche brands may taste a little better but you cannot beat the price for 2 pounds. All in all a good purchase.

I know it's probably more expensive, but when you ship chocolate in the summer, you need to pay attention to packaging.  When I received the toffee, it was melted and all the pieces were stuck together.  I had purchased it for a friend but could not give it to her that way.  I had to get something else locally. It's a shame, I know she would have loved it!
These are great and the price is very good. Try them and you will see. Someone gave me a gift of them but paid a much higher price.

I love these quinoa flakes...they are relatively easy to make (I just cook them in the microwave.  They have a very unique, kind of nutty taste (I guess like quinoa) and can be made thick or thin.  It has the texture of grits or cream of wheat and, like quinoa, is a great source of protein...and it's gluten free.  I have served this for friends at a brunch and they loved it.  I sometimes put warmed fruit (microwaved frozen berries) in it...and it is a great treat.  Highly recommended and a great deal.  Also, the boxes came with a very long shelf life, but I am sure that they will be gobbled up fairly soon.

Ancient Harvest Quinoa Flakes cook up into a hearty hot cereal.  They taste great on their own, sweetened or with butter.  It cooks very fast, which is a definite plus.  Just don't expect a texture like you'd get with whole quinoa.  It's more a mush like well cooked cornmeal, but it's higher in protein.For those who can't eat gluten or are allergic to wheat as I am, this makes a great substitute for Cream of Wheat.  Actually I prefer the taste of the quinoa flakes.BTW, I was happy to find it here at this price since the few times I was able to buy it at the store it was $5.99 per box.

column9: a QUICK hot cereal that isn't overly processed - and is Kosher, gluten free and organic
column10: Breakfast time in our household is very busy, so often I've been setting up our rice cooker with a timer the night before to cook hot cereal that's ready when we are.  This works great, but we wanted to expand the cereal choices.Not ready to order a multi-pack of Quinoa (pronounced keen-WAH), I got a single box of these Ancient Harvest Quinoa Flakes at the local health food store.  It wasn't til I got home that I read on the box that a single serving (1/3 cup dry and 1 cup water) cooked in the microwave in only 2 and 1/2 mins.  Cool.  I was also pleased with the protein content - 4.3 grams per serving, not as good as oatmeal but better than all the other common hot cereal grains.Not an issue for us, but if it is for you, you should know this cereal is gluten free, and per the manufacturer's website, processed in a gluten free facility, as well as Kosher and organic.My husband found the taste a bit odd.  I loved this cereal myself.  To me the taste was ok, but the best part was the texture - it is extremely smooth and creamy, and a bit of Splenda and half and half made it perfect.  It's far finer than Cream of Wheat or grits.  The flakes really don't have a lot of taste which should make folks who like to creatively dress up their cereal happy, and if you like a chunkier breakfast there's always fruit and nuts to add if you want.  If you have ever had bitter quinoa, you should know these are pre-washed and the bitter coating taken off, resulting in a very mild taste.With this cereal, because of its quick cooking time, I don't use the rice cooker, just the microwave.  It's no fuss, meaning a single stir when it's done is sufficient, you don't need to check and stir as you go.The flakes can also be used to make pancakes or waffles, coating for cooking fish or chicken, baked muffins or cookies.  There's recipes on the box.If you're looking for a way to enliven your breakfast easily, a box of Quinoa Flakes is very worth a try.  I can tell this will be a staple for me.

When I first tasted quinoa flakes made as a hot cereal, I found them really bland.  As I continued making the cereal, I found that this wasn't a bad thing but a completely blank canvas for me to create whatever flavor I wanted.  It mixes well with honey as well as a combination of ginger and cinnamon.  The quinoa flakes have a great texture, and the amount of water I use determines the thickness of the cereal.  I haven't made muffins with the quinoa flakes yet, but there's a recipe provided on the box.  For anyone eating a gluten-free or reduced gluten diet, I would definitely recommend this product.  It's a great value for such a healthy, versatile food.

column9: Spicy, filling, hot  and absolutely nutritious breakfast
column10: In East Africa, where I'm from, we have a porridge called Uji, which is essentially made from ground maize and millet. Very nutritious, even one of the first foods you give your baby when you're weaning him/her from milk. At our house, we're big fans of oatmeal, which we've cooked up with bananas (no honey, no sugar) and serve with blueberries, or with some adad lentils with a base sautee of onions, garlic, cloves, cinamon, and chilies. It's absolutely fab. My 20-month-old loves it that way. Until I bought quinoa flakes and made it for him that way--he loved it even more. Today, I made him some garlic peas and carrot hot cereal. Basically, boil the water, add in some peas and carrots (I'm sure corn and potatoes would be divine, too!), salt and pepper (or chili powder), and a chunk of minced garlic. Bring to a boil and then stir in the quinoa. I'm having mine with a dollop of homemade yogurt. Delicious!!!!!!

I am a gluten free girl and finding safe grain alternatives has been a challenge.  Ancient Harvest Quinoa Flakes are great for a hot breakfast cereal and are great to use in baking.  I add chocolate chips to their banana muffin recipe for an easy healthy snack.  I always have several boxes on hand.

column9: Yummy in baked goods, Disgusting to eat plain!
column10: I'm sorry to admit this, but these quinoa flakes are disgusting! I tried eating them savory, I tried eating them sweet. How are you supposed to eat them? I was finally able to make them edible, but after a while I felt that if I took one more bite, I would throw up. These taste fine in baked goods, so I might only buy it for that purpose. Sorry that I had to give this such a bad review.

The flakes are a healthy and quick breakfast to prepare, but the texture is pretty mushy, like baby food. I'd prefer to prep regular quinoa ahead of time and refrigerate it then heat it up with some honey and almond milk for breakfast. But overall the product is good quality and a decent value compared to health food store prices.

I bought this because I needed it for a recipe and decided "why not get a 6 pack??" :-)  I really like it.  It works well in the place of oatmeal in crisp recipes, but I also cook it like oatmeal with cinnamon and peanut butter.  It has a more nutty flavor, but is delicious!
I love Quinoa Flakes.  It is a fast breakfast in the morning.  I usually add chopped walnuts and strawberries with a little stevia.  Delicious.

This product is fantastic!  I cannot tolerate any wheat or gluten in products, so am limited in my choices.  Quinoa flakes is an extremely easy and fast cereal to prepare.  When done, I place a small amount of honey on top for extra flavor.  It is filling.  I also drop an ice cube in the bowl, as it is very hot coming off the stove, and I don't like to wait for it to cool off.  If I don't eat in the morning then I have it in the evening, but eat it every day.Ancient Harvest Quinoa Flakes, 12-Ounce Box (Pack of 6)

Ancient Harvest Quinoa Flakes, Organic and Gluten Free, 12-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 6)I had them for the first time this morning - I'm giving up gluten.  I thought they were delicious and a GREAT substitute for mashed potatoes.  I added a slice of low fat cheese to melt.  Yum.

column9: Always have Quinoa Flakes on hand...
column10: I rotate my breakfasts having either quinoa flakes with a couple of walnuts, payapa with banana and bluberries or 2 soft boiled eggs. So I always have a couple boxes of quinoa on hand, also in case of emergencies, just boil water you have nutrients that will keep you going, it has a good amount of protein.The quinoa muffin recipe on the back is yummy, even my hubbies loves them,he says it feels  healthy :) I add bluberries and/or applesauce.I have given boxes to neighbors and my family they end up loving it too.

I bought this based on the many positive reviews since I've recently been trying out a gluten-free diet. I made the flakes this morning and I can't eat them - even with butter and brown sugar, they have a bitter, unpleasant taste to me. Too bad since I have 6 boxes and they can't be returned!

I've ordered Ancient Harvest Quinoa Flakes several times from Amazon and have not been disappointed a single time.  I thoroughly enjoy this hot cereal with a little bit of almond milk and some almonds tossed in for breakfast.  I first tried it at a local store but found it to be much cheaper per pound here on amazon.com and have since been making my purchases online.  I order one day and within just a few days it's at my door even with the super saver shipping option!  I can't beat that for service!

I raised my daughter on quinoa. She has it as a side dish (like rice), as pancakes and waffles (with no other flour), and the flakes as "porridge" at least once a week. She likes them all. The flakes, having a fairly neutral taste, can be flavored in many ways. I usually make her flakes with cow's milk, which is slightly sweet, with added cinnamon and vanilla. Sometimes I blend half a banana into the milk. For a varied flavor I use vanilla flavored PureCoconut milk which has a small amount of sweetener. I never add additional sweetener. Unlike wheat, corn, or oats, quinoa is very nutritious, and I feel comfortable feeding it to my daughter.By way of comparison, on the date of this writing (May/11), Amazon's 6-pack price works out to $5.23/box with free shipping, and Whole Foods charges $5.99/box. (Whole Foods does also give a 10 percent discount for case purchases. The Amazon price still slightly cheaper than the WF case price.)

As I rotate food on a 4 day basis, it is great to have this as an alternative for my wheat sensitivity. I use it sometimes replacing what asks for the Quinoa flour that is even more expensiveEasy and good. Makes a great pancake with applesauce.
I've been looking all over for this product couldn't find it. But, I was able to get it here almost $2 cheaper a box INCLUDING shipping. And, it got here faster than expected!!
Quinoa flakes are used in many gluten-free recipes, and aren't easily found at grocery stores.  Being able to have a package of 6 boxes delivered to my doorstep is great!

Our grocery store quit handling this product.  I was so sad as I have learn to incorporate Quinoa into many of my recipes.  Glad I could order on line! I am Vegan and like the extra source of protein.  Great for pie crust!
Love these! They are great in a muffin and good as a breakfast cereal. I also like that they are quick and easy to make.
I can remember when this cereal was reasonably priced, now I only buy it when I need the convenience of quick cereal. I think it taste great and it fills me up.
Love being able to get this product in bulk; nutritious, good price & prompt receipt.

I love this stuff so much that I invented my own bread maker recipe with it:1 package of this stuff (12oz)2 cups water1 cup WW flour1 tbsp salt1 tbsp cinnamon2 tbsp butter6 tbsp wheat gluten3 tbsp dry milk1 cup chopped dried fruit1 pack yeastPut your bread maker on dark (it seems to take a little longer in my bread maker then regular WW does)Enjoy with lots of butter.
Hello!  This is a good, quick to fix, product, but it has become way overpriced; may be a good investment.  Jeff  Ithaca, NY
This product is processed in a factory that also processes wheat and is therefore NOT appropriate for wheat sensitive individuals.

Without a doubt these are my favorite flavor of Turkish Delights.  The blend of apricot and honey flavored gel surrounding crunchy almonds cannot be adequately described with mere words, you really have to taste them to know.  I can't imagine ever getting tired of eating them.  I am already buying new, larger clothing so I can keep,eating them without having to go naked because my clothes are too small to wear. LOL

column4: T. Lee "God has died lots of times, but someo...
column10: I bought this thinking the apricot, honey, and almond were separate flavors.  They're not. My Brazilian Raintree is thriving in my livingroom, sitting under a plant grow light, receiving daily mistings, lightly moist soil, and weekly light fertilizing.  I can't keep it outside at all right now because there's a horrid white fly infestation needing to be attacked first.  But this wonderful Raintree bonsai is doing just fine with the attention I'm giving it -- which, by the way, also includes very light pruning on a regular basis since it wants to grow a great deal, but out of shape.  Obviously it's happy.I want to praise the seller, Bonsai Boy:  I've bought other plants and items from them.  I'm convinced my plants are doing well because Bonsai Boy sent healthy plants to me.

I bought this Brazillian Raintree from Bonsai Boy about 6 months ago now. It arrived  safe and VERY well packaged! It's taken some time for this plant to get its bearings. It didn't grow much at all when I first got it, and shortly thereafter it shed all its leaves and I thought it was dying. But it's come back in MUCH better shape with nothing more than very light fertilizing and regular waterings from me. It's now growing almost out of control (hehe, I love to see a happy plant), and has tons of leaves. It hasn't bloomed for me yet, but I can't wait for that to happen. I find it doesn't need as much water as I've read. My plant will develop yellow leaves (from overwatering) if I water it every single day... so usually I just make sure to keep the soil moist (that's watering 3-4 times per week).I love my raintree!

It almost seems silly to me to write a review on refried beans, but having recently started on the "4 Hour Body" slow-carb diet we are eating a lot of them.  My wife has always favored mexican food, and the typical store-brand or name-brand refried beans smelled and tasted, well, not good.  I would usually comment while preparing dinner that they looked exactly how I remembered canned dog food looked when I was feeding my dog as a kid, and smelled the same as well.  So that's how we found Amy's, and I have to say they're the first refried beans that I actually enjoy eating.  However in the retail stores they are around $3.20/can where I live with a slight discount for a case.  I ordered these online and signed up for the monthly autoship since we eat them several times a week now, and the cost was around $27/case of 12, free shipping.  I've tried a few other organic brands but to me Amy's still wins.  Note that the low-sodium version has half the sodium as the regular version, and this seems to hold true for all of their low-sodium canned beans.  The Organic black beans are also very good, better in fact to my palate.

These beans are super yummy. However, I was disappointed that when my last order arrived, 10 out of the 12 cans were dented. Several of my previous orders were the same way. Considering the potential health risks, I decided to just buy them at the store.

I had always used another brand of canned refried beans and switched to Amy's Organic because they were about the same price as my old brand, and I've come to prefer organic products when I can get them.  I will not go back to my old brand.  These refried beans taste like the pinto beans they are made with, and they have just enough onions, garlic, and other spices to complement the beans rather than overpower the flavor of the beans.  As well, they don't seem as "heavy" as other beans that I've eaten.  I will definitely buy these beans again.I was disappointed, though, that most of the cans were dented and damaged.  This doesn't seem to have affected the quality of the product, but it does seem odd that so many damaged cans were sent in one order.  It seems to me that the shipper may be at fault here and may be sending the dented cans because it might be easier to cast them off on the internet-order crowd--they aren't as likely to return them as a shopper in a store would be not to buy them without a discount.

I bought these beans because Amy's products are organic, the company is highly rated on betterworldshopper.org, and the reviews here on Amazon are mostly positive. However, the product is rather bland and the texture is almost like bean soup. Even mixed one to one with Amy's whole pinto beans (drained) and cooked to thicken some, the resulting texture still makes a very messy burrito.

column9: I really wanted to like these beans
column10: I like refried beans, but they tend to have a lot of salt added to them. I looked for low salt varieties, and this is the only one I found. I made my way through a couple of cans. The taste is pretty good. (I add a lot of salsa to my beans, so the salt doesn't matter much.) But I just can't accommodate the texture. It's neither like whole pinto beans nor like typical refried beans. It's just odd. In the end, I just didn't like these very well.

I was buying these at Whole foods for way too much and my kids love them so much they eat them out of the can so I decided to buy them by the case and we order a case about every 2 months.  They taste great, are organic and have reduced sodium.  Absoultely love them for beans and rice or quesadillas.  They are a staple in our vegetarian household.

I made nachos with these beans.They turned out great for meatless nachos!I simply warmed refried beans & shredded cheeseI sprinkled broken taco shells with cumin & sea salt & baked.You can also make tortilla chips with flour tortillasby cutting them into wedges & baking till brown.Let chips set for 5 minutes to harden.Next time I plan on adding a little taco seasoning for added zest.Quick, Cheap, & Easy & Nutritious with Protein & Fiber!Pace Dry Taco Seasoning, Mild, 1.12 -Ounce Packets (Pack of 24)These are the best shells I have ever eaten!Casa Fiesta Taco Shells, 4.5-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 12)Aso try these for more zing!Tumaro's 10-Inch Wraps, Jalapeno & Cilantro, 14-Ounce Packages (Pack of 6)
We've had a hard time finding this product in our area.  It's great I can get it shipped for free and still not pay a lot for the product.  We love these beans
We like to use these organic refried beans in our tacos. They're yummy and healthy and you can't beat that!

column9: Great product.  Surprisingly dented cans not good.
column10: In deciding to buy this item, I read the other reviews and expected a few dented cans.  Yet, I wasn't prepared for what I got.  10 out of the 12 cans were seriously, seriously dented.  I do fully understand that this does not affect the food's safety or nutritional value, but really!  We all know that crushed pages and a torn cover do not affect a book's readability, yet Amazon would not be in business today if they applied the same care in storing and shipping to their books as they do to their canned food goods.  All supermarkets that don't have an on-site cannery deal with shipped cans, and storing cans. Amazon may be entering a retail sector that it cannot so far handle.I just have to point out that even though it may have been easier to buy these off Amazon, it is certainly not cheaper (even with the subscription discount - BTW, I cancelled my subscription after unpacking the cans).  For in fact, they were so dented that no brick & mortar supermarket would think to sell these at anything more than half-off the price.  To see the amount of denting, I uploaded a photo to the product description page.In terms of the product itself, it's something I've loved for a long time.  Just buy a single can of it at a grocery store and try it before buying the 12-pack.  Make sense?

column9: Even with less salt they're still great
column10: I'm a fan of these, the taste does take a bit getting used to at first for some (It did for me), but that's due to the lower amounts of sodium than most beans (sometimes up to 80%+ of your recommended daily intake).  Instead of a salty taste you get a hint of garlic and other flavors, the beans actually taste a bit sweet too (at least to me).  I've really grown to like the taste and the fact that they're better for me is even nicer.Perhaps the only downside really is the cost, but that's cut down some with the subscribe and save, although they won't ever be as cheap as $1/can like some can be found on sale for, but better quality just costs more, plain and simple.
For canned refried beans, they are great. Not too much salt, good healthy flavor and good tasting. Not packed with flavor, but for canned refried beans, they are the best I've tried.

Amy's Light in Sodium Organic Traditional Refried Beans have an odd texture. The taste is okay. The cost is okay. It is nice that they are low in sodium but ... I really advise sticking with the fat free version of the name brands (Old El Paso, LaVictoria, Rosa's, and even Taco Bell).

I write to recommend Wholey foods and their calamari product. It is especially good for those who cannot cook. Product is fresh and good. One must follow instructions.  The seller is very accomodating and friendly and will do anything to see you are happy with the sale. Amazon should  keep this seller on a high level and recommend the product to all. Joe Parzymies

column9: I love this tea, very unique flavor...
column10: I was surprised to find a black tea that has licorice in it, usually licorice is reserved for herbal teas.  The mix of ginseng, peppermint and licorice is an unusual taste treat, one I would recommend to others.  The mint is strong, the licorice sweet.  I normally don't like ginseng in teas, this ginseng stays in the back of the brew and isn't that noticeable yet I am sure I still get the health benefits from it.

This is the best nacho cheese ever! We use this cheese on our fajitas, tacos, and chips. When this product was scarce to find I went to more than a dozen stores until I found one store that carried it and I bought all fourteen cans. As these got low I began searching on the web and was unable to find it. I sent in many request to bring it back. Thankfully as I approached 3 cans left I found it on Amazon and bought 2 cases. I've not found another nacho cheese sauce that makes our mexican dinners at home taste so good. I highly recommend this product, my family loves it and won't eat mexican food at home without it.

column9: This is the nacho cheese to get
column10: I've tried perhaps dozens of brands and varieties of store-bought nacho cheese (or types of salso con queso).  None of them are nearly as good as this for use with chips or in a burrito.  Coming out of the (tin) can, this stuff is a little scary (my wife and I refer to it as "scary nacho cheese"), but once you microwave it and stir it's smooth, creamy, and has just the right amount of heat for us.  I've tried the hot and mild varieties, but the medium is most versatile and shouldn't be too hot for most people.  It's easy to add some of your favorite hot sauce (I like Cholula) to make it a little spicier.This was cheaply available where I used to live (below the Amazon bulk price), but it's much harder to find where I am now.  Look for it in a Mexican section of the grocery store, not anywhere near chips or most other salsas, but usually nearer Goya canned products.

I could no longer find the hot Jalapeno cheese in my area so searched online and found this cheese. It is exactly what I was looking for pluscomes in individual 15 ounce cans. What I used to purchase was the big can like restaurants buy and a lot would taste old by the time you use it up.These small cans are just right for household use.  Great item and I willbuy more when I use up this case.

This is the most nacho cheesey sauce that you can store buy. And best of all it is at a great price. It has a real cheese taste and believe me I have had to try several to find something with out that "fake taste" this is all REAL taste. I like all, Regular, Hot, and Mild. I am so happy Amazon is carrying this product because it has become impossible to find locally anymore. I like it so much I've "subscribed" it! I recommend anyone who like wonderful creamy nacho cheese do the same. It great as a base for more sortof homemade sauces, just aad sausage crumbles or bacon or any meat you want, or add tomatoes but it is great straight out of the can. I even shared it with a co-worker who is of Mexican descent who makes her own nacho cheese from scratch and she thought it was really good too!

This is My 2nd order, the first one went really fast. I got the mild and regular the first time. The regular is really the best if You like just small amount of heat the mild is really mild with just a hint of the peppers. Great for a topping on Your Mexican foods.

What a treat to find this in smaller cans! Not only a great snack over chips but has many uses in meal planning. Add steamed veggies over a baked potato and add the cheese sauce for a healthy, inexpensive and tasty meal that the kids will love.

El Rio is a great cheese sauce. My local Sam's Club has a huge can of it but it would go bad before we used it all up. Glad to have found the small cans on ebay.  Sauce has just enough jalapenos to add flavor but not so hot that  kids can't eat it.

column9: Good taste, but it's just too thin
column10: This nacho cheese sauce is pretty good on taste, especially compared to a number of other canned sauces I've tried. However, it's just too thin. It's the consistency of soup and doesn't hold to the chip well enough. You'll be dripping cheese everywhere if you're not careful.

I bought this item and from what the reviews had me believe that this was like ball park nacho cheese.  I had previously gotten Ortega Nacho Cheese Mild in the large Aluminum can (maxwell coffee type can) and it was too much of a hassle and wasn't hot enough.  I read the reviews thinking this should be better and hotter.  Turns out it was neither, this cheese was mostly liquid before the microwave but after you could literally put it in a glass and drink it.  Completely disgusting.  Do not get me wrong, I would eat all sort of processed cheese, meats whatever, but this is not even close to what it should be.  Going back to BJs and getting the Ortega!

This cheese was expensive compared to other brands I found, but I figured why not try it (bad idea to try things in bulk...). It has a really high sodium content (one can will exceed 140% your daily value). It is also not thick at all. It's so runny it can barely stay on the chip. Save your money and spend it elsewhere, on other brands.
i like real mexican food and i found the taste was suited more towards american taste, and it was not as thick as i want a cheese sauce to be, i bought this like a year ago. will not re-order
Great product I,m buying more of el Rio Nacho Cheese Sauce in the near future.

column9: I just love it, and it saves me money
column10: I can find this in any grocery store around where I live, but at 5-6 dollars for a 15 oz jar. This is 12, 15 oz cans for $2 each plus shipping. As far as hot goes it's just right for me and most people. I'm in, I'm there, this is the best deal I have found on Amamzon in a long time, and I have found a lot of them.

column9: Harold's cukes will change your life.
column10: I first tasted Harold's Durn Hot pickles at a free tasting at a local farmers' market. My eyes and my sinuses were opened that day. I have to have some Harold's in the house at all times now. I will be sharing the Harold's love at Christmas this year, too. Everyone should taste Harold's cukes before they shuffle off this mortal coil.
These pickles are fantastic! My favorite is the Sissy sweet, YUMMY!  I'm hooked! When will they hit the stores in my area?
Received this as a gift and was pleasantly surprised. A gift with a little bit of everything in it. The pickles were awesome! Going to have to order more of each in bigger jars for sure!

I'd like to first say that i'm a bit obsessed with pickles.  Whenever I see a brand i haven't tried, I buy it.Harold's francis cowley pickles and sissy sweet pickles are two of the best pickles i've ever eaten.  Crunchy, favorable, salty and delicious.These are the Rolls Royce of pickles. Thank you!

column9: Low-cost green tea with an added punch
column10: I am not a huge fan of Lipton teas in general, but this variety struck my fancy - the traditional green tea with passionfruit, orange, and jasmine.  I compared it side-by-side with the plain green tea from Lipton and there is a very noticeable difference.  This variety is less harsh and bitter, more smooth and engaging.  It's great when tea has a bit of a fruity taste to it (Earl Grey is the prime example) and this tea definitely pulls it off.  True, it's not quite on the level of other gourmet teas (hence the 4 stars), but for the price, you would be hard-pressed to find a better value.  Highly recommended for green tea aficionados who want a little something different in their traditional blend.

I'm not really a big fan of fruity teas, but the combination of the green tea and the orange, jasmine and passionfruit is subtle, and evens out the usually bitter taste of straight green tea. I highly recommend it!

These healthy flakes taste very good even though they are low in sugar and high in fiber and nutritional value. They do lose their crispiness in a bowl of milk, but I either eat fast or snack on the flakes right out of the box. These make a great healthy substitute for other wheat flake cereals on the market.

I got this because I was expecting my wheat-allergic young grandson for a visit. Assured that his allergist approved of spelt products even though spelt is an ancient form of wheat, I bought a case of this stuff . Curious, his grandpa and I tasted it before grandson arrived , and we were pleasantly surprised --it was similar to other flaky breakfast choices, especially that one known as "the breakfast of Champions".Since it is organic, and it has no added sugars, it meets with the approval of the ultra-health conscious parent. It also tastes good, especially with sliced bananas, so don't be afraid to try it.
I've been buying this cereal since I became sensative to wheat and I absolutely love it. I drizzle a little honey on them and sometimes add banana, but they are marvelous without either.
This is an excellent cereal, especially if you are diabetic. However, the price quoted is far more expensive than to buy it at a good grocery store.

I have been very pleased with getting my Spelt Flakes cereal once a month. It always comes when I am on my last box. I eat a lot of food made with Spelt, and use the flour to make things myself. Buying my Spelt cereal through Amazon has saved me money. I Highly recommend buying products from Amazon, and get free Shipping at times too. Spelt is also good for you, it does not upset my stomach. I hope this helps you in making a purchase.God Bless,Connie Waters
This is our favorite cereal, but difficult to find at times locally.  Product arrived in perfect condition, and on time . Very pleased with the purchase.  Will order again, Amazon delivers!!
Happy to discover it's delicious and high in fiber.I'll have to order some when I finish my All-Bran.
very good taste and healthy and i would buy more from it ,,spelt is better than corn

column4: Bartok Kinski "A casual stroll through the lu...
column10: I suffer from diarrhea and irritable bowel syndrome when I visit many countries in the world.  Usually I eat many exotic dishes that use animal parts or spices that disrupt the large intestine.When I am at home, I pick up a few old grain cereals, which are a good source of fiber.Spelt was an important grain in parts of Europe from the Bronze Age to medieval times.  It is an excellent source of vitamin B2, a very good source of manganse, and a good source of niacin, thiamin, and copper. This particular combination of nutrients provided by spelt may make it a particularly helpful food for persons with diarrhea, migraine headaches, atherosclerosis, or diabetes.It has a good natural taste free of anything artificial.  It may seem boring but I crunch it up alone or with milk.  It's really good.
Great product! I use this instead of bread crumbs on baked fish. Cook until golden brown and crisp, add red pepper and cilantro flakes. I also like it with dried fruit and milk for breakfast.

I purchased these for my daughter who has had alot of difficulty with eating any type of wheat products without incapacitating abdominal pain. She has been craving cereal for the longest time and these flakes have really satisfied her cravings. Her only request was that I let her go through my raisin bran and swipe all the raisins inside the box for her spelt flakes... I tried them myself and they taste to me just like raisin bran or wheaties flakes. I would eat them myself but I'd have to fight her for them... REALLY GOOD CEREAL!!!

Was no longer able to get in grocery and was glad Amazon had it!  Crunchy and mild nutty flavor.  Buying on Amazon in bulk also saved me about $1 per box as compared to previous store price with super saver shipping.

This is a wonderful "bush" tea.  Though I am generally partial to caffeinated beverages, I find that the aroma and taste of this give me enough buzz to do without the caffeine.  How can you not love a tea that has chocolate, vanilla and mint?  This is very good either hot or iced.  The smell is so great you need to remember it's for drinking.  Enjoy!

First, the scent of this tea is phenomenal. I made it at work one morning and several people followed their noses to my office asking what I was drinking. I can't imagine what this company's other flavors smell like.The taste is also good but it is somewhat more subtle than I would have thought. I wish the company would have used a bit more vanilla or a bit more mint in the manufacturing process. It is still a very nice tea and, according to the box, there are an estimated 50 cups to each box.The boxes I received came sealed in a plastic bag. None of the tea had come loose from the boxes during shipping but I was glad to see the added protection around the tea because it is a loose tea. According to a note included with the tea, the packaging is eco-friendly. A snapshot of this disclosure is in the image gallery.I'm trying to transition to diet that has less caffeine. Tea has been my go-to beverage. This particular beverage is a tisane and is naturally caffeine free. The box has a caffeine comparison chart between this tea and others. Please see the image gallery.You don't need to add anything to this tea but this tea can be quite flavorful with a bit of agave and/or milk (in my case coconut milk) for those preferring a little extra in their teas. The box indicates that this tea contains trace amounts of sugar and dairy.I use a Finum brewing basket for this tea and I have no problems with tea escaping into my mug. I will be buying more flavors of this brand in the future.

I had this tea after dinner at a restaurant about a month ago and loved it! I was so happy to see that Amazon offered this tea and at a decent price. ($14 for 2 boxes, approximately 50 cups per box) Since I received this about a week ago (along with the "Buccaneer" tea) I've had about 2 cups a day. I put just a tiny bit of milk/creamer and about a half packet of artificial sweetener and it tastes like a mild mint hot chocolate. Since it's caffeine free you can have a cup after dinner and before bed without worrying that it will keep you up all night.

I was looking to get some loose leaf tea and I'm glad I took a chance on buying some SerendipiTea, this one is delicious.  I think the smell of the tea is much stronger than the taste, I may try brewing longer or adding an extra tsp next time but overall I'm very happy with this tea and will probably order more flavors from this company pretty soon!
So delicious !!We are happy to eat them in JAPAN.Thank you very much !!I'm sorry...I'm not good at English.

These are so good. I never buy the chocolate oreos anymore. I always buy these when i feening for oreos. I'm a vanilla cookie eater more than a a chocolate one, and these are one of the best vanilla sandwich cookies out there.

column4: The Taminator "There's no going back. You've ...
column10: If you've never had these, they're really just a traditional Double Stuff Oreo with a vanilla cookie rather than a dark chocolate one. DH & I like to pull them apart and make "quadruple stuffs," but the leftover vanilla cookies don't go to waste. The golden cookies are just as good by themselves as they are with the frosting in the middle. They sort of make me think of a Twinkie with a crispy cookie outside and extra thick creamy inside, if you want an idea of flavor.I got them on Subscribe & Save, which makes them about the same price as the local supermarket, and I don't have to leave the house to get them. Amazon's subscription policy is incredibly flexible and makes it easy to keep both treats like this and essentials on hand without a huge commitment. For us, the cookie and subscription combination are a winner!

column9: Better be double stuffed with gold...
column10: at that price.  I'm guessing that you guys are aiming for those of us that can't get down to the store for our double stuffs...

column9: Inflation hits the Oreo Double Stuff
column10: Wow, this used to come in a 17 oz package, then 16 oz, now it's a 15.25 OZ package! Say no more............

shipping was quick... packaging was great... only one missing ... it doesn't show any information about expiration date. I was planning to order another batch but i just want to find out when it expires... hopefully the company can email me any information for this...thanks

Yes, these are hot chocolate capsules that fit in Caffitaly coffee machines. No, they don't make very good chocolate. How could they? Think about the various ways of making a good cup of hot chocolate, and then try to figure out how anyone could stuff that into a little capsule -- it's not possible.Even if you want a mocha, there are better ways to make one than one capsule of espresso and one capsule of this chocolate in the same cup.Is it truly awful? No. Just not very rich and satisfying. And you're supposed to use the "long espresso" setting when making hot chocolate, so it doesn't produce very much -- I think it's just 3 ounces.
Hard to find a whole wheat product.  Very tasty.  Tastes even better leftover after pasta has sat in sauce
I purchased this item trusting the image as it looked like a 25oz can. To my surprise, it was a 12.5 oz which is definietly not a deal for $109 - shady!

column9: Spicy and tasty with a cool chutney
column10: These samosas remind me of empanadas. You have a bread stuffed with delicious food. We keep these frozen in the freezer, then defrost in the microwave and cook for 15 minutes in the conventional oven at 350 degrees. They are spicy to me. The chutney (yogurt and mint leaves) helps cut the spices. 4 samosas to a box with 6 boxes comes to ~$1 a samosa--expensive to us. Per samosa: calories 190; calories from fat 90; total fat 10g; saturated fat 4g; trans fat 0; cholesterol 0; sodium 397mg (16% RDA); total carbs 21g; fiber 2g; sugar 1g; protein 4g.

column9: Incredibly tasty, incredibly spicy - worth the $$$'s for indian food lovers !!
column10: I absolutely LOVED their samosas.  There are 4 samosas in one 11-oz package.  They're really supposed to be just appetizers but after just eating 2 or 3 of them for lunch at work, I was full and I didn't feel like eating anything else.  They're HUGE - like large eggrolls folded over and stuffed with peas and potatoes in a spicy mixture and the mint chutney condiment adds a delightful complex flavor to the samosas.  I microwaved my samosas but to get the real fried texture, it's probably better to fry them in a little oil.  I have to agree with other reviewers that their samosas rival what you'll find in a really good Indian restaurant.  I've never seen them made so good and so huge and so authentic by any other indian food maker.  You may want make a type of raita with the mint chutney condiment by adding sour cream or greek yogurt or regular yogurt to it to help cool down the spicy heat from the samosas and make the chutney creamier and less liquidy.  I also usually add loose leaf lettuce/herbs and sliced cucumbers to my raita like it's a "cooling" salad-raita mixture.  Instead of dessert, finish your meal down while cooling down your palate with the smooth refreshing indian yogurt mango smoothie-like drink while eating your meal with Rasna Lassi Mix Mango  or  Rellure Kesar Mango Pulp, 30-Ounce Cans (Pack of 6)  which is a lot more cooling than drinking iced water or other cold drink.  It's too bad they don't have lamb samosas like they have in the indian restaurants - i LOVE lamb!Other wonderful products of theirs to try are their Tandoor Chef Chicken Tikka Masala, 10-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 12) or their quite incredibly tasty biryanis Tandoor Chef Chicken Biryani, 10-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 12) or their Masala Dosa as light appetizers Tandoor Chef Masala Dosa, 14-Ounce Packages (Pack of 12) or their very spicy tasty Tandoor Chef Lamb Vindaloo, 9.5-Ounce Packages (Pack of 12).

I decided to buy these samosas and try them out. However I was disappointed that they lacked some essential spices and tasted bland. In addition, I paid $33 for 6 boxes, which came out $5.50 per box. Today, I went to my local Indian grocery store, and they were selling it for $2.99 per box.

Being from India, and a samosa Lover, i was excited to find out amazon had frozen samosa. Have to say the quality was stale, the taste was bland, it smelled of old oil. Taste could use more flavor. a true indian samosa has a variety of spices for authentic flavor, this had bland mashed potato with salt. disapponted. :(
These are very tasty, filling with authentic flavors.  I eat them without the accompany yogurt sauce.  It is my go to fast food vegan meal.

These are incredible. I took a chance and bought them and have barely eaten anything else in the past week. Perfect blend of spices, I'd call them moderately spicy. The cilantro sauce has great flavor! I'd like to see more of this brand on amazon.

I had these samosas for the first time when I bought them at Wegman's but every time I went back they never had them stocked so I came on Amazon and saw them. They do cost more than the individual boxes do but since shipping was included and they came in one day I really didn't mind, especially when you consider that at a restaurant they cost $4 for 2 usually. Samosas are my favorite from Indian restaurants and these definitely satisfy the craving for them! The chutney enhances them even more.

I was a little skeptical when I first saw the listing for these on Amazon.  Then I read the reviews..and it looked promising.  These are shipped to you chill-packed, so they do arrive cold to your door.  I wasn't sure about that, but when they arrived everything was great.  THESE ARE WONDERFUL SAMOSAS!!!  The chutney that came with them was also excellent.  They are a little expensive, but when we moved from the east to Colorado we found it a little more difficult to find our favored Indian food.  As a once in a while treat they help to fulfill the homesickness of the east.

These are on par if not better than restaurant quality.  The flavors of the vegetables inside of the pastry are simply divine when coupled with the mint chutney (sauce is included).  It has a little bit of a spicy bite to it that does not obscure the delightful aromatic cumin flavor.  Simply outstanding.

I have been an aficianado of Indian food for more than thirty years, thanks to my now-fiance who introduced me to it when we were quite young, and have eaten in many fine Indian restaurants. I decided to try these samosas even though I was not familiar with the TANDOOR CHEF brand. I am extremely pleased with the taste and quality. They are as good as those you get in a high-quality Indian restaurant, actually better than most I have had, and rival the very best. The outer shell of the samosa is crispy yet tender. It's not greasy and has a lovely flavor. The filling of potato and peas is almost perfect. The taste is fresh with complex flavors and the proper spicing. Just the right amount of heat and celantro as well. The addition of packets of mint chutney is a nice touch. The chutney is a proper bright green and has a vibrant, fresh mint flavor. It's not too salty as many are either. My only criticism is that they should have supplied more of it. The two packets are quite small. The samosa boxes arrived in a styrofoam box packed with dry ice and all were still frozen. They cook-up in about 15 minutes in a 350 degree oven. If you like Indian food you absolulutely cannot go wrong with these samosas. They are delicious.

These samosa have a great flavor, just enough spice to bring heat, but not disrupt the good taste of the other ingredients. The chutney is okay, but these are fine without that addition. 4 stars simply because the price is a bit high for what you get - 4 samosa that are simply and accent to a meal, not a meal in and of themselves. Would purchase again.
i like these samosa spice are just right, but not too crazy about the sauce.

These are the best samosas I have ever had including the ones that you can get made froms scratch in great indian restaurants. They are a bit spicy but most people should be able to handle them. The instructions are perfect and they come out great EVERYTIME!!! BUY THESE!!

We recently moved from San Diego to Upper Michigan. The cold is not an issue, but the lack of Indian and Thai restaurants has put our entire Family into withdrawal. These were perfect for us. Of, course, we are now distressed to have them on back order. Please...help us Obi-wan Amazon... You are our only hope. Get them off back order please !

I love that over the past 6 months i have ordered from this Tandoor retailer and they have ALWAYS come through in a timely manner, not to mention that i love love love this product.  It's like a little slice of home.
price is what kills me would have just settled for one packet instead of 5!!!! I cant eat all of these somosas!

After trying K.L. Keller Black Truffle Salt from Whole Foods, I appreciated this salt much more. This white truffle salt is way better. It totally transforms hard boiled eggs and also tastes really good on cucumbers. If you plan on traveling with this salt often, I suggest getting the glass bottle. The other package wouldn't close after heavy use.

As a lover of all things truffle, I hunt down truffle products that are rich in the flavor and a good value. This salt is more mildly flavored than the black truffle salt I've experienced before both in the states and in Italy, which I believe is the nature of the white truffle as opposed to the black. Next time I would opt for spending more on a similar quantity of black truffle salt.Product arrived swiftly and in good shape.
On a low carb diet, adding variety to simple dishes is key. I use this on eggs and fish with great results. Brings new life to old dishes!

column9: SUPERBLY DELICIOUS!!! Really Raw & Wee Bee make top notch honey!
column10: Hello! Just an fyi if youre lookin for some quality honey---- this is it right here. Tastes VERY clean, very pure, and has a natural hint of rose if you really pay attention...Just the right amount of sweetness, and it just tastes and feels healthy!All in all, the 2 best honeys ive tried so far are this, the Really Raw, AND Wee Bee Raw Honey! Soooo tasty, im tellin ya...You wont be let down! These 2 are the real deal in honey!  :)  Enjoy!!!!!!

Unwrapping an egg it appears to be VERY slippery. When eating an egg I can taste the peanut butter and the supposed chocolate coating taste very OILY with ONLY a slight hint of cocoa. After eating an egg it leaves my mouth with an oily feeling. Whether this candy really causes it or not I don't know but after eating several I later had lots of burps. From now on, I will avoid any candy which contains this PGPR simply because of the oily texture and lack of taste of real chocolate.Wikipedia says: It is used by chocolate makers to reduce the cost of raw material. Since 2006, commercial-grade candy bars, such as those made by Hersheys and Nestle, made an industry-wide switch to include PGPR as an ingredient - a possible indicator of a cost-saving measure by the commercial chocolate industry. Makers of PGPR such as Danisco and Palsgaard indicate PGPR can be used to replace the more expensive cocoa butter as an ingredient in chocolate. Palsgaard's website asserts, "Cocoa butter is an expensive raw material for chocolate manufacturers. By using PALSGAARD 4150 the chocolate recipe has lower costs in terms of less cocoa butter but also gives the benefit of having less fat.""Less fat". Guess I'm one who like fat better than an oily substitute. Ingredients such as PGPR should be shown for consumable items IMHO.

I'll say it now, I'm a die hard Amy's fan. I've never had an Amy's food product that I didn't like and these beans are no exception.The flavor is so distinct and hard to describe, but it's very similar to the same flavors in Amy's Chili. It has a depth of flavor that you never get with canned beans, but you do with these. Definitely, worth a try if you've never had these.Since none of my local grocery stores keep the refried beans in stock, I'll be back here again and again for more because once you've had Amy's beans, you'll never go back to the other brands.Plus, these are gluten free.

Thank you Amazon for carrying Amy's at such a reasonable price! I paid about $27 for this case, when they were trying to charge me $40 for it at my health food store. These are the BEST refried beans I've ever had---they taste even better since I add about a half a jar of salsa (mild, great value brand from Walmart) per can. I love them because they don't taste like oil and they don't make me feel sick afterwards, as other refried bean brands sometimes do.I definitely recommend!

Vegan. Organic. Kosher. Creamy delicious organic refried beans. Great for bean burritos or nachos. Just put a dollop on a tortilla with some organic salsa for a quick and easy snack or meal. Wonderful for tacos with fresh tomatos and lettuce. Also really like Amy's Organic Medium Chili, 14.7 Ounces (Pack of 12). Six star company. Another vegan wonder from Amy's kitchen! This review is out there for those for whom this makes a difference. See all of my reviews for more great choices. Check out "Vegan Grocery Favorites" and "Vegan Grocery Top Ten" in Listmania. Your "helpful" votes count and will be greatly appreciated to benefit the search of others. Thank you.

column9: The Best Refried Beans in a Can EVER
column10: I am a lifelong eater of refried beans. As a vegetarian, this is a staple in my diet. These are, honest-to-god, the best refried beans from a can I havever eaten.

My family is completely vegetarian, and prefers to eat only organic when possible.  I was purchasing these at a local store and was paying well over $3 a can, and we were using 2-3 cans a week.  So I was thrilled to find cases available on Amazon!  Thank you for such a great price.  We will happily continue to buy these beans on a regular basis.  Amy's is a great brand, and these refried beans are simply terrific.  We love the spices and the flavor, and prefer the "Traditional" over the "Amy's Refried Black Beans" (although these are pretty good too).  Thanks again, Amazon.

Of all the canned beans I've tried, these are the best. Good flavor and very little "tinny" taste. Like all things canned, don't expect to eat without extra flavoring (garlic, kosher/sea salt, fresh ground pepper, etc). My 6 year-old loves them in an easy quesadilla (buttered, cast iron skillet warmed tortilla, beans and cheese). Great price from Amazon. They beat anything I can find locally, unfortunately.
As with all Amy's Organics products, these refried beans are great. Just heat and serve or eat cold out of the can! All the flavor is there with the added benefits of being kosher, organic and vegan.

column9: Phoenix Home & Garden taste test winner
column10: I'm going to try these refried beans.  I just noticed in the March 2009 issue of Phoenix Home & Garden magazine, Amy's won the taste test over five other brands.

column9: The 2nd order had at least 3 dented cans
column10: That's a lot of dented cans, and there were even ones in the middle of the pack.  The un-dented cans tasted very good, though.
I was very disappointed...i received this product and all but one was damaged..there is no returns on this..so i would not recommend to buy this

These beans are heavenly and we love them, so we thought we would start a subscription for them to be delivered to us.  Unfortunately, when I opened the box and the plastic packaging inside, there were three seriously dented cans in the middle of the set of cans.  I find it hard to believe that they have gotten that dented where they were placed in the center of the set of cans without messing up all the cans around them unless they were set in there that way, so we paid for 12 cans and end up with only 9 usable cans.  Unless I find a way to get the other three cans to replace these I will be canceling the subscription and not buying this brand any more.It is too expensive in our local health food store, and we thought this would be a great idea. Since we got three unusable cans it ends up being too expensive again.  Too bad since it's a wonderful product my whole family loves.

Great beans.  Taste wonderful and they're vegan (dairy-free) and gluten-free which is very important for us since my daughter and I have celiacs.  There's a lot we can't eat, but these are safe for us and it's nice to be able to have taco night again!

When we were growing up, my sister used to eat refried beans.  Straight, from a CAN!  I always thought she was crazy.  That is, until I tried this product.  These beans are amazing!  Never before have I had canned beans that taste so good.  If you are worried about your sodium intake, opt for the reduced sodium version; they are just as terrific.  This is the first brand of canned refried beans that are worthy of eating straight from the can.

Wonderful refried pinto beans. The refried black beans are also wonderful. These are delicious right out of the can. There is no need to add seasonings or do any time consuming preparation. I add a little water and microwave/stir/microwave/stir and they are ready to eat in two minutes. They are great by themselves or as a side dish or dip. I like them with a good veggie burger and some steamed veggies. I consider them mildly spiced, as I prefer. Those with bolder tastes could add a little chili powder or some fresh peppers to spice things up. A spicy salsa would also go great with these beans.

column9: They're the BEST because they ARE seasoned!
column10: These are absolutely the best refried beans I have ever tasted. I don't understand the reviews from the people on here who say they don't like the seasoning. These are seasoned the way TexMex food is SUPPOSED to be seasoned. If you don't like these seasoned beans, then you must not like TexMex food either, so then why on earth are you buying refried beans? With most refried beans, they have about as much flavor as flour and water paste. Also, I like the fact that these beans are not made with lard. In many parts of the country, it is hard to find refried beans that are not made with lard--unless you want completely no-fat beans, and I don't want that. I want the shortening; I just don't want the lard. This is also a good price for mailorder.

column9: Best out of the can refried beans I've ever had
column10: These refried beans are delicious. They have a wonderful flavor that all other canned refried beans lack. Refried beans were a staple in the house when I was growing up, both fresh made then from the can. Of course I prefer fresh made but the whole two step process of making refried beans is a lot of work. I have tried all types of refried beans from the can and these are by far the best I have ever had the pleasure of eating.

column9: The best canned refried beans I've ever tasted. By a long shot.
column10: I've used a lot of different brands over the years, some better than others...Amy's has raised the bar, and now I tolerate other brands only when I'm desperate. In addition to having superior flavor, they aren't disgustingly salty like the Taco Bell brand, for instance. Lest you get the wrong idea, they're plenty salty. The only drawback is, of course, they're pricier...I consider them worth it.

Buyers should be aware that these are not plain refried beans--they're already seasoned. Unfortunately, I don't care for the seasoning. It's not terrifically strong, but I don't like it and didn't expect it: I thought I was buying just refried beans. I'd much rather season the beans the way I like them. I generally like Amy's products, and I'm a big supporter of organic foods, but I won't be buying these again.
This is the ONLY product that works in my recipe for "Death By Chocolate".  It is full of flavor, and very easy to prepare.  Wonderful product!!

column9: Amazon has great price on this
column10: I am a licorice junkie so buy it quite often. I did manage to send some to our troops only because I sent it out right away or I would have gobbled it up.

An excellent deal, much cheaper than I've found Black Trumpets elsewhere.  Note I'm not a mushroom connoisseur.  That said, I thought the taste and texture of the mushrooms was just as good as Black Trumpets I've eaten previously.Although the description doesn't specify, these are dried mushrooms, not fresh.  They arrived in a single one pound plastic bag, non-resealable.

Don't know if I got a bad batch or old batch, but there is no smoke flavor at all.  At least the salt is relatively tasty, but considering that I could have saved money by just ordering normal Maldon Salt - that is what you should do.

I have been on an Indian food kick lately. The local Indian restaurant is quite expensive so I decided to try this sauce as a cheaper option. I am thoroughly disappointed with its flavor. It has way too much vinegar, probably to help preservation. I couldn't even take more than one bite. I would not recommend this sauce at all.

I'm not generally a fan of herbal teas -- most are too floral or minty for my taste -- but my wife bought a box of these at Whole Foods and, after trying it out, I was hooked. It has a really nice, caramel flavor without being too sweet. In fact, add a bit of honey and it's even better (go figure). I find it to be a great, relaxing evening tea. The subscription-based price at Amazon is better than anywhere else I've seen, so I buy here in bulk now.

I placed an order for Yogi Bedtime Soothing Carmel, 1.25ounce packages (Pack of 6); I received a carton with an external white label indicating contents were as above, but in fact the carton contained Yogi Stress Relief herbal tea supplement, 16 count tea bags (Pack of 6). And since this is a non-returnable product,I feel that my hands are tied.

These have the redeeming qualities of not needing refrigeration before cooking and that they cook in minutes. Great for quick meal or side dish with butter or tomato sauce or such BUT as gnocchi, they are not the greatest. They are more like starchy dumplings, heavy dough with no potato texture or taste.

I have a sweet tooth and my favorite way to make this gnocchi is in a butter/sugar and cinnamon sauce. We serve it as a dessert. My kids beg for this. Since it is the only gnocchi I have ever had (and the only way I have ever had it) I have nothing else to compare it to. But my family just loves it this way and it's very simple and easy to fix.

column9: A good buy for the money
column10: If you want to use a lot of tumeric then this is the way to go. The list of health benefits associated with turmeric is very, very long, but at top of that list must be its cancer-fighting properties. Paired up with veggies like cauliflower, broccoli and cabbage, there is solid evidence to suggest it is very useful in preventing prostate cancer (there are approximately half a million new cases of this type of cancer each year in the U.S. alone). Most of us enjoy a drink (or several) and turmeric also strengthens the liver's potential to purify toxins in the body, along with carcinogens found in the diet (bring on the steak). Turmeric is also great at lowering cholesterol as it prevents the oxidization of cholesterol, which is what makes it harmful; this is all good for protecting your heart as it is the oxidized cholesterol that damages blood vessels. The yellow spice is also an anti-inflammatory.

I looked around for a quality Tumeric for a good price. Well, I grew up using McCormick brands, and for the price Amazon is selling this product for is awesome. I bought the 2 pack because I cook with it as well as consume it for the anti-inflammatory properties tumeric is known for. I will buy this again when I run out.

So much turmeric! Two large containers. Lots of it. One pound each. Did I mention there's a lot of turmeric here? But I use it in almost half the meals I cook. I even occasionally put some in my "Masala" tea when I want to add yet more odd flavoring to my early morning kickstarts. I appreciate its health benefits, but after searching around local stores and finding only tiny containers which I'd use up in a week, this was a thrill to find, just for the quantity alone.

column9: is it real brand McCormick product?
column10: I received product, but the packing is different from the picture shown on your web. Normally McCormick product's packing is in RED, but the product what I received is in Blue. I am wondering if it is real McCormick product. Please let me know.

Turmeric has excellent health benefits and this brand is very tasty/excellent source of raw turmeric. It can be used for variety of dishes and gives a yellowish color. Using a small spoon of it daily will go a long way in great health. Highly recommended.

column9: Used For Healthy Steamed Dishes In Microwave
column10: I put 2 tablespoons of Olive Oil in the bottom of a Pyrex small casserole dish.  Then 1/2 tsp Coarse Ground Pepper and 1 tsp Turmeric added to that.  Stirred with a toothpick to mix with oil.  Heated in the microwave for 2 minutes.Add vegetables, fish, etc. and cover with a lid.  I cook it for about 6 or 7 minutes. Love the freshness of it and the taste can be changed by adding other spices with it too, if you get bored.

After trying other decaf coffees, I keep going back to this one.  I love a bold coffee that doesn't taste burnt.  Rainforest Expresso gives full flavor without the acrid taste that I've found in some others.  This is my favorite anytime coffee!

I like the vanilla flavor. I wasn't sure at first if I would like it because I was used to the carob flavor, that unforuntely I have not found on Amazon, but I got used to it. the box says to serve chilled, but I prefer it at room temperature. It goes really good with my favorite breakfast cereal:Nature's Path Organic Millet Rice Oatbran Flakes Cereal, 32-Ounce Eco-Pac Bags (Pack of 6)In the past I was quite often getting nine boxes in my order instead of the 27 I was supposed to get. But I see from the product page that the call I made to customer service actually did change the wording from "Pack of 9" to "Pack of 27" so Yay! this hopefully means I will receive the 27 that I paid for.This milk is very tasty especially when I am in the mood for milk and I have drunk way too many cans of: essn Sparkling Pomegranate & Montmorency Cherry Juice, 8.4-Ounce Cans (Pack of 24)Ok, I am having a craving for cereal with rice milk now so I am off to the cupboards for another breakfast libation to satisfy the cravings for something good for me that also gives me a zing to my taste buds.

My wife is allergic to dairy produces and soy.  This is a great alternative and with the small sizes it is easy to use it up before the 10 to 14 day shelf life once the container is opened.We use to buy the larger containers but would end up throwing out at least half because we could use it up before the product expires.

column9: Overprice and Misleading only 9 8oz boxes not 27!
column10: NOT RETURNABLE!!!!!This product is misleading. There are only 9 8oz boxes total. That comes to $33 for 9 8oz boxes or ~$3.30 for a single glass. So, this is very misleading because this is not 9 package of 3packs but 3 of the 3 rice dream packs. Not only that, this item is not returnable! That's right, I cannot get a refund even if I am not satisfied with the product or something wrong with it. I'll have to contact the customer service directly and test Amazon's service.Buyers must be careful about buying products from 3rd party merchants. They do not have the great return policy that amazon does. I think that this really degrades my experience with amazon. I will be much more weary of buy anything more from Amazon in the future, especially since it is difficult to distinguish those items sold by amazon and those sold by third party merchants. Even more important, it is difficult to know the return policy on an item until you try to return it!-------------------------------------------------------------UpdateI emailed amazon and they notified me that this product is indeed sold by amazon and that groceries with expiration dates are not returnable. However, they refunded my money because the product did not meet my expectations and told me to disposed of it as I wished. Thanks for the free rice dream amazon! Hope you change the description on this item as you have done with the other listings of rice dream.

column9: Excellent gluten free pancake and bake mix!
column10: I bought one box of this pancake and waffle mix and couldn't remember where I had gotten it!  I really liked it...better than some other GF mixes I'd tried.  I was pleased to find it available on Amazon!  I have just ordered a case (four boxes) and signed up for the subscribe and save program which makes the price of this item better than I've seen anywhere!  I usually bake from scratch, and, as you might see in other reviews I've written, I've been disappointed in gluten free mixes. However, this mix makes pancakes and waffles a snap...and it really tastes good!  I also made the pineapple cake recipe on the back of the box and got rave reviews!  It was really delicious and really easy.  I make a lot of pancakes because my hubby loves to take PBJ's in his lunch and I don't always have the time to bake bread for his sandwiches.  One time, when I had some pancakes left over from our breakfast, I made PBJ's using the pancakes instead of bread.  He dubbed them "panwiches" and loves them.  I cook up a bunch of pancakes, let them cool, make the sandwiches, and then freeze them in baggies for an easy grab and go lunch box item!  Unlike breads, cooking them up takes little time, so, whenever I run out I know I can fix up some "panwiches" quickly!  Oh, and I often put a glob of peanut butter in the batter (beat till smooth) to add even more to the flavor!  My only wish would be that the mix came in quantities larger than 16 ounces!Maple Grove Farms Gluten Free Pancake & Waffle Mix, 16-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 4)

Prior to having celiac, I always used Maple Groves products. They make a nice gift basket for gift giving also.I serve this pancake mix to guests not knowing it's GF. Everyone loves the pancakes! look for their maple syrup also, for a wonderful pancake experience!
Fantastic GF Waffle mix!! They were certainly the best gluten free waffles I have had so far. Super easy and fast to whip up. I loved the result and will definitely buy this product again. =)

I've tried SO many gluten free mixes and this is by far the best. Not only is the texture spot on, but the flavor is lovely. My kids and I gobble these up!I've also substituted this mix for muffins and cakes and have been pleased everytime. My local grocery stopped carrying it and I hassled them until they agreed to start carrying it again LOL!!All in all, this brand has the right texture, taste and price! I highly reccomend it and my kids give it 4 thumbs up!

column9: Our kids love it!!!  Best GFCF Pancake Mix around!
column10: After trying multiple gluten free, casein free pancake mixes, this is by far the best.  Our kids love it, and it's especially good when mixed with apples/cinnamon, blueberries, or even chocolate chips for a special treat!  This mix is on the sweet side, but texture/flavor/simple directions make this a great option for those on gfcf diets.I just wish Amazon would keep it in stock and available to those with Amazon Prime.  Please!

I bought this mix from Target after trying numerous other GF pancake mixes, and this was just awful!  The batter smells more like a vanilla cake, and t=once baked, they are so dry, they are inedible.  I tried again using a flax "egg", so there was a bit more liquid to the batter, and they were still dry.  Fluffy looking yes, but so heavy.  I will never buy this mix again.  The closes to traditional pancakes I have found is Pamela's mix.

column9: Best GF pancake mix Ive found, and Ive tried most
column10: My son has celiac but loves pancakes. Ive tried every GF mix I could find in stores. Every pancake is flat, almost doughy in the middle, to the point it doesnt even look cooked. But my son always eat it and never complains. Just a week ago I found Maple Grove mix. When I first mixed it I noticed it smelled like cake batter. The first pancake I cooked I burnt it and set it aside on a plate to throw away. While I was making the 2nd my son walked over, tore a piece off and started to eat it. I said "dont eat that its no good, its burnt."  As kids are, he didnt listen and popped it into his mouth. To my surprise he said "its fine, it tastes good."I did notice while I was making him new pancakes they looked fluffy, like real pancakes, and they smelled sweet, like I was baking a cake. After I made him a few more pancakes I tore a piece off the burnt one, and with no syrup, tasted. I couldnt believe how good it was. It tasted like a cupcake almost. I drizzled a little syrup on it and ended up eating almost the whole pancake that I was going to toss.Hands down, this is the best GF mix Ive found. Im certainly open to trying something else in search of the perfect mix, but I cant see anything else much better than this. I dont have a waffle maker any more, had to throw that out after he was diagnosed with celiac, but I bet it makes great waffles too.I know we all have our tastes and preferences, but I cant understand the 1 star ratings on this, especially the ones that say this mix is grainy. Mixed properly this is the consistency of cake batter. And who doesnt like cake?
The gluten free pancake mix is very tasty it can be used at all times. Also the wafles turn out very good and tasty. I highly recommend it.

The good: If you want to make a gluten free cake, then this pancake mix would be a good base. Also, my gluten intollerant girlfriend said it has a nicer texture than other gluten free pancake mixes she has used.The bad: surpringly sweet, tastes very much like yellow cake from the dextrose used to sweeten it. Personally, I can handle gluten. But I have a problem with eating too much sugar. So we had it with just a little pumpkin butter and marjarine.She liked it enough to eat 3 small (4 inch) pancakes. I had 2, then had to stop eating it as I could tell I was getting way too much sweetener in my breakfast and my stomach would've been upset if I kept eating it. I'd say if you really like sweets, you'll like it. And if you really want cake for breakfast, this is the one for you. If like me, too much sugar hurts your stomach, maybe look at another product.
While I like the consistency and ease of making these (not to mention the taste) there's too much sugar.  Would like a sugar-free version, made with natural sweetener.  Great product.

Our whole house is gluten free due to 3 kids with Celiac & gluten allergies.  This is a great pancake mix.  We took several boxes with us on vacation and the cooked pancakes held up well for on-the-go snacks.  I also hosted Christmas brunch for my husband's family and served these pancakes as part of the spread.  Everyone loved them and came back for seconds - they did not even mind that they were gluten free.  They kind of taste like Jiffy blueberry muffins without the blueberries.  I make the entire box at one time and save any leftovers in the fridge or freezer.  These pancakes are fluffy - Pamela's mix pancakes are very thin.  My kids like them both, but these have the consistancy and look of traditional gluten pancakes.  They also smell sweet - like vanilla when cooking.

I was recently diagnosed with Celiac disease, and have been wildly craving pancakes. Like some other reviewers, I had always used Maple Grove pancake mix prior to being diagnosed. I absolutely LOVED their product...in my opinion, the batter turned out flawless every time. When I saw this GF version at my grocery store, I was thrilled! Well I cooked up a batch this morning, and they were wretched. I have totally accepted the fact that GF foods are just going to taste/feel different than'regular" foods, but these were just so terrible. Not only was the texture very grainy and un-fluffy there was a very strange under-flavor. I always add just a drop of vanilla to my pancake mixes, so naturally I did with this too. When I tasted them, I thought I must have accidentally put half the bottle of vanilla in, before I realized that it wasn't quite the vanilla that made them taste so bad. I smelled the pancake mix, and discovered that the mix itself has a very floral-y or perfume-y scent to it. I have never used a pancake mix where the mix itself was scented. This was very strange to me, and I was just disgusted by the outcome, so I will keep searching for the perfect mix.
This pancake mix is terribly grainy and heavy tasting. We could not eat it. Plus, I had a terrible time getting the auto-delivery cancelled. I would not recommend this product to anyone.
Texture keeps this product from being excellent; just OK but still as good as any gluten free waffle we've found.

First, I'll admit that I've only been GF for a few months, but c'mon! How is this stuff good?! I followed directions today for breakfast. And like another reviewer, it DID have the angel food cake issue! But I couldn't even finish 2 pancakes before I called it quits on trying to choke this stuff down. I've been so lenient and know that GF food isn't going to be 100% like "regular" food, but seriously, I'll stick with eggs and fruit for breakfast.

column9: These are a hit in my house.
column10: Gluten free pancake mixes can be grainy and dense - but this one is an exception. When making the pancakes, it actually smells like a vanilla cake batter. The resulting taste and texture is perfect - we even serve these to guests who don't have celiac - and they don't know they are gluten free!

Definitely the best box pancake mix I've ever had...and it's nice that it's GF, too.  I used to make pancakes/waffles by scratch, but this mix is great and saves me time when I just want to use a mix. We can eat gluten but feel better when we don't. Made from scratch GF pancakes aren't typically very good, and this even beats it's competition WITH gluten. I highly recommend trying this. Prices here are much better than stores.

column9: Weird smell, Not the best I'd had!
column10: I had already found a product that I really liked as far as gluten free pancakes go (Bob's Red Mill), but figured I would give Maple Grove Farms a try because they are fairly local to us.Unfortunately I was put off as soon as I poured the mix. The texture of the mixture was apparently different (very powdery) and smelled of cupcake mix! They cooked kind of strange, and my non-Gluten Free husband and I felt like we were eating them just because they were there. They needed to be covered with other flavors to make them 'good'. I really might try making these into cupcakes though, because the smell is dead on.

column9: Best gluten free pancake mix around!
column10: This is the best gluten free pancake mix!!!!!!!!!!!! I have tried  5 or 6 and this one is hands down the best!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!

First gluten free pancake mix I tried, the overall experience is not bad.  Taste is very good, not much to be missed from using wheat flour pancake mixes.  The biggest problem I had is that this batter burned very easily.  Since Bisquick has now created a gluten free mix that has created perfect pancakes, I will not be going back to this.

for gluten free pancakes and waffles, you can't beat this.  Fabulous in taste, texture, time and ease in making.  We use them on our waffle griddle a few times per week. Love that we add our own fresh egg(s) and milk (vs. plain water) to get nutrient rich breakfast for my kids.  Instead of syrup, we sprinkle powdered sugar and sliced strawberries. You can even make larger amounts and store in container for next morning.  Just add a little more milk to reduce its thickness the next day.  Perfect!

Here's a wheat free gluten free pancake mix that makes light, fluffy pancakes, even after you use the leftover batter from the fridge the next morning. (No flat, rubbery pancakes.)This has a sweet smell and taste, perhaps owing to the unnamed "natural flavoring" from the ingredients list. (To me it tastes like blueberries.) It's pleasing but I didn't find it overbearing, which increases the versatility of the mix. And by the way, I really enjoyed the flavor.I also experimented by putting in a small amount of unsweetened cocoa powder with positive results.I fed this to my family, and my choosy husband who will eat nothing but Jemima's really enjoyed these pancakes and even asked for more. Saves me from having to cook up separate batches for each of us, although this option is a bit pricier.It's nice to eat pancakes again.If you're allergic to rice, this will not work for you. It contains rice flour.

column9: The BEST gluten free pancake mix!
column10: I love this pancake mix.  It makes pancakes that don't taste or feel gluten free!  So many mixes have a grainy texture or get rubbery when cooked, but not this one.  Maple Grove Farms has made a gluten free pancake mix that can't be distinguished from the "regular" kind.  I've done a pancake breakfast for 50 people using this mix without telling them the pancakes were gluten free, and they gobbled them up!
