This is my FAVORITE pancake mix.  I have tried several and none of them tasted "right".  I even tried making some from scratch, and they came out way too thin and runny, even following the recipe exactly.  Some gluten free things have a funny taste, but NOT these.  My entire family of 5 LOVES these and thinks they taste just like regular pancakes.  I make the recipe using WATER, which is the recipe for waffles, not pancakes, but I make pancakes and they turn out perfect.  The pancake recipe calls for MILK.  I'm sure they would be good that way too but I haven't tried it.  The box is not very large and I usually use at least 1/2 the box for a batch to feed my family.  But I think the price is okay since they are really yummy.  They puff up just like a regular pancake, they brown just like a regular pancake, and there is NO odd taste.  I am already on my 3rd order of these from Amazon!  Thank you Amazon!!!

column9: Best Gluten Free Waffle Mix (so far)
column10: We haven't used this mix for making pancakes (Bob's Red Mill is a favorite there), but it is definitely the best option we've found so far for making gluten- and casein-free waffles. Even if it's non-stick, you may need to grease your waffle iron; however, the waffles come out light & fluffy with a pleasantly crispy outside. Even our family members who aren't on a GFCF diet enjoy eating them!

This is the best pancake mix I have tried. It isin't gritty like alot of them. It also has a pineapple cake recipe on the back of the box that is the best I have ever tasted and that includes even pre diagnoses of Celiac disease. This will be a regular product in my kitchen.

column9: Greatest GF Pancake Mix on the Market
column10: I've been gluten free for nearly 6 years now.  The quality of the products on the market today are FAR superior to those of just a few years ago.  I can easily say this is the best pancake mix I've ever had since going GF.I found this on amazon and couldn't be happier!  It's a great product, and now I can have it delivered right to my door without having to go all over town to find my favorites!

With all the gluten free mixes this is by far the best when it comes to pancakes or waffles.Our entire family eats them and only one has Celiac Disease.Don't waste your money on other brands.This is very hard to find in markets because the ones that do carry it are always out of it!!!

This makes really delicious pancakes! There is no grittiness like some mixes we've tried. The pancakes are light and tasty. I will mix up a box at a time and make waffles in my no stick waffle maker and freeze them. Pop them in the toaster on school mornings and they are just as good as fresh.I found this with the regular pancake mix at Wegman's which equals great pricing because it was not over in the `Gluten Free' isle. Try slicing bananas into the batter or adding a little cinnamon or nutmeg to give it a twist! Yummy!!!

This product is not what it says!!!  I ordered it because I needed a low carb sugar free mix.  This what it says in product description "Low Carb Sugar Free Pancake and Waffle Mix".  When I received it, it said gluten free on the front, then I went to the nutritional info and it has 4g sugar and 27 carbs!!!  Worst part about it all is I can't return it, so now I am out money and frustrated!!!!
We will not buy this mix.  We would rather go without.  The texture is terrible -- rubbery and full of bubbles -- and way too sweet.

I have been on a gluten-free diet for less than a year, and can still remember the taste and texture of my favorite, now-forbidden foods. In my opinion, the pancakes made from this mix had a very odd flavor. Finally it dawned on me what it reminded me of: angel food cake! Of the several gluten-free pancake mixes I have tried, I really have enjoyed only one, made by The Really Great Food Company ([..]).

great tasting,perfect balance of crispy and chewy,when it comes to sugar and salt less is more and this product delivers in spades.I find myself eating it for a snack .Its light and filling and did I mention it tastes great.Don't delay get some for yourself today!
Have been eating this cereal for years.  you have the best price and I don't have to go shoppingI am a lady of few words, to have to write 20 is too much

column9: It is the best cereal on the market!
column10: It is a very healthy cereal with 7g of fiber per cup! I eat 2C at breakfast and I am full until lunch time. And depending on how much and what kind of milk you use it comes to 240 cal per 1C. It is shipped to us and costs half the price that we would pay at our health food store. Try some you'll love it!!

This is a very respectable balsamic vinegar at a good price. It is just sour enough, with a smooth sweet finish. I bought the 16 pack to include individual bottles in gift packages for friends, but I also find the 5-ounce size just right for the condiment tray I keep on my table. A few drops sprinkled into sauces, soups, vegetables, and other dishes adds flavor without fat or salt.

Crispy when compared with fresh papadums, but the taste is authentic and right on. Great for snacking, and you can also use curry and dip these in curry like you would with chips and salsa. Delicious.

They are alright. Nothing super great. I bought 2 tins, and liked them at first but got sick of their taste after the first tin.  They dont taste the greatest for a candy and don't foam all that much. They kinda taste like baking powere, but the other flavors are super delicious.  The energy flavor is great.
LOVE this gum.  The mint is refreshing without being overpowering.  The gum is sugarless.  And the flavor lasts a long time!This is one of my personal favorites; a great choice!
The bread was very good when I first received it. In two days, however, it started to get spotty mold. Probably won't order again.
good flavor and consistency. can be used a soup base or to flavor chicken and dumplings. Just wish it was available locally.

column9: Have a cup of South Louisiana!
column10: What could be more reflective of South Louisiana than a cup of Community Coffee? No smooth, suave Starbucks. No flavored creams. Just the pure, bold taste of Community Coffee.You know how the reptilian brain "remembers" aromas you "forgot"? Bring on a taste or odor from years ago and the reptilian brain will recognize it. That's what happened yesterday when I had coffee at my mother and brother's house. My brother had switched coffee brands and made a pot of Community. At first whiff, my brain raced back to my grandmother's house and the Community in her drip pot. Pure bliss!And, yes, my brain flashed back to Lake Charles, where I taught for the first five years of my teaching career. The -ex's grandparents and aunt lived in Lake Charles. They, too, drank Community Coffee. There really is no accurate way to describe the taste and aroma of Community, other than: It tastes and smells like South Louisiana!The package itself says Community is made from 100% imported Arabica beans, roasted, packed, and distributed out of Baton Rouge. "Then through generations of roasting experience, we achieve a full-bodied, yet smooth flavor that reflects the extraordinary culinary traditions of Louisiana" (taken from the back of the package). I chose Medium Roast (rich and smooth) from selections of Dark, Between, and Medium.Just brew, pour, and enjoy! You have a cup of South Louisiana to savor.

I tried this coffee about 5 years ago.  It is more flavorful, with less acidity than Folgers & Maxwell House.  My husband & I won't drink anything else, and I've gone to some effort to get it shipped to me when I'm not in an area where the grocery sells this fantastic coffee.  It is well worth the money!

column9: You've gotta be from here to really appreciate
column10: I love my CC.  So far Amazon has saved me major bucks, it is quite pricey here right now.  It's a good coffee, but can be bitter if you don't make it just right.  It has a smooth flavor, but you have to make it right.
Decided to try out this coffee because it was an excellent price. It tastes wonderful! It has a smooth, balanced taste.

Speculators have driven coffee up the past year.  A 34 oz can of Columbian, 100% Arabica (the good stuff) is at least $11.  You rarely see coffee sold in one pound packages anymore (12 oz is the norm).  With Subscribe and Save and the promo Amazon was running, I got 10 packs for $3.80 a pound.  I can now drink my precious Joe without a guilty conscience.

With prices of ground coffee skyrocketing on grocer's shelves, we couldn't resist this opportunity to purchase our beloved (Louisiana) Community Coffee in 10-pack 1-pound bags from Amazon.com ... it was a good buy and we saved at least $1.50 per bag on the deal!

My husband and I are from New Orleans, & Community is the "coffee of choice" for most Louisiana Locals. It's so rich, without that bitter taste that some coffees have.The price locally is very competitive - however, we've moved to Louisville, KY - and, we can't even find it here, so, we get "our Moms" to load up their suitcases when they come to visit. I was so pleased to find Community on Amazon, and the bulk price was GREAT (plus, I had a "Groupon") so, I ended up getting it for about $2.77 a bag- delivered to my front door!I love having my favorite coffee "flown in" from Louisiana!Well, my fresh pot has just brewed, so, I'm off to enjoy a cup now!

Besides this coffee is still packed by the POUND, it's some of the best I've brewed at home, pot after pot the flavor is great and it does't cost $2.50 a cup. Ground for perk, or drip it's just hard to make a bad cup. The price is great and the medium blend will suit anyones taste.

I am so excited to discover that I can get my coffee on Amazon -delivered for free using my Prime account. I love the medium blend of Community Coffee, but for some reason my local grocery store stopped carrying this blend. Now that I know I can get it in two days w/free shipping -I am a happy coffee drinker again! I can't wait for my cup of java to arrive. This is my favorite coffee, bar none.
I purchased this based on reviews by others, but was disappointed with the taste. I will not be buying again.

I bought both this version and the breakfast blend because it has great reviews for taste.  The coffee isn't bad but it defiantly is not anything special. For the price it could be more ethical (fair trade, organic, shade grown etc.). The taste was OK but I'll stick with Dean's Beans.
If you like perfect spicy bloody Mary mix, you must try it! It will make you blush! Perfect addition to your summer brunch. The flavor is great!

column9: ABSOLUTELY NOT WHAT IT SEEMS TO BE, VERY DISAPPOINTING :-(
column10: I love this time of the year (Autumn/Fall) and love the immense variety of pumpkin food products that are available.  To name a few: Pumpkin Ice Cream, Pumpkin Bread and Muffins, Pumpkin Pie, Pumpkin Spice Latte (coffee), Pumpkin Cheesecake, etc. etc.  I recently started adding canned pumpkin to our Sunday morning pancakes, and was delighted with the results; however, I wanted a stronger pumpkin taste/flavor.  I found this product and excitedly ordered two bottles.  It arrived very quickly (within 3 days), and I just tried it this morning in our pancakes.  The flavor DOES NOT taste like pumpkin whatsoever.  It tastes like a chemical and leaves a bad taste in my mouth, literally.  I dumped both bottles down the sink and had to throw away the pancakes.  I was not able to eat them, they were terrible.  I was actually nauseated after trying to eat them.  I'm not a picky eater and have no allergies whatsoever.  I'm the type of person that will eat nearly everything, and cannot think of any food that I don't like.  I'm going to continue my search for a "NATURAL" TRUE pumpkin extract; however, this is definitely not it.  I hope this helps you, especially if you're as passionate about pumpkin flavor as I am. Happy Holidays to You and Yours.  Sincerely, Tim

this is going to be short and sweet, but this extract is wonderful! It smells delicious and has no bitterness to it.  I got it to make fudge...which in turn, got rave reviews. It is also great in pumpkin bread and pie.I noticed the seller has other extracts as well. I look forward to trying some of their others soon.

In the fall, I used this product and made pumpkin-caramel chocolate truffles rolled in cinnamon toasted chopped pecans.  Everybody loved them.  This is not a sweet extract, but is so flavorful.  use it to add that taste of fall to confections and soups, risotto, etc!  great product and well worth the price.
I bought this extract to use in a pumpkin beer, but I would have ruined the batch. This stuff is gross!

Its spaghetti, so I don't know how you can screw it up, but it was really good. Cooked up well on my campfire grill, didnt stick together, and the taste was really good. I liked this just fine and will order more if I need to.
Initially I bought these sugarless candies in small resale-size bags.  Now I buy them by the pound and keep them in my drawer at work.
I can not survive without my Fox's Ubet Syrup!!! It brings me back to NY!!

They have added a touch of lemongrass to this tea, which puts off an unbelievable scent and adds a nice natural flavor to the tea.  Overall, it is a mellow tea though, not sweetened or artificial tasting in the slightest.  I am addicted!
Sorry but I was looking for a nice madagascar vanilla smooth tea and this one had a very artificial flavor and the smell of it is very unpleasant.

This tea is great! The vanilla undertones are subtle but definitely adds to the richness of the flavor. The (natural) sweetness of this tea is also perfect, no additional sweeteners necessary.  I normally stay away from white teas but this is an extremely well-balanced (not too light) variety. As if that wasn't enough, white tea contains more antioxidants than black or green teas and has numerous health benefits!FYI: This tea is also gluten free and comes in unbleached tea bags.
this is my daily tea. it's not bitter at all if you use water that is just steaming no need to boil. tastier than green tea and just as good for you.

column9: Best white tea I've ever tasted
column10: I first found this tea at a local Randall's grocery store but then recently discontinued this item.  Too bad because I REALLY love this blend of white tea with vanilla.  I can't find it at any of my major grocery chains which is unfortunate.  But buying it off Amazon is about what I'd pay at the grocery store so I'm not too miffed about it.It's a little weird to me to buy and have tea shipped to my home but...I'll do whatever I gotta do to get this tea!
Delicious white tea, smooth and sweet, drink as-is. And, price is about half what you'd pay in the grocery store!
If you like tea, this is the best.  It has a very pleasant taste, even unsweetened.  White tea and green tea are also supposed to be very healthy for you.

Yuck - this tea is really not to my liking.  This tea has a very unpleasant taste, something I cannot quite describe.  I have to force myself to drink it until I use up my supply.  It sort of makes me shudder as I swallow it.  I have tried brewing it for shorter times and I still don't like it.  I have also tried the Decaf White Tea, with the same opinion.It was surprising to me that I dislike this white tea.  I love other Good Earth tea products, with the decaf green tea and organic decaf green tea with mango being my favorites that I drink daily.I know the other reviewers have rated this white tea highly, but I would suggest trying a box from your local grocery before ordering in bulk.

Trying different options to replace processed sugar in my diet.  To date, I've had the most success with Agave.  Delicious...nice and sweet, no aftertaste.  I've baked both a cake and cheesecake with it successfully.  I highly recommend this product.Also, I love the squeeze bottle this comes in, it's handy.

column9: Tasty alternative to sweeteners and better than sugar!
column10: This product tastes great! I have replaced this with using sugar in coffee, and it did not change the taste! Dissolves quickly. Works great with cereals. Guilt free sweetener! I tell everyone and WILL buy more!!

Very satisfied (again) with this sugar alternative that studies show does not spike blood sugar/insulin. I use it every morning in coffee. Doesn't have the strong taste like honey, so the java flavor is not influenced! Since it is a slightly thick liquid, it immediately blends w/ a quick stir. This company served me very well. The product arrived in zip-lock baggies, so if a seal had broken (which it didn't) it would have been contained. Thank you for a great product at a great price and great service.

This Chai Tea has excellent flavor and I have enjoyed many Chai Teas. This one for Keurig is by far one of the best I have enjoyed over the years. Thanks.

column9: Celestial Seasonings Devonshire English Breakfast Black Tea
column10: I highly recommend the English Breakfast Black Tea. I'm not real big on tea most of the time but I give this one 5 stars. Don't be shy and try it.
I was skeptical thinking this tea might not have a bold enough flavor.  It is instead very flavorful with just the right amount of spice.
Celestial Seasons has one of my favorite K-Cup teas in English Breakfast tea.  I am a repeat customer in buying this brand of tea.

I think the Bigelow is my slight favorite, but this is good tea. No aftertaste and nor are there grounds in the bottom of the cup. The price on this one puts everything to shame. Usually the K-cups are more expensive, so this is a bargain. Get it now.
This tea reminds me of the spicy Christmas concoctions my mother made years ago. Fresh and spicy, but not hot-spicy, it's wonderful served hot or cold.
This is an excellent green tea. I enjoy this brand and one from Biglow.I would recommend this tea to anyone who likes green tea. And it is organic for those of you who are into that stuff.
I generally like Chai Tea, however, this one is very, very strong for use in the Keurig. I would suggest watering it down or something.
This tea is bold and smooth at the same time.  If you are a lover of Chai, buy this. Easy to use with Keurig and no artificial sweetners or additions to take away from the tea.

column9: green tea dream...easy quick great hot or cold
column10: Love it....so quick....I can fix it if I want it hot or if i am in the mood for a cold drink. I do recommend you give it a try....

I love this stuff! I add sugar and half and half and get a drink that is very much like Starbucks Chai Latte. The price on the product has gone up since I ordered it on Jan. 7th 2011 -- so, I ordered the CS Indian Spice Chai tea bags instead. I put 2 teabags in MY K-Cup and it tastes exactly the same. If I want the tea a bit stronger, I will remove the tea bags after brewing from the my k-cup and throw them in my mug. Let is steep a bit longer and it is wonderful!
I like Indian chai tea and this teas was very flavourful, not too strong easy to work in my new Cuisinart coffee machine.

column9: Celestial Green Tea with White Tea for smooth taste is a win!
column10: The BEST green tea I have ever tasted. Extremely smooth and great taste! Tastes better than from a tea bag!
This is the only chai brand that i've tried so far but it seems to be very good. nicely spiced. not to strong or weak.
I was thinking this would be a nice break from the normal tea.  However it is a bit too spicy for my taste. Unless you really like the spice chai, I wouldn't recommend this tea.
Be sure when you order this product that you do not want the latte. It was my first order with the K-Cups and I ordered the wrong thing.
This tea taste and smells awful and there is no return, be careful before you buy it, try a smaller version of it.

What I was expecting was a chai tea similar to one I find in popular coffee houses: a spiced tea infused with cream and sugar. This tea smells wonderful but the taste when you are drinking it is very plain to me. Also it is missing the cream and sugar elements so it has none of the flavor and body of a coffee house chai. I've also tried three other chais from Timothy's, Bigelow and Gloria Jean's and had the same reaction to them all during my side by side taste test. The K-cup chais are simply not the same as the coffee house chais. To approximate the coffee house chai you'll need to add your own cream/milk and sugar/honey and give it a little shake.

column9: expensive and a waste of plastic
column10: $15 for 24 servings??  that is crazy, especially that you can get green teas in a box cost a few bucks.  Also, the plastic cups go in landfill.  i will never buy these cups again.

column9: Delicious with 5 spice aromas, not full of sugar and cream
column10: This India Spice Chai while brewing fills the whole room with wonderful aromas of nutmeg, cinnamon, ginger, and cloves almost like the Chinese 5 spice blend.  There is no added sugar or cream so if you want that go with Cafe Escapes Chai Latte K-Cups for Keurig Coffee Machines - 16 Pack.  Those k-cups which are delicious as well have the cream that many expect in a chai tea.  This particular brand of Celestial Seasonings is just tea.  You can add what you want after the fact.  I've not had any trouble with the packaging, nor having the tops flop off while brewing.  This is just a nice cup of spiced tea.  It's not peppery and won't offend or be too spicy for most. I really like it and highly recommend.

column9: Converted me to tea over coffee - it's that good
column10: Before buying my Keurig brewer, I never really like black tea.  I would drink herbal tea from tme to time but black tea always seemed too bitter.  After trying Celestial Seasonings English Breakfast Tea, I was instantly converted.  There is no bitter taste and it's so much less acidic than coffee and therefore much easier on my stomach.  It has a mild, slightly fruity taste that is perfect with breakfast or really anytime of day.  I've tried it plain and with a bit of milk and sugar as well.  I honestly have become more of a tea drinker than coffee drinker since trying this delicious tea.

The India Spice Chai is delicious!  I usually buy the Chai Latte (which I love), but decided to try the Chai tea.  This is not a creamy drink like the Chai Latte.  It is a regular tea.  The spice blend is delicious.  The aroma is divine!  Try this, you won't be sorry.

I drink this tea nearly every day (sometimes twice) and really like the flavor.  With the health benefits of green tea, and the convenience of the Keurig, I drink more of it now than I used to when I did the wait/brew/wait/brew thing with old fashioned tea.  I highly recommend it.
Yum Yum Yum...  I love Chai Tea and this was closest to Starbucks.  Of course I dress it up with a bit of almond milk.

I love my Keurig and use it every day, several times a day. My mum was born in England and is VERY particular about the taste of her tea. I got her to try this and she really liked it. I love it! True tea lovers will like this tea. It is the only K cup tea I will drink.

I'm not a hot tea connoisseur, but I am a big iced tea drinker and occasional hot tea drinker.  These K-cups makes some of the best tea I've had anywhere and I've started to actually crave it.  I set the brewer for 12 ounces and it makes the tea about the right strength for my taste.  The 8 ounce setting also does fine.  Highly recommended.

This green tea is delicious. My new diet calls for green tea or coffee only. I am not a coffee drinker and usually drink ice tea. This green tea is perfect hot or cold! I use Stevia and it taste perfect. With the cooler months upon us, this will make a great hot drink to sip on...not to mention the benefits of green tea! Buy it...you won't be disappointed!

Taste is what it's all about and this tea not only tastes very good but is a welcome change to the morning coffee.  These Green Tea cups (IMHO )provide just the right brewing strength. Another plus is that you don't have to wait for the tea to brew. Using the 10oz setting is just right for me. If you want a stronger brew then use the 8oz setting.

column9: Where's The Cardamon?  Prepare for the Cloveaload!
column10: If the only chai you know is from a chai flavored latte at a coffee shop, this might be a good tea for you.  If you have an Indo-Pakistani family like me, the first thing you'll say after tasting this is "this is NOT chai tea."  There isn't even the slightest hint of cardamon in this tea.  As it is, it should be called "spicy clove tea."  This tea is heavily seasoned with cloves--I can't agree with any of the reviews that talk about cinnamon or other spices.  It's just cloves, cloves, and more cloves.  I guess that's what I get for looking for a simple chai-flavored tea. Real chai contains Milk, Sugar, loose black tea, cardamon, and a tiny amount of other spices according to region.  Cardamon and strong tea should be the dominant flavors.  Check the wikipedia article on Masala Chai for the original chai and how the American chai is a just a strange revision.  I'm sure that my fellow sugar-loving Americans would love to have a cup of super-sweet traditional chai, so I don't really understand why the flavor has been changed so drastically.I was hoping to add milk and sugar to this to get a "traditional" Indian Chai, but I'm going to have to try again with another brand.  For all the people out there who know what Indo-Pakistani Chai tastes like, I'll be reviewing each of the "chai" K-Cups according to how they resemble the original.

column9: Great for regular chai or latte
column10: I love this chai, and it makes a much better chai latte than I've tried in any k-cup before.  To be clear, this doesn't come with powdered milk or cream, so you have to add your own cream in order to make it a latte.I have disliked all of the pre-mixed latte k-cups I've tried because of a combination of artificial sweatener (which they all seem to insist on adding) and the powdered creamer (which is worse than fresh).  I add my own sugar and cream to this chai, and it is delicious!When I tried this without cream and sugar, it tasted slightly heavy on the clove.  With the cream and sugar, though, I don't have any complaints.

I love Chai Tea.  I don't even put sugar or honey in my Chai Tea.  This was just not right.  Tasted burnt out of the keurig and the cloves are overpowering.  No amount of honey and milk could make this right for me.  I am suffering through my 24-pack and may just throw it out.  Very disappointing.  I've had this brand/flavor in the bags before (although not recently) and liked it just fine.  Even bought it multiple times.  Not sure what is not working right with the k-cup formula.

Just received my new coffee maker as a gift. One of the sample K-Cups was this black tea. I set it at 8 ounces.It was so delicious, with a bit of sugar and a bit of cream. I love Red Label English Breakfast Tea and this was as good or even better. Do not be afraid of this tea, you will not regret it. No bitter bite from over processing, just yummmmmmmmm!

I prefer tea that is not steeped too long. This tea is the closest I have found to the way I would make it myself. I run it through the Keurig twice, once at 10oz and once at 12 oz and it comes out exactly the way I like it. You may not prefer as weak a tea, but that can be solved by running it through only once.  It has a clean, refreshing flavor.
I drink this every morning with a tablespoon of sugar. Great tea with just the right amount of caffeine to survive the long, early mornings. Strongly recommend.

I received a Keurig machine for Christmas, so I purchased this tea yet I wasn't expecting much. Well I found that this makes the BEST CUP OF TEA!! I have to pace myself because I could just drink cup after cup it is that good!!
This black tea is delicious and I have found that reusing the cup doesn't affect the flavor until the 4th or 5th cup.

I love this tea! My wife is usually the big tea drinker in the house but after trying this in my Keurig I have to say I LOVE it. I didn't purchase through amazon though because I got the same amount 24 in a box for only 9.99 elsewhere but I would recommend it to anyone.

I love k-cups. They're pretty cool, and I like the idea of them, but I don't like sacrificing the flavor just for the sake of a cup. The tea tastes very watered down for some reason. And I am a tea drinker who doesn't add sugar/honey because I enjoy the natural sweetening properties in the actual herbs. But this herbal tea is missing something, especially with a name like 'Authentic Green Tea'. It's pretty disappointing for the price of these things, but I'll continue to drink it until I run out.

Length:: 2:06 MinsCelestial Seasonings english breakfast black tea is delicious both hot or as iced tea. The tea has a faint perfume but not overwhelming. I like different teas but find this one to be the best for hot and cold. I love that I can control the strength of the tea. Hot I prefer the medium button, cold, I use the largest cup button. Either way I get a perfect serving of tea.
Great tea and a great bargain if you own a K cup machine. Buy your coffee or tea at Amazon. The prices are great and the service is great. Ordering from Amazon direct is seamless.
This is my favorite tea for the Keurig brewer.  I do not like, and therefore don't drink, flavored tea.  This is the tea I prefer.  I have not been able to get in stores lately so I ordered online.
I use this tea as an ice tea instead of a breakfast tea. It is really refreshing and allows me to make one cup of ice tea at a time. If you find it a little strong you can add more ice or ice water.
I love this tea...and I am not really a tea person, but this is a great drink and it is a very tasty treat.

column9: A little weak at the 12 oz mug, but still tasty
column10: I use the Keurig Platinum (B70) brewer and the 12 oz. brew size. This K-Cup is a little weak at the 12 oz. size, but still enjoyable, as I usually make it a latte. For comparison, a Tazo Chai tea bag makes a slightly stronger cup at 12 oz than the Celestial Seasonings K-Cup. Compared to Timothy's Chai K-Cup, Celestial's Chai is stronger (which I prefer).

Wanted to sample the K-cups. Previously a "tea bag" user for the same product.  Will stick with the tea bags, as the tea is not only more fragrant, but extremely flavorful. Will not purchase K-cups again.
This is a very nice chai...doesn't taste like I thought it would..has a very strong spice taste..but still very good.
this tea is wonderfully spicy.  great on a cold afternoon! It would also be lovely with milk, but I prefer it plain.

column9: licorice taste, twinings chai is much better
column10: I am really disappointed in this chai tea. It has a distinct licorice taste. Twinings chai tea is much better. Do not buy unless you like a licorice taste.
This Tea is really good. It comes in an easy to use container.  Its not very sweet so if you want your tea really sweet you may need to add something. Good produxt.
This is very good and makes the house smell wonderful.  I would defintely recommend this to anyone just wanting a quick tea.
This is my favorite K Cup overall!  I love the flavor the the tea and it brews just right on the medium setting.

column9: Celestial India spice chai tea k-cups
column10: I brew this in a keurig 60 model, i like this tea, its good any time of the year. It is on the spicy side and will leave your pallet with a spicy after taste. But oh so good late at night. Good tea for every once in a while, i could not drink this every day as is a little on the strong side.

This tea is the reason why I bought a Keurig. It's my absolute favorite. I make a cup each morning to take with me to work (anyone who works a 9-5 needs a pick me up!). I usually re-order two boxes every couple of months, and my package always arrives quickly. I'll be buying these k-cups as long as they're available!
This is the best Chai I have found for my Keurig. It is not overly sweet like another kind I tried. It smells and tastes wonderful. Great on a cold night!
This is not even tea, it is not even as good as dipping a tea bag in the cup once. It's You'll be drinking hot water with sugar and honey.
I get this for my wife who really loves it.  I am not a tea drinker, other than ice tea.
This is a good Strong Tea. The Flavor is a nice blend not to strong and not weak. Smells great when brewing. You can add milk or drink it plain.
Great tea for the Keurig.  We love it!  Now for a good cocoa and apple cider.(Don't get the Green Mountain cider)

I have purchased the Celestial Seasonings Chai Tea tea bags in the grocery store, and was impressed with the flavor. So when I saw they had them in the K-cups, I immediately jumped on them and ordered a box. I was so disappointed in it. It tastes nothing like their regular tea bag version. Weak is a word I would use. And I'm not sure what kind of spices they put it in, but it's nothing like any other chai tea I've had. I do not recommend this brand. If you're a regular chai drinker, you will notice the difference and likely be disappointed.

This stuff is surprisingly strong and potent. I've always had a problem with chai tea bags because they brew such a dilute cup of tea. But with the Celestial Seasonings Keurig chai, the tea is dark and opaque. I got a huge buzz off of the caffeine. Best of all, it's pure tea and spices, unlike the Cafe Escapes Chai Latte, which is full of artificial ingredients.
I like the tea - but I noticed both an aroma and flavor of clove? I don't think this is ONLY green tea. That being said, I like it and most likely will reorder.

I'm an avid chai drinker--many different varieties of both lattes and straight black tea.  We purchased this product because we noticed that the Cafe Escapes chai lattes--a sweeter, creamier blend--did not actually have much black tea in it, and we still wanted our morning caffeine.  Neither my husband nor I could finish one mug of this stuff, and we will end up getting rid of the box.  It was that awful. There was none of the subtle spice blending--just a watery slightly clove-tasting flavor undercut by a bitterness that almost had hints of coffee. Adding a little milk, as we usually do, didn't help at all.  If you enjoy chai, I'd recommend Bigalow or Tazo and skip this one.
Smells nice but the flavor is weak.  I don't think the Keurig brewers really work for tea.  Good tea needs to be steeped, not just filtered like coffee.
There is a very strong clove flavor in this tea. I like my tea black and did not enjoy it very much. My friend from work added cream and sugar to it and thought it was great.
I usually order Twinings tea, but I thought I'd try something different. This Celestial Seasonings version of English Breakfast is very good, and I will make it part of my usual rotation.

I've tried several brands of black tea and I liked this one the most because I liked the taste of it:A) plainB) with sugarC) with lemon - iced or hotD) creamThe others I tried had a slight (to me) floral taste that didn't mix well with cream or lemon.

column9: The best that I've tried of the K-Cup tea offerings
column10: I've been drinking tea for years mostly for health reasons.  We recently bought a Keurig so I tried this black tea with our new brewer.  It had a nice full body taste and I found it had a better taste than the green tea varities I tried.
THIS IS SO GOOD!  I've had it hot and iced and am in love!  The chai flavor isn't overpowering, but you certainly know you are drinking a spiced tea!  I will definitely reorder!
I did not like any of the brew over iced tea flavors so i tried this and love it.  Would definately recommend for iced or hot tea.

I have always wanted to try brewing real English tea. I bought these for my Keurig, and they were so, so much better than my normal tea bags.  They may not be as good as real, brewed tea, but I think they're delicious.
This tea has a bitter taste that I didn't like.  I am fond of the Gloria Jeans chai tea that Amazon has been out of for a LONG time and will wait for that before trying anything else

column9: Great English tea for Keurig coffee maker
column10: I bought the Keurig coffee make to make coffee for guests but I now primarily use it to enjoy hot tea for myself.  This brand of tea is just to my liking and the price was reasonable with no shipping charges.  Win-win.
Great flavor, no bitterness and a wonderful way to start the day!Have purchased additional packages of this product since first tasting it when I purchased my Kuerig coffee maker.

Celestial Seasonings  English Breakfast Black Tea, K-Cup Portion Pack for Keurig K-Cup Brewers, 24-CountThis tea has a great, smooth flavor. Even my husband, who is not a tea drinker, enjoys a cup of this.
This tea is fine, but not a chai favorite for me.  I don't think that I would purchase it again, but I will finish up the box.

column9: Lacks flavor and taste of Green Tea
column10: I recently purchased this hoping it would be good. I love Green Tea and enjoy trying different varieties. I was not too thrilled with this kind. It lacked flavor, was plain and just didn't have a strong green tea taste. I'd rather spend a little more for something that tastes more like green tea.

The India Spice Chai is a great tea.  I've tried a lot of different brands of Chai and hadn't found any until this one that compared to the kind I made with the actual spices in a pan.  I normally add a little milk and brown sugar to it after it's brewed, but it's very good tasting alone as well.

I bought these mainly for my husband to take to work in the morning, he usually uses actual teabags. So these were going to be the easy solution. However they were not as good as the actual teabags we have. Just wasn't his "cup of tea"

I stumbled upon Celestial Seasonings Green Tea k-cups at my workplace, and since have fallen in love.  For a nice, quick cup of green tea, I haven't found any better solution.  I have fancier or more old fashioned tea brewing methods that I use when I have more time, but I default to this green tea when I need a quick fix.Now about the tea specifically - I have tried other green tea k-cups (competing brands), and none have been as clean-tasting and crisp as Celestial Seasonings.  I will continue to purchase this brand for my green tea needs.

The Celestial Seasonings authentic green tea k-cup is very good.  One K-cup makes adequate flavor of 9.25 oz. of hot tea.  Most of the k-cup assorted coffee produces light, watery coffee at 7.25 oz., but this green tea has  good color and taste even at the max. 9.25 oz.  I would recommend this green tea k-cup.

I enjoy chai tea very much and my partner drinks only tea, no coffee. So when we purchased our Keurig, we wanted to try several varieties of chai to find the perfect one. I shopped on amazon and bought several types with  reviews, cost, recognizable brand and speed of shipping being accounting factors ( in that order).Pros: Quick delivery  The description is accurate and you get exactly what is advertised  Known brand  Fresh  The price is moderateCons: I mention price here again because it is cheaper in other forms ( tea bags)I prefer a non milk based Chai and so this was the ideal for me. I added sugar some days and drank it plain others and both were satsifying. My partner and I both enjoyed it above all the other flavors and I will reccomend and share with friends and family. I will continue to shop and attempt to find a better price, but would pay this again because it is worth it.

I tried this because I can't seem to find the Gloria Jean Serenity Tea which I liked very much.  The Celestial Seasonings was very very bland.  I even tried it on the smallest cup, and it made no difference.  There is no authentic flavor here.  I was brought up drinking green tea.  I especially like the Yama Moto brand green tea, but wanted something quick and easy in a k-cup. I like the Celestial Seasonings Mandarin Spice so I thought I would try the green tea.  I realize that coffee and tea are a personal preference.  For me, this green tea missed the mark completely.

Great Keurig tea pods.  This is not chai latte, so don't expect white milky beverages.  This is just tea flavored with chai spices.  I suppose if you add hot milk you could make a decent chai latte though, but I haven't tried it yet.  Very bright flavors, but not overpowering.
I have been looking for just a pain black tea with no flavors.  I finally found it.  I think it is my favorite tea. Not crazy about the flavored teas.  I use it for both iced tea and hot tea.
This is a great tea. Very smooth. I don't even use sweetener with it, but it isn't bitter at all. If you like tea, you will love this one.
Excellent tea and very enjoyable after a long day at the office.  also great on cold winter days and some R&R while crafting.
this tea was very good,love it and would buy this product again soon. this is my all time favorite of all teas.

column9: Love, Love Celestial Seasonings English Breakfast Black Tea K-Cups
column10: I can not express how much I looove the Celestial Seasoning English Breakfast Tea K-Cups!!!  When I purchased my Keurig, I was drinking Bigelow's English Breafast tea bags which I opened and used in the My K-Cup.  I had a rebate deal that sent me 2 boxes of the Celestial Seasoning tea K-Cups and I've been hooked ever since!The Celestial Seasonings is much smoother than the Bigelow. I'm a purest when it comes to my black tea, I don't like too many other flavors superseding the tea.I wish I could get this in tea bags too (to carry in my purse when at restaurants, at friends houses and what not)!The Celestial Seasonings English Breakfast is just an super-enjoyable cup of tea!

The taste is alright.  I love vanilla chai tea and I thought I would try this.  I added a lot of cream to it after it brewed and then it was more to my liking.  Next time I'm considering adding a drop of vanilla extract, I have a feeling that will do the trick.

I was disappointed when I drank my first k cup ice tea.  I love iced tea, however I do not like lemon in my tea at all - I just want the taste of the tea leaves.  The Celestial English Breakfast Black Tea has a lemon flavoring added.  Ugh ... I was really hopeful I could brew a glass of ice tea with my Keurig.  It is not bad tasting at all - it is just not what I prefer.
I really like his tea because it is mild and has a great taste and it taste good hot or cold. also you can brew the cup for 2 cups if you want
Product was as described. The green tea flavor is okay, it can be a bit strong unless you prefer stronger flavors. I would purchase it again.
This is a full bodied English Breakfast Tea. It is the one I drink when I don't need to drink a decaf tea. It is the best !!!

column9: Perfect Cup of Tea (Hot or Cold)
column10: This is the best tea I have ever tasted at home.  The flavors are blended perfectly.  I like to fill a cup with ice then do a quick brew with the Keurig Machine.  No need to add sugar or cream.  I just wish I could find a comparable decaf so I could have an excellent nighttime cup of tea before sleeping.
This tea tastes amazing!  It is not too strong or too weak.  It has great flavor, it it smells divine!

K Cups over all are a little pricey compared to just buying the regular product, I know! But the machine you use to make it ain't exactly cheap either! Having said that... this cup of Green Tea comes out perfect and yummy every time!Waiting for Celestial Seasonings to make more of my favorite flavors of tea in K-Cups!

I recently bought a Keurig Coffee maker because my husband and I love our coffee and tea, but sometimes want different drinks on certain days and this coffee maker fit the bill. We both enjoy this Green Tea. Likely the best of teas that I have tried so far. They arrived sooner than expected and arrived as described. Happy with the service and the product.

column9: Tastes great, good price and fast service
column10: This tea has a good flavor--not too strong or too weak. It isn't as great as say a fresh looseleaf but is comparable to Twinnings' Eng Breakfast.

I am not normally a hot tea drinker, but my Keurig makes it easy to experiment and try new things. This tea tastes great hot or cold so it has become my favorite tea.  It has a great taste and no bitterness that some black teas have.  Plus, I prefer to sweeten my own tea instead of having it presweetened for me.

Received it quickly.  Box my Tea K-cups came in were the universal boxes for all Teas with the label of the correct "Flavor".  At first, I thought I had received the wrong item.  It had pictures of fruit & flowers and I had just order Black Tea.  Packaging not the same.  Only "complaint" was box, but the correct product was received.

I'm more of a tea drinker than coffee. I am sick and needed some hot tea so my wife bought these English Breakfast Tea K-Cups for me while she was at the store. This is a tasty tea that can be enjoyed at anytime, not just for breakfast.  it has good flavor and fresh brewed aroma.
A little fishy tasting but I'm hoping for the health benefits of green tea and it is enjoyable for a good summer drink.
We got this as a sample in our new keurig elite. I plan on buying many more! Even my 6 year old likes drinking this with me. If you like tea, you can't go wrong with this!
This tea is GREAT!!!  Hot it is great morning treat! Just add ice, lemon and lime slices and makes a REFRESHING SUMMERTIME drink!!

This is my favorite of the K-Cup Chai recipes. The spices are balanced though fairly strong allowing this tea to hold up well with the additions of honey (or sugar) and milk. It's wonderful served hot or cold. For the cold version, add your honey (or sugar) and milk, stir, and then pour over ice. When doing the iced version, I find it works best brewed on the 6oz size and then poured over ice in a 24oz glass. I prefer this to the Chai Latte K-Cups because I can control the amount of sweetener and milk.
Great flavor.  Just enough spice.  A love Chai Tea Latte flavor also, but this is nice when you feel like something lighter.  I will purchase more!
We use this tea in the Kourig to make iced tea.  Just brew, then pour over a full cup of ice.  Easy, convenient and delicious.

column9: not the best chai tea I've tasted
column10: This India spice chai tea wasn't my favorite purchase. In fact, I am thinking I would relist the unused teas in the container and get rid of it. Hopefully someone out there loves it. It's almost a new box.

I'm not fond of diet drinks, but I cannot bring myself to drink regular.  This is a perfect in-between drink, with loads of flavor and only 4 grams of sugar.  The flavors are light and pleasing to my palate, no nasty fake sugar aftertaste.  This is saying alot because I have several boxes of truvia at home and can't bring myself to use them in my coffee.  I highly recommend this, and am ordering it for myself and my husband to take to work, and drink on hot days.It has a light, tropical flavor, with a gentle citrus aftertaste.  I'm sold, only 30 calories per packet.
This product is GREAT!  My Vet suggested it ... my dog loves them ;o)  They came fast and the price was cheaper than my Vet. Thank you Amazon

My dog loves these treats. The vet recommended them, but he didn't always have them available. I was so happy when we found them at Amazon.com.

column9: Treats to Keep Your Spoiled Friend Trim...
column10: My little Boston terrier loves them; it's all about the food with her and I'm glad I can give her Lean Treats when I am smitten by her adorable face without feeling like I'm doing her harm.  She's managed to keep her good figure for 2 years after her spay, and I feel they're helping.  So glad I can get these treats that I first saw at the vet's office!!

Ordering Lean Treats online proved to be wonderful.  I do not have to worry about getting to my vet when he is open.  I also liked that I could order many packages of a treat that my dog loves.  I will be ordering these again.

These are the best treats for those who have to give their dog daily pills.  They are very pliable and fully surround the pill so you can give this to your dog without them being aware of their pill taking!!  These are a must and more than worth their weight in gold!
My dogs love these treats. They have been very helpful in getting our disabled dachshund to start moving around in her wheeled cart. Our vet sells them too

column9: Works great and is easy to use
column10: Length:: 5:00 MinsThe ekobrew cup is a great alternative to buying tons of expensive k-cups. It's easy to use and good for the environment. I love some of the k-cup flavors, and I still use them too, especially on weekends when I want to brew and go, but this is a good alternative to save a few bucks as they are easy to use - no harder than using a drip coffee filter, and they make a really good cup of coffee with the keurig.
We found that the cup makes a nice strong cup of coffee, it is easy to clean. The only drawback is that it tends to overflow and leak over the top making it a bit messy.

If you have a Keurig or are about to purchase one, you MUST get these refillable cups as well. I love the simplicity of the Keurig and being able to make one cup of coffee at a time. However, I could not stand the plastic waste of each of the tiny k-cups for the machine. Also I wanted to be able to select my own coffees to use in the machine. Some of the samples and brands that are sold to use with this machine are simply terrible!! But with these cups you simply fill the cup with your own coffee, empty, rinse and reuse. Get the 2-pack so that you can use one and fill one at the same time.

column9: My coffee is better AND less expensive
column10: I was skeptical. Would these refillable cups last with daily use?  I am pleased to report; they have done very well.  I have been using the brown cup for coffee, for about 6 months.  It does leak a bit around the lid if I over-fill the cup with coffee. I get the results I want using just one scoop of coffee and I see little or no leaking around the lid.  The mesh screen does allow more sediment to pass into my cup when I use pre-ground coffee.The best part: I can use my favorite coffee.  I can use my small batch roaster to make coffee my way and still enjoy the convenience and consistent quality provided by the Keurig system.If these cups wear out before my Keurig machine, I will replace them at once!

I bought these after my husband and I bought our keurig machine at Christmas.  We didn't like how expensive K-cups were, how wasteful they were, and that the beans we prefer weren't available in a cup.  So I got these hoping to meet in the middle.  It was the perfect solution.  After 8 mos of 3x per day use, one of them is finally in need of replacing ... it no longer snaps shut, so I'm replacing with another set.  I am EXTREMELY happy with the purchase.  The cups are simple to use, clean easily, and work great.  They make a VERY strong cup of coffee if filled to the filling point, which for us is great, but others may want to scale it back a little.  You do end up with a little bit of "grit" at the bottom of your cup where some particulate settles, but it's not full grounds, and since we also like french press coffee, that's something we are use to.

I was skeptical after using the Keurig brand filter.  this filter works great.  I can use my own coffee and save money over buying the K-cups.  I drink starbucks and Peets so this helps greatly.  A much have.

Ordered 2 sets for 4 of these, have used for a few weeks now and they work well. Most Keurig owners should use these to save money on K-Cups and can use their favorite ground coffee again. Easy to fill, easy to clean, just rinse under running water. Makes a great cup of coffee. Only reason for 4 stars is the price. I think Ekobrew could do away with the fancy cardboard cylinder packaging and instead offer a 6 pack for $20.

Quite simply these work like a charm. I like to brew my own (Star-you-know-what) and don't want to get ripped off by the prices of the store bought Kcups, so I thought I'd give these a try. They are awesome and work great. Be forewarned that you need to get your coffee ground with a "press grind". If you use a finer grind, the coffee won't flow nearly as well due to the fine grinds packing as it trying to shoot the water through it. I ordered a 2-pack, which works out great because you can set a used one on the counter with the lid up to let the grinds dry out while you're using the other one. The dry grinds empty from the used one easier than wet grinds do. I believe the manufacturer also recommends washing these with soap every once in a while to remove the oils from the fine mesh screens to help improve, or keep, the proper flow rate. 5 stars for sure. And oh, my machine is a Platinum Keurig.

Great concept, but thus far not so great coffee! We have tried good old Folgers Classic as well as freshly ground 8 O'Clock coffees. We have always enjoyed both brands, but we have yet to find the right combination of grinds/water with this system. Both have come out very weak. An additional peeve is the cost! The packaging and marketing babble is more costly than the little bit of plastic required for the filters! Talk about over marketing!
Good stuff.  Have purchased twice now. Can't use real half & half and most restaurants use half & half.

column9: Nice watered-down organic juice for little hands
column10: Like most kids, my daughter adores juice, but I worry about her drinking too much of it.  This juice is cut with filtered water, so she is consuming less juice but doesn't realize it.  The boxes are quite small.  She likes the little Bernstein bear pictures on it and thinks she is getting a special treat.This product is great because it's all water and organic juice, no other "junk" inside like artificial colors or flavors.Overall, it's a nice product!
No point in buying these, the juice is so watered down it's basically a water box w/ a little juice for color.  My girls refused to drink these.

column9: Good juice for a good price.
column10: My three year old drinks one every day.  They have less (natural) sugar and fewer calories than Apple and Eve Elmo fruit punch.  Maybe they add more water?  Regardless, I still like this juice.

column9: Great Concept, Need to Work On Flavor
column10: My children just did not like this juice.  All three of them said that the flavor was bad.  They refused to drink them, so that is why the one star review.

column9: Great quality at a reasonable price
column10: My local supermarket sells one ounce bags of dried oyster mushrooms for four dollars.  For a little bit more than twice the price, you get a whole pound.  They rehydrate back to near fresh quality.  I boil some water in the microwave and soak the mushroonms for about 20 minutes.  At that point, you can use the liquid to fortify a soup or gravy and cook the mushrooms as desired.Angelina's packs these in a plastic bag inside a cardboard box.  Four boxes fill a carton and save on shipping charges.  I mixed it up and got some Woodear, First Quality - 1 Lb Bag / Box Each, BOLETES, CHILEAN, FIRST QUALITY,(DRIED) 1 lb. and BLEND, NORTHWOODS,MUSHROOM(DRIED) 1 lb..  I would like to get LOBSTER,MUSHROOM,(DRIED) 1 lb. or Dried Morel Mushrooms 1 Lb. Bag but I can't justify the high price.I am pleased with all of the products I received from Angelina's and will order again.

column9: Excellent quality re-hydrate in a flash
column10: These are excellent quality dried mushrooms. They rehydrate in hot water (no need to use boiling hot water) in no time at all. Being dried, they of course are not the same taste or texture as fresh oyster mushrooms, but they are great - just different. Just like a dried fruit isn't the same as a fresh one, just different. I found no dirt, pebbles or sticks in them. Some of the other mushrooms from this vendor have rocks and twigs in them - not these.

OYSTER MUSHROOMS,(DRIED) 1 lb.Very good product quality. These rehydrate and cook up fantastically. The seller's packaging was far and away the best I've ever received. I will purchase from Angelina's again for certain...

I purchased 2lbs. Shipping was prompt and the packaging professional. Now to what is important, taste and texture is perfect, you can't go wrong with this. The mushrooms are very tender and meaty as they should be, none of the tough rubbery dehydrated types.Also, as another poster mentioned, one pound is a lot when purchased dried. Enjoy
These are really good. Excellent substitute for fresh mushrooms, after they're rehydrated and cooked a bit, you really can't tell the difference. Very good flavor, and an excellent value.

I love these mushrooms.  They are easy to reconstitute and one can use them in lots of recipes.  They are very meaty, almost like meat.  I use them in all kinds of soups, chili, scrambled eggs and rice dishes.  Great product!

It has great flavor and caffeine free-- it's perfect!I've tried other brands of lemon tea and they haven't been as good.I like rrrrreally strong tea, so I steep it for an hour then reheat it.  I do that with all my teas.I will continue to buy this on amazon because my local grocery store doesn't stock it.  It's worth it!

column9: Pretty solid decaf for a Keurig coffee maker
column10: Drat! I have just been ordered to reduce my intake of caffeine. So much for my K-cup (with caffeine) to start the day followed by a 20 ounce (with caffeine) coffee at work. What to do? My approach? Move to decaf.My first experiment with a K-cup decaffeinated coffee is Newman's Own Organic Special Decaf.I'm not really excited about decaf, but orders are orders! So, trying this has been a rather pleasant surprise. I would have wished for a bolder more distinct taste, but the taste is pretty smooth and the coffee is pretty good. If I have to drink decaf, in short, this will do nicely.

I always liked coffee before, but never drank it daily.  Now I drink up to three cups a day.  Love this stuff.  And it's just too easy to brew.  An added benefit is that when I have a cup of coffee in my hand, it's easier to stay on a diet.  Instead of reaching for something to eat, I sip this coffee.  There's always a fresh cup that is delicious and satisfying.  (Not being a coffee connoisseur, I did not appreciate the subtleties that subconsciously had been turning me away from coffee in the past -- a cup that is less than fresh might not taste "bad" but it does not call out to me and say: "Drink me!")  This coffee is so easy and so good, I fear I am becoming addicted.  Organic K-cups are not easy to find.  I haven't found them yet in supermarkets.  The Newman brand is the roundest and tastiest of any I have tried, and the decaf is great.

I have always considered Newman's Own products to be quite good, so I was excited to try out this coffee.  I was dissapointed from the first sip. The taste is weak, like really watered down coffee. I'm going back to Emerils Jazzed Up Decaf. I also understand that Newman's Own, is actually produced by Green Mountain Coffee Co.
We love Paul Newman coffee.  We were happy to see we could purchase it online and enjoy every drop.  We think it's the best!
Newman's Special Decaf is a great coffee.Good flavor. Smooth and rich. Smells great. Can't tell it from caffinated coffee. It's my favorite K-CUP
This is one of our coffees of choice. Both of us like a stronger brew for openers, but this is our choice for second cup and one all of our friends enjoy too.
My wife and I were very disappointed in the quality, flavor and boldness, of Newman's Own Organics decaf coffee K-cups.Very bland compared to other brands.

For me this is the best decaf.  The fact that it is organic and a safer choice is a plus. I actually like it better than a lot of caffeinated coffees that I have tried.  Just to state the obvious, is hard to pick coffees from reviews as we all have individual tastes.

column9: Only 1 of 2 paid for showed up
column10: I paid for a package of two...the wrapping says 2 packs of 24, but someone cut it open and retaped it.  There was only 1 package of Newman's Organic in the box.  You owe me another box of coffee or $30.

I would recommend this puppy food!  We have a puppy that got off to a sad start.  We found him along an interstate with a broken shoulder and was malnourished. After surgery on his shoulder and good nutrition with Hills Science Diet, he is a thriving, healthy and happy guy!

column9: More Science Diet on Prime Please
column10: As a frequent Amazon shopper, I purchase nearly everything for my household on Amazon.  I use Amazon Mom & Subscribe and Save almost everyday.  I would love to also purchase my dog's food on Amazon through Prime.  It would be great if Amazon offered Hill's Science Diet Small & Toy Breed Adult Dry Dog Food.

We bought this product since it was recommended to help solve the problem of the dog having terrible terrible gas. The dog is a picky eater and would let food sit on his plate. Now he eats all of this dog food. Gas is still bad but it Is not as frequent.

Great high protein snack with just a little sweetness.  Fantastic for those on low carb diets and also for people concerned with keeping blood sugar levels constant.  Can't beat the combination of low cal and high protein.
this product is horrible. no one in my house will touch it. it has a very strange after taste.  i'll never buy it again and would never recommend it to anyone.

I love the taste of these things.  I have been a complete chip addict my whole life.  In fact one of my first memories was of eating Pringles!  But now I must watch my carbs for my health.  These are far too expensive (thus the 4 star rating), but I love to eat them.

These really are delicious and great for low-carb eaters.  They are pricey.  I feel it is a bit deceptive that nowhere in the description is the volume or weight of product listed.  How can one judge whether to make a purchase with just a price and no statement as to the amount/weight?  When it arrives it can be a bit surprising to see the small package.

column9: Cost too much for too little
column10: The crackers are pretty good, if you an stomach the price. Great for low carb diet. You get about 15 crackers in a box. At $5.99 plus shipping, save your money for the gym.
This was *ok*.  It tasted basically like burnt Parmesan cheese... which, I happen to like.

I ordered some of each flavor from Kitchen Table Gormet Wafer Crisps and several were good. The products shipped promptly. I liked the plain and the rosemary better than any others.Something had to be wrong with the parmesan crisps, the flavor was simply awful and the people that were trying these at the office spit them out.
The British can't do anything wrong with their mints and Trebor Bassett is No exception. I love them nonetheless. Everybody should try them.

This is not what you expect it to be they are not the company to buy this from they show you one thing but when you get it  it is something else.  They charge you for a limited edition and it is not. I can get the same item for 16 dollars.  They charge 60. So Collectible Racing Books is not a place to deal with.  I am sending the item back. Don't waste your time.
I couldn't find it at my local store so I searched it online. The price was good and it shipped very fast. I was more than satisfied with this purchase.

Four days from ordering to delivery, pretty good.  I use the mustard seed in my saffron rice, usually to accompany curry dishes.  Had a hard time finding black mustard seed (Americans only seem to know the yellow and brown).  Very good quality and intense flavor.
This is exactly how an on-line transaction is supposed to work.  Effortless ordering.  Extremely quick delivery.  Product exactly as advertised.  Could not ask for more.

I discovered Wickles relish at a grocery discount store and bought the two jars they had.  Loved it and started looking for it again.  Couldn't find it locally so went to my standby, Amazon, and when I found it ordered a case.  This relish is just the right mixture of dill and sweet flavors and I'll have to say makes one of the best potato salads I have tasted, even if I happened to make it.

Basically I bought these to cut back on my spending. I make myself one of these iced coffees in the morning before work and don't need to stop at Dunkin donuts. I like the flavor and this was an excellent price. They shipped and got to my house within 4 days which still amazes me. I would definitely recommend them.

column9: The best thing that ever happened to fish
column10: This product is really good on all fish, even canned tuna.  Try it with canned tuna or salmon and mayo.  It's also real tasty on any white fish fried or baked with olive oil.
I use it when baking and grilling.  Mix it w/ mayo as a topper when baking.
Great seasoning for salmon.  Just a little bit of olive oil and this stuff and you are good to go.
We have used this seasoning on our broiled Salmon for years.  It's the best seasoning for Salmon we've ever used.  My family and friends simply rave about it eash meal.

column9: I won't eat salmon without this!
column10: This stuff is amazing! Even my mom, who doesn't like salmon generally, loves it with this spice!

column9: Salmon Magic does its name Justice
column10: I love Chef Paul Prudhomme's Magic Seasoning Blends ~ Salmon Magic!  I initially purchased it at my local grocery store but they stopped carrying it.  I was thrilled to find it on Amazon and can't live without it.  I eat salmon almost everyday and this seasoning is delicious.  You can't go wrong if you buy this item.

I don't even like salmon without this stuff anymore. Yah, it has sugar in it, and spices, which means its amazing. When I'm out, I've even tried mixing a bag of sugar and my guesses as to what else went in there. Not as good =( Don't stop making this Mr. Prudhomme, I'm warning you.Try chopping up a mango, half a peach, a tiny bit of bell pepper, throw in some cilantro, juice a lemon on top, drizzle some honey, dash of salt, and let marinade while your salmon is in the oven. Serve salsa on top, perfect mix of sweet and sour.

column9: Great stuff, just don't go over board!!!
column10: I love this stuff, it adds a very unique flavor to salmon.  My only suggestion is to not go overboard, a little goes a long way and too much and it gets too salty quick.

I tried to find out the ingredient list before I purchased this seasoning. I went to Paul's website and it didn't list the ingredients. It said this: Salmon Magic(tm), Chef Paul's newest creation, is a unique blend of carefully selected herbs and spices with subtle accents of dry mustard seeds. After I received it the first ingredient listed was Sugar. My problem is that I don't like sweet tasting food unless it's a dessert. I tried to like it but I could hardly get through dinner. If you like your food on the slightly sweet side it will probably be fine for you.P.S. I really like his Seafood and Blackened Redfish Magic.
Since we eat quite a bit of salmon we've found this seasoning to be essential to our enjoyment of it. We've never tried it on other foods, but it would probably be great on a lot of things.
This stuff is FANTASTIC.  Throw salmon in skillet, sprinkle some of this on, and voila!  Most delicious home-cooked salmon you'll ever have, no sauce necessary.

I have about 2 years using this seasoning when I make my salmon .. just add lemon juice, olive oil and the chef paul sazoning magic. after I put the grill and I have a meal as any gourmet restaurant would serve. simply recommend this product 100%

This is my favorite seasoning for Salmon!  It is the perfect compliment to Salmon and seasons it to perfection.  I have been looking for this in stores before I decided to take my search online.  I forgot how much I really loved it.  We have used quite a few of Chef Paul Prudhomme's seasonings and have never been disappointed.
It is the best salmon seasoning I've ever had!! Anyone that I've prepared grilled salmon for just loves it! Even my grandkids, who don't like anything, will eat the salmon this way.

This is a must try!!!  I put it all over my salmon and potatoes and the flavor is amazing.  Whenever I cook salmon with this seasoning I receive so many complements.  Just add a little olive oil, fresh garlic and sprinkle this seasoning all over your salmon, cook at 400 degrees for about 20-30 minutes.  Enjoy!

This stuff is amazing. I first tried it on Salmon, then chicken and potatoes, even pasta...it is absolutely hands down the best thing since sliced bread! Its great on Salmon of course, just gives it a little kick. I really like it on sliced red potatoes with a little olive oil. If my husband would let me I would probably put it on my cereal in the morning. Watch out, its addictive. Good thing amazon has it at a great price!
I really like all Paul Prudhomme seasonings. Salmon Magic is the best salmon seasoning that I have ever used. His Seafood Magic is also excellent for other fish.

We have used this seasoning for the last few years and regularly serve to guests when having Salmon.  Everyone comments on how good it is.  I was so disappointed when Costco stopped carrying it, so I had to order online!  You WON'T be disappointed. It is amazing and the larger container is the best deal!

This seller is NOT certified organic as advertised.  I was suspicious of the product and made several phone calls.  "Certified Organic"  must contain an actual label from the agency itself.  The purchased product contained no such label and instead had a description as "Certified Organic".  As much as I would like to believe that this was an oversight, Im afraid from my direct experience with the owner/seller that he was simply preying on the grey area of "Certified Organic". QAI has been informed of this misuse and false advertisement and is taking action.  If you are curious about this product, call the agencies before you decide to buy from this seller.
These candy are pretty good! The gummy texture is perfect and they don't clump together. The sugar free taste isn't so bad, doesn't taste too artificial either.
I love the taste of these, but they are definitely not carb free. Eating these caused my blood sugar to really spike.

column9: Gift for Granny, now she hates me.
column10: I got these as a gift for my grandma. I really wish there was a warning when ordering these about the gastrointestinal distress that ensues after consumption (seemingly more so than in comparison to other sugar-free products). There was no warning on the bag either!! She has spent the past two days in the bathroom (sorry, over-share) and is really mad at me. She did say they were tasty though.
They taste REALLY REALLY REALLY good going down.But they give you gas so bad you'll want to take a swan dive off a balcony.Horrible horrible horrible gas. Horrible. Don't do it to yourself. Horrible.

I always like Almond Joy but hated the almonds. Bounty is the solution! When I saw them in World Market I bought a bunch and ate them all in less than a week. They are sooooooooooo good. Easily one of my favorite candy bars. Highly recommended.

To truly appreciate Bounty bars, one would have to be into coconut and sugar in some serious ways. This stuff reminds me Malibu and milk with some chocolate tossed in. They are very sweet, and I would have to suggest going easy on them. In all honesty, I am not a big fan of coconut, but Bounty are ok in small doses.

This is WAYYYYY too expensive at $1.84 per bar. Yes, Bounty bars are the ultimate chocolate and coconut experience (especially the Dark variety) but this price is outlandish. A more resonable price would be $4.29 which represents a 20% discount from what you might pay at your local supermarket and which you don't have to wait for DAYS to receive. C'mon you british clowns, Americans are not as stupid as you think.

I'm on a very strict diet and am trying to lose about 30 pounds over a two-month period. So far, I'm down 14 and it hasn't been a month yet. I don't particularly like going hungry so I eat a lot but the stuff I eat is very low in calories (and high in fiber, I might add). It's about 90 % vegetarian except for a few sources of animal protein including Egg Beaters and Non-Fat Milk. Low calorie veggies are fairly east to find, the trick is to make them interesting. As such, I pick up a variety of pickled items. One is a large jar (32 ounces) of Frank's Quality Kraut. The smaller container shown here is exactly the same product, just a different container size. It's an excellent kraut. Fine tasting. Goes well with my other veggies and with my soy protein products. Plus, it's only five calories per serving. Can't beat it!Gary Peterson

The price is way higher than necessary but the kraut is the best I have ever tasted!  Drop the price at least $10 AMAZON!  Because of the outrageous price I can only give it 4 stars.  The kraut is worthy of 5!

column9: Nice taste, texture of canned tuna
column10: This product would be excellent tossed with noodles and/or salad, or baked in casserole.  So far I've used it in salmon tacos and also added it to artichoke dip on crackers.  Both times the dish was excellent.  It would also be good with scrambled eggs... anything in which you would want and pre-flaked consistency to your salmon.  Not too salty, not too oily, feels very nourishing, yum.I point out the consistency because I was hoping this would be more of a trail-side snack/ finger-food kind of thing based on the tags reviewers had given it.  It is not jerky.  It definitely needs to be eaten with a utensil.  If you had no utensil, you could eat it with chips/crackers if you had a bowl in which to dip it, or a tortilla and you can pour it onto the tortilla. It's very good on both.  But I would only eat it with my fingers if I was starving and desperate, because it is not finger-food consistency.  So you know, prepare to have a vector for this food.  Lolz.  Maybe not good for day hikes, but great for camp sites.  Also great in the pantry for surprise guests.P.S. _ I have only opened one pack out of the four packs so far, but if that is representative - not one single bone or any kind of skin/gristle or foreign object was found and you can see pieces of salmon fat which are so good and healthy for you to have in the unadulterated state...  Not too much to where it is overwhelming, just enough like the good cuts of meat kind of thing.  It feels/tastes/looks like a good value for the convenient nourishment it offers and I was happy to serve it and eat it.

This is a very good salmon product.  It is not smoked, so you are not losing the good omega 3 oil.  I find it works well with a bagel and cream cheese-package makes about 3 of these. It is well sealed and apparently lasts foreveer.

I gave this as a gift to a salmon lover, and he tells me he can't describe how good it is and would give me a packet to sample, but too little and too precious to share!  So, that would be the only complaint, a bit pricey.

Imagine watery salmon bits poured out of a can.  I cannot believe the other reviews, this product is certainly not worth the price and tastes like cat food.  Do not waste your money as I did on this awful item.
So easy to grab and go. Toss in my backpack and I'm all set! Great flavor and texture and no fillers or artificial garbage.  Just pure natural salmon!
Good product.  The salmon tastes natural unlike chicken in pouches that I also tried and taste processed and artificial.  I would certainly buy it again.

Worst pasta sauce....IN THE WORLD!!!!  So horrible!!!  It tastes like someone dumped a bag of sugar in it!  I would rather have ketchup on top of my pasta!  (In fact, this sauce reminds me of Hunt's ketchup - - way too sugary.  If you prefer Hunt's over Heinz, then maybe you will like this pasta sauce)  It sounds like I'm exaggerating and I am, but not by much.  You should totally stick to Prego or if you're feeling fancy try Antonello's Salsa di Pomodoro.

This coffee was very good, being at least the equal of the best of the 7 different coffees I have tried thus far here from Amazon.  It was very fresh, had excellent aroma, and produced a very nice brew in my French press.  Upon receipt of the coffee I noticed that the bag was nowhere near full.  I have had other coffees come in less-than-full bags, but this one seemed to be way off. Since I sell merchandise online myself, I have an accurate postal scale.  The "2 pound" bag came in at almost 6 ounces less than a full 32, including the weight of the bag.  From previous orders from Amazon, other coffees seem to be based on the "as delivered" weight, not on some sort of weight prior to roasting.  The bag itself did not have a breather, so it is hard to imagine that almost 20% of the weight was lost in shipping. Don't know what happened here but the result is that I feel I payed almost 20% more for the beans than the advertised price.  I am curious if others have noticed this from this company. I would like to think that I simply got a careless shipment and not a care-less policy.

Really an outstanding coffee. Consistently good flavor from bag to bag. We have been enjoying this for over a year and have not been disappointed with the Sumatran Dark. The roast is optimal -- luscious and aromatic, like espresso, not over-roasted and burnt. Love the fact that it is organic and fair-trade also. The value is excellent, especially with Subscribe & Save.I can't say the same of other varieties of Altura that I've tried; I've only been really pleased with the Sumatran, not others. Also, this coffee blows away competing (and much more expensive) offerings from Jeremiah's and Appassionato which lacked freshness and full flavor.Truly a quality buy! Full 5 Stars - Highly recommend!

I have long enjoyed Cafe Altura's dark roast coffees.  They have a rich, bold flavor and the actual beans smell freshly roasted.  Also, it is nice to have a fair-traded, organic coffee at this price.Highly recommended

column9: Very satifying dark whole bean coffee
column10: I've been using this bean for the past year when making my own dark whole bean blend.  It has a rich, warm taste and never a hint of over roasting.  It is great by itself as well, but when blended with other beans it allows me to create a complex flavor.  The price is reasonable as well.

I love coffee, i have tried so many in the past and happened upon the cafe altura. Now, every other coffee out there is just so-so. I occasionally give another recommended brand a chance but it never comes close to this one.When you open the bag the quality is clear: The smell is intoxicating - not fake like flavored coffees and not 'burnt' like starbucks, but rich full COFFEE flavor. Also, the beans are visually oily, not wet or nasty as i have heard of some coffees in the past but just shiny with the oil (where all the flavor is)Because of the quality of this coffee i use less, the taste will tempt you to take it black, and its organic from an ecologically-minded farmer....sweet!

column9: Excellent Coffee at a Great Price!
column10: I tried several varieties before committing to the subscribe program and this one edged out my second favorite, the French Roast. Every batch is as good as the first and I am very happy with it.I'm also delighted with Amazon's subscriber program, especially since I rely on others to shop for me and this is just one more thing that I can get for myself, on my own timetable, and not have to wait until they are ready to go. Thanks Amazon! Please continue to add more quality items to your grocery service.

column9: Excellent Coffee, but make sure you can store it!!
