I mean, geez, there are only 70 calories in a fun-sized Snickers, but nobody would call it a healthy treat.  A little tiny bit of anything is low-cal (well, except for maybe alfredo sauce), but I wouldn't seriously consider this as a part of a healthy low-cal diet.

column9: Depends on What You're Looking For...
column10: There are three ways you can judge Nabisco's SnackWell's Caramel Drizzle Popcorn:  taste, health/diet concerns, and price.  On the first count, these are excellent.  Given it mixes caramel and popcorn, there will inevitably be some similarly to Cracker Jack, but these have a far better flavor in my book.  On the diet/health side, the only major concern is the high sugar content but then the pluses elsewhere are likely achieved by the small package side more than anything.  Where it lets down is in the pricing.  $35 for a half dozen small bags of popcorn??  I might expect that in a movie theatre but not in the marketplace.  So give it 5 stars on taste, 3 on health/diet, and 1 on pricing.

column9: Glorified Cracker Jacks....but with no prize inside!
column10: I think I expected more out of these. I was disappointed to realize that these taste a LOT like Cracker Jacks - a bit dry, not too flavorful. It was hard to even taste the fudge drizzled on the top. I didn't even really want to finish the bag. I would not buy these in the future. I think I would prefer to buy Cracker Jacks - at least I'd get a prize in the box!

These nifty little snacks are tasty and convenient--the chocolate and caramel combines with the popcorn to create a very pleasant (and relatively healthy) treat. Each box contains five 130 calorie packs (I think 100 calorie packs would have worked just as well), and each package is a convenient way to include a "dessert" in the brown bag or lunchbox you or your kids bring to work or school each day. There's not much nutrition here, but at least the treat doesn't cost you too much in the way of saturated fat (only 2.5 g per package), and only 25 of the calories come from fat.The fudge-drizzled caramel popcorn packs are a good fit for the SnackWell's line (which seems to have disappeared over the years--does this product mark some sort of a renaissance for the brand?). My only criticism--the foil packages are a bit narrow at the top, so it becomes somewhat challenging to reach the treats as you get to the bottom of the pack--a more square and less rectangular package might have worked better.

The chocolate on this popcorn is DELICIOUS, but I really don't taste much caramel. That really doesn't bother me, though, because I prefer chocolate anyway. Hmm, I'd love to try an all-chocolate variety! By the way, don't expect a microwave-size bag of popcorn here; it's small, but good.

This little snack was very delicious.  I would never think that it was only 130 calories.  It tasted like the carmel corn that you would get at the fair.  The chocolate was just enough and not overwhelming.  The carmel had the perfect sweetness to it.  The size of the bag was perfect as well (eventhough I could have eaten the whole box)!

These snacks are just the right amount to give you that sweet and crunchy fix.  The chocolate is just the right amount for me as I am not a total chocoholic.  I really like carmel corn and this was just the right thing to give me the treat of having it but only eating 130 calories.  Great snack.

column4: Meg "Livin la vida loca in Maine!"
column9: Eh, What more can I say?
column10: As I am looking to shed a few of those winter pounds, I wanted to try Snackwell's Caramel Popcorn. It is simply ok as most diet foods are. The fudge drizzle tastes chalky, but the caramel popcorn is light and sweet. I think if it had just been Caramel Popcorn, I would have liked it, but alas the fudge drizzle...

This is individual packs of fudge drizzled popcorn.  It reminds me of crackerjacks with fudge drizzled on it.  It is very sweet - it has caramel and chocolate - but if you like crackerjacks, which I grew up loving, then you should like this.  Thankfully the package is just over one ounce - small enough to limit the calories to 130.I am not sure I would want or need more than one pack at a time.  It would be easy to overload on the sugar.It is popcorn and it can get stuck between your teeth.  But I did not find any un-popped kernels in the package.The chocolate is fairly good, but not overly thick.If you don't like crackerjacks or you don't like really sweet snacks, stay away from these.  If you love crackerjacks and/or want a really sweet snack, this is might hit the spot for you.Overall a very tasty treat but beware it is on the sweet side.

These are great snacks for the following reasons:1. Each package contains more than I expected.  Seriously its a good sized little snack.2. They are low calorie.3. These are totally delicious!The combination of caramel corn and fudge is an outstanding idea and finding a way to make it that good AND low calorie is pure genius.  I highly recommend these!

Six snack-size bags are small portions, about a cupped-palm serving each. Carmel coated popcorn with chocolate fudge striping is delicious. Packaging is graphically pleasing. I have to say, however, if the retail price is the $34.98 listed on the Amazon product page, the price is outrageous. Who spends that much for 6 servings of tasty popcorn?

I love popcorn, and I love caramel popcorn, but I have avoided this kind of snack for years as best I can because of the loaded calories and sugar, but now I can once again enjoy this treat!Snackwell and Nabisco are trusted in the industry for items that are known for being on the healthy side of indulgence, and they have scored again with the FUDGE drizzled CARAMEL POPCORN - just wonderful - and only 130 caolries per serving. It is not too salty, not too sweet. There is no lingering chemical taste from sweetners that some low calorie or diet products have. The popcorn is fresh and crunchy, which means that caramel is not so overpowering that everything sticks.Also, the caramel is light enough that it does not pull teeth out of your head! This snack is just the right combination of sweet flavors and crunch.Also, I like that there are 5 individually wrapped servings in the box...it slows me down from eating the entire thing in one sitting! It also ensures for those more disciplined than me that the reamining product will be fresh when it is time for another snack.These are easy to pack in a luch bag or box or slip in a purse or in the glove compartment of your car. The only problem is that there are only five packages in the box. I hope the company produces a bigger box with more packages for those of us with families and kids.Besides the low 130 calories, there is ZERO cholesterol, only 3 grams of fat, and relatively low sodium and sugars, especially in comparison to less healthy products.

Most of us have tried some variation of this type of gourmet popcorn. There are brands with caramel, brands with nuts, some with cinammon, or even zesty spices.What I liked best about this SnackWell's popcorn was the VARIETY of tastes in each little bite.  First, there's the fluffy popcorn, nice and fresh tasting, and then there's the sweet caramel which is enhanced by just the right amount of salty flavor. It's all topped off by a rich, light drizzle of chocolate. The total flavor is a delicious blending of all of the above!A few other facts:Calories--130Total fat--3gSodium--190 mgPrice--up there!Price aside, I'd recommend this as a special treat for anyone who craves a snack that's delicious and different than the "same-old" popcorn.

I may be nit-picking, and everyone has a right to decide what they can afford, but Snackwell's Fudge Drizzle Caramel Popcorn is unaffordable right now as a regular reward snack.  (I can get truffles for about the same price from Wyoming for a little bit less.)Having gotten that off my chest, the rest of you, who can throw caution or money to the wind would do well to treat yourself to one of the freshest and tastiest gourmet dainties that have ever reached my lips!  The drizzled chocolate is perfection:  Not enough to drown the carmel, and not too little to tease.Forget about those large tins of carmel, cinnamon, and cheese popcorn you get for Christmas.  This is about a hundred times tastier, ten times fresher, and exponentially more expensive.  (And, I, for one, won't complain about those Christmas tins!)Not only do Snackwell's assume you are worth pampering, but the label says each packet has 130 calories per pack, so if you can afford such a richly deserved set of nibbles, time truly IS money.In a word, this Nabisco product is the caviar of snacks!  Forget the fig newtons, et al, they've come a long way!
We really love these and have since purchased them a few times. They have a great sweet taste that is not overwhelming and the individual snacks make for great packing for a quick snack

Nabisco's Snackwell Fudge Drizzle Caramel Popcorn are individually wrapped packages of chocolate drizzled caramel corn.  The individual bags are approximately 1oz each and have 130 calories which I think is just about right for snacking.I found the Fudge Drizzle Caramel Popcorn to have an excellent caramel flavor and a good crunchy consistency.  I personally was not able to taste the chocolate very much but I shared them with some folks in the office and they thought they had a nice, chocolaty flavor.  I like caramel corn and found the taste to be very good.  The individually wrapped Snackwell Fudge Drizzle Caramel Popcorn are a convenient and tasty snack and I would buy they again.DISCLAIMER:  I did not consider price in making my recommendation.

If you are a fan of caramel corn (or crackerjacks), you will enjoy these. Essentially, they are a heavily covered caramel corn, drizzled over with just the right amount of chocolate.I am trying to be specific about the level of caramel, since the brand I have been using is actually "kettle corn" with the chocolate, and taste quite different than these do. These are much sweeter, and really hit home when it comes to having a "sweet tooth."Since they have 150 calories, you will need to be cautious about including them in your diet, but if you are a caramel corn fan, it will be well worth finding a place for these.

column9: You can't snack "well" with corn syrup
column10: Maintaining a healthy diet is always about choices.  I can choose potato chips to go with my sandwich or apple slices.  I love both, but choosing the apples will have a nutritional benefit.  The chips will not.Having said that, I understand that Nabisco is trying to offer not a 'more healthy' snack but a if-you-must-snack-at-least-lower-the-fat-and-calories choice with this product.  I appreciate that.  I do have those stressful days when my attitude is one of survival--as in, "I need something sweet and decadent to survive this day."  On those days, I reach for something other than apple slices.  And this caramel popcorn, given it's crunchiness and flavor (and fudge drizzlings!) would be perfect--except for the corn syrup.Had Nabisco chosen another sweetener, I'd be a convert to this popcorn and would be buying boxes to keep in my cupboard at work.  But the corn syrup is a deal breaker for me.  If it's not for you, try these!

column9: C'mon, just 100 calories of decadence? Really?
column10: I remember when SnackWells first came out.  It's a fond memory.  Indulging your sweet tooth (or teeth) while minimizing sugar and/or fat intake is one way to fool yourself into thinking you're eating healthy, and I'm as fond of doing this as the next guy.  And yes, this lovely little idea of chocolate-covered caramel popcorn is as delish as you'd think.  Enjoy!

The Packaging: I box has 5 packs in it. Each pack has about maybe 50-75% as much popcorn in it as those small 99c bags of popcorn chips. The packs themselves are smaller than a 99c bag of chips; very portable.Taste: The fudge and caramel mix nicely. Its not overly sweet, and you get a nice fudge aftertaste as it melts in your mouth. Its not salty and doesnt leave any sticky residue on your fingers. Its alittle too crunchy and occasionally you run into uneatable bits of popcorn, which may be normal in regular popcorn but really shouldnt be in a sweet snack.Health: Each pack in the box has 130 calories, with 3g Fat, 24g Carbs, 18g Sugars.Verdict: There are healthier snacks that are cheaper than this but if you like popcorn, fudge, and caramel give it a try.

My fiancee and I thoroughly enjoyed this product.  It's a good light snack and the bag actually has a good amount of popcorn in it for having only 130 calories.  It tastes like Fiddle-Faddle except it's a little more chocolatey and there are no nuts in it. It's probably not as healthy as Cheerios to snack on, but even with the chocolate on it, I bet it's healthier than non-baked potato chips.  Healthier than Fiddle-Faddle too I bet.

These are just too tasty. Seriously, they need to come in a big box, like FiddleFaddle. I could munch on these all day long. I don't get to, as my wife and kids keep cleaning out my supplies before I can get to them. Damn you, 8-5PM job!!!

Caramel corn drizzled with fudge?  Yum!  And only 130 calories per pack, score!I thought the flavor was really good and not overly sweet (which is surprising considering it's caramel and fudge!) and both my daughter and I gobbled these up!  Fair warning, they melt very easily.  I live in Phoenix, so definitely have to be careful with the mess.  I thought the portions were wonderful and the packaging easy to open.Not sure though,  I would pay what these cost.  Enjoy!

It's exactly what is pictured on the box (how often does THAT happen?): caramel popcorn striped with hard chocolate icing.  The flavor is a great balance of butter, caramel and fudge with just a touch of salt and "roasted" flavor.  A few nuts would have been nice, and added some protein, but the absence of nuts means kids can take this to school, camp and other nut-free zones.  Pouches are very easy to open.  No, it's not health food, just a little treat when you want something sweet and fruit just doesn't cut it.

Popcorn with caramel and drizzled with fudge - now that sounds heavenly.  This was a really good treat, and the kids loved it.  They gobbled it down quickly.If you like popcorn, caramel, and fudge, then you are sure to love this treat.This particular product comes in six individual packets.

I love most Snackwell products, so I was looking forward to trying this one.  The popcorn is just right, fresh and crunchy, and has the right balance of caramel drizzled with just a bit of chocolate. I enjoyed the flavors together; this type of combo (sweet/salty) is a favorite of mine. One 130 calorie bag is just enough to hit the spot when you need a little something to satisfy the between meal hunger pangs.  I love their single serving bags; they are easy to toss in a lunchbox or purse for when you are on the go. My husband even liked it, and he's hesitant to try the lower calorie pack snacks. I'm glad I tried the popcorn; this snack is a winner!

Snackwell's is known as one of first producers of healthier snacks and this fudge drizzle caramel popcorn is no exception.  It's delicious and each bag only has 130 calories.  Since it's just drizzled, it's not very sweet but you can still taste the fudge and caramel.  The box comes with 6 5.3 oz bags, which to me is just the right size.  I think portion control is just as important as calorie count.  I find one bag is enough to satisfy a snack craving.

I have to say I enjoyed these. They are a nice balance of sweet, salty, and of course the drizzle of chocolate! There was enough in the bag for it to be a good snack. Funny to say, but at times there was a tad too much chocolate drizzle that over powered the popcorn taste. I would be willing to add these to my snack rotation. Of course, this isn't a snack that can stand alone for a few hours - it is more of something to stave off the 3:00 hunger pains that get you in trouble before dinner.Just 4 stars instead of 5 because it would be nice if it were 100 calories instead of the 130. I start to feel guilty if a snack is over 110 calories. Maybe holding back a bit on the chocolate would help. Overall - a great snack though.

Each package in this box is an invitation to experience a crunchy, buttery, chocolate dream. The popcorn is fresh, the caramel coating is sweet and buttery and there is just enough chocolate to leave you satisfied. Once you start eating this popcorn it is hard to stop but since it is divided into 130 calorie packs you can control how much you eat much more easily. My husband loved this popcorn and was kind enough to leave me a package to review. :) If you love popcorn snacks you might want to check out: Strawberries & Cream Chocolate Popcorn - Quarter Pound~The Rebecca Review

I chose this from the Vine program because I rather like caramel popcorn.  As far as caramel popcorn goes, this is a pretty tasty snack.  Flavor-wise, I thought it had a very good caramel taste, but I felt like the chocolate drizzle was a bit overkill.  I just felt like the chocolate didn't add anything good to the flavor (plus the chocolate itself doesn't taste all that good).  What else to say about these?  Well, they come in little "130 calorie packs".  This is useful and convenient for those on a diet but honestly that would be the only reason to get this particular product.  It's probably ten million times cheaper to get a regular large size bag of caramel popcorn than to buy this thing, so the only thing it would be good for is counting calories precisely.  If you need it for that purpose, then this product is good enough, but if you're not on a diet or anything, just get a regular bag of caramel popcorn and chow down on that instead.

I love popcorn, caramel, and fudge, so I figured I'd enjoy Snackwell's Fudge Drizzle Caramel Popcorn. I was right! The caramel flavor is absolutely fantastic--no hint of a burned flavor like some other purchased caramel popcorn has. The portion size is perfect; at first I thought the bags were pretty small, but the popcorn is sweet enough that you wouldn't want to eat much more than one serving. I took this to my office and passed bags out to my coworkers, and everyone agreed that this is a tasty snack. My only criticism (which my coworkers also mentioned) is that the fudge drizzle isn't a prominent enough flavor. The caramel is very sweet and strong, and it completely overpowers the chocolate. I'd prefer to have this without the fudge and save those calories since I couldn't really taste it anyway. Still, this is a snack I could see myself enjoying again and again!

column9: A melt in my mouth surprise!!
column10: I have been a fan of Nabisco 100 calorie packs for the last 2 years, for to me they complement my eating habits and snacking craves. So when I decided to give Snackwell Fudge Drizzle Caramel Popcorn a chance, I opened my 1st bag wondering how they would compare to my favorite low calorie snack. I have to say that I was surprised on the portion size, the fudge flavor, the sweet meets salty, and the simple fact that when I put them into my mouth they just melted away.The portion size was just right for me, and even I could have had a little bit less in my bag since I am use too small portions. But when watching a movie, I would have to say that this size would be perfect to snack on. The sweet fudge taste meets salty popcorn did for me, but I am sweet meets salty person and overall enjoyed the taste. On another note, I can add for those of you who are not chocoholics the fudge is not overpowering. I am not a true chocolate fan and in fact would rather have another type of sweet over chocolate so for me the fudge is very mellow and just the right amount. But hands down my favorite part is the fact that this just melted away in my mouth.As my BF tried his own bag he decided he not only wanted to try them by themselves but also as an ice cream topper! He thought it was a great ice cream topper, reminding him of a sundae with that hint of caramel and fudge.Eat them straight out of the bag, or get creative with them. Snackwell Fudge Drizzle Caramel Popcorn is a great portion controlled snack that is a flavor melt in your mouth.A little tip for others who might be watching their snack cravings: Remember to only eat 1 bag at a time.

column9: Snack Tastes More Like Popcorn, Not Chocolate, Yet Sticks Together
column10: All you taste is the popcorn and salt. There's a whiff of chocolate fudge or caramel but it's too subtle to make me want more. I might as well have popped my own popcorn and sprinkled cocoa over it. Cracker Jacks and Swiss Miss Hot chocolate have more flavor than this. Even when bits of fudge fell off and I sampled it, there was no sugary sweetness, just a curious flatness and blandness reminiscent of tofu (soy is listed as an ingredient). The label also lists cocoa and brown sugar rather than milk chocolate. No wonder! Yet the drizzle is thick enough to make several popcorn kernals stick togehther in one huge lump. It will make you lose weight,however - there's not enough flavor to make me want to eat more.

Snackwell's Fudge Drizzled Carmel Popcorn is delicious.It's a great snack when you need something sweet and chocolate.It's well worth 130 calories, 25 fat calories, sodium 190mg. 0 grams polyunsaturated fat.  There's just enough to satisfy your sweet-tooth.  The popcorn tastes like it was just made.I plan on keeping a box of snack packs on hand.

Food reviews are tough, since it's really such a subjective thing, but I can't imagine someone not loving the taste of these. It hist the sweet just right, you get some crunch, and the portion is controlled to help you manage your calories. Honestly though, do you need me to tell you that fudge-drizzled popcorn with caramel is gonna be good? :) It does not taste like some of the other "diet" Snackwell's products. It's not overly sweetened either. It's the middle bowl in Goldilocks...just right.

Well... they taste amazing!  Nothing like diet food.  Probably because it really isn't all that "diet-y."  It is just extremely portion controlled.  If you need extra packaging to keep you from eating a lot of dessert, this is great for you.  However, if you are looking for something "diet-y" but fills you up or lasts you through a movie, you may want to look elsewhere or you'll end up eating the entire box.Overall, it is delicious for those nights when I am full from a big meal filled with lots of onions and/or garlic and am craving something sweet (why must I have chocolate after onions and garlic?).

column9: This snack receives my unmitigated approval.
column10: I recently began a high-protein, low-sugar diet, and it has been really painful to completely avoid all the delicious, bready snacks I had previously enjoyed.  These popcorn packets are just wonderful as a once-a-day indulgence, just enough sweetness to take the edge off without ruining all my hard work.  They have a wonderful caramel flavor and the "chocolate" drizzle is enough to give you the texture of chocolate while not tasting obviously fake.  I'm a big fan of the calorie-labels and pre-measured servings on all of the 100-etc calorie packs and this one is no exception.  It's very easy to add into your routine and there's no worry that you'll overindulge, unless you bring the whole box with you.

These are a great snack for when you need something sweet, yet portion controlled. At 130 calories per pack, it isn't too bad considering it satisfies a chocolate craving. And they have only 3 grams of fat per bag. They don't have any significant fiber or other nutrients, but they're better on calories than most snacks.I liked how classy they looked with the chocolate drizzled over the caramel corn. It made them seem more like candy than popcorn. It's a good thing they are portioned in single serve bags, or it would be easy to eat too much!The only drawback is that there are only 6 packages in a box and they might be a little pricey for a snack. However, if you think of them purchasing candy in a single serve pack, then it isn't so bad.

A handful of decadent fudge drizzled caramel popcorn to satisfy the sweet tooth.  Unbelievable these are only 130 calories a pack -- they taste so good! Unfortunately, it will be gone before you can blink.  The fudge is very rich and the caramel very sweet with a soft crunch of popcorn.  My family really enjoyed this snack, we just wish there were more than five packs in a box.  However, it is a great snack to toss in a lunch sack or your purse.  We will definitely be purchasing these!! YUM!

We did a taste test with Snackwell Fudge Drizzle Caramel Popcorn and 1 out 3 liked the popcorn. We found it had an after taste and was a weird texture. I found that fudge was nice taste but I passed after two peices.  One who loved them was my 13 year old son who finished the box this week. I would pass - make some popcorn and enjoy!

column9: great tasting caramel popcorns with a tinge of chocolate fudge...yum!
column10: These are ready-to-eat caramel popcorn pouches. I should say we like caramel pop-corn generally. So, with a little bit of chocolate strips on top it tasted even better. The corns were still crispy in the pouch. The pouch sizes are small in volume compared to normal popcorn serving sizes, but with caramel and chocolate each pouch is ~130 calories. tastes good though.

I'm usually a fan of Crunch Munch or Poppycock, so maybe I was expecting too much from this caramel corn.  The popcorn is fine, stayed crisp, but the sweetness is just that, just sweet.  No buttery flavor, no real caramel flavor, and the chocolate was just average.  I wouldn't purchase.

Snackwell's Fudge Drizzled Caramel Popcorn is a sweet and salty snack, prepackaged in 130 calories pouches. The portion sizes are very small to account for such a decadent snack at a decent calorie amount. The caramel popcorn is simply delicious, drizzled lightly with fudge. The flavor is incredible, and would be easy to over-indulge if it weren't for the perfectly portioned (calorie-wise) pouches. As a popcorn-lover, I highly recommend this sweet treat. It's almost as good has mom's homemade caramel corn.

Snackwell's Fudge Drizzle Caramel Popcorn is a snack that is both light and filling. Not overly sweet, but it has a nice milk chocolate and caramel flavor combined with a satisfying crunchiness. I do tend to enjoy a fair amount of caramel corn snacks which almost always have more sugar and chemicals. This is a much healthier alternative. Each bag is consistent, with no hulls or seeds. A very portable, enjoyable and high quality snack. Enjoy!

column9: You Can't eat just one pack!
column10: I thought that this popcorn would taste like a diet food but I soon realized that they were extremely sweet and you won't stop at just one pack (I didn't) besides them being really sweet I really enjoyed this popcorn and I will have to try the other flavors soon.The popcorn doesn't travel well because the chocolate melts  easily, so you have to keep them in a cool area in order for you to enjoy them without the mess. The packaging is smart and idea for a quick snack if you don't want to over indulge(like I did). I think that this is a convient snack without so much guilt.I think that this is a little more healthier than Poppycock or Crunch-N-Munch but I think that the reason it is healthier has to do with the small package that the popcorn comes in and not the actual popcorn itself. I think that it's an overall great snack and I would recommend this for just a little pick me up for dieters who need a reward but want to stay on track.

column9: not much healthier than "regular" caramel popcorn
column10: i'm a big fan of poppycock caramel popcorn, but i don't eat them very much. in fact, i haven't had any in about a decade since the only sweet candy i regularly buy is 73% dark chocolate bars. since i was able to pick an item to review via the vine program, i figured i'd get some free caramel popcorn.i remember when the snackwell's big sell was being under 100 calories, but i guess 100 calories was too restrictive for the current american diet; therefore, the 100-calorie ceiling had to be broken. the best thing about these snackwell's is the ability to portion-control, even though the extra packaging is terrible for the environment. it's kind of sad that people aren't able to resist eating food which is super-engineered to be unnaturally yummy these days, myself included. oh well. anyway, i compared the nutritional value of this to the original poppycock popcorn, serving-per-serving.- one serving of snackwell's is 1.06oz, and one serving of poppycock is 1.1oz, though that could have been rounded up from 1.06oz. basically, they're about the same, but it's easy to eat more than 1/2 cup of poppycock when they come in the huge canister.- snackwell's has 130 calories, and poppycock has 160 calories. so that's good that the healthier version has lower calories.- snackwell's has 3g of fat, 2.5g as saturated. poppycock as 8g of fat, 2g as saturated. clearly, snackwell's has lower fat, but then poppycock also has nuts.- snackwell's has 190mg of sodium. poppycock has 90mg.- snackwell's has 24g of carbohydrates, 18g in sugars. poppycock has 20g of carbohydrates, 13g in sugar.this makes me conclude that this snackwell's item achieved its lower caloric content by reducing fat, but increasing sugar and salt to compensate for the lost fat. in a way, snackwell's would be worse for anyone in danger of developing diabetes, though such people shouldn't be consuming caramel popcorn. actually, no one should, but most of us like to indulge with food. the snackwell's is very light and crispy, but (though my memory of poppycock is distant), i wasn't blown away by the snackwell's like i was by poppycock. since the difference in calories between the two brands is only 30 calories, i would choose the poppycock which tastes better, has nuts, and has lower sugar and salt content. but most people will not be able to stop eating the poppycock after just 1/2 cup (1/1oz), so portion control for cravings is the genius concept behind snackwell's. if you're not disciplined or need to save 30 calories, then pick the snackwell's.btw, crunch n munch (another ConAgra brand) has similar nutritional content as poppycock. and no, i'm not a ConAgra representative. cracker jack also has similar nutritional content, though i was never a fan since it's not as crunchy.

These have just the right amount of sweets on the popcorn - not saturated with chocolate or excess sugar so you don't gasp for a drink after eating them. Packaging has just enough for a snack to satisfy a mid morning desire for some food.  Calorie count will appease everyone.  I try not to have anything over 150 calories since I had breakfast, and will eat lunch, just need something in between.No cons at all.  Winner product here.

SnackWells Fudge Drizzled Caramel Popcorn 130 Calorie Packs (5 packages)is a nice light snack when you're on the go.  It has that lovely salty-sweet flavor that I love in my snacks and the little bit of fudge drizzle keeps it feeling a little sinful without the guilt.  The packaging is nice with a green-and-yellow zebra-stripe pattern and the packs inside the box are labelled as well which is a big thing for me.I give this snack four stars for being tasty and well-packaged.

People who are weight-conscious know that plain popcorn is a relatively harmless, low-calorie snack. Since this is not *plain* popcorn, it is not so harmless. It is, however, delicious. And one of these snack-sized bags will not be enough to satiate most people. Tastewise, this is good stuff. The nutrition information on the bag says it is only 130 calories, which is a good thing. But it also lists brown sugar as the primary ingredient - not such a good thing. SnackWell has a reputation for being (relatively) healthy snack food, and if you consider the serving size in these 130-calorie bags, it's not bad. But with this brand name, I was hoping for a slightly healthier mix of ingredients. That's the reason I don't give it 5 stars. Otherwise, it's extremely yummy, and I definitely want more than one bag.

The popcorn is crisp, sweet, and good tasting. Each pack is enough for an ample and satisfying sweet treat. Also, at only 130 calories, I could see this being very popular with dieters, or anyone who feels they are due a little self-indulgence; it really doesn't taste like a diet snack.

Each pouch was only one point on Weight Watchers how great is that. The popcorn is tasty and fun to eat. Yes I have to hide the box so I don't eat more than one pouch. Usually diet foods taste diet but this didn't. I felt like I was having a treat. This would be a great afternoon snack or addition to the lunch box. I will be buying more soon.

I love popcorn & recently tried different flavors of popcorn. I'm hooked on a couple Popcorn Indiana flavors that I purchase locally.SnackWell's Fudge Drizzle Caramel Popcorn is on the sweet side; the fudge drizzle doesn't have much of a chocolate flavor.  The popcorn is fresh & crispy...yum. I would prefer it to be less sweet with more chocolate flavor.All in all, this is a tasty snack; the flavor could be improved.  It was a hit with everyone who tasted it.Nutrition Facts1 30g pack = 130 caloriesTotal Fat 3g~Sat. Fat 2.5g~Trans Fat, Polyunsaturated Fat & Monounsaturated Fat 0Cholesterol 0Sodium 190mg or 8% of your daily ValuePotassium 30mgTotal Carbs. 24gDietary Fiber 1gSugars 18gProtein 1g

column9: A Different Take on an Old Favorite
column10: This is popcorn that comes in 5 sealed "snack bags". The popcorn is lightly covered in a dark chocolate and caramel. Sweet. Crunchy. No peanuts. Rather high in saturated fat (bad fat) at %13 per 1.06 oz. bag. About 130 cals per 1.06 oz. bag. Definitely not health food, but it tastes very good.

Okay, I am NOT a food critic.  I don't know all the fancy words and such for describing tastes in new and interesting ways.  So here's my modest reaction.  THIS WAS A TASTY SNACK.  The flavor reminded my very much of cracker jacks, which isn't surprising, since this is basically caramel-drizzled popcorn.  But it was more satisfying.  The Caramel covering felt rich and had a nice texture.  The popcorn was consistently well-popped.  I had modest expectations that this would be an "okay" snack...just something mindless to munch on in front of the TV.  In fact, I was very pleasantly surprised with how tasty it was.This comes in 130 calorie packs...not the 100 cal packs we see so many things served in these days.  It tastes WAY better than any 100 calorie snack I've tried (and we've had quite a few over the years).  The extra 30 calories are worth it, IMO.  Now the trick is:  how do I stop at just one pack.  It's so tasty!!

I'm surprised at how good this really is!  The portion size is bigger than I expected too.  There aren't any funny aftertastes that a lot of low calorie/low fat food has.  My only complaint is that I couldn't really taste the fudge drizzle.  It may as well not have been there.

I loved these Snackwell's Fudge Drizzle Caramel Popcorn snacks!  The combination of the caramel corn with a hint of chocolate is really good.  I was most surprised by the fact that the popcorn was nice and fluffy and tasted really fresh.  I expected to find a lot of hard kernels but I didn't. I didn't find a lot of those pesky shells of husks either.The size of the bag is about what I expected from a portion controlled product - a little on the small size but enough to satisfy that afternoon sweet tooth without blowing the diet.  I passed out a couple of samples among friends and everyone really liked them.

This is good!  A little weak on the chocolate, but the caramel flavor is delicious.  It's a nice big bag too for only 130 calorie and satisfied my sweet tooth.  This popcorn is very sweet though so it might not be for everyone, but I really enjoyed it.  It's missing a bit of saltiness that I think would cut down the sweet a bit.  But it's got a nice crunch, a nice flavor and is a great portion of popcorn.

column9: good crunch, a little too sweet
column10: I quite liked this product, but cannot give it five stars primarily for two reasons:1.  The chocolate flavor is a little too subtle.  It would be better if the chocolate was darker/bittersweet to counterbalance the caramel.2.  Even for my sweet tooth, I find this product a little too sweet.  Every kernel of popcorn is entirely covered with caramel and then drizzled with some cocoa mixture.  To give you an idea, each 30 gram bag of this product has 18 grams of sugars.Still, if I were in the mood for a sweet popcorn snack, I would consider purchasing this brand.

column9: If you like other caramel popcorns, you'll like this, too.
column10: There's not a lot to say about this product that will surprise anyone.  It tastes just like any other caramel popcorn product I've ever had (with a small amount of chocolate added).  So, I would say there's definitely no downside or "defect" to describe about Snackwell popcorn vs. similar products.  As far as advantages this product has that others don't, the packaging could (depending on your eating habits) definitely be seen as an advantage.  Other caramel popcorns are packaged in one large box, or even a huge tin, that (once it's opened) allows the entire contents to be exposed to outside air and to become stale quickly.  Because the Snackwells product comes in smaller packets within each package you can only open one at a time, thus keeping the remaining packets fresh.  If you only eat a small amount of popcorn at a time, that's a very big advantage.  However, if you are a big snacker, you would need to open multiple packets at one time - making the packaging inconvenient for you.  So, I guess the bottom line would be - if you like caramel popcorn, but not a lot all at once - this is the right product for you.

There is not a whole lot I can write in a review about this aside from it tastes awesome.  It is so good that it is very difficult to eat just one bag.  It is comparable to a Cracker Jack or carmel corn with a small amount of chocolate drizzle on it.  It is a very refreshing afternoon snack.
A tasty snack, but a little too sweet.  Don't leave them in a warm car they get horribly sticky.  Not for someone with braces either.

Traditionally I am not a big fan of Snack Well products, so I was a little skeptical when I decided to try this new item. The box contains 5 (1.06 oz) packages of snack-size caramel popcorn. The taste is sweet and salty. The perfect combination! Honestly, I couldn't tell it was a low calorie snack. Even my husband and two teenage boys loved them! It's the perfect treat for on-the-go. I would definitely buy this product again. It's yummy!

Snackwell Fudge Drizzle Caramel Popcorn is different than other "drizzled" or dipped or coated popcorn I have tasted in the past.  It seems to have just the right amount of fudge and caramel so as to not turn it into a cookie or on the skimpy side a dusted corn pop.  I liked it and would probably look to buy it in the future.  Just one packet satisfied my evening desert appetite with only 130 calories.  Went well with my cup of tea.

column9: Reminded Me Of Cracker Jacks More Than Anything
column10: As a perpetual dieter, I'm always on the lookout for low calorie snacks that offer a taste that seems more "sinful" than it is. So presented with the chance to try Fudge Drizzle Caramel Popcorn, I was thrilled. After all, some of my favorite words -- "fudge" and "caramel" -- were in the name so it seemed to have promise. In addition, I'm a huge fan of Dale and Thomas Chocolate Chunk and Caramel Popcorn, though I can never really justify the calories. If this snack was even halfway as good as the Dale and Thomas, it would be a winner in my eyes.However, after eating a few bags, this snack reminded me of Cracker Jacks but without the peanuts. The fudge/chocolate taste is barely present. Although you can SEE the chocolate, it didn't really register in the mouth. The dominant taste is definitely caramel. To me, it tasted exactly like Cracker Jacks, which I happen to like but it wasn't the taste I was expecting. I was expecting chocolate and caramel and the chocolate taste didn't come through at all.Because I wanted some other opinions to share, I asked my husband, neighbors and our kids to try the snack too. Here is their feedback:From my husband who uses Weight Watchers: Texture is more like a rice cake than popcorn. Taste the caramel but not the chocolate. It "costs" 3 Weight Watchers Plus points and I wouldn't want to use that many points for this.From my female neighbor who also counts calories: Quite tasty but very sweet. Would like more of a salty taste for a snack like this. Taste the caramel but not the chocolate. Would prefer that it had 100 calories instead of 130; I'm used to expecting these types of snacks to be just 100 calories. Would like to see less sugar if I was going to give it to my kids for a snack. 18 grams of sugar seems like a lot for a snack like this.The kids: All the kids liked it and wanted more and said they would eat it as a snack.Everyone agreed that quantity in the bags was enough. I poured the bag out in my hand and got a full handful and then some. My neighbor said she wouldn't mind if they put less in the bag to get to that "magic" 100 calorie mark.In the end, the consensus was that the snack tasted good but tasted more like caramel popcorn, not fudge-drizzle caramel popcorn. The adults thought they would probably not buy it again. The kids said they would eat it, but both sets of parents thought there might be better snacks with less sugar in it. If you're a dieter who is looking for a sugary snack fix, this might do it for you but don't look for the fudge drizzle to show up in the flavor; it was missing in action in the bags we tasted. Think smaller pack of Cracker Jacks (minus the peanuts) and I think you have a good idea of what this snack tastes like.A Side Note: Both of the moms thought the packaging was very attractive and would make us buy it if we saw it in the grocery store.

Okay, if all you are looking for is a GREAT tasting portion controlled snack and don't care about anything else then this is it!  I also like that the ingredients are pretty good, brown sugar, corn syrup, cocoa, popcorn, oil, vanilla, whey, noting terrible and all pretty darn natural.  BUT, we will not be buying these again which is why despite amazing taste and good ingredients I am only  giving it 3 stars.  First off, each box only has 5 pouches, so for a family of four one box is gone like in an instant.  Next and foremost, we try to limit sugar per serving on our sweetened cereals and snacks to no more than 9 grams, each of these Snackwell pouches has 18 grams of sugar!  We are used to eating Angie's Caramel Corn which for a whopping 2.5 cups serving size has only 9 grams of sugar and 150 calories.  If Snackwell really wanted people to 'snack well' they'd take Angie's caramel corn and drizzle fudge on that and put it into their little pouches to reduce the sugar per serving.

Wonderful sweet treat with a low "calorie" price. I was pleasantly surprised at the nice balance of caramel and chocolate flavors. The chocolate drizzle is just enough to take this from your average caramel popcorn to a more decadent treat, but not too much to overtake the caramel popcorn base. It is a relatively small package but just enough to satisfy a sweet tooth. The only slight drawback is a slightly expensive price for the amount in a package.

I had requested these for my wife who loves popcorn. She was somewhat skeptical at first because of the small bag size of the Snackwell compared to the much larger size of a regular bag of popcorn. She was watching a movie when I handed her the Snackwell. After she tried the contents of one of the bags she declared her assessment of the product to be "excellent". My only concern is that if she becomes addicted to this version of popcorn I would have to sell my pickup truck to pay for this stuff. Maybe sell the dog as well.

I did not have high expectations for these. Aside from the Devils Food Cakes, I can take Snack Wells or leave them. But these were surprisingly good.They tasted like your average caramel corn, so no diet food taste. I loved that they weren't doused in chocolate and over-sweet, just drizzled. The small packs were nice for lunches or a small snack. Great combo of salty, sweet, and satisfying.However, the sugar count was a bit high for a small calorie snack, but hey, it's a sweet snack. And one not to feel too guilty over. The price is a little high too when compared to similar snacks like Crunch N Munch or Cracker Jacks, but I really did find the taste better than Cracker Jacks.Worth the try.

This is a great little snack. It's basically popcorn with a "drizzle" of fudge and caramel, just like the name says. It comes in a small, individual snack pack, so portion control is not a problem--unless you can't eat just one. It's not filling at all--you know how light a kernel of popcorn is--and it all fits in something roughly the size of a deck of cards--or, for the electronically minded among you, something a little thicker than my iPhone. But the taste is really good.I recommend this for a quick, tasty treat. Oh, I also liked that each of the popped kernels was nice and soft--not mushy, but that freshly popped soft popcorn consistency. Good going, Nabisco!

My kids (ages 4 and 8) gobbled these snack-sized packets of caramel popcorn!  They LOVED these packs and I didn't mind giving them the popcorn either because they are portioned out nicely.  They were perfect for lunchboxes and after school snacks.  I can't wait to try them in other flavors!
Length:: 2:31 MinsThis is one tasty snack.It's hard to believe that only 130 calories can taste this chocolatey and sweet, but the proof's in the package!
Popcorn drizzled in chocolate and caramel - wonderful snack.  Love the single serve portions too - great to carry to a ball game!

I like popcorn, but I love chocolate and caramel even more. Snackwell Fudge Drizzle Caramel Popcorn combines all three of these ingredients into one, with a sweetness level that makes this product more like candy than popcorn.When consumers think of caramel corn, the first product that comes to mind is Cracker Jack and this Snackwell product does, indeed, remind me of this classic snack food product. The difference is that Snackwell Fudge Drizzle Caramel Popcorn goes a step further by adding fudge to the mix. There isn't a ton of fudge- it is only lightly drizzled- but it certainly present and it adds more flavor to an already tasty product.This Snackwell food tastes great, but if I had to register one complaint, it would be the same complaint that many other reviewers have already made: there is an awfully high amount of sugar in each serving. The individual serving packs are nice because they allow easy convenience and only a small amount of the snack, helping consumers avoid over-consumption. But even with such a small serving size of only one ounce, there are still eighteen grams of sugar per pack. If you can eat only one pack, you should be okay, but I will be the first to admit that it is very easy to eat two or three packs at a time. Multiply this by eighteen grams of sugar per serving and you are bound to experience a case of sugar overload.Snackwell makes this product with only a minimal amount of fudge. I would have liked it better with even more fudge, but at the same time, I realize that any additional fudge would likely spike the sugar content even higher. So, as much as the chocolate flavor would be enjoyable, I am happy that Snackwell kept its ambitions under control.Snack foods are a regular part of life for me and I am happy to have tried this Snackwell product. I like the flavor profile very much and while I agree with others who voice concerns over the sugar content, this product isn't much worse than other sweet snacks. As long as one keeps their consumption in check and limits themselves to only a package or two, they should have no problem or guilt as they enjoy the sweet caramel and chocolate taste of this popcorn product.

column9: Very Tasty Combination of Popcorn, Chocolate, and Caramel
column10: This is a great combination of popcorn, caramel, and chocolate. And each pack is only 130 calories. What better way to snack when you are craving something sweet?! I admit that it is hard to stop at one bag though. Each bag is just over 1 ounce.On the other hand, there is a ton of sugar in this popcorn, 18 grams her bag. When I tried them, they were way to sweet for me. But if I were craving a sugary snack, they would be perfect with the whole grain of the popcorn.Realistically, I would rather have a 6-cup bag of popcorn that will fill me up than a 1-ounce bag of sugared popcorn. I would probably eat the entire box and want more where as the plain popcorn has satisfied me and has a lot less sugar and calories.Shawn KovacichAuthor of the Achieving Kicking Excellence book and DVD series.

Snackwell Fudge Drizzle Caramel Popcorn, 5.3-Ounce (Pack of 6) These are tasty; however they have no nutritional value and unless you use them as a lunch time snack they can be costly. If you open the pack it is hard to eat just one bag as a serving. This is a four stars product.Nutrition Facts per serving:Serving size-1 pack(30g); Calories -130; Fat Calories-25Total Fat-3gram; Sat Fat- 2.5g; Trans/Poly/Mono Fat - 0gCholest - 0g; Sodium - 190 mg; Potassium - 30mgTotal Carbs - 24 grams; Fiber - <1g; Sugars - 18 grams; Protein - 1 gram  MORE sugars then anything but it tastes good.

Snackwell Fudge Drizzle Caramel Popcorn, 5.3-Ounce (Pack of 6)Talk about yum and I really mean that, even before I was able to try this out I knew it would be good. First off I am a popcorn fan so that is a plus, add in caramel and chocolate fudge and it equals delicious. The box alone makes them look really good so I couldn't wait to get my hands on them. How right I was about how good these things are, very good indeed.Now when I get these things I usually want to share them a bit so I get various opinions on them. Needless to say I didn't want to do the same here especially after tasting them once. After that first little bag I was hooked but unfortunately every one else caught a peek. After that every one wanted some so I had to share and like me they all loved it. The caramel and chocolate taste is great as one would assume, of course with popcorn underneath all that it was great.

If you like popcorn and have a sweet tooth as well, then this tasty snack may be for you.  I find that the combination of fudge with caramel is pleasant.  I even had my first pack with coffee (yes, they're hard to stop eating once you start) and the flavors blended very nicely (fudge, caramel followed by the liquid mocha).They're a bit sticky, so you'll want to keep a napkin to hand.Quite an innnovative offering on a snack tray.  Attractive as well.I repeat, yummy!

column9: All the kids love it, except the 2 year old, and me.
column10: My kids don't get a lot of sweets. So we were all excited to try out this popcorn. It's a little too chewy for my taste. The sweetener was more honey-like, rather than "sugar-y" if that makes a difference to you. It didn't to my children. They all scarfed it down. Except the two year old. She actually spit hers out, as if I had poisoned her.So, it's pretty good, but I have pretty laid back kids when it comes to eating. I won't be purchasing this again, since it wasn't a "slam dunk" with the whole family. Not terrible, but not great.Sincerely,Suzanne GoseMother of Five, Teacher, AuthorFlip Flop Spanish SeriesThe Key to Learning Anything

column9: Excellent!  Run, don't walk, to get some!
column10: If you like popcorn, chocolate and caramel, you're gonna like this stuff!  A lot!  And if you like those little pre-measured packages with 100 calories or 150 calories, or in this case, 130 calories, you'll really like it.  Each 130 calorie package has 1.06 oz of popcorn with caramel and chocolate drizzled on it.  And it's not the kind of drizzling where you taste a whole lot of popcorn and very little chocolate or caramel.  There's a nice balance and you can really taste it.  The little bags are just the right size to tuck in your purse or briefcase for a quick mid-morning or mid-afternoon pick-me-up snack when you're on the go.  They'd also fit well in lunch boxes, backpacks or tote bags.  Yum!!

Very tasty, but also very sweet!  Reminiscent of Cracker Jacks with a drizzle of chocolate, this is a nice snack that will satisfy your sweet tooth and give you a touch of a chocolate fix at the same time.  I enjoyed these very much, but I probably won't purchase them unless they go on sale, since the cost is a little high:  There are only five of these packages in a box.

column9: Tasty But Not Necessarily Worth the Calories/Price
column10: For the most part I generally like Snackwell's products, though it's been quite some time since I tried any.While I liked the taste (nice combination of popcorn, caramel and chocolate)and the serving size to be quite adequate for a quick snack, I don't think I would add these to my regular shopping list. I prefer 100 calorie snacks. I didn't find that the taste justified the extra 30 calories. They also seem rather expensive.I'd rather stick with regular popcorn - much more for your calorie count/money.

love, love, love it. Very fresh taste of chocolate on every kernal & extremly crunchy. I don't really taste the caramel though but the flavor is still so good I don't even care. You get 5 packages in each box and each package holds 2 large handfuls. If you hold it in your hand for more than a few seconds before putting it in your mouth the chocolate will start melting so put it in your mouth right away as you take it out of the package. I love popcorn and usually eat 3 to 4 popped quarts at a time so it's too expensive for me to buy but it sure was good.......

I have always loved Poppycock that wonderful concoction of popcorn drizzled in chocolate or caramel with clumps of peanuts or pecans or cashews.  I can eat a whole bag by myself.  Unfortunately, it's not light in calories or fat so imagine my surprise when I saw the Snackwell Fudge Drizzled Caramel popcorn on Amazon.  A 5.3 ounce bag has only 130 calories.  That is a snack after my own heart.  I tried the chocolate drizzle thinking it wouldn't be anywhere near as good as the Poppycock, but I was wrong.  One box contains 5 individual bags.  The portions are just enough to satisfy your craving for something sweet but not too much that you feel guilty for overeating.  As I seem to have a problem with portion size, it is nice to have individual bags that control the portion for me.  I felt like I had had a wonderful sugary snack without all the guilt. The taste was wonderful.  I enjoyed every bite.  I am so glad I can now have chocolate covered caramel popcorn without the guilt.  The Snackwell also comes in white fudge drizzle which I will also purchase.  This is a great snack if you are watching your weight and even if you aren't. I highly recommend this product to everyone.

I love the combination of chocolate with caramel corn and the Snackwell Fudge Drizzle Carmel Popcorn provided just the right balance of that combination.  The chocolate didn't overwhelm the flavor of the caramel corn.  The popcorn tasted fresh and the caramel coating has a good flavor.Caramel corn is one of those snacks that never seems to fill me up so I love that this is packaged in individual serving bags.  I can eat one bag and satisfy my craving for a sweet snack without eating an entire box of caramel corn.  At 130 calories and 18 grams of sugar per bag, it isn't a great diet snack but a nice treat once in a while.  In comparison, original Crunch 'n Munch has 160 calories and 11 grams of sugar in a similar serving size.

This is good stuff...caramel popcorn with some fudge lightly drizzled over it.  I liked it, my wife liked it, and my daughter liked it.  I guess the only negative I can see from a "healthy snack" perspective is that the key to each serving having only 130 calories is that the individual servings are quite small.  So it all comes down to portion control.  So if you have the self discipline (which I recognize I and many people don't), you could save yourself a lot of money by purchasing a larger package of caramel popcorn and splitting it up into small servings.

These Fudge Drizzle Caramel Popcorn snacks taste really good.  The flavor is pretty sweet, but not overpoweringly so.  They are drizzled with a little bit of chocolate.  Not too much, just a nice touch. This is honestly some of the tastiest caramel corn I've had.  Texture is great as well.  Crunchy but not hard.  Enthusiastic 5 stars.Nutrition:  1 pack == 30 grams.  18 g sugar.  That's 60% by weight.  3 g fat, 1 g protein.  130 kcal (calories)Not health food (too much sugar), but the portions and fat content are moderate, so this may be a good way to satisfy a sweet tooth.The only problem I have with these, is that I want more than one package.

On a diet and need that sweet tooth to calm down and stop trying to beat your gums to death? Then try the SnackWells Caramel Popcorn with Chocolate Drizzle! This satisfies the cravings for "sweet", "chocolate" and "lightly salted" all at the same time! Don't be fooled by the small size of the bags, either. These are meant as a "snack", not a "sit and watch a 2 hour movie" batch of popcorn, but they are surprisingly good and satisfying. I'll be watching for these!

column9: Smooth, Crunchy and Sweet.  What else do you want from a snack?
column10: Snackwell's fudgy caramel popcorn looks terrible.  That's the only negative!  Those ugly streaks of fudge are a surprisingly good complement to caramel popcorn.  They add a smooth texture which makes it easier to savor a kernel.  Also, the fudge and caramel create an entertaining taste war.Nutrition?  It's a snack, not a medicine!  Fat and Sugar levels are high but too high for a snack.  Probably less sugar than a similar amount of candy.  Probably less fat than a similar amount of chips.  Not healthy, but not an outrage to your body either.The fudge will melt in your hand if you hold the kernel too long but, as you would normally pop a kernel into your mouth from the bag one at a time, that isn't a problem.If you like candy popcorn, you'll probably like these.  Check 'em out!
i love the conveinence of the product, but they are a little addicting though. Maybe i am greedy. all and all i see me buying this again.
These are very good - to the people complaining that they're not a healthy snack, well duh!  They're definitely intended to be an occasional treat.  Sweet/salty, and portion-controlled.  Recommended.

I am a major fan of chocolate covered popcorn.  The unfortunate part about loving such a treat is that it is easy to...indulge.  Snackwells has introduced a product that not only tastes AMAZING, but is also available for single servings.  Each package is **130 calories** and is the perfect amount to satisfy my craving for chocolate covered popcorn (yes, I could eat all of them, but I found no problem in stopping after one package).This is a product that I recommend to anyone and I look forward to trying Snackwell's individual serving products.

column4: Julie A. Dawson "Bards and Sages Publishing"
column10: An enjoyable snack in the perfect portion.  Fudge and caramel drizzle was just the right amount, so you taste the popcorn and not just a gob of sugar.  There are less expensive snack products like this, but this was the best tasting.  Grab a bunch when they go on sale to stock up and enjoy.

I am a huge fan of salty sweet snacks so this appealed to me.  The taste is very good with a decent crunch and a lot of sweetness (needs a touch more salt) but the serving size left me wanting more.  I understand that one of the key points is portion control and it is probably my issue and not that of the manufacturer, but I wasn't satisfied after one serving, two bags is too much and at 130 calories per bag, I'm going to have to find another way to satisfy my cravings.  I would rather have a slightly larger serving at 200 cal/bag and be done with it.

I loved the taste and the texture.  The popcorn was fluffy, had just enough caramel and fudge, and was not too sweet.  To submit a proper review, I consumed three 5.3 oz packages during one evening.  I had to be sure; yes this is an item I will be buying.  I also shared them with my family; same review.  I highly recommend this snack item.

The popcorn is very sweet. I thought it tasted very much like real caramel corn.  The portion size is miniscule, even for a diet snack. The package has about six or seven popcorn kernels in it.  I think it is tremendously overpriced for what you get.

column4: T. Lee "God has died lots of times, but someo...
column10: Caramel popcorn is a tried-and-true snack and is always worth having.  Snackwells adds a drizzle of fudge which adds a tasteful hint to the popcorn that doesn't crowd in with the caramel taste.  These come in a set of six 130-calorie packs that make it easy not to shovel it into your mouth.  Indeed I found myself eating one pop at a time and really just enjoying it.  Worth a try.

This was a great little snack.  I'm a big fan of chocolate-drizzled caramel popcorn.  This was not the BEST I've ever had but it was very good, especially considering that this is a 100-calorie pack.  There are six such packs in each box with a nice portion in each bag.  I don't think you'll be disappointed - I wasn't.

My wife and I are fifty-something, and so we watch the waistline! We eat healthy, unprocessed foods - well, most of the time.So Snackwell's Fudge Drizzle Caramel Popcorn is not our normal fare. In fact, it's definitely a Sinful Little Indulgence! The top ingredients are brown sugar, popcorn, sugar, corn syrup and so on. So this is not health food. HOWEVER, it is made by Nabisco, so you know it's professionally produced. Each little pack (6 in a box) has only 130 calories, and that's not bad.Recently we went to see a movie, and instead of buying some great tub of overpriced, grease-drenched popcorn, we each smuggled in a pack in a pocket. It was delicious, and in this case, saved us gobs of calories and bad oils!The popcorn is high quality, puffed just right. The caramel taste prevails, with a delightful tang of chocolate. I found my fingers probing the bottom of the bag for any tantalizing tidbits I had missed.This product lives up to its advertising, and that's a good thing. I give 4 out of 5 stars, because they might have tried just a little harder to put a healthier sweetener in the mix. But then it wouldn't be quite so sinful, would it?

The SnackWell's products I have tried in the past were OK, but they were usually a bit bland. This is not the case here. Imagine Cracker Jacks with chocolate drizzle (but no peanuts), and that is about what this product is like. Very tasty!! The envelopes contain enough to be a realistic sized snack, and they are only 130 calories each.

I love that these bags are individual for snack size.  They taste good, not great.  I only had one wish and that was for a little salty something to cut through some of the sweet.  If you like sweet, you'll love these.  If you do not like things too sweet, move on.  They are very, very sweet.

I opened these up expecting to find maybe 8-10 pieces of popcorn in a bag, but I was pleasantly surprised to find at least twice as many.  You really do get a delicious, sweet snack for only 130 calories.  however, the popcorn was a little chewy, perhaps the result of being left at my door on a rainy day by the mailman.

The box contains five snack size packs of candy coated popcorn, like Cracker Jack, drizzled with chocolate.  It's sweet and salty and very satisfying if you have a sweet tooth and need a fix.  Each pack is 130 calories so if you want a treat that won't be too hard on your waistline this is it.  It makes a nice dessert if you like to have a sweet treat while you sit on the couch and watch TV.  It's preportioned so you can't go overboard. Also doesn't contain artificial ingredients.  However it's not a health food, it contains a lot of sugar and therefore has both feet firmly in the "treat" category. My eight year old also found it to be delicious.

column9: More than what i thought it was
column10: When I put one of these very light, airy, tasty, caramel popcorn pieces in my mouth, I could not believe it. This was really good and delicious. I personally thought it would be kind of hard, sticky, and stuck in your tooth popcorn, but it's not. I will admit it's not really really sweet, so if you are looking for something as a snack that is light, delicious, and a little sweet this is what you need. I was also glad that I could eat the whole bag and not feel bad about it, since one bag is 130 calories.P.s.  There was enough to satisfy my snack craving in this one little bag.

I love Kettle Corn, so, although I'm not much of a snack person, decided to give this a try.  It's perfectly fine combination of popcorn, caramel and chocolate.  They did a good job of making sure one taste didn't overpower.  It's a little salty for my taste and does contain 190 mg of sodium.  I was also a bit alarmed that the very first ingredient was "brown sugar," even before the popcorn - and I noticed a faint aftertaste.That being said, it's a nice snack and a nice size if dinner is late and you need a pick-me-up.  A lot of reduced-calorie foods taste like it, and this did not.  I probably won't buy it very often, but it was worth trying.

As a "career dieter", I am forever on the hunt for legal snack foods that don't taste like styrofoam.  I saw these and thought, what the heck?  I love popcorn and I love fudge...WIN!!  The packages are small and great for satisfying that little craving without blowing the calorie bank.  Satisfying blend of sweet and savory...just right!

These snacks are a big hit with my family.  My kids (7 and 4) both loved them and begged for more.  This snack is similar to Cracker Jacks but with a lot less caramel, and then an added drizzle of chocolate (the maker calls it fudge). Note that they are "drizzled" with chocolate, not dunked.  Pretty yummy, without being sticky-sweet.  I would prefer a hint of salt on them to hit a few other tastebuds as well, but the kids dig 'em as is.  We'll be buying more of these.  Package size is a good serving size for throwing in a lunchbox.

Tasty caramel corn snack with a touch of chocolate.  Very light as compared to, for instance, Cracker Jack.  Individually packed in nice snack sized foil pouches (mine find their way into school lunch bags).  Seems nice and fresh.My two very minor negatives:  Wish they had a small hand wipe packet attached.  These are a sticky fingers guarantee.  And, I wish they would have provided a starter notch for tearing open the pouch.  Hard to get started and welcomes the "teeth method" from little teeth (bad habit).A good light snack choice.

column9: OMG!!! Delish!  Just wish it had better ingredients...
column10: I am so glad that the Snackwell people didn't try artificially limiting everything to just 100 calories, and didn't jump through too many hoops to make the snack low calorie.  It's a perfectly sized serving of yummy deliciousness.  Just enough you have your sweet tooth satisfied, and that you feel you need to rip open another pack because you're not satieted...  but at the same time, you don't feel horribly guilty for over indulging.That said, my biggest issue was with the artificial ingredients.  I think I would have been possible to do this snack with "healthier" ingredients. Not necessarily organic, but more than just a bunch of chemicals.  I was particularly disappointed because the green packaging made me expect a bit more.

You get a good idea what you're in for just from the name: fudge drizzle caramel popcorn. And the taste doesn't disappoint; the popcorn is crisp, the caramel is buttery-good, and fudge is chocolately good. And a bag is just 130 calories, which shouldn't ruin anyone's diet.That being said, nothing is free in this world...so 130 calories amounts to a fairly small (but satisfying) serving. Just right for inclusion in a lunchbox for dessert, or for a special "reward" for those of us who need to count calories.

While this popcorn is truly yummy -- sweet but not overly so, with light caramel and fudge -- it is marketed a bit deceptively. Packaged under the Snackwell name and with today's popular "limited calorie count," many consumers might automatically grab for these, thinking they are healthy. However, in one serving size -- a mere handful of popcorn -- you've got 190 mg of sodium and 18 g of sugar! I did enjoy this snack, but in the future I think I'll stick with something damaging.

column9: A nice low calorie snack option
column10: This is a basic 130 calore snack pack option for those watching calories.It has just enough of a chocolate drizzle to get your taste of chocolate, coupled with a smooth Carmel coating on the popcorn it is a nice option for those sweet tooth days.

I'm definitely not a big salt lover, and caramel can be a bit hit or miss with me.  So I wasn't sure how much I'd like these treats.  Well, I think there's a reason that Snackwell put 'Fudge Drizzle' first on the box!  This popcorn is definitely sweet, I didn't notice too much of a salt taste to the popcorn and the caramel could be more buttery and a little stronger in flavor.  But it's crunchy, it's got a good taste, the fudge isn't overwhelmingly powerful and what's really nice is there's no fake sugar after-taste to the snack at all, which is a concern when they're trying to watch calories.  I'm not exactly inspired to eat more than one bag at a time because of how sweet the popcorn is, but that's not exactly a bad thing.  It's nice to get the chocolate craving satisfied with one pack.

The Fudge Drizzle Caramel popcorn is really yummy -- the caramel is sweet but not cloying and the popcorn is satisfyingly crunchy.  However, like so many SnackWell products, this is NOT a low calorie snack considering the calories to fullness ratio -- my daughter put away three bags in fifteen minutes as her after school snack after a long hard day at school.  This wouldn't matter a great deal except that the price of this treat -- five small bags in a box -- makes them more of a every-now-and-then treat rather than a house staple.The box is really pretty though.  The green made me feel good about opening the cardboard box.  And that's what it's supposed to do, right?  ;)So I'd finally recommend these if 1)  you're not THAT hungry and 2)  you have a lot of money you are wanting to get out.Taste is really good -- so I can see the argument for these.  Worth four stars but only if criteria 1 and 2 work for you.

This is a good-tasting snack that comes in a portion-control pack. The popcorn base is very light and soft, which was the most enjoyable part of the treat, as many times caramel corn is chewy and indigestible. The corns are lightly coated with a caramel coating that I would say is closer to the taste of the old Fiddle-Faddle or Screaming Yellow Zonkers than Cracker Jack, and then drizzled with chocolate, for a more sweet than salty combo. If you are a caramel corn/chocolate fan but are trying to watch your sweet intake, this may be the answer for you. I don't see myself buying them regularly as we are trying to avoid sweets, but I think they would be a good addition to a "ditty bag" like we keep in our car on road trips, to keep from buying higher-priced, larger-portioned snacks at gas station convenience store, which contains a combination of baked chips and crackers, fruit, and trail mix.The one improvement I could think for this would be to add nuts, but of course then that would add calories and fat.

I love popcorn... and I love caramel, therefore I do enjoy caramel corn. I thought the fudge drizzle would make it even better, but that made it too over-the-top sweet for my taste. I think I'd rather just have caramel corn and save the extra calories that the fudge adds. But then, admittedly, I'm not a huge chocolate fan. I'm one of those weird people who can take it or leave it. If you especially love chocolate (like most people I know) you'd probably really like the fudge. I did like that it has limited calories (130) per bag, so you can eat just that much and stop. With as sweet as this is, I didn't have any trouble stopping after one bag, even though it was only a handful of popcorn. Another plus: no high fructose corn syrup, no hydrogenated oils.

column4: M. Jobbagy "Follow Your Bliss - Joseph Cambell"
column10: I enjoyed this Snackwells popcorn. It had just enough caramel and fudge. It's like Cracker Jacks on steroids with the fudge drizzled on em.The portions in the individual packages was plenty for me, and if you want more, just open up another little bag.If you like caramel covered popcorn, you won't want to miss this one, sweet tooth satisfaction, as well as the popcorn crunch.

Which, of course, if you REALLY like EXTREMELY sweet things, you would probably rate this five stars! I just think it's too over the top between the caramel and the chocolate drizzle. The chocolate is okay tasting; not the best. It will certainly satisfy your sweet craving for 130 calories in the individual package. I do like, however, the fact that there is no high fructose corn syrup in this product. Although there is brown sugar and corn syrup. If you really want sweet, by all means, have at these ~ you will most likely really enjoy them!

SnackWell's has always made a great low-fat treat and the Fudge Drizzle Caramel Popcorn is no exception. At first taste, I thought I was eating Cracker Jax with chocolate, and started digging through for my prize! While the package looks small, it's the perfect amount, and not too fudgy or over-the-top caramelly. A perfect afternoon snack for adults. I wouldn't share this one with the kids though -- keep these for yourself!

I bought a product very similar to this one from the Boy Scouts last year. That was good, but very expensive. This one was also good, but the price is more digestible. Really, you get what you expect from this product. No one who doesn't like popcorn is going to buy this product. People who do like popcorn are going to buy this product and really enjoy it. Is it a healthy snack? No! Did you really expect chocolate- and carmel-covered popcorn to be healthy? I guess you get some fiber in there, but - no - this isn't a health food. It is a guilty pleasure. It's just what you'd expect, and that is a great-tasting snack! Each of my kids is going to school, today, with a pouch of this in their lunches. The serving size is just right for this. The only reason I didn't give this product five stars was that I realize there are healthier snacks out there. But if you are just looking for a light snack that tastes great, this is a good one to choose! I'd love to get another free sample of this stuff!

The Snackwell Fudge Drizzle popcorn is tasty, and light.  Each popcorn kernel is drizzled with an adequate amount of chocolate and caramel, and the popcorn itself is very light.  A little too light, such that the chocolate and caramel flavors overwhelm the delicate popcorn flavor with their sweetness (therefore requiring the deduction of one star).  Another reason for the loss of one star is the use of corn syrup; the ingredients list looked promising until I came upon corn syrup midway through.  On the plus side, the popcorn is a delicious snack without the guilt-inducing calories.

As the name says, this Snackwell snack is popcorn covered in caramel and chocolate. It tastes great, but we like the version with the white chocolate drizzled on it better. This may sound strange for popcorn, but either flavor goes well with milk. They are both favorites in our house.Like most low-cal snack packs, the serving size is "small". One isn't quite enough, but two servings would probably be too much.According to the label, each serving (1 package) has 130 calories and 2.5 grams of saturated fat. As of the time I'm writing the review, the box says that it contains milk and soy and was "manufactured on equipment that processes wheat, peanut".

I hadn't tried a SnackWells product in years, and this one was surprisingly enjoyable.  The portion is satisfying, despite the 130 calorie limit.  The chocolate was real, melty chocolate, not some artificially flavored stuff you might expect in a low calorie snack, and I was pleased with the amount of chocolate as well.My kids and husband tried this, too - hubby and one daughter liked it so well, they asked if there were more packets.  The other daughter didn't like it, but she doesn't care for popcorn snacks in general.I will say the other pleasant surprise was that the caramel didn't stick heavily all over my teeth, as some other caramel corn products (like Cracker Jack) do - the caramel coating is light and crispy, and not too sweet for me!

Maybe it is unfair to compare but I had to ask myself if I would purchase Snackwell's caramel popcorn instead of Cracker Jacks. One of my favorite parts of Cracker Jacks besides the popcorn is the searching for the nuts. I love the taste of the caramel corn mixed with peanuts.I really missed the nuts in this small handy snack pack. The caramel taste was very good and very sweet as usual. The popcorn was very fresh tasting. Adding the drizzle of fudge did not bring a taste of chocolate. I felt the chocolate was lost within the sweetness of the caramel.So my conclusion is why would I purchase this when a snack box of cracker jacks is less calories, more protein and about the same amount of carb?

I love sweet and salty food combinations - usually when I eat regular popcorn I have some sort of chocolate to go with it. This Snackwell's fudge drizzled caramel popcorn is a great sweet and salty combination. I thought the taste was just as good as Topsy's popcorn. I appreciate that it's packaged in 130 calorie packs so I can just grab it and go without trying to figure out the portion size myself (and therefor eating way too much!)Allergy information: Contains milk, soy. Manufactured on equipment that processes wheat, peanut.

rather pricey.  Amazon is selling these for $34.98 a carton (you get 6 boxes, each with five little packs in them) That works out to about $5.83 a box.Ok, that said...they are tasty, and the convenient size makes it easy to control how much you eat.  Each little packet has 130 calories.  Not a bad snack if you are watching your weight, as I am.  There is a lot of sugar for such a small little snack size (18 grams), so that is a bit of a drawback for me.  I do like that there is no trans fat in this snack though.When I was young my father used to eat Snack Well cookies, I don't remember what they were called, but boy were they yummy!  As I got older I dont' remember seeing snack wells for awhile, or perhaps I over looked the items on the shelf.  But, it looks like the brand is reinventing itself, with bright new packaging. (The cheery green with yellow is certainly eye catching!)Bottom line-this is a tasty snack.  Something I might buy for myself once in awhile, but at this price point it won't become a mainstay in my pantry any time soon.

column4: Peggy Bowes "Author of The Rosary Workout"
column9: Satisfies a sweet tooth with some crunch
