column10: First of all, this is not health food.  It's mostly sugar with only a gram of protein and fiber.  That said, consider it a fairly low-calorie way to satisfy a sweet tooth and a need to eat something crunchy-- during a movie, for instance or as a treat in a child's lunch box.The product tastes a lot like Cracker Jacks covered in chocolate.  It has a nice crunch and a sweet, caramel-and-chocolate flavor.  My family agreed that we prefer the Boy Scout version of caramel popcorn, but this is definitely better than Cracker Jacks.  If the price were more reasonable, I would buy this as an occasional treat.  But in this economy, rent a movie and buy a box of Snackwell Fudge Drizzle Caramel Popcorn and you can still enjoy a family movie night for a fraction of the cost and calories as going to the theater.

I usually like something sweet to end a meal.  The problem with that, of course, is the calorie overload.  So then comes along this caramel and chocolate popcorn.  I like the size of the pack if I've eaten something else already because it's not too big and not too small.There's enough snack in the bag to be just right without being over the top in sweetness.  Best when eaten with something else though, rather than on it's own because then, not so filling.  The flavor of the drizzle and the caramels seem to be pretty balanced so one doesn't totally overtake the other and the conistency of the popcorn is just the right amount of crunch without being soggy.I liked it and would recommend it for others who don't want a big calorie laden and heavy meal finisher or treat.  My mom took a packet to work and told me several of her coworkers wanted to know where they could get their own and they're a pretty picky bunch, so it must be good!

I wasn't sure what to expect from this little snack pack. I was sort of expecting something like Cracker Jacks. This SnackWells was much better. I was waiting to bite into a kernel that had yet to pop but it never happened.The popcorn itself is light and airy. However, it doesn't have a distinctive popcorn flavor. I don't pickup any caramel flavoring either. I do taste the fudge but to me it tastes like dark chocolate. Which is perfect if you're into eating healthy but I'd prefer milk chocolate.One package has only 130 calories. Very low if you're trying to eat a little healthier.All in all I thought it was a good quick snack. While the price itself seems a little bit high it has some good flavoring and is a good after lunch/dinner snack.

column9: Wouldn't say it's "healthy", but it's yummy!
column10: SnackWell's loves to tout itself as a "healthy" choice, and I suppose their products are better choices than other options out there.  Having a small bag of their Fudge Drizzle Caramel Popcorn is certainly better than a large tub of buttery popcorn at the movie theater.  But as this product is super-high in sugar, I wouldn't necessarily put it in the health food category.However, as far as taste testing-- yummy!  I love the mixture of the caramel corn (which reminds me of Cracker Jack) and the chocolate.  It was a really nice treat. I'm glad the product was separated into individual serving bags, because this helps with portion control.  With one large box, I'd be tempted to have too many servings!If you do buy this product and use it in to-go meals or snacks, make sure that the bag stays in a relatively cool environment.  If left out in the heat, I'm sure the chocolate would melt everywhere and turn into a gooey mess inside the bag.  So it would be fine to put in an insulated lunch bag for work or school, but it might not be the best choice to take with you on a day at the beach.Yum!

column9: A Popcorn Snack For Mature Tastes
column10: As a young child I enjoyed eating Cracker Jacks but when I became a man my tastes elevated and I graduated to heavily buttered and salted home-popped popcorn. Now I discovered a popcorn snack that definitely is for mature taste buds that appreciate the finer things in life.SnackWell's Fudge Drizzled Caramel Popcorn by Nabisco is certainly not as greasy or as salty and has far fewer leftover kernels than my home-popped popcorn. But it has many more benefits than that, like a rich, deep chocolate taste that lingers until the next bite is taken and a subtle but distinct caramel taste. My home-popped snack I eat by the handfuls but SnackWell's popcorn I eat one at a time to fully enjoy this taste treat.This treat was first made in 1992 but it took me nine years to discover it; maybe because they upped the calories from 100 to 130. How can you enjoy a 100-calorie snack? What's with that! And others must have agreed with me because sales for the 100-calorie version sunk from $490 million in 1995 to $32 million in 2010. The 130-calorie version has been introduced on the market with the advertising slogan, "Be Bad, Snack Well." Sounds good to me.SnackWell's Fudge Drizzled Caramel Popcorn comes in a box of five 1.06 ounce individual bags. You might beconcerned about theamounts of sugar, salt and fat, but you can't worry a whole lot about calories when engaged in snacking.Join the chorus, "Be Bad, Snack Well."

There is honestly no question that there are some foods that really need improvement in taste. While carmel corn has been a constant classic, when it does come together with chocolate, it could use a bit of improvement. That is proof of the pudding with Snackwell's new fudge drizzle caramel popcorn. While the concept of the snack is alright, you really don't taste the carmel corn as much as you simply do with the chocolate. It is unfortunate that there was a lack with the taste of the carmel corn, becasue if there was more of a taste of the corn, it would've been a much sweeter snack than what is made out to be. Hopefully, if Snackwell's can keep this one out, they can improve the taste of it.Price: CTaste: COverall: C

These portion controlled treats are like an adult version of Cracker Jack - 24/1.25 oz. bags, replacing peanuts with a chocolate drizzle. I like a combination of salty and sweet, so they hit the spot for me, but other members of the household felt the salt flavor was too strong. We all agreed that the popcorn tasted fresh and the serving size was not too small. As a snack, I'd give it a 4 or 5 star rating depending on the household member rating it. As a 'healthier' option (which Snack Well's promotes) I think it is no better than other candied popcorns on the market. With 5 % total fat (vs 3%) and 13 % saturated (vs 0) I would not always choose it over our preferred candy popcorn brand, despite it tasting much fresher. That said, I would certainly get it for a change of pace, it's a very tasty treat.Ingredients: Brown Sugar, Popcorn, Sugar, Corn Syrup, Palm and/or Palm Kernel Oil, Skim Milk, Cocoa, Whey Powder, Salt, Soybean Oil, Soy Lecithin, Vanilla Extract.Calories 130Calories From Fat 25

column9: Tasty, not entirely unhealthy, VERY sweet
column10: Not that I would expect something called "Fudge Drizzle Caramel Popcorn" not to be sweet, but seriously, the first ingredient is brown sugar -- that's right, there is more brown sugar than popcorn in this!  The next three ingredients are popcorn, sugar, and corn syrup, so three out of the top four ingredients are sugars.  Also, 2.5 out of the 3 grams of fat in each serving are highly saturated palm oil ("and/or palm kernel oil," which is certainly no better).On the plus side, Nabisco appears to have made an effort to use only "real" foods in this snack:  skim milk, cocoa, salt, soybean oil, soy lecithin, and vanilla extract round out the list of ingredients.Snackwell's snacks are positioned as "a sensible snack" aimed at "weight conscious women" (from their own ad copy).  If you really want the fudge drizzle, and you can really eat just one pack, the Snackwell's Fudge Drizzled Caramel Popcorn will definitely hit your sweet tooth and wouldn't be a horrible choice healthwise.  However, each pack provides just over an ounce of caramel corn, a handful, for 130 calories, 2.5 grams of saturated fat, and 190 mg of sodium (8% of the recommended daily value).Compare this to, say, Cracker Jack -- you can eat the whole box, peanuts and all, for 150 calories, 2.5 grams of fat (none of which is saturated fat), and only 90 mg of sodium.  Or, have a full cup of Orville Redenbacher's microwave caramel corn for 80 calories, 3.5 grams of fat, and a mere 20 mg of sodium, less than 1% of the recommended daily value.In my book, that doesn't make Snackwell's the most sensible snack.

column9: A Bit On The Sweet Side
column10: At first taste I found these cloyingly sweet. But once my taste buds adjusted, I wound up enjoying the contrast between slightly salty popcorn and sweet coating. The chocolate tastes nice, it's a perfect movie treat, and I love the concept these days of limiting the size of one package to the size of one serving--really helps me not overeat. For a convenient, low-cal sweet fix, I say very well. SNACK well.

column9: Too much sweet even at only 5.3 ounces
column10: Couple points to make about this.1) I don't think that any product that contains astronomical levels of sugar should be able to legally be sold under the label "Snack WELLs".2) I'm a huge sweets fan (and actually i'm partial to food in general). I don't eat healthy or in moderation. But I had a hard time finishing this minuscule bag of fudge-covered, caramel-coated popcorn in a single setting. I mean really? Do we need to add something to caramel corn to make it taste good? This is just like other American food trends, like the double bacon, extra cheesy, onion ring whopper. NOT NECESSARY. The equation of (great tasting food 1 + great tasting food 2) = food that tastes better than either food 1 or 2 does not always hold true.I would suggest eating this at your dentist so they can just give you a filling right after you're done eating it.

column9: Sweet treat, but not exactly healthy
column10: Snackwell has done a great job over the years of providing low-calorie options for those who crave something a little sweet at the end of a meal. The new Fudge Drizzled Caramel Popcorn is a delightful snack that certainly satisfies the sweet tooth, but isn't exactly a "healthy" treat, so much as a treat that depends upon portion control.Here is a breakdown of the key nutrition facts:Calories: 130 Calories from Fat: 25Total Fat: 3g (5%)Saturated Fat: 2.5g (13%)Sodium: 190mg (8%)Potassium: 30mg (1%)Total Carbohydrate: 24g (8%)Sugars: 18gMind you, these numbers are based on a one-pouch serving, which is 30g. The high calorie ratio isn't surprising, when you consider that the first 2 of 3 ingredients are sugar, with the fourth being corn syrup. Here's the complete ingredient list:Brown Sugar, Popcorn, Sugar, Corn Syrup, Palm and/or Kernel Oil, Skim Milk, Cocoa, Whey Powder, Salt, Soybean Oil, Soy Lecithin, Vanilla Extract.Despite this, one cannot deny just how tasty of a snack this is. The popcorn is crisp and fresh, and the combination of caramel and fudge is undeniably a winner. A healthier, and far less expensive, option would be to pop your own popcorn, with no salt or butter, drizzle a tiny bit of melted caramel over the top, and sprinkle a little cocoa powder. But, for those on the go, the Snackwell Fudge Drizzled Caramel Popcorn is a convenient option. Just be certain to grab only one pouch before heading out the door.
This is a great little snack if you're a caramel corn fan.  It doesn't taste "diety" and it is a bit chewy, but I actually like it better that way.

column9: Tasty but very sweet! Small amount loaded with sugar.
column10: This Snackwell product is *very* tasty, albeit a small amount (1 ounce) for 130 calories. I have quite a sweet tooth, but I found it too sweet even for my tastes. The reason why is because it is LOADED with Sugar. Here's a list of the first 4 ingredients.First ingredient - Brown SugarSecond ingredient - PopcornThird ingredient - SugarFourth ingredient - Corn SyrupThis is not a product that many health-oriented people would choose to put in their system! The product is not about eating healthy or snacking well. The product is all about portion control. If you are looking for a healthy alternative to sweet treats, I think there are better options out there. I am glad I tried it, but I won't be purchasing it again.

When I first opened this product, I was expecting a lower quality cardboard replica of popcorn.  What I got instead was Cracker-Jacks with fudge - more than a drizzle, but less than a coating.  These are scrumptious.The 1.06 oz 130 calorie pack is just the right size for an afternoon snack without feeling overly indulgent.A sweet aftertaste with no added chemical tang that you occasionally get with other products.  The only drawback that I encountered was that they made me extremely thirsty.  Brown Sugar is the first listed ingredient, so maybe that is where the problem lies.Taste wise, Nabisco did a great job with this product.  Without a doubt, I will be purchasing these on my own.Price wise, once again this product can be found cheaper elsewhere.If you are looking for a limited guilt snack, check them out, but first check pricing and get your money's worth.

Reviewing a food product is rather difficult simply because we all have differing palates and consider certain things more important than others. So for example, I think the nutritional value is paramount, whereas someone else may only care for taste.I think it's awesome that this is a sweet and small portioned snack. We don't always want to snack on fruit, veggies or nuts, so it's good to be able to switch it up.  With that said, the 18 grams of sugar is really too much for such a small serving. In looking at the ingredients, there are 3 sugars named: brown sugar ( the first listed ingredient), sugar  and then corn syrup.The reason why this is not ideal (for my family and I) is that after you get that sugar high and then crash, you're most likely gonna want to grab another bag or another snack.With regards to the flavor itself, I would have prefered it without the fudge deluge (can't call that a drizzle). The caramel is plenty sweet on its own and has good flavor.All in all, if they come out with a non fudge version with a lighter coating of caramel it would be a win for me. As it is, this is a snack that I would not recommend.

I LOVE these!  RAVE!  The perfect amount of caramel to chocolate on every single piece of crisp popcorn.I used to spend $5-$6 on a tiny bag of the gourmet popcorn from a little shop to be disappointed that only a few had fudge and it was mostly just caramel. Not anymore! Problem solved, and for a fraction of the cost!  Also, at only 130 calories a bag its the perfect guilt free "dessert".Snackwell Fudge Drizzle Caramel Popcorn will definitely become a regular in my pantry!

column9: Doesn't taste light in calories, but it is.
column10: Nabisco SnackWell Fudge Drizzled Caramel Popcorn is very tasty.  You'd have no idea that this was a "light" or "diet" snack, but it is indeed low in calories and relatively low in fat.This caramel popcorn is moist and has more fudge drizzled on it than you'd think.  I think they're extremely tasty.  I suppose my only complaint would be that each serving is just a bit over 1 ounce.  So it's a very tasty snack but you don't get a lot of it.  I could eat an entire box in 1 or 2 sittings withough any trouble.However, if you are looking for a reasonably healthy and very tasty snack that comes in controlled portion servings, this is a good choice.

column9: Good Enough for a last resort
column10: As far as snacks go, my family tends to enjoy sweet and to the point when we're on the go.  We don't fall in for messy snacks, or snacks that you need to put together for the 'full effect'.  I got these thinking they'd be good for when we're at the park or beach.For purposes of this review I shared the 5 packs between myself, my sister (18), my cousin (13), my dad (50) and my brother (25) so I could get more than one opinion across age groups.First, I want to point out that these are NOT good for warm/hot days.  I kept my package in an insulated lunchbag in my car for the 15 minutes it took us to drive to the park for the picnic, windows down (save the AC!).  It then sat in the bag for about another 10 minutes until we set up the blanket and all.  It was a gooey mess.  The chocolate drizzling we were all looking forward to became a nightmare as we had to tear open the bags so they lay flat and pick out the popcorn nuggets one at time to avoid being covered in chocolate.Taste wise these were better then the average 'low calorie' snack.  In fact until I told my family they were only 130 calories they had no idea.  The packs didn't scrimp on how much either.  The 1.06 ounce package was easily filled 3/4ths of the way, which is always pleasing.  I prefer dark chocolate to milk chocolate, but the group consensus was that it tasted good and didn't have a weird after taste some low calorie foods seem to have.Of the five of us my cousin and my brother seemed to enjoy the snack the most, my sister was so-so on it while my dad and I weren't blown away but enjoyed it for what it was.  I think if the treats hadn't melted the way they did we would have enjoyed these a bit more.

Oh my gosh....I love these.  They just arrived in my mailbox today.  I opened a bag planning to share them with my daughter and was disappointed that I had agreed to share!Each little bag is filled with crunchy caramel popcorn.  The delicious morsels have just the right touch of salt and when mixed with the drizzled chocolate they are sweet as well.  It's kind of like eating fries with a shake, it just works!Each pack is only 130 calories and whatever they did with these little guys to make them low in calories did not include sacrificing taste.  I have made the real deal myself and I think I like this low calorie version better, they are still sweet but not overwhelming.I will be buying more of these, a big thank you to Amazon Vine for the box of Snackwell's to sample and review!

column9: What's with the tiny little bag?
column10: This is really ridiculous.  A little 3x5 bag stuffed with extraordinary popcorn.  At about $1 per bag.  I think a dollar bill might be bigger than these baggies.  I understand that we want teensy bags to fit in the lunch box, and we don't want to overdo our calorie intake, but YES WE DO WANT TO OVERDO IT!!!  Good thing there are more tiny bags in the box.Firm and crispy little popcorns smothered in caramel and prettily drizzled with chocolate... each piece is like a little work of art... really... I could sit and look at them for entertainment.  For just a few seconds.  Before I eat them.I will say that I have experienced tastier caramel popcorn.  Once in a while in life, a person encounters that gourmet caramel popcorn that is just slightly gooey, buttery, salty, sweet... these come close.These are wonderful.  Definitely not diet food... I don't know what they were thinking putting it in a green box and writing calorie info on it.  Very tasty.  You will eat more than one teeny bag.  Unless you have more self-control than I have.  I have eaten three bags.  More than half the box.  I would eat more but my kids already claimed the other two bags.  Poof... all gone.

I love Snack Wells products and this new treat is not exception. Yummy caramel-covered popcorn with a light chocolate drizzle in little 130 calorie packs, these are perfect for throwing in my workbag for a mid-day snack I dont have to feel guilty about eating. The portion-control concept is nothing new, but I truly felt satisfied with the amount you get in the individual bags. This is snack that will satisfy a late night or in-between meal craving for anyone. It also has just the right amount of chocolate drizzle to make it tasty but not too sweet. I hope they come out with more flavors.

I have never tried Snackwell Products before and was pleasantly surprised b the popcorn. Although, it comes in a small package, the chocolate drizzle and caramel makes for a nice treat on the popcorn. And for being a diet snack, you'd never know. It certainly keeps me within my diet. Only 3 Weight Watcher points per bag.

I love popcorn so I was looking forward to this tasty treat and it did not disappoint. This fudge drizzled popcorn is chocolatey and sugary -satisfying the need for something sweet. The portion controlled packaging is great at 130 calories. Each package contains just the right amount to satisfy and indulge without feeling remorse after.This is not a healthy treat. It contains a lot of sugar and other non nutritious ingredients. Certainly an apple or orange would be better. But sometimes that sweet tooth just craves something like this.Price wise it is not as cheap as popping up plain popcorn, but at six boxes for around $35 and five pouches to a box, it works out to just a little over a dollar a bag which is pretty reasonable.I do love the individual packaging. Given a full bag of caramel corn it can be easy to over eat, the packaging here tells you when it is time to stop.Overall, these tasty treats are a good bet to satisfy.

Popcorn can be a healthy snack depending on how it is made and what you add to it.  Adding caramel adds a lot of sugars and calories so I was surprised by how many pieces were in one of these 130 calorie packs. It was a good size amount, a small bowl worth approximately.  The popcorn tasted fresh, it was crispy but soft at the same time.  The caramel was very tangy, not overly sweet at all.As some of my regular readers may know, I've been running a group called The Chocolate Cult for some time.  If this was a review for that group, the number of stars would be lowered to two because this product fails when it comes to the chocolate.  First, I noticed that the chocolate itself was slightly discolored which means it had some temperature problems -- not in my house because we know how to store and use chocolate -- which allowed some of the fat to rise to the top.  Some folks say this doesn't affect flavor but I think it lessens the cocoa intensity.If you want caramel popcorn, this was great.  If you wanted a strong fudge flavor this was poor.  They could lessen the calories and give us more of the caramel corn but just removing the drizzle entirely and it would taste even better.

This fudge drizzzled popcorn is the BEST!! It is caramel popcorn with fudge. At 130 calories it is a small portion of popcorn that is full of taste. This delicious snacks helps me to stick to my portion controlled diet. Very good treat!!

I love to snack and Snackwell's Fudge Drizzled Caramel Popcorn is delicious!  I am not a big caramel popcorn fan, but with the chocolate drizzle and freshness, it is so good!  There is also a lot (1.06 oz packages) in each pack for it only being 130 calories, which makes it a perfect light snack.  It comes in a small enough bag that you can throw one in your bag or purse for on-the-go snacking.  My 4 year old loves this popcorn and we actually fight over it!  I will definitely be purchasing more of these in the future!

column9: Pretty Good but still using corn syrup
column10: The Snackwell Fudge Drizzle Caramel Popcorn comes in package of 5 130 calories bags.No need to put it in the microwave, it is already ready for eating right of the bag.Each bag weights about 1Oz and contains 130 Calories (25 from Fat)Pretty high in saturated fat (2.5g out of 3g), it is also pretty high in sodium, as most snacks, and sugars.I am trying to eat healthy so I would stay away from it just for the fact that it contains Corn syrup. A good point though is that it contains also brown sugar.I distributed the packages around my office and the general feedback was pretty good. These popcorns are quite crunchy and tasty. Almost too sweet for my taste.The packaging makes it also pretty easy to control the portions.Conclusion:Not an healthy food choice but definitely a tasty one!
This is a very delicious snack. At 130 calories per pack, it's not terrible for you either. You won't be disappointed in this snack.

OMG--I thought these were wonderful! Very tasty, chocolately but not too sweet--just perfect. The perfect little snack in the afternoon with a cup of coffee, or a light dessert after dinner when you're dying for something sweet. And only 130 calories--I LOVE these!

I don't like long reviews... and this is a simple item: healthy popcorn with caramel and chocolate drizzled over it. People, it's good. You should buy this item for the simple fact that 1 pack only has 130 calories and is filling and tasty. 5 stars for a great product that meets the sweet-tooth without adding to the belly. Thanks, Snackwells!!!

column9: A new twist on caramel popcorn
column10: Snackwell caramel popcorn adds a new twist to caramel corn.  The chocolate drizzled on them adds a new dimension to the flavor.  They have a sweet, salty and chocolaty taste that is well balanced.  Like all Snackwell snacks, they are not too high in calories (130) or fat (3 grams).  The size is just right for a quick snack but you only get 6 packs per box so you'll want to get several.  Seriously, these don't taste like a "light" snack.  They are really good!

Do you like caramel popcorn? Do you also like chocolate? If you answered yes to both of those questions, you'll love the Snackwell Fudge Drizzle Caramel Popcorn.  It comes in small packages which are enough for a little snack but the taste always leaves me wanting more.  My only concern I would prefer bigger packs.  The downside to a bigger pack, however, is that you have to have more self control in order to avoid over indulging.  When you see "only 130 calories per pack" you know it's not going to be very much. Portions aside, the snack is delicious.

column4: Lettetia "As Long As I Am Able To Read, I Sha...
column10: Snackwell's 130 Calorie Fudge Drizzle Caramel Popcorn is a snack lover's dream.  Not too heavy but rich in flavor.  The tastes explode in your mouth, and taste like it has many more calories.  I'm sold on this line and am adding it to my grocery list now.

column9: Satisfy your sweet tooth without sabotaging your diet
column10: I figured a 130 calorie portion of caramel popcorn would be so small as to be a joke.  While it is true that my husband could easily eat this entire box in a single snack session, I found the contents of one pouch to be a surprisingly satisfying amount.  They are light, sweet, crunchy, salty with a hint of chocolate.  What more could you want in a treat?  They aren't exactly healthy but they are "less bad" than most other sweet snacks.  If you can be happy with carrot sticks for a snack you've got more willpower than the me and I hate you for it ;-)  But for the rest of us these Snackwell treats are a great alternative to a diet killing candy bar.  They are pricey though so I might need a second mortgage on the house to keep these in my pantry.
These were SOOOOOOOOO good. I just knew I was going to be packing on the weight with these. I can't believe they are only 130 calories! Perfect snack!!!

The Snackwell's Fudge Drizzle Caramel Popcorn is sweet, crunchy and tasty.  It is a satisfying snack.  In fact, I think they could've left off the drizzle for fewer calories or put fewer pieces in the bag to get the calorie count below 130.  If they did this, it still would make for a good treat.  At first I saw 130 calories and this small bag and thought it just wouldn't be worth it, but the popcorn is so flavorful and the texture so good that I'm planning on keeping a box on hand as a kitchen staple.This product is a real winner especially for those of us trying to maintain a healthier diet.

These remind me of Crunch and Munch. The fudge coating is a bonus.I was impressed by the taste and found them better than expected.I like the serving size pacages. 130 calories per pack is a reasonable guilty pleasure.No fuss no measuring. If you are on a diet but crave sweetthese pre packaged servings can help you control your portion sizes.This does not taste like diet food and it does have a lot of sugar.I would definitely want to try these again depending on the price.

First off I'm not a picky eater and I love carmel corn so the makers would have to do pretty bad for me not to like it. What I liked the most was Nabisco didn't go nuts with the chocolate. It is lightly drizzled so that the prominent taste is still the carmel.Maybe the batch I had was extra fresh but for popcorn this was also the freshest tasting carmel corn I've had from a package. Packaged popcorn can have a little stiffness to it but the package I had tasted and felt like it was popped that day. I think I was as impressed with that as the new flavor.130 calories per pack doesn't hurt either. Great little snack to take in your lunch to satisfy your sweet tooth without hitting a vending machine for a candy bar.

column9: Yum!!  Much better than Cracker Jacks!
column10: For those times when your sweet tooth is calling, this is a fulfilling snack! The chocolate is not only drizzled on the top but the bottom of each huge kernel is covered. The popcorn tastes freshly popped with just the right combination of crunch and softness. Unlike Cracker Jacks, the carmel does not stick to your teeth, nor break them on hard pieces.While not nutrition rich, at 130 calories per package and 25 calories of fat, this is a nice occasional snack.I was sent a box free under the Amazon Vine program; however, think the Snack Well folks made a good investment as I plan to buy more!

Snackwells has done it again! These 130 calorie snack packs are great tasting and just the right size. The chocolate and caramel are done in just the right amounts to satisfy your cravings without being so heavy as to bog you down. The texture is just right as well. The popcorn gives you a good crunch while the chocolate and caramel give you something chewy to satisfy your cravings. We shared the sample packs with friends and they all gave us an enthusiastic thumbs up!

I do like the new 100-calorie pack craze; it has been opening up some new horizons for those who can be disciplined enough to eat just one pack. These caramel corn packs come in at 130 calories, which to my mind is close enough.The caramel corn itself is very good, tasting like the caramel corn I enjoyed as a child, but even better with some fudge drizzled across it! I really do like these packs, and think that you will too!(Review of Snackwell Fudge Drizzle Caramel Popcorn)

column9: Does what it says on the tin: Chocolate Caramel Corn
column10: This is a decadently tasty snack.  In fact, it's so tasty that I almost wouldn't want it for my snack drawer at work, because I'd eat all the packets right away.  It's good fluffy caramel corn, drizzled with just enough chocolate to give a good balance of caramel and chocolate.  The bulk of the flavor is very sweet, with just a hint of salt from the popcorn coming through underneath.  You get a good amount of product in each packet, though I've become so accustomed to 100-calorie packs that I wouldn't be upset to have a little less product per packet to get them down from 130 to 100 calories (and just put a sixth packet in the box).  The price here is a bit insane, especially with shipping (works out to over $1.50/packet), but I'd definitely buy these in the grocery store for 50 to 75¢/packet.  This would be a great product for bulk packaging for home snacks, too, though I'd personally be tempted to eat way too much at once in that format.

column9: It's going to be a favorite snack!
column10: I love this snack!  SnackWell's Fudge Drizzled Caramel Popcorn sounded good 'cause it has my favorite treats combined so I was hopeful when I opened the package.  (The individual bags are a great idea, btw.) It reminds me of Poppycock, a favorite snack--crispy and crunchy and caramelly.  It's drizzled with fudge, but though it looks like it's covered with a lot of chocolate, there's not a real lot of chocolate taste, but it doesn't need it.  I'll definitely be enjoying this snack again.
These are surprisingly tasty treats.  Typically, these calorie limited snacks either taste strange or come in bags that are insultingly small.  This product gets it right.

I have blood sugar issues so I am very limited in the sweet snacks I allow myself and reading the numbers on the box,I can have these wonderful taste treats.This popcorn is so crisp and the fudge & caramel drizzled on it is to die for,soooo tasty and I LOVED having this new treat.It comes in nice little packs that are only 130 calories each and I look forward to adding these to my short list of occasional snacks.These are so good!

I am a big fan of popcorn snacks...and these Snackwell Fudge Drizzle Caramel Popcorn are perfect for my tastes.  The caramel coating is just right...not too thick or thin.  It's a perfect coating of caramel deliciousness, with a dark chocolate drizzle on top.  It is light and satisfying.  Not too heavy and overly sweet like some caramel corn.  It's perfect for putting in the work lunchbox.  Mine showed up in the Amazon box on my front step warm from sitting in the sun, and the combination of warm dark chocolate and caramel on the popcorn was amazing.

When you think low fat or low calorie - you automatically think it's not going to taste good.  Not the case with this product.  The Fudge Drizzle Caramel Popcorn by SnackWell's is actually really good.  The popcorn taste just like the Cracker Jack's brand (minus the peanuts), sweet and full of flavor, plus the added fudge drizzle is a nice addition.  I actually forget this snack has only 130 calories per serving because it is very filling and tastes great!  The only problem I am going to have with this product is keeping it away from my husband.. he's a big fan of flavored popcorn and he can't tell a difference in the taste of this product verses other higher fat choices.

These just arrived today and I'm having a hard time keeping myself from eating the whole box! This popcorn is delicious. The caramel taste is not quite as strong as that of, say, Crunch 'n' Munch, but it's good anyway, and so is the chocolate. Also, a pouch of them feels more substantial than the 130 calories that are in it.It's pretty sugary so it's not actually a "health food," if that's what you're looking for. But it's YUMMY. The pouches make it easy to portion out a small indulgence. If you're after portion control, though, I recommend taking one pouch and hiding the rest. Maybe in a bank vault. Because I promise you will want another one.

I am enjoying this popcorn snack. The caramel popcorn is appropriately crunchy, and there is the right amount of fudge drizzled on. The individual packaging with its corner tear-starter is friendly. And I think the amount in this 130-calorie portion is just right -- a good item to throw in with your lunch, which I did today. I wasn't as concerned about the health aspect of this snack (just a dyed-in-the-wool chocoholic -- sorry), but it is nice to read the ingredient list and not find a bunch of chemicals.

These are nicely packaged in single serving sizes.  However, it takes a lot of will power to just eat one!  I noticed another review saying they could not taste the caramel.  I could although it was subtle.  If there was any suggestion I'd make on this, I'd say lighten up on the chocolate just a bit (and I LOVE my chocolate).  I just think it would be even tastier if the chocolate (fudge) were reduced just a bit.  Overall?  ENJOY!

Talk about good.  These little packs of Fudge Drizzle Caramel Popcorn are SO good.  Be warned....once you eat the first bite...you can't stop till they're gone.  I shared with my teenage grandsons and they agreed.  Absolutely great.  A treat for sure.  Try some soon!

I usually stick to 100 calorie pack snacks, but at only 130 calories, I thought I'd give these a try. They are very tasty-not too sweet, but enough to satisfy my ever-present sweet tooth. The size of the package is just right for a mid-day snack.

In our weight obsessed world we often give up flavor for fashion.  Hooray that with "Snackwell Fudge Drizzle Caramel Popcorn, 5.3-Ounce (Pack of 6)" we can have both.  At 130 calories per package it helps maintain the waist without going to waste.  Dreaming of caramel, buttery, popcorn with just enough chocolate drizzled to melt in your mouth?  "Snackwell Fudge Drizzle Caramel Popcorn, 5.3-Ounce (Pack of 6)" is your destiny my dieting friends.Rich, decadent and delicious, treat yourself to a treat with this mouth-watering snack.  No regrets!!!!

I'm generally wary of 'snack' things.  I love snacks, but I've been kind of disappointed with either the serving size or the taste of many other 'low-calorie' or 'healthier' snacks.Not so with these! This really is chocolate and caramel on popcorn. No fake taste, and best, no stale taste as popped popcorn can easily get.The packets are a good size--you really have a nice amount for those of you, like me, who do enjoy the whole 'reaching for more' thing.  There's 'more' to reach for, but not too much.I used these as a midafternoon pickmeup snack and I found myself looking forward to snacktime the way I normally only did when cookies or brownies...but with less guilt.I will definitely buy these again!

I love popcorn. I love carmel popcorn. I love chocolate.  Fudge drizzed carmel popcorn felt like a dream come true.  I truly enjoyed this product, it quite delicious.  It tastes more like eating candy than popcorn, though.  It had the crunch of popcorn, but seemed rather sweet and sugery. I almost would prefer a little more popcorn and a less sweet carmel so that I can get the real feel of eating popcorn.  To sum it up, it's good, but really on the sugery-sweet side.  More like a dessert rather than a snack.

This popcorn makes for a very tasty snack!  The popcorn is generously covered in caramel and drizzled in chocolate.  It's a tasty sweet treat.  The individual packs are handy for lunches, and convenient because they keep you from eating the whole box (you'll want to).  This didn't taste like a diet or low-fat food.  There were no weird flavors or strange aftertastes.  I would definitely buy this; I'm hoping that there are more flavors.

column9: A tasty snack definitely worth the calories
column10: I've always been a fan of popcorn as a healthy (relatively) snack that at least offers a modicum of fiber, not too heavy calories and that is more or less good for your body if you can handle the sodium. Unfortunately, reduced portion packs of popcorn rarely satisfy, while reduced calorie popcorn tastes like cardboard, and whole bags of popcorn have just too many calories for a diet conscious body to consume. Then there's the 100-calorie "snack packs' of various other things like crackers, cookies and chocolate that just as you start to get sated, the pack goes empty and you struggle with whether you should open another pack or just suffer through your hunger pangs. SnackWell's, on the other hand, offers this rich caramel coating with luscious fudge accent over crispy popcorn that comes in individual 130-calorie servings. The rich flavor, satisfying crunch with varied textures of stickiness, crispiness and chewiness makes it feel as though you are eating something substantial, while the extra 30 calories over the usual 100 leaves one feeling satisfied and not craving another pack. The mix of saltiness with caramel and sweet chocolate is just right. The 130 calorie packs are convenient and not diet breakers. And that's it. SnackWell's tastes great, helps in controlling calorie intake, and dispenses with hunger. It is highly likely this snack will become a regular in my diet.

If you love popcorn and want a low calorie snack, this could be a good option for you. The single serve bags have 130 calories each. The taste is good and the serving size is ok compared to similar snacks. Personally I'd prefer a salty/sweet combination of flavors with this type of snack instead of just heavily sweet. And while the serving size is good for this type of snack, popcorn just seems like something you should eat by the bowlful (although not if it is covered with caramel and chocolate, I guess.) This was not a five star snack for me, but it could well be for someone else whose tastes are different. The quality of the food is very good.

This great little snack was a nice suprise to me. It has the crunch, sweet, salt and chocolate needs covered all in one neat little package with little in the way of calories and fat. I highly, highly recommend these who crave crunch, sweet, salt and chocolate in a snack and want to avoid the pitfalls of large calorie and/or fat intake. Fit in the lunch bag/box, light, convenient and very practical.

To me, I did not enjoy these that much, and would not purchase them. I enjoy popcorn, but would rather just have a big bowl of fresh popcorn than these things. The coating was too sweet, and did not have much flavor. After eating a little bag of them, I found myself hungrier than when I started.For this type of snack, Fiddle Faddle is a much better product. The popcorn is bigger and better popped, and the coating is much more flavorful.

column9: Good calorie count, but perhaps too sweet
column10: I tore into these the moment they arrived.  I like that these are 130 calorie count packs, as I am on a pretty strict exercise regimen, but allow myself some snacks as long as the calorie count is low (FYI- I measure everything on the food scale if it isn't already premeasured).  The mix of chocolate flavor and caramel is fine, and certainly more crunchy than Cracker Jack, but halfway through the pack, my tongue started to burn from how sweet these are!  Now I don't eat a lot of sweets normally, but when I do I do not normally get this sensation.  Perhaps it's just me... but even my wife said these are extremely sweet, and she eats sweets more often than I.  Reading the calorie info, it's clearly the combo of fairly high sodium (190 mg) and the 18 grams of sugar in each pack!  In any case they're worth a shot if you're looking for a sweet treat that you can pop into your lunchbox.  Be wary however if you are sensitive to sugar... these are definitely not for you.
I will definitely purchase these again!  If you like Cracker Jacks and you like Chocolate, you will love these.  They taste just like Cracker Jacks with a light chocolate drizzle.

SnackWell's introduces it's Chocolate Drizzled Caramel Popcorn in single serving 130 calorie snack packs. This is just the right amount for a late-night snack or for the person who likes to eat a little too much. Limit yourself to one pack (good luck, because it tastes so good) and you can easily moniter how many calories you're consuming. The popcorn is fresh and crunchy, with just the right amount of caramel and the chocolate drizzle adds that little something extra. Great size to keep in your purse for a pick-me-up or to keep on hand as an easy snack for your kids. All this and only three grams of fat!

column9: As my wife said, "Very good, I like."  So do I.
column10: I saw my wife eating one of the bags of Snack Well's and asked her, "What do you think?"  She said, "Very good, I like."  I agree.  They are very good indeed.  They have a nice crisp caramel flavored pop corn crunch with lines of chocolate, which the manufacturer calls fudge, somehow "drizzled" across them.  Good enough that it's good they are in small packets are one might be tempted to eat the whole box full in one sitting.  I can comfortably recommend these Snack Well's.  I kinda wonder why the manufacturer put an apostrophe before the s, but perhaps there's an explanation somewhere in the ether.  Enjoy.  They're good.

column9: Yummy!  The Pefect Non Guilty Indulgence
column10: I LOVED these! Popcorn, caramel and chocolate. Sweet and salty; the perfect snack combination...at least in my opinion. The Snackwell's Caramel Popcorn packs reminded me of the gourmet popcorn that I sometimes buy, but A LOT cheaper and easier to get since I can pick it up when I am at the grocery store. The packs are only 130 calories and have just enough in them to satisfy your cravings for something sweet and salty. One pack won't fill you up, but then again it's not really meant to....it's a snack. I think these would be great if you are on a diet and have that NEED. I'm sure there are many who can identify :) It's a controlled indulgence, and well worth every single penny. Instant gratification in a handy snack bag!

column9: Three Delicious Tastes All Mixed Together
column10: Popcorn, chocolate and caramel - what could be a better combination?  The snack packs are only 130 calories each and 24g of carbs (which makes it within the snack guidelines for diabetics of 15 to 30 carbs).  Sometimes popcorn has a lot of hulls, but they used sufficiently good quality popcorn here to avoid that.These are very yummy, but at only 1.06 oz. each, there isn't much in each package.  I could have easily eaten 2 or 3 packages, but that would have upped my calories and carbs, so I stopped at one.  If you are really hungry one pack is not going to curb your hunger.  Anyone who likes sweetened popcorn will love these.  This is a winner.

column9: Convenient for sneaking into the movies
column10: These little treats are quite tasty.  They are like a sweeter version of Crackerjack with the added smoothness of the fudge coating.  Definitely a nice package and at 130 calories not too sinful to pack in a lunchbox or sneak into the movies as an alternative to the dreadful tasting and overpriced stuff you get there.

It was an OK treat, kinda tasted like Cracker Jack, but I would prefer Cracker Jack or just plain popcorn. I did think it was a little too sweet for me, but the portion was small enough so not to bother me too much. At 130 calories for a 1.06 ounce package, that was OK, but as I said, I would rather just plain popcorn, with probably less calories for the same size portion.

column9: 3-1/2 stars: mixed reviews from a single family
column10: In general, I love chocolate drizzled on caramel corn. However, I do not love everybody's chocolate caramel corn. Sometimes it's too sweet. Sometimes the caramel is too sticky. Striking the right balance can be a challenge. I was very excited to try another version of chocolate caramel corn, especially one easily purchased at a local grocery store (instead of a specialty shop) and I was particularly excited because this one looked like it would have just the right amount of chocolate so that it wouldn't be overpowering.As soon as my kids came home from school (I have almost 12 yr. old boy/girl twins), we immediately dove right into a single bag of the popcorn. Sadly, my daughter and I only ate a few pieces before declaring it just "okay" with a slight aftertaste, I think from the caramel. My son, however, really, really liked it and gobbled the rest up, then asked if he could bring the rest in his lunches. He said he'd give it 4 stars, but my daughter and I would only give it 2-1/2 stars for taste. Due to some other positive factors about the popcorn (which I will explain below), I decided on an average of 3-1/2 stars.  I do think there will definitely be people out there like my son, who don't notice any kind of aftertaste at all and will love it.There are 5 snack-sized bags of popcorn in each box (1.06 oz) and each bag is 130 calories, with 3 grams of fat (2.5 g of that is saturated). With caramel and chocolate on it, I figured I'd be lucky if there were 6 pieces of popcorn in the bag, so I was pleasantly surprised to see a nice size serving. Given the sweetness of the corn, and the fact that it's definitely NOT healthy popcorn, it's enough. (Out of the first 4 ingredients listed on the package, 3 of them are sweeteners- brown sugar, sugar and corn syrup. Interestingly enough, popcorn is the 2nd ingredient, not the first.)The popcorn has a nice texture and consistency and the caramel does not stick in your teeth (a definite plus in my book). The amount of chocolate on the popcorn is good, not too much and not too little.Overall, I think many people will find this a nice snack.

I'm oftentimes disappointed by diet food desserts.  Usually they taste a little bit off, probably due to using a sugar substitute.  These were delicious!  All of the great taste of caramel popcorn with a little bit of chocolate mixed in.  Mmmm.  Really easy to just pop a bag in my lunch and it seemed like the perfect amount of popcorn to eat for one sitting.  I crave something sweet at the end of a meal and these were very satisfying.

At 130 calories, this is a nice little snack when you crave something sweet. Although it's not really healthy, there's a lot of sugar in each bag; the popcorn does a good job of fulfilling the craving, without going overboard. I really like that each bag is portion controlled so you don't find yourself absently eating more than you intended. I personally thought they were a bit too sweet, but my daughter and husband loved them so that's a matter of personal preference. I'd definitely toss a bag into a lunch box for an occasional afternoon treat, but I think the price point is a bit high for what you get.

I remember SnackWells from the early 90s. The SnackWells division of Nabisco was one of the first to come out with fat free and low calorie versions of unhealthy snacks, such as fudge covered marshmellow cookies.  Unfortunately the taste of the cookie was not that great.  SnackWells has struck gold with the small, low calorie (only 130 per pouch) packs of fudge drizzled caramel popcorn.  I was pleasantly pleased with the taste of the popcorn-it was fresh, and the caramel/chocolate on the popcorn was very flavorful.  I had one for lunch as a desert, and I decided to see if my kids would enjoy these low calorie snacks in their lunchbox in school.  Both my kids loved them.My only complaint is that I wish the box held more of the pouches-they are expensive for what you end up getting.  There are only 5 130 calorie pouches in a box.

column9: Good - Cracker Jacks with a drizzle of chocolate
column10: These were pretty good.  They reminded me of Cracker Jacks with chocolate drizzled over the top.  You get a decent helping per package.  They have about 130 calories, and 3 grams of fat.  That isn't too bad for a treat, although after I was done eating them, I just wasn't satisfied.  That quickly lead me to see some of the things that I could have had instead, like 2 chewy chips ahoy cookies, or part of a snickers (although way more fat in one of those), or a three muskateers.  If it were me I probably would have chosen the 2 cookies, or 1/2 of the muskateers instead; but left the snickers because of the fat.Truth be told however, I would probably just eat them all :)All in all, this was a yummy treat, and I would chose to buy them at a good price.  Keep in mind that they probably aren't a super "healthy" treat, they are definitely still a treat.

"Reduced fat" food is something I pretty much never eat. If I don't want to get a bunch of empty calories from some sugary thing, I just don't eat it. The diet versions invariably taste like cardboard, and who wants that instead of sugary treats? I only ate these because of the Vine program, and I have to say, I was shocked by how much I liked them.First, they actually taste like caramel corn, which was quite a treat. The chocolate drizzle is really not that noticeable, but that's not a huge problem unless you're buying this specifically because of the chocolate (and you probably aren't, right?). Second, the portion size is remarkably large. How they give you this much food for 130 calories I do not understand. The little pouch must have had 20-30 pieces of popcorn in it. As a little after-work snack, there was almost too much here. That's not a bad problem to have!Overall, very pleasantly surprised. If this is your kind of thing, or even if it isn't, you may want to check it out. This is an intriguing product.

As a lover of caramel popcorn I looked forward to trying this product with the added "benefit" of chocolate.  I couldn't have been more disappointed.  The alleged caramel coating had no flavor- none at all.  The chocolate was only marginally better- if I really concentrated I could discern a mild chocolate taste, but none from the caramel.  On the positive side, the popcorn flavor came through loud and clear.  I did not snack well on this product!

With a name like Snackwell's ("well" underlined for emphasis), the line of products tries to advertise itself as a healthy snack. This snack's box draws attention to the fact that a serving contains only 130 calories. Despite the convenient portion-controlling packages, do not mistake this product for a healthy treat. A company will often market foods as low in fat or calories, but while these foods contain fewer calories, they compensate for the loss of delicious fatty ingredients by containing excessive amounts of sugar. The Fudge Drizzle Caramel Popcorn, for example, contains 18 grams of sugar per serving! Although tasty, the popcorn is overly sweet and thus tolerable in only small amounts.

I'm a big fan of popcorn, both coated and naked, and I've always enjoyed Snack Well's treats.  In this case, they missed the mark.  The best thing about this product is that the packets are measured so you're reasonably sure your calorie count is accurate.  The popcorn itself is nicely done, light and fluffy with enough snap to be satisfying.  But the coating, which should give a sweet-salty zip to the corn, falls flat.  Not quite enough of anything and too much of whatever leaves a bitter aftertaste.This isn't a terrible choice of snack food, and kids probably won't complain.  Only picky adults are likely to decide that the taste doesn't warrant the caloric hit that could better be achieved with something tastier.  Plain popcorn would do the trick.

After trying one piece of this Snackwell Fudge Dizzle Caramel Popcorn, I about chocked to death it was so sweet.You definitely won't want to even eat one 1.6 ounce portion, which is 130 calories.  The box is 5.3 ounces total, with 5-1.06 ounce packs.If you really have a sweet tooth and eat this, you should be more than satisfied with just eating the one pack, you won't need to go over the 130 calories.I don't have an aversion to sweet things, but this is way beyond sweet!For me personally, it's just too hard to enjoy something that is so sickeningly sweet, so that it makes you choke on the first bite!

column9: Popcorn Caramel & Chocolate Fix all in one
column10: I don't usually go for the portion control snacks that have become so prevalent on the supermarket shelves these days but I was pleasantly surprised by this one.  The Snackwell Fudge Drizzle Caramel Popcorn has taken three of my guilty pleasures (popcorn, caramel & fudge) and put them all into one 130 calorie pack.  The sugar may be a little on the high side if you're a member of the snack police but if you stick to the one bag rule I'm sure you come out ahead.The pack portion size contains enough to get you over that afternoon slump or to enjoy at the movies without feeling guilty.  The taste is really very good with none of that "pretend food" taste you get in many of the healthy food choices.I think the cost is a little more than I'd spend on a regular basis but as a special treat I'll probably buy it again.

For snack lovers, the bad news is that this Snackwell product features popcorn dipped in caramel sauce and drizzled with fudge.  The good news is that it comes in handy small packets rated at just 130 reasonable calories per.  It does make for one yummy snack and is highly recommended for its excellent flavor.

I just tried the Snackwell Fudge Drizzle Caramel Popcorn for the first time, and was not impressed at all. You get 130 calories for a small serving. The taste is nothing special, and is not as tasty as a box of Cracker Jacks. It is loaded with sugar and the price for for you get, it ridiculous. Do yourself a favor and stick with nutritional snacks. They are much less expensive, less calories, more nutritious, and better tasting. Just because a product is marketed as nutritious or low calorie, doesn't make it so. Read the fine print and be smart. This is a product you should pass on...If you get the craving for popcorn, make it yourself. You will save a bundle of money and it will be better tasting and more nutritious! Pass on this product unless you are a junk food junky with money to spare!

column4: Wandrwoman "Wise as Aphrodite, Beautiful as A...
column10: If you have a sweet tooth and would like to indulge without getting into a huge amount of trouble, this might be just the thing.I am usually not too pleased with the SnackWell line of reduced or limited calorie snacks as the taste is often ersatz and the portion size pathetically stingy. However, these little (1.06 oz) packs of caramel popcorn drizzled in chocolate are quite delicious and the serving is just generous enough to leave one satisfied. The best part is that each pack is only 130 calories! Who can feel guilty about that?Each box contains six packs of popcorn. Each pack contains 30 grams of popcorn which is approximately two good handfuls. The popcorn is decent sized, fresh and crunchy. A thin layer of caramel and a drizzle of chocolate coats each piece. The taste is sweet/salty/chocolate/caramel/chewy/yum.How healthy a snack is this? Not great but not that bad either. The ingredient list has some good or natural items including brown sugar, popcorn, sugar, cocoa powder, skim milk and vanilla extract, but then starts veering off into junk-food-land with palm oil, whey powder, soybean oil, soy lecithin. Salt is the tenth listed item and for popcorn that is quite impressive! One warning is that this product contains both milk and soy.I was quite pleasantly surprised by this product and I would definitely purchase it!Check out my photographs to see what the caramel corn and the portion looks like.

I originally wrote a positive review of this Snackwell Fudge Drizzle Caramel Popcorn -- until I was awakened in the middle of the night by an extreme attack of heartburn, of the kind I usually experience when I have eaten something that doesn't agree with my cholesterol medication (generic Zocor, or simvastatin).To be sure that this popcorn caused this reaction, I kept my diet the same a second day but refrained from eating any of the Snackwell Popcorn.  Result: NO heartburn -- I slept like a baby.Usually butter is the culprit when my cholesterol pills go to work, but I don't see butter listed in the ingredients on the popcorn package.  Nabisco also claims that this popcorn has NO cholesterol.Well, I don't know what to think, but I would suggest that folks suffering from high cholesterol -- or anyone taking cholesterol medication like simvastatin -- approach this product with extreme caution.  If you experience similar reactions from your cholesterol meds to foods you shouldn't be having, try a single-serving pack of this popcorn before you buy a box and see how you feel.Those who have no problems with cholesterol, however, may like the flavor of this Snackwell Fudge Drizzle Caramel Popcorn, which is tasty, if pricey at around a buck per ounce of popcorn.  I myself threw out the remaining four packs in the six-pack box -- the pain of eating these far outweighed the pleasure.

Wow, this little snack really packs a sweet punch!  I picked up my first package and thought for sure I'd be disappointed in how small the serving was and not satisfied by the snack.  Boy was I wrong!  I found I ate it rather slowly and instead of the bag being empty before I was done, it seemed I was done before the bag was empty.  This isn't a snack I see myself consuming on a regular basis, but for times when my sweet tooth is raging, this is a good choice to satisfy that sweet tooth while remaining well within my calorie range for the day.I think the size of each individual pack could be reduced (maybe down to an even 100-calories) as that would make it a better size snack.  I also got a couple really hard bites in the first bag I had (though the next bag was fine).  The price is also pretty steep.I don't see the nutrition information on the product page, so I thought I'd throw it in here.  This is what is printed on the individual bag I have sitting in front of me.  I give no guarantees as to it's accuracy beyond that......Serving Size: 1 pack (30 g)Calories:  130Total Fat: 3 gSat. Fat:  2.5 gTrans Fat: 0 gPoly. Fat: 0 gMono. Fat: 0 gCholesterol:  0 mgSodium:  190 mgPotassium:  30 mgTotal Carb:  24 gFiber: <1 gSugars: 18 gProtein: 1 g

Nutrition Facts per serving:Serving size - 1 pack (30g); Calories - 130; Fat Calories - 25Total Fat - 3g; Sat Fat - 2.5g; Trans/Poly/Mono Fat - 0gCholest - 0g; Sodium - 190 mg; Potassium - 30mgTotal Carbs - 24g; Fiber - <1g; Sugars - 18g; Protein - 1 gIngredients: Brown sugar, popcorn, sugar, corn syrup, palm and/or palm kernel oil, skim milk, cocoa, whey powder, salt, soybean oil, soy lecithin, vanilla extract.As others described, these taste a lot like Cracker Jacks with a little chocoloate fudge drizzled on them. I am not sure why so many people could not taste the chocolate fudge or caramel, as I could taste both. However, what was overwhelming to me was the immediate sugar overload. Having 18 grams of sugar in a 1.06 oz snack package is atrocious; that is nearly 50% of what you find in a 12 oz bottle of cola.  For a product that is supposed to primarily be popcorn, this one is far off base.Despite the overly sweet flavor and non-nutritional punch of sugar, overall it tasted pretty good. I am not too fond of overly sweet products, though, and would not purchase on my own and certainly not at the price I noted while writing the review. Those who love Cracker Jacks would probably enjoy it but only if it can be found at a more reasonable price.

Check out the first four ingredients on these snacks:  Brown sugar, popcorn, sugar, corn syrup.  That's a lot of sugar!  It's a little disconcerting that the popcorn is not the first ingredient.  These popcorn snacks are very sweet, of course, reminiscent of Screaming Yellow Zonkers.  They have no caramel flavor, which is a problem since the Snackwell's are supposed to be caramel popcorn.  The chocolate drizzle is nice, I like chocolate paired with salty-sweet.  The sugary glaze is so sweet that the chocolate actually cuts the sweetness!  The popcorn itself imparts almost no flavor at all, it's just a flavorless foundation.  The popcorn is nice and crunchy and with a good mouthfeel, though, not stale or chewy like other pre-packaged popcorn can be.  There are 130 calories and only 3 grams of fat, which is pretty darn good for a sweet snack of this size, but there are 24 grams of carbs, almost all of it sugar, if you're concerned about such things.

In my opinion, desserts should not be made to be healthy, because doing so generally makes them into something that isn't a very good dessert.  If you need healthy, I understand, but don't eat desserts.  Still, this dessert snack manages to find a reasonable balance between healthy and satisfying.They are sweet.  Brown sugar is the first ingredient; it also contains sugar (presumably white) and corn syrup.  The fudge drizzle is made from cocoa instead of regular chocolate, probably as a concession to calories, but it does add chocolatey taste.The box has five packets of this snack, each packet having 130 calories.  If calories are important to you, this is a great way of letting you know how much is one serving.  Also handy for putting into lunch bags, of course.I have had much richer caramel corn.  It often has a thicker glaze, and the caramel is often made with butter.  But that caramel is not made to put a limit on calories, as this one does.I'm quite happy with the snack.  It is sweet enough to satisfy my sweet tooth, gives me a taste of chocolate, and does not make me feel deprived.  The packet has enough to satisfy, and keeps me from eating too much at once.

And it's only 130 calories!  Sure, if you eat a ton of these it'll outweigh the `good for you' and replace it with `OMG THE SUGAR' (18 grams a bag) but, in moderation this is a great snack.  These bad boys don't even taste `low calorie' at all.  Instead, they taste every bit as unhealthy as the real thing.  So grab a bag and snack away.  The popcorn crunches, the caramel coats and the chocolate melts in your mouth!

column9: Tasty, yes ... but a waste of space
column10: Esssentially, this is a Cracker Jacks rip off with some chocolate thrown in. To my taste, after a few pieces the added chocolate made them a bit too rich.Cracker Jacks, while also completely lacking any nutritional value, are at least a bit less expensive and 10 calories less per serving. (Plus you get a really cheap, unentertaining, and useless toy with Cracker Jacks).For the price and the calories, you'd be much better off to eat an apple. An apple is filling, and contains fiber and other nutritional elements. For that matter, you'd be better off to just eat lightly buttered popcorn. You can eat a LOT more popcorn for the same calories, and really popcorn is more satisfying as a snack, as it doesn't have all the sugar to keep you thirsty that this snack does. Of course that depends on how heavily you salt it too.I tried a bag of these as a filler snack when I was feeling hungry a couple of hours after lunch. Ten minutes later, I was just as hungry again. Since almost all of the calories in this snack come from sugar, that was no shock to me. LOLIf you are underweight and looking to spend better than a dollar a pop for a VERY small bag of candy popcorn to smear directly on to your hips, this is your baby. However, the product otherwise is a slap in the face of the better eating habits many of us would prefer to embrace.

Okay, I have to admit that I am not a health food person.  I try to eat well but not to the point that I force myself to eat Styrofoam rice cakes or whole grain wood-chips.This caramel corn with chocolate drizzled on it is really quite tasty.  That it happens to be healthier than many options is a pleasant surprise and definitely a mark in it's favor.My wife says that these are "surprisingly satisfying".I highly recommend these tasty treats.  Give them a try.  YUM ! ! !

I purchased this at Walmart & really liked it. I seen it was a warehouse deal with free shipping, so I stocked up! I enjoyed the flavor, the calorie count & that the bag was full! I enjoy a treat like everyone else , the bag helps you to know when you should say when. It is a snack & in a controlled amount and that is perfect for me. I can carry it with me, too. Love this alot, perfect carmel & fudge balance. A sweet snack that you can enjoy, No one says that every little thing you eat HAS to be healthy. Once in a while it is nice to have a treat. I don't find this sticky like carmel corn that has a high fat content. Enjoyable and yummy!

These snacks taste fairly well. They are really sweet and do not taste like it is diet food. It does have quite a bit of sugar in it, so if that is something you are trying to avoid, this wouldn't be your best option. It comes in a very small package so not a very large serving. You might be tempted to eat 2-3 bags before you were satisfied. On the other hand its a good snack size to fit in a lunch bag.

Tastes like Cracker Jack or Fiddle Faddle but lighter and with a tasty fudge drizzle.This is sweet so I found I can't eat much at one time, but that's just me, hence the 4 stars.  My co-workers found it good as well.Good product though.  May purchase it again.Thank you.MEF

The snacks themselves are delicious.  There's a good mix of the chocolate and caramel flavors along with the salty popcorn.  The packets in the box are a pretty good size for a satisfying snack, or at least they were for me.  The chocolate fudge was the most prominent flavor for me.  The clusters were crunchy without being crumbly.  So it didn't make a mess.  I suppose if you left the box or a packet in the sun or near something hot the fudge would melt a bit and stick together or the inside of the bag, but when the item arrive that had not happened.  So shipping wise it appears to be well handled before it gets to the customer.At the time I'm writing this review, Amazon is selling a 6 box pack for $30.50 (which would mean free shipping).  Each box has 6 packets for a total of 36 packets at roughly $0.85 per packet.  That's a pretty good per unit prices if you ask me.

I had a taste of this popcorn when i took a jewelry class.  In fact, i had two bags, it was delicious!  I came home and went on Amazon to buy it.  I bought too many and now i have to give them away.  Anyway, this popcorn is DELICIOUS!

What could be better? Caramel corn drizzled with chocolate. YUM!This comes packaged in individual servings each totaling 130 calories.  If you can stick to just ONE pouch, you have more self control than I do.  It satisfies my cravings for crunchy sweet and chocolate all in one snack.Now, if I can just train myself to eat only one package!

"Fudge Drizzled Caramel Popcorn" really sound pretty good.  In execution these are kind of like a cross between the chocolate and caramel popcorns the Boy Scouts sell every year.  Not bad but not great.  They come in handy packets to take on the go.  They aren't a show stopper but they aren't too bad either.

It's a good thing these Snackwell Fudge Drizzle Caramel Popcorn bits are packaged in a portion control pack- otherwise you'd eat the whole box at one sitting.  My family is a big fan of Crunch N Munch which we can barely keep around when we get it.  This goes Crunch N Munch one better in that the caramel clusters of popcorn are lightly drizzled with a rich chocolate coating.  Much better than the milk chocolate than you'd find on your typical candy bar.  So, go ahead and grab a box. But, make sure you tell yourself you're only going to have one package when  you go to get them from the pantry.

For low-calorie candied popcorn, you really can't beat the price, but, really, it's quite a hefty price tag.The chocolate and sugar seem to be of good quality, and the popcorn itself was great, with a bare minimum number of shells and no old maids.My family will continue to make our own candy corn, but might consider a box of this stuff for the next long car trip.

column9: Tasty, good luck eating just one
column10: Popcorn with caramel and fudge; what's not to love?  The taste is great, and handy that the serving is pre-measured in 130 calorie packets.  Just enough to satisfy a sweet craving.  The popcorn is very crisp and fresh tasting, and balances the sugary coating so  you don't feel like you're just eating candy.

column9: A tasty snack for the whole family
column10: In fact, most of these were consumed by my family before I got to taste them.They were in fact quite tasty, I thought them a bit sweet for my taste, but what did I expect from caramel corn.What I liked the most was that there is nothing in here that I had to worry about giving my healthy kids.  My wife liked them as well.I liked this snack so well, I not only bought more of this, but am currently shopping to try other snackwell products as well.

Someone better come rescue me because I loved this so much I went to Wal-mart the next day and bought a buggy full.  SnackWell's products are so tasty and the packages are so convenient.  Loved it. Great taste.

column9: Not Good, Not Great, Absolutely Fantastic
column10: There's not a lot I can say about these. They're good. They're very, very good. Actually, I can say something very nice about them. They come in little packages, so it makes it difficult to nosh on the entire box in a single sitting. I loved them. I shared them with my wife and she loved them.

column9: what ain't good for ya is good to ya
column10: ok, so the kids LOVED it, hands down, greasy hands down, but still, are we not bad in serving up FUDGE drizzled CARAMEL POPCORN??was it bad . . .they loved it . . .how could it be bad . . .just read the ingredients in there . . .and the brand nameSNACK WELLif they snack well, how bad could it really be?I'll pass on it, anywaykids left nothing anyway

While i understand the portion control, i must say it was hard not to eat 2 bags at a time, but with that said, i am a pig, and these were delicious, i don't feel guilty, enjoyed every minute of these!:)

I really liked these.  The caramel corn was rather light and airy, not as heavy as some other caramel corns can be.  The chocolate drizzle wasn't overwhelming and served more as an added flavor.  Not overly sweet.  Somewhat sticky, altho I didn't have any problems with the popcorn melting together in the unopened packages.  These are perfect when I'm at work and want to munch on something that's sweet but not heavy or overwhelming (altho I will say, I tend to eat 2 packages at a time, which defeats the purpose of the 130 calories packs!) I'd definitely recommend this product to anyone who has a sweet tooth looking for a tasty snack that's not high in calories!

popcorn that is single serving sized already, and drizzled with choc and caramel! this is greattttttt.only downside is the sugar content. my wifes grand mom wouldnt have been able to eat these cuz shes a diabetic.but either way they taste good and it has nice packaging.

column4: Jeffrey S. Andrews "Once on a Desperate Highway"
column10: These are great little packets of Fudge Drizzled Caramel Corn to take with you in the car or plane if you are a road warrior...like I am.At first I wasn't so sure...then I took a pack on a recent trip and when I needed a snack they are great.  I usually take power bars and peanut butter crackers...these are a great alternative!  Even my 90 year old father-in-law tried a pack and liked them...of course he is a chocalate lover!

column9: Decent, but would be better without the cheap "fudge"
column10: Maybe I'm a simpleton, but I like caramel popcorn. The popcorn in these snack packs is actually quite good, and they do a nice job finding a way to avoid packing a bunch of kernels in each pack; you're not paying for a bunch of duds at the bottom. The only reason I can't rate this higher is that the chocolate used is of such low quality that you can taste how bad it is even though it's a small proportion of the snack. They probably thought they could get away with using cheap chocolate because it's mostly caramel and popcorn, but they went too far.

column4: B. McCarthy "Engineer, CERT, Amateur Radio Op...
column10: I guess Amazon can't say that because of copyright laws, but I can because I have no financial interest in the product.  Harry and David has lost their formula.  Except for two differences:  These do not have peanuts (which I didn't like in them anyways), and these are much cheaper.However, the nutritional information is appalling!  3.5 grams of saturated fat in a 130 calorie pack!!  I will only be able to eat these on special occasions...

Another great Snackwells product, fresh tasting, fudge drizzle is outstanding (not too overpowering and not too bland, just perfect). The caramel popcorn is also tender and sweet.  The only problem (like most Snackwell products) is that you'll probably end up eating a lot more low calorie packs than your diet might allow, making this tasty treat not so low calorie!  But if you have the willpower, this is a great snaking option for the sweet tooth.

The best way to describe this snack is think cracker jacks for adults.  The popcorn is crispy and the caramel and chocolate fudge are downright sinful.  Normally I would share my snacks at work but these have been hidden in my drawer!  I am not sharing.  If you love sweets and fudge and are looking for a healthy low calorie alternative these are awesome.  I would highly recommend for anyone who likes sweet snacks.

column9: Pretty good, but a bit sweet
column10: Overall, this had a pretty good flavor and certainly didn't taste like "diet food."  However, after the first couple bites, the sweetness was a bit much for me.  Cutting back on the sugar a bit would improve the taste and make it a healthier snack.

column9: 130 calorie snack that does the trick!
column10: I happen to like the prepackaged snacks so that I'm not inclined to overindulge in any one item.  One package of Fudge Drizzle Caramel Popcorn will leave you satisified. You won't feel as though you were a deprived dieter. Instead, you will feel like you treated yourself to a tasty snack. For those watching carbs, this is rather high for one snack - 25 carbs.  My son loves Dale and Thomas Choc. Drizzle Popcorn and he loves this! I think that alone says alot! This item got 4 stars instead of 5 for the cost per package compared to other single package snacks.

I was pleasantly surprised to discover that these did not taste even remotely like cardboard as I had come to expect from low calorie snack packs!Hurrah!I bring them to work and the ladies here try to sneak my snacks before I notice!Be on alert people will try to steal them they are that yummy!Enjoy!

I'm obsessed with this popcorn snack.  It has just the right amount of sweetness coupled with a drizzle of chocolate on each piece!  My family has always been a fan of the SnackWell brand and this doesn't disappoint!  Biggest complaint is that the individual bags, within the box, aren't big enough!  Ha Ha Ha!  I'll be tracking this item down at the grocery store tomorrow - definitely gonna stock up on a few boxes!

The people at my office must love me for all the food products that I share with them.  Overall people liked this.  I heard more than once that it is really sweet but still enjoyable.  One co-worker and I laughed that if you make the portion size small enough you can have anything be a 100 calorie snack - even popcorn that is covered in sugar and then drizzled in chocolate.Since I love sugar one little pouch didn't do much for me as a snack -- it just made me want to eat another, and another and another.  I think that might defeat the benefits of putting it in little pouches.All and all it was a tastey little treat.

It's hard to review a box of caramel popcorn, but I'll try. Very brief review: good box of popcorn disappeared fast. I really enjoyed this and I really recommend it for any aficionado of popcorn or chocolate. Really satisfied my sweet tooth. Can't say I'd eat a box too often, because I don't want the calories. But as an occasional snack, it's great!
I would have preferred this product was just caramel corn.  But the chocolate was very light, and the individual packs made me notice I got a lot more for my cals than I figured I would.

This was a very good product. I was hesitant at first because I am a bigger guy and I like a snack that will actually fill me up, but surprisingly this snack was quite satisfying. I am by no means a calorie counter, but I can definitely say that if you are this product will help you stay within your limit.

I am shocked that these snack packs are low in calories and taste wonderful.  There's nothing else I can say. I will be buying them.  Rarely does a food pass the taste test of all 5 members of my house and this one did.  I would recommend these for portion control, price and taste.  Great job Snackwell's!!

column4: Mrs. K "From the wilds of the Mojave"
column9: Good size, but just too sweet
column10: Caramel corn by itself would have been great. The chocolate drizzle was kind of overkill. I wish they'd make a salty popcorn product with the chocolate drizzle -- I could go for that.Anyway, love the individual size bag. My kid enjoyed them as well.
