I find it very weak when I make it in my drip filter contraption (Melitta). When I ground it finer, it clogged the filter. But when I use my manual, stove top espresso maker it's good.
I was looking for a cheaper alternative to Teeccino as an alternative to coffee and this is it.  Tastes more like coffee and costs a lot less.
if you want to replace coffee that's it!!!!or mix it with coffee and it's just delicious in both way!!!!

I love Cafe Orzo at night, after dinner, when coffee keeps me up. I brew it in my stovetop "Moka" type espresso pot or in a french press.It isn't coffee but it is a very nice alternative; just like we drink it in Italy!

Best coffee alternative I ever had.  I usually drink french roast coffee, or anything dark.  I brew this strong and add cream and sugar as usual.  The flavor is very rich, a lot like coffee but it finishes with a deep, nutty flavor that I really dig.  It's earthy, but not in the "tastes like dirt" kind of way.

This Cafè Orzo seems to be ground for a filter coffee maker.  However it works quite well in a french press, with very little detritus coming through on pouring.  It is not like Orzp Pupo, which can be used like instant coffee, but a fresh press is very little trouble and cleans up very easily when used with the product.  The taste is excellent.  Daphne has trouble with the oils in coffee (they upset her intestines), and I cannot have caffein because of my heart.  The taste of this product does not leave us wishing we had coffee.  It is excellent as it is.  We use two teaspoons per 8 ounces (240 ml) and get a firm taste with just the right level bitterness.Michael Ryan
It tastes OK, but it has too many carbs. I am on a low carb diet and I gained four pounds after I started drinking this (nothing else in my diet changed). They came off when I quit.

column9: Lil' Cup of Heaven from Turkey
column10: If you love coffee, you simply must try Mehmet Efendi's delicious Turkish coffee! When I am in Istanbul, I make my pilgrimmage down past the spice bazaar to the busiest shop in town...sometimes the line travels all down the shops for a long way..but it moves quickly, because the efficient counter boys know their business. Boom! You walk away with an armful of tins that travel back home and provide the finest coffee experience with no special equipment needed! I seriously htrew away half the clothes in my suitcase to fill up with Mehmet Efendi tins. Better than buying an expensive espresso maker, use a small pot and make your coffee on the stove, boiling the water and letting crema occur naturally...Read up on how to make it! You will not be disappointed with the results!!!

I've purchased this water for a year now for the high alkaline content and the great taste.  Recently, I've been getting shipments that are NOT the New Zealand spring water but rather distilled water from Walnut Creek, California.  The taste difference IS night and day.  You can only tell the difference between the original New Zealand Spring water and the distilled water from Walnut Creek by looking at the label.  Therefore, I won't be buying any more Eternal Water on the internet; you must actually see the label to know you're getting what you paid for. This is dishonest on Eternal's part -- I hope they literally clean up their act.

I called the company and got a detailed explanation of everything that was commented  on in the other reviews.  The company spent a great deal of time with me explaining the below and seemed sincere.CHANGE FROM NEW ZEALAND TO USThe majority of their customer base was primarily attracted to the naturally occurring 8.0 alkaline water, and had an issue with water being trucked half way around the world.  Most of the customers wanted a similar quality water with less of an environmental impact.  So the company made the business decision to follow this feedback and invested a great deal of effort finding three natural springs in the US that are naturally alkaline.  Water from New Zealand is no long available.The sources and the water quality report from the new US based springs can be found on their site.[...]DISTILLED WATERDuring this time an unfortunate mishap happened regarding an order of specially requested water by a department store.  This department store requested distilled water.  The bottles were labeled differently, but the cases looked the same and unfortunately some of this water wound up being distributed by mistake.  The company states they will never create another lot of distilled water and while they regret that this water has hit the market in some areas, it is of limited supply and the issue should dissipate.LABELINGThe original water that was manufactured in New Zealand, says "New Zealand" on the label.  It is no longer being produced.  If you are lucky enough to still be in possession of this water, you have a collector's item.The new US based water, from the three naturally alkaline springs says Source: Multi-Spring, bottled for Eternal Beverages, Walnut Creek CA.  This is the water the company is basing its future on.The distilled water that is out in some markets actually says distilled water on the back of the label.  If you are in possession of this water, you have an inferior product.MY PERSONAL OPINIONI happen to be in possession of the original New Zealand water, the new US based spring water, as well as several competing brands: Hawaiian Springs and Mountain Valley Springs.Comparing them by taste and smell, my husband and I agree that this is how we would rate the four products.  1.) New Zealand water is the clear winner, it's a shame we no longer have the option to purchase it, 2.) The US based Eternal Water is our second choice, 3.) Hawaiian Springs is a close second to the US based Eternal Water, 4.) Mountain Valley Spring Water.  Note: Mountain Valley Spring water does contain some fluoride.
Do not buy. Water source changed. Company has no ethics. I won't be buying anything from Eternal again. Buyer Beware!

DoNOT Buy this Water. This water used to be delicious but the have recently within the last 3 months started making changes to this water. Cheaper packaging and the water is no longer purchased from New Zealand it is actually now purchased in different parts of the US and they charge the same price at my local Whole Foods as if it was still from New Zealand. The water now tastes horrible....it tastes like it has sediment or contaminents in the water. I inquired about the change in the water and here is the email I rec'd: Although Eternal was previously sourced in New Zealand, there are many reasons for our decision to change to a US-based source. Your naturally alkaline spring source is nestled deep in the Great Smoky Mountains of Eastern Tennessee at the base of English Mountain.I am now searching for another water to drink. SMH!!!

This is NOT "Puppy food" -- that is to say, it is not branded or sold by NutriSource as quote-Puppy-unquote food.In fact, while large print on the package says "Adult Dogs," this food IS perfectly suitable for puppies; and NutriSource say this in the smaller print of the packaging. It's certainly not part of the branding: NutriSource do not currently make any such thing as "Grain Free Chicken" food specifically for puppies.That said -- this is the same food as the small bag (with, confusingly, a quite different-looking packaging) of kibble our breeder sent us home with when we adopted our little Havanese puppy.He loves it. He produces a nice stool and has never either been constipated or had diarrhea using this formula.So, hooray, a very good puppy food that is not "Puppy food."

My wife and I use this as a low sodium alternative to regular table salt.  We cook with it and we sprinkle it on food on the plate.  Either way, it tastes absolutely the same as standard salt....still with the iodide we want but with 66% less sodium, according to the label. We certainly recommend it.

These wafers are great.Sensitive stomach's of our mastiffs approve.  I love the large wafers as if the dog has done something really good, they get a full wafer.  Otherwise, they get just a broken off part, I like controlling their rewards to how important the rewards are.Appears they are great tasting, the dogs go nuts.  I ran out of these and am using some others now, but still using the bag for the new treats!  It is a great durable, air-tight, ziplock bag.GREAT Product!
This product is mostly sugar (it contains only 20% pistacchio butter!!!!). If that would have been listed on the description I wouldn't have bought it in the first place.

The jar was less than 1/3 full. For this price, one would expect an entire jar...full to the top.  The product coated the inside of the jar so it wasn't until i opened it to find it is mostly empty. It tastes fine, but what am i going to do with 1/4 cup of pistachio nut cream?

I make cannoli with pistachio nut cream.  My regular store's supplier (of another brand) hasn't sent them any stock, so I tried this.  Big disappointment.  Way too thin, almost watery.  The jar was only half full.  I won't make this mistake again.

column9: I low carb and I love  this for a huge treat!
column10: It's creamy delish and like nothing I've ever tasted, I eat a little on the tip of a spoon and it's enough to satisfy my sweet tooth.  Just love it.  Originally, I got it from some relatives who brought it back from Sicily.  I had to have more!

I love this pistachio paste/cream. This brand was specifically called out in a recipe book that I have and I love it. I specifically bought it to make macarons, but used it in some buttercream frosting for cupcakes not too long ago and it was perfect for that as well. I also look forward to using it in homemade ice cream this summer. I don't think the price of the item is bad at all, although I do think the shipping seems a bit expensive, but, since I can't get anything like this where I live, it's worth it. : ) I also don't mind how much sugar is in this cream. I'm using specifically for baking, so that sugar content doesn't bother me.

Excellent taste and texture.  I used this product for homemade gelato and was pleased with the results. I did not have any problems with the amount in the jar as had been commented on by two other reviewers. This is authentic pistachio cream from Bronte Sicily known throughout the world as one of the best regions for Pistachio growth.
Tiene el auténtico sabor de Bronte Pistachio cream, pero menos de la mitad de su contenido.- ¿Puede ser debido al transporte?

I got this for making a batch of ice cream and it turned out great!  Much better than shelling the pistachios, soaking them, and then straining from the ice cream for sure.  It took the whole jar to make a batch (~2qt) with good pistachio flavor.  I couldn't resist and had a spoon of this stuff while making the ice cream and thought it was great!  I thought the price wasn't too bad compared to other pistachio pastes out there.  Definitely worth it for me.  Btw, I didn't have the problem as another reviewer did with the quantity in this product.
i like the the powdered from of zipfizz as well.  the liquid form is just more convenient and handy. the taste is not bad but not amazing, just ok.  i would order again

This is pretty much standard Matzo bread. It tastes fine and is exactly what I wanted, at a fraction the price of our local grocery store. We use quite a bit of this at my church for communion bread, so I expect I'll order more in the near future. Unsalted is not always easy to find!

column9: The expiration date is ten months ago
column10: The matzohs seemed to have shrunk a bit, and were curved instead of flat. So I looked at the expiration date on the boxes, and they'd expired in March 2010. This is January, 2011.I've never had amazon ship me an item that was past its expiration date before, so I hadn't expected it. Not very nice, considering that I paid full price.The expiration date on matzohs is usually two years or longer, so these are at least three years old.Another example of caveat emptor.Before I order a product, I'd like to know if it is already past its expiration date. Is there a way that I can do that?
This version of Matzah is NOT Kosher for Passover.  I wish Amazon had some Kosher L'Pesach Matzah available.
I like these alot. They are great unsalted product to snack on instead of those salty types of snacks.

I've been a big fan of Tetley tea bags since I bought them in UK. Nice taste and reasonable price!! Milk tea made with Tetley tea bags couldn't be better. It's difficult to get them in Japan. So I'm happy to get them at Amazon USA.
I'm not sure why the reviews are so negative.  These are great, I love GOOD soft cookies!  I also like the fact that they are individually wrapped.

column9: Good cookies, but see my review
column10: These are good cookies, and worth the four stars, IF one rates the cookies one can get from the mall and/or order directly from Mrs. Field's website directly to be 5 stars.  These are soft as an aside.  I would disagree though and not rate them "YUCK" as one reviewer has done here.  I can tell that the grade of white chocolate isn't quite the same as the cookies sold from their website for instance.  So, much better then "YUCK", I'm not disappointed at all but next time I want a box of their cookies I'll probably order from Mrs. Field's direct.
I sent these cookies to a friend of mine in the hospital and he loved them.  He promised to eat only one a day until they were gone!
I bought these for a girl i love and she loved the cookies. She said they tasted amazing and were soft. You will just have to buy these cookies to see if you yourself like them.

I don't know what it is about these cookies, but, they are NOT good at all. They're sort of bland, taste a little off, and cannot be doctored in any way to fix the problem. They taste nothing like the ones you can get online or in the mall. I ended up giving them away to family members in gift boxes to get rid of them. I will never ever purchase these again. The strange flavor was NOTHING like a white chocolate and macadamia nut cookie should taste like.

column9: Unfortunately, These Cookies Have NO Flavor and Are Tasteless
column10: Unfortunately, zero stars not possible on here. I agree with the reviewer who said "yuck" (though I wouldn't put it as straightforwardly rude as that). When I saw these Mrs. Fields White Chunk Macadamia cookies on here and saw some people thought they were good I just HAD to say something (and, check my record- I usually don't post reviews!)!  I bought 2boxes of these Mrs. Fields White Chunk Macadamia because I love Mrs. Fields- I adore her other cookies/wanted so much to love these!  However, the first bite of this White Chunk Macadamia cookie ruined that. The 1st box I bought from a local CVS store. They are totally bland and have virtually no flavor- even the white chocolate didn't have any flavor although the chunks were plentiful. Which is kinda unbelievable- as, white chocolate is supposed to make it even more flavorful (for example- Hershey's white chocolate bars and kisses taste, extremely flavorful/like chocolate). VERY DISAPPOINTED in this flavor of Mrs. Fields.  Since I love Mrs Fields Cookies (and, obviously, giving her the benefit of the doubt):  I thought, ok, maybe I got a bad box.  So, I bought another one from the Walgreens in Downtown Chicago. AND NOPE- THIS FLAVOR IS STANDARDLY BLAND AND TASTELESS.  The only good thing about these cookies were that both boxes were very fresh/cookies were indivially wrapped as advertised.  If only Mrs. Fields would've put as much thought into the actual cookie itself!! SO- IF YOU HAVE A TASTE FOR WHITE CHOCOLATE AND BUY THIS COOKIE PLEASE BE PREPARED TO HAVE 2THINGS ON HAND- BOTH WHICH ACTUALLY TASTES LIKE  WHITE CHOCOLATE, AND A REAL CHOCOLATE CHIP COOKIE!  HOW could a professional like Mrs. Fields get this so horribly wrong????  When it comes to sweets I'm easy to please- trust me (and, my scale can, at times, attest to that):  But, in this case THIS COOKIE NEEDS A REDO!!  I am convinced that the people who thought these even had a scintilla of taste either works for the company, or need tastebud transplants! I've been as honest as I can.  I wonder what Gordon Ramsay would say to Mrs. Fields upon sampling these white chunk Macadamia cookies???  Oh, the horror.

I am so sorry I did not listen to the other reviewer.  These gumballs are tinier than anything I have ever seen sold in a package like this.  It takes about 6 of them to equal the size of one regularly-sized gumball.  I have posted a picture so you can see how small these gumballs really are.  The package clearly states "25 cents".  The fact that the Amazon reseller is charging nearly double that price is shameful.
I bought a box of this gum for my kids stock stuffer. Overall they were disappointed, because the gum lost its flavor very quickly. As my daughter described it "five chews and the flavor is gone".

column9: I didn't know they would be so small!
column10: I was surprised when I received this product.  I was expecting the only size dubble bubble that I have seen packaged in a tube.  I was expecting the larger gumballs.  They seemed to be priced too high for the little gumballs.  The little gumballs I received had a 50 cent price tag.  If you sold the packages for that price, you would lose money.

These are not the normal 1" tubes of gumballs that you usually see in stores, but instead tubes of 1/2" balls.  They are charging "only" $13.97 even though the individual tubes are printed "25 cents".  That would be $9 worth of gum with a "list price" of $18.00.  It would be cheaper just to walk into a store and buy the tubes individually.  The only reason that they didn't get 1 star, is that it's still Dubble Bubble and I've gotta give them something for that.

I was not disappointed with this Mole paste.  I agree with another reviewer, it does benefit from adding chili powder to kick it up a notch, but the flavor itself is spot on.  It really lends itself to a multitude of uses.  Buying another brick for sure!
This was very good mole paste.  You may want to add some chile powder to spice it up, but it is natural and high quality.

I've used dried mushrooms many times over the years and these are among the best.  Though expensive the morel has great flavor and is easily reconstituted.  Already I've used them in a mushroom risotto and my favorite Fettuccine Alfredo.  The 4-ounce package has a volume of about five cups of the dried morels so it easily beats what I find in the local supermarket.

These mushrooms were easy to reconstitute and, when used as a component in another recipe, they add an excellent flavor and texture.  Before I purchased them, I noticed that one reviewer said that these mushrooms didn't have any flavor, which caused me a little anxiety about ordering them.  I believe I know why he/she might believe that is the case.  The mushrooms themselves don't have huge amounts of flavor when you pull them out of the soaking liquid.  When you reconstitute them, be certain to keep the soaking liquid.  DON'T DISCARD IT because that's where most of the flavor is.  I suspect that might have been what happened in the other reviewer's case.You can strain the liquid or run it through a coffee filter to remove grit.  Then reduce the soaking liquid to add back into sauces or other morel recipes and the flavor can actually become more intense with the reconstituted mushrooms.All in all I'm very satisfied with this purchase, even though they are very expensive.

I'm extremely glad I ordered these mushrooms.  The price per ounce, especially rehydrated, ends up being quite reasonable.  I usually rehydrate with warm water (and make sure I use the water in the recipe for extra flavor) then add the morels to sautees, soups, and stir-frys.  Really excellent product.
The mushrooms I received had absolutely no flavor.  It was like soaking up cream sauce with pieces of rubber.  Really disappointing.

The toasted marshmallow Jelly Beans are irresistible and possibly the best flavor ever! What more can one say?These are creamy, and while they are sweeter than a real toasted marshmallow, these are worth searching for in any bag of mixed jelly beans.~The Rebecca Review

I ordered this as an Xmas present for my husband, who is a blueberry freak.  We spent all morning today licking the spoon.  The Oregon Coast Jam website warns that it may be tart and need sweetening, but we did not think it needed a thing!  Absolutely wonderful jam, with no artificial ingredients or sweeteners.  Exactly what I was looking for.  I'll be ordering a mixed case from them next month.

Never a fan of Truffles, since it was like playing Russian Roulette-never knowing what exactly was inside, I was absolutely amazed at these delicious confections. It's like Heroin to a Choc-a-holic, only better and legal. They're great with your morning coffee/espresso, an afternoon Tequila or an evening glass of Red Wine.
Bought this as a gift for a chocolate truffle fan, and the double pack is perfect because the recipient LOVES them! They said they're SO good, it's almost wrong!

Our office received these truffles for a Christmas present. Truffles have always been one of my favorites, but there is a huge difference between brands, types, etc - even in the so-called "home made" stores. One bite of these, and I was spoiled forever! (Personally, I'm buying the two pack so I can keep one and give the other as a gift --- hopefully! LOL)These seem to be seasonal, so if you are at all interested, be aware of this.

We received this product in about 2 days, really surprised. It has two bags in a box, the package is good, having no defects. As for the truffles, I should say they are perfect. We just can't help eating one and another one and......so delicious and sweet. I think I will buy again for my family and friends.
the chocolate is decent, so is the packaging.it is not sweet at all, which I like the most!!

These were so delicious and I selfishly kept one bag (which was opened slightly in transit)  and I'm still treating myself to one or two a day.  The best truffles ever and will definately be ordering again.  Not too sweet and was a hit as a Christmas gift.
These truffles are really very good.  My wife loves getting them around Christmas for the last few years.  Definitely 5 star.

Just bought a 2.2 box (has two sealed 1 lb bags in the box) at Costco yesterday for only $8.99.  They are good , not great and not nearly as good a Godiva. Dont taste very "chocolate-ty!"  Looked at the ingredients list  -and no wonder - Vegetable (Palm) Oil is theifrst ingredient (??) followed by sugar, low fat cocoa, whey powder, cocoa powder.UPDATE - Served these Xmas Eve and they went over well.  Still would not buy them again due to the ingredients.

The taste melts in your mouth and you will eat more and more until your full! My sons gobbled up all the truffles as fast as thay could, so I took them out and do lots of exercise. :) Thanks to the truffles this valentines day will be the best!

column9: So Very Rich, I Can Eat Just ONE!!
column10: I love truffles, but they're too expensive. This was a tremendous deal... so many truffles for so little cash! I have trouble "eating just one" tasty chocolate. BUT! These truffles are so rich and creamy, I can limit my intake to just one! (I got fooled though...these truffles are from Canada, not France!)  I love these truffles... a great gift. Keep one bag for yourself and gift the other bag!  Highly recommended.
I ordered these chocolats and when received were completely melted, a mass of chocolat no individual truffe at all!  The flavor was also different (maybe because of the melting?)

Please send help!!!! I cant stop eating these divine chocolate-coma inducers! Seriously though, some of the best chocolate I have ever eaten. Perfect blend of dark and lite chocolate make these babies totally addictive. 5 stars.

They are very smooth, i love just letting them melt in my mouth.  And they have a very rich cocoa taste.  not like swiss miss, like a batch of fresh made dutch cocoa.  The only downside to the one i bought is i think they were kind of old.  normally they are dusted in cocoa powder and are literally powdery on the outside.  But this case i bought they were actually a bit moist and there was no powder, it was absorbed.  So probably they were sitting on a shelf for a while.  But they still taste awesome.
the natural truffles have an unsweetened coaco powder on the outside with a nice smooth texture.  this is not to sweet more of a european style candy, wonderful.

Tried the Lyndt dark chocolate truffles as they were most readily available at the grocery.  I even purchased a box (60 ct) of the Lyndt from Amazon.  In looking to reorder, I noted the ingredients in Lyndt vs. Chocmod . . .  Chocmod won hands down for being 'natural' and free of artificial flavorings.  So being the Type A personality persona that I am, I ordered 2 boxes.  If I was wrong, then I would be sorry.  I am not.  There is No bitter taste.  At the initial outset of these melt in your mouth glories, there is an 'intense' chocolate flavor which is immediately followed by a creamy dreamy chocolate experience.  I'm going for the 4 pack next time.  .  .  I was satisfied with one whereas with Lyndt I wasn't.  Can't believe what a great price these are.  1000 grams is over 2# . . .  much better bang for your buck and better for you than any other option.

Oh My God!!!  What more is there to say.  Between the texture and the wonderful taste I must say it is the best chocolate I have ever eaten and I am a chocolate addict...  I also read somewhere that it is one of the healthiest chocolate because it is very dark and has less carbs.

Sure, we'd all prefer the ingredients list be organized differently, but this is a solid truffle that can be gotten for $5.39/box @ Costco during certain times of the year (Easter & Winter holidays, it seems).

What a disappointment. I bought these (at Costco) after reading some internet article that gave them a great review. However, when I tasted them they seemed bland and overly greasy. I read the ingredient list and there was the explanation. They're made of palm oil and chocolate powder. I should have checked the ingredients before buying this, ingredients say a lot about quality. This is not a good quality product and tastes nothing like a well-made truffle.It is, at best, passable. Odd texture and a faint chocolate flavor. Will not buy again.

Some one highly rated this chocolate candy that it was made only once a year by a high end France store.I thought this Chocmod Truffettes be more or less like the Canada made Ferrero, before the purchase.Big disappointment! It's not even close. It has no taste, no flavor, just plain nothing .....other than a 85% saturated fat swirling in your mouth. I wish to get my $30 plus, back.Save your hard earned dollar, you deserve something better, much better.
These are good chocolates, very rich.  It's probably a good thing that they are so rich and monotonous because you really need only 1 or 2 a day to satisfy your chocolate jones.

I have celiac.  I bought my first box of these at a local HFS.  The plain are too boring, but with the tamari, they are quite tasty.  I save a bunch of money by buying them by the case from Amazon.  You have to eat a lot of them to get calories, so I could go through a box quickly.  I also use rice cakes, and these little crackers are far superior to them.  I make a seed butter out of toasted, ground pumpkin seeds with a little olive oil, and it is quite tasty with these crackers.

column9: Great Taste, Wheat/Gluten Free, and Good for You
column10: This is a great product for those of us with wheat and gluten allergies.  It's crunchy, has great flavor, and a real treat.  I eat them with soups, chili, and crunch them up and use them as a breading for meat.  These crackers fit into my whole and natural foods list.  These are my favorite.  You won't be disappointed with the taste or the price.

These sesame crackers are soooooo good, soooo low cal, and such a bargain from Amazon!  I love them with garlic basil chevre and Mendicino hot sweet mustard! That combo really brings out the flavor of all the ingredients. They also arrive in a very short time.  Enjoy.

column9: They changed the recipe! No longer tasty
column10: They used to be my favorite cracker but always so expensive could barely afford and also because they used to be so tasty I'd eat the whole package in one sitting. But today I splurged on a package and unfortunately they changed the recipe and they tasted bad. Sure enough I called Edward and Sons and they said due to Japan nuclear meltdown they changed the manufacturing to Thailand. But why didn't they make sure Thailand could make it just as Japan did before putting in markets? Morons. Hopefully they get their quality back. Today they taste like crap. Dry, and rancid sour taste.
Great with blue cheese, seafood, veggies, and spreads.  Healthy, low cal, and satisfying.  My shipping container was well packed--no broken crackers.  Delightful!

These were the first crackers that I liked after going gluten-free. The Tamari helps a lot and is by far my favorite cracker made by this company.They work pretty good if you need breadcrumbs for meatballs, just put them in the food processor or blender and there ya go!

column9: The Cholula Original Hot sauce is excellent. Their Chipotle version is watered down and near tasteless
column10: I love Cholula's original hot sauce. One of the finest, general purpose hot sauces, available. The original is loved by many including Scott Roberts. Who is Scott Roberts? I didn't have a clue until a recent NPR show. It turns out that he is the unofficial head of the chili-heads, the hot sauce movement.After trying the original - I could not agree more. What an excellent hot sauce.Then - I tried the other Cholula varieties. This company also offers a lime, garlic and chipotle versions. All of these were a major disappointment.Their Chipotle based hot sauce lacks almost any flavor beyond a heavy dose of vinegar along with a bit of gentle heat. At best - there is just a hint of this smoked (Chipotle) pepper.Far better (for a Chipotle based hot sauce) are either the Tabasco Chipotle hot sauce or the El Yucateco Chipotle Hot Sauce. Both of these are excellent and have a rich Chipotle favor and far surpass the Cholula Chipotle.Make no mistake - the original Cholula is excellent but the variants of their original hot sauce fall far short of the original.Everyone needs a hobby and I've been blind taste testing about 40 different hot sauces for over 6 months. I stumbled on Scott Roberts review long after I had determined that the Cholula Original was an excellent hot sauce from my point of view. But the garlic, lime and chipotle versions are surprisingly inferior.PS: Watch out for Amazon sellers that offer a low price for a product but charge very high shipping rates ON a PER Bottle basis. So even if you order multiple bottles at the same time you will still pay very high shipping charges based on the single bottle shipping rate.

This is my favoarite hot sauce, unfortunately i can not find large bottles or other forms of a bulk purchase.  This purchase saved me a few cents per bottle and was definitely worth it. Just wish I can find a better deal. Amazing hot sauce, and I will buy from this company again.

As another reviewer said, these are pulverized in our house.  Once the can is opened, somehow that aroma waifs through the air on the back of a gnat and they're by my side in 1/2 a millisecond! My only suggestion is that if you have a cat that doesn't like pates, be careful on these grilled varieties.  They're supposed to all be shredded but they do have a couple that are actually pates and well, up went the nose on those!  I pay about six dollars less for this loaf pack at my local grocery, so keep that in mind with the pricetag.  I think it's high.  Other than that, highly recommend!

As a cat with a discerning palate, I only eat Fancy Feast.  It is a fragrant delight of tasty morsels covered in a delicate and lip smacking au jus. The texture is viscous and balanced.  In fact, it is so delicious, I wait until no one is looking then knock over the trash and dig out the empty can so I can lick the sides. (I would not recommend this however as it sometimes gets me thrown outside).I put this at the top of my list!  A++Steve,,,^..^ ,,,~

column9: Fancy Feast Gourmet Cat Food 3-Flavor Grilled Varieties
column10: Cats enjoy every can without hesitation and it arrives on time before we run out of food.  [...]

column9: my cat loves it, though has more gluten and filler than regular grilled line
column10: for canned food fancy feast is the only thing my cat eats.  shed rather starve than eat anything organic.  my cat devours this stuff within minutes. she particularly loves the beef. after checking the ingredient list though im wee bit alarmed. for the regular grilled line poultry or beef is listed as the first ingredient, followed by broth liver or fish, then meat by product. these gravy ones has broth as the first ingredient, followed by poultry or beef, and has a higher percentage of gluten. hence the gravy i guess. it sure taste good to my cat but it's like more like junk food than a healthy meal. the kitty won't get these on a regular basis anymore, regular grilled variety is better for her health. suscribe and save is such an awesome deal. it comes out to 46 cents a can. my local walmart used to have fancy feast for 47 cents+tax, no more! now its 54 cents!!!

column9: My cat seems to love this
column10: My cat is now 21 y/o and I have stopped giving him the hard stuff, I think he enjoys a nice soft meal now.  He loves this stuff.  I do not care about the price, what does it matter when we have our pets for such a short time, I am  lucky I have had mine a long time, maybe because I don't worry about price but buy good quality.  My cat deserves the higher priced car foods.

column9: My Mocha likes it and smells good to me
column10: I, like many cat owners, love my cat very much.  I enjoy watching my cat eat as it is a sign of good health.  I also enjoy more when she eats and finds her food delectable.  She gives you that 'look' and you know when the food she ate has tasted good.Anyway, this is the 3rd fancy feast i bought for her.  i bought the pate version (or classic).  Classic ones have a very pet-food stench to it.  On the other hand, this smells a bit more like human food and isnt stinky.  The food is shaped like canned tuna filets but a bit stiffer in texture.  My only complaint:  there is WAY more gravy on the can compared to the pate version.  I'd say 1/8 of the can is gravy.  as for the meaty filets, i'd say 1/2-less 3/4 can is actual food itself.  quite disappointing.  i feel ripped off b/c  i do not get my money's worth in terms of quantity so one star off.  quality is good; comparing it to pate, it seems Mocha enjoys this and pate equally.  I only notice she seems to enjoy chicken flavor more b/c she eats it all in one setting.I know Fancy feast (FF) isnt the 'ideal' wet food out there.  I dont have the means to afford evo, wellness etc.  I feed this in conjunction with dry kibble, and one FF can lasts about 2-3 days.  I mix in homemade meat or greeny vegetables at times with FF.  In short, i guess i am saying that i am glad Fancy feast sells this 'crack' food (as known in many cat lover circles...lol) that cats run for.  Thanks to swagbucks, I am able to get this for FREE from Amazon and even take advantage of del. subscription to give my cat some pleasure in life.

I was surprised to find out that Fancy Feast is shorting their 3 ounce can to 2.7 ounces (occasionally 2.8 oz) I was curious when the bulk and weight of other foods felt heaver.  I took a bowl, put it on our digital ounce scale tared it out so that is showd 0.00 ounces. Then I opened and emptied a can of Fancy Feast into the bowl being careful to get every last crumb of food out of the can and all of the liquid from the sides and top. Came out to 2.7 occasionally 2.8 ounces constantly.We purchase our groceries once a month so I have too much on hand considering that it is time for a switch to smething else. No more Fancy Feast unless they can convince me that their cans will contain at least 3.0 ounces from now on. I know it is difficult to change a cat to something else however, a cat will not starve itself.  My cat will be eating something else next month!!

My cats love, love, love these.  The product is great but the price here doesn't make it cost-effective to order from Amazon (hence, the four stars).  I just paid $12.29 (regular price) at my local supermarket and paid even less at Sam's Club.  They seem to be building in the cost of shipping.

column9: Great lower price option for diabetic cats
column10: 2 years ago, my vet said that I should start my diabetic cat on what he called "The Catkins" high protein diet. He offered a lot of high priced foods designed specifically for diabetic cats, then said "but if money is an issue, Fancy Feast has the correct ratio of protein to other nutrients for much cheaper" my cat has been eating it since, with very very good results. When eating this instead of his previous diet of normal dry adult cat food, he needs a lower dose of insulin to maintain his blood sugar. The icing on the cake is that when I order it from Amazon, it's cheaper than the stores in town. With subscribe and save I don't even have to think about it, it just shows up on my front porch every month!
You get a better deal for these if you order a subscription on Amazon.I have three seven month old kittens who devour Fancy Feast almost instantaneously, the moment I serve them a can.

I have not tasted this variety of Fancy Feast, so I can not comment on that.  I have asked my cat, Bo, how it tastes, but he pays no attention to me at all once I set his plate of Fancy Feast down.I can say without a doubt that having an Amazon subscription to this food is great.  I placed the order once, and the every thirty days another case is delivered to my door step.  This is the greatest idea since the invention of the can opener.  No more late night trips to WalMart because I forgot to buy cat food.  Oh, Amazon gives you a discount off the regular price if you sign up for the subscription!  No regrets here.
Our Cat likes Fancy Feast, especially the grilled flavors. It is somewhat pricey in our local stores, so I bought it on-line.

Although this is still a supermarket brand, I can't afford to buy both premium wet food as well as dry food. So he's on a Fancy Feast and Wellness CORE diet.At first, I was afraid he'd reject this food like he had with the other two brands he tried, but he's stuck with it. For the past three months, Fancy Feast has been his chosen food. Of course I buy loads of different flavors so he would have some variety.

My 2 cats snub all wet food except fancy feast grilled varieties.  My one cat has irritable bowel disease, and these foods are on the safe list for him.  My other cat acts like his life's over if we run out.  The food is made mostly with meat, not filler unlike other non premium brands. Thumbs (paws?) up!

Nice to see more than one flavor in a case. My cat really likes this one. Likes the extra gravy ones the best. Wish they sold them in varriety packs. They use meat by-products in their food. I could not get my cat to eat any thing else. She did not like the natural food. Up to you.

What can I say, my cat loves these. They're good sized portions and the product smells very good and looks appealing to the eye, so my experience feeding her is nice as well. She loves it and gobbles it up.In case anyone is keeping track of Calorie intake for their cats, according to a canned food guide I found online, these 3oz cans are 76 Calories each.

My cat Tim is a fussy eater. But he absolutely loves his Fancy Feast, especially if it has lots of gravy on it.  Some days, all he does is lick the gravy and leave the meat in his bowl!  Since we've been on auto-order from Amazon.com, we've never run short of cat food, or had to make an emergency run to the market just to keep the cat happy.  I very much appreciate being able to buy the 24 can packs of cat food through Amazon.com, mostly for the convenience, but also for the slight price break compared to the local market.  These days, every $ counts, I don't have so much bulk to carry home from the store, and I never run short on his supply. You see, Tim stays up late at night, and when he thinks we're not watching, he gets into the pantry and counts how many cans of food are remaining.  He feels most secure when there is a large stockpile on hand, and his behavior the next day proves it.
My cat loves this food. I tried alot of different flavors and brands but this is the one. Mello loves the gravy thats in the food !!!!!
I now will never run out of food for my cats.  They both love it every time and I love the price.
This is very convenient way to make sure our cat has food without running to the store. The price is right too!
My cats simply just love em'....they're quite finicky...but I am finally able to find it without having to donate many previous cat food that my cats simply refused to consume.
I haven't gotten her to go veggie so am pleased at least to find a brand she eats instead of wasting it.
I LOVE it that this is cheaper than I can buy in a pet store or the grocery store. It also arrives at my door and I don't have to lug it about. My cats won't eat anything but fancy feast.

This is my cats' 2nd favorite cat food.  It is very easy to have it delivered once a monty and I really appreciate it.  Not as much going to the grocery store solely to purchase cat food.  I really like having a subscription for the cat food.

This is my second time ordering this product of Fancy Feast and I must say it has been wonderful the order always on time. Also it's much cheaper than in the stores. I highly recomened to any one that loves their cats and wants the best for them.Thank you Amazon.Vivian C. Gold

column9: My two cats love Fancy Feast
column10: My cats love this canned food.  I subscribe to a monthly delivery through Amazon & find that this is an economical and reliable way to have their fave food on hand.
Our three cats all love the shredded texture of the grilled version of Fancy Feast.The small cans are ideal for a single feeding - no need for half cans to be stored in the refrigerator any more.

column9: box contents did not match description
column10: I ordered ASIN: B0010B6IFY "Fancy Feast Gourmet Cat Food, 3-Flavor Grilled Variety Pack (Beef, Turkey & Chicken), 3-Ounce Cans (Pack of 24)" but what arrived was a box containing Classic Variety (Cod Sole & Shrimp, Savory Salmon, Ocean Whitefish & Tuna).

column9: They like everything except the beef...
column10: First I'll start with packaging - it's minimal and all paper which can be recycled. Kudos.There are three layers in the box - one for each variety of food. I've been removing the paper from the layers and mixing them up because sometimes they just don't want the same food for days in a row. I prefer this minimal packaging because the box and the cans are 100% recyclable without any additional waste and no plastic.As for the food quality - it looks great and smells good too! I haven't tried it myself, but for the Turkey and the Chicken, the cats love it and devour the entire portion in one sitting. I wish I could say the same for the beef.It's probably just personal preference for our three cats but NONE of them like the beef as much as the other two varieties (or the three fish varieties in the other pack that we purchase).Aside from the beef issue - we've compared this product to several IAMS varieties and this one wins hands down for the cats. The IAMS paste products don't seem to be as interesting to the cats, and it's hard for me to tell if there is real product there. The Fancy Feast actually looks like shredded/chopped turkey/beef/chicken.The produce is soft and always moist, making it very easy to eat. We will sometimes put just a little bit of water in the dish with the food so the cats get some extra moisture (especially important for our older cats).I'm giving these products 5 stars. The packaging and cans are fully recyclable; the product looks like real food; every can appears and smells fresh; we have yet to find any quality problem with any can. This is on my subscribe and save list.

Amazon has the best price with a subscription for this product. Being a "Prime" member enables for monthly shipments to be shipped to my home and no freight charges. This is just one more item I do not have to put on my grocery list and my sweet, kitty Haley loves the product. She favors the chicken so I have begun a monthly order of chicken, too.

this variety package is perfect; it has great texture and my cat loves it...I like to add the variety and perk my cats interest with different flavors, my cats don't like the same old same old...so  I make life interesting for them by giving them variety of what they love!!

One of our cats prefers Fancy Feast Grilled flavors which are finely minced with gravy. While our vet doesn't recommend gravy because of carbohydrates from cornstarch, we compromise on this one. I like the Variety Packs because we can vary the protein source with each meal, which I understand is healthier for cats. We are delighted with Amazon's Subscribe and Save automatic delivery, which is reliable, saves money, and prevents running out of food.

I have a cat with a very sensitive stomach and I thought I had ordered the cat food that made her stomach purr.. For some reason this cat food gives my adorable cat the runs.  I should have ordered the Classic Fancy Feast.  So I have to give away three cases of cat food since my cat makes it very unpleasant for all of us when she "runs".  I was going to order the Classic but it was through another vendor and I would have had to pay shipping.  Grilled Fancy Feast was ordered but I actually did not come out ahead with having the cat food delivered to my door with no shipping costs.  I will donate it to a shelter and go back to finding the Classic Fancy Feast at the grocery store.  I am working with the vet to find a diet that agrees with her and one she will eat. Classic was finally one that I found that worked.  I would like to say that Amazon rocks. It is so convenient to order things on line and have them there when you need them...of course that is only if I am not paying shipping...

column9: The only food my cat will eat
column10: Fancy Feast, and more specifically, the grilled variety in gravy, is the only wet food my cat will eat. He loves it.

My cat loves Fancy Feast.  When he was found he didn't even weigh a pound.  Now a year later he's a healthy, he's not fat be any means, 13 pounds thanks to Fancy Feast.Amazon was great on the shippinh time.  I thought it would take much longer than the 2 days that it did.

My kitty loves this food! It's probably her favourite. She loves gravy! She is actually very picky, and doesn't like a lot of foods, but she loves this one! I even use it as treats for her because she likes it so much.

I own an eighteen year old kitty.He arrived on one of our wedding anniversaries.Fancy Feast grilled cat food is his ultimate favorite.He often consumes two cans a day.I love the ease of online ordering from Amazon.I never have to make a trip to the store for the right food for a most important mamber of our family

I am trying to get my cat to gain more weight so I switched to wet cat food.  Compared to retail stores Amazon has the best prices.  Also my cat loves this food.

column9: Variety is the Spice of Life

i like that is come right to my door and my cats love it , that like the different flavors and easy to use and open to place in cat dish. thank you

My kitten (10 months old) loves fancy feast, I first tried a so called more healthy food `Core' she hated it, wouldn't touch it. column9: Not as much cat food for your $
column10: I bought this pack because the fishy pate fancy feast smells terrible. However! I noticed that most Fancy Feast cans instruct something along the lines of "feed one can per 3 lbs of body weight daily." I feed my cat both wet and dry food, so I usually just feed her 1 can per day. However, the cans in this pack say "feed one can per 2 1/2 lbs of body weight daily." This means that these cans are less filling. I think its a nice change, but I'd rather get the other types from now on. Also, in the grocery store, I found a flavor with a label instruction to feed one can per 3 1/2 lbs of body weight.

I tried getting this delivered on the subscription service because the price was right and I am handicapped so it's hard for me to lift things in and out of the car. Nice to have it placed on the porch. However, I did not understand the subs service and somehow set it up twice. My mistake which Amazon did not care about one bit, cost me 40.00 in bank fees. That was some FANCY Fancy Feast!

column9: Don't Feed Your Cats Meat By-Products!
column10: The definition of meat by products:The non-rendered, clean parts, other than meat, derived from slaughtered mammals. It includes, but is not limited to, lungs, spleen, kidneys, brain, livers, blood, bone, partially defatted low temperature fatty tissue, and stomachs and intestines freed of their contentsIn summary, it is NOT meat, and is NOT safe for human consumption. So why feed your pets this stuff? Sure, it's cheap, but food such as Chicken Soup for the Cat Lover's Soul does not cost much more and is free of meat by products!

column9: Disgusting...unheathy...made my cat vomit all the time
column10: Pets cost money...so if your going to be cheap and feed garbage to your loyal pets so you can save a few dollars a month...don't get pets....when feeding Fancy Feast to my cat she was always throwing up and had gooey stools...i listened to her behavior...even though she loved the taste( kids love candy...but is it good for them)...as soon as I switched her to a better quality food the vomiting stopped, no furballs, and better stool...she is much happier and thanks me everday for it with her energy and contentment

it's definitely not the worst out there... but's it's FAR from the best, and it should definitely NOT be called "gourmet."byproducts are gross things like skin, hair/fur, bones... it's a cheap filler! NOT good for your cat. in a good canned food there will be NO byproducts or meal.and to those of you saying my cat is ___ and is doing fine, isn't that how it always goes? isn't something fine until there is a problem? also it's like some people can eat junk all their life and not die of a heart attack or get diabetes doesn't mean it's not still junk.
This is the worst food along with purina and meow mix that you could ever feed your animals! if you want your animals to have healthy weights and a healthy life do not buy!
Absolutely delicious!!! We recently had these in New Orleans in Bloody Mary's and loved them. We knew we had to get some for home.  They are great to eat just on their own.

This vinegar has a subtle tomato flavor that is intriguing. If is a very welcome change from the common balsamic vinegar. The shipping, at $10, is insane, but I ordered 12 bottles, and the shipping was only $13. Lots of friends will be getting tomato vinegar for Christmas presents this year.

I dicoverd this product while staying in Arenzano,Itay a few years back. If you like tomatoes you should love this. I was skeptical when the other reviewer said "just like the restaurant" (used to serve). column9: Tastes just like the ones they used to serve in their restaurants!
column10: I wasn't expecting the same recipe that their restaurants used.  I was pleasantly surprised.  Boy I sure missed these.  One bag makes 5 biscuits.  Rather large ones.  Very good taste, just like I remembered.

column9: These biscuits are dry and need additional "help"
column10: Unlike other Marie Callendar products, these biscuits need additional ingredients during the prep phase.  If you follow the instructions, as is, the biscuits are dry and have a light cheese flavor.  Adding butter and cheese can improve the product.When compared to other low cost biscuit mixes such as Betty Crocker or Bisquick, Marie's mix need additional flavoring and butter/oil.  I enjoy Marie's other products and will continue to try the other products.  This mix is good to use when you are a rush, so long as you have time to to "help" the mix.

Easy but they have a definite pre-fab taste, the cheese reminds me the kind of cheese crackers you get out of a vending machine.  Extremely easy to make though, I don't have kids but they taste like something kids would really enjoy.

These taste like Bisquick with macaroni and cheese powder mixed in. That's probably more or less what they are. If these are restaurant-style, I shudder to imagine this restaurant in my mind. I bet it serves potato flakes and Jell-O instant cheesecake too. There are other cheddar biscuit mixes out there that at least come close to the flavor of the ones at Red Lobster. These come close to the flavor of cheddar sand. (I don't like them.)

you are gluten free....and have not found the best thing to eat and feel like everyone else? try this! seriously feed this to many marines and family and they do not even know they are eating gluten free....because we all know going gluten free is hard and it taste like chalk but thus brand has made food taste goodagain! Trust me I have eaten it all being pregnant being healthy and there is still away to enjoy food by trying this product with chicken, eggplant, meatballs!  try it or you are missing out...SERIOUSLY!
This was the perfect flavoring at a wonderful price.  This item also came very well packaged.

Today was the first time my cats have had this brand of food and they were too funny with it!  I split a can between the 2 of them to ward off any problems that could arise with a new food.  They were having Natural Balance turkey and giblets for dinner, so I put that on one side of their bowls and the Tiki Cat Hana Luau on the other side.  They both sniffed it and ate a little but then both dove into their turkey, which in all fairness, is one of their favorites.  They kept coming back to the Tiki food though and then would look at it and eat some more.  It didn't take either of them long to decide it was acceptable to them.  After all, they probably figured I try so hard to give them the best, they would go along with it.  Too funny!  They did both lick their bowls clean and thoroughly enjoyed their first dinner at  Tiki's.  I will be adding this food to their menu, but only the varieties that don't contain they synthetic vitamin K - menedione sodium bisulfate.

I was expecting the content would be more chunky and higher quality. But it is mostly thin slices and gooey dark red matters. my two cats do not take too much liking to it. So I mix it with the more chunky type of cat food for them. With the high price, I think the food should come with better quality than this.  I will not order this again even though the food smells and looks fresher than regular canned cat food.

Being a human means that I cannot personally vouch for this product but my two cats have indicated their willingness to provide this review. According to them the Tiki Cat food in general is of the highest quality, tastes incredible and makes-you-look-forward-to-breakfast. My personal observation is that there is never even a scrap left on their plates and that I usually just have to grab the tins to have two very interested and demanding friends circling and excitedly talking to me. This pasta sauce is so good! I didn't expect this to be So Very Good, but it is.  All should try it. Vendor Ships quickly and I was very satisfied with my order.
