column9: Barbara's Bakery Original Shredded Meat, 13-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 4)
column10: I purchased the Barbara's Bakery Original Shredded Wheat for my pet goat to eat.  Lately, I've noticed that he's been putting on a lot of pounds due to eating high fat leather shoes and other junk he finds in the garbage.  Barbara's Bakery Original Shredded Wheat is pretty healthy and tastes good, at least that is what he tells me when he's not drunk.It is pretty basic Shredded Wheat, so it's cleaned up and nice.  Some people might be put off by the appearance of the Shredded Wheat, it looks like a 17th century buffoon wig or a haphazard pile of old textile fabric, a nest for blind moles, or even a coiled spider web.  I don't mind, I just put it in milk.  If you wear glasses, it'll just look like a white blur to you.If you suffer from dementia, or can't see that well, just a note to add, Barbara's Bakery Original is changing their logo and box covers.  Don't be alarmed if you get a new cleaned up Barbara's Bakery box that looks nothing like the old.  I did notice some Shredded Wheat all over the box, and I didn't even open it yet.  I hope it's still fresh.

Being a Shredded Wheat fan since the 50's I tried this brand a year ago..  Super taste, way better then the normal store brands. so I made the switch and now receive the 4 boxes every six weeks. Try em, you will like them..

I have a special place in my heart for foods that have exactly ONE ingredient, which is the case with Barbara's shredded wheat biscuits. I purchased a box recently as a result of finding a coupon in the monthly Whole Foods shopper, and couldn't be more excited. Excited about shredded wheat, you say? Yes! They taste amazing - I prefer mine with a little sugar, but I suppose you could leave it out. And the little rolled-up biscuits were super-fun to crush up in the milk. This food was perfect...I can't think of any way it could be improved. Thanks, Barbara!

This is a tasty, filling way to start the day.  I mix 1 biscuit with a cup of fruit and vanilla yogurt (whole milk yogurt - if you've only used low fat, try this and discover what REAL yogurt tastes like!) I prefer the original Post product - as do a number of the other reviewers -  but good luck finding it.  In the DC area, even the biggest grocery stores no longer carry it, presumably dedicating the shelf space to more sugar frosted breakfast candy.  Whole Foods carries this brand, but the price is comparable to Amazon's, I'm switching to subscribe and save on this item.
I love that Barbara's Bakery Original Shredded Wheat does not have BHT added to its packaging.  The two-biscuit serving is perfect for breakfast or as a snack.
I grew up on shredded wheat and loved it. I love this product just as much, maybe more. It's just plain fun to see those circles roll out.

I had never really had plain shredded wheat before and now that I am trying to maintain my weight and because of the fact that there is nothing like sugar or salt added to it, I felt like it'd make a good breakfast. I cut up one banana and some strawberries and put in two of the shredded wheat biscuits. I then poured cold fat free milk over it, soaking the biscuits to make them soft enough to pick at with a fork. The way the biscuits soaked up the milk is great, so delicious. And with a bite of banana and strawberries, how could you go wrong?

column9: Best Shredded Wheat biscuit on the market
column10: I was drawn to this product because it contains zero amounts of sugar but the fiber count is just right too. The texture and taste are heartier than other shredded wheat products you may find down at your local Wally World.The only reason for not giving 5 stars is because the packaging does not fully seal the food from air. Within the box, the biscuits are wrapped in thin paper packaging, 6 biscuits in each of three packages, that is glued in spots along the seam (not glued continuously) and in-between the spots of glue the paper is open and not fully sealed. The packaging really comes apart when you remove a couple of the biscuits for a serving. The glue is not strong, the packaging falls apart with handling and creates the need to store the remainder of biscuits from the opened package in your tupperware. Maybe these shredded wheat biscuits need to breathe but I do not think so. I have complained about this on Barbara's website and a company representative responded but as of yet, no action has been taken.
These are good but Quaker shredded wheat is better. Just wish I could have kept my subscibe and save for the Quaker. Oh well I probably will cancel subscribe and save on this brand.

These biscuits(cereal) are about as true to natural as you can get.  No added sugars or sodium or anything else.  They aren't fortified with vitamins and minerals but you could always take a multi-vitamin if you wanted to.  They taste very good, and because of that, this is my second order.  I'll definitely buy again (as long as the price remains acceptable!).

column9: Not even close to real shredded wheat
column10: Just did a side by side comparison to the original Post shredded wheat.  The post shredded wheat had a toasted wheat flavor while this tasted like raw uncooked flour.  The Post brand was also crispier and easier to chew.  If you look at each side by side, you can see why the products taste different.  The Post biscuits are made of thin, straight, parallel strands.  The strands in this product are thicker, crinkly, and are wrapped in a spiral.  The Post biscuits probably bake more efficiently.  I guess decades of experience does make a difference.

column9: The product is excellent but the packaging could be better
column10: The product is excellent, but the biscuits are packaged in plain paper sleeves that are envelope-folded (not sealed) at each end. I'm sure it's environmentally friendly and would be fine if I had bought a single box. But I bought a carton of four.The paper packaging won't provide enough protection from the "critters" that invariably get into grain products that are stored for a while without the proper protection. I guess I'll store these away from my other grains and try to use them up quickly.
I give it 4/5, losing one star for decreasing the ounces during the recession. An old trick, but still reliable, I guess.

It was very disappointing when these were received as the product was NOT as described. It clearly stated 3.5000 pounds of cough drops but after delivery it consisted of the same 12 bags.The net result was a higher price for the same amount of cough drops.

My kitty Petunia, received a bag of these treats for Christmas from a friend. She runs when she hears me take the bag out of the kitchen drawer. She is pretty finicky, but absolutely loves these treats. So we ordered lots from Amazon. Yum!

I have one older (13 years old) dog and a 7 month old puppy. The puppy eats everything so she's not a good judge of taste, but the older one has developed a much more refined palate. They both LOOOOVE these! They smell strongly of gingerbread. I break them up into many small pieces to give as training treats to my puppy or one or two big pieces to give to the older dog whenever. I picked mine up at a local grocery store that actually usually doesn't carry pet stuff. I hope they are available on amazon soon in the 4 pack!

column9: Great holiday gift for your canine friends!
column10: Good thing the folks at Cloud Star came up with a 4-pack bundle of Buddy Biscuits because your canine pals might not otherwise be willing to share!The Christmas holiday version of Buddy Biscuits is gingerbread-flavored and comes in beautiful shiny metallic silver and red packaging that makes each box ideal for gift-giving.  Humans will appreciate the all-natural healthy ingredients while our furry friends will just gobble them up with delight.  Free of corn, soy, sugar, salt, dairy, and egg.  Our three dogs enjoy the biscuits (in many flavors) all year 'round but the holiday version is especially fun.The holiday packs seem to sell out quickly on Amazon.  But don't despair.  Amazon always seems to bring in another delivery. In a hurry? You can simply go to the Cloud Star site and buy them there.  Only Amazon carries the 4-packs though.

First let me begin by saying that this product is not an inferior one, my dog did seem to enjoy the bones. However, the bones are small and my dog had eaten 1 of them in about 30 minutes or less!I have a full grown male Boxer and these bones just aren't big enough. If you have a small dog, anywhere from a Pug to a Beagle you may be fine.I did see where the same company had 15' bones of the same type, I think I'll go that route. But like I said, my dog did seem to like them. Plus the delivery time was terrific and the price was very fair.The only reason I give this product 3 stars is because it is very misleading. When you see the word "Mammoth" you anticipate it being very large, it was not.
Great product. Fast service. Only thng I wasn't aware of is that the bones are cut in half. Not a whole bone. Otherwise, everything was great!
The original description showed this as a "white wine, merlot".  It is a white variatal of some sort. I may return it.

I recently picked up a few bottles of Zico coconut water with pineapple at my nearby grocery store. I was curious. I used to be an endurance athlete and I've read about things like this. It's loaded with potassium and other electrolytes and is fairly low in sodium and sugars. It would make a good replentishment drink and some might suggest it for people who suffer from cramps. Well I find it very bland in taste. That's okay. It has pineapple flavor added, but it's so low as to be almost unnoticeable. I prefer to drink it ice cold and that seems to diminish the bland taste. It's an interesting product. Endurance athletes who sweat a lot will appreciate it.Gary Peterson

I bought this to put in my coffee and espresso. I had Gastric Bypass and can not have sugar but this in my favorite flavor at Starbucks. I know that sugarfree is going to taste different from the original, but this was way too different. To me it tasted sweeter than the original flavor.
Great tasting. Found the right combo for taste. Better than eating all that sugar. you will not be disappointed with this syrup.

This large-leaf black tea has bits of orange peel and "other citrus" mixed in, something I didn't expect from the product description.  My preference is for straight unflavored tea, but as additives go, a little tangy fruit flavor isn't bad.  The underlying tea is of excellent quality - as have been all my Hyley's purchases - so I'll look over their other products to see if I can find the same tea without the fruit.
Best Toscano salami available.  wish it would be carried by the major food chains.  Thank you for a great tasting salami!

Well built, works great and easy to clean. A little on the pricey side but you get what you pay for. Very sturdy, goes together easily and stays together while in use. I used it for 3 hours straight and it worked perfectly. I found you need to clean the screen occasionally but other than that it is excellent.
The product is great and performs as expected but there is no multi-lingual instruction booklet, only French!  Thank goodness for pictures!

column9: The sauce is great, but the Juicer and process less so ....
column10: The Back2Basics Manual Tomato Juicer is great conceptually but in execution less so.  Probably this is due to the price point ... it's "reasonable" but the manufactured pieces don't fit together well, and if you don't crank just right, the whole thing comes apart and all the juice currently in production will be all over the kitchen.  So, if you want just tomato juice, fine go for it -- it will be delicious but what with the aggrevation trying to put the contraption together, the horrific clean up process, and the time, you'd be better off spending big bucks and getting another product.Also, don't be fooled by the image.  The three strainers shown with the press are not included ... available at an extra charge.  That noted, I purchased the extras as I wanted a coarse salsa, which was fantastic, but given the investments noted above, still wish I'd spent the extra $$$.

This wine kit came with everything you need to start making wine, if you already have the basics such as a carboy, hydrometer, syphon, and fermentation bucket.  Getting ready to bottle it Tuesday, looks great and has cleared very well.

When the garden has been harvested and there is nothing Organic to make and the farmers market has closed and everyone has gone home for the winter. Get this soup mix. Even though I didn't like the raw onions I still picked them all out and used them in my family's spaghetti sauce by sauteing  the celery and onions that came in it or you could use them even in meat loaf but the rest I made into my delicious homemade vegetarian soup and then I canned it.Well take care easy as my husband and I always say and I will catch ya later

This cereal is so delicious, and I love that I can eat it without feeling too bad about the nutritional quality.  While there are healthier cereals out there, I love that this one makes me feel like I am cheating with some sugary fluffy cereal, and yet the nutritional profile is still pretty decent.  I definitely recommend it!  Oh, and of the flavors I have tried, peanut butter is the absolute best.  I won't buy any of the other flavors anymore because the peanut butter just hits the spot so well.

The Peanut Butter Puffins are really delicious, I agree with the reviews out there that they taste great.  Peanut Buttery with a hint of wheat taste.  I add a handful of nuts once in a while.One gripe I have was that out of the 4 boxes ordered they were a little inconsistent in terms of taste and texture.  Some boxes taste more peanut buttery than others and some boxes are fluffier than other boxes.  I may have just gotten a bad batch but one of my boxes had really dense Puffins (not sure if this is normal this was my 1st time eating these. it had the consistency of a stale crouton)

column9: Peanut Butter Puffin's Cereal, from Barbara's
column10: A couple of years ago Barbara halted production of the Peanut Butter flavor Puffin.I fell into a medium-deep depression (possibly withdrawal symptoms), sensing that my reason for rising was gone, impossible to replace.To my relief, the company saw the error of its way, and it was back, albeit, sporting new packaging, and what seems to be a variable, Ounces per Box concept, (I have seen 11 and 15oz boxes.)The ONLY complaint I can register with this wonderful product is, of course, the intensity of the peanut butter flavor has dimminished quite noticeably.  This is NOT GOOD.  I would love to taste the taste, once again.Please bring back the peanut butter... go a little stronger.Otherwise, this is the finest breakfast cereal money can buy.  Thank you, Barbara!Richard Anderson  PS.  I fill a bowl half full with fresh-frozen blueberries, fill the rest of the  bowl with B's PB P C, and moisturize with Organic Vanilla Soy Milk or  Vanilla Rice Dream.  Mmmmmmmmm, crunch.

When I buy these, I have to HIDE them from the rest of my family because if I don't, a box will be gone by the end of the day - 10 servings and all. Sometimes, I have to hide them from myself since it's just not possible to eat a serving at a time... I keep going back for more (I just finished off a box; off to buy more!). Peanut butter puffins have great nutritionals AND taste delicious. Even though the cinnamon variety packs in more fiber, I would pick the peanut butter flavor any day!

Did they change the recipe?  It would have been 4-5 stars but I think they messed with the recipe and made them healthier.  Seems like less sodium and less sugar(which is good but they now taste like cardboard with peanut butter on it.)  Trying to deal with the new taste but I'm not sure I can.  Disappointing...also, the pieces are smaller which is fine by me.  If only they tasted good, WHY BARBARA WHY!?

I can't believe the good reviews of this product. The cereal has a light peanut butter SCENT, but tastes like straight up corn. No peanut butter flavor detectable. Only one other review mentions this. There are healthy cereals that taste great and there are peanut butter cereals that taste great (a'hem, Cap'n Crunch), but there is no overlap in the Ven diagram to cereals.

column9: Great cereal, but comes horribly stale
column10: This is a breakfast staple for me, it's great with soy milk and strawberries. I leaped at the chance to order it in bulk online, thinking it'd be more cost effective.The cereal was pretty stale, not unbearable, but not worth ordering online again.

column9: Get my captain crunch fix on
column10: The sweetener is Evaporated Cane Juice, which I think is a fancy way of saying "sugar" (from sugar cane).But they aren't too sweet.  The hint of peanut butter is just right.3/4 cup seems like an very small amount, and it has 110 calories (16 from fat), 2g fat, .5 saturated, 230 mg Sodium, 105 mg Potassium, 23g carbs, 2g fiber, 6g sugar, 3g protein, 2% A, 2% Calcium, 6% Irion.I mix them with 8g of Yerba Prima Psyllium Whole Husks and Barbara's Bakery Shredded Spoonfuls Multigrain, and then pour sugar free almond milk (organic whole foods brand), or So Delicious Vanilla Sugar Free Coconut Milk over the mixture.The So Delicious Sugar Free Vanilla coconut milk actually has stevia in it, which makes that combination a very sweet experience.

column9: Possibly the best cereal ever invented.
column10: I'm not even kidding; this cereal is sooooo good. Sometimes I'll eat a whole box in a day because I just can't help myself. It is crunchy, yet not too hard on your teeth, and the texture only improves with a good milk (soymilk) soaking. The other flavors are great too, but something about the peanut butter makes this the best flavor with creamy undertones in the flavor. You won't be disappointed. Get some and you'll be on cloud nine.

This is my all time favorite cereal, and I'm a cereal addict! I like to eat healthy and natural food and this fits both categories, a little more sugar than other things I choose but such a good treat and soooo much better than indulging in real peanut butter.
Barbara's Peanut Butter Puffins are very addicting...be careful...they are crunchy and quite tasty!  Get some...you'll love them!

This is the worst cereal I have ever had. I hoped it would taste like Cap'n Crunch, but it was more on par with old cardboard. They taste like they could possibly be made of actual puffins. The texture is just as bad. The cereal stayed hard (not crunchy, hard) for quite awhile, then suddenly became very soggy and disgusting on the outside with a hard center. The ingredients are good, I'm not sure what went wrong with the final product but I would not recommend it.

column9: This is cereal.  It tastes kind of peanut buttery.
column10: I like this cereal.  I find it tasty and delicious.  I "Subscribe and save" this item.  I get 4 boxes every 2 months.  I eat the cereal and it nourishes me.  And it is less expensive on the internets via subscribe and save than I find it at my local stores.  This is the peanut butter variety. They have other flavors, but peanut butter is my favorite.  Why are you reading reviews on cereal?  Go spend a few bucks and buy a box in the brick and mortar store.  If you like it you can buy more here.  If you don't, maybe this cereal isn't for you.

I learned of this product from a Today Show Healthy Food segment. It's "all natural since 1971," "free of artificial flavors, preservatives and additives," and "whole grain oats and corn." Made with real peanuts. Per serving, the sugar content is low (6g), low fat, and serves as a good tasty snack.  No milk needed - I've even served these in a bowl as an appetizer snack.  I first bought them on Amazon, but I am now able to find them in the Healthy Food section at the grocery. I have purchased the Peanut Butter variety because that is the flavor that the Today Show recommended, so I have not tried the other flavors.  As a side note, they named their products after adopting a puffin and her name is Barbara. You too can adopt a puffin... [...]

My son is on a gluten (almost) free diet and he loves these things.  While they are not 100% GF due to the oat flour (which is controversial) and because they are processed in a plant where wheat products are produced as well, they will do for my son's diet purposes.  I have to put a limit on how many times a week he can eat these.  It is the ONLY cereal he eats with milk, so I thank Barbara's for that.  At least I can get some calcium in him now.

column9: I could eat my weight in this stuff!
column10: It tastes great! Crunchy and peanut buttery! Pretty healthy too. I saved a lot of money by purchasing it online! This is the only cereal that my little autistic picky eater will eat!

I would say that this is my favorite cereal, or one of them. Super filling and super crunchy/puffed up. If you like peanut butter then you will love this cereal. It's corn meal based though so it has a subtle corn flavor that's more accented than I thought.

column9: A pretty good cereal with some room to improve.
column10: So, I just picked up my first box of Peanut Butter Puffins. Overall, I'm satisfied. It has the not-to-sweet peanut butter flavor I was looking for. Two things surprised me. I guess just by looking at them had me expecting a texture similar to that of Cap'n Crunch... I have to quote an earlier reviewer's description of an "almost stale crouton." It wasn't enough to make the experience unpleasant, but it was noticeably strange. Second, the size of the pieces was much larger than I'd expected. Admittedly, I didn't look too hard at the box when I bought them, but I think a smaller sized piece would have made for a superior product. Still, pretty good, with the perfect amount of flavor.
I swear I have never touched a cereal more delicious than this one.It's peanut buttery goodness drives my taste buds mad.It's the only cereal I would ever dare buy in such bulk.

I am always scouting out new and delicious vegan food. I have a weakness for cereal. I have seen this cereal and the other varities of it in many stores but was a little nervous to try it because usually a box would go for 3.50- 5.00 bucks a box and it would be a shame to hate it and waste the money. I figured by the ingredients that there kind of was no way i wouldn't like it. I like getting cereal with ingredients that i can read, a low amount of fat and sugar. I do not have the world's biggest sweet tooth so just a little sweetness for me goes a long way.This cereal is perfect. I feel the same way for the original and cinnamon verisons. They are large crunchy puffs that stand up well in soy or almond milk. They have a great peanut butter flavor while not being over the top sweet. I am glad to see this on amazon for much cheaper than what organic stores sell it for. I got it while it was on sale 4 boxes for 9.92, you seriously can not beat that for just about any cereal now a days. Try any of the Puffin cereals they all are great.

I wish I could start by saying this was the worst tasting cereal I've ever tasted so you wouldn't buy any, leaving more for us! We love this stuff. We can't begin to say how yummy this cereal is. My wife and I go through a few boxes a week, it is that good! Best of all, the ingredients are all natural! We try to eat as natural as possible, no high fructose corn syrup for example. This cereal is as natural as it gets, and the taste is awesome. I gave a bite to someone at my work and she said "Wow, this tastes like Reese's Pieces!". You get what you pay for, I'd recommend this to anyone!

Wow, I thought maybe I was the only one that was a freak about this cereal. :) Peanut Butter is by far the best flavor of Puffins in my opinion. The other flavors will stay on the shelf forever, but the Peanut Butter will be gone in a flash and then the stockers just slide the other flavors into it's old spot to cover the hole. Yeah, like I don't notice, oh I notice alright, I notice that I've been known to go to 3 or 4 stores looking for it. And now I've found it on Amazon. Oh happy days! :)

Amazon list this cereal as being certified organic. It is not organic! The company website only shows 4 of their many cereal products to be organic.  The use of the word "natural" means nothing as the ingredients in any "natural" product may be laced with pesticides,fungicides or hormones and made with genetically modified plants,fruits or vegetables. "Barbaras" the corporation is no more concerned about making the world a better place or protecting the environment than any of the other food conglomerates.It always comes down to profits. Make people think "Barbaras" is synonymous with organic products and then start selling "natural" products at inflated prices. Makes for a great profit margin by taking advantage of well intentioned, but ill informed, consumers.

column9: Wanted them to taste more peanut buttery (and another 1/2 star to make it 3 1/2)
column10: Ok, I picked these up at my local Trader Joe's...they're not bad, but I have three issues that would cause me to pass these by next time:1. they just don't have enough of a peanut buttery taste. They're more like buttery corn muffins with a hint of peanut butter flavor. I do like that they are not overly sweetened, but it needs a bit more peanut butter flavor.2. The cereal isn't stale, but I like the way another reviewer stated the texture/crunch, sort of like a crouton that is just starting to go stale....3. The puffs are way too big. I can just about get only two or three in my mouth and milk is drooling out all over the place. But just putting one on a spoon isn't enough (I know, picky...).  Oh, and get ready for the scrappage of skin from the roof of your mouth. It's like sandpaper.  So I'm eating these now as a snack without the milk and spoon.  Not bad.So that sums it up.  I'm eating the cereal and enjoying it (albeit the last three comments), but next time, I'll pass. Might pick them up again if they go on sale, but I would be using it more as a healthy snack and not a cereal.

column9: Maybe I had a bad box....
column10: My husband and I are trying to eat healthier foods, so we were excited to try this cereal. Honestly? We both thought it tasted like cardboard! The only way I was able to get it down was to let it soak in my cereal long enough so the icky stale taste went away. :( I thought this was gross....never again.I give it two stars (instead of 1) because it is healthy, and (slightly) edible.

This is the best cereal ever. I love it! It frequently becomes my nighttime snack, with a cup of coffee or milk. I like to eat it straight out of the box, but in doing so end up consuming WAY more than one serving! (3/4 cup is just not nearly enough!) I don't worry too much, though, because it's low in fat and calories, is all-natural, and is DELICIOUS! Perfect crunchiness and peanut butteriness. My mouth rejoices when I bring a Peanut Butter Puffin to my lips. ;)

This cereal stands heads and shoulders above the rest of them for taste and texture. It's absolutely addictive! I have to pace myself, or it would be my breakfast every day.  It stays crunchy, and has a yummy hint of peanut butter. I've never taken to eating cereal for a snack before but sometimes now, I'll have a bowl at night too, like it's a dessert.

It did not have much of a peanut butter taste. It has a very strong corn taste. Like kix. Very disappointing. And its rough and scratches the roof of your mouth. And to me it left kind of an after taste.

Item shipped very quickly and was packaged well. The price was excellent. Overall, the product was ok. I liked that there wasn't too much chocolate on them, as is the case with some chocolate covered espresso beans. However, I did not really care for the type of chocolate covering them. I don't know what percent cacao the chocolate is, but it is definitely not dark chocolate, as I had anticipated. It's very mute in flavor. I may order them for my wedding and put them at a candy bar though, because the price is great.

I purchased 2 packs of this 6 pack product. I purchased them last August. They were very fresh, great tasting and very little sediment. We use this juice for cooking and refreshments. I do not agree with the other comments. This product is very well balanced, fresh and tasted great. I have to wait for restocking so I may buy more. THEY ARE TAKING FOR EVER TO RESTOCK. There is a better Lime Juice and better pricing. Fast shipping. see this one.ReaLime 100% Lime Juice 1 Gallon Bottle by [...] $12.00 for a gallon of lime juice. Fresh Fresh Fresh...just ordered 4 more gallons.ReaLime 100% Lime Juice 1 Gallon Bottle

column9: Stronger Than We're Used To Using
column10: Although stronger than what we're used to using. It's still very good and can be blended to taste for limeade and Margaritas pretty well. We also use it in cooking and natural DIY spa-di-dah and household cleaning concoctions. It will be put to good use no matter what.

I bought Sadaf Lime Juice Shiraz, pack of 6, because of the price and the convenience of getting six bottles delivered to my door.  We use a lot of lemon and lime juice, and I thought this would be a good deal with free SuperSaver shipping.Unfortunately, it just doesn't taste that great.  It's tart, but not distinctly lime flavored.  It almost tastes like artificial lime flavoring in water.  Maybe it's old, or just a cheap brand.I will probably use this when dehydrating or canning apples, potatoes or bananas, just to use it up.  These foods need to be coated with citric acid to keep them from turning brown.  I'm pretty sure we won't be using it in beverages or foods at the table.As a side note, Amazon shipped these bottles lying on their *sides* in a box with one small air pillow for packing material.  Two of the lids had come off in shipping, although the inner foil seal on the bottles kept them from leaking.  What a mess that could have been!

I was so happy to get this order, but unfortunately when I used the first bottle, it tastes old, on the verge of being bad.  The sediment was way thicker than a fresh bottle should have had.  I am not at all sure I will even use the other 5 bottles.

column9: These are great -- hard to find lime flavored.................
column10: I loved these.  It is so hard to find lime-flavored candy of any sort -- I am so glad to found them.  I will definitely order again.

column9: Simply the best salsa you will ever get out of a jar.
column10: Briefly: most canned tomato products (salsa, pasta sauce) have too much sugar and are nasty sweet. Sugar is for dessert, not tomato sauce. This salsa does not have that problem. This salsa has the perfect combination of spiciness, smokiness and thickness and tastes better than any other salsa I've had, canned or fresh. I've tried Jardine's other flavors and wasn't really keen on any of them. I buy four or five cans every time I'm at the grocery store--the Chipotle stack is almost always picked clean, while their flagship Texasalsa and Peach salsa are overflowing and sit there unbought for weeks on end. Clearly I am not the only person to know about this salsa. I have ended up driving miles away to a second grocery store when the first one is out of this. That's how addicted I am.This salsa on top of Garden Fresh Gourmet tortilla chips is perfection.

Jardines, Salsa Med Chipotle. Better than all time classics like Goldwater's pineapple or Fronterra's habenero salsa. The problem with this salsa is price. Mail order runs 8-10 USD per jar (with shipping). Rarely I will find it at the grocery outlet for $0.65 a jar. Thats right, less than a buck for the best salsa on planet earth. Please AMAZON stock this stuff so I can save on shipping.

I have followed the instructions provided exactly and the only thing that has grown is mold. The directions say to remove mold with a stick but it just keeps coming back( I think this is going to be the 4th time now.) I wish I had known what a piece of crap this item was. Oh and the dome they provide is a piece of thin plastic that doesn't even fit in the rock.
Disappointed that I received a rock with a seed to grow into a plant.  This item was not as presented as I did not understand that I would be trying to grow a plant from the seed up.

I bought this kit for my dd last year. She was SO excited to receive it and followed the directions exactly. But, nothing grew- not even a shoot. She was very disappointed and even called the manufacturer since her kit only came with 2 seeds. They said just to wait and see ... well nothing happened. She still has the container sitting on the window sill after a year! Really a waste of money.

Got the "garden" in the mail and discovered as soon as I opened it that there was a crack that ran from the top of the "rock" to the bottom. The rock was actually a lump of clay like any pre-school kid uses to make their hand print or an ashtray in class; not a "rock" at all. I followed all instructions to the letter. It has been a month since I planted the seed and still nothing. Total waste of money so far. I have planted another seed (leaving the first intact, just in case it is VERY slow to germinate) and will try for another month to 6 weeks. So basically, it didn't do as advertised; was nothing like what was advertised, and the only educational value to it was the lesson learned: Don't waste my money on stuff that I could build myself! Being a Bonsai hobbiest, I was sadly disappointed in this product. I expect better from Amazon.com!

Remember these traps are only for survey work to see if the moths are in your area.  You only see the males flying searching for the non-flying females, which the phermone lure immitates This product has absolutely nothing to do with irradication or control  The only effective means of controlling large populations is spraying a bacteria called Bacillius thurengiensis, which destroys the feeding caterpillars.  The caterpillars do the damage not the adult males.

column9: Less than useless, sorry I wasted my money!
column10: I do not reccommend this product...Moths flew right by it,,,an kept going. Other types bait traps have worked in the same area. Dee
It is a pleasure to see the males circling and finally getting trapped. I hate them, love this.

I love the berry taste, it's kind of tart though, it does need some sugar added, at least for me. But it's great both hot or cold, I really enjoy it everytime I drink it. it's very concentrated so you don't need a lot to get tons of flavor.

This organic Haddock Chowder is delicious when made with whole milk or cream and butter plus lots of black pepper.  It is 90% (??) diced potatoes though.  I thought about adding more haddock but I really like this expensive fresh fish pan fried so I vetoed that idea.  It is a hearty soup that is very flavorful though a bit salty.  Being diabetic, I probably should not eat it since potatoes immediately turn into sugar when they hit the stomach acids.  I had hoped for more fish like the non-organic Snow's Fish Chowder has (a large block of fish usually).  But if you like chowders, this one is loaded and hearty........ and very flavorful.  I'll try it again but not too often since it is basically potatoes and therefore 'sugar'!Addendum:  Once I started eating from the second case of this soup that I bought in one purchase, I definitely noticed that there was a LOT more Haddock.  Maybe the first case of 12 was the 'end run' or made by error because comparing the two cases is like night and day.  If the second case is the norm then I really find this soup to be fantastic.  It's actually loaded with Haddock......taste wise and visually!  When I buy more I'll have to see what actually is the norm.....high potato with little Haddock or a good quantity of Haddock.  Wolfgang Puck's soup have the same problem.....one case will be loaded with veges and/or proteins while the next case is nothing but flavored cream.  I will be buying these again though!

Unfortunately, after years of looking for a replacement, for Snow's Fish Chowder...I was very disappointed when I received this.  I have ordered other products that were "Fish Chowder" only to find they used fish, other than Haddock in their chowder.  When I found this, I was thrilled to find it.  If you want Fish Chowder that has Haddock in it, don't order this item.  When you receive it, it is Look's Atlantic brand Premium FISH CHOWDER, not HADDOCK CHOWDER.I bought this based on the label saying Haddock, and the other reviewer talking about how much Haddock it had in it.  I was disappointed to find it has Alaskan Pollack in it instead of Haddock.  Believe me it doesn't taste the same.If you do buy this product...be warned, you cannot return it.  For some reason, Amazon.com will not allow this to be returned, even though it is shipped from and sold by Amazon.com.

My son, my husband and I can not eat anything with gluten in them. My husband and I felt so sad constantly telling my son that he couldn't eat his favorite foods anymore. When we tried other gluten free products, the flavor and texture were just not acceptable. Nuffins saved the day! These products are even better then gluten containing products! The texture and flavor are amazing and they come with very clear directions. Thank you Nuffins for bringing joy back to our grocery list!

I held off on purchasing this item for a long time because the dimensions of the product were not mentioned in the description.  I tried asking but never got a response.  Recently after seeing the price had gone down I decided to risk it and just purchase it thinking that if it's not the size I needed I could just return it.  I was wrong!  I recieved it- found out all the info that was lacking in the description and then when I tried returning it I was told that this product is not returnable!  Last time I ever purchase something that doesn't have dimensions listed.  I also find it really weird that every person that has reviewed this item has ONLY reviewed dilmah products and nothing else.  The product seems fine and the box is good quality as far as I can tell, but I'm dissapointed that I had to buy it to find out basics about it and then find I can't return it.The box is about 9&1/4" x 6&3/4" x 2&3/4" the tins inside each carry anywhere between 1/2 an ounce to an ounce of tea each and each tin is about 2.5 inches high and less than 2" in width.20 grams of earl grey10 grams of chamomile10 grams of silver tips (white)20 grams of rose with french vanilla (black)20 grams of italian almond  (black)20 grams of keemun special (black)20 grams of nuwara eliya pekoe (black)15 grams of moroccan mint (green)20 grams of ceylon young hyson (green)

I'm a coffee drinker and over the years I've leaned a lot about what I like and what I don't like when it comes to coffee.  Tea was something Mom gave us when we were sick and it was alway's Lipton's.  But age has its disadvantages and one of them is that drinking coffee all day is no longer a good idea.  A couple of years ago, I decided to limit my coffee consumption to early morning and try tea for the rest of the day.  This decision was prompted, in part,  by the discovery that green tea is a wonderful beverage and reputedly good for me.  However, after drinking a lot of green tea, I wanted to expand my knowledge of other varieties.  It's an adventure.  A real high point in my road to discovering very good tea was my purchase of the Dilmah presentation.  These little tins don't have a lot of quantity but the quality and variety are suburb.  Once I tasted their white tea, I knew I'd never go back to the supermarket variety.  I've already ordered the white in quantity.  I fell in love with Jasmine teas, in general, for the aroma but this challenged by the intoxicating scent of Dilmah's Italian Almond.  I tasted each of the teas and none of them have been a disappointment.  I'm trying all the varieties again to decide which ones to buy in bulk (although I only needed one taste of their white tea to make that decision.)  This little box is a treasure.  Hope you like it as much as I did.
I recieved this in the mail very quickly. I gave it as a gift for Christmas to my brother-in-law and he really enjoyed it. I would recommend this to friends!
Tastes just like you would get at restaurants!!  It's a great way to find the flavor that you like the best too.

column9: I Give These Seasonings Two Thumbs Up!
column10: These seasonings are excellent combinations of spices! They are delicious when put on many different foods (besides bread dipping): you can put 'em on scrambled eggs, meats, veggies or just butter and toast your bread in the oven with these seasonings sprinkled on top. :)

I have ordered this variety pack before and love it.  I use the variousseasonings on roasted vegetables, assorted meats, mixed with olive oilfor bread dippings, and with sour cream for veggie dips.  It also makesa great hostess gift when invited to dinner.  I always order 4 at a timebecause I never want to run out.

Great product!  Solves the problem of the seasonings staying on the bottom when you pour it in a dish  like mostbread dippers.  Just pour the oil of your choice and and the seasonings of your choice.  Yummy!!!

These are really good have been using for a long time. The store I buy these from closed so I ordered from Amazon. The reason this gets 3 stars and not more is because the picture shows the bigger bottle and the description is for a bigger bottle and what gets shipped to you is the smaller size.

column9: I use this for Steak Seasoning - and it is the BEST EVER!
column10: I rip off the top and dust all 4 flavors over steaks and chicken, whatever goes on my BBQ has this seasoning on it. I have been using it for years, everyone raves about our special blend of spices. I just wish it wasn't so expensive to buy online.

This is a real family favorite with quality balsamic vinegar and extra-virgin olive oiland a good dense bread.  It also makes a nice dressing with the vinegar and oil.A great party and conversational snack.

We really enjoy going to dinner at Carabba's. Before dinner they give you a dish of seasonings with a loaf of bread for dipping. Olive oil is added to the seasonings at the table.  Dean Jacob's seasonings give us a taste of Carrabba's each and every time we serve it.  Our family and friends really enjoy these flavorful seasonings.

Great for bread dipping and also for seasoning. I love to use the Rosa Maria flavor on potatoes for a wonderfully delicate rosemary taste. Also the Parmesan Blend to flavor noodles and/or pasta. Sometimes I just open 2 or more sections at the same time and shake away - gives an interesting flavor combination. I gave one of these to my daughter and her family with a nice bottle of olive oil and a set of the dipping dishes. Makes a nice gift and they're also hooked now. Wonderful product. I bought my original container in a gourmet kitchen store. So glad to find that it's now available on Amazon.
Yum, Yum, Yum! We did find mixing it with a Light Virgin Olive Oil tasted much better. Regular Olive Oil was a bit strong on the "olive taste". I also reccommend purchasing the Xcell Dipping Saucers!
Love this product. Nice fresh spices to add to your cooking or just with Oil to dip your bread in.  Awesome!

I am familiar with Dean Jacobs bread dipping seasonings and normally pay $6.00 for a bottle that is 5 inches in height.  The picture displayed on Amazon appears to be this size, and the shipping weight was 1.8, which seemed to be about right, so I ordered 2 bottles.  When they arrived I was very disappointed to find that there were about half the height and appeared to be mini bottles.  In other words 2 bottles equal one of the bottles I usually buy for $6.00.  Therefore I paid $20.00 for half the amount.  Next time I will shop more carefully and question the picture display as to accuracy.  Very unhappy about the price, but the product is good.
Great gift or to use at home. It is used weekly if not more at my house! Great flavors! My  family loves it!

I got these same dipping spices as a present a few years ago.  I could never find them again at a store when I ran out, but then looked on line and found them through Amazon.  There is nothing like a fresh piece of bread dipped in Olive Oil and a flavor of these dipping spices! Yummy!! I also received them in less than a week when I was told it could be up to 21 days...another bonus!

I LOVE this stuff.  It's sold as to season oils for bread-dipping, but I've been using it to season my steak and chicken breast, and it's incredible!  It can give an awesome flavor to pretty much anything you want to add a bit of flair to.  I was given a jar a while ago, and had to re-stock before it ran out!I'll NEVER let my bottle run out.  This stuff will ALWAYS be in my kitchen.

i have had this product before and enjoyed it very much, and was so glad to get it from amazon. thanks for having this item...i've used it on chicken and fish and it was very good. I love to dip the bread in it..........  A.G. new york

column9: Mixed spices make you a gourmet cook
column10: Not just for dipping, these spice mixtures add zest to meats, salads, mashed potatoes -- about anything edible you can name.  My only complaint is that I use them so often in so many different dishes, that I frequently run out -- so I've learned to buy in quantity.
Been working my way through one of these for a couple years now.  It is a great mix of seasonings, just mix in with some good olive oil and some balsamic and dip away.

This is a wonderful product.  Not only do I deprive myself of carbs all week so that I can use it as a dipping sauce with bread, but it's fabulous on chichen, fish and steak.  So many uses and all four combinations are delish!!!!

I just got this today and mixed the Tuscany flavor.  It was awful - all I could taste was the salt.  I did let it sit for an hour as was recommended, which probably made it worse - and every flavor has salt as the first or second ingredient. Since when does dipping oil have salt anyway?

It's been over a month and I am still waiting to receive my order, This is terrible service I just hope I get my variety pack!! I can see that other people are getting orders. I just wonder where the hell mine is. I am very very unhapppy with The Wire Wisk.
If you like really sweet jerky than this is for you. I didn't like it. I thought it was really expensive.

column9: Great tasting, easy to use, makes a satisfying meal
column10: This is my third Leonard Mountain soup product and all of them have been delicious. This is perhaps my favorite. Very simple to make, seasoned well, and the pasta ends up tasting great. Just add your favorite chicken (we pre-cooked ours a little), bring to a boil, then add the pasta. We did as suggested add more water near the very end and this helped. Even adding the additional water this makes 4 servings at most.As to the trans fat. I went directly to the website and the soup is listed as having zero trans fat. But the box is outdated. This makes a great tasting chicken soup, quickly and easily. Recommended.

This item has old outdated packaging indicating the product has been around a long time - the Nutrition Facts box on the package doesn't even include a line for Trans Fats but the list of ingredients indicates that the product contains a significant amount of extremely unhealthy trans fats. This stuff should't have been sold. Amazon has dropped the ball here - buyer beware.
This is an excellent product but unfortunately its not eligible for super saver shipping so the cost is too much per tart

column9: My cat won't eat anything else... that says it all! :)
column10: I received TWO (2) 24-pack boxes of this product; not the 12-pack as pictured. The price is better than I get at the grocery store (Amazon Prime member).I've tried other brands of cat food, even the more expensive "healthier" brands; I even try the regular Whiskas. But, the Tender Bites is kitty's favorite! I can't get him to eat any other kind anymore. If I try, he refuses and turns to his dry cat food until I clean the dish and refresh with Tender Bites!

I buy this products occasionally for my 5 cats, since they really like the taste.  I think it's a very good product, it's not filled with too many fillers, and it doesn't smell too strong. The biggest downfall with all of these Whiskas pouches is that they are messy to dispense, and it is very difficult to get all of the product out of the pouch.  I find I get the gravy all over my hands, not the biggest issue, but ewww.

We have six indoor cats, and they all have different likes.  Our siamese cat will only eat the Whiskas Tender Bites chicken.  That is the only flavor she likes, and it has to be the tenderbites.  She usually just likes the juice but will sometimes eat some of the food as well.  Why she only likes this one, I don't know.  Amazon is the only place I know to get the box of 24 in the chicken only.  I rated it five stars because she likes it!

My cat is not a huge fan. Sure, she'll lap up the gravy, but leaves the little meat-like bits as dry as a bone. It feels like saving money, but not if your cat is only gonna eat cornstarch gravy and turn her nose up at the meat by-products. It's probably fine for a grocery-store food, but a better quality food will make your cat happier and maybe healthier. Also I can't imagine gravy has got the nutritional content my cat needs.Pouches seem like a great idea compared to messy, annoying cans, until you can't figure out a way to get the stuff out of the package without getting gravy all over your hands.I switched to Merrick cat foods and my cat is happier--she doesn't leave lots of uneaten bits.

To all you cats out there,I love this food, my pet keepers feed it to me 4 times a day, I meow in protest if it's late. If asked I'll even sit on command so I can eat Whiskas morning, noon, and night!Thank you for keeping them well supplied.Stella(typed by the Keeper)

I purchased this as an option for my cat since he only eats chicken. This is a much drier and diced product (no juice) as compared to the other Whiskas products in a pouch. However, the pouch is quite stuff, so if you cat likes it, he will surely get enough to eat from this pouch. Also, the picture does not look like the product I was shipped.

Our older cat (14 years old) would only lick the juice from the bowl and let the chunks alone.  I've read since then that cats are carnivores and therefore should not be fed a grain-based diet.  So many cat foods on the market have grains as the main components, and so you have to look for products labeled "grain free".  We found some at our local feed store.  Maybe our first cat would have lived longer if we'd fed him better.

Even my most finicky cat LOVED this flavor.  The bowls are spotless after their meal!  I haven't been able to find this flavor by itself in the store, only in variety packs, and my cats don't like all the other flavors in the variety packs.  I'm willing to pay a little more to get a box of food I know they love!

This used to be my cat's favorite food.  But a couple of months ago, they changed the formula and now my cat won't touch it, and I know why.  Each of the four flavors says "in juices" after it.  But since the formula changed, there is absolutely no juice in this food.  The food comes out in one big dry clump.  The juice was my cat's favorite part.  I'll still by the other Whiska's flavors, but not this one.
Walmart.com has this for $4.88 for a box of 12 packs.  It was even cheaper at my local grocery store.  Amazon is ripping us off.
This is a Repeat Buy for me. My cats eat these and its cheaper and easier to buy in bulk.
I love being able to order this item online and have it delivered. The price is amazing and not having to worry about running out of food for the furry foster babies is much appreciated!

If you subscribe, you save and you don't have to trek to the store to buy these bulky boxes. I thought purchased enough for a 2 months supply but no, my cats must not be felines because they have appetites like pigs. ;) I have to change my subscription so that they deliver more frequently.

I sometimes get notes from my cat Steve regarding his food, litter, toys etc. and I post them here. - - I know, its weirdDear Grocery Lady,Please don't think because I am of the feline persuasion that I did not see and understand the "buy 1 get 1 free" coupon I saw for this terrible food. In case you didn't get the hint that I don't like this and you should never bring it again, I threw up in your shoe as gentle reminder.You know I have a delicate digestive system and a discerning palate.  Stick to the cuisine I like....don't go rogue again!Sincerely,Steve-the-cat  ,,,^. . ^,,,~

I am very pleased with my shipment of wiskas tender bits turkey with giblets. I have been unable to purchase the box of all one flavor. I have tried to special order this at my local store and been unsuccessful on several occations. purchasing this through amazon.com I am able to get my cats favorite food on a regular bases.  thank you amazon.com

Although I like the convenience of the food and my cats like the taste the 24/$15 is more than 50% over what I pay even at Petsmart. I was going for the convenience of monthly shipments, but the premium price is too high.

column9: Love the product - question the price
column10: I love the tender bites as do my senior cats (17 & 18 yrs old). But I do question the price, which is a unusual.  I get the 24 count variety pack for $9.49 at my local Food Lion grocery store.  I would expect a 48 count pack to be no more than double that price (18.98) so $28.11 would seem a bit high.  Unless of course  48 means 48 - 12 pack boxes.  Then the description needs  a little work.

column9: Really tasty, but wish it lasted longer.
column10: Great tasting gum, nice flavor, but always wish the flavor lasted a bit longer. Regardless, a great tasting gum.

This product is excellent. I have ahd an overactive bladder for years- since I was a teen. but this tea really works. I went from not being able to hold my bladder for only a little over an hour- bot being able to hold myself for up to 3 hours. This means I can watch an entire movie without losing out on bits and peices of it-- or stay for the whole chruch service. I highly recommend it. I intend to comtinue using this porduct as long as it is available.

I am very satisfied with this product.  It really does what it says it will.  I am also amazed at the speed I receive it from Amazon when I order it.  Thank you all.  I will continue to order this product.
Was anxious to give this a try, hoping that it would work, but no such luck. It tasted good but didn't work.

I purchased this product from Amazon and was very satisfied with delivery of the product but very disappointed with the product as it did not live up to its promise of helping in bladder control.  After two weeks of use my wife found no improvement in her bladder control, so I gave the product one star for prompt delivery but the product wasa complete disappointment.migem

column9: Excellent for Cleansing and Less Frequent Urination Feeling...
column10: I live in the Southern CA area in San Diego.  We have had a lot of chemtrail activity in our area and one of the health issues that a lot of people are having are kidney and bladder related inflammations.  It is due to the heavy metals in the air that are being transmitted into our foods.  They have increased the fluoridation of water also, so this is adding to the problem.I drink a lot of caffeinated teas, so make more frequent trips to the bathroom than most people.  This tea really helps cleanse your system where you are not feeling that bloated feeling like you need to run to the bathroom as much. Within the first day or two of drinking this tea, I could tell a difference.I was able to sleep over 5 hours after drinking this tea and clearing my bladder, where as I was normally waking up 2-3 hours into sleeping and needing to go to the restroom again.  This makes a big difference!  I'm buying my 2nd box of this tea now!Great stuff.  Try it... I don't think that you will regret it!I wish I had found this a few years earlier!

Bought this tea for my old mother as she has problems with having to go the the bathroom 5-6 times every night. It has helped her well and most of the time she does not have to get up so often. She also likes the taste.  Will buy again.

column9: Common ingredients do not merit price
column10: I noted that it was very expensive for tea, but the reviews made me give it a try.  When it arrived, the ingredients list is nothing but common herbs recommended in books and readily available in any decent size bulk herb store.  Bell did not even put the tea in tea bags.  So I really fail to understand the expensive price.  I probably will not pay for this product again, but rather mix my own.CranberryGoldenrodMarshmallowNettleParsleyRosehipsUva UrsiWillow herbNatural citrus flavor
Did not seem to work for me, but have only used for a month, so will wait and see if with longer use it is helpful.

column9: Yum! Dark chocolate is my favorite...
column10: My family has been enjoying Bug Bites organic chocolates for years. I highly recommend both the milk chocolate and the dark chocolate varieties. They are very smooth and rich, and not the least bit "waxy" tasting like some of the more popular American chocolates. Each individually packaged bite is the perfect size for an adult and maybe a little more than a mouthful for a young child. Each tiny package contains a special treat- a tiny insect card which features a color photograph and interesting facts. If you have a budding entomologist on your hands, these are the perfect treat! The Endangered Species company is environmentally conscious too, and dedicates 10% of their net profit to support species and habitat preservation.
It's not a bad thing that these are too bitter, it keeps me from eating more than one. I use a "smidge" of peanut butter to balance out the bitterness. Love most dark chocolate, like this one.
I love this chocolate, however this price is more than retail.  Buy from someone else.

Badshah Punjabi Garam Masala.Garam Masala is a quintessential ingredient in various dishes of Indian Cuisine.  It is a powdered mixture of whole spices that is used to elevate the taste and aroma of a dish.  It can be quite strong so a little bit goes a long way.  I have used several different brands and types of Garam Masalas and this one is by far my favorite. It's not hot and the aroma is amazing.The ingredients mentioned on the box are as follows: Coriander, Black pepper, Cumin, Tejpatta, Clove, Green cardamom, Black cardamom, Cassia, Anistar, Dry Ginger, Nutmeg, Mace, and CarawayUnfortunately, I couldn't find it in any Indian store around and was delighted to find it at amazon. I actually like it so much that I don't mind paying for the shipping and Ive stocked up in my pantry.  It arrived well packaged and wasn't old stock. I will definitely order again when I run out of these.
Good tasting pasta. But this has too much corn and not enough quinoa. Only at 10 percent. But very good rating. Please give it to your children to get ten in a healthy track.

column9: I can't find these anymore in stores!
column10: Most of the time there are none on the shelves, and when I do find Milk and Cereal Bars at all, they are packaged with Cinnamon Toast Crunch, which I do not care for at all!  Please come back!

We bought these for party favors at our wedding and at first were a little skeptical of the price.  They turned out to be well worth it.  We used them in tiny buckets with brown sugar for the sand.  We had to tell a number of people that they could eat them, they looked so real.  We were more pleased with these then half the decorations that cost 10 times as much.Oh, and they taste great too.
The package arrived in a ripped envelope.I had hoped to use for part of wedding favors. They arrived broken and melted.You would think they would know how to package.

I wanted a natural raspberry flavor for beverages. I guess I did not read the description thoroughly. In any case we did not care for the flavor. It tasted too artificial, like cough syrup. Maybe you will like it. We went for true raspberry extract next and it tasted much better.

Delicious and best thing ever. Nice spice has a little kick! If you love grilled artichokes, ignore review that stated the product was stale. They are packed in SUNFLOWER oil not OLIVE oil, hence the different taste...

Absolutely wonderful, fresh and very flavorful! I ordered four different artichoke products from different companies and these were by far the best, much better than what you can get at an olive bar in a grocery store. Perfect size for snacking or cooking and you get 4 of the trays for a fairly reasonable price! I am going to order several more plus sign up for the automatic delivery option. I am eating more artichokes on the advice of my nutritionist to help my liver. And they taste good!

column9: Olive Oil was stale and spoiled
column10: I love artichoke hearts (and hearts of palm) but as soon as I opened it I could smell the stale olive oil. I would have been embarrassed to serve them to guests. the olive oil also tasted very badly. I will now only spend this much money at the deli.

column9: Kahve Koffee's Cordoba Blend is the reason I get up in the morning
column10: Since I switched to Kahve Koffee's brand of gourmet coffees, I now have a reason to look forward to waking up in the morning.  Like a faithful alarm clock, the thought of getting up to make my coffee beckons me. I can't wait to grind the beans and start my morning brew. The taste and full body of this coffee is superb. It is rich, dark and flavorful but never bitter. I have never had a better more consistent cup of coffee. It is no wonder it is served in Boston's finest restaurants! Very reasonably priced for the high quality you get. I also tried and loved the Sumatran Viennese, Kahvé Sumatran Viennese Coffee  Barcelona Blend  Kahvé Barcelona Blend Coffee  Italian Roast Kahvé Italian Roast Coffee Espresso Napoli Kahvé Espresso Napoli Coffee and several of their decafs, most notably the Decaf Danish  Kahvé Decaf Danish Blend Coffee.  I could not tell the difference between their decaf and a regular cup of coffee which is very hard to find.  Just excellent coffee! Can't wait to try some of their other blends and single origins. I happen to personally favor darker roasts, but their lighter blends are just as flavorful and rich- I just add more of it to suit my taste.  Now that I have been drinking Kahve's coffees, I am hooked for life!

column9: Was a Great deal for quality cat food
column10: I got lucky and found this deal on a brand my cat will eat in his incredibly finicky way so long as I don't feed him the same foods more than 3 weeks at a time.  I never knew a cat would desire such a variety and change as much as my Sammy does!  It was shipped quickly and received in 2 days.  This food is in a pate form much like the Fancy Feast Classic is which I have found to be better for my 2 cats as they eat more actual food and not just the gravy.
This appears to be really good food for my kitties, but neither Maine Coon will eat it; they hardly will even smell it.  I'm stuck.

I bought these as "a little something extra" for Christmas gifts.  They were a hit, even for adults.  The tin is adorable for any age and the cocoa tastes just like any other candy cane flavored cocoa.

Look, if you are expecting "real" bread, or you are a recent change over to a gluten-free diet you will not like this bread. None of the gluten-free "breads" taste much like bread, and this is no exception. And, the lack of eggs will make this bread a little crumbly. This is a reality of all breads like this. You have to understand what you are buying. BUT, if you are looking for something to toast for a quick snack, or to use for a sandwhich this is the best gluten-free bread out there. The bread works best if you lightly toast it first and eat it warm. It also works especially well if you cook it with hot toppings. And, if you have a child who just wants to eat a sandwhich like all other kids at school, then this fits the bill. But, bread it ain't. If you are an adult who is new to gluten-free, it will likely taste like school paste. It all is in what you are expecting. But, in my experience, this is the best you can expect for a gluten-free, egg free, oat-free, bread.

This was a keeper. The best I have found, so far. Light and airy. Can make peanut butter & jelly sandwiches.. doesn't NEED to be toasted like the others... Makes a "mean" french toast... My daughter (who is pretty picky) eats this bread a lot.

Texture & taste was really good for a GF bread. I would give it the highest rating if not for it's shape. The slices were small & somewhat mushroomy in their shape. Looks like the bread did not rise properly before being baked so that sides collapsed . The odd shape made it impossible to make normal sandwiches or to use them in sandwich maker. My kids did not like deli meat hanging as dogs tongue on sides of their sandwiches. I would not write here if not for all 6 packs were of same poor quality. It's my second unpleasant experience with Ener-G Foods product on Amazon. Their products at grocery stores seem of much higher quality for some reason. I doubt if I will order them again in bulk.
A well priced bread for the gluten free diet. Nice texture, toasts well, and stays freash for up to a week.

I ordered the light rice loaf by mistake. I have always gotten the regular white rice loaf for my six-year-old son that has Celiac disease. I gave it to him thinking he wouldn't like it but I had to try because we already had it. He absolutely loves it. He asks for bread (with nothing on it) all the time. He will eat 8 pieces a day if I let him. He likes it much better than the regular rice loaf. What a happy mistake!

I have tried just about every gluten-free bread and bread mix over the past 7 years and this is the BEST!  Some are high in fat content, others are too thick and heavy.  This bread is just right.  It is best to me when toasted.  I keep this bread in my home.  Kroger has it, but Amazon is MUCH cheaper!

column9: Ener-G Foods Lite White Rice Loaf
column10: With my husbands allergy to wheat, I am always looking for bread he can eat, as I don't have to bake all the time.  The bread is so awesome, it actually taste good and has a shelf life, I don't have to freeze and/or refrigerate.  He is happy with the taste, so that's all I need to hear.  I just mailed a loaf to my niece for her son who is autistic and cannot not have wheat or glueton either.Very pleased, highly recommend this bread!!!!!!!!!!!

column9: The best gluten-free bread I've found
column10: When my mother-in-law purchased "light" rice bread, I expected it to be even worse than the regular rice bread we had been tolerating.  However, I was in for a pleasent surprise!  This bread is much lighter than the very dense rice bread made by EnerG.  It still tastes better toasted, but my 4 year old will eat it straight out of the bag too.  I am enjoying it as well - and so much easier to use than my previously preferred brand, which had to be pulled apart with a knife after storing in the freezer.  I have used to make rice crumbs for meatloaf, as sandwiches, as garlic toast, as regular toast, and am hoping to try french toast soon - the first bread even worth attempting that one with!

column9: Wouldn't even feed it to the squirrels
column10: I've only been on a gluten free diet for four months, so maybe my palate has not yet become accustomed to things that taste horrid.  The worst part is that Amazon has left me stuck with six loaves of this.  I'd put it out for the squirrels but I'm not sure they'd eat it.  If you're expecting something that tastes anything like bread, you're in for a shock.

I have been eating this bread as a last resort? I thought I had tried every gluten free bread out there, and this was the best of the worst. Well my mistake, as of today I will be buying my bread from Denver Colrado. Udi's has bread that doesn't need toasting or microwaving, you can eat it right from the package.[...]

column9: I would rather do without bread then eat this
column10: I have eaten a few loafs toasted.  I made tuna fish sandwiches it worked well.  I tried this as an egg sandwich the taste of the food I was eating was not strong enough to compensate for this breads flavor.  It worked well with a cheese burger.  I prefer the popcorn waffers with cream cheese and a lunch meat best.  The expiration of this bread is measured over 12 months out.  Might try again or just go to a speciality bakery  instead.  I recently discarded three loafs that had not expired so that I had the space instead.  Bread is not that important to eat when it tastes like this.  A bowel of rice works well enough.  SJR

My daughter has autism so we are trying Gluten free diet! This bread did not help! It was almost a month out of date, it was hard and not very good! My daughter just will not eat it! Thought it was a good deal but just a waste of money.
Love this product - great tasting for gluten-free!A couple loaves were moldy, but when I contacted the company they replaced it right away.
It is a gluten free product so it always tastes better toasted.I have been very pleased with this bread and buy two cases at atime.

This is the WORST tasting bread Ive EVER tasted!! It taste like crumbley WOOD chips. Im out $13.00. Everything went to the trash. I will just stick to fruits and veggies with lean meat. I know this company tried but this taste HORRIBLE!!

My 8 year old is allergic to wheat, eggs and milk.  She used to eat the regular White Rice Bread when I took a chance and ordered the Light.  Wow!  Not only is it half the weight per load (16 oz down to 8 oz), it toasts up crispy and light.  She can't stop eating it.  Plus Amazon.com's price and convenience can't be beat.  Thanks for making my life easier.

column9: Best bread ever tried for far......
column10: We buy this bread for my 6 yrs old daughter. She enjoys it lightly toasted and it is really good to make sandwiches because of the texture. So far it's one of the best gluten free bread that we have tried.

Just starting out on the GFCF diet for my autistic daughter.  She was so excited to see me unwrap this (it looks like bread!!).  I had tasted it beforehand and had reservations about whether it was even edible.  She took one bite, spit it out, and handed it back to me.  DH asked "how bad could it be?".  Came home, tried it, and he stuck it in the garbage bin.  Yuck.

My mom has an allergy to gluton and this is her preferred bread and one of the only gluten free breads she will eat.  It does not taste anything like normal bread, and she rarely eats it untoasted, but if seems to calm her bread cravings.
My son is on a GFCF diet and this is the only bread he can have. It tastes best toasted.

We purchased this bread locally through one of our regional health food stores as well as a large national chain. Their prices were forever increasing, and we decided to buy in bulk from Amazon. column9: Acai Lemonade is a good alternative to soft drinks (and other powdered beverage packets)
column10: I received a free sample of this through an entity that sells products made by NOW Foods.  I was very hesitant to try it because most powdered based beverages are simply awful.  This particular flavor by NOW Foods is very drinkable and has a nice lemonade (more of a pink lemonade) taste.This product is sweetened with "Better Stevia" and lacks aspartame and acesulfame potassium, which are two additives that have been linked to cancer in rats.  Many flavored powdered beverages, including those bearing the Crystal Light, Wyler's and Hawaiian Punch names, have these additives.The directions note that the packet should be poured in a bottle and then shaken.  When you mix this in your water, it is a shade of pink. I didn't find that any of the powder floated to the bottom or lumped together.  It seemed to disperse evenly throughout the water and dissolve.The product has 15 calories and is loaded with vitamins.  It has 100% of you daily vitamin C, 25% of Vitamin A, 50% of Vitamin D, 50% of Vitamin E, 50% of Thiamin, 50% of Riboflavin, 25% of Niacin, 50% of B-6, 50% of Folate, 50% of Pantothenic Acid and 1670% of Vitamin B-12.You need to use a little caution when opening the packet.  Compared to other powdered beverages, I found this powder to be made easily airborne. At the present time, there are external providers selling this for a much lower price (iherb.com is one of them - if you want a discount, search the internet for codes or you can use my code LEK375) and many health food stores carry the product as well.As a powder-based beverage, this is a decently flavored product.  It seems to offer a lot of vitamins and has minimal calories.  I would recommend it.

column9: This Has Become A Staple At Our House
column10: So far, we have only tried the Acai Lemonade, Pomegranite and the Berry flavor, and I love these little, inexpensive packets that make a delicious and refreshing sugar free drink.  As a diabetic, it is hard to find foods and beverages that are not loaded with sugar or artificial sweetners.  These NOW sugar free drink sticks are small and portable, so I can take them with me into restaurants that have limited choices for people like me.  Just order water and add the packet!  They are also good for children because they are yummy and sugar free.  I feel good about giving this drink to my grandkids.One other reviewer stated that she didn't like the Berry Tea flavor, and everyone in our family agrees with her.  Don't waste your money on the Berry Tea, because it tastes artificial and watered down - no one around here likes it.  The Acai Lemonade if very good, though, and the Pomegranite is positively delicious!  My personal favorite is Pomegranite.  It is pretty, too, and festive looking for a luncheon gathering.  Four little packets will make 1/2 gallon for a group.I did find the powder to be a little difficult to dissolve, but it only takes a few minutes to stir most of it into a glass of water.  I always pour the water into the glass first and then add the powder - otherwise it makes a mess and the powder will never disolve if you pour the drink mix into your glass and add the water last.  It is important to add the powder to an already full glass of water.  I have never gotten ALL of the powder to dissolve and there is always a small bit of residue in the bottom of the glass.The flavor is delicious as long as you don't mix it with more than 16 oz of water.  I hope they will eventually offer this in half gallon size packets, like Kool Aid.  But as I said before, it only takes 4 packets to make a half gallon.This is one of the best finds I have made, and if they keep this level of quality and price, I will keep buying it.UPDATE - 5/25/11: We have now tried the Fruit Punch flavor and do not like it.  We all thought it was really watered down tasting, and had no special flavor that would motivate us to buy it again.  Pomegranite is still the most favorite variety at our house, with Lemonade coming in second.  I will continue to update this review as we get the opportunity to try other flavors.

I like the classic flavor on all the traditional items that I put ketchup on. But I use the spiced flavor when I want to add a little zing to sauted vegetables or add some body to a Bloody Mary. It also makes a darn good dipping sauce for shrimp, and if you're a ketchup dipper, like my daughter, just about anything else on your plate. I'm delighted that it's now available on Amazon. Just in time for BBQ season. I hope Sir Kensingtons comes out with some other flavors in the future, but keeps that real tomato taste.
