Mini Variety Pack (Chips Ahoy!, Nutter Butter, Mini Oreos), 12-Count Snak Paks (Pack of 2)THESE ARE GREAT TO PACK IN LUNCHBOXES, I GIVE THEM TO MY SUNDAY SCHOOL CLASS STUDENTS AFTER A LESSON, JUST ENOUGH FOR THEIR TINY STOMACHS (AGES 4 TO 12)
This variety pack is a great combination of some of my favorite snack cookies. Ordering from Amazon, the boxes I received were fresh and delicious.

These are super small packs of snacks.  Other than the small size they are pretty tasty.  A real person would have to eat several of these but you may be able to get your kids by till a real meal or need some calories on the go.  I would not get them again unless they were on super deal from subscribe and save or with a coupon.
I love it when Amazon offers deals like this.  This came quickly and worked great for snacks for my daughter's kindergarten class.

Those cookies in small packages is very good.  It is very nice to open just one pack instead of a large package of cookies.  Also, you get a great variety of Chips Ahoy, Nutter Butter and Mini Oreos!  It's a great idea for a sweet treats for small kids and big kids, too!
These packets of cookies are just the perfect size for a splurge when I'm on the go. I have a hectic schedule and It satisfies my sweet tooth when needed.
We will not be buying these again. They only had a few cookies in each pouch and they were tiny, mostly broken and crumbly. Very disappointed with this purchase.

What a good combination.  I love the Nutter Butter ones, my grandaughter loves the Mini Oreos, and the 3rd one (Chips Ahoy) just disappeared.  Who knows where it went.???  I have changed my order, so I get a order sooner

I have been eating candy bars from the Mars company as long as I've been alive. That's 50-years (give or take). Now, in all that time I formed attachments and allegiances to various bars in their line of candy. One might be my favorite, while others were less so, but any of them, from number one to the very bottom of the list was a joy. Every one was different with varying ingredients and combinations of flavors, but they all had one thing in common, great taste. Hand any of them to me as a child and my face would light up. That's why the 3 Musketeers Chocolate Bar, Coconut is such a huge disappointment. Simply put, it tastes bad, really bad.It amounts to a regular 3 Musketeers bar with a terrible artificial coconut flavoring added. I am a huge fan of coconut sweets. I also have a soft spot for chocolate. These bars are the worst of all possible worlds. The artificial coconut flavor is overpowering, chemical and leaves a nasty aftertaste that lingers for a considerable time. I would have never thought it possible for Mars to create something like this. How in the world did this get past the product development process at the company? I know it's just a candy bar, but it also feels like a little piece of my childhood was ruined by this. There were never many things you could absolutely count on in life. Now, there is one less.

column9: Sometimes you feel like a coconut, sometimes you don't (get any)
column10: I bought this candy bar by mistake as, in my haste, I mistook it for a regular 3 Musketeers bar. When I got home and unwrapped it, I noticed that the wrapper said it was the coconut variety. Okay, I like coconut. Inside I found two half-bars. The chocolate on the outside and the nougat inside tasted about the same as a standard 3 Musketeers bar, except there was a fairly subtle but definite coconut flavor. Coconut flavor, but no coconut. I was expecting something like the offspring of a Mounds bar and a standard 3 Musketeers bar, with real coconut inside. No such luck. The coconut flavor comes from, "artificial and natural flavors." This candy bar tasted good to me, but I was disappointed with the lack of real coconut.

I ordered a box of these a week ago when it was $14.plus change.  A couple days later the price dropped to $8.36 so I ordered 3 boxes to get free shipping.  A couple days later the price dropped to $7.01.  I didn't order any as I don't need that many.  The next day the price jumped to $20. plus change.  The lower prices weren't lightning deals either.  Such a drastic change in pricing is ridiculous.  Who's going to pay $20 plus tax and shipping for 24 candy bars when they can just buy them in the store for the same price?  Get with it Amazon.
If you are a coconut fan then this is the bar for you. I was very impressed with the taste and look forward to sending to my Mom.
I ABSOLUTELY FELL IN LOVE WITH THESE COCONUT 3 MUSKETEERS. IF YOU HAVEN'T TRIED THEM YET, YOU SHOULD RIGHT AWAY. THE COCONUT FLAVOR IS JUST RIGHT. YUM!!!

Weight of regular bar is 2.13 oz, but Coconut is 1.49 oz.  Worse, there is no coconut in this candy.  Just a hint.. and I do mean a hint.. of flavor somewhere lurking inside the I just got ripped off nougat center.Yeah, there is a small banner saying "flavored"..the banner is half the size of the banner heralding the "richer chocolate" on the regular bar.  They're trying to hide the fact that there's no coconut.  AND failing, since they put a big color picture of a broken open coconut front and center (oh boy, no real coconut... just some so called flavor somewhere.. oh joy) and there is plenty of info. about how this bar has less calories.  Sure it has less calories, since we're getting ripped off.  What a terrible tasteless candy and a bad decision on the makers part to rip off consumers.

I've cooked for about 50 yrs now and used all the Smoke products, but Wright's is absolutely the best I've ever found! It's great in baked beans all the way to using it in meat marinades. You'll find no better liquid Smoke product than Wright's.

column9: Chicken is good an good for them
column10: When this Fancy Feast with Cheddar first came out in Arizona, which was about six months ago, I snapped up several cans as I am always trying to provide variety in the diet of my kitties. And we all know that we want to miss that "can't you see that I am tired of this" expression on our felines faces when they have had to much of something. Mine seem especially burned out on things with chicken in it although I know the chicken is good for them.Over six months time, this has not been and issue with this Cheddar Chicken. My cats love it. When we are having a "blah" day and no food seems to suit, I get out the Cheddar Chicken and all are happy. This especially applies to my Alpha Female Kitty. She is the one who has the problem getting tired of things!But she seems to hang in there with this Chicken Feast.She also likes the WhitefishFancy Feast Delights with Cheddar Grilled Whitefish & Cheddar Cheese Feast in Gravy Canned Cat Food 24 3-oz canned But she is burned out on Turkey and so I do not get that one.Fancy Feast Delights with Cheddar Grilled Turkey & Cheddar Cheese Feast in Gravy Canned Cat Food 24 3-oz canned I give them real Tuna to eat on Sundays (yes they are spoiled) so I do not get the Tuna one at all.Purina Fancy Feast Delights with Cheddar Tuna, 3-Ounce (Pack of 24)As soon as I found this avilable on Amazon, I quickly ordered it so that a case would come to my house every 3 months. I was delighted.If you have not yet tried this for your kitty, I would definitely recommend it. Gabriella, (2 years) Trinity (3 years), Wisdom (5 months) and Mercy (5 months) all said that they agree. They feel like, unless your cat eats only finer things than this, your kitty will enjoy Fancy Feast Chicken. They say they are just "middle of the road spoiled", but not "totally spoiled" and they should know. Thank you for your kindness in listening to them. I, too, feel it is a good bet your kitties will like this and I recommend it!Thank you for your time!

I have Fancy Feast shipped on a regular schedule because that's the only wet food my four cats will eat. They absolutely devour this flavor--Delight with Cheddar and Chicken. Talk about clean plates! This service from Amazon is terrific... don't have to search through shelves of cat food at the pet store to find the right flavors. Now it's delivered to my door step and at the right price.
My cats never tire of this even when they tire of everything else. So I am thankful for a decent quality decent priced cat food. And getting it delivered is so convenient.

My cat is very particular in his eating habits. Right now this brand and flavor is the only moist cat food he eats. I bought more expensive brands stuck his nose up at em. I love the ease of buying from Amazon it works well for me.

This is one of those items on the grocery list immediately after they're gone. The kids gobble these things up so fast, you don't even know you actually purchased them!  The taste is amazing and they make wonderful snacks for sports team practices and games.  They're individually wrapped in small packages so it makes it quite easy to send off in lunches too.  We buy these by the ton - mom and dad like them too! Highly recommend!

These are delicious and though they have a lot of sugar they also have a lot of vitamin C.  If you have trouble getting the kids to eat oranges, strawberries or anything with vitamin C - these can help.These sell for a good price too, especially with the food discount going on!

These are so wonderful!I made a full head mask out of them!The only problem was they got stuck in my hair.I tried to make a suit out of them but they wouldn't hold together....it seems you can only make coverings for parts of the body that don't have joints or that move around a lot.I guess I will stick to  spandex for my super duper seizure sessions.
Why not buy the pure fruit roll-ups??  These sugar-rich, fruit-poor roll-ups are not nearly as healthy.  Look at the Joray or Stretch Island or Simply Fruit rolls for better, more healthy selections.

This coffee was a very pleasant surprise.  I enjoy flavored coffees, but find most of the k-cup varieties to be too weak.  After my initial round of taste testing I had settled in with GM Mountain Blueberry, Mocha Nut Fudge, and Caramel Vanilla Cream.  After reading reviews I decided to try the Butter Toffee when Caramel Vanilla Cream was unavailable for a while... I'm glad I did!  The flavors are distinct without overpowering the coffee essence, and the aroma is wonderful.  If I've brewed a cup and walk out of the room, when I come back in the scent hits me immediately.  Yummm!This coffee, as typical of flavored k-cups, isn't particularly strong, but it holds up in the small cup size nicely.  My usual routine has been to alternate flavors during the course of the day, but I now find myself reaching for a second cup of Butter Toffee.

I like flavored coffees but not my husband. That's part of why we got Keurig maker. Have started trying the different flavors and this is the dessert-y kind of flavor I'm looking for (and my other top favorite so far is Green Mountain's Caramel Vanilla Cream). Been making it on the 8oz mug setting and just fine!

My Keurig coffee maker made me a coffee drinker, Gloria Jean's Butter Toffee has me looking forward to a cup every morning. Medium Bodied, with an intoxicating butter toffee scent. Makes breakfast extra special.

column9: Good taste - poor quality control on K-cups
column10: The flavor on these butter toffee k-cups is decadent, and the first few my husband and I drank were great. Now we've have 6-7 cups in a row in which the filter seems to malfunction, not allowing all the water to drain out, but LOTS of grounds. The result is a half-cup of coffee full of grounds and a Keurig to clean up. May just be a crummy box, but beware! (The Timothy's brand k-cups never give us this trouble.)
Great Coffee for a great Coffee Maker and you can't beat the price.  Huge selection of flavors.  A must have.
Gloria Jean's Butter Toffee is my favorite flavored coffee!  Good flavor and not too strong.
It's aroma is wonderful, but the flavor is not very strong.  I also find it a bit bitter.  But considering the limited amount of flavors available in subscribe & save program, it will do for now.

column9: Stick with Timothy's or Green Mountain
column10: I ordered this flavor, butter toffee, based on the reviews I read.  This flavor sounded wonderful and isn't one of the flavors offered by either Timothy's or Green Mountain, so I thought it was worth a try.  What a disappointment!  The coffee is pretty weak and the flavor is just off - certainly NOT the rich, buttery toffee flavor I was looking forward to. I guess I've gotten spoiled by the rich coffee and wonderful flavors of Timothy's and Green Mountain, and there is absolutely no comparison between those coffees and this brand.  From now on, I'm sticking to the brands I can count on to deliver a wonderful cup of coffee every single time.

This is my absolute favorite of all the K-Cup Coffee flavors I have tasted.  I love the buttery/carmel flavor and the smell is wonderful.  It is on the mild side but still has a rich, full-bodied flavor.  I haven't had any problems with grounds in my cup, so maybe that was an isolated incident?  This is definite "must try" coffee.

It's been said we in the IT industry have coffee for blood, if that's the case, this is the best choice you can make for a transfusion! :) A great flavor, and smell, but not overpowering. Makes a wonderful second cup in the morning, or afternoon. If you're looking for something bold to hammer you over the head this isn't it, but if you're looking for something to enjoy over and over, look no further. I've also had no problems with quality control and we've gone through probably 12 boxes of this in the past 6 months.

column9: Butter Toffee - the best k cup for your Keurig!
column10: This is by far the best flavored coffee for the Keurig.  Just the right strength and sweet enough that you don't need to add any extras!  We also tried the vanilla caramel but it was too light, this 1 is the bomb!!!
Gloria Jeans coffee is a little weak for my taste. Not as much flavoring. I have found that the Timothys and the green mountain have a much more intense flavor, and the coffee is stronger.

Gloria Jeans hit it out of the park on this one!  Why not a 5-star?  There are only 4 k-cups that get 5-star from me:Timothy's KahluaGreen Mountain BlueberryTimothy's Parisian NightsGloria Jeans German Chocolate Cake <-should be a 10-star

column9: Smells fantastic, but almost zero flavor.
column10: Wonderful aroma. However, I have to agree with the other one star reviewer. This coffee has almost no flavor of any kind (coffee, or butter toffee).  I ended up having to mix it with another K-cup flavor so it would not be a total waste. I can not help but feel it was a complete waste of money. I recommend Timothy's Cinnamon Roll flavor as it taste like coffee with a hint of cinnamon roll. Probably a wise choice if you enjoy weak coffee.

After trying some other GJ flavors, I must say that this is really "up there" on my list of favorite "flavored" coffees. I tried it at a friend's house. It reminded me of a holiday coffee, like Pumpkin Spice. It's not for everyday use, but when it's right, it's right! It's especially good when your throat is soar (like pumpkin spice).I would recommend this highly.BTW, If you don't like a particular k-cup flavor you've purchased, you can trade, sell, or give it away at the K-Cup Exchange on Yahoo. Just go here; http://groups.yahoo.com/group/K-CUP/ENJOY!
Very good favored coffee. I usually don't put sugar on this favor because the butter toffee seems to taste sweeter than the other favors.

column9: Yuck.  Watered down and artificial taste.
column10: I purchased this based on the reviews.  Maybe I just got a bad batch, but, who knows?  If you like a very light watered down coffee that's loaded with what seems to be an overpowering artificial flavor, you will love this.  Not my cup of "coffee"...  I gave it a sincere try.
I generally like Gloria Jean's flavored coffee, but I'm not too thrilled with their Butter Toffee - it tastes too syrupy and sweet for me.

My work has a Keurig coffee maker, which is where I first tried Gloria Jeans Butter Toffee Coffee. I love this coffee so much that I bought a Keurig for my home so I can have it any time I want. I have never been much of a coffee drinker but this coffee is awesome and has such a good aroma.

column9: If you're feeling a little adventurous.....
column10: Try combining 1 Butter Toffee k-cup with 1 Extra Bold k-cup (right now I have Sumatran Reserve...delicious and strong) and you're in for a real treat!!  It seems to solve the problem of the Butter Toffee being a little too weak....
When I brew a cup of this coffee in my office everyone who comes in for the next hour breathes in deeply and asks what is that delicious aroma emanating from...A delight to both taste and smell...
This is delicious coffee.  A little on the strong side for me, but very tasty!

I bought a Keurig one cup brewer last year and have tried several kinds of K-Cups; this one was excellent and I would highly recommend it.  It's the first Gloria Jean's coffee I have tried and it has a wonderfuly smooth butter toffee flavor, not too strong.  It's as good as having dessert without the calories.  I would recommend it and will definitely get it again.
Everytime I walk back to my office, everybody says "What is that? It smells so good".

I like strong coffee, so I was prepared to be disappointed. WRONG! I brew 2 k-cups on the smallest setting into my mug, add plenty of sweetener and creamer, and sit back and enjoy. This is sooooooooo yummy, just like dessert! I will buy more.
I tried this coffee after a good friend recommended it. It is wonderful! It has a very nutty and buttery flavor. If you like flavored coffee you must try this one.
This coffee was great and offered at a great price. Would do business again. Thanks
If you don't have a Keurig coffeemaker, I'm sure Amazon can fill the order. Then, buy the K-Cup coffee to go with it.  Gloria Jeans has very good coffee, and we really enjoy it.

column9: Wish I could give this more than five stars
column10: My husband and I were always afraid of making fish, like so many others.  Just never quite got the cooking down right.  Well, now we're having fish most every night.  Halibut, swordfish, sea bass - you name it, we make it.  This rub makes one a five star chef.  Rub some on any fish, heat up the George Foreman grill and voila!  I can't say enough about this product.  I only hope and, yes, pray that this fish rub is always manufactured.  Have to say it is the best at home cooking product we've bought since we've been married - and that's 34 years now!  So, you can see how good this product is.  Emeril's Fish Rub, the way to healthy cooking at home.

column9: Taste lovely, texture is wanting...but a nice treat for the sugar-free York Patties lover
column10: I gave up sugar (mostly 99% of the time) a bit over a year ago. For a while, I just didn't really have treats. Saw these in the drugstore and got some. Ya know, they do taste like the YPP we know and love. Nice and minty and chocolatey. BUT....The texture is just not the nice one associated with the original. This lacks that creaminess and...well...the texture magic. These are dryer...er...it's hard to describe, but it's not a lovely textural experience.Hence the 3 stars.Also, I wouldn't recommend more than one, two max at a pop. The sweetener they use will make you visit the bathroom and gurgle you up in more than minimal quantities. Well, they do me, anyway.But, for sugar avoiders, one of these once in a while after a meal is rather nice. :D

I love my single serve Kurig, but couldn't find a k cup to brew a STRONG 6-8 oz cup.  This is the strongest roast I've found with the best flavor (closest to a triple shot americano I can find), plus it's decaf, so you get all the best experience of the coffee with less caffeine!

If you are wanting  a strong coffee to make cappuccino, this will do the trick.  I use the 6 oz setting on my k-cup machine and froth my milk with an automatic milk frother.  Once combined, it is perfect!  Delicious!  You will not know it's decaf...very strong and flavorful.

column9: BEST cup of coffee I've ever had!
column10: I thought I'd splurge and try this coffee.  It costs much more than other decaf K-Cup options.  But I hoped that meant it was better coffee.  It IS better coffee.  I've never had a better cup of coffee than this.  It is excellent when compared to any other decaf or regular coffee I've tried.If you like BOLD, FLAVORFUL decaf coffee try this coffee and you'll really like it.

column9: A little harsh for my palate
column10: I love Italian roast coffee and wanted this in K-Cup pods to use in my Keurig maker. I have used San Francisco Bay's French Roast but could not get Italian roast in that brand. This brand is a close second to other, smoother brands of Italian roast and works well as a basis of my Latte's made with my HIC milk frother. My order arrived on time as expected with Amazon Prime.

My cat Hanx and I both love Merrick- me for the wholesome ingredients and him for the flavor. Though it's hard to judge, I think this flavor might be his favorite! He sits and licks his lips for 5 minutes straight after eating! He's the least finnecky cat in regards to food, so he likes a lot of stuff. He LOVES Merrick, though!

This is really a great way to save money on an actual Thanksgiving Day Dinner.  Since I spend it alone, I don't have to worry about angry guests.  Not to mention, I can share the meal with any of my cats (I have 15, but the number fluctuates as they have territorial fights to the death).  I highly recommend this - it's maybe not as cheap as Ramen, but my desire to eat afterwards seems to drop more substantially with this.

column9: One cat loves it, the other doesn't
column10: Great ingredients. I am disappointed that one of my cats will not eat it.  My other cat, however, loves the Thanksgiving Day Dinner
My kitty loves Merrick Grammy's Pot Pie, Thanksgiving Day Dinner, and Turducken. All seem to be high quality foods, and lots cheaper from Amazon than they are locally.

I tried the Jello Splendid Mousse or whatever they are calling their latest product. Very ho hum. I can't believe they are making such a splash of it. I tried the Chocolate in this Spenda and BINGO! great taste. I made it with cold water and dried skim milk powder because I didn't any anything but buttermilk on hand. Really tasty. Rather expensive here but if you can find it in the grocery try it. I haven't seen the other two flavors but would love to try them. If I can't find them in the grocery today I'm going to order from Amz just to try.

This is not as sweet or chocolaty as I would have hoped, but it is a nice variation of the natural Smooth Move Tea. As the name says, it's very smooth: I've taken more than 20 of these and I've never experienced cramps or other pains that I used to experience with other laxatives. Highly Recommend it.
It works most of the time. I don't drink it the the night before. What I do is let it sit overnight then drink it early in the morning. It usually works about 4 hours later or shortly thereafter.

I LOVE the taste.It does more than being the most effective laxative, it naturally helps your body learn how to work properly again.Excellent product. It tastes great, very much like chocolatey coffee done well.
this is product is what i always drink after eating my dinner. I love this product. I will deffinitely buy more after 6 months because i purchased 6 boxes of this so they will be good for 6 months.
I was looking for something to keep me regular.. This was a good cup of tea, but did not always work..
If you're constipated drink this tea. I'm not particularly fond of the taste, but it's drinkable and does the job.
This product works great but no nasty side effects.  Tastes smooth not a big chocolate flavor but enough for a non-tea drinker to drink it all with no problem.

This tea should be treated as a laxative. I have horrible problems with bloating and cramping so i take this sometimes. I'd advise using it ONLY when you are going to be home for a long time :P And DON'T drink more than one cup a day unless its an emergency, I made that mistake once.... T_TI really hate the taste but I suppose that is probably different person to person. I think it's the senna itself I hate, not the carob(chocolate) taste, because I've tried other senna teas and they have that same disgusting flavor :/ I just drink it with my nose pinched xD

column9: Works fine. Tastes like spinach juice.
column10: Smooth move works fine. I like the mint better though. The chocolate tastes just like spinach juice to me. I can tolerate the taste as I like spinach; otherwise it would be a "no go" considering the taste.

I usually order Adagio genmaicha (which costs 5 times as much), but decided to try this because the price was right.  I didn't know what to expect, but it is very comparable to Adagio tea. The leaves were smaller in the Hime tea and overall the tea was a little more nutty, but still wonderful. Genmaicha has a great smoky and earthy taste that is great to drink at any time.  The packaging is 4 big boxes in foil packages that seem to store well so far.  I'll be ordering again when I run out.  It's delicious.

Hime Genmai Tea is the same tea exclusively served at our grandparents' house in Downtown Los Angeles in the 1950's.  I was so pleased to find it advertised online, which is where I purchased it, 4 boxes shipped out at ~$22.00 including shipping.  The flavor is earthy and delicious, with a subtle nutty aspect, derived from the roasted rice.  It is yellow, not green, in color; a large tablespoon is sufficient for a good-sized teapot.  You definitely want to use a teaball, as it comes loose-leaf from the box.  This tea is so satisfying, you need not add any sweetners.  It goes well with any food, and I find that a cup consumed at the end of my day is highly satisfying.  I've given away boxes to my son's family, my hairdresser, my friends.  Makes a nice gift.

This really is excellent genmai cha: they obviously have started with good-quality green tea, on which many brands clearly skimp, and have both roasted rice and puffed sorgum (which some brands omit). Inside the box, the tea is in a sealed foil bag to maintain freshness and reduce oxidation of the polyphenols. And the price is really quite good.
I love this tea, i used to buy it at the grocery store in Chinatown all the time. It has a nice relaxing taste, the leaves last at least two seepings and you get a nice amount per box.

This tea is wonderful. I have looked forward to it every morning for the past 10 years.  It has a mellow and nutty flavor, and I can easily say it is the best green tea I have ever tried. And, for me, one box lasts upto 6 weeks!  You will not be dissapointed.

This is an excellent loose leaf tea, which can be brewed as long as you like (I forgot about it for about 30 minutes first time I made it), and it's never bitter.  I like it hot, but iced is devine.I will say that the box instruction -- brew for 30 seconds -- is useless.  30 seconds gets you barely colored hot water and zero flavor or aroma.  I usually brew for about seven minutes, using 3 tablespoons genmai to 4 cups water.  Then I re-use the leaves for another 4 cups, brew for 8 minutes, and blend the two brewings into a pitcher.  Perfect iced tea.Excellent tea, excellent value.

There is a surprise when you spoon the tea into a tea strainer.  There are popped sorghum seeds that look like miniature popped corn.  The tea has a stronger aroma than most green teas and a richer taste.  It is now a favorite tea right up next to gunpowder green tea.Because Amazon only has it available in 4 box cartons I am sharing it with my daughers who also are tea drinkers.

column9: Finally found the green tea that I was looking for
column10: This is the closest I got to the green tea I drink at Japanese/Korean restaurants. It is delicious and nutty without any bitterness. You can make it as strong or weak as you like based on the measurement you use. Tea comes loose and should be used with a teapot but I don't have any problems dropping about a teaspoon in the bottom of my cup and drinking it with the leaves on the bottom. Very happy with my purchase.

I used to buy this tea at Safeway but can't get it there anymore. I've since tried others - all more expensive - and none lives up to this one. Great value, and yummie tea. For those who don't know Genmaicha - it's a very satisfying green tea that's a wonderful and healthy coffee substitute.

Ok, so, Genmai Cha tea is not for everyone. My wife won't let me make it in the kitchen because it smells SO bad. I personally love it even though it kind of smells like nutty toasted tuna (really).All Genmai Cha smells like this (I have found). However some are better tasting than others. This one is just "ok", not totally nasty, yet not great either, but it is cheap, so that's a plus (I guess). I usually get the Peet's Tea brand, but it is SO expensive ($10 per 1/4 pound).This tea is a bargain if you can embrace the nastiness. :)

column9: NOW stevia extract is the best I've tried so far
column10: I give NOW stevia 5 stars as they have the best stevia I've tried so far - but I've only tried their extract packets.  This one has no additional ingredients and no aftertaste (if used sparingly as intended).  Stevia will not have the exact same type of sweetening taste as granulated sugar or honey or other such sweeteners.  It is concentrated and super sweet, and has its own flavor and the more you add the more unpleasant it can get.  A smaller amount is best over a larger amount. I eventually got used to using a smaller amount and adjusting my sweet taste - just like adjusting to lower salt.  From my previous research, stevia is the safest alternative, calorie-free sweetening product (or should I say "nutritional supplement") available.  It is a natural product and not a manmade or altered substitute sweetener and appears to have none of their negative side effects.  I like the handy packets of the pure extract to carry with me and have used it mostly for adding to things like hot and cold cereal and drinks like tea and coffee.I've not tried it much in baking, but there are stevia cookbooks available on Amazon.  There are cheaper products available with a mixture of stevia and other sweeteners, but not everyone reacts positively to some of the other additive sweeteners.  If you don't, then try another brand, or stick to the pure extract.
I have tried many versions of Stevia and this one seems to taste the best.
Now Foods Stevia is excellent.  We have been trying to get away from splenda, and find this to be the best stevia product we have purchased to date.
I've used several brands of Stevia and am very happy with these packets.  No aftertaste and clumping.

I love Now Products and have always been pleased with the quality.  I am giving this product one star because somehow I missed in the ingredients list that this item contains rice maltodextrin - which is an issue for some folks which need to be gluten free (not sure based on the research if maltodextrin is gluten free for sure or not....) or for people who have issues with carbs or don't want to eat anything derived from corn, rice wheat (paleo, primal), and also, isn't adding maltodextrin to stevia kinda like mixing sugar with stevia?  Or am I wrong? Maybe it's added in for pouring ability.  Anyway, I am disappointed, I just wanted pure stevia.  I went with the Sweetleaf product after returning this.

This Stevia does not have the bitter aftertaste of some Stevia sweeteners that I have tried. The taste "breaks down" after a while in coffee, and a nice sweet flavor remains.This was a good price for a good product.

I great up on Malt-O-Meal hot cereals on Sunday mornings. As I got old enough my father used to let me help him in the preparations. It remains one of my best memories growing up - spending time with family, good food, and a sense of accomplishment as a kids - who could ask for more?So I thought I would share my family's recipe. This recipe serves 2 to 4 adults, or maybe 5 to 6 kids.Ingredients:- Half cup of Malt-O-Meal- about 3/4 this amount of sugar (more or less to taste). We use cane sugar, but you can use refined sugar. You could also use a portion of this in brown sugar. I have never liked more than 50% brown sugar though.- about a quarter stick of butter (don't use the fake stuff). You can double this if you prefer a heavier feel.- Milk (about 1-2 cups to taste, see directions below)Preparation:- Start with a pan (not a non-stick variety - I use a wok) and melt the butter. Use medium to medium-low heat. Don't do this on high heat as you may burn the butter.- Add the Malt-O-Meal to the pan after all the butter is melted and stir until the mix is a golden brown (it starts off brown, so your really looking for it to darken a touch). On medium, we're talking about maybe 1-2 minutes, on medium-low maybe 2-3 minutes. Make sure there are no clumps as they will remain in the final product.- Add milk to taste. My preferred method is to add milk until it covers the whole mixture and then add about another half cup. This would typically be 1.5-2 cup. You can go a bit less or more depending on how fluffy you want the final product (more milk = more fluffy).- Bring mix to boil while stirring. The mix will likely have started to thicken, so you may see air bubble breaking through.- Simmer on low to desired consistency. Remember to keep stirring.- Enjoy!We have tried this recipe with various cream of wheat blends and rice cereals, but always go back to Malt-O-Meal for the rich taste and texture. Don't worry it's plenty smooth, just filling. I'd love to hear if anyone has other ideas!

column9: Why use a brewer for instant coffee?
column10: This stuff is NASTY.  I don't even think it's particularly good instant.  Why would anyone spend all that money on a keurig coffee maker in order to make instant coffee at home?  You just need a kettle or a microwave.  And what a waste of space in your kitchen and landfill.  The worst part is that you don't know it's instant until you taste it, look carefully at the package, and see that it's "water soluble"-- code words for instant.  Open one up, and you'll see!

This is my favorite coffee out of the 18+ Kuerig cups that I've tried. It's smooth, and not too heavy or bitter.I think this product is priced above it's value, but it's as good as Starbucks for abut 1/3 the cost.

THIS HAS BEEN MY FAVORITE COFFEE SINCE DAY ONE OF HAVING MY KEURIG. YOU CAN'T MESS IT UP. EVERY CUP IS PERFECT.

This coffee is perfect for the morning. Not to strong but it gives you the perfect smooth jolt that we all crave in the AM..highly recommended.

I will admit that I like strong flavorful but not burnt tasting coffee. column9: This is our favorite k-cup coffee!
column10: We have tried many different types of K-cup coffee flavors and this is the one we keep coming back to.  Neither one of us cares for bitter, strong tasting coffee.  This has a mild, pleasant taste and it never varies from that. Definitely recommend!

column9: On the Light Side of Medium Blend Coffees.  Smooth with No Aftertaste.  Typical Breakfast Blend.

column9: Green mountain coffee for the Keurig, breakfast blend
column10: Love this coffee. I received it within 2 days and was very happy witheverything.I would recommend this brand and also Donut People coffee.

I had received a Keurig coffee maker for the holidays and have been hooked since. I am not a real strong coffee person so this morning blend is perfect. Consistant in flavor. I love this brand of k-cup! Just the right blend for me... not too strong, not too light... just right. Amazon gives you the best value when buying k-cups :)

My favorite to use in my Keurig. The Breakfast Blend is not too strong, but it isn't so weak that I can't taste the coffee after adding creamer. I do not like a dark roast, but I also don't like an incredibly weak roast. This blend is absolutely perfect for those who like a coffee that is just right. :)
Excellent taste, smooth, easy going.  I like a mild drink to start my day and this is it.  Heartily endorse this coffee.
I have tried other mild brews but this is the best by far it meets all of my requirements for this type of coffee.

I have usually ordered my K-Cups direct from Green Mountain, but thought I'd try Amazon's larger package and subscribe/save. This is a mild coffee which I really like.  I don't care for a really dark blend as it tends to be bitter, but this breakfast blend is quite good.  I have had a few other blends and I may change and get the columbia blend some time but the breakfast blend is not bitter and so far I like it the very best.  It has a pleasing taste and aroma.

Very dissapionted in this oder.Have had this coffee before from another source,but it wasn't avaliable at the time so I odered it thru ammazon.Not the same coffee.Very stale and weak.My hhusband and I both noticed it.Wish I had not order the 50 count but something smaller

I use all sorts of K-Cups, but this breakfast blend is definately my Go-To blend!! It is perfect - not too light, not too dark. I highly recommend this, as the price for the 50-count box is pretty good!!
Always brews great in my tall cup. Many other coffees tend to be too weak when you use the larger cup settings but not this one... Like I said... Yum!!

Having lots of problems with Green Mountain cups. Coffee is fine, but plastic seems heavier than other brands and does not fully drain into cup, but drips considerably when removing to dispose. Will probably choose other brands in the future instead. Have been using K-Cups for over a year and only have had problems with this brand.
The K-cups are great. This blend was just right. Have to have at least 1 cup  a day. Enjoyed it. The taste was just right. Will definetly buy again.
Good to purchase in a larger quantity! Ease for keeping supplies in stock! Easy to obtain from Amazon without a third party involved.  Got to use my free shipping - yea.

I love this coffee.  I'm a fan of lighter roasts.  I like the lack of bitterness and higher caffeine that comes with them.  This one is my favorite.  For most K-Cups, even lighter roasts, I have to run the machine twice through one K-Cup to get a decent, not overly-strong, cup of coffee.  These come out perfect for me with one run.  I do tend to go through them more quickly because of that, but that's okay. The great coffee is worth it!
Very pleased with this product. This is not the first time I have purchased Green Mountain Coffee and it wont be the last.

I switched to Green Mountain Breakfast Blend after not being able to get Black Tiger as a super saver item.  It was a real disappointment.  Very weak and certainly not something I would want as "breakfast blend"..

I knew there was something wrong when I opened the outer packaging from Amazon an it contained loose coffee grounds.  I found the Breakfast Blend box to be leaking the grounds. column9: Good Blend, but roast was too light.
column10: I like the taste, but the light roast was too light for me.  I find myself brewing smaller cups of coffee, hoping for a stronger taste.  Next time, I'll go for a medium or dark roast.  I think it was the medium that I had before and I really liked it.

My wife has drunk this coffee for several years.  She tried many different brands before settling on this k-cup. It is a mild great tasting brew that you will like if you like a typical donut shop coffee. Not a Starbucks brew, but a regular mild brew. Give it a try.
I love this product. No more measuring coffee in the morning.No more throwing old coffee out. Best Ideal ever.
I searched Google and found these k-cups. The price is reasonable.  Exceptionally fast delivery. I am very pleased and will order again.
Green Mountain Breakfast Blend is the best moderate blend for the Keurig Brewer.  Very good taste and not acidic.
Tried this blend as a change from routine, but did not find it as enjoyable as I had hoped, still, it was good, just not great.Pat

column9: Love Green Mountain Breakfast Blend -- Great Coffee!!!!!
column10: I just recently got my Keurig, and I've been trying the sample pack of coffee that came with it.  So far this is by far my favorite.  I nice mild coffee taste to enjoy in the morning or anytime.  I actually wish they made this coffee in a decaf version also so I could enjoy the great flavor of this one anytime!  I think this will be the main coffee in this house; I've tried some of the others and liked some of them more than others, but this is the runaway favorite.  I tend to put a good bit of cream and sugar in my coffee (can't stand it black!) but the nice flavor of this one comes through the cream and sugar.  (I've found that cream and sugar can't cover up the taste of coffee I don't like!)  I don't care for the bolder coffees at all (I don't feel like getting slapped in the face by my coffee in the morning!)I'd encourage everyone to give this a try if you like a light roast coffee with a mild, pleasant taste in the morning -- you won't be disappointed!!!
Green Mountain Coffee Keurig Breakfast Blend, 24-Count K-Cups (Pack of 2)WE LOVE THE BREAKFAST BLEND- WE'VE TRIED MOST OF THEM,THIS ONE IS IT FOR US.

column9: I've been buying these regularly for months now.

best coffee from green mountain so far i recomend this to anyone who loves coffee great taste and good price make this a great buy

I just received a new Keurig and have tried a couple of different K-Cup varieties. I just have to say that for a smooth cup of plain deliciousness this is one of my top picks!
didn't get ,quite the taste i wanted,brought thru amazon. but overall will still keep using this product,until it runs out.

I love the taste of the Breakfast Blend K-Cup coffee. You can't find a better dealanywhere else. keep up the great work

column9: Not the best, but CERTAINLY, not the worst!

It's just entirely more smooth, no bitterness at all, and just a very enjoyable cup of coffee. Try it to see if it suits your taste but get the 12-pack first.  Otherwise, if you think the way I do, 24 of these guys is a LOT of coffee to wash down!

When I bought my coffeemaker, tried out several different brands and types of coffee but this one has become a stable.  I can count on it for a great cup of coffee - not too strong or too mild, just the way I like it.  Unfortuantely, I now drink more coffee than I probably should because of the taste but that's the only downside.

I have enjoyed this brand of coffee for several years now and it has been consistent in flavor!  I was happy to see that it came in a 50-count box....with cold weather approaching, I will be drinking a LOT more coffee.
If you love your Keurig coffee brewer, you'll love this buy for Green Mountain 50-count Breakfast Blend Coffee K-Cups. GREAT!!!
Love green mountain coffee, but the breakfast blend was not strong or bold enough for me, will try stronger and bolder ones and get back to you all with another review, thanks

i drink nothing but green mountain k-cups,nothing can even come close to the taste.Everyone should a least try it once.

I love this coffee it's my favorite so far I want to try them all. I don't like strong coffee and I hate bitter after taste coffee to me this is the perfect cup  of coffee. I'm not telling everyone to go out and buy it this is my own opinion.
this was a great product at a great price, i would recommend it to everyone that uses the kcups. its a great product
I love this green mountIn coffee it is so good my whole family drinks it, doesn't compare to other coffees, it is just right not too strong, I also buy the decaf brand.

This is a great tasting coffee. Not only good first thing in the morning, but anytime. Very smooth. Green Mountain puts out great tasting coffee on all flavors and blends

Thiscuit has long since been a leader in having a wide variety of crackers. This one, as well, is among their best. It can be used alone or with spread's, cheese among other topping's. I highly recommend this biscuit above most others.

If you want to enjoy these nasty jelly beans they are as described. All gross flavors are gross!! I play a simple game with them and its great to see peoples reactions. I get 4 or so people together. column9: They mean what they say..."Dare to compare!"
column10: "You want to be careful with those. When they say every flavor, they mean every flavor!" So says Ronald Weasley to Harry Potter. well got these from amazon today and with the exception of rotten egg/buttered popcorn i could tell every flavor apart-the good from the bad!FTW

I was so glad to find this product, my daughter loves it. I assumed that for the price it was a multi pack. Shame on me. This was a ridiculous price for this product. Never again will I be fooled like this.

column9: Thicker, mild banana flavor instant oatmeal
column10: Since watching my cholesterol, I have been using Quaker's instant oatmeal Fruit & Cream variety, which only has two packets of the Banana flavor in it.  Since that one is my favorite flavor (it's made with dehydrated banana flakes), I have been searching around for a box with more of the banana oatmeal packets in it.  I have seen the Quaker instant oatmeal Heart Healthy series in stores, but never this Banana Bread variety, so I purchased this one box (rather expensively) from Amazon. You do get a larger portion (it fills up about half a 9 oz. hot cup, as opposed to about a third with the other), and even with repeated dabs of hot water to loosen it up, the product remains a thick consistency that you can stand a plastic spoon up in.  The banana flavor is very faint, to me it has more of a maple syrup flavor, and the ingredients only say "natural and artificial flavor," nothing about dehydrated banana flakes.  I think this Banana Bread type is made to go with cut-up banana slices to accompany it, to boost its flavor - personally, I am going back to my original Fruit & Cream box, and be satisfied with a lesser but better, more natural banana instant oatmeal product.

We've loved the John Wm. Macy Cheddar CheeseSticks and didn't know how they could be improved upon. But John Wm. Macy did improve them. These Cheddar CheeseCrisps are the same wonderful flavor with an improved shape. These Crisps are cut into squares rather than long sticks and are easier to get out of the package, eat, and use with other foods. We noticed there was always some breakage in the packages of sticks and these crisps solved that problem. You must try these unbelievably delicious treats.

column9: Always enjoyed but got a bad case.
column10: Over the past 2 years I've ordered 10 cases of these wonderful cheese crisps but my lastorder was NOT the same. Every box in the case tasted the same, NO flavor. I E-mailed thecustomer service department at John WM Macy's and got no response. I took a chance andordered a second case and it was the same. I'm very disappointed. When you find a productyou like so much you tend to count on the same taste, my guess is the cheese isn't the same.I don't blame Amazon for this, it's the Company that isn't living up to the standards it should.I was always willing to pay the price but now it's not worth it. If I ever hear back I'll fill you inbut so far after 3 E-mails to Macy's NOTHING. Before I gave them 5 stars, not now.

column9: Can be purchased for less elsewhere
column10: We purchased this product, which is quite delicious, at COSTCO for the price of $7.99 for a resealable 22-0z bag with an expiration date of six months from date of purchase. This equals a cost of about .36 per ounce vs. a cost of about .57 per ounce through Amazon, a price differential of 58%. With COSTCO, of course, you don't know for sure if an item you purchase will be there the next time you visit.

Someone brought these to a potluck lunch at work, and if I knew who it was I would thank them personally.  These Cheese Crisps are unlike other snack products, and unlike my expectations (that is to say they exceeded my expectations considerably).  What you will find in this package is not a cracker although it has a cracker-like shape.  It is DEFINITELY not just another poofy, greasy, "cheese flavored corn curl" product although that may be what comes to mind if you only glance at the box.  John Wm. Macy CheeseCrisps are robustly flavored and firmly crunchy, with a high level of quality that is evident from the first taste.  I invariably consume the entire box in one sitting.  If it is open , it is gone! Dear family of mine, be there when the box opens or lose out.

These cheese crackers are the BEST!!! I love cheddar and Asiago, so these crackers are a perfect match. The taste of asiago and cheddar are the right amount, not too subtle, not too strong. There is also a hint of pepper in the taste. The chips are crispy. I first tried in when it was sold on Costco (cheaper, but in much bigger bag, 22 oz) but they don't have it in stock all the time. I was craving for it already and Costco didn't have it so I searched online, and amazon has the best online price. Better than the John Macy's online store itself. The package came quickly,  and so far I think I finished 3 boxes and they are all the same great taste. If you like cheese, you'll most likely love this one. You can really taste the cheese in each and every single chip, unlike other chips that claim to be cheesy but you can't really taste the cheese at all. This is perfect. The picture in the box showed the chips in perfect square shapes, the inside, though, are not all like that. I mean some of them are broken chips, which is fine if just eat it by itself, but if you are using it as a base for some oeur d'oeuvres or something you should realize that some of the chips are broken into smaller pieces.

As far as natural snack foods and texture, it's pretty good. I like the crisp and the combination of flavors. My only complaint is the cheddar taste isn't as powerful as advertised. I would like a more deep and powerful cheddar cracker but these are good.

column9: John Macy's Cheese Crisps Do Not Ship Well
column10: The first case of crisps were excellent but the last two cases contained over 3/4 broken pieces and less than 1/4 whole crisps.  The taste and the texture was outstanding but since the crisps were so broken they were only good for sprinkling on a salad or for topping a baked savory dish.

column9: John wm. Macy's cheddar and asiago cheese crisps
column10: I have enjoyed these cheese crisps for a few years, but they are becoming harder to find.  COSTCO use to sell them by a big bag, but no longer carry them.  I have taken many of these boxes to cocktail parties and everybody loves them, but again have trouble finding them.  They are the BEST!

column9: We love these things! They are delicious!
column10: We love these little bite size crackers. Great nibblers. Crunchy and cheesy goodness. Please don't make them hard to find. :)
Know the delicious cheese crackers....great deal...but inside practically every box were little crackers pieces...can't use them for appetizers...what happened in the factory or shipping?

I remember back when the only flavor you could get your hands on were the cheddar twists and they were absolutely delicious and completely addictive.When they came out with these crisps I thought it was a stroke of genius.  They are the perfect size for snacks at a casual gathering with friends, pairing beautifully with fresh fruit and wine, the tang of the cheese and the kick of heat at the back of your throat the perfect counterpoint to the sweetness of grapes, apples and pears.When having a more elegant gathering I'll put out black olive tapenade or a quick relish made with finely diced English cucumber, green onion, a touch of sundried tomatoes and marinated artichoke hearts.  They disappear off the trays and because of their sturdiness they hold up pretty well to having a dollup of something on top.These also offer a delicious alternative to croutons when served with a salad because of the complex flavors that you can get.The one thing that I will warn folks about is that these crackers are crunchier than your traditional crackers, not as dense as biscotti but it gives you about the same crunch when you chew, but the beauty of these crackers is that the more you chew the more flavorful they become, and they really pair beautifully with adult beverages of every sort.Give these a try as an alternative to chips and you'll find they can be more addictive than chips and they're healthier for you!

John Wm. Macy's Cheddar & Asiago CheeseCrisps, 4.5-Ounce Boxes  Pack of 12)  These are habit forming and really good with a glass of wine or most anything else.  They are hard to find in most stores and in my area impossible to find.  Costco had them once and evidently discontinued them.
These are my absolute favorite cracker.  I've ordered these several times and always recieve my shippment promply and have always recieved fresh crisp crackers.

column9: Initial taste is very good, then a little of a chemical after taste
column10: I was sad not to see a direct contact method on the package and like others on here did not hear back after 2 emails to the company with regard to my problem.

I have ordered this twice, now.  I used to like "Cheese Nips" but these are SO much better! Not as salty and the most satisfying crunch. This is a great snack as well as a great companion to soups and salads. Made with real cheese and baked to perfection... I have tried most of the other flavors, but this one is my favorite.
After trying the Gruyeres and sesame.  This is so far the best flavor.  However, Costco starts selling it.  Better price.

Errr....crackery.  These are the best cheesesticks I've ever found.  I order cases to eat all by myself.  Yes, I do.  If my partner asks nicely, I may give her a piece.  The rest are for me.  Comparing these to the Trader Joe's cheese sticks are like comparing sparkling wine to dust.  Or something like that.
These cheese crisps are great.  We eat them plain and crumbled over soups and salads.

I first purchased the John Wm. Macy's Cheddar & Asiago Cheese Crisps at my local grocery store in the deli area.  They were a little pricey which caused me to almost bi-pass them.  The first bite made me want more and more.  They are so crisp and extremely flavorful.  They are awesome with a dip, hummas and better yet - just plain.  I really hate to cover up the flavor of the crisp itself.  I located these at Amazon and OH MY - what a savings of $1.75 A BOX so I ordered a case of 12 boxes.  If you love cheese as much as I do you will definitely keep these on hand always!!
I have purchased these crackers in the supermarket for twice the price.  these were very fresh and arrived in 4 days.  very good buy

We first tried this in Rome Italy about three weeks ago, and were hoping to find some in the US.  Our last jar ran out last night, and there it was on Amazon this morning.  It is addicting.  And now our entire family is hooked.  It is so choice. If you have the means, I highly recommend picking one up.
My two papillons absolutely love Instinct dry dog food.  Grain free and high in protein and all natural ingredients.  How can you go wrong?I rotate my dogs among the different varieties.
My dog loves this dog food. Sometimes she is picky, but she eats Instinct Chicken every time, every day. Finally a dog food she doesn't walk away from!

I recently tried this tenderizer/seasoner when I saw it at a discount store here and found it excellent.  It's the same big 27 oz bottle you get for a very reasonable price here on Amazon, and it is well worth it for the taste, and its tenderizing ingredients.  When it comes to tenderizers I have never really found all that much difference in how they work as to actually softening the meat. Even the cheapest brands I have picked up seem to break down the sinew in meat that binds it together, and thus has it cooking up a little tough at times.  What sets this Bolners brand apart is its taste beyond its performance as a tenderizer.  Just a lick of it on your finger will tell you it adds a delicious touch to steak or any other meat you favor.  I love it and use it all the time now and will be ordering more of it from Amazon when I am done with this bottle.  Really delicious seasoning and tenderizer that I highly recommend.
I sent this to 2 children under 9 that had just lost their father. It was a great pick me up for the kids.
This was the best gift I could have gotten for the two children, both under 9 years old, who just lost their father.

I purchased these cakes and found them to be very dry and the filling was practically non-existent.  The picture on the website shows the filling to be oozing out of the cake.  I had to cut the cake in half to even find a pinch of filling.  Very deceptive advertising.Lex

This is a cute product to use in place of sprinkles - the bright colors of candy coating look great, and the chocolate center keeps them from being overly sweet.However this price is roughly double what you pay at Michael's (or Marshall's, when they stock stuff like this). Plus you can get the same product but in a 16 oz bag on Amazon here: http://www.amazon.com/CK-Products-Rainbow-Candy-Coated/dp/B00375LAO0/ref=sr_1_1?ie=UTF8&s=home-garden&qid=1300131716&sr=1-1. Comes with Prime shipping too!
Tossed this out after trying it.  Texture and taste were far below expectations.  Seemed kind of mushy and pasty.  Pricy to boot.
I actually gave these to a local baker for my daughters cupcakes. They looked great. Showed up perfectly on white and chocolate icing. In great shape.

I'm from NY and my family and I loved all the Drakes products,including Devil Dogs,growing up in the 60s and 70s.I moved to Wisconsin in the early 80s and they don't have Drakes products in this state.I've waited over 25yrs to eat Drakes cakes again and I finally found them at Amazon.They're just as great as ever so get some right away.Those substitutes just don't compare!

product came within set time and was wonderfully fresh and brought back many memories. We haven't tasted these since we left new york many many years ago. Several years ago we found them in a walmart in southern nevada but haven't found them in years. why aren't they available in Southern nevada anymore as there are many new york transplants here?

Very happy to have found these as they are my husbands favorite...but purchase to give as a gift...they expired so soon after arrival they were not good for long after they were given.  The result was to freeze them, then they were forgotten. Will not order again. Oh well.

Recieved these treats for my cats from a friend.  My cats loved them!  A few of my cats have food allergies, and I am very happy with these snacks as they are simply dried herring without any further additives.  I"m off to get more!

My cat loves these herring steaks. They are one of his favorite treats, and some of the only treats he can eat. He has digestive problems and can't eat grains. These treats are nothing but dried fish, and so are perfect for him.

If you were a fan of South Beach Living Protein Fit bars and are having trouble finding them, look no further. These are the exact same product relabeled under the Snack Well's name. Same size, nutritional information, taste, etc.For a complete comparison with photos, check out this blog:[...]

This is not the most healthy choice in terms of ingredients, but I do notice that it has lower Saturated fat and sodium than the South Beach bars so that's also a plus!  Same great taste and everything, as well!
Of all of the snack bars that I've tried, this is by far the best as far as taste for the amount of calories and the 8 grms of protein help you feel full.

column9: love them! But rather expensive here...
column10: I can buy them for substantially less a box at the nearby grocery store. Good flavor, nice protein hit, no weird aftertase. Nice with coffee.
Delicious peanut buttery rich taste in a filling treat (and only 140 cal!).  Tons of protein leaves me full from 3 pm to dinner!  and Yummy!

"Phenomenal is how I describe those lemon bars." My 26 year old son actually took a moment to email me that sentiment after he ate one. The rest of the family agreed. I have made a lot of lemon bars from scratch that were always good and eaten many others on dessert tables but these were so much better. Here's why: The crust is a very good balance of its ingredient and doesn't fall apart under the absolutely luscious, creamy, tart lemon custard that's on the top. They also looked very nice when they were dusted with the powder sugar topping that came in the box. You'll get three packets in the box: one for the crust that you combine with your own butter, one for the lemon filling that you'll combine with your own eggs and 3 lemons, and a generous amount of powdered sugar to sprinkle on the top. (I only used about half of the amount provided.) The directions are very clear and helpful, also. Be very careful to follow her blending speed recommendations and total times for mixing as you combine ingredients.I'll admit I was a little worried when I first took them out of the oven because they looked so different than when I had made them from scratch in the past. The toothpick test in the center made me even more nervous when it came out a little wet but if you follow the directions of letting them completely cool, they will not disappoint you! I'll never make them from scratch again and will probably be less enthusiastic about any other lemon bars I encounter in the future if they aren't made from Ina's mix. These are THAT GOOD!!!

I am normally a very big fan of the Barefoot Contessa Pantry mixes. I have tried a few (like the blondie mix and the chocolate muffins) and they have always turned out really well. However, I am sad to say that these Lemon Bars were a dismal failure. First of all the crust calls for almost 2 sticks of butter, which I was willing to try, but the taste of the crust was gross, as if you were eating a bar of butter, not at all like the advertised shortbread taste. Also, the filling was way too sweet and did not set properly, it was runny to the point that I could not even cut the bars, they just turned into an icky sticky mess. I had to throw the whole pan out, it was such a waste, considering that the mix was expensive and after 2 bars of butter and 5 eggs, I wasted good ingredients. I would have made do if the taste was passable, but I don't think anyone could eat them. Ugh. I am giving it 1 star as I am willing to take a hit on my baking skills, though honestly, I have been making baked goods since my teens and I have never had anything turn out as badly as this mix did. These are certainly not your grandma's Lemon Bars. I'll have to find a Lemon Bar recipe to make from scratch because this mix just doesn't cut it.

I started by buying the Presto 03510 FlipSide Belgian Waffle Maker here on Amazon. We experimented with the Presto and Epicurious recipes and cooking times. Three keys with the Presto:1) Use cooking spray on the griddles, not butter or oil, which cause mottling. [EDIT- now that my Presto is "seasoned" a bit, I don't wash it more than necessary and I often skip the cooking spray altogether]2) Ideal cooking time is 3:15. I don't see why others complained about the timer feature.3) Don't try to be healthy and use egg whites or substitutes...it doesn't work as well.What DOES work is this Carbon's Malted. I think what's sold here is the same as they sell at a fancy cooking store known as W-S. We've been trying to find a malted recipe like you find in hotels and restaurants. With some Googling, you might find ideas about going to home brewing stores to source liquid malt. Well, consider the value of your time and just get this. Add butter, water and eggs, cook for 3 minutes 15 seconds and enjoy.Don't forget- splurge on real maple syrup...life is short and how often do you have great waffles?
The Golden Malted Original Flour makes delicious waffles.  Great taste -much tastier than Bisquik - and just as easy to mix up a batch of batter.
This is the best pancake mix I have ever used. And my Great Granddaughters agree. Everyday I keep them , they want pancakes or waffles
This is the best waffle mix I have ever purchased. Easy to make. I have a professional waffle maker and this batter makes all the difference. Just like eating out.

column9: Light, crispy and easy.  Perfect combination!
column10: I don't buy mixes for anything.  Combining flour, baking powder and a few other things is not difficult and is easier than having various cake, pancake, etc. boxes filling the cupboards.  I bought my first Belgian waffle maker (the Waring Pro - excellent, by the way Waring Pro WMK300 Belgian Waffle Maker, Brushed Stainless) and made my first batch of waffles.It took 1 ½ hours.  I needed to let the yeast rise, mix everything just right, wait and wait and wait...  The waffles were very good, but they were not something I would have made on other than special occasions.I tried another recipe.  A little faster, but it still took an hour.I read the reviews for this mix and tried to find a recipe I could make from scratch that would replicate the mix.  The ones that looked like they would be close weren't any faster than the recipes I had already tried.Then I gave up and bought this mix.  I am really glad I did.  It is very quick and almost foolproof.  I had an 8 year old making them this morning.  Stir the mix with an egg and some water, add a little melted butter, and you are ready to go.  Pour it into the waffle iron (I use setting #5) and in just a few minutes serve crisp, very light waffles.  Easy and tastes great.  Waffles are now a common breakfast around our house.
I am addicted to this mix...its the only one i ever use and for both waffles and pancakes, i always use milk...never water! Tastiest pancakes/waffles ever!

column9: YUM, YUM AND YUM, MAKE PLENTY
column10: They are light and fluffy.  You have to control yourself.  I ate 2 and wanted more all sense of calories and control disapeared.  Hide the can, you guest will be impressed and want receipe.

column9: Hubby loves the smell and flavor of this mix's waffles
column10: I'm a super lazy cook, and so I don't feel like making mixes from scratch. (I tried, and it didn't taste as good as this, anyhow.)  Although another reviewer complained about the vanilla "fakey" smell, we love it. I love how the house smells when I make these (or when we reheat frozen ones I make from this mix.)I like the flavor, even if it's kinda bland (other reviewers touched on this). The texture is nice. It freezes great for reheating through the week, so I make one big batch that covers several breakfasts for me and hubby.This is a solid, good product, and I've ordered it more than once from amazon. Note that it will be good for about a year, so if you don't think you'll go through all these cans in that time, you may want to skip the amazon purchase and get one or two at a time. I find that three cans takes me fine through a year, as we don't eat waffles every day/week, and I don't use this for pancakes, as we like Heidi's Grainy Day for that. (Also available here at amazon).Thumbs up.

For ease of preparation, for wonderful flavor, for great texture, this is the best mix I ever used.  I normally never, ever use mixes because I'm such a purist:) I order the six-pack so I can give some as gifts!  I do add just a teaspoon of real vanilla and it makes it a little more exciting!  But, I'm just being fussy...this is the real deal and the price is great!

This mix makes nice crispy waffles but the flavor was surprisingly bland.  Next time I make them I'll throw in a tablespoon or two of sugar and see if that helps.  I was hoping for a mix comparable to Bellegem and this is not that mix. If you're looking for waffles with amazing flavor, you should pass this one up and try Bellegem instead.
Excellent mix for Belgian Waffles.  We have tried many recipes but none were as good or as easy as this mix.  Definately worth trying.
This mix is just the best!  Waffles are crisp and light and super yummy.
Yummy.  If you love waffles, you must use this waffle mix.  It's the most tasteful you'll ever try.
My wife uses this in our waffle maker, and it makes perfect waffles every time (see KitchenAid KPWB100NP Pro Line Waffle Baker, Nickel Pearl).

Used with a waffles, this mix is very good.  Testing with the Kitchenaid Pro Line Waffle Maker, waffles came out very light, crispy and with a very soft and moist interior.  During cooking, the house smelled amazing.I also tested with a Betty Crocker scratch recipe.  The waffles came out a bit heavier, but still crispy and moist.  The flavor may have been slightly better using Betty Crocker's recipe, but the texture could not compare to that of the Carbon's mix.While I don't think this mix is necessary to make outstanding waffles, it is very good with an unbeatable texture.

I have used it over the last year and find that it is great.  One 16oz. container makes about 5 waffles.  I had to tweek the label recipe by adding water as theirs came out thick.  The waffles are consistently good.  We have used the waffles with syrup, ice cream and fried chicken, all tasting great. If writing this uplifting review gets me a dozen complimentary cans they will be gladly accepted.

First the good about the product; it comes with all the stuff in the flour, so all you have to add is water, egg, and melted butter.  It is very quick to fix; less than two minutes if you have your act together.  I have made both the pancakes and the waffles (the recipe is slightly different for each one), and I tried variations. I tried milk in place of the water, it wasn't much better (but it wasn't worse).  The thing I found that improved the waffles and pancakes was using BUTTERMILK!  That made the taste much better.  If you try the product, do try the buttermilk substitution for the water; leave the egg and butter amounts the same.  As for the bad, there isn't any, sorry to disappoint those of you expecting me to say negative things about the product.  I guess  my only negative thing is it is not the cheapest product in the world for pancakes/waffles.  (But you often get what you pay for!)

I'm a newbie when it comes to homemade waffles. I purchased a belgian waffle maker through Amazon and was looking for a good recipe for the waffles. When reading the reviews of the waffle maker, so many mentioned this waffle mix that I figured I would give it a try instead of making my own. I'm so glad I did! I used the tip of adding milk instead of water and followed the rest of the directions exactly. From start to finish this morning, I was enjoying fresh waffles in 5 minutes. The taste was restaurant quality and it was easier than I imagined.

We had JV football players overs to spend the night with our football playing son. When they got up they fixed pancakes. And for the next 3 hours they made and ate pancakes. Three cans and 8 boys and nothing left.

This is absolutly the best waffle mix, and at the best price I've found any where.I use a flip over type belgian waffle maker and these are consistantly light and crispy. Having had great waffles at several different resturants and resorts, whenever I asked what they used for a mix, I  was told Golden Malted. Get a double order when Amazon offers free shiping on orders over $25, and split it with your friends.
Easy to use, tastes good, no sticking, what more could you ask for in a waffle mix.

This is a perfect mix.  A lot of butter needs to be used and cutting back will affect the outcome, so it's a calorie splurge.  With the proper setting, crispy outside, soft inside.  Great flavor without that overpowering flour taste.  Great price as well.
Best waffles I've ever eaten. Just a few minutes to prepare and a few to cook. I recommend a flip type iron for cooking.

If you want "real" Belgian waffles, this is the real deal.  Crisp outside, lighter than air yet still moist inside.  Who knew that a little malt can make the difference between ordinary and extraordinary!  Easy to mix, easy to pour, easy to want to make waffles everyday!Golden Malted Pancake & Waffle Flour, Original, 16-Ounce Cans (Pack of 6)  I wish I had bought more.  Try it with the Presto Waffle Maker. Presto FlipSide Electric Waffle Maker

My husband ordered this after reading all the good reviews it had. He was tired of the bland flavor of Bisquick waffles. These had a sweet flavor and came out very light and fluffy. I only wish we could find it locally. I hope this helps=)

column9: THIS is the waffle mix you have been looking for!
column10: You know those absolutely wonderful Belgian waffles you make yourself at motels or hotels that are too small to have a full-on kitchen to make breakfast for their guests, but are too classy to serve just coffee? You pour a cup  of waffle batter in the waffle maker, rotate the handle, wait for the beeps, and then lift out the yummiest waffles you've ever had. I wondered for years where to get the recipe for the batter, and finally found an award-winning Executive Chef who ratted Carbon's out. This is THE stuff! Easy to make, easy to run out of! Simply delicious! Will fill your kitchen with a wonderful aroma!Amazon's price is the lowest I've found. Would make a heckuva wedding present if somebody else is giving a Belgian waffle maker!

I've always been a "pancake person." Waffles just weren't my thing, but whenever we'd go back to visit my wife's family in Fort Wayne we always had to have breakfast at "Richard's" for the waffles. I guess you could say that waffles are in my wife's DNA.Two or three years back Richard's wasn't the same and it was my husbandly duty to satisfy my wife's waffle jones. We bought an inexpensive waffle maker and proceeded to try almost every waffle recipe available on the world wide web, but to no avail. Then we discovered Carbon's. Okay, the waffles still weren't nearly as good as they once were at Richard's, but they were much better than any others that we tried.We eventually purchased a terrific waffle maker (a Waring WMK-300, a birthday gift from my wife) and we now have unbelievable Carbon's waffles. Yes, better then Richard's EVER were, and yes, I've become a "waffle person."We have waffles about twice a week and this small-can six-pack lasts about three months. Highly recommended!!!

I was disappointed with the artificial vanilla smell from this product.  Artificial vanilla produces an overly sweet smell that reminds me of the funnel cakes you buy at carnivals.  Real vanilla cannot be duplicated (at least as of now).  Otherwise, it is acceptable and convenient.
This is THE best pancake and waffle mix on the planet. Easy to use & a crowd pleaser.

Great mix for the belgium waffle maker that I bought from Amazon.  I make one for my son in the a.m. and save the remainder of the batter in the refrigerator for the next a.m.  The recipe is quick and very yummy!

I am not a waffle fan, but have been impressed with  the belgian waffles I made in several motels' breakfast rooms. I tried to duplicate them using grocery store batter mixes and mixed several  by recipes in gourmet magazines. All  were mediocre at best.  I saw a  Golden Malted add in one of the travel kitchens; I saw it, contacted the factory by internet and voila! I am now a Belgian waffle fan.  It's good stuff. Haven't made pancakes with it  yet, but I will.

We were first intoduced to Carbon's Golden Malted Pancake & Waffle Flour at Treebone's Resort in Big Sur, CA. We wanted to duplicate that great breakfast experience at home so bought a wafflemaker and began ordering the Carbon's Golden Malted Pancake & Waffle Flour. The flavor and texture is always consistent and delicious and the texture is light. We have been using this product for at least six years to make pancakes & waffles for breakfst, lunch, dinner & dessert. We also enjoy the blueberry & organic apple cinnamon flavors.

I bought this because I had some at a hotel and thought they were yummy.  I have made these by the directions on the can, and have found them well....not soo good.  They just don't taste the same as the hotel ones do, and they frankly are really just not that good.  I has signed up for recurring deliveries of them, but I will cancel that soon, and will give away the remaining 5 cans I bought.  The best kind I have ever made or found thusfar has been Maple Grove Farms waffle mix, but the local store I used to get them at no longer carries them.  I am still hunting for good waffle mix, and just haven't found it in this product.Erik

Definitely the best! You don't really need the butter in the recipe (I put tons of butter on top).  We have been using it since we stayed at LaQuinta in CO (2010).  We have the Oster belgian waffle maker (flip), and they are amazing waffles. We ate waffles every weekend for a long time they were so good!  Can't go wrong here.
I just got this stuff, but after one batch I'm hooked. It's easy, it's tasty, it works. I admit I doubled the butter but I can't say it was necessary.
Bought this product on a friends recommendation and it was worth it. I took the mix on my family vacation and we enjoyed the perfect combination of morning waffles and family. Thank you and Aloha!

My husban and I frequent hotels that use Golden Malt at their breakfast buffets.  We found it on Amazon, purchased it and it IS the best waffle mix ever. Anyone who uses a waffle maker or just for pancakes, should buy this!!!

After reading the reviews of the product, I eagerly ordered it to make waffles in my new waffle maker. The scent of the waffles cooking is heavenly, but I was very disappointed by the flavor. They were very bland, not at all what I expected from the smell that filled the kitchen. Even with some butter and syrup I thought they were bland. Definitely a disapointment based on the other reviews. I ended up finding a quick recipe online that was much better. I won't be using the rest of the mix.

We had waffles made with this mix in a hotel and they were great, so we decided to get some for home use.  On a whim I substituted coconut oil for the 2 Tbs. butter called for in the recipe, and wow, was it ever good.  The coconut flavor compliments the vanilla and malt flavors well, and reminds me of Shipley's Donuts, which are fried in a coconut oil blend.

This is the best ever.  I have used it in 2 different waffle makers and had outstanding waffles.  the aroma of it baking is heavenly and tastes just as good.  Can't imagine how I ever lived without it and will never make another waffle without it!!

This is our second bulk purchase of the Malted Waffle mix.  It makes excellent, malt flavored waffles.  If you happen to like the flavor of malt (as in malted milk), you'll love this product.  We love the waffles.

column9: Great price...Great taste...better than pancake mix for belgian's
column10: The title says it all.  Six-pack was on manaager's special so got the smaller cans but go through the larger cans quickly enough.

Best waffle mix I've had, leagues better than any supermarket brand, and even better than some "from-scratch" mixes I have tried at home.FYI, this mix is either the exact one or extremely similar to the one they use for breakfast at the Hampton Inn hotel chain.It yields sweet, fluffy (yet crisp on the outside, depending on your iron settings and timing) waffles that are best enjoyed with even more butter on top! If you're looking for health food, look elsewhere :)I definitely will be buying this again. And again and again!

The malt in the mix makes this the very best waffle mix I have ever purchased or tasted.
