I was worried that my cat wouldn't accept this food but she LOVES it. She is eating less and her litter box isn't as bad as it used to be. This food is great and quite reasonable considering the quality ingredients and the fact they eat less of it.
the popcorn is awsome! very flavorful and fun! It is something that everyone in the family can enjoy and would be a great gift for all of your friends and family.
This stuff is truly delicious-- I wish it were more widely distributed at local supermarkets. I can't find it around my city. Hard to understand why it is not extremely popular. Very tasty.

I can eat any pizza. Putting pineapple/ham on it makes it a bit sweeter and better. This pizza is great food! Buy this product! It's really good! Don't like it? Eat a bunch of fast food like fat people do.

Bought these for Passover since two family members are gluten intolerant. Turns out everyone thought these were better than the regular and all the gluten free ones disappeared leaving the regular type untouched. The supermarkets are sold out. I'm glad to find them here on Amazon as we want these year round. These are the best gluten free crackers we've ever tried. The toasted onion crackers are especially wonderful.

This is the best tasting matzoh I've had, especially the onion version.  No way to tell its gluten free other than it crumbles slightly more easily.  I currently eat it year round and take it when I travel (in a hard rubbermaid case) just to be sure I have gluten-free alternative when faced with buffets filled with buns & cakes.Only issue:  VERY expensive when ordered on line.  Cheaper in stores, when they have it.

column9: Gluten Free Yehuda Toasted Onion Matzo's
column10: These Gluten Free Yehuda Onion Matzohs are outragious. The taste is unbelievable and very addicting.  Everyone who tries it, loves them.

This matzah was gobbled up by everyone at both seders. We bought four boxes and wish we had bought a case since we can't find it anywhere for the rest of pesach!  The packaging does not do justice to the taste.  We were all turned off by the toasted onion picture and thought it would be spicy.  It is the BEST matzah I have ever tasted.  Hands down.

I love loose tea and for the most part, I've always gotten Adagio loose green, oolong, and white teas.  They are all very good.  A lot of green tea can have a bitter taste (particularly if it is steeped to long) or taste kind of grassy, both of which can be good depending on your taste.This Green Snail Spring Green tea is neither bitter, nor very grassy, it just has a nice smooth mellow green tea taste.  It's not bitter at all and has just the slightest grassy taste to it.It comes in a cool package but you need to be really careful when you open it or you will lose half of it on the floor.  The inside part of the aluminum container does not go all the way up inside the container but the tea inside it does.  If you open it up by simply taking the top off you've got tea all over your feet all of a sudden.If you like a nice mellow green tea, give this a try but be careful when you open the container!

Update to original review. I have had the candy for a while now. I have to say I am pleased with the flavor, but fall back to the original feeling that the price with shipping was much too high and I will not be purchasing any more in the future.I will update this review when the candy actually arrives. The low review is for the shipping cost, which was a jolt to me. The cost of the candy was $6.50, but the cost of the shipping was $8.00!! This brings the price up to over $14 per pound! I am hoping these are amazing candies so I can improve my review, but at this point I am not sure if I would have purchased them knowing the true cost. Still, it is an item I was looking for for a considerable time.

beware! pictured is a package of pipes.. that's not what you get. i was looking for a small corn cob and thought i was buying what is pictured: a set of small corn cobs.  i got one big one that i have no use for.  sigh..

column9: Fantastic Green Tea, the Best of Tazo
column10: *****Tazo's China Green Tips Green Tea is a slightly stronger green tea than Tazo's Zen, and I liked that it doesn't contain Tazo's omnipresent "natural flavors" that almost all of their other teas contain, which to me is not an advantage. I like a natural, real taste with real ingredients sans vague "natural flavors" and sans flavorings, sans essences, etc. China Green Tips delivers this in a cleaner, purer way than Tazo's other teas. I liked this green tea!The ingredients in China Green Tips are simply spring-harvested green teas from China. It contains caffeine.Tazo is an interesting company that makes only super premium teas. They are socially responsible, based in Portland, and have the motto, "The Reincarnation of Tea". Tazo is owned by Starbucks. Their web site is fun and quirky, with a Zen-type focus, definitely worth checking out. It is unclear, though, from their web site, how many of their ingredients are organic or kosher, and they do use some "natural flavors" in their teas--this wording seems a little vague and unnecessary for a super premium tea. China Green Tips has none of these "natural flavors" and it shows in the quality and cleanliness of the tea experience.On the paper tea packet, Tazo writes, "a traditional Chinese green tea with a delicate fresh taste and a light green liquor." This is the perfect way to describe this tea! On their web site, Tazo describes the flavor profile of China Green Tips as "grassy, vegetative, sweet, ricey". Tazo describes the aroma as "vegetative, popcorn".I would rate this tea, and Tazo in general, as very good---better than premium teas like Stash or Celestial Seasonings---but not as good as Numi or Aspen. Still, this tea is excellent, so I'm breaking my tradition with Tazo teas and giving it five stars. If you enjoy super premium teas, and are stuck with Tazo for some reason, choose China Green Tips and you will be quite satisfied. I can't honestly say that about any other Tazo tea.*****

column9: Tazo China Green Tips Green Tea
column10: I have been drinking this tea for about a year, on and off. It is the best green tea that I have tasted. I brew it overnight at room temperature, and I find that it has a full, smooth, and mild flavor.Another writer stated that the fluoride levels associated with this tea are 8 mg/L - that is, indeed, pretty high. Unfortunately, the writer did not quote a source or describe how the levels were measured, so we don't know how realistic this number is, and how it relates to the number of cups consumed. Unfortunately, too, it seems that many other sites have picked up all these Amazon reviews verbatim, and copied them to their own sites, so this information is spread across the net. I have heard (from other sources) of Chinese product fluoride levels and would like to know the truth - in real numbers - about the fluoride levels in China Green Tips tea. So I contacted Starbucks. They replied..."Thank you for contacting Starbucks Coffee Company. Unfortunately, the information you are requesting is proprietary information, which we are unable to divulge. I apologize for any inconvenience this may cause." One wonders if by "proprietary," do they mean that the fluoride levels are part of the "secret" ingredients from which they make China Green Tips tea (and here I was thinking that the tea was, well, you know, tea leaves...) OR are the fluoride levels really so high that they are afraid to let folks know for fear that tea sales will suffer? One can only speculate...~R~Update: 2010-12-02: I contacted the FDA to get their informal (non-binding) opinion. They replied that Starbucks answer is accurate under federal law. The FDA does not currently have authority over food service and the regulations for labeling do not apply. Foods imported into the U.S. must comply with FDA regulations so no excess of fluoride or other contaminants would be permitted.So I did further research and found this report "http://www.ars.usda.gov/SP2UserFiles/Place/12354500/Data/Fluoride/F02.pdf", which has entries showing green teaTea, green, brewed - 1.15 ppmTea, green, decaffeinated, brewed - 2.72 ppmIn water, at low concentrations, the approximation 1ppm = 1 mg/L holds up pretty good because the density of the solution is approximately 1 g/mL or 1 kg/L If you start getting in the range greater than 1000 mg/L, this starts breaking down.So we still don't know why Starbucks doesn't want to give a range for fluoride for their green teas. I /did/ discover that green tea has much less fluoride, on average, than black tea. (See the report.)These folks "http://www.traditionalmedicinals.com/FAQs_ingredients" state (2010.12.02) "We have had our organic green tea products tested for fluoride at an independent laboratory and the test results have shown none detected." (I neither recommend for nor recommend against this company.)"The American Journal of Medicine, Volume 118, Issue 1 , January 2005, Pages 78-82, Skeletal fluorosis and instant tea" may be of some interest.~R~

column9: Cheap version of what you get from Startbucks
column10: Powder like chopped tea in a bag.It's cheap, you get a lot, but the tea is the lowest quality one.Even the box looks exactly the same as Starbucks', but those sold in Starbucks are full tea leave and taste better (and more expensive).I should have know this before I buy it, now I have 6 boxes of them I don't know what to do :(

This green tea tastes like the expensive green tea my father bought as a present for his professor grown in asia. It has that nice subtle gentle flavor underneath the usual green tea flavor which I really love. It's not too harsh (for me anyhow) and I don't like it when people mix green tea with lemon... so this tea is good for me to just enjoy the tea leaf flavor without breaking my bank!

If you really like the flavor of green tea, that is the almost grassy flavor, then this strong tea is what you are looking for - no kidding. Also great because it will not impurify your precious bodily fluids, God willing, as we will prevail in peace and freedom from fear and in true health through the purity and essence of our natural fluids.
I like just plain green tea and have always liked Tazo brand.  This tea is very pleasant and I use this as my regular green tea.

I found this tea cheaper at Whole Foods and didn't have to buy 6 boxes. I'm in the process of taste testing various green teas. So far this Tazo is the only one I didn't like even though it comes highly recommended. For me the taste is slightly metallic. I liked Allegro's Organic Asian Gen Mai Cha much better.
We drink a lot of green tea and TAZO is one of our favorites. It's a good deal when I buy it on amazon prime. 6 boxes of 20 for $4

Tazo makes the best packaged tea in my opinion. I started with Earl Grey and Zen since they were both at my local grocery store. I got my fiancée the multi pack through Amazon for Christmas and this was our favorite of the bunch. I came back on shortly and ordered a whole box. If you are a fan of Green Tea then this is a must try. I am sure you will not be disappointed.

column9: Green Tea - Straight Ahead What You Expect
column10: The following recommendation is based on having enjoyed over 100 tea varieties in the last 2+ years.When steeped as recommended...Tazo China Green Tips tastes just as you would expect for a green tea. Pleasant and mild... for a much harsher and strong taste... steep longer.Try it.

column9: Very good flavor, more like a Japanese-style green
column10: I really enjoy the distinct flavor of this Tazo. I prefer the straight green teas, rather than those with other flavorings added (except for the delicious Genmai Cha with toasted rice).  I've been trying a variety of Japanese green teas, including Sencha, and some brands have been high in quality and flavor.  But they have been weaker-tasting than this one, too, which has disappointed me.  I find that most Chinese green teas tend to have a smokier or not as bright flavor, and are sometimes not even green in color.  Although labeled "China", this Tazo looks and tastes more like a grassier Japanese-style green tea.  I've read that fluoride levels in green teas, particularly those from China, can be pretty high, and I don't think this Tazo green is organic either.  Some teas labeled "Japanese" are actually harvested in China.  I noticed many green teas advertised here do not mention where the tea comes from.  It's a concern, though not a deal-breaker, and I'm still looking for a real Japanese green tea that matches the flavor strength of this one, as well as the reasonable price.

I would exercise extreme caution with this tea.  I used to drink one cup of China Green Tips Tea in very clean water per day.  After 6 months, it had toyed a great deal with my endocrine system.The toxic limit of fluoride is 1 mg per liter, and this tea exceeds 8.The toxic levels of fluoride is a product of the adulturated land and water of China.  As a note, don't buy ANYTHING from China if you value your health!

When I first got the package, I was excited to finally try this candy I'd heard about from my friends in the UK.  However, upon opening the package, I realized that the Wine Gums' package was previously opened and that there was only half of the package left.  It was a total rip off.  Obviously I didn't eat it.  A complete waste of money.

I buy a lot of coffee on Amazon. I was drinking Millstone ground hazelnut decaf. This time I decided to go with something different, as I like to grind the beans fresh. This coffee is quite good. I brew a half of a pot at a time, as I like to keep the standing time on the burner to a minimum. The longer coffee sits on the burner, it gathers a bitter taste. Now, I've read comments on how decaf coffee tastes bitter... Well my first pot of the day is 'Kick Ass' dark roast, caffenated. The rest of the day, it's decaf. Quite honestly, I wouldn't know if decaf is naturally more bitter or not. I just know what tastes good and what is worth buying.  I will def. be ordering this again, I love it! I hope this helped.
Delicious!Tastes great!Smells wonderful.I look forword to drinking it at any time.Dark, rich, smooth, creamy, nutty, and tastey.
This coffee has a great flavor and aroma. It is as good as any we have bought in the stores or coffee shops.

column9: Sorry to give these up -- afraid of cancer recurrence
column10: The flavor of these bars is very, very good.  They are filling and have many good nutritive qualities.That being said, we have to stop buying these bars.  They are using soy protein isolate, which probably met two of the manufacturer's goals:1) Vegetarian/non dairy2) Save money -- that is one cheap-o source of proteinAlthough we all know that an alternative -- WHEY protein from cross-microfiltration -- is the highest form of protein available right now, it is expensive.  It is more easily assimilated than soy, causes fewer GI issues (gas, indigestion, etc.), and has a better amino acid profile, etc., plus has little to no lactose remaining."Instead of using destructive chemicals, cross-flow microfiltration uses filters to separate protein from undesirable fat, cholesterol and lactose, based on molecular size and shape.(18) The low-temperature process isolates the native protein of whey at its biologically natural pH, carefully preserving its biological activity. GMPs and other immune-boosting components remain intact."informational reference:  www <dot> sportswhey <dot> com/science_ion_exchange.htmAside from the problem we have with the grossly inferior form of protein they are using, our main reason for stopping with this product is this:>>>>> We don't want our cancer to return. <<<<<<<We have had breast cancer, and it was estrogen positive.  Our oncologist has indicated that while foods containing soy are ok in reasonable amounts, SOY ISOLATES ARE NOT SAFE FOR THESE TYPES OF CANCERS.Research backs this up.These bars are possibly cancer-promoting in the sense that they have estrogenic-effects.Women who are at risk for breast cancer (and who knows how much of the population this includes -- we don't know until after we have gotten it most of the time) SHOULD NOT BE EATING THESE BARS.Maybe they can put a warning label on them to say women should check with their doctors before consuming them.The research on this is readily available on the Internet, and my oncologist has studied this issue extensively.We are sad to give these bars up because they were our favorite in terms of flavor.

If you haven't had handi-snacks before...I'm not sure why!  I know the cheese is fake, and you can get much nicer items, but the breadsticks and cheese combo is really perfect.  Could use a better distribution, as I am fonder of the breadsticks more than the crackers (and it comes with more crackers) but hey, when I buy this in bulk how can I complain?

This box comes with Clubhouse type crackers and cheddar cheese spread and also the breadstick crackers plus cheese spread. They taste fresh and natural.Both my husband and my children devour these things. Definitely an easy favorite of any cheese and cracker lover.

My kid loves this snack. I love the fact that the boxes come with a mix of both crackers and bread sticks. They also have a right size: neither too big, nor too small. Some palates might find them on the salty side, but I am OK with them.

column9: The Only Food That Works on a Sensitive Stomach
column10: I have tried many foods with my dog's sensitive stomach. I have limited his treats and human food but he still ends up sick. I have been working with natural foods and non-preservative foods and they seem to be better.  I found this brand at a local store and he rarely has issues anymore.  I am so happy with this product.  However, it is hard to find, at this time.  If your dog has food allergies or other food issues like mine, you really need to try this.

column4: Just a Mom with her thoughts
column10: My little Westie, Sugar, loves Nutrish Just 6! We have to make sure we portion her food otherwise she'll eat too much of it - she loves it that much!Did you know that proceeds from Rachael Ray's Nutrish product go toward helping animals through her Rachael's Rescue organization? So while you're giving your dog something good for them, you'll also be helping animals in need. Nutrish just 6 also contains NO corn, wheat, soy, fillers, preservatives, or artificial flavors.

My dog has really bad skin problems. I thought it was allergies, but we aren't sure. This food cleared up his symptoms in two days of feeding him. He doesn't like the taste very much, I tried crushing the kibble and mixing it with warm canned salmon and he loves it. He licks the bowl clean, that's something he's never done before. I was skeptical to try this at first, but I'm really glad I did, it's better than I expected!

My dog is 1 year 7 months old. She has had minor digestive issues when changing food in the past. I tried the other Rachael Ray foods and they were good, but after feeding Just 6 to my dog, I noticed she started to grow hair under her belly (it had been almost bare) and her breed is known to react through their hair and skin to foods. When we adopted her, her parents both had hardly any hair because of a food change. Seeing her coat get thicker and shine makes me really happy that we switched to just 6- no corn, no allergens, etc. However, I only wish it wasn't only "lamb meal". Other than that, I trust it and am glad to see such positive changes!

We rescued a mini schnauzer and I wanted to feed her the best of the best as she looked malnourished and too bony.  Not knowing her usual appetite, I proudly served her this food and she would eat at it here and there.  I thought maybe she was adjusting to us and maybe overwhelmed with all of us.  She was very lazy, sleeping all day, barely moving.  Her bowl was lasting about 2 1/2 days.  She's only 8 lbs since I was thinking she probably didn't eat much.  I decided to try another food, she devours her new food, with the first bowl gone in 5 minutes! I couldn't believe it because the bowl had been lasting over two days!! She has so much energy and is a little jumping bean who just wants to play! This food did nothing for my dog and left her thin and out of energy. I threw the rest of this food away.

column9: Great Stuff for a Better Price
column10: Just got back from walmart with this bag because we were running low on our Blue Buffalo that we can only get from the pet store 30 pound bag at $35. Well we all absolutely love walmart with it's people and lines and screaming kids. I had a headache was ready to go home and we thought let's check out the commercial dog food to see if anything has changed. Our dog cannot have any grains because he's allergic to everything his hair did so well with the blue so we kept him on it. Until today, we see Just 6 everything he needs and like I said I was ready to go home and not deal with anymore stores after dealing with walmart so we took the plunge well it past my test on being $15 for a 30 pound bag and the first ingredient being a meat and not a by-product and no grains and wheat. It also passed the ultimate test. Our dog loves it. We still use Alaskan Salmon oil and adding a little warm water for extra skin care and joint health, fish oil rocks. (Like you other amazon addicts I check on here, sorry, walmart is better in price) So I had to comment on this. Pretty soon commercial products will get better I feel and Just 6 is a great start.

My puggle eats this and seems to like it ok. She has never been into hard food so it is hard to judge her feelings about it but I like it because she has almost no gas anymore compaired to when she was on puppy food.

column9: My two dogs LOVE this food!!!
column10: I requested a sample in the mail and my dogs liked it. I got some coupons online and bought it at my local W-mart. It's less than the grocery store. My dogs transfered quickly and no tummy problems, I can't believe they like it so much what a great surprise, they are very picky eaters. I don't have to go as far to get the food and coupons/on sale too.  Thank You Rachel Ray for such a good food!!!

column9: The Most Delicious Lobsters In The World
column10: In my humble opinion, Maine lobsters taste better and have more meat than any other lobsters in the world. The title "Alive Maine Lobsters" is not quite accurate, because catches can be in the coastal area from North Carolina to Nova Scotia. My father placed an order with Hancock Gourmet Lobster Company for me and they were delivered at 6:18 am on Dec. 24th.  The lobsters were alive, healthy, and ready to cook.  I got a pot of water boiling and my wife walked into the kitchen to see what I was doing.  She got mad and wouldn't let me put them in the pot.  I had to buy a salt water aquarium for them and now they are my new pets.

Brought back wonderful memories of several trips Downeast.  The flavoring is superb and the instructions for heating and serving were very helpful.  Will certainly order again and will try other lobster products from this company.

I bought a quart ($50 + shipping) direct from the vendor, expecting to be amazed based on AMZN reviews and reviews on the vendor's site.  I wasn't amazed.  Yes, it is delicious, something like a lobster bisque with a few chunks of claw meat added.  Very rich and flavorful, but not noticeably better than any premium lobster bisque in your grocery.  Did I enjoy it?  Absolutely!  Would I buy it again?  At $50 a quart plus shipping, no way.  A can of good quality lobster bisque plus a few big shrimp will satisfy your craving for the flavor and leave a lot more money in your pocket.

I purchased this item as a Christmas gift for my father n law  from my children. He loved it. He said it was close to if not the best lobster stew he had ever eaten. He said it had lots of lobster in it and was very very tastey.It was definately a hit with him as far as Christmas gifts go.

column9: Thin, Watery, and Lacking in Flavor. Unimpressed.
column10: I purchased this with the expectation that, like most lobster bisques I've had at high-end restaurants, it would be creamy, thick, and filling.  Instead, it was watery, thin, bland, and not at all worth the price I paid.  Yes, there is a decent amount of lobster meat included in each serving, but it does not compensate for the lack of flavor and texture in the soup.  I would strongly advise against spending your money on this.That being said, Hancock's lobster mac and cheese is fantastic and worth every penny.

I wasn't sure what I was going to think about a combination like cocoa, cranberry, and walnut (AND granola), but this stuff isn't bad for munching. Though the cranberry flavor isn't as good as the other flavor I tried (almond cinnamon).One note: it's a very HARD granola, to be sure, and so too much continued snacking will lead to sore jaws! I mean, harder than granola usually is. I'm sorely tempted to treat it like a granola breakfast serial once and pour some cold, softening milk over it ...

I'm trying to judge these for what they are, which is a semi- healthy candy/snack, rather than for what I want them to be, simple granola clusters than can be a snack or cereal, so they get 3 stars instead of the 1-2  my general disappointment favors.With most granola clusters, you can also break them up a bit to eat as cereal or as a yogurt topping. But these are large, cohesive,  chunks held together with cocoa coating, more like ting-tings or other homemade no-bake cookies (but not as yummy because it's cocoa instead of actual chocolate). They're distinct, large clumps (most an inch or more) completely coated and glued together with a bittersweet (more bitter than sweet) cocoa coating.My main problem with this product (aside from the fact that it's in flavor limbo) is that the packaging/product page downplay the cocoa element, which is absolutely the defining flavor here, completely neutralizing the "cranberry walnut" flavor listed on the package. The picture just looks like it could be extra-toasty granola, and the label says CRANBERRY WALNUT GRANOLA CLUSTERS in large letters with "the natural antioxidant power of cocoa" in a little bubble off to the side. The description mentions cocoa but doesn't say the clusters are completely smothered in it, so you'd expect the stated flavor (cranberry walnut) to have at least an equal footing. Since cocoa really is the dominant flavor, the packaging or at least the Amazon title should have cocoa in the name.As a snack, it is nice that the clumps stay together, since crumbly clusters are always an issue with granola snacks.If you want kind of a hippy candy, not chocolately enough to actually taste like a treat (unless maybe you're on a low carb diet), but way too cocoa-y to make a good cereal or fruit/granola topping, then this is for you.

Title says it all!  They need to come up with a better name.  Now onto the good things...  My kids LOVE it.  We originally received 4 heavy 12 ounce resealable pouches and they were gone within 7 days.  The bad thing is that because of the chocolate/cocoa flavor the kids like it way too much!  It becomes rather unhealthy if you eat half a bag in one sitting.Pros:Deep dark chocolate/cocoa flavor.  I personally prefer dark to milk chocolate so the smokey deep flavor had me reaching for more.Pieces are sized right to hold with fingers, opposed to reaching for tiny granola bits.Small subtleties can be tasted the longer you are snacking on them.  At first you will be overtaken by the cocoa but eventually it mellows where the cranberries will stand out a bit.Travels well... in a BIG purse, diaper bag, car or hiking backpack.Considerable amount given where you don't feel as if you purchased just air.Cons:Very hard and toothsome.  If you have dentures or teeth maladies then these are not for you.I wish that the other flavors were a bit more pronounced at times; especially the cranberries.When you reach the bottom of the bag you are left with granola crumbs :(So sweet that you can possibly sit in front of the television snacking half a day.  TRUE STORYChoking hazard for small children.They go too quick when everyone in the house likes them.... not a true con!Highly recommend to any individual that enjoys dark chocolate and cocoa flavors.  If you have any teeth issues, including severe TMJ then I suggest looking for another company's offerings.  I suffer from TMJ and having chewed for a while cause me a bit of pain.

column9: Cranberry not my favorite, but this works!
column10: Given a choice between this version and the dark chocolate version, well, chocolate beats just about everything.  But for the interested muncher with concerns about urinary tract health, cranberry has to be appealing, and I love the walnuts, so yeah, thumbs up!

column9: Very good snack food...just don't eat too much
column10: I really like the Eat. Think. Smile. snack line (the Cranberry Walnut granola clusters in particular). The flavor is distinctive and appealing, and the quality is first-rate. As with any granola-style treat, the challenge is moderating your consumption of these high-calorie products. Good luck with that!

. . . in my household!As I've indicated in another food review, my eldest daughter came home from college and put the family on a diet.  Um "Lifestyle Change"!  NOT always much fun!  And let's be honest here.  Not all foods that are "good for you" are "good"!These granola clusters are certainly both good for you AND GOOD!  They were extremely well received by the entire household -- even by some who don't care for walnuts!No downside; would purchase again!

These chocolate nutty granola clusters are addicting.  They make an excellent afternoon snack and even satisfy my chocolate cravings.  The flavor is delicious and doesn't have any artificial aftertaste like most products on the market.  They are packed with antioxidants too.  I also love that they are manufactured in the USA. I am excited to try the line of granola bars that they make too.

These granola clusters have a good heft and body to the pieces.  Cranberry and Chocolate make a great combination and the addition of walnuts reminds me a little of brownies.Unlike some others who somewhat objected to the cocoa content or amount thereof, I loved it becuase I just love chocolate.  Looking at the package I knew cocoa was a major component of the snack, as well, these are a line of cocoa snacks that just happen to have additional flavorings.Provided nutrition data uses a slightly strainful font so I provided another.

We enjoyed these even more than we thought we would.  We saved them to take in the car on an upcoming road trip.  They were delicious and really hit the spot when lunchtime came and there was not an appealing drive-in or restaurant within miles.When we arrived at our destination we left the bag in the car.  Surprsingly enought after four days of sitting in a locked car they were just as good going home as they had been when we started out.Admittedly we like both cranberries and walnuts so we may be a bit partial but we would recommend this as a snack.

Eat. Think. Smile. Granola Clusters, Cranberry Walnut, 12-Ounce Pouches...hard and crunchy -- so much so, one might just use Eat. Think. Smile. Granola Clusters, Cranberry Walnut to clean the tarter off their teeth -- like a carrot.Never one to shy away from trying something new, if a snack product boasts of being all natural and antioxidant -- on the front of the package --, it usually ends up in my shopping cart, especially of late, 'cuz that's the way I roll. :)Eat. Think. Smile. Granola Clusters, Cranberry Walnut was an especially nice surprise, as I found it to be dry and crunchy, not messy and sticky (which is a big "plus" in warmer weather), with an extraordinarily satisfying cocoa/cranberry/walnut taste -- that did not leave me feeling bloated/over stuffed, if ya know what I mean.The extra thick zip-lock like re sealable bag really came in handy, as I was tempted to eat more than one of the 10 portions contained in the bag.  It is that good!  :)Cons:  Although extraordinarily delicious, Granola Clusters, Cranberry Walnut nuggets seemed a bit hard to chew -- but that may be subjective -- as I have very expensive dental work that I tend to be overly cautious about -- , so I won't deduct a "star" for that.You might also like to try a couple of other Eat. Think. Smile.products that I've reviewed and thoroughly enjoyed: Eat. Think. Smile. Crispy Thins, Sweet Cinnamon and Eat. Think. Smile. Crispy Thins, Savory Sea Salt.  I can't make up my mind which variety I enjoy more...  Highly Recommended!  --Katharena Eiermann, 2012
These are just great.  Even my dog liked them, stealing a pack off a coffee table and eating darned near the whole thing.

This product is manufactured and distributed by Apure Foods, which is a wholly-owned subsidiary of Hershey's founded in 2010 "to bring cocoa-based health and wellness products to consumers", according to the Hershey's website.That being said, my wife and I thought it was pretty good. We both enjoyed it and will likely purchase it once in a while in the future.The taste took some getting used to, as it is not overly sweet-tasting. It is made with cocoa rather than chocolate, for example, and although brown sugar is ingredient no. 2 after oats, it tastes "healthier" than you would think after reading the ingredients list. The combination of the cocoa and cranberry flavors is unusual, and struck us as original.The nutritional information indicates that a 35-gram serving contains 24g carbohydrate (including 13g sugars and 3g fiber), 7g fat (including 2g saturated) and 3g protein.All in all, a good offering for those who can afford the carbs, and a surprise for me to learn that Hershey's even has a "health and wellness" segment.

This is a great snacking granola.  I was kind of surprised to see the big, hard chunks, since I think of granola as a breakfast-cereal type of thing and this surely isn't.  in fairness, the picture on the bag does depict them as big chunks. "Hard" was a bit of a surprise, though.  They seem to be playing on the new "chocolate is good for you!" thinking, since these are very liberally dusted in cocoa powder and the package features its antioxidant properties; the cocoa flavor pretty much overwhelms the cranberry and walnut contributions.  They are very tasty, though, and the ingredients are very straightforward.  I found the cocoa flavor paired excellently with coffee, and they are healthier than most of the sweets I would choose with coffee.

These clusters aren't super sweet, and they seem to actually be pretty healthy. I'm giving these 5 stars on the advice of my children. An eight-, six-, and three-year old all agreed that these were delicious. They can get pretty picky about snacks (especially the healthier varieties). This snack went fast.

I usually like granola and chocolate, but this product was not for me.  The granola was too sweet and the appearance was not very appetizing.  I tried it several different times of the day, even as a cereal in the mroning, but it never did have a good taste and texture.I would not purchase this item.

It's hard to find granola that doesn't have an ingredient list that looks like a chemical factory AND that tastes good, but this one fits the bill: oats, sugar, walnuts, palm oil, cocoa, crisp rice, cranberries, cinnamon, salt, almonds. The only questionable ingredients are "natural flavor" (which could be almost anything) and soy lecithin. Although high in sugars (like most snacks), it is relatively low fat. I liked the mild chocolate taste and consistency.
The best!  Nothing better than this to munch on during a movie.  Or for breakfast with coffee.  Or a snack anytime.  "Eat Think Smile" indeed.  You will smile!!!  Get 'em!!!

column9: Addictive once you acquire the cocoa flavor -- although many sugars
column10: I like the idea behind this company's products: foods with what they claim is very high in antioxidants, particularly revolving around their proprietary cocoa blend. The ingredients looks simple and natural, so I decided to try it. It does have 13 grams of sugars per 35 grams of product, so I wasn't terribly excited about that (brown sugar, evaporated cane juice, sugar and honey).When I first tried it, I wasn't quite sure what it supposed to be -- a cereal or a snack. I found it to be on the hard, crunchy side, but not too hard. The pieces are rather large, so it just doesn't work as a cereal. At first, it made me think of eating granola with bitter cocoa powder on the outside, but I quickly acquired the taste and really got to like it. The cranberries and the cocoa are the dominant flavors, which is a unique combination to me and one that I now enjoy. My wife tried one and thought it tasted awful.. I liked the first four bags so much that I bought another 4-pack.

The first bowl of this cereal took me by surprise because of a combination of flavors that I wasn't used to eating together. It only took a second bowl to really like it. The chocolate flavor is pretty intense, and the cranberry taste is prominent as well. Once I had eaten this combination of flavors a couple of times it really tasted good to me.Not only is it good with milk on it (holds it's crunch instead of getting mushy), but great on ice cream and yogurt too.If you like Cocoa Puffs but want a more grown-up cereal made with whole grains and 3 grams of fiber per serving, give this unusual granola a try, or better yet several tries. If you are like me, this strangely satisfying flavor will grow on you quickly.

I was pleasantly surprised at how good this granola was.  The chocolate was a nice flavor, not too sweet. You can distinctly taste the cranberries, while the walnuts added more of a subtle flavor. The dried cranberries were soft, and the walnuts were in small unobtrusive bits.  The granola tastes good in vanilla yogurt, but I mostly eat it by itself.  Granola is always dense in calories, but I found the serving size of 1/3 cup was more than enough for a large snack.  Generally, I eat about 1/4 of a cup, which looks small but is deceptively filling.  The 12-ounce pack is a large size and will last a while.  Mine has been opened a month and is not stale at all, plus the pack reseals nicely.  It's the best granola I have had, and I would definitely recommend giving it a try.

column9: Healthy snack.  A bit over tough.
column10: I snacked on it some and then my husband ate the rest of it before I got to writing this review.  This has a pleasant slightly sweet and cocoa taste.  I remember tasting cranberry a bit and but don't remember tasting the walnut.  I'd prefer some nice big chunks of walnut.I appreciated:  No high fructose corn syrup.  No peanuts.  We reject many granola products because of a peanut allergy and this doesn't have peanuts.My complaint about it is that its bit too hard to chew for me and it you eat too much it does rather feel like rocks in your stomach.  I realize that granola is not the easiest thing to chew, but this seems a bit harder than usual.  That didn't stop me from snacking on it, but it did limit how much of it I would eat at once.

I didn't think I would like chocolate in my granola, but this is awesome stuff. When a craving for something sweet hits, now I know I am eating a healthy alternative to the chocolate I usually eat. The walnuts and cranberrys are just gravy. Really good snack when you want something sweet.

The eat,think,smile granola clusters cranberry walnut is absolutely delicious.It is a bit hard but I crumble it up in my vanilla yogurt and ave an out standing breakfast or anytime snack. I will try some other flavors also.Love the great dark chocolate on the granola.

As with the almond cinnamon flavor this granola is largely made up of big hard chunks.  The addition of berries in this flavor makes it not only hard but chewy too.  I tried it dry as a snack and I tried it in a bowl with almond milk.  It is best as a dry snack because it's so hard and chunky.  The flavor is okay but nothing to get excited about and the texture (big hard and chewy clusters) makes it difficult to eat, especially with milk on it and using a spoon.  Update - I put chunks of peeled sweet potato in the container I had the granola in, put the lid on, and next day the granola was way better.  Not nearly so hard so I could enjoy the taste more.  This would work even better with a cut up apple but I didn't have one

I found this to be a great snack. The crunch was amazing and the taste a good mix of sweet and tangy.The first thing I noticed was the rich chocolate flavor. It was more of a semisweet than a milk chocolate. I am a fan of dark chocolate, so I didn't mind. Secondly, the crunch is so satisfying when trying the less it more approach. Sure, it might be granola and be 'healthy', but it is still chocolate, right? Lastly, the tang of the cranberries really brought the flavors home.I used it on frozen yogurt and it was so good. My husband tried it in vanilla yogurt and enjoyed it. My kids just ate it by the handful as after school snacks.The only negative is the fact that the bag goes stale before my family could eat it all.

Great standalone snack or addition to yogurt. Cocoa flavor is solid but without a candy taste. Using this for an on-the-road or on-the-run snack was much easier than individual snack packs. One bag was just a bit more than a snack for four girls and dad. Next thing we are going to try is putting it in home made ice cream.
This was a tasty snack that I enjoyed. Might be a little to hard for those with teeth problems, but otherwise okay. Oats, walnuts, and cranberry with a little chocolate is a good combination.

For a price equal to a bag or "regular granola" snacks, these are just fantastic.They are crunchy, chewy, and perfect on the sweetness scale (in our opinion). Probably not the best thing if you are looking for a cereal...(and this is the reason for the 4 instead of 5 star--though we weren't looking for a cereal): some of the clusters are on the large size-even for granola snackers like us.Nothing but nature in the bag AND a healthful snack provided you don't sit down and polish off a whole bag which IS a danger because they are so good.We can't wait to try the other flavours. These are well worth your snacking dollars!

column9: Cranberry Walnut goodness that's good with a salad
column10: This is bite-size granola in a package that can be eaten a few at a time as a snack.  Each package is 12 oz. and there are ten 1.2 ounce servings in each bag. Each serving is 160 calories with 60 calories from fat.  There are 3 grams of protein and 13 grams of sugar in each serving.  Each serving also constitutes a daily dietary intake of 12% in fiber and 8% in carbs. The first three ingredients are whole grain rolled oats, brown sugar, and walnuts.  Cranberries are 8th on the ingredient list.I am use to eating my granola with milk so this was a new twist on a what was formally a cerael.  I felt these were dry but they tasted good.  Drinking a glass of milk took away most of the dryness.  There is a high cocoa and cinnamon flavor and the cranberries tasted like raisins to me.  I didn't taste the walnuts at all. As a result, I felt the flavor was a bit muted but still good.Obviously granola is a high calorie snack and it's hard to eat just 1.2 ounces.  Nevertheless, I feel it's much better to eat this than candy and cake.  After having tried these, this is not a snack I would purchase because of the dryness and the muted flavor.  However, I've been eating these for a couple of days and have discovered that putting these clusters in a salad takes away the dryness and gives the salad a nice crunch (like croutons) in addition to adding additional flavor.I had my boyfriend try these and he likes them.

column9: A good snack for those who enjoy granola clusters.
column10: Eat. Think. Smile. Granola Clusters (Cranberry Chocolate Walnut flavor) is a real treat for those who enjoy eating a healthy snack.  Granola Clusters is one of my favorite snacks and I was very happy to try these out.  I wasn't dissatisfied with the product and I enjoyed them very much.  The granola is not at all stale or tough to chew.  I enjoyed the walnut and cranberry taste (with a hint of chocolate).  Overall, I have to highly recommend this product.  A delicious snack for those who enjoy the wonderful and healthy taste of granola.

I really enjoyed these Cinnamon Cranberry Walnut Clusters.  They are easy to snack on because of they are medium sized clusters and taste really good with milk.  The predominant flavor is chocolate from the powdered cocoa but the cranberry also adds a fruity flavor.  The second ingredient is brown sugar so these are not a diet food plus they are addictive so be careful!!

Eat Think Smile Cinnamon Cranberry Walnut Clusters is an interesting snack that I've started to enjoy more after trying it a few times.  It's not my favorite flavor of this product, and it's not exactly health food, but I don't think there would be an issue in enjoying this treat in moderation.Eat Think Smile Cranberry Walnut Granola Clusters is made up of large granola clusters, too big to be eaten easily as a breakfast cereal but just the right size for snacking. The most obvious ingredients are oats, walnut bits, cocoa, and small bits of cranberry.  Cranberries are fairly far down the list of ingredients, and as a result in many bites I really didn't detect any cranberry flavor.  There is also a barely detectable amount of cinnamon added.  I was ready to knock this product down a star because I didn't think it was nearly as good as Eat. Think. Smile. Granola Clusters, Cinnamon Almond, 12-Ounce Pouches (Pack of 4); but after trying it again I rather enjoyed the plainer flavor of this mix.Now as I mentioned above I would not consider this product health food, despite the claims on the package about the antioxidant power of the cocoa and cranberries.  After all, a small serving contains 7 grams of fat and 13 grams of sugar, and among the ingredients listed are brown sugar, palm oil, and evaporated sugar cane juice. But as a substitute for more highly processed sweets this will do OK.  In summary this is a good product; it's not as tasty as their Cinnamon Almond Granola, but if you want a subtler taste this may be a good choice.
These are granola *clusters* so they are perfect for snacking (as opposed to the crumbly kind that you'd mix with yogurt). Not too sweet and nicely crunchy and satisfying.
These were by far the worst pecan logs I have every tasted. I sent the whole box to work with my husband and the laborers wouldn't even eat them! We ended up throwing them all away. :(

Very pleased with service and product.  It was a surprise gift for a very good friend who loves Stuckeys Pecan Logs so I decided to send some to her.  It was a great idea and everything went very smoothly.  I will gladly go through Amazon again for gifts and itmes for myself.
We used to get these when we went on vacations because you couldn't get them where we live. So excited you can get them on line now. They are really good.

For anyone not familiar with Wysong and their products, they are are small family-owned ethically sound company.  They do what's good for the health of our pets, not for the health of their pocketbooks or for marketers' pocketbooks.Archetype is the best dry raw food out there.  It's truly non thermally processed, so the integrity of the ingredients/nutrients is maintained.  The ingredients reflect everything that's good for your pets (meat, organs, bone, nutraceuticals, antioxidants, enzymes, probiotics, prebiotics) and none of the garbage that other companies include, such as sugary starches.My cats love Archetype!

column9: INTENSE AROMA and HIGH OIL CONTENT make this a winner!
column10: The beans themselves are quality, uniform, and have an intense lustor glow to them. Freshly ground, this coffee makes the most intense aroma that will FILL the entire house or office space. We drink this steadily at our hospital, and what a productive day we have! Wonderful product.

Really great bag of coffee. I picked a bag up from BJ's. I enjoy Dunkin Donuts coffee but drink this as well whenever I feel like grinding the beans. Its pretty strong stuff. Does not compare to crap like folgers or maxwell house.

column9: Can't open bag without destroying it
column10: The kind of glue they use makes the bag impossible to open without ripping it apart. They obviously intend it to be resealable since there is a wire wrap included. If that's the case, they need to swap out the glue. Had to put all the beans into Tupperware after prying open the bag.
love it and will come back for more. A pleasant surprise. Not sweet and a nice pairing with bread and wine

column9: This Cheese is Almost Too Good to Share!
column10: The thing that got me interested in this cheese was the "Raspberry" in its name.  It's not one of those sweet cheese things that someone cooked up in some fake cheese factory.  This has a great cheese flavor with a well-rounded and seasoned raspberry note.  Cut this up for crackers and warm it in the microwave for a bit... cheese lover's paradise!  Both "raspberry-holics" and plain old cheese lover's will adore this stuff.  It's so good that I almost didn't want to clue the rest of you in.  I guess that I'm just too nice a guy to keep it a secret!  Enjoy!

I have an 18 year old Siamese cat who has developed hairball problems in the last year or so.  She is pretty finicky, but likes this food.  I can say that I have seen improvement in her health and well being since placing her onto this diet.  The classic version of the food works well for my cat as she doesn't have a lot of teeth.

column9: Hill's Scient Diet Hairball Control Canned Cat Food (Seafood)
column10: I have a one year old cat and a senior cat.  The senior cat--a fussy eater with no teeth--was eating another brand of canned cat food, but preferred to "gum" dry kibble most of the time.  When I bought the Science Diet, she enjoyed it right away and now prefers it exclusively.  In retrospect, I believe the other brand may have been upsetting her stomach; she slept all the time, had issues with hairballs and was not interested in play at all.  I had attributed this behavior to her age, but since I switched her to the Science Diet she has begun to play again and her coat is extremely soft and shining.  The hairballs have stopped entirely.  I'm very glad I bought it.  (All of that said, the young cat will not touch it.)  So you might test it out before buying in quantity.  Overall, I'm thrilled with what it has done for my senior cat.
My cats did not like the Chicken, but ate the seafood flavor. Some food was left on the plate. Sci diet does not have a strong odor but also does not have a strong appeal for my cats.

These are not full-sized Swedish Fish. Each one here is around 3cm long, or about half the normal size you may remember.That said, these fill the bill in every other way. The four traditional colors and flavors are spot-on (most people like the red, I prefer the orange and green). The texture is just right--not as hard and rubbery as modern gummy bears but very chewy and long-lasting. The surface turns white and they crack just right when you pull or twist them. The entire bag was well-sealed and fresh. These are the same Swedish Fish I remember from shopping with my mom at Emporium Capwell's in the 1970's in every way, except for the size.Of course, I am not the same size either. If this size is the new way, then so be it. (The fish.)Edit: I see many different vendors selling this item now. My order was sold by SweetGourmet.com, LLC and shipped by Amazon via Prime 2-day.

column9: Not as good as Planters, but acceptable
column10: One of our family members is a Spanish peanut lover and eats a few every day, so we try to keep some on hand.I ordered these because the Planters brand was temporarily sold out.On the plus side, when ordered from Amazon.com Herman's cost less per ounce than Planters. When I wrote this review, according to my not-always-reliable math, Herman's Spanish peanuts were about 16 cents per ounce while Planter's were about 21 cents per ounce.On the minus side, there is a difference in quality. Herman's Spanish peanuts are not as fresh smelling or tasting, and they are not as tender. They also don't have that nice shine that Planters Spanish peanuts have.They aren't bad. They're acceptable if you're looking to save some money. But for a Spanish peanut connoisseur like our family member, they just aren't as satisfying as Planters.
My neighbor was talking about these saying how he had not had them in years.  Found them here and giving as a birthday gift.  Thanks!

column9: Herman's Nut House Nuts are very good!
column10: Spanish peanuts are the BEST peanuts for sundaes.  Herman's Nut House's Spanish peanuts are very good!

A couple years ago, I decided to simplify my home brewing operation and focus on really "nailing" a few recipes (instead of always brewing something different).  And part of that process was choosing a single yeast to harvest, store and re-use.  2308 has a reputation for being excellent but temperamental.  I have found it amazingly versatile.As you might expect, I use this for all my European lagers, but I also use it for my porters and stouts, fermenting at higher temperatures--think of "steam" beer.  And, in fact, my IPAs are just that--steam beer (which many beer experts have said resemble IPAs more than anything else).So even if you don't decide to choose a single yeast as I did, with a little planning, you could do a series of beers from a single packet of 2308, save yourself a few bucks--and end up with some very nice beer.

column9: Elijah Craig 12 is mature, sophisticated, and excellent: the greatest bargain in all the spirit world.
column10: If you're looking for absolutely the best distilled spirit you can buy for the money (an issue that used to come up every Friday night in my younger days) you simply cannot do better than Elijah Craig 12.  It's an under-appreciated classic of American bourbon crafting.  You simply cannot buy a distilled spirit of any kind from any country remotely close to this refinement and quality for anywhere close to the bargain basement low price of Elijah Craig 12.  It's a stone. cold. bargain.  Have I said that enough?In the glass it's dark burnished bronze with a molten luminescent core: beautiful and rich.  The aroma blooms with lots of time, like a good whiskey should: corn on the cob, black fruits (prune / fig) sawn oak, and old tanned leather.  First sip and I'm amazed at how dry and sophisticated this is for bourbon.  There's burnt caramel and corn fruitiness - but muted below the rich oak tannins and wood resin.  You can taste the years this whiskey has laid in the rich wood.  Mid palate has big red fruit notes married to the wood, a sophisticated sherry-like presentation.  Finish is long and complex with faint drifts of sandalwood and distant smoke weaving in among the buttered corn, hot spirit, sherry and tanned leather.  The dark fudgy edge curbing the fruit sweetness reminds me of bitter orange or very dark chocolate.  This is a top flight bourbon flavor extravaganza that feels lean and sinewy while at the same time as it manages to be sweet and rich.  The red fruit speaks of sunlight and sugar while the dark wood and bitter notes speak of age and darkness.  This is excellent depth of flavor and character.This bourbon would be impressive regardless of price.  At this price (the same as any ordinary mass market bottle of hooch) it's astounding.  This bourbon is of a piece with fine single malts or vsop/xo cognac.  Sip it slow and neat in a small glass.  I pray they never come to their senses.

Even a few minutes too long results in a bitter, bitter tea, reminiscent of orange pekoe with a strong perfume added. What a letdown! Even properly brewed, though, this tea cannot, in my opinion, warrant more than three stars.The ingredients in Earl Grey are just black teas and bergamot essence.Tazo is an interesting company that makes premium teas. They are socially responsible, based in Portland, and have the motto, "The Reincarnation of Tea". Tazo is owned by Starbucks. Their web site is fun and quirky, with a Zen-type focus, definitely worth checking out. It is unclear, though, from their web site, how many of their ingredients are organic or kosher, and they do use some "natural flavors" in their teas--this wording seems a little vague for premium tea.Instead of Tazo's Earl Grey, I would highly recommend Numi Earl Grey, which does not disappoint in any way and is comparable in cost.Not recommended, unless you don't mind somewhat artificial and chemical flavors in your tea.***
The outside is a very mild mint flavor and goes very well with the chocolate inside.  They are almost addicting.

Arcor chocolate filled mintsI searched for these candies and for a good price on them. I think they are just right for stashing in your purse. They are a hard candy, not sticky. They are individually wrapped. They have the right ingredients....mint and chocolate. They are perfect for my use.

Finally found that these chocolate filled mints may be found at Amazon.com. What wonderfulcandies they are and a treat to get them so easily on Amazon.com. Thanks forthe great service.They are a refreshing terrific tasting candy. As long as youdo not have to have sugar free foods, try this, you'll like it.
Ordered as a gift, my parents loved the parmesan garlic the most.  It's a huge bag and arrives fresh.

I haven't owned a dog in over 25 years but I got a puppy in November 2010.  She was rescued (with her brother) because her mother was killed by a coyote.  The woman who rescued her hand fed the puppies with bottles.  When they started eating she put them on Science Diet.  I have read some pretty nasty comments about Science Diet in the reviews.  I agree with a guy that wrote that the results from feeding Science Diet speak for themselves.  My pet is perfectly healthy, full of energy, her stools are just right, and her coat is very shiny.  I guess it would be better if I could afford to have dog food made from products humans would eat. People seem to rave about these dog foods made from all healthy almost human consumable ingredients.  As my puppy is doing so well on this food, I am choosing to leave her with it till adulthood.  Then I will may shop for another brand.  As they say, why fix it if it ain't broke!

column9: Excellent for a snack or light lunch
column10: Can't really improve upon the prior reviews, but I'd buy it elsewhere other than through Amazon. The Winn-Dixie and Wal-Mart in my town normally carry it at between $1.45 to $1.50 per kit.  Thought it be cheaper buying in bulk through Amazon but no such luck.

I love this tuna.  It's unlike any other tuna I've tasted.  I usually don't like canned tuna, but this is an exception.  I eat it for lunch right out of the can. It needs nothing else (no salt, pepper, mayonnaise) and doesn't have that canned tuna taste like others do!  Makes a great snack, too.  I like spicy, and the Thai Chili tuna is spicy  with a slight sweet flavor. It's my favorite.  Lots of flavor! Makes a wonderful light lunch with some zest.

This is the kind of creative food that keeps the Bumble Bee products at the top of our list.  When we head out fishing, we grab one of their wide range of products.  We would grab this particular one every time if we didn't know we would get tired of eating the same thing every time.  I do take two of these at a time, because the first one leaves me wanting a little more--but that's probably more of a reflection on the quality of the product than the portion.

column9: Oh Bumblebee, I WEEP with gratitude.
column10: Forgive me for being overly dramatic, but I consider my quest for palatable, convenient lunch options as seriously as some people treat their personal finances, or stock portfolios. With my daily 3 hour commute, I have leisurely breakfasts and dinners only on weekends. Lunch is the only meal I may actually be *sitting down* to eat so I [expletive deleted] refuse to settle for something tasteless. I do not have a sweet tooth, and that eliminates half the things I can grab from a vending machine. Carbs put me in food coma, and so that eliminates the other half.  I do not have the discretionary income to eat fig and duck confit sandwiches from the fancy cafe next door to work, and that leaves me with having to quest for lunch options I can store in my office cupboard and prepare with the least hassle. Some of my finds  have been decent, some have made me cry at how desperate I had become to be eating something that tastes like the aftermath of drunk moose.  But this...this was tasty. Genuinely tasty.Ever since I got it out of "I wonder what this tastes like" curiosity at Target ages ago, it was love at first bite. This product smells strongly and cubicle dwellers may wish to note that but the kit is easy to store, the can is easy to open and if you have a napkin, you are all set. The tuna tastes amazing. Even if you are not fond of the fish in its other "tuna kit" or "chicken of the sea" avatars, the slightly spicy, slightly sweet, zesty flavor of this will appeal to those of you who like more flavor in your food. It is thick, chunky and not watery, so it is not messy to eat, and did I mention it is actually tasty? This may be the only thing of the many things stored in my office cupboard for food emergencies that I actually enjoy eating.Though sadly, most of my Thai Chili lunch kits get borrowed by colleagues with such astonishing regularity, that I am forced to have this on autoship. MONTHLY!

Purchase from the commissary! Perfect snack size, the combination of the crackers and tuna make very balance protein to carb ratio and total calories are under my 250 calorie per meal (eat small meals every 3 hours). Taste is spicey and yummy without a "sauce". I tried a different BRAND and it had a sauce in the tuna,yuck. Not this! I also used this to make tuna cakes and did not have to add ANY seasoning!  They were such a hit I had to go buy a case from the commissary to share with the ladies group!! Hoping Amazon will get it so that I can order it as an automatic subscription. Even my hubbie that is not a seafood person, loves it.

Bumble Bee made it taste good. Amazon the cost really great. As the price of EVERYthing goes up Amazon manages to keep offering up great deals on great tasting foods. And I dont miss having to deal with traffic,crowds and long lines at the store.
Love this healthy snack.  The tuna has just the right amount of spice and the whole chili is a nice bonus.
I love this stuff for a quick lunch, especially handy to keep in the car.  I recently bought a case through Amazon, but just found it at my local Aldi's store today for only $1.19 a pack!
this tuna is soo good if you want a change try this tuna and it's not too spicy. I wish it came with more crackers other than that this is a must have product in my pantry.

I love these.  I break them out when I am too busy to fix a meal, when I want a snack, or even sometimes when someone drops by and I am randomly pulling things from the pantry.  I usually serve the tuna with crisp rye or wheat crackers, just because I prefer them. However, the crackers that come with the package are also delicious, and I do use them, too.  It seems like every time I put them out with snacks for guests, someone wants to know where they can be purchased.  They are so flavorful.  LOVE these!

I first tasted spicy canned tuna when a friend brought some back from Korea and I just had to have more. I was happy to come across this Bumblebee brand Spicy Thai Tuna and it was so good that I now buy it by the case. The price on Amazon is nearly the same as our local grocery but it's so much more convenient to buy from Amazon.

column9: Delightfuly spicy and good tasting, 3 ounce tuna can in each packet, 130 calories tuna, 80 crackers
column10: I really like tuna, but it can get boring. Not with the Thai Chili from Bumble Bee. It has a nice spice kick, and I can go spicer than most people I know, with even a little afterburn (not unpleasant to me at all). There are even one or two of the chilis that are pictured whole in each can.The crackers are just so-so and tend to crumble a little before you take them out. And they are not very good quality crackers. I personally can't have just this for lunch all the time. But you don't need much more: an apple, piece of cheese and you do have, for me, a full lunch. But you are also getting your calories worth. For 210 calories pretty darn filling.So crackers not great. But the tuna certaintly is. Tasty and light tuna is a good source of protein, selenium,vitamin B-12, niacin and iron. Also less mercury than albacore, but albacore does have more Omega-3s. For the price, taste, good use of calories: overall highly recommended.

column9: Like spicy Thai food? Then YES!
column10: This is a tasty meal or treat and it comes with a little spatula to spread tuna on crackers.  My can had a whole red hot chili in it, but it was yummy and not too hot (well not for me, my family comes from the South and hot sauce is practically put into baby bottles!)  I tried the tomato basil, which is okay, but not as flavorful.  Got these for a snack bin in the living room that has healthy alternatives to chips and cookies.  the total calories only comes to 200, which is a great small meal to cut hunger and get in some protein, if you don't eat the crackers than it's only 110 calories! Save the crackers for soup some other day!  This will become a regular for me in the future---it's a great late evening snack!

I travel in remote areas for work and my gear gets thrown around a lot.  I appreciate the box that the tuna kit comes in because the crackers are always whole, no matter what has happened.  I buy this tuna kit instead of other ones because it has the simplest ingredients: no corn syrup, no artificial weirdness, no modified anything.  The very small can is a good serving size for me.  The spice is pretty intense and I know many people who would not like it, but it is fine for me.  I usually mix in crushed kale chips to add a vegetable to my meal.  I often save the enclosed mini-spreaders and have started to save the plastic boxes to make other meal kits, so in a way, it is possible to reduce the amount of packaging wasted by this product. This is one of my travel staples and I always have some on hand.  I'm not giving it five stars only because there are tuna products out there (such as bonito del norte) that have far superior flavor and are the only ones that I give five stars.

I've been buying stuff off of amazon for years now and have not once written a review.  These things are SOO good.  Doesn't even seem like you're eating tuna.  Please everyone try them.  For a while I was worried they they wouldn't get enough sales and would be discontinued.  I'm very scared of that.  Just so good.One problem.  Only recently they've switched the crackers in the container from Ritz quality to some off brand one that is a bit more airy.  I want them to switch back.

column9: Bumble Bee Thai Chili Tuna Kit
column10: This is my favorite of three flavors offered.  Great snack in between meals.  I would definitely recommend this item to anyone.

Well, I really like this stuff - it's got a Thai zing to it that I really like.  Portable - great for keeping at work when I've forgotten my lunch - just enough to be satisfying.  Can't say much wrong about it!
I LOVE the Thai Chili tuna kits!  The tuna is spicey and the crackers are a tiny bit sweet, and the combination is divine.

I like these for a small lunch, with a little tastey kick to it, not hot but a little spicey.  The crackers and the very little plastic spoon to get the tuna onto crackers make this a grab and go lunch for me.  While I call this lunch, my son barely calls it a snack.  I do have a hard time opening the tuna because the can is small, which makes it hard for me to get a good grip.  But I will be getting more becaue I like the unique taste of this tuna.

These tuna kits are perfect to bring to work for lunch or to just keep around for an emergency snack.  You will WANT to eat them, they are so good.  The spice is noticeable but not burning, a perfect amount of kick for me.  When you open the can I recommend taking the pepper sitting on top and grabbing it on the pointy end and squeeze it so that the insides squirt out into the tuna, then toss the pepper skin.The only problem is that the kit is overpriced on amazon right now.. They go for $1.51 at target right now.  I want to buy bulk, but there needs to be a discount over the grocery store!

I thought I was eating my grandmother's Fettucini Alfredo - really. And the portion? I never realized that an aportioned size could fill me up so well! Thank you MedifitNY - you showed me an entirely new way to eat!

column9: Chex Mix Muddy Buddies pack of 7
column10: Muddy Buddies was a real life saver.  Not kidding.  My father was in an assisted living home and when he would not eat I would bring out the Muddy Buddies and he would say I will only eat one.  That was ok because then he would eat another and another.  They have both the sweet and and salty which helped a lot.  He would eat at least a handful and then we were able to get a meal down him.  Thanks Muddy Buddies you really were a life saver.  I think I cleaned out all of the stores in the area.

Came very quick!! Thank you very much.  They tasted great!! Muddy buddies are my 3 yr old sons favorite guilty pleasure. I use to purchase them at Costco but they discontinued this item. So I just check on amazon and you guys had them. I was so excited. Woot woot. They were packaged in small bags which was perfect!! Thank you. Will keep shopping from you guys. They arrived really quick too. '

I am so glad to have discovered these! They are my favorite sweet/ salty snack and totally addictive. Even better when you put them in the refrigerator. I can luckily find these at my local grocery store. Thank you Chex! These are AWESOME!!!

Chex Muddy Buddies are just what you need to cure a sweet tooth! They're crunchy, sweet and chocolatey! Buying them premade saves me a bunch of mess in the kitchen and the product is just so much more consistent than what I can make at home. I could eat the whole bag!
