There is no doubt that this Starbucks coffee is better tasting but it is a too expensive when drinking 4-5 cups a day.Recommended for the flavor (5 stars) but not at the retail price (3 stars).CFH

I find this kcup to have a bad aftertaste. It is fairly strong, and I do primarily drink strong coffees. I much prefer the Tullys French Roast.  If you can pick this up on sale they are worth a "shot".
I bought this, because it came out to around 58c/K-cup for Starbucks.  I would not pay $1/cup, but this was a great deal.
My fav is french roast, I mix with the semi sweet chocolate syrup and poor over ice then add up to 1 cup of milk for an iced mocha...... delicious!!
Love, love Starbucks French Roast K cups. Wish I had an endless supply of them. We use about 4 a day so we need a large supply. We love them. The flavor is so rich and satisfying.

I have purchased these 3 or 4 times by now in bulk.  It tastes just like a starbucks cup of coffee, and cost about the same per cup.  Other places bj's, sams club online k-kup sales companies sell the same product at about20 bucks cheaper.  I will continue to purchase this product but not through amazon.
I feel guilty for spending a dollar per  k-cup every time I order these.  But.... I truly love this product and will keep buying as long as I can afford it!
Good stuff!  Almost a buck a cup, but cheaper than buying a cup from the coffee house and I get drink one of my favorite coffees.

I was so disappointed when I tried my new Keurig.  The coffee was weak and some of it tasted like bad diner coffee.  The Starbucks French Roast k-cup saved it for me.  Flavorful, strong without bitterness or "diner" taste.  I brew the 7oz size.For reference purposes my in store drink is a Starbucks Americano.My favorite k-cups are:Starbucks French RoastStarbucks Caffe VeronaStarbucks Pike Place RoastGreen Mountain Xtra Bold Sumatran ReserveGreen Mountain Double Black DiamondGreen Mountain RevvGreen Mountain Dark MagicOther k-cups I've tried:  Coffee People Jet Fuel ,Green Mountain Dark Magic Decaf, Emeril Jazzed up Decaf, Starbucks Caffe Verona, Coffee People Black Tiger,  Starbucks House Blend, Starbucks Breakfast Blend, Starbucks Sumatra, Wolfgang Puck French Roast, Green Mountain Lake and Lodge, Green Mountain French Roast, Caribou Mahogony, Wolfgang Puck Sumatra Kopi Raya, Emeril Big Easy Bold
If you like coffee that is flavorful, dark, and somewhat strong, this coffee is spectacular. I have tried numerous dark coffees and this is the best.

column9: High price BUT a great cup of coffee...
column10: Simply the best K-cup I've sampled so far (and I've sampled many).  If you like bold, rich coffee than you should definitely try this one. When it comes right down to it, it's still cheaper than buying a cup of coffee outside of the home (even at a donut store) so I don't see the price as that exorbitant. Sometimes quality comes at a price.

The best K-Cups I have tried so far.  Others have said they like Newman's Own, but that this Starbucks Dark French Roast is better and I have to agree.  A bit stronger than Newman's.  I just purchased this 54 pack, but I have already went through a couple of 12 packs (not beer :-) .  I also recommend the TAZO Green Tea.

Amazed at how much I got for the small price. Best coffee I've tasted for the Keurig machine if you like, bold dark flavor in your coffee. Had the order within a week--Highly Recommend!! I just ordered another box!

This coffee tastes like chocolate that's gone bad.  It's overpriced and just not very good.  Starbucks has always over-roasted their beans.  I guess if you like that then you might like this coffee.  To my tastebuds however, it was just bitter and gross with a weird off-taste that left me making faces long after the cup was gone.Also, to all the reviewers who are saying that this was finally a strong k-cup, I say bah.  There are many other brands that make a cup just as strong but much better tasting.  This was just swill.  Bitter gross swill.If Coffee People still made their french roast I wouldn't have even bothered putting this in the brewer.  San Francisco Bay Coffee One Cup for Keurig K-Cup Brewers, French Roast, 36-Count is my current favorite for my Keurig.  It's so much cheaper than a Starbucks k-cup.  But even if it weren't, it's still a better cup of coffee.Don't waste your money.  Overpriced and over-roasted equals bad coffee.

This bag of coffee was not fresh. There is no aroma, or fresh test in this coffee. I always buy coffee online, from Starbucks and other companies, usually they are great. This wasn't a good experience. i wish i bought one pound bag.

I was very disappointed in this coffee, as I really wanted a good organic Italian coffee to replace my favorite yet non-organic staple. Although it may be a little darker in color than traditional medium roasted coffee, the flavor was very "green" tasting. It lacks the robust flavor of a true Italian roast, compared to an unknown brand I had at the home of a very traditional NY Italian family, and the non-organic Italian roasted beans which I normally get at a well-known coffee chain. I ordered ground by mistake, then whole bean, but plan to give away all of what I have left, as the taste simply falls flat.
These Matzos are full of flavor. You can taste the "everything" listed. They're great for dipping as well.

We have bought Manischewitz for over 20 years and they make a superior product. I would recommend them over and over for their matzo and other products. However, when we ordered this product we ordered it for the Passover holidays and did not receive the product for almost 14 days later. The holy days came and were gone by the time we received the product. I placed an order from another seller at the same time who had run out of the product, bought replacement product and had it shipped before this seller even sent the order confirmation. If you are placing an order 6 months ahead of time then I would recommend this seller.

I ordered a case of 6.  Way too salty and terrible flavor.  I decided to crush them to make matza balls for vegetarian chicken soup.  They simply made me sick.  I trashed the remaining 4 boxes.  Poppy Seed in these "Everything" matzos is not good, because the laxative effect is strong.

My wife, her mom and our kids had never tasted Matzo!  Since it was everything everyone liked some very much and others bot so much but even I have my favorites!  This is the only sensible way to decide which you like best and least!  I grew up on Matzo so I love it all!
Lots of flavor. But mine are way too salty for some reason. So I ordered the UNSALTED MATZOS which I think I will like much better.
My diabetic husband likes these crackers an awful lot.  I find them good, also.  They are also good crumbled in soup or with peanut butter or jelly on them.

The deer in my area (private land in the south western part of virginia) really like this product. I poured it out once in front of a trail camera and the deer activity remained fairly constant at the location for 2 weeks. They scraped the first 2-3 inches of soil off trying to get to it. I poured it out again when the acorns started falling and there was probably 50% less activity at the site but, they were still visiting the site. Because these are not farm country deer and reside mostly deep in the mountains, I will continue to use the product to provide the deer with minerals they would otherwise have a difficult time locating naturally and because they apparantly like the taste/smell because they usually find it the same day I put it out. Not to mention, it's much easier to carry up the mountain than a 50lb sack of corn.

column9: Great for a low carb, low calorie diet!
column10: These are the best tasting treat or in my case, breakfast! I feel like I'm eating a cinnamon bun.  I'm on a low carb, low fat and very low cal diet, and I enjoy these when I have a sweet tooth craving.  The cinnamon adds a very nice flavor and it's chewy enough to savor.

These bars should be listed as candy rather than a snack bar. The fact that they have a tiny bit of oats in them didn't make up for all the gooey caramel and the overly sweet taste of the sugar substitute. If you want a snack bar that's low in sugar, I recommend Glucerna's chocalate crisp bars or one of their other flavors.
WAY TOO SWEET, WHICH MEANS THEY USED TOO MUCH SWEETENER. OF COURSE JUST MY OPINION.ALL I COULD TASTE WAS SWEET NOT CHOCOLATE AND OTHER INGREDIENTS.LOVE LOVE RUSSELL STOVER , BUT NOT THIS ONE.

column9: tea for 2 or tea for you
column10: Excellent tea.  Well worth the price.  Seems quite exotic with the rose buds and rose hips and other spices.
Everything I have bought from this brand was wonderful : tamari soy sauce, applesauce, crackers, bread, and something else...everything is tasty, organic and has very few ingredients.

I had never used Tamari before, so I had nothing to compare it with except regular soy sauce. I needed it for a particular recipe, and I was pleasantly surprised how many other uses I found for it. I was delighted with this product.

...a fun, delicious way to get the great taste of garlic, and it's health benefits, in soups, salads, omlettes, sandwiches, etc.  My husband and I enjoy the crunchy little gold nuggets with the mild, just-right flavor of garlic.  They add just the right kick to any favorite dish.  Enjoy!
These garlic nuggets are much better than ordinary dried minced garlic.  They're light and crispy, and mild enough to sprinkle directly on salads or pasta--the jar was gone within a week!

column9: Garlic Gold Nuggets - Super crunchy and Yum!
column10: They are the best!  I love garlic and Garlic Gold has a great line out there.  I popped some of the nuggets (more like mini-nuggets) into my hand when I got the jar and wow - great stuff!  I use this in so many recipes from stir fry, to sauces, to meats, it is just very versatile!  Share one with a friend, they will be hooked too!  Wish you could mix and match the 3 types instead of needing to buy 6 of each type though.
This is such a surprise.  We use it on salads & such.  Wow at the garlic taste.  Light & crunchy.  As long as everyone has your breath will be fine.  hehe

I love this product. I originally bought it to put in dipping oil for bread (like Macaroni Grill). But I have since sprinkled it on everything like salad, cous cous, vegetables etc. I also bread chicken with these and panko bread crumbs. They have a good little crunch and hold up well to moisture. The flavor is subtle not over powering garlic. They are light enough that they actually stick to food instead of falling to the bottom and being wasted. Love them. With a six pack I end up just sending home a jar with friends.
Order came promptly. We love this easy way to make a flavor addition to a number of our foods. Will likely try other products from this line. The food bloggers were right, very yummy.
A friend gave me a container of Rinaldo's Organic Gold to try -- and I loved it!  So, of course, had to stock up with my own stash.  Very good on salads, with the crisp and the garlic.

Wellness makes really good, healthy cat food. My cats really like this food, and I like that its really healthy for them and is made with high quality materials. I believe that if cats eat healthy, high quality cat food, they will have less medical problems and live longer. I think the phrase "we are what we eat" applies to all species.

All in all this is an excellent product.I've only been using it for a short time but not only are my cats trimmer, but they also seem noticeably more energetic. I've also noticed that the shedding is getter quite a bit better, which is wonderful! When you own two cats, the cat hair problem can get a little bad.It did take them a few days to get used to the food. This is probably because just like my kids they prefer junk food!But if you take it slow and mix the old food with the new for a while, they will adjust without having an upset stomach and getting to upset about the dietary change. And even though it's a little more expensive than the Purina that I was previously feeding them all of the benefits in my opinion outweigh the cost.
The cat with hairballs gets them less with this food.  It seems filling, because both cats eat less of it than the prior food.

column9: Wellness cat dry and wet food
column10: Wellness Complete Health Deboned Chicken, Chicken Meal & Rice Recipe Dry Cat Food (12-lb bag)My cats began to loose hair! At the end, they were totally bold! I had three bold cats and I did not know what to do to help them. I spent thousands of dollar to vets to figure out what was wrong, some said mange, some said flea allergy! A friend of mine suggested to change their food to Wellness. Since then their hair grew back, they became normal looking cats again. Nothing was helpful for them but Wellness dry and can food.

In one hour you can have homemade soup, and no prep is needed.  The seasoning packet covers the spices.  How much easier can it get?  This is healthy for you, and contains protein and barley.  Everything in one bowl!
Never seem to be able to find Sweet Cinnamon in local stores.  Buying in larger quantities is the way to go!

column9: The best Cinnamon gum on the market
column10: I love this gum.  Stride Cinnamon is hard to find in the stores.  I don't know why, because it is the best out there.  It is not hot like some, it is just right.  I buy on Amazon, so I can buy in bulk and get a better price per pack....plus no tax and free shipping!!!

After Altoids made the silly business decision to no longer produce their version of a cinnamon gum (which, in my opinion at the time, was the best on the market), I had to look for another alternative.  I found a worthy substitute with Stride Sweet Cinnamon gum.  Tastes great.  The flavor lasts as long as it should and it doesn't turn into a rock within the first few minutes of chewing.  Nicely done.  Stride:  stay in business!
Thanks for the order....If you love cinnamon you'll definetly love this gum its a must have.

This barley was purchased for sprouting.  I can only compare it with a purchase from the Sprout House.  This barley is not as vital (lower sprout rate) and seemed dirtier (more loose chaff floating about).  The price was better than the Sprout House so there is your trade-off.
I ordered this for making barley grass for juicing.The seeds are viable and the juice great.Its easy to grow and juice.

I purchased this for beer making. I read the other reviewer's warning but this was the cheapest barley I could find online. The closest place that sales barley is 100 miles away.These are guesses. I'd say only 5% sprouted the 3/4 the length of the actual barley grain. 75% sprouted but didn't make it past 1/4 the length of the grain. The rest didn't do a thing.There goes $40 down the drain. Barley is normally priced at about $12 for a 50 pound bag.

This stuff is awesome, tastes great and though a bit pricey - is worth every penny for what you get by NOT loading up with sodium.  If you are looking for a healthy option, this is it.  One thing missing from the packaging however, is the recommendation to refrigerate it.  I had it in the cupboard and it seems ants love it as much as I do... :(  Keep it in the fridge or in a air tight container.

I am a frequent purchaser of the Plato Salmon Treats which my dogs (as well as neighbors' dogs) love, but the salmon treats are very fishy on the fingers and can't be put in my pocket.  The Duck Strips are chewy and not smelly, so I don't have to wash my hands each time I handle them and I can keep a few in my pocket for an unexpected reward.  Of course, all the dogs love them, too. I highly recommend both of these treats for their quality.  If you love your dogs, these are the treats for them, not wheat-based biscuits.

I love the Plato line of products as they allow me to just mindlessly pick from the line and know that I am feeding something good to my dog(s). As for "Smart Dog Snacks" with Ginkgo Biloba and DHA...I'd better watch out, because my dogs love these treats so much that the treats just may make them smart enough to figure out how to open the "treat cabinet" take the container down and unscrew the lid to help themselves!While the treats themselves look like beef jerky, they are made with all natural, organic ingredients. The dogs don't care what's in these treats, they just know they love them. As I am typing this they are both sitting at attention, staring at me and whimpering while trying to do the Jedi Mind Trick of "you want to give us more Smart Dog Snacks, pick up your hand from that keyboard and reach in the container and hand us more. Do it. Do it now."There's so much junk out there and plenty of junk food that claims to be natural (just like people food) but this stuff is the real deal. Much like the food that I feed to the humans in the family, I know what each of the ingredients are and love that the first two ingredients are duck and brown rice. There aren't cost cutting fillers in these treats; it's a straight up high quality product. As an aside, I've bought from the seller, The Whole Healthy Pet many times, and I am always impressed with the products they carry. Just as I know that I can trust the Plato brand, I know that if a product is being carried by The Whole Healthy Pet, then it is a high quality product and I feel like a good parent getting it for my dogs.
My beagle loves this treat.The texture is like a cookie and is kind of perfect treat to break into pieces, stuff it in a kong toy etc.

I selected the Plato treats due to the natural ingredients. Wow, my pug Ponch LOVES them! I currently have a bag each of the duck, salmon and chicken. When we get home from our walk he runs straight to the kitchen and runs in circles waiting by the fridge for his treats! These are the only treats I'll buy.

My dog underwent allergy testing a month ago to determine why he's was so itchy and losing hair.  He's now having allergy shots and the vet recommended we limit his diet to duck and potato for now.I bought duck and potato biscuits at the pet store but there was nothing on the package that stated where this product was made; although my dog liked them, I was bothered that a smoke flavoring was obviously used.  Then I found duck jerky at the pet shop but it is made in China.  The store clerk said none of the customers had complained about it and my dog seems OK with them but I decided to look aroundI was relieved to find these duck treats as they are made in the U.S.  They arrived yesterday and as soon as I opened the bag, my dog was right there.  His eyes light up when he sees the blue bag and I call these his duck cookies.  My only wish is that these didn't have salt.Just wanted to alert people planning to order these - the first time I ordered these, I bought four bags and all of the bags were fine - however, the second time, I bought two bags and I just noticed that there were a number of strips in the bottom of the second bag that are covered in mold - I had to chuck the moldy ones in the trash (with my dog watching wide-eyed) - so I'm glad this is now available through the subscribe and save program - I hope ordering one bag at a time will avoid the risk of this happening again

I just received the Salmon, the Duck and the Chicken strips.Our JRT is very fussy and horribly spoiled.She turns up her nose and walks away from many treats I've tried.Most of the "organic" or "healthy" treats I've tried haven't won her over.She just had one each of the Salmon, Duck and Chicken and LOVED all of them!I'm thrilled that they are made in the US and contain ingredients I approve of.Thank you Plato and Amazon!
..my dog has allergies and eats these without reaction!
My Dog loves these, break them in half and make them last twice as long. I highly recommend to everyone, especially those who have dogs that are allergic to chicken.

I purchased these as an alternative to the duck jerky (made in China) that I no longer wanted to feed to my small/medium dogs.  Since one is allergic to chicken my choices are limited.  These arrived today and my 3 dogs sniffed them suspiciously.  I broke them in half for them and they decided to give them a try.  They seemed to like them...they are different then I thought they would be.  They are almost the texture of a soft granola bar and not like jerky at all.  They are about 2" by .5" and the  contents of the bag were not crumbly like some have described.  All in all, I think these will work to replace the  jerky and since they are made and packaged in the US, I feel better about giving them treats.... Oh, and the  cost is pretty good too...

column9: Great product, made in the USA
column10: My boxer has food allergies and I looked all over the internet for duck products. I finally found Platos. She loves them and they are made in the USA. No reason to fear these products. I only buy dog products from the USA, I will not chance my pets life to save a few bucks. Besides, Amazon sells them cheaper than every other site I found them on.

My dog loves these treats and it makes me feel good to know these are made in the USA.  I have made a point to buy dog food and treats that are made here.  In my opinion, better safe than sorry, so if I have to order treats on line I will.
My dogs love these treats and buying them online was much cheaper than retail. However, both bags that I ordered had dry, crumbly treats inside.

Another favorite treat my dogs love.  It is not organic - so I can't give it a 5 star rating - but I am hoping the duck is from a reliable source of humanely farmed U.S fowl.  I care about my dogs health, but I also care about the animals that are the source of protein for my dogs.

Our Boston Terrier loves these strips.  She has food allergies so our vet has her on a strict duck and potato diet.  She doesn't like to have her nails clipped so we reserve these strips as an extra special way of rewarding her for letting us clip her nails.  These strips have worked magic with allowing us to be able to clip her nails.

My border collie adores these. What's not to love? They're more than 90% duck, with brown rice and vitamins. I have to store them out of her reach, otherwise she'd eat the whole bag. They are kind of rich, so it's best to feed them just one or two each day as an extra special treat. Plus, they're made in the USA. Wonderful!

column9: Dog has never jumped this high!
column10: She loves these treats.  The bag seals well and the product seems (smells) fresh. Word one, Word two, Word three?
My dog loves them. He's very picky when it comes to dog food and treats.  He really enjoys them and does all his tricks to get one.

column9: Excellent treats and made in the USA
column10: I've tried all three (and yes, the Salmon is fishy smelling and a bit greasy) and the dogs love them all. It is hard to find dog treats worth buying that are made in the USA that don't cost a fortune. These are reasonable. Don't be fooled by companies that are based in the US but the actual manufacture is in a country not to be named. I also will buy treats made in Canada. I think most pet stores, including ones like Petsmart and Petco are charging way too much for DOG TREATS. I found mine at a human health food store (Fruitful Yield) and was surprised at the cost. Now I see I can order all three from Amazon, shipped for a comparable price. Just wish I could order items in the US and have them shipped from Amazon to say England or Australia. Would love to easily send these to my friends' dogs.
This is a good product to use if you train with a mix of treats. I just break the treats into smaller pieces and add them to my bait pouch. My dogs seem to like them really well.
My dog is absolutely crazy about these treats, and that they are made in the U.S.A. is just icing on the cake.

column9: very good value for organic treats-good for your pupper
column10: These are very inexpensive at this site because they are usually twice the price in all the typical pet stores you usually go to.  They are an awesome deal for organic.  I try to feed my dog only organic food and treats as close to all organic as I can.  I had a dog that was very young, 2 1/2, and he died from cancer and ever since then, I have been very cautious of what I feed my dog now.  Organic does make the difference and these treats are low in calories so they are a good treat to give your dog if you are trying to control his weight.  You don't have to feel guility giving him/her these treats, they are small and as I mentioned low calorie.  I would reccomend these to any dog owner and I have also purchased the chicken, duck and salmon treats made by Plato, all good choices.  The Salmon ones are very very stinky though, beware of those, good for your dog though, lots of Omega 3's in them.
My very allergic dog loves these treats!  She knows where they are kept and goes right to the spot.  Thanks Plato

These treats are GREAT! My dog LOVES them! They are very healthy and a great snack for her. They are made in the USA and that is very important to me in these times of pet (and human) food recalls. Give them a try, your dog will thank you!

My two Chihuahuas loved "Cadet Gourmet Pet Treats Duck Breast Fillets", the 32-Ounce package I had been buying at Costco.  However, I discovered it was made in China and feared this product could make them sick or cause death.  So I started searching for a company in the USA that made dog jerky treats.  I found Plato Natural Duck Strips and ordered a bag.  This product does not look like or smell like duck jerky strips.  My Chihuahuas sniffed it and just walked away.  It doesn't even smell like duck.  Rather, it smells somewhat fishy.  A waste of my money!

column9: These are duck chunks not strips
column10: My darling dog can only eat duck snacks, she is allergic to everything else. I had ordered Plato duck strips before and they are excellent. (Seriously, is there anything a dog won't eat?) But these are CHUNKS, thus the FOUR stars instead of five. They are about 2 inches long and an inch wide, preformed snacks. The Plato strips I bought before were duck strips, not preformed. Of course she loved these but they are covered in a bit of "duck dust" for lack of a better term, so I didn't like to handle them as well as strips. Shipping was quick. The packaging says that these are made in America, important to me. If I am going to pay premium prices for dog snacks, I don't want to kill her with Chinese products! If you asked her, she would give them FIVE stars, because they smell "duckier".

column9: Paws Up for these Pricey Treats!
column10: These are expensive (I would guess the 24 oz pkg contains maybe 20 sticks), but you can cut or break them in half (harder to break smaller pieces off) to make them last longer.  They're a huge hit with our two big guys - have to admit I was shocked at how quickly our big dog consumed one when we first opened the package!  I like varying protein source, so they split one each morning along with a mix of other snacks - it's a real treat for them, and Made in USA is a BIG plus for me as "Mom."
my dog has allergies and this product was a great treat to give him that does not contain by products or preservatives.
Pricey, but my dogs love it and it's a great training aid. I cut them into smaller pieces and use them for blackmail, or training, depending on how you look at it.

I purchased the Plato Duck Strips for my 12 1/2 year old Golden Retriever.  They are chewy, but not hard, for her old worn down teeth and low in calories as she is less active now due to arthritis.  I was very pleased to find them available at a good price through Amazon.  Thank you.
Our dog loves this line of treats.  He tends to be a meat eater and doesnt like cookie based treats.  He loves these treats in all of the flavors but esp duck and salmon.
My dogs love these, I feel good about giving them these treats as they seem to have quality ingredients. If you want to give your dog a special treat, get some!

I got these from my local pet store, where they carry quality items (made in USA, no grain fillers, etc.).  I brought my pooch in one day for his regular food and the shop owner gave the pooch two of these.  Needless to say, I am a sucker for my pooch so of course I bought them.  After my dog had one of his legs amputated due to bone cancer, I switched from the common store brands to higher quality items like this.  I have noticed a marked improvement in my dog's overall recovery.  Even if your dog isn't suffering any kind of terminal illness, I recommend that you consider these sticks.

column9: Have I tried these myself? No...
column10: ...but the way my dogs almost take my hands off when I offer these to them says it all. They like these. They REALLY like these. (I know, dogs will eat anything, but mine are a little fussy. They are INSANE about these.)

Dogs love it. Trying out the Chicken next, but they had the salmon and this too; like clockwork there they are sitting motioning their eyeballs to where it is kept. They never done this for treats before!
but he won't got near these treats. i'm so sad because i have a large package of them. my chuggle/puggle put one in his mouth and spat it out. again, sad.

column9: Niether a ChickenStrip  nor a Chicken Jerky ( or Duck Jerky)
column10: This product is more of a crumbly cookie.  My beagle ate it for a few days and then refused them.  I thought that his digestive system was a bit disrupted by this product, as well.  Of course, I cannot say for sure that these treats were the cause of his upset...perhaps my beagle can.  Anyhow, I will not be repeating this order.

column9: My toy doggies enjoy these rolls
column10: Our family has two Yorkies and a Chihuahua.  They are not aggressive chewers so these treats are perfect.  I just snap each one in half for a serving.  They are a good value.  These treats were very fresh!  I first got them in a specialty pet boutique and I had to saw through them with a sharp knife to break in half!  I thought that was normal until I got the big container from Amazon.  Very fresh and easy to snap for smaller treats.  I will buy these again.

I ordered four containers and two were fine, but the other two were not. The bad treats had  a greasy coat on the sticks and when I tried to split the treats in half, they crumbled and fell apart. I am debating on whether to purchase another container because they are much cheaper online, but prefer the consistent quality of the retail store in my neighborhood.
Dear Sir,I think this product is great and my dogs go crazy for this product and I am just going to order more.Carl

These treats are the worst I have ever encountered. Yes, they are natural, but good? No.  They are dry as hell and I liken them to particle board because of the way they shred and crumble. I would choke if I had to try to swallow these dried up things.  Nothing about them resemble duck meat. My dogs wouldn't eat them, and one of them would pretty much eat anything. Would not recommend these at all.
These are in no way 'strips', they're actually medium size nuggets which are not even chewy but more like biscuits.  My Golden does love them, hence the 3 stars, but the name is extremely deceptive.

The duck sticks were old, greasy and had a rank smell.  The container had a US flag sticker on the lid.  My dog really likes the Tinker duck treats, but I wouldn't give her these.  I hope Amazon finds a different supplier.

This is an easy review because the judgement was made by our two papillons.  They live for their treats and are NOT especially picky about treats.  These items are dried, uniform in size, and although they may be "organic" they smell bad and my dogs would have nothing to do with them.  I threw them out and wanted to share the expensive experience with others so they would not waste their money.

Not knowing this was a Kraft Foods brand, we bought this in Paris and brought it home to the US. It is one of the best whole bean coffees we have ever had. I just wish our local stores sold it.Not too bitter, with a very complete taste. I like more flavorful, and he likes bitter - we both loved this coffee. Highly recommended.

Came across this coffee in a hotel in Kazakhstan during a business visit. Really enjoyed it ,but it is not available in Australia to the consumer. Found it on Amazon, and now have it every morning.If you like coffee with real "guts" and a bit of flavour but none of that bitterness, this is the one.

We have tried many coffees and a number of home coffee makers but have  been unable to brew anything to match the quality of the coffees we enjoy in our favorite restaurants. But this morning we tried the Carte Noire given us as a Christmas gift. What a delightful surprise. It has that "blackness" that we associate with good coffee but none of the bitterness. It is unquestionably the best coffee we have ever made at home. And with a small addition of Irish Creme syrup (another Christmas present), it was simply quite wonderful.

I found Carte Noire in France in 1993 and started bringing packages back with me three or four times each year.  What captured my attention so firmly?  What makes this coffee so great?It is unusual simply because: (1) It is 100% Arabica; (2) It is 100% Colombian.  (3) It is roasted by the French.  There is only one other coffee with this particular rare pedigree, and it is good, but not quite as good as Carte Noire.  Amazon's ad terminology calls this an after dinner coffee.  I disagree with them.  We have always used it exclusively in the morning, as do the Europeans who value its rich taste.This coffee is bold but not overpowering.  It avoids giving you a thin or a bitter coffee taste.  One package of 250 grams (very finely ground) will last for exactly five days when brewed in a 12-cup pot.  My coffee philosophy is this:  If you're going to drink coffee, buy and drink the best one you can find anywhere.  This is it.  I wouldn't lie about something this important.

I haven't ordered this from Amazon, but can certainly vouch that this coffee is without a doubt the best! It is a pity that it should be so pricey online while you can get a three pack in a regular supermarket in France for less that 10 euros.  Quite shameful, really...

My wife and I found this coffee in France during a "coffee buying spree".  We bought a little of everything and enjoyed them through out the year.  One of the more inexpensive brands (in France) is Carte Noire.  It might be common coffee in France, but to us it was the absolute best.  We order several each year.  I'm the hit with my fellow adults when I bring it to a Boy Scout camp out. My fellow adults even pout when I run out.This is some great stuff and the seller does a nice job in shipping it.  Be aware that sometimes it is out of stock, so you might join us and order a few and stock it up in the freezer.

While in France this year, we were drinking this brand of coffee every day for two weeks and very happy to have found that it was available here.  It's a great coffee, bold, rich, great aroma and very French.  The shipment came in perfect order and faster than quoted.  Over all, very please with vendor and of course, love the coffee.  Recommend it to all coffee drinkers.

During the winter of 2008 I lived in Paris, surviving on very little money. Carte Noire was the cheapest coffee in the Monoprix supermarket, costing perhaps 2 euro. That stuff rocked--it shames every American brand. Ironic that here it's pretty pricy.
I had this coffee during my trip to Paris, it was very good. I bought this coffee but it was not fresh or had the same aroma as the one I had in Paris, I don't think I will buy it again.
Great coffee always! I knew it since I tried it long time ago in Europe. I want to try whole beans because since instant is so good, the whole beans should be excellent.

Have traveled the world and tasting coffee for over 52 years; have been a Carte Noir lover for a long time. Great to have it available in the USA. If there is a better coffee somewhere out there, I'd sure like to try it.

We became addicted to Carte Noire while living in Paris.  It is available through Amazon and others as individual serving pods for Tassimo machines, also.  Which was the main reason we bought one of those, when we returned to the U.S..  Now, if we could just transplant our favorite cafe, too....Quel bonheur!!!

These candies rock!  I am totally addicted to these.  When I open a bag of these they are usually gone with a half hour because I can't stop.  I can't explain it either.  I'm not a big cola drinker, not a big soda drinker at all but I love the taste of these.  Maybe that's why I like these.  I get the cola taste anytime without having to drink it.  I don't know.  But like I said, I'm addicted and I would recommend these to everyone.  Haribo makes some other wonderful candies also.  Their pink grapefruit slices are sooooo good!  When I was on Lipitor I couldn't have pink grapefruit but the grapefruit slices satisfied my craving for it!  So by all means, pick some of their candy up!  They rock!

I like their original gummy bears so much that I grab a pack of this to try.  Not disappointed at all.  You can really taste the cola flavor on this bottle shaped candies.  It is not too sticky that it glues your teeth together; although a bit on the rubbery side.  Not too sweet neither. Just the right combination of flavors to taste.  .  From the biggest gummy bear manufacturer in the world (Haribo - based in Germany).Just FYI: 5 oz bag has 3.5 servings, with each serving at 140 calories, 10% carbo, 21g sugar, and 3g of protein. A serving is about 17 pieces of gummies.

column9: Bet you can't eat just one.
column10: Delicious and addictive. Those are the two best words I can use to describe these excellent cola flavored treats.

My love of Happy Cola is not the slightest bit healthy.  In fact, if you look at the nutrition facts for Happy Cola (not recommended), Happy Cola is not the slightest bit healthy.  I'm pretty sure each individual delicious chewy cola is like 290 calories.  When you finish the bag, you better plug in P90, or you are totally f'd.  These delicious cola-flavored chewables are not for amateurs.  I'm pretty sure they should be left for 12-year-olds with unlimited metabolism, but I've always had a rebellious side.This is my favorite item in the Haribo product line.  That hint of cola-flavor (is it Pepsi or Coke?  I'll never know) is exactly what I need in my life.  When you need a change-up I recommend going crazy with the Haribo Gummi Candy, Fizzy Cola, 5-Ounce Bags (Pack of 12) which is a totally different experience.In other news, if you do Subscribe and Save at around $1.00/bag, you are saving at least $0.29 per unit versus purchasing at over-priced New York City bodegas.  I love per-unit savings almost as much as I love calling in sick and playing golf.  What, no one else does that?5 stars, easy.

Order arrived promptly via Amazon Prime, but the Happy Colas were very stale.  The gummies in every pack were hard as rocks.  Ordered Gold Bears as well.  Gold Bears were fresh.  Better quality control is necessary.

column9: Hard to find in stores, Great stocking stuffers
column10: These tasted great. I don't really buy them often, but I'm glad I was able to buy them off from here. I think the price is fair and since they are 12 packs, it's easy to share them.

I love all of the Haribo flavors, but this has to be my favorite.  The consistency is a little denser than other gummi candies - which I really like.  This flavor tastes like cola (with a touch of caramel) which has helped me cut back on my soda intake.

This has been a surprising taste treat for our whole family.  While I don't think these taste like something similar I remember eating a few years ago (but who can trust that kind of memory?), I do think they are really good.  And so does my husband and 3 kids!  Very good product.
I highly recommend this product if you like gummy candy that is sugary and sour tasting.  This product has a wonderful cola taste and a fantastic fizz!
My whole family loves gummy bears and of course we feel Haribo is the best!!
I didn't think it tasted very much like cola, rather, it tasted like some type of fruit.  It was harder than I expected too.

column9: I don't know what all the fuss is about...
column10: These are ok. The best way to describe the taste is that they taste like pepsi cola that's gone flat. They're not terrible but they also aren't that great.
Great tasting!  perfect for taking to the movie theater or enjoying a bag at home or work
My twins picked a bag of these up in a recent shopping excursion, didn't like them, and gave them to their Papa... Now, I can't stop snacking on them, a huge bag, please, send help...
Great price on a great product.  If you love gummi candies, you would love this one.
if your looking for cola candy, you've found what your looking for. its the best.

column9: Not as gummi as other brands
column10: I love gummi coke bottles and prefer them over choclate.  I have always got mine in bulk from a store called Henry's which recently stopped selling them.  So I tried the Haribo and was very disappointed in the several bags I have tried.  The candy was stiff and actually required severe chewing to the point that my jaw got tired.  The taste was there it just was not as soft as other brands and there was no way you could pull a bottle apart with your hands like other brands I have tried.

column9: A simple pleasure that belongs on any office desk, Happy-Cola Gummi Candy!
column10: These bottle shaped candies are clear at the top and dark brown at the bottom. They are rather chewy, you can give them a generous bite unlike your standard gummy bear that is soft when chewed, falling to pieces in your mouth. While not exactly like a Coke, the candy does have that distinctive kick. I guess I just like the sensation of chewing up my cola rather than drinking it.Product TestingIn the interest of science, I threw several candies at coworkers, doors, walls, old computer cases, monitors, desks and nerdy programming books in attempt to break them. They did not. Gummi colas do exhibit strange bouncing properties when placed on spinning CD-ROM's. The slightly sticky surface gives them enough traction to fly at an alarming speed. Research was abruptly stopped when I discovered my manager does not approve of food testing without prior FDA approval.Gummi Candy CharacteristicsBought 6/2008, my bag has an expiration date of 5/2009. While this bag will not last that long in my sugar craving hands, I think this is an amazing amount of time for a product made of the following ingredients: Corn syrup, Sugar, Gelatin, Dextrose, Citric Acid, Caramel Syrup, Starch, Artificial and Natural Flavors, Fractionated Coconut Oil, Carnauba Wax, Beeswax CoatingEach bag has about 30 pieces of gummy coke pleasure tipping the scales at 5 ounces or 142 grams. 10 pieces register as follows on the ole nutrition scale: Calories 150, Total Fat 0G, Sodium 0G, Carbohydrate 34G, Protein 3GThis product is Gluten free and Casein free. A diet without these products eliminates the intake of naturally-occurring proteins: gluten(wheat and barley) and casein(in milk). Among others, the Autism Research Institute recommend the diet as a treatment for autism and similar conditions.

I met my wife in Peru in early February of 2007. I was searching for a soda (I've never been a fan of Coke or Pepsi) and Inca Kola looked a lot like Mountain Dew. It's not a thing like Mountain Dew. It's far sweeter, and far more delicious. In about a week I'd probably drank 3-4 gallons of it while I was in Peru. Very very very few places in the states offer Inca Kola though, and this is a very good price for it. It arrived in excellent condition and very thoughtfully packed from this seller, not only would I heartily recommend Inca Kola, I'd also recommend Mexigrocer!
My husband is from Ecuador and loves this stuff. He's limited his intake of soda, but he says this if worth every penny to get it shipped to the States.
I tried Inca Kola on a trip to Peru a couple of years ago.  You'll never forget it's unique taste.  It's worth a little bit of indulgence to bring this unique Peruvian flavor into your home.
Any soda that has me paying more to ship it than the soda itself HAS to be good!  It is very sweet and looks radioactive, but my kids love it and it reminds us of our trip to Peru.

The Inca Kola is better than Coca Cola for sure. At least in Peru, since I was born there, I had been drinking it all my life and we all Peruvians know the difference between both sodas. Inca Kola seems to keep you happier than Coke. So for regular occasions drink Coke but for the special occasions Inka Kola is the answer. That's why now even Amazon sells it here. Whow! looks pretty demanding by now.

Very good soda . I add a little club soda to it . I mix it about 2/3 soda to 1/3 club soda and find it perfect .Now I get it at a spanish supermarket, 1.99 for a 2 liter to save quite a few bucks. Enjoy!!!!

column9: Unique, worth trying at least once
column10: This is a unique soda pop, I'm not quite sure I've had one like it before.  For the record I've never been to anywhere in Latin America, just the States and Canada.  Anyway, it is very much worth trying at least once.  Some people describe the flavor in reviews as like bubble gum, I'd say that close but there's something else there too.  For something as "simple" as soda pop the flavor is very subtle.  It is VERY sweet though, not sure if my bottle uses sugar or corn syrup (the ingrediants on the bottle I got says either High Frutose Corn Syrup or Sucrose was used) but regardless, it is very sweet, probably up to the level of Jolt way back when they still used cane sugar if not more.  It's not something I'd want every day, I'd grow tired of it, but that is probably true of almost anything.  But it is a nice unique treat to try, and despite the price and shipping (It was packed very well as an aside, and shipped quickly so I don't think the shipping was overpriced considering that) I know I'll order it again when the mood hits to have this.

I consider it one of the best soft drinks I have ever had. In Peru, this is often referred to a kids drink. Tourists seem to gravitate towards it. It is extremely sweet and has a distinct bubblegum flavor with a hint of banana in my opinion.As far as the product received from the shipper (MexGrocer), I'm pleased. It was packaged extremely well. As expected it had some loss of carbonation as it traveled a considerable distance. Still great stuff.Thanks Amazon and MexGrocer!

I bought this soda because I heard it was very popular in south america and wanted to try it.  I enjoyed the strong scent and fairly strong flavor and would def. have it again.  I wish they sold it in nor. american supermarkets

column9: Taste it while it is COLD
column10: You have to drink it cold. Drinking Inca Kola is like drinking beer, it has to be cold. The magic is in its taste at a low temperature.If you are tasting it while it is not cold you would not like it. I believe bad reviews come from people who are drinking it while it is not cold.Give it a try!

column9: Taste the original of Inca Kola
column10: I love this soda!!!! Have you ever been to Peru? Well if you have you'll know about Inca Kola. Tried it and you won't be disappointed.
I think this is too sweet but maybe I will give it another try sometime.

column9: Great Flavor but Bottle Top Hassle
column10: I used it in a Moqueca which is a Brazilian Fish Stew, and it was very delicious. The problem I had was with the bottle top. The recipe called for 1/4 c of the oil. Unfortunately, I was unable to remove the plastic top which does not unscrew.  It just has a flip top cap with a single hole in it and ended up just shaking it by drops into the measuring cup which was messy and a hassle.
I had never heard of Dende Oil before I read a recipe for Braziliam Fish Stew.  I had to make it authentic so ordered it from here!! So glad I did as it made the dish!!! It's really awesome!

I have ordered this product in the past. I must say it is excellent. However I am surprised to see the price hike. Once you add shipping, it is just ridiculous. Swiss Miss makes a sugar free hot chocolate mix that can be purchased at Walmart for a fraction of the price.

Ordered them for my sister's birthday. The actual clams were excellent but shipping was by necessity VERY expensive. That's because they fedex overnight with ice. To be most cost effective get a group together and order a lot and split the shipping.

column9: All Natural big pieces with no added sugar
column10: I was nervous buying this at first because the description was a bit vague with a bad picture, but when I received the box I discovered HUGE pieces of all natural papaya which are not at all like the store bought kind.  It comes in a plastic bag in a box about the size of a shoe box.  This is pure dried papaya and it's a bit leathery, very colorful and flavorful almost like apricots, whereas the stuff you get in stores is more like candy, added sugar and SO2, and has a lot of water weight.  Highly Recommended!  I am uploading a picture.

I purchased this server so I could have my Caviar parties in style. It makes me feel elegant to serve out of this lovely glass bowl. The ice keeps the caviar cold and it looks just great. I would recommend this lovely server to anyone. Another great product from Amazon.
The sprinkles were delivered today and they are completely melted. The sprinkles are compacted and this is totally not worth the money spend!

Ordered the Pork Jerky and loved, loved loved it!  So I figured this one must be as good as the pork jerky.  Boy, was I wrong.  Much more chewy and really didn't like the mandarin orange flavor, of course I'm not sure I tasted that as much as I felt like I was eating leather.  My cat won't even eat it!  I say skip this one, and save your money, I wish I had.

If your kids like bland pasty mac and cheese, they might like this.  I bought a case and donated the other 11 boxes to the hungry college students down the street.  I looked up the company on the web to complain, and while searching for the name found out that they are part of Kraft.  No wonder.These guys do make cookies however that taste pretty good.  The mac was just not for me.

column9: Try a Box Before Buying a Case - a review of BTN's Mac & Cheese
column10: I like organic. We do organic milk and meat, and vegetables when we can afford the latter. My children like macaroni and cheese - not my homemade casserole, of course (lol), but out of a box. (Reasons for this preference are unknown.)In any case, you would think organic *Back to Nature Macaroni & Cheese* would be popular at our house but it's not. Simple put, my children won't eat it.Perhaps it is because of the lack of chemicals that the cheese sauce comes out a little grainy. Or maybe I just made it wrong, but my testy tikes won't gobble this down like non-organic, over-processed wheat Kraft Mac.Two Stars. Maybe I just had a bad box. Or maybe I just didn't make it right that day, but my two (boy and girl) would not eat this macaroni and cheese product. If you are going to try it (products do get IMPROVED every day) then my advice would be to buy ONE box and try it; and not a case.

column9: Great with a few extra ingredients added.
column10: I am a huge fan of organic foods and have experimented for years on how to get my children to eat things that are better for them. That said, this pasta is as good as any other on the market, but you can make it wonderful just by adding two simple ingredients. After I take the pasta out of the pan to drain it, I add about a tablespoon of light margarine (any soft butter-type spread will work) and about 3 tablespoons of fat free sour cream (you may also use plain yogurt). I whisk the cheese powder into this mixture and then add the pasta back to the mix. My kids finish an entire box EVERY time. Try it!

BTN macaroni & cheese is so much better than any other brand we've tried (regular & all-natural/organic--we've tried many).I usually make mac & cheese from scratch, but this one is great (when I can find it in the grocery store-it's hard to find)!My 3 yr. old son loves it too, he won't eat the other brands.

I highly recommend this product.  My family loves this macaroni & cheese.  It's so much better for you and tastes even better than the chemical-filled "blue box" brand.  Clean your conscience and buy this already :)

We are trying to eat more healthy and organic foods when possible (and in the case of macaroni and cheese, less of the "blue box" that all kids seem to love).  This is a hit with all of my kids and my husband and I too.  Great price also!

Don't buy this if you think you're buying organic macaroni and cheese.  I guess I'm more than shocked about how this is fraudulently advertised on Amazon.com.  In its product features, it says: "Made with organic cheddar cheese."  This is blatantly false.  When you receive the Mac and Cheese, it's packaged in a neat little "Back to Nature" box announcing its support of the Nature Conservancy on the back of the box giving it the veneer of being "natural."  However, if you read the ingredients, not even the cheddar cheese is organic.  There is no organic certifier to be found, either.Now, this actually breaks the National Organic Program standards and should be investigated by the Agriculture Department.  This changes my whole view of Kraft -- not that it was especially good before.  But apparently, this company buys into the "greenwashing" effort to try to cash in on the good organic name without actually supporting the type of food system we expect when we buy organic.
Nutrition facts posted by Amazon list product as organic but it is not USDA organic certified and nowhere on the box is the word "organic" listed.
This is my son's favorite mac and cheese.  It's nice and simple to make, but feels a little less junky than the more familiar brand.

My children are extremely picky eaters, and they like this product quite a bit. I've eaten some as well in a pinch, and while the salt is off the charts, it is tasty.Regarding their truth in advertising: every box of macaroni & cheese in the case we bought contains an envelope of Kraft "white cheese sauce". Which is a bit deceiving considering the "1960 in the back of a small health food store in Pasadena" story they are telling in the product description, and the advertisement of 'real natural' cheddar cheese on the box.If it's a Kraft product, why not disclose this before we've opened the box? What does Kraft have to hide?

This is good macaroni and cheese.  Some other reviews called it gritty but I didn't see this happening (maybe they're not putting in quite enough milk for the powdered cheese to cover the mac).  Probably number 3 out of my top 3.  The #1 is Trader Joes Mac & Cheese, #2 is Annies, and #3 is Back to Nature.

The only reason I did not give this product a five star rating is because the cheese sauce keeps a "cardboardy" type taste.  I am the only one who has noticed this.  This product is rated delicious by a 4 yr old and a 2 yr old!  That alone says a lot.

This is  a good alternative to fake cheese and artificial ingredients and harmful colors.The pasta is not that healthy at all but it is good enough to eat as a treat.We like it to much probably. The same company makes the bad kind too so i hate to support that but  you have to have some fun!

We've tried other brands of organic mac and cheese, but they were grainy and clumpy.  This one was really good.  It didn't clump like the other organic brands of mac and cheese.It tasted like regular Kraft mac and cheese, but without all of the added artificial colors and additives.  Later we found out that it is made by Kraft, that's why it tasted good.  (Like what we ate previous to our transition to organic.)

I just received the 5 bags of OvaEasy today and immediately opened one and made some scrambled eggs.The crystals are a darkish golden color, mix very easily with water. The directions are very simple, mix 3 parts cold water to 1 part OvaEasy and whisk. I was a little worried about the color and that the finished eggs would still be dark gold, but they weren't. This mix cooks up to the closest thing you will ever get to fresh eggs. I made them exactly as I would have fresh eggs. Fried in butter with salt and pepper. You cannot tell the difference.

I am very satisfied with this product and will continue with ordering from Amazon.com. They stay fresh in a used cappuccino plastic container. Keeps the eggs fresh for a good while,and I love the omelets I cook from them. These are good eggs & nice if you don't have a fridge.  You can't go wrong and safe too!

column4: R. Dutch "Lifes great when using your creativ...
column10: We eat OvaEasy in frittatas, scrambled and we use these when we are packing our packaged mixes and meals for camping..Excellent, tastes like fresh eggs for Real...OvaEasy Powdered Whole Egg 1.75 lb

column9: Fishing boat in Alaska loves these!
column10: The captain and crew on our AK fishing vessel love these eggs. They taste great and are super easy to use. Sometimes on a fishing vessel you don't have time or proper conditions for lengthy meal prep, so the OvaEasy whole eggs are perfect for our boat. Love eggs and the nutrition they provide, so the OvaEasy eggs are a great find for us. Glad we bought them. We are planning on ordering more for our next fishing season. Thanks so much for your wonderful product! (P.S. They are also a very tasty item to bring tent camping.)

While not exactly like eggs it is pretty darn close. The main difference between these and eggs I would say is the consistency. If all you are doing is scrambled eggs or baking then it probably won't be noticeable. However, if you were to make an Omelet for example you would likely notice the texture difference. OvaEasy is very consistent both in color and texture, real eggs however are not.Flavor wise they are pretty darn close to real eggs. If you couldn't tell the difference between the texture then you probably wouldn't know the difference. A nice easy measuring spoon of sorts would be nice for cooking purposes so you could easily calculate how many eggs you were making, but I also wonder how accurate their measurement per egg is as well as it does seem a little on the small side.I have not attempted any baking with this yet, but imagine it will work just like regular eggs given how they cook up directly in a pan. The real trick here is going to be in measuring out the correct amount of egg. On a side note, I have found that the shaker bottles work well for mixing up the egg.

If you like pecans, then you'll probably like this. Eating pecan butter even tastes better than just eating whole pecans, in my opinion. This product is raw and organic - which makes the nutrient content even better! :)

Over the past 5-6-years, I have truly enjoyed this seasonal rice for a simple, tasty breakfast. We just moved to Omaha, where I was unable to find the rice locally. After some searching on the web, I located a small supply at Amazon. Thank you, Amazon.The rice will also work in soups, stir frys, and casseroles, but I try to save it for my breakfasts. Just prepare the rice as instructed and keep it in the fridge. Take about 1.5 cups of cold, cooked rice. Put it in a breakfast dish and add some raisins and brown sugar. Stir it up and microwave it for 1 minute. Add some milk to cool it off and enjoy a nice breakfast.

column9: Best rice around - available in two different packagings
column10: Simply delicious!  I now use no other rice but this.  The "Christmas Rice" packaging is not always available, but Lundberg says the Wahini is the same rice, just different packaging.
We really enjoy all the Lundsberg Rice blends and the Christmas rice is no exception.  You can't go wrong,
Well, it's not exactly red but is colorful, and it is a delicious rice. The 1-lb bags are convenient.

This oil looks deep green. It smells and tastes fruity and fresh. This is the first time I have bought any large can. I realy like the pull up spout. It's just like a five gal. paint can spout. I filled my small bottles easily and with out spilling. I am also happy with the value. The only bad thing is my can was very crushed. I'm suprised it did not burst and or leak. I will only buy it again if the packing problems are worked out.

This is the second time I have ordered a gallon of extra virgin olive oil thru Amazon. The big problem was opening the spout. First, the plastic ring was glued down, second it was impossible to pull out the spout after I losened the ring, until I punched a small hole in a corner of the top to allow air to replace the air needed to fill the spout as it was extended.I will go back to Amato next time.

Good everyday olive oil. Good color, good yup-this-is-EVOO flavor.  Nothing remarkable, but an excellent value for the price.  Also, apparently they seem to have improved the packaging since previous reviews were left - it was packed in it's own fitted cardboard box with inserts to keep it still and suspended, inside a larger box with air-padding.  Had a very minor dent.  Pouring was a bit awkward with the spout, but it only dribbled a trivial amount.  Would recommend.
This is a very good oil.  The can was dented, may want to put something around it when you ship it.  The product is a good tasting oil!
Mu sister loved it! Said it looked and tasted great! Great Product! Thank you! Will Def order again! The presentaion was great and also the price was reasonable.

column9: These banana snack pieces are attractive, tasty and are 100% natural and certified USDA organic
column10: This is a great tasting snack that's good for you!The banana snack pieces are attractive.  They look like naturally glazed rounded slices of the fruit.  I find Crunchy N Yummy banana to be the most visually appealing of their 'tropical fruit' snacks.Banana is a rich source of magnesium which is used for muscle tone of the heart and assists in controlling blood pressure.  In general, magnesium is used to relax the muscles.  I call Crunchy N Yummy banana my 'relax snack' :))At only 110 calories per 1 ounce serving, you get the great taste and nutrition of a full serving of banana in packs that I can have on the go! I also use Crunchy N Yummy bananas in my cold cereals, yogurt and ice cream toppings.  The kids love them too! ... that's a plus!These banana snacks are 100% natural and certified USDA organic - just sun ripened and freeze dried banana with no additives.Crunchy N Yummy snacks contain no sulfur dioxide (E220), a food preservative commonly used in dried fruit.  (Some individuals may be sensitive to sulfur dioxide especially in large amounts).Check around ... the price varies on Amazon.Hope my review was helpful ... Jeffrey A. (Jeff)

This is my new favorite snack food for whenever I have a craving for sweets!  There is so much fruit for so little calories.  I love to eat it at night when watching TV and I even bring it to the movies to eat instead of popcorn.  I get all the crunch I love from chips, all the sweetness I love from candy and none of the guilt!  And my kids love it too - win, win, win!

I have tried so many brands of freeze dried fruits, and crunchy y yummy is by far the most delicious one. its is really crunchy and tastes like the real fruit.On top of that, its healthy and super practical to carry around for an anytime snack. I highly recommend!!!

These didn't taste at all like the freeze dried bananas I get at the grocery store. I am a little confused, because both brands list bananas as the only ingredient (no sweeteners, salt or flavorings added).  These taste terrible.  They do not have any banana flavor and there is no natural sweetness to them at all.  I cannot eat them straight from the bag, so I have tried mixing them in with granola and into muffins, but they just taste like a bland, tasteless chip.  I tried giving them to my puppies as treats, and they wouldn't touch them.  What a disappointment. I don't know how you can mess up a product with only one ingredient.

These chips are awesome!  Thin, crispy, lightly salted, and perfectly flavored.  I'd be tempted to eat them if they weren't GMO free, use non-hydrogenated oils, etc.  But they are all of those things, so I go out of my way to eat them.  My favorite tortilla chip ever.

The atomic fireballs are just as good as would be expected.  I did however order the extra large size and received the smaller/regular ones from Bayside Candy hence the three stars.  I didn't want to pay to return 10lbs of candy so I kept them.  Fortunately the fireballs are available from a variety of sources.
It arrived quickly and was very good quality,love the candy ,will buy more!!This was a deal,thank you!Sno-caps have gotten hard to find and we love them.
Chocolate seemed old.  It was powdery on edges and some areas of surface. The chocolate did not seem to be of good quality.
I love this this curry, I make a peanut curry cabbage salad, which has been a hit everywhere I take it.

The intensity of flavor is nearly non-existent.  I don't know if it's the variety of rosemary, how it's processed, the freshness, whatever... it is very, very much weaker then the dried versions at the grocery.Sorry, can't recommend this one.
The title is really it. These peppers are certainly crisp enough, and may very well be exactly what you are looking for. To my taste, though, they are far too sweet.

McCormick is a fine source of spices, but the shelf price in groceries is unbelievable.  This price is not cheap but is less than half, by weight, of what the grocery price would be.

column9: Best Biscuit Flour you can get!
column10: I have use many ready made biscuit flours as well as many attempts to make my own, this is by far the best! Just wish I could get it at my local market!

Lapsang Souchong is my all-time favorite tea, yet it is very difficult to find.  I was unfamiliar with Tao of Tea, but desperate enough to give this a try.  I am extremely pleased with the flavor and the value per price.Normal brewing proportions creates a pleasant, smokey, dark gold result, excellent as either hot or iced tea.  A little more tea to water is my preference, as I like my teas strong.  I've over-brewed twice, yet the results were not bitter, just richer.  Also, you can brew the leaves at least twice and still get the same satisfying result.I'm very, very happy with this tea, and will most definitely order it again.

The Tao of Tea Lapsang Souchong page recommends 1 teaspoon of tea for each 8 ounces of water.  I've been experimenting, and now prefer it a bit stronger, so have been using 6 teaspoons for each 24 ounces of water.  This works especially well when I add a bit of milk afterward.  In some ways, I feel the addition of milk brings out the smokiness even more.At first I was concerned these were packaged in paper bags, compared to the plastic packagedStash Premium Lapsang Souchong Tea, Loose Leaf, 3.5-Ounce Pouches (Pack of 3).  But since the Tao of Tea packs were cheaper per ounce than the Stash Lapsang, I decided to go with the Tao of Tea.  It turns out the Tao of Tea paper bags are lined with plastic anyway.It's my first time buying tea from amazon, and I'm tempted to try some other varieties now.  Also, it's my first time making lapsang souchong at home, rather than having it at a hotel tea.  As someone without a lot of tea knowledge, this was a satisfying product.UPDATE: This tea makes a very pleasant room-temperature or iced drink.  Also, it is very difficult to oversteep, and has never once tasted bitter.  I thought 24 ounces was quite a bit of tea to buy at once, but I'm already almost finished with the first bag!

column9: You either really like it or you don't, but either way you WILL smell like a camping trip
column10: I do really like this tea.  Not my favorite, but it's a really nice addition to the collection as it is so unique tasting.  I don't think I'd drink it exclusively, but very glad I bought it.  Three bags of 8 oz is a LOT of LS tea.  Going to give two packs away with tea infusers as presents.  Will make very nice housewarming / xmas stocking stuffer gifts.

It's one of the mellower Lapsang Souchong teas but it allows for a long steep without turning bitter or acrid. It also holds the smoke smell well. I'd rate it as being a bit bolder than the Adagio LS tea and I am definitely glad I took the risk and got the 3-pack.

I'm a big fan of smoked tea and this brand lacks a strong smoke fragrance and presence. I've brewed it really strong and still found it lacking. On the plus size, it doesn't get bitter when it's brewed so strong. The price is good, also. If you enjoy a very lightly smoked tea than you may enjoy this one. If you like a really strong smoky taste, look elsewhere.
Good price and really fast - all the way from OZ, too!  I'm not an Australian, but learned to love Vegemite while living with them in Indonesia in the early '70s.

I bought some Vegemite to send to friends in Chicago as part of an 'Aussie' gift package to send with my daughter who was staying with them when she came to the US.  For Australians, Vegemite on toast is regarded as one of life's staples.  We eat it for breakfast, after-school snacks and late night suppers.  It's a cure-all when we're sick and great when we're hungover and can't face anything else. One note of caution - Vegemite is not designed to be spread thickly on toast - it has to be spread in a very thin, even layer, otherwise, it's unpalatable. Enjoy!

The Kraft Vegemite definitely tastes better -- it has "depth" of flavor, compared to the other faux Vegemites like Marmite. I spread it on whole wheat matzoh (believe it or not) and love it on roasted unsalted almonds for a really good snack.  I must be the only non-Aussie within 200 miles who has gone through several 220 gram jars of the stuff already! Love it!
For nearly $20 and a photo showing two I thought I was getting two at an AVERAGE price! Very deceptive. If I have made a mistake and another one is on the way... But I don't think so.

Be careful - this is for one small jar - What looked like I was getting two giant jars of Vegemite ended up to be one small jar.  This was purchased as a gift for someone who was a fan of Vegemite... next time I'll just go to the market for a fraction of the price.

I have always heard of Vegemite, from people and a song that mentions it.  I decide to order some and try it.  It actually taste pretty good, I've tried it on crackers and on toast.  I give it 2 thumbs up.
I realize a bunch of people don't care for Vegemite, but I really like it.  It's kind of like a creamy limburger cheese, flavored with beef bullion.
Yeast Extract has an Acquired taste!~ Spread a thin layer w/butter on toast. Reminds you of the after'taste of beer!~

I like my tic tacs powerfully flavored and the cherry passion pack has two terrifically intense flavors.  The wild cherry are wonderful and the passion fruit are delicious, making this combination wonderfully delicious.

I'm overjoyed with the advent calendars! They're adorable and they have authentic German chocolate--reminds me of home. column9: Like the ones my German Godmother bought for me when I was a kid
column10: As a child, every year my German godmother would give me an advent calendar filled with wonderful chocolates. Now that I have godchildren of my own, I have continued the tradition. Until recently, I have always been disappointed with cheesy, uninteresting artwork and sub-par chocolates from Cadbury's and the like. I was skeptical when buying this from Amazon because it was so much cheaper than other calendars on this site, but boy was i wrong - this could be the same calendar I got as a kid! This is a real German calendar with real German chocolate and an old-timey hand-drawn Christmas scene (it's just printed of course, I don't mean someone drew each box!). I ordered 6 and got 2 different designs. Great stuff altogether - I'll definitely be ordering more next year.

Minor's has changed their soup bases for the worse increasing the salt and starch filler at the expense of flavor.  I bought some soup bases a few years ago and especially liked the clam and mushroom bases.  Unfortunately, the manufacturer sent me a promo postcard years later offering free shipping and cheaper prices if I ordered directly so I ordered a bunch and the only tolerable one was the low sodium chicken.  This mushroom base is useless and you will taste acrid saltiness before you ever taste mushroom.  I use it in lieu of salt (with the bonus of an msg quality) in oatmeal, teff flour, ground beef and ginger pieces for a not quite Cream of Mushroom Soup stand-in.

Thought it would be more inclined toward the mushroom concentrate than any other thing. So when I started the water and put an average amount, the kind I would use on other base products, I was startled by the amount of salt I found myself tasting. Yes, if you use a much smaller quantity it does have its redeeming quality but, really, if I wanted so much salt on a base I would have ordered Salt Base. It works in small amounts and do not get me wrong: I am a dedicated fan of Minor's products but while plenty of others are above average on taste this one exceeds the allotted salt limits. I remember having to amplify my creation by a ratio of ten more cups of water to lessen the salty taste. Somewhere in there, lurking in the broth it made, a mushroom flavor was present. Yes, I agree with the first review (2006) on way too much salt. Therefore, 2 Stars at the most.
have used this product for 20 years. Makes the perfect base for my mushroom and vegetables, pasta soup. Everyone loves it. Great for vegeterians.

I think most Cheez-It flavors are pretty good, but there's something special (and super addictive) about the Cheddar Jack flavor. I've only ever seen this flavor at airports and never in the regular supermarket so I'm glad that it is available here. I like that these are the "grab bag" design because it makes sealing them up after snacking much easier.  My only complaint about these crackers is simply that they exist and that I like to eat them. This is my favorite of the Cheez-It flavors. I give it five stars. Yes some out there might say that the price may be a little high, but if you factor in the cost of gas to go to the store and back then it hurts a little less in the price. I wish that the company has a low salt variation of this flavor. I also love the Chedder Cheese flavor too. I would recommend this to a friend to give it a taste.

It's smells fruity, has a tangy tropical taste, and just fizzy enough to tickle your nose and delight your palate. It's a fun drink to share with your honey to stir up some romance, turn the love tunes on and see what happens next, bottoms up!!!

It gives a nice uplift of energy and I've not noticed any crash. It doesn't wire you like other drinks, meaning that you can use it for a boost and help focusing on the task at hand, but it won't keep you from sleeping if you're tired and need to rest. column9: Were Great From Amazon; New Vendor Ships Loose, Stale Product
column10: I love these almonds, and for quite a while when I purchased them, they came straight from Amazon.  The price was reasonable and with a Prime membership, they arrived quickly.For some reason, the almonds no longer come straight from Amazon; rather, they come from a vendor I wasn't familiar with.  The price went up and I now had to pay shipping, but I went for it anyway.Big mistake.I was immediately suspicious when the product arrived.  When the almonds shipped directly from Amazon, they came in a sealed box from Emerald Nuts.This vendor threw individual boxes of almonds into another shipping box.Why does that matter?  The sealed case product was of very high quality.  These individual boxes were absolutely terrible and tasted old.This is an educated guess, but my gut feeling is that these were purchased at a discount by the vendor and then sent to customers at full price. At least I hope that's what happened, because these almonds were just awful. Chewy and stale.I miss buying these, but as long as they come from the current reseller at an inflated price, inflated shipping, and inferior product, I will not purchase them again.  If we're ever lucky enough that Amazon starts carrying them straight from Emerald, I'm in.Check the source of the product;  I personally recommend you not buy if they're not shipping directly from Amazon.

Cains Mayonnaise is the best store-bought mayo, period, far superior to the usual national brands. It has a distinct flavour all its own.  I venture to say that it is the Platonic Idea of mayonnaise. It's a pity that it not to be found in New York City.

I have been using Cains All Natural Mayonnaise for at least 20 years. It is the best product out there. Almost all my friends and family request my salads, especially my potato salad. When they ask me why mine tastes so much better than others, I tell them it's because they NEED to start with Cains Mayonnaise. The flavor is perfect and is not overpowered by the taste of lemon or vinegar, like many other mayonnaise products I had previously tried. The texture is creamy and smooth. And I find the opened jar keeps exceptionally well, despite having no preservatives. Even in the winter, when I make less potato salads and cole slaw than I would in the summer, I have NEVER had a jar go bad. It's simply a great product.
Great full flavor tea. Bags are exceptional quality and have not leaked on us yet. Tea/spice pieces are large and identifiable not the dust found in some other bags.

i love this chai tea!!  its really delicious and it doesn't get that burnt taste if you leave the bag in too long.  my husband doesn't even like tea but only requests this specific one.i love the individually packaged bags. worth the price!

column9: Good Chai But Not My Favorite
