These peanuts are delicious and do remind me of Bloody Marys, without the vodka.  Nicely spiced and addictive.  If you like spicy (but not too spicy) peanuts, you will enjoy these!

If you love green olives like I do then these are a must. The garlic & jalapeno bring out the best in the green olive. I was concerned when I first tried them because of the jalapeno in them but it was only a hint and actually made the whole experience better. I was given one jar by my wife at first and after trying them I bought a case as these are amazing.

This granola is awesome! I love that it is made with Gluten Free oats, that was hard to find in other brands.The clusters are nice and large. This granola is crunchy and tastes really great. The best thing about this granola for me is that it is not too sweet, it has just the right amount of sweetness to make it delicious but not overpowering and still fairly low on calories.The texture is excellent, the raisins are chewy, the oat clusters are crunchy, and the almonds are crispy. I eat it with milk usually, but it's also delicious as a dry snack straight out of the bag.I ordered a 3-pack of each flavor that Love Grown makes, and they are all delicious.The only con I can think of is that it's so good you may end up eating it too fast and have to order more. Luckily it comes in a 3-pack :)
did not feel guilty! 2 bowls of Gluten free a day! I have been searching for a cereal that have Gluten,Sugar and other fillers.I think I'm in LOVE GROWN, Get It?
Finally a granola for people who cant do gluten. Love Grown tastes great, made with some really good stuff and none of the bad. I am very happy with this brand and will be purchasing more.

You have to try this wonderful granola.  It is the best granola I have ever had! Trust me, we have a lot of "granola" to choose from in the Boulder, CO area and this one is perfect! The cinnamon is just the perfect amount and it is not too sweet. And it won't break your jaw when you chew it.  My kids loved it in yogurt and right out of the bag as a snack. We loved how  healthy it is for all of us.  We couldn't wait for more!
These are a great vegan treat.  i love the low sugar/high protein content.  And they taste great too!

This is a great soup! Just like homemade from scratch! With the limits I now have it is handy to have on hand for days when I do not feel up to cooking a lot but need to eat healthy! I am hoping to keep these on hand!
My Dad loves Chiclets and they are now hard to find.  He loves the gum.  I dislike the shipping costs.

The product is great. The shipping cost however is a joke. The cost of shipping shioluld be to get the product from the seller to you the buyer. It should not be a source of additional profit to the seller which it clearly is in the case of this item and this seller.
Down with sugarless gum!  Up with chiclets!  Just one thing--I'd like to see cinnamon chiclets for sale on Amazon.  I know they're out there....
Product was great, it just cost "WAY" to much to ship this little pack of gum, never agaion............Thank YouStephanie Cadigan

This gum is a throw back to my childhood! I loved it then and happy I can still find it now! I like that it is offered in a big pack as I hate to run out! I am not a big sugar free gum person so these little squares are small little pops of fun to chew! They make excellent bubbles too!

This pasta is the only one I have found so far that is a good replacement for the wheat variety. I live abroad where I can only purchase the white rice inferior kind but it doesn't hold its shape very well after cooking and always seems to be either uncooked or starchy and mushy. Tinkyada provides the right texture and the variety in shapes we need. I have been using it for five years now and am very satisfied.

I'm definitely a hearts of palm snob. I look for (in this order) consistency of texture, taste, and price. The best palm i n the world is SunPix, from Costa Rica, but Costco has stopped carrying it, so life is a quest for the next best. This product, also from Costa Rica, is entirely satisfactory, and I will buy it again . . . at least until Amazon (or someone) makes SunPix available to me.

Love this coffee, i am so glad that i have found this online, it reminds me of back home, when i use to live in Ethiopia. I hope this purchase will help my country somewhat economically. Roasting the coffee beans is part of our tradition or culture.

Although there is no regulatory body monitoring the claims of fair-trade and organic for coffee beans - these are quality beans that the vendor is providing. With the beans coming from the worlds' origin of coffee, they have a rustic, almost ancient characteristic about them that sets them FAR apart from newer world beans. Even in the roasting, you will detect a vast difference between these and most other beans (especially Central American or Hawaiian varieties). If you blend varieties, these will bring up the qualities of almost any other bean to give that roundness which defines the pleasure of coffee. [Hope that wasn't overly pretentious, although I truly am a fan of really good coffees.]
This online store had a tremendous selection of green coffee beans, especially I was drawn by the array of Decaf varietals available. Will definitely buy again.

Roasting green beans is so easy, either in the oven to get a complex flavor (mix of light and dark roast) or on the stove with a Whirley Pop popcorn popper. This coffee is great. It's so cool to be able to buy green beans, and it saves money, too.

column9: got 2 packs, enough for 4 batches with 1 order
column10: I am pleased with the price and ammount, however I can't really comment on the performance since both batches went bad on me.

So this does not beat my love for macadamia nut matcha and I probably even like the almond matcha more HOWEVER this is a very good matcha!Its funny because pistachios are my favorite nut although macadamia does run a close second the things are just too darn expensive! Not that pistachios are cheap or anything but for the price - heck I will just buy matcha instead!This pistachio matcha really does smell like pistachio.There is a slight very slight chemical like smell but it does not come out in the blend when you make your matcha regardless of if you use just water or make a latte with it.I really do like this matcha and the base comes through very nicely and with pistachio for some reason seems to make even more sense because pistachios have green on them. Yeah I know its a mental thing and I am after all somewhat mental however this may also be quite nice in a white base as well!Try as many of these Red Leaf Matcha as you can you won't be unhappy with your matcha flavors!

This is a delicious matcha with pistachio flavoring that is authentic and lovely. When I first smelled the prepared bowl of matcha, I was surprised and confused that it smelled kind of spicy, like nutmeg and cloves. It wasn't unpleasant, just totally unexpected. The smell carries over to just the beginning part of the taste, where it initially seems a bit spicy but then morphs into a nutty, rich pistachio flavor. The matcha underneath definitely takes on an earthy flavor, and I can't help but wonder if the spiciness isn't at least in part from the matcha that the pistachio flavoring is just bringing to the foreground. Overall the nutty flavors really work well with matcha and make for a great energizing drink!

column9: Deliciously nutty, naturally sweet and smokey!
column10: The matcha straight out of the bag smells very strongly like sweet pistachio, reminding me of pistachio halva. Very intoxicating smell!The matcha frothed up well during whisking and is a lovely green colour, matching a perfect colour to pistachios too!As a traditional cup of hot matcha, great strong earthy green tea base holding hands next to the  pistachio flavor. The matcha isn't astringent. Slight bitterness, but it fits the bill almost with a smokeyness of the pistachio. There is a sweet nutty taste at the end of my sip. The best part of this cup is that sweet nutty taste, very well done! I'm thinking I could drink this one as a traditional cup all the time.As a iced latte (prepared with matcha, ice, soy milk and a bit of sweetner), this pretty much tastes like pistachio ice cream! Creamy, sweet, and nutty with strong green tea base. This one came out sweeter than normal because of the sweetness of the flavoring. With that said, if adding sweetener, be gentle.So my tea peeps, totally give this one a shot. I guess it sounds kinda weird since I think others might associate pistachios as just a salty snack, but this one is sweet, nutty and tasty!

i love the pastry. i love the filling. i love my pop tarts. they are packaged very well and i had very little damage. any damage i think would be from shipping. the two tarts are packaged in an aluminum foil like material for freshness. i just pop mine in the toaster for a couple minutes. i really like the crust alot. i am reordering because i like them so much and the price is really good. always watch for a sale price or special on them.

Always love these.  Just pop in toaster and voila, a delicious instant breakfast.  Got a really good deal w/25% off coupon and S&S another 5% off, making these about 17cents a piece.  Love the unfrosted ones much much more and strawberries is my favorite flavor.

This cereal has only 170 calories, 1.5 grams of fat, 3 grams of protein (not counting the milk), NINE grams of fiber, and the 12g of sugaars isn't too bad for a cereal. I imagine the high fiber helps keep the blood from spiking too much. Love it!

Very delicious cereal and so sweet and the pecans give it an extra special flavor and so rich.  I just wish it was available at the local supermarket!!!  One of the best cereals I have tasted in a long time and healthy too!!

Dont know why this is so difficult to find in stores.  This cereal is delicious and I wish Kellogg would make it more available in stores.

column4: Kerry T. Givens "One out of five doctors"
column9: So small...couldn't hurt to eat just a few...so very small...
column10: So here's how it went down.My teenage sons crowd around with innocent curiosity as I take the mammoth 5-pound bag out of the cardboard box, the box with the beguiling Amazon smile on the side. That knowing, wicked Cheshire grin. Within seconds the bag is neatly cut open. An oddly hypnotic aroma wafts out.It begins.We all sample one or two of the pleasantly rubbery candies, but find ourselves exchanging the same puzzled expression: that flavor---not really cola...vaguely medicinal, yet not offensive. Hmm. Further testing is required.We all sit down. Sampling continues now in earnest---they're so small! Where's the harm?---and we agree that you need to eat quite a few to identify the flavor with any accuracy. Not a name brand cola, to be sure...one of those "store brands," after it's gone flat. We notice that after the first 50 or so, the flavor seems to change somewhat, perhaps because all our teeth are now caked with adherent masses of gummy residue. Our mood is high, so testing continues.General consensus is reached after the first pound or two that the bottles in the middle of the mass are softer and more fragrant than the stuff from the top of the bag. The bag is passed around, sniffing ensues. Great effort is expended seeing how far a bottle can be stretched, while held between the front teeth, until it breaks.The unmistakable signs of hyperglycemia ---exhilaration, rapid speech, a cola-like aroma on the breath---go somewhat unnoticed as we burrow deeper into the jiggly wad of gummies. Dinner is postponed along with homework. A telephone call from my ex-wife goes unanswered. The scientific process cannot be interrupted. Would Fermi have taken time out from inventing the x-ray deathgun to take a call from his ex-wife? Please.The fun almost stops when a bottle goes up a nostril ---kids!--- but everything is soon back on track when we discover that moistened bottles can be stuck to the forehead for minutes at a time. Soon my sons' faces bristle with the things. A joke is made about "edible lesions". Hilarity ensues. Photos are taken. Outside it grows dark while leaves blow about, unraked. The scratching of a pet at the door stopped some time ago.Bottles are eaten ten at a time now. Cola-stained spittle dribbles down a chin. No time to wipe. Got to keep chewing. They are SO VERY SMALL.Suddenly the bag is empty.Empty. The room goes quiet.  The box is re-examined, but no stray gummies are found. The box with the grin. That damn, mocking grin. I have to explain to the children why I only ordered one 5-pound bag. We all feel somewhat sick. We are all trembling now.Parents, sometimes single dads cannot be trusted to make good judgments about their kids' eating habits. Living with the stress of alimony can pervert that part of the mind which regulates dietary choices, or common sense.I hope this will serve as a valuable object lesson for you all.

column9: Country of Origin Changes Depending On Supplier
column10: I am a long time Haribo fan. I was first introduced to Haribo gummies when I moved to Germany in 1979. My parents were in the US military and we were stationed in (formerly West) Germany. I spent many years of my early and happy childhood there. Upon returing to the US in the 1970s, one of the many things I missed about Germany was the fantastic German candies. I was able to find the Haribo Bears in the mid-1980s and the Cola bottle in the late 1980s.The Haribo products are much better than their American imitiations. The Haribo products tend to be a bit firmer and of more uniform consistency. The American imitations are way too soft and too sweet. The Haribo products have a better, finer and more complex flavor. The 5 pound bags are an excellent deal!

The taste of a Haribo Happy Cola Gummy is quite honestly a miracle. I still have no idea how they're able to take such an intense amount of cola flavor and pack it into a teeny-weeny piece of chewy deliciousness. It's downright succulent! If I had a five pound bag on me at this very moment, I'd down them all in an instant...but not before I pinched my nose with a clothes pin.These things reek. Every bag I've ever bought knocks me on my haunches and I've come to accept the bad odor as a bit of extra baggage. Sometimes they smell like poop, sometimes they smell like vomit, but they always smell wretched whatever the case. Not only do I avoid sticking my nose anywhere near the bag, but I have to wash my hands as soon as I'm finished snacking! It's sick!If the smell which emanated from these little guys was that of a freshly cracked can of soda pop, five stars would be issued all around. But it's not. It's the same stench that I wake up to after a hard night on the town.Once again, the taste is great. I still eat them after all, so I can't knock 'em completely. Buying a bag wouldn't be a mistake, but opening the bag in a small, draft free room would be.

You can really taste the cola flavor on this bottle shaped candies. It is not too sticky that it glues your teeth together; although a bit on the rubbery side. Not too sweet neither. Just the right combination of flavors to taste. . From the biggest gummy bear manufacturer in the world (Haribo - based in Germany).Just FYI: 5 oz bag has 3.5 servings, with each serving at 140 calories, 10% carbo, 21g sugar, and 3g of protein. A serving is about 17 pieces of gummies.

column9: Great deal on a delicious candy!
column10: I used to always eat these as a child and loved them, so I had to treat myself to this when I saw it on Amazon! The 5 lb bag is a great deal for the price and these are so good that it's hard to stop eating them! Someone else mentioned that Haribo has the best gummy candies, and I'd have to agree whole-heartedly. They are gummy but not too hard, and the "cola" flavor is perfect. This particular bag would be great for a party or something like that. They are so delicious that it's hard to stop once you start! The bag came in perfect condition, and the gummies tasted fresh. I'm almost finished with the bag, and all in all, I'd buy it again!
I can't get enough of Happy-Cola.  The 5 pound bag is a great value.  I have ordered it several times from Amazon and it has always arrived quickly and very fresh - the expiration date is a year out.
These shipped fast and were fresh and tasty. They last longer if you put them in the fridge and take some out to sit and soften before you eat them.
Everytime I order these, my family, friends and coworkers would just eat them up in record time.  Everyone seems to LOVE these gummies; they're almost addictive.  You really can't go wrong here ;-)

I have always loved these things.  When I deployed to Iraq, the PX stocked a variation of these with a slight lemon flavor (like a lemon in your Coke).  Recently, the PX stopped stocking these for some reason.  So one day I was browsing and saw that Amazon sells these in 5 lb. bags!While it is unfortunate that Amazon won't ship grocery goods overseas, I had these sent to my home address, where my wife forwarded them on to me here in Iraq.I munch on these in my down time and am glad I can always get more!Thanks, Amazon!
I got my gummies promptly and I am enjoying every bite of them. The bag was bigger than I thought it would be, but thats a good thing.
It was very nice.Package was big, came a day early. Highly recommeneded.

column9: A little bit goes a long way
column10: Just a note: this is a LOT of candy. If you are ordering this make sure you have a lot of friends and family that will help you finish off the bag.After the first handful (which is excellent, mind you) I was set for a few days. Apparently no one else in the house cares for gummy candy and it took me a few weeks to finish up the candy.Other than that, they taste good (although not entirely like cola) and have a good consistency.

column9: Just like I remember as a kid
column10: These are awesome. I love cola bottle gummi candy and Haribo are the best.  These bring back so many fond memories of my childhood.  Mmmm. . . .

column9: Don't buy these if you don't alredy know you like them!!
column10: These are my favorite candy of all time. HOWEVER... a lot of people don't like them. I would strongly recomment finding them locally and trying them first!Also be aware they are a little harder than gummi bears by nature... even at their very freshest. I actually like them better if they've been open for a few days... but I'm just weird that way.After paying just over $2.00 for a 5oz. bag at my local grocery store, I was thrilled to find a good place to buy bulk online.If you know 'em and love 'em don't hesitate to buy. If you don't know them, then try them somewhere first.They also ship very fast.

My family was excited to get the 5 pound bag of cola bottles because we go through the little bags quickly.  But, 5 pounds is a lot of gummy cola bottles and we it has taken us months to go through half the bag.  I think the other half will spoil before we can eat them.
I order these all the time. Great value bulk price. If you like coke cola, you will love these.
This is my son's favorite candy.  Thank you for the prompt delivery.  It's exactly what I ordered!
I love any gummi products.  This is definitely one of my favorite flavor.  If you haven't tried it, you should.

I remember these from my college days. I don't remember how I stumbled onto them on Amazon, but when I did, I bought a bag. They were just like I remembered them-annoyingly addicting! The more you eat, the better they are. They were soft and reasonably fresh, certainly better than in the store, if you can find them.Highly recommended, but not if you are on a diet.
I almost ate the whole bag in one sitting.  So good, but I'm sure it's not healthy to eat so many. Be careful and space them out!
They where so good i ate them all in less then 24 hours with my other friend.

column9: a favorite treat from my childhood - revisited
column10: I used to splurge and buy a handful of these gummi treats with my allowance when I was younger. Then, a few years back when traveling in Italy, I found a pack of these at a snack bar in a train station. They have quickly taken over as being my favorite gummi candy. The 5-pound bag is lasting a lot longer than I thought. And I will re-order when I run out!
These are the best gummies that I have had in a while.  They were just the way that I liked them... FRESH.  I would get another bag if I could afford the weight gain.

They are great and were fresh.  It takes a long time to eat 5 pounds of gummies. I also like them cause they are fat free.  If you have never had the gummi cokes... they taste (to me anyway) a lot like that holiday spice pepsi they had a few years ago.

I used to get these when I was a kid, and finding them again has been a real treat.  These are sold by about 5 sources on amazon, so prices vary.If you have never eaten these, then go find a 3oz bag somewhere and try them.  They are not for everyone.
I have ordered these a couple of times and they have been fresh both times.  Delivery is quick also.  No regrets.

Shipping was super fast. I got it two days after I bought it. And the candy was great! I enjoyed it, my little sister enjoyed it, and my mom even enjoyed it after she found out that I bought 5lbs of candy. Its been about a  month and I only have a few ounces left. It wouldve been gone sooner if my mom hadnt hid it from me! (I'm 17 by the way)
I love this candy, period! They have a slight coke taste and also the white part taste kinda like sprite, go figure eh?
Wifes loves these.  If we're lucky a 5 lb bag will last a few weeks.  If you haven't tried these, try them.....

The Gummi Colas are one of the best gummi candies out there. It was a very good bargain to get a 5-lb bag for such a low price. Being my second favorite gummi candy of all time, I was glad to see it on Amazon and quickly snatched a bag. The delicious flavor of cola is a wonderful sensation in the form of a gummi.
This really is a great candy, and very hard to find in stores.

I love the cola flavored gummies. LOVE it! but these are a little too hard/stiff for me. VERY chewy, almost a stale type of chewy. wish it was more like the soft gummies that you can get from the grocery stores. but the flavor is good though.  price is great for 5 pounds but it's only getting 3 stars. it would have gotten 5 stars if it was softer.

I grew up in Europe, and for me this candy is a classic.  After I moved in the US I only saw this product in small bag, and in few and far between places (and nowhere near I live of course).  So it was great to see Amazon selling it!  I immediately bought 2 bags (to get the free shipping) and enjoying them immensely.

column9: WARNING!!!  Do not order these in the Summer!!!
column10: Be cautioned, do not order these in the summer.  No protection was taken to protect these from the summer heat, so I received a 5 lb bag of gummy goo!  The entire bag was liquid when I received it.  I love Haribo gummies, but will not order them in the summer ever again.  They were shipped with expedited shipping.
These candies are not bursting with flavor.  I don't know if I just got a bad batch but they are rather bland.

column9: Haribo Gummi Candy Happy-Cola tastes terrible
column10: I thought this gummy candy would taste like cola - turns out it is citrus flavored and sour.  Not at all what I expected.

column4: G S Del Rio "G Del Rio"
column10: This particular batch was lacking the usual "fizzy" taste and texture.  However, they were sweet and chewy.
Just amazing, great tasting snacks.  Bought them as a gift for my wife as she loves Huckleberry, she let me try one, but only one, if that tells you how good they are!
Yummy ! for my girls and for me, really tasty ! Love them, we will need to order more soon.
Great gummies! You can almost just use these for the aroma because they smell incredible!  They also taste great.
I bought these grizzlies out of curiosity. I love the hot cocoa, tea and lemonade! These have become my new favorite candy! :-)
One of the best, tastiest purple snacks around! I'm keeping one as a decorator item to sniff now and then for a sweet scent.

column9: Fan of all Greenies products- except this one.
column10: Though my cat is a huge a fan of all of the Dental Chews produced by greenies, my experience with this product was less than pleasant.This product did the opposite of what it set out to do.  My cat violently vomited hairballs the same evening I fed him these.  In fact, he couldn't digest them at all and has never thrown up so much at one time.  This was unusual and still has me shocked, especially for an animal that regurgitates seldom and mildly.  Be careful, as I wish I had.

First off, my cat HATES regular Greenies (the big crunchy ones) and won't even try to lick them. Any flavor. But my big fluffy Himalayan was hacking up stinky furballs in unreachable places, so when I saw these at the pet store I bought them on a whim.She loves them! I don't think she even chews the things, she inhales them so fast. Tuna treats are ok but chicken were more popular around here. She likes these better than the Temptations treats she had before, and I am convinced that these are somewhat healthier.The pouch recommends 12 treats a day, all at once, or even more for my big-boned cat. I usually do more like 5-6, because that many treats seems excessive (she would love it though). Either way, she hasn't had any hairballs since. I am not positive about the causal relationship, but I suspect these did the trick. They're great!

We have tried other greenies treats and other brands. Usually one cat likes one flavor/style and the other doesn't. Both of my adopted cats love these treats. If it were up to them they would eat these treats all day, every day!

column9: cat loves these, even more than regular greenies
column10: My cat loves these. She is very small even though she is fully grown so the regular greenies just seemed uncomfortable for her to eat. I tried these and she LOVES THEM, even more than Temptation treats. I've never had problems with vomiting after these.
My cat likes these better than regular Greenies and has had no problem with hairballs or vomiting with this product.

I purchased this box mix at an outlet originally.  I only purchased one box to test it out.  It was fabulous.  I can bake it plain or add nuts, cranberries, chocolate chips or whatever.  You can't imagine how easy and quick it is to put together.  Everyone I serve it to.....raves!!!!!  This brand has many other choices in their box mixes and they are all wonderful.....but this is my favorite.  After I could not find it at the outlet anymore I got desperate and went on Amazon.  It was out-of-stock and I went on the waiting list and they notified me.  Then I ordered 6!!!!!  A must try.

I bought this product on a clearance table at a local discount store.  My entire family thought it was yummy.  It was so easy-just a cup of water and an egg.  The box says it is a bread mix, but it is more like a cake.  I used a little vanilla frosting on top (there is a Cinnamon icing recipe on the back of the box).  It makes a great desert or a quick breakfast. I'm ordering other flavors now and can't wait to try them!
This was easy and fast to put together. Bakes quick and taste amazing.  The best cinnamon cake I have ever eaten. Well worth the money

I will definitely be trying other Dassant products.I occasionaly try different breads from Amazon.I have a bread machine (This is not for a bread machine) and while looking for machine mixes saw this. I almost didn't get it because it is not for bread machines. But it looked so good and was inexpensive enough to try. There are 6 boxes. 3 boxes went in 3 days! I took one to work and it lasted all of ten minutes. The other 2 loaves were gone fast at home.I even played with the mix a little with no bad results. I added a 1/4 cup of brown sugar at the last minute of mixing so it wasn't quite mixed in. It left swirls of goodness all through the bread. yum!This is easy, tasty and priced right. I highly recommend it.

column9: Fast, Easy, and OH SO GOOD!
column10: First thing to note, this isn't for a breadmaker machine, but it is so easy, you don't need a machine any way. Just add water and an egg and pop into the oven! Very easy and very good. I've brought this to parties and it was an instant hit!
Easy to make, moist, great tasting. One of the best sweet breads I have ever had. I have the same result with every baking. Great product
I was searching for bread mixes for my bread machine and came across this bread mix. This bread mix can not be used for your bread machine however it is a great mix for anytime of the day.

I initially bought a box of this Bread Mix at my local upscale supermarket and brought it home to give it a taste test. I like to bake, but am not a dyed in the wool "scratch baker." Frequently I start with a mix and add ingredients until I have something really unique that my friends and I like.So I took this mix, added nuts, baked it and took it to my Wednesday AM get together with the girls. Oh My Gosh! It is SOOOO nice and rich. Instead of bread, it tastes like cake. All the ladies liked it, so I bought another box and planned to use when needed.A bread and salad potluck came up, and I was in a hurry so I just whipped up the bread and baked it in the oven and took it with me. Soon, ladies at the potluck were asking "Who brought the wonderful bread?"I love it. My friends love it. SO,I put in a Subscribe and Save order with Amazon. It is great just as it is when cooked with no additions, but is even better with nuts. I'm sure you could add chocolate chips and/or dried fruit. Your imagination is your limit. It is great. Tastes like Cake. Have fun and Enjoy.
This was a terrific buy for this product.  Can't find it anywhere locally. A very easy and quick bread to make and absolutely delicious. Yum!

Just add water,baked very well in toaster oven.used Cuisenart pan 9" B0000ULZY0 MODEL #AMB-9LP dishwasher safe,and yes it is a little like a cake.No yeast to wait for,52 minutes and I was eating.This tastes very good.

I expected cinnamon bread like you'd find in the bread aisle but it turns out more like a cake bread.  My husband and i didn't care for it, but my kids LOVED it, which is good since we have six boxes! I found adding a brown sugar / cinnamon mixture to the top of the loaf about ten or twelve minutes before its baked, made it a lot tastier.
I'm talking, STRICTLY, GOOD STUFF!  Easy to prepare, and very good.  I did mine, in a convection-type toaster oven, and it turned out pretty well ...though, the top, was a little brown.
So tasty and so quick and easy. Love it. I knew it was going to be good when I licked the spatula. Bad news is it additive.;-)

The Dassant Cinnamon Chip Bread Mix is very easy to prepare.  I first tried the Dassant products several years ago.  I like all of the Dassant products I have tried so far, however the Cinnamon Chip Bread Mix is my favorite.  The bread can be eaten for breakfast, as a snack, or as a dessert.  When I make this bread and take it to work, it is eaten very quickly because everyone loves it!

column9: Great price of a wonderful product
column10: I tasted this bread at a local kitchen store.  It was $6.99 per box of mix.  I found it here and so much cheaper.  Great bread...my whole family loves it.
Highly recommend!  Easy to make and great flavor - the second time I made this - I added walnuts and raisins - very good!
This mix is not quite as good as the others I've tried by this maker, but still a good, quick coffee cake like bread.  Is best with icing.

I was hoping this would be a sweet bread - but it is not.  It's thick and a bit doughy, but not the sweet taste that I typically expect when mixed with cinnamon.  I was very disappointed. I gave away all the unopened boxes to a food drive.

column4: Todd Sullivan "The Esteem of the World Isn't ...
column9: Great product- I cant stop drinking it, but price above is to high
column10: As most of my friends know. I LOVE Coffee, I am what you call a Coffee snob. I practicaaly lived at Starbucks! When I first heard the ad for Healthy Coffe my ears perked up. I was interested I mean a coffee that is healthy who wouldnt want some health benefits from  Something they love, but, like most my first question was OK but what does it taste like?The ad offered a free sample so I bit and sent for one, when the package arrived with the picture of the cup of coffee and the od looking mushroom, I was more than a bit scared but prepared it anyway and took a drink... Wow, this stuff was good. OK I drank the whole thing. Now I have had problems with coffee before, having acid reflux disease but I couldn't give it up so I dealt with it. This stuff didnt hit me like coffee did I could enjoy it without the acid side effects. I was and am hooked, today I drink it all the time and have not been to Starbucks in weeks, should pop in they probably are concerned, I ordered more and decided that what the hell, I like this so much I will sell it. And I sell it at wholesell e-mail for info and I would love to give you the drink-gano domain.Make It a Great OneTodd
This tea is wonderful, subtle pleasant flavors are abundant and refreshing. I have had it for over 8 months now and really enjoying it!

column9: Refreshing and calming tea in a nice gift box
column10: This is my second purchase of the Bana Tea Company Limited Edition Premium Raw 2008 Tea Cake. I'm enjoying the first one so much (bought directly from Linda Louie at the L.A. Tea Festival) that I bought this second one as a gift.  I might buy another and stash it to experience how it ages.A previous review said that this tastes like green tea. Yes, a very refreshing green tea, which is what raw Puer is, I believe.  This particular tea tastes slightly fruity rather than just "green", and the flavors stand up to repeated brewing:  9 or 10 (small, Chinese) cups.  It's great as iced tea, too.

column9: Tastes decent but it tastes more like green tea than pu erh
column10: I've had really good pu erh tea and this does not taste like it at all. It tastes and looks more like green tea. Although it tasted decent, I was expecting something that did not taste so much like green tea. Alot of vendors are jumping on the pu erh bandwagon charging customers alot of money making them think it's pu erh. I do not believe this is 100% pu erh as stated in the description.

the product arrived on time and in good shape. the packaging was attractive, but inside the goodies were scant. each container was mostly empty space. example  would be a package that could hold six pieces would only have two. will NEVER purchase again!!!
For this price for what quality and quantity you get is unbeatable.Mom absolutely loved the basket.. Was a perfect gift to send love from far away

column9: A darned good Mother's Day gift
column10: I bought this product, the "Art of Appreciation Gift Baskets Decadent Chocolate Truffle Treats", for my wife for Mother's Day.  My wife has reached the point in her life where she doesn't like me to buy her jewelry very much ("I have more than I can wear now!"), and while flowers are nice, a guy can't just get his girl flowers on every occasion.  But good chocolate ... now there is something she's never told me she's gotten too much of.  :-)  With that in mind, I searched around to find a chocolate gift basket for her, and this one looked like it would fit the bill.  Below are my ... well, her ... impressions.- All of the chocolate treats are of good quality.  By that I mean there are no cheap chocolate fillers.  And there was a decent variety of items to sample.- Some of the boxes don't have nearly as much product inside as the size of the container would suggest.  However, she tells me that the amount of treat for each was just right, enough to be satisfying, and gave her a good sample of the item.- The gift basket was presented well, and was attractive.  The contents rested on shredded purple paper inside of a red tin basket, was enclosed in cellophane, and tied with a bow at the top.  She intends to re-use the tin basket when making a gift for another occasion, so it's not cheap looking or junky.- While a little on the pricey side, when you consider the quality of the treats and the overall presentation, I would say this gift basket is worth the money.Taste in chocolate is like taste in wine ... it can vary widely between individuals.  While none of the treats here struck her as "Omigosh, get me more of this!", she liked them all, and appreciated this as a gift.  Four stars.

I gave this as a gift to a favorite cousin who is an admitted "chocoholic". She reported that there was nothing included that was "throwaway". All the products first class and the kind of truffles, chocolates, cocoa and so on that a true lover of the bean likes.  Quantities were sufficient to give you a decent taste of each one.  I had become discouraged with gift baskets that had a couple good items and a bunch of stuff nobody would love.  This one is not that way; actually safe--and satisfying--to send someone you really like!

This is the best French dressing I have ever had. I found this product at Hilton Homewood Suites hotels where I was staying. I am ordering some for home. This is the very best sweet French Dressing ever!!!
I'll be honest only the home made house french dressing at Ember's steakhouse can compete, I only wish I could buy in a store.

This is what I've been looking for. This version is not sold in stores where I live and you have to go Mcdonalds to get it. I was so happy when I received it, tasted it and it was what I was looking for. The seller gave me 2 extra for free. I will definitely purchase in bulk next time!
got the product really fast, it look good, it should be good for the chili oil I'm going to make, hope it is hot , hot, hot.

This cheese has a very strong flavor since it is aged very long. Almost too strong for my taste, but otherwise a very excellent cheese, as you would expect an imported cheese from Holland to be. So if you like aged Gouda then give this a try.

I ordered the peanut oil and was excited about the purchase.  I was going to use the oil to fry a turkey with for thanksgiving.  When I received the package, the cap was partially on and the seal was broken. The oil had leaked out of the container.  I contacted seller and did not get a response until I filed a complaint with Amazon.  The seller than contacted me and told me to retract complaint and they will resolve the problem.  I wanted another container of oil, but they refunded me my money.  That is nice, but it's hard finding peanut oil in certain areas of the United States and at such short notice.  I have ordered from company in the past and will probably order from them again.  I think they should respond to customers issues in more timely manner.

Because this thing is sooo sinfully delicious, any eater is very likely to go through the entire pouch (contains maybe 7-8 joined cashew pieces) in one sitting. And that, according to the nutritional information printed on the back, equals about 940 calories and almost 66 gms (100% of R.D.A.) of total fat and 11 gmss (66%) of saturated fat. My point is this is not a healthy food by any meaning of that word. Also, each pouch has about 22 gms of sugar, which is why I gave it only 4 stars. I think it still would have tasted just as good without that sugar.That said, it is still better than eating most junk snacks that are laden with god knows what and how many artificial abominations. The thing I like the most about this cashew product is it is dry roasted, unlike most brands you find on the supermarket shelves which are fried in oil. Nuts are naturally oily/fatty; there' s no need to deep fry them in oil again. Besides, I think nuts taste better in their raw forms.Finally, I think the label in the package is a little misleading. It reads the product is "Vegan, cholesterol-free, dairy-free, and wheat- free." But, isn't that self-evident? It's like saying bottled water is fat and sugar free.

column9: Simple, natural recipe with big flavor
column10: Great taste.  I especially like the bite-sized pieces that didn't crumble like peanut brittle and make a mess.

Mrs. May's cashew crunch has saved me from eating a whole bag of chips many times!  All I need is a couple of squares of crunch and I'm good to go!  It satisfies my sweet/salty/crunchy cravings all in one and is delicious to boot!
Really good snack. My kids favorite so far. Also, my child with braces can eat these snacks as they are soft enough for her without breaking brackets.

I love this product.  It's so tasty and crunchy.  This is really the best cashew crunch I've ever tasted probably because it's dry roasted and not loaded with sugar.  Great snack - very difficult to just eat a few pieces.

Definitely worth the money.  Unfortunately, they are quite addicting.  These nuts are the best thing since sliced bread.  I am so hooked on them. I actually have to fight myself so that I don't order another dozen bags.
I almost wish it wasn't possible to order these in such a large quantity.  Oh well, sometimes sacrifices need to be made.

column9: Mrs. May's Dry-Roasted Snack, Cashew Crunch
column10: The Cashew Crunch is a very tasty snack.  The flavor of the cashews is not destroyed with a lot of other ingredients.  I love that they are all natural with no artificial colors or flavors.

I first found these in a natural foods store.  This deal on Amazon is great...I am on a scheduled delivery and get a discount and free shipping.  Can't beat that!I use this snack when I make my own trail mix.  I bring it everywhere I go, and the Cashew Crunch always goes first.  Not too much sugar.  There are other varieties, but I keep coming back to this one.
This is my favorite snack.  Pricy, but other than that, a good experience all the way around.
I love this product. Crunchy and sweet but not too sweet. Can't get enough. Only negative is it is very hard to stop eating and you can go through a bag in no time.
I highly recommend this snack food.  It's a healthy alternative to chips.  It's crunchy and flavorful.  I trust the Mrs. May's brand as they are consistently good.

column9: Best Gluten Free snack on the market!
column10: If you suffer from Celiac, you know that yummy treats are expensive.  There are many flavors that Mrs. May offers, and because they are essentially all nuts, it does not take much to have a satisfying snack or treat after a meal, at a great price.  Also, I am very sugar-sensitive and these fit in well with not disrupting my levels.
Mrs. May's is a great snack.  Healthy and delicious.  Not much in it--simple and yummy.

I loved Mrs. May's Cashew Crunch. What I didn't love about it was the nutritional information. The pieces it is cut into are very small. They are easily popped into the mouth and in a crunch or two they are gone. So consuming the entire pouch is VERY easy to do! ONE OUNCE of this has 172 calories! 12 grams total fat (2 grams Saturated Fat)! Once ounce is gone so quickly that you'll easily overdo it. This snack may be made with healthier ingredients than the garbage you can buy at the local store but it is in no way healthy to eat this snack. I love it but I'll never eat it again.
Thse are one of my most favorite munchies! Nothing but to healthy stuff in there. Better than generic boring granola!

column9: Not a "health food" if it's made in China
column10: This product is made in China.  I would not believe any claims they make regarding allergy safety and vegan/kosher.  Considering Mrs. May's markets itself as a healthy product, I was shocked when I glanced at the back and noticed this product was made in China. China has proven that we can not trust their manufacturing practices. Unsafe toys, dog food, and now we're supposed to trust them making our health food?Not to mention the carbon footprint created by shipping something halfway around the world. I will not buy this product anymore.I would rather purchase the Sahale snacks that are made in the US, even if they are a bit more expensive.

I was a Mrs. May's regular for years.  I ordered a case of their cashew crunch directly from them and it arrived in a box that said:  Made in China.  I wrote them and, to give them credit, unlike most American companies today, they responded honestly and without the typical excuses. They told me they'd produced their products in China for years with no problems.  My dogs were affected by the Chinese dog food poisoning incident and I did not want to subject my family to the possibility of tainted food purchased in the belief I was giving them something healthy. Also, the fuel used to ship these from China to the U.S. makes them less than viable candidates for sustainability. I already work very hard to ensure than things purchased on Amazon come from areas near my home.
This is so good I wish it comes in a bigger package!
I really like this pancake mix.  All you have to do is add water.  They are very fluffy and tasty and don't taste like they have fiber but they do.  You need to try this.

column9: Best tasting spring water I've ever had!
column10: Kiwaii water is by far the best tasting spring water I've ever had!  My entire family loves it.  No other water has such a clean and pure taste, leaving no aftertaste at all.  The bottle caught my eye at first and after I went on the company's website and read more about it--I was totally sold!  After my first bottle of Kiwaii, I knew I'd never drink anything else!  We used to drink Fiji water in the past, but Kiwaii simply tastes much better and I'd rather purchase water from a company where integrity and honesty to their customers is completely important to them.  And that is Kiwaii 100%!  We've ordered it from Amazon several times and it's been a very easy and positive experience.  It's also great that we can purchase it in other stores around our area.  I would highly recommend this spring water to everyone!

column9: Best Spring Water I have ever tasted!
column10: I love this water!  It is the best tasting water I have ever had.  The first time I bought it was at a Southern California market called Gelson's, and its packaging stood out from the rest of the pure waters so I gave it a try.  Since that time, I have put Kiwaii on the top of my list.  I think it's taste is far superior to Fiji, Voss or any of the other waters out there.  It tastes clean and refreshing.  My entire family including 3 small children only want to drink Kiwaii if they have a choice.  We don't always drink bottled water, but when we do, the clear choice is Kiwaii.  Give this water a try, there is no going back!
This water tastes better than Fiji Water and doesn't interfere with local governments or avoid paying it's fair share to the land it is from! Kudos! I've switched, you should too!

Kiwaii water from New Zealand!  I cannot begin to say enough good things about this water!  It tastes SOOO GOOD!  You can't go wrong drinking this!  And, it's less expensive to order it from Amazon than from the actual Kiwaii website!  (The shipping from New Zealand will break the bank!)

This is the best tasting water I have ever had. It was easy to drink and left me feeling very satisfied.I am hooked. I use to drink whatever water was on sale but I will bel Kiwaii customer from here now on.

I had never seen or heard of this product before. It was not in a super market but in a small local store in my area. Initially the name and design drew my attention-then I read the description and decided to try it, It was great tasting, smooth and refreshing. It is definitely superior to many other brands that I have tried! Now I'm hooked and hoping it becomes a stand shelf item in my area!!!

column9: Best Bottled Water I've Ever Tasted
column10: I just found Kiwaii in my local grocery store and I have been hooked ever since.  It is the most refreshing water I've ever tasted and hope to see it in more stores soon!

I purchased this product in the hopes of giving Fiji a run for it's money.  I, however, was truly dissapointed.  While not bad, I found this water to be more on par with all other bottled water.  That is to say several steps below Fiji.  And considering it costs more than Fiji, I must recommend sticking with the best... Fiji.
This is an awesome product. Price was a little high, however. If ordering any more than a few oz, look elsewhere.

column9: Wonderful noodles I grew up with!
column10: These are the best noodles, delicious, light, just like what my Austrian mother cooked when I was growing up.  They bring back warm happy memories of food in my mother's kitchen.  Noodles were our "potatoes" and I highly, highly recommend these.  Safeway has them for 5.99 each, so this is a great bargain. I've made them with just a little butter over them, and have even added some pesto sauce.  Great to be able to order a case - thank you Amazon!!

this item is available @ world market for $4.99 and i recently purchased it due to its distinctive packaging and its deep eggy color.  i always thought the amish had the best egg noodles but this was THE BEST i've ever eaten.  i will be ordering this item from amazon in bulk where i've calculated a unit cost of about $3.00 rather than the world market price of nearly $5.00

I bought these noodles for my German husband and he loved  them.  They are giant and delicious.  I originally found them in a gourmet store in my neighborhood but they were almost twice the price of Amazon.com.  With the free shipping you can't loose!  Try them -  you'll love them.

column10: Hey, when Amazon sold me this exact case of Bechtle Traditional German Egg Noodles, I paid $40.12, or $3.34 each bag. column9: 14 out of 48 suckers broken in slivers
column10: This is my favorite childhood candy. Sweet on one side sour on the other side makes the whole unbroken suckers wonderful. Either shipping was rough or I was sent a poor box. I purchased these suckers for Valentines Day at my daughter's kindergarten class. There are 14 kids in her class and I will attach the suckers with thin ribbon to Valentine card with a hole punched in it. Good news!- my husband said he will eat all the broken pieces and he does not eat suckers.I will buy the "angel mints" from a Fla. based company next time, peppermint and chocolate will go over well with the children.

I bought this for my nephew when he ended up with a torn spleen.  He was not allowed to be active at all for a while, and he just loved it.  He called me up to thank me and the first words out of his mouth were "Thank you for the monkey" which was his favorite part.

column9: 4.5 Stars for Ease of Use, Availability and Taste
column10: I admit I'm kind of a wimp when it comes to hot spicy things. For that reason, lots of times I end up not liking hot wings which can be disheartening after you've gone to all the expense and work to create the wings. With this packet, I get the spicy flavor without so much of the heat.I've used McCormick's Buffalo wing mix on boneless tenders, wings and legs and always had good results. You just coat your chicken pieces and place in your pre-heated oven. Super easy!The only downside is if you like the skin on your chicken to be crispy, then it's a bit hard to do with this because it tends to brown/blacken somewhat easily both in the oven - I tried to crisp using the broiler in the oven - and out on the grill. You can get it a little crispy but you have to watch it like a hawk because one second it'll look fine and the next, it's blackening.Bottom line: Tastes really good without being horribly hot, easy to use and I can even find it in the small town I live in.

Wings made with this seasoning are perfect; so delicious! A few prep. ideas: 1. Coat your wings  in a reusable container, not a plastic bag. 2. Line the baking sheet with oiled parchment rather than aluminum foil; better results, easier clean-up. So good; not too spicy. Glad it's available through Amazon because it's becoming hard to find at the store. Yum!

I have used this seasoning for several years now and always get great compliments on my Buffalo Wings at parties. So I highly recommend this McCormick seasoning mix. And the service from this seller was awesome!
Our local supermarkets have all stopped carrying this product. My daughter loves this, just spicy enough. I am happy to have available!

This seasoning pack produces the tastiest buffalo wings ever!!!  Love that the wings are baked, not fried.  It has some heat but not too much and it's super delicious and even easier to make.  Just toss and put them into the oven and wait until they're done.
I personally love them and my family loves them. Sure it's alittle expensive, but my sisters enjoy them at their school and kids always ask them where they got it from. I give this five stars!

I have been using this cereal for breakfast for about 6 months now, and I love it. The only drawback is the cook time. I have had the best results using 1 part cereal (1/4 cup) to 3 parts water (3/4 cup) in a tall bowl. Nuke for 12 minutes at 30% power.It lends itself to mixing in a variety of other foods. Currently I am mixing in about 1/4 cup plain fat-free yogurt, applesauce, a bit of canned pure pumpkin, and berries. I have used flavored yogurt and other fruits as well. Very tasty and quite filling. Good for the body as well, who could ask for more?

For those who are trying to watch their diet and adhere to the DRV values it is a great product. It has and enormous amount of fiber, almost no sugar. I make it with chicken as a side dish or for breakfast with raisins and/or peaches. Takes about 10-15 minutes to make on the stove top, I did not try to make it in the microwave. Make sure you stir it once in a while especially by the end of cooking when the water has almost evaporated completely.
I was very satisfied with the flavor of this pie.  Some of you bakers will think you make better, but it truly was delcious and delivered in texture and flavor.  I would buy it again!

This tastes exactly like that Reggie! Candy bar made by baseball player Reggie Jackson in the late 70s, and If you've never had this before, you don't know what you're missing. I haven't found this candy anywhere else, so it's pretty rare. Please try this out if you havent tried it before, because it is DELICIOUS!
I like onions, but this was like eating a dehydrated one.  This product went in the garbage.  I would not purchase again.

column9: A quality 'Traditional Breakfast Tea' at a value price
column10: Until Twining's decided United States customers who enjoyed their Traditional English Breakfast Tea were not important and no longer worth the effort (yes, I know you can still buy their Breakfast Tea for Americans in the Orange tin, but not the traditional) I was not familiar with Ahmad Teas.  As I was searching for a quality replacement I tried this tea and Eureka!  It is an ideal Traditional English Breakfast Tea.  I have since also tried and thoroughly enjoy Ahmad Traditional Afternoon Tea and Ahmad Evening Tea (Decaffinated).  I am delighted there is a vendor actively interested in bringing quality teas to American tea drinkers.  As for that other vendor?  Oh well, to the dustbin of history with them.

column9: Delicious tea in a nice tin
column10: I really like the flavor of this tea and the tin box is a nice touch.  Each tin contains a single bag of tea.  No individual tea bags.I will likely reorder this product and figure out some amusing way to use the extra tin boxes.

I received this tea as a gift from a friend who went to London. I loved it so much I had to buy more. I was so glad Amazon carried the brand. I can even brew it in my coffee machine. I gave some for Christmas gifts & they loved it too.

column9: From Cane Grown in Volcanic Ash
column10: I first found this sugar while working at Larry's Market in Seattle. The India Tree company is also located in Seattle. It was one of the greatest food discoveries I'd forgotten about. Well, not quite. I just had no idea why the sugar we ate in Africa was so rich and similar to molasses in color. This sugar is milled on the island of Mauritius off the coast of Africa and has the divine flavor only possible from cane growing on volcanic ash.Here in America, most of the brown sugar seems like white sugar coated in a brown coloring in comparison to this rich, dark and almost seductive slightly salty tasting sugar. When I found this sugar, it brought back tons of childhood memories. Mostly memories of eating a spoonful of sugar as a treat. This sugar is "that" good.Muscovado is slightly moist, has a very high molasses content and is delicious in gingerbread, coffee cakes, chocolate cakes and anything with chocolate in it. You can basically use this sugar in any recipe that calls for "dark brown sugar."When making cookies, you will notice some of the lumps don't quite work themselves into the dough. This is no problem, because then you just find a few sugar lumps in your cookies. If you prefer your sugar to be perfectly soft, you can add a piece of apple or bread to your sugar jar until the sugar softens.This is one of my "Top Ten" ingredient finds of the century.~The Rebecca Review

I bought this food after doing a little research over the internet after my dog had some stomach problems and was throwing up  a little with his previous food. This one he loved immediately and has not have any problems since he started it.  I like that is a limited ingredient food and has not all of those dangerous chemicals and preservatives and stuff you find in other dog foods. Love it!!! :)

column9: The Best for Dogs with sensitive stomachs
column10: This is the only food that my dog digests well. And by digests well, I mean I am able to easily dispose of the end product. For responsible urban dog owners, this is paramount!

This is beautiful black finishing salt.  I have used it several times at family gatherings, and it ALWAYS starts conversation!  Very flavorful without being too salty.  Tastes great on anything.  Only con is that it will make your hands, clothes, and teeth black if you get it on there.  No big deal, though, just blow it off!

My 2 year old male cat was eating Wellness canned for most of his life but then got diarrhea so I had to put him on a bland diet of boiled chicken for a little more than a month. I tried switching him back to Wellness but the diarrhea came back so I have decided to try a new food. He never really ate the Wellness food with enthusiasm but loved his boiled chicken so I tried to find something as close as possible to JUST chicken (with the vitamins he needs of course). I've done a ton of research and Tiki Cat came out on top due to its nutrition, grain-free, no preservatives, low ash, etc. I just started switching him to this today, and I am already so impressed with the Tiki Cat food. It literally smells and looks like something we would eat (it is human grade)!He ate this so fast and loved it so much, I thought he might throw up after. He left some of the boiled chicken behind but each bite of the Tiki Cat is gone. It makes me happy to be feeding him something so healthy that he loves so much.

I agree with everything the previous two reviews have said.One of my cats has stomatitis - her teeth and gums are chronically inflamed, making it difficult for her to eat most canned foods (since most canned cat foods are mushy and stick to her teeth like peanut butter). The texture of this cat food is different - it comes in little shreds or strips, making it much easier for her to eat because nothing gets stuck to her painful, painful mouth.Also, the manufacturers will send you detailed nutrition information (down to the exact calories and milligrams) if you email them!Sidenote - all but maybe one or two of TikiCat's varieties are very low in phosphorus, making them super awesome for cats with kidney issues.

I bought quite a few of the tuna varieties plus the 72 can packs of chicken and of salmon and wanted another kind of chicken to alternate for my cats dinners.  I bought one case of this to make sure my pickiest cat would like the egg in it and gave it to them last night.  It was a big hit so I'm back to take advantage of this sale.  Kind of funny that the real sale is with the single case other than the larger amount, but as long as I get the best deal I don't care.  (6 single cases which is equal to the 72 pack is only 85.68 versus the 91.87 for the 6 pack) My cats are loving this food and I intend to keep buying it for them.

column9: Packed full of chicken and egg
column10: This can is absolutely jam-packed with small bits of shredded chicken and a few little cubes of egg.  The food is moist, but there is very little fluid in the can.  I was surprised at how much food it seemed to be when dumped onto a plate; it seemed to "expand" to more then the typical plateful from a 3.3 oz. can.A freshly opened can smells like chicken - nothing more.  It looks and smells better than canned "people food" chicken!Our cats typically eat Weruva, but picked some of this up to try; they have licked the plates clean each time it is fed and seem to really enjoy it. They seem to have a slighly easier time with the size and texture of the Tiki Cat chicken - or, at leas, they make less mess when eating it.  We always find stray bits of Weruva chicken on the floor after feeding that food. Our cats have not had any stomach-related adjustment problems, either.This company also has an informative webpage with clear nutritional facts about their product.  From what I can tell, it looks like a safe, high-quality, low-carb, high protein cat food option; a good pick for pretty much any kitty with healthy kidneys.

...I am at my wits end... My cat only eats one single brand of food - Purina One, and only chunks with gravy. I have tried soooo many healthy, grain free, organic foods, and he just won't eat them. It is ridiculous..!! TikiCat and other brands contain such amazing ingredients...how can he not like those???The last time I wanted to force him to eat the good stuff and didn't give him Purina for several days...he pooped on my bath rug..!! Should I just give up and keep buying the cheap stuff..?? Any advice from my dear fellow cat griends..?? I'd be very thankful...

column9: Zero Stars - Don't waste your money on this!

column10: This coffee doesn't have anything special about it. I like good Kona coffee and I think 2 stars really tells it all.
love the coffe since i went to maui.also bag comes with convenient clips to keep coffee freshthe taste is great just like i had it in maui

It says 100 percent kona so i thought it would taste very similar but maybe because it is a different brand?! I will not purchased this again because so far i am not happy with the taste of it at all especially for the price. I'm having doubts that it is 100 percent kona at all maybe it is a blend. maybe i brewed it wrong but pretty sure i did not but i will try again tomorrow. disappointed and i don't recommend this if your expecting the stuff you got while on vacation!

column10: Without a doubt 100% Kona Coffee is the best.  The Maui 100% Kona seems average but maybe not the freshest available.  The coffee is clumpy inside the bag which may indicate it has been on the Amazon shelf for a while longere than maybe it should be and there is no sell by or best before date on the bag to provide any further data.Unfortunately this appears to be the only 100% Kona Coffee available from Amazon so the only alternative is to order it drect from a seller in Hawaii (the prices are about the same) but you do have to pay for the shipping.
This was a birthday gift for my brother who reports that this is good coffee, significantly superior to his usual brand.

column9: Better Kona Coffe elsewhere for the price

If this is the reason you want it. It is not bad but next time I will wait for better coffee at the same price. It has a slightly bitter taste. Tastes better than what I would get at starbucks or the supermarket but if you are wanting to duplicate  your memories of Kona coffee go elsewhere. Packaging is a big plus for this product though, for those of us that are too lazy to grind our own beans.
Kona tastes just as great as always. I'm so glad to find a site that I can buy from and not be burned.

This is a great product for anyone wishing to lower there caloric intake and enjoy pasta. This pasta tasts the same or better then the real thing, unlike whole wheat products. This is a great product just alittle on the expensive side.

I found that the Amazon price per package is the same as the manufacturer, but I ordered plenty and received free shipping with Amazon.  The NOH brand also offers many different items but the Teri-Burger mix is something we can't be without, it is a wonderful burger seasoning.

Got this because of the good review here, and brought it from another site. Glad I didn't get the pack of 12. It has a bit of a "puke-ish" smell. Made it with ground beef. Stick to black pepper and other seasonings. This just makes it taste bad. Like a light Teriyaki that someone vomitted. Sorry to be graphic. But that's how it was to me. Will not buy again.

column10: This is going to be great seasoning in plain old ground beef for BBQ hamburgers.

column9: Great for all ages and delicate stomachs
column10: We have a puppy and a three year old who always eat each other's food. With the all life stages food, we don't have to worry about it. The limited ingredient, no grain has also helped the adult dogs digestive problems.

My wife is a vegetarian and finding products that taste good to both of us is a challenge.  After finding Osem consomme products at a local Safeway, we were both hooked.  It is the next best thing to the real meat broths in flavor we have ever found.  I am glad Amazon carries these in bulk packs at a good price.

This product is positively wonderful!  Use it anywhere you might use ordinary balsamic, but use it sparingly as it packs a very fruity punch.  Apply just a bit to some fresh berries and pour it over vanilla ice cream for a fantastic desert treat.
Perfect snack while hunting or fishing or hiking or boating. Favorites of the youngand old alike and they pack away easily and stay fresh.

column9: Drank this every day in Ireland
column10: I'm really a coffee drinker, but after drinking this every day in Ireland, I'm hooked. Brew up a nice strong pot, pour in some milk and enjoy with some biscuits (That's cookies over here).

I was highly recommended to stop at Bewley's Cafe while I was in Dublin, and was definitely not disappointed. The lingering memory of the visit was the gorgeous tea I had for breakfast. I didn't get a chance to buy some while I was in Ireland, and was so excited to find that I could purchase it through Amazon. I've given a few bags to friends and family, and all have been very impressed with the taste. This tea has a very nice, smooth taste, and not nearly as strong or bitter as most breakfast teas I've tried. It's very refreshing in the mornings, even when I "ruin it" with a splash of milk and a little honey.

While in Ireland last summer, I drank Bewley's tea at the B&B in Kilkenny and bought a box at Dunne's to bring home. Those bags ran out long ago, so I ordered some online. Drinking Bewley's is like being back in Eire, walking in the garden smelling the lavender and loam. As soon as you drop the bag in the hot water, it begins to swirl a rich, dark brown, and in only a minute you have a wonderful cup of aromatic, flavorful tea.I've ordered from Bewley's before - hampers last time - and have not been disappointed. I was glad I could order though Amazon [...]. At last, I've found a place where I can order black pudding. If you want a taste of Ireland, get some Bewley's.
Bewley's Clipper Gold is my favorite tea.  I was introduced to it on a trip to Ireland and was glad to find I could order it through Amazon.  The transaction was excellent!

I make homemade pasta every Sunday and I recently gave Bellino Semolina a try.  I was really impressed with Bellino's Semolina flour when making linguini.  Normally when making pasta with a hand crank roller and cutter I need to use half Semolina and half white flour but with Bellino I was able to skip the white flour all together.  It's easy to work with, has a great consistency and has a great taste.  I highly recommend this product.  The ingredients I use for my homemade pasta is one bag of Bellino's Semolina flour, 4 extra large eggs, 4 tablespoons of Olive Oil and 1 teaspoon of salt.

I've been making my own pasta now for 2 years and thought I'd give this semolina a try. While I was a bit skeptical going in, I was hugely impressed with the results. My 12 year old daughter who 'lives by pasta' says it's the best...and actually, so do I. I'm disappointed to find it's no longer available on Amazon but I wish you'd reconsider and bring it back!

this stuff looks like fine grits but it works, it totally smoothes out when the water, egg, ex.  is added to make pasta. each bag has about 2 and 3/4's cup of the flour.  prepared with the one egg one cup and splash of water, it works great and makes a smooth pasta that is exactuly like store bought plain pasta; it is indistinguishable to me, aside from the slightly ill regular shaped noodles  b/c i rolled it out with a rolling pin and hand cut.advantages; the cheapest stuff i could find.  1.50 off+ free shipping for sighing up for auto send.disadvantages; you need to order a lot even to "play" just a little, because the bags are small.  there is not a recipe for pasta on the package. The price it still higher then if you bought already made pasta. currently you have to buy 4 bags at a time. one cup recipe makes about three large hand fulls of flat cut pasta. so one bag makes a little more the say 8 large "side servings".
This is a good product.  It's not the superfine grind, so its good for use on baking peels.  The 4 vacuum pack is good as it keeps it fresh.  I'll buy this flour again.

I bought this to use in place of corn meal on the pizza peel and stone when I make pizza. I had heard that semolina flour wouldn't burn like cornmeal, and I can definitely attest that it doesn't leave an acrid flavor or smoke up like burnt cornmeal would in my 550 degree oven.  It works great as a pizza lubricant, but I have yet to try it in homemade pasta (which I hope to do soon).  These came well packed and was actually significantly more flour than I was expecting (comes out to over 4 lbs. total between the packs).  But the packs are really hard to get open without spilling flour everywhere, as they are vacuum packed really tightly and seem to "explode" if I am not super-careful when I cut them open.  And the flour seems to kind of clump together and needs a pretty thorough sifting before it can be used.  But considering that I couldn't find coarse-ground semolina in any of my local supermarkets or Whole foods, it was well worth ordering off of amazon.

I am just learning to bake bread because we are living in a small US city this year which, while it has a terrific local cuisine and lots of organic ingredients and bakeries, did not have any authentic tasting semolina bread, which happens to be my favorite.  I found a recipe online and thought I'd give it a try.  I already knew from long experience that it was always best to buy dry pasta that was "made in Italy" if you wanted the best taste and texture -- US made pasta has a tendency to go from undercooked to overcooked mush in less than a minute -- Italian pasta is more forgiving.  Anyway, for my first batch of dough, I used this Bellino semolina and, while it wasn't perfect (I needed to make many adjustments in the recipe due to the very high altitude here), the taste was really good, very authentic.  For the next batch, I used a bag of Bob's Redmill(?) semolina because I found it at the local Whole Foods store.  The first two loaves I baked were so tasteless compared to the original ones I made, and I couldn't understand why since I had finally gotten the texture right in spite of the high-altitude complications.  Then I remembered that the Bellino semolina was from Italy, and the Bob's stuff wasn't.  Indeed the dough looked fine, but when I tasted even the raw dough, it lacked the rich creamy taste of real semolina.  My advice: don't mess around with semolina that's not from Italy if you're making pasta or bread!  Just like New York bagels, you really can't get the right result if you don't have ingredients from the right place.

Seller shipped super fast, was earlier than expected.  Product is fantastic--made pasta that was super delicious! would order again--can't wait to try the recipes on the sides of the packaging, it sounds simply wonderful!

If you want to make great pasta, then this is the flour for you to use! The amount of Semolina in the vacuum packages allows you to use just enough to make a sizable meal or two, keeping the other unopened packages of Semolina fresh.

I am fairly new at making my own pasta, but I have purchased several different brands of semolina and for the price, Bellino is pretty darned good.  So far it is the nicest quality for the price.  The vacuum packs are easy to store and stay fresh for an eternity.

Sadly, I purchased this believing all the hype in the reviews. Must be employees of the manufacturer or they own one of those industrial strength stand mixers. Of all the Keurig coffees I have tried thus far, this one is my favorite.It doesn't make sense, but this 18 pack is also the least expensive per unit of all the various sizes I could find on Amazon. This may change over time, so check for yourself first before assuming this costs the least.

column9: Great Coffee - very much like expresso!
column10: I bought this coffee because I was looking to try something new and a flavor that I could find in my local stores since my favorite is Timothy's RainForest Expresso-Extra Bold which, I can only find online and buy here.Consequently, I am happy to say, I struck gold! column10: Dark and extra bold was the description but it fell short of that. It was dark but didn't have the fully deep and lasting flavor of coffee not just strong, but deep, lasting "heavy" flavor.

I guess I shouldn't expect much in terms of taste from baby food but my son who was 8 months at the time just didn't like it at all (I bought every flavor and they all taste about the same).  I tried it and it taste kinda pasty like flourlish in addition from being bland (the bland part I expect).

My son really enjoys these toddler meal bowls. They are really tasty & the chunks of pasta in it are great as a finger food for him to feed himself. These are perfect to have when traveling. I also always bring one with me when we go out to eat at a restaurant so I know he is having a nutritious & organic meal instead of feeding him the junk from the restaurant..
My daughter hated this. I was going to order more, glad I didn't.  Love the ingredients but has no taste so unfortunately she didn't like it. I can't shove it down her throat.
i love this butter. it's better than regular butter and makes eggs or anything else taste great. Plus it's organic with higher levels of Conjugated Linoleic Acid (CLA). A must in every home, i think

Sleepytime is a popular tea that has been around a long time due to its high quality. The natural flavors and ingredients have made it a required tea for the cupboard of persons interested in healthy eating for the last 30 years! The predominant flavors are of chamomile and spearmint--but the additional ingredients--including rose buds--create a satisfying, complex blend that is very tasty and soothing. Not only is Sleepytime caffeine-free but it contains herbs that are mildly relaxing and healing for the stomach. Drink this lovely tea before bed either with or without honey.Sleepytime contains chamomile, spearmint, lemongrass, tilia flowers, blackberry leaves, orange blossoms, hawthorne berries and rosebuds. The healing qualities of some the herbs in Sleepytime are listed below, however please note that there is insufficient quantities of each herb to have anything more than a very mild effect. Blackberry leaves, which are soothing to the stomach, contain tannins which provides a tea-like base for the flowery flavors of chamomile and rosebuds. Spearmint is one of the milder mints and is also useful to soothe tummy ache. Chamomile is a wonderful herb that has a relaxing effect; it also can be used to soothe tummy aches, headache, menstrual cramps and is a mild anti-fungal.Celestial Seasonings gets extra points for their packaging: they utilize 100% natural recycled paperboard in their boxes and they don't package each tea bag individually. Instead they use a system of a waxed paper bag inside the box that stays shut when you fold it. It keeps the bags fresh and utilizes less packaging than individually wrapping each bag. The art they use on each box is beautiful as are the quotes and information they put on every surface.Quote from the box:"Ultimately, the bond of all companionship, whether in marriage or friendship, is conversation." Oscar Wilde.
