column9: Best New Idea from Coke in a Long Time!
column10: It's my understanding that this product has been pulled from Coke's lineup of products.  If that's true, it's rather disappointing news.  As a self-proclaimed "Diet Coke-aholic" I was thrilled when I heard they were adding vitamins and minerals to Diet Coke.  While it's no substitution for a well balanced diet (and you still should take a vitamin supplement if you don't get the RDA from your diet), it was an added benefit for someone like myself who drinks a lot of Diet Coke.  The addition of vitamins and minerals did NOT affect the taste, so it was the same as drinking a regular can of Diet Coke.  As I usually purchase at least 2 cases of Diet Coke each week, I'd buy 2 12 packs of Diet Coke Plus and 2 12 pks of regular Diet Coke and alternate my consumption.  Last week I discovered that there was no Plus on the shelves and the place tag for the item had been removed.  When I asked our grocery manager about this, he told me he believed that Coke had stopped production of Diet Coke Plus.  I hope that this is not true and that they're just repackaging the product (I understand that the FDA had concerns about how this product was labeled).  The added benefits of Plus would seem to outweigh any packaging discrepancy, so I hope this is something that Coke plans on fixing and soon!

I wrote to the Coca Cola Co -no response- and called my local bottler and was told due to lack of interest, that they had discontinued this product.  I work as an RN on 12 hour shifts, and would drink about 4 cans a shift.  I would feel great after I consumed this drink and miss it immensely.  Im not paying 50 bucks for a12 pack, however.

I recently went to dinner at a Moroccan restaurant and has the most delicious fruit salad there.  What made the dish so special was the combination of orange blossom water and mint that the fruit pieces were stewed in.  I bought this product to recreate the dish, and love it.  I also put it in a combination of espresso and hot milk, along with cardamom, to make an authentic north African-style coffee and it is far better than anything you can buy in a fancy cafe.  Granted, orange blossom water is and acquired taste, and I would not recommend tasting it by itself.  It is much better served in small portions, mixed with fruits, nuts, coffees, teas, and pastries.  A superb product!
I used this in Baklava.  Smells good and the Baklava tasted great.Great seller.  Packed well and shipped fast.

column9: Is it supposed to taste like this?
column10: I've cooked quite a bit with rosewater, but I'd never tried orange flower water before. I found a recipe that called for it that I wanted to try so I ordered a bottle.the water looked clear but when I opened it up I was greeted by a smell reminiscent of stagnant pond water. I was ready to throw it away, but my mother insisted on tasting it, in case it tasted better than it smelled.She spent 10 minutes over the sink spitting and gagging. Is orange flower water *supposed* to taste and smell like this? Please tell me this is a mistake. I can't imagine why anyone would want to cook with it.

column9: Not like the old french BRAND of orange flower water
column10: After reading the listing I thought it would be similar to the old French bottle brand that is no longer made, but it is not. I needed this to make my Ramous Gin Fizz. It is not as strong and is not even close to the fromer French brand.
My wife loved cooking with this product. We added it and a little bit of orange zest to make the best homemade orange whip cream we had ever had! It's a fun product to try!

I prefer the sweet licorice to the saltier versions. This is just right. Same taste as the expensive Panda boxes you can buy. Not sure how long it will take to eat 7 pounds, so hopefully it will hold up.  I am very happy with this product
This is the nicest licorice I've had in a long time. Full licorice flavor but not as harsh as the Australian.

The potatos and hot dogs are really good.... In fact they are great and will order again. The steaks and burgers are crap. Steaks are very chewy and dry. The burgers are too.... Id rather eat bubba burgers... They are much better.
I ordered this, again for my brother's Birthday.  He enjoyed it so much last year, I ordered another one for him!  Great tasting food!

I have eaten many Etouffee dishes and this by far is the best..It is easy and fast to fix with little fuss and muss..I would recommend this to anyone who enjoys Cajun dishes...The other Zatarains Cajun dishes are just as easy and taste great...

column9: Great Etouffee Base, Closest to Making Your Own
column10: This is a great shortcut if you don't have the time (or the energy and resources) to make a blond and dark roux from scratch.  If you're the kind of person who does make from scratch, this base gives you the flexibility to add your own personal touch.  I've let this base stand alone and I've added my own mix of spices.  In both scenarios, everyone who ate (even some folks who've frequented New Orleans for cuisine) were honestly pleased.Of course, keep in mind, this is a shortcut.  It won't match up to true blue creole cooking, but for folks like me who live hundreds of miles from Louisiana, this is the next best thing.Amazon priced it well, keep in mind, it's a box of 12 and the expiration date might be within one year of your purchase.  While that would seem like a downside to some, I think etouffee once a month is not enough etouffee at all.

We have a fantastic local cajun restaurant that makes incredible Crawfish Etouffee -- so I'm a big fan.  On the way home from the doctor picking up my scrips at Walmart my son and I are looking for something he can cook for dinner.  He's 24 and been around the kitchen, but we wanted to keep it simple.  Saw this item and ding.  Picked up two boxes, a couple packages of frozen, peeled, deveined shrimp and long grain white rice. Worked out so well.  I was pretty amazed.  He was very proud.  What a great product.
Etoufee by Zatarain is just as good as I remember at restaurants in New Orleans.  Simple and easy to prepare too.
Great taste! What I was expecting. I may be buying them again in the near future. They also arrived much faster than the initial estimated date.
I thought THIS WAS THE PRODUCR I GREWUP EATING , BUT IT WAS NOT IT WAS RATHER SALTY WITH VERY LITTLE SUGAR ON IT. I HAD TO THROW  IT OUT.IT WAS NOT EDIBLE.WILL NOT ORDER SALADITOS AGAIN.

These are so good!  I can never find the milk chocolate flavor in local stores.  I enjoy many things in dark chocolate, but for some reason, the milk chocolate ones are my fave.  They are thin and crispy cookies covered in milk chocolate, and they are really delicious.  Yum yum!

column9: REMINDS ME OF BEING A KID!
column10: THESE COOKIES ARE GREAT! NOT TOO SWEET, I GIVE THEM OUT TO MY SUNDAY SCHOOL STUDENTS, NOW MY PASTOR AND FAMILY JUST LOVE THEM! CANT KEEP ENOUGH IN THE HOUSE!

I've tried all kinds of famous red bean recipes from scratch yet nothing beats Zatarain's red bean seasoning mix - it's simple, easy and is one of my family's absolute favorites.  I've had friends come over who would swear that no box would ever beat their (friends, grandma's, mom's, etc.) recipe but all go away agreeing that Zatarain's is truly the best.  I typically use with smoked turkey sausage and have been making it for over 12+ years now.  Almost impossible to find in stores in the NW.  Ordering on-line is best bet.  Enjoy!

column9: Next best thing if you don't want to make from scratch
column10: I usually make red beans from scratch, but since I've tried Zatarain's Red Bean Seasoning Mix, I rarely make my own. I was surprised how good it was, since I found their Red Beans and Rice package mix not very good and would never replace my homemade red beans with that product. Only wish I could have purchased a mixed 12 pack case of a variety of other seasoning mixes like, their Etouffee, Shrimp Creole, and Gumbo base mixes, instead of having to purchase a 12 pack of only one item.
Cheaper than buying in a store(if you could find it in the store), comes right to your door,and free shipping!!What better way to shop! Don't buy from other online sites, Amazon is the best!

Zatarain's New Orleans Style Red Bean Seasoning Mix, 2.4-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 12)This stuff is so good I buy it by the 12 box pack!It makes cooking red beans a snap. Just add water and seasoning mix to beans. How much easier can it get?The flavor is awesome! It takes the spice cabinet and puts it in the pot with one mix.Saves money not having to buy all the different spices - they are all in the packet!It has made red beans and rice a hit in my home!
My order came quickly and the product was not damaged in any way.  Thanks for helping me to find this product it is great.

Zatarain's red bean seasoning is the bomb! It has easy-to-follow instructions on the box and the result is consistently delicious. I like them juicy, so I use 8C of water. For all of you who prefer cooking porkless - FYI, I cook vegetarian beans. I use a hickory seasoning that gives the flavor of smoked meats without all the extra salt and fat. This is a definite winner.I bought Zatarain's in the local grocery stores for years, but I have been unable to find it lately. So Amazon to the rescue. It's much cheaper by bulk anyway. Thanks, Amazon.

Senseo Decaffeinated Coffee Pods 48-count PodsThis is a nice 48-count bag of decaffeinated coffee pods for the Senseo system (mine is a little Hamilton Beach Personal Cup One Cup Pod Brewer, ASIN B003GW873G). Unlike the medium-roast Senseo coffee pods I have purchased, these had a bunch of loose coffee grounds in the bag, but if one of the bags leaked or exploded, I haven't discovered it yet and the coffee's fine.I was very careful in my selection, having read about disasters with some products advertised as compatible (one Melitta product was specifically advertised as completely compatible anywhere Senseo pods were used, but several people discovered after a few uses that it broke the coffee maker; some people tried coffee products with milk solids in them which jammed the coffee maker).These fit the Senseo system perfectly, really seem to be decaf (I didn't test them or anything, but they feel like decaf), they work, and they're tasty!

Without a doubt this is by far the BEST beef gravy mix that my family has ever had.  I tastes just like I made it from scratch from a pot drippings.  My grandson eats it on his all his beef and smothers his french fries with it too.

Our local specialty grocery store carried this, and I fell in love with it.  Best gravy mix ever, and way better than I ever succeeded in making from scratch.  Unfortunately the store went bust, so I was left searching.  So glad to find it here.  Same price I paid locally, and with free shipping (prime), I am back to making gourmet grave again!

I love 'spuds' - potato donuts and potato bread (w/cheese, salsa and cilantro in  a rolled loaf like cinnamon bread) and this flour works perfectly, meaning I don't have to use mashed potatoes anymore!Delivery was on time and in good order.

column9: If you like making potato bread than this IS FOR YOU!!
column10: Really fantastic stuff.  I have been baking bread at least once a week for a few years now.  Some recipes call for potato flakes.  You know the packets of dehydrated potato flakes for instant mash potatoes?  What they really mean is this potato flour.  I guess maybe it is hard to find??  Comes in small plastic bag.  I thought that it would be bigger.  Like the size of a sandwich bag.  In most of my recipes I use 2 tablespoons in place of the instant flakes.  THIS STUFF REALLY MAKES A BIG DIFFERENCE.  I also recently purchased some gluten.  I now add in 1 tablespoon for everyone cup flour.  These days all my loafs and rolls really turn out like a professional quality. I will be buying again soon!!

column9: Just Made for Lazy Cooks Like Me
column10: I have a fraternal twin sister who always uses fresh garlic when she cooks, which is not as often as I cook. As for me, I found buying jars of crushed garlic in my grocery store eons quicker and less messy than doing it myself. However, my store stopped carrying it, carrying only minced garlic. I liked the pasty texture of the crushed better and was relieved to find it on Amazon. I could have ordered a single bottle but it would not be Prime, so I elected to buy the case since I do use garlic a lot, and I do mean A LOT. When the shipment came I used some for the shrimp I was sauteing and it flavored the product with plenty of garlic flavor. I use it on steaks, chops, mushrooms, in spaghetti sauce and anything else I want to add a garlic flavor to. Needless to say, this product will be used frequently. The McCormick name deserves its reputation and I am very satisfied with the quality of their product.

Ordered from Amazon and the item received was already expired. Complained to Amazon customer service but received no response so far. Very disappointing shopping experience. Would recommend buying from local grocery market, i.e. Whole Foods.

This is my absolute favorite granola. I have been eating it every morning for about 4 months now and I still look forward to each morning's bowl. The oats, because of the way they are toasted, shatter in your mouth rather than sogging up like thicker oats do (for example, those in the Bear Naked granola, which is also terrific, but not on quite the same level). The amount of cranberry and walnut is just enough to keep your taste buds interested. A serving of Udi's with a whole chopped apple or a half dozen chopped strawberries topped with milk...mmmm...can't wait till morning!
I do enjoy a good bowl of cereal, but I want more than just good taste.  This gives both the yummy fruity sweet taste and the healthy start to my morning.

I have an obsession with Udi's Cranberry Granola. So much so that I have Amazon deliver it to my house in 6 packs every month! I literally eat this every morning for breakfast. Some people look forward to their morning cup of coffee...I look forward to my morning bowl of Udi's!!

column9: Don't break you teeth on cranberrys
column10: I loved the Hawiaan mix, and when it was no longer available, I decided to go for this one.  I am so disappointed, and spend my mornings picking out the cranberry rocks.  Ussually all Udi products for the gluten free are superior, but this cranberry granola should never leave the factory,

No one sells Udi's in my area.  After a bit of hesitation I ordered this product and am very glad I did.  The granola arrived fresh (exp. date 4 months away) and was well packaged.  I highly recommend getting your Udi's fix via Amazon.

you get what you pay for, this isn't the cheapest out there but it's the highest protein, lowest carb/sugar, highest fiber of any of the store brands carried locally and doesn't taste like you're eating wood chips. I love this stuff, the dried cranberries are fantastic, I normally have some of this with a 1/3rd cup of blueberries and a 1/2 cup of yogurt. Fantastic. I got a 6 pack of this stuff when the local grocer stopped carrying it for a month and I'd tried the "next best" offering that they carried and it was horrible, I HAD to have my Udi's!
This is the best granola I've found. It's relatively low in carbs (18) and has 3g of fiber. I recommend it highly. I would like Amazon to sell the 16oz rather than the 13oz bags.
Love this granola over fruit and yogurt.  Haven't been able to find this variety in my supermarket lately. Pleaase continue to carry the cranberry .

This granola is spectacular! It is crunchy and flavorful, the cranberries are zingy and add the perfect touch. It is lower in fat than most granola and tastes just as good, if not better! I have been eating it with yogurt, with milk or just plain out of the bag and I can't get enough! The ingredients are simple- no hydrogenated oils or corn syrup, just oats, honey and canola oil. Fantastic!

Our family really likes this granola. It is a natural, healthy, organic cereal and it's also delicious. My husband eats it almost every morning for breakfast with a little yogurt stirred in.I was glad to find it online. After I'd purchased it the first time I had trouble finding it. We go through the six bags quickly so it's not a problem ordering a case.
I have tried different natural granolas...Udi's is the best one I have found so far...try the variety pack and pick your personal favorite!
I LOVE the cereal, however, when I've purchased it at a store it was fantastic and what I bought through Amazon was a bit stale.  The cranberries were so hard I couldn't bite into them.

column9: Zatarain's White Bean Seasoning Mix  - the way to cook beans!
column10: Zatarain's White Bean Seasoning Mix is an excellent addition to any home pantry!It makes cooking dry beans so easy and effortless. You don't have to think about what spices to add to help flavor the pot of beans sitting on the stove.I buy these in bulk when I buy them because I can't get them at my local grocer.Try it - you won't be disappointed!

I enjoy this white beans seasoning, it gives a rich flavor to the beans I just love it, my mother in law didn't know about this Zatarain's brand and now she is traying different seasoning and she likes it very much.Thank you Amazon for having it because now I can't find it in stores, I like to have this 12 boxes because I can made it whenever my family want it.

I just made my first pot of white beans and I can't believe how good it is.  Coming from New Orleans I love the food and this is like being there.  I added andouille sausage and it is a perfect addition.  I would recommend buying this to anyone.  Enjoy.

column9: Great,easy for a fantastic taste...Order by the case saves money
column10: This product has great flavor and I am glad to find on line so I can afford to buy.The shipping was fast and great. I recommend to anyone that likes flavor to try.We add  large lima beans one week and the next week we use great northern.Just what ever you like.its great..

This is a must have!  Spices are just right.  A little on the spicy side, but not too hot for people that doesn't eat hot spicy foods.  Captures the taste of New Orleans!!  I add smoked sausage slices and it everyone loves it!
This product I recommend to everybody, beans were very tasteful when you use this seasoning mix.

Zatarains white bean seasoning mix works equally well with large limas (butter beans) and navy beans. The seasonings are perfectly balanced and the flavor is simply scrumptious. Purchasing in bulk from Amazon was easy and the order arrived quickly.

I am an avid tea drinker-we're talking several cups a day, so I am constantly buying teas and looking for new and exciting ones to change/spice things up. My normal favorite is the Lipton Green Tea "Superfruit" collections, but came across this one, and decided to give it a try. (The fact that it was Egyptian Mint and in the "pyramid" shape made it more appealing since I'm an Egyptian Pagan, but it was the Green tea peppermint combination that caught my eye originally-really. :)The flavor is very nice, not overwhelming nor too bland. The pyramid sachets are individually wrapped in a supersealed plastic/cellophane type wrapper that truly seals in the freshness (and keeps them dry if you accidentally drop them into a wet sink, or water etc)(Yes, I've done that with the lipton bags before ruining a whole box, as well as dropping the pitcher on the counter and soaking everything within run off range. These are accident proof, though!)The ingredients are: Green Tea, Peppermint, and Licorice Root. Peppermint is good for the digestive system, and Licorice Root is good for metabolism (as is Green Tea.)Plus for those of you who are Mother Earth-wise, the sachets are 100% biodegradable, so they won't add to the landfill problem. And lastly but equally important, all three ingredients are certified organic-no pesticides to pollute your body!!!!

Tea arrived in a timely manner and we love this tea iced.  I drink this tea a lot in the evening as is has no caffeine and is so refreshing.  I have purchased from Harney and Sons a few times and have always been happy with my items.  Thank you H & Sons for some great tea!

The ingredients in this tea are wonderful... no soy lechitin, no hidden weird flavors.  I have bought this sachet packet from Harney and Sons and also their foil-wrapped individual travel bags.  Both are a great cup.  Each bag can brew several servings before needing a new bag.  Wonderful tea and wonderful brand.

Flavor is good, not excellent. I really like these but I have to stay accurate here with the review. They are very good but not the best. I guess there are some limits you get from staying healthy. As a health snack I'd give them 5 stars though.Secondly, they leave almost no oil residue in your mouth. So you don't have to wash them down with any strong soda to cut the film off of your tongue. And let's face it, a healthy snack is not healthy if you have to use some unhealthy drink to wash it down.All in all, these are one of my favorite healthy snacks. Very good.

These are THE original veggie stix.  If you go to to a major grocery chain store or Whole Foods, most have resorted to selling veggie "straws," which are like veggie stix but hollow, hard, and overly salty.  The Good Health veggie stix are a lighter snack and simply, just taste better in my opinion.I was happy to find the product on Amazon, but learned quickly that 10-7oz bags is a lot.  I bought the product in the beginning of Summer and it had an expiration date for August.  Unless you really love snacking on these things, it's probably more worth it to buy in the store if you can help it.

One of the things I really appreciate about these (good sized) three ounce bags of veggie sticks is the following:Servings per container: 3Calories per serving: 140They taste great and a one ounce serving is generous. They really are a good snack and a good value.

My husband and I love this snack food. Unfortunately, we love it so much that 12 bags can easily be consumed in a week or less. They are a terrific alternative to potato chips or fries as a side "dish" when serving hotdogs, hamburgers or a simple tuna sandwich.If you are in the market for a light, tasty, not-too-salty or oily snack food, this product is just the ticket. But be forewarned, it can be addictive!

I just got this product and the expire date is for March 2012!  That's crazy.  Not to mention how long the product took to get to me.  I ordered several other things on the same day and this order came more than a week after everything else. Will not buy again!

column9: Good value, not oily, crisp, fresh, but dominated by the potato variety
column10: Overall one of the better veggie stix I have tried. I liked that they have much less of an oil taste than other brands I have tried; very fresh tasting. Also better than store bought price especially if you use subscribe and save.I got these in late December and they had around a 3 month expiration date. The have the standard potato, tomato, and spinach flavors. And like most brands I have bought in store they are not evenly placed in the bag, the potato flavor dominates. But not more than other brands, and these taste better and better priced at Amazon. Recommended.

column9: Yummy.......and good for you (well, better than some other stuff)
column10: Trying to break the frito habit, I tried veggie chips.  Really yummy and no greasy aftertaste.  Buy them by the case and put on monthly auto-delivery.  You will always have something appropriate for late night snacks and those take-along snacks to the lake or golf course.  Each bag contains only 140 calories - with much better ingredients.  Unfortunately, I'm now addicted to Veggie Chips, and so are my five children and 12 grandchildren.  But I don't feel guilty.

I chose these to have as a light snack being that they are only 130cal/package, which is 1 oz. They do the job and they are quite filling but they are soo greasy. It feels as though they just sit in my stomach and make me feel icky!

I was grocery shopping two days ago at the local Wal-mart. My daughter went down the chip aisle looking, of course, for potato chips. Out of the corner of my eye I saw a bag that read Veggie Stix. I picked them up, glanced over them and said to myself "Naw, probably tastes like crap.",and walked away. I was trying to find a snack for myself and everything was high in sodium or contained additives. So, I went back and decided to try the Veggie Stix. That was the best purchase that I made in the store that day. I got them home, tried them and had to force myself to stop eating them. And the BEST part is that when I let my grandkids try them they LOVED them. That was the only bag that I saw in the store that day, but believe me I will be checking to find out if it is an item that Wal-mart regularly stocks. If not I will be ordering from Amazon.com. Very Good.
I am a feeding specialist whom gets many complaints about children not eating their vegetables. This is a great healthy alternative fun snack to veggies.  I recommend this product to parents weekly.
These taste great and are healthy for you, as well. Great alternativwe to chips. We give them to our 2 year old as a snack. It is a sneaky way to get some extra veggies in to her.

I liked the taste of the bags that were sealed good, but probably about half of the bags were not sealed properly.  The ones that were not sealed correctly tasted stale, so I was really disappointed with these.  I have had this brand in a larger bag, and really liked them, so I don't know what happened, but I do know that I won't be buying these smaller size bags anymore!  There were openings in a couple of the bags on the end, but most of them just did not have the air tight seal in the bag.

This package comes with 24 same bags of mixed chips.  When I say mixed, I mean green, yellow and orange chips.  They are supposed to be made from good vegetables like carrots, spinach, etc. but they all taste the same - yummy though!I buy these 2-3 times a year and have it delivered to my office where I enjoy them as a late afternoon snack once in a while.

I tasted it first time in Vancouver and I Loved the Taste!!Jenssens Orchard is best but too expensive.Send it regularly to Afghanistan and I think they got addicted.And the price is very good. 24 packs is quite fine.Right now I am frustrated because I cant get it delivered here.Another product I intend to stock as soon as I can.  It is like a meal.Children should replace doritos and the like with these. less harmful for health
I recieved a free sample of the Veggie Krinkle sticks and really was very impressed!  I am planning to purchase and be a customer as I think they are a healthy alternative to potato chips1
These are really good but, I feel, a bit pricey. I've not seen these anywhere else, but then I haven't been looking. Good snack but not as healthy, I believe, as one might think, Still very good!

column9: The best chip I've EVER had
column10: I'm not even going to lie, I learned about these delicious little snacks by snagging a couple from my roommate's bag.  I go to the store that is almost 10 miles away--on the bus--just to get a bag of these.As one commenter suggested, they can be a little bit greasy, but since I bring them to work in a paper towel and inside of a baggie, I don't have a problem at all.  I don't think they're too salty.  They're about as thick as fries from burger king and they taste EXACTLY like french fries.As has been mentioned, almost 40 straws is one serving and its only 130 kCals!  I've switched to eating these as a snack instead of any alternative and I don't even need to portion them out by serving size.  They're so filling, I usually don't even eat 25 at once.I hope these are sold all over the country because the prices here are pretty steep and I'd love to share Veggie Straws with my family back home.  I get them at the grocery store for about 3.50/7ounce bag.Happy snacking!

If you want a low-fat and low calorie natural snack, these veggie stix are tasty and have 55% lower fat than potato chips.  They are fun to munch on.  I was surprised, however, that they had no Vitamin A as some vegetable snacks do.No fiber, and only 1 g protein.  So, they are more healthy for what they don't have, than what they do offer.  And that's fine for a snack.  If you want snacks that offer some nutrition, popcorn chips offer fiber and sweet potato chips often have Vitamin A.  I'd get these for fun for a party for something different, but it would be great if they had a little more nutrition in them.

column9: Love this product/Glad Amazon sells this
column10: Most everybody loves chips, but don't want to feel guilty (at least I don't), about eating them. These chips are a good way for me to get the crunchy/salty flavor and satisfaction from eating "chips", yet these are healthier than just regular potato chips. I love the hint of salt and garlic. For those that are afraid of the "spinach", you really can't tell that you are eating spinach. I love the convenience of the size of these. Since it's just me , I can sit and eat a whole bag (bigger), without even thinking about it, but with this size, it's easier to control the portion. Since not all stores carry this product, it's great that I know that I can order from Amazon. I think the price is reasonable also.
I love love love these and would really like a bigger bag.  24 one ounce bags is ok, but would like to choose my own portion.  They came very fast and were in perfect condition.

I am hooked on these.  I am on a diet and they are healthy but still have calories, so I limit myself one a day as my treat, and ANYONE would like them.  Anyone that has tried then at my house do.  And, they come in two sizes.
I wanted a healthy alternative to chips for my 2 year old. These are it. He loves them and they actually taste great!
I love having these on hand to pack in lunches, or to satisfy the urge to crunch.  Probably not as healthy as a salad , but more nutritionally sound than regular potato chips.
NOT ONLY THE DELIVERY WAS EXTREMELY FAST BUT THE PRODUCT IS WORTH EVERY PENNY.  PRODUCT IS DIFFERENT, LESS GREASY, NOT TO HARD TO CHEW AND FUN TO OFFER IN PARTY TRAYS.  I LOVE IT.
I'm so happy with this purchase! Not only are the Veggie Stix great, but the portion control is so easy this way. AND the price is right, too. Adefinite win-win!
These chips are really great tasting especially for a healthy version.  These are the best tasting healthy chips I have ever had.  They are really addicting!  You save money by buying on Amazon too!

...but I love these!They're light and crunchy with a much more interesting flavor than plain ol' chips. Don't know anything about the nutrition of them, but I hope they're healthy since I just ate a whole bag of them.

column9: Was a good idea for school lunches...BUT!
column10: So, so not fresh; they were stale. Stale. Stale. Stale, so stale. Disappointingly stale. Stale! And oh yeah, all the bags were stale.

These had good flavor but not the texture.  I thought would be like a real vegetable chip or at least be like a real potato chip..you know, crisp, etc.  I really don't like the pringle like texture..if you do, you'll probably enjoy these

Ten bags were consumed in eight days. If you are worried about not eating enough vegetables, this product is GOOD.  The taste is great and as a snack or with soup or dip your guests will enjoy this vegetarian product.  There are other Vegetable Chips that contain more nutrients but they are more expensive.

I ordered the 10-bag product and only received 6 bags.  Do not order from this company as it does not fulfill it's obligations to their customers.  I could have tolerated the 10-day wait for the order to come in if it had been exactly what I ordered, but it wasn't.

I got these, thinking that they'd be a good healthy snack, and they do indeed taste pretty good. But they are way too oily. I expected them to be more like Veggie Chips, which I really like. But they aren't.Hey, they might be healthy but it doesn't matter. They leave a greasy residue in your mouth/throat after eating just a handful of them. Just as bad as french fries.

I would not buy this from Amazon because they have not provided the nutritional information on the package. I find it ironic that they provide disclaimers about reading the labels when they don't provide the information needed to make an informed choice.

column9: Awesome item but can't order in Alaska
column10: I loved this item, and wanted to order, but wasn't a option in my area. I would really like to order Good Health Veggie Stix, 7-Ounce Bags (Pack of 10) but says they cannot ship to my area. I gave bad review becuase they won't ship to my area. Alaska is a state. Its not like its out of America!!
Oh my gosh, this is some of the best coffee I have ever tasted!  I am a toffee fan to begin with, but this is a perfect combination, and it's done well!  I will be buying more soon!!

This coffee is fine, if you like average.  But, both my husband and I like a rich bold taste without bitterness. We adore the flavor of the Carmel Kiss in particular.  If you want a nice smooth cup of coffee with just a hint of toffee, this is for you.

I received a bag of Coffee Masters Highlander Grogg as a present when my son was born (another Five Star Coffee).  I stumbled across the Sticky Toffee on Amazon when I went to order more HG and figured why not?  To truly have a great cup, if you don't have one already, pick up a grinder, a bag of whole bean Sticky Toffee, and enjoy yourself.

The belts were fresh and tasty, just like the candy store used to have. The cases were cracked when they arrived in the shipping box so it seems from some of the other review its pretty common, but didn't affect the quality. 1 order is 2 tubs, which last a long time.I do not recommend vaccum sealing to keep some fresh as the vaccum smashes the belts together and makes them hard to peel apart. Ziplock bags work much better.

column9: Not quite sure how you could go wrong with these
column10: These are the strawberry belts of my childhood. They're rarely sold in small packaged quantities like other gummy candy, but they're like the candy at the candy store.They came nicely packaged and fresh. Absolutely delicious. There is a LOT of extra sugar in the box and they're more sour than the ones I remember.These strawberry belts are great. They're addictive, though--I wouldn't sit down with the box.

column9: A delcious gift for anyone who loves sour candy.
column10: A fantastic gift for anyone who loves sour candy. Extremely addictive and fresh.Containers arrived in perfect condition with a plastic bag around each one for extra freshness.These seem to last forever! Way fresher than the mall vendors.Did I mention they are fresh!?
I found these at harry potter world in universal. xD I fell in love instantly and went on a internet search for more, they're defiantly the same ones~! So good. >w<

I LOVE my candy!! I used to each these as a child and then I found them when I was on a cruise. I looked and looked and looked and could never find them.....until I checked on Amazon!!!!!!!!! Thanks so much (I cant stop eating them!)

Wow!  These things are awesome, taste just like the ones you get from a good candy store at the mall except these are a bit more sour.  My package also arrived quick and unbroken which was a relief.  I would recommend this product.

I lived in Europe when I was and would purchase these from street-side kiosks. These are good however I "age" them to greatness by leaving the cover off for about a week. This gives the belts just the right amount of staleness and brings back the nostalgia of youth.

The classic strawberry belts that you find in those expensive candy stores at the mall. These are so good, the only downside to these which others have mentioned is that the boxes may have a crack in them when they arrive, there is a plastic wrapping that seals the two packs together but one of my boxes the candy is starting to get a little bit hard, it will not stop me from eating this delicious candy.

column9: For me, there is no other!
column10: These are the perfect amount of sour. I compare them to candy stores in malls. The kind where you pay by the pound. I normally sneak in there and grab just a few strips... paying through the nose... typically $11 per POUND! These are JUST as sour and tasty, except, $3.86 per pound!Great deal, great candy! Will be buying another batch soon!
What you see is what you get: Two gigantic tubs of strawberry-flavored diabetes strips. They're just as good as I remember them as a kid, except in a delicious package of 300.

column9: Delicious, but a little too much sugar
column10: As stated in the title, these belts are delicious, but believe it or not, they actually have a little TOO much sugar on them. I actually have to scrape some off. It's not that they're too sour. It's just way too much sugar. I would buy them again, but I prefer the other belts that are on here a little more.
Read some reviews on amazon and decided to go with these because they got good sour ratings.  Man, these things were super sour.  Plus u get two boxes!
love these candys so much but when they were shipped there container got broken. Still the Candy was still fresh

I ordered these right before the new year to give to my brother as a birthday gift. Both tubs were cracked pretty bad but I called Amazon's customer service and was told they would send me a new shipment as soon as they came back in stock. Excellent customer service and in my opinion the best sour belts around, much better than the brand sold at Costco. Just make sure to leave feedback in your order history regarding the packaging.

I used to buy these for a dime a piece on the way home from school when I was growing up. Now I can have 300 shipped to me whenever I want :D They are so sour and sweet and tasty, it could probably be the best candy ever made, especially if you love sour candies :)

I fell in love with this candy in Virginia, where I found it in a bulk candy store in Williamsburg.  When I moved to Utah, I couldn't find these anywhere.  I called every local candy store I could find online but nobody had them.  I was so happy to find these!  They taste just like the ones I bought fresh in the candy store in Virginia!  When I got them in the mail, they were still soft.  Great purchase!

Came very quickly to my house and I was so please with the amount that I got. The only difference from these belts to the ones you buy at a candy shop is that they are a little more sour. If you really LOVE sour candy, this is good for you.

column9: Great Product but plastic tubs arrived broken
column10: This was exactly what I was looking for and shipping was fast, reasonable prices but poor packaging. Both plastic tubs were supposed to be sealed but they arrived extremely damaged, cracked and broken. Candy was awesome as was shipping.

Ate these since I was a kid and still love them today as an adult! I'm so glad Amazon sells them and it's a very reasonable price. Will continue buying from Amazon and it's fast shipping. Overall, love these candies!

Very disappointed with this order.  My tubs came completely cracked!!!  I have had this candy many times and LOVE IT but the plastic tub packaging is unacceptable. Who would eat food that has been exposed and open?!  The best way to go is the individually wrapped ones (which I have ordered before with no issue).  I would not recommend ordering this kind.[...]
i love this product...but shipping needs to be revised  received in broken containers 2 out of 3 containers were broken!! i was giving them as gifts..cant now...again great product crappy shipping

just love these rolled butter cookies~they are delicious dipped in chocolateand make wonderful gifts for an occassion!have yet to find anyone that didn't love them.sorry they are so hard to come by.waited 6 months before i got an alert that icould get some to my door..

column9: Guar gum for the gluten intolerant stomach
column10: Guar Gum Powder, 8 oz. Great product, great price. As a person that can not tolerate, Gluten, corn in any form, soy, any form of emulsifier, or food color, I have to be carefull. I tried this and it really improved the texture of the bread I baked. My family is happy with it, The only reservation I have is that I was a little dizzy the day after I ate it so I will wait a week and test it again. I really hope I am NOT sensitive to this as non gluten bread is not so good with out it. I will continue to use it for the family as every one else have had good results from it.
I love sun drops but, a high price. They taste great! Love that they are all natural. I rated 4 stars of the price,

These are a good candy for children that need to be on all natural diets.  If eaten plain, they are no match for M&Ms.  They worked well in monster cookies, however.  At least, I thought so.  My husband and children did not agree with me, however.  I think these are an excellent alternative if some of the artificial flavors and colors found in other candy do not agree with you (or you don't agree with them).
I love these and have been eating them for a long time. They are yummy both with and without peanuts.

ALL natural Plain Chocolate Sundrops are REAL candy.  This candy does NOT contain chemical concoctions such as artificial colors and artificial flavors. I could never give my grandchildren a chemical laced candy.  ALL natural Plain Chocolate Sundrops - the finest candy available.

I bought these because they were all natural.  I've been trying to avoid eating foods containing artificial dyes and these were a great replacement for the popular candy that has dyes.  I find them to be a little less sweet but actually prefer that.  The candy shells are quite brittle and most of the candies came with cracked shells.  i.e. The bottom of the bag had quite a bit of chipped candy coating.  This didn't really bother me as I like these for the taste, not their appearance, but I could see how others may be turned off by this.  I'd buy these again.
My family & I think these taste way better than m&m's, plus they don't have all the added nasties!  This chocoholic says a big "thank you!"

I agree with the other posters  and I like how these do not have artifical colorings and I eat these pretty much guilt free. Since I really like M&M's, these are a healthier alternative and I gobble them up quickly! On the other hand, I will say they are quite expensive ($1.99 at Whole foods) and they do not have the sweetness of an M&M. While I like to have sundrops for the "natural" aspect of things, I do like the taste of M&M's a little better but only because they add more sugar.Overall, a good product and one I would recommend, especially for children! I like to have these with a salty snack, preferably popcorn!
I have been eating Clearbrook Farms Jams for many years. They are the only comercially made jams that I have ever been able to find that are like what my mother made. Simply delicious.

column9: The most amazing jam on the planet
column10: You're probably thinking "it's just jam, how good can it be".  I give this jam to everyone I know and then they find that no other jam quite measures up.  It has an extremely concentrated, clean flavor. Also this is quite a large jar of jam so the price is fairly reasonable.  Try it, you'll love it.

column9: Amazon is wrong- this jam DOES have added sugar
column10: For those people who are looking for jam with NO ADDED SWEETENERS:I bought this beautiful jam from Amazon, which states it as having "No added preservatives or sweeteners" which is why I purchased it.Since we have stone-age speed dial-up, I was unable to ever get any label page to load (I tried for over 2 hours! with no success) to check on the truth of the Amazon statement before I ordered it. Amazon does have quite a legal disclaimer stating that the info they have on their website may be wrong. I wanted to see the jam's label and ingredients. I had no luck getting any more info than what Amazon had.However, I needed a gift in a hurry - one with no sugar added for a very special person, so I took a gamble that Amazon's statement "No added preservatives or sweeteners" was correct.  I lost the bet... my fault obviously (considering their disclaimer), but still very annoying.I am very much less inclined to order from Amazon in the future if their product info is what I am basing my order on.While the jam may well be wonderful for those who eat sugar, it is unfortunately typical of the kinds of sugared jam one can buy anywhere, except that this jam is wildly expensive. If you are looking for something special with no added sweetners - you need to keep looking beyond this Clearbrook Farms Oregon Red Raspberry Preserves- it has added sugar in it.
Worth every penny ... nothing compares. I found this jam in a TJ Maxx and wish I had bought more than one. It is that good.

I bought this jam on a whim for the first time at an upscale grocery store that specializes in gourmet items.  I was amazed when I tried it.  It packed more flavor than any raspberry jam I had ever eaten and I now look forward to breakfast because of it.  The grocery store where I bought it is an hour's drive from my house so whenever I was in the area, I would make a special stop to purchase more of Clearbrook Farms Oregon Red Raspberry Preserves.  Imagine my surprise last time when I found the store no longer carried it!  I was not to be stopped and found it through Amazon.  I bought two jars knowing that would last me a while since the jars are big and one needs less jam since the flavor is intense.  Delivery was timely; the jars were well packed; and I'm a happy camper.
Opening this jar is a chore, easiest done by heating it a while in hot water, then pry off. The preserves are delicious
I bought these for our dogs (Samoyed, and a Golden Retriever.) They liked them, but ate them in a matter of a few minutes.My biggest complaint....that they are made in China.I won't buy them again.

I purchased these bones for my two large dogs.  I purchased the largest bones available, thinking this will keep my dogs busy for a while.Man, was I wrong.  My dogs went through a large bone each within thirty minutes.Now I have one very sick dog on my hands, which will probably end at the vets office.

First of all, the ingredients listed on Amazon are not nearly as complete as the ingredients listed on the actual bag. One of my dogs is allergic to peas and carrots, both of which are in the ingredient list on the bag, but not listed on the site.Secondly, one large "SmartBone" takes my large breed dog no more than 5 minutes to devour. At three dollars a bone, this is way too expensive.

We bought a SmartBone from Petsmart (not Amazon) but were so disappointed that we wanted to warn as many people as possible. Our dog loved it, but within seconds the end of the bone popped off and she almost choked on it. Then she got really hyperactive and was breathing hard for a long time afterwards. There's a lot of sugar in this product and none in her regular food, so we think she had some sort of sugar rush. She's just now starting to calm down several hours later. All that aside, the bone didn't last nearly as long as it should (for the price), and the mental anguish just isn't worth it. Spend your money elsewhere.
These are the best bones ever! SmartBones really hit the nail on the head with these bones. My dog likes all the flavors and I like knowing they can digest them easily.

My dog would sell her soul to get a SmartBone - but will chew through it and finish it off in less than 5 minutes (I have a 65 lbs pitbull mix and bought the large SmartBones recommended for 50+ lbs dogs).  It's a great reward for her as she'll do anything to get it - but it won't keep her busy.

I had dined at a great asian/fusion restaurant where sweet soy sauce was served as a dipping sauce, in addition to regular soy, and everyone at our table much preferred the sweet soy sauce. It so far surpassed the regular soy in flavor....I was astounded....much milder and not as harsh in taste as the regular soy. I got this here at Amazon from importfood and it was shipped super fast and packed very securely. It is somewhat thick, and in order to add it to rice etc., I mixed in about 3 parts water, and it makes a great dipping sauce in that consistency as well. I have also used it without diluting it in stirfrys, and it is never overpowering, just right. I am thrilled to have found this. I also ordered some of the ABC Sweet Soy, it is much thicker than this one[like molasses] and somehow seems stronger in taste than the Healthy Boy. I am however,still in the early stages of experimenting with these.  I went to my pantry and got out the supermarket brands of Kikko.... that I had, and gave them away. Never will I use those again. Do give this a try if you like Asian, Thai, or stirfries of any kind.

These cookies are great, great taste, healthy ingredients. I amm gluten and lactose intolerant and it is not too hard to find cookies made with out gluten, but finding cookies with no eggs, lactose and gluten is difficult. I have likes all of Enjoy Life Products and order through Amazon all of my cookies and breakfast foods. Comes right to the front door and I do not have to travel around trying to find what I want. Seems like the gourmet and specialty food stores are not consistant with their inventory and keep changing products, so you never know if the store will have the same products from week to week.

The sugar crisp cookies are delicious. I am gluten intolerant, but my husband is not and he loves them too. I like the chocolate chip almost as much.They are better than anything I can make at home with a gluten free mix or gluten free flour. They remind me of what I used to make at Christmas before the gluten intolerance. I can't believe they can make these without allergens.I also use them to make almost instant no bake cheesecakes.You can use store bought cheesecake filling on top of a cookie or make your own.I use 4 oz mascarpone, 1 t (or more) lemon juice, 1 T (or more) confectioners sugar 1 t vanilla.I mix all of this and spread it on top of 2 cookies and top them with 1 crumbled cookie.

The most amazing hypoallergenic cookies around!!! They are sweet and crunchy and soooo addicting!! My friend sent me a box in a care package and I was hooked! I got right on Amazon and bought a case of 6 boxes. If you have allergies, these will be your best friend!!!
I ordered these cookies for my son who has celiac disease.  He loves them!  I will keep ordering them from Amazon because it's a great deal!!!!
Best sugar cookie flavor!  Crispy crunchy vanilla yum.  So delicious.  Addicting!  I will definitely buy this flavor again.  I also love the choco chewy bars.

Enjoy life products have always been hit or miss with me.  I had heard good reviews about their new cookies and decided to order the sugar cookie. One of my sons has a tree nut allergy and I have Celiac,an oat allergy and am lactose intolerant so Enjoy life is a mainstay in our house.Man are these cookies good!  They are very buttery (with no dairy!,crisp and very addictive.  Amazon had such a great price, I wish I had ordered 2 cases. Everyone in the family tried them and loved them. I highly recommend this product!  I cannot wait to try the other flavors!

My 2 yr old son has autism, sensory processing disorder, and multiple food allergies (wheat, dairy, and soy). He is a very picky eater and finding foods he can and will eat can be very challenging. These are by far his favorite cookies. I've always loved sugar cookies so I figured I would try them too, even though I can eat any foods I want. I have to say, I was very pleasantly surprised at how delicious these are. I'm going to purchase several boxes so my son and I don't run out. I'm addicted to these cookies and my son always chooses these over all of the other Enjoy Life cookies and other brands (not many out there for him)including homemade cookies that we have tried. Thank You Enjoy Life for making products free of all 8 major allergens. You have made my life easier!!!

I'm new to the food allergy world.  I stumbled across this brand's Enjoy Life Very Berry Chewy On The Go Bars, Gluten, Dairy & Nut Free, 5-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 6) at my local Whole Foods so I went in search of other products in their line.I was hoping these cookies would provide a nice relief for my sweet tooth but the texture is a bit tough to get over.  The taste is fine (in that they are sweet) but these cookies are very sandy.  Imagine if you made a thin cookie out of mud, then let it dry in the sun.  Then after a few days, you took a bite.  That's how I described the texture to my husband (who does not have any FA).I'm glad to have these as a choice but frankly, I won't be ordering them again.Lastly, I wish the company would repackage their products so there's not so much wasted space.  The boxes are slightly smallish, which I expected, but when you open it and there are 7 cookies on each side, with a big spacer in the middle, makes you wonder if they do that on purpose to make the customer feel like they're getting more?  I'm fine with the price but there's no need to try to pretend to be something you're not.If you have a sweet tooth too, I would suggest Enjoy Life Foods Chocolate Bar Boom CHOCO Boom Dark Chocolate 12 Barsinstead.  The Milk choc and the rice ones don't taste very good but the dark chocolate is pretty tasty (and I'm not even a big chocolate fan).

I had these 5 years ago to help with morning sickness, when I was pregnant with my daughter.  They really helped my stomach.  Last month, my father was diagnosed with cancer.  The side affects to all the medications and cancer symptoms made my dad nauseas.  He had nausea medication, but the dosage didn't last as long as it should have.  These little babies helped my dad and made the nausea bearable.

I had purchased this assortment from Costco and of course they no longer carry it.  I tried several times to find this product, even e-mailed Hersheys.  They kept telling me this assortment was available at Krogers and Meijers, not at any of my stores.  The chocolate is awesome and each square is 45 calores.  What is not to love about that.  I would highly recommend this assortment if you love dark chocolate, there is nothing better.  Awesome!
We first bought these at Costco, however they no longer have them so I went on line to find them.  They are perfect to satisfy my need for dark chocolate

In an effort to reform my omnipresent sweet tooth, I thankfully have acquired a taste for small, almost daily doses of dark chocolate.  I have tried numerous dark chocloate brands but the one I always come back to is Hershey's dark chocolate assortment.  I love the small thin, little wrapped squares and the smooth, rich taste. Alas, when my favorite squares with the blueberries and almonds are gone I long for them and I am tempted to buy another bag to replenish, but I resist and enjoy the others...almost as much (I sometimes eat them along with a few roasted almonds). I realize Hershey's makes the larger bars with the blueberries and nuts...but it's just not the same as those little thin squares which make it so much easier to constrain yourself. One suggestion for Hershey's:  please give your customers an option to customize the assortment, similar to what m&m's does with the personilized orders - it would make my day :)
I can tell Hershey try to mimic some higher end chocolate. But they still need to improve the taste a little bit. Doesn't taste as good, neither as smooth.

Hubby loves this chocolate for his "fix".  Used to find it locally in stores but is no longer carried, so I was SO happy finding in online through Amazon. I order regularly to keep these chocolates in a basket on the counter!

Our fat orange tabby had been on Science Diet all 9 years of his life. He started hurling on the carpet more then usual (usual being kitty revenge for some slight) so we contacted my boyfriend's sister who has been a vet for over 15 years. She said sometimes manufacturers just change the ratios or ingredients in a cat food and it doesn't set well with some consumers. Eukanuba was one of the recommended brands -- a kennel I worked at in college swore by it -- so we weaned him onto it and no issues since. I'd recommend it solely because he's picky ( hates treats, milk, cream, tuna fish oil ... Everything ) and because it settled his stomach.

I have a 12 year old female who is over 15 pounds and my vet recommended a lower fat dry food.  I switched to this food and for about 8 months did not notice any improvement in her weight.  What I did notice was at least 3 times a week blood outside her litter box after she had a bowel movement and a regular routine of vomiting. I became alarmed and brought her to my vet.  After a full "costly" check up, he asked me what food she was on.  When I told him he told me that it was not the first time he heard of problems with this brand.  I started giving her 1/2 and 1/2 wet food in the morning and Innova Cat and Kitten in the evening, problem totally solved!  It's been over a month and not only are the bloody stools gone, but no more throwing up.  Be very cautious with this food.

Eukanuba is a well-respected name in pet foods, and it's a bit pricier than some other big brands.  So when we wanted to switch our cat Caesar from Iam's and saw this on sale, I figured that I was getting quite a bargain.  Oh the folly...Chicken by-product meal, Corn grits and corn meal are three of the four top ingredients.  This is what the high cost buys - by-products and corn?  If we wanted to continue giving him crappy ingredients then we'd have kept buying Iams and saved the cash (not to mention the fact that Caesar actually liked it)!  I imagine the weight-loss claim is probably true, because my cat would eat just enough of this to get by...he hated it!  We decided to change to a new brand after half a bag, phasing the new food in with the Eukanuba  in growing proportions.  Throughout this short period, the kibble from the other brand was always gone first.If Caesar had liked it, I probably wouldn't stick with it on principle...I don't think I should pay top-dollar for substandard ingredients.  Luckily, Caesar came to that conclusion all by himself!

Eukanuba Cat Indoor Weight Control and HairballThis is probably one of the best kitty foods I've bought. I think it's very effective with hairballs. I still have to wait a little longer to see if it's effective with weight control.

column9: Too much grain, not enough meat
column10: Just like the human food manufacturers, the pet food industry is also all about thebottom line and cheapest manufacturing.While I can understand cost control, I can't understand the junk they are putting into our pets' foods.Then again - they don't mind chemical cocktails in our human foods, so guess this doesn't bother them!I had given some thought to buying this food, at least for snacks, because it sounded like somethingthe cats would like. The commercials are certainly cute enough as well, and led me to at least look at theproduct.Well, I won't be buying it at all.For those who are not aware, cats are carnivores. That means they mainly eat meats.This does NOT include fish even, and it is a common misconception that all cats adore fish.Not true (as any cat owner can tell you), and fish are also something that should be limited.Cats need ZERO grain in their diets. They do not stalk the farmers' fields, pouncing on that low ear of cornor stalk of wheat! They do not require it and it can cause health problems ranging from allergies to hot spotson their skin to diabetes due to blood sugar issues with the high carb grains.Here are the ingredients for this product - they aren't listed here, I had to go to the manufacturer siteand look them up. Note how loaded with grain this product is - it might be okay for feeding a stray or some feralcats who will supplement their own diets with mice, but for the average indoor housecat, it would be a mess.Note the addition of not one, but FOUR named food dyes, many of which are already known to cause health problemsin people - why put it in our pet foods?! Lots of grain, meals (soybean hulls? really? cats don't need soy either),and yuck, with a few vitamins tossed in to meet the minimum standards. It's like they use all the discards fromevery other food process to make our pets' foods.INGREDIENTS:Ground Yellow Corn, Corn Gluten Meal, Chicken By-Product Meal, Meat and Bone Meal, Beef Tallow Preserved W/Mixed-Tocopherols (Form of Vitamin E), Turkey By-Product Meal, Powdered Cellulose, Animal Liver Flavor, Soybean Hulls, Malt Extract, Phosphoric Acid, Salt, Dried Cheese Powder, Potassium Chloride, Choline Chloride, Added Color (Yellow 6, Yellow 5, Red 40, Blue 2 and Other Color), Parsley Flakes, Calcium Carbonate, Taurine, Zinc Sulfate, Ferrous Sulfate, Vitamin E Supplement, Niacin, Manganese Sulfate, Vitamin A Supplement, Calcium Pantothenate, Thiamine Mononitrate, Copper Sulfate, Riboflavin Supplement, Vitamin B-12 Supplement, Pyridoxine Hydrochloride, Folic Acid, Vitamin D-3 Supplement, Calcium Iodate, Biotin, Menadione Sodium Bisulfite Complex (Source of Vitamin K Activity), Sodium Selenite.They could do so much better by your pet.So can you. I recommend passing on this grain filled food.

column10: ....is just as delicious!  When I was a kid, these were sold as Scooter Pies.  I believe Moon Pies was the original name, but locally (New Jersey) these were branded as Scooter Pies, named after NY Yankee shortstop Phil Rizzuto, who was nicknamed "The Scooter."Whatever their naming legacy, these are every bit as delicious as I remember as a child.  Coated in sweet chocolate on the outside, soft graham cracker like "pies" on the inside, layered with soft, gooey marshmallow.These are pretty large by today's standards, so one is plenty as a snack, and some kids may be fine with half of a "pie."  Each pie is 2.75 ounces, big enough to fill the palm/fingers of your hand.  They are NOT a healthy treat, at 300 calories each, and containing 7 grams of fat, 5 of which are saturated.  They have no trans fats.If you want to give your kids a taste of something you ate as a child, and give your taste buds a taste of nostalgia, try these!Whether you knew them as Moon Pies, Scooter Pies or something else, these are every bit as good as when you were a kid.
I've always enjoyed moon pies. I thought I was getting a pretty good deal from amazon when I ordered this box. When it arrived, I realized why: they were stale...

column9: Gave as gift, friend went nuts!
column10: I have some friends that grew up in the South.  One talked about Moon Pies and how much he loved them.  Found this 24 pie count on Amazon and gave it to him as a gift.  He just loved getting them and said how it brought back memories of his childhood. He also wished he had RC Cola to go with them???  Anyway, if you have any friends or are from the areas of the country where moon pies were a big deal you cannot go wrong with this item.  I tried one and liked it with a big glass of milk.  I'm originally from Philadelphia so I would go crazy over Tasty-Kakes which you cannot find here in Arizona.  Ah childhood memories.

I love a very bold tasting coffee. Although Starbucks is pricey, I still love their coffees. Starbucks Gold Coast is the best I have had thus far. When I use up the Gold Coast I have, I will be re-upping for another pack of 3.

column4: Bill Your 'Free Form FM Print DJ "bill nicholas"
column10: Gold Coast is one of the most bold of the Starbucks Coffee. You can take deep mouth fulls of this. Has a slightly bitter flavor and extremely large mouth feel. Spicy, woody, impressive.Still, every coffee the mermaid makes is well balanced, and this is no exception. Less adventurous drinkers can add lots of milk or cream to this and still get a bold cup.It won't take the paint off the walls--unless you come over and let me make it.

I bought these after seeing a recipe for chai concentrate and not being able to find cardamom in my local store, however, once I got them I found that I love the little packets!  They are pre-measured and packaged so that they stay fresh until you use them.  The three little tins means I can use some and pass another tin on to my favorite cookie baker.  It isn't as inexpensive as purchasing jars of spices but really, how many of us end up tossing out half-empty bottles anyway?

This is a fabulous gift.  It has yummy recipes and the corresponding pre-measured organic spices to match.  Great for entertaining and fun activity for the family.  I've given the tins as Hostess gifts and teacher gifts. These organic spices have more flavor than anything in a jar.The Spice Kitchen: Everyday Cooking with Organic Spices
Excellent service!  Excellent Price!  Excellent Product!  I can't keep the dog off the phone telling her friends how much she is enjoying her Best Buddy Treats!  I have a very happy dog!
My dog loves the treats!!! I have a yorkie and they are just the right size for him. I let a friend give her dog some and they loved them also.

The seller is great. I received them in a timely manner. They shipped when they said they would. I think these are great treats. They smell fresh. The are crunchy treats. There not too hard and not too soft. My dog (Lucy) likes them but it's not her favorite. She doesn't get too excited about them, but she does eat them. That's why I didn't give them 5 stars.

My Maltese absolutely LOVES anything that Exclusively Pets makes. But if you really want to train your pet, give him or her a cheese treat! The greatest thing about their products is that they smell exactly like whatever the package says. The cheese treats smell like Cheez It! The carob cookie treats smell like chocolate chip cookies... So forth and so on. I used to buy these locally but saved buying them online.

First Impression: The friendly folks over at "Exclusively Dog" heard about my website and sent me 5 of their products to test.Let me just start off by saying that I Love how sweet all of these treats taste. Dad was/is considering trying one because they look and smell so much like human cookies. Plus the ingredients are very straight forward, they are probably healthier than most the stuff Mom eats... But there in lies the problem. Dad thinks that they are too sweet for a puppy of any age. The second ingredient in almost all of them is sugar. As we all know puppies have a hard time processing sugar, and just like humans can develop diabetes.Conclusion: Your puppy is nearly guaranteed to LOVE the taste. However these should only be used as an occasional treat! If you were to feed your puppies these sugary sweet morsels every day, they would soon plump up. If you puppy is already overweight or does not exercise regularly, you may want to think twice. On the PRO side they are all natural, with no animal bi-products! 3 out of 4 paws, because Dad made me! If we were judging on taste alone they would be a 4.

This is a great ham.  My family usually gets thier hams from HoneyBaked Ham Company for the holidays.  This ham is just as good and not nearly as expensive.  I send one to my family every Thanksgiving.

My husband was given an Amazon gift certificate and decided to order a ham for Christmas from Omaha Steaks. Wow. This spiral sliced ham was the best ham we have eaten and the company takes great pride in their presentation and shipping. The product came in a wonderful container, which kept it refrigerated while being shipped. We will certainly order from Omaha Steaks again. From the taste and presentation of this product, I'm sure all of their offerings will be fantastic.
The ham was awesome and the service was prompt and courteous, I would do business again with Omaha Steaks.
This was purchased as a Christmas present.  It arrived on time and was delicious.  Would order again.

I must admit to having some amount of reservations about ordering hams of any kind from Omaha Steaks.  After all, I had never seen Omaha Steaks ads for their hams or for any other food product except for their steaks.  The hams, all three me and my wife ordered, arrived within the scheduled time span.  Curiously, the instructions how to heat them up (they were already cooked and frozen) were not with the hams.  We called customer service and got the directions from a most nice rep.  Followed it and the hams came out just great.  No loss of moisture and our extended family enjoyed the hams very much for Easter.  We have no regrets and the price was actually cheaper than if we had gone to Honeybaked, about 6 miles from our home.  This included price plus delivery charge.  Would recommend these hams to any- and everyone.

Was actually off from work x-mas and needed to feed my family so on a whim and going off of other reviews I dropped the $60 this spiral ham cost. At $8.57 a pound I was worried and having a ham delivered by mail worried me too. Our fellow Amazon customers reviews reassured me that it would all be OK. Well, my order arrived in 2 days plenty of time before the big day and still plenty of dry ice still in cooler to last another day. I cooked it as directed and served it to the hungry ones waiting. The ham was/is amazing. Not salty like most that you buy and seasoned/cured perfectly!! My 5 year old and 7 year old had seconds and I had fourths lol. I am a big fan of x-mas ham and would not be giving this review if unwarranted. BEST CHRISTMAS HAM EVER!!! Yes I said it.....
I enjoy these so much I now ship them as Christmas presents to family members.  One of the best hams I have ever tasted.

column9: Spiral Sliced Ham from Omaha Steaks
column10: Although I have enjoyed many products from Omaha Steaks in the past, I didn't even know that the company sold a spiral sliced ham.It was terrific.  We ate every morsel.  No need to stand in line for a Honey Baked Ham!  Hope Amazon offers this products again for the holiday season this year.  Thanks Amazon!
Bought 6 for gifts. Everyone said they enjoyed them. Tried some from one receipient. Pretty good.

This is hands-down the best corn chowder outside a restaurant. The mix is easy to make and it's very tasty. Our family loves it.

column9: Williams Country Store Corn Chowder Soop Mix
column10: My husband and I really like this soup mix.  With the closing of the Farmer Jack stores, I was unable to find it in the local supermarkets.  I was glad to find it online.

Let me just say that this tea is about average. I feel like the tea wasn't made to high standards, but then you have the fact that they're whole leaves. I think this creates a weird situation where you have a bad product of high quality. I'm a supertaster, so I will describe the product as best as I can. It has your typical oolong bass notes, but the higher notes are very grassy (sometimes oolong is sweet, bitter...etc etc etc, this is grassy). It has a fair balance between bitterness and boldness. Incase you aren't gathering what I'm trying to say... it's a very neutral flavor and doesn't really 'wow' me at all. The grassy flavor taste exactly like wheaties cereal (no frosted).... and that sounds stupid but when you try it you'll instantly make the connection.So, in conclusion it's a plain tea that I won't really hold up high on my tea shrines, but it does have one last unique quality. It taste odd, but I can't stop drinking it. It's like raman noodles... you never say "man I can sure go for some raman", but when you are actually eating raman you make sure you eat every last noodle. It's like that.12/10/11 EDIT: After drinking a few of these, I can say that it's a great tea to drink without anything added. I normally add sugar to most of my teas in some way or another (honey, sugar, guava), but I find that this tea is actually really good without anything added. I'm not going to officially change my 3 star rating, but I am tempted to bump it up to 4 stars.

Alvita's Ginger Peppermint tea is an excellent infusion for what ails you! It's soothing for the digestion with its heady blend of ginger and peppermint; since it doesn't contain caffeine,it's also relaxing. It's a delicious blend of herbs. It's excellent if one has a stomach virus, lousy digestion, or food poisoning. It's a home remedy in a cup!

This is some of the best food available. My 127lb German Shepherd has been fed this formula twice a day for many years (since back when it was O&M)and at 15 years of age is still going strong! All of the seven shepherds we have on this food are remarkably strong and healthy with no digestive, skin or allergy issues.

A great organic dog food for senior dogs. The company resides very close to where I live and are active in the community. I found them at a street fair where they were giving away free samples and all the dogs were very happy about it. They have a friendly staff that really cares about your pet. Highly recommended to keep your dog happy and healthy. Laughing Dog has different formulas so you can find the one that is just right.

Our family has 4 dogs and a cat :) The most fragile is our wolfie dog (siberian husky). Ever since we switched his food he has more umph in his prance! I think all the omegas and coconut oil really help his aging joints.  We went from a dog we thought we were going to have to put down a year and a half ago to a happy husky. column10: It actually tastes pretty good.  Like drinking chocolate milk.  Believe it or not, it actually keeps me full till lunch....I eat a snack in between but really don't feel hungry.

column9: Gentlease has 1/5 the lactose of milk-based formula
column10: A good way to start shopping for this product is to call Enfamil to see their current pricing, keeping in mind any differences in can size and number of cans in a case in the event that you might buy in bulk. I have purchased this product through Enfamil, Amazon and a few other places, always taking advantage of the best deals. I've purchased single cans of all types and cases too.Next... The World Health Organization recommends exclusive breastfeeding until six months of age. But here in the U.S. after your 3 months maternity leave, are you able to pump enough and store in a refrigerator at work? And you might need formula anyway as we do. I mention this because some imply their formula is as good as human breast milk.We're blessed with twins. They started out colicky and we found that Nutramigen worked at that time. They got through that phase and we've been using Gentlease and solids. After they're a year old it will be all solids. Our pediatrician recommended Gentlease. It has 1/5 the lactose of milk-based formula.I really researched formulas. There are even organizations promoting the sale of human breast milk and there are organizations wanting to stop the sale of human breast milk for fear of health hazards that the FDA cannot control. No matter, those offering breast milk do so at prohibitively high prices - nothing charitable about it.All the brands that I've seen have DHA and ARA, nutrients found in breast milk that promote brain and eye development, iron which is necessary for growth and many more ingredients. The government requires them to have certain ingredients. The major brands do not seem highly differentiated to me except for their specialy models. Gentlease is one of those.Gentlease is one of the special formulas because it has a much lower amount of lactose as well as broken down proteins to make it easier to digest.The prices vary and so do the size of the cans and the number of cans in a case. Unfortunately, I haven't seen Gentlease in big cans at the big box stores. One can also check at the local pharmacy or grocery store for comparison purposes. Keep an eye out for coupons too. You've got to keep constant watch for the best price, and there have been times when the Amazon price prevails.
I ordered this specifically for the LIPIL component.  Vendor ships plain Gentlease.  Disappointing and of course, was way over priced since they really are selling regular Gentlease.  Buyer, beware.
They sell this same size can at my sam's club for $34.28.  It is crazy to charge $47!
Our main seasoning.  Have been using since 1980.  Enhances all cooking that is not sweet. Veggies, main dish's, soups, sauces, egg dishs etc. We recommend it to all cooks.Karin and Harry
