The packets are great, and I love that you can buy them in bulk like this.  However, I only gave this item 4 stars because I took one away for the price.  While it is still cheaper than the price of the small boxes at local grocery stores, if you have a sam's club membership, a box of 1000 packets is only 18.99 plus tax.  If you order it on the website, they will pull the item for you and you can pick it up at the courtesy desk at your local store the next day, no need to go searching.  it may be worth it to check out the other bulk stores as well.

I use Splenda every day to help reduce my sugar intake and limit calories in order to keep the weight off.  I actually prefer the taste of Splenda over normal sugar.  It has a much sweeter taste than sugar.  I use it things like Coffee, Tea and Kool Aid for the kids.  These large packages last us a long time.

This is a nice economical pack of Splenda, which is a great sweetener because it tastes just like sugar and since it is made from sugar, it is as close to sugar as you can get without your body metabolizing it (getting calories from it). I purchased it when it was on a Friday Sale. Just be aware that if you are going to cook with it, that it is more potent than sugar (add a lot less than the amount of sugar called for in recipes).

i like splenda the best out of all the artificial sweeteners but rarely purchase it because it costs much more than the others. using amazon with the subscribe and save it ends up costing the same as the generic equal product with no shipping charges even though its under $25. now i can use the sweetener i prefer every day.

Splenda is a great sugar substitute.  The taste provides nice sweetening. Better than Sweet n' Low, for example.It is used just as sugar is, so one can easily (without any measurement problems) use this in recipes instead of sugar.Enough in the package to last quite a while!
I only use Splenda, period.  When I buy these, I'm looking for price per packet.  Over the years, I've bought this packagine and several others, it all depends on the price.

This is the only sweetner that I use. This box lasts on and on and is very reasonable compared to the grocery stores that I shop. You don't need many packets and I ususally use one for a cup of tea. There are 800 in this shipment for a good price. I recommend this.

column9: Tastes great, less filling, life's good
column10: I could not use any of the not-to-be-named pre-Splenda sweeteners. I simply could not tolerate their taste AND the after-taste. I've been a Splenda user ever since it became available because... well... the taste is VERY close to sugar's own and, as far as I know, there are NO side effects.My understanding of the Splenda technology is that the process starts with what is supposed to be a 'sugar' molecule and then ONE atom is replaced with another which makes it impossible to digest so it simply passes through your digestive tract. You get zero calories, good taste and no side effects.So... what's not to like? The price? That's were the wisdom of buying these large but not too heavy Splenda boxes comes from. Buy in bulk and save :). 1000-count and 2000-count boxes are available.I NEVER put anything sweet into my tea or my coffee - a habit I probably developed during those dark, sad, pre-Splenda days - but, when it comes to Cappuccino... it's a different story. I am reaching for the little yellow packets. A box of these lasts me for a long, long time.

Splenda is a great product and Amazon has it at a great price.  We have tried them all and think Splenda is the best one.  We have used it for several years and only two people have ever noticed a taste difference in the food we used it in.
As I use alot of Splenda, this was a great $$ deal on a bulk purchase, as compared to my local pricing.

column9: The Only Sugar Substitute Without The Scary Health Warnings
column10: I am used to see either the pink (saccharin) or the blue (aspartame) envelope. One warns about cancer while the other one warns about brain damage. Splenda does not have any of those. Now, the pink and the blue are gone from our work office. First approved for use in Canada in 1991 and later on in the US in 1998.Splenda is multiple times sweeter than the previous sugar substitutes. Unlike saccharin, Splenda does not have a metallic aftertaste.Another advantage is that Splenda is stable under heat and can be used for baking.
I purchase this for an MD practice and the auto ship is so convenient. This way we never run out of Splenda and the price is half as much as we were paying another vendor.
A great deal and much cheaper than what the smaller size boxes cost in a Store.
It is so easy to order Splenda through Amazon and have it arrive at your doorstep. Once I run out again (MONTHS from now, I am sure), I will order again.

column9: Taste good, but not good for your health
column10: I have used this splenda products for the last few years without knowing any side affect.  After reading a few health and diet book, I decided to quit this usage and I threw them away.  Now, I used Stevita Stevia and organic raw blue algave products, they are natural products and good for your health.  They taste great too and highly recommended.  Don't take my word, just google splenda and you will find it out.  I gave this product 2 stars because the taste is fine, but not for your own health.  Give yourself a better health with the above products that I recommended.  Life's too precious!
I love this sauce! It is delicious with stir-fry. I've also put a couple of tablespoons of it in some white rice and that tasted great too.

This sauce is fantastic. They use it at Hannaford's supermarket for their General Tso's Revenge wings at the Wing Bar. It's the perfect blend of sweet and tangy with a hot kick to boot. It's also thick and sticky so it coats wings thoroughly. They're messy to eat but it's totally worth it!
There isn't much to the product, so there won't be much to this review. It's 100% pumpkin. The only ingredient is pumpkin. You get a can full of pumpkin. No secrets or surprises here.

AMAZON VERIFIED PURCHASEThe cans of pumpkin puree were so poorly packed that the box was nearly open and all the cans were badly dented--so dented that it was hard for the canopener to open them.  The puree itself was ok, but I'm surprised that no can was perforated and leaking.  I will never order these again.This is the first time I have recieved anything from Amazon that was so poorly packed and damaged.  Everything else I have ordered from Amazon has been well packed and in excellent condition.  I was very disappointed.

column9: Great Price Delivered to Your Door
column10: Club crackers have arrived FRESH, in good shape at less than twelve bucks - a good deal! It's getting too hot to bake bread at home so crackers are on the summer menu. The hors d'oeuvres style goodies on crackers along side salads have been a hit with the family as a change of pace. The teens enjoy making peanut butter and jelly whip for a sweet cracker treats. It never fails that good old cheese and crackers are TV treats too. All-in-all versatility and variety relatively on the cheap :)
We eat a box a week of these crackers, so ordering in bulk from Amazon helps us cut costs!  And they deliver it to us monthly through subscribe and save!
These crackers were so delicious and fresh. The kids really love them.Before I was buying them from Costco now, I would get them from Amazon.
Great product!I've always loved these crackers and was delighted to find them so affordable here. Sorry to see they've now become too expensive to buy, though.
These are my favorite crackers ever. I've had the pleasure of eating these for many years. The flavor is always fresh & the crackers nice & crunchy. Perfect cracker.

column9: Exceelent product & even better in an emergency supply kit...
column10: along with the Peter Pan Peanut butter Peter Pan Creamy Peanut Butter, 40-Ounce Jars (Pack of 3) these were a mainstay of DAYS without power here in SW Va 1st week of July 2012 - Suggest keeping at least three packs sealing in air tight plastic container and rotate as water in an emergency kit. They are in individual wrapped stacks in each box.
The big problem with these crackers is that you can't stop eating them. Great with pate or chopped chicken liver spread.

The crackers were starting to stale when I received them. The taste was off, and the crackers were really brittle. I had a pack of them myself, and then the kids ate the rest. I heard no complaints from them.

This is one of those products that should be a staple in everyone's closet.  Right beside the Ritz and the Nabisco Premium Saltines.  I LOVE the buttery taste of these crackers and have been using them for about 35 years.  My parents before that always had them in the house. The one thing that can be a challenge is that I don't recommend that you put them in a bowl of canned soup.  The canned soup is usually overly salty anyway and these, well, they're a bit heavy on the salt as well.  If so, be sure to have steady access to water because you'll feel like you just consumed the Dead Sea!  Anyway, these crackers are best served with dips and made into appetizers.  They are quite buttery so if you think that might not work for you, try the Ritz.  They have a bit less butter and have a bit richer flavor.Great product, highly recommend!

column4: Desert Gypsy "A Brooklyn Girl Out West"
column9: three and a half stars really....
column10: These crackers have a nice texture - crisp and just a little flaky. They are a bit on the salty side and are good paired with creamier cheeses that will cut a little of the salt.The butter taste is a more akin to a margarine flavor which is where this cracker looses points with me. Kind of like if you tried to make a croissant with oil - just not quite what's called for. These would be much better with an authentic butter taste.

Stocked up on crackers at the excellent Amazon Grocery price in anticipation of the holiday parties and drop-in guests. Simple snack to have on hand for soups, cheese, and dips. Who doesn't love the buttery goodness of a Club Cracker.  Seriously, just good. No problems in shipping, arrived in great conditioned and wrapped in plastic. If you like to buy in bulk (or are expecting a house full this holiday season), this pack of four will serve you well. Pricing, shipping, and quality all great. Enjoy!
I love these cracker. I use as a snack as well as crushed and used to coat chicken strips. I tried the mini's but they were just too small.
Light, crispy and buttery, these are ideal little crackers to keep at hands. Great with cheese for snacking; with some fruits or a cup of tea, it's a delight for a break.

Delivery was fine, no broken crackers, no stale product. Well packed, lots of air packages.I just am not that enthused about Club crackers. I had them many years ago, saw them on here and thought I'd give them a try again, but turns out I don't really care for them any more.4 crackers for 70 calories seems a bit high also, although I really haven't done any research into this. That might be average or even low, but I was hoping for fewer. Perhaps crackers aren't in my future!Got a good price too, $8.50 on subscribe and save, but I think I won't keep this subscription.Ha, sorry for the boring review, but I am just not enthused about these.
I love these crackers when they're fresh. Although delivery was fast, these crackers had a stale odor and taste. Disappointing!

I ordered these without really checking the brand name.  They are Keebler brand.  They don't taste as I expected.  The crackers seem excessively salty compared to the ones I usually buy at the grocery store. I will give them to the kids of the neighbors.  They will eat anything.
I have tried several different brands of raspberry chipotle in the past, and this was hands down the best ever!

First, let me point out that you should get 2 bottles of this oil and it is NOT "light" olive oil.  It is extra virgin and organic.  The taste is smooth with a bit of peppery finish.  It is certainly a bit pricey so I am not using it as a general cooking oil.  I use it for salads, drizzling on tomatoes and broiling, and if I ate bread, I'd mix this with garlic and herbs and black pepper--YUM!  Hope you enjoy it :)By the way, when I got my order, it only had one bottle and as I bought it thinking it was "light", I was really disappointed.  But the customer service from Baker's Box was excellent.  They let me keep the bottle and refunded my money, since it is not the product as advertised.
These chocolates were so cute and tasted very delicious. Very rich and creamy chocolate flavor. They were a perfect addition to my daughters graduation party.

This Arizona bottled water is good tasting purified water.  It also has Electrolytes added to it.  Each bottle is 1 quart in size.  It is promoted as "Vapor Distilled Water" which means it was filtered in a lab to make pure.  The Arizona company is based out of New York, but not sure where they actually get the water from or bottle it.  If the water is from New York, I kind of wonder if the purification really takes out all of the bad things in the water considering the recent news about pharmaceuticals found in tap water.  I guess it all depends on if they filter the water good enough or not.  Perhaps Spring Water is a better alternative depending on the location it comes from.From eHow:Although we know water as having the chemical composition H2O, in reality the water we drink and swim in has a much more complex chemical composition. With plenty of particulates and molecules found in water sources we encounter everyday, pure H2O is quite scarce. Vapor distilled water is created in a lab that filters out all the excess material and is much purer than the water typically found in nature.
Its Water description should be more clear that it has minerals added wanted it to use in Cpap machine and with added stuff no good

column9: Authentic Peak Brand Full Cream Milk
column10: Authentic Peak Brand Full Cream Milk.  This is the genuine article.  Shipped quickly, too.

column9: Quite good for commercial grade, but the price is insane
column10: I've raised many a healthy kitten on Purina's Kitten Chow (pre-Nesley acquisition) and same applies to the Complete version of their dry food. The price with shipping is so high, I'm wondering if this is some horrible hallucination. I guess whatever a person like myself could have saved on gasoline is more than offset by the price you're asking.Ah, well. It's like this: y'all put the prices into the Ionosphere and I'll just get sensible and make my own dry cat food. The advantages are more than monetary as I don't have to sweat recalls and such. Nestle, being associated with chocolate, well.. it's a bit toxic for cats and dogs, isn't it.Nice of you to carry this, though and charge six bucks for shipping so people with busloads of money to burn can acquire it at their convenience.

My dog loves these!!! But they are very light not like real jerky, if that is what you are expecting.  They do not last very long.  I thought it would occupy the dog for longer then 5-10 minutes. He is a medium size dog. But even a 5-10 min break is nice from our very hyper puppy.
This tea is full of flavor! We make it without so much sugar and the blackcurrant flavor is great. A favorite restaurant serves this and we have been hooked on it for years.  Try Try!

I was looking for a tea with a hint of black currant flavor complementing a black iced tea blend.  This tea brews up looking like red fruit punch.  The black currant flavor is tangy bordering on bitter.  I didn't see that there was any black tea contribution to the final brew.  I didn't care for it at all.

I brewed this tea as directed.  It has no blueberry flavor at all.  Though the flavor is nice, it is not appealing to me.  Guess I was expecting to have a blueberry taste...I wonder why!  Oh, yes, it is a blueberry flavored tea!  If you are looking for blueberry, pass by this product and try another brand.  Though I love Stash teas, especially the mint ones, this one is disappointing.
This tea doesn't taste at all like traditional blackcurrant tea I have had in the past.  It is very fruity tasting and red in color. Disappointing.
I ordered Lemon Blossom tea, but I received Stash MEYER Lemon Blossom tea. This is a very different product and I do not like it as much as the Lemon Blossom.

I brewed this tea as hot tea, letting it steep for 5 -7 minutes.  I did it two 1/2 gallons - one at a time with the same tea bag.  Then I refrigerated it overnight. There was no cloudiness and the tea is nice and strong with no bitter after taste.  Everyone who tries it, loves it.

The tea bags make a very nice raspberry flavored tea, however there is a lingering flavor that reminds me of a slightly fermented older tea.  While nice red color and raspberry flavor, do not make stronger than recommendation of 1 tea bag per gallon.  Will not buy again do to the fermented taste.

This tea is much more bitter than other Stash black teas. I brew using the "moon brew" method, leaving the bag in the pitcher in the fridge overnight. I use a 4 quart pitcher so it is not an issue of too little water. I recommend brewing for less than 5 hours to ensure less bitterness.

column9: You should not go... with this mango.
column10: I bought this for someone who loves both mangos and cold brew Iced T.  After trying this out, neither one of us really cared for the taste, as it was pretty bland.  Turned out we just ended up throwing it out and getting what she usually drinks which is Lipton Cold Brew.  I would not reccomend it.

I originally tasted this as iced tea in a fine restaurant several years ago. I asked for the brand and flavor and have been ordering it ever since! When I serve it to friends they always want to know just what I had asked!My son-in-law, who does not drink coffee, visited us and I gave him some as iced tea. He loved it, took some bags home with him and has been drinking it both hot and cold ever since. He now has his father drinking it!

This tea is just OK. It doesn't taste bad, but it doesn't taste any better than Luzianne or Lipton. And, unlike Luzianne, it's cloudy which I really don't like to see in a clear pitcher and glass. I would be embarrassed to serve this to guests. I've made it according to the enclosed "moon brewing" directions and also in my iced tea maker. It's cloudy both ways. Also, these tea bags make a gallon of tea each so unless you like really strong tea, they're too big for a 3-quart iced tea maker unless you dilute it after you brew. I'm disappointed and won't order this flavor or this brand again.

I have looked all over for this product. Hidden Valley changed recipe to use regular milk and it is just not the same. Now that summer tomatoes are ripe, I can't wait to have the original again!Try adding Bleu Cheese crumbles to this, MMMMM!

My family and I use this dry mix to make dressing for salads, chicken tenders and a host of other dishes.  Around where I live, a packet of Hidden Valley Ranch dressing is about 1.50, sometimes more depending on what store you go in and how desperately you need it.  This is the best deal I have found to buy this product in bulk.  This mix is good for a host of things, including fresh roasted potatoes.  Just wash and cut potatoes any way you like, put in a bag with a little vegetable or olive oil and as much of the dry mix for flavor as you like, toss, put into a glass dish or on a pan.  Put into 350-375 degree oven and cook until done. You have a simple side to go with dinner.  Onions are also a good addition to this dish.I will continue to buy this product from Amazon.com as long as they offer it.  Now, if I could only find my favorite chili mix...

Sure, everybody knows about Hidden Valley Ranch Dressing.  Want to try a great dip?  Throw one of these into a pint of sour cream.  Perfect!!  Better than any onion dip you'll ever have!I buy this pack of 24 and keep it in the pantry.  Since I've discovered this, we buy alot more sour cream!  We use it for veggies, chips, on baked potatoes - even Mexican dishes.  I highly recommend this!
We mix with yogurt to keep our thin figures. Still the best Ranch out there.

Hidden Valley needs to remove this from their products. MSG is the 2nd ingredient in this, which means it contains a lot. MSG is poison and causes cancer. I will never buy another one of their products as long as they keep using this.

This is the best White Cheddar Cheese popcorn topping that I have ever had. I have been buying it for a few years. When I run out I want more. If you like cheddar flavored popcorn you should try this product. It's great!

I purchased a three-pack of this seasoning from Amazon, thinking that I could recreate the taste of the commercial bags of white cheddar popcorn I buy at the super market. Unfortunately, this product tastes nothing like the white cheddar seasoning I was looking for. There is very little cheese flavor evident. The taste is more like a seasoned salt (Lawry's or McCormick, for example). I could taste a hint of celery salt and paprika, but not cheddar cheese. So I am stuck with three jars of seasoned salt. Maybe I will try it on a salad. I don't know why they formulated this stuff the way they did, but to me it is not worth the substantial sodium intake.
Flavor is too subtle.  I found myself putting a lot on my popcorn and it still didn't seem as good as I had hoped.  Doubt I would buy it again.

My hubby is the popcorn fanatic in this family. I found a bottle of this seasoning at a store 150 miles from here and brought it home.  He rolled his eyes at it, but about a month later tried it (tired of listening to my oooh's and aaaah's) and now it is his FAVORITE seasoning! You won't be disappointed!
I use this on my popcorn. It's not as good as Kernal Seasons, but's very good! I would recommend it to anyone. I will probably use in cooking as well.

I have been trying to wean myself off Cheddar popcorn because of the calorie and fat content.  I discovered this white cheddar popcorn seasoning and I am loving it.  It really satisfies my cheddar popcorn cravings without the damage.  I would definitely buy it again.

column4: A Picture Is Worth... "A Thousand Words"
column10: I've honestly never tasted coffee so rich, soothing, and simple.  The higher content of Arabica in the Davidoff blend accounts for a warmer, mellow taste.  After drinking Douwe Egbert for years, this is the first coffee to unseat my allegiance.  Not to be missed!

A lot of gummy worms on the store counters claim to be sour, but really aren't very sour at all. These have a nice sour pinch to them. They might be a little tough to bite into, but if you stretch them out a bit, it'll soften them right up.

I purchased these because I love sour gummy worms and so my order would qualify for free shipping.These gummy worms are the most sour I've had and the sour sugar on them is thick which at times overpowers the fruit flavors.I also felt that these were a bit tough but not stale. The fruit flavors were all very enjoyable except I thought that the blue (raspberry) had a different taste to it then I am used to.This is a good quality product but doesn't suite my tastes. If you are looking for a sour gummy worm that has more sour power than Trolli brand this could be for you.

I love the Dinty Moore Potatoes and Ham and I hope that they continue to offer it. I've tried to find it locally but I can only find it at some local drugstores who only get small quantities at a time.  I guess it isn't a best seller so that might be why it's so hard to find but I love potatoes and I had to try it. I like the potatoes and ham more than any of the other Dinty Moore bowl products.  I order a case all the time from Amazon.  I've made this from scratch but everything always taste better homemade. The small bowls are just rIght for me if I want just a little something late at night and don't want a whole sandwich and don't want to cook something.  I just microwave and stir. I had to start ordering the larger size too since my husband likes the potato and ham and he's a picky eater and doesn't like food from a can. I have to admit It didn't look appealing to him but once he tried a spoonful of mine I can't keep it in the house.

column9: dinty moore scalloped potatoes and ham
column10: This is a very easy go to food I like to keep in my stock its very tasty an hardy stick to your ribs kinda food . Thankfully I was able to find it at amazon.com they quit selling it in my area.

column9: Why we love Dinty Moore Scalloped Potatoes and Ham
column10: Dinty Moore Scalloped Potatoes with Ham microwavable bowls are one of my daughter's favorite things to eat; they used to be available in stores, but we were suddenly unable to find them anymore a few years ago.  So when I saw thatthey were available on Amazon, I wasted no time in ordering them.  The taste is incredibly good; I even eat themoccasionally!  They are quite easy to prepare in the microwave; you can even add things to them like differenttypes of vegetables. Try them, but please save some for us!
I used to get this out of a vending machine many years ago when I was in school and loved it then...welcome back old friend.

column4: Doreen B. Bishop "Doreen Bishop cat parent"
column9: OLD NAME AND STILL GREAT TASTING
column10: It seems like this product has been around forever and I use it alot. I am a lucky colon cancer survivor and need to eat soft foods, and thats just fine when they taste as good as DINTY MOORE scalloped patatoes with ham. The flavor is addictive and the ingredients healthy.My very healthy husband eats a bowl at night before bed or snacks on it with a beer and friends. They also are wonderful for camping or storing as survival food. Try it :-)

column4: ChibiNeko "Sooo many books, so little time!"
column9: Started off fine, made me nauseous afterwards
column10: While I like Dinty Moore's beef stew, it seems that this is just one product of theirs that I just don't like.The food isn't that appealing- the food was all pale & pasty looking, but looks can be deceiving when it comes to food, so I went ahead & got it anyway. C'mon... ham & potatoes! How can that be ruined?I unfortunately got my answer- you ruin it by loading it up with tons & tons of grease. The first few bites of this weren't bad & I think that if I only had a small portion of it, it wouldn't be such a terrible thing. (Hence the 2 stars rather than 1 star.) I managed to struggle through the bowl (I hate wasting food & had nothing else to eat), but shortly afterwards I just felt sick to my stomach.If you have either a cast iron stomach or you REALLY like food like this, then you'll probably like it. Me? This is just one DM product I'll never be buying again!!
I order my product Badia Complete Seasoning on September 12th and it is now November 1st and I still have not received my product.  Needless to say, I won't be ordering from them again...

Hi. I absolutely LOVE my Badia Complete. I've been trying to find it for 3 years. Anyway, my diet has changed since then, so I was a little sad to see that it contained MSG. (Monosodium Glutamate) Not a good thing. :( But it does have a wonderful flavor.
I love this product, I use it to make my own salad dressings and use it to cook and everyone loves the taste!

I have put this on EVERYTHING! Veggies, fish, chicken, doesn't matter! Love it! Gives a slightly different flavor to anything you put it in. We can definitely tell the difference when it's not used. A new must have in my kitchen!
This is an excellent product for the price.  Sprinkle this seasoning on vegetables for a delicious flavor.  Wonderful on green beans and cauliflower.

It's a great blend of spices. When I'm cooking beans and don't really feel like going through all the spices in my kitchen I know I can just add some Badia Complete Seasoning and I'm good to go. It's also really good on meat. At 1.75lbs this is a pretty big container so it'll last you for a long time.

I love this product and have been using it for years. However, the estimated delivery date was March 23rd. This is April 5th and I still don't have it. My first email to the shipper has been ignored. Tracking shows the item as shipped by USPS but tracking is not available. I sent another email to shipper today. I'll keep you posted on the results. Unless this is an isolated incident these people are bad news. My account HAS been charged.
When mixed this tastes like real cantalope.  I spilled a little on the counter and the kitchen smelled like cantalope all day.  This is the best.

I love wasabi peas, but they are a bit strong.  The World Peas Hungarian Garlic (though I like all of the flavors) are tasty with a great real garlic taste and so much better than your regular wasabi pea.  I have found that a lot of wasabi peas are made with all kinds of artificial ingredients and are full of MSG, these are all natural.  As a side note, after eating a few handfuls I discovered they are actually good for you, so no guilt.
Product was very tastey and fresh, will purchase again!  I am interested in trying the other flavors now :))  This is a great alternative to junk food!
This is my first time trying this snack. And I love them great crunch nice chip substitute. Had to put them up almost ate whole the bag.

I frequently snack on nuts while I'm at the computer, and these are a magnificent addition/substitution. I ordered all 4 flavors and only this chile is a bit spicy by itself (although I think they'll be great mixed with the others). I'm thinking about using a mixture of all flavors in a homemade batch of Chex Mix for Christmas. Until then they're a terrific snack. (I'm not totally enamored of the modified corn starch, corn starch and sugar in the ingredient list but, as long as I concentrate on the calories -- 105 for 45 peas -- I'm happy.)

I love wasabi peas so I decided to give Mama Lu's World Peas a try.  They are all awesome, but my favourite is the Sichuan Chili.  They have a nive kick like wasabi, but they are more flavourful and tangy.  Not only are World Peas a great product but they are shipped super quickly!!  Thanks for providing this great healthy snack!!

I tried these for the first time the other day, and they are so tasty! The crunch is perfectly satisfying, and the BBQ flavor is quite good. I love that they are good for me, and not full of junky ingredients.

I could not have been more impressed with this product.  I get tired of peanuts and this added a whole new twist on a light snack.  Bold flavor that is consistent with every handful.  I like that they are healthy and when you get to the bottom of the bag there is not any messy seasoning that gets all over your hands like with peanuts.  A portion of the profits go to a great cause and the bag can be recycled.  Great new innovation!
I got Texas BBQ, Garlic, and tomato/garlic flavors. My favorite was BBQ and tomato/garlic ones. I would love to purchase them again!Also, they were pretty filling! :)

I cannot stop eating these things. At first I was a bit underwhelmed by the amount of seasoning on almost all flavors. Probably because my point of reference is chili peas that I get locally from Big Lots which are pretty spicy. I couldn't stop eating these though and they got better with each tasting. I would be ashamed to say how many peas I have eaten in the last 24 hours. I expected to like these, so i ordered all of the flavors and the unexpected standout was Bombay Curry. It's just so true to the actual flavor. Also, there are a LOT of peas in these bags. It's a great product. UPS screwed up but I'm not going to factor that in to this review.
I wanted to try these because I like wasabi peas and these are not as spicy but have great flavor.

I wanted to correct my previous feedback. The product is as described, the delivery was very prompt. The quality of the product tasted like it had past its shelf-life. The peas tasted very dry almost petrified.Otherwise, the seller is a reliable seller. The taste is my very subjective opinion, others my like the taste.

I was already a fan of the BBQ, and then I bought the bacon and the curry - so good!  They are such an easy, guilt free snack, and I put bowls of each out at a party - next to appetizers I had been cooking all day - and they were the first things to go - why did I cook?  The flavors are interesting and complex and actually made for party talk.  The next weekend, I threw bags into the car for a road trip with a few friends - again a hit.  HUGE fan of the peas in general and loving these new flavors!
I love these.  I found them at a discount store and would like to have more, and other flavors.  Crunchy, good stats/nutrition.  Delicious.

Love it! It's got very authentic Chinese Sichuan style flavoring. It is not just about the spiciness, but also the numbness that Sichuan Pepper induces. (Pericarpium Zanthoxyli).This taste fantastic. And authentic.

column9: Good but not as spicy as I hoped.
column10: I was expecting them to be spicier than regular wasabi peas but they were actually less spicy.  They had a good flavor.  I would not order them again.

I frequently snack on nuts while I'm at the computer, and these are a magnificent addition/substitution. I ordered all 4 flavors and only the chile is a bit much (although I think they'll be great mixed with the others). I'm thinking about using these in a homemade batch of Chex Mix for Christmas. Until then they're a terrific snack. (I'm not totally enamored of the modified corn starch, corn starch and sugar in the ingredient list but, as long as I concentrate on the calories -- 105 for 45 peas -- I'm happy.)
