It is nice to have a healthy snack that dont feel guilty about eating!  Thank you for selling this great product and for shipping super quickly as well!!

I have to say I did not know what to expect buying these peas. That are quite hot and full of flavor. I used mine as a seasoning and had them grounded up and makes a great accent to a dish. I am giving it four stars because  the peas are a lot harder to eat then anything else.The was some that was as hard as a rock.
These peas are the best snacks!  I'm a vegetarian (which u don't have to be to love em) and they are the perfect snack!  I keep em stocked in the pantry plenty...like 8-10 sacks!

column9: An Awesome Twist on a Thanksgiving Favorite!
column10: I ... like so many others who observe Thanksgiving, think that the holiday simply isn't complete without a slice of pumpkin pie.  And while it is one of the healthier desserts out there (well, I like to think it is, anyway, because of the pumpkin), it is still not at all what I'd consider healthy or low fat or low calorie.But ... this is the perfect alternative to those who feel guilty after indulging in a slice of pumpkin pie.  THIS is pumpkin pie without the guilt!  It has the flavor of Matcha in it (of course), but also the sweet, delicious, rich and savory taste of pumpkin, a touch of cinnamon, and the buttery taste of pastry in there.  So yummy!I recommend trying this one as a latte.  I used a 1:1 ratio here, using 1 part hot water to 1 part warmed milk.  This helped bring out the creaminess of the pumpkin pie, and also brought out the pastry notes as I had a hard time tasting them without the milk.Scrumptious!

When I opened the pouch and sniffed I was very pleased because it smelled spicy, but also richly creamy-pumpkin. But you often can't tell what something is going to taste like from its dry smell, and that seems to be the case here. For this first tasting I prepared the matcha with just hot water (then added a little sugar later). I got almost no froth when whisking this one, which has to be an effect of the flavoring somehow. It smelled very clovey when prepared, that really is the dominant aroma.The flavor of the matcha when prepared straight is pretty subtle, but improved when sugar is added. When is really shines, however, is in latte form.  The thing about pumpkin pie is that it's creamy and sweet, so adding more creamy and sweet elements really brings out the pumpkin pie flavor. I will definitely really enjoy drinking it this way this fall.

So frothed up on its own (no additions) it was quite spicy. Well, not spicy hot but tasted a lot like spices! The pumpkin was definitely in the smell though, so I knew it was a pumpkin tea and not just a spice tea!Of course, what's a pumpkin pie matcha without a latte? This is where the tea did SHINE! I frothed up the matcha with a bit of brown sugar then added about ¼ cup warm water. I then heated up the rest of my Vanilla Almond milk, added it and topped the cup with a healthy helping of whipped cream - oh mama! The brown sugar brought out the sweet pumpkin flavour - I could even taste a bit of crust! I love when that happens.I definitely recommend this tea as a hot latte on a crisp fall day in your cutest flannel and plaid scarf. You can add in some friends to share, or be like me and keep it all to yourself.

Maybe I don't have as rich a pallet as the others that have reviewed this tea, but it did nothing for me. It was very bland on the pumpkin side. Just matcha to me. I added some cream and sugar, and ended up having to add a lot for me to get it down. For me, if I'm adding more than three spoonfuls of sweetener, the tea is just too bland for me.I was actually really excited for this tea. I expected something really rich and decadent and a "kick in the mouth" kind of flavor. I had high expectations when I opened it, it smelled really delicious and I was excited, but I ended up just pouring my cup out and setting my packet up on the self. Maybe I was making it wrong? Maybe I added two much water...Well, I'll be trying again until it runs out, but I wouldn't buy it again. I wish they had a smaller trial size that wasn't twenty dollars...EDIT: I gave it two stars at first, but I'm raising it to four. Four and a half if I could. I was making it wrong and with a good shifting of the powder and a good shifting of the tea it's self, plus some sugar and cream, the tea is quite, dare I say it, "delicious." Even decadent. Now that I know how to make it correctly, I'd certainly buy another, larger portion. So just be careful of the directions, unlike yours truly.

column9: Smooth pumpkin pie without the calories!
column10: Ok, I have to start by saying that I love Thanksgiving!  That is because I love that you can get so many pumpkin things at this time of year.  For one month I get to indulge on pumpkin flavored everything!  Then I have 11 long months of waiting for companies to bring out the pumpkin again!  And let me tell you, I overload myself so much on pumpkin that I'm ready for it to end.  That only lasts about a month before I'm craving pumpkin things again.  SO, that is why I just HAD To order the Pumpkin Pie Matcha from Red Leaf.  I'm hoping that they'll keep this flavor around and not just have it available in the fall.I really wasn't quite sure how I wanted to prepare this the first time.  I opened this matcha and got a cloud full of heavenly pumpkin spices.  I put it into a tin to keep it fresh but I doubt that it'll stay there for very long.  The small size fits perfect in the tin with a little wiggle room...enough to be able to get the measuring spoon in.I decided to prepare this matcha as a latte with warm milk.  I heated up 10oz of milk on the stove and then used my frother to create foam.  I then added the matcha and whisked the latte....finishing off with another round with the frother.  This matcha was very smooth.  I think the milk really complimented it well and made it taste just like a pumpkin pie!  This was so good that I don't think I want to prepare it any other way.  I think it needs the milk to take it to the next level.  To get your own tasty Pumpkin Pie Matcha from Red Leaf Tea - GO HERE NOW!!!![...]

Okay this is seriously awesome! If you've had Starbucks or other coffee places that make a pumpkin latte you will forget all about them when you make your own with this. I loved this and I highly recommend it to anyone and everyone! I have had quite a bit of pumpkin stuff in my life recently (October so who hasn't?) but this is my favourite I'm thinking about using it to make cookies with :D if I did they would rock! If you haven't ordered this yet go and do so right NOW!

Pumpkin Pie matcha can best be described as pumpkin pie spices melded with vanilla creaminess melded with the best matcha equals perfection in a cup. The smoothness of this matcha impresses me. The drinkability of this blend makes me realize I should have ordered the large size. If you like pumpkin pie, then you will love this blend by Red Leaf Tea, another home run!!!

It's pumpkin. It has to be good. Alone, sort of shot-style, it's spicy, not like hot-spicy but like pumpkin spice spice-y. I stir it into hot milk and then it's creamy and pumpkin-y. Overall it's hella better than green tea and hella healthier if what they're telling me is true. Absolutely rivals the pumpkin spice latte in my opinion due to the fact that it is creamier, lower calorie, and much healthier. I've tried two of the other matchas (the berry and the caramel) and this one is better than both to me, however I am a sucker for pumpkin and just finished a big container of roasted salted pepitas from Lowes Foods in three days. When I make it, I pour about a quarter cup of milk into a mug and heat it in the microwave for about twenty seconds, and then whisk a half teaspoon of the matcha powder into it with a fork. Then I fill the mug the rest of the way up with milk and add about a half teaspoon of sugar (naughty, I know, considering plain green adds no calories or sugar to my diet) and then heat it up. It's very warm and cozy but different from a cocoa and healthier than cocoa, which is a good switch for me because I really go for my cocoa in the wintertime.Here's the stuff. It's worth a shot. At the worst you get some hot rich anti-oxidants. But it's really good. It's pumpkin, how could it be bad.[...]

column9: A Fabulous Frothy Dessert-Pumpkin Pie Matcha
column10: I had some excitement at my mailbox yesterday when I found my package from Red Leaf tea and I knew my  Pumpkin Pie matcha had arrived. There was a bit of fall in the air and I love pumpkin pie, so I had high expectations.  I opened the packet and immediately knew I was going to like it, since the scent was delicious. I decided to make a chilled latte, so I mixed a teaspoon of the matcha with 2 oz hot water and whisked it until it had some froth. I then put it in a shaker with 15 oz unsweetened almond milk, a splash of cream, and some sweetener. Added a few ice cubes, and Wow, fantastic!! Pumpkin pie without so many calories. I am amazed at how well it captures the real thing. A fabulous frothy dessert.

It's fall, and you know what that means .. TRY ALL THE PUMPKIN THINGS! In all serious, I'm not a pumpkin fanatic, but I do enjoy indulging in the various pumpkin related offerings this season, especially pumpkin pie.When I first opened the package the smell was AMAZING! It didn't taste artificial at all and instantly evoked memories of Thanksgiving dinner for me.I knew this had to be enjoyed hot, so I brought out the gear. I whisked it up, added some milk, and took a sip. And man oh man, is this delicious. The pumpkin pie flavors really pop, especially the cinnamon. I think the spices are a little more pronounced than the actual pumpkin flavor, but it's a delicious and yummy treat.  I even added sweetener to kick it up a notch and it certainly did.All in all, a fantastic desert  and a lot less guilt after having this than a regular pumpkin pie.

Out of the package, this matcha smells strongly like spicy whole cloves with a bit of sweetness.Prepared as a traditional hot matcha, (1/2tsp of matcha powder whisked with 175f water) the spices are very present over top a pumpkiny mellowness. Slightly sweet in flavor as well. I'd call this more of a "Spicy Pumpkin Matcha" than pumpkin pie. I did not detect any bitterness in this matcha. Overall not bad if you are in the mood for spicy fall flavors.Now, this is where Red Leaf's matchas shine - in latte form! I'm doing a iced latte as it is too hot in SoCal right now. I used soymilk, ice, pumpkin pie matcha and a bit of sweetener shaked up in a blender bottle. The result: very amazing flavoring! I can taste the pumpkin pie spice more as a whole, with a bite of spicy cloves and ginger that linger in my mouth after drinking. The pumpkin is present and my brain is making me almost sense the smushy texture of the pie as a I drink this latte. The green tea is in the background and tasty.

My first hot matcha in God knows how long. Summer just doesn't lend itself to hot drinks, I'm more likely to just my matcha with cold water and blend vigoriously. But this one was just crying out to be made hot...so I'm taking it to work with me today (all I ever do anymore is work). Well after a day straight from hell, this tea was sorely needed. After yet another patient called in to yell at whoever was unfortunate enough to answer the phone (aka me), I decided to take a break. I found a quiet corner and curled up with Hunger Games and this beauty of tea.It tastes exactly as advertised! I really did feel like I was drinking a hot cup of pumpkin pie...yum. So much yum. I'm not the biggest pumpkin pie fan, but it's grown on me in recent years. But I am a huge fan of pumpkin lattes, at least I was, so this is definitely going to be mixed with soy milk next time. And cheesecake matcha. And french vanilla matcha. The possibilities are endless! This has made me eager for Thanksgiving and my signature pumpkin pound cake. I wonder how that would taste with a matcha icing...

Nothing makes me love fall more then pumpkin pie. When I saw this I ordered it right away. Its great it tastes just like your eating a piece of pumpkin pie. This is a bit heavier on the cloves but you can still taste the pie sweetness, its still tastes amazing. And the matcha isn't put on the back burner while the pumpkin shines. You taste the pie but also the matcha which is perfect!I think everyone should try this for a lovely fall drink. Made this into a hot latte delicious!

I made a tiny amount of this matcha and added it to a cup of hot skim milk and stirred in a teaspoon of raw sugar.  Oh my goodness!  This is so rich and so decadent, so GOOD!  Don't buy the small tin, because you are going to want to drink this all the time this fall and winter!  This isn't just a drink with some pumpkin pie spice in it, this is a well thought blend of flavors to give you an extraordinary warming experience.

This is the 4th Red Leaf matcha I've tried, and my favorite so far! The flavors are perfectly pie-y: clove, cinnamon, nutmeg, ginger, and of course pumpkin! It is JUST like a warm slice of pumpkin pie. Of course, the flavoring doesn't overshadow the nice, grassy matcha at all. They compliment each other perfectly, heavy dense pumpkin and light summery frothy matcha. This is best as a hot latte with a bit of sugar, such a nice treat.

With the start of September I have been craving autumnal flavors, especially pumpkin.  Upon opening the package, pumpkin pie flavoring filled my nose.  It was AMAZING!  It smelled exactly like a spiced pumpkin pie was sitting in my kitchen.I immediately made this into a cold latte based on the delicious smell alone.  Two ounces of warmed water blended with the pumpkin pie matcha, a smidge of sugar and a healthy 6 ounces of icy-cold milk later, I found myself speechless!  After downing the entire cup in record time, I must admit I really want another one!  This is Fall in a cup!In this particular flavor - pumpkin pie - the spices are rich!  Cloves, cinnamon, and nutmeg - they all mingle with the pumpkin without overpowering it.  It sort of reminds me of the Starbucks Pumpkin Pie coffee lattes I used to look forward to around this time of year.  I loved them so much I'd try recreating them at home.  Well now, I don't have to!  There's a much healthier version right here without the added sugar.This will not last me very long.

This tea has all the traditional spices of matcha with a heaviness on the clove but in a latte this matcha is AMAZING! Creamy spicy pumpkin pie goodness like mom makes!So good it totally satisfies the desire for a sweet dessert! I love Red Leaf matcha the quality is tops!When made into a latte with milk or creamer and ice it is total bliss!Tastes like pumpkin pie!

This is great for my espresso Gaggia machine !With subscription you got a quality/price combination that you simply cannot beat.Illy is only slightly better, but twice as expensive, and this Davidoff is better than Lavazza.
I didn't think this was very flavorful or spicy at all.  It wasn't terrible either though.  I think I would rather get real chai tea bags and just use sweetener instead of the instant mix.

This david rio chai tea is delicious! i love it. I was introduced to it last year and i think it is amazing. It's a great winter treat. I bought this for my dad for christmas because he needs sugar free stuff, and he loved it. You honestly can't even tell its a sugar free item. I would highly recommend this! you won't be disappointed!

I was disappointed with this product because I have had David Rio's Chai Tea Mix before with sugar and expected the same great taste. This was a little flat and did not have the strong spice flavor I expected. I love the Spicy Chai tea and was looking forward to one that was sugar free and this did not come up to my standard. I had to put more mix into the glass than was recommended to get any real taste out of it, thus making it more expensive. If you want a spicy Chai tea like they serve in coffee and tea shops this one is not one you would want to buy.
Anyone who love chai lattes but not the huge calorie in take from coffee shop versions will love this.  It tastes just as wonderful and is a soothing treat on cold nights.  Highly recommended!
A terrific chai mix.  I mix it with skim milk and it is fantastic, much better than what I get at a local coffee house.
Great alternative choice for diabetics.  Easy to prepare and take along for work or socializing with my friends.  Price was low enough for me to be willing to try it.  Definitely would buy again.
I love this stuff, we used it in the cafe that I worked in for year, they have many other brands one is called the elephant chai..its SO good..

column9: Finally! A sugar feww spice chai tea that tastes good!
column10: David Rio sugar free orca spice chai tea mix is good;for $10 for a 11,9 ounce can..I use a couple spoon fulls of mix and add ice;put it in my magic bullet and it is a good taste texture and best of all..sugar free:)  I also make this mix with hot water..a good tip is this for the hot method... use just at a 'roll' hot water..not boiling... I will buy this again definitely. Quick shipping!

There's a cafe in Midtown NY I go to that uses this brand of Chai mix. Really happy that I was able to go this as it'll save me money in the long run!In terms of taste, I really like the fact that this kind of Chai has more flavor - due to it being 'spiced'. As well, I recommend using whole milk with it as it'll give the chai more of a body. Water works just as well, but the taste underneath is slightly different. If you're one to not care much about that then just use what you like. (As an aside, I like the taste of this more than the Starbucks Chai latte if you need a comparison.)

I wish I had known that there was 4 grams of fat, per cup.  I would not have ordered it.  I appreciate that it is sugar free, but since I am obsessed with my health/weight, it was a little dissapointing...maybe it will taste really good though...
This is my favorite candy.. we hide the bags in my house! Try it...you'll fall in sweet gummy candy love!

column9: HARIBO Brand is the very best gummi candy available
column10: I bought some bears and rattlesnakes for a camp out and they were a big hit.  HARIBO candy comes in so many different forms that it's easy to please all! Besides the two I ordered, here are a couple more that I really like. Haribo Fruit Salad Gummi Candy ( 5.29oz / 150g ), Haribo Gummi Candy, Twin Cherries, 5-Ounce Bags (Pack of 12)

Bought these for a reptile party and did not need them all, so was able to sample a package.  There are about 18 snakes per package, each snake is two-tone in clear, bright colors and about 4.5 inches long.  They have two little eyes and a squiggly line up the back.  I expected them to be softer, but found them a little tough and chewy.  They taste great, though and my 8 year old enjoyed them so I suppose that is the truest test!

My friend received the item quickly and was thrilled. He has a hard time finding the product and had asked me to keep a lookout for him, so I sent him a case. They arrived fresh and he has enjoyed them very much. Thank you for such wonderful service.

I love Haribo Gummy Candy.  This candy has a flavour that is unmatched by anything else I've ever tried.  Thanks to Amazon for having this product, which is readliy available in Europe, but not here in North America!

column9: It's okay, but did I really pay that much for it?
column10: This was a late night purchase. I must have gotten a better deal than I recall today, because I'm pretty sure these should cost $.99 a bag. If you LOVE Gummi candy these are good. Not too hard, nice plasti-fruit flavor. The kids love them. It was good to have some on-hand for a couple of kid parties we had.
This is great tea. I am thankful to have found it on-line as our local tea shop source closed after Christmas.

I bought the 5 pack for a two year old rat terrier. After a few sniffs he refused to eat one bite. I offered it to two beagles and neither would eat a bite. A large poodle Took a bite and tried to spit it out. Two othe neighborhood dogs would not eat any of it.  I bought twenty two pounds because of the good reviews and the free shipping. I will give the other four bags to the SPCA. Maybe there is a dog somewhere that is hungry enough to eat it.

I love this pasta!  And it's very hard to find in my area, plus even with shipping it cost less per package than purchasing in any store ... which I can no longer find ... just order enough packages to make it worth while.  Skinny Pasta Lovers Unite!!!!!

column9: disappointed in La Truffiere black truffle infused oil
column10: I was so disappointed with the flavor of La Truffiere truffle oil. Just does not have a quality taste in my opinion. The olive oil was just too heavy, took over the truffle taste and it seemed to coat the inside of my mouth, and stayed that way for a very long time.  I feel like I wasted my money. I have had La Tourangelle infused white truffle oil and really loved it. The base of it was organic sunflower oil and it was very lite. I decided to try a different brand just to see the difference, I will not do that again, I will go back to La Tourangelle infused white truffle oil, as it had such a lovely taste.

column9: Umm, didn't get what i ordered...
column10: i bought this stuff with some other coconut water and some software from Amazon, my order was wrong on arrival, i got Nirvana, it just was without pulp...  My order was for ones with Pulp (these HERE)...It looks like Amazon packaged the order, but this purchase came from Sold by SCS Collectibles, Inc (ToysNGamesEtc)I'm not sure who is to blame for it...The package arrived from UPS broken open, all the cans inside are very bent, the box was so open I'm surprised i didn't lose my order in shipping... it was literally just barely holding together, and some of my order was hanging out of the open box...There was absolutely no filler in the box... no bubble wrap, not even a single piece of paper or popcorn...  I was worried my software dvd would be broken, but it wasn't..fortunately none of the cans burst, though some definitely look close to it, paint is shaved off the cans in spots...Long story short i somehow got all my stuff and its "okay" - i don't mind, to much the blunder, certainty not enough to really contact anyone for.I just wanted to make other consumers aware that if you purchase this here on amazon, you like me, very well might get without pulp instead of with pulp...  And the shipping might be hazardous i definitely wouldn't order anything fragile with it again...the without pulp tastes okay-good, i'm a little new to coconut water, but this stuff seems just right...  sweet but not like a can of soda sweet, and watery not thick. It has some flavor but maybe not as much as a real, fresh, from the store coconut - or maybe I'm just missing the pulp -_-;i really am stunned at the condition of the box - this is the first order from amazon that has been... bad...  Generally my stuff is packaged well with some level of care and thought put into it...  This was just throw order into box/ship.

This is the best coconut water I have tasted. It's actually better in the glass bottle but for canned, this is the best I know. I have tried about 8 different brands. I was inspired to search out a good brand after having a fresh coconut water in Hawaii at a Thai restaurant. I love this beverage. Great for before and after running. Better than a diet coke, coke, gatorade, beer, wine, etc., for you. So don't nail bite about the sugar like the other reviewer. It's all relative. Instead, cut out the unatural processed sugary crap you're eating. This has so many nutritional benefits. Potassium per serving is out of this world. This is great for women around their "lady time" when potassium levels go low causing cramps. Ralph's and Mother's sells single bottles. Try it there and see what you think.
I'd probably have given this two stars, but if you like pulp this may be fine. I decided to try it but it's not my thing. Also it's pretty high calorie and too sweet for me.

Loved these suckers as a child and couldn't find them anywhere!!! I became pregnant and wanted tem again!! Ordered them for around $13 total and didn't realize they sold them at the dollar store!! Boo!

column9: Tastes too good to be healthy but it is!
column10: These delicious little nuggets are so yummy- everyone in my house fights over them, humans and chinchillas alike (they were bought for the chins until the humans realized that they were so good). I love dried fruit, especially pineapple, but it doesn't satisfy the need for crunchy snacks the way this does, and it is hard to find dried pineapple without sugar added to it. Usually freeze dried fruit has a powdery texture/taste, but this is different tasting - similar to those 'dried' banana chips that are actually fried and worse for you than potato chips. Crunchy-n-Yummy has a taste that makes you sure that they are lying about it being sugar free and simply dried-but it really is just dried pineapple, and one of the best snacks I have tried in a long time.

column9: It's delicious and has the crispy consistency of a chip!
column10: This is a great tasting snack that's good for you!Crunchy N Yummy pineapple, like the Mango and Papaya is certainly in keeping with the Crunchy N Yummy brand name - it is delicious and has the crispy consistency of a chip.  At only 100 calories per 1 ounce serving, you get the great taste and nutrition of a full serving of fruit in packs that you can have on the go!This snack is all natural - just 100% sun ripened and freeze dried pineapple. The pineapples are certified USDA organic.  All Crunchy N Yummy fruits are produced under the most eco friendly conditions.  Even the water that is removed from the fruits during drying is returned to the farms for growing new crops!Crunchy N Yummy products contain no preservatives and no artificial whatchamacallits!  These snacks are free from sulfur dioxide (E220), a food preservative commonly used in dried fruit.  (Some individuals may be sensitive to sulfur dioxide, so rest assured there's none in Crunchy N Yummy Freeze Dried Fruit Snacks!)The freeze dried pineapples are great in salads, cereal and as a healthy topping in yogurts or ice cream.  I even add Crunchy N Yummy Pineapple and Papaya fruits to my muffins and chiffon cakes.NOTE: Mango melts during cooking, so stick to using it in cold foods.Crunchy N Yummy Freeze Dried Fruit Snacks are shipped with an expiry date of up to two years.  So far, I haven't tested whether the bags can actually stay fresh that long. My Crunchy N Yummy Snacks tend to magically disappear from the cupboards! :))The only negative comment I can make is the high price for these single serving snack packs. I do hope Amazon would offer these Crunchy N Yummy snacks at cheaper prices soon!NOTE  TO AMAZON: Could you consider offering customers 'Subscribe & Save' for Crunchy N Yummy products?  That way we get a discount on the everyday price as we receive new shipment of the items in intervals!RECOMMENDED:Crunchy N Yummy Organic Freeze Dried Fruit Papaya is great for snacking on the go. At only 55 calories per pack - you can even start another pack without guilt tripping!Crunchy N Yummy Organic Freeze Dried Fruit Mango is another healthy and tasty snack with only 100 calories per serving pack.I usually have a couple bags of Crunchy N Yummy Freeze Dried Fruit Snacks in my gym bag. :))4 STARS for the high price - 5 STARS for a great tasting crunchy dried fruit snack!
This was a great change of something sweet and low calorie.  It was a very satisfying snack.  I would recommend it to anyone.

I've tried a lot of freeze-dried pineapple snacks and tried "Crunchy N Yummy" because my favorite was not available.  I'm glad I tried it.  "Crunchy N Yummy" is now my second favorite low calorie freeze-dried pineapple snack. (If you must know, "Funky Monkey" is number one).  "Crunchy N Yummy" is imported from Bolivia and is kosher and gluten-free.  It has a very good taste mixing both sweet and tart.  It also has a great satisfying crunch.  It contains 100 calories per one-ounce package.  I highly recommend this freeze-dried pineapple snack.

I have tried so many brands of freeze dried fruits, and crunchy y yummy is by far the most delicious one. its is really crunchy and tastes like the real fruit.On top of that, its healthy and super practical to carry around for an anytime snack. I highly recommend!!!

These are the nastiest dried fruits I've ever tasted.  The picture on the bag shows pieces of fruit, not the nasty flakes inside the bag.  The papaya doesn't taste anything like papaya.  Everyone in the house found it nasty tasting.  Yuck, $31.00 down the drain.  Gave it one star, because it was the lowest I could give.

column9: One of the worst products I've ever bought
column10: The pieces of pineapple were hard and crunchy. I bit into one piece and part of it was as hard as gravel or an olive pit. I hardly noticed the flavor because the texture was so awful.There is another dried pineapple product brand called Made in Nature that is excellent, so I suggest you buy that instead. Their product is moist and chewy and delicious.

This is my new favorite snack food for whenever I have a craving for sweets!  There is so much fruit for so little calories.  I love to eat it at night when watching TV and I even bring it to the movies to eat instead of popcorn.  I get all the crunch I love from chips, all the sweetness I love from candy and none of the guilt!  And my kids love it too - win, win, win!

Tasty enough, for sure, but I got these to put in my morning cereal - soaked in milk.  As such there are very hard an chewy and don't go well in that scenario.  Possibly be better just eaten as is, but still pretty hard.  Flavor was fine though, very pineappl-y :) sweet and tart.Depends what you want out of these, but not for me and I won't be getting more.Note: I've had other fruit in the Crunchy-Yummy brand (strawberry, apple) and they were very good, 5-stars, so I think it's the type of fruit itself that's the problem for me.
My favorite drink in the world (besides water lol). I love this lemonade, it has just the right amount of sugar. It's not sweet and it's organic. What more can you ask for?

column9: Amazon worker took one out of my box!
column10: Box was opened at the perforations and was only 23 in the box, thief amazon worker took one. Makes me think twice about ordering grocery items. Bright side is one less candy for me to get fat on.

column9: Needs nothing but more beans in the bag
column10: Our whole intention for this brew was evening iced coffee's out on the deck. Took 2 pots before we found out that it needs a bit more grounds to make it just right. Either it didn't lend itself well to iced, or it's not strong enough.  Of course, we just added more coffee, we brewed it strong, and that took care of it. Even brewing for your normal morning brew, it needs just a hair more (about a scoop more) to make it come alive. Another pretty decent deal, under $20 for 3lbs, within reason for quality flavored coffees.Oh, and those iced coffee's on the deck in the evening....are relaxingly wonderful.
Great texture.  Reminds me of the old Reeses crunchy peanut butter cup.  No gluten, no dairy, no white sugar or corn syrup - - plus flaxseed.  And no stir.  What more can you ask?

Earth Balance Peanut Butter, Creamy, 16-Ounce (Pack of 12)This is a really good peanut butter! We have had a terrible time finding a replacement for Henry's no-stir peanut butter since they discontinued it. This is a perfect choice! It has all natural ingredients without the hassle of the oil slopping all over the place, or the peanut butter running once it reaches room temperature. I still prefer the Henry's version, but until they bring it back we've found a replacement!

Earth Balance Peanut Butter is the BEST peanut butter on the market! It's gluten free, vegan, organic, and unlike other brands, it doesn't solidify. Solidification happens to even the most delicious of peanut butters... but with Earth Balance (that has the extra boost of healthy flax seed), it stays shelf stable. It doesn't become nastily chunky, nor is there the usual layer of oil.Earth Balance is EXCELLENT in Thai peanut dressings (like the one in Easy Cooking The Costco Way: Favorite Recipes using Costco Products),in stir fries, or even straight from the jar! Earth Balance gives a delicious balance. It's definitely Peanut Butter Solution [VHS].

If you're tired of the laborious task of stirring natural peanut butter, look no further.  Earth Balance tastes great and arrives stirred and stays stirred, and without refrigeration!  The secret is added flax seed, which, of course, is also a great health boon.  Just know that this is not organic peanut butter, just "natural."  It is sweetened with agave and tastes great.

This is the first natural peanut butter I found that doesn't need to be refrigerated. I bought different PB brand each time, as long it's organic/natural, for my super picky eater son. Turned out this product also containing good stuff such as flax seed and agave syrup. I personally never like any kind of peanut, but this peanut butter is so tasty I don't mind eating it too. Besides, the flax seed helps to lower bad cholesterol and I suppose agave syrup is better than other sweetener. I don't think if it's really beneficial for health but it is said to be 3 times as sweet as table sugar, meaning it takes less to sweeten, meaning less calorie.All pros, no cons for me, and my son does not complain. This is going to be my last search of the perfect peanut butter. I have found Earth Balance natural creamy peanut butter to be it.

This peanut butter contains no cheap "filler oils" and no sugar.  The no-stir quality makes it hassle free, but the best part is the taste!  The agave sweetened aspect is the perfect touch on a pure product.

I sampled this product, which is good, but I will not buy it because of the plastic packaging.  I'll stick with all natural peanut butter that has the oil on top and comes in a much Earth-friendlier glass jar.

I use tahini primarily to make hummus dip for fresh vegetables and pita bread.  This is a fresh tahini paste (vs roasted) with a fresh nutty-sesame flavor.  This tahini is more liquid than other tahini that I have purchased.  You may need to adjust your hummus ingredients to use less liquid to get the consistency you prefer.  The current price point of $5.00/lb ($30 for 6 pounds) is OK (previously very reasonably priced from $3.00 to $3.79 per pound.) In addition, 6 pounds is a huge quantity for me despite my liking for hummus.Hummus can be prepared in 5 minutes in a food processor if you start with canned or cooked chick peas. You may need to stir the tahini before using as it tends to separate. Start with 1 clove garlic; chop and then mince in the food processor; add a 15 oz can (drained,reserve liquid) chick peas, 1/3 cup tahini, 1/3 cup olive oil. Mix and process at high speed until smooth; adjust thickness with reserved liquid as needed.  Add seasonings such as salt, pepper, cummin or lemon juice to taste.Whether you call it tahini or tahina, this sesame seed paste is also used to make halvah, a  candy and debis which is the Middle East  version of peanut butter and jelly.This product: Al Wadi Tahina, 100% Ground Sesame, 16-Ounce Jars (Pack of 6)

Fresh and Delicious! This is my second case and will be back for more once this is done too -- makes awesome hummus and is also delicious as a replacement for Peanut Butter for those of us that can't have highly sugared types!Great Stuff!!

column9: The best raw tahini I've ever had
column10: This is the best raw tahini I've ever had -- and I've tried many brands. It does have a very strong "raw tahini" flavor however, which some people may not like. But this strong flavor was exactly what I was looking for. Unlike one reviewer, I found little bitterness in this tahini -- I'd say it is far less bitter than the average raw tahini. If you want a mild tahini, go with a roasted one, not a raw one. But if you want a traditional tahini for traditional Middle Eastern dishes, I strongly recommend this one.I've used this tahini in hummus, baba ghannouj, sauce for falafel, and sesame noodles. The results have been fantastic with the tahini flavor coming through in the final product, whereas other tahinis you can barely taste.As another reviewer noted, this tahini is more liquidy than other tahinis, no doubt due to a higher oil content, so you may have to cut back on the other liquids or oils in the recipe.
Product was fresh tasting and made a very yummy hummus.  I will buy it again once I go through all 6 jars.
I use this tahini to make hummus.  It is not too thick and not oily at all.

Good tahina is not hard to find, but good tahina at a great price is much harder to locate. Al Wadi produces a quality product that makes making tahini sauce one of the easiest tasks a cook could have. There's no waste, it can last for ages in the refrigerator (but not in *my* house, we eat it too often!), and I always have some on hand for a snack with fresh bread, or for wraps, or a dip with kebabs.

Excellent product for hummus or any other recipe that calls for tahini. Since it is natural with no junk added, the solids separate from the sesame oil. I just shake the container each time really hard before using it and when it becomes very hard on the bottom, I cut it with a knife and just use a bit of water or lemon juice to thin it. Al wadi again delivers a great product.
I've tried a range, and this is definitely the best for the real deal in authentic tahini for Middle-Eastern hummos.
This would be much better if it were thicker. I used to buy Maranatha raw organic tahini, and it was much better--- unfortunately not available anymore. It had a much fresher, sweeter taste.

I am very pleased with this tahini from Al Wadi. All my jars arrived okay, although the plastic wrapping around the jars was a little greasy to the touch (I just washed it away with a little warm water and soap). Unopened, I believe these jars can be stored unrefrigerated, but I refrigerate mine anyway just to be safe. I use this tahini mainly in hummus, and it works well for that, but you can also make an awesome spread for falafel by putting some tahini in a food processor with lemon juice, a couple of garlic cloves, some cold water and mint leaves.

I normally get my Tahina from a local lebanese shop near my home. Their tahina is excellent and great on their falafel sandwhiches they make to go. You can buy tubs of their tahina to go as well, which is what I've been doing up until now. While their Tahina has added to it a little salt, lemon and garlic, it is a more, white creamy texture than this Al Wadi brand offered on Amazon.com, but there is no milk in it, the owner told me, that accounts for its white creamy texture. Al Wadi, offered on Amazon, is on the liquid side at room temperature I noticed upon opening my first jar, that is until you add the juice of a small lemon, for each 1/3 cup of tahina into the mix. It also gets less liquidy, if you keep it in the frig for a few days. Anway, when you add the juice of a small lemon, like I indicated, the whole thing thickens up dramatically. So don't let the liquid texture fool you. I had to add more sesame seed oil to it, after adding in the lemon, just to thin it out: Interesting reaction. I love to dip fresh cooked falafels into a Tahina dressing. Yum! If the Tahina is really well prepared, like where I get it locally, its good for pouring onto salads as well. However, this Al Widi preparations would have to be really thinned out more with Sesame seed oil to make that possible, especially after you add lemon juice to it.I have to keep an all vegetarian diet these days to help my blood pressure and follow a program designed for breaking down myofacia tumors in the body, all naturally, given the tumors are inoperable. So I can't get out and get to my local Lebanese store to get my tahina like I use to, which is why I thought I'd try this brand offered from Amazon.com. I do thank God for the Internet when you are shut in like I am.I think this preparations has a good solid nutty flavor to it and is also great to spread on whole wheat bread with some honey. I'm not disappointed, especially since I bought 6 jars to take advantage of the Free Super Saver shipping offer.Hope this helps cover some points not mentioned in the other reviews? I gave it four stars because its just not quite up there with what I buy locally at the commercial level, but it is a good tasting product regarless and I would buy it again.
If you are going to make hummus, this is what you want to use.  High quality, reasonable price, and free shipping.  This isn't rocket science. Buy it. Now.

Love this Tahini. Been using it for over 1 year. Makes the best hummus.But this last order, I ordered 6 smaller jars rather than 2 larger ones. And 2 of them came in damaged. :( I do not know if it was packaging or defective jars.

column9: Ok, have had better and worse..
column10: Very runny on top, thick at the bottom which is OK with me as I use the top to make a salad dressing with Sriracha chili sauce, soy sauce and lemon juice. Taste is very mild, I prefer the bitterness of tahini. We have a middle eastern grocery store an hour away which has THE best tahini, this saves me the drive though..

My family and I went to a Greek restaurant every week, mainly for the pita and hummus.  We realized it was an expensive habit and decided to try to make it at home.  I easily found good-quality pita bread at the grocery store, but I could not find tahini.  (My large grocery store offers pre-made hummus, but I wanted to make it fresh.) One weekend, we drove into downtown Houston to a Mediterranean market, where I picked up a jar of Al Wadi Tahina.  My first attempt to make hummus with it was a success, and since then we have never purchased pre-made hummus.  It's very quick and easy (not to mention cheap) to make yourself, and you have the option to personalize it to your tastes.  (We add a bit of red pepper flake to ours.)A few observations to make your experience with Al Wadi Tahina a success: 1. It's more a liquid than a paste.  Keep this in mind when making your  hummus.  I did not need to add much liquid to mine at all because of this.  2. All tahini has a bitter flavor.  Some recipes call for a lot of tahini, but you may want to add a few tablespoons and taste before adding more.  It has a great, smokey flavor, but it can be too bitter if you use a large amount.  3. Always stir well before adding tahini to the blender or food processor, and scoop from the bottom to get more of the paste.There are more expensive tahini options available, but this brand offers a decent price point and authentic flavor.  I was able to make hummus that tastes exactly like the hummus at our favorite Greek restaurant for less than $3 a bowl versus $6 at the restaurant.

The tahina arrived in the correct amount of time. The only problem was that the oil had leaked from the containers and they were all covered in a layer of oil. I'm not sure if the lids were not tightly sealed or what.

I love Hummus!!!! Yet, finding a good ground sesame was impossible! Until, I read an article that referred to this Tahina available on Amazon!!  I was upset to find out I had to order 6 jars, yet how quickly they they go! They store easily in my pantry and I have even given some to friends.  Compared to ground sesame available in your local market, this is the best.  Make hummus at home and enjoy the great taste in minutes. Recipes are available on-line, easy to make, in-expensive, healthy, delicious and full of fiber.

The tahini is great. I've used it already to make hummus twice and also found a tasty recipe for tahini cookies that I tried and loved (very lo-cal, no flour). The jars I ordered came intact and ahead of schedule. Absolutely no complaints.

I *love* this tahini. It has such a good flavor and the price is so reasonable. This is my fourth 6-pack that I've ordered in the past year. I do use it to make hummus, but my favorite use for it is my delicious tahini dressing. Just whisk about 1/2 cup of it with the juice of a lemon and some good salt (I use Himalayan), and then whisk in some water until it's the consistency you want.  You can optionally add seasonings like garlic and herbs, but I love it best just plain like that. Super easy and delicious.  Oh and everyone does love my hummus too!

I like this tahini. I have ordered it a few times now and it has always been tasty and easy to work with  -- not so difficult to stir like some brands.  It is thick and you could dilute it if you wish, but I prefer to eat is as it is. It goes good on everything from quinoa to salads.

The Al Wadi Tahini has a wonderful texture but it is very bitter compared to other Thaini brands and it is not a good fit (in my opinion and I am a Tahini "addict") for making a Tahini paste or even Hummus

Makes a wonderful, creamy hummus. I would also suggest using the Cook's Illustrated technique, mixing the tahini with olive oil and dribbling it into the processed garbanzos (and other ingredients) that are already in the food processor. Always gets rave reviews.

column9: My Love Letter to this product...
column10: When I saw these for the first time, on a shelf in a gas station mini-mart, it was one of those moments where time seems to suddenly stand still, and (like a scene from a movie, & if moments in life had their own accompanying soundtracks) would have been 'justified' in having a choir singing some sort of crescendo -based bit of non-verbal hallelujah, thereby triggering goosebumps, & a sudden involuntary 'gulp', as one then regains one's composure... my first thought (when I was finally able to think, after initially staring in stunned silence [nay, reverence]), when coming face-to-bag with this ridiculously delicious bit of heaven, was something along the lines of, ~'omg... this is genius...'.This is like some sort of food-based 'designer drug' -- because, trust me, if you like almonds, & you like (or, rather, love) the marriage of sea salt with that somethin'-somethin' oil-based bit of extravagance otherwise encountered in whoa-that's-good -tasting potato chips, then this, my friend, is your new difficult-to-resist temptation, addiction, & 'frenemy'... ;)On any drive back from a relative's place, when I stop to get gas, prior to beginning the drive home, I intentionally go to the gas station that I know carries this item -- & when I get back in the car, & open that first bag (I let myself enjoy 2 of the 1.5-ounce bags as I 'head off into the sunset'), you'd think I was about to bite into the world's best chocolate cake, or the greatest pie, or a mind-blowing cheesecake -- yes, this stuff is 'right up there' with the rest of my hallowed favorites when it comes to savoring every single tastebud interaction -- but, whereas the confectionary treats are otherwise enjoyed on relatively rare occasions, & largely restricted to celebratory events, my partaking of these delectable skinless almonds, & their Goldilocks-like, 'just right' mix of sea salt & oil, is more on a 'whenever/any/every time I can' basis, & renders whatever moment I can have them dance across my tastebuds its own celebratory event, & 'tastebud holiday', if you will...Yeah, it's safe to say that I love these little bits of almond nirvana...  Be warned, however -- these things are 'addictive'... & if you should make the 'mistake' of placing a bowl of these out at a party or family gathering, you'd better make sure you've arranged for refills (or risk the frustrated wrath of those who suddenly find themselves craving more [& who might be 'driven' to suddenly leave the premises, in search of more, albeit with one parting inquiry -- 'hey, where did you get these?'])...To whoever dreamed up, let alone greenlit, the manufacture of this product -- oh, the power of what you have unleashed... even if we end up being a 'cult following', know that this 'cult of the sea salt & oil -ized skinless almond' enjoy the dickens out of this wondrous almond delight...These taste SO good... & what a nice little dance of 'textures', with the slick oil on a surface that's smooth & gets moderately crunched, & then the wonderful taste of sea salt & oil getting introduced to the previously unexposed interior aspects of almond that have been newly released due to chewing... I know I sound ridiculous, but, oh, this is yummy... what a delightful series of minutes for one's sense of taste...

column9: Buying them in store is better
column10: These are a tad stale... they don't taste bad but the ones from the supermarket are much more fresh and have a CRUNCH to them that these do not.  The expiration date on this is 8 months away so that shouldn't be the issue.  Maybe they are kept in a hot warehouse or something, but I won't be buying these from here again.

I was not an almond fan untill I was introduced to this product. The olive oil and sea salt add up to a wonderful taste; they are skinless but not greasy. I keep a bag at work and one in my car to provide instant protein and energy. They are difficult to find in local stores, (and I don't live in Spooner, Wi, by the way, I am in a large suburban area) which is why I resorted to ordering a whole case on line!

Purchased a small package in a store and loved them.  They have a slightly differnt taste and I love the sea salt and olive oil flavoring. I was pleased I could find them on line because I checked everywhere and could not find a store again that carries them.  I will be sure to buy more.

I have had a hard time finding these nuts since Planter took them out of ALL the grocery stores in my area. These are the only type of Almonds I will eat. They are GREAT. My Dr. had suggested that I eat these for health reasons.

column9: Delicious -- The olive oli makes all the difference
column10: If you are an almond lover, you owe it to yourself to give these a try.  Sure, you should probably buy a single pack somewhere first, but these are amazingly delicious, addictive and, unfortunately, pretty fattening.Make sure to have napkins at hand, as your hands will be finger-licking-good greasy when you are done!

column9: Planters Sea Salt & Olive Oil Almonds
column10: Healthy, and DELICIOUS!!! A satisfying, healthy snack.  Give them a try, trust me, you will love them!!!Nutrition Facts:27 Whole Almonds = 170 Calories.Total Fat:  15gSaturated Fat 1.5gTrans Fat  0gPolyunsat.Fat 3.5gMonounsat.Fat 9gCholesterol  0mgSodium  130mgPotassium  200mgTotal Carbs  5gDietary Fiber 3gSugars  1gProtein  5g
yes they can be hard, but almonds usually are.  they are skinless and just plaing good. I highly recommend them.. If you like to snack on nuts...these are great

column9: More like Qdoba's Tortilla Soup than NM Green Chile Stew
column10: I adore the Green Chile Stew I used to get from the Frontier Restaurant in Albuquerque, NM (but now I'm in Indiana).  I also really like the Tortilla soup from Qdoba's (this product is rather similar in basic flavor, though not in all ingredients).  I had a hard time identifying the green chile in the cooked product.It is very hard to find a good GREEN chile flavor outside of New Mexico; most everything 'Mexican' tastes for more Tex-Mex and RED chile.  This soup is very flavorful and mildly hot, but very far from what I think of as 'Green Chile Stew'.  The canned Hatch is much closer.  However, I still give the product high marks for being (as far as I can tell from reading the ingredients) all natural, and also for being quite tasty.  I tried it plain the day I got it, and then added canned Chili Beans and Tomatoes with Green Chiles and El Yucateco Green Habanero sauce and some potatoes... this made a very satisfying stew, but not what *I* was looking for in a 'Green Chile Stew'.  Leonard Mountain is based in Oklahoma - nice but not NM.  Very fine product, but not with this name...  I will use the other 4 boxes over time, but I don't think I'll keep the subscription.

This product may well be a backpacker's delight, but it probably will be a disappointment to a home cook.The product no doubt will hold its own in comparison with other dried, light-weight products for the hiker's food bag. But the package directions (which are very small print and hard to read)can tip off a home cook that the manufacturer makes enough suggestions about to improve the mouth feel and taste of the product that the home cook realizes that for roughly the same amount of work and roughly the same expense of materials and utilities, one can make a much more tasty green chili stew at home.  Understand, please, that this is not a bad product if you want backpack trail food.  But if you have a stove and refrigerator and the usual household commodities potatoes, onions, chilis, spices) on hand, your family almost certainly will prefer chili stew made from scratch, and it will take about the same time and effort.

I have high blood pressure and have to watch my sodium intake.  I discovered Leonard Mountain soup products at a craft fair.  Seeing that they were somewhat low in sodium, I bought several, cooked them up, and loved them!  I tend to add my own veggies such as tomatoes, an extra can of green chilies, diced potatoes and onion to this mix and I end up with a wonderful, low sodium, tasty, very hearty stew!  I use the soup mixes as a base as the spices are wonderful and very flavorful.  Add your own veggies and meat to make a lovely stew for your family.  Add corn tortilla slices for an extra special touch!

We received this as a gift and I tried this a couple of days ago when we needed a quick dinner and I wasn't feeling well. The spices were perfect- and the ingredients all by themselves worked great for us. We prepared according to the simple directions- no creativity at all on our part. Can't wait to make it again and try a little of our own flare to it! Also plan to purchase more for gifts...
My family in Manhattan was delighted to receive the gift basket. It arrived in good time and those who ate the contents are very happy to recommend Geoff & Drew's cookies.

column9: RIP OFF PRICE .. only$ 2.29 in store for the large container
column10: I would never buy these from this distributor at this price. I wanted to ship some to my girlfriend in Florida because we have not found it here yet and I live in Ohio. The price in our stores is only about $2.29 for a large can. This price is half more..... Unless they lower there price I would not ever buy it from them. Not only is this not discounted for quantity.. it is no bargain to begin with and then shipping will make it even more. I would report them for ruining the awesome Chips brands reputation.... find em.. buy em.. eat em up.. they are the best... I even lost a lot of weigh eating them to curve hunger believe it or not. My cholesterol is just fine too btw.  Love PIK NIK the best.. reminds me of being a kid again.

I have been eating the Pik-Nik Shoestring Potatoes ever since I was a kid. I always liked them better then potato chips. I can buy these in the store but since my family eats a lot of these I was hoping to get a good deal thru Amazon. NOT!!! The price for these when shipping is added does not make for a good deal! Matter of fact, I'd consider these at $40.16 for a case of 12, from the distributor that is carrying them, to be a huge RIP_OFF! That makes each 9 oz. can cost $4.16 each!!! I can buy the same size can at my local market for 2.49 each. So don't get ripped off with this one folks! Remember, the product is great, the price is NOT!
I live in Europe and wanted a little taste of home, and this reminded me of just that. Well packaged, arrived with NO Damage.

I had this coffee in a restaurant and loved it so much that I order it through Amazon.  The dark roast is also quite good.  For the first two bags, the shipping was almost as much as the coffee, but if you order more the shipping costs don't increase, so it's best to order multiple packs.
Excellent coffee.  My husband had it at a restaurant in Arkansas and we had to order it as soon as we got home.  Other people in the restaurant were talking about how good it was.

I ordered this after having my first experience with Douwe Egberts at a local restaurant.Although this isnt exactly the same (the restaurants use a concentrate that the machine measures precisely) it was damn good none the less.I'm not much of a coffee drinker because I hate the bitterness in most coffee's but this had no bitterness at all and was very smooth.I'll be ordering this again.
Big price, small package, and doesn't taste quite as good as it does at the Embassy Suites, where I first tasted it.

My son loves these puffs and they are organic and a good price.  That's all I care about.  This is also a weird thing:  I love the packaging.  It's more slender than other puffs that I've purchased, so they don't take up as much room.  Weird, I know but these reviews have to be at least 20 words.  :)

Organic, low-calorie, melt-in-your-mouth snacks that taste great....what more can you ask for?  My 1-year-old loves these.  Unfortunately, none of the local stores seem to carry them, so I have them auto-shipped directly to my house.  Love that!  Don't tell, but the husband and I also eat a few of these from time to time.  They really are yummy!

First, I LOVE Plum Organics products!  This is not a review against the company, just this particular flavor. Its not really a banana flavor to me. Very mild. The blueberry/purple sweet potato and strawberry/beet have the most flavor with apple/spinach being the third.  I'd say this is the 4th and the least flavorful is the mango/sweet potato.  My son still ate them but not as well as others.
What's to say? Baby and 3.5 year old love them! They're good too...I tried them. Yum! We will definitely order again! Bulkis the way to go with these.

Bought diff flavors while the local store had them on sale. This is the first time I tried Plum's brand. I only opened the yellow one and the purple one. The yellow one is supposed to be banana and peach... Tastes like nothing but just rice waffle in star shapes. No banana or peach flavor or smell. I understand it is supposed to be organic but ORGANIC doesn't have to be tasteless. The purple one which is supposed to be purple potato and blueberry, which tastes like cough syrup. I drank water and still had the weird taste in my mouth. So disappointed. Will return the unopened one back to the store and try other brands instead.
Baby loves them!! I personally dont think they taste much like anything, but hey!! Im not the one eating them! If you want to feed your child a healthy treat, this is a good option.
My daughter LOVES these puffs.  They are a smaller package then the other organic puffs, but they taste 3 times better.  Great product and I would recommend to others.

column9: Power Puff for Digestive Health Leads the Pack!
column10: Searching for a low-sugar wheat-free puff to offer my baby girls, I discovered Plum Organics with much joy. Clearly superior to all other major brands of baby puffs for digestive health, who's better than Plum for my family? I've successfully battled to contain a serious digestive disorder called Ulcerative Colitis for over a decade in part by special attention to diet. In that time I've learned even moderate amounts of wheat causes problems by creating an overgrowth of Candida yeast in my system. Some know this as a sensitivity to gluten or sugars, others suffer without realizing as so many foods contain wheat or high amounts of sugar. For me it's cumulative folks, a little in nearly everything really piles up. I notice my body getting too much as soon as I begin to heavily crave breads or sugars.  Before you know it, that gummy gluten renders me 90% incapable of absorbing nutrition altogether.Back to the Puffs... wheat is high in gluten, but the oat and rice based Puff offered by Plum Organics stands out with ingredients more gentle on digestive function. This is in addition to providing all the stuff HappyBaby remains conscious of, like sugar and vitamin content. Rice is gluten-free and minimally processed oat may be too, but many still leave it off the list of gluten-free foods due to typical cross-contamination issues with lots of wheat growing and processed alongside oats. Small amounts are ok with me anyway -- I'm looking for regulation rather than elimination here. So I'm happy to introduce all these foods to my daughters at healthy levels.How about the sugar content? Super low, and only natural organic fruit, vegetable or cane juice is used (not corn-syrup as another reviewer erroneously reported -- [...]). And can we really get upset about a little blueberry or sweet potato juice temporarily staining a cloth when you account for their health properties? Regulate, read the labels for yourself and take joy in offering your kids a simple, low sugar, high vitamin, low gluten snack.Oh and must say, I love that they're mainly just puffed air with a fantastic balance of nutrients. 1/2 cup or about 75 pieces per serving keeps my little dears engaged in motor development and feeding skills for a while without concern for dietary imbalance.Bunch of facts, all packed up to help someone out there enjoy a little extra peace next time they offer Plum Puffs to their kids.  Live well!
We were surprised of the low cost for really good saffron. We will be purchasing more in the future. I highly recommend this product. My husband is a chef and was very pleased with this saffron.

This is the best drink to have over ice on a hot day..Really any of the Ice Tea's have a great taste to them. You make them as sweet as you want or add no sugar at all. My husband seems to be drinking more than me in the Ice Tea world which I find hard to belive.. Time to play catch-up :)Its also a great drink to offer company instead of coffee, beer, wine, ect...

The raspberry flavor and the sweetness are very subtle. So much that I add a spoonful of sugar or two which really brings out the raspberry flavor (as is a trend with Celestial Seasonings).  Very refreshing and very delicious.

column9: A very HOT sauce lacking any other redeeming quality.  A vague hint of tomato with a bitter aftertaste.  Impossible to recommend

There are also pepper extracts where gloves and eye protection are recommended if pure heat is what you are after.  I frankly don't understand the logic that hotter is always better but tastes vary.Conclusion:  High heat, a bitter aftertaste and a vague hint of tomato. column9: By far the best mass produced coffee
column10: I've tried nearly every single mass produced preground coffee from terrible cups like maxwell house and folgers swill to nicer espresso roasts and I've found that this is by far the best mass produced blend on the shelf. I only buy the small cans so it stays fresher, there is no question that grinding the beans yourself is the best way, but sometimes we don't have time for that and this is where this coffee really shines.  The cans are made of metal and vaccuum sealed with a metal piece of foil to lock in that freshness--Sara Lee always makes a quality product.I make my coffee with just under boiling filtered water poured into a coffee press, stir to bring up the froth, and steep for 4 minutes before pressing.  I drink it black or with a bit of real heavy cream for a different flavor.  The New York Roast is amazing and my favorite, it's a dark and smokey flavor with not a hint of bitterness--Starbucks doesn't have anything that's even close to as good as this coffee.  This coffee is also good in drip machines, but the real secret to good coffee is throwing the drip machines out and making either a 12 hour cold brew or pressed coffee--it can take a mediocre cup to a good cup and a good cup to an amazing cup.Bottom line:  If you aren't interested in spending big bucks on coffee, you owe it to yourself to try this coffee.

Enjoy Life Foods sent us four boxes of their new crunchy cookies to taste test. Dr. J now recognizes their label! He wanted to taste test the Double Chocolate first, and of course this chocoholic mommy did not protest!Remember, Enjoy Life Foods products are free of the top 8 food allergens. Could that kind of product make a double chocolate cookie that tastes "real"?Um, YES! My mouth waited for the rice aftertaste, but it couldn't find one. Enjoy Life Foods created a chocolate taste on par with homemade, and the crunch satisfied! The boys loved them, as you can see, but I was elated! I confess I hid the rest of the box and saved them for me, though guilt did kick in later and I shared one more with them, ha!Now, it would have been very easy to gorge ourselves and eat all four boxes at once, but I needed to test these cookies on a non gluten- and dairy-free eater...Daddy! The next night we had another taste test, this time trying two cookies: Chocolate Chip and Vanilla Honey Graham. Again the boys loved them! And Daddy? My pickiest taste tester of all things allergy-friendly? What was his verdict?Good! He preferred the chocolate chip, but said the Vanilla Honey Graham was decent. There's an ever-so-slight after taste to the graham cookies, but Meatball didn't seem to mind!If you've been counting, there is one more flavor left--Sugar Crisp. Now, I grew up with a Type 1 diabetic mom. The sugar cookies she made were reduced sugar, and I loved them. Most other sugar cookies were always too sweet for me. I figured this would be the case as well, and Daddy and Meatball would get the bulk of the sugar cookies.Wrong! When I bit into my first Sugar Crisp, I was amazed. There was a buttery flavor to it. I grabbed the box--was there some mistake? Was dairy hidden there and somehow Enjoy Life Foods missed it, marketed it wrong? What were the ingredients? How did they get that flavor?I don't know! But there's still no dairy in there! The Sugar Crisp had just the right sweetness, and of course the same satisfying crunch. I ate a lot of them. At first Dr. J didn't want them because they looked a whole lot like another sugar cookie he had tried and not liked. I asked him to please try a bite, and of course he didn't like them. However, after two days of watching Mommy and Meatball eat them, he finally gave them another taste, and was quite happy to consume some himself!I think we can happily say Enjoy Life Foods Crunchy Cookies will definitely be a back up plan for when Mommy forgot to make cookies and we need to take a treat somewhere. My flavor preferences in order were: Double Chocolate, Chocolate Chip and Sugar Crisp tied (seriously, who would have thought!), and finally the Vanilla Honey Graham. Some of you will be able to find them in your local allergy-friendly grocery stores now, and some of you will need to be watching (and ASKING) for them as Enjoy Life Foods continues to get them into the market. You all have my permission to eat two Double Chocolate cookies when you get them--one for you, and one for me!Enjoy Life Foods sent us their Crunchy Cookies for taste testing and honest review. All opinions, and cookie crumbs in the keyboard, are my own. You can learn more about these cookies and their other new products here at their website. I also want to thank them for donating crunchy cookies to our Southeast Michigan Spectrum Moms family picnic in May.

I can't say enough good things about Enjoy Life and these cookies!  They are fabulous and a true treat for allergen free kids and adults!  They are delicious and you would never know they were gluten, casein, soy, etc free!!

Snickers Marathon Chocolate Nut Burst Protein Bars are a middle of the road protein/energy bar. I really like the taste of these, and their 22g of protein is the highest content of any of the protein bars that I regularly eat - Cliff Builder, Kashi, and Promax being the others.  They are also fairly high in electrolytes with 360mg of Sodium and 260mg of Potassium, and these are important to those who train hard and need the extra minerals.  The one downside to these is that their sugar content (at least in part) comes from corn syrup and high fructose corn syrup.  The other products that I mentioned avoid this by using more natural sources such as evaporated cane juice.  Because of the sweetener, I do not use any of the Snickers products as my primary protein bars.  I use them more as a change of pace to keep from burning out on the others.  For the more nutritious conscious, I would recommend products from Cliff, Kashi, or Promax.  While these are better than a regular candy bar, you can still do better.

A friend of mine told me to try one of these. I've always been skeptical of these bars because of the Snickers name attached. Not that Snickers bars taste bad, but it's just not a name you associate with "lean and muscular."I checked out the nutritional info and it compares pretty favorably with comparable bars. 14% daily fat, 15% sat fat, 13% carbs, 44% fiber, 21 g of protein, 280 calories.It tastes a lot better than your average meal-replacement bar, too. I don't know if I'd go with these regularly, but for a change of pace, they're pretty good.
Take it from somebody who has been at dieting awhile.  You won't stick with something you don't like.  These have decent nutrition with a low GI and have better than average taste.

I love these bars! They are excellent when I want a protein boost, or want something that will fill me up in between meals. I prefer the Chocolatey Nut Burst to the Caramel Nut Ruch.
