column9: Great coffee, but bag that rips off consumers
column10: This is a totally enjoyable dark roast coffee, but Baronet has chosen to sell it in a "fair trade" bag that contains 8 unprotected pods and drastically shortens the shelf life of the coffee once you open the bag.  If you drink 3+ cups of coffee a day and only drink this variety, this is fine because you'll use up all the coffee pods in less than 3 days.  But if you like to choose from several varieties of coffee pods, and drink only 1-2 cups a day,it's a definate minus and totally anti-consumer.  One of the most important advantages of single-pod packed coffee is the freshness and aroma that's assured when you tear open the bag.  This form of packaging is the equivilent of using your mother's Maxwell House coffee in a 1-pound can that often stayed around the house for months.At least give the customer a choice of packagings!SUGGESTION FOR CONSUMERS:  DON'T BUY ANY COFFEE SOLD IN THESE BAGS!!!SUGGESTION FOR AMAZON:  DON'T SELL ANY POD COFFEE THAT'S NOT PACKAGED IN SEAL INDIVIDUAL SERVINGS!!!

I'm thrilled that there is ketchup emerging that doesn't have high fructose corn syrup.  It's wonderful!  This one from Hunt's is very good, and I do recommend it.PROS:- Smooth- Full-bodied, fresh tomato flavor.- Not too sweet, just a hint of sweetness.- No high fructose corn syrup!- No problems with the bottle or in dispensing the product.- Thick enough for great dipping or for putting on a burger or hot dog.  Not too thick, though.  Perfect density.CONS:- None!

These Glory Foods string beans are amazing! After trying multiple brands and varieties of green beans, these are BY FAR the best tasting. They are seasoned perfectly and not too salty. Will definitely be trying more Glory Foods products in the future!

I will never make a green bean casserole for the holidays with anything other than Glory Foods canned Seasoned String Beans (or Sensibly Seasoned). The flavor added the a to amazing in my finished dish!
Glory Foods' String Beans are so delicious. The seasoning is perfect and doesn't need anything added to it to make it a delicious part of the meal.

No problem, here's what you do.Drain half the liquid (and there is a LOT) and pour this entire can into apan containing a 27oz. can of Glory Pinto Beans. No lie, the combination isunbelievable, and needs no seasoning.By itself, these green beens are too soft, over cooked, and in short supply inthis can cause its mostly liquid. What a gyp! On the first bite I knew thisstuff needed something, so I pulled down a can of Pintos and now I have a newfavorite dish. The synergy is amazing, and I've never mixed these two veggiesbefore in my life. Great stuff, but like I said, dont bother trying to servethis by itself. If you must have green beans get some Allen's or Margaret Holmes.

column9: Something I Look Forward to After Each Workout
column10: I'm writing this review as I sip the Yogi Green Tea Muscle Recovery tea.It has a subtle honey flavor throughout and I also taste the lemongrass flavor especially in the beginning (you would smell the nice lemon scent as well). I taste green tea flavor also but its flavor becomes more definite during the aftertaste. If you like herbal teas, I think you would like this tea as well.Like other Yogi tea, I like that the tea never gets bitter even if I brew it longer than I suppose to (3 minutes). One tea bags make at least two cups of tea.As far as muscle recovery effects goes, I "think" I'm feeling a difference. I have been working out 5 times a week, and when I drink Yogi Green Tea Muscle Recovery tea, I do not have prolonging muscle aches longer than a day. However, I have to point out that it might be because I am getting used to my work out routine and need to push myself a little further to start feeling the "pain" again :-P Anyhow, this is okay as I'm not expecting a complete muscle recovery from a one herbal tea bag. What I like most about this tea so far is that its gentle scent and flavor definitely helps me to relax after each workout. I like to think and visualize that my muscle are growing as I sip this tea and it's a plus psychologically :-)I initially found this tea at local Whole Foods market.Purchasing this tea (pack of 6) from Amazon is cheaper than buying it individually from Whole Foods, and probably many other natural food stores. I hope Amazon will start having the Subscribe & Save option for this product like other Yogi teas.[UPDATE: Oct 12, 2011]Amazon now offers Subscribe & Save option! :-)I extracted description/effects of the top 3 ingredients (Green Tea Leaf, Lemongrass, and Blackberry Leaf) that contains the most in each tea bag as well as some other ingredients that Yogi Tea claims to play an important role in this product.Green Tea Leaf:- contains the most antioxidant polyphenols, which are responsible for its many health benefits.- is a more potent antioxidant than broccoli, carrots, spinach or strawberries.- enhances immunity and benefit oral health.- balance total cholesterol and LDL cholesterol, as well as triglycerides, and to support a healthy ratio of LDL cholesterol to HDL cholesterol.Lemongrass:- supports mucous membrane function, and it is used to promote sweating.- is a warming herb that speeds digestion and reduces gas and nausea.Blackberry Leaf:- its vitamin C and tannins in the leaves helps boost immunity and heal wounds.- contains ellagic acid, which is a powerful cell protector and antioxidant.- is a source of mild astringent compounds (tannins), which tighten up and dry out loose, soggy tissue (so blackberry leaf has been used traditionally to ease minor sore throat, diarrhea and skin rashes).Devil's Claw Root Extract:- Native to southern Africa- is a shrub that has lush foliage and red flowers (The plant gets its name from its fruits, which look like a hooked, gnarled claw).- Historically, African people have employed the root for a wide range of conditions; from digestive function to joint support.- Since its introduction to Europe in the early 1900s, the use of devil's claw root has spread throughout the world, and continues to be used primarily for joint support.Yucca Root-Herbs:- A desert plant that grows in the Southwestern part of the United States and in Mexico.- is a Native American remedy used to soothe irritation of all sorts, and to support healthy joints and skin.- The main nutritional agents are saponins, which have a soapy consistency. Native Americans used yucca as soap due to its lathering effect and also as a blood cleanser.Ginseng-Eleuthero Extract:- is not a true ginseng, but a cousin of Asian ginseng.- has gained that nickname due to the fact that Siberian natives use it as a broad spectrum health enhancer, much the way ginseng is used.- has a long-term stamina enhancing effect.INGREDIENTS (as it appears on the product package):Organic Green Tea Leaf, Organic Lemongrass, Organic Blackberry Leaf, Natural Lotus Flower Flavor, Rose Petal, Organic Skullcap Leaf, Organic Lemon Myrtle, Organic Turmeric Root, Yucca Root Extract, Ginseng-Eleuthero Extract (Panax ginseng, Panax quinquefolium, Eleutherococcus senticosu), Stevia Leaf, Cat's Claw Bark Extract (Uncaria tomentosa, Phenols 15%, Alkaloids 3%), Devil's Claw Root Extract.PRODUCT DESCRIPTION:Stay active with a cup of Green Tea Muscle Recovery(tm). Our satisfying blend starts with gently stimulating and antioxidant-rich organic green tea and combines it with traditional soothing herbs such as organic turmeric root, one of the most widely used herbs in India. We then add devil's claw root and yucca root--herbs from indigenous herbal traditions--to help decrease recovery time from the minor aches and pains that may result from exercise. What's more, ginseng-eleuthero extract helps you reenergize.* So get invigorated, be energized, and stay active with Green Tea Muscle Recovery![Above information extracted from Yogi Website: [...]][Edit: It seems I can not post Yogi web address on Amazon review. Please google "Yogi Tea" if you would like to obtain more detailed information about this product]

I love this tea and drink it almost daily!  Like a previous reviewer said, it doesn't get bitter when brewed hotter or when the tea bag is left in.  So, I brew and out the door I go enjoying my wonderful lemon-grass, green-tea and herbal concoction.  As a fitness instructor with a full class load, not only do I love the inclusion of turmeric for muscle recovery (although you don't taste it) but also the fact that it tastes so good that I'll actually drink it.  I just ordered the pack of 6 on Amazon as a regular delivery item to arrive every 6 months and saved about $3 more!  I'd get it every 4 or 5 months but that wasn't an option.  I might need to change to a more frequent delivery schedule?  But, I can always get a box or two from Swansons when I order my vitamins, for around $2.80. Don't let the very clinical sounding name fool you, it's really yummy!

I have tried several varieties of Yogi Tea, and love them all.  This one is very tasty (but brew it at green tea temperature!) and seems like a good choice after a run or a workout.  The price is excellent...  I have paid twice as much for this tea at the health food stores.  Buy it from Amazon!
This tea tastes wonderful is  satisfying even as a strong brew. It never tastes bitter. Recommended by a yoga instructor and has been a favorite since. So good I buy it by the case.

I got this Yogi Muscle Recovery tea after starting a rigorous exercise program. In the past the only thing that stopped me from increased exercise was sore muscles, now that is no longer a problem! I will drink this tea before and after a workout and it is amazing the difference I feel!This works very well for tired muscles. Highly recommended!

column9: Tastes great, not sure how much it works
column10: I am a very active person and I got this tea because it was hyped up to be a muscle recovery tea and is loaded with antioxidants.  While I haven't been drinking it consistently enough to see if it has helped my recovery periods I do know that it tastes great and has a lot of green tea in it.  They are still finding benefits to drinking green tea so I figure it can't hurt.  The taste is great, it's green tea, with a very subtle lemon taste.  I enjoy it a lot and would reccommend to anyone considering buying it.

I am a loyal Yogi tea drinker.  I work out 5 times a week and my muscles ache.  I use this and I have noticed a difference.  The flavor is kind of lemony, light.  Recommend this product for anyone with sore muscles, regardless of the amount of activity.

Like most Yogi teas it's tasty. In the words of my husband: "very flowery, much more herbal than it is tea." It doesn't have that strong licorice flavor that some Yogi teas can have. It tastes good enough that it's worth drinking without working out, just for the taste!The husband just went through 8 weeks of military training where they kicked his butt for two hours every day, and once he started taking this he noticed a difference in how he recovered for the next day. He never fully recovered during the week, but he fared much better than his classmates.
My baby loves these as a nightly snack. Perfect size for a small indulgence. I only wish I could find out more about the nutrional information.
I love these british candies.  I grew up in England and long for all the great childhood sweets.It is wonderful to be able to get them again!

i was really happy to find these on amazon. For some reason they haven't been available in North America for about 5 years. I thought the packages that came in the case of 36 were going to be a larger size, but that's not a big deal. Package was delivered quickly and everything was as it should be.

column9: Just What We were Hoping For
column10: I never thought I'd find these little things again!  Thanks, Food Ireland, they were just as we'd hoped!  Great nostalgia, very fresh!

First to let you know where I am coming from: I am not a big drinker and currently not drinking at all as I am trying to get pregnant. It's not unusual for me to make nonalcoholic drinks just to be "festive" (i.e. mix soda water, OJ with lime) when my husband drinks. However, thought it may be nice to have a glass of nonalcoholic wine once in awhile. So coming from this point of view - my expectations aren't too high for a decent nonalcoholic drink.After reviewing Ariel's website - there was a pretty big sell on their Award winning wines, how they have actually beat alcoholic wines, how it is not grape juice but made for those who like fermented taste of grapes...with that information, I figured I may as well try it.What a mistake. While the Cabernet has a deep purple color, the taste is significantly watered down grape juice that leaves a bad taste in your mouth (in more ways then one). I tried to like it & even tried to chill the bottle. Whether you drink warm or chilled, this bottle is just not pleasant. You could create the same taste with 1/4 grape juice and 3/4 water. I wish there was a satisfaction guarantee do I could get my $7+ back!

column9: Great alternative for those who can't drink alcohol
column10: This alcohol free wine is a great alternative for those who cannot, or choose not, to drink alcohol. Highly recommended, wish there were more companies producing alcohol free wines.
The wine has a horrible chemical rubbery after-taste. Presumably a result of the process which extracts the alcohol.

I'm pregnant and cannot drink alcohol.  I like wine that isn't chilled and if you get this I recommend you chill it fully before trying it.  If not it tastes like watered down, very bland wine.  When chilled, it tastes like grape juice with not enough sugar in it.  I will buy sparkling cider instead for my Xmas party.

They call Ariel Cabernet-Sauvignon wine? I'm just going to skip right to the chase and say this blech smells literally like when someone has been wearing their socks for too long a hasn't washed their feet and tasted worse. Like some of the other contributors here my girlfriend got this wine because she's pregnant and was sick of drinking water (is there really any good things for pregnant women to drink-we have yet to find anything). She had an immediate distaste for it and I barely got past the smell. $10 literally down the toilet (maybe it would work for a toilet cleaner). Not worth a star.
Because of health reasons I can no longer drink wine with alcohol.  I bought a bottle of the Ariel Cabernet Sauvignon and it was like grape juice that had gone bad.Don't waste your money on this.

Ok, so I'm pregnant, and have to quit the alcohol.  I thought "hey, why not try this stuff, they say it beats out real wine in some taste tests."  I'm not sure what swill they were testing against.  For someone that enjoys a nice cabernet, this was an insult.  It tastes like raisins and something else I can't quite put my finger on.  The sweetness is cloying, which is way off for a cabernet.  I couldn't finish a glass, and had to pour the rest down the sink.

This is absolutely the very best wine we've ever had!  We've shared it with many & all have the same opinion.  Great for Holy Communion too.  Has a very full & authentic flavor.  We've had all of them, including the  champaign, which is the best, as well.  Try it once & you'll never buy any other.  Ariel Nonalcoholic Wine is truly the very best.

There are a million different snack bars out there. The ones from Divinely D'lish are unique and in a class by themselves. I discovered them at the farmer's market in the Ferry Building in San Francisco. One taste and I was hooked for life.Since then, they have found their way into local shops here on the peninsula in the Bay Area. But now that they are available online at Amazon, anyone anywhere can enjoy them.The ingredient list is simple, straightforward, healthy and impressive. No GMO, no trans fats, unsulphered dried fruit, an emphasis on organic. They look like someone took tons of different kinds of grains (but they're wheat-free), seeds and nuts and mashed them together with dates, raisins, syrup, coconut. You can see every seed - nothing is pulverized and there's no flour filler. They're soft, but the nuts and seeds give them an oh-so-satisfying crunch.I heat them up very slightly and they taste like the most heavenly fresh baked cookies imaginable. My husband's favorite is the Cheeky Cherry Chocolate but since I try and steer clear of chocolate, my favorite is the Haute Diggity Date. He packs them on long business trips to help him over jet lag. I pack them as gifts for my east coast friends instead of the See's candy I used to bring. People seem to really appreciate something good to eat they don't have to feel guilty about.The only negative - and it's a big one - is it's almost impossible to exercise moderation with these things. Even if you can buy them locally here in the Bay Area, you might as well buy them online by the box. They'll be gone in a flash.
these bars are awesome.  Taste  great and healthy.  Took two boxes to the office  and they were gone in days.  People love them. Highly recommend them.
Glad Amazon carried this product! It is sometimes hard to find. These are the best!!!

I bought this from [...] when they had their sale. Amazon is cheaper on normal price though. It's pure awesomeness! best granola bar I've ever tasted. good organic ingredients. chewey, buttery, chocolatey, fruity awesomeness!!!!sure the calorie is a little higher than I'd like it to be. something like 230 calories. and I usually only eat half of these granola bars, but this one was so good that I finished the entire thing.HIGHLY RECOMMENDED! it tastes like you are eating chewy oatmeal chocolate chip cookie.

Okay, these bars could really put me on the path of a health nut.  LOL  They are WONDERFUL!!!  The best I've ever had of this type of snack.  Soft, moist, and of the highest quality ingredients.  The Cheeky Cherry Chocolate is my favorite, the Haute Diggity Date the next.  We purchased the Nibble a Sultana ones, but they didn't seem to be quite as nice.  Haven't tried the cherry/fig ones yet, but we're hoping to get them soon.  You just can't miss with this product, especially if you need to be gluten free.
I bought these as emergency supplies for an overseas trip.  Usually I abandon the uneaten items rather than carting them back home, but these were so good, they came back with me.
YUMMMMMMM!!!!  By far my favorite granola bar.  A little pricey, but worth it for such a good quality product.
This is my favorite gluten-free granola bar that I have found.  It has just the right amount of sweet and chewy consistency.  Enjoy!

column9: Best single-serve granola/muesli bar out there!
column10: 18 Rabbits makes the best single-serve granola/muesli bar on the market, all the flavors are great! A good source of fiber, and low in sugars, it is a satisfying breakfast or midday snack.

column9: THE best granola bars you will ever eat!!!
column10: I have purchased alot of products from Amazon, liked most of them but this oneis the first product i have written a review about.I tried the Cheeky Cherry Choc bars and i will buy more. They are tasty andsatisfying.Packed with everything i like!

I was in MOM's looking for a low sodium bar for my husband.  This was a new product sitting on the shelf. I reviewed the sodium level which was 2 mg. He tried it the same day and asked where'd I gotten it. He said it was very good. When I tried it myself, I could't believe how great it tasted. Unbelievable good! I highly recommend you try it.
These taste great.  They are very soft and filling between meals.  Great to take on hikes and biking.  Give it a go.

I liked it well enough.  Not my all-time favorite, as I prefer my Trio bars (nuts & fruits) for breakfast, however, if you're a chocolate fan but feel guilty about eating candy, this is the product for you.

This is great. I got a sample and then went on there web site and it showed where to uy it, but whole foods is not anywhere near me and it had amazon, so I ordered it y the box and it comes out cheaper that way then driving 30 minutes to the other side of town, to use th gas and it is higher that way. These things are great to have in your purse when you jsut need a snack and I also have them for my afternoon snack.
18 rabbits are the best granola products i've ever had...absolutely delicious!i really can't say enough great things about these tasty treats.

No more dry, tasteless granola bars! These are yummy, yummy, yummy!  I have been looking for a bar that I can grab and take on the road with me. These fit the bill. Chewy, sweet, and not too costly in calories, these are a great product.

I do not know if I received a bad batch of these granola bars, but they were awfully hard to chew.  Perhaps they are not as fresh as they should have been.  Reminds me of the pressed wood that they are using in construction these days.  However, I do like the taste and the fact that they are low in sugar.
A friend gave me one of these bars and they're delicious! I really like how they're low in sodium, soft and slightly chewy. I'm considering buying a dozen and I highly recommend them.

column9: Great packaging for a great product
column10: I love 18 rabbits and since I can't find them in NYC.  I have been ordering them from amazon.  They came within two days, packaging was great, the box the bars were in were not damaged and when I ate one of them, you could tell they were not stale, that they were fresh ( as fresh as packaged granola bars can be ha ha).  I will definetely be ordering them again soon.

My husband and I cannot get enough of these granola bars. They recently underwent some texture changes, for the better. The Chunky Cherry flavor is by far the best, but the others are good as well. It's great to have a simple, organic snack available.

Bought a box of the Cheeky Cherry Chocolate.  They are wonderful!  They are a hard chewy granola bar that is made with organic chocolate & cranberries.  Very good for hiking since the bar actually stays together when you unwrap it.  A lot of granola bars crumble apart when you handle them.  They taste natural - not too sweet.  I am ordering another box, so I highly recommend these delicious bars!

I really like these. They remind me of old school granola bars. The ones on the market now are too sweet for my liking and too chewy. These are not very chewy (a little tough) but thats the way i like them. The chocolate and cherry chunks are delish!

Be forewarned this bar is absolutely addictive and yummy!! I hate taking the very last bite because I don't want the great flavors to end.  Its so healthy and plus organic ingredients.. coconut, pencans, chocolate etc....can't beat it.  So if you're looking for a tastey and nutritious bar, look no further; this is it.

Wow, just wow!!  I am in love with these granola bars!  The "cheeky cherry chocolate" is my favorite, but the banana one is great, too.  I am going to try the other flavors soon.What I love about these bars:- USA grown/packaged- Certified organic- Perfect combo of chewy/crunchy texture- Awesome quality ingredients- No extra crap ingredients -- none- Tastes absolutely terrific!Just to tell you how much I love these bars, I get three boxes a month on Amazon "Subscribe & Save" program!They are great for a breakfast meal, after lunch snack, or even a late night snack to satisfy hunger.  They taste like they should be a reward like dessert, not a granola bar.  Yum!  I'd give them 10 stars if I could...

My first purchase was in San Francisco, I needed something to bring on a long flight.  Because I cannot eat soy, finding portable food is always an issue.  I found these to be flavorful and not too sweet.  Each bar as enough chocolate and cherry it make it interesting. My order was delivered quickly.  And I will order more as soon as I need them.

column9: I Agree With the One Star Rater
column10: Very chewy and not too sweet = perfect.  If you eat them at your desk the way I do, you'll appreciate the way they stay together and don't dribble bits in your lap and keyboard.  They have a fresh, homemade taste and are very healthy snacks.

These bars are really good. Nice and chewy; maybe a tad sweet. Beware health-food addicts. They actually contain butter, which I found surprising. But it seems a little butter goes a long way, since these bars are far superior than others I have tried.

Just received them last night.  Plenty of nuts, chocolate, cherries, and cranberries.  Chewy, but not too sticky.  It's the perfect granola bar. I plan to order more, as they are disappearing quickly from the pantry.

column9: Dense granola bar Cherry/Cranberry Flavor doesn't stand out
column10: This is a densely packed, high calorie granola bar. I prefer a moister, crumbly bar where the fruit is more visible & contributes more to the flavor. Not as sweet as traditional bars & has more of a 'wheat' than oatmeal taste.

these granola bars my be good for some, but in my error i over looked a key word on the description.  pack of 12!  i figured, like the other granola bar orders i was viewing, that it was 12 packs bundle together and there would be 12 of them. looking at the picture of the box is what I did wrong in my understanding of the order.  the granola bars are not worth the $2+ price!  they are very difficult to chew and we had to warm them up just to eat them and even then were not the best granola bar we have tried.  i will not order these again.

column9: Gotta love 21st Century technology -- and this GREAT tasting milk
column10: 1% fat.  Low sugar.  REAL sugar instead of corn syrup.  Real cocoa instead of chocolate flavor.  Perfect lunchbox, purse, and briefcase size.and did I mention, Great Flavor!Yes, I love chocolate milk.  And I won't be guilted out of it by the diet police.  This is better than any of the over-sweetened whole milk varieties available at the grocery store, AND it is organic and from cows who have not been slathered with growth hormones and anti-biotics.2 of these for breakfast give me all the calcium I need to help avoid the growing-shorter-grandma syndrom that runs in my family -- plus I'm being treated to something wonderful!

Organic Valley is known as one of the more reputable organic milk companies. I was very happy to find the product here on Amazon as it is very hit or miss finding this in my local grocery stores. The price is also cheaper here than in my local store. There servings are a great size, just right for a children's snack. The chocolate is my favorite as well as one of my little ones. I love that when I need a "chocolate fix" I can grab one of these and not feel guilty. The taste and quality are great. The shelf life is around 4 months in the ones I have received. I love that I can get them delivered regularly through the subscribe and save program. We purchase all 4 flavors and my kids drink them all. The box of 12 does not take up a lot of shelf space, which is really good. While they taste best when cold, they can remain in the pantry, on the shelf, etc. with no problem. Its nice that I can have a healthy drink for my kids when we are on the go (although they should not be kept in the hot sun).Just a really great product that is relatively healthy, taste very good, has good sturdy packaging, and the company is repuatable and honest with their labeling (something that isn't true for many "organic" companies).

Chocolate milk is one of my special treats that I don't usually buy very often.  I saw these on an Amazon special and decided to pick them up partly because I love chocolate milk and partly because my friend's parents own a dairy farm that is part of the Organic Valley co-op.  I like knowing that my purchase is helping the family owned farms in our country--and specifically that I know one of those families.The milk is awesome!  It is sweet, but not overly sweet.  I've also tried Horizon, which I find to be a little too sweet compared to OV.  The expiration date was 3-4 months in the future on the box I received, so it was fresh.  I now have it on Subscribe & Save along with the plain 1% milk from OV.  They are nice to have when I need a quick pick-me-up and I'm also pregnant and in need of plenty of calcium, so these work great.

The chocolate drink has great flavor and not too sweet.  The best part is no refrigiration needed, especially for little kids' lunch drink during summer or winter!  Once in awhile, it's ok to drink these lowfat chocolate milk, but the sugar content per box is 6 tsp of sugar - OUCH!  The least sugar is the lowfat milk of all the 4 flavors, has 3 tsp sugar!  Fast delivery, too!  I would still recommend these drinks as lunch drink at school (alternate with milk), better than the cafeteria ones :)  5 star for fast service & good price, 3 star for sugar content.

The quality of the product is great and exactly as described.However, the two boxes I received were previously opened before they were shipped and were both haphazardly repackaged with packing tape. The boxes were also stamped to expire a few months after receiving it and while the product is ultra-pasteurization and the quality should be okay post-expiration date, I would be very careful when ordering from this Vendor/Company.

Although it is called "chocolate" milk, it really only has barely a trace of chocolate flavor, IMHO. It was a little less expensive than Horizon Organic milk that I normally buy, so I decided to give it a go. Won't buy it again, ever.
I buy this milk for my son's lunches. He likes the milk very much.  Other milk that is with hormones gets us with upset stomach and bloating. I like to have a deal when purchasing organic milk.
I love this milk... but see if your local whole foods carries it.  I just bought this same 12 pack for $5.99.

Bought these for my kid sister who lives far away (really, who needs more toys, so I went with a healthy treat instead). Awesome that Amazon can send her a treat from big sis on a regular basis and not charge me shipping!She loved them! Drinks them for school lunch and snacks and at home. I asked her if she wanted more and got a great big smile. She says they taste good and that I'd like them too, very tempted to order some for myself!

We've been drinking this and the strawberry milk from Organic Valley.  We love it.  Nice flavor, the price is right, no artificial colors, and it's nice to have this option since organic groceries are sometimes hard to find.  No added DHA like other organic milks are doing.  (DHA uses questionable chemical solvents in its processing.)
My son LOVES this milk! Perfect for him to take to school. Organic, low fat, low sugar........

My daughter has the regular plain milk from Organic Valley on weekdays. This is the weekend treat for her. We always carry a couple of cartons when we go out. So when mommy and daddy get Starbucks coffee, she gets this milk.
I put these I my daughter's lunch. Great chocolatly but not too sweet flavor. I love the packaging too since I can get them in the mail and I don't have to keep them cold.

column9: The Perfect Post Workout Recovery Drink.
column10: Stationed in Afghanistan, I bought this as a recovery drink to have after workouts when I got tired of other recovery drinks. Just to mix it up a little. The shipping is fast, often getting to me in a matter of days. Being 8oz makes for a perfect portion. 24g carbs, 9g protein, make for a perfect ration after a good lift or run. The taste is amazing. I've ordered several times and will continue to do so.
I still don't understand how this doesn't need refrigeration, but my kids love it.  I will probably continue to get this regularly

column9: Great Milk.  Tastes Good and is Healthy!
column10: Everyone in the house likes this milk.  From a 6 year old all the way up to adults.  My picky husband who doesn't like healthy stuff even likes and wants to drink all the time!

Kids love chocolate milk!  This is the same brand of milk we buy Organic milk. I stumbled across this by accident in Amazon and glad to find it. They have multiple flavor too. My family did not like Horizon before and this one looks good.
Great milk, my 4 year old loves it.  We used to drink the kirkland brand but can't get that where we live now.
I use these after my workouts. Tastes great and you cannot beat the ability to just throw a milk into your bag for the day.
my son loves taking this choclate milk to school lunches. way better than the hormones and antibiotics in the school milk. he wants me to buy this often

I store these in the cupboard and if I run out of milk I have regular and chocolate handy. Also I can grab a few milks and some granola bars when I leave to pick up kids at school. Better than buying bottled water or milk at the store. These milks taste delicious. I can even enjoy the white milk at room tempurature-right out of the cupboard.
I enjoyed the convienence of the packaging and the product itself rather tasty. However the price just seemed a little too steep to warrant it being a regular product for me.

I am a big fan of chocolate milk.  I personally feel that Schepp's available in Dallas is the best tasting out there.  I have been on a several year quest to find something that is healthier, low fat, and available to buy in multiple cartons.  I came across Organic Valley first at Whole Foods and was amazed at its great taste.  In my opinion, this is as good as it gets. column9: Great chocolate flavor in convenient packaging
column10: I'm a frequent purchaser of milk in asceptic packages.  I find the packaging to be incredibly convenient for our family of two, to avoid waste due to spoilage. Previously, I'd purchased Horizon's brand of chocolate milk in aseptic cartons and was reasonably satisfied with it.  However, Amazon stopped carrying it, which forced me to try a different brand.  The difference with Organic Valley's milk is like night and day.  The chocolate flavoring is incredible compared to Horizon's.  It is dark and rich with a light sweetness.  It's not as sweet as melted ice cream, for example, but it's on par with hot cocoa mix, I think.Furthermore, I did some research this time that I hadn't done before.  Organic Valley is a co-op of farmers.  To join the co-op, farmers have to meet OV's practices, which include several anti-cruelty measures as well as ensuring that the cows have pasture access (granted, the farms in wintry regions may only have pastures open for 4-6 months of the year) and plenty of room for each cow to move.  Yes, I know that things can be faked and loopholes can be found...but given what's available and out there in this product space, Organic Valley seems like a better choice than some other brands for consumers concerned with animal welfare.

I googled Organic Valley to find out how to let them know the lot number of some spoiled aseptic chocolate milk.  I was planning to return the milk to the local grocery where I bought it, but since I've always thought Organic Valley was an ethical cooperative, I figured they would want to know about the spoiled milk.To my horror, I happened upon a recent article (April 2011) describing how Organic Valley is allowing giant factory farms that abuse their animals to sell milk and eggs via the Organic Valley label. I am so disgusted. Here I've been paying a premium for organic milk, eggs, and cheese (carefully avoiding Horizon since they are notorious for factory farms), and now I find out that Organic Valley has been lying to us about all the "family farms" in their cooperative.The board of directors of Organic Valley should be ashamed of themselves.  Honestly, the only thing that has kept me from going vegan was thinking it's OK to buy organic. Guess what--it's not OK to buy organic dairy products. Animals are still being abused.Organic Valley is evil.

column9: It works for me and that is all I care about
column10: I read some of the reviews on here and I almost didn't purchase.  But I reached a point where due to my erratic work schedule, trying to fit in my studying time and completing assignments, my sleep pattern was disrupted and it was affecting my mood and concentration.  So I bit the bullet and purchased this at a local B&M store.  When I got home after work, I boiled some water and opened the package.  I noticed that this tea was packaged in a plastic bag so I guess it did has a pungent smell.  I opened the plastic bag and took a big whiff.  I was kind of disappointed.  It doesn't smell as bad as some of the other reviewers made it out to me but then again my nose has been wonky for some time so it could be me.  Yes I will admit that it does has a funky odor but it is not that strong to me.  To me, smells like this health food store I used to frequent in the Hyde Park neighborhood.  Very musky but weirdly comforting.  I have tried it with peppermint, turmeric (for a different affliction) and I have tried it plain with stevia and it taste okay to me.  I wouldn't say I have an iron stomach because I can easily get sick if food is left out in the open not at the proper temperature.  For me, this product took about two days for it to kick in and I am now able to sleep for a full eight hours straight instead of sleeping in fits of four hours here, wake up for about two hours, sleep for three, wake up for a hour and sleep for another four hours.  For those with sensitive noses and sense of taste, you have been amply warned by other reviewers.  For others, I say give it a shot or at least pair it with some other teas to dilute the taste a bit.  There are some great suggestions mentioned by other reviewers, like mint for example.
this is a great product,it helps to relieve my bloating.I will order it again.Thank you.its better then anything else i have tryed
It was exactly what I ordered. This product was hard to find and they had it! I will order from them again!

This deal was a rip off. The tea tasted nothing like it was supposed to. The item was over-priced. Add the shipping cost, and all together it comes to a huge disappointment. Don't but this tea if you have had real Lychee-black tea, cause this ain't it... sorry
Excellent intense flavor, a cut above other lychee teas (such as Foojoy) that I've drank over the years.
This tea doesn't really taste like lychee.  It's kind of fruity but not great.  If you're looking for real lychee flavor, good luck -- I have yet to find it...and it is certainly not this one.
I love Lychee tea and have found it difficult to find whole-leaf tea that is of high quality. The China Mist brand that I purchased through Amazon has consistently lived up to my expectations.

column9: Hard to find... depending on where you live
column10: I have learned that Delaware Punch is sold at most Central Markets in Texas[call and check but Houston and San Antonio have it] for 6.99 for the 12 pack of cans. The manager said there were no plans to discontinue carrying it. The Delaware grape is the reason for the name...not the state of Delaware. Like Fritos and Pace Picante Salsa, it was first made in San Antonio ... this beverage in 1913. I remember it as both tart and sweet with a mostly "grapey" taste. I wonder if the current product tastes the same. Google it for more info.

I recieved my first care package from my mother the other day and in it were these Emerald Chocolate Cherry flavored trail mix, packets. Such a surprise! And a delicious one at that. I was so happy, I almost demolished the box that night. I love the dark chocolate covered almonds especially. Multiple health benifits there...and the other ingredients just enhanced and complimented each other and well, all in all, made my day. Since then, I've tried other trail mixes, but...none even come close.

I cant find this stuff in any of my local stores anymore. They used to sell it in kroger but stopped about 8 months ago. Here on amazon it is cheaper per bag and as fresh as ever. I take a bag of this with me when i go out riding my motorcycle or kayaking or rock climbing and it gives me the energy i need to stay strong all afternoon. I defenitely prefer the dried cranberries over the raisins in most trail mixes and the cocoa roasted almonds blow plain ones away. Theres no going back to generic trail mix after this.

Quality ingredients!A little pricey, but isn't everything now? (and they say there is no inflation)I've had other Emerald trail mixes, as well as Diamond nuts (the holding co.) and the quality and taste has always been superior.
This Trail Mix is the best quality I have ever had. The Emerald Chocolate Cherry is GREAT !

column9: Emerald Chocolate Cherry Flavored Trail mix is the best!
column10: This is the most delicious Trail Mix ever. It satisfies both the sweet and the salty in your taste buds. The amazing mix of the cherry flavored cranberries mixes deliciously with the chocolate pieces to actually make you think you are eating chocolate covered cherries! I had originally tasted this at the Emerald Bowl on Dec. 26th when they were handing out free samples and I couldn't find it at the grocery store. I finally wrote to the company and they told me that certain Walmart's were selling it. I located bigger bags right here on Amazon! It was a much better value!

column9: Good bye Red Bull & FRS, Hello Orbana
column10: I'm not an avid consumer of energy drinks; I occasionally drink Red Bull or, more recently, FRS to get me through tired spells at work and into the gym.  Those helped, but you felt a noticeable loss of energy and attention after the effects wore off.  I don't know the science behind Orbana - I understand it is the most healthy, natural of its kind on the market (although I never really believe those claims) - but what i can attest to is a heightened energy level over a sustained period.  You don't notice the come down; rather, there is no come down. And you don't become dependent on it.In short, it works. And for me at least, its better than Red Bull, Lucozade, Gatorade or FRS. 2 thumbs up!

I have really enjoyed using Orbana this year as I prepare for marathon season. I have done 9 marathons over the past 5 years and experimented with a number of supplement drinks for pre-race and while running. Some taste great but really don't do much good. Others taste horrendous:so bad that if there was any improvement in performance, it was hard to tell. Orbana hits the spot as it is proven, tastes great and gentle on the internal engine! Give it a shot. You won't be disappointed.

column9: Orbana helped me qualify for Boston!!!
column10: I just ran my fourth marathon.  I had never fueled during any of my races or training except for water.  I tried Orbana for this last marathon during some of my training runs and for the marathon.  I actually PR'd by 16 minutes, and qualified for Boston with 12 minutes to spare!!!  The recovery was also incredible - I was actually functional after the race.  I highly recommend this product for any athletes looking to PR.  I will never run another race without fueling with Orbana!

I have used Orbana for two different long distance running races (a 10 mile and a half marathon, both PRs) and several long runs (all at least 10 miles) and it is the only energy drink I have tried that delivers on its claims.  When I take Orbana, I have sustained energy through my run, which can be crucial for those difficult stretches.  I would highly recommend Orbana for any endurance athlete, especially for races.

Overall:I would recommend this product to be used as a supplement for athletes to occasionally help boast their performance.  I do not think it would be a good idea to become overly dependent on this or any product so obviously use at your own risk.  All in all I think that Orbana delivers on what it advertises, especially as a pre and during workout supplement. I would say that you could find better supplements for post workout.  I will have to test it's effectiveness during an ultra event to see if it still has a similar effect at 2:00am at mile 72 of a 100 mile trail race.  I'll let you know how that goes.Full Review:[...]Video Review: [...]

column9: Orbana is Great! Love this product!
column10: Orbana is awesome! At first I was expecting a jolt, like the kick you get from coffee or other energy boosters, but this came on slow and soon I was hoping around the office crossing things of my to-do list and smiling at the same time. I feel good about drinking it and it helps it all sorts of ways. It's like taking my daily vitamins. If I didn't have time for breakfast, it gives me enough energy to make it to lunch. If I go running, I am sure to have one as I feel I am hydrated and can confidently push myself up the hill. I feel healthy, and that's enough for me to order again. Thanks Orbana!Britt Ventriglia

column9: More energy, even for those who don't need it
column10: I may not be a marathon runner like all these other reviewers *allegedly* are, but I like to have a little extra energy myself from time to time. Maybe I'm taking out an extra heavy load of beer bottles to the recycle bin, or maybe I just don't want to fall asleep in the middle of a good movie or baseball game. In either case, I have found this product to be very effective. When my friends comment that I look less lethargic, or am a less sluggish video game opponent than usual, I just smile and quietly thank Orbana.

While I'm not a triathlete (yet!), I found Orbana very helpful while running around Lady Bird Lake in Austin in 90F+ weather.  It kept me hydrated and energized.  The powder form was super convenient too.  I was able to carry it with me and mix it with the water available on the trail when I needed it.

I am a lifetime runner, completed 27 marathons including a couple Boston's, Chicago's & ultra's in the mix. I'm always looking for something that willhelp me with those tedious long runs. A friend tuned me into Orbana & I've been pleasantly surprised with the results. It's kept me hydrated, I'm able to maintaina nice pace, & I've found I have a little extra left in my tank @ the end of my runs too. I never write reviews, but I think this is a good product. It's goodfor the endurance of my sport, & it's worth a shot.
I was given a packet by a friend at the gym. We both took it and I really enjoyed the energy boost. I will be buying more!

This is a new product here in the States and I must say I'm amazed.  Not just pleasantly surprised but actually amazed. I'm a professional cyclist and have tried nearly every hydration / nutrition product out there for cycling and bike racing.  From rides ranging from 1hr - 5hr Orbana has left me feeling the freshest and most "bonk-free" I can remember. I find I can sustain a higher threshold, for longer and recover faster after an effort. Nice job Orbana - thanks for sharing the secret- I'm onboard!"

column9: Orbana gives you the lift you need to get out the door!
column10: I have always looked to running as a special treat to selfishly do something that is just for me. My choice distance is the Marathon. Last year I ran Eugene and had a great race with a Boston Qualifying time of 3:27. My friend was visiting from London around the same time and gave me a sachet of Orbana to try. It was a cold and rainy morning and I didn't feel like running, but I mixed my Orbana into water and drank it down. As I got dressed I started to smile with anticipation of my run. Orbana gave me the lift I needed to get out the door. Even though it was pouring rain I couldn't be more excited to be outside running. I flew through my run-I was hooked. I spent the next 6 months training for the Long Beach Marathon and used Orbana exclusively this time. I drink it 20 minutes before I run and again about 2 hours into my run. All I need to carry is water-I don't need to mess with all the ooey, gooey stuff that leaves me feeling ill. Last fall finished Long Beach ten minutes faster than Eugene with my PR of 3:17. Boston 2012 here I come! Thank You Orbana!

All my purchases of your products have been very satisfactory. The last couple of deliveries via UPS  have been very UNsatisfactory. I have complained to UPS a number of times but to no avail.How can Amazon correct this in order to keep me as a customer? Thank you.
This flavor works great for home made ice cream and Gelato. Will be trying some of the additional flavors from this company
This was probably the best tasting Folgers I've ever had. The individual packets ensure great tasting, fresh coffee, cup after cup.

I was looking for something healthy to snack on at night.  A lot of the mixed nut/fruit products out there are full of sugar, fat and other things that are not good for you.  This product is all natural and quite tasty.  To compare, the equivalent Kirkland brand all natural mix is 150 calories for 3 tablespoons.  The Terrafina product is 140 calories for a 1/4 cup.The only reason I didn't give it 5 stars is sometimes their fruit is a little sweet because they do add a bit of sugar for their fruit.  That's probably more of a personal taste than anything.  Otherwise great product.

column9: Nuts were bland, not very tasty.
column10: This product was advertised as natural, so I wasn't expecting as good of taste as a product that the nuts had been roasted, salted, etc.  However, the raw texture and blandness of the nuts left a foreign after-taste.  The raisins and cranberries were flavorful, having a little sweetness added.  I definitely prefer a not so "natural" product to this one.

column9: Awesome! Perfect for a low carb diet!
column10: What a great deal! This is so much healthier than soda and it seems like you are drinking soda because of the sparkling water. Great for a low carb diet or those just trying to avoid sugar sweetened drinks or artificial flavorings. I wouldn't recommend it for a child though because my son said it was too spicy because of the carbonation. I love it though.

column9: peach flavor very nice;  quenches your thirst;  "as in life, chill for best results"
column10: If you use sparkling water, this peach-nectarine Talking Rain Sparkling Water would be a nice choice for you.If you are just plain thirsty, in my experience this product quenches your thirst quickly.To me, the peach taste and aroma are  quite good.Ingredients are:  carbonated water, essences from natural fruit oils and extracts."All natural, no calories, no sweeteners, sodium free"A case of 4 groups of 6 cans each, with  plastic loops for every  6 cans,  arrived in fine condition with lots of padding in a large cardboard box.No dents, no loose cans, no spills. Delivery was quick.Some of the reviews remind me of my first experience with sparkling water years ago when I discovered that plain sparkling water has no flavor.I am  grateful for the peach-nectarine flavor in this, and like the motto on each can :  "As in life, chill for best results."  In addition,  for the record, I drink this slowly since it's carbonated, always a  varied adventure with carbonation

column9: Inconsistent quality from can to can
column10: This is the first time I can ever remember such a difference in a beveridge's taste from one can to the next of the exact same product.  My first couple of cans were very appealing, with just a subtle hint of flavor mixed in with the sparkling water.  Then out of the same case, I suddenly find a can of Talking Rain with an intensely awful taste, as if some absent-minded employee had left the flavor spigot on too long resulting in a very nasty, strong taste that was far removed from the delicately flavored water I had first sampled.  Doesn't this company have testers to assure uniform quality throughout?  Apparently not, which is very sad.

column9: Finally! Refreshing, tasty and free of sweeteners!
column10: I tried Talking Rain Sparkling water with fruit essences in Washington State a couple of times. I think it IS wonderfully refreshing and delicious.  There are no distributors outside of WA that I can find, so I am so happy to see Amazon starting to carry it. THANK YOU!

column9: Please keep this flavor in stocK!
column10: Peach nectarine is my favorite flavor, and this is my favorite daily beverage. Zero calories, zero carbs, GREAT flavor! My only complaint is that it is often out of stock, so I am forced to wait... wait... wait... and then finally order four or five cases at a time just to make sure that i don't run out. Please, Amazon... do a better job of keeping this flavor in stock.

This drink really tastes bad. Simple as that.  I buy their Lemon Lime and it's great, but the Peach Nectarine tastes like they just got the formula wrong.  After trying a few to see if it was just a bad can or two, I finally threw the remainder in the trash.
Love this product, please keep in stock and part of the Prime membership!Wanted something with a bit of natural flavor and no other preservatives added, and no sugar or artificial sugar.

Two problems:1) Cans are extremely thin, so six of the cans were either completely empty from rupture or just about to rupture, so had to carefully open and empty.2) Hate to admit it, but this product really tasted like the "seltzer"-type cold remedies, but worse, because the lemon flavor of the seltzer "medicine" actually tasted better! I really wanted to like this, especially since I've had such good results with other brands of similar products, but it's definitely a no-go.However, Amazon very kindly refunded me the cost of the entire shipment, even though I didn't hold them responsible for the lousy handling/shipping which was out of their hands, and I thank Amazon for their consideration. I've had great results in shopping with Amazon, and will continue doing so since this is the only way I can browse, compare, and shop (am bed-bound, but prefer doing my own shopping). Thanks.

column9: Good, but not as good as lime flavored version
column10: This is a decent all natural product if you really like peach flavored water. I find that peach will make the sparkling water feel less refreshing. If you're simply looking for a sparkling water with fruit flavor, then you should definitely choose Talking Rain lime soda (which is absolutely superb).

column9: Peach Nectarine: Taste Like Alka Seltzer
column10: I bought this item with such great expectations but I am disappointed in the taste.  Yes, it is true that it smells great, just like peaches, and it has no calories but when you taste this beverage, it reminds me of alka seltzer (yes, the pop-pop fizz fizz medicine).  I don't recommend this product.  However, if you can get past the bitter taste you may like it, buy with caution.  You may want to buy only one case, (24) cans, for about $12.00 on subscribe and save to make sure you like it.  I have tasted the Talking Rain kiwi strawberry which is five calories a can but it tastes great; the calories are probably because of the juice and splenda added but I don't mind the five calories per can to have a great tasting beverage!
this product has a terrible.  the taste is awful. You only get a hint of the flavor peach.  i like it has zero sugars ,fat carbs, but does it have to taste so bad.
I opened one can and it was nasty.  I don't have the courage to open another can. I will be pouring this stuff down the drain.

I like this water, but I agree with the person who said the flavor varies from one can to the next. Sometimes it's more peach, sometimes more nectarine, sometimes heavier and kind of perfumey. I think that's the peach. I don't know how else to describe it; it reminds me of perfume. But the price is great and, like I said, I like it. I buy a lot of unsweetened flavored waters from Amazon, and this one tastes good to me. My shipment wasn't very well packed--just the four six-packs and some paper in a box that was a little too big. Two of the six-packs came undone in transit, and the cans were loose in the box. I'm torn about saying this, because sometimes the packaging seems excessive. I get annoyed with heavy shrink-wrapping and boxes inside of boxes, too, but the loose cans were a pain.

A subtle peach flavor with 0 calories and no artifical sweeteners? Yes, please!The fruit essences make it slightly sweet with an underlying bitterness, all without overwhelming the palate. Not for those looking to satisfy a sweet tooth - the taste is subtle. Heavily carbonated and lightly flavored makes this drink very refreshing at work or home.No shipping issues with 12+ cases of various TalkingRain flavors, mostly this one.Serve cold, drink often. Amazon, keep this in stock!

column9: Love this stuff, but the shipping packing, not so much
column10: I became a fan of Talking Rain while visiting my son in the Pacific Northwest.  Sadly, it's not available in my home state, and I was glad to find this available on Amazon.  The only reason it doesn't get 5 stars is the rather shoddy packing when shipped, the case of 4 six packs is placed in a larger box, with two sheets of crumpled kraft paper.  With the handling during transit, the cans come loose from the plastic rings and on occasion are damaged (punctured).  I received one shipment where the case was shrinkwrapped, and the cans stayed neatly in place and arrived in good condition.

column9: ONLY WAY TO GET THIS FLAVOR
column10: I used to live in the Northwest and moved to the southeast. I used to get Talking Rain at Costco. It is not available here at all.Once again Amazon pulls through for me. There are other brands of sparkling water that come through with other flavors but notthe peach nectarine. Every once and awhile I get the craving for it and order it and have that ahhh moment.

column9: Wonderfully Refreshing, Calorie and Fake Sugar Free and Cheaper Than the Plastic Version
column10: I love talking rain water. I get cravings for carbonated beverages, so it is wonderful to drink these - which are calorie free and free of artificial sugars (ick!) These are way cheaper than the plastic bottled version. With mineral water you need to drink it right away or it goes flat, so I don't mind it being in a can. I love this flavor, it is subtle and tasty. When you open the can there is a wiff of peach nectarine which is delightful. I highly recommend this drink!

column9: Bitter Peach Alka-Seltzer in a can.
column10: I wish I could rate this product zero stars.If you like an overly carbonated, bitter, seltzer drink with the essential oils of the nectarine peel, and a hint of peach, then this is exactly what your looking for.Definitely not a refreshing beverage!It is however, a decent remedy for an upset stomach or heartburn.

column9: The Only Honey Mustard for Me!
column10: I absolutely love this honey mustard... I started using it when I lived in Tennessee and now that I am back in California it isn't sold here... I buy it on Amazon and will continue to do so... O'Charleys honey mustard is the BEST!!!
I love agave, and I love the price I get it for on Amazon.  I also like the convenience of it automatically being mailed to me
Love this product!! Glad to find it in a smaller bottle. Love agave, would never go back to white sugar!! Product arrived promptly, great service.

column9: The stuff received exceeds the time limit of use,how do I should do?
column10: my purchased item use by 1 Jul,2012,but there have no clue to figure out this.Now I received the stuff,but it exceeds the time limit of use. Anybody can tell me how to do?

This coffee plugged up my pot and didn't have near the flavor I am used to getting from a flavored coffee.  I did use it all but ended up mixing it with another flavor in order to spice it up a bit.  I wouldn't buy this one again. I drink flavored coffee everyday.
The recipient of this gift of cookies was happy to report they were delicious, beautiful, and quickly eaten.  So I'm a very satisfied shopper, even though I didn't get to taste one for myself.

You have absolutely gotta try these. The flavors don't sound good together but I"m telling you they just sing. They are not hard but the crunch sound is really intense. A sure hit at the office. Pass them around and become a hit.
The garlic is my favorite flavor out of all of them. I usually get mine at the local oriental store.

Cracker Nuts are just Wonderful! I live on Guam right now, & these are produced in the Philippines. I'm moving back stateside soon & have been trying to figure out what I should bring back with me that I know won't be sold in the states. I'm so glad to see that Amazon has cracker nuts, because they are wonderful! The outside is like the texture of a cracker and there is a peanut inside. It sounds weird, but they are amazing! :)
We had an independent contractor bring these to us at work and we fought over them. They are addicting and probably the best snack ever! I even went so far as to add this to my wish list!

column9: Nagaraya is the best crackers nuts
column10: I had these during my childhood, yet they are very addicting until you try the Garlic Flavored ones.First time I tried was the Original flavor which has a subtle flavor of Butter. It is not like you tasted movei theatre butter popcorn which is similar to Orville Redenbacher's butter flavoring.Then a few years, I tried the Adobo and the Garlic flavors. The garlic flavor is one of the best flavors of these addicting cracker nuts. The shells is not too hard to crack with your teeth, and the crunchiness is intense too.  The cracker shell has garlic powder coated, and it somehow little sweet.  You can also feel the peanut once you crack open the cracker shell while eating it.Although it is hard to find these at the Midwest or East Coast. It is usually popular in any oriental grocery store. If you want to huge amount of Nagaraya cracker nuts, you can buy them at Amazon. Then you need to include shipping and handling. Delivery is prompt and fast when Amazon delivers with its affiliates.I wish they produced a bigger bag and portions of the cracker nuts. Keep them in stock while you can.

I've been getting these from an ethnic grocery for years now (I've never seen them anywhere else until now) and they are FANTASTIC! You normally would not put a candy coated peanut together with a salty garlic flavor, but it really, truly works. They taste amazing and become very addicting. I've never really encountered anything similar to compare them with. Do yourself a favor and give them a try, it's worth it!

column9: How to eat these tasty snaks
column10: A friend had some of these snacks and I tried one. Then two. I was eating them by the handfulls! I could not get enough!I purchased my own, and soon found that my breath was too overwhelming for anyone to be near me! The way I get around this, is to make sure I offer some to everyone in the room, and make sure everyone eats at least one. Then, nobody notices me, and I can eat them all I want!. Works even at the workplace! When there is someone near me that I don't particularly want to speak to, I just pop a few into my mouth and talk up a storm. Works every time!
It's impossible to find whole nutmeg in stores anymore, so I was glad to find it here at a good price.  Freshly grated nutmeg is far superior to the ground nutmeg.

Had a hard time finding whole nutmeg for seasoning white sauces(Grandam's recipe) and sweet potatoe recipes...the fresh ground nutmeg has a totally different flavor than the preground you can find on the grocer shelf..when I searched for it on- line, I found it @ Amazon...very inexpensive and it was here in just a couple of days...thanks and I will use Amazon again.

column9: One of my basic staple for baking AND cooking
column10: When I first got this, I surprised how many were in the package.  I love how it's fresh and the way it smells.  As matter as fact, I got rid of the powdered nutmeg in a jar.  I use the fresh nutmeg all the time now not just for baking but for cooking too.  I will be  buying more for the holidays to use them as gifts for baskets.  It's a bargain.  Why didn't I even buy them in the past!

This is my favorite flavor of tea. It has a smooth mint flavor.I had been purchasing Stash Moroccan Mint tea in local stores up until recently. I have not been able to find it anymore. I was so pleased to find I could purchase it online and buying the loose tea in bulk is cheaper than buying individual bags.

Stash English loose tea is our breakfast favorite.  At a teabar we learned about tea washing as a first step for Oolong teas ... and once we applied this as a first step to brewing a pot of Stash English Breakfast tea ... our morning tea has been smooth and rich.  So try a quick splash of hot water over the tea filter and immediately pour that water out, next fill the pot and brew for 3:30-4:00 minutes, remove the filter from the pot, and enjoy a cup of great tea.

I try to drink several cups of green tea every day, and I like a little variety in flavor. The Jasmine Blossom flavor is subtle and light. I used to be able to find this in stores, but I can't find any local stores that carry it now. This is really good tea, and buying in bulk makes it less expensive than purchasing the individual bags.

The tea tastes average and smells great... but I don't like the heavy flavor of the black tea.  The black tea overwhelms the jasmine.  This is a good breakfast tea alternative... will keep you awake for hours if you tend to drink your tea in the morning.

I'm a big fan of both green and mint teas, so moroccan mint (a blend of mint and green) is a natural favorite of mine.I've tried moroccan mint from other places, and have not been impressed. The moroccan mint from teavana was just plain gross. This though, I can say is the best tea I've ever had.A great price too. Something like a dollar per ounce. Tea stores usually charge $8 for every 2 ounces.I steeped a spoonful with about 12oz in an IngenuiTEA. Very pleased. ;)

Guess what. Stash really means it when they call this "the espresso of teas"! "Robust" in their description is code for "This sucker will rouse you after a night of throwing back pints of ale and carousing at the local pub." It is a dark, rich, and strong brew, but to say it has only one note is plain wrong. I am sitting here drinking a cup as I write (I buy mine on Amazon in the 3.5 oz pouches, so I might not show as a verified purchaser.), and I taste a range of flavors in the lower register. There are toasty warm notes, licorice, tars, and, yes, bitter notes, as befits its dark nature. If a light-hearted tea is more to your palate, you must look elsewhere, but if you are seeking a strong, rich, flavorful, cup of tea, with a bit of an edge, this is it.
I love this tea.  It has great flavor.  It really beats all the tea bags I've been using.  Add some fruit while brewing for extra flavor.

column9: If you like the flavor of plastic...
column10: Just finished drinking some of this and the flavor of the thick industrial plastic bag is still in my mouth.  Very strong taste of chemicals and quite possibly the worst tea I have ever drunk.  I drink the Stash English Breakfast tea bags on a daily basis and enjoy those quite a lot so I had very high hopes for this product and was thoroughly disappointed.

column9: Be wary of these ingredients for your pet
column10: I have studied canine nutrition for the last 5 years and one of the biggest negatives I see in many commercial dog food companies is putting profit over care.In looking at ingredients in treats and food, many companies are fabulous. However, sadly, some put the cheapest ingredients that often even cause negative reactions in dogs into their products and then add flavors to make the dog want them so they continue to be bought.Ah, but don't take my word for it.First ingredient in these? Rice Flour. Not meat. Not whole wheat flour. Not brown rice flour. Rice flour...bad carb, no protein, breaks down into sugar. But it gets better. Second main ingredient? SUGAR.Let me repeat that. This contains mostly sugar.Yes they are shaped like bones and you feel like you are getting some good protein in and that they aren't like giving your pet hard candy. Naw. That's marketing. They only contain 7% protein and the protein source is derived from "dried meat by product".  In other words, meat waste.But lets go back to sugar. You could give your dog a tablespoon of sugar each day and they would crave that too. But you will also have to pay for extra tartar scrapings from your vet which are stressful to your canine companion or have a pet lose their teeth in their later years.But I'm just getting started. 3rd ingredient? Wheat flour. Not whole wheat flour...processed and stripped of it's nutriotional value. Cheaper.So you think the fourth ingredient must be some protein huh? Naw, it's Propylene Glycol.Then powdered celluloseThen sodium caseinatebut we dont want our dogs to thumb their paws up at such ingredients so natural poultry FLAVOR is then added. This is what some dog companies do, besides adding sugar, to make a product marketable...have it TASTE to the dog like it has something they need or want in it but it just be a flavoring. Then they beg for it and owners think it's great, buy more, and profit is good.BAD.Now then, let me sum this up with the warning under the feeding guide:"Up to (meaning no more than) 5 sticks every week"and "not suitable for puppies or dogs under 5 lbs." Yet the jumbone mini with a yorkie on the front has these ingredients and then says not to give it to small dogs! That is called a legal disclaimer should your dog develop issues from the feeding of this product. What more needs to be said?Yeah, you don't have those warnings about nutritional harm when you just feed your dog some good natural treats or meat.Animal crackers or saltwater taffy would offer your dog the same taste and ingredients for the most part as these and be cheaper.I take it back. The above two wouldn't have as many artificial flavors and preservatives.Don't buy into the hype "big meaty center"If by "meaty" they mean 'sugar and cellulse" then I agree...I so hate seeing profit over care for companion animals.Why did I give it 2 stars? If you have to go by will your dog like it? You bet! But they like chocolate too...doesn't mean they should eat it.I am not promoting any particular dog food or treat here...just giving my opinion (based on 5 years of study on the subject on my part) that you may wish to avoid sugar and cheap fillers for anything going into your pet. Animals are so little and dependant upon our choices for them. And, especially if you dont brush their teeth daily as most of us don't, giving them something filled with sugar and bad-carb flours is highly detrimental to thier livers, teeth, livers, kidneys, and full canine systems.Not to mention the artificial fillers and dried meat by products. Meat waste can have very bad things in it. It's not suitable for human consumption (these include the parts thrown away that may be diseased or tumerous. Yes, seriously, these ARE allowed to be used in dog food.)And don't even consider the vitamins added. When made into a processed dog food of this type, they get baked out at such high temperatures used in the processing. So consider that teeninsy bit added at the very end of the ingredient list null and void after processing.Buy em a real soup bone or give them carrots or NATURAL wet dog food or cottage cheese for a treat.Dogs don't do well on things like this and it can cost you more in their health than the savings on buying a less expensive brand.I love em (pets) too much not to review this honestly...

Using agar to set the jellies means that I can use a lot less sugar and get something like a fruit spread.This is a reliable product, just be careful not to get any water in the jar, measure out what you need, then seal it back up. If you're making a recipe you usually use gelatin with, use less agar, start with half the amount called for, then increase as necessary. Agar gels up very firmly if you're not working with high acidic fruits and it's pretty stable once it's gelled even at room temperature.Recipes for kanten call for agar frequently, and agar makes a good vegan substitute for gelatin, but it's not as nutritious as gelatin. It is a decent source of dietary fiber though.I still use gelatin for some recipes, and agar for others. Agar doesn't have the faint smell that gelatin has so for a lot of desserts, it is preferable. For a good dessert book that uses agar as an ingredient, I suggest Q&E Chilled Desserts from the Japanese Kitchen (Quick and Easy Series).

It works as well as agar in bar form and the price is good. I do however recommend you use half the recommended amount, so more like 1 tablespoon to 1 pint of liquid versus 2 tablespoons, but you might have to experiment and it will depend on the liquid. But 2 tablespoons I find will make it too stiff.

It's been described here as like "stout," or "Coffee" and even "strong enough for a mouse to trot upon.  I just describe it as kick your butt strong, and one heck of an astringent flavor.Amazon did so many things right when they offered this tea:  loose tea instead of bagged, which in my opinion, is the easiest way to prepare your tea and make it go from average to delicious.  It's a simple matter to take a teaspoon of tea and let it swim in the boiling water in your teapot. All the good stuff in the tea leaves comes out and you're drinking tea the way it has been drunk for thousands of years. If all you've ever had was tea in a tea bag, you're in for a treat.Back to to the tea:  I always found that Irish Breakfast was harsh and astringent, and not at all pleasant. I always drink my tea black, and never thought to drink tea any other way.  You can't do with with Irish Breakfast Tea.  When drunk black, it's very unpleasant.  However, when cream is added, the tea undergoes a metamorphosis.  Besides the obvious color change and dairy tastes, the tea itself seems to change.  The harshness I detected when I drank the tea straight had disappeared, replaced by a rich, deep tea taste with a strength that gets you out the door in the morning with a smile on your face.Okay, you say.  Then what the heck do you mean by the title to this review?  It's because Twining's is selling their loose tea in far too large a quantity.  Six tins could last a family a year, and that's much too long to have tea kicking around.  Black tea is meant to be drunk right away, not stored in a kitchen cabinet for months on end, perhaps being opened, and certainly being exposed to heat and air.  The tea tins they sell are great for preserving a small quantity for the time it takes to drink the tea.  But tea kept for many months becomes stale and flavorless.If you do purchase this package of tea, keep two tins for yourself and give the other four to friends, making sure that they know this tea is meant to be prepared with cream and sugar. column9: Here are the actual ingredients from the package...
column10: Ingredients: Spices, salt, onion, paprika, garlic, dextrose, vegetable oil (partially hydrogenated soybean oil to help protect flavor), corn syrup solids, silicon dioxide (anticaking agent).Dad was the plant engineer at Stegner food products in Cincinnati, on a private drive they named "Chili Hill" so I think I can translate here. First and foremost you're buying their proprietary blend of spices, which they don't have to list individually, then salt (some really good spice blends I've tried advertise being salt free which makes them a better value, but this brand is a Cincinnati staple and including the salt is normal). Onion makes it unnecessary to chop one, paprika is a given in Cincinnati chili, I assume garlic also. Some Cincinnati chili recipes include chocolate by the way.Anyway after that dextrose is referred to as "grape sugar" on wikipedia, and the soybean oil has to be hydrogenated to be incorporated into a powdered mix. One packet will serve a family for dinner and contains:32g TOTAL grams of Carbs per packet, 8 grams of which is fiber and 8 grams of which is sugar.4 TOTAL grams of fat, so no big deal on the hydrogenated oil unless you REALLY hate the stuff.8 TOTAL grams of protein.So a little bit of "grape sugar," naturally being a processed food a smidge of corn syrup sludge, and a tiny amount of silicon dioxide, which sounds a lot like some kind of sand-like molecule to me, not exactly appetizing but the last ingredient on the list and surely harmless.All you need to make the chili itself is 6oz of tomato paste and a pound of ground beef, and you don't even brown the ground beef, how easy is that? All in all considering how unhealthy the MSG and BPA in canned chilis and soups are, and the much higher price and limited availability of other Cincinnati Chili recipes, the convenience of this mix make it worth buying. As I understand it none of these ingredients can 'disguise' MSG (there are at least half a dozen ingredients that don't say MSG but can contain MSG).I made my first batch with two packets, 2lbs of beef, 2 cans of tomato paste, and a 1lb bag of pre-soaked Chana Dal beans, which have just about the lowest glycemic index of any carb source out there. It drew raves, but as much as like this mix for now if/when I get the time I'd like to look up recipes with chocolate in them, mix my own spices, chop an onion, mince the garlic, (stew a tomato? slaughter a cow?), and see how good the chili can get.

I'd have trouble even suggesting "Boldly-Mild."  I have to set my machine to the lowest of the 3 settings and it's still not a satisfying coffee.
