This is a great product, coffee is great and price is even better.  Delivery was prompt without any issues I would certainly order again.

As a lover of "bold" coffees who is trying to limit his caffeine intake somewhat, I tried this coffee.  I guess I'll never know why they still can't make a decaff that's as good as regular, but I guess that's the trade off.  Overall, Timothy's isn't bad, it's just no where near as bold as you might expect of a blend labeled "espresso."  It's more of a medium roast than dark but it's not horrible.

Timothy's Decaf Rainforest Espresso Extra-Bold and Emeril's K-cups, Jazzed Up Decaf show that great coffee can be made from decaf K-Cups.  Both are rich and full bodied with ample taste and aroma.  I'm not sure which I like better at this point but you can't go wrong with either if you drink decaf.  Actually, it would be difficult to to know you are drinking decaf unless you looked at the K-Cup.  Moreover, there is no buzz with this decaf, unlike some other decaf coffees which still have a lot of caffeine.

This is absolutely the worst coffee I've ever had! I was expecting a dark, full flavored, bold coffee - AN ESPRESSO! Instead what I got was the equivalent of a supermarket, off the shelf, canned coffee. You know the type, weak, no flavor, stale, so thin you can see through it. If you like supermarket, canned coffee then this is for you. If  you're looking for an Espresso, Stay Away! This isn't it.

column9: Not for those who like bold....
column10: If you are used to a dark roast with bold flavor, this sounds like it should do the trick -- but it doesn't.  Even on smaller cup settings, I think those who prefer bold/dark coffee will find this thin and lacking flavor.  Best for those who prefer a medium roast/ breakfast blend cup of coffee.

I was looking for a decaf coffee K-cup with good flavor and Timothy's has delivered.  I wouldn't classify it as extra-bold, nor particularly espresso flavored, but it's definitely got nice well rounded flavor.

column9: Nice bold, blend. People don't know it's decaf.
column10: I love coffee, but I gave up caffeine so I'm always on the hunt for a good robust blend. I think this is a great espresso- not bitter, rich and full bodied. The K-cup allows me to brew a 6 oz cup of some great coffee in our Keurig Platinum. This espresso is also wonderful iced, using the iced drink setting of 3.25 oz brewed directly over ice. At 3.25 oz, I'm almost getting a double shot out of 1 k-cup.Is this coffee as good as freshly ground, tamped down in my espresso maker? No, but this deliver system doesn't claim to be. It does deliver a bold espresso taste in a very convenient form. I've served cappuccino portions (4oz) after dinner and people were concerned with having caffeine after dinner, surprised when they were told it was decaf. Hubby brews this decaf along with a Mocha K cup (tastes mostly like chocolate) and enjoys his own version of a mocha.The 2 pack price is great and we are enjoying more coffee at home and less espresso drinks out, at the savings of $3-$4 per drink.
Good bold flavor with little acidity.  A very good decaf.  And...you can't beat the convenience of K-Cups.

This extra-bold decaf is one of the best tasting K-cup varieties, especially in the decaf space.  The price over time, however, is all over the place and buyers must be cautious.  More than a year ago, I began ordering this variety under Amazon's Subscribe and Save program at about $20 for a pack of two 24-count boxes.  Later, with no apparent rationale other than supply and demand, the price shot up to $38.  I immmediately started using other decaf K-cups.  During this time, I saw a listing that appeared identical to this Timothy's variety that I had been ordering at about $20, only to learn when it was delivered that it only included only ONE 24-count box and not two as before.  Effectively a 100% price increase!!  Nice try, but I quickly sent it back as misleading and not as described. Recently, the price came down again to about $23 for two boxes, although no longer available under Subscribe and Save.  Still, it is a great product so I placed orders over the past couple of months.  Now, after a couple of months, at the end of April 2011, the price has again risen to $38.  Is this a "bait-and-switch" tactic by Amazon or its supplier thinking that buyers won't notice the price increase?  The coffee deserves 4 to 5 stars but the misleading pricing brings my rating down to 2 stars.

This stuff is horrid. It says it is Extra-Bold, but it is more like dishwater. It is so thin you can see through it and the flavor is lousy.  (Espresso is not only a strength, it is supposed to be a flavor. Not here!)  To be clear, I LOVE my Keurig machine. I use it happily with Newman's Own, Sumatra, and regular French Roast. So, while I do like strong coffee, I am normally happy with what is sold for this machine.  But now I am stuck with all these servings of stuff I am never going to use.  Even the Donuts decaf is better than this.  I buy tons of stuff from Amazon but this is the first time that I have been unhappy enough to write a review.
Not as rich and dark as I would have expected for an coffee called Espresso.

column9: My favorite decaf...at least for the Keurig brewers
column10: I've tried a lot of different decaf coffees for my Keurig, trying to find one that doesn't taste like coffee-flavored drain water.  This is my favorite.  It could still be a bit stronger, but the flavor is good, not harsh or excessively acidic.  It holds up well to the addition of a modest amount of milk or cream.  (Or, even better, a tablespoon or two of Trader Joe's Coffee Espresso Ice Cream. :>) )Try it if you drink decaf.  It's the only one that I keep reordering.
This is a great decaf, even for non-decaf drinkers.  It's bold and flavorful, and makes wonderful iced coffee.  It's my favorite!
This coffee has very hearty bold taste and even tho it is de-caf it has a rich taste. YUMMY YUMMY YUMMY. I recommend this product 100%.

column9: Don't care for the this flavor
column10: I'm a coffee lover. Due to health preference, I only drink decaffeinated coffee. I ordered several kinds to see what varieties I may like. This one I don't care for. It's just too blah for my taste buds.

Timothy's Rainforest Decaf Espresso is full bodied, strong without being bitter or biting as espresso can be and decaffinated!! However it couldn't be automatically delivered which was a minor inconvenience. It's been a favorite in my house for years but has gotten so pricey that I no longer purchase it from Amazon. *Sigh* Sorry Amazon however the coffee is deeelish!

column9: Something Was Wrong Here - But Good Customer Service
column10: I bought two boxes of these K-cups.  I have lost count of how many failed in the brewer.  It seems that the tops aren't adequately attached to the cups.  About half way through the brew cycle, the seal breaks and coffee grounds and coffee come out everyplace.  We have used a number of other brands, and never had this problem before.After I posted this, I contacted GMCR Specialty Coffee Business Unit.  I didn't expect anything other than denial that it could be their packaging.  What a pleasant surprise.  I got a very prompt and courteous response and they have agreed to replace the entire order.  I am impressed.  I'm not sure what was initially wrong, but their response to my complaint was very professional.  They kept me as a customer.
I just love this coffee.  It is not only decaf, but it is a stronger cup of coffee, which I love.  I would highly recommend it.
This is my go to Decaf K-Cup for Bold flavor and Value.  There are a couple of more bold Decaf on the market but cost a lot more.

I LOVE LOVE LOVE the taste of this coffee.  It is the best tasting decaf I have found.  BUT... The problem I had with this batch is that several of them had holes or the seal wasn't good.  So when the coffee started to "brew" in its cup, it overflowed in the brewer and there were leaky grounds and a mess everywhere.  Not a good thing.  Several in this batch have done this and because of this, I won't order it again.  I read a review that said maybe there was too much coffee in the k-cup causing it to build up too much pressure.... whatever it is, believe me, you don't want that mess.

column9: decaf k-cups Timothy's Rainforest xtra bold
column10: I like this product. I use all extra bold k cups yet I find they do not carry that extra flavorful taste I find in fresh in brewed coffee.

Its so hard to find a good decaf. Either their is a nasty burnt, stale taste or it just taste old.. I wanted a coffee that was rich, dark and has a "coffee" taste. I didn't want that decaff "old" taste. Like its been sitting in a canister, then brewed then sitting in the pot for 6 hours.Well this is it.. I really can't taste the difference between a reg blend and this. I drink lots of coffee and finding out I am pregnant I can only have 1 cup of coffee a day.The pricing was perfect too.
I have been drinking this coffee for several years.  Find it gives me the punch of a regulatr coffee--and more--yet it is decaf.
When I was told only one regular coffee per day by my Dr. I nearly freaked. This decaf is really good. I can hardly tell the difference.

The coffee is good, but I don't know that it's extra bold. It still tastes a bit watery to me. But if you load it up with cream and sweetener it's good (what isn't really?)I'd buy it again as the default regular coffee to have when I don't want flavored stuff.
This is by far the best decaf I have tried.  I often choose it instead of a caf just because the flavor is so like a caf.  It does not taste like a flavored coffee, just a good, full flavored caf.
The decaf espresso has a great taste and is convenient to use. I was able to drink this espresso in the evenings, and it wouldn't keep me up at night. It works flawlessly with the Keurig B70 machine.
For those that need decaf, but still like the strong and bold taste. This is the one. My go to cup of decaf.

I have tried many decaf coffees and this one has a good solid taste, not bitter and yet full bodied. It's one of the best I've tried, so far! I normally drink regular brews, but, if I have coffee late at night, it tends to keep me up, so, that's why I've been looking at the decafs! I think if you try it, you'll like it!

I finally decided it was time to go for decaffeinated coffe and I am very happy with this choice. It tastes as strong and flavorful  and what I have been used to. Now I can enjoy my after dinner espresso and still sleep the night away
I enjoy the decaf coffee every morning.  It has good flavor and it's easy to make in the Keurig Brewer.
The longer i receive the timothy espresso coffee decaf. the weaker it gets. thinking of changing brands. It is starting to taste like dish water.
A coffee that lives up to it's name.  I enjoy it either hot or on ice.  The flavor is robust and not wimpy.  Satifying for an avid coffee like me.

SEEN A REVIEW THAT THIS COFFEE MAKES A GREAT CUP OF ICE COFFEE.I TRIED IT FOR MY ICE COFFEE AND IT IS GREAT!I USE MY MIDDLE SETTING TO MAKE IT A LITTLE STRONGER,ADD MY CREAMER, CARAMEL OR VANILLA FLAVORING.PERFECT!!

I'm new to the K-Cups world and being an Italian coffee snob, I selected Timothy's because I tried a cup of decaf regular strength while furniture shopping and loved it so much I thought the decaf espresso would be just as good for my iced coffee.  Frankly, the jury is still out on that.  I found it to be a bit bitter.  After trying a few more brands I  may change  my mind and come back to this one.
We have tried many of the available decafs and found this one to strong and smooth. Really can't tell it from the same brand's regular coffee.
The best tasting decaf.  Tried all the samples and  decided to stay with this.
Bought it. Tried it. Liked it. My wife and I both like strong coffee.  This one tastes exactly like the caffeinated one.  It is delicious.

Probably as close to a steam machine expresso as you will find.  I love the convenience of the Keurig brewer, and recommend it to the expresso lover wanting convenience.  It's decaf without loss of flavor intensity.
this is my favorite decaf.  strong, but not bitter. i love to make it on the smallest cup setting and make iced coffee with it. very good!
This is a great robust blend decaf coffee, my wife and I both love this blend for a good brew for a after dinner or late night cup of coffee
one of my favorite k-cups, definately the best of the decafs that amazon has to offer
I was looking for a 'strong' decaf and was pleased with this one.  I would order this product again.

I enjoy coffee that is robust, full flavored, but not acidy or sour in any way....and I have no need for caffeine.I have tried many, many brands.  This is one of 2 or 3 that hits the mark perfectly every time.The automatic shipment plans that Amazon offers are great and come with a discount...Highly recommend!!!

Timothy's World Coffee K-Cups Decaf Rainforest Espresso Extra-Bold for Keurig Brewers tastes like Regularespresso.  Strong, but not bitter - has no decaf taste about it.  I like that I can drink it any time,even in the evening.  Quite amazing!

This is good coffee!  In fact it is early morning and I am enjoying it right now.  It smells good, tastes better, and is immensely satisfying as a way to start the day. I heartily recommend Timothy's World Coffee Rainforest Espresso Extra-Bold in both decaf and regular.  Better than most others by a country mile.

Lately I have been making half-caf cups of coffee throughout the day to cut back. The problem is that the only K-cups that are half caf are from Green Mountain and they are pretty lame. I'd rather use a single cup and not waste a second one for a single cup of coffee, but alas, not an option. So if you want bold coffee, then you need to burn two cups - one that is decaf. These really do the trick. If you have a good strong cup of regular (I like the Rainforest regular), then this compliments it perfectly and you'd never know you are drinking weaker (caf-wise) brew.
We needed this strength just to get a good cup of 9oz coffee from the Keurig coffee machine.  The regular decaf is fine if you only want a 5oz cup of coffee but whats that, 2 sips?

Finally the bold flavor of coffee in a Kcup.I have had trouble finding a Kcup strongenough to satisfy my coffee taste. Mostcoffee lends little flavor of coffee, itmostly tastes of the sweeteners and creamput into it. I do like this one becauseI can close my eyees and tell you I amdrinking coffee.

Finally, a decaffeinated coffee with a good strong flavor and no chemical aftertaste. The regular Rainforest Espresso Extra-Bold is one of our favorite K-cups -- so it's nice to have that same great flavor in a decaf option.

column9: Timothy's World Coffee K-Cups Decaf Rainforest Espresso
column10: This is a pleasant tasting coffee. It has a rich flavor. Some decafs can have a washed out taste, but I enjoy this one.

K cup users will always get a great brew from Timothy's.  I am a very dark roast lover and this coffee is one of the best.  It isn't easy to get a bold flavor without bitterness from decaf, but Timothy's has done a great job.  I would recommend this for anyone looking for decaf with a well rounded robust flavor.
This is probably the best decaf I've had.  Excellent rich, robust flavor yet very smooth.  You'll forget you're drinking decaf!
Strong enough for a decaf in the evening after dinner or with a dessert.  Timothy's coffees are by far the best K-cup brand that I have tried so far.

column9: I will never be without this coffee!
column10: This is my go-to decaf. Delicious and comforting. I start out my day with one cup of full caff and then switch to decaf. With the Timothy's Decaf Rainforest Expresso, I don't feel I have downgraded taste from the full caff. It fools every full-caff-only guest I give it to. I am on auto delivery for it and will be forever. BTW Amazon's auto delivery K Cup options are awesome. I used Green Mountain Coffee Roasters for years but recently cancelled that program due to Amazon's great Timothy's coffees and super-simple ordering process.

column9: Timothy's Decaf Rainforest Expresso Extra-Bold K-Cups
column10: This is a very good BOLD Decaf coffee and we would definitely recommend you give it a try.
My wife and I have tried several of the K-cups and found this to be one of the best decaf products available.  The emerils jazzed up decaf is our favorite but this is very good too.
Of all the Decaf Coffee"s out their this one is the best for the Keurig. The others taste like colored water.
It's harder to find non-flavored full-bodied kcups in decaf than regular.  This one fills the bill.  Not bitter, but dark-ish.  Good choice for me for afternoon coffee.

Timothy's Rainforest Espresso is bold without being bitter.  Great for coffee drinkers looking for a stronger brew without the caffeine.  Also perfect to make iced coffee that doesn't taste watered down. Price was excellent.

Received four box's of k-cups last delivery. All the boxes condition were in perfect shape. TWO of the boxes contents were machine crushed and I complained to Amazon in a written memo with no response.  If it happens again I will discontinue all my purchases with this company.
I was really disappointed after eading the reviews.  Leaves a bitter aftertaste.  Would not purchase again

I WOULD LIKE ONLY 1 OF THIS ITEM TIMOTHY WORLD COFFEE RAINFOREST DECALF EXPRESSO EXTRA BOLD 24 K-COUNT K-CUPS PACKAGE OF 2  NOT 2 ALSO I WOULD LIKE TO ORDER TIMOTHY WORLD COFFEE REGULAR MILD BLEND ADRIENNE LANDINO

OK, I admit it. My name is Ashtar and I'm a caffeine-oholic.I'm so addicted to caffeine, that I have to drink coffee before going to sleep, otherwise I *can't* sleep.You heard me. I mean, what's wrong with this picture? Sometimes, I wake up around 3.30 AM, shaking like a leaf in a storm, not knowing what hit me. It's because I haven't been drinking coffee, stupid!As you might imagine, I consider decaf to be the most silly invention in world history, with the possible exception of beer without alcohol (!). Several people have kindly informed me, that decaf is for those who like the taste of coffee, but don't like to get stoned by the caffeine.I beg you pardon? Are there people who actually *like* the taste of coffee????Let's get this one straight. Coffee doesn't taste good. It tastes like...well, the moderator won't let me tell you. It's only redeeming quality is the caffeine.You Americans are a strange breed. You live in slivers, celebrate incomprehensible holidays such as "Halloween" and "Labor Day", and...drink decaf.Well, at least you vote Democrat. Always something.
We bought these oils instead of giving out bottles of wine during the holidays.  These oils were very popular and recipients thought they were a very innovative gift.  We will given them again.

column9: Nice flavor additions to my kitchen
column10: You can cook with these delicious, lightly flavored oils, or use them after cooking to "season to taste". Great as bases for salad dressings, including pasta salads.
This olive oil is so delicious!  It is wonderful to dip french bread in with some fresh or dried thyme, oregano, rosemary or basil.

This is the best assortment of flavored oils I have been able to find online.  There are good reasons to buy flavored oils prepared by a reputable manufacturer than to make your own; if not filtered properly these kinds of oils can harbor botulism  (particularly if you are infusing olive oil with garlic).  Each bottle is 8.5 ounces, which will leave you wanting more.  This suggests  that the oils are best used in vinaigrettes, as a finishing oil (on pasta, fish, meat), or some other raw application rather than in cooking, which could absorb too much for too little flavor.  Oddly, in the box the shipper did not include any advertising on their products or other paperwork that would enable the buyer to order more and in greater quantities - a missed opportunity!
Love this product, especially the lemon, so bright and fresh flavored, does wonders for veggies, fish, soups, rice etc.Would buy again!
Purchase this olive oil for all the great flavors it came with, enjoy cooking with them and using them in salads. Would recommend this brand.
received this set as a gift and am back to order more,this product is wonderful.i would recommend this to anyone as a nice gift item or just be selfish and give yourself a wonderful gift.

column9: Organic, Low Sugar & No Artificial Sugar - Finally!
column10: We eat healthy. That means my kids drink very little juice and zero soda. By very little I mean I never buy it, they might have some at a friend's house or a party or something. Generally they drink only milk or water. But that means they feel left out when the other kids have sugar-filled juice boxes or caprisuns. Enter Honest Kids! Yes, they have sugar in them, that's what I like. Go look at a box of 'Roaring waters' - that has artificial sweeteners (and sugar too, something I never could quite figure out). I would rather my children had a small amount of real sugar than artificial sweeteners. Since they are used to drinking only water otherwise, they like these, they don't complain they taste watered down. In fact if you compare these to a typical CapriSun, its kind of like the difference between a Vitamin Water and Gatorade. When you are used to Vitamin water, (original) Gatorade is going to taste sickly sweet, if you are used to Gatorade, Vitamin water is going to taste like water with slight flavor. Ask yourself which you want your children to be used to?I've seen other reviewers complain that they are hard to open or messy - my 6 and 8 year olds have no problems with them.  They put the straw in themselves and don't have a problem spilling them.Now they don't feel left out when everyone else has a juice box, and I feel good about the amount of sugar they are taking in. At only 40 calories and no artificial sweeteners, this is exactly what I've been looking for!

these are normally the most delicious and addictive pretzels.  I usually buy the in bulk at the Co-op next to my son's school but we ran out of them right before school went on break and ordered these on amazon.  They were very overpriced but our family loves them so we were willing to pay the extra money just to have them in the house.  these tasted completely different then the bulk ones and like they were packed in plastic forever ago.  I do not recommend buying these especially if you have had Sunridge Farms pretzels in the past.

Wow! Was that evey fast from when I ordered -- couldn't ask for more. Perfectly wrapped and delivered as anyone could expect. For the price, ingredients and the quality of them, nobody could ask for more. Everybody should hop on the wagon.

About 60 calories in each piece and enough sweetness to satisfy my cravings.  I keep them in a jar at work which spreads goodwill and happiness among co-workers. I paid just over $2 a bag for them on sale which is way cheaper than I can buy them at Walmart.

This is a delicious candy which I enjoyed as a youngster and now as an "oldster" --- a lovely 2-bite snack I share with visitors.  My order was shipped almost as soon as I placed the order and I received it in just a couple of days --- very prompt service.  Thank You.

column9: Great, but not worth $12 a bag
column10: $12 a bag if you include S&H. What? Are they hoping we're STUPID???? I bought the same tonight at the store down the street for less than $5! I was thinking about keeping the Chocolate Drawer at work replenished by auto-ordering every couple weeks, but this is just insane! I'm sure there are folks that never paid attention in 3rd grade math who will buy them anyway, poor suckers. There's always someone with more money than sense.

I shouldn't have bought this. I cant stop eating them. It came in the box you find in gas stations and stores and was wrapped in plastic. Arrived ahead of schedule. 5 thumbs up and amazon is bad ass!!!

9 out of 10 Grandpas agree that Werther's Original Creamy Caramel Filled Hard Candies will stick to their false teeth, but is still well worth the battle.  Most Grandpas will opt to remove their dentures and just gum the sweet treat.I am not a grandpa, nor do I wear false teeth, yet I still enjoy these little chewy delights because they will fit inside my Fabric Waist Pack Many Colors! and the thin hard shell offers a moderate layer of insulation to the caramel when I am out and about on a hot day, such as at the largest flea market West of the Mississippi.

I got addicted to Werthers Original Hard Candies years ago. The unique flavor became a favorite during long hikes in the mountains, and years of working in the desert. Many a weary hiker would smile when I would offer one of these to them along the trail....a simple, yet satisfying pleasure. These new cream filled morsels are even more of a good thing, but as most people will tell you, they don't last as long, and you wind up eating a LOT more of them. And they're even more addictive! I suspect that the Shortage has a lot to do with folks wanting to HOARD these things, and I can understand why, because that is exactly what I'm trying to do! I'll feel better when I have a case or 2 hidden away....in a cool dry place.

The review title pretty much sums up this product for me. I found them to be very addicting! My friends and co-workers would agree. I keep a bowl of them out on the table and people often ask to take a few home with them. They are good enough to buy the 12 packs ;-)

column4: Bonita L. Nowicki "Bonni Nowicki..Red Hot Reb...
column10: these particular werthers...are excellent..and remind me of the butterscotch syrup that was available when i was a child...i am 63 yrs young..i cant find these regularly in our stores in bflo NY ..so i ordered a case..i have to hide them from myself..they are wonderful..and thank you!!!!
These are the best things Werther's has ever done!  However, I should warn you that they are addictive.  If you like chewy candies and butterscotch - you will be pleased.

Well, they must be good.  I am on here trying to find out where I can get them.  They are marked as discontinued at my local grocery store.  I love them.  The candy outside and the creamy inside is what I love about them.  I have tried the original too but I just like this variety's texture I guess.
The Werthers and the Tootie rolls are in great shape and great taste. You can get some really good candy and other sweets.

Unlike the chewy caramels which pull on your fillings, these are hard candy (which isn't really so hard) filled with a soft carmel center.  They are sooo very addictive it's amazing!  When you want just a touch of a sweet treat, pop in your mouth for a satisfying experience.  I received a package of these as well as 2 other new Werther's Original Caramel products as part of my bzzagent packet.  I am glad I took this campaign and so are those who I associated with that week as I heard not one complaint from anyone who tried them.  This is a buttery, satisfying treat!
These are not just for your Grandpa anymore... perfect balance of carmel and hard candy.  Wonderful prodcut!  Was offered to test through BZZagent.com

Having purchased these candies twice, I must say that the product is excellent, and the taste is superb! I hope you keep carrying this candy, so I can buy them online when I run out of them again! Much easier than running to the store and not finding any there, as so many other people must love them too and they get sold mighty fast!

Not being a fan of chewy caramel, I was pleasantly surprised with this combination of hard and soft candy.  I got to enjoy the crunchiness of a hard candy and the mellow sweetness of Werther's Original.-Samples provided by BzzAgent
Not much to say. I was looking for a good price and this was the best at time of purchase. If you like this type of candy, go for it.

As the wife of a Type 1 diabetic, you quickly discover that you never know when or where a quick shot of carbs will be necessary during a surprise, potentially dangerous, low blood sugar incident!This is a favorite mobile 'quick fix' until access to 'real' food is available. Easy to tote and a favorite flavor, as well.  It has been a real life saver (no pun intended)on many occasions.

column9: Werther's Original does not taste the same
column10: I have been buying these little pleasures for many years and they have been consistently great; however, the past two orders - now up to 24 bags of 5.5 ounce hard candies - taste has changed drastically in my humble opinion.  Something is different.  Has anyone else experienced this?  I don't usually write reviews - probably my first now - but maybe some of you other consumers will let me know if you have the same opinion.  All bags are marked with 2012/10/31 -P35F expiration dates, so they are not too old.  The past years' quality taste is gone.  You all may know the great smiling feeling you get when you pop an original Werthers into your mouth - that is gone for me with this batch. I have compared these new candies with some of the ones left over - had to look in suit coat pockets and glove compartments to find any. I asked a few others their opinions of old versus new that I had given them, and we all agree - it is different - not as good - more like mass production generic candies now.  I complained to the Storck Company online, which is the only way I found to contact them. No address to write to, so I offered to send my defective candies to them for testing.  You can only write a few sentences on the website email, and then get cut off, so I had to write two emails and fill in all the info over and over.  The reply from Storck was a snail-mail letter thanking me for buying Werther's and 3 coupons for $1 off my next purchase.  They completely missed the point that something is wrong with this production and I don't want any more if they are going to be like this new taste - I just don't like it.  But that was not even mentioned.  I asked for a phone to call and discuss this, but that was ignored as well.  These candies are marginally OK as usual hard candies go, but the price is way to much for an average taste.  Amazon was great about it and sent me a few replacements, but the problem is- they are the same batch and taste the same unacceptable way. I want my old style original Werther's back!  I tried another few emails on the Werthers/Storck website, but that has gone unanswered for several weeks.  So I finally found an address in the European country Storck operates in, and wrote to the president to see if they will allow me to send my two dozen bags of 5.5 ounce Werthers back to them to test themselves.  That was last week, so I will have to give them a little time to respond internationally - if they will.  I remember when the experts changed Classic Coca Cola and what happened with that blunder.  I hope Werther's is not doing the same - but if that is their idea, I ask them to please take a lesson from Coke.  The old quality and attentio to excellence is what makes these candies sell.I hope I am just missing something and it will all be explained that I got the wrong item or something.  Please let me know if you find the same thing happening with your order.Werther's Original Hard Candies, 5.5-Ounce Bags (Pack of 12)

While without any doubt I give the Werther's original and caramel chews a big 5, this candy doesn't really fit the bill at all.  For starters, the description on Amazon is totally misleading "Werther's Original Original Creamy Caramel Filled Bag" made me believe I was ordering the caramels, then to my dismay it was the hard candy with caramel filling. column9: Enjoyed by dogs, both large and small
column10: I have three large dogs, two labs(70+ lbs) and a mixed breed. My mother has a very small dog, about the size of a chiwawa. About once a month I pick up a pack of these Dentist's Best 5" Twists for my dogs, and pull one out from the pack for her pup. My dogs get them every so often as a treat or as something to keep them busy while something else is going on. They are able to have them eaten within an hour. My mothers dog chews on it for a month before she's able to eat through the whole thing. Which is why I just pull one twist out from the pack a month to give her.The dogs all enjoy them because they are easier for them to chew on the the traditional rawhide bones with rounded ends. Even though they do still get the much larger, regular shaped rawhide bones from time to time as well, they always prefer these because the shape and size make chewing on them so much easier. Their small size also tends to keeps dogs who swallow food without chewing thoroughly from choking. I have one dog who seems to always choke at some point on pieces of the large rawhide bones, then gets sick all over the floor. That is never an issue with these little sticks/twists. She's able to tear these up into small bit-sized piece and swallow them without any difficulties. They make great little snacks for dogs, of all sizes.

This is my doggies favorite!  For some unknown reason he prefers the stick form to the bones and especially the chips.I love the product as he will chew on it for a while as opposed to other teeth cleaning treats which are gone in two seconds and have him begging for more!

column9: Great but must be used as directed
column10: The reason, I suspect, that people have varying results regarding glucose levels after eating Dreamfields concerns overcooking. Their website explains that it must be cooked precisely according to the individual box directions in order to retain the low carb aspect. This should probably be explained on the box as well. The website states:"It is very important not to overcook Dreamfields because over cooking can damage the protective matrix and increase the digestible carbs per serving. We also recommend pouring any sauce over the pasta just before serving. If the pasta is mixed in a pan with the sauce, do this only over low heat for a short amount of time."I don't cook mine even a minute longer than the the recommended time.With the exception of the lasagna noodles, it's not recommended for storage after cooking, either. The company recommends only preparing what you will consume at the time. Storage in a sauce, especially an acidic sauce (like one with tomatoes or vinegar), will also break down the protective matrix which prevents digestion.Needless to say, portion control is important, too. A diabetic friend told me that her blood sugar level rose significantly after eating it but, upon further questioning, she admitted she'd eaten almost the entire box at one time.This product does work, but has to be as directed.

This is so disappointing!  As someone who must restrict my carbohydrate intake (for my glycemic index), this Dreamfield's pasta is a fabulous find and I love the product performance; the price here wasn't bad, either.  HOWEVER, I ended up with an infestation of flour beetles (teeny tiny dark things, that don't really destroy anything as they eat grain products but DO cause an awfully annoying infestation) and the ONLY product in my huge pantry--we went through a couple hundred nonplastic or nonmetal-wrapped items items--where I found these bugs in UNopened packages was the Dreamfields pasta, and they were in all 8 remaining boxes of angel hair and in 6 of 8 remaining boxes of penne.  No bugs were apparent when the shipment arrived a couple or so months back.  When I found them inside the Dreamfields, the bugs were crawling over other items, speckled on the pantry ceiling, and had gotten inside a few other opened packages (especially a box of Milk Bone), but only this pasta had them inside unopened boxes (which were still semi-wrapped in plastic), as I said.  Thus I must conclude that this batch was the original source.  The boxes immediately went in the trash, would be unfair to try to return them, but since I'd only used 2 boxes when this was discovered, it was a big waste of money!  It took 4 hours and two of us to go through everything in the pantry, I promise I would never accuse any product specifically unless I had a pretty good idea of what happened.Any way, love the product, it does not ever seem to spike my blood sugar, but I guess I won't be buying it in bulk again, even though it seems so convenient, because in the end it was horribly inconvenient and an expensive loss.

column9: Sadly this didnt do it for me
column10: Culinary Teas Gourmet Teas Pumpkin Spice TeaPrice: >$16 (4oz bag shipping added to my total) Purchased through amazonCaff-O-Meter: Undetermined, I'd estimate 15-30 since the base is not all black teaIngredients:Luxury Black tea, Hibiscus, Rosehip, Almond pieces, Cinnamon pieces, Rooibos, Vanilla pieces, Apple pieces + Natural dried Orange, Sunflower + Calendula petals, Triacetin, Natural flavors.-Smell (.5) - The smell is not very strong nor does it remind me of pumpkin  or fall. Scent falls flat-Taste+Unsweetened:++Hot (.5) - Does not taste like anything other than normal tea.++Iced (1) - again no flavor is present aside from just tea to me*I prefer my teas Iced and 1 cup to .5 packet of sweetener. So unless it wows me, without sweetener will always be lower in points so to compensate I add .5 points to the unsweetened taste average.-Sweetened++Hot (1.5)- Adding the sweetener (.5 pkg of truvia) usually makes flavors stick out, and until I added the sweetener I didn't detect anything other than just black tea.++Iced (2) -  So Iced with sweetener is the only way I find this tea to be enjoyable.2nd Steep (2) it maintains its flavor through a second steep but I'm still not impressed.Summary -  I really wanted to like this tea but it just didn't do it for me. The tea was very weak, perhaps I will try to double the strength in a few days and update my rating. to me it just tastes very bland.If you must have some pumpkin tea now, here is a decent method to get you by (don't expect a miracle of flavor). Pumpkin pie spice (I prefer 1 tsp per 16 oz water) "steep" it for 5 minutes hot water then add your preferred tea for a normal steep time. Strain/Sweeten to preference. I use plain Lipton loose leaf for now but I can't wait to try this with plain rooibos when I get it.I have many other tea reviews so keep checking back. To get a better idea of whether or not we have similar tastes in teas check out my profile (I used to actually hate tea).*** I have spoken with the seller who has assured me the tea is not old. You cant make everyone happy flavor wise and this was just not for my palette, I have a feeling it may be due to tea having no sweetener added and I prefer a sweetness to my tea. I am very pleased with the professionalism of the seller  and I will be giving them the full rating.

My dogs love this stuff! They will do anything for liver treats!Be careful, very rich, a little goes a very long way, give sparingly!!!!
These items were delivred quickly and exactly as promised.  Thank you.  Super large container and the pieces were well intact.Thanks you.

My 2 year old German Shepherd loves this treat.  I keep it on my counter as a quick and handy treat for "mini, spontaneous training sessions".  The only issue I have is that most of the treats are a bit big and difficult to break into smaller pieces which is necessary for obedience classes where we go through many treats.  Therefore, I do not use these treats for that purpose.  (The container recommends only 3-4 cubes per day for large dogs).  Having said that, they are an excellent treat for occasional use and I would highly recommend them.

column9: My dog would do anything for this treat
column10: By far this treat is the best one that I have bought.  We used it to crate train out puppy and whenever he saw us going for the bucket or smelled it being opened he would run for his crate and sit in there until we gave him this treat.  The large bucket is the most economicay, but it does have a really strong odor when you open it; for that reason we always keep a small ziploc with the treats in it that we use regularly and only open the bin to refill that bag.My one complaint is that the sizes of the treats varies incredibly - but if one is too large we just split it, we will give 2 of the small ones, and the powder and bits at the end just go in his dinner one night for an added treat!

My wife and I both like the spearmint flavored BreathSavers, but they were becoming hard to find locally. It seems most stores had Breathsavers, but not the spearmint flavor. I decided to check online and found them on Amazon at a super price. We bought enough to qualify for "free shipping". We'll be buying more when these run out--Thank You !!  Vaughn & Diane

This is the "old" breath savers and the best as far as I am concerned.  The new so called "3 hour mint" are too strong and awful tasting. So if you want taste and enjoyment for your dollar you should choose these.

column9: These are the "original" BreathSaver Spearmint mints!
column10: I have enjoyed the "original" BreathSaver Spearmint mints for years. Recently I ordered some online that had the same image as these, i.e., an image of the "original" Spearmint, but when I received them, they were the BreathSaver Spearmint "3-Hour" variety, an entirely different taste, not as pleasant. This item, however, is the real stuff, the "original" mints that I am used to. Tasty! Thanks.

This is the BEST mint. But again this company has chosen to remove this flavor from the stores. At least I can't find them around where I live. The other flavors are available just not spearmint, weird. As always shipping from Amazon is the best and since I have set this up through their subscribe service I never run out!
I like them very much.  I did buy them at Walmart when it was a small Walmart.  Now that it is a Super Walmart they don't cary them.  Thank you Amazon for having them
At the office, I use these to always be fresh for meetings.  It's a great deal with the bulk purchase.
I'm sort of addicted to BreathSavers, but the only flavor I like is Spearmint. It's been harder and harder to find this locally. Thank goodness for Amazon and SuperSaver shipping! :)
I couldn't find these delicious mints in the stores anymore and I checked with Amazon.com and alas, they had it.  Very convenient to buy them online instead of running from store to store.

My recent order was the second I've made with the same Amazon affiliate. The Geomar conch is beautiful. I use it for conch chowder. I was amazed when I opened the can.Moreover, the M5 affiliate is top-notch. On my first order, they called to tell me the Chilean quake had interrupted their supply chain and would call me back when product became available. They did so. The most recent order arrived in a flash.I hope California (where M5 is based) won't ruin this vendor's affiliate status. Trying to solve the state pension problem on the backs of Amazon affiliates is like trying to move a beached blue whale by kicking it.
This product is great, just wish product was available at stores near me.  Hate having to order on line.

I love this sausage. Really brings out memories from way back then, tastes like european homemade sausage, the type grandma would make . I love it as it is, but sometimes my husband wants to cook with it/ grill it. Makes me cringe since I prefer it straight from the packaging. Might sound weird, but taste delicious with just some bread and tomatoes. Anyways, wish I could find these on sale, I'd stock up for a long time.
The sausage is good at first bite,But has a strange rancid oil type aftertaste that only leaves after a good brushing of the teeth.Good consistency,pretty to look at,but scared to share with others.
I love the tasty, healthy munchies and they keep me from craving unhealthy chips. The spicy flavor and little crunch is a treat.

Let me preface things by saying that I am vegan and eat all sorts of food that most people sneer at. I am also a fan of sushi rolls, seafood (in my fairly recent past life as an omnivore), and weird foods in general. However, I found this to be one of the most unappealing things I've ever encountered. I was hoping to find a new healthy snack -- maybe something like kale chips? Nope. It's just extremely thin sheets of seaweed. It looks like cellophane and tastes  like the bottom of the ocean. I could not discern any chipotle flavoring, and after two bites, the entire pack was in the trashcan. In the future, I will just pay for overpriced kale chips because at least I enjoy eating them!

If you want something different and healthier, and enjoy the flavors of nori and other seafoods, give these a try! The spice is a bit hotter than I thought but the flavor of the nori still shines through. They are light and crispy and could be your new favorite snack. I'm looking forward to trying the other flavors they have. The texture is actually a bit lighter than some other nori sheets that I've tried and they are easier to break apart and snack on than nori intended for rolling.To everyone posting negative reviews claiming these "taste like the bottom of the ocean" - stop kidding yourself - they are not potato chips. If you want a potato chip go and buy a potato chip. They are seaweed after all and the product name "Seasnax" seems to be clear enough to me that they are not masquerading as anything else.
I put this on all my food. It taste great on everything. I dont see how a hispanic can cook without it.

column9: Mediterranean Curry - Best of the Near East Couscous line
column10: I have had this the Pine Nut, the Parmesean, Roasted Garlic, and Chicken and by far the Mediterranean Curry is hands down the best flavor.  It's not an extreme curry but spiced well enough to make this my default favorite from Near East.  I prefer eating this over rice and make this a meal itself as it truly takes 5 minutes on a medium high flame for the consistency I like.

column9: Scandinavian Cheese Assortment (2 pound) by igourmet.com
column10: The recipients of the gift of four Scandinavian Cheeses were pleased and offered thanks for the items as well as for the considerate effort.
Got my Mary Janes in a timely fashion, but upon receiving them found that they must have overheated and were stuck together from leaking out of their wrappers.

I have eaten these little gems for more years than I care to admit.  But about a year ago I decided I needed to lose some weight and I began to cut out both sugar and fat items.  However, to be successful in the long term on this you shouldn't deny yourself everything and the one treat I kept was these bite-sized Mary Janes.  They're only about thirty calories each and give your taste buds a long, satisfying chew that makes you think you've eaten an entire candy bar.  I lost the weight I wanted to lose and these guys helped.  If you enjoy the rich taste of peanut butter and molasses then you should give them a try whether you're attempting to lose weight or just want something delicious to enjoy eating.  And very importantly, you'll save money buying them in bulk via an Amazon vendor.

I have been fostering kittens for a few years now and I think that this is a great food to start out on if you have a tighter budget. I really like the holistic foods, but I think that starting out with this is not too bad. It's not as great for you kitten, but it provides all their necessities and it's not too bad of a brand. It still contains some corn and that is not that great food your pet, but i think that this is probably better than the other science diet formulas. I just wanted to note that the higher quality food that you feed your kitten, the less waste they will produce and the general health will increase (shinier coat and etc). I always get this is the big bag because it seems to be the most worth it and this food is not too bad when you can get it on sale. You can also buy these from your local petsmarts so I think it is pretty convenient. Remember to get your pets spayed and neutered as well!! prevent the over accumulation of strays in our shelters and stop overpopulation!!!

Label clearly says "Cranberry, JUICE COCTAIL FROM CONCENTRATE with other natual flavors",verbatum incl. caps on, except the word Cranberry is 4 x as larger than the other wording below it.  How the heck can they claim it's not from concentrate when it's clearly worded otherwise on the front of the label!I was expecting to actually get to taste natural juice for a change...boy was I wrong.  How do they get off writing their story when the label clearly states otherwise?  It's ridiculous.It has a slight cran tang to it, but a far cry from tasting fresh!  In fact it tastes like it's ingredients...THE MAIN INGREDIENT IS WATER and the second is HIGH FRUCTOSE CORN SYRUP...the worst ingredient ever!I AM APAULED AT THE FALSE ADVERTISEMENT GOING ON HERE, SOMEONE SHOULD SUE THEM...they advertise natural juice not from concentrate while trying to sell their product, then you get water, high fructose corn syrup and a little natural juice that is from concentrate!SHOOT THIS COMPANY'S ADVERTISING EXEC IN THE HEAD, he's trying to kill us with the ingredients and I am actually drinking the crud because I paid so much for it, so he's probably adding to my death.I can throw it out because Amazon said they will make good and are investigating the product's advertisement...Amazon has great morals, thanks Amazon...hope you like the pics that prove I am not a crazy, irate customer.27% juice, the rest water and high fructose corn syrup (worse for you than sugar)...I posted pictures.

column4: Kimberly J. Karas "a New England mom"
column10: My cats were needing a change and this hit the spot.  They often make a mess of their food over the floor or leave bits at the bottom that they will not no matter how much they seem to like the food.  Iams health naturals is entirely devoured with not a trace left behind!  Literally not one bit (from four kitties.  The four 1.8lb bags keep it fresher than a roughly 8lb bag would be even in a food keeper.  I was happy with the price, I hope this deal continues to be offered on Amazon.

I am pregnant and all I an tolerate is this refreshing mint drink.  It tastes like a mojito because of the mint and citrus flavors.  I am usually partial to minty stuff but this is just perfect.  Thank you!
I love sparkling mineral water, and when I saw this I was all over it.  Unfortunately it was flat, no carbonation at all.  The taste is like another reviewer said, like toothpaste.

column9: It's lemon, with a little mint!
column10: I ordered this assuming it would taste like soda water flavored with mint.  Wrong!  It has  heavy lemon flavor with mint overtones.  I don't like lemon with mint, so if you like lemon laced with mint this is for you!  I'm not happy with this at all.  It contains lemon juice concentrate as a major ingredient, they don't advertise that fact! Also, the mint is not spearmint, it's more of a mix of mint brewed into an extract.  The result is not the pleasant flavor I was hoping to find.  I suggest this product would be great if it were soda water infused with spearmint, but I suppose that wouldn't make everyone happy.

I love the clean taste of R.W. Knudsen Sparkling Essence drinks. I have four of the flavors on standing order with Amazon. I sip them over ice. They have enough taste and aroma to satisfy. I bring them to work and drink them in the afternoon as my after-lunch pick-me-up.

column9: Not for everyone, but great if it's your type of drink!
column10: If you really hate that "seltzer water" taste, then this isn't for you. The flavoring isn't too strong and you can tell you're drinking carbonated water. For me, though, I like the taste generally and I love the lemon-mint flavor. They're not cheap, but these sorts of sodas never are.If you want something with 0 calories and no artificial sweeteners that's crisp and tasty, then try this out! It's a guilt-free drink for when you want a soda.However, if you don't like something that isn't sweetened (sugar and artificial sweeteners typically hide the carbonated water taste) then this isn't for you.

I bought this at a local store near me thinking it would be a nice alternative to drinking soda or flavored beverages. Maybe its just the mint flavor or maybe its me but it tastes like you are drinking toothpaste. I didn't care for it at all. Just figured I'd let people know before they spent the money.

This was my third time ordering this product.  I really enjoyed the first 2 cases of the cookies last year, but this batch was not as flavorful and had a dryer, harder texture.  At first, I thought my memory of how good they were was just faulty, but my daughter told me she felt the others had been much better, too.  I contacted Pamela's Products about the problem, and after some discussion, they sent me replacement cookies.  These cookies made me fall in love with this product all over again - they had an enjoyable texture and those lovely little taste treats of crystallized ginger pieces that leave the mouth tingling for awhile after the cookie is gone.  I am glad I persevered, as these are exceptional for "store-bought" cookies!

column4: Lover of Books, Food & Good Deals
column10: If you like your ginger cookies chewy and really spicy, then this is the cookie for you - even if you aren't on a restrictive diet! Among the many flavors of Pamela's cookies, it's the one that comes closest to "legal" for me because, besides being 70% organic and  gluten-free, it's nut-, chocolate-, and dairy-free as well. It certainly has 5-star taste, but I didn't award it 5 stars because the indgredients do include eggs and processed sugars.Check out the whole Pamela line, reading the ingredient lists carefully, to see what might work for you. The only ones I've tasted that I wouldn't recommend are the Lemon Shortbread. They have that "rice & tapioca flour" taste and texture, and don't even really fill a craving for something sweet.

column9: If you like ginger, its hard to stop at just one.
column10: I love ginger and these are probably the best cookies out there for my taste (gluten-free or otherwise).  The texture is soft bake (they aren't snaps, after all), and there are pieces of crystalized ginger that give little ginger boosts/crunch as you eat the cookie.  Warning: its hard to stop at just one.
These cookies are great.  They are not hard and crunchy, but not soft either.  They have a spicy bite to them that is very satisfying.

These taste like a really good, spicy molasses cookie.  They remind me of the Grandma's Molasses (tm) cookies that you buy in the single serving packs, only a little spicier and a bit softer.  The texture is good, not at all gritty like with some gluten free products, and the spice really plays up the ginger flavor.  Great for that afternoon tea or coffee break.  I will definitely buy these again and would recommend these to a friend.

column9: My name is Maureen and I'm addicted to these cookies
column10: Amendment: I no longer eat these cookies because they are almost always rock-hard stale (at least the ones I get through Amazon).  I'm leaving the stars and review as is because when you can get these cookies fresh, they are delicious.---------------------------------------I'm not kidding.  I can't stay away from them.  What I think is best about these cookies is that they have a true ginger flavor, kind of like gourmet ginger snaps.  The bits of crystalized ginger on top are like getting a small reward.  The cookies themselves are moist, but firm (not crisp!), not sticky like some GF cookies I've tried.  I've read this comment sometimes about GF baked goods: it has good mouth feel.  So do these cookies.The other thing I like about the Pamela line of cookies is the size of each cookie. Not too big, not too small, but as Goldilocks would say: just right.  Even if I weren't obliged to live GF, I would buy these cookies.

I am very pleased with these cookies. They are soft and chewy, which is how I like my cookies. And they are very tasty. If you have to eat gluten free, you know the challenge is to find ready made products that are not outright bad, or something you would only eat because you have no choice. Granted, they cost more than normal packaged cookies, as gluten free products usually do, but price aside, I can say I would eat these even if I did not have celiac.When buying from Amazon you have to buy more at a time than you would if going to an actual store, and sometimes expiration dates can be an issue. When I received these they had an expiration date good for 6 months, so I was happy with that. I think they will be gone in 2 weeks, but it is nice to know they are not near their expiration.

These are my all-time favorite "store-bought" cookies! They have an intense flavor without being overpowering. Love the spicy bits of ginger. And for a gluten-free, dairy-free product, what a find! I bought a box of six packages thinking they'd last two to three months; stretched them a whole three weeks lol! (There ARE only nine cookies per package.) Maybe next time we can use more restraint. Will for sure re-order them.

I love gingerbread and ginger cookies, and Pamela's Spicy Ginger Cookies are the best tasting ginger cookies I've found. When they are fresh they have a nice chewy texture and just the right bite of crystallized ginger. I spread them with peanut butter for a fast breakfast or quick snack: the flavors meld perfectly. My only quibble: they are rather pricey, and if they are not at their peak of freshness, they get hard, dry and brittle, though you can revive them somewhat by dunking them in milk or tea. In the store, you can tell the state of freshness by lightly pressing your thumb on the sample cookie through the cellophane. The cookie will yield slightly if it is fresh. If it doesn't yield at all, the cookies are stale: don't buy the box. I would give these cookies 5 stars if they were always sold fresh.
I first had this honey many years ago in Greece. When I open the bottle, the memories of eating this honey on my morning bread (fresh from the bakery) come back in a flash. The taste is truly unique.

Absolutely the best honey I ever tasted. It's much milder than clover honey. I have it on Greek Yogurt with Walnuts and Golden raisins and it takes me back to beautiful the wonderful Greek Islands and exciting Athens. The sun, the sea. There's nothing like a food memory to take you on vacation again...

I first had this honey on Mykonos in 1980.  Each morning before going to the beach, I would go down to the harbor for a breakfast of goat's milk yogurt, peeled peach slices and honey.  The combination was incredible and the taste is something that will always take me back to those 6 weeks in the Cyclades.  Today I found real goats milk yogurt at Trader Joes and just had to find the honey as well.
i really love this honey . its not too sweet , just purfect over fage greek yougurt with some walnuts.

I first tasted this honey in Greece where it was served along with Greek yogurt. it was so satisfying that I have continued ordering it and eating it with the yogurt available here. It has such a depth of flavor that no domestic honey can compare. I recommend it highly.

column9: As close as you will get to Greek honey!
column10: This may not be the best tasting honey out there from Greece but it is much better than many other brands available in the market.The color is great and the flavor does not disappoint either so all around its definitely i good purchase especially when you get the 3 pack because you save a lot. If you like honey and you use it like i do then you definitely need to consider getting more ahead because these bottles go quick in my kitchen!

This honey is the best. It is worth buying this imported Greek honey. It is great in tea, on oatmeal, on toasted bread with butter! On yogurt, anything that you like honey on, this will be a new experience for you!

Ate this piled on yogurt whilst in Greece for breakie every morning when we were on holiday in Greece.I was a hasppy person when I spotted it in Greek yogurt(Fege)along sidea little side pocket at Whole Foods.
This seasoning works great on steaks!  Once you try it you won't go back to not using it!  In our household, we always use this seasoning when grilling, baking, or broiling! Also kids love it too.

20 years ago, my mother-in-law introduced me to Cavender's seasoning.  Since then, my kitchen has always been equipped with it.  We sprinkle a little on eggs, and use it as part of olive oil marinade for steaks. It also comes unsalted, if that is what you prefer.  To me this is as important as having salt and pepper handy when cooking.  So to make sure I never run out of it, I buy it by the 5-LB jug!
For the past five years we have used Cavender's seasoning. We use it on everything that you would use salt and pepper. Great product!!

i have been using this seasoning for many years, which i first bought in a specialty store and then had to buy it direct from the manufacturer.  now that it is available only from amazon, i am not happy to have to buy 12 8 oz shakers.  that would last me 10-15 years.  i will give some away as gifts, but some people refuse it because of the msg.  nontheless, it is a wonderful seasoning and i use it for salads, meats and vegetables cooked in the oven with just a little olive oil and cavenders.

Really a great unique seasoning. I love it on everything.  Pizza, steak, popcorn, veggies (of course), poultry and seafood.Excellent in buttery sauces.  Kind of a fragrant/savory herb, butter and lemon.Highly recommended!

column9: There is nothing else like Cavenders
column10: I have been using Cavenders for years.  I use it on everything - fish, poultry and meat gets sprinkled before going into the pan, vegetables get a good shot while cooking, soups just taste better with a real good pinch of this seasoning.I also use it as a maranade.  Just mix some with Extra Virgin Olive Oil and marinate chicken.  Tastes just like the chicken at the greek restaurant.Trust me - you won't be disappointed.  Just a warning - the regular (red shaker/bucket) is salted.  Do not add additional salt to your recipe.  If you don't want the salt, buy the blue shaker - it has no salt at all.

column9: Cavender's is A Staple in My Kitchen
column10: I use Cavender's on everything!  Squash, bell pepper and onion in the microwave with Cavender's!  yummy!  I put Cavender's on roasts and Cavender's on steaks!  We love it!

My wife and I can't get enough of this. It's great on pork and lamb done on the grill. No mess, just open and shake it on to taste. If you like to cook Greek food, or grill with something different, then you have to try this product. It's worth every penny and it is inexpensive too.

column9: THE BEST  Multi Purpose seasoning ever made
column10: Cavender's was doing this long before anyone heard Emeril say "BAM!"This seasoning has always been in my family's kitchen.  I've turned many people on to this one on flavor alone.  Don't let the word "Greek" throw you off.  It doesn't taste "GREEK" per se but it does contain all the essential seasonings for delicious Greek AND general purpose seasonings.  Everything you want is in here.  How easy is that?If you've never tried it you simply owe it to yourself to have at least one go at it.  Your family and guests will rave and beg to know your culinary secret.  Can you believe it's all in this one little shaker jar?  Shhhhh... don't tell anyone else okay!

column9: Wonderful on grilled items, in salads
column10: A friend who visits family in Greece each year gave me my first Cavendar's Greek Seasoning.  It is great on grilled meats and vetetables and in salads.  Brush small pita with oil and sprinkle Cavendar's Greek Season, then bake in oven until crisp - better than any crackers you can buy.  I now order it to give away when guests ask about the pita bread toasts.

column9: The BEST use for Cavender's Seasoning EVER.
column10: OK people.  Its grillin season.  This is hands-down the best recipe you will ever find for a steak on the grill.Take a nice thick ribeye.  (Or any steak for that matter, we just use ribeyes)  Season it with garlic powder, (not salt) freshly ground pepper, teriyaki sauce and Cavender's.  Rub this into the meat and let it sit for awhile...the longer the better. (We have let them sit for as little as 15 mins and as long as 12 hrs; both still good.)  Then, grill to your heart's content.  Trust me on this.  You will make these for someone and they will want the recipe.  Oh, and better make two steaks; one for you and one for the neighbors because they will just show up when they smell em cooking!  Let me know how you like em!

As others have intimated, this salt-based spice mix is amazingly versatile and tasty.  I first tasted this product about 25 years ago on some hamburgers that my grandmother grilled out on the patio.  I have been hooked ever since.  I used to be able to find this occasionally on my local grocery store shelves, but it just became more and more scarce over the years.  I went to the manufacturers website only to find an option to mail order........what?  Sorry, but that's just not going to happen.  I was excited to find it on Amazon a while back, but it was only available from one vendor.....and they never seemed to have any in stock.  When I found the 12-pack of 8oz shakers, I immediately purchased it and gave some to my friends and family.How does my family use it?  Well, we love it on fried eggs....yes it's great in scrambled....but I prefer the kick it gives the fried ones.  I use it as a seasoning on all types and cuts of meat before I bake, broil, or grill.  Use it on large cuts of pork or pork tenderloin, lamb, excellent on all beef cuts like steaks and burgers, works ok on chicken breasts, but you can't be quite as liberal due to the leanness of the cut.  The more fat on/in the food, the more seasoning you can use....like most seasonings.  I've used it as a rub on chicken thighs that I barbecued and it was amazing.  We enjoy it in homemade mac and cheese as well.  I enjoy a shake or two on salads and tuna sandwiches.Though the package size may be too big if you just want to try some for the first time, you can always share.  Besides, if you came to Amazon looking for seasonings anyway, there's a good chance you'll fall in love with this stuff and need a dozen yourself........you know......so you have a stash at all times.

for steaks and chops.  I don't have them often, but when I do, this is my favorite "enhancer".  Parthenon Foods provides great service and a wide variety of options for Cavander's.  One wonderful use:  gournd lamb, Cavander's, herbs de provance, in small "slider" sized patties, served with mint sauce (vinegar, salt, sugar, dried mint, water).  A great light meal or appetizer.
It is easy to add to many types of meals for just the right spice.  We use mainly on Pasta, Chicken, Meat and Fish.  The kids love it too!!!

Yaba-Daba-Doo-oo..it's a great seasoning for me and you!  It spices up everything from eggs, to salads, to meat - particularly lamb.But of cour-r-se (he said in his finest French accent) you probably already knew that.  I bought a case because Amazon cut the price to true bargain (under $3 ea.)and I can share a few of them with friends.

column9: I give Cavender"s All Purpose Greek Seasoning " 5 stars"!
column10: My daughter introduced me to Greek seasoning about 8 yrs. ago.  I have stopped using a salt shaker and only use greek seasoning. It helps limit the amount of salt I use. I only used salt on corn-on-the-cob, fresh tomatoes, and salted everything before I tasted it. Using Greek Seasoning helps me limit salt use and my blood pressure , with the help of medicine, has dropped to the normal range. I love the taste of the perfect blend of different spices. I have used other blends and have found Cavender's to be the best tasting blend for me. I purchased this product through Amazon.com and am very happy with the service and promptness with which it was delivered.Cavender's All Purpose Greek Seasoning, 8-Ounce Shakers (Pack of 12)

Used Cavendars for many years and then for a couple years could not find it in the stores.  My son ran across it at Bi-Lo - SC and picked me up 3 cans.  It is the best BEST seasoning unless you want to pay $100 plus for seasoning.  Works on everything, anything.  Egg and cheese sandwich, tuna salad, steaks (OOH), chicken.  It just can't be beat for the normal to upper scale home kitchen.  (I have left reviews on the web - maybe 5 times in 12 years.)
The seasoning is wonderful, but the little red cap on top of the containerdoes not stay on and you could be pouring alot that you did not want.

I have looked for this product in Canada for a long time...finding it through Amazon was easy.......check out the recipes online.  There are lots to choose from and they are easy to prepare, not to mention tasty......Enjoy!
This stuff is great. Use it on just about anything you can eat - well, maybe not ice cream.

My son-in-law spent time in Greece when he was in the Air Force. His mother, who cooks wonderful New Orleans food, brought that young man up cooking like a pro.  When he was in Greece, he fell in love with tasty Greek dishes made with lamb and chicken.  Now when he cooks that wonderful food for my daughter and the rest of us serious eaters, he seasons it with Cavender's All Purpose Greek Seasoning.  That little yellow shaker is all he needs to make his food taste the way he remembered dishes tasted in Greece.It is necessary to remember that this seasoning mixture is a food rich in sodium.

column9: Perfect blend that we never tire of eating!
column10: We love eating this on our kettle-popped popcorn. Delicious!Amazingly, we never grow tired of the taste. It takes on a different taste for each different dish. We love it!

This is the best all around seasoning.  I have been using Cavender's Greek Seasoning for years and never get tired of it.  It's great on steaks or even chicken.  I use it even in scrambled eggs.  I love the flavor and it smells so good!

Ever wish you knew the secrets of a great steakhouse restaurant? This is it. It's good as we've all said here.This is our favorite way to use it:Place 4 thin boneless chicken cutlets in a flat bowl. Add the zest of half a lemon to 1/4 cup extra virgin olive oil. Pour over chicken, turning to coat both sides with lemon oil mixture. Sprinkle both sides with Cavender's Greek Seasoning - (we like a generous amount, but you should experiment with the amount until you find what you like).Heat an outdoor grill or an indoor grill pan with ridges on med-high heat. When hot & almost smoking, add chicken to pan. Don't move the chicken for 3-4 minutes, then turn and cook on the other side for 3-4 minutes more, or until juices run clear. Remove to a clean platter and cover loosely with aluminum foil. Let chicken rest for 5 minutes. Chicken will continue to cook while resting. Slice and serve over salad or on a roll with lettuce & tomato. Opa!PS: You can also mix Cavender's with garlic powder to make an incredible garlic bread!
Very good seasoning,we use it a lot when we grill outand also makes a great greek salad,a recipe I got frommy sis in law,thanks so much will order more soon,patty
No thank you there are a few other seasonings out there that taste much much better.Sorry just not for me.

I'm getting it addressed by an oral surgeon, and in total it's all costing me over $12,000 out of pocket (no insurance). A quality product from Bolivia.  Each tea bag comes in individual pouch with a bag, string, and a tag.  Singles are quite alright, in this reviewer's opinion.  Brings back very pleasurable memories of Peru!

column9: Very fresh but only 0.80 to 0.90 grams per package
column10: The leaves without the bags weigh 0.80 to 0.90 grams.  With the bags, 1.0 grams.  The crushed leaves were perfectly green and dry.  In chewing one bag with gum like a guide in Cuzco instructed me, my tongue and roof of mouth were a little bit numb (like a pinch of benzocaine oral gel), showing it has the expected ingredients. After leaving in boiling water a minute and pressing really well, the used leaves do not cause my tongue to get numb, so boiling as tea must be working correctly.  It requires higher temps for a longer time than other teas, or I can still sense some numbing from chewing on the used leaves. It definitely needs pressing with a spoon on the side of the cup while still very hot. Someone suggested crushing with baking soda but I found the taste to outweigh the any theoretical benefits.I had a cold today and 9 bags seem to be helping phenomenally.  My sinuses are now clear from all the hot fluids, at least. Not a jittery feeling like coffee (3 cups today) which did not seem to help nearly as much.  I am not bouncing off the walls or anything, just feeling nearly up to par.I estimated the effect of 1 bag chewed with gum to be about like 50 mg of benzocaine oral gel in terms of how numb they each make my mouth (50 mg is a small drop and is a little more than what you would use on a small mouth sore).  The oral gel is 20% benzocaine, so 50 mg provides 10 mg benzocaine equivalence in my estimate of the comparison.  Coca is supposed to be 0.5% alkaloids which gives 5 mg from a 1 gram bag, so if benzocaine has the same numbing effect per mg, then these bags contain at least as much alkaloids as they should.The effect is so identical I looked up benzocaine and learned the German discoverer traveled a lot and in 1890 wanted to mimic the pain relief of "concentrated coca" without the negative side effect of addiction (or at least habit forming). Benzocaine only works as a local anesthetic.  Benzocaine is being discouraged because at only 50 mg it can cause methemoglobinemia (blocking blood's ability to carry oxygen).  Some people have died.  This is ironic because they recommend coca for altitude sickness (lack of oxygen in the air), and coca does not cause methemoglobinemia unless it is in the form of a pharmaceutical with aniline.  Benzocaine is sometimes used to cut a certain common drug which has caused some people to get methemoglobinemia.
I gave it a four not a five because you need 2 bags. The tea you buy in Bolivia or Peru you only need one bag.

thanks for fast delivery of these teabags - my health-freak husband is delighted with them, haven't tasted them myself - expect to be ordering on a regular basis

column10: If you are a bacon head, here is your bait:  Nueske's cherrywood or applewood smoked bacon.  Pricey?  Yes.  Worth it?  Well. we sure think so. I really like these oats.  They are quicker to cook up than some other GF brands of oats, although they really still take a good 5 minutes to cook up well. column9: great tasting, good value and more nutritious than other oats
column10: my local Jimbo's sells the 1 pound bag of this legacy valley quick oats for $5.25 so thanks to amazon, I can save about 20% by purchasing these two 3lb bags on the subscribe and save.  I have not found any other gluten-free oats that works for me.  Also with most other brand the quick oats is lower nutritional value but with this hullless variety of oats, the thinner cut is easier to digest and assimilate giving one more nutritional value

I have purchased GF oats from Bob's Red Mill and from Legacy Valley.  I store all my grains in the freezer so they should not become rancid once they are in my possession.  But the oats from Legacy Valley taste rancid, they have a very bitter after taste.  None of my kids will eat them and unfortunately I bought a whole case.  I do NOT recommend this product.  Buy Bob's Red Mill instead!

The taste will tempt you to do so.It is pricey, but certainly worth it. I keep several in my Go-Bag.

column9: Delicious, moist, low calorie, lower carb
column10: My spouse and I are on the go and like to have healthy easy-to-carry foods like this always on hand. These are very healthy and tasty.

Pamela's Products Chocolate Chunk Pecan Shortbread Cookies are a pleasure to eat! These are the best packaged gluten free cookies I've found since I was diagnosed with Celiac disease.
