Glad to see that wasnt a problem here.  I found at least six coffee's I havent tried yet (and I've had a LOT of different k-cups) but wanted to before buying a big box of them.Very pleased with the purchase.Edit: I've pretty much given up on Crazy Cups variety boxes at this point.  While I was happy with them at first when I wrote the original review, my last order for a summer variety had christmas cups in it, and the most recent 70 pack was about half decaf and the grove square powdered cups.  Guys, most people don't drink any decaf, let alone in these volumes and the powdered stuff not only clogs the nozzles on the brewer, you can get a packaged powdered coffee/hot cocoa/whatever for a lot less money and the quality is better in the packages.  Most of the powdered cups have nasty oils in them and fake sweeteners.  Ick.So since these guys aren't focused on delivering a quality product, at these prices I can just buy a bunch of regular variety packs without the decaf and powdered cups and get a better price per cup.

The k cup sample pack contains so many different brews of delicious coffee, cider, hot chocolate, iced coffee, cappacinos, espressos.  There are hardly two cups that are alike. Every one is different.  I don't know how there could be so many and every one delicious. I've ordered the sample pack before and plan to many more times.  It's a great gift for anyone with a k cup coffee maker. The value is good too.

If you can get past the fact that this does not arrive in any form of a "package" with the picture that is shown your good!  If you are looking for a great assortment of flavors that would be impossible to get all on your own...then this is for you too.  I was very pleased with the assortment, and how fun to go through and pick your flavor to try each time.  I purchased this for myself since my huband is more loyal to only one plain flavor k-cup and I like variety.

I gave this product 5 Stars because well...it's awesome. The value was incredible, and the variety was superb.My only gripe...if you even want to call it that...is that this is advertised as Crazy Cups 70-Pack that comes in those pretty display boxes. I know the difference between these, because I ordered this 70-Pack not to long ago for about $10 more!That's pretty much why I gave it 5 Stars. I got 70 awesome K-Cups as advertised, they just happen to be thrown into a USPS flat-rate box of sorts. I can assure you though there was not ONE K-Cup damaged, and I'm enjoying the hell out of these. So again, 5-Stars all around, just be aware you probably won't get them in those 2 display boxes, and that could really piss you off if you happen to be gifting these to somebody, MAYBE?Personally? I'll be buying again for sure.

column9: My favorite k-cup coffee sampler to date!
column10: Okay, first and foremost I want to say I am in LOVE with my Keurig machine and I don't mind decaf coffee (especially because most taste wonderful) I bought this sampler and was not disappointed in the least. The day I got my package I opened it up to find 2 beautiful boxes neatly containing a vast variety of different brands/flavors. No duplicates came in my samplers and I was so over joyed with my purchase that before EVEN TRYING a k-cup I put in for a second order that same day and 2 days later I was beaming with joy when my next sampler pack came in. I am a coffee addict and I don't mind decaf (mind you, I need caffeinated coffee in the morning's before work) I just love the flavor of coffee, period. I don't always need the jitters so I'm cool with the amount of decaf that comes in these samplers. There were about 15-20 in each order of 70 -not bad at all, plus a cider or hot chocolate. All in all I recommend this product to coffee lovers of BOTH caffeinated and decaf. If you're all about caffeinated then this isn't the sampler for you, plain and simple. *raises mug*

I ordered this because I wanted a variety of coffee.  I was happy when it said absolutely no duplicates.  I read the reviews about some duplicates, but it was always the same flavor in decaf and in regular.  I was going through my box (which was packaged very nicely!) and saw Gloria Jean's Butter Toffee coffee, which looked great to me.  I opened the next box and saw Gloria Jean's Butter Toffee again.  I went back to make sure and there they were, both regular versions of Gloria Jean's Butter Toffee.  I went through the whole box to see if there were any other duplicates and found Green Mountain Coffee Dark Magic twice!  Again, both regular.  I feel cheated out of two different coffees and think this should not read "no duplicates" because I clearly got TWO!Also, 20% of my box was decaf (14 cups), which is not horrible, but just to let everyone reading know.

column9: My mom was very happy with her present
column10: I bought this for my mother. The packaging as perfect for gifting, no wrapping needed. The coffee was all different and had very interesting flavors that she is excited to try. The only issues I had was that this company sat on the order for nearly 4 days, making this gift late. Not sure why they chose to sit on the order, but I am happy that it is finally here and that my mom is pleased with her late gift.

column9: Nice packaging and great deal at $35!!!! Great Gift box
column10: Ordered this as a gift for someone.  I was a little concerened about the reviews, but saw this deal for $35 on a deal website and could not refuse.  Came in two nice gift boxes.  The best part was it had a better variety than some other types I have bought from amazon with a nice amount of premuim brands.

column9: WOW- it actually came in the package shown!
column10: Even if it had come in the plain cardboard box I would have been satisfied, it's very refreshing to get a sampler that actually has a wide variety of flavors and bands- this does! I was completely blown away when I saw it came in the boxes pictured. WOW!!!! My employees love it (except when someone thought they were donuts, ha ha). Great, thank you! Will buy from again- with or without the box!

This is our second order, we first got the 35 cups, and it was just in a box. This order came in a nice flip open top box, with all of them in order. Good selection, some decaf but oh well. I plan to order again from them. We love getting a wide variety.

I did indeed get 91 assorted coffees and what might be a limited edition print but the packaging was atrocious.  The box was a plain cardboard box & it looked like they had just dumped all the coffee from damaged boxes into a bin and had counted out 91 k-cups into the first box they had found handy. (At least the selection seemed extensive.)  The tube with the print was so stiff that I couldn't get the print out. Since this was the last one in this shipment I sincerely hope that there was a shipping accident at the vendor's and they chose to send something rather than cancel an order and the one that I ordered as a gift went out in a proper box.

I was disappointed, as it was my belief that this was a "coffee only" sampler. If I had wanted 3 different kinds of cider, I would have ordered them. I also did not expect to be sent decaf. That is something that someone generally orders specifically. I think I'll stick to ordering specific K cups in the future.

I ordered this not knowing that is contained over half favored and decafe coffee's!Very disappointed in the fact they assume that coffee drinkers would want decafe coffee. Will not be ordering this again.

column9: Love the selection just don't drink decaf
column10: I have ordered this twice and was very pleased.  I liked the fact that a couple of teas and other specialty drinks were included.  If you guys would make a version with NO decaf, I would be a regular buyer.  My last order was over 1/2 decaf :(.I'm sure a caffine filled box would make a lot more folks happy!

The boxes are really nice to see all the different kinds of coffee.  Most of the coffees I really liked and I made note of the ones I didn't.  I just wouldn't order again because there were 13 or 14 decaf and I don't really have a need for those.  I guess it's fine to have a few here for guests but would stop me from purchasing this box again.

I got my pods in a plain old box with the coffee just thrown in. Some of the pods were damaged.  Since the coffee selection was good as was the value, I'm going to order again after reading other reviews that they upgraded the packaging.  I couldn't believe a business would package like this.
Always a great selectional at a great value. My choice when I buy k cups is to go for the assortment.

column9: Great way to sample coffee flavors
column10: I ordered 2 of the sample pacs sent to my sister who was expecting a large number of guests, including me.  We really enjoyed trying the different coffees.  There were choices to everyone's specific tastes.
This is not my first purchase from Crazy Cups for my K-cups and it will not be my last. Each purchase I have made has totally met expectations. Their name is reputable and they do not disappoint.

Shipping was relatively quick...5 days. The estimated shipping quoted was 3-4 weeks. It would have to travel around the world 3 times to take that long. Out of the 70 cups, 12 were Decaf. There were 3-4 duplicates. I have previously ordered this product and it arrived in 2 neatly comparted boxes so you could clearly see your selections. This time it came all thrown into one box loose and I had to sort them so I could arrange them in some kind of order. The selection is probably 60/40 (regular/flavored) with no teas or items other than coffee. I would buy again.
I just got my keurig so I bought this to try different flavors. This is a great way to test out what kinds you like. I would recommend it for anyone new to k cups.

I ordered this sampler pack when I had family coming to visit.  It was a hit with relatives, something from the bold to mellow flavors all available for anyone's interests. Definitely order again when we host a large gathering.

I received my 70 count assortment in two seperate 35 count gift boxes.  Very pretty hinged, printed boxes with individual holes for each little cup made a great presentation.  No two k-cups were the same, and there was a variety of both caffeinated and decaf varieties, which was perfect for us since I prefer decaf and my husband prefers his caffeine.  We also got a few cappucinos, which I haven't tried yet.  Nice assortemt of flavored, dark roast, and regular roast coffees.  I already placed a second order!  This was a fantastic way to try different kinds of coffee, especially for those new to the K-cup world.

column9: A little bit of heaven for the K-cup owner
column10: Okay. Let's all get this out right now. If you use a K-cup machine at work, or have one at home, eventually you will want to try EVERY flavor. This gives you a whopping 70 cups, albeit many are the decaf version of one in the box, too. But still...sooooo many to chose from.....For the sheer, odd thrill of uber selection, this rocks! When I bought it for myself, my fellow K- cuppers at work begged me to bring it in, just so they could drool over the selection...but I knew I would never get it home without a couple of the cups missing!No, per cup it is not a bargain. But the only way to get this many different flavors at once would be to have a K-cup exchange like a Christmas cookie exchange sort of thing. Much easier to order this.

column9: Most of the flavors were vanila, hazelnut, etc. not regular coffee cups
column10: Wouldn't recommend for those who want to try various coffee coffee kcups. These were mostly vanila, hazelnut, choclate and other various flavors but not for those who like their coffee for the original taste.

I placed the order on 5/30/2012 and it came in the next day, I was happy that it came in so quick, when I open the box, the coffer has s label with expiration date August 2012.. since I am the only one drink coffer in the family. the coffer will exire before get finished.. I will never purchase coffer from Amazon again..

Product was packaged very well. 2 separate flats with the k-cups nestled firmly into their own spots. Our previous bulk k-cups were just dumped into an amazon box. They even took the time to align the print on the k-cups so it was all facing the same way in the flats.Was a bit unpleasantly surprised by the inclusion of 8 Decaf cups in the first flat (luckily only 2 in the second) Wish they would have mentioned that in the description because that makes 10 of these k-cups totally useless to me and my wife, and cuts down on the value of buying in bulk. The incredible variety of the pack though nulls out the useless decaf in my opinion. We have been drinking the exact same k-cups for the last year so the variety is welcome.

First things first, heads up everyone, this pack contains decaf! I'm not a decaf person and neither is anyone in my house. So, while I'm sure we will use the decafs, I wish I knew they were in there before I purchased this pack. Looking in the picture provided by the seller, you can see decaf written on some of the cups, but it is pretty hard to see and this is something I'd expect to see in the description.That said, I'm incredibly impressed on all other points. The price is great, the assortment is great (although I did get one duplicate, oh well) and the flip-top box they come in is great! I have purchased other "custom assortment" k-cup selections on amazon before and gotten them in a brown lunch bag. And honestly, that's about what I expected. But, the flip top box was over the top. I figured I would share a picture of it on here. FYI, the numbers on the side in my picture were written by me, they did not come the way from the seller. Seems that the seller really did get the hint from the other reviews.I would recommend this to anyone who doesn't mind a few decafs thrown in!

When I got this I was a little disappointing in the packaging, and was thinking this is at best a 4 star item, then I started rummaging through all the different flavors you get. Half the fun of the Keurig is all the flavors you get to try, when you're buying online and it's all 24 count boxes it gets pricey to keep trying them and we have a few boxes that we hate and have no idea what to do with. This sampler pack is just perfect, it allows me to try them all without spending a fortune.My wife and I have a lot of fun trying new flavors every day, compare notes pretending we're coffee snobs. We jot down the flavors we love for the future and now we're set going forward.In a nutshell, yes the packaging sucks, but being able to try out 90 flavors more than makes up for it...

column9: Good, but Decaf is not a flavor.
column10: Overall, this is a good selection of coffees for the Keurig brewer crowd and a good value.  I've enjoyed quite a few new selections that I have not had the opportunity to sample previously.I have just one complaint, which kept this item from getting a 5-star review:  Decaf is not a flavor.  Drinking decaffeinated coffee is a choice.  In general, I would say that those who drink regular, caffeinated coffee do not want decaf.  Likewise, those who drink decaf often do so for health reasons and certainly do not want caffeinated coffees.  This selection of 70 cups included about 12 decaf "flavors".  I put them aside for offering to the occasional friend who may be over for dinner or what not, but will probably end up drinking them myself as a last resort.  This is, however, not a choice I would have made and not at all what I would expect from a sampler selection.These sample collections should be offered in separate caf and decaf versions.  In that way, decaf drinkers can get a good sampler (something I rarely see available for them), and the rest of us get a selection of coffees that we actually want as well.

I loved this sampler pack.  Lots of great choices and nothing to "weird" to try.  The coconut coffee and carmel creme were my favorite.  I wouldn't have thought to try these if it were for the sampler.
We love it! A great variety to choose from and we liked them all. We like samplers with less decaf, but allow us to try more new things.
Well packaged, very good selection. It gives me plenty to try for a great price. All coffee was not expired and packed individually.

I bought this for myself and it is everything I dreamed of...coffee!Unlike some of the other reviews that stated the one they received were random cups thrown haphazardly in a box, the one I received was nicely packaged. Mine came in two boxes of 35 each and I think it is nice enough to wrap and give as presents. There is a nice variety among coffee brands such as Wolfgang Puck, Coffee People, Green Mountain, Caribou Coffee, etc. There are some flavors that are great and others that don't do it for me, but that is why I bought it. I wanted to try variety without commitment. I would recommend this to anyone wanting to try different varieties or to give to a coffee lover as a gift.

column9: Roll the dice and win a prize!
column10: Actually a really good idea - a variety of coffee without having to buy multiple boxes.  Let's you see the breadth of choices out there for Keurig machines.  I didn't know half of these types existed.  Some flavored, some single-sourced, some blends - you won't know what you're getting for sure but you're sure to find something you'll like.Downside: you might get some decaf.  :)  You might also get some non-coffee K-cups like tea, hot chocolate, cider, etc. that you might not like.
We are enjoying the various flavored and types of coffees in this assortment. It even contains some decaf cups for those who don't drink caffeinated coffee. I would definitely order this again!

column9: Variety is the spice of life
column10: Our small company just purchased a Keurig for the office and none of us were K-Cup aficionados.  This variety pack not only got us off the ground running but helped us to decide what our favorites are for future orders.  Description of product is accurate; pricing is good and shipment was timely.

I was so excited to get this sampler pack; I felt like a kid in a candy store with all the choices!  I enjoyed most of them; just simply my preference on how I like coffe (bold vs. not as bold).  The only thing I wish was offered (and maybe it is, it's that I am not aware it exists) is that there should be a decaf variety pack and a caffinated variety pack.  Anyway, a really great purchase if you don't necessarily don't want the same coffee every day.

Coffee only - regular and decaf. Only 1 duplicate. Would of been nice to have more Van Houtte or Wolfgang Puck. I received mostly Green Mountain coffees. You apparently get the nice gift boxes when ordering from Amazon.com as the seller vs a third party seller.
Great Coffee!!  The only problem I had, is I don't use decaffinated coffee and about 1/4 of the box was.  Other than that I found many different flavors that I like and will order.

Crazy cup coffee sampler was nice although I wish they would give the option to purchase caffeinated or decaffeinated coffee as we like caffeine. The variety was good but had too many decaf coffees for my taste.
product was well packaged and the variety of flavors are wonderful.the downfall of this was all the d-caf coffee that came with it.  I Think you should separate REGD-CAF accordingly..

I would have given it a five star if it had arrived in gift packaging.  Not that the packaging is necessary, but in my book if you make a promise in an advertisement you should follow through.  However the lack of any packaging besides a regular priority mail box did not harm the product.  What I received was a great selection of coffees, no repeats, lots of flavors, different blends and roasts.  All in all a great product!
This offer has the best selection of coffees that I have ever purchased. It comes is a presentation box suitable for a gift.

I love this sampler and have purchased it twice in the last couple of months.  The price only a month ago was around $36.  Wow has it gone up.  I guess I will be looking for something more affordable in the future.
Good coffee mix, including decaf options. My first k cups purchase, so the variety allowed me to sample different types.
I love these little cups.  They allow me to try different flavors without having to make too much for just a taste.
The Sampler Pack is as described.  I will order again if the price is the same -or less ;-).  I took these to the office, none of the de-cafe has been touched yet.

Wanted to try a bunch of different types of coffee when I first got the Keurig coffee maker so I could see which one I liked and which one I didn't.. Can never tell until you try them all.. Can't take other people's word for it, you have to try it for yourself, especially something so special as that first cup of coffee you have in the morning!!!!
For a first time K-Cup user, this sampler pack is great.  It has a wide variety of different coffees to try.
THIS IS A CONVENIENT WAY TO OBTAIN A VARIETY OF SAMPLE COFFEES THAT CAN BE PASSED TO GUESTS TO MAKE CHOICES AS WELL AS DETERMINE THE COFFEE THAT IS RIGHT FOR YOU.

This product shipped really fast - we received it two days early.  However, the packaging was crumbled and dented.  Also, upon reviewing our two boxes, we have already found 3 sets of duplicate k-cups.  So we didn't really receive 70 different kinds unlike what the product description stated.

WE PURCHASED THIS SAMPLER PACK FOR MY WIFE'S B-DAY GIFT, ALONG WITH A BREWER. ALTHOUGH SHE WOULDN'T PURCHASE 1/2 THE FLAVORS OFFERED IN THIS PACK, AT LEAST SHE KNOWS NOW WHAT FLAVORS SHE DOES AND DOES NOT LIKE FROM WHAT WAS INCLUDED.

Placed the order on July 15th, delivery was suppose to be Monday, July 23, 2012 but was delivered on Sat, July 21st which was a nice surprise especially since the shipping was free. Recipient was very happy with the gift, the selection, the assortment. Nice gift to someone who hasn't had a Keurig all that long so they can see which beverages they prefer. Super easy purchase with great satisfaction!
A great way to try different coffee/tea flavors before deciding to buy a box of 18 or more.  Nicely packaged as well.

I like samplers because I can try different varieties without being stuck with a whole box of something I don't like.  This one has some really good coffee in a variety of brews.  I would buy again.  It would be a nice gift!

We never get the same mix twice which is great. We like trying all the different coffees. There is very little wast too. They throw the loose cups in a box and call it a day. I have ordered this pack a few times and will continue to!!!

Really liked the variety pack.  Could do with fewer teas and decafs but overall was a good variety.  I get bored with the 50 cups of the same coffee which is mostly all I can find in the stores.  Don't understand why sellers don't offer more of these variety packs.  Put together a variety pack of nothing but different selections of coffee (no decaf) and I'll buy it regularly.
I thought the K-Cup adventure couldn't get any better!!!  I may never buy boxes of the same flavor again...everyday I get to sample two or three different cups of coffee or iced coffee!!!

column9: Read disclosure statement way down on page
column10: They say "no duplicates" but this is not true.  Way below that, Amazon makes a "disclosure satement" that tells you there may be substitutions.  Plan on there being substitutions!  All in all, I gave it a 4 star because of this.  For the most part, they give you a great selection.

Im very happy I took a chance and ordered this.  There were indeed 70 different cups.  Only two iced which is great because while I love iced coffee, my Keurig doesnt make it.  There was a great balance of flavored lighter roasts and more bold, darker roasts.  There were several from the same brand, like green mountain coffee, but all different flavors.  There were also several brands I have seen before, so that's exciting.  It was packaged very nicely.  Overall I'm very happy and will order again when these are gone.

The variety was good, and I was impressed with the packaging.  However, there are multiple (3) Maple Grove K-Cups that were not included in the description of the variety pack.  I could have done without the Maple Grove.

The picture associated with this product is a little misleading as the assortment of k-cups just come in a brown shipping box.  I did receive one k-cup of 91 separate varieties (although I probably got 10 different hazelnuts and a bunch of french roasts just by different manufacturers).  The limited edition print was kind of strange to me (a beetle and a coffee bean with a solid white background) but didn't influence my decision to purchase this variety pack (I was sold solely on the coffee assortment) so I don'thave much of an opinion on it.  Overall, it's a good variety at a great price!
Great selection of different coffee options.  It included different blends, flavors, and roasts. Great option if you don't like drinking the same thing everyday!

Package arrived one day after the order, which was amazing! Packaging was beautiful. DECAF? I wish I'd seen in the description (or the reviews) that there were decaf in the selections! I don't drink decaf and although I keep a stash of decaf K-cups on hand for guests, I bought this for myself and don't want/need decaf.  Bummer....Changed my mind from 3 to 4 stars, as I'm sure the decaf is "good" coffee....but please someone, change the description to note this!

column9: My cup of joe is still unfulfilling
column10: I was kind of disappointed in the assortments (20% goodies & 80% blah flavors) To my knowledge, each cup should be air filled like to lock in freshness but some of them were pretty much deflated. Is this what you get for what you pay? Only great thing, delivered fast!
Product came on time, and was packed like a gift inside box! It was perfect for my husband! all cups where different!! It was a great price and a great purchase!

This came packaged in a box with circles cut out for each individual pod. Had a good variety with only a few duplicates (and the most was only three of the same, not 7+ like other reviewers' experiences). Bought in mid-June 2012 with the whole lot expiring 30 Sept 2012. Bought this as a wedding gift and I'm very happy with it.
What a great selection with a great price...a couple to many decaf selections,but a variety is exaclty what this is, i will be ordering again,tthanks for the coffee crazy cups..

The package got here in perfect condition. The packaging was attractive. The selection of coffees is great. The joy of having so many to choose from each morning makes it hard. Love Love Love this coffee package.

what a huge selection!!  TONS to pick and choose from!  I won't get bored with all this!  I love having a big choice for coffee.  Sometimes you want a mild cup, sometimes you want something a bit stronger.  And I love that I can try all these different flavors without buying a lot of one kind that I may not like (or will totally love).

column9: Total of 8 K cups arrived "busted" and all the coffee is spilled inside the two boxes!!
column10: Total of 8 K cups arrived "busted" and all the coffee is spilled inside the two boxes!!I'm not too happy honestly...I was super excited about this purchase...however, when it arrived, there were two what looked like peeled open K cups in one side of the first box with one other busted in the lower left corner.When I opened the second box, there was coffee all over the inside the lid.  There were four K cups open.This is unacceptable.  The coffee is messy and not fresh.  I would like it rectified.

I was hesitant at first but after seeing this is defiantly the best bang for the buck, I ordered this sampler pack. Let me tell you, you will not be disappointed! There is quite the variety! The packaging is quite nice. Just like the picture that Amazon has under the listing. I would not hesitate to gift this in the wrapping it came in. The only negative that I believe is in the amount of decaf you receive. Great product, fast shipping. Pure Awesomeness!

I am very pleased with the selection although it does have about 8 or 10 decaf out of the 70 but we use it as the 2nd or 3rd coffee of the day so I am fine with it. The packaging is very nice, 35 cups in a box nicely nested each one in their own cell, perfect for a gift.

I really was bummed to open my package and find nearly a fourth of the k-cups were decaf. I was happy to see this product and really hoped it would work out for me. I expected a few, but really at almost 25%, I felt I'd been given a disproportionate amount. I don't drink decaf at all but I figured if I got a couple I'd give them to people at work. At the end of the day with that amount of decaf in the mix it will work out cheaper for me to go to an Ebay seller that allows buyers to pick their own flavors. Packaging was good however.

column9: Huge Assortment - But a few clunkers
column10: Yes, Indeed, there are 70 different K-Cups in two attractive 35-count boxes.  Every cup is a different type, but I would say that it was 1/4 Decaf, and there were also many "nut" flavored roasts which may not be good for someone who has nut sensitivity. A good value and experience, I think it will let us find the ones we like the best and order those in single-type quantity in the future.

column9: some cups were crushed in on the sides
column10: and didn't work in the keurig because of this. don't send damaged goods. i would say this was 20 percent of what i received. Not all 20 percent didn't work but of the 70 so far I tossed about 5 of the first 50.Variety was good, would have liked more flavored coffees.

IT HAS BEEN OVER A WEEK SINCE I WAS SUPPOSED TO RECEIVE MY MERCHANDISE! RIDICULOUS! THE ONLY CONTACT THERE IS, IS THE SHIPPING COMPANY. THERE IS NO PHONE NUMBER TO CALL OR DIRECT E-MAIL FOR AMAZON... I HAVE NEVER AND I MEAN NEVER HAD AN ISSUE RECEIVING MY MERCHANDISE IN THE TIME THAT WAS ALLOTTED ON THE SHIPPING WEBSITE. THE FACT THAT THE SHIPPING MAGICALLY STOPPED AFTER IT LEFT THE SHIPPING FACILITY IS BESIDE ME. I CANNOT BELIEVE THERE IS NO OTHER WAY TO REACH SOMEONE WHO CAN SHED SOME LIGHT ON THIS ISSUE OTHER THAN LEAVING A NASTY REVIEW! I AM NOT ONLY INSULTED BY THIS PROCESS OF TRYING TO FIND WHERE MY STUFF IS BUT AM COMPLETELY AND TOTALLY DISAPPOINTED THAT AMAZON.COM WOULD NOT GIVE THE DECENCY OR HAVE THE COURTESY TO GIVE THEIR CUSTOMERS AN OPTION TO CALL!!! I DON'T KNOW IF I CAN TRUST USING AMAZON AS A SELLER ANYMORE, IF I CONTINUE TO PURCHASE FROM THIS SITE IT WILL BE THROUGH OUTSIDE SELLERS... NOT AMAZON!!!(THE ONE STAR ISN'T FOR THE PRODUCT IT'S FOR THE COMPANY AND ITS INABILITY TO COMMUNICATE WITH THEIR CUSTOMERS)

I was looking for a reasonably priced, shelf stable, orange juice and boy did I hit the jackpot with this product!  It is only one Weight Watchers point for the juicebox.  It's small (one half cup) but portion control is what I am working on so it helps with that.  It's real juice, and though it doesn't quite taste like Minute Maid or Tropicana Pure Premium, it's still yummy.  I would say it tastes like a slightly 'tropical' orange juice, as it has some passionfruit juice added to the orange and tangerine.  Wonderful tasting juice, maybe better than the name brands, you will love it and your kids will too!

My 4th-grade grandchildren were introduced to this product at their school cafeteria, and they love it in spite of the muppet box!  When it is stocked in my fridge, it is their first choice of after-school drink.  This makes their mother and me very happy, because it is a healthy choice.  I'll admit, I don't find this kids' juice as tasty as they do, but that is beside the point.

My dog's dermatologist put her on this food because she itches and scratches and a fortune in tests solved nothing.  She tolerates this food very well.  She doesn't care for the bagged form, but eats a can of this daily.It is the only dog fod so far that doesn't cause problems.  She is very allergic, sensitive and can't eat grains,milk products and after a while beef, chicken and turkey didn't work for her.

After about 6 months of cleaning up cat barf, lots of trips to the vet, changing litter 3 times and food about 8 times, I finally tried Science Diet Mature cat Hairball dry food for my 12 year-old Himalayans. column9: Filler food is empty, leaves your cat always needing more
column10: This review will make me sound really stupid, but whatever. I don't really care as long as people find out what's real and can avoid my mistakes.I got my wonderful little sweet Bella Bean when she was a few days shy of three years old. She had been bounced around from house to house and eating whatever was cheap. I have had cats around me my entire life, for about twenty-five years now. My mother always just fed them whatever, the kinds of food you buy in the supermarket - Friskies, Nine Lives, Kit & Kaboodle, stuff like that. And our cats were always fine, at least in terms of their eating habits. They would eat in the morning, stop when they were done, come back, and eat some more when they got hungry.My housemate at the time was working for Hill's and assured me that this was the best food ever made, so great, so on and so forth. I now know that she is an utter buffoon, but I initially trusted her judgment, which is so unfortunate because she doesn't think. She also had plenty of coupons for free or deeply discounted bags, which made it a much more attractive choice.I first tried feeding the little Bean an unmeasured amount of Science Diet in a bowl, but that didn't work, as she would devour it in one sitting. So then I took to measuring it, and she did the same thing. Then I started parsing it out to twice a day. That didn't work either, because she would start going crazy in the middle of the day, running around, intentionally destroying things, deliberately spilling her water, crying, etc., until she got more food. So then I split it into three servings. Same thing. Then it got to be four servings. That was a little better, but it was too much maintenance and unrealistic to be around every day to feed her four times. So then it went back to three. All the while, I was trying to reduce the amount of food I was feeding her to less than 3/4 of a cup because she was a little chubby. Reducing was hell. She became even more hungry, but I figured she would get used to it. Not really.For over a year, she would wake me up every morning looking for food in a serious way, knocking things off my desk, ripping up any paper she could find, scratching at the door and committing general acts of mischief. As soon as she got food, she was back to her sweet self, but only for three or four hours.We thought she was bored, we thought she was a little nutty, and maybe even had a kitty eating disorder. She always wanted food. It was kind of funny but in the end it was just sad.A few weeks back, we took her to a new (good, non-money factory) vet for her second checkup since I've had her. I talked with him about her being always hungry. He asked what she ate, and I told him the adult indoor Science Diet. Without saying as much, he basically told me that this food is garbage and I should look for something else. He said cat food should have a protein followed by a carbohydrate as the first two ingredients. Science Diet does, in a very loose, by-product kind of way - ground up slaughterhouse leftovers and corn dust. Then they put a bunch of vitamins in it to make it "healthy," instead of just using good ingredients from the beginning. Not that I care about spending money on the Bean, but this food is way too expensive for what it is.So we began transitioning her onto Wellness indoor formula about two weeks ago. She is still eating 50 percent Science Diet with 50 percent Wellness (you really shouldn't just give a cat different food one day out of the blue) but SHE NEVER FREAKS OUT ANYMORE. It's amazing. And it's 100 percent because she is eating real food now, along with that sawdust and chicken hearts I still regrettable have to feed her. We have her down to eating twice a day, only 1/3 cup in TOTAL. She was eating three times a day, 5/8 of a cup in total. Now she eats some in the morning, walks away, eats some more a few hours later, and then looks for dinner about twelve hours after her initial feeding. No more knocking things over, no more trashing Dad's papers on the desk, no more howling, no more deliberately spilled water on the floor. It's incredible.I feel so bad that I was doing this to her for so long. We really thought she was just being dramatic or whatever. But no, she was genuinely hungry because she wasn't eating any real food.Do your cat a favor - buy her or him so food made with real ingredients, things you would eat - Wellness, Halo, Innova, Evo, whatever. Figure it out for yourself, but please don't feed your cat this. It's garbage.

I like to drink XO Café neat in a shot glass - no ice, not mixed with other liquor, or not even with coffee. No fuss, no muss. Unlike other coffee liqueurs such as Baileys or Kahlúa, it's not so sweet and syrupy that it needs to be mixed. I enjoy the deep rich color of XO Café as light reflects off it, displaying amber hues toward the edge of the glass, making it even more pleasing to the eye than it was in the bottle.A sniff of this and you can't help but detect the predominant coffee aroma. But breathe in deeply and the smoky, woody notes of tequila come through. Why would anyone want to mask such deliciousness in a mixed drink? Now, if you prefer perhaps more of the tequila and less of the coffee, I would suggest what is called a "Bullfighter" - half a shot of good quality silver tequila with half a shot of XO Café. But for me, it's all about the coffee. And I couldn't be more pleased with XO Café.I think what surprised me the most was the surprisingly dry finish. There's just a hint of sweetness, but like a good dark chocolate where the rich chocolate is not masked by sugar, the light sweetness of XO Café does not crowd out the flavor of coffee. It's just enough to make it luxuriously smooth, with a balanced medium-weight body, highlighted by notes of tequila in the background. There's a slight burn, but not so much that I feel like I'm throwing back tequila shots like a college student. It's more sophisticated and refined, and as such, one shot of this after dinner is more than satisfying for me.

The product description doesn't really tell you much about the uses for tapioca maltodextrin. Chances are if you're at this page, you must have heard about it from molecular gastronomy related sources.This powder is able to absorb liquid fats and turn them into powders. So far I have been able to make chocolate powder, olive oil powder and bacon oil powder with it. I think in smaller quantities it can also be used in milkshakes to give it some body and bulk.The 1lb tub is quite huge, unless you're working with it on commercial scales it is plenty for the home cook. khymos.org has a whole bunch of recipes you can try with this compound.While you're at it, get some xanthan gum too!

This product was one of my first forays into the "molecular gastronomy" field of cooking. I was apprehensive, because I've never been good at chemistry (although I'm a very good cook -- go figure).Tapioca maltodextrin is a chemical used to make powders out of fat. For example, adding the chemical to olive oil or melted butter will allow you to make olive oil powder or butter powder. I bought it because I wanted to try making a powder from aged cheddar cheese. Well, it failed to do that, but I have no idea whether it was *supposed* to work with cheese, so I can't give it a great positive or a great negative mark.The tapioca maltodextrin powder is very light, so if you open the bag and inadvertently jostle it too much, the powder will go flying everywhere. It's best to open the bag, measure out what you want, and then seal the bag back up again.
