Apple Jacks, one of Kellogg's troika of cereals that Moms hate but kids love! (The other two of the troika are Corn Pops and Froot Loops.)To me, Apple Jacks have the least intense flavor of the troika, I find the flavor of the apple and cinnamon mild compared to the corn and fruit flavor of the other two banned cereals. Moms hate them because of the sugar, but this cup serving only gives you 20g of sugar compared to 39g in a 12oz Coke, so at least it's not as bad as a can of Coke and fruit juices all have sugar so you can't really get away from it. And it does contain quite a bit of vitamins and minerals (see nutrition panel) so it's a lot better than a can of Coke in the morning!This individual pack is very handy. You can carry it anywhere with you and all you need is a small carton of milk to make it a meal or a snack. And this individual pack prevents you from overeating it (unless you decide to eat 2-3 of them at once.) This container is much better than the old small carton container which you had to find another bowl to pour into or dump into a carton of milk to eat.So:Pros: Handy size. Convenient on the go. No bowl needed.Cons: Moms don't like them.

Product arrived quickly and as described.Apple Jacks cereal is by far one of the better tasting cereals.When it's packaged like this, it makes it easier to handle for trips or a quick snack during the day with or without milk.

column9: Great cereal but a few health issues...
column10: Kellogg's Apple Jacks provide a delicious, sweet cereal to start anyone's day! Amazon correctly notes that this cereal is made from wheat and corn. It seems like Apple Jacks have been around forever; and it's not hard to see why. With their tasty, sweet flavor you can get your kids to chow down on something half-way nutritious before they go to school; and you can even treat yourself to a bowl of these in milk now and then. They can even be eaten dry as a snack.Apple Jacks does indeed contain no cholesterol and the fat content is almost zero--hooray! There aren't even trans-fats in this cereal. What a relief! Apple Jacks are kosher as well if that matters to you. They contain 25% of the recommended daily allowance of Iron, Niacin, B12, B6 and more.A major advantage to eating Apple Jacks within the individual cups is that you can keep the sealed cups in a child's lunch box, a backpack, your briefcase, pocketbook or anything similar you may be carrying. That way the sealed cup automatically serves a dual purpose--it prevents the cereal from spilling onto anything else someone may be carrying while keeping the cereal in a measured portion that goes easy on diets. The compact cup is also very easy and lightweight to carry. Once the cup is opened by tearing off the cover anyone can just add milk or eat them dry as a sugar boost snack.Unfortunately, every cereal has its drawbacks; and Apple Jacks cereal is no exception. Apple Jacks contains sugar which can turn into fat inside your body if you don't get enough exercise. Moreover, Apple Jacks contains carbohydrates. If any of this is a concern for you, ask your doctor if you should be eating this cereal.I would also recommend that you eat Apple Jacks cereal before the expiration date stamped on the box. You wouldn't want to eat stale cereal, now would you? SMILEOverall, Apple Jacks is a great way to get kids to eat something for breakfast before school without completely sacrificing nutrition. You can eat them as a snack or eat them as a sugar boost snack during the day if you are on the go and can't stop for something more substantial.I recommend this cereal for kids--and us grown-ups, too, who are able to eat Apple Jacks without going against any dietary restrictions your doctor may have given you.Enjoy!

column9: All the Apple Jacks you can eat!
column10: I remember growing up in Brooklyn in the late 70's, happy and carefree--a perfect childhood in every way but one: my parents would not let me or my brother eat Kellogg's Apple Jacks.Saturday mornings were the happiest times for me any my brother. We woke early, rushed down to the living room to watch cartoons, and munched on our favorite cereals--but never Apple Jacks. Every time that commercial came on with its snappy, rhythmic jingle, my brother and I would sing along:"A is for apple,J is for jacks--cinnamon, toasty Apple Jacks.You need a good breakfast,that's a fact.Start it out with Apple Jacks!Apple Jacks! Apple Jacks!10 vitamins and minerals,that's what it packs!Apple-y, tasty, crunchy, tooKellogg's Apple Jacks!!"And always on those final words, "Kellogg's Apple Jacks!!" my brother and I would punch each other in the face and fall down on the floor, laughing our heads off.We begged our parents for Apple Jacks, but they never got them for us. We ate a bowl once, at a friend's house, and got so pumped up and full of apple-y goodness that we not only punched each other in the face, but we also punched our friend's mother in the face as well. She told our mother, and from then on, we were never again allowed to eat Apple Jacks.It's been a long time since then and I'd forgotten all about Apple Jacks until I saw an Apple Jacks commercial one day while my kids were watching cartoons. Suddenly the memory of my childhood hit me like a ton of bricks and I immediately put my mother in an old-folks home and then went out and bought some Apple Jacks. As soon as I paid for them I ripped open the box and began munching down great big handfuls of Apple Jacks in the supermarket. Some pimply-faced bagger mumbled something about not being allowed to eat in the store, but I punched him in the face and laughed. I was filled with apple-y goodness!Imagine my overflowing joy, then, when I found I could get an entire case of Apple Jacks, packaged into convenient, ready-to-eat individual cups, shipped right to my door! Now Apple Jacks are the only thing I eat, and even my pee smells like Apple Jacks! I called my brother, and he also got a case. We also put our father in a nursing home, but not the same one as our mother's.

column9: A really good genmaicha (roasted brown rice tea)
column10: Genmaicha is green tea mixed with roasted brown rice (popped like popcorn). I had a sample of this at Mitsuwa, a large Japanese supermarket in NJ and loved it. It is flavorful and refreshing with a nice green color (from the added matcha powder).This makes a wonderfully healthy and exotic gift for friends and co-workers. It's an affordable tea that looks much more expensive than it really is. The box is attractive and the tea is delicious. The tea is grown in Shizuoka Prefecture, one of Japan's main tea-producing regions. Shizuoka is where Mt Fuji is, so the photo on the box is not just a marketing ploy. It's really where the tea is from.One side of the box is in Japanese and the other side is in English. Directions for brewing are on the side. Pour very hot (but not boiling) water on the tea bag and wait 2-3 minutes before serving. Genmaicha can be enjoyed hot or cold, depending on the seasons, or your preferences. You can make a few liters of it and refrigerate like I sometimes do. In Asia, green tea is almost always served unsweetened so don't put any honey or sugar in here. Sweetened genmaicha would taste funny anyway.The price offered by the seller is a reasonable premium for this tea if you cannot find it locally. Around me, where there is a sizable Chinese community, one box of this can be had for under $2.

I love this tea.  First had it at a sushi house and it was so good I saved the tag so I could order some.  It took me six months to find it, but it was totally worth the trouble.  Its very smooth green tea with a hint of rice at the end.  It comes as a case of 12 boxes, with each box containing 16 bags (192 bags of tea total)

I was looking for chews to keep my dog busy while he recovers from a minor paw injury (no walks or running for two weeks).  I saw the busy bone and thought I'd give it a try, mostly because it was on sale.  When I got home, I read some reviews about it and felt concerned, as some felt the bones were dangerous.  However, I am one to regularly give my dog rawhide, and have never had a problem with it before.  Following the same caution I do with his other bones (mainly, supervision), I went ahead and gave the busy bone a go.  I was actually more impressed than I thought I'd be.  Other reviewers laid claim that their dog was easily able to get large chunks off the bone and that it only lasted a few minutes, and this was not so for my dog; he gnawed away contently, only getting very small pieces off smaller than the size of a dime.  He chewed heavily for about 40 minutes before panting and needing to take a water break and then nap: half the bone is still there waiting to be chewed.  I was glad he was able to get a good workout during his recovery.I will say that the bone was more messy than I liked.  There are small crumbs scattered about where he was chewing it, and even got some small pieces stuck to his chin.  Yet, this would not stop me from purchasing the bone a second time.Ultimately, I'd probably not recommend the bone for very strong chewers.  My dog, a greyhound, I'd consider a moderate chewer who can do damage if he really wants to, but doesn't have a natural urge to demolish toys like other breeds (Labradors come to mind...and I mean this affectionately, as I have lived with several!).  Additionally, I don't know that I'd get any size other than the "ultimate" that was 15oz.  I could see where a smaller diameter of bone might be easier to snap, so regardless of your dog's size, I'd probably go with the biggest and thickest for safety.  And, of course, be at the ready to rescue your dog should they show signs of choking...not a toy for alone time.

I have always loved Merrick brand dog food, for my corgi, but it was always too expensive...found it on amazon for a great deal and it was shipped very fast!  I also enjoy being able to feed my puppy grain free food! Great product!

column9: Good quality Dog food, but made my dog smelly!
column10: I like the quality ingredients  of the Pork dog food, but it really made my dog smell. She is a small 9lb Shihtzu. Not sure if anyone else noticed this. Her name is Ellie and my husband and boys started calling her "Smelly Ellie", mean I know. We took her off the kibble and put her on Avoderm Grain Free Turkey. She doesn't smell at all anymore. Smelly Ellie no more. She had been on the Buffalo, but she is allergic to chicken and it contains chicken. She loved several of the Merrick canned foods though. They actually smell pretty dang good when you open up the can. I would recommend the canned indefinitely.

If you enjoy a very fiull  bodied coffee without the "burntness" of espresso, try this.  Shared it with my sister the coffee/ Bustelo fan and she really fell for the non- bitter, strong brew from my drip pot.  Makes great ice coffee too. This coffee was a great break from the Starbucks and 8 o'Clock I had been drinking. Price is $2/ per package cheaper than my local market on Amazon

column9: Best coffee I've ever tasted - really.
column10: I know everyone's tastes are different but honestly this coffee has the best flavor - for me - ever. After having one shipment and trying a few other brands I went back to this Lavazza Gran Filtro Dark Roast. I signed up for the automatic shipment with the 15% discount. So as a Prime member I get two and a half pounds of the best coffee I've ever tasted, shipped free, for fifteen dollars a month. Seriously.
We had this brand over in Italy. When we got back, we ordered this coffee from Amazon. We got hooked on the Oro espresso ground, but this kind makes a great cup of coffee and is less expensive.
The coffee is extremely tasty, and the smaller size of the packages keeps it very fresh and is better than the huge coffee tubs...

column9: Great for vacation when all you have is a drip coffee maker
column10: I am addicted to espresso and strong full bodied coffee. When we went on vacation recently I needed something that would work without an espresso maker, because all the house had was a drip machine. Believe me, I was contemplating to pack my machine, anyway I gave this a try and it worked out well. It had a bold flavor and satisfied my coffee in the morning cravings, obviously there wasn't crema to speak of. I would definitely buy it again for this purpose.
I first tried this coffee in a hotel, then i started loving it. I know a certain kind of food, like music, cannot make everyone happy. IMHO it is the best with a dripper.

I don't think I can go back to drinking anything else now. Well worth ordering with the subscribe and save purchase. My husband and I both agree on this one. Smooth, rich, not bitter, my new favorite.

I'm a Lavazza lover. The Gran Filtro (Blue Stripe) has been a favorite of mine for years. I asked my son to pick me up a bag of 'Gran Filtro' at a shop near his apartment, and he returned with the Dark Roast beans (Brown Stripe). I instantly loved the dark roast and when I found the coffee at Amazon, I ordered it as ground coffee. It just doesn't taste the same to me. Maybe it's the way I grind it, maybe it's just fresher when the beans are ground just before brewing. Whatever the reason, and I'm working on it, I prefer the beans to the ground coffee. It's not like it's bad coffee, it's just not as good as I'd hoped.
This coffee is the best I have ever had and I KNOW good coffee! The club gives you a discount and it is exactly the number I need todrink four and share one!!
Had hopes it would be a bit stronger, but I would still order again.  Grounds are good for wire basket.

My wife experienced Lavazza coffee for the first time while in the Grand Caymen Islands.  She loved the flavor so much that we looked for it on Amazon when we got home.  She no longer drinks anything else in the morning.
Really nice, strong but full of flavour coffee. We live in the USA and miss our French coffee. This one is excellent.

After discovering this coffee I do not think I would brew anything else at home ever again.  Lavazza is excellent, and I should try more of their varieties.  So far out of the gold and gran filtro dark, this one is the best.This coffee has a very subtle and smooth flavor, hints of chocolate and it is slightly sweet.  It is easy to drink without milk and should not be mixed with sugar.  Use a coffee press to make it and you can taste how delicate it is.  And, although its imported from Italy, buying it online is cheaper than buying most coffees in the store.There's no reason not to buy this online if you like coffee, except if you have a problem with pre-ground coffee.  But, keep it in an airtight bag and it doesn't spoil too fast.

I was so excited by the possibilities of ordering Lavazza via Amazon. Unfortunately the coffee doesn't measure up to what I'm used to in a Lavazza shop. Granted, this was typically espresso based drinks but this coffee is not accpetable to me even as every day coffee. I'm back to my local fresh roasted beans...most of my six bags will go into storage as emergency coffee for when I run out unexpectedly.

A very nice cup of coffee. I often get compliments from company, just good coffee. 1 Tablespoon for each 2 cups in a regular drip coffeemaker. Nice packaging, easy to store, and did I mention, it is just good coffee (comfort food for me).

column9: Great tasting coffee for those with discriminating taste.
column10: Lavazza is excellent coffee that provide a chocolaty strong flavored coffee with the bitter burnt taste you get from other brands.
This coffee is the best, and we have it sent to us monthly...absolutely no hassles!! Amazon.com ships it right on time every month! We love it.

I am no connoisseur of white tea but I use FOOJOY SHOUMEI as the standard to compare the rest. This tea has a naturalsweet undertone that makes it  a pleasure to partake. I like to just steep it to a golden yellow and savor it. Othe white teas I have tried have a slightly bitter taste,I have tried the much more expensive and similar priced ones and this beats them all hands down. White tea kills more bacteria on contact in lab studies (google it) than green so its part of my fight the flu season regime as well. Did I say the price was unbeatable? Lets keep that our little secret.

This White Tea was included as a 'bonus' in a box of FooJoy Green Tea that I purchased at an Asian grocery store, but this is now my new favorite.  It is mild, delicious and soothing, but what surprised me was that it seems to help my mental alertness and mental energy - a nice "side" effect!
Just had my first cup. Rather than "mild," I would call it delicate. Not so astringent as black or green tea, it seems. Pleasant. Not intrusive.

This tea is hard to find.  I originally bought it at a Chinese grocery.  I would recommend it to anyone who enjoys a mild cup of tea.  Unlike Silver Needle white tea, it does have some color.  However, the flavor and aroma is like other white teas.

column9: Not as good as store bought tea bags
column10: The packaging looks the same as the ones you can buy in Asian stores but the tea is weak and lacks the strong body of the store bought bags and it cost more. The only reason I bought it online is the local store didn't have it. But I was very disappointed in the product. Next time I will drive to Portland and buy it instead of buying a poor imitation like this

This is truly a premium product, carefully packaged to maintain freshness.  I am new to the world of white tea which has more anti-oxidants than green or black, and a really unique flavour that is wonderful with Garibaldi biscuits in the afternoon.  The product is pricey but worth it.

If you're a flavored coffee lover then treat yourself to this delicious coffee . Use standard amount (3 coffee scoops ) so as notto spoil the blending of each flavor ( chocolate , caramel , and nut).Though this makes a terrific cup of hot coffee I find personallythat the flavors are even more distinct when iced . Other coffeesno longer even compare to Coffee Masters coffees . I've tried theCreme Brulee , Almond Ameretto , Caramel kiss , and Winter Frost (winter frost may be harder to find and costs a little more but it'sworth it ) . As well as purchasing the decaf French Vanilla for my husband . Each one is yummy but the Turtle Sundae is my personal fav.If you're in the market for a great tasting and reasonably priced coffee , give Coffee Master a try . You won't be disappointed .

I had been drinking Cameron's coffee sold on Amazon and, well.....it was watery and bland.  Oh, it smelled great but that's about as far as it went.  So, I tried this brand instead.  It is rich, creamy and soooooooooooo much better than Cameron's.  Let me reiterate that again:  It is SO (I'd put "SO" in bold if I could) much better than Cameron's!!  The only reason I gave this particular flavor four stars is that it is quite good but I want to try their Caramel Kiss the next time as that is my favorite.  Being a chocoholic, though, I just had to try the Turtle Sundae.  I'm convinced that whatever your favorite flavor of coffee may be, this company will deliver the flavor, richness, creaminess, and robustness of the coffee that you desire.  In my humble opinion, any coffee from this company is WELL-WORTH THE MONEY.UPDATE: August 16, 2012I've now tried their Caramel Kiss and am absolutely hooked!  Again, that rich creamy and smooth flavor that is well-beyond any coffee maker I have ever tried.  So, let me reiterate what I said in my original review:  It just doesn't matter which flavor you buy, you WON'T be disappointed and might find, like myself, that it's now your favorite coffee.
I generally like this brand's flavored coffees. The Turtle Sunday flavor that I bought this time does not suit my taste. However, the quality cannot be beat.

My yellow lab has both allergies and digestion issues.  We tried every type of dog food including lamb and rice and he couldn't tolerate it.  He finally was ok with venison and potato by Royal Canin but still had bouts of diahera and stomach pain.  We were very happy when we found Natural Balance venison and sweet potato.  Our lab no longer has any digestion issues and is doing great!  We also like the fact that they make a biscuit so he can also have a treat.  Amazon is great to order from.  We don't pay any shipping and the orders get here in good shape.

But the fundamental problem is that these three things are all genetically modified, with chemical insecticide spliced into the dna of the seed. You can look this up on Google, please do. The Poodle had allergies to everything. The Italian greyhound/chihuahua was so starved you could see every rib and knuckle (severe neglect). This food is like 'good medicine' to these little friends of ours. I never have to coax them to eat. I feed them the "grain free" dry kibble, as well. They eat it slowly like they are enjoying every bite. Their weight stays level and they look shiny and beautiful. No more hair all over us!!**If you are starting a sick, weak, or rescued "puppy mill" dog on this food; you must give it four to six weeks to see the full benefits. Like building blocks. The metabolism will renew and the blood will get stronger and you will see muscle tone and bright eyes. Then their minds sharpen and you see a personality, which is a real treat! I love dogs! There is something magical about them, don't you think?The cans are 13 ounces, with a 'ring and pull top' opening. (It smells like something you could eat on a cracker. Human food/grade, grain free, dog food.5 stars it's all good. Natural Balance Dry Dog Food, Grain Free Limited Ingredient Diet Fish and Sweet Potato Recipe, 28 Pound BagNatural Balance Canned Dog Food, Grain Free Limited Ingredient Diet Venison and Sweet Potato Recipe, 12 x 13 Ounce PackBest wishes.

No complaints here, my dogs eat the NB venison & sweet potatoes dry dog food and I have to mix in a little of the can food as well so they will eat the dry food. Apparently my dogs are extremely spoiled and refuse to simply eat dry dog food LOL
My baby not only loves this food it's GREAT for her!!  The value of this Grain Free is excellent and keeps my dog allergy free!

column9: Natural Balance Venison and Sweet Potato
column10: My dogs love Natural Balance dog food.  They particularly like the Venison and Sweet Potato canned food.  Limited ingredients providing great nutrition, so what's not to love?

We use this as a supplement for our dog who eats the dry version.  We use it for frozen Kong treats instead of fatty peanut butter and other treats.  He loves it and it keeps his digestion regular.  Natural Balance is definitely more expensive than other brands, but you know what you're getting with this and it can help dogs with allergy/digestion issues.  We did find that our other dog doesn't like the flavor of the food, even dogs can be picky!

We have an 11 year old Golden who suffered for two years with re-occuring ear infections. Nothing the vet prescribed touched it. When she started biting and licking all the fur from her paws and legs, I traveled 30 miles to see the vet that took care of my family's dog when I was a kid. He pulled her off of all commercial dog food and treats, recommending I find a Limited Ingredient Diet product for her. We brought a bag of the kibble and a can of this to show him, and he told us "this has a lot of good stuff in it" so we tried it. Seriously, within two weeks the ears had NO black discharge and the smell was gone. Her paws went from hot and red to cool and pink. This dog got to the point where she disliked being touched because her skin was so stressed, but after introducing her to this food.. she plays, and talks, and loves being a Golden again. Oh, and she snarfs the food. Kibble, can, mix together.. she makes it disappear. We highly recommend Natural Balance Duck and Potato, and Venison and Sweet Potato found in both dry and canned.

My dog, who is on a vension diet due to allergies, likes it better than the Science Diet I was buying at the vet, and the price is better ($4 vs. $2 per can).  I think he's itching less as well, that may be because he's no longer getting into the cat's food that we try to keep inaccessible to him.

My dogs absolutely love this dog food. I only use this to supplement their dry food but they would have no trouble eating just this. I had a problem with 2 half-empty cans in one case and the manufacturer replaced them and then some very quickly. They also like this brand of dry food.

We have a 4yr old pug that has MULTIPLE skin allergies and is a picky eater. He is allergic to MOST grains and meats so I was stuck cooking individual meals for him which was very time consuming and expensive. This is a great alternative! Our pug loves it and the sweet potato base actually smells like sweet potato! Natural Balance had been reccomended by a canine nutritionist and this product is wonderful. It has decreased our vet bills and the need for steroids and medications for allergies.

column9: My dog loves it, and it helps her ear infections.
column10: My dog loves this high quality food.  Allergies can cause those dreaded ear infections, and mine has not had one since I started her on the LID dry and canned food.  12 can case is cheaper here than at the pet store; no clue what the prior reviewer was complaining about, the description clearly says 12 cans, and nowhere is it written that a case has to be 24 cans.. Guess some people just like to complain : )

My mini schnauzer is allergic to corn and soy and this is the first dog food I have found that doesn't make her sick and/or itchy.  I don't know where the previous reviewer shopped but I just got home from Petco and realized I could have saved seventeen dollars if I had bought the same items from amazon.com.  I will be buying my dog food here from now on.  Amazon also offers more of the 'limited ingredient' line for allergy-prone dogs like mine.

Our Vet is very much into quality nutrition for our pets and recommended this dog food.  Right away you can see the difference from a good quality food as opposed to the bargin brand.  The food is so clean and doesn't stick to the can like the cheaper ones that are filled with grease and fat and all kinds of other horrors you need to know about.  Do you know that our dogs and cats have been eating diseased animals, in addition to eating the remains of their own species who have been euthanized.  Did you know that the makers of dry dog and cat food spray used grease on the food to make it more palatable?  Well, they do.  These things and more are what we've been unknowingly feeding our pets...food so dangerous that the incidents of cancer amoung our cats and dogs is running rampent.  Quality food may cost more, but I'd rather pay a little extra than have one more of my pets die from cancer.  Do yourselves and your beloved pets a favor, feed them a good quality food.  Others besides Natural Balance include Royal Canin and Blue Buffalo, plus more.  The higher priced foods in your grocery stores (Iams, Science Diet) are on the list of BAD foods.  Do a little research, you'll be shocked by what you discover. I highly recommend this food.

column9: It's not the product, it's the advertising of what you are getting
column10: I have no issues with the product, in fact it is an excellent product and our puppies love this food, but I do object to it being represented as a case of 24 cans and being priced like 24 cans only to find out it is a "half-case" of 12 cans.  Enough said ... it's worth it to drive 50 miles and buy from the store.  This is the second provider that represents the product as a full case and delivers a half-case!

You absolutely cannot tell this from top quality regular pasta, yet it will not raise your blood glucose levels!  This puts pasta back into the diets of diabetics and hypoglycemics.  Thank you Dreamfields.

Be careful not to overcook this pasta; otherwise more carbohydrates will be released.Cook to the time recommended on the package and no more.  Check the Dreamfields website for more information under FAQs.As with all pasta one cooks the more it is cooked the faster the carbohydrates (and calories) are absorbed by the body.In other words, watch your pasta's cooking time, especially when it is time to stop cooking it.To reduce your carbohydrates and calories even more mix in some non-starchy vegtables with the pasta.  You can some up with some very great tasting combinations with a little "trial and error."

column9: Fantastic Low Carb Pasta! Highly Recommended!
column10: This great tasting pasta is a diabetic's Godsend! Being a Type 2 Diabetic, I am always looking for ways to reduce my carb intake. Up till now that has meant avoiding pasta completely since a single serving of normal pasta has about 35 - 40 carbs. This has been one of the biggest impacts to my diet as we love Italian cooking. I was not sure about Dreamfields' claim to only have 5 carbs, but we gave it a try anyway.After having a full serving, my blood sugar levels only took a modest rise, about what I would have expected from 5 carbs (plus the 15 others from the rest of the meal)!It does cost more than regular pasta, but it is worth it to me to be able to eat pasta again.Highly Recommended!

Dreamfields Pasta Healthy Carb Living, Rotini, 13.25-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 12)Dreamfields Healthy Low Carb Spaghetti PastaI have found all Dreamfields Pastas to be of superior quality.  The taste is better and it doesn't stick together because of the low carbs.  My family loves it and my friends now buy it too and we also buy the case lots and split them.  More people get a chance to try it that way.

This is the best pasta if you love pasta!!! All the ingredients are perfect. Haven't gain any weight from Dreamfields. I just wish they had fettucine & other pastas...Orzo..WORTH TRYING!! We won't buy any other brand after having Dreamfields.

This pasta tastes great! It tastes like the best quality regular pasta, you'd never know it is low carb. I'm a diabetic and my husband is not - it's wonderful to be able to have something that both of us can eat that isn't a sacrifice for him! Dreamfields pasta is a Godsend for diabetics - there are so many more possibilities for low carb dishes. It tastes so good that the non-diabetic members of the family don't feel deprived either.

We have tried soy pasta and wheat pasta as "healthy" alternatives to conventional pasta. Soy is horrible, horrible, horrible. Wheat is funky. This pasta is a wonderful alternative. It tastes like regular pasta but gives 19 grams of starches/sugars per serving as opposed to 41 grams with conventional pasta. Even without being on any special diet, we figure, "Why put all tha extra starch/sugar into our bodies, not to mention the bodies of our children and grandchildren?" Anywhere we can cut down on starch/sugar intake is, in my opinion, good.

I have tried at least 25 types of low or lower carb pastas.  Some have been so bad that my family and I take one bite and throw the rest out.  This pasta is GOOD! And, I weigh myself every day, since I am on a very low carb diet and have lost 30 pounds.  I did not gain weight with this, eating one  1 & 1/2 cup portion, and I often do if I sneak in some regular pasta or bread.

column9: It does what it;s supposed to.
column10: The item came within a day or so and it tastes the way it should. What more could I request?
Living the low-carb diet you'd be crazy not to stock up on dreamfields. I got a great deal and I don't have to worry about my local store running out of stock.

I discovered Dreamfields when Trader Joe's discontinued their not-quite-as-good low-carb product about two years ago.  I like Dreamfields, and it's the closest "low carb" pasta to plain "high carb" pasta that I've ever encountered.  The picky eaters in my life have never turned up their noses at this.It's a bit pricier than the alternatives, but Amazon's current price is 12 cents less per (now 17% smaller!) box compared to my local grocery store, so I've just placed my first order here.Two things that might interest a person that hasn't ever tried it:* This is not a "low calorie" pasta.  The calorie count is almost identical to regular pasta.  If you're trying to lose weight, then you need to control your portion size, not just your carbohydrate intake.  However, I find that controlling the portion size is somehow easier with this pasta.* It seems to want a bit more water for boiling than regular pasta.  If you've perfected the art of boiling your pasta in the smallest possible pan, then this probably isn't going to work as well.  It seems to froth up and make a mess if I don't give it a more reasonable amount of water.
Great pasta, been on the low-carb diet for some time now. Only diet I can seem to manage.  Just wish you would ship to Canada.

column9: As good as any pasta I've ever used
column10: We love the Dreamfields pastas.  They taste as good as any of the other higher carb pastas, and they cook up just as well, too.  We've switched the whole family to these pastas, and they love them, too.  Even my husband, who is really sensitive to changes in tastes, agrees that they are great.  These also have the same texture as other, higher carb, pastas.  I use them in cold salads where taste and texture are important factors, and, so far, even our guests haven't been able to tell the difference between the Dreamfields pastas and any of the others I've used before.  My thanks go out to Dreamfields for providing us with a tasty alternative to high carb pastas the whole family likes!
We always use Dreamfield pasta. My husband is diabetic and this is the only pasta he can eat without raising his blood sugar levels. We keep it on hand always.
Absolutely the best pasta. My family does the 'Zone Diet' and this pasta completely keeps me in the zone. Thank goodness for Dreamfield's.
I love this stuff!  I pray butter spray on my popcorn and then use this on top and it is awesome!  Also helps it to stick to the popcorn. Chocolate marshmallow flavor is sooo good. :)

I got a 6-pack of these in the mail yesterday and threw it on some of my air popped popcorn. It reminded me of s'mores. it also tasted good on some tcby :) but i do not recommend trying to sweeten up your eggs in the morning with it (cinnamon and truvia work wonders but not this!) it's better than i expected but not as natural of a flavor for 5 stars.
Great flavor, makes great popcorn.Good price.  Would buy again when I run out. (which probably won't be a long time since you get so much)
Got this to try it out as I love their carmel flavor, but I found I didn't really care for this one. Just not much flavor to it or a sweet tasting as the caramel!

This is by far my favorite flavor of these popcorn seasonings and the hardest to find. I first stumbled upon it at a movie theater and have been in love with it ever since. Sure the salty and cheesy flavors are great, but for that ultimate sweet tooth, this is a must to try! It also works great for seasoning other things like oatmeal or cottage cheese or your hot drink, be brave. :-)It just increases the flavor if you dump it on movie theater popcorn though, if you are making popcorn at home I recommend spraying your popcorn with spray butter or Pam so there's something for the seasoning to stick to.
The price when you buy a box of 6 is less than half the price of the grocery stores.  Tastes great.
Had this flavor at a movie theater and can not possibly live without it.  Only place I could find it was Amazon.  My daughter and I are hooked.

Sour Patch kids are by far my favorite candy of all time! When I was a young Heidi Kakes my mother would buy me a 1 pound bag nearly everyday and less than 2 hours they'd be gone! Yes it was wrong and I'm suffering for it now with a toothache every now and again but you just can't deny how addictive these things are! So I recommend them to everyone but if you're parents interested in these for your children, get them a small bag every once and awhile, just don't go crazy like my mom did because these things are pure sugar!
These biscuits were delicious with a wide variety of cheeses. I really liked that the almond had a little spice from the black pepper they put in it. These were delicious!

I have never received an item from Amazon and was disappointed. The item was poorly packed or they sent them broken up and to small to spread cheese or anything. I have most of it and thinking about throwing them out. Not happy at all. I was excited about getting the biscuit , but not happy at all.
Another great product from Barry Farms. Makes wonderful flour when put through the coffee mill!

I tried another brand, not Barry's, huuuuuuuuge mistake! Am finding mouse droppings in a single 10-lb bag.  Go with Barry's! This is not only organic and pkgd in convenient pouches, but it is clean. My birds love the berries even before they sprout!

These seeds were accompanied by small broken pieces of seed that just make the bag weigh 1 pound but the water is cloudy at rinsing and doesn't germinate.  They sift their way to the bottom of the barrel and should be thrown out.  They are included to weigh a full pound with pieces that should not be included. I have been growing wheatgrass for over 15 years.  I will not buy these seeds again.

column9: I baked my first loaf of bread!
column10: I purchased this 1-pound package of hard red wheat berries for my first attempt at grinding my own flour and making my own whole wheat bread. And what a success!  The wheat berries were clean and flavorful - good enough to pinch a few berries during grinding to chew on them plain.  And the bread came out with  excellent flavor and texture.  Now I wish I'd purchased more!  One pound is only enough for one loaf of bread.

These treats are the perfect size for training, and my pugs love them.  I don't think they are expensive at all, so I don't know why the previous reviewer gave these only one star.  The treats are about a centimeter in diameter, so you can give your pet many of these before they constitute an actual "treat" portion.  You won't regret buying these if you have a puppy who needs positive reinforcement.

column9: great product! Not so great oz vs money
column10: they smelled really good and my husky loved them! Not worth the money tho and not many in the package!

The first time I tried Kukicha twig tea at my friend's house, I instantly fell in love with it. It had a rich and nutty brown rice taste.If you shop around, Kukicha twig tea is actually kind of pricy. I decided to make this purchase, because the price seem like a bargain and it was organic. However, the flavor........ is another story. I am still dreaming about my friend's kukicha tea, while this sits some where collecting dust. It'll probably be better to buy something more expensive.

We love flavored coffees but the price is just to high so I bought orange flavor, hazelnut flavor, cherry flavor, caramel flavor, and chocolate flavor powers, to make my own and they work very well. we can flavor by the cup or the pot and we are very happy with them.With some experimentation we fond all but the chocolate dissolve in cold. So we can and do use it in ice coffee, and we can now make our own flavored water with out having to pay the overly high price.

This truffle puree product really lacked the strong truffle flavor i was expecting.  I did not understand why, when they are sold in packs of three (25g x 3), the recipe attached, although i did not use, asked for 200g of truffle puree.  (That would mean 8 tubes of puree).  I would stick with whole truffles in it's juices over the truffle puree.

We ordered two 2-packs for our kitchen and mum's.  No self-respecting German would be without Maggi in her kitchen!  We've known the product all of our lives [70 years for mum]. We use it for soups, stews and vegetables, and there are lots of other ideas on the label.One caution to a new user:  to us, it does NOT taste like soy sauce, so if you're thinking soy and use it for your sushi, you may not like it.  We stick to the "seasoning" uses vs. the common soy sauce uses.The bottles were well-packed for shipping, and the service was quick from this vendor, too.  We will be repeat customers!

I fell in love with Maggi seasoning while in Switzerland - I brought home a bottle and became addicted!  I was excited to see it available in the States, but when the seasoning arrived, I was turned off by the "chemically" smell and taste!  It doesn't taste anything close to the real deal.  I still have a bit left of the original I had purchased in Switzerland, so I did a taste comparison - there is no doubt that what is available in America is NOT what you can get in Europe.  Like the Maggi you can get in Europe (which is produced by Nestle), this version is also supposedly produced by Nestle, but UNLIKE the stuff you get in Europe (which is manufactured in Germany), this "Maggi" is produced in CHINA.  And it tastes like it - the chemical taste and aroma is so overwhelming, I think I just have to throw out the two bottles I ordered!  Total bummer!  If you love Maggi, find an importer of German products rather than try and buy this version...

I'm actually gonna check out price comparisons now, I should honestly look at buying some maggi bulk from manufacturer. I've been using Maggi as a food enhancer since I can remember, it was on my parents parents tables, for example. Anyway, it's not like an every meal thing (not even every day), but yeah, I will never not want Maggi. Regardless, this gets 5 stars because it's Maggi. There is practically zero chance you will dislike it. Not at all an exaggeration or wives' tale: Every single person we've introduced to it has loved it and become a user.I think it's like crack.
This is just a great seasoning, it should be in everyones spice cabinate. Maggi Seasoning Sauce brings out more flavor in so many dishes and adds to so many more
best addition to eggs and salads on the planet........put into soups by the German chefs for years adds a nice touch to meals

column9: Perfect buy! I love this stuff. It gives any dish an Asian kick!
column10: This old seasoning sauce is one of the favs. You cant go wrong with it and I strongly encourage if you like soy you'll love this even better!

I use this all the time for a quick lunch. Try using 1/2 chicken stock & 1/2 water, add 1/2 can corn (drained) some protein (left over chicken is ideal), extra curry and it is a totally satisfying, stick-to-the-ribs lunch.

This may well be my favorite packaged lentil soup and is my favorite from Taste Adventures (I also like their Split Pea and their Black Bean).  I like the curry seasoning; the packaging is convenient; preparation is easy.  One package makes enough soup to serve as side dishes for two people or as the main course for one.  After preparation, the soup is delicious and has a nice thick consistency, almost like a vegetarian chili.  I usually enjoy it with grated cheese, a nice grainy bread and red wine.

column9: Great tasting, all natural, simple to make
column10: A great tasting lentil soup.  Easy to make--just boil water!  Add some grated cheese and a piece of bread and you have a full meal.  All natural ingredients as well.

If you are an on-the-go vegan you will appreciate this EASY, tasty, high protein, versatile soup. I buy it by the pound i eat it so much! if you add less water you get a sort of thick stew. Add vegetables and spices of your choice. I make it different everytime.

column9: You could do a water taste test and you'll always pick this over anything!
column10: I was introduced to this water by the owner and once I had it, I wouldn't trade it for anything else. If you don't believe me.... DO A TASTE TEST..  I'm willing to bet you'll always pick Aquahydrate over any other water out there!! I used to drink about a few of the 16oz bottles of regular water until I tried this... now I drink two liters of Aquahydrate. They also just re-launched this as well. Go to the website and find out where you can buy this locally to try, but I've always been very happy with my purchases on Amazon.

column9: Great pancakes and more, bravo Orgran.
column10: This is a very good substitute for real pancakes. I'm celiac and have tried some truly abysmal rice pancake mixes, but this buckwheat is wonderful. I make it with a pinch of salt and use buttermilk, and it's even more like Bisquick taste. On my first attempt and just mixing by guess it made a very respectable crepe by thinning with milk and a little International Delight cinnamon hazelnut coffee creamer. It's near impossible to burn, much more forgiving than wheat to extra heat. I can't imagine what the pan review was tasting but it wasn't this mix.

We use this mix with vanilla rice milk, and often add cinnamon and xylitol for sweetness to make the most delicious waffles you can imagine!  It's our Sunday treat, and love the gluten, dairy , dugar free aspect of this tasty stuff.  Keep it in good supply in your kitchen if you love waffles.

column9: powder goes up in the air
column10: i wasn't satisfied with this mix. What really bothered me is when I opened the bag and slowly emptied the flour into a bowl, it just let out a cloud of flour dust into the air while settling into the bowl. It was more airborne dust than I ever had to deal with from any flour! Also, this is a mix and though it says buckwheat, the mix contains less than 50% buckwheat flour, which to me is overpriced. it's more economical and healthy to buy a denser flour, and add your own baking powder and baking soda to it. The taste is okay but I added my own mashed bananas and pumpkin puree to the batter, for more nutrition and flavor.

The title for this review says it all.  Perhaps a better name for the product would be Bland Rice Pancake Mix with Traces of Buckwheat.  If I had wanted that much rice and other flour in a buckwheat product, I would have ordered a rice flour product.  If you love buckwheat, this is not for you.  BTW, I have 7 boxes of this mix available for sale...

When I could no longer find my favorite Buckwheat Pancake Mix (Orgran's) onany of the gluten free shelves of Whole Foods, Sun Harvest and the like,I luckily found it at Amazon.com and promptly ordered a case!!  I havebeen sharing boxes of it with relatives and friends, and of courseenjoying my own special mix of it with buttermilk, almond flavoring and whipped egg whites ----YUM!

column4: Silvia Bridger "Publisher of The Truth About ...
column10: This gluten-free pancake mix also makes great waffles.  Use vanilla rice milk and add cinnamon for a great dairy-free and gluten-free treat.

column9: Not at all whay I expected!
column10: It has been many years since I last tasted Buckwheat pancakes.  What I recall is a strong flavor of buckwheat.  I couldn't detect any unusual flavor is this mix!  It tasted "neutral"?  To be fair, the buckwheat flavor I remember may be limited to the brand I used years ago.  Perhaps the Orgran Stonemilled Buckwheat Pancake Mix is more normal?  I don't know - but I was disappointed with it.

column9: Orgran Stone Milled Buckwheatr Mix is Yuck!!!
column10: I am accustomed to a coarser grind in stone milled products. This stuff is like dust and tasteless. Buy Hodgson Mill and really enjoy old fashioned Byckwheat Pancakes!!! I don't work for or sell Hodgson.

My son is 5 and absolutely LOVES these apple/cherry pouches. We buy them in bulk, stick them in the fridge or freezer and take them just about everywhere we go - school, park, friend's houses. Great on-the-go! The organic ingredients are very important to me since both apples and cherries are on the Dirty Dozen list, and with organic cherries being so expensive this is a great way for my son to have them. And, I admit that I have eaten my fair share too :)He doesn't care that it's baby food (or maybe doesn't realize it), he loves them and I hear him tell his friends about them too, which is very cute. Great product packaging, easy to take with us and easy to open.
Perfectly spiced. Tangy without being overly sharp. The very best dijon grain mustard I have ever tasted. Puts Grey Poupon to shame.

This similac formula was just what our daughter needed.  She had been underweight at four months and the doctor recommended a high calorie formula.  She is now doing well and at the proper weight.  The company did a good job of shipping it to us as fast as possible, and responded promptly to my questions.

We have tried the mango and apple flavors, and prefer the tangier taste of the mango.  These fruit leathers are soft, sticky, and totally delicious.  The packaging colors/design look a little different in the pack we bought, but the essential size is the same.  At our store these cost 69 cents apiece, so ordering a box from Amazon.com is a deal (although then we eat a lot more of them too!).Nutrition info on the "mango sunrise" flavor we bought, each strip serving (14g) has:Calories: 45, Calories from Fat: 0zero fat/cholest/sodium/protein, 85mg potassium, 11g carbs, 1g fiber, 9g sugars, and offers 4% Vitamin C.All sugar comes naturally from fruit.  Diabetic/Diet Exchange:  1 Fruit.Ingredients:  Apple puree concentrate, mango puree concentrate, natural mango flavor, lemon juice concentrate.

column9: Very real but maybe just not my thing!
column10: I'm sure if people like sun-dried fruits they would really like this but i guess i was expecting something else so its kind of hard to give this a fair review....Its very flavorful, it tastes and feels very "fresh", it has an interesting texture and you can easily "fool" your eyes and stomach with this "healthy" treat!!

We eat these everyday around our house. A great alternative to fruit roll-ups. They are healthy and even my 1 year old loves them. They are sticky, but just carry some wet wipes when you feed them to them out in public.

I've been a Fruit Leather fan for a long time and it really pays to buy in bulk.  When these are on sale at our local grocery stores they're 50 cents each.  What a deal on Amazon with the current promo code!  I ordered 1 box of mango and 1 box of raspberry, and both were fresh (not old/hard/stale as some Amazon groceries can be). Yum!  Hopefully I can make these last longer than a week in our household!

column9: Mango is good, but the Cherry is better!
column10: Great snack, good source of vitamin C and Potassium. Much cheaper than in stores, much better than the standard supermarket "candy" type.

column9: Good, but not as tasty as some of the other flavors
column10: These are good, but I prefer the apricot, cherry, and grape flavors. The apple and mango are my least favorite. The quality of the product is great across the board, but I suggest trying these out individually before buying the box of 30.
These make for small sumptuous snacks in between meals or during work. The taste is good and it's not too sweet.

We've been geting Stretch Island fruit leathers for about 10 years and my kids love them and I don't have to feel guilty about letting them have them.  They accept them as genuine treats, not like the "healthy" treats you get from a health food store that taste like it's good for you.As for myself, I like them too. I'm not ordinarily a mango fan but I must say that I really do like the mango fruit leather

My whole family loves Stretch Island fruit leather! It makes a great snack for adults and kids alike! My two toddlers can't get enough of these, and I feel great giving them such a healthy snack. Mango is my favorite flavor of all, it is delicious! But honestly, all of the flavors are very tasty! Also, I love being able to purchase these on Amazon since we live in a small town that doesn't carry these anywhere. Thanks Amazon!!!

after seeing this at my daughter's home,i thought this would be a great treat for our son who runs long distance for a michigan college.  he aboslutely LOVES them.  he actually prefers this healthy and natural snack to any other candy like substance.  he went through 3 boxes-raspberry, strawberry and mango in one month...so looks like we'll be ordering more often!  Great for runners!

We've always loved the taste and getting it delivered to our door step for a great price from amazon makes it ideal.  I have two almost 4 yr olds who love this as a snack and so do I.  We subscribed this product for ourselves and another family member.
yum-yum-I share this with my co-workers and they love me.  It is a great pick me up in the mid afternoon too...  :-)

Of the fruit leathers, this is one of my preferred flavors.  I like the package of all one flavor so I don't have a multi-pack with less preferred-flavors like apple.  Compared to most dried mango, this has less flavor and tenderness, but because it is a dried puree, it is a different product and thus can't 100% be compared. I would give Philippine Brand dried mango five stars and this mango fruit leather four stars.  These fruit leathers come in single-serve packets, which, like all single-serve packets, are wasteful, so I try to use these when I need the packaging, such as on the go, in the pocket, camping, and travel.  They are very slim and can be tucked in anywhere.

I keep a few of these and the apple flavor at my desk at work.  These are a great mid-morning or mid-afternoon snack; sweet, but not too sweet, and the perfect size.  It's an added bonus that there's no added sugar.  The taste is great, though these are a bit stickier than other flavors.  I think sticky fingers is a small price to pay for a delicious, healthy snack.

Every time I eat one, I get into it like Jaws dragging his teeth onto fruit wood. The ingredients may be self-explanatory. It would be better if it was summer. Buy if you love or never had a real mango before.

Most excellent, except that I had the pleasure of a cherry one that was actually juicy out of the package, which led me to believe that all of the flavors could be the same. So it's not juicy in the pack but still tastes EXCELLENT!!!
My preschool age boys love this fruit leather for a quick snack and so do I. I feel so much better feeding them these than the character fruit snacks filled with chemicals.
My kids totally love these things. I like that they make a great snack when we're away from home and that they are all natural.

column9: Stretch Island Original Fruit Leather, Mango, 0.5 oz Bars (Pack of 30)
column10: Stretch Island Original Fruit Leather, Mango, 0.5 oz Bars (Pack of 30)  This was purchased for a family of 7. All 7 of us at various ages enjoyed this on kayaking trips and packed in lunches for 3 working in a foundry.  They are slender and easily fit into just about anything. The flavor of these mango bars was excellent and I was disappointed when I went to purchase them again and they were not readily available. I tried 3 more times that week when logging onto Amazon.com but they just were not available the second half of June.
Wonderful product that is all natural and no sugar is added! A very tasty treat your kids will love!
I love this product.  All healthy ingredients. Great price.  Not many things don't have added sugar of some type and still taste great.
I think this is really good if you like Mago, which I do.  I will buy more of them in the future.
These are pretty tasty, but are small and expensive. For an average adult, you need 2 or 3 just to feel like you ate somthing.
Amazing flavor! This is my family's favorite flavor. Fruit leathers are a convenient and healthy treat or on the go snack.

I really love these things. Prior to tasting the Green Apple ones, these were by far my faves. Anyway, they still rank second for fruit leather snacks, and pretty much second for snacks overall in my book. Very bright mango flavor, just the right size for a quick snack or pick me up, and very inexpensive. A definite winner. Enjoy!
I liked these, but I bought them for my kids' lunches and they did not like them.

definitely not a fruit roll up and definitely leathery. I like to nibble on it to stave off my hunger. if you are looking for a quick fruity snack, you're looking at the right product. p.s. i bought mango
tastes like plastic! Tastes nothing like mango at all. Its lightly flavored..not sure what it tastes like. but its pretty flavor-less.I wouldn't recommend this flavor.
We love fruit leather, but this is almost impossible to eat it is so tough.  My kids can't even eat it.  I will not buy this brand again.

Can't say that I like this soup. Can't say that I dislike it. It's kind of a culinary non-event.  There just isn't any flavor to it to speak of other than potato.  It's a good base though if you want to dress it up by adding more broccoli,cheese, or a little chicken stock.
campbell's soup usually taste very good, but this one is exceptional.  This soup taste terrible. can't believe it's from campbell.

The first shipment of Campbell's Select Potato Broccoli Cheese soup package arrived safely, and I could enjoy the soup I like that rarely is in stock at the local grocery story. I would give that shipment 5 stars.BUT the second shipment, received a few days ago, was in very poor condition. Most of the cans were bent inward, so I am wary if they are safe to eat or not.Can replacements be obtained?
I enjoy spicy seasoning, but there was way-too much salt in it! You'll be drinking water all night!
Pros: Delicious on just about everything. Seller shipped quickly.Con: Outrageous shipping costs. In order to justify it I ordered several shakers.

column9: How could this be so good?
column10: ingrediants from cajunsupermarket.com were:Ingredients: Salt, Red Pepper, Black Pepper and Garlic. NO MSG.How could this be so good? Sounds like too much salt.

column9: I love it. The best stuff out there
column10: I've been using this for over 5 yrs and wont try anything else. Ever since I tried other stuff, I keep coming back to this one.  I also get the HOT and use it in conjunction with this one.  Or the hot one in Chili is great.  Im a guy so not sure of women will like it this way but i use it on my steamed veggies, meats and even sometimes eggs when I want a kick.  For Split Chicken Breast with skin, I powder the top with this and a little of the Hot Version and make big slices in the meat so it can seep in.  Then back for 45-50 min at 375.  Good stuff!!
This seasoning is great! My family uses it on everything, veggies, pork, chicken, steak, potatoes!Bought extra for friends and they love it too. Big fans!thanks

Awesome combination of "salt, red pepper, black pepper and garlic"... Do we really need to have someone mix it for us and charge us $6-$12 bucks... I have some cheap property for sale if you like swamps!
Use this for chicken, fish, steak...u name it!On fired rice, salads or any other dish you like, it will add a lot of good flavor to it. And the price is very good. Thx amazon
Loved the product on almost everything even fruit,  try the dip on the back I take it to all the partys!
Love it! I put it on most everything. From pizzas to spaghetti to eggs. There are at least 87 foods you can put this on. I ran out once... I dont plan on that happening again

column9: Slap Ya Mama wakes up flavor
column10: Excellent seasoning for anything you want to add zest to the flavor.  Makes ordinary foods receive extra taste.  Highly recommend trying Slap Ya Mama seasonings - not too hot, just right...

I had this at a local Christian Men's Fish Fry seminar. Had to find out what it was that made the fish taste so wonderful. The cook told me his secret and where to get it and I ordered it. I did just recently find it in a local grocery store.
I love this stuff. We use it on just about everything eggs, chicken, pork even popcorn.It even adds sizzle to vegetables. Shipped fast and on time. Product was as described.

I found this on my trip to NOLA for my bachelorette party :)  I was shopping around for some souvenirs and found this at one of the shops.  My only regret is not having grabbed more.  I only purchased one.  I sprinkle SYM on pork chops and chicken... my oh my, delicious!  My husband and I love it!  I haven't tried the spicy version, but soon will.  Being Mexican, I love my heat and spice!  I'm happy I found SYM on Amazon.  I had told my husband I was going to have to make a trip to NOLA again just so I can replenish my pantry :)

column9: It is Seasoning It is Good
column10: My son's sprinkle this on just about everything.  Steaks, Eggs, Chicken, and many other things that you would use salt and or pepper on.  My favorite is French Fries.  Enjoy!

I bought this seasoning at a New Orleans cooking school and splashed and dashed it on everything until my container went dry.  I am so glad to find a source for this as I have not seen it in any of our local stores.  This has just the right amount of spice to add a dash of heat and flavor, with the hot version I had to be very careful to not sprinkle too much but this version is more forgiving. It does have salt, I just add a few shakes for flavor and adjust my salt seasoning accordingly.  The flavors are well balanced and give more interest than just adding red pepper or cayenne.

I love this seasoning! It tastes delicious on just about everything. I recommend not adding salt to anything you are seasoning, because this already has quite a bit of it. Try the Slap Ya Mama Cajun Seasoning White Pepper Blend too.
This is the best seasoning i have ever purchased and i will be using it as long as it is available.

OMG!  This stuff is the best!I first tried it after my mom told me about it.  She learned of it from my brother's girlfriend who is from Louisianna (or at least lived there at some time, I think).  It is really such a great spice with a little bit of a kick but not enough to floor you.  It has a great flavor.  Some "hot" spices just burn but don't have much of a flavor.  Or, they are kind of sour tasting (too much citrus, maybe?).  This "Slap ya Mama" is really good.  We love it!

I bought this for my boyfriend's birthday along with a ton of other seasonings and hot sauces. He is very into spicey foods and informed me that this was his favorite and it's actually got him cooking. Woohoo!

Best price available anywhere for this quantity of wild rice, but I find that the rice has an odd taste.  Kind of musty and unpleasant.  I had been using Lundberg wild rice up until now, and never experienced this issue of odd taste.

column9: Great inexpensive option for having good wild rice on hand
column10: This is good, tasty wild rice.  No grit.  It's great to always have wild rice on hand.  Our usual easy use is to follow Alton Brown's instructions for baking brown rice, replacing 1/2 cup of brown rice with this wild rice.  Wonderful and easy.

column9: Great taste and easy to make
column10: We eat a lot of wild ride and use in soups as well.  This is true MN Wild Rice that has great flavor, taste and very good for you.

column9: A Whole different type of licorice
column10: I still like the Darrell Lea licorice, but this is so much softer than the Darrell Lea.  If I had to choose it would be hard to. I recommend this as it is raspberry and not that flavor isn't available in the Darrell Lea brand.  Delicious.....But I must say that the Darrell Lea is a better bargain w/ twelve 7 oz. bags as opposed to the four 10 oz. you get from RJ's.

Now that I have found nirvana in the form of red licorice, there is no reason to keep trying other brands.  The texture is completely satisfying, the way the log gives way to soft chewy goodness, the way the hint of slightly sour essence of pure raspberry rises to the top.  Unlike other high end licorice I've tried, there are no artificial colors like Kookaburra, and the texture is so much more RIGHT than Panda (which has more of a sticky wheat-type texture and less berry flavor).  I'm sold on this form of life pleasure.
4 stars because i feel it is lacking 'substance'. It feels a bit like eating hard raspberry jam. It is still a tasty treat but the black liquorice from RJs is far superior in my opinion.
This Licorice has actual licorice extract, unlike many other brands that are full of sugar and artificial flavors.  Good stuff!
Nice, soft, chewy licorice! This licorice beats Twizzlers hands down. I was skeptical at first, but now I'm a convert - RJs all the way.
This is my favorite brand and flavor of licorice.  Neither the raspberry or the licorice overpowers the flavor and actually compliment each other quite well.
I absolutely HATE raspberry licorice but this taste more like a raspberry gummy bear. It is fantastic. I'm glad I bought it for a friend and tried it so now I will be buying it for myself.
This arrived with the pieces not sticking together which is nice.This licorice has a unique texture and taste, which is yummy.This is real licorice and not some anise flavored sugar concoction.

This licorice is really addictive, it has a really great taste and texture. It is suitable for vegetarians and vegans and in moderation is a healthy snack. The only problem: it is impossible to stop eating it!

column9: Bland and no match for the black
column10: We tried this based on how much we loved RJ's black licorice, but even my wife, who is a big red licorice fan, was disappointed with this red version.  We found it bland and lacking in flavor, and without the wonderful consistency that the black has.
MY PROBLEM WITH THIS LICORICE IS YOU CAN'T STOP EATING IT, IT IS ABSOLUTELY THE BEST I HAVE PURCHASED. IT IS EXPENSIVE, BUT IS WELL WORTH TRYING IT.

column9: Please get this back in stock.....
column10: I ordered this awhile back and just gave it as two gifts to different people....THEY ARE CLAMORING FOR MORE.....So being the good friend I am, I returned to the scene of the crime to place further orders only to discover it is not currently available and amazon.com can't say when or if it will be....boo hooo......Please just know that everyone who indulged, actually was raving about the flavor, texture and freshness....they ALL LOVED IT....

I've come to really appreciate good gourmet licorice recently, including Lucky Country, Darrell Lea, and I'm awaiting a shipment of Kookaburra licorice right now. I received these today and I couldn't be more disappointed with the product. For starters, this licorice isn't soft, and it's quite sticky, which of course leaves my fingers sticky and messy after eating them. This would be excusable if the taste was good, but these just taste horrendous. The best way I can describe it is if someone were to spray raspberry scented perfume on some wax, roll it up into a log and put it in a bag. Needless to say, I won't be buying again, ever. After trying other delicious brands of licorice from abroad, I never thought I would say this, but Twizzlers taste better than these things.

I adore their black, and since the store was out, I bought some of this. Ugh. I tried it, then I kept eating since I paid money for it, until finally I just couldn't finish it, and it sits in my pantry. I think I will throw it away today.

I actually looked for this brand of truffle oil because I had a little sampler from a friend that blew me away.  Not only did I find it, I found it in a box of six.  I add this too all my salads, meats and pasta with great joy--definitely adds to the cafeteria food they serve in Afghanistan.  My war time meals are "molto bene" thanks to this amazing oil.

I primarily bought this gum (and some other Orbit gums) here on Amazon because the local stores are hit and miss, but also, it's slightly cheaper to buy it in bulk here.But seriously, IMO, this is the best sugarfree gum I've ever had. It's like an injection of minty ice. All my tastebuds are on high alert. I once had a subway sandwich with tons of jalapenos after chewing this stuff and it burned like mad when usually, spicy is no big deal whatsoever. Also, ice water, after chewing this stuff, is painful. The crystal thingies are the bomb.Anywho, yeah, good gum, try some at a gas station first if you're not sure.
I started buying it on Amazon because it got hard to get at my local big box store.  I'm glad they carry it, even if it is a couple bucks more than the big box store price.

I love this gum, but it's getting harder to find in most brick and mortar stores.  Of course, Amazon has it!  Good stuff.  Orbit changed the formula on their standard peppermint gum a while ago - the peppermint mist gum tastes more like the original.
This is a really nice product. The service was great! The item arrived promptly in the condition advertised at the site. I am happy with this purchase, and would shop here again.
It's hard to find this in all stores.  I skipped (one) of the middle men and just bought it online.  I love it!

I tried the fact that I frequent sufferer of dry mouth at mid morning to all way to night. It just doesn't last long, I felt like I chewing rubber at some point. Flavor vanished and fact that gum lost its chewy texture? I not sure what else you call that? SO I stopped chewing this gum. Looking for mints now.
Fabulous taste and easy to carry in your purse for a teensy (3 calories each) treat! First found them in one of JFK International's gift shops.

column9: Love Bob's Red Mill Hulled Hemp Seed
column10: I began using Bob's Red Mill Hulled Hemp Seed several months ago for the added omega and protein.  I had changed my diet, or I would rather call it a lifestyle, and continue to eat mostly steamed veggies and fresh fruits.  I add the hemp seed to my fruit and it is especially good with oatmeal and salads.  It can also be added to baked goods and most anything you are cooking.  I love the nutty texture and flavor it adds to foods.I have tried other brands, but prefer Bob's Red Mill Hulled Hemp Seed.  I have purchased it at health food stores, but found it was so much easier and less expensive to order online.  As recommended it can be stored in the refrigerator or freezer, so I buy a case at a time.Enjoy healthy eating!

We use this product each morning at breakfast time as an added source of essential Omega 3 and 6 along with helpful amino acids.  The supplier through Amazon provided easy ording process, saving us a trip to the local Health Food CO-OP.  Our order arrived in excellent shape and well before the anticipated delivery date.  The supplier's price is very competative compared to local venders.

I BOUGHT THESE YESTERDAY AT MY LOCAL HEALTH STORE AND COULDN'T WAIT TO GET HOME AND TRY THEM. THEY ARE VERY TINY PIECES OF CREAMY,NUTTY GOODNESS.I COULD HAVE ATE A WHOLE BAG ,BUT GIVEN THERE ARE 6 GRAMS OF GOOD FATS,I THOUGHT I OUGHT TO REFRAIN MYSELF.IF YOU HAVEN'T TRIED THESE AND HAVE WANTED TO,PLEASE DO,YOU WILL LOVE THEM.

column9: By far the best Hemp seed I have tried!!
column10: I have been using Hemp Seeds for many months now and have tried several of the top brands for same on Amazon and in the health stores.  Each and every one had small hard pieces or hull pieces in the packages.  Bob's however is by far the best as none of that is in this product.  It tastes great and I wouldn't think of ever purchasing another brand. Yes it is a little more expensive but it is worth it if you don't like eating those hull and hard pieces of whatever is included in the others.Enjoy and try this one.

column9: Bob's Red Mill Hulled Hemp Seed
column10: Bob's Red Mill Hulled Hemp Seed, 12-Ounce Bags (Pack of 4)Excellent product.  Has a nutty flavor and is very nutritious.

This Coffee Sampler has been helpful to find some coffee flavors, which I would not have ben detected on my own. It will help me to decide, which flavors in larger packs I will order in the futuer. It is entertaining to try coffee with such differences in aroma.

Wonderful selection of coffee!!! One of the things we love most about our Keurig is always being able to try different types of coffee. I saw this, and decided to try it out! It came in a pretty package that was't damaged at all, and it arrived very quickly! Will be ordering again!
Thoroughly enjoyed but, when I tried to send same to a friend...it was no longer available! Shame. Should be put back on your list.

column9: Would buy again, but not for a gift.
column10: I really enjoyed this selection of k cups for my new Keurig. There was a really nice variety and I received one of at least every kind that was featured. Overall, the selection was great. However, I am glad that I did not purchase this item as a gift because the "gift box" looked almost as if an animal had ravaged it. It was torn in multiple places and basically falling apart. If I was giving this as a gift I would have had no choice but to re-package it. I would definitely buy this again for my own use, but would be cautious if buying it as a gift, especially if I were having it sent directly.

column9: Amazon's proce is double than in grocery store
column10: I discoved this drink two weeks ago at a truck stop on my return home from Virginia. A cool can from their refrigerated diaplay cost $2.49. I liked the flavor and kick from the Starbucks Doubleshot Energy Plus Coffee drink and the Starbucks Doubleshot Energy Plus Mocha & Vanilla flavors, also $2.49 a can. I couldn't find either type in the local grocery store, so I automatically began my Amazon.com order then, right before I checked out, read the customer reviews from the other Amazon sites about the high price Amazon was charging $79.95 for a 12 pack of the Starbucks Doubleshop Energy Plus drink as well as $59.95. I checked with my local Walmart grocery store, and bought both kinds for $2.50 a 15 oz can which comes to only $30.00 for 12 cans.  I am very disappointed that Amazon.com is charging in excess for this product and will definitely do some comparative price shopping in the future before I automatically shop at Amazon.com.

I buy these Starbuck drinks daily at my local quick store at $1.99 a can. I as well found this price to be way too expensive and researched it and found it to be the same size can that I was paying half the price. I hope customers are not purchasing this from them in a 12 pack bulk which is normally sold in bulk for a cheaper price because at my local store I can purchase for under two bucks.

I've been using the Beef & Broccoli packets for years.  It's so easy to mix with water and soy sauce.  Our favorite recipe is to replace the beef with SHRIMP!!! Super delicious.

column9: Fast and easy, if a bit bland
column10: Unlike the Sun-Bird Sweet and Sour Seasoning Mix, the Sun-Bird Beef and Broccoli Seasoning makes for a quick dinner.  I used a whole head of broccoli and chopped it myself; using packaged cut-up broccoli would make it even faster.  I used round steak, popped it in the freezer for a few minutes to make slicing easier, and even with broccoli and onion prep, the whole dinner took twenty minutes.There are only four components to the beef and broccoli dish--beef, broccoli, a chopped up onion and the sauce.  You combine the sauce mix with two tablespoons of soy sauce and water.  Even though I used a whisk, there were hunks of cornstarch in the liquid. I let the mixture sit for fifteen minutes, and the clumps went away though the mixture separated and had to be restirred.  Stir frying the beef, broccoli and onion was fast and easy and the sauce took only a few minutes to reduce.  The finished dish was OK, but pretty bland, and I added a little steak sauce for flavor, which helped a lot.  Catsup would also be a good addition, if not traditional.Consumers on low sodium diets and low fat diets should realize that the nutritional information on the package does not take into account the two tablespoons of soy sauce the recipe requires, nor the oil for the stir frying.  I suspect the predominant ingredient in the mix is cornstarch, though the balance of flavors is pleasant.  My experience with this mix was much better than the Sweet and Sour Seasoning, and I'd probably purchase this one again.

I tried this sauce on a whim, when I saw it in Whole Foods Market. It had a local label and I'm all 'gung ho' for trying out products made locally. I wasn't sure what to expect so I tasted a little bit before mixing it with my other ingredients, and was initially surprised that it truly tasted like its name as well as very authentic. But boy was I surprised after I used this with a stuffed shells recipe and really tasted the flavors! The flavoring of the herbs in the sauce were simply robust and just delicious, complimenting my other ingredients extremely well. I vowed never to buy commercial pasta sauces ever again, but this certainly changed my mind. This is very close to making a sauce from scratch, in my opinion. If you're skeptical, I would suggest buying a jar from your local health food store before buying in bulk...you won't regret it!
I can't believe that something this tasty is 0 sugar!  I tried w/ H20, diet 7up, and seltzer.  Better that full sugar soda!!

Really refreshing and different!  A small bit goes a long way! I mix with seltzer to make a refreshing sparkling drink that's better than sweetened soft drinks! I am tired of how everything in America is made super sour with more and more citric acid, but this syrup is very naturally pomegranate-tasting with balanced sweetness and tartness. Fantastic!

I thought I would try this and hope upon hope it might taste good.  Well It was "GREAT" not good.  I could not believe it was sugar free.  I received the product in record time and could not believe it even looked good.
This is a very good canned food. It is rated a 5 star on the Dog Food Advisory website. My dogs love it.

The Beef flavor are just as wonderful-really anything from Merrick is great.Make your dog happy and try these treats!  They're my dog's absolute favorite.  :)

column10: I bought these Merrick Lamb Training Treats from my local petco. I gave them to all three of my dogs and one threw up. I thought it was odd since he had never thrown up before. I ordered Lemon Blossom tea, but I received Stash MEYER Lemon Blossom tea. This is a very different product and I do not like it as much as the Lemon Blossom.

I brewed this tea as hot tea, letting it steep for 5 -7 minutes.  I did it two 1/2 gallons - one at a time with the same tea bag.  Then I refrigerated it overnight. There was no cloudiness and the tea is nice and strong with no bitter after taste.  Everyone who tries it, loves it.

The tea bags make a very nice raspberry flavored tea, however there is a lingering flavor that reminds me of a slightly fermented older tea.  While nice red color and raspberry flavor, do not make stronger than recommendation of 1 tea bag per gallon.  Will not buy again do to the fermented taste.

This tea is much more bitter than other Stash black teas. I brew using the "moon brew" method, leaving the bag in the pitcher in the fridge overnight. I use a 4 quart pitcher so it is not an issue of too little water. I recommend brewing for less than 5 hours to ensure less bitterness.

I love sugar-free red bull. I hate being sugared up, but really need the caffeine.

column9: Total Zero Tastes Different Than Sugar Free - Don't Like
column10: I highly recommend you buy a single can of the new "Total Zero" version of Red Bull before you buy a case of Total Zero. wow.. now I dont need to take a red bull before I go to the store to have the energy to lug it home.Amazon will ship it for free. I looks like they lowered the price on it !

column10: I love sugar free Red Bull and it's the only kind I drink. Go just about anywhere else and you'll see this price is a joke.

column10: These are some of the best tasting turkey jerky I have come across.
