My daughter loves these!  I know the box says toddler, but like the previous reviewer said, there is little difference between these and the baby variety.  These might be slightly thicker and they are a round.  I love Mum Mums.  Such a great alternative to Wagon Wheels and Biter Biscuits, which can be a choking hazard.  And the previous reviewer who calls these "expensive" needs to learn to read, or at least, read more carefully before leaving a review.  There are 6 boxes in this pack.  They sell for about $3.50 per box in the store, so it's not a bad deal at $18 for a 6 pack.

My daughter loves the "Mum Mum" snacks! My little girls favorite is the vegtable! For those individuals who are not wanting to buy them because they are made in China.... Well, its made from rice..... If you feed your baby any product with rice in it where do you think it originated?

column9: Page fails to mention box recommends for 2 years and older
column10: Infant son really likes the basic Mum-Mums so I thought I'd give these a shot.  After opening the package I noticed that they say for 2 years and older.  Unfortunately our son is only 9 months old and these will expire in Sept. 2011.  Also found out that these items are not eligable for return.  Disappointed that the recommended age is not included in the product details by Amazon.
I am vegitarian and apparently its egg-free but decided to add gelatin...how hard is it to make simple cookie/cracker without adding the animal crap to it?

column9: Organic Chinese Product too Sweet to Believe
column10: I tasted these before giving them to my kids and the strawberry flavor is very sweet.  I couldn't believe it was this sweet by using natural/organic sugars (and not pushing the calorie count up).  I have not had these tested by a lab or anything like that, but I found these "too good to be true" to give them to my kids.

Are you serious folks? From the country that sells us poisoned pet food, lead filled products for children? I am not being presumptuous here. There is too much info out there that we should be VERY skittish even for the most innocent seeming products. AND...ORGANIC!? FROM CHINA!? Sorry, not possible. That country is THE MOST POLLUTED TOXIC DUMP. Saw a documentary on this on PBS. A pretty reliable source that cares about our kids, the environment and able to tell the truth. So, this might be the best thing out there for some, but not this Mom. Do your research, don't risk your precious children.

These are made in China, the country that sent the U.S. tainted raw ingredients which killed at least 149 people (ingredients for Heparin, a blood thinner medication).  China also exported pet food to the US that killed many pets.  Amazon did not include the "Country of Origin" listing for this product, but I read the box after I brought it home for my daughter and then threw them away.
Unless this is a mis-print or I read it wrong, they are charging $18 per box...Walmart and other stores sell them for less than $3 a Box!!!

I tried this after reading the ingredients which include sweet agave, and an anti-oxidant extracted from "Porphyra yezoensis Ueda", a type of seaweed commonly made into seaweed crackers or "nori", and l-carnitine.The effect was noticeable and with a quick onset, but without the increased blood pressure normally associated with stronger energy drinks.The flavor is excellent with no hint of bitterness.

I love Harney & Sons, their Hot Cinammon spice and Chamomile is my favorite.This one was nice and bold, but not for me.  I had to add alot of sugar and it tasted a little burnt/bitter/off for me.Smells good though.
didn't really care many of the cakes at all. not up to normal standing for wilton yearbooks of the past. the best cake is on the cover.

column9: A must have every July for cake freaks
column10: I love every summer when the next year book comes out so that I can see next ideas. I don't use all of htem but great for ideaas for upcoming parties

column9: about 10% of 2 different orders of this brand, arrived damaged
column10: I ordered a large shipment of these and out of 40-odd bags, 15 were punctured, not sealed, and un usable... I also tried the other brand (in the silver mylar bag) which you see on Amazon, and it seems to have a higher quality of workmanship (no unsealed bags from them)!

I use these pods with my Senseo, and the coffee is delicious!  I had never even heard of Senseo until I went to Barcelona, and my flat had one.  As soon as I got home, I purchased one from Amazon, and then began experimenting with different brands of coffee pods.  Without doubt, Wolfgang Puck's is the best so far, and Caramel Cream is my favorite flavor.

Wolfgang Puck Coffee Caramel Cream Pods, 18-Count Pods (Pack of 3)For the past 5 years we've used Senseo coffee pods.  To our great dismay they have been discontinued.  Fortunately the pods by Wolfgang Puck are an exact match for our one cup brewer as well.  This is the 4th batch I've ordered and honestly couldn't be happier.

column9: Similar to Senseo's Paris French Vanilla, just not as good
column10: You may be able to tell from the title for this review that I enjoy Senseo's Paris French Vanilla coffee pods.  I decided to try Wolfgang Puck's caramel creme in my Hamilton Beach 1 cup pod brewer because the Senseo brand has been unavailable for quite some time. Unfortunately, Wolfgang Puck's version is not as good.If you prefer a strong cup of coffee this brand will most likely not satisfy you.  Also, the Hamilton Beach Pod Brewer does not make the crema layer that a lot of people seem to like, so I don't know if this brand will do that well or not.  I drink my coffee weak -- not super strong -- but also not watery.  My daily one cup of coffee is a treat I allow myself and I enjoy the French Vanilla and Caramel flavored coffees. Also, I use a smaller coffee mug (it holds at most 8 ounces comfortably) so I don't need a lot of coffee but this stuff is extremely weak (even for me) and I have to be sure to use **no more than** 6 ounces of water with this brand, otherwise it is just too weak and watery to be palatable.  Again, if you use a different pod brewer you may get different results.I've also tried Wolfgang Puck's French Vanilla flavored coffee pods, but I find that flavor to brew up even more weak and watery than this does and it has a very "acidy" aftertaste which aggravates my heartburn -- I have not had that problem with this flavor (Caramel Creme.)If you want a larger, stronger cup of flavored coffee, you might be able to make this work better for you by using 2 pods with 12 ounces of water (the maximum amount for the HB Pod brewer); it just hasn't worked out for me.  Using 12 ounces of water and 2 pods seems to more than double the strength of the coffee and it comes out stronger than I like.  Also, I really only want 1 cup of coffee for my morning "ritual" so the rest is just wasted.

column9: Strong, but makes the best cup of tea
column10: Ok, this mint is very strong. I got these for desk candy and got very polarized reviews from customers. Some loved them, but most seemed to prefer mints that were just mostly colored sugar. Why 5 stars for me? I put one in a hot cup of tea and WOW! Mind you it is being diluted in about 10 ounces, but the pure mint really gives a cup of tea a refreshing coolness. I will keep getting them for this alone.

These mints are great. Small size (1/2 - 5/8"). I bought them to use in wedding favors instead of the boring old buttermints. They are very tasty. Not artificial sweetener taste. They are natural. Not too strong either, which is good because I hate mints that burn my tongue. I love the fact that I can pronounce all of the things on the ingredients list! Highly reccomended to anyone who likes mints or maybe wants some for an occasion like a wedding!

Think the taste of an Altoid mint with the consistency of Brach's Starlight mints (drops are 3/4 the size of Starlight)...and no questionable ingredients. These mints are a staple in my home and purse.

Yummy Earth Organic Candy. The best peppermint candy I have ever tasted. Refreshing taste that lingers in your mouth even after the candy is gone. Everyone that I have shared the candy with love the fresh peppermint taste. This one is a keeper.
This candy is the best.  Because of what's not in it, it's so refreshing and tasty.  It's even good for a stuffy nose and it soothing to a sore throat.

These are great mints.  I love starlight mints, but I am trying to be more responsible about what I eat. These have the flavor of a strong mint like an Altoid, and a hard candy texture like starlight mints.  These are great for a mint lover who wants to be more responsible with what they eat, or has alergies to certain food things.
These are great tasting, long lasting, strong flavored mints.  My family and I love them and will be back for more.

column9: Keep your kids away from this.....Same as any industry hard Candy
column10: These are not flavors derived from natural fruits....they are flavor industry created chemicals that can be called "natural" only because of the very very lose definition the FDA allows for flavorings. These candy's are as bad for you and your kids as is any other hard candy. These guys are just a fraud or just so stupid that they just don't understand what they are doing. In either case you are better off just giving your kids some real organic fruit and keeping them from acquiring a taste for this type of trash!

I love these little peppermint drops.  They have a rich peppermint taste that commercial peppermint candy don't offer, plus they are low in calories but big in taste.  I buy them by the big bags to always have them on hand (I don't eat any other candy) and when I am running low, I go ahead and reorder/restock so I never have to run out.
I love these mints.  I carry them with me in my purse for a quick snack or breath freshener.  However, be warned that they have a very strong mint flavor...too much for my husband.
Product was shipped timely.  And the Peppermint flavor is good and strong.Will buy again.

I used to buy Brach's starlight mints all the time.  Because of the red dye and H/F corn syrup, I decided to look other places for a good mint.  I bought the 4 16 oz bags for $20.  I like them a lot.  Since I am trained on the starlights, it will take awhile to get used to these mints...but I know I will. Very, VERY minty.  Buy 'em.  No undesirable ingredients.

YummyEarth Organic Candy Drops, Wild Peppermint, 16-Ounce Bags (Pack of 4) are pretty good according to my loyal mother. She claims they even help her to breathe better but that point is debatable. At one time she had me believing that cough drops were good for her overall breathing but I came to find out that what she really likes is hard candy in any form or shape. I conducted a brief experiment with her: I bought her a large bag of regular candy, like 20 lbs of variety type candy, and stopped giving her cough drops. Well, it seems that what she mostly wanted was hard candy in her mouth and she never once asked me for the cough drops while she had this sizable bag available. At her age and according to her doctor she should get away with almost anything so I did not sweat the situation. Her dental work is, of course, expensive for she is addicted to sugar in the form of hard candy. Getting back on track: while she was enjoying YummyEarth Organic Candy Drops, Wild Peppermint, 16-Ounce Bags (Pack of 4) she praised them daily. I liked the amount on each bag and the many kind and encouraging reviews I found prior to purchasing this item. 4 Stars and when the faithful bag of candy disappears in time record I will give her the last two, which I am sure she will go back to endorsing the healthy properties of this cough drop, wild peppermint and all!
These candies by Yummy Earth are absolutely fantastic!!!!  I have multiple food allergies, and it is one candy that I can have, with an extra plus that it is organic.

I bought this when I was reading that it lowered blood pressure, which is a good thing! Bad thing was trying to actually drink it. Gag reflex wont allow you to swallow. For cooking applications this would be great.
This product came quickly and is a great buy for the money. One caveat though is that it is packed rock hard and difficult to dispense but, as the price is right, I'll continue to buy it.
if Amazon has all the suppliers like this, customer would not worry about getting their order in time.I think the quality of this product was good that's why I ordered more than one time.

column9: You can't trust the site. They will change the price after ordering.
column10: I placed an order and had the confirmation. It was cancelled. They said they no longer had it. I was directed to the site again. The price for the product went from $25 to $140. I wouldn't order from them again.

Got 4 10-packs of these for $6 during a manager's special.  Product arrived, had leaked out of the packages, and what hadn't leaked was sort of congealed, coagulated and crystalized.  Not sure if this stuff can go bad, but I wasn't taking the chance!  Sounds like it would be tasty, but avoid buying these from Amazon.  Hope you have better luck than I did if you decide to try them!
Wow! A chunk of heavily processed meat in a plastic bag for only $23 a pound. Who could pass that up? Me, for one.

column9: Delicious, my favorite brand of tulsi
column10: This is plain tulsi, but it's anything but plain. The sweet and spicy basil flavors make a well rounded cup of relaxing tea. Drink everyday for a build-up relaxing effect.

I love peppermint and mint in all of it's forms - but this is a really nice light peppermint, delicious and refreshing.  It's not strong enough that using honey would clash flavors, works perfectly with all sweeteners or no sweetener at all.I like how strong and high quality these teas are. :)

I have used this item about three times since I purchased it and used them to write on fondant that has been dried a day or more.  This product is excellent so far.  It has a medium tip and writes well.  I would definitely purchase again.Update...have been using these markers for 2-years and still going strong. LOVE them!! The tip is still as precise as the first day and enable me to do amazing detail work.Originally I stated that I waited for the fondant to dry a day or more, which is still true. However, if you are decorating fondant that has been rolled fairly thin, you can decorate within 10-15 minutes with the marker on a normal (not humid) day.
Great vibrant colors, easy to use and the tips are very sturdy too and hold up to the abuse of being used on sugar cookies.I love these!
Great product!!!  Fine tip for details, but can also fill-in large areas.  Would definitely buy again.

I bought these because I was hosting a baby shower for my sister. My daughter, my daughter's friend and I were making cake pops for the event.  I bought these because they were the least expensive and I thought that they would be comparable to other name brands.  edible pens are edible pens, right?  Wrong! We made 60 baby themed cake pops and we needed these pens to draw the eyes, hair and cheeks on the "babies."  My daughter and her friend were practically cursing these pens before the night was over.  The black marker held up a little better that the rest, but the other colors were not good at all.  They smeared everywhere after a while.  The tips were not the best.  It was almost like they could not handle the interaction with the chocolate.  They got the job done, but barely.  Next time, I would add a little money to my purchase and get the Americolor Food Marker Writers- 10 Color Pack.  I have heard nothing but good things about these pens, and plus they are the ones that Bakerella uses and recommends on her cake pops. :)

First of all I'd like to say Ateco is Americolor.  I wanted to buy Americolor and thought I had purchased the wrong ones but they're the same the markers say Americolor though the package says Ateco.  Using these markers to write on candy coating.  Initially I was upset with these markers when I took my candy coatings in from the cold and started to write, the ink beaded up and didn't stay on.  I could easily wipe it away with paper towel.  I realized later if may have been condensation from the cold.  So I tried again... AND IT WORK!!!  Not easily though but it does work as your writing some of the coating comes off and on to your marker so have a paper towel near by to wipe marker tip.  Will post later of my snowman brownie pops.

I haven't used this product too much yet, but I got it to write on candy melts.  The wilton brand I bought before was horrible.  These are so much better.  For writing on candy melts, get this product, not the wilton food writers.

These worked pretty well for what I needed them for (drawing on fondant). I did find that I had to press very lightly, and keep the fondant very cold, or the markers would punch holes in it. But overall I am pleased with the product.

My son being a hard core Mario Bros. Fan, I had to make him a cake because no one makes one with that theme. I pretty much color all the characters like they were on a level with the castle and stairs at the end all in fondant and everyone loved it.
Fine point worked great on our first try at Cake Ball Pops.  Product lets my 14 yr old be very creative.

These look and act just like real markers. Made decorating my son's cake so much easier. The only downfall is that, just like markers, it shows the individual coloring lines. Considering I was recreating a video game character, I didn't care too much. Very happy

I used these to add detail to fondant on my son's Mario birthday cake; question marks, coin marks, brick mortar, dress details for Peach, etc.  They worked brilliantly,  Now I only wish I had more birthday cakes to make, these were fun to play with.
These markers are so easy to use and perfect for adding that extra touch to any smooth food surface.  Excellent for stenciling/lettering.

These have worked well for me for cookie decorating. I haven't tried them on anything else yet. Maybe bento lunches in the future. The black one doesn't seem to work as well as the other colors I've used. It's a bit "dry" I guess, but it came that way. Red looks great, really truly red.Really great for cookie decorating. I use them all the time.

I bought these to write on candy coated cake pops for valentines day. The red pen made it through about a dozen hearts and then the tip started to break down so the writing got really slopping. After a few sloppy hearts, the ink started to dry up. I wouldn't buy this again.

column9: Great Coffee at a great price
column10: I moved from Northern California to the Ozark Mountains of northern Arkansas. I can get Starbucks at the nearby grocery stores or more expensive "gourmet" coffees, but that's about it. I have been on the lookout for robust,full flavored whole bean coffees at reasonable prices. I tried Pete's espresso blend and liked it, but it wasn't available the last time I checked. So I tried this Fogbuster and I like it even more. Good thing, since it comes in a 5 lb. bag. If you like Starbucks French Roast, this compares quite favorably.
Fogbuster is excellent for a dark roast, and the 5lb.bag is a great value.  If you're looking for something mild, I'd suggest Jeremiah's espresso or Kona blend.

column9: Fogbuster Coffee Beans really do it!
column10: The best wake-up in the morning coffee beans ever.  Strong and rich without any bitterness.  I can't start my day without a cup to "bust the fog".  Store in the freezer and grind as needed to keep the flavor.

column4: K. D. Kelly "home and away wrecker"
column10: This is the first Jeremiah's variety I've tried, but I am completely satisfied and finally feel like I've had a "truth in advertising" moment of my very own. Although it's really the number of positive reviews already in place that sealed the deal. I figure if you're writing reviews about coffee on Amazon, you probably know a thing or two about the grind.Now, to reiterate, Fogbuster consists of dark, oily beans packed with rich, nutty, semisweet flavor. It also makes a full-bodied iced coffee. Fogbuster is most similar in flavor to Taylor Maid Farms' Goat Rock roast; it's as good or better than any cutely named Blue Bottle variation; and if you're waiting to hear what I have to say about Pete's Coffee, you've missed the point.I live in San Francisco where this is brewed, but the Jeremiah's store is in a sketchy neighborhood and it's actually far cheaper -- at the moment anyway -- to order Fogbuster through Amazon than Jeremiah's website. I've already set Fogbuster up to be ordered automatically every six months (I know one 5 pound bag won't last that long, but I also know I'm finicky and will want to try some others inbetween).A parting shot at Jeremiah's: Offering pre-ground beans to your customers through a middle-man warehouse is akin to Ian Astbury joining The Doors. It's sacrilegious.

column9: MMMMmmmm GOOD!!! SUBLIME COFFEE- BEST EVER~
column10: I have bought this coffee two times and it is wonderful! Dark roast similar to French Roast. I don't particularly care for espresso burnt bitter. This is a dark roast that is robust, smooth and very flavorful. I also store in freezer and decant into airtight containers that I use during the week. Good to store coffee beans in freezer for 3-4 weeks, but bring to room temp for grinding or oils are heavy.

This is by far the best bean in town.  Before I left the states I was drinking Trader Joe's French Roast which I really enjoyed.  Fogbuster takes it up a notch.  The coffee is strong, rich and has a great depth of flavor.  I highly recommend this to those who enjoy a strong cup of coffee with a good flavor.

It's hard to tell if this is a truly good coffee. It very may well be when the beans are fresh. As soon as I opened the bag there was that vague smell, almost musty and definitely stale. I made a pot anyway. (I'm cheap that way.) Honestly, the stale smell is not evident after brewing but this is a mediocre coffee at best. Maybe it would be better if the beans had been fresh, maybe not. The flavor is almost rich, almost dark, almost really good. It just somehow misses the mark. The beans themselves were, aside from the smell, decent; uniform, a good color and firm. I've had much better coffee and I've had much worse.

Despite its name, don't expect this to be the darkest, strongest coffee you've ever had--unless you're switching from Folger's, or Gloria Jean's, or even Lavazza or whatever. The Fogbuster is a nice, dark roast that doesn't cross over into a French or espresso roast. For the past few years, our everyday coffee has been Longbottom (a local Portland roaster) Black Gold blend. The Fogbuster is milder, my wife prefers it, so it is going into a regular rotation with the Black Gold (which I recommend you coffee lovers might want to Google). I like it, too, the price is outstanding, and the five-pound bag is convenient. I'll also mention that we like Italia D'Oro from Boyd's, because along with our fondness for Longbottom, that might serve to give you some points of flavor reference. (Wouldn't it be great for Amazon to publish a chart showing that people who like coffee A also tend to like X, Y and Z?) Last thing, this coffee came in a bag just like the picture, not a clear bag as some have mentioned, and there were no issues with the way it was packed or sealed.

When the local MegaMart stopped carrying two pound bags of the beans I'd been buying for years, I was outraged and started shopping around.  I found Jeremiah's here on Amazon and ordered this five pound bag.  It was a tad more expensive than equivalent supermarket beans, but hey, it's delivered to my door.Oh, happy day!The beans even LOOK better--oily, almost black and powerfully fragrant--and make the best coffee we've ever had at home.  It's just this side of bitter (a good thing), one sip of this and you know you're drinking Serious Coffee.  I do agree with the reviewer who said to grind Fogbuster more coarsely than usual.  For some reason it makes a big difference in flavor.I signed up for six month delivery, and since no way will five pounds last us that long, I'm going to try the Kona next.Thank you MegaMart!

column9: A pretty good cup of joe
column10: This is a good all around coffee. Nothing bitter, good flavor, good aroma (but not much aroma). If you like a really powerful brew, this is not it (don't be confused, this San Fransico bean will not bust any mental fog). If you just wa good coffee you can drink all day, this is an excellent value.

This is definitely a very strong, dark, moist, roast coffee--it lives up to its name. The flavor packs a real punch. If you like a dark coffee but without the bite, try Java Trading Co. Espresso. Java Trading Company Espresso Jet City Whole Bean, 5-Pound Bag Dark but much milder--and the price is better!
If you love a really dark roast full bodied cup of coffee this is it.  Low acidity, very dark oily beans, tons of flavor.

column9: This clears the early morning fog!!!
column10: This coffee is rich and full bodied with not a trace of bitterness. It is a hearty cup of coffee that will clear the fog of early morning!!! For my work I often have to get up super early! I'm ready for anything after I have my cup of coffee!!!! I love it!

column9: Great coffee for an excellent price
column10: I have been buying the Jeremiah's Pick for quite some time.  The beans are always fresh.  The Fogbuster, in particular, has a great full-bodied, slightly acidic roast.  It definitely gets me started in the morning!
Rich taste, strong coffee. Not for 1/2-caf drinkers or weak of heart. :) Definately busts through my morning fog! Store in the freezer and grind as needed to keep rich flavor.

The beans are oily with the appearance of an italian espresso bean. The brew, with a french press, is a rather flat, average coffee. Don't know whether its arabica or robusta or both. It lacks personality. I don't feel a kick of caffeine, either. I am neither here or there with this one. I know coffee because I worked at a gourmet coffee house well before Starbucks came along. This is just okay, not great.
This coffee is a wonderful dark roast.  Once it is opened the 5 pound bag also maintains its freshness longer than many other brands.

I am a lover of coffee with a really robust flavor.  The reviews seemed to be mixed, so I decided i would give it a try. I have to say I was a little disapointed. The coffee was just ok, nothing i would ever order again.

column9: I'm picky and I pick Jeremiah's Pick
column10: My friend Don gifted me with a bag of Jeremiah's Pick Coffee Fogbuster whole bean coffee.  I figured that HUGE, 5-pound bag would last me forever.  NOT! Not when I tasted how GOOD was this coffee.  I brewed many a pot and shared beans with family and friends.  Then I bought a bag from Don and kept on drinking and sharing. Now I have my own amazon.com account.This coffee is strong without being bitter; a nice, full-bodied flavor enhanced only by a splash of heavy cream. Mmmmmmm, heavenly!If you DO have some for reheats, put a new filter in the coffeemaker, add a healthy pinch of ground cinnamon, run the leftover coffee through the machine.  Of course, add cream!  Love it!

column9: Quite good, though not consistently so.
column10: I make three or four triple espressos a day with a very good grinder and espresso machine.  I carefully store the beans in vacuum once I get them.Most of the time, these Fogbuster beans I get (from Amazon) are good, even excellent.  This last batch, well, not so good.  Tastes slightly stale.Obviously, it's understandable that there would be slight variations in quality from time to time, but I wonder about the freshness.  Their description says: "We roast our coffee daily. ensuring that the coffee you buy is fresh."Well, you can roast coffee every minute, but if it sits on a shelf in a warehouse, on a truck, or at Amazon for weeks or months, it's not gonna be so fresh when it gets to the drinker.I found no date stamp on the bag, so I can't tell when this batch was roasted.  It would be interesting to know just how recently the beans were roasted.

column9: best cup of joe i've ever had
column10: buy this coffee you won't be sorry best cup og coffee i've ever had  keep it in the freezer to keep it fresh enjoy

Jeremiah's Fog Buster is my go to choice of coffee. I get it on subsciption and the savings are good. It's hard to beat the price with this high quality of bean. The taste is well rounded and never overly bitter.

column4: Lynda "First off, I'm in Greensboro, GA, USA ...
column10: This is a very tasty coffee and is offered at a reasonable price.  We've been very happy with it and enjoy receiving it automatically from the Subscribe and Save program.

Very dark and strong. Not bitter. Coffee has slight oil. I use a french press and had to reduce amount I use significantly. /too strong for my taste that's why only 4 star. Seemed fresh and aromatic from the bag. Lighter caffeine that Colombian supremo.
wasn't sure what to expect from this as most coffee is hit or miss but what a pleasant surprise and i am so glad i joined the monthly delivery  now i can have great coffee  always !!!!
We liked this dark roast blend so much we signed up for scheduled delivery on a semi-monthly basis.  Dark tones and such a nice cup.

This is a great coffee for everyday drinking.  One of the drawbacks of buying coffee in bulk is that you are often stuck drinking it every day for over a month.  In the case of the Fogbuster, that is no problem!
This is very good coffee. There is no bitter after taste, the aroma is excellent and for the price it comes highly recommended.
Beautifu beans, aromatic coffee, like a fine wine, indulge yourself and you will never go back

We love Fogbuster whole bean coffee. We have autoship for this product and just love it. It is strong but not too strong. It is always fresh when it arrives to us.We would definitely recommend this to anyone who likes a dark rich roast.
I am getting ready to order my 3rd 5 lb bag. I have been very happy with this mix. Great coffee for the price.

column9: This is a good brew, our OFFICE FAVORITE!
column10: We have ordered many beans for our espresso machine (which doubles to make Americanos for some) and we have all agreed on this coffee. Its always fresh, slightly oily and aromatic. There's nothing like "Busting the Morning FOG" especially on a Monday. Our corporate motto is now .. "How about a fogbuster?" everyone says yes. We've probably had 10 bags so far.

column9: Watch the shipping on Amazon and Jerimiah's coffee
column10: I recently ordered the following coffee: Jeremiah's Pick Coffee Fogbuster, Whole Bean, 5-Pound Bag. It arrived promptly, but tastes stale. The package does not look like the colorful one illustrated in the picture. Rather, orders are shipped in clear plastic with no information about the company, and in my case the package was defective. A seam on the side had split open, allowing air to enter, which must have affected the coffee as it tastes stale. Jermiah's, so far, has been a big disappointment.

I must use roughly 50% more beans (and grind them finely)to get the same strength coffee as I am used to with other beans. Taking that into consideration, it's not such a hot deal.  I have no explanation.  I will drink it up but would never reorder.

This is simply great coffee.  Wonderful, smoky, full flavor.  Never bitter from first cup to the end of the pot.  With free shipping, this is a great value made even better by the outstanding nature of the coffee.
Great product.  Everytime it is dripping with oil fresh!  Great value!
Very nice taste, not as bold as I expected based on name, but very, very good. Very fresh roasted, placed in zip lock bag and sealed. Should stay good for awhile.

This coffee will truly lift that fog in your head in the morning.  Great robust flavor, you know your drinking coffee not some of that weak stuff from the grocery store. I also find this a great value.

After reading the reviews when searching for a good coffee to make, I stumbled on this item.  I am glad I did.  The five pound bag is huge! Alas, the beans are dark and oily.  This coffee imparts a great flavor and smell experience.  I bet it would be great if brewed in a french press.  This is less intense as Starbucks and better.  It will really bust the fog for you!  It is also Kosher.

I receive this coffee on auto ship. It always arrives sealed and fresh. I like the taste of this coffee. I keep it in vacuum canisters to make sure it stays fresh. Auto ship is a great way to save money with Amazon.
With the Amazon discounts, five pounds of good coffee for under $30 is good.  I expected more "Macho"/ Starbuck's type flavor.  But it is still good.
We always look forward to a fresh shipment. The beans are are moist and good right out of the bag!

I mix my coffee beans with decaf beans and it was a pleasant surprise to find out that this still retained its robust flavor.  In fact my husband asked me how come the coffee was so strong.  And the size is great because I am not constantly buying more bags of coffee.

column9: These people do not know good coffe
column10: Don't be fooled.  This is not good coffee.  When I grind the beans they are dry as a bone, no oil left at all.  I am going to spread it around the garden this summer to ward off bugs.  At least it will have some useful function. I just wish there was a rating less than 1 star.

This coffee literally stinks! Opened the bag, dripping with oils and I almost got sick from the smell. It is so strong in flavor you cannot make it drinkable. I find it bitter unless you add a ton of milk and sugar (not good). I do not understand all these good reviews (thats why I chose it)because it is hands down the worst coffee I have ever had!

We have been receiving this coffee for about two years now on an Amazon subscription, which is simply a super way to buy coffee.  Every three months, a five pound bag arrives -postage/shipping free- and Amazon applies an additional discount for using their subscription process.  We love this coffee and Amazon's Subscription program too.Followup Review: 01/13/12 - Although the quality of this coffee may still be as nice as it was when I first did my initial review, the price has gone through the roof!  We no longer get this coffee through Amazon's Subscription service - however, we still do get our coffee via this route; it just requires 'shopping' for alternatives each time our current choice rises in price too dramatically, as has this one.  Jeremiah's seems to have fallen victim to the price escalation disease more so than many other coffee sellers, but they all have raised prices, as their own costs have gone up.  Watch your Subscription Service notices of imminent shipping - Amazon is good about this, and they clearly let you know when the price is about to rise, bur what you may not notice is the rise over a year's time, or more!  Shop carefully.
It took a long time for me to receive this coffee, but it was worth the wait! I'm spoiled now and I find that regular coffee is lacking in flavor.
I like darker roast but this stuff tastes like ashes. All you get is a scorched burnt taste. No brightness, no complexity, just a one note over roasted French Roast. What a disappointment.
Lightning fast delivery of nice coffee reasonably priced so thank you is in order i suppose.

column9: terrible tasting...smells aweful...to oily for grinder
column10: This is the worst coffee I have ever bought. It stinks really bad. The beans are very oily which is bad for the grinder (I have a super automatic). The taste is bitter and dark and strong...not smooth and rich like the Lavazza I usually get. I have no clue why anyone would give this coffee a good rating, unless the beans they sent vary A LOT and I got a bad bag. Then I tried to contact them and I cannot find any reference anywhere. Never again!2 weeks later....I want to add that I sent the coffee beans back to Amazon and they refunded my money! Thank you Amazon...once again you have proven to be a great company!
This is my second and last purchase of this coffee. The coffee beans are the most terrible beans I have ever bought. They stink and it would take my Bunn grinder 8 cycles to make one cup of coffee

column9: Taste? Good. Packaging? Not so much.
column10: This tea is a wonderful way to cap off a long walk or day-- providing, of course, you can get the cap off. I recommend a grippy potholder, such as what one uses on a stubborn jar, and patience.Probably just best to locate your nearest store and enjoy your tea fresh.
I ordered this 6 pack from Argo.com and it was delicious. I wasn't sure about the ingredient combinations. Ginger, lemon, vanilla. But its very good. I highly recommend this drink. Enjoy!!
We got these with several other cat treats to help put some weight on an older cat.  She loves them and we are very happy with them.

My cats refuse to eat these, but they don't mind the Grizzly Salmon Oil All-Natural Cat Food Supplement in Pump-Bottle Dispenser, 4 Ounces mixed with canned food.  My vet recommended fish oil (without lots of additives) for my cat with itching due to allergies.I'm giving this a four star review because it looks like a good product and I appreciate having options for including fish oil in my cat's diet.Since my cat often doesn't want to eat new treats anyway, maybe in time she'll try them. She is not used to eating fish.

These are great treats with healthy (well, healthy as far as treats go) ingredients, and my dog loves them. They're moist, but not sticky or gooey, so you can keep a couple in your pocket with no worries.  They break apart easily, so they're really good for smaller dogs.  The only downside is that if you don't keep them sealed in the bag, they get hard.  The price on amazon is basically the same as you'll find at PetSmart or Petco.

I have two Siberian Huskies who don't always like to pay attention to me.  As soon as they know I have a handful of these treats with me, their eyes are constantly on me awaiting my next command.  I can honestly say they love them!  I love them too cause it helps me teach them how to behave.

column9: Head and shoulders above the rest
column10: These are excellent treats that I would recommend to almost any dog owner. After purchasing Bil-Jac Little Jacs Liver Treats while in a rush at the store, and then reading the ingredients list, I knew that I didn't want to purchase anything with additives and low-grade chicken any more! My wife and I picked these up at a pet store and so far we have been quite pleased!PROS- Contains NO chicken by-products*- Contains no wheat**- Perfect size for puppies, small dogs or training- Also available at pet storesCONS- A tad pricey- Give some dogs loose stools****While this product doesn't contain chicken by-products, don't be fooled into thinking that it contains high-grade chicken. This is definitely better than most dog treats, but it's not on par with Newman's Own Organic Chicken Treats or Flint River Ranch Dog Treats, that use human-grade meat and poultry.**Some dogs are allergic to wheat. If your dog has allergies or even is beginning to show symptoms, wheat should be the first thing you cut out. Many MANY foods contain it as a filler, and many allergies are traced back to it.***It is important to note that this may mess with a dog who's stomach is used to other food. Swap these with their regular treats slowly to avoid gastrointestinal discomfort!OVERALLThese are a little pricey, but you are paying for a healthy, nutritious treat, not some WalMart-grade by-product infused junk. If you care about your dog, you need to feed them with the best food and treats available, and these Chicken Bits are a great place to start!

I don't know what it is about these little treats but she literally goes crazy for them!  I try to feed her all natural and organic foods and Blue Buffalo is premium.  I also feed her the small breed dry food and wet and she loves those as well.  Wish they were a bit cheaper tho!

I was turned on to the Blue Buffalo brand by the trainer at the training class I signed me and my pup for.  He is my new little fur ball so I have been very cautious about what he eats and the type of foods that he is exposed to.  I really didn't want to get into the habit of buying cheap foods and treats with random fillers and terrible nutrition, so I was always open to advice from the "experts".  After doing some reading, I realized that Blue Buffalo is indeed one of the best most natural brands of Dog Foods available, so I jumped at the chance at trying these little treats for my in-training pup.  They are great! He absolutely loves them and will literally do anything for them!  He has already learned how to sit, lay, 'dance', 'paw', and stay!  The great thing is that they don't even smell terrible, they actually smell a bit like beef jerky.One thing I do recommend, is that if you have a smaller pup (mine is a shihpoo, 5months, 8lbs) cut these treats in half!  They are perfectly capable of eating them as a whole piece, but you totally get your money's worth by breaking them down in halves ;)
The picture shows 2 bags...to my surprise it was only 1 bag for 6.99! I can get them cheaper than that anywhere!!

I fed this to my 9 week old puppy and she loves them. However, a couple hours later she burped and wreaked of garlic. Then followed by loose stool. I stopped giving her these treats for a few days and the symptoms disappeared. Then tonight I gave her a couple of these treats again and same thing happened. This time after the loose stool, I think her stomach was still upset and she wanted to go to sleep but kept fidgeting and wimpering. I sat with her rubbing her stomach. Eventually she fell asleep. Well, I'm never buying this brand again.

I really like these sour bears and the fruity bears also by Surf Sweets. I was actually expecting small snack size bags for some reason and these are the larger bags for sharing. The bears are fresh and have an expiration date some time from now so no need to worry if they will be finished in time. Very delicious and vegan friendly as well!

I bought some of these for .89 a bag at a local health food store. They are very good! Organic fruit juice tastes much better than what's in the normal gummy bears. I'm not a fan of sour stuff but I like these. Definitely not as sour as sour patch kids (which I can't handle). They aren't hard and tough like most gummy bears and have more of a consistency of fruit snacks. I recommend getting these. You could find them for less than Amazon's price at a health food store.

I lived in London for a year; this was my favorite tea.  I've had a a few boxes mailed over from friends, because I love it that much.  I've never found it anywhere in the States, but it should be.  It really is that good.  Smooth and strong, a combination that's hard to find in  one tea.

This is much better than the regular Twinings breakfast tea.Stronger, great flavor. I have never seen it available in the USA.If you use milk in your breakfast tea the stronger flavor works.I really can not imagine anyone drinking this strong oftea without milk, soy or something added.  (however I'm probably wrong about this)The "strong" idea works well with this English Breakfast Tea.I also drink Green Tea and Quality Black teas without anything added but the water.I previously became tired of English Breakfast,however this 1706 version has me going for it first thing every morning.It seems to be a result of the curing of the tea and not the quantity.  I can add extra-bagsof regular English Breakfast and not get the same quality of flavor as with1706. The 1706 might be considered the "espresso version" of English breakfast tea.

I also bought a 6 pack of the Almond flavor macaroons about a month ago and found them inedible. The almond flavor tasted like rubbing alcohol. I tried contacting the company since I couldn't return to Amazon but they have ignored my email.

We've bought Jennies macaroons for years now, so when we saw they had almond flavored macaroons, we didn't bat an eye. Bought 'em right away. When my daughter and I tasted them, we had to spit it all out. Maybe they were expired? There was no way to tell, but they were sickening. Due to them not being returnable, we had to throw out all 6 cans. The whole experience was hard to swallow.

I have now gone thru 9 cans of these extra tasty, delicious, guilt-free cookies. They are super moist and sweeten with honey is the added bonus, for enriching ones taste buds. WE LOVE Jennie's Coconut Macaroons...
Wonderful Macaroons. Always fresh in the can. The almond flavor is delightful. I will happily buy this product over and over again. Yummy!

column9: Dry, hard, and made with cane sugar
column10: I had tried Jennies individually-wrapped coconut macaroons a couple of years ago and loved them. Unfortunately, these canned almond macaroons are totally different. They're dry and hard, with a totally different texture than I expected. They are edible, but hardly the delicious treats I expected.Jennies also changed the recipe last year. These used to be sweetened entirely with honey, and I learned about Jennies from people following the Specific Carbohydrate Diet. They are now made with evaporated cane juice (meaning sucrose), putting them off-limits to the SCD followers who I know constituted a substantial part of their customer base. As I write this, Amazon still has the old ingredient information. This is my first time trying these canned macaroons, so I don't know if this made a difference in texture or taste.

These cookies are so moist and delicious,I save them as my special treat. For all of you on the SCD, these are a real indulgence and they are legal too! Amazon has been my best access to getting them. The price is great too.

column9: Jennies is ruined by new company
column10: I have eaten these for years and years and loved them. Jennies was bought out by Red Mill Farms and they moved the manufacturing plant from Brooklyn to Pennsylvania.The macaroons are now inedible. I would get one good can, then 2 bad ones and so on. The bad ones were either burnt or so hard you could drive a nail with them.They don't respond to emails-ever. They have a facebook page where I left some comments without a reply. There was one contact email posted by a former Jennies employee-she says she still gets email from people complaining about the poor quality and the addition of sugar to the recipe. She said she left the company for these reasons.Once again a great product ruined by a takeover. They should have left well enough alone.The question is-who makes quality coconut macaroons that we could switch to? Good coconut is healthy but most out there is sulfited poor quality coconut.

I had bought the original Jennies Coconut Macaroons in the local health food store for years, and then I decided to buy them online, but I didn't notice that these are "almond flavored".  I have some health issues (including marathon migraines), so I'm very sensitive to unnatural foods and flavorings, and these taste so artificial.  Good thing they keep so well because I didn't want to throw out the whole case, and I've been showing up at gatherings for a while now with these.  Some people think they're wonderful, but I can't eat them.  I've signed up to be notified when the original ones become available.

date codes DS11 and DL11 use a bad batch of coconut, which tastes like soap. this batch was DS11 - a bad batch. another thing is that jennies macaroons are now made with sugar rather than honey, although the almond macaroon packaging doesn't reflect that change yet.

Mary Kretzmann:I love these and I can't always find them in my health food store. So I am glad to find them here! I loved the taste of almond croissants - but I have been gluten free for 10 years now...and this satisfies the desire for that moist, almond flavor.
These Macaroons are fantastic.  We keep them in the fridge so they're chewy.  The Almond taste is very strong but we love it that way.

I have little luck with this seed and am very disappointed. I have tried several batches and get 10-15% yield from them. I do not know if the is old seed or what the problem is. Wheatgrass will usually grow no matter what so I gotta believe the seed is not optimal. Very expensive waste of time and money for me = (

I am on my third batch with these seeds and they are preforming as well as others I have bought before. The blades or stalks are full and lush with great color. I use potting soil, vermicite, peat moss and azomite blend in the soil. Grows great!

column9: Want Wheatgrass Daily.? Buy in Bulk.!
column10: Just a note to endorse the quality and economy of this product. I have grown wheatgrass on and off for years..decided to go "all in", and add to my (protein heavy) diet daily. At approx.6oz. seed/flat, that's 65 weeks of fresh grass for $40.! The quality/sproutability of this seed far surpasses that of my local health food store.

column9: I actually sought out this seller again because of the results I had with first purchase
column10: I tracked down my invoice from a year ago so I could find this seller again, and when I found them was surprised to see the negative reviews. I bought 25 lbs in Sept. 2010 and due to personal circumstances was not able to start growing any wheatgrass until this summer. I just did two trays, with 2 cups of seed per tray, soaked and then germinated for 3 days in the dark. I had good thick trays of grass, and most importantly it was so deliciously sweet!  This was my first time growing wheat grass and it smelled so strong and bitter when I juiced it-- I was concerned, thinking it would taste awful. But it was so sweet to the taste. I was later told by an old pro that some say the sweetness is due to the seed, which brings me back to why I sought out this seller again. Obviously, I can't be guaranteed that the next 25 lbs will be equally sweet since it's a year later and likely a different harvest, but I hope so!
While I see that others had problems, my experience was flawless.Growth: 5 - 6 days, no sun (just room light)Density: thick (see picture that I uploaded)What's not to like?

All 25 pounds arrived.  Now I'm growing and grinding like crazy.  I grind to make flour and I grow for juicing and for my dog.  Yep!  My dog loves it.  He needs wheatgrass for his health too.  I have not consumed the entire 25 pounds of wheatgrass yet; but what I have eaten is satisfactory.  I would definitely order from this vendor again.

I am new to growing wheatgrass & am very glad this was not the brand I tried first.  I had been using some from healthy-eating and was quite happy with it (the only other brand I've tried so far) but decided to try this one because it is about half the price.  Wish I had only bought 10 lbs. instead of 25.  The grass here is very slow to grow and sparse and patchy.
I was so happy to find the chocolate licorice as it was for a gift for a friend that grew up eating chocolate licorice.  She had been unable to find it anywhere so Amazon came thru.  Jo Ann, Napa, CA

column9: Terrific chicken noodle soup discovery - easy to make too,
column10: Thank goodness, it's soup season again. The Alessi chicken noodle soup mix makes preparing a delicious soup a breeze. The mix is chock full of very good noodles and vegetables in an excellent broth. I added a generous cup of cubed, already cooked chicken strips to up the protein content for a full meal. Serve the soup plus a salad with some really good bread, and you're good to go. This mix puts the big name brands to shame.

column9: Best Dried Chicken Noodle Soup on the Market
column10: This soup puts all other dried soups to shame. It is absolutely delicious. It reminds me of Boston Market Chicken Noodle Soup and up until now, this was my standard of comparision for all Chicken Noodle Soups. I did add some cooked chicken to the soup after it was cooked, but is was tasty and hearty even without it. The noodles cook up nice and firm and are not pasty like some tend to be. They are nice broad noodles that have a good mouth-feel. Enjoy!

My wife and I first tried the Alessi Chicken Soup two years ago. It is delicious and simple to make. And it is easy on the budget since it makes enough for 4 adult people. We usually add a little chicken to the mix and maybe some extra peas and onions to taste. With or without additions, it is a tasty wholesome soup. We're always surprised at how big and plump the noodles become after cooking.
oh my mamas i need some right now. i could live off of this soup, and i bought it by pure accident. luckiest soup encounter of my life.

column9: I never eat soup, but I wont pass up this!
column10: I hardly ever eat soup due to not liking it that much. This soup however is amazing in taste, quality, and quantity. I actually enjoy eating it! Plus when you compare it to a can of Progresso chicken soup for 2.00$ (where I live) this is about the same price and you get over 4 times the amount of soup.
I really enjoy this soup.  It is not salty and makes a very good lunch.  Not homemade but good.

I needed a replacement soup mix for a function I work at. The old supplier will not sell in our small quantity. (20 gal) I purchased this mix as a trial with others. This one lost. I was weak in flavor. It did not have much chicken pieces in it. (common problem with mixes.
Excellent soup mix, even better when you "doctor" it up with your own vegetables and chicken. The best store bought soup mix there is.
Love Love this soup. I don't put as much water as it calls for so I get a much richer chicken stock flavor. I buy this often
My husband loves this soup. We add things to it to thicken it up and also use less water.

This soup was very close in taste to home made. It made a very large amount too!  I added some left over chicken I had and served it with crusty bread and a salad. It was plenty for my husband (who is a big eater) and I. I will definitely be buying this again.
just okay.  i bought a case of these but only ate one.  a bit too much sodium for me.

Who better than a diabetic to vouch for this product? Unlike most low-carbohydrate dieters, I test my blood sugar at least four times a day. I know how foods affect me. I have very tight control on my blood sugar; my readings are very predictable. Because of that, I know when foods have hidden carbohydrates in them.I experimented last year with Dreamfields. I paired one serving size of the spaghetti with an olive oil and garlic sauce and topped the dish with some Parmesan cheese. Because some diabetics complain of delayed spikes, I tested every hour for four hours just to make sure. Pre-meal: 69; 1 Hour: 62; 2 Hour: 73; 3 Hour: 82; 4 Hour: 69. As you can see, I returned to pre-meal levels by four hours and my third-hour reading was the highest, but the number wasn't high in itself. I have since eaten Dreamfields on two other occasions with similar results.I think the key is restricting your portion size to that listed on the box. Cook al dente, as overcooking can weaken the protective coating that blocks the carbohydrates. Be mindful of the sauces you're using. Jarred tomato sauce is just full of sugar. I buy a jarred Alfredo that only has 1 gram of carbohydrates per serving. Pesto and olive-oil sauces are good options, too. Add a protein to your dish; that helps.As far as taste goes: amazing. Tastes exactly like real pasta. No one in my family knew that it wasn't the 'real' stuff. I love that Dreamfields makes more than just spaghetti. I actually got to enjoy macaroni salad at my last family gathering thanks to Dreamfields.

column9: Low-carb pasta that tastes like PASTA!
column10: It is almost too good to be true, but the stix (Atkins followers will know what I mean) don't lie:  Dreamfields pasta won't mess with your low-carbing (or your lipolysis).I've low-carbed for the better part of 9 years, and this is one of the few low-carb products that not only delivers, it does so without any concessions.  The taste & texture are spot-on, and the non-dieters in your family won't raise an eyebrow.  Of course, keep it in moderation, but do give it a try.
We can once again enjoy pasta and still feel good about the carbs we are eating.  Dreamfields pastas cook and taste just like the high carb versions we used to eat.

We love Dreamfields pasta. I agree with other reveiws that one must pay attention to the serving size.  For instance, the box of angel hair pasta is NOT a 16 oz box as one might be accustomed to using, it is 13.25 oz. and one box has 6.5 servings,or approximately 2 oz. of dry pasta per suggested serving.  So one must be aware of how much pasta is on the plate!  If you want to know just how Dreamfields works, do some research on the web.  I always like to find articles that do not come directly from the manufacturer so I know they are not actually marketing materials.  There are such articles about this pasta from various sources.  I believe that it takes about 45 carbs to spike insulin, so do be careful about the sauce.  A large serving of the pasta and a high-sugar sauce difinitely defeats the purpose.  We cook ours 4 minutes and enjoy it regularly for a great tasting pasta.  And in my family's opinion, it taste much better tasting than the whole wheat pastas available.

This is excellent pasta.  Tastes and cooks like regular pasta.  I've been trying to eat whole grain pasta but don't really like it.  So I'm glad I heard about this. I found that you can also buy it from [...].  It's cheaper and they only charge [...]shipping no matter how much you buy. I'm going to use the Amazon wishlist button the next time I order it.  I did give me some gas later on.  I read somewhere that means the food it getting digested in your colon and not in your intestine.  I assume means the carbs are not getting asorbed and that is why this pasta is low net carb.  I definitely plan to buy more Dreamfield pasta.

column9: Fantastic Low Carb Pasta! Highly Recommended
column10: This great tasting pasta is a diabetic's Godsend! Being a Type 2 Diabetic, I am always looking for ways to reduce my carb intake. Up till now that has meant avoiding pasta completely since a single serving of normal pasta has about 35 - 40 carbs. This has been one of the biggest impacts to my diet as we love Italian cooking. I was not sure about Dreamfields' claim to only have 5 carbs, but we gave it a try anyway.After having a full serving, my blood sugar levels only took a modest rise, about what I would have expected from 5 carbs (plus the 15 others from the rest of the meal)!It does cost more than regular pasta, but it is worth it to me to be able to eat pasta again.Highly Recommended!
I am medically on a low carb diet and their products increase the quality of my life!
This product is truly outstanding considering its excellent texture and taste and unbelievably low glycemic index.

Being a victim of diabetes, and a lover of pasta, this wonderful product made my life so much easier to deal with. At times, I eat more of this pasta than I should. My blood sugar does not rise at all. Of course this may not be the norm for every one. It tasts and has a texture of any major pasta maker.

This is trully a great tasting product. I am on a low carb diet and have not had any spaghetti in months. I tried this product and I love it. I will continue to use this product even if I go off this diet.

Before discovering Dreamfields it was always difficult to enjoy pasta especially at night. The taste is great.  Would like to see Angel Hair added.  My boyfriend is a type one diabetic and our dining previously had been so limited because of carbs. I am so happy to have discovered Dreamfields.

I really love the taste of Dreamfields spaghetti. Cloudy starches do not appear in the boiled water when I cook Dreamfields pasta. I only wish they would provide an organic version.  I highly recommend the product and I enjoy the benefit of serving the pasta for my friends and loved ones that must limit their carbohydrates.

I did my own test on this, and for me at least, it spiked my blood sugar almost identically to regular pasta.  That is with cooking it to the exact time on the box, with the exact tiny portion size.  This is indeed a case of- if it tastes too good to be true it probably is.

column4: Joe Bruno Sr. "Fiction and Non Fiction author"
column9: Dreamfields Pasta Tastes Just as Good as Regular Pasta!
column10: I bought Dreamfields Pasta because I had started the Atkins low carb diet, and after a few weeks, I began to get the urge to eat pasta again.I was amazed that when I ate Dreamfields Pasta, which I bought in several different styles, like linguine and rotini, that it tastes just as good as regular pasta. And each two ounce serving is only 5 net grams of carbs. Spread some red or white sauce on top, add a couple of low carb meatballs, made without breadcrumbs, and you have a great Italian dinner, without the guilt.

column9: LOVE it!! I can enjoy pasta again!
column10: When I received by diagnosis of type 2 diabetes, I thought pasta was a thing of the past. But then, a few years ago I discovered Dreamfields and I have been eating it ever since. It tastes great and has little effect on my blood sugar. My husband, who is such a picky eater, can't tell the difference between regular pasta and Dreamfields. It really has made low carb eating so much easier for me.
Very good pasta. Son is dibetic and this is the only way he can enjoy pasta now. We all loved it.

This product is exactly as described.  Can't taste the difference between it and regular pasta.  In fact, in my opinion, its better with all the benefits of no spiking numbers after the meal.  I ate a normal healthy portion with sugar free sauce and meatballs.  2 hours later,  checked my numbers,  was 115.  With anyother pasta,  would have been through the roof.  I will order again.
I love the product and will continue using it. It tastes like the regular brands of spaghetti.

column9: Reacted very badly to this pasta
column10: My wife and I ate the recommended serving (2 oz dried). It was delicious, and we felt full afterwards. Later that night, neither of us slept well because we were so hungry. I don't know if this is related, but we both had heart palpitations that night.We both woke up feeling starved. I usually don't even feel hungry in the morning! My wife checked her blood sugar levels (she has gestational diabetes) and found they had skyrocketed.This is not a low-carb product, it is a high-carb product where the carbs have been altered in a way that affects absorption - but not necessarily to truly lower its glycemic impact.If it works for you, great, but it REALLY did not work for us. We're throwing out all the boxes that I bought based on the 5 star ratings here. If you want to try it, start with a single box and see how it makes you feel.

Careful if you take fast acting insulin before meals.  Those protected carbs must loose their protection sometime between dinner and waking up the next morning.This happened three times, had two serving in a 60 carb dinner, went to bed with a blood sugar 140-150, but woke up with my glucose near 300!Theory, the carbs took too long to digest and my fast acting insulin, Humalog, couldn't catch it.Taste great.

This is the best example of buyer beware. The glucose rise happens 3-4 hrs after. Do not listen to the hype about cooking in acidic tomato sauce. Your stomach uses hydrochloric acid. A heck of a lot stronger than that in tomatoes. If you need to watch your blood glucose watch out and check at hr 3 and 4 and you will be shocked. No differece than regular pasta. The 5 grams of real fiber (inulin) just causes a delay in the high rise. Metamucill makes an easy dissolving fiber with inulin. Take it right before normal pasta ingestion and you have the same affect.

All Dreamfield Pasta is great and tastes likes regular pasta without the sugar spike. Although I have never experienced an issue with my sugar spiking, and I'm not diabetic, some people have reported a spiking in their sugar level a few hours after eating this product. If you are diabetic, you might want to test your sugar every hour for at least 4 hours after eating this to see how you react to it.

I love this Pasta... as good as any "normal" pasta.  I can not tell the difference.  What is up with the price though... ?  $7.95 per box???  For real??????  I can get it on the Supermarket for less than $3.00!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!

column9: Only 2.49 at the market over priced
column10: You can buy this product at your local supermarket for less then $3.00 it is very good but Aamzon is way over priced
Because it is. I am a low carb eater and one serving of this kicked me right out of ketosis. It tastes awesome, cause it's pasta. Regular old pasta.

column9: Do the math yourself and see.
column10: Check the ones who have listed five stars for Dreamfields vs those who have graded it down and you will see that Dreamfields is the real deal. I have been diabetic for twenty years and had to take pastas out of my diet...until I discovered Dreamfields a few years ago. I use insulin and pills to control my blood sugar and know what will spike my sugar levels. Dreamfields properly cooked has never once sent me to the insulin syringe for spiked blood sugar levels. I do not know what others may have done that caused their levels to spike. Maybe they over-cooked it, or used some ingredients that have sugars in them that they forgot to check.I am happy to say both my wife (also a diabetic) and I can now eat pastas again. We tried to eat whole wheat pastas, but they were no better than regular pastas for blood sugar levels. And they just don't taste as good! I am not concerned about the "nutritional values" of pastas. I just don't look to pasta to provide certain nutritives. I eat a well balanced diet and get what I need from homemade home-ground whole wheat, grains, vegetables and fruits. So, if Dreamfields somehow falls short of listed claims or expectations, it doesn't bother be in the least.If you don't need to eat lo-carb pastas, don't waste your money on Dreamfields. It is a pasta with a purpose; to offer those who need to control carbs an alternative worth buying. Buy the untreated and save money. But, if you need it, it is a good value for what it does for you. I cannot tell the difference in their flavor or tastes from regular pastas.If you don't like the pricing, consider a competitor brand. Oh, wait! They have no competitors! No one seems to care enough to fill that gap! So there you are!
Wonderful product! It really does not raise my husband's blood sugar ( we are careful with portions) Tastes great, texture is great also.

I recently found out that I have Type 2 diabetes.  I was really bummed out about being limited to how much pasta, potatoes or rice I can have.  I found Dreamfields pasta and I absolutely LOVE it!  It tastes just like regular pasta but it doesn't cause my sugar to spike.  I'm stocking up my pantry with Dreamfields spaghetti, elbow macaroni, penne pasta and any other kind of Dreamfields pasta that I can find.

column9: I have 25 packages sitting at home.
column10: Nuff said. But I'll say more.  You WILL NOT find a better low GI pasta product. Won't happen. A light bulb flashed in my head just recently that Amazon might be offering the same low carb products that I've been purchasing over the years from another seller. Thankfully, they offer about half of them that I consumer regularly, and this is one of them. This pasta taste about 80% (90% when you throw in the pasta sauces)just like the real deal, and they come in so many different shapes, so they end up being extremely versatile. Along with Bella Vita sauce (which has no added sugar, has very low carbs and is one of those not offered on this site [you'll have to get from Netrition or some other online retailer], you'll be in heaven; especially if you're a pasta lover like me. Man...do I love pasta. You will not be disappointed with another "meh" low carb product here. I was extremely skeptical at first and thought "this 'aint low carb dude, something's up", but I've eaten a lot before just in order to test it (ahem...yeah, to test, it was) if it would throw me out of ketosis, and was thrilled when it didn't. I stocked up for the upcoming Armageddon. You should to. Happy low carbing!!
I LOVE SPAGHETTI. THIS MAKES IT EASY FOR A DIEBETIC TO ENJOY SPAGHETTI AGAIN.GREAT TEXTURE AND TASTE.

The pasta is ok, although it doesn't have the same texture as Barilla for example, but NOTICE THE WEIGHT.  IT IS 13.5 OZ......NOT A POUND.  They lowered the weight by about 20% and didn't lower the price.  They are taking advantage of the fact that the American consumer today is being dumbed down.  I have diabetes and the blood sugar readings are not that much different from regular pasts.  LOOK AT WHAT YOU BUY.  Dreamfields is screwing you.  Period.

It tastes good. That is about all I can say for it. It does not lower my blood glucose level and very obviously contains more than 5 grams of carbohydrates.If you base your meal on about 40 grams, everything seems to work out all right.

This pasta tasted absolutely wonderful - but it's very deceiving. If you compare the nutritional facts to that of whole wheat pasta (which is also delicious, and can be bought anywhere) the whole wheat pasta is actually BETTER for you. Dreamfields packaging states that there are "protected carbohydrates", but never explain this concept. By which standards are they measuring these "protected carbohydrates"?? I say this is a great alternative to regular pasta, but it's not exactly what it claims to be - it's still pretty high on the glycemic index.

column9: Good addition to gluten free flours
column10: This 4 pack of Bob's Red Mill Gluten Free Sweet Sorghum Flour is very economical and a super addition to the GF pantry. I use this in combination with oat, quinoa, brown rice, and teff flours and it blends very well as is tasty. Great for making muffins, cookies, and cereals.

If you are looking for a nice GF flour, sorghum is one of our favorites.  We don't use it alone, but mix it in with quinoa that we grind ourselves to make a tasty flour for things like donuts, cakes, etc.  Amazon has the best price that I have found, making this a great thrifty buy for the GF baker.

I have never tasted sorghum before, so I was pleasantly surprised by how nice this tastes. I use it for gluten-free baking since most of the books I have, recommended it or called for it in a recipe. This is so MUCH better than any of the other fava/garbanzo mixes by far. I could not get those flavors to work for me, somehow they were too beany/metallic or something. I made a cornbread with this, tapioca and potato starch and my family loved it. I think some people find this flour hard to get, but if possible, get it. It will give your baked goods a lot more texture, flavor and feel compared to rice flour.

I have been using this to make GF bread - this flour works better than any others I have tried.  Breads still aren't the same as "real bread" but at least they have the texture and don't fall apart when we eat them!
I used this in a recipe for homemade bread and it came out fluffy and delicious.  This flour is a little hard to come by, so I appreciated the option to buy 4 packages in bulk for a decent price.

We use Bob's Red Mill for all of our GF flours except those we can grind ourselves (brown rice, quinoa, flax). We love the consistent quality and freshness, and we love the ease of purchase and delivery - as well as the great prices! - that we receive from Amazon.
I like Bob's Red Mill flours and the sorghum flour is great too. The pack of 4 is a great price (at least where I live) and it works well in creating the recipes from my gluten free cookbook.

Sorghum flour is pretty much a staple for gluten free baking - I use it for pancakes, bread, cakes, cookies etc and go through quite a bit of it.  Unfortunately, it's not always that easy to find in the store and I always end up having to check a few places.The pack of 4 from amazon ships in a Bob's Red Mill box which is placed inside a larger Amazon box so the bags arrive in perfect condition.  I find that the price on here is better than what you typically find in the store.  If you plan on doing a decent amount of baking I highly recommend ordering this product, but if you're not sure how much you'll go through or have never baked with sorghum flour before I would recommend buying it at the store and trying it out before buying it in such a large quantity.
I made my first loaf of gluten free bread today, using my new bread machine and a recipe for sorghum based bread. WoW!

It arrived being boxed well.  The expiration date is a long while from now.  I was happy about that as there were four of the bags of flour in the box.  Bob's Red Mill is a great product, no matter which product you buy.  It is quality.

column9: Another good gluten-free flour from Bob's Red Mill
column10: I buy most of my flours from Bob's Red Mill in the 4-pack boxes, if only because having all the bags the same size makes it easier to store them.  It's good flour, and the bag's a good size for baking for a small family - also a good shape that will stand up on the counter while you scoop flour out of it.

column9: I don't have to hunt this down anymore!
column10: I live in the sticks, so when I found out about the subscribe and save service sith this product, I was ecstatic!  I don't have to go all over the place to hunt this down anymore!  Not to mention it's much cheaper buying my flour here than at the store.  I am on a super strict diet do to food allergies, which doubled my weekly grocery bill, so anywhere I can save money is great  :-)

I have only been cooking a GF diet for 18 months so I am still learning, but I have found the sweet white sorghum flour to be among my favorites for cookies & breads.  The cost to buy in local stores is so expensive that I searched for less costly ways to make my own foods without the high costs and get variety of gf flours.  Amazon had good prices when bought in bulk and since the gf flour bags are so small anyway, it works out well for me.  I have found gf flours keep well so far, so this is also helpful. column9: Perhaps the tastiest of the tobascos
column10: Living in Tejas, we love  our spicy southwest foods. A bottle of hot sauce is never far from hand at meal time. Regular tobasco adds a lot of heat to any meal, but relatively little enjoyable flavor. My sons (both under 10) even enjoy its flavor, not finding it too harsh or pungent.If all you're interested in is showing off your manliness by eating outrageous sauces, then pass this bottle by. If you're interested in making simple meals a little more exciting, then this is the condiment for you!

I love this sauce so much I bought a half gallon of it--I go through this sauce quickly.
