From what I heard, the basket was nice and delivered on time but the recipient had no idea who sent it. Despite my well worded thank you note (the gift was a small token of appreciation)that I had entered in the appropriate box on the order form, there was nothing included. The recipient eventually called Amazon and found out who had sent it.  This was embarrassing and a let down on what good service I have grown to expect from Amazon.

column4: Trisha Morriston "Nero Wolfe and Journey Fan"
column10: Just got this Gift backet today for my dad for Father's Day tomorrow. Didn't think that I would be getting this till next week.  Great that I did in time for Father's Day. Will buy from seller again.

column9: Best Macarons in the City of Chicago! no Wait the U.S.A.
column10: Had the great opportunity to eat these delicious treats and they are by far the best I have ever had. If you truly want to enjoy the best then you must purchase these macarons. The white chocolate blueberry is amazing!

column9: I can't decide if the outhouse or my cozy toilet is the better place for this product.
column10: After trying this for myself, I suspected that those high ratings were only illusions. My husband told me that company's consider these reviews as just another form of advertising and pay people to lie about a product's quality. I really can't imagine anyone thinking this product is drinkable, let alone, pleasurable. If you want a couple recommendations on decent tasting t-discs for your Tassimo machine, the Jacobs Latte Macchiato isn't bad if you add sugar. This morning though, I drank it after I tried the Voluptuoso and my mouth has a metallic taste to it. Not sure which one is responsible. Another thing, the milk in the disc tastes sour, but when you add sugar, there is a decent flavor there. For the 2nd decent beverage, you can take the Kenco Crema with some Coffee Mate's Spiced Pumpkin and Vanilla Spiced Chai (a liberal amount) creamers, with enough sugar, and have a nice smooth cappaccino. I've tried about nine flavors now, and the coffee, cremas, most lattes and cappaccinos, have the same inferior quality in looks and taste, as a cheap instant coffee, as well as, having your mouth taste like you just drank the contents of an ashtray. Kenco Crema is the only one that did not taste like nicotene. These are the coffees I've tried: Gevailia Cappaccino, Maxwell House - House Blend, Hag Crema Decaf, Jacobs Kronung, Carte Noire Voluptuoso Classic, Kenco Crema and Jacob's Macchiato. After finding one inferior brew after another, I've given up looking for a good cup of black coffee and/or cappaccino, for the Tassimo. Don't do what I did, which was believe all the positive reviews and downplay the critical reviews. My curiousity has been appeased after spending $34 in Tassimo beverages. Thankfully, 2 packages were free. Now I can either spend more money in S&H to return them, or drink all 56 cigarettes...coffee I mean. Oh by the way, for a tasty hot chocolate beverage, try Celestial Seasonings "Tuscanny" 1 bag made strong, followed by 2 pkgs Carnation Instant Hot Chocolate, with mini marshmellows, and hot water in a tall to-go insulated mug. Amazon sells both, but you can get the chocolate mix on sale for about $1.50 in a grocer.

Bring back the Racconto!!  I purchased these crushed tomatoes since my favorite were not available, and they were reasonably priced.  Do not purchase this product if you have been spoiled by Racconto.  Despite the name recognition, these tomatoes are sadly WATERY.  Racconto has three ingredients; tomatoes, salt, and citric acid.  Contadina adds WATER.  I didn't pay for water, I paid for tomatoes, hence the disapointment.

"Good stuff". Excellent for thai food and spicy creative cuisine, easy to use, when opened I just keep-it in the fridge and take a little when I need. The taste is very strong, so this small pot give you enough for a long time

I thought of writing something witty and smart to take some of the sting out of my review, but there's not too much you can say that's good about this tea, other than the enticing aroma that comes up from the dry tea leaves; A nice blend of rooibos, chicory, and peach that enticed me to brew a cup. That was mistake #1; brewing it ruined the nice smell of the dry leaves, and the first sip was worse still; that was mistake #2. Holding on to it for so long hoping one day I would grow to love it was mistake #3.Finally, my girlfriend agreed to give it a try, and she loves it! Go figure! So I gave the box of stuff to her and now we're both happy!

column9: Good on the pinch, Strange on the taste buds
column10: This cornbread mix is very easy to make (just add water) and i can appreciate that. Flavor is mild corn, kinda gritty texture, and has a strange aftertaste. i bought mine from the grocery store, but i won't get it again.

This stuff is really, really good--maybe too good. It would be way too easy to pig-out and eat the whole pan full in one sitting. I tried several other brands I obtained locally. They weren't too bad--if you slathered enough butter on them to cover the taste. You don't need butter to make this brand eatable. I don't know how this product could improved upon even if one was cooking from scratch. It's easy too. Just add water and cook. You can even microwave it, although I haven't tried that. I would certainly recommend this mix to anyone who likes cornbread.

column9: I can't say enough about how great it is!
column10: This is the BEST tasting granola there is! It is low in calories as far as granola goes and it compares to most of the best home made I've had in Mexico. I am so glad I can get it on line because I can not always find it at the local stores.

We first had this in Kauai, loved it, and thought it would be easy to find at home. Since that was not the case, we ordered thru Amazon and got a great price for a quality product. I thought the amount of six bags would be too much to store, since we eat a variety of breakfast items, but the bags are compact, and easy to store even sideways in a small space. The flavor is great, and a good base for adding any fruit and yogurt combination. You don't miss the oil, and there are enough almonds to feel like you have eaten something more filling.

I was the lucky recipient of a trial package of this granola and was eager to buy a full-size package.  I understand why they sell them six at a time.  What I don't understand is why they don't package one box as an assortment.  I am the only one who eats it.  By the time I finish 6 bags of Vanilla Almond I am really going to be tired of it.The granola is packaged in super-strong resealable plastic bags.  There's no danger of it all growing stale before I get to the last of it.Taste?  I love the taste.  Not too sweet.  Made without oils.  Lots of yummy things.  The almonds in this mix are really great.I would recommend this to anyone who loves granola or wants to try it.  Just pick a flavor you think you'll really like.

I love this cereal and I am so glad I found it. They had it at my local health-food grocery, then it disappeared off the shelf. So I ordered a half dozen form Amazon. The oats are baked in fruit which is a great idea. The taste of this cereal is why I wanted to order it again plus it stays crunchy in rice milk. More importantly I can eat almonds but no other nuts. I will order this cereal again.
I rated this product 5 star. It is really the same when you buy it from any other dealer, so the best deal really wins. I mean to look for the least cost.

This product is wonderful!  I enjoyed it at Christmas, but had toget some more because I enjoy it year round.  If you add a littlemilk and sugar to the tea, it has a mild flavor of eggnog, whichmight sound like an odd combination with tea, but actually, isquite good.  I was pleased to know I could purchase it in June,since it was only available in stores around Christmas.  The pricethrough Amazon was much better than the grocery store price, also.

column9: tastes good, but not like eggnog
column10: I was hesitant to try this tea because I thought eggnog-flavored tea sounded like a weird combination, and I'm not even a big fan of eggnog by itself.  However, it turns out it doesn't really taste like eggnog anyway!  It has a mild nutty/vanilla flavor to it instead; it's very similar to the Celestial Seasonings "Nutcracker Sweet" flavor.  I like it, but probably not enough for it to displace my other favorite flavors.  (A person can only drink so much tea....  so many flavors, so little time....)
my mother and i love this tea! it has a wonderful vanilla scent and a smooth taste. great for dipping cookies of all kinds in it. taste really good with a vanilla creamer as well.

column9: This tea is my all-time FAVORITE!!!
column10: I originally bought this on a whim and did not try it until after Christmas.  Then, WOW!, fell in love.  I am sooo glad that Amazon was able to make this available and would highly recommend it.  The flavor is very light and refreshing.  It has just enough spice in it to highlight the great flavor.  I have given boxes to several friends, who have also fallen in love and had to order.  This is a favorite that should be available year round.
This tastes a lot like a butter rum Lifesaver or, with milk or cream in it, like Butter Pecan ice cream.  Yum.  :9

I was not a frequent tea drinker but found one tea bag of eggnogg'n in a holiday basket sent to our office and fell in love with it. I search for it in stores but found I could only order it online by the case-amazon had the best price so far. I just ordered my second case of the tea-when people in the office smell it they want to taste it and I love sharing it with others-one co-worker just asked to purchase one of my boxes. Great taste-don't let the name "eggnogg" stear you away, to me it has a great flavor.

This tea is absolutely AMAZING! I couldn't find it in the store 2 years ago and finally found it this past Christmas. I was so excited, I did a little dance in the store :) (I love eggnog). It was even better than I expected and I went back to buy 6 more boxes. This is honestly one of the best teas I've ever had (amazing because I was addicted to Chai tea for years) but I wouldn't recommend it black; you HAVE to have it with vanilla or eggnog creamer to really bring out the flavor :)

column9: Tasty, but not quite like real eggnogg
column10: Overall, this tea is really tasty. It smells like real eggnogg, and tastes somewhat like the real thing if you add milk or cream, and sugar. I had it plain and strong the first time I tried it; it was okay, and then I had second cup with milk and sugar, and it tasted better. Really light, and good for a cold winter's day. Plus, it doesn't have all the calories of eggnogg, so it's great for people like me who need to watch their weight.

column9: The people at Bigelow know what they're doing
column10: If you find yourself surrounded by people drinking delicious eggnog during the winter months while trying to watch your weight, I highly suggest drinking Eggnogg'n. I made mine with almond milk and a tiny bit of sugar and may I say, I was in heaven! It doesn't taste exactly like eggnog. However, it definitely has a rich, comforting taste to it. Highly recommended!

Yesterday at church a young couple "shared" a box of Bigelow "Eggnoggn" tea bags with me.  She'd been given the tea while pregnant and it didn't sound "appealing" to her.  But as a tea fan...and an eggnog fan...I thought it sounded interesting.  Little did I know the delight that awaited me.  I added a spoon of sugar and some french vanilla flavored creamer.  I've never added cream to tea before, but there was a recommendation on the box to try it...so I did.  VOILA!!!  I now have a new favorite drink.  I loved it so much I came online looking for more.  I will keep this stocked in my house from now on as my go-to drink for a few minutes of peace, quiet and just plain enjoyment.  Thanks to whoever thought to try this combination.  LOVE LOVE LOVE IT!
I prefer coffee to tea, but the Bigelow line is great, especially this one and Vanilla Chai. Glad I could get a holiday flavor in the late spring!

This is such delicious tea and is only available at grocery stores in RI during the Christmas season. I ran out of the tea after Christmas and went looking for it.  I found it at Amazon I ordered it immediately.  The vendor sent my order quickly and I have been enjoying Eggnogg'n tea to my heart's content. Thank you for making this tea available beyond Christmas. Grateful yours.

A friend introduced this tea several years ago, and I have been searching our local grocery stores and kitchen shops for it since then to no avail.  Then I thought about searching online for it and found it at the best price through Amazon.com.  I purchased a large quantity of this tea and have been serving it to family and friends throughout this Holiday Season.  Everyone loves it!!
Wonderful!!! Great tasting tea. The flavor really come to life if you add milk or cream to it. More cinnamon taste than eggnog. I love it either way. There is a faint taste of eggnog.

This tea is fun and perfect for anyone who loves eggnog but doesn't want all the calories. I love the flavor of eggnog, but don't always want a thick creamy drink, so this is great for me.Though I do think it tastes (and smells) like eggnog, there's also something else there. I keep thinking Jelly Belly's buttered popcorn jelly beans? (edit: I hate those jelly beans, so I think I meant more of a buttery candy taste. Popcorn in a jelly bean? Should not happen!!)I love drinking this after dinner to calm my sugar cravings! Oh, but it goes well with chocolate, too.

column9: My favorite tea of all time
column10: I host high teas fairly often and had four high teas between Christmas and the first week of the new year and this tea was the hit of them all (my tea menu usually has a dozen or more teas from which to choose), with people wanting several cups or even second pots of it.While other people feel it is better with sugar and/or milk, I actually love this tea plain, and there are very few teas which I like plain.  It's also been a hit with males and not just females.  I'm ordering six boxes from Amazon as our store is no longer carrying it (hope it's back next winter) and I think they'll also make great stocking stuffers next year.

I ordered a single box from Amazon and just received it today.  I am sitting here drinking my first cup with no milk, cream or sugar.  I must agree with several other reviewers; it does not taste entirely like eggnog.  However, I am very much enjoying it.  It definitely has a "seasonal" taste that reminds me of the holiday season.  Also, I can definitely see where adding sugar and vanilla creamer would enhance the eggnog flavor.  I will definitely order this tea again, but peppermint herbal tea remains my favorite.I have to knock off a star because it would be nice if there was a decaffeinated / herbal version.

column9: Seasonal Item, Hard to Find Elsewhere
column10: After talking with a friend of mine who was quite sick at the time, the subject somehow turned to tea. She is a hot tea drinker and had finished off her box of Eggnogg'n tea quite a few months earlier. She said she was looking forward to getting some more around Christmas time, because that seems to be the only time she could find this particular flavor, which she says is wonderful. It does smell nice, but I prefer coffee, not tea. Anyway, I was so tickled to find this on Amazon, and at such a reasonable price. I had some shipped to her with a little get-well note and she was so excited, she had missed this so much. I normally wouldn't review something that I haven't personally had regularly (I did try this quite a while back, just a few sips, but I was waiting for the coffee to perk at her house:) The scent and flavor is surely similar to the spices found in egg nog, which I do like at Christmas time,  but this is a dark tea, and when I do drink tea (rarely) I like the green teas. Smelling it, though, almost makes me wish I did like dark teas, but I don't even like iced tea. This is one of those teas she likes to have from a favorite cup, and sit and enjoy, not so much a grab and gulp sort of thing. I haven't actively looked for this elsewhere since finding it on Amazon, but I understand it is mostly seasonal and hard to find elsewhere from her experience. I am so glad Amazon carries this, and at such a reasonable price.

Found this on clearance at the local supermarket, would not have bought it otherwise.  Eggnog tea?  It just sounds so weird.  Yes, it is, but also tasty.  There are eggnog like aspects to the flavor, and soy lecithin is their "eggy" flavor.  (Lecithin was originally found in egg yolks, but most lecithin these days is manufactured from soy sources.)Don't expect it to taste like eggnog.  Do expect it to taste pleasant.  Follow the directions - it is best when sweetened and has some milk in it.

First off, this review is extremely biased. Not because I work for Bigelow, but because I've been a consumer of Eggnogg'n for a few years now. And I looooveeee it. I can't say it tastes exactly like eggnog- especially the home made eggnog I make (trying to avoid the HFCS in the store-bought.) Maybe if you added a small amount of nutmeg to your concoction it could. But I see where they were trying to go with the taste. Regardless, it tastes amazing to me. I love eggnog, I love tea, and I especially love this :)A bit of soymilk and sugar and it's the final ingredient to not only a perfect cold winter day, but even a chilly summer night. Even a drop or two of vanilla extract helps out too. Mmm. If you have a couple spare dollars, definitely get a small box to give it a try. Whether an eggnog connoisseur like myself or not. Just talking about it so much, I'm going to make some right now!

Omg I love this tea. bought one box at the store. tried it. LOVED IT! went back and there was no more anywhere!! So glad I can get it here.Great eggnog taste. good alternative to eggnog 0 calories & 0 fat!! Wonderfull holiday treat!

I was hesitant to try this at first because honestly eggnog (which I love) in tea form did not sound appealing!  My aunt kept telling us we HAD to try it, but we've been unable to find it in stores so far this year.  She liked it well enough to have me order a 6 pack here on Amazon, and even subscribe to having it delivered on a regular basis.  When it arrived, she shared some with us and I have to say it is quite delicious!  It does have somewhat an eggnog flavor, but to me it's almost more a mellow Chai flavor, lightly spiced, with vanilla.  Very good & something different, tea-wise.
I tried this tea for the first time today.  I enjoyed it.  I can't really say it tasted like eggnog because to me it didn't but it still had a nice, seasonal taste to it.  I'd buy it again.

My mom really liked this tea and she was sad that she couldn't find it off-season... so I bought this 6-pack for her as a gift.  She convinced me to try it and after a few cups, I'm hooked!  I was afraid we wouldn't use up all of the tea before the next shipment, but now I'm sure we'll have to order long before then.In otherwords... This stuff is awesome!

column9: Bigelow  Egg Nog Tea Bags Box of 20 Tea bags
column10: I picked up  2 boxes of  this Egg Nog tea  from a local grocery store not knowing anything about itexcept that I like Egg Nog at  holiday time. The first cup got me hooked. I went back to buy more boxes, but  they were gone, and as this is a 'seasonal' tea, the store was not re-stocking.I take my own tea bags  when we eat out and a waitress caught the odor and asked what kind of teathat was. I gave some waitresses a bag to try at home, but said they were only available at Christmas. Too soon,I was opening  my  second box and knew thatI would definitely  run out, so I decided to writeto the company and see if they had any in the warehouse. I found that I could still buy the tea at Amazonand ordered 2 cases, A friend , also a tea drinker, bought 2 boxes from me, and I gave a box to 2 of mydaughters. Thanks  to Bigelow for  making this delicious tea, and to Amazon for having it availableat a price I can afford.

The perfect sip for pre-work pep! It's calming yet energizes without giving you a shaky feelings. I love how it has a mixture of different types of tea in it too because it makes me feel as if I am drinking something even healthier than just one type of tea! Also, this is a very worth while buy in that it's very inexpensive for a 6 pack! Definitely worth the money!

I tried this tea on a whim when I found it at the grocery store and LOVED it!  I was so bummed when I couldn't find it again and was so happy to find it here on Amazon for much less than the Bigelow website!  Honesly, I almost paid full price!  Not sure it actually tastes so much like egg nog, but I just love it!  Can't wait to try another flavor!
a nice alternative to the real thing, for those of us who are lactose intolerant. it does not quite hit the mark as "eggnog", but is acceptable as a substitute.  overall a 8.5

This tea is just fantastic!  If you add egg nog creamer to it, it truly tastes like egg nog.  Its just delicious!  I like that each tea bag is individually wrapped.  I highly recommend this product for year round flavor.
Eggnogg'n is the best tea I have tasted in a long time.  The smell is fantastic and the taste.
I have put this on automatic shipments because I like it so much.  I like the taste of eggnog without all the calories, a definite "try it" tea.

column9: Yummy Flavor with Sugar & Milk - Nutmeg/Vanilla Highlights
column10: I picked this up at our local grocery store.At first I thought this tea would be a little weird, but then decided that since I drink my tea with milk anyway, why not try it (it was on the seasonal discount rack).I'm glad I tried it.  This tea has a nice "yummy", semi-rich taste (with 2% milk & sugar) & is a good alternative to the other green/fruit/chai teas that I drink.  There are hints of nutmeg & vanilla that make this tea work.Recommended.  I will definitely buy this tea again.

Got this at a local store, packaged with apple cider and ginger tea (a holiday threesome)... This was THE best in the bunch. I never thought I would enjoy eggnog inspired tea the way I like this. It's great!
This is really good. It smells good. It tastes good. It is delicious. But you know what? It doesn't taste a whole lot like eggnog.

If you love egg nog like I do, you will love this tea.  I use stevia in it and a little half and half and it is wonderful.  I am always looking for ways to satisfy my sweet tooth and this tea does just that.
this tea did not meat my tastes but should be worth a try. it didn't taste to me how i thought it should

This one didn't do it for me, nor any friends and family that I had try it.  All I could taste was a light black tea with a slight buttery taste.  I expected a bit of nutmeg, but didn't taste any of that, or much else.

I was disappointed that it barely has a faint eggnog flavor as it is more like a butter toffee flavor and fragrance. It is a pleasant mild tea that I brewed at the longest setting on my electric tea maker to obtain the strongest flavor without any bitterness. I will easily use up the 6 boxes by giving them away and using myself, but I will not reorder since I desired a true eggnog flavored tea.

I love Bigelow teas, and based on all the positive reviews, I was shocked to find that not only did I not like this one, but I can't even force myself to drink it.  To me it tastes like artificial rotten eggs and literally nauseates me, but maybe it's just my particular taste buds.  As such, I'd recommend trying it first before placing a large order.
Item as described and tastes delicious. I bought this size quantity for me and my girlfriend to do the Master Cleanse for 10 days each and it is well worth it.

John West brand sardines & herring are tasty and excellent quality. The Skippers (2 layer sardines packed in safflower oil) are tasty. If you compare the Skippers to King Oscar 2-layer in olive oil, this may be a tie score and dependent on your tastes and uses. I like the King Oscar version a touch better. Neither the JW or KO sardines are cheap but the quality and flavor are worth the cost, imho.

column9: Excellent Product- One of the best
column10: This is one of the hidden gem. It has Butter Flavor. ..Excellent Product. one of the best so far i have seen.

This is a newly discovered product for me, I didn't know there was such a thing out. Pretty great to not have to worry about it spoiling or burning. The price was comparable for the most part to what I've seen so far.
I have purchased numerous seasonings by Simply Organic (AKA Frontier) and is now the only brand I will use.  Superior product!

Today I took my small dog to the vet for emergency removal of part of her Flossie from her throat. Same caution as rawhide bones exists with these. Some dogs handle this type of chew well and others do not. This dog had previously done well with a Flossie-today was not her day.

We have a 6 lb yorkie that can't get enough of the Flossies. We cut them in two and he spends 30 minutes or so chewing a half piece. Yorkies are nortorious for having dirty teath resulting in the need to have a vet do an annual cleaning. With theFlossies, our little guy hasn't had to suffer this difficult task. We're happy, and he's happy.

My boxer loves these flossies. In the past I would by them individually from the local store. They are expensive snacks but I could not find them locally in bulk until I looked on Amazon. Only problem is my dog eats them fast. I'm currently trying the Jumbo Phat flossies.

I was looking for a product to replace Greenies for my three year old Chinese Crested. Although Bonnie never had any serious problems with Greenies I read about dogs choking on them and I know a few dogs even died. I realize dogs can choke on any product but I began to get very nervous.Flossies are great! Each Flossie lasts a lot longer than an individual Greenie did and they appear to be digested better by mydog.  The crude protein in Greenies states "not less than 52 per cent" and in Flossies it states Crude Protein, minimum 89.73 per cent!" It is a low fat treat that my precious "baby" loves.By the way, in fairness to Greenies, they have come out with a wonderful "SMART BISCUIT" that is very digestible for dogs, as well as a treat called BARX, which is a very healthy soft snack stick.But Flossies will last your dog a long time and Bonnie guards her's ferociously!

column9: Haven't known a Dog who refused a Flossie
column10: I purchase Merrick Flossies regularly for my two Westies as well share them with my "dog park friends" of various sizes, breeds! I have not known one dog who refused such addicting treat! Larger breeds would normally woof this size of Flossie down in a few minutes while the smaller breeds much longer.

These treats really seem to satisfy our pug's chewing requirements. They don't smell great from a human standpoint, and sometimes she gets too enthusiastic and swallows too big a bite-but we ALWAYS supervise to make sure nothing untoward happens.  The only drawback outside of those mentioned is that her treat prices exceed what we pay for our own!
My two pugs are totally wild about Flossies.  I don't know what makes them so much more tasty but they are defintely prefered over all other chews.  We buy them by the case.
My sheltie LOVES them. All natural, and our vet recommended them over the rawhide. I have given some to our friends with dogs and the same reaction!!  Dogs LOVE them!!!!!

After hunting for Flossies on Ebay and finding the price getting more ludicrous by the day, I decided to give this a try and hope for the best. Well - the best is what we got!The flossies shipped quickly, they were fresh and I saved a chunk of money dealing with this company. I'll be back to order again. Happy customer and happy dog!Thanks so much for being a great merchant!
Our dogs have loved these for years.  They get tired of other treats, but have never tired of flossies.  We always have them on hand.

I have been ordering these Merrick flossies for years now, they're made in the USA, not China, and keep my dog occupied for almost 30 min. So the price is usually worth it- nothing else keeps my dog occupied that long. BUT I was highly disappointed by this last shipment that I ordered last week. They are not only shorter, but much, MUCH thinner. My dog goes through one in half the time now. Also, each one of the 50 flossies are individually wrapped, super inconvenient having to open each and every one every time, not to mention the waste of plastic... Not sure what is going on with the Merrick brand. Otherwise, amazon is great in ordering & shipping.

I've been buying these treats for my 2 pugs for several years and they still go crazy everytime they see the box.  They are long lasting (for my pugs anyway), which is great because it keeps them "busy" while hopefully helping to clean their teeth.  Every evening they sit by the cabinet waiting for me to bring them out, and they happily chew away for an hour or so.  I especially like them because they are natural, and not loaded with lots of fat and fillers.  One note, if you have a smaller dog like my pugs, you may want to take away the flossie when it gets down to the last couple of inches as my dogs tend to just swallow it whole... make sure you keep the water bowl full with plenty of fresh water nearby.

Our Daisy dog loves these treats! I tried the cheaper ones but he knows the difference and won't chew anything but Merrick Flossies.  Our vet says our dog has the cleanest teeth he has ever seen because of the Flossies.  Love your dog?  Treat him/her with Merrick Flossies ... you are sure to get a smile in return!!
White Dog Bone is a very good source for Merrick Flossies.  They are right on the ball with delivery. I am pleased and will use again.

I have an adorable American Pitbull Terrier who is a FLOSSIE JUNKIE !!! He gets a small Flossie EVERY morning after his breakfast. It is the highlight of his meal and "we" make a big fuss about it. Believe it or not,he prefers the smaller Flossies over the Phats! I like that they are 100% tendon and a part of the body that he ( Spencer ) would consume in the wild. Because I do feed him raw, I like to keep his treats consistent with his diet. Merrick is RIGHT ON in that department. They rate above the charts in our household. Thank you Merrick for your awesome quality products.

Our dog is a small lasapoo who just loves these treats!  We can't seem to keep enough around for her.  We rate this product 5 stars and the service we get from Amazon is amazing!  You won't find a better product or price!

Merrick Flossies are awesome.  We have ordered them many time.  PetFoodDirect (via Amazon) really stands behind their service.  The first shipment was supposedly delivered by UPS but either wasn't or was stolen from my porch.  Another case was shipped pronto and with no questions asked.  My pups were desperate for their Flossies and the service was really appreciated.  Order with confidence!!Merrick Flossies Dog Treats (50 Count)

column9: Good but new recipe - just so you know.
column10: My pups LOVED these flossies and I would buy them in cases of 50.  I would cut in half and give each shih tzu one and it would keep them busy for a while!  But, I recently ordered another case and they were "greasy" to the feel and look.  Turns out the manufacturer is now putting salmon oil on them (but has not put it in their description YET).  Just wanted you to know.  Sadly I now have to find another brand without the fish oil on them!  Some dogs may still love.  Mine did not.
Theses are great treats. My dog loves them. Price has been going up steadily over the years. Too expensive now! Time to quit buying them.

column9: Merrick Flossies are great, and this is a great price
column10: I have a Jack Russell Terrier who is 10 years old, 10 inches high, and 10 pounds, rather small for a JRT, but like all JRTs she has a big dog heart in a small dog body. At this price, a bit more than $2 a piece, I can afford to give her one every other day.  A LOT cheaper than teeth cleaning AND I don't have to worry about her being anesthetized. (Of course, I am also using a couple of natural products to clean her teeth and keep them clean.)  She really goes to town on the Flossies, scraping away on those back teeth, which is exactly what I like to see.  One Flossie lasts about 30 minutes to an hour, depending on the size and shape of the particular Flossie.  A few notes in response to other reviewers -(1) Flossies are a natural product, thus the size and shape varies from one to the next.  All in all, they are remarkably uniform, considering.  So don't expect the perfection of extruded by-product or undigestable fiber.(2) Flossies are a natural product, so they smell when combined with dog saliva.  As long as you expect it, it isn't horrible.  Again, I would rather have that smell than some artificial "spearmint" thing from a plastic toy.(3) ANY TIME your dog is chewing on a Flossie or any other rawhide or fake rawhide toy/treat, YOU should be aware/watching. Any dog will, from time to time, get it in their head that they need to swallow what's left of their treat before they are really finished, usually to protect it from another pet or from you.  Don't leave a dog unsupervised with any edible treat like this or you may end up fishing a curly piece of Flossie out of their throat, especially if you have a dog that tends to swallow things whole or inhale their food.(4) This is the cheapest price I have found and I have looked EVERYWHERE. column9: Buyer beware, Proctor & Gamble has ruined this food!
column10: My girlfriend and I have been rescuing, fostering, and adopting out (through a rescue group) cats and kittens for over 10 years. We also have a number of feline companions that live with us and bring us a lot of joy. So we're very experienced in all aspects of cat care, and we always try to feed our feline companions high quality foods. The foods are more expensive, but worth it for the health and well-being of our beloved companions!We had been using Innova Cat & Kitten Dry Cat Food for several years, once we discovered that it included no by-products, corn filler, or other junk ingredients. Our cats loved the food, which we mixed with another high quality dry food for variety.Fast forward to our experiences over the last few months. We heard that Proctor & Gamble, manufacturer of IAMS and other junk cat foods, had purchased Natura Pet Products, maker of the Innova, Healthwise, and California Natural brands, among others. Proctor & Gamble has questionable pet food testing practices (search the internet for it), so we naturally never buy their products and do not want to support the company in any way. So we were very upset about P&G's purchase of Natura, but we stuck with the Innova Cat & Kitten food for the short run, hoping we could later find a better alternative.Well strangely enough, for the last 10 or so 15lb bags of Innova Cat & Kitten that we've purchased, something has changed. The food is much more "crumbly", i.e. there is a lot more "food dust" in the bags, and the kibble looks a little different (lighter colored). We didn't think much of this change until our cats, which had previously LOVED the Innova food, lost interest in it and really didn't want to eat it. In the dry food mix we make, we noticed that very often, the cats would eat the other part of the mix, and leave the Innova Cat & Kitten behind. Clearly there is something different about the way P&G manufactures this food, as opposed to how it USED to be made by Natura Pet Products.This is EXPENSIVE food, and for the money you pay, it should be TOP QUALITY. Well, it ISN'T anymore! We finally reached our boiling point one day when we looked around at all the cat food bowls (which are usually totally empty after feeding time), and saw that much of the Innova part of the mix was leftover, unwanted.So that was it; we returned our last 3 large bags of Innova Cat & Kitten to the store we'd purchased them from, and will never buy this food again. In fact, we've now decided to never buy ANY Natura products, which include Healthwise and California Natural. We did find a good quality alternative cat food called "Simply Nourish", and when we tried it with our cats, they LOVED it. There is no longer ANY food leftover in their bowls, and we know the new food we are feeding is good quality.WARNING: For anyone currently purchasing "Innova Cat & Kitten", or planning to buy it in the future, we believe that P&G appears to have changed the way this food is made, for the worse. We can only assume that this large company was trying to save money, and in so doing have ruined one of the formerly best brands of food on the market. AVOID this food, it does NOT appear to contain the same formula/ingredients as it did before P&G bought Natura Pet Products, and ruined it!

This is less of a review of the actual cookies; though I rated them 5 stars.  The real merit of this "review" is to provide  information that may help others avoid the confusion that I experienced when I received my order.I stumbled upon the product page on Amazon for "Double Stuf Oreo Chocolate Cream."  The Amazon product image clearly said "Double Stuf Oreo Chocolate Cream" and I had never seen that product description or package previously.  I had seen regular Chocolate Cream Oreos before and even original Double Stuf Oreos (with the white filling) in local grocery stores but never the Double Stuf Oreo Chocolate Cream.  I put my concern about the potential need to buy new pants aside and I ordered a case of 12 boxes, which is the minimum order.I received the case promptly from Amazon.  When I opened it, I found 12 boxes that simply said, "Chocolate Cream Oreo".  I uploaded a picture of what I received.  I called Amazon and told some nice representative in India that I received the familiar regular stuf Chocolate Cream Oreos that I have seen in stores and not the Double Stuf Chocolate Cream I had been expecting.  He apologized and shipped another case.I received another case today and it was the exact same product that I received a few days previously: "Chocolate Cream Oreo".  Instead of calling Amazon, I decided to call Nabisco (Kraft Foods, Inc.) for clarification.  The number is listed on the package 1800-622-4726.The following is probably the real virtue of this review.  I was told that the package now for the Double Stuf Oreo Chocolate Cream does not say "Double Stuf" anywhere.  As I mentioned, I uploaded an image of the Double Stuf product package that I received.  According to Kraft, the only way to tell is the UPC and package weight.  The package weight for Double Stuf Oreos is 1 pound 1 ounce.  The package weight for regular or normal stuf Oreos is apparently 15.6 oz.  The UPC for Double Stuf Oreos is 04472700.  The UPC for (regular stuf) Chocolate Cream Oreos is 044000025298.  Since the package does not say Double Stuf anymore, I am not even sure what my local grocery carries.  I need to check the package weight and UPC at the grocery store.Therefore before you jump, head-long, into buying 12 boxes of this magical Double Stuf Chocolate Cream, you may want to check what your local grocery store carries.  I really do not see the logic in having 2 different products with the same package, but there you go:  that is apparently the case with Double Stuf Chocolate Cream and regular stuf Chocolate Cream Oreos.  I will also mention that it would be interesting to see a side-by-side comparison of Double Stuf and regular Oreo cookies.  My guess is that the difference is not as significant as you might expect since I initially thought my cookies were regular stuf.

So yummy.RECIPE2 cups semi-sweet chocolate chips2 tablespoons shortening1 package Oreos*optional: 1 cup white chocolate chips and 1 tablespoon shortening**Before you begin, make sure everything is absolutely dry. Even a drop of water will ruin your creation.**Melt the chocolate chips with the shortening in the microwave for 1 minute. Stir until melted. If needed, heat another 10 seconds at a time until melted. Be careful not to burn the chocolate.Place one cookie in the chocolate and coat. Use a fork to scoop it out, tapping against the bowl and scraping the bottom of the fork on the bowl to remove excess chocolate. Place on wax paper and let it set. Store refrigerated.Optional: To make it pretty, melt a cup of white chocolate with a tablespoon of shortening at 70% in the microwave for 1 minute. Dip a fork in the white chocolate and let it drizzle from the fork onto the semi-sweet chocolate covered cookies. If done neatly, your cookies will look beautiful.Hint: I do one batch in semi-sweet chocolate and one batch in white chocolate. Then, I drizzle the cookies with the alternate chocolate. Plate them together for an eye catching presentation.

column9: Think of this product as a delicious starting point....
column10: My wife and I love Indian food - I prefer the hotter the better, but she prefers mild with rich flavors.  The Tiger Tiger products fall right in the middle as an excellent compromise.  We've tried the Chana Masala, Mutter Paneer and Veggie Korma, all with excellent luck, but with a word of advice.  If you think of these products as complete meals (as they are advertised), you will be pleased but not blown away.  However, if you think of them as an excellent place to start, then the possibilities are endless.With the Chana Masala, we usually add another can of chick peas and some cilatro or other herb that cooks well.  Then we just let it simmer on the stove top for 30-60 minutes.  With very little supervision, and medium low heat, you won't have any concerns over burning, and like many "saucy" foods, it just gets better with time.  They give this a 3-star spice rating, but it is NOT hot in any sense of the word.  I usually add a little chili oil to my serving to punch it up because it adds hot without affecting the flavors.The Mutter Paneer is excellent as is, and the only thing we have found that we like to add is a very healthy dose of chopped fresh spinach.  Spinach is already one of the ingredients, so we just put the Tiger Tiger sauce in a pan and add about 6-8 oz of fresh spinach.  It takes about 7-10 minutes for the newly added spinach to cook down, and the result is great.The Veggie Korma is probably the easiest to doctor up because it closely resembles a sweet Thai curry sauce (in our opinion, anyway).  You can add any combination of steamed vegetables (green beans, broccoli, asparagus, carrots, etc.) and protein (chicken, shrimp, fish, tofu, etc.) and you'll almost certainly come up with an excellent product.As for comments on the rice - it's all a matter of taste.  The Basmati Cumin rice packaged with the Chana and Korma is on the al dente side, but this can be helped by adding a little water to the packet before you microwave, and then cooking it a little longer.  The flavor is fine, but not very intense.  Our favorite is the Basmati Pilau rice packaged with the Mutter Paneer as it starts softer and has a little more flavor to it.  We do find that when our creations are done, we sometimes need to steal the rice from an uncooked package, and when we use plain old brown rice the next time, it's not a huge loss.Finally, one reviewer stated they had lots of sand or grit in their meals.  We have probably eaten 15-20 of these so far with zero occurrence of any contaminants in our food.I'm giving the product 5 stars because I feel it is an excellent tasting product, that when purchased on sale (think $12-$15 per case instead of $25) is an exceptional value.  If you are a regimented cook who likes to follow the rules you may not enjoy the more relaxed method with which we experiment.  In that case you may wish to try these individually from the store before purchasing in bulk.  In any event, I feel you'll be pleased with the results, even if you think you know better.

Truly delicious, spicy which should appeal to those with leanings towards Mexican or Sezchaun Chinese.
