At first, the order arrived and all of the bags were just crushed to pieces.  I called Amazon and they were GREAT and sent me a replacement; however, the second batch wasn't much better which made me think it was the composition of the pears that crumbles during shipment.  The taste is too sweet, which is surprising since there is nothing in there except pears!  I prefer the apples in this line, and if you are looking for a great snack this is perfect.  I love to give them to my toddler (one bag = one apple!) as a snack when we are on the go.  And my fifth grader loves them in her lunch - they are what the "cool" kids have as they are a bit pricy (but come on what would you rather spend $1.25 on...organic apples or some high fructose junk which you know you'll end up buying in those little packs that cost twice as much per oz.!)So bottom line - love the crispy apples, pass on the pears unless they revamp the recipe and get a new pear variety.

I bought these for baking and once they arrived, realized that they were not the baking kind of fruit at all. I guess I just did not pick up on the "Crispy" detail in the title. I thought they were just your average dried fruit that I could cut up and put in breads and cakes, but they are certainly not that, so do not make the same mistake with them that I did.Otherwise, they are pretty nice. Now, as you might guess, I am an adult. So once I realize that I had a snack item on my hands, I decided to try it out in that capacity. That is where I became disenchanted with this product to some extent. The little packages of pears are not NEARLY enough for a snack for an adult. I have to eat 3 of them to feel like I got a snacks worth, and I am not a heavy eater. A whole candy bar is too much. A whole pear is almost too much, but these little packages are just not enough. The package says it holds the equivalent of one pear. My guess is, that these are mighty small pears.They are nice and sweet though. That is the biggest positive about this item. The taste is GREAT. I really do like that part.One reviewer mentioned that these tend to crumble easily and they do. About an eight of the product is at the bottom of the bag in a mess of crumbs. That is a disappointing factor. Since I had expected dried fruit, I guess I also expected that these snacks had a little more body to them than they do. The big pieces that hold together are quite good, but an awful lot of the product ends up at the bottom of the bag.I finally gave these 3 stars. They taste good, but there is just not nearly enough product. It crumbles. It is an awful big package with very little in it. column9: Outstanding Tea for Connoisseur or Non-Connoisseur Alike
column10: Like many, I have drank tea for many years, decades, actually, and have had the opportunity to sample everything from the standard bagged teas available everywhere to some of the most expensive hand-made teas developed in Europe using traditional processes. I won't try to pretend this St Dalfour tea is the equivalent of these highly esoteric (and incredibly expensive) teas, but what I can say is that this is a truly great tea for the bagged varieties, and, due to its unfamiliarity, would certainly qualify as a "sleeper" find. I can recommend this particular brand and variety as one of the best I've had.What makes this so good? First, the ingredients are all natural, with no artificial flavors or fillers (check your labels carefully and be surprised to see how many flavored teas rely on artificial flavors). To take it a step further, the ingredients here are all organic (see the information on the boxes and on the website to read about this), with no pesticides, artificial colors, or flavors added. At first blush, one might not be immediately attracted to a "black cherry" tea, but the manner in which St Dalfour blends this results in a flavorful tea that contains a subtle flavoring and aroma of black cherry that is really wonderful.If you prepare the tea correctly, you'll end up with a very smooth and delightfully flavored tea that may become your favorite. One secret for this, or any, tea is to not steep the tea more than 60-90 seconds MAX, and then remove the bag. It might seem like too short of a time at first, but if you force yourself to keep to this time, with a few dunks at the end, you should begin to see how tea can really taste if it isn't over-steeped and allowed to turn bitter. (Everyone has a strength preference and so you'll have to experiment at first, but if you can keep it to no longer than 90 seconds, that should be ideal.) Further, if you have a water boiler that allows you to select temperature, if you use a water temperature right below the boiling point, that smoothness can be extended further.An easy recommend to the tea lover, this tea is one of my favorites. Five stars.

column9: Calming tea but has no flavor
column10: I do not suffer from insomnia but occasionally I get stressed out and find myself worrying too much about things I have no control over.  I have used Bach's Rescue Remedy in the past for this and while that helps relieve anxiety it also makes me spacey and a little sleepy. This tea IS relaxing and calming.  It does not make me sleepy or lose my focus - I can have this during the day and go on with my activities.  The directions say to pour boiling water over the teabag and let it steep for 2 minutes.  I let it steep for 4 minutes in order to get some flavor out of it.  I find the tea rather bland.  I add no sweetener or lemon, just drink it plain.  It is not a bad tasting tea, it just has a faint herb-y taste, and that is fine.  The package says it relaxes muscles and mind.  I have noticed that after drinking the tea my neck muscles loosen up a bit.  To summarize, this tea will not hurt you, and the flavor will not be offensive to you.  It MAY help you loosen up and lighten up a bit.  If you have serious anxiety or insomnia you won't find a solution with this product and should discuss this with your doctor and consider a pharmaceutical solution instead.
I read this tea works well with anti anxiety or sleep prescriptions.  Have been using it for several weeks and it seems to help so that the medication is more effective.

column9: I'm drinking it as I write
column10: I hope you'll buy this tea. I want it to be extremely popular, so Yogi will never discontinue it. I'm crazy about it and drink it after dinner every night.I drink high-test Japanese green tea in the morning and herb tea at night. It's hard to find an herbal tea that doesn't seem wimpy after my intense green tea buzz. Yogi Aztec Sweet Chili tea is the herbal tea I've been looking for all my life - mysteriously full-bodied and satisfying.It's made from organic spices that wage war between sweet and peppery tastes. These contradictory flavors are amazingly stimulating, without the aid of caffeine. Ultimately this lively sensation turns into a warm serene feeling.Ingredients include licorice root, orange peel, ginger root, fennel seed, anise seed, cinnamon bark, cardamom seed, clove bud, cayenne, black pepper and cocoa shells - all organic.I suggest you use a covered cup or pot and steep the bag well over five minutes to bring your tea to full strength. It's curiously filling, without the aid of calories.I buy mine at my local co-op, but now that I know you can get six-packs through Amazon, I might try that. It would be nice, never to run out.

column9: Very Striking Flavor, A Must-Try If You Like Horseradish.
column10: I bought a few bags of these chips without wasabi a month or so ago, very much enjoyed them, so naturally I wanted to try this. I wasn't quite sure what wasabi was until I tried this but apparently it is the Japanese version of horseradish, which I absolutely love. I wasn't sure what to expect when I thought of combining shrimp and horseradish, but I figured "what the hell". Anyway, the bag got here a few days ago and I was pretty shocked with the flavor in a good way. The wasabi is very pungeant and you might need a few seconds to reel after your first fry, but you'll want more. Check it out; you'll never know until you do.
I bought this for my brother's birthday, he really likes them, so yeah, 5 stars! Lol

column9: No corn or chicken! Don't be fooled!
column10: This is only a box of beans! It has no chicken or corn or any other necessary ingredients to make a soup except a spice/condiment pouch inside the box! In fact, the instruction tells you to buy your own chicken, tomatoes, corn, okra and others to make it a soup. The image and title of this product is tantamount to false labelling and advertising. Who needs beans to make corn and chicken soup???? This is like just a recipe you are buying and nothing more! The other soups from this company turn out to be more of the same! Don't be fooled.

While I will admit I had the same visceral reaction as the other reviewer when these arrived and I read I had to add the corn and chicken myself in order to make the corn and chicken stew, I have found myself especially surprised. In fact, it's on the counter to make tomorrow. I buy a bag of frozen corn, a bag of frozen okra and throw in some Tyson grilled chicken strips and there you go - it's dinner. I don't think you even need to add the chicken. It will still have plenty of protein without it considering the beans. Several people have come to the house to sample this and ALL have liked it...from my picky 'I always need meat' husband to my Earth Girl best friend to my 3 year old and his constantly changing palate/food mood swings to my 9 month old who discovered he loves okra from this recipe. I have made it twice and everyone eats it. I don't know what it is! Using my last box tomorrow and ordering more cause it is still an easy dinner that everyone can agree on!
As advertised, the products met the seller's advertisement and exceeded my expectation.A top-notch customer relations team is available to resolve discrepancies.I would highly recommend it.

My Persian kitten has got to be the fussiest cat going she loves this catfood but only to eat the gravy....  I've tried all the brands but Fancy Feast is her favorite..the gravy anyway and my Lab loves finishing it off...

column9: Great product can add cinnamon flavor without changing the color
column10: I have had problems with some recipes that used cinnamon.  It changes the color of it.  Like Rice pudding.  With this you get no color change. It is also good with apple pie and pumpkin pie. One thing from my youth in the 70's. You soak tooth picks in it and let it dry they put it in your mouth to keep your breath fresh and the teacher can't smell the cigarette you just smoked in the bathroom. LOL  Warning it's a little spicy hot.

column9: Maybe you like it, I don't
column10: That Hain Celestial company that is manufacturing Health Valley and other brands has gone crazy of late, balancing purity with excess calories and lack of nutritional value. column9: This was an HUGE hit with my pups
column10: They LOVED the basted flavor.  The product is larger than what my local PetSmart has in stock.  I've since switched to the knuckle bone 'steaks' because they are kinder on their teeth while still providing the nutrients needed for healthy joints.

This is one of my favorite coffees, and I'm fussy when it comes to coffee.  The hazelnut flavor is noticeable without being too pronounced, and the coffee itself is from quality beans.  There is no burnt or metallic flavor, which sometimes happens with beans of a lesser quality.  Eight O'Clock coffee of any flavor is excellent, and I wouldn't hesitate to recommend it to anyone.  Using whole bean rather than ground coffee is the best way to make fresh-tasting coffee every day.
The coffee is good but it does not have the hazelnut flavor. I was disapointed because it just taste like regular coffee.

column9: Better off purchasing from your local store
column10: Bought this last week, shipping was very fast.  After doing the math and making a trip to the store (one which i won't do free advertising for) I discovered I overpaid with amazon.Check with your local stores before purchasing.
My husband bought me this coffee to try after reading a positive review. It is great! It is now my new favorite coffee. No artificial/chemical flavoring taste
My family started buying this for camping trips, now we even drink it at home.  I think it has a clean taste, and the price is right.

The description of the product did not indicate that the coffee was in "Whole Bean". I assumed it was ground. I do not have a grinder, and am not interested in buying one. At this time it was a waste of $30.

We had decided not to give our dog rawhide, but he is an aggressive chewer and needed something to chew on.  I ordered the SmartBones hoping for a substitute for the Dingo Bones we had given our previous dog.  Bogie loves the SmartBonese, and they last quite a while, although not as long as a rawhide bone.  The fantastic part is they are made from vegetables and are easily digested.  We are dedicated SmartBone users.  I give them an A++++++++++++.

I bought these from PetSmart, not Amazon (though they are about 4 bucks cheaper on Amazon). My dog was born without enamel on the tips of his teeth.  This means he can't chew on anything hard or else his teeth might crack.  I was extremely excited about these bones since they were pretty soft and weren't actually rawhide.My dog loved them, but I don't The bones are extremely flimsy.  In the bag I just felt to see if they were softer then rawhide and they were slightly softer.  My dog had the bone destroyed within 25 minutes.  He also ate all of the bone and left sticky remains all over the floor.I gave my dog another one several days later and a third a few days after that.  At the end of the week I woke up to him throwing up at 3am.  His vomit was all the Smart Bone material.  He threw up several times and has continued to throw up since.  Do not buy this brand.  It just isn't trustworthy.  These bones were the only change in his diet and the only plausable cause for vomit.  (He has since stopped after switching to a different brand).  I wish I had seen the other reviews before I purchased it.  After reading the other reviews about some dogs becoming ill I've switched to buying my dog chews at a local, small run dog shop that can tell me the ingredients in each bone and what is safe and what is not.  Why do so many companies make such unhealthy/dangerous things for our dogs?

column9: Not very durable, much softer than other bones that look similar
column10: My dog did enjoy these bones, but they are so soft that he obliterates them in less than 10 minutes. There is another brand that looks similar to these that has a much stiffer/dryer texture, and it takes him several hours to work through those. Additionally, with these SmartBones, he was able to bite off the end entirely, which can be a choking hazard. I won't be getting these bones again.
At first I thought they are a bit too big for them... But no its perfect!!!!I have 3 small dogs, all different in breed and sizes...and they all love these so much!!I'm DEFINITELY getting more!!! :D

I like that these are an alternative to rawhides but they definitely are not made for super chewers.  My dogs finished them in about 15-20 minutes.  They were more like a treat rather than something to keep them occupied.

Did not want to give my dogs rawhides and smart bones are awesome.  My dogs LOVE them.  They are a little pricey but work every bit of the money.  I have bought from this seller before and they are great.  Thanks for making it a hassel free experence and thanks for keeping the price down.

granted it's small but when you wanna shed the pounds, sacrificing is the name of the game.  that being said, this is a nice treat - even more so when you refrigerate or better yet freeze it.  takes a lil longer to eat and you can psyche yourself out that you have actually more to eat.  let's face it, losing weight is 90% mind games and we need whatever help we can get.

I typically order the cheapest bag of whole beans from Amazon that ship with Prime;  I tried this bag on a whim and I'm very happy.I grind 4 cups automatically each day and it is a nice flavor.  Not too strong, not too weak.  Good morning blend. (If you have never had freshly ground coffee, and are not scared of paying for freshly ground each day the rest of your life, hop on a bag on sale on Amazon and give it a try.  I use a Krupps integrated auto-grind unit, and I'm a big fan.  And the unit has broken once and I had it repaired!)I'm not a cofee snob but this stuff is night a day to pre-ground coffee;  I much much prefer this brand to the Jeremiah's bags of beans (I believe I had the Jeremiah fogbuster earlier which was not great...)

This is one of the worst coffees i have ever purchased.  There was no indication in the product description that it was a "blend".  The product was listed as Dark Roast, however, it is light roast at best.  The roasting is uneven.  It is weak, overly acidic and tastes awful.

This is the weakest Dark Roast that I have ever encountered.Somehow I managed to order the wrong coffee, but I tried it anyways.What a mistake. Small, deformed and immature beans; half seem hardly roasted at all.Even roasting it myself did nothing to improve the flavor.Caffeine. but little else..

If you look on the package picture close enough, you will see that it is a "blend", which means it can be 90% of any coffee other than Papua New Guinea.  Nowhere in the product description it mentions that it is a blend.  I realized this only after buying. For generic coffee, it is a decent blend, certainly no worse than what you would buy at a local coffee chain, but much less expensive.  An undiscriminating coffee drinker would find it acceptable.  But don't expect any special flavor nuances from it or try to compare it to 100% PNG coffee.

This product, although still usable, is not what I would call high quality onions. The color most of us are used to is white and the texture very fine. This is not the case with this product. It is a medium brown color and tastes as though it has been toasted to a degree. To me, it does not do as well in recipes as other brands on the market. It plumps up much more leaving a grainy texture and throws off the color of recipes.It is not a replacement for onion powder by far, and I really will not purchase it again.On the flip side though, if you are looking for a coarser texture with a very mild onion flavor, you might like it.

Melitta coffee is an excellent coffee for daily use.  It is a little stronger than most American brands, but your taste quickly adapts to it and you do not want to go back to regular coffee.  To me, Brazilian coffee tastes better than Colombian coffee and is smoother to drink with a good flavor.  I would recommend that anyone try a bag and see for yourself; just use a little less than usual to keep it from being too strong.

If you like the Colombian Arabica coffees, this is as good as any other Colombian. Medium roast with full rich and smooth flavor. Leaves smoky-chocolatey aftertaste (a nice one). The price is also excellent at .46/cup, don't let the price make you think that it has no quality; very satisfied with my purchase and I will buying more for sure; this is one of the best deals with T-Discs.The coffee is also 30% Rainforest Alliance Certified, which makes me feel even better helping a good cause. Get it while it is available.Update: After going through the first package; this one has really grown on me and I can't wait for it to be available again.  Very tasty and smooth way to start your morning. Highly recommended.
Usually drink the French Roast but found this to be smoother & richer.  Hope to continue buying if I can get it at a decent price.

This drink doesn't need a lot - the sweetness of the juice is plenty enough.Amazon - your price for this 12 pack is more expensive that my local hipster health food store! Unbelievable. column9: Very Good Product From Blue Sky
column10: I have been sampling energy products lately and wanted to try this variant of Blue Sky energy drink.  The taste of this product is very good and quite different than the original product.  In my opinion it is definitely better tasting than most energy drink products you find on the market.  I like the fact it contains 50% juice and they don't use any artificial sweeteners.  My only compliant would be it tends to be a little on the sweet side and it does contain 58g of sugar.  I would recommend Blue Sky cut back on adding sugar (sucrose) since the product is probably sweet enough already due to the fruit juices.  Overall I would purchase again if I do find a better product.
This is a good tasting drink that does not over-energize.  Also, due to the size, it is a good source of liquid for morning wake up.
Very good taste and it gives a good feeling of alertness with no jittery feeling.
I really didn't want to review and rate this particular product because its toooo good and I want all of it to myself. This cookie mix is from the gods. Please leave me some, don't buy it all please!

Very simple to understand, and the ingredients list isn't a mile long!  As an added plus, the preparation is VERY simple -- just an egg and a stick of butter, and you're off and running!Give them a try, and maybe you'll have a new favorite ;)

column9: a different, tasty chocolate chip cookie
column10: When you think of a chocolate chip cookie, I don't think the first word that comes to mind would be "hearty".  These cookies are hearty. Both the oatmeal and whole grain flour create an unusual consistency and flavor.At first, I didn't think I would buy these again; the whole grain took a little time for me to embrace. Now I am hooked.  One would think that because the cookies are whole grain, they are more nutritious.  While I am not a nutritionist, I believe that a lot of the nutritional value may be compromised when the baker adds the stick of butter that is cited as an ingredient.  I guess it is important to consider that while the butter adds fat, these cookies are so filling that eating one or two is completely possible.  After eating one or two, I can walk away feeling like I got a cookie fix (try eating one or two out of a box of commercial cookies, it would be rarely possible to feel satisfied).  When short on time, I have even used two cookies as a meal replacement (recall my previous admission that I am no nutritionist).  The cookies keep me stabilized for several hours when necessary and they taste better than most protein bars.It should be noted that a suggestion is given on the box to replace half of the stick of butter with applesauce in order to reduce the fat and calories.  As I did not try that option, I cannot comment on how it impacts flavor.If you are baking these for the first time, take note that the bottoms of the cookies brown quickly.  When they come out of the oven, they will still be soft on top and appear slightly undone.  Let them cool for 15-20 minutes and they will be fine.While I really like these cookies, I am only giving the product four stars because of the price.  I will be trying more of the Kodiak brand in upcoming months.

column9: These are the very best cookies EVER!

SO SO easy to make and they turned out perfectly - ME, I either undercook or overcook every cookie I have ever tried to make but these?  PERFECT.  We love them.  We decided to do the subscribe and save and may give boxes for Christmas presents this year to our friends.  Who wouldn't love these?

column9: I really like these - Just like the ones from the old days!

column9: old fashioned yummy candy & made in the USA

column9: whole grain pasta even my child will eat
column10: I have tried most every whole grain pasta there is.  All were rejected by my "white food" son..until now.  This pasta is so delicious he asks for it.  I bought about 8 boxes, and they are almost all gone. Al dente, tasty, and good for you-what more could one ask for?

These are healthy treats, not intended to be a large part of a dog's diet. The ingredients of most of the Wet Noses products are all good for dogs. NOT included are wheat and corn, which some dogs react poorly to, and which may be contaminated, especially if imported.These biscuits break in two fairly easily, but are firm enough give the dog some crunchy chewing exercise. I only use rewards to train my dog, and these are very motivating for him.
Organic. Made in the USA. Our Westies love it and it doesn't give them bad breath, unlike the salmon treats we were giving them...

We have a 12 year old Akita dog that has developed food-related allergies and intolerance as she has gotten older. Akitas as a breed are also more sensitive to chemicals. For this reason, we're very selective about what dog food and dog treats we buy. Wet Noses is one of the few dog treat lines which meets all our requirements, and our dog LOVES these treats! Wet Noses uses all organic ingredients and stays away from ingredients such as corn, wheat and soy to which dogs are more likely to be allergic. Every ingredient appears to have been selected to give exceptional nutrition for the money and for the calories it provides. We bought the sweet potato treat, a flavor dogs seem to love but which is rarely found in commercial dog food. (Before we found this line of dog treats, we used to add pieces of sweet potato to our dog's regular commercial dog food.) We were also impressed that Wet Noses uses quality ingredients such as rye flour, turmeric, sesame paste, cumin and cinnamon. All of these ingredients appear to have been included not only to make these treats taste good, but also for their health benefits. I would highly recommend this product. The treats are a little over an inch in diameter.

Okay, Stella is a dog if it is edible she will eat it.  I can not say this is her favorite snack but I say treat and she knows where to go and will sit impatiently while I get them out.  Proof enough for me.  5 stars.

The first treat all six (yes six!) of my dogs agree on! Finally my picky eaters are happy! They love the apples and carrots, and I am buying other flavors today to see how they like those. Thank you Wet Noses!

These little round "cookies" are unassuming and I wasn't sure how they would go over with my spoiled Jack Russell and Chihuahua.  An instant hit!  They seem to have staying power, as after several weeks of offering these at treat time, they still get snatched out of my hand with approving tail wags.The ingredients list is actually tempting (organic oats, Wisconsin cheddar, olive oil, dill, etc).  I'm impressed.  A good treat product.

I purchased a package of these snacks in Seattle while on vacation, and brought them to work for our office dogs.  They absolutely love them!  I was afraid that I wouldn't be able to find them in California, so it's great that Amazon sells them.  Our 4-legged friends give them a Paws Up!

Love this product becasue it's high quality and Made In the USA! Most dog treats I've looked at lately are made in China and I won't buy them. My dog has problems with allergies as well as seizures and these treats don't cause either to flare up. Other treats do. The best part is dogs love them!

I also used this reviews for the Apple Thyme flavor (these are the only two varieties we've tried this far):These treats are both healthy and high quality. They contain no wheat, which is a definite plus. The dogs like them enough, but aren't crazy about them dry. What I usually do is mix them with yogurt and other coordinating ingredients (applesauce for apple flavor, canned pumpkin for pumpkin flavor)and use as a Kong stuffing. They gobble them up that way.

column9: Very nutritious and dogs love it!
column10: Title says it all, very nutritious and dogs love it!  Good quality ingredients, I enjoy giving them treats that I believe are good for them.
My Cocker Spaniel has many allergies. The only treats he can have are natural with out any meat fillers, wheat or corn. These are great he loves them and has no skin problem after eating them.

My five Cavalier King Charles Spaniels love Wet Noses.  The organic,limited ingredient treats give me peace of mind that I'm providing them safe and healthful ingredients. Buying Wet Noses products through Amazon is more affordable than the pet stores, too.

column9: Dogs Love Them + Organic, Made in the USA
column10: My dogs love these treats. We have tried the peanut butter and pumpkin and they love both types. It's also great that they are organic and made in the USA.

column9: Treats I feel good about giving my dog.....
column10: I love Wet Noses!  I feel really good about giving these to my dog.Organic is always best, it's never good when you don't know what an ingredient is or why it's in a dog treat!?!?!My dog will eat anything, but I think he really loves these!  ENJOY!

I bought these for my dogs and they go crazy for them. I love that they are all natural and are not made in Mexico. The story of how this company started is also, a great benefit! I recomend these to everyone I know!

My German Shepard loves these treats, and he is a picky treat-eater.  I highly recommend this to anyone with a picky dog.

column10: My dog loves this treat.  This product is a must for your fur buddy.  He really loves this treat and he plays with it before he eats them.  I will be getting this along with usualDogswell cage free chicken treats.

When I opened the package, I was ready to eat them.  They smell like a pumpkin pie!  The dogs came running and love them, perhaps the scent enhances the flavor to them.  I like that there's no sugar in them.  Having one pet with diabetes was enough.
Treats are fine.  Our lab likes them.  The 3 boxes came in good condition.  I don't like the fact that they don't have a ziplock bag on the inside.
My dogs love these treats.  They go crazy when I bring them out.  The pumpkin is good for their digestive systems too!

My dog doesn't digest wheat well, so this product filled the bill. It's a nice size for a treat -- important if your dog is watching his/her weight like mine is. Also nice is that they don't tend to disintegrate in the bag, leaving a pile of crumbs.

column9: Wet Noses Sweet Potato dog treat

column10: These are hard cookie like treats. I haven't seen my dog eat more than one of these. She just buries them. I keep finding them when I cut the lawn. Unfortunately, these are just about the only thing my dog or even cat won't eat and I wish they would.

My wire-haired pointing griffon loves these treats and is rewarded with one each time she correctly performs her working dog tasks/efforts.  Great product and I recommend it to other dog owners/lovers.
Our two little dogs love these. We break one in two and they each get half every time they come in from taking care of business.
Our dog has an extremely sensitive stomach and this product is great as it doesn't seem to cause any problems.  Love the 3-pack too b/c we usually go through them pretty quick.

My dog has many food allergies so it is hard finding a treat that she is able to eat.  Wet Noses Apples and Carrots has quality and limited ingredients that are not only healthy for her, but also highly appealing. She loves eating these treats! Wet Noses dog treats are the best in the business.They've got it all from the "Crunch" to the fact that they are the real deal...no undesirable ingredients...plus the price is right and doggy, of course, loves them. I also buy the Pumpkin flavor.
My dog loves these treats, and they're so great for him! We've tried every flavor and he loves them all. I highly recommend these to anyone who loves their dog and cares about their health.

column9: if you must mix mint & chocolate... the perfect bar
column10: i am not ordinarily a fan of mint/chocolate combos, which usually are toothpasty hideously-refreshing mint in cheap-&-common somehow-simultaneously-waxy-&-gooey milk chocolate.  i also dislike rosemary in many of the places it crops up - woodenly weeding up an otherwise lovely savory, for example.here we have the marvelous exception with rosemary being the ingredient that pleasantly sneaks up on you.  the chocolate is rich & on the dry side; the mint is more like the mellow mint that volunteers around outdoor faucets; the rosemary is pitch perfect.

This -- and the Dagoba Lavender bars -- are the perfect balance between dark and super dark chocolates.  The rosemary and lavender tastes are not immediately evident - they just linger as a faint fragrance in your mouth after you've eaten the chocolate.  The balance between the sugar and chocolate in the bars is perfect -- sweet enough to not be bitter but not so sweet that the chocolate is overwhelmed.  I can't recommend this chocolate enough.  Even a small piece is satisfying.

column9: Sub-par chocolate at an absolutely silly price
column10: Everything this company touches turns to flavorless, waxy chalk. This company seems to be running on a pure-profit scheme of hyper-inflated prices and, while all their products are aesthetically appealing, this actually counts against the final product as the taste and texture is so far beyond disappointing for the price that I actually came here to write negative reviews on their products to warn customers that their money is better spent on better-tasting chocolate. If you just must have chocolate from Vermont, take a trip to Stowe and look for Laughing Moon--same price range...and THEIR chocolate is heavenly. If you want seriously delicious chocolate for a pretty good price, look for green mountain chocolates--recipes in Swiss Chocolate from a White House Pastry Chef of 20 years...also founded in Vermont, though now they're in Mass. Shame :/ When Lake Champlain purchased the retail outlet from Green Mountain Chocolates, they switched all the fantastic chocolate out, dumped their terrifyingly high-priced brown wax-chalk into the same glass displays.  Walking in without knowing what had happened was like being a character in a Twilight Zone episode, or a contestant on a malevolent Japanese game show. I once accidentally paid 28 dollars for half a pound of what they assured me were truffles but was actually a box of sadness and regret.

column9: Smaller bars, New nutritional info, & Other information
column10: Great tasting bars - we eat them when we crave something a bit sweet. I don't believe these bars are necessarily "good for you" or suitable as a meal replacement. However, they are a healthy alternative to packaged bakery items, cookies or candy.The bars now are smaller in weight - from 61g to 54g. As a result, the nutritional information has changed but Amazon's website has not - I have posted the new nutritional information as a customer image & hope it helps someone. This change occurred a couple years ago.We've recently noticed a change in volume as well. Our latest shipment of bars is smaller - the box & package is the same, but the bar itself is smaller but with no change in weight (still 54g). I did not notice a change in taste but the texture seemed smoother. I'm not sure why these bars are smaller than previous batches. Is it a change in recipe? A quality control issue? A new ingredient? Don't know. What I do know is that I just ate a bar with yogurt, which is typical for me, and unfortunately I have to report that this snack is not as filling as before. My DH also noticed that the bar was less filling. I think something is different about the bars once again, but exactly what it is I don't know quite yet.I'm a Weight Watcher with life-time status. column9: When in doubt, drink the original!
column10: It's summer. It's so muggy you can see the steam rise off the pavement. Yep, you're in the semi-tropics now. It's New Orleans and the living is easy. And it is 8 o'clock in the morning. Time for cafe au lait made with coffee and chicory and a plate of beignets dusted with powdered sugar. It's the chicory that gives cafe au lait its robust, mellowed down flavor.Chicory? What is chicory? Thought you would never ask. I just happen to have that answer right here:From Wikipedia: "Root chicory (Cichorium intybus var. sativum) has been in cultivation in Europe as a coffee substitute. The roots are baked, ground, and used as a coffee substitute and additive, especially in the Mediterranean region (where the plant is native), although its use as a coffee additive is also very popular in India, parts of Southeast Asia and the American South, particularly in New Orleans. Chicory, with sugar beet and rye was used as an ingredient of the East German Mischkaffee (mixed coffee), introduced during the "coffee crisis" of 1976-9." Chicory is also related to endive and raddichio.Cafe au lait is strong coffee mixed half with hot milk, and sugar added as desired. There is nothing like it, especially when drunk in the atmosphere of New Orleans.

Chicory gives this coffee its rich taste, dark color and syrupy body -- I guess, although no other chicory-cut coffee I've ever tasted was this good. Although this coffee tastes very strong and robust, I suspect it has less caffeine than the straight stuff; at least, I've been able to drink a lot of it without getting the jitters.I usually buy mine for some ridiculously low price at an Asian market, but lately they've been out of stock. Anyone know why Asian markets carry this product? I wonder if there's an interesting story behind that...

column9: Tried Many - This is not the best
column10: Prior to visiting New Orleans I drank the usual national-brand, plastic-jug coffee sold in supermarkets across the country.  After visiting New Orleans and developing a liking for C&C (coffee and chicory) I've tried numerous brands of both medium-dark roast and dark roast C&C.Of the two roasts I found I like the dark roast more (which Cafe du Monde C&C is).  I was excited to try the brew from the coffee stand we visited several times near Jackson Square but was disappointed when I made my first pot of Cafe du Monde C&C.  It has kind of a burnt taste to it (while the French Market City Roast I tried - which is also a dark roast - has kind of a chocolate taste to it).Cafe du Monde may be the preferred brand if you're going to serve your coffee 'au lait' style with 1/2 hot milk (as they do at the actual cafe near Jackson Square) but it's not the best if you're going to have your coffee with just a touch of cream and/or sugar.

I have been to NOLA twice, and both times drank as much Cafe Du Monde as possible.  Make it 50% coffee (I use a french press) and 50% hot whole milk.  I get mine at the local asian market for $3.65 a can but this price is fair for the coffee, and it is simply the best, full chickory taste.  Great with grits in the morning too!

But with cream and sugar, the taste transforms. It becomes rich yet smooth. It is so easy and addictive to drink that you can get caffeine overdosed without knowing it until bedtime. It takes me 10 seconds to make a Senseo coffee pod with a regular 4-cup basket coffee filters. The brew from Senseo is stronger than drip coffee maker with crema on top similar to the result from an espresso machine. You will love the result without the mess from a coffee press.Since this is the coffee of choice for Vietnamese ice coffee, you can find this coffee sold in most large Asian supermarkets. column4: Leah M. Brown "Leah Marie Brown, Author"
column10: On a sultry July morning, a few years before Katrina blew into town, a friend and I wandered into the frenetic, powder-sugar dusted Cafe du Monde for an early cup of coffee and the famously fabulous fritters we had heard so much about. We were hot, sweaty, and more than a little worn out from having hoofed all over the historic district. It would take more than a few Dunkin Donuts to revive our exausted, jaded spirits and a whole lot more than a Krispee Kream to skewer our skepticism.The pastries needed to be fresh, hot, and Paris-pretty to impress us. The coffee had to be perfectly percolated to perk us up.What we had that morning (several plates of steaming, sinfully-sweet, precisely-powdered beignets) were tiny pillows of pastry perfection. The beignets were so good, we made several more early morning trips to Cafe du Monde during our stay in New Orleans. The coffee was utterly addictive, strong, lovely, full-bodied, with a rich aroma that could be detected long before we entered the shop.Once home, I experienced a serious post-perfect-beignet let-down. Krispee Kream no longer cut it. Starbucks was sadly unsatisfying.I was thrilled when I discovered I could buy Cafe du Monde's beignet mix and coffeee online. I ordered several boxes and cans, stocked up on a truck-load of powdered sugar, and anxiously waited by my mailbox. When the much-coveted beignet mix was finally delivered, I wasted no time in firing up the oil and brewing a pot of coffee.I was very pleased with the beignet mix and the chicory coffee. The directions were easy to follow (just add water) and the amount of mix in the box was generous for the price. Once properlly prepared, the beignets were just as delicious as those served at Cafe du Monde (of course, you do have that tiresome clean-up when you make them at home that you don't have when you go to the cafe in New Orleans, but all truly great things come with a price).Pefect patries and heavenly coffee.  Forget Starbucks!

column9: Just as good as other brands of coffee and chicory
column10: Only purchased this to bring my total purchase up to $25 so I could get free shipping. I can buy French Market Coffee and Chicory at Safeway here in Kailua. I've found no difference in any of the brands of coffee and chicory I've ever purchased. They are all great.

I have never been to New Orleans and had no idea if this coffee would be any good; past experience has proved that 'coffee in a can' was almost always bad (but usually cheap). I like chicory though, and once read that Henry Miller enjoyed coffee and chicory together.This was an impulse buy. I saw this in the Asian food isle of the Food4Less store here in Portland, Or. for only 5 or 6 dollars. So if you have that store or an Asian market in your area, check there first. It'll be way cheaper, and plus, no shipping cost!It's delicious just black, not bitter at all, but great as well as with milk or cream.

the reason this is at asian markets is because it is used in making Thai iced coffee.  find an authentic asian resturant (the SE asians learned french cookery) and order it but ask first if they use cafe dumonde.  they put about 1/2 inch of eagle brand milk in a 8 oz. glass, fill it with ice and cover it with a little stainless drip gizmo full of the coffee and pour boiling water ove the grounds,INCREDIBLE

Today I received a care package with two cans Cafe Du Monde in it.  It has been several months since my last cup.  Being deployed and taking my first sip helped me forget where I am.  This coffee is delicious and helps me remember the good ole U.S. of A.
We love this coffee, it's all about the chicory which adds great flavor making this a rich tasting cup of coffee.
Fast shipping, so nice to be able to get this coffee I had in New Orleans. Great strong cafe au lait!!

I have recently tried to give up soda, and am making the effort to Tea.  Both lightly sweetened and unsweetened.  I have recently tried Honest Tea in there smaller sizes 10oz bottle for $1.25 (the 64 oz is a good deal price wise).I found that the tea is best served very cold but has a little more bitter after taste than other premium teas.  I have continued to buy it as it is my second favorite tea in the Unsweetened flavor, but I much prefer the mint flavor.

I really wanted a good source of anti-oxidants in a green tea without having to constantly brew my own.  Honest Tea is the answer.  One of our local stores carries this product in the small bottles, but it is no value, very expensive.  I did a lot of research to find this product and it is nearly perfect.  I actually add a small amount of sugarless bottled lemonade which makes it even better tasting.  This is a best buy, especially, if you can find it locally.  I have not been able to find the 64 ounce bottles locally which would be the best value.
I learned about this tea from the Abs Diet book and let me tell it is awesome.  Tastes great and gives you a real energy boost.  Would definitely buy it again.

column9: 5 Stars for the Green Tea itself, 1 star for the price
column10: First off, before my review, I get this Green Tea in my local health food store, the same exact 64 oz. bottle, for $5.99 normally, and it's often on sale for $4.99.  This price of $7.99 plus shipping is completely outrageous.With that said, this Green Tea is without question the best bottled Green Tea I've ever had.  I don't know if it contains more caffeine than normal tea or what, but I get SUCH a rush from drinking this tea.  I almost feel sort of drunk, actually.  In a good way though.  Not stumbling around with slow reflexes, but from a mental aspect, I feel happier and more energetic.  I've never had this happen with ANY other Green Tea I've ever drank.If you've never tried this Green Tea, but you like to drink it, you're doing yourself a great disservice.  This Honest Unsweetened Green Tea is absolutely incredible.  I'm not such a big fan of the flavored ones -- they don't work as well for some reason.  It's only the Unsweetened one that I rave about.

column9: Five stars for the tea itself
column10: Words cannot even begin to describe my love for this tea. I was looking for an authentic unsweetened tea that contained a substantial amount of antioxidants. This tea was it. It's organic. It has no artificial sweeteners or high fructose corn syrup. It's Fair Trade Certified. It has a ton of antioxidants. Oh, and did I mention how energized I feel after drinking it? Just Green Tea is the real deal. I lucked out because I live close to a Wegmans, who carries the 64 fluid ounce bottle at a good price. This tea is wonderful for health-conscious folks, those seeking to lose weight, college students who have an 8 A.M. class, and tea connoisseurs. Five stars for the product, one star for the Amazon price.

column9: Love it because it doesn't take like Green Tea
column10: I'm doing the "Eat right for your type" diet and the one beverage that benefits me is Green Tea.  We all know that you can go to any store and find a slew of different products in this category, but after reading in a major men's publication that this was the healthiest green tea sold, I had to try it.  I'm not real big on the taste of green tea, but this actually taste like strong tea, so I can drink this stuff all day and be happy.  Also, I've found that buying it on Amazon is much cheaper that going to your local Kroger/Scott's store.

column9: One of the best beef flavors....
column10: This is like the other reviewer said  better than Knorr,and they make some of the best flavorings. I just don't know how they managed to get the browned beef bone exact taste. Almost all of the beef bouillon I have tried all tasted the same untill I tried this brand. Even when you open it up you can smell that wonderful rib bone and you just want to take a bite out of it so good.....

I discovered this product when I was shopping in a supermarket in a Spanish neighborhood. Since I'm always looking for something new in the way of ingredients I bought some. This is the greatest beef flavoring product on the market. I use it in a lot of different recipes. One reviewer said it's as healthy as eating salt, but I disagree. If you use it in a recipe and cut back on the salt called for in the rest of the recipe, I think you'll be Okay.For example, one thing I use it in is sauce bolognese. A teaspoonful or so in the sauce gives it an all day cooked flavor without cooking all day. In cocktails, a drink called a Bullshot is made with bullion, lemon juice and vodka. Serve it to your friends and they will wonder about the great flavor.Everyone has a secret ingredient in their recipes that when someone asks you for the recipe you sort of forget to write down. This is mine. If the recipe calls for bullion, I don't tell them I use Maggi and they still wonder why mine tastes better.

This is the absolute best beef flavoring product out there! Seriously, you should give this a try if you ever use any other kind of beef boullion. I add it to burgers, braises, rub it on meats going on the grill, use it in soups and gravies and just generally use it anywhere that I am using beef. It ups the beefy flavor and makes your sauces and gravies sing with taste. For a long time I couldn't find it, I had originally picked up a few boxes of the cube form when I was on a road trip and haven't found it anywhere else since, when I finally used up the supply I had I was having withdrawals and tried every other product out there but they all fell short on the flavor that this has. I mentioned it on a group I belong to and one of the other members sent me the Amazon link to it in the canisters, I ordered it immediatly and couldn't wait until it arrived, it is exactly the same taste as the cube form and I am once again a happy cook, I even went back and ordered another six pack of the canisters and signed up for auto delivery of it for the future. What usually happens is when I find something we really like, it then stops being sold and I can't find it again for a long time. This time I will have a stockpile of a dozen canisters so I am set for quite a while. You also can't beat the Amazon price of the six canisters, consider that I paid almost two bucks for the pack of 8 cubes that I had originally bought and the price at Amazon is like getting it almost free compared to what I paid for 8 little cubes and each of these canisters is almost eight ounces of the product. Try this stuff, you'll love what it does for anything beef.

column9: Fantastic and GREAT with Miracle Noodles
column10: This really does taste like ribs!  It is very good and makes an excellent low calorie, high fiber snack when used with Shirataki Noodles (Pack of 5)  The noodles absorb this flavor and are a healthy alternative to Top Ramen types of snacks.

I used this to season a pot of Hungarian goulash soup and it did enhance the flavor, it's good to know this is available.I plan on using it for stews, minestrone soup and many other dishes.. Perfect for cooking hearty food in the winter!Oh yes, I will not run out of this for quite some time!

A bit higher in sodium than most of the broth/bouillon/soup-bases we use, but not bad enough to make it onto our 'not' list.VERY tasty, even if you use less than the recommended amount, we are still pleased with the result.Home made veggie+steak soup, quick noodle soup (pho), refried beans, and "mop rolls" are the projects so far tried, and enjoyed.

This is the best seasoning I've ever found.  I bought the bouillon cubes a while back in my local grocery store and found the were fabulous in everything I put them in.  Unfortunately my local grocer quit carrying them and I was thrilled to find it here on Amazon.  It's better than the regular beef seasoning. I would highly recomend this to everyone!

Better than the Knorr version.  Like most bouillon, probably about as healthy as eating salt.  But so very tasty.  (I've only used the cubes so far)UPDATE  Have now used the shaker bottle, yummy!  One note, unless you plan to spoon it out, tape the non shaker side down, or you will accidentally open that side and get too much out.  You can always unscrew to use a spoon.

Once upon a time this was available in local grocery stores, but no longer. So I bought a dozen at a time from eurofoodmart and ate them sparingly. When I tried to re-order in December 2009, I discovered that overnight, greed struck and  eurofoodmart bumped up the holiday price by 50%. Not only that, they now offer only the 4 oz package, not the standard 6 oz with the larger wedges. So much of the time you will need to use two wedges to do what one did before.There are better places to get this cheese than eurofoodmart, and fairer internet merchants to do business with. Pass up these price gougers and keep looking.  Support the good people, not the others.----------------Now it's November, 2010, and there seems to be deception with this product. Amazon is selling the 4 oz cheese wedges, but the supplier gave them a graphic of the 6 oz.

Tiger Gruyere cheese is an excellent product, impossible to find in local stores.  I had been "turned on" to Tiger brand Gruyere when living in Baltimore, appreciating the mild but very unique flavor.  My order arrived promptly, & I have been pleased to enjoy it ever since.

column9: Just like buying locally in good old Germany
column10: Product in excellent fresh condition - just like buying it in a local supermarket in Germany. Euro Food Mart shipped quickly in excellent packaging. I will be back for more...

I used to get this at one of my favorite restaurants in their cheese/fruit basket served at the end of the meal, but I think they stopped adding the cheese because of cost. I was thrilled to find this on Amazon! For a packaged cheese, it has a great nutty flavor that I love in Guyere cheese. I would definately buy this again. There have been some problems with it being "sold out" so I sometimes have to watch for it to be available. I guess it is pretty popular!

When we got my dog, she barely ate. She didn't even like treats. We finally got her to eat, but the regular (more affordable) brands didn't sit well with her system. My vet recommended this or to cook her food on our own. Obviously, cooking food for a dog gets a bit time-consuming, but this Pinnacle food really was great for my dog. She finally started to gain weight. (She was so skinny when we got her from the shelter.)My dog doesn't seem to have the farting problem the other reviewer said.I guess every dog's system is different and you just have to find the one that's right for your dog. this one works great for ours :)

My canine companion is a 132 pound, five year old, Shiloh Shepherd.  The Shiloh Shepherd is considered a 'giant breed.'  With his enormous size, athleticism, and the general nutrient demands, we all must consider, his diet has always been a primary consideration.  Not to mention, he has the sensitive tummy often seen among the German Shepherd breed.  His breeder has always been partial to 'Premium Edge Lamb.'  This is the formula he was weaned on.  I had no desire to change what appeared to be a successful regimen.Then to my dismay, I learned 'Premium Edge' was placed on a recent recall list.  I knew that a change in diet was likely to be detrimental to my fur friend, but I had to take immediate action.  And, at the time of recall, I didn't have time to gradually transition to a new diet, which is always the way to go, to avoid negative symptoms.After carefully analyzing formulas of numerous dry kibble, I opted to give Pinnacle (Trout & Sweet Potato) a try, ordering a 15 pound 'starter' bag from Amazon.  In addition, I ordered some digestive enzymes to assist in the transition phase.The bag arrived.  I opened it with my dog assisting to see what his response would be.  The first whiff out of the bag was strong, smelling of fish.  I noted the kibble size, itself, was quite small for a large breed dog, but felt this was only a minor reservation.  The ultimate test was not what I thought about it, but what my Shiloh would.  He immediately had a positive response.  In fact --- he loves it!  He appears more enthusiastic about it than the 'Premium Edge.'I had to start the Pinnacle before the enzymes arrived, so I was expecting some terrible gas and possibly some diarrhea.  Well, that was not the case.  He has gone through the 15 pound bag, and half of the next order --- a 30 pound bag, with no diarrhea, or gas, at all.  In fact, his stools appear firmer and more consistent than on his previous diet.  Supplementing with the enzymes was actually not necessary.I'm delighted with this new regimen.  I also love that I can order a 30 pound bag through Amazon and have it delivered to my front door.  I'm now avoiding a considerable drive,  and,  the back-breaking-discomfort, of lugging around heavy bags of kibble.My dog is happy, and I'm happy.  That said, after an adequate therapeutic trial, I feel confident in recommending Pinnacle.

column9: Only thing that will settle in my Bichon's stomach
column10: I have a Bichon Frise with a horrible stomach for keeping any food down. This was the only dog food we could find that she wouldn't throw up. It was recommended by our vet who said our Bichon just had a lot of allergies and this food was known to work well with dogs having her problems.It's a bunch cheaper on amazon than any local pet store we could find, and we don't have to have the trouble of lugging the 30 lb bag home.However, the reason for the loss of 1 star -- our dog really dislikes the taste of it. She's on a pretty tight diet to lose weight currently and still refuses to eat the food immediately when poured into her bowl. She'll sniff it on and off for about an hour before eating it. It also gives her pretty bad breath, but these are both things I can live with to eliminate the stained carpets.We have been using the food for over 2 years with no problems; I definitely recommend it if your dog has a sensitive stomach.

column9: My picky dog enjoys eating it
column10: My dog, a Great Pyrenees, has a few food allergies (rice, chicken, eggs, soy, nuts) and is picky about the food he eats. I was feeding him Orijen 6-Fish and, after a few months, he decided to stop eating it.  After trying a few different foods I heard about Pinnacle Trout and Sweet Potato.  He loves it and it agrees with his digestive system.  I order it from Amazon because the price is lower than the local pet stores in my area. With Amazon Prime, it arrives in 2 days.Four stars because I do need to mix the last quarter of the food with the next bag (treating it like a new dog food - I didn't need to do that with Orijen 6 Fish).  Highly recommended.

column9: Good food for my allergy prone elderly Papillon
column10: My elderly Papillon, Beau, has had skin allergy/itch problems for the past few years.  Maybe it's age or maybe it's the Pinnacle Trout & Sweet Potato, but he's no longer scratching himself raw.  Thank goodness!  The ingredients in this food seem really good and it's the only food I give him.

column9: Alternate meat source = less itchy dog
column10: My dog started developing signs of an allergy last year - nothing overt - just noticable skin twitches when I touched her in certain areas on her back.  Unsure if her reactions were due to environment or food, but they didn't seem to be seasonal grass allergies, so I chose to test the easiest source first.  I chose a food with a completely different meat source, switching from chicken to fish.  It's only been a week and I'm already seeing improvement.  She's still showing signs of itchiness, but her reaction is much less when I pet her back.  And on top of that, her fur is softer too!  It's early yet, and there can still be some progress made, but I have no doubt that the change in food is helping.  I sat and read review after review on dog foods with in-depth ingredient analysis before settling on Pinnacle Trout & Sweet Potato.  If after 6 weeks, she still shows some signs of being itchy, I'll happily try the Salmon and Potato Grain Free variety to see if grains are a factor in her allergies as well.Have seen some reviews mentioning breath after eating the fish based foods.  I have to say, I haven't experienced this with my dogs.  There might be a slightly different odor to their breath, but it isn't by any means too "fishy" smelling.  Just different.  And neither dog has experienced any gasiness or changes in stool since the switch was done gradually.

column9: We switched to Pinnacle upon recommendation
column10: A German Shepherd breeder recommended this food for my itchy GSD.  No way.. he HATES this food.  It smells like cat food actually.  I have a case and a half left.. guess I'll donate it to the shelter.  Shame as it is expensive.. they won't eat the dry kibble in the trout formula either.
This food is excellent for labradors. I use this for my puppies first food through adult. Price is a value and can't beat free shipping! Will order again.

I have a Bichon Frise and for the longest time feeding was nothing but an endless hassle for me.  Both my dog and me would be completely stressed out because he couldn't find a food he enjoyed and I was buying tons of food that he would just stare at for hours and refuse to eat.  One day I went into a local pet food shop and they had sample packages of all the different types of foods they had and they gave me several to try out. I took them home and set them all out for my dog... he went around and sniffed at all of them but this was the one he finally went for.  A couple years of using this food later and he never seems to protest.  Thanks for making my life easier.

This food is an exceptional product.  I take care of a number of dogs and am very selective about the formulation of their food.  In particular, I have one with pancreatic insufficiency, requiring a low fat content, and a little fellow who has had a bout with gastroenteritis, so needed a food with a different protein source than chicken.  Both are healthy and happy with the Pinnacle Trout and Sweet Potato.The only drawback, and it does not concern the food itself, is that Amazon uses FedEx for their delivery.  Apparently, when there is a holiday on a weekend, FedEx home delivery takes extra weekdays off.  Consequently my order arrived after my kids ran out of the food they needed.  It took 4 1/2 days for FedEx to get the parcel from the Columbus, Oh area to central West Virginia.  UPS was delivering while FedEx was still holding up my shipment, as my UPS driver passed here the day before my dog food arrived.  I have spoken to Amazon corporate headquarters about the fact that it appears UPS can get the job done more efficiently.  Perhaps a UPS option is in order for those customers who would rather not use FedUP...oops..I mean FedEx.  Hey, weren't these the guys that were hurling Christmas packages out of their trucks?

Pinnacle Dog Food is the best in my opinion.  My dogs have had excellent long term health and long-term perfect weight with this food.  Its good for all life stages, from puppy to geriatric, and I feed "ad libitum" so that their bowl is never empty.  They self-regulate their intake and this is the only food I've been able to do that with.  And they love it.
I ordered this food on Tues. and received the very next day from the supplier.  Thank you for great expeditious customer service.

Recommended by our vet, and our dogs love this food. Usually mix it with some canned food / sardines / veggies / yogurt.So happy this is available via Amazon Prime. At a reasonable price point as well. Please, Amazon - keep this in stock! Not available in my area otherwise. THANKS!!!!
this is the only dog food my highly allergic golden retriever can eat without getting hotspots!!!

column9: Dog doesn't seem to be bothered by it....
column10: Tried this food for my adult mix that has been on a fish based diet since puppydom. I thought trout and sweet potato would be an interesting change from salmon, but nope, not really. It gets eaten, though not with any particular excitement. I think it is safe to say while my dog is indifferent to it, the ingredients and price are a plus. Spruce it up a drizzle of olive or canola oil and it gets eaten.

If you have a dog, you probably know the distinctive "dog fart" odor.  This food, for some reason, multiplied that for one of my two dogs.  It really turned our house into a constant dog gas zone.  Wow.  It's supposed to be a pretty good dry dog food, but beware of the possibility of DOG GAS.
Huh. The batch I got didn't have corn-nuts in it, but it was still pretty good.

I was looking forward to giving this made-in-the-USA treat to the little person who shares her home with me.  There are few ingredients in the formula, which, I believe, as with human food, make for a better product.  They even smell good.  I have heard great things about how kitties love this treat, and I looked it up on Amazon to find rave reviews.  As she loves all things chicken, I tried this flavor for her.  Unfortunately, she turned her nose up at it.I thought, maybe it's just not what she's used to and she needs to acquire a taste, so I added one to her dry food.  Less than one hour later, she threw up her entire breakfast.  This is the first time ever, since she has owned me, that she has thrown up anything, and I don't think it's a coincidence.  There are unusual ingredients in this formula, such as green tea and rosemary oil.  I believe she was trying to tell me she had some sort of a sensitivity or allergy to something in the formula.  I just wasn't listening.I hate to give a bad review to something so many other kitties are crazy for, but just be aware that there is a (probably small) percentage of kitties out there with whom these ingredients just don't agree.

WOW, the same experience as the previous review. I gave a few of those treats to both of my cats and both of them threw up after 30 min or so. Older one can't stop for over a day now. I needed to take him to a vet. Hope he is going to be OK. I think there is something wrong with those treats...

We have a very difficult cat, we have tried many types of cat treats, and he does not want any of them. Just the pink boxes of Pitr'Pat he liked.So now we tried the green ones for a change.Apparently our cat adores them both.
Pitr Pats have always been a faorite of my cats.  They really do help freshen their reath.
My 3 cats love the treats.  Cats are like people can be sensitive to foods and treats.  May work for your cat, it may not.  Mine love them and digest them no problem.

I purchased Ahmad tea for the first time on a recent trip to England, and our whole family enjoys it immensely.  Ahmad is about the best tea we've ever tasted.  This green tea is excellent and turned some family members from "no thanks" to "where's my tea?" every night!  Even the boxes are a work of art.If you like tea, don't be put off by the seemingly "large" size of the package.  We're already halfway through our second case and showing no signs of slowing down.An excellent tea at a great price.

column9: Forgotten taste of real green tea from Sri Lanka
column10: If you are like me, and was missing the taste of real tea in America, then this tea is for you! This tea is packed in Sri Lanka, which is apparent from the wonderfully strong taste and aroma that these tea-bags produce! When you drink this tea, you taste green tea, not water.The tea-bags are wrapped in some kind of plastic foil, so they are hermetically sealed to preserve freshness.The boxes have instructions in English and most other European languages, including Russian. Tea-bags have brewing instructions in English.
Ahmad has great teas to begin with, but their green tea is so much better than many others. I enjoy it everyday!

A very delicate green tea with a smooth light taste, subtle floral tones and no bitter aftertaste.In the 20+ years we have been drinking Ahmad teas not even once have we been disappointed. The superb quality of Ahmad teas has remained consistent throughout the years.I am so happy to find Ahmad teas available here because only a few stores carry it in my area and they are quite a few miles away. The current deal for the pack of 6 is superb (much cheaper than I can find locally).This is a great tasting tea, which I am happy to recommend.

This is my favorite green tea ever.I've tried it once, and I'm hooked since then.I've tried a few other brand as well, but this is far the best in my opinion.I bought this Ahmad green tea at Tjmaxx, but they don't carry this item all the time. Luckily, I found it at Amazon at a very reasonable price.I'm happy:)!

column9: Bottle Caps aren't just for Bottles!!
column10: Bottle Caps really take me back. Back to a kid in the 70's. Back to when candy bars were bigger, and only cost 9c at the local candy shop. When we had 4 different stores where we could go and gaze at all the variety of candy to spend our meager allowance on. If you are looking for nostalgia, try bottle caps. They really take you back to when there WERE bottle caps on the actual bottles!

When I saw these available I was delighted, having not seen them in what seems like forever; memories of the General Store (or Kate's Market as it was actually named) came flooding back to me.  These were a favorite of mine growing up and I had all but forgotten about them until I stumbled on them recently.  To my delight they taste just as I remember them and I was very happy to get them here.  I can now keep a healthy supply on hand which goes over well when my oldest friends come visiting.  I would offer this caveat though, the bottle caps here are not the same ones found in the movie theater box of bottle caps.  The boxed ones are smaller and have a different flavor than the rolls of bottle caps.  The rolled caps are the ones I enjoy the best.

I grew up in the mid-70's and 80's eating Bottle Caps, Sweet Tarts, and "Un-Cola" (which was basically the same as Bottle Caps, except they had no Root beer or Cola flavors).  Bottle Caps were always my favorite candy, along with Zots and Pop Rocks.  Prior to finding them online, I would occasionally find a store that carried them while traveling and I would buy everything they had.  Now that I can simply purchase them online, I can get my "fix" anytime I want, which is great.  While the wrapper has changed a bit over the years, the candy is exactly the same and they're still just as delicious as they ever were back in the day.  I've introduced them to my kids and they love them as well, though I'm trying to impart a little moderation so that they don't spoil their dinner...
a gasp from my past. i can't believe these are still being made. now, i am getting a box every six months. YES!!!! i loved the root beer ones when i was a kid.

One of my favorite types of candy and when ordering in bulk it saves me almost around $20. If you are like me and buy a little candy each time you go to the store then it makes a lot more sense to go ahead and order these two cases.What's better then a candy store right up the street? Having a candy store in your closet.Not much else to say except if you like bottle caps and buy them even on a semi regular basis then this is a great deal.

column9: Much better than I remember it
column10: Nesquik dissolves into cold milk completely. And it tastes great. The old "Nestle Quik" that I grew up with was slightly gritty (but a nice chocolaty kind of gritty). This Nesquik makes a tasty, smooth, creamy glass of chocolate milk. It also tastes great sprinkled on ice cream. It has no corn syrup like Hershey's Chocolate Syrup. It also has less sugar than Hershey's. In addition, it is fortified with calcium and vitamin C, among other things. If you grew up with Quik, you'll probably love Nesquik.

column9: This is the best chocolate milk out there
column10: This is By far the best chocolate milk out there, nothing compares to the taste of Nesquik and with 25% less sugar than other brands it's better for you.  We drink a lot of milk in my house and sometimes plain milk is just, well... boring.  With Nesquik it's so easy to just jazz up a glass if milk, make a smoothie or even recreate the infamous Frosty.

column9: Drinked it like it was going out of style
column10: This is some good stuff, wow. Easy to dip out of the can and easy to drink it fast. What else can I say. Buy and enjoy.Thanks

column9: WAY OVERPRICED, THIS IS NOT THE MEDIUM CANISTER!
column10: This is a rip off! I thought this was going to be the standard size you get at the grocery... it's not! It is some weird small gas station size! Even this price for the medium canisters would have been a little high, but the conveinience of being shipped right to the door is nice... For six tiny canisters, it's about double what it should be. SHAME ON YOU AMAZON!

I myself was never fond of the taste of this chocolate powder and I've been drinking it since I was a child 25+ years.  To me, when Quik was available was like "ehh" and sometimes not even.  When I lived in Puerto Rico, the best chocolate powder was Kresto.  Hands down, nobody can make chocolate powder like that.The next best would be Ovaltine, which resembles Kresto almost exactly.  Now the Nesquik people want to make efforts for new customers by making it 25% less sugar; and I say, does it matter to most kids?  It tastes horrible still!  For some reason it tastes somewhat like they added a pinch of coconut flavoring to it.  Absolutely horrible.

We love these bars.  Sweet, salty, low calories.  They don't have much of that "soy protein isolate" taste, which is good!  The texture is great and it is definitely a treat --  and it has a decent amount of fiber in it!  Recommended!

column9: Quite good - can be hard to find
column10: These are quite good - 90 calories each - .77 ounces.  Taste like chewy chocolate covered pretzels.  Very satisfying.  Currently not available on Amazon.  I found at Walmart for $2.50 per box of 6.

I've already gone through several boxes of these amazing little bars!  They're SO good--the perfect blend of sweet and salty--and I can't believe that they're only 90 calories each :).  Excellent snack, definitely worth buying.

This item is great for those who are watching their calories and need a little something to tide them over till lunch or dinner. The sweetness and the salty flavor goes great together and really hits the spot.

There things are awesome.  And the price is wonderful with subscribe and save.  The best 2 point bar on the market.  If you are on weight watchers, you HAVE to try this bar.  Such a savior! I love Amazon!
My local grocery store introduced me to these, and then stopped carrying this flavor.  Go figure.  So Amazon came through and I have enough to last me for a good long while.  They're delicious!!!

Imho Fiber Plus is the best tasting snack bar 4 my buck but they dont have every variety so i've been trying out other brands. These r very tasty, chewy with a bit of pretzel crunch. Smaller than Fiber Plus bars hence less calories. But i gave only 4 stars cause the small size often doesnt satisfy my inner snack monster + i end up eating 2!

So I got these as hold over type foods if I had to work late and man did I make a meal out of them some nights. I like that they came in individual boxes because if had the box I would have ate the box all at one time as I sit at my desk and plug numbers.

column9: Salty & Sweet - But look elsewhere for a more natural treat
column10: Sometimes when I want a snack, I crave something salty, and sometimes I crave something sweet.  This fits the bill at only 90 calories.  Amazon doesn't show the nutritional information for this bar, so for those who are concerned, I will point out that the ingredients include both corn syrup and partially hydrogenated oil.For those who like these chocolate bars but are looking for a change of pace, I'd also like to recommend the delicious Health Valley Tart, Chocolate, Multigrain, 6-Count 8.5-Ounce Boxes (Pack of 6).  It's got 130 calories but no corn syrup or partially hydrogenated oil.  In fact, unlike Special K, all of the ingredients are pronounceable.

I started buying these for myself. I wanted a little bit of sweetness, and a minimum amount of calories while still getting a filling snack. It fits that bill perfectly. I didn't realize that my daughter would love them so much. I don't mind letting her have them because they are only 90 calories and have some nutrition. She loves them! We get these on subscribe and save now.
This is indeed the best and most tasty bar on the market. Delicious, crunchy, and I can't live without it.I have at least one per day and on weight watchers it is only 2pts. Definitely try.
I've used Amazon for over a year and have yet to leave a review for any product--but THIS, this is delicious!

This is the best flavor of Special K bars... AND...unfortunately you cannot find them in the stores..they are always sold out!!  They need to order 10X the supply of these..and ditch the other flavors that no one likes!!
I don't usually like cereal bars, granola bars, etc. But this flavor is now my favorite. The rice cereal and the pretzel bar in this masterpiece is one of the best snack foods out there.

I called Kelloggs® once & said, "Your box is mislabeled......  it says 'A Bar' is a serving & I've just finished my 3rd today....."I LOVE these!The first one tasted smoky but the subsequent ones have been wonderful.  I'm a non-smoker who doesn't have a fireplace so it made me curious about where the seller stores them.Would NOT hesitate to buy them again!  Might just try freezing them if they seem smokified!Yay!Jana K.

yum - oNote to Kellogg's though: when you introduce something THIS good, make sure it continues to be available.  The store where I purchased these originally has been out of stock ever since and I cannot find them ANY WHERE.But if you like chocolate covered pretzels, and a 90calorie serving, I HIGHLY recommend these. They are REALLY good.

These may be the best diet snack bars I have ever tasted.  I feel like I could serve them to company: Remove the wrappers, cut them in half so they look like bar cookies, and serve on a pretty platter.  They are salty and chocolaty.  The only down side is that it is hard to eat just one.  Unlike the meal replacement bars, which are quite chewy so they take longer to eat, these are light and, well, just leave you wanting more.  I am not sure that is a good thing when you are trying to restrict calories.  But I gave them five stars anyway.  They taste very good, they have at least a little fiber in them and a few vitamins.I have been trying to lose weight for a long time.  The Special K line of low calorie drinks, bars and crackers have become a way to simplify eating for me.  Each night before I go to bed I put out on a tray what I plan to eat the next day up until dinner-which is a real cooked, healthy meal full of vegetables with some protein and carbs on the side, fruit for dessert.  My tray currently includes 600 calories made up of Special K meal replacement drinks, bars and protein water, supplemented with green tea and coffee.  It is working for me.  I have lost eight pounds in 2 months.  This is a sustainable plan.In the long run I am concerned about all the artificial ingredients in these processed foods.  But I have read the literature, and it seems that lowering weight has so many health benefits that it is worth it for the short term.  Keeping it off will be the test.

column4: Penny Pinching Polly "Check out my website fo...
column10: If you are looking for a good tasting meal replacement bar, this is not it.  These are small, weighing approximately 3/4 of an ounce.  I knew when I purchased these that they are meant as a treat or snack, NOT as a meal replacement.  They are part of Special K's weight loss line, and are often mistaken for meal replacement barsThese are VERY, VERY good.  I sometimes crave something salty and sweet.  These take care of the cravings and have 90 calories and 2 grams of fat!The bottom is coated with delicious milk chocolate.  The top has crunch, yet is soft.  The combination of the crispiness, the chocolate, the pretzels is incredible.  For an actual meal replacement bar, I suggest Atkins Advantage Bars, Chocolate Chip Granola, 5/1.7-Ounce Bars (Pack of 2 ).
