I decided to try these based on all the glowing reviews. You folks were sure right! These are delicious! We got the variety pack and every flavor is good!

These strawberry fruit sticks are great!  Organic ingredients, the equivalent of one serving of fruit, 70 calories, and very tasty.  They remind me of Twizzler twists in the way that they look.These are not a really sweet snack.  They are actually a little tart.  One grandmother used to make homemade strawberry fruit roll-ups from dried strawberries (no sugar added, I don't think), and these snacks remind me very much of those.  I really like them, but if you are buying them for someone with a big sweet tooth, then they might not be as big of a hit.

These are tasty, fun snacks. They are easy to take along in a backpack or bag, and are pretty healthful. They're probably wonderful for kids, but I would caution adults to be a bit careful with them. I broke a tooth while chomping on one. I still buy them, but am now much more cautious about nibbling on them.

My grandson is allergic to red dye 40, blue dye, and yellow 5.  It is refreshing to fine snacks with out the dyes.  He uses the snacks at school so he is not subjected to the snacks they provide.  Red 40 has caused him to not be able to focuses, blue dyes cause him to be moody , yellow dyes cause him to be angry.  We spent 2 years coming to this concussion, now he is a happy young man who is getting As and Bs  in school.  Thank you
These are hands down the best dried fruit snacks I have found. Healthier than others and made by a trusted brand....Cliff.
My Daughter has a sensitivity to processed sugar but has found these to be a great alternative to fruit snacks. Too bad they don't come in apricot!

These are great fruit snacks. They are like fruit roll ups but a lot denser. It's organic, all natural and contains no extra sugar and/or high fructose corn syrup or artificial sweetener. They have a nice tart taste and not overly sweet. Flavors included are Strawberry, Sour Apple, Mixed Berry.

column9: My kids love it...they think of it as candy
column10: These are great tasting snacks. I always have some in my diaper bag and my kids think of these as candy.  I've tried different flavors of the Clif Kid twisted fruit ropes and they all seem to be a big hit.  These are better tasting then some of the other fruit treats out there and I feel good about giving these to my kids since they provide a serving of fruit and have no added sugar.  I just wish they would now create one that tasted this good but provided a serving of veggies.
These are pretty good, kind of pricey, and in my opinion not near as good as fruit roll ups. But hey.. fruit roll ups arent 'organic'.

I got the Sour Apple version of the Clif Kid Twisted fruit, and even though I'm not a "Kid" exactly, I still take these to work for lunch.  They do taste good.  The first two ingredients are Apple Puree and Apple Juice, and the rest of the ingredients are added vitamins & minerals (plus pectin and wax to give the juice and puree structure).  Yes I know, these are full of sugar - apple juice concentrate is another way of saying "sugar - apple flavored".  But as far as a sugary treat goes, this one at least has some vitamins and even a smidge of fiber hidden inside.  It's tasty and I get my candy craving out of the way.  It's mostly organic, so I don't have to worry about my treat putting pesticides into the environment.  Maybe a real apple is better for you, but this will do in a pinch.
I bought this product and sent it to my daughter that is currently attending college. She was very grateful for the present and said she really likes it.
Our son is serving with the Army in Iraq and we order this candy on a regular basis as this is his favorite snack.
My whole family LOVES the Clif Twists!  Tropical Twist is one of the big favorites in our house.
My 3 yo and 22 month old enjoy these all the time.  They have been eating them as a snack for about 6 months now.  They are a bit hard so may not work for kiddos w/o teeth.

column9: Best snack and lunch box filler
column10: I really love these Clif fruit ropes and so does my son.  They're easy to pack and not at all messy to eat.  He finds the sour apple a little too sour but I love all the flavors.  For traveling, you can't beat these as a snack. For lunchboxes, they're a great "extra" treat without being too sugary.

I have been craving candy and this is a super answer; they taste great and have super ingredients. Also try Annie's Homegrown Berry Patch Organic Bunny Fruit Snacks, 5-Count Pouches (Pack of 4) I prefer the citrus.

I tried these at the local food coop in New London CT (where you do not have to be a member to shop BTW!), eighty five cents ea. there. Great to satisfy a sweet tooth, no added sugar, very grape-y, sweet and tart. Didn't see any reviews mentioning the grape, so for the naysayers, try those before you write these off your shopping list!

column9: Tart...the adults liked them more than the kids did
column10: The texture is great, really substantial.  I liked that it had a tart taste instead of being really sweet, but none of my kids liked them very much.

This is a great deal for some quick, healthy snacks to go.  My wife and I gobble these down on hikes and just as an everyday afternoon snack.The sour apple is the only one that is just ok.But the rest are great!I can only imagine once we have kids how often we will buy these.Clif is also a quality company that I'm proud to support.
these were all really good except the apple ones.  i only made it through one apple one until i gave the rest away.

I was quite excited when I found these.  Organic, made of real fruit instead of sugar and high fructose corn syrup, and cheaper than the Fruitabu rolls that my girls had been eating.  These are great in concept, and the taste is great, but unfortunately, my daughters prefer to unroll fruit snacks, rather than just bite the end of fun twisty things.I would -definitely- continue to buy them, if only my girls would eat them consistently.

column9: Not the most nutritious but better than others
column10: I realize that these snacks sort of straddle the line between fruit and candy, but they are better than most "fruit roll-up" type snacks with all the added sugar. At least these ones have no added sugar and are mostly fruit.My kids like all four of the flavors in the multi-pack, including the Sour Apple which I had thought they would reject. I personally find it way too sour for me but they love it!These snacks are individually wrapped which makes them great for tossing in a lunchbox or taking along on outings. And they are thicker and chewier than most "fruit leather" or similar type snacks, which makes them more satisfying to eat. I find them a pretty good compromise in terms of price, nutrition value, and taste.

It's a great way to get organic fruit!! ALL the flavors except the sour apple were loved by all my grandchildren and me.  No one liked the sour apple.  Next time I'll order  boxes with one flavor at a time.

I worried that these would be like some other fruit strips we've tried and hated. Some fruit strips taste like they have a helping of sand added to the mix. But not these! They taste awesome and are not grainy at all. The kids LOVE them. I love them, too. And they are not strips at all but a large twist (think Red Vines only fatter and better). We got the variety pack and haven't had a bad flavor in the entire box. They are super fruity, slightly tart, but still sweet. The texture isn't too soft or gummy. They're just right. These make great snacks for school or anytime. I'll definitely be ordering them again and again.

column9: A nice alternative to sugary fruit rolls
column10: We purchased the variety pack (strawberry, mixed berry, tropical, and sour apple) and overall are quite pleased with these. My daughter really enjoys the strawberry, berry and tropical flavors. However, no one likes the apple. It's not the sour factor (I love sour things), there's a weird bitter aftertaste in this particular flavor that's not appealing. I love how dense and chewy each rope is; they're surprisingly filling and are a very nice healthy alternative to the regular 'fruit' rolls on the market. We'll definitely be buying these again, although next time I'll buy each flavor separately to avoid the apple.

Our family loves these fruit ropes.  They are very chewy and tasty, and because of the way they are wrapped, you don't get your hands or mouth sticky eating them.  The are a great snack for when you are on-the-go.  The price on Amazon, with the free shipping, by far is the best price for these I have been able to get.  We just buy two boxes at a time to get the free shipping.  Highly recommended!

I would highly recommend these in place of fruit rolls ups or other gummy fruit snacks that are full of sugar. These are all fruit, no added sugar and have a strong, excellent, fruity-tarty taste. I like them as much as my granddaughter. Walmart used to carry them. I requested that they continue stocking them but have not had any luck. So I have to purchase them from Amazon.com. A bit expensive but delicious and healthy!

These tasty treats are great alternatives to the gluten packed fruit snacks etc. They are all natural and organic. My daughter (2 1/2) loves them and I prefer she eats these over the sugar filled snacks
I was excited to see these on Amazon. My kids love these fruit ropes & I have a hard time finding them in the store.
I was very disappointed in these. I love fruit snacks, these did not measure up.

column9: My kid didn't like them...but I loved them.
column10: My 4 yr old daughter disliked these. But, I have been snacking on them since I received them. I must say they are a little on the tart side and perhaps that is why she disliked them. Yet they fit my tastes just perfectly.

We love these fruit snacks! They are a great, healthy "sweet" snack for the kids and I am very happy that they are organic. These sell for 0.99 each in the store so they are a great deal on Amazon. The flavors are very tasty, but sour apple is my least favorite (it's quite sour).
These are like the Gerber graduate fruit twists but better quality and taste along with a better price. I highly recommend them if you kid likes fruit bars.

This is a great alternative to the "juicy treats" as my soncalls them, that are marketed for toddlers. My son loved all theflavors and the are easy to eat on the run without a big mess.Its nice to give snack thats a healthy alternative when regularfresh fruit isn't an option. Thanks for offering them at such agreat price!!
I love these! My boyfriend and I ate the whole box in a week. I just ordered more. They taste great and they are better for you than a lot of other fruit snacks.

These are absolutely wonderful.  Well- my son likes them, anyhow... I don't really.But, they are so much healthier than the awful fruit snack you can buy in the grocery store.  There is nothing in these besides fruit.  I am not a 'health nut'- but I do try to avoid high fructose corn syrup, and unnecessary sugar.  Which makes getting things for my son's lunch very difficult.Anyhow, my son has one of these in his lunch almost every day.  His teacher noticed that his fruit snack was actually made of fruit- and so has been recommending them to parents- (his school has a 'no candy' lunch policy, and the fruit snacks that you can buy in the grocery store fall into the candy group).They are expensive.  I don't particulary like them myself (I've never liked fruit snacks of any sort though, so that isn't indicitive of the product's worth at all!).  I find that they leave my son with sticky hands.Even with those negative points- they are still a 5 star snack.  They are healthy, and my son loves them- what more I can ask?

column4: T. Bowles "vegan child of the King"
column10: i got the variety and they were all tasty and sour apple was sour but it was nice to know i was eating something healthy i would definitely recommend them for anyone wanting a healthy snack

MAde by the great brand that does adult snacks now for kids. all natural and organic. have great flavor and are good for you. my kids love them and I have ate a few myself. definately worth the price when u compare it to the cheaper not good for them fruit snacks.
These taste better and have better texture than fruit rollups.  My kids will pick these anyday!  I love them too!  We went through 2 boxes in 2 weeks!
A little expensive but very convenient.  My 5 year old would eat the whole box if I let him (and he is a super picky eater).

column9: Pass if your child has reflux
column10: These twits are good but VERY sour (at least the strawberry ones are) as they are made with apple juice concentrate. I gave up on the idea of giving them as a snack to my little girl who has reflux... Apple juice is not easy on little tummies suffering from reflux.

I bought the 24 piece variety pack and each of my four kids did not finish their rope. We eat a lot of organics but they each turned up their noses at these. They are very soft and sticky but there is not a lot of taste. Fruitabu and Stretch Island are better.
my 2 yr old grandson loves these and asks for them.  he does not seem to find them too tart at allmuch cheaper than buying the gerber fruit strips .

column9: Great fruit snacks; not just for kids
column10: It's nice to see Clif branching out into a different range of products (like not just energy bars) without sacrificing the quality of ingredients that go into them.  These fruit snacks were great; nice flavor, not too small or too big, and obviously made from real strawberries.  There's not much else to say, other than that I'm not a kid and I'd buy these for myself.  Don't judge me!

One of our favorite treats especially on the go and it's good for you.  One of these fruit ropes meets the daily requirement for a piece of fruit.  Obviously, it is best to eat fresh fruit.  If you don't have the time or have a little one who is picky, then these are great.  Mixed Berry and Strawberry are my favorites with just the right mix of sweet and tart.  Personally, I can't stand the Sour Apple, but luckily my kid likes it.  Looking forward to trying all of the other flavors!

column9: "Daddy the fruit rope makes my tummy hurt."
column10: What can I say, I got caught up when this was a gold box item and I didn't take the time to research the product.  Essentially these 0.7 ounce about 60 cent each fruit ropes are pulverized apple guts and apple juice with a few other vitamins and flavors.  They may be organic, but they weren't well received in our house.  The line above is from my three year old after she ate one. We'll stick to real fruit (fresh and dried) from now on.

My 26 month old son LOVES these! He used to like the Gerber graduates fruit strips and twists, and still does, but prefers these if he has a choice. I've tried one of these myself and they taste good for adults too. The only bad thing about these.... my son keeps asking for more!!!
Great, quick snack for my toddler.  He loves them and I feel "good" about giving it to him.

While I was pregnant with my son I constantly carried fruit leather. Not this product, but similar. Remembering and wanting some I went searching for them and found these instead. My children LOVE them. They call them candy. They are even better than the fruit leather since the texture is easier for my children. THey are good for them, taste good, and now I can use them as rewards when my children ask for Candy. Personally, I like all of the flavors I've tried (have not tried pineapple). My children have one or two each that they do not prefer, but this is all a matter of Personal Tastes. I recommend these to everyone I know with children as a candy substitute and to all of my friends as a healthy snack to carry around that will also satisfy their sweet tooth. If you don't like the first flavor you try, try another since they really are a great product. I can not buy this brand locally for less than a $1 each, but they are worth it. Candy costs the same, so why not pay to get something Good for you?
Bought it for the kids to enjoy. Only sour apple was a hit with the kids. Rest of them i finshed it. I loved it. My 2 cents... but it for Adults, not for the kids to be guranteed hit
I loved these just as much (possibly more) than my 4 year old.  Have them on subscribe and save and can't wait to get the next shipment.  They're definitely a little sour and chewy, but awesome!
I feel better giving this to my daughter than other fruit snacks with artificial colors/flavors.  It also tastes good!

My daughter loves these snacks. She doesn't care if something is sour she will eat it if she thinks or knows its a snack just for her. I love these because they are better for her than majority of the other fruit type snacks out there and they are organic. They aren't as sticky or messy as other items in their group either which I love. I can keep a few in my purse on busy shopping days and just hand her one is her car seat and she is happy for a good while. I recommend them to any parent looking for a healthy and tasty snack for their kids.

This is a really great snack for kids.  The fact that they are organic is a big plus and it takes no arm-twisting at all for the kids to eat them.  Only complaint I have is that they are a bit expensive.
My daughter loves these and they're good for you too....Even I've become addicted to them.

Ordered these for my daughter and ended up sharing them with my autistic niece who is on a gluten free, dairy free, dye free diet.  No dairy, no gluten and no food coloring in these only natural fruit, a tiny bit sour but great tasting for entire family!!!

Clif Kid Twisted Fruit Ropes Variety Pack Of Strawberry, Tropical Twist, Sour Apple, And Mixed Berry, 0.7-Ounce Wrappers (Pack of 24) This is a great product. Bought them for my grandkids, and ate them myself--best tasting 1 serving of fruit especially as a lunch or snack at work. Or about any other time. Nice and soft, could eat it with  my braces.
Organic, soft, and chewy.  Perfect snack at a much better price than in stores.

column9: The whole family loves this product!
column10: We love these fruit ropes so much that we bought 2 boxes instead of one. They taste great, not too sweet & great texture that makes us feel like we are eating candy! My kids are 13 yrs., 16 yrs and 19 yrs. and they all love them. I wish the product was around when they were younger!

My kids can't get enough of these twisted fruit ropes.  The price is great as they go for 99 cents a piece at my local grocery store.  They are convienient too.  I keep some in my bag and in the glove box in the car for when the kids want a snack on the go.
My daughter loves these fruit twists . I was pleased to find them in bulk at a great savings , in the super market they cost nearly a dollar each!!!

I ordered the Sour Apple twists and they were delicious!  Very dense and chewy.  I expected them to be more artificial-tasting, almost like Sour Straws, but they were quite fruity.  These are worth the extra cost.
these are sooo good!! i couln't stop eating them! I was looking for a snack that was healthy and organic and this snack is so good my fav is mixed berry! :)
my four kids ages from 4-14 all like them, of course they have their favorite flavors.  i am very serious about what i let them eat and you have to have the good stuff available

These are the best snack ever!  They are delicious and don't have the bad ingredients some other fruit snacks do.  I usually buy these at Costco because it's cheaper there but there have been some great promotions on Amazon.

My dogs absolutely adore these treats, and I feel good about giving them since they're made out of "real" ingredients. After I bought these, one dog actually kept looking at the treat jar and whining - never had that happen before!

Finally! An all natural biscuit that my dog craves!  Free of fattening corn and additives, I really feel good about giving my dog these. I've tried her on the mint, veggie, and sweet potato. Especially since she's on a diet. She loves them all! These especially. Great alternative to those cheap biscuits in the stores. Dog and mom approved!!!

column9: Good, but too expensive -- and leaves too much residue
column10: The tea from these is very good -- but I've gotten comparably good tea from cheaper K-cups by Bigelow and Gloria Jeans.  And with those brands, I don't have lots of residue from the K-Cups floating in my coffee.  I won't be buying these again.

British by birth, my mother used to put half warm milk and half tea in my baby bottle. So, I know what a good cup of tea is. No, it's not as good as fresh brewed, but it's as close as you're going to get in a K-Cup.
This is a good strong black tea - very little after taste.  Also cheaper then store and  when buying on super saver.

Twinings has one of the est tasting products on the market. The Keurig K-Cup version keeps it's outstanding flavor and adds convience to the mix. The only reason I didn't award it 5 stars is due to the cost. For speed when company is upon us, K-Cup is indeed convient. But for every day use I use Twinings T-Bags.
All of the K cups I have recerived are excellent.  I love my Keurig and would recommend it to everyone.

I have been using this Mt. Olympus Rub and the Prairie rub for some time but can no longer find it in our local stores so I am pleased to find that Amazon is selling it.  They are very tasty on lamb and beef and easy to use.  Having no salt, they are great for people like me who must stick to a low sodium diet.

column9: Love this rub, great for low sodium diets
column10: I had actually purchased this product from our local grocery store for a much higher price.  Since I was using a lot of it I was happy to see it on Amazon.  My husband is on a low sodium diet (no we're not even 30 yet) and it's always a challenge to find tasty seasoning blends.  I have used this blend on everything, most recently steak on the grill, yum.  The spices are in large pieces and I most strongly get rosemary and lemon flavor from them.  It's a good all purpose grill seasoning blend.  I just purchased the 8 pack with almost all of the blends so will soon be reviewing more if anyone is interested.

A friend brought me a tin of the Mount Olympus rub as a gift several years ago. I have since become addicted to it, as well as several of the other Nantucket rubs (Rasta, and Prairie are also terrific for meats, and the Veggie rub does wonders for freshly steamed produce). It works with any sort of meat, whether you're grilling or broiling or baking. The fact that there's no salt added is fantastic. I wish I could find it in my local market - hence the reason for buying the 6 pack. And, a couple of different Nantucket rubs does make a great hostess gift! Check out the other rubs from Nantucket, too.
Mine arrived in a giant crusted mass and all the spices were very old and black. Tasted way too salty and herbs were basically rancid... stay away

column9: Good stuff, but the price is too high for it...
column10: While diet grape Faygo isn't *THE BEST* diet grape soda out there, it is one of the few that you can find pretty easily and generally offers a good value.  This particular offering, and many others for that matter, do not reflect that value.  If you're paying more than $7.00 for a 24pk of cans, then you're paying too much (not including shipping) because this is on of the few you can order direct from the company.

The Faygo diet grape is not as good as Crush, but you can't find diet grape soda anywhere.  It took a very long time to get this product from seller to home close to a month.  If you really are ready for a diet grape soda, better to look locally.

This product arrived in great condition and tasted great. The main complaint is the exorbitant cost. It was almost twenty dollars originally although the seller later credited two dollars after we completed a review of their service which was excellent. By the time we added shipping costs, we had almost thirty dollars tied up in a 12 pack can of pop. I will just live without it in the future.

Since there was no other way to purchase grape diet soda in my area I took the plunge and bought a 12 pack as a birthday present to myself.  The soda was great, ordering on line was easy, but the high $16 shipping price made this a once-in-a-blue-moon purchase.

column9: I've waited a long time for this...
column10: I've been talking about how awesome diet grape soda would be... my eyes just about bulged out of my head when I saw this in a convenience store in the middle of nowhere. It was delicious! Great flavor! A must for health conscious grape soda lovers.

column9: Recipe changed recently - for the worse
column10: I have enjoyed this cereal for years, recently they redesigned the box (taller / thinner) and changed the recipe. Looking at the ingredients it seems to be an increase in barley and a decrease in other stuff. Well, the new recipe is - to me - just bad. It used to taste almost like eating banana nut bread; now it is more like banana+cardboard. It is becoming harder each day to find a good, but not over-sugary, cereal.
The title of this claims to be Gluten free, but if you look at the ingredients, it lists Wheat Flour.  Either correct the list of ingredients, or correct the title of this food.
We love this curry paste.  Absolutely delicious - can use more or less to make dishes slightly or very spicy.  This stuff makes it unbelievably easy to create a great meal.

I've tried Sukhi's Vindaloo Curry Sauce several times and my family loves it. We usually add sauteed onions and mushrooms and at the last minute of cooking we add peas. My 6 year old and 9 year old daughters both rave about it.

This truffle oil is tasty - and affordable.  We've used it in mushroom risotto and numerous other recipes with great results.  If you want a strong truffle flavor this wouldn't be the product for you, but if you love the mild flavor of truffles, go for it!

I'm not sure why the first reviewer was so negative. If she can buy the product cheaper, then do so! Not everyone has access to a store that sells tamarind puree...and you'll never find it for a dollar!While this puree is not inexpensive, I have tried about 20 of Perfect Puree products over the last few years and each one is top quality--one couldn't ask for anything better. I use this flavor to make a Tamarindo (tamarind) Margarita, the recipe that was the winner of the 2012 World's Best Margarita competition in February. Amazon does not appear to allow outside links in these reviews, so do an online search for <<world's greatest margarita national margarita day>> and you'll find the recipe.And Amazon: If you're reading this, it would be nice to be able to link to recipes and other relevant information.
People must be fool to buy this when you can get the same thing at the asian market, chinese food stores or indian stores for only one dollar, are they seller the jar or the tamarin. be careful.

column9: Bella's Cranberry Orange Biscottis are also a good cookie.
column10: I really enjoyed the flavor of these cookies, more so than the Lemon Pistachio Biscottis.  The cranberries are tart and the orange balances it out.  They, too, are a little too "dusty" crumbly, leaving too many particles in the bottom of my cup but the great flavor makes up for it.

column9: Innovative Addition to the Beverage Market
column10: I'm big on beverages and am always trying something new. I got the 6-flavor pack, and although it would be best to review each of the products separately, I've been drinking them over a multi-week period and wouldn't be able to remember enough of the details.With the exception of Rhubarb (which is exceptionally tangy), all the beverages are very lightly flavored. The issue though is that you can taste the acidity of carbonation since there's not enough flavor to counteract the acid taste. However, I did get used to the carbonation taste and have found myself concentrating on the actual flavor of the beverage.After drinking most of the bottles (still have about 2-3 left), I'm actually beginning to crave them. It's really nice to have a super light soda on hand (about 50 calorites per bottle and fillingness to match). I'm not so sure I'll be buying more because of the expense once shipping is added (I reserve $2+ a bottle beverages for 5-stars beverages), but Dry Soda is a great beverage to have on hand. I love grabbing one of them after I've already had my 'soda of the day'.

Dry Soda is the ONLY soda maker who GETS IT. If you want less calories use less sugar, now how hard is THAT ?  DO NOT use a bunch of chemicals to over sweeten your pop. Just some flavor and bubbles will do fine. Use REAL sugar too, High Fructose corn syrup is horrible nasty stuff and actually makes refined sugar look good. This is very tasty pop and I LOVE it.

A friend introduced this to me. The flavors our subtle and fun, and it's not too high in calories for a natural soda - no nutrasweet or saccharine. Original flavors and fun for a party, especially if you want a nonaloholic alternative. Try the lavendar.

Best flavored soda water on the market! Love the unique flavors. Unique and delicious! I discovered this brand while vacationing in Sacramento, California. Currently, it is only sold at organic stores, like Whole Foods, New Earth, etc. I like this water so much, that I've requested that my local grocery stores begin to carry this product!

As I write this review, the cost of shipping is greater than the cost of the pop.  Nevertheless, I've just ordered my fifth case.  I like all the flavors except Vanilla Bean--Rhubarb is my favorite--but my girlfriend likes that one best, so it's safe to say there aren't any clunkers in the bunch.  When we run out, we miss it.What I like best about it is that it's actually refreshing; it doesn't have that thick syrupy quality that regular pop has.  It's great on its own and makes an interesting cocktail mixer.If this were Prime-eligible, we'd probably order a case a week.  Dry Soda has earned a permanent place in our fridge.

column9: The Avant-Garde of today's soda making!!
column10: Dry Soda puts a new and very interesting spin on the art of soda making.  Each flavor is subtle yet satisfying, fragrant and effervescent.  These remarkable products redefine what a soda is traditionally thought to be.  The sweetness is barely detectable, yet the flavors are rich and vibrant.  A must for the soda connoisseur or the curious at heart!  Highly recommended!!

column9: Great Soda! Need Cheaper Shipping options!
column10: Been a Dry Soda fan for a while now and it is one of the better non-alcoholic drinks available.  The flavors are subtle and sophisticated.  I would personally love to see a stevia or other natural sugar-substitute option available.  I think price per bottle is fair; however, something definitely needs to be done about the shipping cost.  Buying off amazon or even Dry's website is very expensive, making Dry an impossible choice as my regular soda fix.5 stars for the drink, 3.5 stars on the price, 1 star on the shipping options and availability.

Most flavors were so subtle they were nearly nonexistent. The vanilla bean, rhubarb, and juniper berry had some flavor and I liked them; they weren't too sweet. The kumquat initially had a bit of flavor, but it disappeared overnight (I left the bottle loosely capped in the fridge).

column4: Jesse D. Keilson "Cooking and computers - it'...
column9: Alternative to York doesn't meet expectations
column10: My office typically has York peppermint patties on display for the staff to snack on.  After a bad experience with an "off" batch of Yorks, I decided to try these.  They're made in America and seem to have a fair number of fans.Personally, I found these to be an acceptable substitute.  I like the chocolate coating much better than the Yorks, and the slightly smaller size seems virtuous.  I find the texture a little less appealing than a good batch of Yorks, but the Pearsons were much better than the bad batch of Yorks.However, all of my office-mates complained that there is a saltiness to these that they found very unappealing.  It's definitely noticeable, though I didn't mind it (but I like sweet/salty - I make my own salted caramels).Generally speaking, if you're used to Yorks, stick with those.

This item does not show measurements and it should.....chocolates are 1.5" by 1.5 inches - def not worth $3.50 each, ouch! Most of the decorative crosses fell off the chocolates during shipment and there wasn't enough time to glue them back on before our daughter's baptism! The only saving grace about these is that they are tasty.

This is awesome tea. Perfect sweetness and taste. I could not make it better. I do make two at a time and get a big glass full...Love it!!! It is hard to find, because it is so popular that everyone runs out of it. Stock up if you can. It is 70 calories a kcup. That's better than a soda with all the acid. Anyway, you will love this taste.
I didn't think the k-cups could hold both enough sugar and tea to make a decent southern iced tea, but it was actually pretty decent.

This tea is the very best iced tea k-cup out there.  I just can't figure out why anybody would buy the 44 pack when it's sooo much more expensive than the 22 pack.  The 22 pack is less than 75¢ per k-cup whereas the 44 pack makes each k-cup more than a dollar each.  Crazy.

While some may not truly enjoy a sweet tea like I do...  I found this sweet tea outstanding not only is boldness but also simply a great taste.  I enjoy Bo th hot in the morning or cold during the day as well....  Certainly is much better than any type of coffee ... Plus does not have the strong acidic taste of coffee eitherCelestial Seasonings Southern Sweet Tea 44 K-CUPS for Keurig Brewers

column9: I ordered Green Mountain and was sent this...YUCK
column10: I love the Green Mountain Sweet Black Tea and that was what I ordered. I opened this sweet tea and brewed a cup (over ice, as instructed). This has a bitter taste the lingers after the tea is gone. It also had no sweetness that I could tell. Even when sugar is added, it has the bitter taste and after taste. I would not recommend to anyone.
What can I say, great tea, great price & everyone that I have given a glass to goes & buys a box. Can't get a better review than that
Love this tea and the price on here is better than in stores! I would definitely recommend it! Came in mail on promised date
This product is the perfect brew every time and I can have my cold glass of tea in less than a minute!
I love this tea for summer.  I fill a 4 cup measuring cup about 3/4 full of ice and brew over the ice for two delicious glasses of fresh tea for my husband and myself.
This product is excellent as both ice tea and hot tea. The flavor is great. Have enjoyed drinking it at all times of the day.
This is a great product.  Each K-cup makes the perfect glass of sweet tea.  It's just the right amount of tea and sweetness.
I love my new Keurig and am very happy to have found a place to order K-cups at a lower price than the stores her.  The product arrived quickly and in perfect condition.

This makes a good cup of iced tea. The tea taste is strong which I like, it's sweet and tastes as if I brewed my own tea over ice. I would not call this southern sweet tea though. It will not taste like any southern sweet tea you buy from the grocery store in a bottle. The name is a little misleading but I had my expectations when I purchased this product.

column9: The best tea I have found.
column10: I was very surprised by the flavor of this tea.  The sweetness in just right, not too overpowering and allowed the flavor of the tea to be tasted along with the sugar.  I will be buying this product again.
Perfect blend of wonderful tea flavor and sweetness.... not too sweet to take away from the tea taste.... love it
Excellent product and I love the large pack size!!!  Tazo fresh brewed from tea bags is better of course but not worth the hassle - this is so easy in the Keurig!
I absolutely love this tea and they don't sell it in the winter.  But you guys had it in a huge box and it came quickly and easily.Thanks so much!!
Not very sweet in comparison to Southern Sweet Tea I've had and not very tea tasting either.  Quite disappointed and won't be ordering this again.
I simply love this tea. I have a hard time keeping it in the house as everybody loves it. I highly reccomend it.
I buy this for my teenager. She loves it as hot tea. I have also tried it and it is delicious hot. I don't think either of us has tried it as ice tea, but we've discussed it.
Pleasantly surprised that this trail mix was so good.  Love everything that's in it. Delivered in a timely manner as Amazon always does. I will be purchasing more.  Thank you.

We've been fans of Sutter Home Fre wines for years.  They're flavorful, yet nonalcoholic, and low in calories.  They taste like real wine, not like fruit juice.  Fre Brut is a particular favorite.  We like to keep it on hand for guests who don't drink alcohol.

I suppose this could pass for cheap champagne.  That's better than I can say for most "non-alcoholic wine".  Drinking this is at least somewhat enjoyable.Perhaps too sweet to call it "brut".  The flavor is a bit like green apple candy, only in sparkling liquid form.I'm currently drinking a bottle of the stuff as I write this.  Only 210 calories in the whole bottle, so that's nice.Better than soda pop, anyway...

PRODUCT = 4 stars - Tastes pretty good for "diet food" (actually it was one of my favorite Nutrisystem foods) but this price is wayyyyyyyy to expensive. The shipping kills the sale won't be buying from "sergandjlopgiftshop". :-/ I hope to see better prices in the future Amazon. PRICE = 0 stars

These in my opinion, are some of the most delicious pieces of chocolate you can buy. I have had the equivalent to this from Godiva and Ghiradelli ones were MUCH BETTER!! The chocolate is perfect and the center is full of delicious, smooth caramel. I was expecting a tiny bit of caramel in there but was pleasantly surprised! So creamy and chocolaty and divine...they are even really good out of the freezer. I Love these little chocolates! Will DEFINITELY satisfy your chocolate cravings!! Delicious!!

This is the perfect combination of caramel and chocolate. The chocolate has a really smooth consistency and they've added just the right amount of caramel to go with it. I like these much better than Caramello bars.

If you're a chcolate and caramel junkie like I am (yes, I do go through the boxes of mixed chocolates and grab them ALL for myself!), well, be SURE to try these!  They're particularly nice if you don't have an extra moment to dive into a Caramello bar.  However, these still have the same problem all chocolate and caramel bars have - you just can't carry them in your purse to snack on as you go.  They WILL leak out of their foil packages and well, that can get messy!  The chocolate is very, very creamy on these, very smooth, and the caramel is so good.  Just rich and nice.  I still prefer Caramello bars just becasue they're bigger (hee, hee) but these will do as a time saver!  Highly recommend!

Every so often something comes along that you're glad you discovered. Such is the case with Gharardelli Chocolate Squares.  One bite of these caramel-centered chocolates, and I'm transported to chocolate heaven where all's right with the world!Each square is the thinnest sandwich with chocolate on the outsides and a just-as-thin layer of caramel inside.  Unless you make a concerted effort, you don't taste the caramel separately, and it all blends in for a sweet sensation.  However, if you manipulate the square "just so" in your mouth, you can find that sweet caramel by itself.No matter which kind of chocolate you prefer, the sensations are the same. The chocolate itself is the smoothest, creamiest, and purest you'll ever taste.  You will marvel over it! The caramel is the same, like melted butter on your tongue.Alas, the square melts in your mouth, and you're left with a sweet aftertaste, like slowly waking from a happy dream.  And then it's gone.  You have two choices: Use the most determined discipline and forget about the experience, or do what most of us do: Reach for another piece!!!

well not really, but... Yup these are Bhuts. Hottest dang thing I've ever tasted. Be careful with these things!I might need to order some more as I keep giving a pepper to undeserving friends 8^) .DO NOT eat a whole pepper like those morons on YouTube! Try them in tiny slices to build up to the heat challenge. You can thank me later.
we have not tried the peppers yet, but we were disappointed at how very small the package is. For the price we paid for shipping, we thought it would be much bigger!

I have been on a search for this spice for my BB-Q sauce for that last 2 years. I finally found it here on amazon and the company that supplies it is wonderful. Silver Cloud Estates did an amazing job of making and sending out this spice to me. I hated going into the store and hearing that they could not get it. It's such a simple spice that does not require that much hard work to find. I know first hand I found it on Amazon. It was also nice to see people paying attention to detail. This spice is not what people think and Silver Cloud Estates makes sure that you as the consumer knows this and knows what you're paying for. That means that when I add my Pasilla Negro chili powder it is not at all the same as my Ancho Chili Powder and the taste is completely different. I appreciate that since I use both in my BB-Q sauce. Thank you Silver Cloud Estates and Amazon for providing me with my "special" chili powder. Well done.

column9: Healthy for your teeth, not much for your taste buds
column10: I am all for the idea of chewing gum made with Xylitol, and wanted to try out this brand. I previously bought a supply of Epic brand direct from the company, and I don't like Xylichew nearly as well. There is a whole lot less cinnamon flavor, and it seems to fade out in 10 seconds, leaving a bubble-gum aftertaste. To be honest, Epic flavor is not long lasting either, but at least it starts out with lots of flavor. I won't be buying any more, at least not the cinnamon - I might try one of the other flavors.

column9: Xylichew is made in Finland, not China.
column10: I am a big fan of Xylichew gums.  My favorite Xylichew flavor is Peppermint - flavor seems to last longer.  Xylichew gums are made in FINLAND.  Cheaper xylitol gums like Spry and most others are made in China.  With all the health scares from Chinese products, I'd rather pay more and go with Xylichew.

column9: A good gum but their licorice is better!
column10: This is a good gum in the Xylitol gum pantheon. It is not as good as Xylichew's licorice flavor, but it is better than their fruit flavor. The cinnamon flavor is a bit synthetic I find, but not bad. It starts off fairly intense, and holds flavor alright, but I actually like the lost flavor taste as I find it tastes a bit like cola candy, if that makes any sense. Overall, I would recommend this gum. DO NOT buy Xyliburst gums, which are the shortest lasting gums ever. I only buy Xylichew and I am not a shill.

I started getting Xylichew gum after doing research on different types of gum.  Most sugar free gums are sweetened with Malitol and Manitol which can very easily cause diarrhea in adults and so are not very good in large amounts.  My husband chews massive amounts of gum and so was getting the aforementioned malady.  Xylichew not only avoids the gastrointestinal problems but xylitol (the sweetening agent used) is actually good for teeth and can be a good addition for dental hygiene.

I bought this gum because I was looking for something sweetened only with xylitol, no artificial sweeteners.  It has a nice texture and the flavor lasts a decent amount of time.  On the downside, it's a little pricey and I wish I could get a larger quantity packaged in a paper bag or something instead of a little plastic tub that I keep having to throw in the trash.
One daughter loves this gum and the other prefers the fruit flavored or the spearment flavored version.  Cinnamon flavor is strong, but not overwhelming for me.

I shouldn't have to use my imagination to find the cinnimon flavor. At first I thought they might've put in the wrong flavor, but after 4 pieces I still can't figure out what flavor it's supposed to be. Like someone mentioned, it tastes synthetic, not exactly appealing. A rating of 1 star is too high.

I will give the cookie the review and not the price. The cookie is huge, about 12-14 per box. I tried these around Christmas time last year. They taste like maple creme and dense shortbread. They are not worth the listed price here unless you do not know anyone that can go to Trader Joe's for you. If they are in stock they cost $4-5/box. They are simply inflated because TJ's doesn't ship or mail order. Greedy people!
$12.49 for one box of these cookies. You've got to be kidding. Must be for more than one box but I could not find any information indicating thus.
I taste-tested these at my local Trader Joe's and was so blown away I bought two boxes.  For a store-bought cookie, these are surprisingly tasty.  Excellent for fall and winter parties.
Oh my goodness these cookies are absurd!  My kids eyes went round and wide and if I would have let them they'd have eaten the whole box.  Mapley and delicious!!

column9: Totally better than candied sunflower seeds
column10: I used to get David's chocolate-covered sunflower seeds when I was in my teens. I only ever found them at Big Lots (so not too popular apparently). I LOVED them. I've looked for years to find them without the gross candy coat that completely masks the chocolate flavor. Finally, I found them on here and I was so happy and excited! They were VERY good, but just not quite the same as the ones before. It's the difference in the chocolate, I'm sure, but I'll still be getting them again because I enjoy them so much and it sure beats that candied stuff.

column9: Not as good as candied sunflower seeds, but still good
column10: I was pretty excited to get the chocolate covered sunflower seeds since its so much cheaper to buy it in bulk.  I thought they would be like m&m's, but they're more like raisinettes.  They're still good, and really, I go through the candied ones fast.  These are so sweet that I am done after "just" a small handful.  So good in that they'll last longer, bad in that not as good as the candied ones.Super fast shipping from te shipper though!

column9: no lime flavor I could find
column10: This is just green sweetener.  While there's nothing wrong with that, I was hoping for something with a strong lime flavor.

This is very nice for teas, sodas and my low calorie shakes. Although the lime flavor could be stronger, it is great as it is, and has a very characteristic lime taste. it is especially good mixed in sodas, and fantastic in green iced tea.

column9: None Better!! I love these olives!
column10: These olives are available from time-to-time in Houston, TX, and I LOVE them!! A friend told me that they are available at AMAZON -- how awesome is that?! I can hardly wait for my first shipment.

these excellent olives are just like Mamma used to make !! These are better because i don't have to do all the work required to get this scrumptious flavor & quality!THANK YOU, SICILIAN VILLAGE !!D Caruso
These are awesome olives!  I highly recommend all of the Sicilian Village products.  Buy in quantity because they can be addictive.J M Dean

I love, love, love olives in general, but am often disappointed in "marinated" olives because they are either very oily/greasy, or the herbs are bitter or unpleasantly "twiggy".  These olives are none of the bad things, and all of the good things -- salty, tasty, bursting with flavor.  An added bonus is the convenient package size -- it's about two good servings, and is in a nice little recloseable plastic tub.  I have NOTHING bad to say about these olives, and am about to order them again!
We love Sicilian Village Olives!  I've given them as gifts and brought them to parties.  People can't get enough of them!
I always keep an order of these olives on hand for snacks, appetisers, antipasto and salads.  They are delicious and convenient to store for months without refrigeration until opened..

Sicilian Village ® Marinated Sicilian Green and Black Olives, 6-Ounce Units (Pack of 6) are packed with full flavor. You can really taste the Italian herbs and spices, not just a vinegar taste like some bottled olives.  Enjoy.  They make a great complement to cheese and crackers for an easy appetizer plate outside on the patio.
These snack bars are so tasty. The only downside is how small they are but what can you expect for only 100 calories. Great snack and helps stop cravings for unhealthy foods like candy too.
I really enjoy snacking on this product, I continue to purchase them. They are tasty, flavorful, and a great snack product. I've purchased several boxes and ordered three times.

column9: Delicious and a Great, Satisfying Snack.
column10: This snack bar is incredibly delicious. It satisfies my sweet tooth and my late afternoon "need" for a quick something with protein and fiber to keep me going until dinner.  I sometimes use it as an indulgence for dessert, also. I cut it into a few pieces and eat it with a cup of tea and it tastes like a wonderful confection. So good.
I love the south beach s'mores but have not been able to find them so tried these.  They are OK, sort of taste like peanut butter toast but not bad and healthier.  Filling when in a big hurry.

First off, it was DELICIOUS. Mango was definitely the main ingredient, although to my dismay there is also other juices blended in (grape juice) I'm sure as filler but either way if I am special ordering something I'd like it pure. It tasted great, although the real reason I am giving it a 3 star is because it did not come as pictured. It arrived in a cardboard carton. I was really hoping for the glass one pictured, or at the very least plastic.
I love bumble bee's pink salmon, eating this twice a week is even better for the overall health, just great!!

column9: Not quite the same as what you get in stores
column10: Packaging looks exactly the same as what you buy in stores, but the contents, strangely, are not quite the same. Store-bought salmon cans contain solid chunk(s) of fish covered with a little bit of semitransparent liquid. This thing here otoh, is not solid fish, but more like broken-up mish-mash in a larger amount of rusty looking, smelly liquid. I didn't quite like it and still prefer the store-bought version, even though it's a tad more expensive. I can frequently get this thing on sale though, where it's even cheaper than this online offering. Otoh, perhaps it's this particular shipment that was defective. First we like canned salmon, a lot!  So you have to go from that angle.  This is a great product, it is kosher and has good flavor.  If you don't like canned salmon you won't like this but if you do you will be happy.  I didn't find a lot of fat, skin, or bones but just what you would expect.

I use canned pink salmon for salmon loaf and salmon cakes. Over time I have used many brands but this Bumble Bee Brand is the best I have found. The taste is clean and fresh.There are minimal skin and bones in the meat. Both are edible but easy to pick out too if you prefer. I am very glad I found this brand and it will now be my brand of choice.  The price for 4 cans was very reasonable at Amazon too. Shipment was fast and arrived with no damage. But the stars are earned by the good taste of this Omega-3 fish.
I have always used this brand of canned Salmon. It is very nice to be able to get it through subscribe and Save. Good Price.
Would not feed this to my dog!  I guess in a disaster life or death situation I would be forced to eat it but I'd probably die from the horrible taste!

If you like Pink Salmon, I would not recommend Bumble Bee Pink Salmon in a can. It has little skelton bones that look like small vertebraes.When I contacted Bumble Bee about the problem. They did not respond, leaving me to believe that they don't care what people think of their products or don't care if there are problems with them.They get a 0 rating from me and I will never buy another Bumble Bee product.
Great sea salt!  You don't have to use very much, just a pinch to obtain great results & great taste.  Recommend highly, if you haven't tried it...please do so.

FOUND A RECIPE THAT CALLED FOR THIS SEA SALT.  IT HAS A UNIQUE FLAVOR THAT WORKS WELL WITH MANY DIFFERENT FOODS.  I LOVE IT!  COMES IN A VARIETY OF COLORS DEPENDING ON THE MINERAL WITH THE SALT.SHIPPED PROMPTLY.

I love trying out different spices and salts. This salt claims to have a sort of clay taste afterwards and it really does. The price was right and the size of the bag was good also. I sometimes just take a pinch and enjoy it.

OMG wow! This stuff is awesome. The flavor is incredible, and it allows for great color contrast in certain dishes (e.g. I sprinkle it on some hummus for color + flavor). It works awesome for fish and veggies. The flavor is phenomenal, and the amount you need for that salty taste is perfect. We ordered several different salts (pink, gray, black, etc.)....but this one is, by far, our favorite over all. It tastes so clean!!!You want good flavor without the unhealthy punch of regular salt? This is your answer. Very versatile and welcome.

This feedback concerns Black Hawaiian Sea Salt and Hawaiian Red 'Alaea Sea Salt from the Spice Lab. We had come across a recipe for slow cooker Kalua Pork on a Wednesday and it recommended using these two kinds of salt. (My wife has a food porn problem and Pinterest is not helping.) column9: The perfect salt to cook with ...
column10: With a nice salty taste you don't need to put much on the food. A little bit will do you, and gives great flavor to your food. I use it in all my dishes!

Maybe it's a psychological thang but it seems to have a nice salty mineral flavor without being tooo aggressive.  I like to use it in a grinder and use to finish off my steaks and roasts.  Will buy more soon
Cost including delivery was the same as if I bought it in Hawaii.  Delivery took 2 days from order.  Of course, I am very close to the warehouse.
Great product with fast delivery!  The price was right on target too.
If you are into exotic salts "Alaea Sea Salt" from Spice Labs in the one to order.It can be used in all forms of cooking.

This product is very good!  It makes a delicious addition to simple recipes.  Try sprinkling a bit of it on a pork chop or simply rubbing it briskly on some deveined kale for a couple of minutes and rinsing it off.  It should be in every kitchen!

column9: You will never use regular salt again
column10: This makes everything taste a little better including sweets. It is not as "salty" as regular salt, so it has a more subtle earthy effect.

column9: Made a delicious roast with this
column10: Was given a recipe by a coworker that required Hawaiian Sea Salt.  The recipe came out perfect after using this product.  Well made and well packaged.  Would recommend.

column9: Black lava and Red Alaea - both great!
column10: These are both very nice salts.  As promised, I can taste a hint of charcoal in the black lava and a hint of clay in the red.  I certainly don't consider myself to have a refined palate, but there is no mistaking the flavours. A little goes a long way - another reason this salt is well worth the extra expense.  I guess I'll have to try the bamboo next.

column9: Quite hard crystals not as good as others
column10: I got this and "Course Gray Sea Salt" from Brittany both from Amazon. The crystals in this salt tend to be very hard and hence are more like little stones than anything else and also do not impart as much flavor as you eat them added to your meal.I have not tried grinding them up. The other salt was not as hard crystals and added a lot of good flavor to the meals I added it to (sprinkling a little on top).I will not get this again. I will get the other again.It will last you forever unless you are a salt junky looking for high blood pressure, as this amount of salt is a HUGE amount of salt in you want to stay healthy. Just a tiny bit with each meal is plenty, and that is the problem here! The tiny bit doesn't impart much flavor or texture. The Brittany did.
i have used hawaiian salt and it's always been a fine grind.  this very coarse grind is not what i expected and i wish it would have been in the description - i will definitely never buy this again

AMAZING, bought these for a party for my family and they held us so nicely, delivered in a beautiful box not one dead one, had to pull off a few wilted leaves but absolutely worth the price! will order again
They best development in Mayo since its inception. Works with and on anything. Great potatoe salad, superior sandwich spread and fantastic on a fresh sliced tomato.
It;s far too sweet why do they make things too sugary??, bought as a 2 for 1 deal...  added cider vinegar to make it into a dressing still too sweet threw it away.

column9: NESTLE'S GOOBERS ALWAY GREAT AT A GREAT PRICE
column10: If you've eaten some Goobers, you know that they are delicious, and they are difficult to find in stores.I have found them at Walgreens and RiteAid (and often they are sold out), where they sell for $1.39 a box.For 18 boxes, it would come to $25.02. Here, at Amazon, that total shrinks to $16.38 or 91 cents a box, a 35% savings.5 stars for the taste: another 5 stars for the price.
A Classic you can share or not! They are good to keep in your desk if you get a little hungry!

I have always been a chocolate covered peanuts fan, but I must say that all too often I have been disappointed with the quality of them. Sometimes you open a bag, and find that the peanuts are rancid, absolutely destroying the taste, or the chocolate is of poor quality, or what have you. But, for whatever reason, Nestle's Goobers are always of a uniform quality - excellent!The peanuts are never rancid, and the chocolate is the same great Nestle chocolate that they use in all of their candies. Yeah, I am a fan. When I tear open a box of Goobers, I know I am going to be pleased!

It tells me 3.5-ounce boxes(Pack of 18) But I received a Pack of 60 3.5 boxes of my favorite candy Nestle's Goobers.Also Nestle Bunch of Crunch gave me 36 boxes not 18 and this is a great deal and more than 18 boxes i expected.

My niece is an absolute 'nut' for Goobers.  So for Christmas I wanted to get her an "unlimited" supply, but prices were very high other places I searched.  I was very pleased at Amazon, as I have been in the past, with price and expedient service.  Thanks again, Amazon.

I must say I like the Birch wood better.My retailer stopped providing free shippingand also jacked up the price. Therefore Iordered this instead.It is an acceptable replacement,no ill effects...does the job.I would prefer Birch though.

Recently ordered Epic Dental 100% Xylitol sweetener from Amazon. My brother with diabetes recommended this sweetener to me.I would recommend this sweetener to family and friends. It is a very good substitute for sugar. They call it the healthy sugar twin.

column9: Perfect for taking lunch to work
column10: I really like Dr. McDougall's low(er)/light sodium soups.  I only wish there were more to choose from. I ordered a case of these and keep them in the cabinet in my cubicle.

column9: Horrible bitter and lemon taste. I recommend Diet Gold Peak Tea instead
column10: This tea is not pleasant to drink. It has a bitter lemon taste that lingers in your mouth. Very dissapointed. Amazon WILL NOT take returns on Grocery items so please DO NOT BUY this item. EWWWW, YUCK.

This was a gift for a friend who lamented the loss of Mars bars.  He was thrilled with the gift and parcelled them out in small increments so that they would last.  I will definitely order these again.

column9: Excellent Home Scrub for the Scalp!
column10: I ordered this brown coarse sugar crystals to use as a homemade hair scrub for the scalp and it worked wonders.  I will order this product again.
The blue paper tastes sweet. I can't quite detect a cotton candy flavor. The blue paper looks cool. They burn nicely.

I have been searching for Sage Honey at a reasonable price, cold packed and unfiltered.  Used to be able to buy it locally, moved over 20 years ago and have not been able to purchase locally or otherwise.  This is the first Sage Honey that I have been able to locate totally raw.  May not be local, matters not, great honey, has not crystallized, makes my tea soar with wonderful sage tones.  Thank you so much, will be back for more.
One of my favorite teas from Teavana. It's smooth and fruity, NATURALLY sweet, and just enough flavor in every cup. HIGHLY recommend

I just spent a small fortune on four different types of this tea. Along with the pitcher and tins. I just went on Amazon and saw that it was a fraction of the cost I paid for. But I must say this tea is outstanding, in taste and a little goes a long way. I will most definitely purchase it through Amazon and not at the actual store. Wish I had done some research before spending lots of money on these products.

This is one of my husband's favorite teas.  I wish it weren't so expensive, but it does last a long time.  I bought an 8 ounce bag and received 4 separate 2 ounce bags, which is quite a waste of packaging.

column9: Great for food allergies - and even if you don't have them!
column10: These muffins have always been a hit with my daughter! She is 6 and has severe food allergies to milk and egg. Almost all boxed cake mixes require one or the other as an added ingredient, or it is already in the mix. When we found these, we felt like our quest for the perfect muffin (aka cupcake) was over! We have tried other allergen-friendly brands, and they just dont compare. Everyone (adults and children alike), love these cupcakes! I buy milk-free frosting, and icing them just as I would with any other cupcake. They look great and taste fabulous! Since my daughter is at the age where she is getting invited to a lot of birthday parties, I make a batch of these, freeze them and then when we have a party to go to, I take one out and icing it so that she can have a cupcake at the party. HIGHLY RECOMMEND THIS PRODUCT!

We use many of the Cherrybrook Kitchen products. Our five-year-old son has multiple food allergies. We have to avoid milk, eggs, peanuts and tree nuts. We have tried several other allergy-friendly brands. This is by far the best in terms of taste. Packaging is nice to look at, too, not that that is a factor... but the boxes are cute and my kids get excited when they see them tucked up on the shelf. Highly recommend the chocolate chip muffin mix as well as the brownies, chocolate cake, vanilla cake and both chocolate and vanilla frosting mixes. The pancake mix is simply awesome. Buying in bulk through Amazon is the most affordable way I've found to purchase these mixes.

column9: Good product, but 3 of 4 cans significantly dented.
column10: I ordered 4 cans of this product.  The product is fine, but 3 of the 4 cans were dented.  Many people will say there is nothing wrong with dented cans, but I prefer undented cans.  I have read many reviews regarding dented cans from Amazon, but do not know if Amazon gets them dented, therefore can sell them for less. They were still wrapped individually so would appear they were packed dented.
Fast delivery! Thank you. I've always been curious about those tiny paper-wrapped bottles and, upon reading Parsons's Bitters, was encouraged to try...

I have 3 dogs 3 different sizes and this bag had something for all of them. From bully sticks to pig ears. Usually I have to buy treats in three different bags for the different sized dogs but this had it all. They loved it. Would recommend this!
This product is a FAKE! It is billed as Lavender Honey but once I received it found out it is actually CLOVER HONEY flavored with lavender. What a disappointment; I felt dupped!

column9: Guess I did not read the label
column10: Clover honey with lavender flavor injected.  Not what I wanted.  I was disappointed.  This is not lavender honey.
Yummy with tea, or biscuits, or even in whip cream.  Don't use too much it's very sweet.
Fine honey infused with real lavender.  It's smooth, refined, and a great condiment from the San Francisco based Restaurant Lulu.

I bought mine at a store- so I knew it was honey FLAVORED with lavender essence. I read the ingredients- which are also listed right here on Amazon.  If you like that lavender flavor you will love this.  It's quite clearly supposed to taste like lavender, NOT be a lavender honey derived from lavender flowers.  IT's quite unfair for that negative reviewer to get mad at this product because he or she did not read the ingredients.  This is absolute perfection for what it is- and it's quite clearly listed in the ingredients what this is.  So if that sounds good to you, that is what you will get.  I eat mine on toast and pancakes and cheese.  I think it would be lovely over ice cream, cream puffs and profiteroles, but I have not tried that yet.
I sent these as a gift to Vancouver. The shipping was expensive and a little slow however they got there fine. I would recommend getting them if they lowered the shipping costs.

My husband and I fell in love with these years ago when we lived in Britain for a short while.  They are some of the best Chocolates we have ever eaten.  We like them from the Uk as the ones from here don't taste the same.  We buy them as a treat for our selves for the holidays.
This has to be the world's smallest box of chocolates, and its not even the 220g that is advertised. It is less than 200g. Very disappointing

This was my first purchase of this brand of dog cookies. I cook everything my dogs eat so I am always looking for things to keep in the pantry that are human grade ingredients and made in the USA to help me out when I am short on time. My Papillon is severely  allergic to flaxseed, soy, oats, brewers yeast and chicken which rules out most commercial foods and cookies. I was very disappointed in how stale these were and skimpy with the bacon bits. Call me crazy but I did a taste test like I do on my homemade dog cookies made with human grade ingredients. The expiration date was still a year away but without preservatives these have a much shorter shelf life than that. I store homemade dog cookies in the fridge or freezer to preserve quality but was hoping the claim of "made fresh daily" on the cute bag was true. My dogs and I give these "Four Paws Down".

This is my second time buying these for my dogs.  The last box of 6 bags went very quickly with two hungry golden retrievers who love these treats.  They are small but that way they last longer for them.  My dogs love the flavor of them and will take as many as I hand out.  They are fresh and the packaging on these is cute.  I gave one bag as a gift to a friend and it was well liked.

My Doberman has to take medication every morning.  I use these biscuits as bribery.  The dog is waiting for her meds and then biscuits first thing in the morning.  She really loves these biscuits and would not take her meds without then.  We have been using Becca's Barkery for years now.

column9: Fantastic- Will Buy Again and Again!
column10: I love the fact that these are made with human-grade materials- you can actually READ the ingredients on the bag and understand them unlike other dog treats. My dogs love, love, LOVE these- and these biscuits are just the right size to split in half for my 2 Chihuahuas. I have even given these as gifts. I will continue to buy these for my dogs for as long as they make them.

column9: Doesn't Get Any Better Than This...
column10: I'm originally from Chicago so I had access to many different products from different cultures.  I've missed having that in my backyard for the last 20+ years, but it's amazing what you can find on the Internet.I mainly love date syrup with Tahini or cream cheese and have tried several brands but this one is absolutely the best.  Made in Iraq too which is why it's so good.  Now if I can only find Tahini that's made in Iraq too, I'll be set.  You can't go wrong with this date syrup in my opinion.The only thing with it being canned is that once you open it, you'll have to dump it in a jar.  It's an easy-to-open can with a pull-tab so no can opener needed.

I was a little skeptical when I saw this at the local WF store, but picked up a 6-pack to put the product to the test. Boy howdy, did Zevia get this one right! It's a delicious approximation of it's Mountain Dew source of inspiration. It has a crisp feel to the body, rather than what I perceive as MD's thick/oily feel. Definitely a stronger hint of grapefruit in this citrus mix. An all-around lovely drink.At the time of this review, the product was not available from Amazon.

I bought this at my local Whole Foods and loved it. I got the last can, or else I would have gone back to the store to get a dozen.  Slightly tart, citric, thirst-quenching flavor, decent caffeine kick, no spiced plum undertones (yeah I think the cola has a little of that--not terrible just not quite what you expect), and perfect over ice.  This tastes as good as Mountain Dew, but more natural.

I bought a case of this via Amazon, having never tried it before. Frankly, the first Zevia Mountain I had was just so-so to my palate. I need to state that I have had a 15 year addiction to Diet Mt. Dew, and probably 5 years of regular Mt. Dew before that. I do not think it tastes like Mt. Dew. With all that said, I also know that all tastes are learned. I once again was committing to letting go of Diet Mt. Dew as I know that the aspartame is no good for me, just as a smoker knows cigarettes are no good for them. Knowing that doesn't make it easy, it just makes it important to do anyway. So, I drank another one a few days later. Then, I drank another one a few days after that. Hmmm....it seemed much better to me! It still does not taste like Mt. Dew, IMHO, but now that I seem to have the Diet Mt. Dew out of my system, I have grown to love this! I just ordered another case, and the best thing of all is that I can now honestly state for the first time in YEARS that I am not and have not been craving Diet Mt. Dew (which I preferred to Mt. Dew, as I believe aspartame is very addictive - I have had a harder time breaking this addiction than quitting smoking years ago or even giving up white sugar and flour products, and other refined grains!). This has been such a relief to me (I got several migraines every month, craved carbs while drinking Diet Mt. Dew, and still could not let it go!) No migraines in a month now with Zevia Mountain, my carb cravings are actually gone, also, and I have dropped five pounds! Nothing else has changed in my diet or activities to attribute these shifts to.And the best part is that my tastes acclimated to this much healthier drink and I truly enjoy it! I just got a few other flavors at the local health food store for my husband to try, as he did not care for the Mountain (but he doesn't care for the citrus flavor and was not the avid Mt. Dew drinker that I was). It's nice to be able to have a soda that does not spike insulin, nor have other potential health issues (such as many have with aspartame). I love it!

I found Mountain Zevia undrinkable.  I purchased it as a 6-pack when it was on sale.  I like the Zevia Cola and figured I'd try this since I love Mt Dew, Sprite, Squirt but this stuff is nasty.  I couldn't finish one can and am throwing the rest away.  So far the only Zevia drinks that I've liked have been the Root Beer and the Cola.

Diet Mountain Dew has been my diet drink of choice for years now, but I've always been weary of the aspartame in it.  Noticed Mountain Zevia and was hoping it would be a new alternative as I use Stevia-based sweetners on a regular basis now for coffee and tea.  Unfortunately, this has a long way to go to be an acceptable alternative to Diet Dew.  It's a very offputting taste, almost peppery and not nearly as smooth as Dew.  I have also tried regular cola Zevia and noticed the same issues.  I tried with ice and without ice and while ice made it somewhat more palatable, it was still not enjoyable to me.There is a lot of erythritol which is a sugar alcohol and may have something to do with the different flavor.  I would love to see a combination of stevia with a small amount of real sugar which would add negligible calories but could perhaps add the kick of flavor needed.

This is a great alternative to chlorine laced artificial sweeteners. From what I remember of Mountain Dew, this tastes pretty darn close...kind of makes you feel like a kid or a computer programmer locked in a basement with pizza :) Has a little more caffeine than the cola and and Dr Z. Give it a try.

column9: It doesn't taste exactly like Mountain Dew but I still love it.
column10: I absolutely love Mountain Dew however I have started to eliminate High Fructose Corn Syrup from my diet and I know how horrible the artificial sweeteners are for your brain.  When I found out Zevia came out with a Mountain Dew like soda I was thrilled.  Though I was a little disappointed that it didn't taste exactly like Mountain Dew.  However even though it tastes different I still love the flavor of Mountain Zevia.

This stuff tastes great, and I love love LOVE that it's stevia sweetened with none of the nasty ingredients included in my former nasty addiction (I'll just let you guess what product I used to be addicted to).  No, it doesn't taste EXACTLY the same as ... that other stuff.  But it's better!  I can't go back to the way I used to drink soda.  Love it, thank you Stevia, thank you Zevia!

This is pretty close to Mountain Dew, but more citrus-y... probably due to Zevia's use of natural flavors.  It certainly packs the same caffeine punch as Mountain Dew, with 55mg per can. It's not my favorite, but a nice choice when I want something different.

Quick, someone please hand me a towel so I can wipe this off my tongue.  The can says: "It's what soda should always have been".  If all "regular" sodas were like this, sodas would be only tolerated, not drunk by the gallons by a large percentage of the population.  That's not to say that "regular" sodas are good, I don't like them anymore either since eliminating high fructose corn syrup from my diet.  This has a very bland taste & a horrible cling-to-the-back-of-the-tongue aftertaste.  I use stevia all the time & was surprised at the odd flavor.  This also does not taste anything like Mt. Dew.

We drink A LOT of this stuff.  It's become the favorite and most consumed flavor in our house and we drink a lot of Zevia around here.  Easily 100+ cans a month.  Now, probably half the total consumption of that is Mountain Zevia.Is it exactly like Mountain Dew?  No, but it's pretty close and on it's own it's very good.  I don't think it's as grapefruit flavored as an earlier reviewer suggested, but slightly more on the orange side.  Regardless, it's very refreshing and tasty.

I recently tried the new Mountain Zevia. It's a zero calorie soda which tastes decent if your into that. I'm not really into the whole zero calorie soda, but it would be great for anyone watching their weight or someone with diabetes while wanting a nice, cool, and refreshing pop to wash down their meal with. I got the chance to try both the Cola and Mountain Zevia flavors. After letting them cool down in my fridge, I drank the Cola one first. It has very particular taste to it. It tastes kind of metallic and truly yucky. Again I don't drink coke zero or anything. Mountain Dew and Pepsi with all the bad sugar and calories is for me! Lol. So I don't know how competing drinks would taste. I ended up finishing the Cola flavor drink (not something I recommend). I took a break from the stuff, and with the upcoming dinner I drink the second can of Zevia ironically the flavor is called Mountain Zevia. Probably their signature can. All aside it tastes a lot better than the cola flavor. The sweetener is what really makes or breaks a soda. I just can't get use to the natural sweeteners used in these more "healthier" drinks. But as everyone knows it's how your raised and what your use to that determines how your taste buds react to the flavors. It's something that would take a little getting use to if your not normally a zero calorie soda drinker, but if you are one I recommend you try the Mountain Zevia (it's like Mountain Dew just with natural sweetener) before the cola. Right now they are on sale on Amazon for select Zevia Cans. But for a 24 pack the general price range is $27.00 without the sale going on with them right now. Not something I'm willing to spend $27.00 for every 24 pack I get. What I liked the most about Mountain Zevia was the colorful cans (they are fairly eye-catching and color popping). Other than that the taste is downright awful with the cola flavor and bearable with the Mountain Zevia flavor. I had my girlfriend and her family try them too. None of us really liked them (it's really a hit and miss). Some will like it, while others probably will agree and say it's not for them. Overall the key word is that they are decent, and that if your looking to watch your weight there are plenty of other cheaper and more flavorful options. (:

column9: Good but not from the same mountain
column10: If you are looking for something that tastes just like mountain dew, then look elsewhere.  However, this soda is refreshing and tasty. I would say it is more like a cross between sun drop and sprite.

Firstly, it's hypersweet.  It's sweeter than mountain dew, and that's just wrong.  They need to lighten up on the Stevia with this particular product in their lineup.Next, and just to explain to the ladies, there's a small hockey puck shaped thing, usually pink that sits in a men's bathroom urinals called a 'urinal cake', placed in the line of fire to mask foul odors.  Most of the time, it's a fake cherry smell or a janitorial, industrial 'red' scent, but sometimes it's fakeLymon - fake lemon / fake lime.Zevia Mountain Zevia tastes like how fakelymon smells.They are probably cut from the same fakesensoryindustialscentingagents cloth at discount monsanto, any random industrial chemical scenting and flavoring agents manufacturer for the fakescented candles, car deodorizers, incenses, fakescented urinal cakes, fakescented alternative beverages/candies/other food products industries.Sorry guys, but Mountain Zevia is nasty.

column9: Great product, but the pricing for Amazon is odd...
column10: This product tastes great for a soda that seems popular among my health food friends.  I was skeptical at first, but I found this product to be a great alternative to Mt. Dew and it's diet form. Because of its crispness, I can't drink the soda as fast as I normally would. This might be working out because I used to drink 1.5 L of Mt. Dew throughout the day at my office.  Now I drink about 2 cans of Mountain Zevia a day, which is roughly half of what I normally would. And there are no calories.I will say that I can actually buy this product for much cheaper in the stores where I live. I was hoping that buying in bulk would be a benefit but it seems not.
