I found this very similar to Diet Mountain Dew.  I love Mtn. Dew, and the diet version is okay (but nothing like the real thing).  I was hoping for more of the original, but Zevia isn't like the original.  If you like Diet Mtn. Dew, this will probably be up your alley (and a little healthier than the aspartame-filled Pepsi product).

column9: Not very good ... try something else
column10: I love mountain dew, and well ... this tastes nothing like it.  Now I could get past that if this tasted good at all - unfortunately it doesn't.  Don't bother with this one, or try it first by buying the Rainbow case.

I enjoy Zevia sodas. This flavor was somewhat disappointing. It's good but compared to Zevia's other flavors, especially Dr. Zevia, this Mountain Zevia doesn't come close to tasting like Mountain Dew.I would order it again. It's not too bad. It probably could use more sweetening.

column9: Do NOT expect Mt. Dew taste
column10: All right - I am a new convert to Zevia and LOVE the idea of Stevia-sweetened, all natural cola.  I hope a lot of health-conscious people will support what this company is doing.Having said that...Mountain Zevia doesn't taste very good.I assume they are imitating Mt. Dew with this, but it is not really close.  The aftertaste is so strong that none of my family wants to drink it.I LOVE some of the other flavors though, but don't expect Mountain Zevia to be a Mt. Dew knock-off.

column9: Not the worst thing I've ever tasted
column10: I try to avoid artificial sweeteners, but I love Mountain Dew and Diet Mountain Dew. I've enjoyed Zevia Root Beer and Cola in the past (though only when poured into a glass - it is nasty straight from the can.)When I saw Mountain Zevia at the Sunflower Market I thought I would give it a try. Uhm, you know how Mountain Dew looks like anti-freeze? This looks more like pee. I can get past that, but it tastes like Airborne - you know the Vitamin/Cold treatment? I would say half orange/half lemon lime Airborne. Not the worst taste, but I don't take Airborne for the flavor, and when I take it I usually mix it with a small amount of water and drink it like a shot.I don't regret trying it, but I won't buy it again. Mountain Dew is incredibly artificial tasting, and I imagine that is hard to duplicate with only natural flavors. Thanks for trying Zevia!I don't recommend this flavor - but I do recommend the Cola and Ginger Root Beer. Those are yum

I was so excited to try Zevia for the first time and this is the flavor I picked up. It's really gross. It has a taste similar to something bitter--except worse. Plus, it's so expensive for its bad taste...and it's not like it has nutrients in it. I wouldn't repurchase this if it was free. Just drink sparkling water.

Awful is the best think i can say about this.  I bought a six pack to try it, thinking it cant be to bad, but I was wrong.  This tasted like carbonated water, not even close to Mt Dew. One star is to high a rating.

column9: Not Mountain Dew, but not bad
column10: As a huge fan of Zevia Cola, I eagerly awaited the release of Mountain Zevia. Unfortunately I was very disappointed with the product.  Standing on its own I have given it 3 stars, but when comparing it to its namesake, it suffers greatly.  The drink has a strong grapefruit flavor, not the lemon lime of Mt Dew.  If you like grapefruit, you will love this soda.  However, its not a substitute for the Dew.

These coffee candies are strong...there's not much of a milk flavor to them....let's just say if they were coffee instead of candy, they'd be closer to straight black than most coffee candies you find around...they are just sweet enough. It took me no time at all to get used to the fact that they're not overly sweet. I really recommend these candies for those of you who like stronger coffee and expresso...I, personally, love them, I bought five bags...and if you decide to buy them...I hope you'll enjoy them... :)I hope this helped... :)
I needed this for allergy-free baking.  The stores local to me don't carry this product.  It is expensive with the shipping charges, however, worth every penny.  Shipped very fast!  Love Amazon!

column9: A gluten free bread MUST have!!
column10: Every gluten free bread baker must havethis item in his or hers pantry.
Ideal for popcorn machines that require oil. Does not leave any after taste or over power food. A great healthy alternative to other types of cooking oils.

If your dog loves pig ears but you worry about clogging pup's arteries, try these. They satisfy my dog's (1.5 year old lab mix) urge to chew but I don't have to worry about leftover grease spots or deal with slimy plastic wrap. These ears arrive individually wrapped, which is always a plus in my book, and my dog loves them so much that I'm able to get out the door without a guilt trip. I like this product so much that I am moments away from ordering another dozen.

I used them to decorate my birthday cake. My cake was so cute. It was so pretty and dainty I didn't want to cut into it. I had to take a picture of my cake before I even thought of cutting it. My only problem is they're a little yucky.

column9: Size is both an asset and a challenge.
column10: Since these are rather large, just a few go a long way. They are especially nice on cupcakes. The colors are pleasant and they are large enough that you can sort them into piles if you just want only a couple of colors for your theme. A plus is that they don't add a taste of their own to your frosting or stain the frosting with rub-off color.The drawback is that you almost have to place them where you want them, one by one, which ends up looking kind of stilted. They aren't the type of decoration you can sprinkle on (despite the name). A lot of them tend to land on their side if you sprinkle and look kind of odd, and when you flatten them they have frosting on them. I confess to being a bit of a nit picker so, if you don't mind the random look with daisies landing every which way, these will do a nice job of visually filling out a cake or cupcake for a child's party or any family occasion. They look nice combined with single-colored sprinkles to emphasize a particular color from the assortment, such as pink, and this brings back the random-sprinkle look I lost when arranging the daisies how I wanted them.

Amazon.com,PLEASE DISCLOSE NUTRITIONAL INFO ON EDIBLE PRODUCTS SO THOSE WITH LIFE THREATENING ALLERGIES CAN MAKE EDUCATED BUYING DECISIONS. This item didn't say in the listing on Amazon.com anything about peanut traces or other allergens. When I received this bottle, it clearly states that it's made on the same equipment as peanuts. I never would've bought this item had I known that. Sending it back would cost me more in shipping than I paid for the bottle.
Were not as big as I had expected, but this was not a reflection of the shipper.  But they did come on time.
This my 3rd Timothy's Coffee in kcup form I have tried and its exceptional. The pefect italian blend. Just right!

Received 2 boxes of Reg Timothy's and 2 boxes of Decaff. Packaging was excellent and delivered in just a few days. Amazon did a great job, but I must say the Decaff is a 5* but the regular is a 4* since it is a bit too strong. I can not blame that on Amazon, it's just a learning curve for K-cups for my Keurig coffee maker. Thanks Amazon. I'll be back. B
Used one pod for the big mug - not too strong and really good flavor.
This is the best for both taste and aroma. It will make your day start on the best note possible. Enjoy the taste, inhale the aroma and know what great coffee should be like!
This is a great deal for this coffee.  The Italian Blend is my favorite for it's smooth flavor...not too dark, but still has a kick!  Thank you
I wanted slightly stronger but not ex-bold coffee so I ordered Timothys Italian Blend and enjoyed it very much so I ordered it on automatic renewal.

This is one of the WORST k-cup coffee varieties I have tried. I have been enjoying Tully's Italian Roast, but something is messsed up with the pricing on Amazon (like: it is twice the price I paid for it last time!) So, I figured I would try the Timothy's instead. What a mistake!!!  It is bitter, weak and truly disgusting. I wouldn't subject my worst enemy to this one.

column9: Worst of all Timothy's K cups
column10: I have tried all of Timothy's coffees. This is by far the worst. It leaves a very bitter aftertaste in your mouth. Will not purchase this one again since so many others are great!!

column9: One star is even too high
column10: VERY poor taste - or no taste would be a better phrase. Has a watered down taste, not an italian roast at all!
I ordered this item on November 14 and I'm still waiting on it.  Wasn't informed that there would be a delay when I ordered.  I'm getting pretty impatient.
amazon overpriced this product,it is not worth the 80% increase i have shopped elsewhere for my coffee.
This coffee has a really bitter taste and leaves a really bad after taste.I would not recommend this coffee at all.  The only good kcups are Green Mountain the Columbian is superb.

This is my favorite unflavored K Cup coffee.  I've tried many brands and flavors, and this one comes out on top.  It doesn't taste watered down like some of them do.  It has an excellent, medium-bodied flavor.

We just got a Keurig brewer for Christmas and had tried several different k-cup brands that came with it.  Timothy's World Coffee, Italian Blend was one of the samples and we loved it!  Now we have it sent to our home very two months via Amazon.  Great coffee with a very smooth, but full-bodied flavor!!!

This is a delicious medium bodied coffee that leaves only the lingering taste of the wonderful brew.  You can make it stronger by selecting the smaller cup on your Keurig Brewing System.The Subscribe and Save is the way to go.  Not only saving you money but delivered to your door. Much cheaper here than Target or Costco.......Love it!

When I received my Keurig coffee maker with a variety pack of different coffees, I tried very hard to find my favorites because there were many I didn't like at all. Out of the assortment, I liked 3 and the Italian blend was one of them. However I couldn't find it in stores so eventually I ordered it from Amazon. Now that I have been drinking this blend for several weeks, it really isn't as good as I remembered. It's okay but I like the Kona and Nantuckett blends better.

column9: Just Try it and you will agree it is one of the better Kcups
column10: I have tried at least 20 different Kcups.  This is definitely one of the better ones.  Very nice medium bold taste not bitter and very consistent.  Give it a try and see for yourself.

The Italian Blend has a nice aroma and good flavor.  I brew it on the 10oz. size and it still has a nice little kick to it for a medium roast. I would say that it's comparable to the Timothy's Kona Blend, although it's a bit bolder and not as flavorful as the Kona. Still, a very nice cup of coffee.At this point, I think I've tried about 10 different types of K-Cups, and I think I'm liking Timothy's Kona and the Mocha Java the best.  However, the Italian Blend is a nice cup of coffee.

After drinking Dunkin Donuts coffee for years I was given the keurig coffee machine as a gift. I started drinking this coffee and i will not drink any other coffee anymore. Nothing compares. I have tried several other types of K-cups however the Italian blend is awesome.
As I have said before, this company gets it right.  This blend is "simply the best."  It is smooth and enjoyable right down to the last sip.  Only bad part is you will want to drink more.

column9: OK, but there are better choices
column10: I have been exploring the range of k-cups looking for my favorites. While the Timothy's Italian Roast isn't bad, there are better options.I like my coffee starbucks style: bold, strong, with lots of character. As a point of reference, my current faves are Coffee People Black Tiger, Tullys French Roast and Italian Roast, Emeril's French Roast, and Coffee People Sumatra and Dark Magic. I tried the Timothy's version of the Italian roast expecting a similar flavor to others I have tried in the bold varieties, and I found it to be on the weak side. It does have some of the nice smokey elements that you expect from an Italian roast... but Tullys does it better if you are looking for full flavor.If you prefer a medium bodied roast with some punch you will be happy with this, but it wasn't for me.

I guess I'm used to an Italian coffee being a bit bolder.  I was definitely expecting a darker roast.  My favorite Italian roast is still Tully's Coffee Italian, K-cups for Keurig Brewers, 24-count,  Boxes (Pack of 2), although this cup is a good every morning or anytime coffee with that crisp Italian finish.I would definitely recommend this , just not if you're looking for something incredibly bold.

If you are still trying to find a K-Cup that is not too strong but not too weak, you have just found it.  Look no further and and order this Italian Blend.If there is a better K-Cup than this out, I haven't found it.Perfect.

column9: Perfect coffee flavor for a variety of tastes
column10: My husband generally prefers Sumatra and I prefer Colombian. We decided to give this coffee a try and to our amazement we both truly enjoyed it. It seems to be the perfect blend for the both of us.There is no bitter aftertaste at all, it has a depth of flavor and is smooth and delicious. Tastes great black and stands up perfectly to flavored creamers without being overwhelmed by them.Italian Blend will now be the regular coffee in our home. I completely recommend it.
Timothy's Italian blend is the only coffee I can drink black. It has perfect balance and is full bodied without being overpowering.

Timothy's World Coffee Italian Blend is a smooth, meduim coffee. I have tried other brands and they seem bitter compared to this. Other people who have tried this coffe at my home have also commented on how good it was. Love it.
I was so disappointed to find out i could no longer buy this coffee at my local store, but so glad I can sit at home, and with the click of a button, order it on amazon!

Great medium tasting coffee, smooth no harsh taste drink it black so you do not miss the flavor. I have been buying this on auto subscribe since we bought our Keurig brewer. You won't be dis-appointed!

I have enjoyed the Timothy's Italian blend K-cups. They are rich without any bitterness. I tend to like a strong brew and this is what I would consider med. to strong. A very good choice for that first cup in the morning!

This is hardly an Italian brew. I was just drinking a cup and notice it tasted light, watery, and tasteless. I will not purchase again. I have tried plenty of k-cups (see my reviews) and this is not a good one, unless you like really light coffee.
Always a wee bit reluctant to invest in new tastes, I went ahead and too the leap.  I'm glad I did!  This is a very fine coffee and one that enjoy every morning.

column9: Not the depth of flavor I was expecting!
column10: I had hoped this would be a stronger more full bodied coffee.  Tastes very weak even on the smallest cup setting.  I expect an Italian blend to be very hearty.  This was disappointing.

column9: Timothy's World Coffee Italian Blend - K Cups
column10: This is awesome coffee. I am very picky with coffee. My husband can drink any, I will threw it down the sink if I don't like it. I can drink this every morning.

I am not a huge coffee drinker but my husband is and he likes a strong, bold cup of coffee.  Normally an Italian blend is pretty bold but my husband was not impressed.  I thought it tasted fine but then again I used a good bit of creamer anyway.
I drink a lot of coffee and this is by far one of the best K-cup coffees around.Strong, smooth w/o any bitterness.  Highly recommend.
Great coffee - much better price when you order on a regular basis thru Amazon than you can get in grocery stores or other websites.
This is my favorite coffee.  All of the flavor, none of the bitterness of dark roast.  A smooth, delicious coffee.
If you like a no frills plain cup of coffee.... This is it!  Nice smooth full flavor, not bitter!  My favorite!

column9: From Flavorful Favorite to Weak Disappointment
column10: I would have given this a 5-star review in the past but my last shipment (October 2010) was extremely weak and didn't taste anything like it used to.  The k-cups didn't seem to have very much coffee in them.  They seemed very light when shaken as compared with the past.  I would also like to note that I have noticed this same problem on quite a few of the k-cups.  Also, they all taste very similar and not a good taste.  I had read that Green Mountain may have taken over some of the k-cup business for Timothy's, Caribou, etc. and maybe they have changed something.  For now, I will buy from BBB when they have a coupon and I can check the freshness code on the package.But, really I have gone back to using a french press which really doesn't take that long to make and has superior flavor.

When I bought this coffee I was skeptical that it would live up to it's Amazon rating. After I tried it, it exceeded my expectations. This coffee is excellent. Not bitter at all. I drink my coffee black which usually allows me to taste the coffee fully without diluting it with cream or sweetening it with sugar. This coffee was not too weak and not too strong to the point it was bitter. It will definitely remind you of an Italian cafe.

Timothy's World Coffee, Italian Blend for Keurig is likely my favorite all-around coffee blend. Somewhere between a medium and mild blend, this aromatic coffee is sure to  please the most discriminating of family and friends.
It was OK as a coffee, but not what I was expecting for an Italian Blend (darker, richer, full bodied)
Awesome idea!  Coffee is great and don't have to worry about comparing prices at the local stores...Amazon is always the cheapest and I don't even have to go pick it up!

When I purchased my Keurig coffeemaker I had no idea what coffee to buy.  Especially since there is such a huge selection of coffees to choose from. The saleslady suggested the Timothy's Italian Blend based on what kind and what flavor that I told her I liked. Plus, she really liked it, too. I'm from Louisiana and was a little hesitant to buy it.  Italian coffee.........for a southerner??  Well, I'm so glad I did! This is the smoothest, best tasting coffee I've ever had! No bitterness, just a great cup of coffee!! I even converted my husband over to it. He drank only one brand, one kind of coffee for a number of years. Now, he loves it and won't drink anything else!! I keep it on hand at all times. Try it, you won't be disappointed.

I last bought this in May 2011, for around $26.  I used to get it for around $17 on Subscribe and Save, before Amazon ended that option.  I had to stop buying all my k-cups from amazon, because the big warehouse club has an 80-pack of Donut House and Caribou blend varieties for $33.  I first thought it was just the coffee product that amazon was having pricing issues with, but their prices seem to be inflating across the board, while their competitors are not reflecting the same sort of steep increases.  I've found myself going to v*t*c*st.com for many of the repetitive grocery items that I used to order through amazon.  The main difference I can see is that amazon's competitors don't have to worry about pleasing Wall Street, so their prices are kept more honest.Italian Blend coffee is a decent mild coffee, my wife's favorite.  We'll keep ordering it, but it won't be from amazon.

I have had a Keurig for over a year and have tried many of the different k cups.  So far, this has been the best k-cup.  It isn't too strong and isn't too weak.  It holds its own against the half-n-half that I use with it and makes a consistently good cup of coffee.

This is my favorite k-cup coffee.  Believe me, I have tried them all.  I have purchased 4 Keurig machines in the last year, so you know I use a lot of k-cups.  I try the new ones when they come out, but I keep coming back to this one.  One cup at home, and one cup at work to start my day!Followup:I have just got into the third box of the 4 in this order, and I am having blowouts with the k-cups.  Three in a row this morning.  I finially gave up and had another brand.  I hope this doesn't continue.  I may have to find another favorite!!

As we sample many flavors of k-cups from Amazon.com, a few stand out and Timothy's World Coffee, Italian Blend stood out. It has a fantastic flavor. Rich and delicious. I recommended it to one of my co-workers and they enjoyed it as well. This will be one of my stock items from now on.

I drink this coffee as my second, third, etc cup of the day.  I usually drink a lighter cup first and then continue with the Italian Blend.  I love this coffee.  It's a little stronger but has no bitter taste and still manages to taste light in my mouth.  I love it.

Have only had the Keurig for about 2 months.  The Timothy's Italian blend was in one of the sample packs.  One cup, and I was hooked.  Usually bold & extra bold are deliciously strong but also have a bite to them that ruins the taste of the coffee for me.  It tastes like the brewed coffee was burned.  The Italian blend has the perfect combo of strength & fullness, without the bite.  It is sooo smooth.  I know that everyone has their own taste in coffee, but to my mind this is "kewl beans" (don't know what that means, but heard it somewhere and it sounds right, lol)  Absolutely delicious.

Timothy's Italian Roast is a very good medium roast coffee.  I found little bitterness or aftertaste with it.  A nice smooth cup of coffee.  So many choices in the k-cup world. There's something for everyone. I would give it 5 stars but the name says Italian Blend.  I would figure an Italian coffee would have a darker roast.

column9: OK Medium Blend Coffee. Slightly Bitter.
column10: Timothy's Italian Blend is a standard Medium roast coffee - nothing remarkable in my opinion.  I found it to have a hint of bitterness, which is also a negative for me.I prefer Tully's Coffee Italian Roast for Keurig Brewers, 24-Count K-Cups (Pack of 2) because Tully's seems to have a little more flavor, but is also a touch bolder.If you are a medium to light blend coffee drinker, then you may find this blend pleasing; however, if you lean to medium bold blends, then you should look elsewhere.
This isn't a bad dark roast if you like a stronger coffee, but I prefer the Diedrich French Roast - better flavor.
Nice aroma and is a great breakfast blend.  Strong enough but without the harsh after taste.
Timothy's World Coffee, Italian Blend for Keurig Brewers, 24-Count K-Cups (Pack of 2)  Its Great! Tastes like coffee with a little kick. And the price is right thru Amazon.com.

Tastes like coffee!  Not burnt, not bitter, just good coffee.Only gave it 4 stars because of "blow-outs".  Unfortunately, with this brand, I get about 1 blow-out per 30-35 k-kups.  I have never experienced this amount of blow-outs with other brands (in fact, only a single one in about 500).  I would recommend gently squeezing before inserting in to brewer to verify a tight seal on the top.

We just bought a Keurig a few months ago and are trying different coffees to try to find what we like best. So far it is the TWC Italian Blend medium...very smooth and not bitter. However, I do not like an Extra Bold coffee.
The Italian blend is very smooth with an outstanding flavor. Unlike some dark or bold roast coffees this one has no bitter taste. Timothy's Italian blend is is one of our favorite coffees.
I love Timothy's brand but this ones a miss for me.  It has an "off flavor" that won't get me to buy this one again.

column9: My clients wait for their Timothy's cup!
column10: Timothy's Italian Blend is WONDERFUL! I run a salon and every morning I have clients who tell me they have waited to have their morning "cuppa" at my shop, as they don't have a Keurig (WHY!!!!!!??????)It's just delicious! We make the 6 oz cup and it is almost syrupy in flaver.....rich, caramely, heavy coffee flavor with no bitterness (even when served black) Robust, but not acid, fragrant .......wow, we just love it.

Nice new blend. I am starting to like this one. A change of pace, not bitter or too strong but still has a lot of flavor. Try a box or two and see. I have it on the subscription program with Amazon and it works well.

I love the Italian roast the best. It has the coffee shop flavor I love and you can't find this flavor at other stores that sell these pods. My parents asked me to order this for them also and have it delivered to their door.  I recommend the auto ship method from Amazon.com so you know you will have it regularly.

I tried this coffee based on the suggestions of other reviews. I wasn't disappointed. This coffee has a rich, smooth taste. My Keurig has 2 settings. I make mine with the lesser amount of water and it truly is delicious. Very satisfied customer!!

column9: One of the best single cup servings available
column10: If you like a bold yet smooth coffee, this is the one for you.  I didn't expect much from a single serve product because I had another product with similar features.  I was pleasantly surprised by the full flavor and rich tones of this coffee.  They finally made it easy to get real coffee instantly.
great coffee, nice flavor, smooth... enjoyed this coffee very much. The price was right too...I would recommend this to anyone who enjoyes a good cup of coffee.

Timothy's Italian Blend Coffee is number #1 in my book.It has the best flavor and a smooth taste out of most of the coffees we have tryed. We usually drink Coffee People's- Donut Shop Coffee which we have on auto ship. However, I do enjoy buying this when it is on sale!
I have been getting this flavor for awhile now. It is one of my favorite of Timothy's. Not too mild and not too strong.

We have been getting this for awhile now. My husband really enjoys the flavor. This last shipment was very disappointing though as several of the cups didn't have the tops on the cups so the coffee was lost. They are expensive and you not expect to this to happen.

After trying about 10 different k-cups with my new Keurig, this is one of my top 2 or 3.  Definitely strong enough for a nice mug of coffee on the 7.25 oz setting, but not too dark or bitter.  I'm disappointed that its apparently not available directly from Amazon any more.  I see some reviewers got it with Subscribe & Save, which is not currently showing up. :(
I have bought this product before so I knew what it tasted like. Its a good coffee not bold at all.

We tried several different varieties of Timothy's and other K-Cup providers (Green Mountain comes to mind, but I know there were others also) and found the Italian Blend by Timothy's to be an all-around very drinkable blend, and as a result also practical to order through subscribe&save.  When using multiple blends it was not practical to manage each subscription because of lower volume, but having been able to settle on one favorite the additional subscribe and save discount, and the ease of managing just one subscription makes this a winner.  Also, it is admittedly a fairly small sample size but the number of cups that are duds (i.e. when brewing either grounds end up in the mug, or the mug does not brew completely) has been much smaller with the italian blend than with other Timothy's or other manufacturers products.

The Timothy's World Italian Blend coffee is a great K-Cup for those that just want a simple cup of coffee, nothing too strong or too weak. It's the kind of coffee you could drink every morning and be just fine with . I personally like my coffee on the stronger side and wouldn't mind a little flavor so I was looking forward to getting my second shippment in so I could try some different kinds. Right now I am loving the Tree Hugger's Organic blend. It's got just the kick I was looking for!
It's has been a pleasure ordering from Amazon.com. The coffee arrived sooner then expected and in good condition.
Everytime I try a new coffee I always come back to this one and my husband agrees. It's just a good strong but not bitter like dark roast cup of coffee. Of all the brands I prefer Timothy's the best.

This is the best k-cup I have found so far.  I have tried them all...  If you are new and looking for the perfect cup of coffee, buy this one.  The best price I have found so far however, is at Bed, Bath & Beyond (using your 20% off coupon = 44 cents a cup or $7.99 for 18 k-cups).

This is great coffee but I cannot believe this company has jumped in to sell it at twice the price Amazon was selling it for a month ago.  Amazon needs to get it back in stock and get the price back down into the realm of sanity!I love the smell and taste of Starbucks Espresso Roast in the latte's we make at home and work, which is why I decided to try the Italian blend, and it is by far my favorite.  It smells like a good morning cup should smell, then tastes just as good.  Most of the others have too much coffee in the k-cup for me and come on much too strong.  This one makes a perfect large cup of coffee.  I still buy others because my husband likes to explore but, in the morning, this is my coffee.

column9: Good robust flavor, lots of jitters!
column10: I enjoy a rich, robust cup of coffee, this coffee fits the ticket if you like the same.  AFter reading the reviews, I decdied to try it.  It seemed to be priced well in comparison to other Italian Roasts out there. I will say though that it must be packed full of caffene.  I can only drink one cup of this stuff, it gets me pretty wound up.
I really love this coffee  and i think you will also  I will buy it again and again

column9: A very good cup of coffee
column10: I have tried several of the Timothy's coffee's as part of the initial variety pack which came with the Keurig brewer.  I tend to use the 10oz brew and add a bit of creamer or flavored creamer to my cup of coffee, but I always try to taste the coffee itself before doctoring it to my taste.  This was a very good cup, I prefer a medium to dark coffee, and usually drink a moderately strong french roast at work.  This was the best of the non flavored coffees, Timothy's or otherwise which I have tried so far (coffee people french roast is a 3 star, Newman's extra Bold and Timothy's Nicaragua extra bold are both very good but a little strong for my taste)  If you like a medium coffee that is smooth and flavors nicely with a creamer give this one a try.
I tried several coffees before settling on this smooth blend. It has a robust flavor and smells wonderful. If your looking for a smooth coffee with a little kick,this is the one!
Timothy's Italian Blend is a great cup of coffee for those that do not want that bold and robust taste. Mild flavor and no aftertaste.

We have this delivered monthly from Amazon on the Subscribe and Save program; it's my husband's coffee of choice. Always fresh, always consistent, it's a favorite in our home.  If you like a little extra kick from your coffee, this roast is a nice, milder espresso blend--not too dark and heavy.  Great coffee.

We love this brand of Timothy's K-Cups. After only drinking the Green Mountain variety for a long time, I decided to give Timothy's a try.  The Italian Blend is a favorite in our house.  It tastes great!

column9: A great-tasting cup of coffee every morning!
column10: We have owned our Keurig since before Christmas, and have sampled many of the k-cups through the 5-cup sampler packs.  After all of the tasting the Timothy's Italian is my favorite blend.  It is crisp, robust, and has a coffee-shop freshness every time I make it.  And what a great surprise that I can purchase this coffee through the subscribe & save program on Amazon!  I just signed up for automatic delivery, because I have not and don't expect to tire of the great taste of the Timothy's Italian Blend. (Try some of their other blends, especially the Fair Trade.)
Timothy's Italian blend is bellisimo a bold rich flavor with that special edge espresso has in a minute. We love it!

Just a great cup of full bodied coffee, pure, rich with flavor, strong aroma, very smooth with no bitterness. Similar to Kona in flavor. If you like a strong cup with pure flavor and no burnt taste try this, it is a winner!

column9: Not for Dark Blend Coffee Drinkers
column10: I am a fan of other Timothy K Cups, but not this one. I tried it based on the reviews, but unfortunately it is not that strong. Of course it's a matter of taste. I prefer the darker blends, but if you are someone who prefers a "not so strong" coffee than I guess you would enjoy it. Don't get me wrong, it does not taste bad, just too weak for my preference.

Realizing that these reviews are very subjective and it is hard to judge taste... these are my favorite K-cups so far and I have tried many. They are not too dark and not too weak, but with a great sweet and nutty flavor and are very consistent. If typical breakfast blends and the like are just too weak for you and the super-double dark ones are too bitter, give these a try, I don't think you'll be disappointed.For a "taste preference" reference point, I am also a big fan of Kona and Kona blends.
Timothy's Italian roast is a mild not bold coffee...It has a nice taste however much weaker than other coffee's I have had...I would surely classify this coffee as a weaker blend of Italian Roast...

column9: weak was stronger the first time I bought it
column10: Don't if they changed it,but it did not taste like the first time I ordered it,don't know what they did to it?

column9: Good For Those Who Like Their Coffee Less Bold
column10: Certainly flavorful, but less body than I usually prefer. I think of Italian blend as a bolder, darker coffee. If you're put off by the stronger taste (think Starbucks)of the coffee house blends, this is the brew for you.
this is a blend of coffee, and has a weak flavor, the Italian roast is much better

This italian blend is a very pleasent coffee to drink anytime. I do not find it harsh, bitter or too strong. I have a few cups a day and can drink this well into the afternoon. I cannot recommend Timothys Italian Blend coffee enough... And AMAZON you "rock my world" on the delivery, always here within 2 days of placing my order !!!!! Couldn't be a happier customer !
Have used many boxes of this coffee in my Keurig.  It is full-bodied and very good, but not too strong/bitter.  Highly recommend.

column9: Everyone LOVES these little Italian candies!
column10: When I bought these for my office, everyone was asking me where I got them from. They are perfect and everyone says they are "just right" for light afternoon break snacking.

It's hard to get almonds just right. I don't really like them unless there is something sweet or flavored coating them. These were fairly dry and unexciting. Would probably be good in some recipe to spice them up, though.
I can't taste any salt on these almonds.  I'm sure that makes them healthier, but YUCK!  I need my sodium fix and these don't cut it.

This is my second purchase of these almonds, and this time around I am very disappointed. They taste old & stale, and are a bit chewy - not a good sign for a supposedly roasted almond. I won't be buying them again.

I have tried quite a few different almonds but these almonds are our favorite. They taste good (both roasted and salted) and the zip-lock kind of bag it comes in ensures they stay fresher for a longer period of time.
These almonds are delicious.  I like the fact that they use sea salt.  Remember to always purchase almonds from California as opposed to imported almonds.

wow- I wasn't expecting such large packages of this extraordinary salted licorice. yes, it is salted, but not so much you need a water chaser. I served it at a recent art event, and had some very happy clients. I'm certainly going to it buy again-

Was hopeing it was more salty.  The bag opens and rips easily.  Once open it needs to be poured into a zip lock quart sized bag.  Some saltiness but more sweet than I was expecting.  I'm ordering a different brand next time w/hopes of a saltier flavor.  It's good for what it is...Downgraded because of the poorly designed bag.  It can't be resealed and usu makes a mess.
I really enjoy the combination of coffee and spice in this blend, and will keep ordering it as long as it is available. Now we need a decaf in the same blend!

I was sad after running out of Green Mountain's Island Coconut Coffee that we enjoyed over the summer. We looked everywhere for more but couldn't find any. I came across Green Mountain's Pumpice Spice K-Cup Coffee on Amazon and after reading the few reviews about it, took the plunge and purchased the 108 K-Cup pack. I am so glad I did! This is a wonderful coffee I look forward to every morning.I'll be ordering another 108-pack so I don't have the same disappointment as the Island Coconut, and will also be sending some to my daughter for when I visit!Edited to add:I got this box of 108 at $69.95 = about 65 cents per cup.
I love Green Mountain's Pumpkin Spice coffee! Thanks to Amazon I am able to enjoy it all year long.  If you love the taste of pumpkin, this coffee is for you.

I love Green Mountain Pumpkin Spice coffee. The blend of spices is just perfect. The coffee itself is never bitter. Just a smooth yummy taste. I never stop at the name brand coffee houses anymore as none of them can beat Green Mountain coffees.

These are by far the best dark chocolate nonpareils I have ever had. I first discovered these marvelous discs of succulent deliciousness at my local grocery store. I have a soft spot for dark chocolate, so I wasn't even slightly off put by the higher-than-average price tag for small 3 oz bag of these. Now I have the convenience of purchasing a whole pound for a cheaper price per unit? Oh dear god help me. I can resist anything but temptation.I'm not the best at describing flavor, but I wouldn't want to ruin the surprise anyway. If you like dark chocolate or nonpareils, you will love these. Try them at least once!

This product brought me back to the old day's that's for sure. It was soooooogood!!!!!! The dark chocolate was absolutely delicious! I know that I will be purchasing more from this company & you should too.

column9: Dreaming in chocolate has never been better!
column10: I love these truffles! I usually buy the bags at the grocery store but it's a total crapshoot as to how they've been stored so they sometimes haven't been kept cool enough and it ruins the outside shell so i thought I'd try buying them from Amazon. They came in two days with regular shipping (nice!) and were packed really well with chill bags. They were perfect! I will definitely order them again.

We had some other maker's dark chocolate truffles and loved them, but couldn't find them. We had seen commercials for these Lindt truffles, so I gave these a try.  They are listed as dark chocolate, but I would only consider them as milk chocolate.  We MUCH prefer dark over milk chocolate, and would not order milk chocolate truffles.  So we were disappointed.  They are probably real good if you like milk chocolate, but if you are expecting dark chocolate, you might want to try a small sample first, or get some from another maker.So now we have to eat all these.  It will be a tough job, but we will get through it.  I just wish their dark chocolate was dark.

Ordered this a couple weeks back and worried that they may melt while en route to my house due to what other customers have said in different posts. Once I received them, everyone loved them! They seem to have been stored in the right temperatures, and they taste great. They are definitely safe to buy from this seller - they don't seem to be last year's chocolates.

I received this item in 2 days time. I was worried that when I receive the package the candies were all going to be melted but I was pleasantly surprised to find that the package came with ice packs to keep the candies from melting upon delivery. Amazing!

My husband loves his chocolate fix, but there is really nothing more satisfying to him than the Lindor Dark Chocolate Truffles -- for him, every other chocolate candy pales by comparison. So to go completely overboard for Valentine's Day, I ordered the 60-count box. Yes, that may have been overdoing it, but I couldn't have made him happier. Also, he had recently seen a History Channel special on the making of chocolate, and was pleased to see the high quality of Lindor's processing featured! He has exercised unbelievable restraint in making the box last a while -- and every single bite brings bliss. Bravo, Lindor! Letting these dark chocolate truffles melt slowly in your mouth is a truly sensuous experience.
THIS WAS A BIRTHDAY GIFT FOR MY MOTHER IN LAW SHE LOVES CANDY AND THINKS THAT THIS IS DELICIOUS AND JUST MELTS IN YOUR MOUTH.
my husband and I love these chocolaes.  Sometimes it is hard to stop at just one.  They are so creamy and not sidkly sweet.  Often we have one after dinner to satisfy our craving for dessert.

God help me, I love this chocolate.  I could write haikus and some serious poetry about this chocolate.  While I love Godiva's as well, there's just something about the creamy chocolate goodness of Lindt chocolates.  It's simply hard to resist.
Wow. Amazing chocolates and soooooo dangerous because you cannot just have one!!  Love all the flavors but these are my favorite.

I am not a big fan of dark chocolate but this one made me eat at least 20 pc. the same day I received the box. Packaging was also great. I intended to gift the packet to a friend but ended up sharing only a few pieces with her and eating all by myself.
OK, the only bad thing about these is that there are 60 in a box. Otherwise, they are delicious, perfect sized pieces.
This is my very favorite of the truffles. It is a medium dark and very delicious. If I have one, it screams at me to have just one more! As long as they are made, I will be first in line to purchase.
These truffles are the best.  Chocolatey and not too sweet.  And they got here in no time.  Only one problem.  They seem to disappear.  They're almost gone already.
When it comes to chocolate, I am always so happy. But this one let me down. I'm not paying for a melted box!!!

This is my very favorite of the  truffles. It is a medium dark and very delicious. If I have one, it screams at me to have just one more! As long as they are made, I will be first in line to purchase.
I'm not a huge fan of truffles in general but I bought these for my grandmother and she loves them.  She's pretty picky too.

column9: best chocolate for  a reasonable price
column10: I have purchased this at least twice, maybe 3 times...once I got the 120 count box and that lasted a long time. I am not a fan of dark chocolate, but this is not a truly DARK chocolate flavor. It is not quite milk, but not bitter like dark chocolate can be. The Truffles with the black wrapping are way too dark chocolate for me...so this is a nice balance between the milk chocolate in the red wrapper and the black wrapper dark Lindor truffles. I have to keep a sharp eye on the price, because for a while there it went WAY up and I didn't buy during that time. The reviewers that complained about melting must have not received their candy carefully wrapped in a styrofoam box, with little ice packs in the box. By the time mine got here on a very hot day, the packs were melted, but the chocolate was fine. Love the convenience and quantity!
These dark chocolate truffles melt in your mouth.  They are smooth and very delicious.  I'll bet you can't eat just one!

column9: Count was off, but it was fixed
column10: I bought these chocolates along with some ribbon and bags to give as thank you gifts. They come in a display type box that you would find in a store and it wasn't really closed. As I was portioning them out (5 per bag) I realized that there were 3 missing, which was a problem for me because I needed exactly 12 bags. I called amazon and they offered to give me a cash discount or return it normally. Very helpful. Thank you.And these are delicious.

Have ordered these before and most certainly will again.  Hold in your mouth until the outer layer melts and let the creamy center stream aceoss your tongue.  Go ahead, I dare you.  It's almost impossible to resist chewing the whole thing at once.
These truffles are very delicious in dark chocolate.  They also arrived very quickly.  I would most definitely purchase this product (and other products) in the future.

column9: ADDICTED! Just when you want a simple bite, you're in heaven!
column10: Lindt Lindor Truffles Dark Chocolate is heaven itself; but be careful ... you can't stop at one! YIPES! The shell is nice and not hard, but once you take a bite, you suddenly become pleasantly surprised with its creamy, fluffy and oh so heavenly truff-o-holic-ly inside .... YOU ARE GONE TO CHOCO-LAND!It is difficult to believe these nice little sized balls holds such a powerful punch and is jam-packed with Chocolate power! But one word of warning, it is very addicting!

This thing makes a great present for any chocolate lover, I ordered all three, milk, dark, and white... and have had no complaints from serious connoisseurs. The price is only contestable when Lindt holds its 2 for 19oz bags @ 20 deal, but still, you are cutting it really close, and when you factor in shipping, forget it. Walmart at best can only match this price through an online offer, however, with additional charges this substantially brings up the total cost.Word of caution, this deal may not work for those requiring shipping in hot weather or steamy climates.Comment
Better than sex, very chocolate, great taste, I love them. I cannot get enhough of them, they are habit forming.

I have tried to love DARK chocolate since reading so much about it's health benefits...... especially compared to milk chocalate.  Trouble is, it is usually too bitter for my sugar corrupted taste buds.This particular divine mouthful of heaven is a decided exception!  I really think that this traditional,revered company richly deserves it's enduring reputation!The "per unit" price is also exceptional, especially for European chocalate.The retail display packaging is easily disposed of,  and my only fear initially,as I tipped these glorious morsels into a silver bowl, was that I would be induced to eat one EVERY time I passed this enticing little mountain of deliciousness!Surprise!  This exceptional treat is truly so satisfying that I seriously don't crave another, and another! As a woman who can easily consume an entire bag of Maui potato chips in one sitting, this is remarkable!!!
The best review I can give is that my girlfriend and her roommates annihilated these within a couple days of getting the package.

I ordered these delicious truffles once before, obviously from a different company, since when I opened the box, which took unusually long to arrive - to give someone one, EVERY SINGLE CHOCOLATE WRAPPER WAS COVERED IN MELTED CHOCOLATE>>> DISGUSTING
This is the best deal. I have found on this candy .it really nice for the price .I can't wait to buy more
Nice gift. They were as advertised and I would recommend them to skinney people who want to get fat,or not.

These are excellent chocolates. The outer dark chocoate coating is a very creamy and smooth chocolate. If you like dark chocolate, you'll like these. They are addictive! If you are not a fan of dark chocolate, I would suggest trying the milk chocolate truffles (red wrappers). In addition to chocolate truffles, Lindt also offers a variety of other flavors.

I ENJOY THIS CANDY BECAUSE I CAN KEEP IT IN THE REFRIGERATOR AND THE CENTER BECOMES A LITTLE FIRMER.  IT DOES HAVE A GOOD CHOCOLATE FLAVOR BUT I DON'T LIKE MY CENTER TO BE RUNNY.I PURCHASED THIS CANDY FROM AMAZON AND I AM HAPPY WITH THE DELIVERY AND THE PRODUCT.

I have a super-picky older dog and two cats who LOVE the freeze-dried raw treats!  They are really worth every penny since they never go to waste and they are the only treat I've purchased in YEARS that they all LOVE.  Seriously...my picky dog, who is still finicky about her dinner, can barely contain herself when she knows she's getting these goodies.  These will probably be the only treats I purchase for them in the future since they're consistenly a hit.  I feel good about feeding them a high-quality natural food that isn't filled with byproducts and grain fillers.

My Shih Tzu's love these! I didnt think they would eat them at first but as soon as I gave it to them it was gone =)They have allergies to most grains, we feed them a grain-free diet & these are perfect & wont make them itch like crazy. I will definitely purchase these agian & would recommend them to anyone!The shihpping was VERY fast, I ordered them on Friday night (06/18/2010) & got them today (Monday 06/21/2010).

My 15 year old cat has IBD (Irritable Bowel Disease) and is on a limited ingredient diet. I bought this for him since duck is the protein source of choice for him. It is very hard to find duck treats for cats! He loves these, and I am thrilled to be able to offer him a healthy, tasty treat once again. I wish they came in smaller pieces for cats, but they do split into pieces relatively easily. I am a vet tech who will be happy to share this find with clients in a similar situation. Absolutely worth the price!

I use this as a treat for training and my dog just begs for more lessons!  I slice into small bites then add a little warm water and soak for 5 mins ... easy ... and my dog won't choke when she "inhales" the food during lessons.

My two kittens can be quite picky with treats, but these things bring out their inner wild ocelot. One bats it around all over the house like half-dead prey for twenty minutes, while the littler one sits in the corner gnawing on it and snarling to break it down and keep it away from other predators. Who knew indoor cats could get this way over a simple treat. These duck hearts are on the big side (for cats or small dogs), but my two kittens seem to like the challenge of taking the time to chomp them down. They're pretty easy to cut into smaller pieces with a butter knife, if you do want to give them bite sized pieces. All in all, I highly recommend!

I got these because I have an elderly cat with both Diabetes and Inflammatory Bowel Disease and I was glad to find a ' novel protein' low-carb treat for him.  He was glad too -- he loves them.  My other 2 also went crazy about them including the 4 month old kitten who who growl with horrible relish as he devoured the treats.  ( I did have to cut or break them into smaller pieces for the kitten but that was no big deal. )

I tried these treats for my cat who was having serious nausea and food issues. Because organ meats contain taurine, I wanted a limited ingredient treat to augment meat-only baby food (which obviously lacks taurine). Despite being very nauseous, my cat gobbled these up.If they like these things, it's like kitty crack. Out of my three cats, two LOVE these. The other one wouldn't even try them (he's that way).I gave a bag of five cut-up heart pieces to a friend to try with his IBD kitty. He put the bag on the counter and in the morning found the chewed up bag with all of the treats gone!I use kitchen shears to cut each heart into about four pieces. I was very pleased to discover that the end pieces can easily hold a pill, making them a grain-free pill pocket. It's been a great help in pilling my sick cat. (Fortunately, he's now doing well and can eat cat food -- and these special treats, of course!)
Cats will eat it and seem to enjoy - but be sure to cut it up into small enough pieces for them.  They don't go crazy for it, but will eat it after playing with it a bit.

Our picky rescued mutts went nuts over these treats.  It's wonderful that every part of the duck can be used; we did have to thank the duck for its life and its heart for the pups to have such a healthy and delicious treat.  Will continue to buy.

column9: Much healthier than processed cat treats
column10: I bought these along with some bonito flakes as a replacement to unhealthy processed cat treats (with disgusting ingredients and byproducts) that were making them fat. I make my own real meat cat food with chicken, turkey, beef, liver, heart, gizzards, bone and vitamins, so the treats were the only thing they were still eating from a shelf.  Because it can be hard to find chicken hearts, I have to add extra taurine to the cat food.  I like that I can now give them real heart as a treat or training aid.  I chose duck hearts to mix it up a bit.  It's a good price and there are a ton in the pack and it's a resealable Ziploc bag.  The hearts can be broken into pieces as well.  The cats love it.
My shih tzu has allergies, he can only eat duck and potato food and treats.  He went crazy over these treats, they're his new favorite!

I gave my 3 year old yorkie this treat and he snubbed it. I tried mixing it in a bowl of his food and he picked around it. The bag was vacuum sealed and appeared fresh, so not sure if he just wasn't in the mood or he didn't like them. Giving a 4-star for packaging and product freshness.

Chemical-free, freeze-dried, and bite sized - pure, healthy snacks that my 5 lb. female Papillon thoroughly enjoys. What could be better?Warning to cat owners: This is NOT for cats.  My Felicia took a bite out of one, and her fangs were embedded; I had to remove it myself.  This is JUST FOR DOGS.

I ordered these after my husband and I started remembering candy bars from our childhood.. I remembered the 7-up bars, which I loved, and he remembered these bars.. I did a search on the internet and discovered the 7-up bars are no longer made, but these are. So I bought a box of them for us since I'd never seen them in stores (right after that, we noticed them in a few stores. lol).. I love chocolate, but this is that cheaper kind of chocolate.. I'm not sure what the difference is, but it's unnaturally too sweet and kind of cheap tasting. The fillings are also way too sweet, in a cheap product kind of way.. The peanut butter is barely there, the white creamy feeling is just too sweet and cheap tasting (like the cheaper candy they sell in stores), the caramel is ok, but there isn't a whole lot in there and the fudge center is also ok, but there also isn't a lot in there.. All in all, this isn't the candy of yesteryear...We only ate a few each and have started giving them to the kids and grandkids stuck in gifts, just trying to get rid of them. Some of the grandkids don't even like them, though.Unless yo like that cheap, overprocessed, over sweetened chocolate and filling taste, I wouldn't recommend these.

I'm sorry...I am not reviewing the actual product, but just the misleading information, with the parenthetical {Seven-Up Bar}. This is NOT a Seven-Up Bar. Believe me, I KNOW. I used to steal money from the top of my Dad's dresser, sneak to the corner market, buy one of these and a Richie Rich comic book, and it was HEAVEN!!! Shame on Sky Bar for this misleading advertising.

column9: I remember this when I was a kid
column10: I grew up loving these. I bought a box a year ag and my mom and I ate the whole box in a month. Ha
I love this tea. Very fruity and flavorful and way cheaper than Teavana tea. Comes in a plastic bag and keeps pretty fresh in it, clipped shut.

Great snack for my daughter. But also my wife and I enjoy its really good taste. This presentation is great for on-the-go situations, but also to keep the product fresh for later (only if you can keep yourself from eating the whole pack).
Though the container says '3 servings', it is really hard to put down the container once it is opened. Good snack. Better (more healthy) if you have self-discipline!

I've enjoyed the original SkyFlakes for a ling time so when I saw there was a garlic version, I just had to try it. They're amazing, not too garlicky and they stay very fresh in their individually wrapped 3 packs inside the air tight canister. Give 'em a try. You won't regret it.

A great tasting substitute for anyone who needs to watch their salt intake.  Received it within a week when ordering through Amazon.  I've ordered this product from the AlsoSalt company out of Washington state over five months ago and still have not received the product.
I carry a bottle of Also Salt in my purse to use when we go out to  restaurants.  It taste like salt unlike the bitterness of other substitutes.  I am delighted to have found it.

I read some other reviews here that said there's a metallic taste with this product - that's nonsense.  This tastes almost exactly like regular salt.  I have a serious salt addiction and I've been putting it on almost anything.  Of course, this has led to me having dangerously high blood pressure.  Also salt may have literally saved my life, because I will never use real salt again!

column9: Best sodium free salt substitute yet!
column10: I am cooking for someone who is in CHF, so sodium free is a must.  I first tried this product in Heinz No-Salt ketchup and was impressed that there wasn't a metallic after-taste.  I tracked this down and have used it in baking mixes, general cooking or anything that I would normally salt.  It's really good!  I had to slip it by my Dad, but once he actually tried it in food, he was hooked.  It's not identical to salt flavor, but it's close enough to fool many!  I highly recommend this product!
Also salt does not pour like salt it is powder. You have to use a lot of it to taste it and then it leaves a bitter taste. Would not recommend.

I ordered this from Vitacost and received it promptly.  This is about as good as it gets for a salt substitute.  Don't taste it out of the jar, put it on something and it does taste like salt.  It doesn't have that potassium aftertaste that most salt substitutes have, even though it contains potassium chloride.  There is 356mg of potassium per 1/4 tsp. so people who need to limit their potassium should be aware of that.  I use it mainly in recipes for the bread machine so the bread doesn't fall, about 1/2 tsp. per loaf and the bread comes out perfect.  You might have to adjust the amount of yeast to just a teaspoon or a little more.As stated by the previous reviewer, I used to order it direct from AlsoSalt but the last time waited for months for a shipment.  Ordering from Vitacost through Amazon is the way to go.

column9: Awesome product for any new parent on the go!
column10: If you just had a baby and are an active parent these bottles will change your life! Forget about the mess, you will never go back to carrying around a million bottles to mix formula. You wont be disappointed!

This product is fantastic for when you are traveling with a baby.  Instead of heving to search for clean water or having to wash a dirty bottle in a public sink, you can just open this, add formula, shake and serve.  Love it!

We were not able to find this product in any nearby grocery store.  My wife does a lot of baking during Passover, so when Amazon had this product listed, we very very pleased to be able to purchase it.  Additionally, Manischewitz has an excellent reputation for providing wholesome Passover products.

Vail Mountain Coffee might have their biggest fan in Dallas, TX. I have been addicted to the Gore Range Blend for months now and just am getting around to trying out their other blends. I can't speak highly enough about this coffee- way better than Starbucks or other higher end coffees that I have tried. Next I am on to the Bridge Street Blend. I will update with a review of Bridge Street after I try it.

I have been spending bajillions of dollars ordering in Ikura/Salmon Roe sushi because I crave it all the time!  I thought this was a brilliant plan to save a little money, and to cut out the wasted rice.No.  This is no substitute. For starters, jarred caviar is reeeeally salty and preservative-y tasting.  Which I maybe could have dealt with for the price difference, except that whatever the "Smokehouse" flavor is is GROSS.  I even like a smoky beer a local brewery makes, but this was not for me.I will not be buying again.

This item arrived fairly quickly but was unedible. I can't help but wonder if it spoiled in transit or was it spoiled at the warehouse. For starters, the color wasn't anything like the picture. It wasn't bright orange. It was more brown in color. It was only half full and it definitely wasn't "fluffy" looking. Against my better judgement, I spooned more than a few into my mouth only to discover that it had a horrible bitter taste to it. Because it is a grocery item, Amazon's policies prohibit its return (for safety reasons). However, Amazon did continue to earn my business by quickly refunding the $20 I paid for it. The refund processed within a day. I won't ever buy this product again.

Bitter, bitter, and far too strong. I've had Salmon Roe before, and I love it but this made me feel as if I would vomit after each bite. I thought possibly it was just how I was eating it so I tried it with rice. Just made the rice taste horrid. Don't waste your money or spend a little extra for something better.

This is a good choice for anyone who likes salmon, even if they have never made the leap to salmon roe. It lacks subtlety; it is a bit on the salty side, and the smokiness is a bit strong, but that can help to ease the impact of these little salmon-bombs for one who is new to the experience.
Took a long time to get to me, but product was as advertised when it arrived.

I usually buy Indian mixed pickles in a large can but gave the MTR brand a shot and was pleasantly surprised. Very strong, spicy flavor and aftertaste, you can tell there's Asafoetida (sort of a gum resin, used as a digestive aid, popular in Indian pickles and often substituted for onions and garlic in cooking by some as a religious preference). Has a bit of sauce with the vegetables which for me is great. A little can go along way and it's a great condiment for rice and some Indian meals. I've eaten this out of the jar by the spoonful, it's one of those tastes one can aquire and find hard to shake.This is advertised as a pack of 8. I noticed that it was delivered in a 9-pack with one missing. The quantity delivered is right, just made me do a double take and grin, thinking of a shopkeeper putting individual jars on his shelves when he could have charged me a bit more for the entire pack and saved himself the hassle of opening all those flats to pull one out of each. Sort of an Apu-Simpsons moment.

column9: a little too salty for my taste
column10: I will start by noting that I am a long time fan of Patak's Patak's Mixed Relish, Hot, 10-Ounce Glass Jars (Pack of 6) with their mixed pickle among my favorite things; (an understatement, I would almost call it an addiction  BUT *the* store which carries it locally has almost tripled the price, so I turned to Amazon... hoping, but, alas, they will not ship to Hawaii.I have found quite a few things here which are as good as, some even better than, my old "tried and true" and so I gave the MTR pickle a try.  The price is exceptional.  No complaints in that department, but I personally found this pickle a bit too salty.  The consistency is also different, not as chunky.Now these things are a matter of personal taste, likely more so with respect to food than anything else I can think of.  It is also a bit of a challenge to describe, particularly if you do not know, or necessarily share someone's personal taste.This is not a bad product and I can imagine a lot of people liking it more than I.  Any pickle is going to have a good deal of salt because... that's what a pickle is: something preserved in salt.  I tend to go lower on salt than most.  That said, if you like salty foods, you will like this better than I did.  I also prefer a chunkier consistency.  This pickle approaches a spread.  Again, this is not necessarily a bad thing, more a matter of personal taste.I like the spice blend in Patak's better as well, and this is the most difficult to describe as it is subtle and noone wants to detail their recipe(and I can not think of a single ingredient which stands out).  So, all I can say is that I did not like it as muchThe MTR pickle is also not as hot, and I personally like HOT.  This is a place where many people will not share my personal preference, as I know from experience that I eat food hotter than the vast majority of people (It was years before my husband could eat curries as hot as I tend to order or prepare them).As Indian pickles go, in my experience, this is on the milder side.  Judging by the reviews I have read of several products here, *most* people will differ from my tastes in this area and probably prefer a relatively milder pickle.All that said, this is a condiment which one would add to bring up the heat in a dish, maybe make it a little more flavorful.  I frequently have Annies frozen entrees for lunch (quick, convenient and healthy); the ones available locally being the spinach and paneer, and one or 2 bean curries with rice.  i find them fairly bland and *always* add pickle (I think without the pickle I would not enjoy them, maybe not eat them at all!).  I think the MTR mixed pickle will work OK to spice up those bland dishes.  It is not something I am going to either throw or give away, however, it is also not something I would order again.I hope I have been able to provide a description which is adequate enough for people to decide whether or not this would be to their taste.  In sum, I found this pickle to be saltier and milder than what I am used to.  It also has a different consistency than most, being somewhat smoother and less chunky.  Again, none of these things is necessarily bad.  It is all a matter of personal taste.Edited to note that by the time we got to the bottom of the first jar I had sussed out the ingredient which threw the taste, and my opinion off.  The "heat" is provided by paprika, rather than chile (which is what most or all of the other brands I have had use).  Paprika is nowhere near as hot a cayenne, or chile, and so much more is required to make this hot.  Ultimately it is not as hot, and the other flavors are somewhat diminished (because of the quantity of parika required).  if you like paprika you may like this, and if you don't, get another brand.

With six cats in the house, let me say I was THRILLED that Amazon.com offered this in their vine program. My cats eat anything that doesn't run away from them, but everyone from the year old cat, to the seventeen year old diabetic kitty LOVED this food. Even my mom's cat, who is known to be pretty finicky loved it.The food looks like "real" food, not the loaf-type food so often seen in canned cat food, and it smells great. Not stinky at all. The cats gobbled it right up, and I like that there is plenty of broth and liquid on the food, because that helps my eldest cat, who is missing several teeth, eat it just fine.I've been feeding wellness and Eagle Pack Holistic food in addition to prescription food. This ranks right alongside those expensive foods. Good stuff!!!!

This is a nice item -- chunks of meat, good gravy. My cat is not fond of all the varieties, but it is a nice little treat nonetheless.But I do think this item is a bit pricy ... about $1 per 3-ounce can.

column9: Mixed reviews from the house felines
column10: Dash loves it. Jasper does not. Dash Hoovered both his bowl and Jasper's, while Jasper took two bites and then moved over to the kibble bowl. We've tried three different flavors so far, and the verdict has been the same. So safe to say, not ALL cats want to eat "people food." I don't know much about this product except what's on the label. The fact that it's a product of Thailand concerns me a bit -- I don't know what their standards are for pet food, and after the scandal with the lead in Chinese-manufactured toys, well, I'm a little skeptical. It's also an expensive product. Since I don't have a consensus among the house felines, I doubt I will purchase any more of this product.

column9: My Two Cats Inhaled The Stuff
column10: OK, so I couldn't personally taste this cat food and give you a review. But all I can say is: my two cats (14 and 15 years old) virtually inhaled it. Clawdette is the older one and she is fussy. She likes a cat food that has seafood and tomato in it. Chappie is less picky, but he can turn up his nose at some supermarket brand cat foods. So more often then not I buy the canned cat food at petshops (or on Amazon). I fed them each of the cans in the Variety Pack...and its as if the food vanished off the face of the earth within a few minutes. The bottom line: they loved it, it left their coats nice and softy and glossy, and they had lots of energy. So I (or, rather my cats) give it five stars.

column4: Glenda Boozer "Live, live, live! Life is a ba...
column9: If your cat likes people food, this may be for you.
column10: My cat George never quite finishes a 6-ounce can of cat food, so I thought I would try these 3-ounce servings. However, George is not terribly fond of people food, and he has only finished one of the cans that I have given him so far - the Sesame Chicken, as it turns out. He clearly likes the broth in the Chicken Pot Pie, but he doesn't finish his vegetables, or even all of the chunks of chicken.Of course, we can hardly blame him for abandoning one can to attempt to get into the turkey liver I was cutting up. Some people food is too good for cats to pass up!

My fiancee brought this home from his moms and my cat went crazy! She inhaled an entire can in seconds and then begged for more. I completely grossed my fiancee out when I tasted it and let me tell you as someone who is an avid cook the Chicken Pot Pie is very good. I make chicken pot pie and reading the ingredients were like reading the ingredients in a chicken pot pie you would make or buy for yourself. The chicken did not taste processed. The first time I saw the can of food I thought it was gourmet tuna and had to read to make sure it was cat food. I can't say that I blame my kitty for enjoying this so much. We have a local health food store that carries it so it's easy to find for me but the deals online are amazing! I'll be going via Amazon from now on. My cat reacts to this the way she reacts to fresh tuna, she goes nuts!

Petite Cusine is the only canned food I feed my two cats Smokie and Elvira. Its natural products are my main cuncern. They let me know when it time to feed them. They both block my way in the kitchen till I feed them.

My Tigger was a kitten when he came to me (Dropped)he loved the outdoors but often got into some accidents that ended up at the Vet's office, needless to say he then wouldn't eat and was loosing weight. I had tried other cat foods but nothing he would even look at, then I tried Petite Cuisine Tuna & Shrimp to mine and Tigger's amazement he fell in "LOVE" and eats well now. He is now 2-yrs old and I have another (Dropped) 2-yr old male Cat and he also loves this cat food. Tigger and Ziggy are very "Happy Cats".

column9: Paris loves it and that's enough for me!
column10: My sweet cat Paris loves this kitty food and that's enough for me!  I can no longer find in my grocery store so very happy it is available on Amazon.  THANKS!

column9: More like "human" food than Cat Food
column10: My cats are crazy for this food, including the one that has turned up her nose at all wet food for 6 years! Unfortunately the price makes it prohibitive as an every day meal since I have 5 cats. Also, I've heard that too much fish is not healthy for cats, they need meat too and they aren't that crazy about the Petite Cuisine Chicken.  I still buy the tuna and just feed it occasionally as an extra treat. The food itself looks and smells just like tuna for humans, maybe even a little better. Some of it has tiny little (whole) shrimp and some pieces of codfish - it also has a lot of tuna oil, which I guess is what the cats like about it because the first thing they do is lap up all the "gravy". I thought maybe if I bought human tuna in oil and spiked their usual soft Friskies, they would enjoy it more, but that didn't work, so I continue to buy Petite Cuisine.

Directly above it says this review is FROM Petite Cuisine Cat Food. In actuality it is FOR Petite Cuisine Cat Food!!!I used to purchase this cat food at Winn-Dixie stores. About six months ago they stopped carrying it. Amazon was the only place I could find besides the manufacturer that would sell me this at retail. Since the manufacturer wanted an exorbitant amount for purchase at retail Amazon was the only retailer left. Fortunately for me the Amazon program of monthly purchases worked out perfectly. It enables me to buy the food at a price that is acceptable and keeps my cats happy at the same time.As far as the food itself is concerned all I can say is that the cats love it, and it gives them very healthy looking luxurious coats and satisfies their appetites at the same time. If you need a link to make a purchase cut and paste the following into your address bar: [...]

`I was very pleased to see this product online.  I always bought Baby Girls canned food at Food Lion and now they no longer carry it at the local store.  Every cat and kitten who has had the pleasure of trying it loves it.  NOT gummy or looks like mystery meat.  Great product.

Otis is what I call a very picky eater. The fact is, until now, he would not eat the same cat food twice! He is 10 years old.I was in the habit of buying food one can at a time for obvious reasons. I did that for the Petite Cusine as well....the Tuna and sole. He inhaled it. I bought 2 more. This time 2 different varsities of the same brand. Again....gone.Since it is not cheap, I looked for it on line. Amazon had the best deal and I bought 4 cases of variety packs. That was almost a year ago. He still loves it!The other things I like are the ingredients. They are healthy for him.....no fillers.

The cats should love these little jars of different wet flavors, and even you cats who are accustomed to dry food should like this.  You feel like you're giving them something healthful and gourmet when you serve them this.  The food is quite liquidly, which could be a good or bad thing depending on their and your preference.  Open a jar and serve it to them, and don't mistake it for tuna for yourself!
My cats ate it but they didn't seem to like it to well.Wouldn't buy it again.

column9: Human food but apparently not cat food
column10: It looks and smells really good. It has no harmful additives. It is in a cute package. It has names of food that I like. If only my cats could appreciate all of the above qualities! I wonder if other people's cats do. I couldn't find any fault with the food, but then again, I'm human. I'd say it probably depends very much on what your cat's taste is. If your cat enjoys fresh organic food... then buy this. If they like Fancy Feast - don't!!

Would of given this 5 star if it was cheaper. I love the small cans for convenience but not willing to pay for the cost of it. I liked that their was no gagging fishy smell as some cat foods have. My cats loved this food and would of eaten 2 cans at a time if I let her. I will consider keeping this on hand for those times when I need the small can convenience. However, can not afford to purchase this all the time.

Any review of this product, necessarily, must be based upon observation of the four footed furry feline friends (barring any truly dedicated and odd reviewers). We have two cats that deign to call us their owners, at least at feeding time and when the litter box needs cleaning.This is soft food in the petite cans favored by the feline haute cuisine products. However, the similarity seems to end there as the product is flaked rather than sliced or diced, and the sauce is clear with an oily consistency (somewhat like vegetable or olive oil), the pot pie cans were considerably more fluid.The boy, Otis, will eat just about any soft cat food put in front of him unfortunately we were disappointed with his response to this product. The girl, Crystal, is the pickier of the pair and will usually lick a little of the food or sauce before abandoning any soft food (leaving the remnants for Otis), but would not touch this product. I was gratified to see that the product did not come out of China after the problems of the past year.Bottom line is that the cats did not seem to like the product as much as other soft foods. The poor response from the cats means that this one will not make it into the rotation.

column9: Great cat food but it is a little pricy
column10: My finicky cat LOVED these petite cuisines.  He would scarf them down.  The ingredients are wholesome, lots of juices and you could actually see the real tuna, mini shrimps and so forth.  The only reason I gave this 4 instead of 5 stars because it is really expensive in the stores.  But if money is no object for your little 4 legged feline friends, then I highly recommend this cat food.

column9: A Feast For the Most Finnicky Furry Feline
column10: This food is a delight to give to one of the most important members of the family.  She's a bit choosy & will walk away readily from many foods. So, it is really something to watch her just gobble this down!The smaller sized can is nice as well for it insures that she'll eat the whole thing-down to the carrots. With the larger cans, she'll leave a third or more sitting there and it goes to waste.Petite Cuisine may cost a bit more, but nutritionally it is a very good meal for the kitty and she likes it, so none goes uneaten!  So, in the long run, it is a good value.On inspection of the cat food, it is composed of very good ingredients and is a high quality product.Our kitty loves it and gobbles it down at one sitting!
