The next morning I tried it with butter on toast and was in ecstasy.  Ended up bringing it to work so I could enjoy the smell and enhance the aroma of the coffee. (Why do I need to drink coffee outside of the flavour now?)I just tried it in a peanut butter, Vegemite, and butter toasted sandwich that utterly knocks the socks off the best sharp cheddar toasted sandwich that I've had without a doubt.  The fact that I left it on one side too long so that it started carbonising didn't matter.I can't wait to cook with it and use it more now that I've found my local World Market to carry the 220g jar for only a bit more!Absolute pros:* It tastes beyond awesome!* The aftertaste is excellent and lasts for hours, yet doesn't leave you with a bad breath.* Extremely versatile.* Energises your body and mind.Cons:* You need to warm up your knife a bit before spreading it when it's cold out.  This makes it far easier to spread without having to spread it only on hot toast immediately after it's left the griddle or if you don't desire to microwave the Vegemite.  You may be able to spread it directly on bread that's not been toasted if it's a sturdy loaf at this point too.  I found that holding the tip of the knife against the griddle until the knife is a bit warmer than your fingers to be an excellent way to do so.* The 2.5kg tub isn't available in stores up in my area.You'll prolly like it if you enjoy:* Salty and savoury foods.* Ample levels of brewers yeast in your foods or the flavour/smell of the brewers yeast.* Peanut butter and garlic salt sandwiches.* Toasted sharp yellow cheddar sandwiches.* Smoked yellow cheddar.Thank you mum for raising me on a diet heavy in brewers yeast! :D

We've all heard of Vegemite through the famous song. I thought I'd research this, and found that it was autolyzed yeast extract.The jar arrived in fine shape, has a long shelf life (refrigerate after opening) and has a consistency just a bit thicker than brand-name peanut butter.  This is definitely an acquired taste, but the nutritional benefits are well worth a little effort. I don't recommend you buy a large jar at first; believe me it won't go fast at first.

My wife and I have always wanted to try vegemite and now we have... Not my cup of tea! It has a salty yeast flavor, just a little to strong for my taste. But how cool is it that all I have to do is log on to Amazon, and for a reasonable price we can try a favorite from another culture in our own home. I will not be finishing this but I have a friend who grew up in New Zealand and he will love to have a taste of home :)

I love the 'mites'. Vegemite, marmite and promite. Vegemite is an acquired taste, so it's not something I recommend trying unles you know what you're in for. It's a beer by-product and it's loaded with vitamin Bs, totally vegetarian and great on toast. If you like sweet and salty things, I recommend trying it on cinnamon raisen toast, or even pikelets or scones, if you're game. Some people use it to add flavor to casseroles and for an added vitamin boost, I'm sure it would be great.The product was just the same as I would purchase in a New Zealand store (even though it's Australian). Would I recommend it? I did mention that it's an acquired taste right? Go easy spreading it on your toast. A thick coating is not recommended.So, if you can't find it locally, yes buy it here. It's cheaper if you can find an international food store and save on the shipping.
Excellent product for any Antipodean how misses home.Also if hard to find here try the Australian Cataloge Company for vegemite. Reasonably priced too.[...]
bought this for my son because he was curious about it (due to a song from Men at work). It is SALTY. so if your blood pressure is high, dont try it. I guess its ok if you like it but we don'tY

I bought my first jar of Kraft's Vegemite (the Australian brand) and I must say the flavor is strong, salty, and slightly bitter.  Every morning I have a bit of Vegemite on my buttered toast.  I have quickly become very fond of this new morning ritual.  It is an excellent source of folic acid and B Vitamins.  I recommend that you experience the flavor sensation for yourself.

I LOVE my vegemite, but then I am a kiwi and grew up as a vegemite kid. I eat it on toast, crackers, use it in Gravy as a flavour boost, I put it in stews, for the same reason. Its great on baked potatoes with a dollop of butter... remembering that in the Downunder way you use only a small amount of it as its very strong. I recall as a kid having it on sandwiches, cheese and vegemite, cheese, lettuce and vegemite. Vegemite and chopped walnuts on bread. Grilled cheese and vegemite, on and on it is so multi useful. Dry toast it on bread sticks for teething babies... I am nearly out of my current vegemite, having shared it to some adventuring Americans here a work, for the record I got no converts but one of the Dr's assured me I would find it on Amazon so here I am looking and yayyyy i don't have to be deprived. I read another review and here is my absolute favourite way to have vegemite.. thick slice of fresh bread, thick load of butter and a small portion of vegemite.. scrape on and scrape off.. ( just like the other reviewer said ) and whammo a great feast !!! Thank you Amazon !!!

column9: done right it's very tasty, but hard to acquire
column10: A friend sent me  small jar of this a few months back with stern warnings to use sparingly, I tried it the traditional way with only a tiny bit mixed in with plenty of butter on toast and loved it, actually, I enjoy tiny bites right out of the jar (of course I eat miso the same way, I love salty flavored things). I found it adds something to soups and stews as well, and it seems to have helped with my low level anemia issues.sadly the jar is long gone and I am trying to find a way to order it. I've been a bit shocked looking here on Amazon to see that the shipping costs more than the product does! Who in this economy can afford that? I would understand if it had to be refrigerated before opening...Such a shame too, as I am so craving a nice toasted vegamite/ham/cheese sandwich!

column9: Nice condiment, but watch the prices
column10: Go to my review list for a review of this thing (for some reason the same product pops up on different pages and I don't want to post the same thing several times). It's a very nice condiment with the main flavour being salty.However the prices here are mind-blowing: would you pay ten bucks (plus oversized shipping) for a bottle of soy sauce? Probably not, and neither should you pay for this thing, especially considering how tiny this jar is. Btw, still overpriced, it ia available at Wegman's for slightly over six bucks. Still too much, but less than a half of what I see they're asking for here. Don't buy into hype and snobbery and don't overpay: this is nothing terribly special, just a kind of salt, basically; slightly bitter and with a lot of vitamin B in it. This jar should really cost less than a dollar and be available in grocery stores.Btw, Wegman's also has Marmite, which is very similar to Vegemite; for under five bucks for the same amount; Marmite is also available in Whole Foods, though more expensively: over seven bucks a pop).

column9: I loved it at first bite.
column10: I'm not sure why so many are squeamish about Vegemite.  I saw the item in passing at my local Cost Plus World Market and saw a video from Peter Furler (musician) who recently advertised to fans the common toast/butter/vegemite recipe.  I like to try new things so I picked up a jar today.  I love it.  I tend to like salty foods so just a tad of vegemite on buttered toast was the bomb.  It reminded me of potted meat but not as salty or uh, meaty.  It was perfect.  I look forward to using it in various recipes.
I purchased this because friends and I have heard how popular it is in Australia. If I had a choice between being eaten by a croc or eating Vegemite...I will definitely choose the croc.

I was quite disappointed in the flat taste of this product. There was a lot of meat, however, but the sauce and potatoes seemed to be rather lackluster in appearance and taste. I finally mixed 2 packages with some brown gravy, added a bit of blended seasoning and brought it to life. I would not buy this product again.
This isn't a review of how this tastes:  it's a fairly average canned beef stew.  However, it's gluten-free, according to their online product list.Thanks guys!

This is the ideal product for us to use when preparing products in our pharmaceutical facility.  I hate it that it is IMPOSSIBLE to find the 7.5 oz size of Dinty Moore Beef Stew.  I wish this product would become available again!  It was difficult to find it on the shelves the past couple of years and now it is impossible to find even on the internet.  Hopefully the company will continue making this very desirable product!.

column9: Yum, Tastes Great , Free of artificial ingredients
column10: This product has been available since I was a child, and even before. ( I am in my late 60s)  It was good then, and it is still pretty good. The meat is real beef in chewable chunks. I think the gravy may be a tad thinner, and the carrot and potato pieces just a bit smaller... still a safe, and nutritious lt. meal. Serve it on a biscuit, or a slice of bread to utilze all the gravy, it couldn't be quicker.Can offers a bit more product; the little plastic tub is a light meal, or lunch - perfect size for a small to medium sized grandchild.Glad to see the manufacturer has kept this product's quality up, and kept chemicals out.

I haven't liked a lot of these 7.5 oz micro bowls(most of the chefboyardee) but was pleased with this. There was a good amount of meat & veggies with not to much liquid. A slice of bread & butter & I'm all set. Gave 4 stars because like all of these I've tried the lid is really hard for me to get off. Especially with arthritic hands.
A QUICK TASTY SATISFYING STEW. POP IT OPEN, MICROWAVE 90 SECONDS. SERVE WITHBUTTERED BREAD OR OYSTER OR SALTINE CRACKERS.Dinty Moore Beef Stew, 7.5-Ounce Microwavable Bowls (Pack of 12)

Good portion size (7.5 oz), not too carb-heavy for a diabetic, reasonable nutritional value, just enough to satisfy hunger when paired with a small sandwich for lunch. Good amount of meat, gravy is a little blah but it's canned food, really. Good price bought in bulk online. Glad it comes in this size, would say that it's part of a good cold-day-take-to-work meal.

column4: Zach Hammel-Shaver "The Man With The Plan"
column10: I recently bought over $100 dollars of 6 different kinds of Licorice. And let me tell you this is the best. Although I wish it had the nutritional fact/ingredients.

column9: my dog did not like it
column10: Product is good I belive but my dog is very picky and it did nto like it. But firends dogs did like it.

I had purchased this dog jerky from Petsmart and my dog love it.  Then when Petsmart no longer sold it I ordered from Amazon.  Not sure what happened but it with in a few weeks of my purchase it was fuzzy with mold.  I threw both containers out before I had a chance to open them.

While walking in the West Village  searching for a nutritious snack, I came upon raw crunch bars.  The juice bar I strolled into didn't have much of a selection, so I was pleasantly surprised how delicious it was!  I immediately  googled the company and ordered boxes of the different favors.  Athiough goji is my favorite , the medley of seeds and nuts  with just the right amount of sweetness, makes every flavor satisfying.  Even my husband, the carnivore, likes them and so will you.

I was excited to try this after all the good reviews.... but seriously, why is everyone making a big deal about them? I'm not even a picky-eater, but these taste so boring. I rather just eat a handful of seeds and nuts on their own, rather than this weird combination put into a bar.
This is an outstanding bar.  It is hard to find a raw organic "granola bar" and this fits the bill perfectly. Love Them!

column9: Finally a GREAT low sugar, gluten free nutrition bar
column10: With a diabetic family history, a gluten intolerance and recent recovery from Candida,  I have been searching for a delicious nutrition bar that I can eat.I just recently discovered the Raw Crunch Organic Bar at my local coffee shop and was so pleased. It is scrumptious. It has no gluten, very low in sugar, is loaded with protein and nutrients .... and it is organic!  My thanks to the founders of Raw Crunch Bars!  I just ordered a case for my upcoming 7 day trip on the Boundary Waters.
Since the Dollar store does not have these all the time and you waste a lot of gas finding them, this is the way to go .

We were buying these at the dollar stores but all the stores stopped carrying them the last 6 months.  We searched the internet and found them here.  These are a white chocolate and are great to suck on in church. Though the price is for 5 lbs I think that still great.

First off, we all love rice at our house. I also love wild rice and rice pilaf,although the others are not all that big on those dishes.So, when I read the descriptions on this, I thought it sounded really tasty, buthad some real hesitations about buying six packs of the rice. I wondered how we'd actuallymanage to use six bags before it went bad.Well, the bags are not all that huge. Each bag is one pound of rice. I guess I had a hardtime visualizing it, but the bags are fairly small. I don't have one in front of me, but theyare maybe 6" square.Anyway, we made the first bag this weekend, putting it in a crock pot and letting it cookon low for 2 or 3 hours. Hubby is the chef in our house, and he used beef broth with the rice.We had it with some sausage for dinner. Let me say - WOW!This is really tasty rice! Between the four of us, we managed to wipe out the entire poundof rice (yes, it was that good!), and were figuring out what the next meal with the rice would be!Watch your prices on this - they vary widely, even across Amazon.Try to stay under $3 a bag.Seriously, this stuff tastes great! It was tasty, filling and actually easier tochew than I thought it might be (I have troubles with crunchy foods).Thank you Lundberg for a really great blend of rice.  You've converted us!

column9: Delicious and at a great price
column10: These syrups for Sno Cones are delicious. Our family loves them, we had also purchased a pack of the Hawaiian Ice syrups and we prefer these (and they are cheaper). A very good deal. I will be buying more soon.
EXCELLENT PRODUCT, SWEET TASTY AND THE KIDS LOVE THEM....GREAT FOR PARTIES OR ANY HOT SUMMER DAY....ALL OF THE FLAVORS TASTE GREAT...
These syrups are great for slushes. My kids love them and they are great for summer parties. Very good product.

I have ordered Hawaiian Shaved Ice 10 pint pack for $44 and this time around decided to try Great Northern Polar's 10 pint pack for $29 (both have free Super Saver Shipping).  I was pleasantly surprised and happy with my Great Northern purchases upon testing.  The ten flavors all taste very delicious and I prefer the texture of the shaved ice when G N P's syrup is poured on, as opposed to Hawaiian Shaved Ice's.  I'd definitely recommend this less expensive option for snow cone syrup!!
I bought a 10 pack of quart bottles of Great Northern syrups for my Polar Ice Cub shaver and they are so good, we all love it.  Well worth it.
A very easy process with good communication and the product exactly as advertised.  I particularly appreciate the packing - very secure.
Worth every penny, a little goes a long way.  Ordered these and many snowcones later, still have plenty.  The taste is awesome, and the thicker syrup covers the ice great.
I bought a 10 pack of this snow cone syrup for my grandchildren & they just love it. The taste is great & it's nice having it already to go, no mixing. I would/will be buying from them again.

I had recently bought an Hawaiian Ice Machine from Great Northern which we love.  The kids loved the flavors and the added cones and straws are an added bonus.  A little pricey but delivered to your door and ready to go.
this product is the best in usa , We bought this for our grown-up snow cones. Absolutely yummy. Pour spouts are easy to use Flavours are delicious

I bought a ton of this stuff, not realizing that it is 1960's style FREEZE DRIED crystals. It was so awful, it actually upset my stomache and I am just going to heave the rest into the garbage where it belongs. Make sure you understand what it is you are buying. Spend a little more and get something you can enjoy!

column9: Just mediocre instant coffee in a K-cup.
column10: This is just plain ordinary instant coffee in a K-cup.No micro-ground fresh flavor. No micro-ground heartyness.Just regular old plain Freeze dried instant coffee. As much as they make it sound like its going to taste like Starbucks high quality VIA, it is NOT.Just freeze dried instant coffee.Very plain run-of- the-mill instant coffee.

Not being an eater of conventional meat products, this was a nice treat for me now that I live outside of the access boundaries of obtaining grass fed meat products. I cooked in a very hot skillet sprinkled with sea salt. This method seals the meat and  locks in the juices. Just Yummy!

If you've had Millstone chocolate velvet before, youalready know how good it is..This was just as good asthe bigger bags, though I'd get the bigger bag next time forconvenience. Smooth, excellent chocolate smell, nice finish..highly recommended.
Finally a coffee that really has the taste of chocolate. This is so good that I recommend it to anyone who likes chocolate in their morning coffee.

I looked forward to trying this; the combination of coffee and chocolate seemed unbeatable, BUT the contents were artificially flavored and nauseating; I couldm't make it through a small cup.  UGH!!  What a waste!!!

column9: S U P E R B !
column10: I was a little concerned when Folgers bought Millstone a few years back.  Kind of thought of Folgers as the American Motors of coffee. You know... the Gremlin and Pacer? Anyhoo, Smuckers bought the whole kit 'n' kaboodle [2008] and quality was kicked up more than a few notches company-wide.  Even Folgers familiar off-the-shelf red jug is now drinkable.  Thanks, Smuckers!I've purchased both the regular packages and the 1.75 ounce packages of Millstone... the latter were on sale for about $10 bucks recently. (Watch for Amazon to put it on sale, which happens from time-to-time!) I like the convenience of being able to take the small packages to work, and they're a nice litte "thank-you" gift for friends, neighbors, co-workers, etc.I think this is THE best chocolate flavored coffee I've had, bar NONE.  And I've tried many... Gevalia; Berres Brothers; Camerons; Caribou; a couple of local coffee house blends; and three or four "boutique" brands - the kind you often find at places like T J Maxx, The World Market, and so on.  The Millstone is SMOOTH, MELLOW, AROMATIC, and the CHOCOLATE comes through perfectly.This is truly one of my favorite flavored brews.  It'll be one of yours, too!
bakes these for my family this morning. we threw them away they were so horrible. we decided they tasted like cardboard.

column9: Healthy ingredients and my kitten loves it!
column10: My 9 month old kitten is a very picky eater. I decided to switch from a regular cat food, to a healthier brand with more meat and pure ingredients. I was skeptical buying a 2.5 pound bag since I often end up throwing away food because my cat refuses to eat it, but he actually ate Wellness Kitten food right out of the bag as I was pouring it. My cat and I are very pleased with this food.

column9: Most delicious milk alternative! (But look for the best price.)
column10: This is not only the most delicious coconut drink on the market but also the most delicious and addictive of any milk alternative.  The "original" flavour is just the right level of sweetness -- and it is far tastier than the "unsweetened" and "vanilla" options.  This product is a treat to have in cereal or to drink on its own.BUT (double-underlined!) you should NOT be paying $4.00/carton for Coconut Dream.  Even at my over-priced local grocery store, this product sells for $3.59.  So unless it's worth it to you to pay a premium to have 12 cartons delivered to your home all at once, I would suggest looking elsewhere.I hope that other companies will begin to ship Coconut Dream through Amazon, thereby making the price more competitive.
Tried them all - this tastes the best - got the Chefs Best Award - and it lives up to that. Great for drinking by the glass or even in recipes.
I absolutely love this product. I am the only one who drinks it at my house and I have to reorder every couple of weeks.

This flour is outstanding. Very fresh, delicious flavor. As the other review noted, it's finely and evenly milled so the texture of breads is much more refined than with normal whole wheat flour. I just topped a cassoulet with some drop biscuits made with half unbleached white flour and half this whole wheat pastry flour--the "is that whole grain again" factor never arose. Using 100% whole wheat is also great in banana bread and other uses. The half and half biscuits were as light as usual and much tastier. I will buy this again, and again and again. Note--whole wheat flour can go rancid quickly and 25 lbs is a lot for most homes, so I freeze what I'm not going to use in a couple of weeks in tightly sealed 1 or 2-gallon ziplock bags.

This is my favorite whole wheat pastry flour.  It has a very fine texture & it doesn't have big pieces of bran like some brands I've tried.  I use it 100% in pancakes & they turn out light & fluffy.  I also use it as about 50% (regular white flour for the remaining 50%) of the flour in biscuits.  We like really fluffy biscuits, so that's why I only use half.  Works great in cookies too.  This is for non-yeast baking & works much better than w.w. bread flour in cookies, pancakes, etc.

column9: The best price for the best flour
column10: We are almost running out of our second bag of this delicious flour and are subscribed to get a fresh package every other month. Quality is awesome to bake all kinds of cookies, pound cakes, brownies, pancakes, pies and we even made pizza from it. It's soft and easy to manage.But the best part is that it comes packaged without plastic (palstic-free)!!! I was so impressed with that - it's packaged in brown paper bag and "sealed" or threaded with thick cotton thread (the way they did cloth sacks with grains in olde days).So even if there is a cheaper organic pastry flour, I will stick to this one just because of awesome environmental packaging!

As a professional baker, nothing is worse than running out of pastry flour unexpectantly before a big order.  I initially turned to Amazon because I have a Prime membership and was hoping to find a "quick fix" to my problem.  Boy did this flour make me rethink things!  I have been using whole wheat pastry flour for years, but this is the softest, whitest, and finest milled whole wheat pastry flour I have ever worked with!  I will absolutely be getting in contact with Great River directly about bulk shipping options for the future!  Thank you for offering such a quality product!

We substitute this for some of the regular whole wheat flour for pancakes and some of the "finer" baked goods and it works wonderfully.  I ordered it on Amazon and it showed up quickly.  I have signed up with the saver / replenish program.
Who knew that one could buy a whole wheat pastry flour for a reasonable price. I love this flour and have used it for many applications.

Vegan. Organic. Kosher. Very high quality. My maternal grandfather was a baker/pastry chef. My mother worked in his business and then carried the family traditions and expertise into our home. Prepared a large batch of a family 'favorite' [vegan-style] today which requires a large quantity of pastry flour. Very pleased with the results using the Great River flour. Beautiful whole wheat. Very economical, especially with Subscribe & Save. Highly recommended. This review is out there for those for whom it makes a difference. See all of my reviews and the vegancompassion Profile for more great choices. Check out "Vegan Grocery Favorites" and "Vegan Grocery Top Ten" & all the other helpful "Vegan Grocery" Listmania. Your input counts and will be greatly appreciated to benefit the search of others. Thank you. *** SUBSCRIBE & SAVE ***

column9: Great substitute for all purpose flour!
column10: I have been using this flour for almost a year and absolutely love it! We use it to make waffles, pancakes, cakes, cookies, etc. It doesn't have the heavy feel that most whole wheat flours have. My baked goods always come out light and yummy. You can't beat the price either! I portion the flour into 4-5lb bags and store it in my deep freezer to keep it from going rancid.

This flour is so good, I use it for literally everything. It is very finely ground so it can substitute white flour completely. I even make crepes with it. It has a very nice flavor, not overpowering like some other whole wheat flours I used in the past.Even my mother-in-law was impressed and she is a very experienced cook. She made fabulous apple pie crust with it. Very nice, very nutty flavor! Buy it, it seems to be excellent value for the money as well! Especially if you subscribe.
I have got this bag several days ago and tried it several times to do whole wheat crapes and pancakes. I should say that this flour is very fresh and has great quality.

column9: Perfect pastry flour and perfect price!!!
column10: I prefer organics for my family's staples. I bake all our baked products. First thing I did was bake a cake when my flour came and wow, nice flour. This is so much better than anything from our local store, which does not carry organics.Its fluffy and light and makes a soft poofy cake. :DI'm happy and am using subscribe and save since this company is now my only source for all my flour needs. :DBest part is its in bulk and delivered to my door. We are rural and cant even find a source for bulk flour of any kind. So this is a major win for our family.

This flour is light and fluffy, just like you'd want your whole grains to be in pancakes, cakes, etc.  I am VERY happy with it, and look forward to continuing to use it in my kitchen.  I ordered this item, the whole wheat bread flour, and the organic cornmeal, all from Great River.  The two flours are replacing my King Arthur White Whole wheat that I used to buy so much of at my local grocery.  The flavor of these flours is definitely superior to the KA (which I also liked).  But now, I know I am feeding my family organic.

I'm no expert baker, but I've had great success using this in a variety of baked goods. It makes them a little lighter than the bread or regular unbleached flour options provided by this company. I've purchased two or three of these so far and plan to continue.

This bag of Great River Organic Milling Whole Wheat Pastry Flour was short 1 pound.I have two scales and both displayed "24" pounds for the weight.Now, surely, most of you would agree that is you pay for 25 pounds, you should get a full 25 pounds.Domino Sugar had a problem one time and they sent coupons for sugar to compensate for the weight shortage.One can only hope this company is not shorting all it's customers.Hopefully they will get their scales calibrated!Until then, be aware and WEIGH your bags.

column9: The flour is too fine for making Indian Roti
column10: While the flour is good, it is just too fine for making Indian Rotis/Chappatis. Probably has to do with the fact that it is pastry flour. The Rotis/Chappatis made with this flour turns out a bit chewy. And the cold Rotis/Chappatis turn very tough to chew. For Rotis/Chappatis, you need a slightly more granular flour.

I was lucky to be given a sample of this matcha by a friend. Its very good - so good it is now sitting in my cart ready for purchase later this evening as I have more looking around to do.It tastes like fresh oranges! I can't stop thinking about it ever since I sampled it about a week ago it has been on my mind!Really good mixed with peach although I prefer the orange over the peach as a stand alone matcha - very good combined - like a fuzzy navel! :)

column9: likeable for even a non-orange fan
column10: If you were to give me an orange, it had better be a blood orange. I can tolerate orange juice every so often, and other than that, I don't care for orange candies. I'll eat them, but they'll be last.This matcha does not apply to these usual feelings of mine. This is an orange flavor I can stand. It's somewhere between a fresh orange and an orange candy. I can drink it no problem...especially because it mixes with other flavors so well.If you're adventurous, this one is a beauty with cola matcha. This is a fantastic addition to a smoothie, especially if you just need a little citrus tanginess to it. It's almost like being able to add a touch of orange juice but without adding more sugar and instead adding a little bit of a different dimension of flavor to your smoothie.Of course, if you dig orange flavors, this is probably a winner no matter what.

My Matcha journey continues with Red Leaf Tea"s Orange Matcha. Orange is one of my favorite fruit flavors. If you are a fan of the flavor orange as well, I highly recommend that you treat yourself. Perhaps even if orange isn't on your top 5 favorite flavors list, you may want to travel outside your flavor "comfort zone" and give this one a try. It certainly does not disappoint! The aroma is intoxicating and the flavor is straight up orangey goodness! I prefer this one cold but that may just be because it has been so hot lately. I prepare it according to directions, add a wee bit of simple syrup and chill. It is a refreshing citrus energy drink that is loaded with flavor and all the benefits of Matcha tea. I can not say enough about the energy drinking a cup of this tea provides. A great way to start your day or an excellent midday pick me up!So many ways to incorporate this magic matcha into your day. Perhaps add to your orange cranberry muffin or scone recipe. One of my favorites so far has been to add a teaspoon of my orange matcha, a scoop of vanilla low fat frozen yogurt, a splash of low fat milk and a quick mix in the blender = a yummy wonderful dessert-like creamsicle flavored smoothie!

column9: Orange you glad I didn't say banana?
column10: This blend is one I worry about, which is why it jumped in and out of the cart so many times when the new matchas were first released. I love oranges, but I'm very specific about. If it doesn't taste like fresh oranges, then why bother? For years, until just recently, in fact, I thought orange candies, like orange Skittles or Runts, were put in because they were cheaper to produce because nobody really liked them. Everybody knows that grape and strawberry are the good flavors, right? Wrong. This is what comes from a skewed worldview, folks. But it works out beautifully, because I love the strawberry and grape flavors of the world, and my wife loves the orange, lime, and lemons. So what that long story was winding up to was that if this matcha tastes more like candy orange and not fresh orange, I will be very, very sad. And then I'll mix it with the French Vanilla and everything will be just fine. And, of course, cranberry is one I must try mixed with the orange at some point. I also have a history of citrus matcha not turning out as good as I'd like (I'm looking at you, Lemon and Peach), but there  is a history of my being afraid of blends and having them turn out amazing (That's Watermelon and Earl Grey) as well. So I'm just trying to keep an open mind!I'm sitting here with three little cups of matcha to try (Orange, Apple, and Brandy) and I reached for Orange first. I took a sip, chuckled, and handed it to my wife. She doesn't like matcha, but she likes this one! I knew she would because that first sip is tasty, tasty orange candy. It's incredibly tasty (as you might have guessed) but it isn't really fresh orange or orange juice. It's orange Runts and juicy orange Skittles. Yum. My wife likes it, so I think this might become a morning treat for her, but for me...well, I don't know! But if I want oranges in the morning, I'll likely reach for orange juice proper. I have cotton candy matcha, also from Red Leaf Teas, what other matchas do I need? Still, I keep reaching for it as I sit here writing, so maybe it'll grow on me. It is very good, and if you're a fan of orange candy, this is one you must try. Not a touch of bitterness, though!

The lid to this tea box detached after about 2 weeks of use.  The screws to keep the lid on are too short and stripped the pressed board the product is made out of.  So basically after opening and closing the box 1-2x per day it is ruined and there is no way to fix it.  I do NOT recommend this product.  Very disappointed.  Don't waste your money.

If you are buying this for the box, Don't! It is plastic feeling and poor quality. Ours had paint drips. Also, it is NOT returnable if you are not satisfied. I didn't see that printed anywhere until we checked on returning the item. I wouldn't recommend it even if it is on sale.
I got one of these 5-6 years ago as a gift and have wanted to give this same thing to my sister.  She has admired mine many times.  I finally did, and she loves it just as much as I do.

column9: Looks are average but but not my cup of tea
column10: Received this as a gift and I was thrilled because I've been eyeing the Bentely's Finest Elegant Wooden Tea Chest for a couple years.  The box is smaller than I'd expected, especially since it houses 120 tea bags, but the footprint is smaller, and that's a good thing for a small home.  Each stack is 10 teabags. The tea chest is a very dark, non-wood appearing not too heavy box with solid feet and cheap looking shiny brass colored metal hardware.  The interior contains red felt separators which can be removed if you want to use this for larger tea bags or something else after the tea is consumed.  Since it appears that this was marketed as a presentation box for Bentley teas, I'd give it a solid 3 star at the half price cost, would have given it a 4 if it did not have the bright gold Bentley ad on the inside of the lid.  If you actually use the chest to present the teas to guests, it's rather tacky in appearance.  The teas are far from the best I've drunk, but I have found that they are very nice for brewing iced tea.  The bags are made of bleached white paper, sealed at the edges, have a white string and small paper hang tag attached at one pressed seam.  Each bag is enveloped by a brightly colored lightweight paper.  There is not much tea powder residual found inside the paper, so the tea is contained well.  The teas are all black with assorted flavorings or the single green tea option without additional flavoring.  It's absolutely an average product.

column9: A very nice item, though damaged
column10: These tea chests were half off when I ordered them.  We drink a lot of tea and the chest seemed like it could be useful for storing things, so...I ordered.  The chest has a big ding on one corner which mars the look of it.  Otherwise it's fine and the tea is quite good.  There is a good variety of flavors in the box.
These cookies are our dogs favorite treats - peanut butter especially.  Also happy to hear that 10% of profits go towards charities!
I am a diabetic and this stuff is GREAT.  Tastes wonderful and doesn't raise my blood sugar.  Since it has no caffeine, I can drink it any time.  LOVE it!
This is far more chocolate than coffee and that is yummy to me.  Impossible to find in stores any more.  Delivery service from Amazon was efficient.

I am a Pre-Op Bariatric patient and have been trying different protein drinks to get ready for my post -op liquid diet.  After surgery I can't have sugar OR caffeine so this is a perfect fit.  I found this at my local Walmart and decided to give it a try.  YUMMY!!!!!!!!!  I mix two teaspoons in with my protein powder and unsweetened almond milk and have a delicious, chocolately shake for breakfast in the morning (and sometimes dinner).  I'm so glad that I found this here as I can tell that it is a popular item at Walmart.  The one I bought was hidden waaaayyy back on the shelf so I wouldn't have seen it if I hadn't looked. PLEASE keep this one around!
There are so few products for those of us who can't have caffeine OR sugar. This is the best! It tastes indugent and delicious and I don't feel I'm compromising on the flavor one little bit!

I have loved drinking this coffee for years.  Recently it had become impossible to find it in grocery and discount stores.  I thought that Maxwell House had discontinued making it.  I got "on line" to the manufacture and they recommended amazon.com.  I was successful in finding it and placed an order.  I had 4 cans delivered to my home in a oouple of days.  The cost was about the same that I had paid at the grocery store and the shipping was free.  I'm thrilled to have my favorite coffee again!!!!!

column9: Don't Want to Live Without It
column10: I absolutely love this product (to many words in the name to spell out) * I love chocolate * I have loved coffee since I was 5 years old and drank from my parents cups when they left the room * I try to watch my calories with reduced or no sugar products * I RARELY drink caffeine and go out of my way to choose decaffeinated productsIt's a perfect fit, a great taste and always feels like a special treatI have been buying this product for years (maybe even a couple of decades) and it is getting harder and harder to find in stores.  Recently, I did extensive research to find who sells this and at the best price.  Amazon's auto ship is definitely the best price out there.  The auto delivery makes it easy and I don't have to think about it.  The auto delivery is also flexible as I can change my delivery preferences any time I want (number per shipment, how often, etc).  I already think I'm going to have to move my next shipment up because I drink it at least once a day.I have also checked store shelves and the internet over the years and have never found ANY product that had all of the features that I want (see bullets above).  The combination of sugar free and decaffeinated are hard to find in any beverage type.I strongly recommend this product to people wanting this combination of product features and, if not, I encourage you to look at Amazon's other choices within the I.F/Maxwell house line.  I have tried many of them over the years and I'm sure you will find one you like (and at the best price).Bon Appetit

column9: Another pantry staple in our household
column10: Along with the French Vanilla variety of this sugar-free, caffeine free product, this is one of the items our household can't do without......(along with peanut butter and graham crackers!).  It is a satisfying and delicious substitute for the hot cocoa we both love and can't have.  When we moved West, we discovered the local super markets in our small town don't carry the sugar-free, caffeine free variety of this product, so we gratefully turned to Amazon!  Thank you Amazon!

My husband can't drink coffee or decaf so he drinks this every morning.  It is very convenient for me to buy it via Amazon as I can buy a large quantity in one shot.  I think the price is about the same as grocery stores, but most stores in our area don't carry it so this is the way to go for me.  Saves me time from running from place to place looking for it.

This product has an oily consistency.  Perhaps they were going for creamy, but it winds up tasting like it came out of a Star Trek food synthesizer, and I mean the old 1970's series, not any Next Generation tech.  And I'm still not quite sure if heating up those artificial sweeteners is a good idea.

column9: Maxwell House International Coffee Decaf Sugar Free Suisse Mocha Cafe, 4-Ounce Cans (Pack of 4)
column10: Tasted great for sugar free. I like adding a spoonful to my regular coffee to make it taste a little chocolatey. Wish I could find it in the stores.

This chicken spread is not as salty as the Underwood Deviled Ham Spread. However, it's still saltier than it needs to be and if you're on any sodium restrictions, this is not the product for you. Otherwise, it tastes good and it's inexpensive. Great to have in your pantry for when you don't feel like going out and want a quick bite.

column9: Delicious and best with French Baguette
column10: Tasty canned chicken spread.Especially for eating with French Baguette.Saving time and money for cooking and restaurants. Will order again in future.

column9: For a quick snack or light meal
column10: So handy to have around to spread on crackers before bedtime with milk or for a sammy with soup for a light meal when you just don't feel like cooking. Good to tuck in those hunters' and fishermen's gear too, and to tide you over on road trips to hold out for a nice big meal later on. No refrigeration needed and the price is right!

While it's still good for a quick snack by just spreading it on hot toast, it has  become a little saltier than before. It's useful as a base for quick chicken salad, but if you're on a low sodium diet, you better look elsewhere.

Cardamom-an ancient spice native to India-is also an integral component of "garam masala" used to spice curried dishes. Originally Vikings brought the pods and seeds back to Sweden, later Germans used them in cookies. Large black, white and green pods are used in a variety of dishes. Here is the recipe using Lipton tea bags1 1/2 cups whole or fat-free milk2 Lipton tea bags3 teaspoons sugar4 green cardamom pods, cut in half2 sticks cinnamon, broken into pieces4 whole cloves2 (1-inch pieces) crystallized ginger, chopped2 teaspoons four peppercorn blend1. Place the milk, tea, sugar, cardamom, cinnamon, cloves,ginger and peppercorns in a 2-quart saucepan.2. Heat over medium heat until steaming.3. Strain into two tea cups and serve hot.Hint: For weaker tea use decaffeinated tea bags.Makes 2 cups tea.~The Rebecca Review

column9: Claim victory in taste and nutrition!
column10: I am a college freshman and have become particularly concerned with my nutritional habits over the past couple of years because my father is on the verge of becoming diabetic.  In hopes of avoiding gaining the "freshman fifteen" this year and in maintaining my dietary goals, I've stocked up on Swiss Miss Diet Hot Cocoa Mix.  It provides me with the sweet fix I need when I'm craving chocolate and don't want to calorie splurge.I used to be a Starbucks junkie, and before my dietary turnaround, I downed my grande (16 ounce) Starbucks Signature Hot chocolate as if it was water.  When I became aware that my formerly innocent, non-fat, no-whip, winter refreshment still had 410 calories and 42 grams of sugar in it, I began my search for a better alternative.  In discovering Swiss Miss Diet Hot Cocoa Mix, now I am able to get an even greater satisfaction with the 25-calorie miracle packet that transforms plain water into my favorite treat.Without the addition of milk, it is essential to add a large spoonful of Splenda to reach optimal taste.  When I first tried the mix without artificial sweeteners and mixed with only water, I was very disappointed at how bland the flavor was.  However, now, with a heap of Splenda, a Swiss Miss Diet Hot Cocoa Mix packet, and a mug of steaming water, I claim victory in taste and nutrition.I began buying Swiss Miss Diet Hot Cocoa when I found it at my local grocery store, Pavilions.  It would cost around $5.25 a box, and with six packets in each box, around 88 cents per packet.  At Amazon.com, I am able to purchase the mix in bulk and in purchasing a case of six boxes, each packet costs me 31 cents, saving me 57 cents per packet.Some reviewers have claimed that the hot cocoa clumps up in mixing it with water.  This has occurred to me several times when my water was too hot.  Avoid boiling hot water, and stir as you pour the water into the mug with the hot cocoa mix and Splenda already in it, and you should no longer encounter this problem.I have experimented in using sugar-free chocolate syrups to make hot cocoa instead of using a mix and have been highly disappointed with the results. The syrup does not mix as well, and the texture of the hot cocoa is too thin, especially if just mixing the syrup in water.After a long day of studying in the library and a snowy trek back to my dorm, a mug of Swiss Miss Diet Hot Cocoa with a heap of Splenda and a spritz of cinnamon is my always highly anticipated reward.

column9: How much better does it have to be?
column10: This is one of my new best friends.  On Weight Watchers, it is 0, as in zero, points.  It is 20 calories.  It has a satisfying chocolate flavor.  It does clump a bit and takes an extra stir or two, but I think this is an amazing way to have a hot drink and a little chocolate fix.With also perhaps a dollop of fat-free whipped cream,or a tbsp of skim milk added, you will feel you had a sweet treat.  Note that this variety is called "Diet"--it is not the same product as merely low-fat or sugar-free.

column9: Hard to find in the local store
column10: This cocoa is so good! It is also the one that has none of the ingredients that are on our list of "no nos" (due to a restrictive diet). But we had trouble finding it in our local store. We found it here and for a great price. Thank you Amazon!

Swiss Miss Diet is a terrific little 25 calorie treat (or in my case, 50 calories since I use a 16 oz mug) when you just need to have something chocolatey but don't want to spend the calories on some actual chocolate.  For those who complained about the way it dissolves, after adding the powder to your cup, pour in about one quarter cup of boiling water and stir briskly until all the clumps are dissolved.  Then pour in the rest of the water.  I also like to add some of the mix to my coffee for a nice change of pace.  All in all, a very tasty drink.

I love this product.  I currently get it automatically monthly.  But suddenly the price has more than doubled for the same thing.  I realize this is from another company but I can get this cheaper in the local grocery stores. I am really disappointed.  This is my favorite not so guilty pleasure.  I am a lifetime Weight Watcher and have been using this for years to stay on plan. I hope Amazon can get a different supplier and reduce the price.Update: The price is back down!! Yea! I now would give 5 stars.  I love this stuff.  As for being hard to dissolve, yes, but if you add a little water at first and stir well, then add gradually it is fine.

Let's get real.  This is not equal to a world class hot chocolate made with Valrhona or Scharffen Berger chocolate in whole milk with a little cream added and real sugar.  But then when did 25 calories ever taste as good as lets say 300 or more calories.  For only 25 calories it is excellent.  You will have to search for a long time for a better low calorie snack that also helps with your chocolate cravings.  If you find that other snack, please let me know.  Some have commented on it being to sweet.  I have found if you let it cool to very warm, but not hot, the artificial sweetener taste is not as strong and it taste more like chocolate (just my opinion).  Remember, it is what it is, but I think for what it is, it is worth 5 stars.

I use this product along with Hills Bros sugar free cappuccino mix, International Coffee sugar free Swiss Mocha coffee, and sugar free hazelnut Coffee Mate to make a great cappuccino in the evenings.  I love it!
I started using Swiss Miss Diet a few months ago and love it for on;y 25 calories. The price on Amazon far exceeds any grocery store in my area.

column9: Better than the Sugar Free Nesquik
column10: I love to have a mocha coffee in the morning, which I fix with microwaved skim milk, a teaspoon of instant coffee and cocoa mix.  But, I desperately need to lose weight and did not want to have to give this up.  I tried the Sugar Free Nesquik, and it seemed, as is often the case with artficially sweetened things, to be WAY too sweet, plus, when reading the ingredients, I found that it had hydrogenated ingredients in it.  As that can clog arteries, it concerned me.  I tried this, and it IS frustratingly hard to get it to desolve, but it tastes great, and does not have the hydrogenated ingredients in it.  So, I will be using this. I just wish it came in larger containers, so it would be less expensive.  Only plus to the packets, is that then I only use a set amount.

I really love chocolate but have been trying to watch my weight and sugar intake lately.  First I tried the no sugar 60 calorie Swiss Miss and it was delicious, so...I thought why not try the diet Swiss Miss???  Well with only 25 little lovely calories this 6 0z. of chocolaty warm heavenly beverage definitely satisfies my chocoholic cravings with no guilt!  Delic!  Love it!  I highly recommend trying it if you are a chocolate lover and you are watching your weight.  Of course it's not like eating a Dove bar or Lindt Chocolate but if you keep it in check, than you realize wow for what it is, it's pretty darn good!

column4: Jolly Green Giant "You can try Birchbox too! ...
column10: This has been a regular in my house during the winter and occasionally at breakfast. The flavor is very good (don't add too much water). I add a splash of cream and a pump of sugar free vanilla syrup to make it even better. Sometimes I even add a little cinnamon or sugar free whipped cream. This is one of my favorite treats since I'm a low carber.

column9: I wish I had found it sooner!
column10: I can't believe how great this is!  When I saw 25 calories I expected it to taste like cardboard, but WOW, it is really good!  I use my 16 oz mug and two packets and even add one big marshmallow and it is still a total of 75 calories.  Absolutely wonderful!

column9: Wonderful stuff, & easy to get rid of the clumps
column10: This is such a great product.  Yes, it's a little harder to dissolve than the fat-free kind. Here's what I do:  While I'm waiting for the water to boil, I put a couple of tablespoons of water (room temp is okay) into the cup with the powder. Stir it with a tiny whisk or a fork until it's totally dissolved, 30 sec or less. Voila! When you add the boiling water, there are no lumps at all. Perfectamundo.

column9: Hot Cocoa for a long time
column10: Swiss Miss Hot Cocoa  (diet) is a staple in our house and now we have plenty of it  with our every month plan.  We love it,  Can invite the whole neighborhood in for a cup of cocoa.

I've tried this and tried the similar product by Nestle, and this one just doesn't dissolve well, it leaves big lumpy clumps along the inside of the cup as you drink it, and too much sediment in the bottom. I was pretty sad I ordered this and happy to go back to the Nestle version, which I drink every day.

column9: Great for sweet tooth without the guilt
column10: Product mixes well with boiling water and satifies the craving for something sweet.  No guilt just pleasure at any time.

This Swiss Miss product has only 25 calories and most importantly no "modified milk ingredients" which is a filler product known to cause severe allergic reactions.  Most of the lower calorie products contain modified milk ingredients, the more expensive or 'organic' hot chocolates do not; but then they are very high calorie.  Swiss Miss is the perfect trade off.Mix it with coffee for a mocha!  To prevent clumping, try blending a small amount of hot liquid into the chocolate, stir until smooth then add the remaining hot water/coffee/milk.
If you are used to diet products this is good. However, there is very little flavor. I usually add some spearmint extract in it and it gives it some nice flavor.

I am a true chocoholic so I was hesitant to order this very low calorie cocoa mix. But I am so glad I did so. I was so very pleasantly surprised with the rich chocolate taste and I really feel like I am having an indulgent treat when I sip this wonderful cocoa. I just ordered 12 more boxes! PS: Don't be surprised when you open the box and it appears to be half full, the epitome of over-packaging, but I guess folks wouldn't buy a tiny box into which the eight packages would fit. (I have never seen this product in stores, btw)

column9: A wonderful pleasure in pushing for a healthy life
column10: I don't usually review products but I must for Diet Swiss Miss Cocoa because it has been a miracle to me!  I choose not to eat or drink more than a few grams of sugar at a time as I have made a lifestyle change to loose weight and be healthy.  When comparing the nutrition facts of other cocoa mixes it becomes apparent why the United States has such problems with obesity and other health issues.  One packet of mix can easily contain over 140 calories and 25 grams of sugar and often more than just one serving is consumed at a time.  This is astounding for something as simple as hot cocoa.  In my searching I have tried many different brands and types of cocoa; Nestle, grocery store generic, fat free, no sugar added, etc.  Diet Swiss Miss is the best when you want taste and decent nutrition.  It has a much smoother flavor than all the rest and also has the least amount of calories and sugar I have found (25 calories, 0 grams fat, 160 mg sodium, 4 grams total carbohydrate with 1 gram fiber and 2 grams sugar, 2 grams protein, 30% calcium, 6% iron, and 25% Vitamin D).  However, don't expect to love it right after drinking a cup of Ghirardelli double chocolate cocoa or the like.  This is not the decadent, indulgent stuff with the rich calorie and sugar price tag.  I personally choose to add a couple drops of EZ Sweetz liquid sucralose sweetener which has less fillers (carbohydrates) than the powder variety of Splenda and also packs an unimaginable bang per drop.  More sweetness is gained by doing this without adding calories or grams of sugar.  All in all this is an amazing product perfect for diabetics and those working to change their lifestyle without having to give up some of the little pleasures like a warm glass of cocoa.  One last note, Diet Swiss Miss is very hard to find in the grocery store.  Every time I go shopping I make it a habit to check the cocoa stock and prices.  If even available the cost can easily be over $4.00 a box in the Seattle area where I live.  Amazon.com offers this product at a great price.  I recommend you stock up not only so you save time and hassle in reordering but so you can also qualify for free shipping.  The only other place I have found this at a better price (and it was only one time) was at a Super Wal-Mart where I bought the entire stock on hand.  Best wishes in healthy living while you enjoy your hot cocoa.

For 25 calories, this isn't a bad treat.  I was pleasantly surprised at how good the flavor was.  The major drawback with this is that it is difficult to get it to dissolve into hot water...takes some work mushing the lumps on the side of the cup, but it's worth it.  This is really good with some nice cinnamon added.

I have been receiving this product on a subscription basis for sometime now and it is a really good deal.  6 boxes of hot chococate mix for around $15 (which includes shipping) which is so much cheaper than the store (plus I don't have to go to the store to get it).  This last time there was a screw-up with sending 2 shipments but they credited me for one and let me keep it anyway because it was food.  So all in all I have had a good experience with Amazon concerning getting this product.

I purchased this product to make a Hungry Girl recipe for hot chocolate. The recipe called for 2 packets of Diet Swiss Miss Hot Chocolate packets. I couldn't find them in the store, so I bought them on Amazon. All I could find in the store was Swiss Miss Sensible Sweets No Sugar Added. So I had purchased a box of that in the store.When I received my "Diet" Hot Chocolate in the mail, I looked at the nutritional facts AND the size of the packets inside and compared them to the "no sugar added" ones I purchased in the store. It turns out that using 2 packets of the "Diet" hot chocolate was not much different than using the 1 packet of the "No Sugar Added" hot chocolate.The "Diet" hot chocolate packets have about 1/2 the amount of hot chocolate in them! That is how they are only 25 calories and the "no sugar added" is 60 calories. It actually is cheaper for me to make my recipe by using the "no sugar added" that I can buy in the store.I am following Weight Watchers, so my main concern is that my special hot chocolate drink is low in points...and using 1 packet of "no sugar added" hot chocolate instead of 2 packets of "diet" hot chocolate didn't change the points value for me AND it will go twice as far because I only have to use one packet!I'll have to say...that if I was just making a glass of hot chocolate, that the convenience of the smaller "Diet" packet is nice (you don't have to use half a packet and save it for later, like you would with the "no sugar added")The taste is great and it only has 25 calories. I gave it a 3 star because I was disappointed that I was spending twice as much to make my recipe than I had to...because of my discovery that the packets of chocolate are 1/2 the size than the one I bought in the store :-)

like all other diet powdered chocolate, it doesn't dissolve well, even in the hottest water.  You have to smash some of it against the side of the cup to get it to dissolve.  I use it in my coffee... mmmmmmmmm yum

I have a problem with the diet swiss miss hot chocolate. I eat a box or 2 of them daily-- I seriously need to cut back. However, they are only 25 calories each packet, good calcium and even some fiber and protein.And, of course, chocolate!They go well in recipes and just as a drink. I HIGHLY recommend these-- they are very, very delicious.Nestle's similar product, their fat free hot chocolate, is NOT as good.This may be a bit more "clumpy", but they taste SO much richer and more satisfying.

When I'm in the mood for something a little special and desert is totally out of the question, Swiss Miss Diet Hot Cocoa Mix is just what I need to fill me up, satisfy my sweet tooth and make me feel that I've indulged myself somewhat.When I add the hot water into my cup, the Swiss Miss is already in it, along with a teaspoon of instant coffee. As I add the water, I stir it up and it blends well enough to convince me I'm having one of those overpriced coffee bar drinks.Swiss Miss is good stuff, and it also gives you a little boost of calcium.
Those are very good for satisfying late night sugar cravings without the guilt. will order more when i finish this pack for sure

column9: Enjoy some self-indulgence without feeling guilty!
column10: If you are on a diet or a diabetic you have to watch your calories, carbohydrates and sugars.  It really makes it bad when you have to give up some of your favorite things like sipping on a hot cup of hot cocoa while watching your favorite TV show or reading a good book.My wife brought some of this and it is pretty good.  You get a rich chocolate taste and you don't get a lot of calories and sugar.  This drink only has 25 calories, no fat, 2 sugars and 4 grams of carbohydrates.  To make the drink you just pour the contents into a cup and stir in 6 ounces of hot (Not boiling water).  Make sure that you stir the drink well to get it all to dissolve.This drink allows you to have a little self-indulgence without paying a big penalty and feeling guilty.  For a lower calorie substitute it does a good job of satisfying your chocolate cravings. We enjoy it once in a while and I recommend it to you.
25calories! And chocolate! I am on weight watchers and this is only one point! I love this for night time treat.

I tried really hard to acquire a taste for coffee but no matter how much chocolate caramel creamer I put in it...just not going to happen.  Yet, I still really wanted a cup of something in the mornings.  Short of just heating up my creamer and drinking it straight I thought I would look for a hot chocolate that didn't provide 50% of my daily caloric intake in one serving.  Way to go Swiss Miss!I took the advice of another reviewer and added sugar substitute (Sweet 'N Low in my case).  I used one packet of sugar substitute to two packets of the hot chocolate mix.  Perfect in my opinion.  Maybe if you did a side-by-side comparison with the regular stuff you might find the diet mix wanting.  I am quite pleased with the diet.  It is very creamy, and there is enough chocolate flavor in this stuff to cure the cravings of any hard-core chocolaholic.

column9: Great taste for my morning coffee at only 25 cal and 4 carbs.
column10: It's a bit hard to tell from the listing, but this price $15.90 is for 48 envelopes in all (6 boxes of 8 each). The taste gives me the sweet chocolate for just 25 calories/envelope. No fat and no added sugar (the 4grams of carb come from skim milk powder). I'm very pleased with the product quality and the price which is MUCH less than at local grocery stores.

column4: Ethel Jean Saltz "Heard It From Tetragrammaton"
column10: I leave the k-cup in the Keurig and then use this for second cup. Great for diabetic chocoholics. It doesn't dissolve easily but figured out a way to stir and it all works out. Can use the right amount for my taste.

column9: Tasty guilt-free solution to chocolate cravings
column10: This just works for me! A cup of chocolate can be a great stress reducer and an effective way to stay away from a hankering for a Snickers!As for those folks that complain about it being hard to mix this in their cup, I have no problem if I put the powder in, pour in a quarter cup of hot water, stir vigorously for 30 seconds and then fill the cup up with just a couple of stirs needed to make everything ready for enjoyment.It's quite worth it for that little effort!

column9: 25 Calorie Diet Swiss Miss is a hit
column10: Love this stuff. Have bought it multiple times now, and will buy more. Satisfies my sweet tooth after dinner. Does it taste like leaded? Of course not, but you get used to it, and look forward to it.

This was gross. It tasted funny and also would not mix up with the hot water or hot milk. the powder would just stay in chunks, floating on the top. I tried this a couple times, then donated the rest to a food bank. Wont be ordering this again!
I like the Diet Swiss Miss 8-Count Pack of 6. I use it for my low fat cafe mocha every morning before work.

I have been buying this in bulk for over a year! The truth is it's not bad once you add a little "truvia" (0 calories) and some unsweetened almond milk (7 calories)you can no longer tell its diet and it is only 32 calories. At the end of the day after dinner I need a little sweet kick without all the extra calories and this hits the spot. I have one at least 5 nights a week. The liquid fills me up and prevents me from reaching for high calorie desserts. The only things is that it doesn't mix so well if you just whirl a spoon around. I use my cappacino mini-frother. ($ 20 from WIllim and Sonoma) and it gets a better consistency. I set up the Amazon account where they automatically resend it to me every 2 months! It is great price as well!

Iam a diabetic and I been looking for some kind of hot chocolate or cocoa with less sugar. I found this from Swiss Miss. This is diet and with 2g sugar is perfect and taste like Cocoa. It taste good with milk. Many people say it taste bad with water but i think it does taste different but not worst. recommend for people who are diabetics.

column9: Too good to be true (but it is)
column10: I couldn't find it locally, but based on all the good reviews, I went for the 48-serving deal. It's surprisingly good for 25 calories. It even has some worthwhile nutrition. It's not "rich" or "creamy" but it is chocolatey and sweet. I prefer the sugary, milky dark chocolate but can't afford the calories or sugar. I add sub-boiling water gradually as per the instructions and have no trouble getting the powder to disolve.

I was looking for something to flavor my coffee with as creamers dont taste like much when you try to control the serving to one tablespoon. This is a great way to give coffee lots of flavor while keeping the calorie count in check. One its own it can be a bit bland and is definitely not as flavorful as real full calorie hot chocolate. As a diet drink though, it packs plenty of flavor with it's 25 calorie label. Definitely will keep buying.

column9: Yuck!  It won't dissolve in hot water.
column10: If you like drinking watery chocolate with lots of globs of powder in it then buy this stuff.  I can't get it to dissolve.  Time to find a better hot chocolate.
Low calories, low carbs and one point with Weight Watchers plan! Great for chily winter months. Value can't be beat and will tell all my friends.!!

It tastes sweeter than normal Swiss Miss hot chocolate, but that can be said of many diet products where artificial sugar is used. If you use whipped cream and/or cinnamon, then it tastes better. Still, I don't think I'm going to buy this specific product again.

column9: Great sweet tooth fix when on low carb diet!!
column10: This tastes pretty darn good. You do make it with water so it isn't as creamy as i would like.. but c'mon...it has 3 net carbs! When you haven't had anything sweet for weeks this hits the spot! It does take a little more work to dissolve it.. a lot of Stirring.. but I don't care.If you like hot cocoa and are diabetic or low carbing you will love this. I made it for my kids and they could not tell the difference. This helps me stick to my diet and it can help you too!

column9: Tastes great while avoiding a lot of sugar!
column10: I love this mix! Just had some! No problem mixing it if you do it by the process of graduated dilution... put the cocoa in your cup, then pour only part of the premeasured hot water over the cocoa and stir. You should mix it 1 to 1, like mixing flour & water for a good gravy without lumps.  Stir til smoothe, then gradually add the rest of the water little by little, continually stirring. I avoid sugar and 2 grams is not too bad. If you try the totally sugar free brands, they sacrifice taste. I especially like making my own peppermint hot chocolate, better than Starbucks! I buy sugar-free starlight mints, break them up, and put in the cup on top of the cocoa powder before adding the hot water... one mint per packet of cocoa. I break up the mint by hitting with a knife on the granite counter.... mint still in the wrapper of course... works well & only takes a few moments. This peppermint hot chocolate is absolutely delicious! Wish I had sugar free marshmallows lol! Local stores don't have this cocoa, except for Wal-Mart. I ranked it a 4 because it does have sugar. If they leave out the sugar without sacrificing taste, it would be a 5!

column9: Good Taste For Only 25 Calories Per Envelope!
column10: Having a Keurig B60 brewer but finding the K-Cup hot cocoa rather expensive and not having found a K-Cup brand with a good taste I thought I would give the Swiss Miss Hot Cocoa Mix, Diet with Calcium, 8-Count Envelopes (Pack of 6) a try. I was pleasantly surprised when I gave it a try. I used the Keurig on the 6 oz setting and filled my cup with the 6 oz of hot water...poured sometimes 1 envelope and other times 2 envelopes of the Swiss Miss in the cup depending on my wanting a more chocolate taste or not. Stir the cocoa with a whisk to break up the clumps then put the cup back in the Keurig and add another 6 oz of hot water. To me the taste has been better than any K-Cup Cocoa mix I had tried. I love my hot cocoa during these winter evenings and sometimes during those cold winter days.

When looking for low carb items I found Swiss Miss Diet hot cocoa.  When I have a sweet tooth craving or the need to eat when I'm not hungry,I have found this to be a good alternative.  When I drink it, it satisfies my sweet tooth and because it is a hot liquid, it makes me feel full without adding to my waistline.That being said, I will tell you when I made it with just hot water, ugh. Not very tasty.  I have discovered that if replace 25-50% of the hot water with half & half, creamer or milk it make a HUGE difference.  For an extra special treat, I add whipped cream on top!  =)  This is probably not a good choice for those NOT on a low carb diet since the addition of milk and whipped cream will add fat and calories.For a spin on plain hot cocoa, try mixing it with coffee for a low carb mocha without spending a fortune.

It's definitely not as decadent as the full-fat stuff, but its a great alternative.Shipment came rapidly and boxes were in good shape.  The expiration date was a bit too soon (mid next year) in my opinion.
I really like this stuff.  Also, Amazon's price beats the local competition.  If you like hot chocolate and don't like calories you really ought to try it.
For diet, it's not bad. Scratch that, it's just not bad. It does leave a little bit of the powder left over even after I've added hot milk, but it's chocolaty goodness so I can't really complain.
There is no way to top this, just accept. You get your chocolate taste, but don't have to pay the high price calories.

Love this product, I am on automatic delivery but I usually use it before than and have to have it shipped sooner.  I put it in my oatmeal at night for only 25 calories it provides the bigggest chocolate bang and stops that chocolate craving.  I have lost 70 lbs on Weight Watchers and it is products like this one that make that possible.  And because I use automatic delivery, it is cheaper than in the store and NO shipping cost.  Now that is what I call a bargain!

When following a weight loss program, there are times when a little hunger calm is needed, like still being hungry after a controlled meal, or shortly before bedtime. A cup of hot Swiss Miss Diet with calcium satisfies on several levels. The calming to the tummy wards off the hunger and satisfies like a sweet treat and provides a dose of calming calcium. It will put a smile on your face and for 25 small calories, it won't affect your caloric intake negatively. It is rich in flavor and satisfying, whether you just want a tasty hot chocolate, or you need a little hunger calming. We give it an A+.

This product satisfies me without (much) guilt when I crave chocolate.Of course, it is not as tasty as a 400 calories homemade hot cocoa, but the ratio satisfaction/calories (guilt?) is quite an accomplishment.

This is not the same as the regular Swiss Miss, but I find it an acceptable option for diabetics.  I have this on subscription.  It's nice to be able to have a mug (use two pkg) when I make cocoa for my grandkids.  You can add a little splenda to sweeten, but I have gotten used to the less sweet flavor.  Cocoa does settle at the bottom a little, but a stir midway though would do the trick.  Although not low fat, to richen it I have added a tablespoon of half and half.  It's good added to coffee to make a mocha drink.  I rate this 5 stars as I have tried to make my own diabetic mix formula and this is so much simpler.  Not perfect, but perfect for me.

I wouldn't have minded this as much had I not tried another brand of diet cocoa mixes. I bought a generic store brand (krogers) which had a richer chocolate taste and didn't clump up as much. I rather drink that instead of this...

column9: It is OK for a diet product, but...
column10: PROS:1) One serving has only 25 calories (zero points if you are on Weight Watchers).2) Sweet enough to kill your sweet tooth for a long while.3) Tastes better then other "diet" hot chocolate powders I have tried.CONS:1) Even with the little amount of water (6 oz.), it tastes watery...Much better with fat free milk, but then has more calories... To fill a full mug (typically 10 oz), you must use two packets.2) The chemicals in it make my tummy feel odd. I cannot drink more then 6 oz...FINAL VERDICT:I keep it on hand, for when the sweet tooth strikes, particularly in the evenings (easy to get away with due to the low calorie count). Still, if you are looking to fill a "sweet" void in your low calorie diet, this may be a good choice for you as it does taste better then its super market alternatives... I guess you have to pick your battles... ;o)

column9: Diabetic type 2 - love, love, love this product!

It was not excessively oily and easily fed through my machine.I was hooked.  So I subscribed to a 2-pack of 12.3-ounce cans.  They were horrible.  The beans were sour smelling and tasting. The expiry on the cans was April 16, 2013.  (Unrelated, one of the cans also had a fine animal hair between the lid and the seal, but this could have slipped in anywhere, including at the Amazon warehouse.)This may be just a batch problem - bad beans - however I will not purchase this product again.What a disappointment.

Coffee like any other food will spoil when not consumed fresh and this is case with this coffee. You are buying coffee that was roasted 6-12 months earlier and all oils in it, and this is roasted to such degree that oils are plentiful, simply went rancid long time ago. And when you smell it you can really notice this. Coffee should be consumed up to 4 weeks after it has been roasted, not bag opened, not the date coffee expires, but the day it was roasted.I got cheated every time I try these stale blends hoping to discovered that somehow magically they stopped staling process but alas, it is fools errand.If you live in USA you are lucky because I think that we have the best coffees in the world available to us today. And there are plenty of roasters that will ship you the coffee the same day they roast it: Klatch Coffee, Terroir Coffee, Red Bird Coffee, Counter Culture Coffee and tons of others. Please give fresh product a try instead of this old, stale composting material.
